title: Learning to Accelerate Vision-Language-Action Models through Adaptive Visual Token Caching
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated remarkable generalization capabilities in robotic manipulation tasks, yet their substantial computational overhead remains a critical obstacle to real-world deployment. Improving inference efficiency is therefore essential for practical robotic applications. Existing acceleration methods often rely on heuristic or static strategies--such as rule-based token caching or pruning--that are decoupled from task objectives and fail to adapt to dynamic scene changes. In this work, we reformulate inference acceleration as a learnable policy optimization problem and propose a novel framework that integrates a dynamic, task-aware decision-making process directly into the VLA model. At its core are two lightweight, cooperative modules: a Cached Token Selector, which determines which tokens should be reused, and a Cache Ratio Predictor, which controls how many tokens to reuse. Training these modules is non-trivial due to their discrete decisions. We address this by adopting a differentiable relaxation that allows gradient-based end-to-end optimization. Extensive experiments on the LIBERO and SIMPLER benchmarks, as well as real-robot evaluations, show that our method achieves a 1.76x wall-clock inference speedup while simultaneously improving the average success rate by 1.9 percentage points (from 75.0% to 76.9%) on LIBERO and by 5.0 percentage points on real-world tasks, significantly outperforming existing baselines. This work highlights the potential of learning task-aware computational allocation policies, paving the way for VLA models that are both powerful and efficient.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务中展现出了卓越的泛化能力，但其巨大的计算开销仍然是实际部署的关键障碍。提高推理效率对于实际机器人应用至关重要。现有的加速方法通常依赖于启发式或静态策略——例如基于规则的令牌缓存或剪枝——这些策略与任务目标脱钩，并且无法适应动态场景变化。在这项工作中，我们将推理加速重新表述为可学习的策略优化问题，并提出了一种新的框架，该框架将动态的、任务感知的决策过程直接集成到 VLA 模型中。其核心是两个轻量级的、协同工作的模块：缓存令牌选择器，用于确定哪些令牌应该被重用；缓存比例预测器，用于控制重用多少令牌。由于它们的离散决策，训练这些模块并非易事。我们通过采用可微分松弛来解决这个问题，从而实现基于梯度的端到端优化。在 LIBERO 和 SIMPLER 基准测试以及真实机器人评估上的大量实验表明，我们的方法实现了 1.76 倍的实际推理加速，同时在 LIBERO 上将平均成功率提高了 1.9 个百分点（从 75.0% 提高到 76.9%），在真实世界任务中提高了 5.0 个百分点，显著优于现有的基线方法。这项工作突出了学习任务感知的计算分配策略的潜力，为功能强大且高效的 VLA 模型铺平了道路。
tldr: The paper introduces a learnable, task-aware token caching mechanism for Vision-Language-Action models that improves inference speed and task success rates, achieving a 1.76x speedup and improved success rates on robotic manipulation benchmarks and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种可学习的、任务感知的视觉-语言-动作模型令牌缓存机制，提高了推理速度和任务成功率，实现1.76倍的加速，并在机器人操作基准测试和现实任务中提高了成功率。

title: ConLA: Contrastive Latent Action Learning from Human Videos for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve preliminary generalization through pretraining on large scale robot teleoperation datasets. However, acquiring datasets that comprehensively cover diverse tasks and environments is extremely costly and difficult to scale. In contrast, human demonstration videos offer a rich and scalable source of diverse scenes and manipulation behaviors, yet their lack of explicit action supervision hinders direct utilization. Prior work leverages VQ-VAE based frameworks to learn latent actions from human videos in an unsupervised manner. Nevertheless, since the training objective primarily focuses on reconstructing visual appearances rather than capturing inter-frame dynamics, the learned representations tend to rely on spurious visual cues, leading to shortcut learning and entangled latent representations that hinder transferability. To address this, we propose ConLA, an unsupervised pretraining framework for learning robotic policies from human videos. ConLA introduces a contrastive disentanglement mechanism that leverages action category priors and temporal cues to isolate motion dynamics from visual content, effectively mitigating shortcut learning. Extensive experiments show that ConLA achieves strong performance across diverse benchmarks. Notably, by pretraining solely on human videos, our method for the first time surpasses the performance obtained with real robot trajectory pretraining, highlighting its ability to extract pure and semantically consistent latent action representations for scalable robot learning.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过在大规模机器人遥操作数据集上进行预训练，初步实现了泛化。然而，获取全面覆盖各种任务和环境的数据集极其昂贵且难以扩展。相比之下，人类演示视频提供了丰富且可扩展的场景和操作行为来源，但由于缺乏明确的动作监督，直接利用受到了阻碍。先前的工作利用基于VQ-VAE的框架，以无监督的方式从人类视频中学习潜在动作。然而，由于训练目标主要侧重于重建视觉外观，而非捕获帧间动态，因此学习到的表征往往依赖于虚假的视觉线索，导致捷径学习和纠缠的潜在表征，阻碍了迁移性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了ConLA，一个用于从人类视频中学习机器人策略的无监督预训练框架。ConLA引入了一种对比解耦机制，该机制利用动作类别先验和时间线索将运动动态从视觉内容中分离出来，有效地缓解了捷径学习。大量的实验表明，ConLA在各种基准测试中都取得了优异的性能。值得注意的是，通过仅在人类视频上进行预训练，我们的方法首次超越了通过真实机器人轨迹预训练获得的性能，突显了其提取纯粹且语义一致的潜在动作表征的能力，从而实现了可扩展的机器人学习。
tldr: The paper introduces ConLA, a contrastive learning framework for pretraining robotic policies from human videos by disentangling motion dynamics from visual content using action category priors and temporal cues to mitigate shortcut learning and improve transferability. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on robotics benchmarks, even surpassing methods pretrained with real robot trajectories.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为ConLA的对比学习框架，用于通过人类视频预训练机器人策略。该框架利用动作类别先验和时间线索，将运动动态与视觉内容分离，从而减少了捷径学习并提高了可迁移性。在机器人基准测试中，该方法取得了最先进的性能，甚至超越了使用真实机器人轨迹进行预训练的方法。

title: Inject Once Survive Later: Backdooring Vision-Language-Action Models to Persist Through Downstream Fine-tuning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become foundational to modern embodied AI systems. By integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action planning, they enable general-purpose task execution across diverse environments. Despite their importance, the security of VLA models remains underexplored -- particularly in the context of backdoor attacks, which pose realistic threats in physical-world deployments. While recent methods attempt to inject backdoors into VLA models, these backdoors are easily erased during downstream adaptation, as user-side fine-tuning with clean data significantly alters model parameters, rendering them impractical for real-world applications. To address these challenges, we propose INFUSE (INjection into Fine-tUne-inSensitive modulEs), the first backdoor attack framework for VLA base models that remains effective even with arbitrary user fine-tuning. INFUSE begins by analyzing parameter sensitivity across diverse fine-tuning scenarios to identify modules that remain largely unchanged -- the fine-tune-insensitive modules. It then injects backdoors into these stable modules while freezing the rest, ensuring malicious behavior persists after extensive user fine-tuning. Comprehensive experiments across multiple VLA architectures demonstrate INFUSE's effectiveness. After user-side fine-tuning, INFUSE maintains mean attack success rates of 91.0% on simulation environments and 79.8% on real-world robot tasks, substantially surpassing BadVLA (38.8% and 36.6%, respectively), while preserving clean-task performance comparable to standard models. These results uncover a critical threat: backdoors implanted before distribution can persist through fine-tuning and remain effective at deployment.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为现代具身人工智能系统的基础。通过整合视觉感知、语言理解和动作规划，它们能够在各种环境中执行通用任务。尽管它们的重要性不言而喻，但VLA模型的安全性仍未被充分探索，尤其是在后门攻击的背景下，这种攻击在物理世界部署中构成了现实威胁。虽然最近的一些方法尝试将后门注入VLA模型，但这些后门在下游自适应期间很容易被清除，因为用户端使用干净数据进行的微调会显著改变模型参数，使其在实际应用中变得不切实际。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了INFUSE（注入到微调不敏感模块中），这是首个针对VLA基础模型的后门攻击框架，即使经过任意用户微调也能保持有效性。INFUSE首先分析不同微调场景下的参数敏感性，以识别基本保持不变的模块——微调不敏感模块。然后，它将后门注入到这些稳定模块中，同时冻结其余模块，确保恶意行为在广泛的用户微调后仍然存在。在多种VLA架构上的全面实验证明了INFUSE的有效性。经过用户端微调后，INFUSE在模拟环境中保持了91.0%的平均攻击成功率，在真实机器人任务中保持了79.8%的平均攻击成功率，显著超过了BadVLA（分别为38.8%和36.6%），同时保持了与标准模型相当的干净任务性能。这些结果揭示了一种关键威胁：在分发之前植入的后门可以持续存在于微调中，并在部署时保持有效。
tldr: This paper introduces INFUSE, a backdoor attack framework for Vision-Language-Action models that persists through downstream fine-tuning by injecting backdoors into fine-tune-insensitive modules, demonstrating high attack success rates even after user adaptation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了INFUSE，一个针对视觉-语言-动作模型的后门攻击框架，通过将后门注入到对微调不敏感的模块中，即使在用户适配后也能保持高攻击成功率，从而在下游微调中持续存在。

title: ZEST: Zero-shot Embodied Skill Transfer for Athletic Robot Control
summary: Achieving robust, human-like whole-body control on humanoid robots for agile, contact-rich behaviors remains a central challenge, demanding heavy per-skill engineering and a brittle process of tuning controllers. We introduce ZEST (Zero-shot Embodied Skill Transfer), a streamlined motion-imitation framework that trains policies via reinforcement learning from diverse sources -- high-fidelity motion capture, noisy monocular video, and non-physics-constrained animation -- and deploys them to hardware zero-shot. ZEST generalizes across behaviors and platforms while avoiding contact labels, reference or observation windows, state estimators, and extensive reward shaping. Its training pipeline combines adaptive sampling, which focuses training on difficult motion segments, and an automatic curriculum using a model-based assistive wrench, together enabling dynamic, long-horizon maneuvers. We further provide a procedure for selecting joint-level gains from approximate analytical armature values for closed-chain actuators, along with a refined model of actuators. Trained entirely in simulation with moderate domain randomization, ZEST demonstrates remarkable generality. On Boston Dynamics' Atlas humanoid, ZEST learns dynamic, multi-contact skills (e.g., army crawl, breakdancing) from motion capture. It transfers expressive dance and scene-interaction skills, such as box-climbing, directly from videos to Atlas and the Unitree G1. Furthermore, it extends across morphologies to the Spot quadruped, enabling acrobatics, such as a continuous backflip, through animation. Together, these results demonstrate robust zero-shot deployment across heterogeneous data sources and embodiments, establishing ZEST as a scalable interface between biological movements and their robotic counterparts.
summary_zh: 实现类人机器人在敏捷、富接触行为中稳健地进行类人全身控制，仍然是一个核心挑战，需要大量的单项技能工程设计和脆弱的控制器调优过程。我们提出了ZEST（零样本具身技能迁移），一种简化的运动模仿框架，通过强化学习从多样化来源（高保真运动捕捉、嘈杂的单目视频和非物理约束动画）训练策略，并将其零样本部署到硬件上。ZEST能够推广到各种行为和平台，同时避免使用接触标签、参考或观察窗口、状态估计器和大量的奖励塑造。其训练流程结合了自适应采样（专注于训练困难的运动片段）和使用基于模型的辅助扳手的自动课程，共同实现了动态、长时程的动作。我们还提供了一种程序，用于从闭链执行机构的近似解析电枢值中选择关节级增益，以及一种改进的执行机构模型。ZEST完全在具有适度领域随机化的模拟环境中训练，展现出卓越的泛化性。在Boston Dynamics的Atlas类人机器人上，ZEST从运动捕捉中学习动态、多接触技能（例如，匍匐前进、霹雳舞）。它可以将富有表现力的舞蹈和场景互动技能（如攀爬箱子）直接从视频迁移到Atlas和宇树G1机器人。此外，它将技能扩展到Spot四足机器人，通过动画实现了杂技动作，例如连续后空翻。总而言之，这些结果展示了跨异构数据源和具身的稳健零样本部署，确立了ZEST作为一个生物运动与其机器人对应物之间的可扩展接口。
tldr: The paper introduces ZEST, a zero-shot embodied skill transfer framework that enables robots to learn complex behaviors from diverse data sources (motion capture, videos, animation) and deploy them on hardware without retraining, demonstrating impressive generalization across robots and skills.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ZEST，一个零样本具身技能迁移框架，使机器人能够从各种数据源（动作捕捉、视频、动画）学习复杂的行为，并在硬件上部署它们而无需重新训练，展示了在机器人和技能方面的出色泛化能力。

title: World Models as an Intermediary between Agents and the Real World
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents trained using reinforcement learning has achieved superhuman performance in low-cost environments like games, mathematics, and coding. However, these successes have not translated to complex domains where the cost of interaction is high, such as the physical cost of running robots, the time cost of ML engineering, and the resource cost of scientific experiments. The true bottleneck for achieving the next level of agent performance for these complex and high-cost domains lies in the expense of executing actions to acquire reward signals. To address this gap, this paper argues that we should use world models as an intermediary between agents and the real world. We discuss how world models, viewed as models of dynamics, rewards, and task distributions, can overcome fundamental barriers of high-cost actions such as extreme off-policy learning and sample inefficiency in long-horizon tasks. Moreover, we demonstrate how world models can provide critical and rich learning signals to agents across a broad set of domains, including machine learning engineering, computer use, robotics, and AI for science. Lastly, we identify the challenges of building these world models and propose actionable items along dataset curation, architecture design, scaling, and evaluation of world models.
summary_zh: 使用强化学习训练的大语言模型（LLM）智能体在低成本环境中，如游戏、数学和编程领域，已经取得了超越人类的表现。然而，这些成功并没有转化为复杂领域中的应用，这些领域的交互成本很高，例如运行机器人的物理成本、机器学习工程的时间成本以及科学实验的资源成本。在这些复杂且高成本领域中，要实现智能体性能的下一级飞跃，真正的瓶颈在于执行动作以获取奖励信号的代价。为了弥补这一差距，本文认为我们应该使用世界模型作为智能体和现实世界之间的中介。我们讨论了世界模型，将其视为动力学、奖励和任务分布的模型，如何克服高成本动作的基本障碍，例如极端的离策略学习和长时程任务中的样本效率低下。此外，我们展示了世界模型如何为包括机器学习工程、计算机使用、机器人技术和人工智能 for 科学在内的广泛领域中的智能体提供关键且丰富的学习信号。最后，我们指出了构建这些世界模型所面临的挑战，并提出了在数据集管理、架构设计、扩展和世界模型评估方面可操作的项目。
tldr: This paper advocates for the use of world models as an intermediary between LLM agents and real-world environments to address the challenges of high-cost interactions in domains like robotics and scientific experiments, focusing on overcoming sample inefficiency and enabling effective learning signals.
tldr_zh: 本文提出将世界模型作为LLM智能体与现实环境之间的中介，以解决机器人和科学实验等领域中高成本交互的挑战，重点在于克服样本效率低下并实现有效的学习信号。

title: Physics-informed Diffusion Mamba Transformer for Real-world Driving
summary: Autonomous driving systems demand trajectory planners that not only model the inherent uncertainty of future motions but also respect complex temporal dependencies and underlying physical laws. While diffusion-based generative models excel at capturing multi-modal distributions, they often fail to incorporate long-term sequential contexts and domain-specific physical priors. In this work, we bridge these gaps with two key innovations. First, we introduce a Diffusion Mamba Transformer architecture that embeds mamba and attention into the diffusion process, enabling more effective aggregation of sequential input contexts from sensor streams and past motion histories. Second, we design a Port-Hamiltonian Neural Network module that seamlessly integrates energy-based physical constraints into the diffusion model, thereby enhancing trajectory predictions with both consistency and interpretability. Extensive evaluations on standard autonomous driving benchmarks demonstrate that our unified framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in predictive accuracy, physical plausibility, and robustness, thereby advancing safe and reliable motion planning.
summary_zh: 自主驾驶系统需要轨迹规划器，不仅可以建模未来运动的内在不确定性，而且要尊重复杂的时间依赖关系和底层物理定律。虽然基于扩散的生成模型擅长捕捉多峰分布，但它们通常无法纳入长期序列上下文和特定领域的物理先验知识。在这项工作中，我们通过两个关键创新弥合了这些差距。首先，我们引入了一种扩散Mamba Transformer架构，该架构将Mamba和注意力机制嵌入扩散过程，从而更有效地聚合来自传感器流和过去运动历史的序列输入上下文。其次，我们设计了一个Port-Hamiltonian神经网络模块，该模块将基于能量的物理约束无缝集成到扩散模型中，从而增强了轨迹预测的一致性和可解释性。在标准自主驾驶基准测试上的广泛评估表明，我们的统一框架在预测精度、物理合理性和鲁棒性方面显著优于最先进的基线，从而推进了安全可靠的运动规划。
tldr: This paper introduces a Diffusion Mamba Transformer with a Port-Hamiltonian Neural Network to improve trajectory prediction for autonomous driving by incorporating temporal dependencies, physical laws, and uncertainty modeling.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种融合Port-Hamiltonian神经网络的Diffusion Mamba Transformer，旨在通过结合时间依赖性、物理定律和不确定性建模，来改进自动驾驶的轨迹预测。

title: Any3D-VLA: Enhancing VLA Robustness via Diverse Point Clouds
summary: Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically take 2D images as visual input, which limits their spatial understanding in complex scenes. How can we incorporate 3D information to enhance VLA capabilities? We conduct a pilot study across different observation spaces and visual representations. The results show that explicitly lifting visual input into point clouds yields representations that better complement their corresponding 2D representations. To address the challenges of (1) scarce 3D data and (2) the domain gap induced by cross-environment differences and depth-scale biases, we propose Any3D-VLA. It unifies the simulator, sensor, and model-estimated point clouds within a training pipeline, constructs diverse inputs, and learns domain-agnostic 3D representations that are fused with the corresponding 2D representations. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate Any3D-VLA's advantages in improving performance and mitigating the domain gap. Our project homepage is available at https://xianzhefan.github.io/Any3D-VLA.github.io.
summary_zh: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常以2D图像作为视觉输入，这限制了它们在复杂场景中的空间理解能力。我们如何结合3D信息来增强VLA能力？我们针对不同的观察空间和视觉表征进行了一项初步研究。结果表明，将视觉输入显式地提升到点云形式，能够产生更好地补充相应2D表征的表示。为了应对（1）3D数据稀缺和（2）跨环境差异及深度尺度偏差所导致的领域差距这两个挑战，我们提出了Any3D-VLA。它将模拟器、传感器和模型估计的点云在训练管道中统一起来，构建多样化的输入，并学习与领域无关的3D表征，这些表征与相应的2D表征融合。仿真和真实世界实验表明，Any3D-VLA在提高性能和缓解领域差距方面具有优势。我们的项目主页位于https://xianzhefan.github.io/Any3D-VLA.github.io。
tldr: The paper introduces Any3D-VLA, a method to enhance Vision-Language-Action models by incorporating diverse point clouds to improve spatial understanding and mitigate the domain gap in 3D data, demonstrated through simulations and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Any3D-VLA，一种通过整合多样化的点云来增强视觉-语言-动作模型的方法，它能够提升空间理解能力，缓解3D数据中的领域差异，并通过模拟和真实世界实验进行了验证。

title: SA-VLA: Spatially-Aware Flow-Matching for Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exhibit strong generalization in robotic manipulation, yet reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning often degrades robustness under spatial distribution shifts. For flow-matching VLA policies, this degradation is closely associated with the erosion of spatial inductive bias during RL adaptation, as sparse rewards and spatially agnostic exploration increasingly favor short-horizon visual cues. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{SA-VLA}, a spatially-aware RL adaptation framework that preserves spatial grounding during policy optimization by aligning representation learning, reward design, and exploration with task geometry. SA-VLA fuses implicit spatial representations with visual tokens, provides dense rewards that reflect geometric progress, and employs \textbf{SCAN}, a spatially-conditioned annealed exploration strategy tailored to flow-matching dynamics. Across challenging multi-object and cluttered manipulation benchmarks, SA-VLA enables stable RL fine-tuning and improves zero-shot spatial generalization, yielding more robust and transferable behaviors. Code and project page are available at https://xupan.top/Projects/savla.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型在机器人操作中展现出强大的泛化能力，然而，强化学习 (RL) 微调常常会降低其在空间分布偏移下的鲁棒性。对于流匹配 VLA策略而言，这种退化与 RL 自适应过程中空间归纳偏置的侵蚀密切相关，因为稀疏奖励和空间不可知的探索越来越倾向于短视程的视觉提示。为解决这个问题，我们提出了 \textbf{SA-VLA}，一个空间感知 RL 自适应框架，通过将表征学习、奖励设计和探索与任务几何结构对齐，从而在策略优化期间保持空间基础。SA-VLA 将隐式空间表征与视觉标记融合，提供反映几何进展的密集奖励，并采用 \textbf{SCAN}，一种专为流匹配动力学定制的空间条件退火探索策略。在具有挑战性的多物体和杂乱操作基准测试中，SA-VLA 能够实现稳定的 RL 微调并提高零样本空间泛化能力，从而产生更稳健且可迁移的行为。 代码和项目主页可在 https://xupan.top/Projects/savla 获取。
tldr: The paper proposes SA-VLA, a spatially-aware RL adaptation framework for VLA models that addresses robustness degradation under spatial distribution shifts by preserving spatial grounding during policy optimization. It achieves this through spatial representation fusion, geometric progress-based rewards, and spatially-conditioned exploration.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了SA-VLA，一个空间感知RL适应框架，用于VLA模型，通过在策略优化过程中保持空间定位来解决空间分布偏移下的鲁棒性下降问题。它通过空间表征融合、基于几何进展的奖励和空间条件探索来实现这一目标。

title: USS-Nav: Unified Spatio-Semantic Scene Graph for Lightweight UAV Zero-Shot Object Navigation
summary: Zero-Shot Object Navigation in unknown environments poses significant challenges for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) due to the conflict between high-level semantic reasoning requirements and limited onboard computational resources. To address this, we present USS-Nav, a lightweight framework that incrementally constructs a Unified Spatio-Semantic scene graph and enables efficient Large Language Model (LLM)-augmented Zero-Shot Object Navigation in unknown environments. Specifically, we introduce an incremental Spatial Connectivity Graph generation method utilizing polyhedral expansion to capture global geometric topology, which is dynamically partitioned into semantic regions via graph clustering. Concurrently, open-vocabulary object semantics are instantiated and anchored to this topology to form a hierarchical environmental representation. Leveraging this hierarchical structure, we present a coarse-to-fine exploration strategy: LLM grounded in the scene graph's semantics to determine global target regions, while a local planner optimizes frontier coverage based on information gain. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of computational efficiency and real-time update frequency (15 Hz) on a resource-constrained platform. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of our framework, showing substantial improvements in Success weighted by Path Length (SPL). The source code will be made publicly available to foster further research.
summary_zh: 在未知环境中进行零样本目标导航对无人机（UAV）提出了重大挑战，其根源在于高层语义推理需求与有限的机载计算资源之间的冲突。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种轻量级框架 USS-Nav，它可以增量式地构建统一的时空语义场景图，并在未知环境中实现高效的、由大型语言模型（LLM）增强的零样本目标导航。具体来说，我们引入了一种增量式空间连通图生成方法，利用多面体扩展来捕获全局几何拓扑，并通过图聚类将其动态地划分为语义区域。同时，开放词汇表的目标语义被实例化并锚定到该拓扑结构，从而形成一个分层的环境表示。利用这种分层结构，我们提出了一种由粗到精的探索策略：LLM 以场景图的语义为基础来确定全局目标区域，而局部规划器则基于信息增益优化边界覆盖。实验结果表明，在资源受限的平台上，我们的框架在计算效率和实时更新频率（15 Hz）方面优于最先进的方法。此外，消融研究证实了我们框架的有效性，表明在路径长度加权成功率（SPL）方面有显著提高。源代码将公开提供，以促进进一步的研究。
tldr: The paper introduces USS-Nav, a lightweight framework using a unified spatio-semantic scene graph and LLMs for efficient zero-shot object navigation of UAVs in unknown environments, demonstrating superior computational efficiency and performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了USS-Nav，一个轻量级的框架，它使用统一的空间语义场景图和LLM，用于无人机在未知环境中进行有效的零样本目标导航。实验表明，与现有方法相比，该框架具有优越的计算效率和性能。

title: Toward Reliable Sim-to-Real Predictability for MoE-based Robust Quadrupedal Locomotion
summary: Reinforcement learning has shown strong promise for quadrupedal agile locomotion, even with proprioception-only sensing. In practice, however, sim-to-real gap and reward overfitting in complex terrains can produce policies that fail to transfer, while physical validation remains risky and inefficient. To address these challenges, we introduce a unified framework encompassing a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) locomotion policy for robust multi-terrain representation with RoboGauge, a predictive assessment suite that quantifies sim-to-real transferability. The MoE policy employs a gated set of specialist experts to decompose latent terrain and command modeling, achieving superior deployment robustness and generalization via proprioception alone. RoboGauge further provides multi-dimensional proprioception-based metrics via sim-to-sim tests over terrains, difficulty levels, and domain randomizations, enabling reliable MoE policy selection without extensive physical trials. Experiments on a Unitree Go2 demonstrate robust locomotion on unseen challenging terrains, including snow, sand, stairs, slopes, and 30 cm obstacles. In dedicated high-speed tests, the robot reaches 4 m/s and exhibits an emergent narrow-width gait associated with improved stability at high velocity.
summary_zh: 强化学习在四足敏捷步态运动方面展现出强大的潜力，即使仅依赖本体感受感知。然而，在实践中，仿真到现实的差距以及复杂地形下的奖励过拟合可能导致无法迁移的策略，而物理验证仍然具有风险且效率低下。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了一个统一的框架，包括一个用于鲁棒的多地形表示的混合专家（MoE）步态运动策略，以及RoboGauge，一个量化仿真到现实可迁移性的预测评估套件。MoE策略采用门控的专家集合来分解潜在的地形和指令建模，仅通过本体感受实现卓越的部署鲁棒性和泛化能力。RoboGauge进一步通过基于本体感受的度量，在地形、难度级别和域随机化下的仿真到仿真测试，提供多维度的评估信息，从而无需大量的物理试验即可实现可靠的MoE策略选择。在宇树Go2上的实验表明，在包括雪地、沙地、楼梯、斜坡和30厘米障碍物在内的未见过的具有挑战性的地形上，实现了鲁棒的步态运动。在专门的高速测试中，机器人达到了4米/秒的速度，并表现出与提高高速稳定性相关的涌现的窄幅步态。
tldr: This paper presents a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) based reinforcement learning framework with a predictive assessment suite (RoboGauge) to improve sim-to-real transfer for robust quadrupedal locomotion across diverse terrains, validated on a Unitree Go2 robot.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个基于混合专家（MoE）的强化学习框架，并配备一个预测评估套件（RoboGauge），旨在提高四足机器人跨多种地形的稳健运动的 sim-to-real 迁移，并在 Unitree Go2 机器人上进行了验证。

title: Agentic Reward Modeling: Verifying GUI Agent via Online Proactive Interaction
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is pivotal for the continuous evolution of GUI agents, yet existing evaluation paradigms face significant limitations. Rule-based methods suffer from poor scalability and cannot handle open-ended tasks, while LLM-as-a-Judge approaches rely on passive visual observation, often failing to capture latent system states due to partial state observability. To address these challenges, we advocate for a paradigm shift from passive evaluation to Agentic Interactive Verification. We introduce VAGEN, a framework that employs a verifier agent equipped with interaction tools to autonomously plan verification strategies and proactively probe the environment for evidence of task completion. Leveraging the insight that GUI tasks are typically "easy to verify but hard to solve", VAGEN overcomes the bottlenecks of visual limitations. Experimental results on OSWorld-Verified and AndroidWorld benchmarks demonstrate that VAGEN significantly improves evaluation accuracy compared to LLM-as-a-Judge baselines and further enhances performance through test-time scaling strategies.
summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习 (RLVR) 对于 GUI 智能体的持续演进至关重要，但现有的评估范式面临重大局限性。基于规则的方法可扩展性差，无法处理开放式任务，而 LLM-as-a-Judge 方法依赖于被动视觉观察，由于部分状态可观测性，往往无法捕获潜在的系统状态。为了应对这些挑战，我们提倡从被动评估到智能体式交互验证的范式转变。我们引入了 VAGEN，一个采用配备交互工具的验证智能体的框架，其能够自主规划验证策略，并主动探测环境以寻找任务完成的证据。利用 GUI 任务通常“易于验证但难以解决”的洞察，VAGEN 克服了视觉局限性的瓶颈。在 OSWorld-Verified 和 AndroidWorld 基准测试上的实验结果表明，与 LLM-as-a-Judge 基线相比，VAGEN 显著提高了评估准确性，并通过测试时缩放策略进一步提高了性能。
tldr: The paper proposes VAGEN, a framework using an agentic verifier to actively probe GUI environments and improve the accuracy of reward modeling for GUI agents compared to passive observation methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了VAGEN，一个使用代理验证器主动探测GUI环境的框架，相比于被动观察方法，提高了GUI代理的奖励建模的准确性。

title: UniMotion: A Unified Motion Framework for Simulation, Prediction and Planning
summary: Motion simulation, prediction and planning are foundational tasks in autonomous driving, each essential for modeling and reasoning about dynamic traffic scenarios. While often addressed in isolation due to their differing objectives, such as generating diverse motion states or estimating optimal trajectories, these tasks inherently depend on shared capabilities: understanding multi-agent interactions, modeling motion behaviors, and reasoning over temporal and spatial dynamics. Despite this underlying commonality, existing approaches typically adopt specialized model designs, which hinders cross-task generalization and system scalability. More critically, this separation overlooks the potential mutual benefits among tasks. Motivated by these observations, we propose UniMotion, a unified motion framework that captures shared structures across motion tasks while accommodating their individual requirements. Built on a decoder-only Transformer architecture, UniMotion employs dedicated interaction modes and tailored training strategies to simultaneously support these motion tasks. This unified design not only enables joint optimization and representation sharing but also allows for targeted fine-tuning to specialize in individual tasks when needed. Extensive experiments on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset demonstrate that joint training leads to robust generalization and effective task integration. With further fine-tuning, UniMotion achieves state-of-the-art performance across a range of motion tasks, establishing it as a versatile and scalable solution for autonomous driving.
summary_zh: 运动仿真、预测和规划是自动驾驶中的基础任务，每项任务对于建模和推理动态交通场景至关重要。尽管由于其不同的目标，例如生成多样的运动状态或估计最优轨迹，这些任务常常被独立处理，但它们本质上依赖于共享的能力：理解多智能体交互、建模运动行为，以及推理时间和空间动态性。尽管存在这种潜在的共性，但现有方法通常采用专门的模型设计，这阻碍了跨任务泛化和系统可扩展性。更关键的是，这种分离忽略了任务之间潜在的互惠互利。基于这些观察，我们提出了UniMotion，一个统一的运动框架，它捕捉跨运动任务的共享结构，同时满足它们的个体需求。UniMotion构建在仅解码器Transformer架构之上，采用专用的交互模式和定制的训练策略来同时支持这些运动任务。这种统一的设计不仅实现了联合优化和表示共享，而且可以在需要时进行有针对性的微调，以专门从事各个任务。在Waymo开放运动数据集上进行的大量实验表明，联合训练能够实现稳健的泛化和有效的任务集成。通过进一步的微调，UniMotion在一系列运动任务上实现了最先进的性能，将其确立为自动驾驶领域一种通用且可扩展的解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces UniMotion, a unified Transformer-based framework for motion simulation, prediction, and planning in autonomous driving, achieving state-of-the-art performance through joint training and task-specific fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了UniMotion，一个统一的基于Transformer的框架，用于自动驾驶中的运动模拟、预测和规划。通过联合训练和针对特定任务的微调，实现了最先进的性能。

title: APEX: A Decoupled Memory-based Explorer for Asynchronous Aerial Object Goal Navigation
summary: Aerial Object Goal Navigation, a challenging frontier in Embodied AI, requires an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) agent to autonomously explore, reason, and identify a specific target using only visual perception and language description. However, existing methods struggle with the memorization of complex spatial representations in aerial environments, reliable and interpretable action decision-making, and inefficient exploration and information gathering. To address these challenges, we introduce \textbf{APEX} (Aerial Parallel Explorer), a novel hierarchical agent designed for efficient exploration and target acquisition in complex aerial settings. APEX is built upon a modular, three-part architecture: 1) Dynamic Spatio-Semantic Mapping Memory, which leverages the zero-shot capability of a Vision-Language Model (VLM) to dynamically construct high-resolution 3D Attraction, Exploration, and Obstacle maps, serving as an interpretable memory mechanism. 2) Action Decision Module, trained with reinforcement learning, which translates this rich spatial understanding into a fine-grained and robust control policy. 3) Target Grounding Module, which employs an open-vocabulary detector to achieve definitive and generalizable target identification. All these components are integrated into a hierarchical, asynchronous, and parallel framework, effectively bypassing the VLM's inference latency and boosting the agent's proactivity in exploration. Extensive experiments show that APEX outperforms the previous state of the art by +4.2\% SR and +2.8\% SPL on challenging UAV-ON benchmarks, demonstrating its superior efficiency and the effectiveness of its hierarchical asynchronous design. Our source code is provided in \href{https://github.com/4amGodvzx/apex}{GitHub}
summary_zh: 空中目标导引是一项具身智能领域的前沿挑战，它要求无人机(UAV)智能体仅使用视觉感知和语言描述，自主地探索、推理和识别特定的目标。然而，现有方法难以记忆空中环境中复杂的空间表示，难以做出可靠且可解释的行动决策，并且存在探索和信息收集效率低下的问题。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了\textbf{APEX} (空中并行探索者)，一种专为在复杂空中环境中进行高效探索和目标获取而设计的新颖分层智能体。APEX建立在一个模块化的三部分架构之上：1) 动态时空语义映射存储器，利用视觉-语言模型(VLM)的零样本能力，动态构建高分辨率的3D吸引力、探索和障碍物地图，作为一种可解释的记忆机制。2) 行动决策模块，通过强化学习训练，将这种丰富的空间理解转化为精细化和鲁棒的控制策略。3) 目标定位模块，采用开放词汇检测器来实现明确且可泛化的目标识别。所有这些组件被集成到一个分层、异步和并行的框架中，有效地绕过了VLM的推理延迟，并提高了智能体探索的主动性。大量的实验表明，APEX在具有挑战性的UAV-ON基准测试中，超越了先前最先进的方法，SR提高了+4.2%，SPL提高了+2.8%，证明了其卓越的效率和分层异步设计的有效性。我们的源代码已在\href{https://github.com/4amGodvzx/apex}{GitHub}上提供。
tldr: APEX is a novel hierarchical agent for aerial object goal navigation that uses a dynamic spatio-semantic mapping memory (VLM-based), reinforcement learning for action decisions, and an open-vocabulary detector for target grounding within an asynchronous parallel framework, achieving state-of-the-art performance on UAV-ON benchmarks.
tldr_zh: APEX是一种新颖的用于空中目标导航的分层代理，它使用基于VLM的动态空间语义映射记忆、强化学习进行动作决策，以及开放词汇检测器进行目标定位，并在异步并行框架内运行，在UAV-ON基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

title: A Low-Cost Vision-Based Tactile Gripper with Pretraining Learning for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation in contact-rich environments remains challenging, particularly when relying on conventional tactile sensors that suffer from limited sensing range, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. In this work, we present LVTG, a low-cost visuo-tactile gripper designed for stable, robust, and efficient physical interaction. Unlike existing visuo-tactile sensors, LVTG enables more effective and stable grasping of larger and heavier everyday objects, thanks to its enhanced tactile sensing area and greater opening angle. Its surface skin is made of highly wear-resistant material, significantly improving durability and extending operational lifespan. The integration of vision and tactile feedback allows LVTG to provide rich, high-fidelity sensory data, facilitating reliable perception during complex manipulation tasks. Furthermore, LVTG features a modular design that supports rapid maintenance and replacement. To effectively fuse vision and touch, We adopt a CLIP-inspired contrastive learning objective to align tactile embeddings with their corresponding visual observations, enabling a shared cross-modal representation space for visuo-tactile perception. This alignment improves the performance of an Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) policy in contact-rich manipulation, leading to more efficient data collection and more effective policy learning. Compared to the original ACT method, the proposed LVTG with pretraining achieves significantly higher success rates in manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 在富接触环境下进行机器人操作仍然面临挑战，特别是当依赖于传统触觉传感器时，这些传感器存在感测范围有限、可靠性差以及成本效益低等问题。 本文提出了一种低成本视觉触觉抓取器LVTG，旨在实现稳定、鲁棒和高效的物理交互。 与现有的视觉触觉传感器不同，LVTG由于其增强的触觉感测面积和更大的开口角度，能够更有效地稳定抓握更大、更重的日常物品。 其表面皮肤由高度耐磨的材料制成，显著提高了耐用性并延长了使用寿命。 视觉和触觉反馈的集成使得LVTG能够提供丰富、高保真度的感觉数据，从而促进复杂操作任务中的可靠感知。 此外，LVTG采用模块化设计，支持快速维护和更换。 为了有效地融合视觉和触觉，我们采用了一种受CLIP启发的对比学习目标，将触觉嵌入与相应的视觉观察对齐，从而为视觉触觉感知提供一个共享的跨模态表示空间。 这种对齐改进了动作分块 Transformer (ACT) 策略在富接触操作中的性能，从而实现了更有效的数据收集和更有效的策略学习。 与原始ACT方法相比，所提出的LVTG与预训练相结合在操作任务中实现了显著更高的成功率。
tldr: This paper introduces a low-cost, durable visuo-tactile gripper (LVTG) that uses CLIP-inspired contrastive learning to improve the performance of an Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) policy in contact-rich manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种低成本、耐用的视觉触觉夹爪（LVTG），它使用 CLIP 启发的对比学习来提高动作分块转换器（ACT）策略在富接触操作任务中的性能。

title: Parallel Stochastic Gradient-Based Planning for World Models
summary: World models simulate environment dynamics from raw sensory inputs like video. However, using them for planning can be challenging due to the vast and unstructured search space. We propose a robust and highly parallelizable planner that leverages the differentiability of the learned world model for efficient optimization, solving long-horizon control tasks from visual input. Our method treats states as optimization variables ("virtual states") with soft dynamics constraints, enabling parallel computation and easier optimization. To facilitate exploration and avoid local optima, we introduce stochasticity into the states. To mitigate sensitive gradients through high-dimensional vision-based world models, we modify the gradient structure to descend towards valid plans while only requiring action-input gradients. Our planner, which we call GRASP (Gradient RelAxed Stochastic Planner), can be viewed as a stochastic version of a non-condensed or collocation-based optimal controller. We provide theoretical justification and experiments on video-based world models, where our resulting planner outperforms existing planning algorithms like the cross-entropy method (CEM) and vanilla gradient-based optimization (GD) on long-horizon experiments, both in success rate and time to convergence.
summary_zh: 世界模型能够从原始感官输入（如视频）中模拟环境动力学。然而，由于搜索空间庞大且无结构化，利用它们进行规划可能极具挑战性。我们提出一种鲁棒且高度可并行化的规划器，它利用学习到的世界模型的可微性进行高效优化，从而解决来自视觉输入的长时程控制任务。我们的方法将状态视为具有软动力学约束的优化变量（“虚拟状态”），从而实现并行计算和更简易的优化。为了促进探索并避免局部最优，我们引入了状态随机性。为了缓解通过高维基于视觉的世界模型带来的敏感梯度问题，我们修改了梯度结构，使其在仅需要动作输入梯度的前提下，朝着有效的规划方案下降。我们的规划器，我们称之为GRASP（梯度松弛随机规划器），可以被视为非凝聚式或基于配置点的最优控制器的随机版本。我们提供了理论论证以及在基于视频的世界模型上的实验，结果表明，在长时程实验中，我们提出的规划器在成功率和收敛时间方面均优于现有的规划算法，如交叉熵方法（CEM）和原始的基于梯度的优化（GD）。
tldr: The paper introduces a parallel, stochastic gradient-based planner (GRASP) for world models which optimizes state trajectories with soft dynamics constraints, achieving better performance than CEM and vanilla GD in long-horizon, vision-based tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于世界模型的并行随机梯度规划器 (GRASP)，它利用软动力学约束优化状态轨迹，在长时程、基于视觉的任务中实现了优于 CEM 和普通 GD 的性能。

title: DISK: Dynamic Inference SKipping for World Models
summary: We present DISK, a training-free adaptive inference method for autoregressive world models. DISK coordinates two coupled diffusion transformers for video and ego-trajectory via dual-branch controllers with cross-modal skip decisions, preserving motion-appearance consistency without retraining. We extend higher-order latent-difference skip testing to the autoregressive chain-of-forward regime and propagate controller statistics through rollout loops for long-horizon stability. When integrated into closed-loop driving rollouts on 1500 NuPlan and NuScenes samples using an NVIDIA L40S GPU, DISK achieves 2x speedup on trajectory diffusion and 1.6x speedup on video diffusion while maintaining L2 planning error, visual quality (FID/FVD), and NAVSIM PDMS scores, demonstrating practical long-horizon video-and-trajectory prediction at substantially reduced cost.
summary_zh: 我们提出了DISK，一种用于自回归世界模型的免训练自适应推理方法。DISK通过具有跨模态跳跃决策的双分支控制器来协调视频和自我轨迹的两个耦合扩散Transformer，从而在无需重新训练的情况下保持运动-外观一致性。我们将高阶潜在差异跳跃测试扩展到自回归链式前向过程，并通过rollout循环传播控制器统计信息，以实现长时程稳定性。当在1500个NuPlan和NuScenes样本上使用NVIDIA L40S GPU集成到闭环驾驶rollout中时，DISK在轨迹扩散上实现了2倍加速，在视频扩散上实现了1.6倍加速，同时保持了L2规划误差、视觉质量（FID/FVD）和NAVSIM PDMS评分，证明了以大幅降低的成本进行实用的长时程视频和轨迹预测。
tldr: DISK is a training-free inference method for world models that adaptively skips steps in autoregressive video and trajectory diffusion, achieving significant speedups with minimal impact on performance metrics.
tldr_zh: DISK 是一种无需训练的世界模型推理方法，它自适应地跳过自回归视频和轨迹扩散中的步骤，从而在对性能指标影响最小的情况下实现显著的加速。

title: End-to-end Optimization of Belief and Policy Learning in Shared Autonomy Paradigms
summary: Shared autonomy systems require principled methods for inferring user intent and determining appropriate assistance levels. This is a central challenge in human-robot interaction, where systems must be successful while being mindful of user agency. Previous approaches relied on static blending ratios or separated goal inference from assistance arbitration, leading to suboptimal performance in unstructured environments. We introduce BRACE (Bayesian Reinforcement Assistance with Context Encoding), a novel framework that fine-tunes Bayesian intent inference and context-adaptive assistance through an architecture enabling end-to-end gradient flow between intent inference and assistance arbitration. Our pipeline conditions collaborative control policies on environmental context and complete goal probability distributions. We provide analysis showing (1) optimal assistance levels should decrease with goal uncertainty and increase with environmental constraint severity, and (2) integrating belief information into policy learning yields a quadratic expected regret advantage over sequential approaches. We validated our algorithm against SOTA methods (IDA, DQN) using a three-part evaluation progressively isolating distinct challenges of end-effector control: (1) core human-interaction dynamics in a 2D human-in-the-loop cursor task, (2) non-linear dynamics of a robotic arm, and (3) integrated manipulation under goal ambiguity and environmental constraints. We demonstrate improvements over SOTA, achieving 6.3% higher success rates and 41% increased path efficiency, and 36.3% success rate and 87% path efficiency improvement over unassisted control. Our results confirmed that integrated optimization is most beneficial in complex, goal-ambiguous scenarios, and is generalizable across robotic domains requiring goal-directed assistance, advancing the SOTA for adaptive shared autonomy.
summary_zh: 共享自主系统需要有原则的方法来推断用户意图并确定适当的辅助级别。这是人机交互中的一个核心挑战，系统必须成功运行，同时关注用户的自主性。以往的方法依赖于静态混合比例或将目标推断与辅助仲裁分离，导致在非结构化环境中性能欠佳。我们引入了BRACE（基于上下文编码的贝叶斯强化辅助），这是一个新颖的框架，通过一种能够在意图推断和辅助仲裁之间实现端到端梯度流的架构，微调贝叶斯意图推断和上下文自适应辅助。我们的流程将协作控制策略建立在环境上下文和完整的目标概率分布之上。我们提供的分析表明：（1）最佳辅助水平应随着目标不确定性的增加而降低，随着环境约束严重性的增加而升高，并且（2）将信念信息集成到策略学习中，相比于顺序方法，可获得二次方的预期遗憾优势。我们使用一个分为三个部分的评估，逐步隔离末端执行器控制的不同挑战，验证了我们的算法与SOTA（IDA，DQN）方法相比的性能：（1）在2D人环游标任务中的核心人机交互动力学，（2）机械臂的非线性动力学，以及（3）在目标模糊和环境约束下进行集成操作。我们证明了相对于SOTA的改进，实现了6.3%的更高成功率和41%的路径效率提升，以及相对于无辅助控制的36.3%的成功率和87%的路径效率提升。我们的结果证实，集成优化在复杂、目标模糊的场景中最为有益，并且可推广到需要目标导向辅助的机器人领域，从而提升了自适应共享自主的SOTA水平。
tldr: The paper introduces BRACE, a novel end-to-end framework for shared autonomy that integrates Bayesian intent inference and context-adaptive assistance, demonstrating improved performance over state-of-the-art methods in robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为BRACE的新型端到端共享自主框架，该框架集成了贝叶斯意图推断和上下文自适应辅助，并在机器人操作任务中表现出比现有技术更好的性能。

title: Environment-Aware Adaptive Pruning with Interleaved Inference Orchestration for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models hold promise in embodied intelligence, their large parameter counts lead to substantial inference latency that hinders real-time manipulation, motivating parameter sparsification. However, as the environment evolves during VLA execution, the optimal sparsity patterns change accordingly. Static pruning lacks the adaptability required for environment dynamics, whereas fixed-interval dynamic layer pruning suffers from coarse granularity and high retraining overheads. To bridge this gap, we propose EcoVLA, a training-free, plug-and-play adaptive pruning framework that supports orthogonal combination with existing VLA acceleration methods. EcoVLA comprises two components: Environment-aware Adaptive Pruning (EAP) and Interleaved Inference Orchestration ($I^2O$). EAP is a lightweight adaptive channel pruning method that incorporates the temporal consistency of the physical environment to update sparsity patterns. $I^2O$ leverages the FLOPs bubbles inherent in VLA inference to schedule the pruning method in parallel, ensuring negligible impact on latency. Evaluated on diverse VLA models and benchmarks, EcoVLA delivers state-of-the-art performance, achieving up to 1.60$\times$ speedup with only a 0.4% drop in success rate, and further reaches 2.18$\times$ speedup with only a 0.5% degradation when combined with token pruning. We further validate the effectiveness of EcoVLA on real-world robots.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在具身智能领域展现出巨大潜力，但其庞大的参数量导致了显著的推理延迟，阻碍了实时操作，因此参数稀疏化具有重要意义。然而，在VLA执行过程中，随着环境演变，最佳稀疏模式也会相应改变。静态剪枝缺乏适应环境动态变化所需的能力，而固定间隔的动态层剪枝则存在粗粒度和高昂的重训练开销。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了EcoVLA，这是一种无需训练的、即插即用的自适应剪枝框架，支持与现有的VLA加速方法进行正交组合。EcoVLA包含两个组成部分：环境感知自适应剪枝（EAP）和交错推理编排（$I^2O$）。EAP是一种轻量级的自适应通道剪枝方法，它结合了物理环境的时间一致性来更新稀疏模式。$I^2O$利用VLA推理中固有的FLOPs气泡来并行调度剪枝方法，确保对延迟的影响可以忽略不计。在各种VLA模型和基准测试中评估表明，EcoVLA提供了最先进的性能，实现了高达1.60倍的加速，成功率仅下降0.4%，并且在与token剪枝结合使用时，进一步实现了高达2.18倍的加速，性能仅下降0.5%。我们进一步验证了EcoVLA在真实机器人上的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces EcoVLA, a training-free, environment-aware adaptive pruning framework using Environment-aware Adaptive Pruning (EAP) and Interleaved Inference Orchestration ($I^2O$) to improve the inference speed of Vision-Language-Action models with minimal performance degradation, validated on VLA benchmarks and real robots.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EcoVLA，一种无需训练的、环境感知的自适应剪枝框架，使用环境感知自适应剪枝（EAP）和交错推理协调（$I^2O$）来提高Vision-Language-Action模型的推理速度，并性能影响极小，已在VLA基准测试和真实机器人上验证。

title: Evolving Interpretable Constitutions for Multi-Agent Simulation
summary: Constitutional AI has focused on single-model alignment using fixed principles. However, multi-agent systems create novel alignment challenges through emergent social dynamics. We present Constitutional Evolution, a framework for automatically discovering behavioral norms in multi-agent LLM systems. Using a grid-world simulation with survival pressure, we study the tension between individual and collective welfare, quantified via a Societal Stability Score S in [0,1] that combines productivity, survival, and conflict metrics. Adversarial constitutions lead to societal collapse (S= 0), while vague prosocial principles ("be helpful, harmless, honest") produce inconsistent coordination (S = 0.249). Even constitutions designed by Claude 4.5 Opus with explicit knowledge of the objective achieve only moderate performance (S= 0.332). Using LLM-driven genetic programming with multi-island evolution, we evolve constitutions maximizing social welfare without explicit guidance toward cooperation. The evolved constitution C* achieves S = 0.556 +/- 0.008 (123% higher than human-designed baselines, N = 10), eliminates conflict, and discovers that minimizing communication (0.9% vs 62.2% social actions) outperforms verbose coordination. Our interpretable rules demonstrate that cooperative norms can be discovered rather than prescribed.
summary_zh: 宪法式人工智能主要关注于使用固定原则的单模型对齐。然而，多智能体系统通过涌现的社会动态创造了新的对齐挑战。我们提出了宪法进化，这是一个用于在多智能体 LLM 系统中自动发现行为规范的框架。利用一个具有生存压力的网格世界模拟，我们研究了个人福利与集体福利之间的张力，并通过一个社会稳定评分 S 在 [0,1] 范围内量化，该评分结合了生产力、生存和冲突指标。对抗性宪法导致社会崩溃（S= 0），而模糊的亲社会原则（“有帮助、无害、诚实”）产生不一致的协调（S = 0.249）。即使是 Claude 4.5 Opus 设计的、具有目标显式知识的宪法也仅实现了中等性能（S= 0.332）。通过使用 LLM 驱动的、具有多岛演化的遗传编程，我们进化出最大化社会福利的宪法，而无需明确的合作指导。进化出的宪法 C* 实现了 S = 0.556 +/- 0.008 (比人类设计的基线高 123%，N = 10)，消除了冲突，并发现最小化通信（0.9% vs 62.2% 的社会行为）优于冗长的协调。我们可解释的规则表明，合作规范可以被发现，而不是被规定。
tldr: This paper introduces Constitutional Evolution, a framework that uses genetic programming to automatically discover behavioral norms for multi-agent LLM systems, achieving improved social welfare in a grid-world simulation compared to human-designed constitutions.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为“宪法进化”的框架，该框架利用基因编程自动发现多智能体LLM系统中的行为规范，在网格世界模拟中实现了比人类设计的宪法更高的社会福利。

title: SEISMO: Increasing Sample Efficiency in Molecular Optimization with a Trajectory-Aware LLM Agent
summary: Optimizing the structure of molecules to achieve desired properties is a central bottleneck across the chemical sciences, particularly in the pharmaceutical industry where it underlies the discovery of new drugs. Since molecular property evaluation often relies on costly and rate-limited oracles, such as experimental assays, molecular optimization must be highly sample-efficient. To address this, we introduce SEISMO, an LLM agent that performs strictly online, inference-time molecular optimization, updating after every oracle call without the need for population-based or batched learning. SEISMO conditions each proposal on the full optimization trajectory, combining natural-language task descriptions with scalar scores and, when available, structured explanatory feedback. Across the Practical Molecular Optimization benchmark of 23 tasks, SEISMO achieves a 2-3 times higher area under the optimisation curve than prior methods, often reaching near-maximal task scores within 50 oracle calls. Our additional medicinal-chemistry tasks show that providing explanatory feedback further improves efficiency, demonstrating that leveraging domain knowledge and structured information is key to sample-efficient molecular optimization.
summary_zh: 优化分子结构以实现所需性质是整个化学科学领域，尤其是在新药发现的制药行业中的一个核心瓶颈。 由于分子性质的评估通常依赖于昂贵且受速率限制的预言机，例如实验分析，因此分子优化必须具有高度的样本效率。 为了解决这个问题，我们引入了SEISMO，一个执行严格在线、推理时分子优化的LLM代理，在每次预言机调用后进行更新，而无需基于种群或批量的学习。 SEISMO将每个提议基于完整的优化轨迹进行条件化，将自然语言任务描述与标量分数，以及在可用情况下，结构化的解释性反馈相结合。 在包含23个任务的实用分子优化基准测试中，SEISMO实现了比先前方法高2-3倍的优化曲线下面积，通常在50次预言机调用内达到接近最大值的任务分数。 我们额外的药物化学任务表明，提供解释性反馈可以进一步提高效率，表明利用领域知识和结构化信息是实现样本高效分子优化的关键。
tldr: The paper introduces SEISMO, an LLM agent for sample-efficient molecular optimization that leverages trajectory information and explanatory feedback, achieving superior performance on molecular optimization benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SEISMO的LLM智能体，用于高效的分子优化，它利用轨迹信息和解释性反馈，并在分子优化基准测试中取得了卓越的性能。

title: Structured Self-Consistency:A Multi-Task Evaluation of LLMs on VirtualHome
summary: Embodied AI requires agents to understand goals, plan actions, and execute tasks in simulated environments.We present a comprehensive evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) on the VirtualHome benchmark using the Embodied Agent Interface (EAI) framework.We compare two representative 7B-parameter models OPENPANGU-7B and QWEN2.5-7B across four fundamental tasks: Goal Interpretation, Action Sequencing, Subgoal Decomposition, and Transition Modeling.We propose Structured Self-Consistency (SSC), an enhanced decoding strategy that leverages multiple sampling with domain-specific voting mechanisms to improve output quality for structured generation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that SSC significantly enhances performance, with OPENPANGU-7B excelling at hierarchical planning while QWEN2.5-7B show advantages in action-level tasks. Our analysis reveals complementary strengths across model types, providing insights for future embodied AI system development.
summary_zh: 具身智能要求智能体理解目标，规划行动，并在模拟环境中执行任务。我们使用具身智能体接口（EAI）框架，对大型语言模型（LLM）在VirtualHome基准测试上的性能进行了全面评估。我们比较了两个具有代表性的 70 亿参数模型 OPENPANGU-7B 和 QWEN2.5-7B 在四个基本任务上的表现：目标理解、行动序列、子目标分解和状态转移建模。我们提出了一种结构化自洽性（SSC）方法，这是一种增强的解码策略，它利用多重采样和领域特定的投票机制来提高结构化生成任务的输出质量。实验结果表明，SSC 显著提高了性能，其中 OPENPANGU-7B 在层级规划方面表现出色，而 QWEN2.5-7B 在行动层面的任务中展现出优势。我们的分析揭示了不同模型类型的互补优势，为未来具身智能系统的开发提供了见解。
tldr: The paper evaluates two 7B LLMs (OPENPANGU-7B and QWEN2.5-7B) on the VirtualHome benchmark for embodied AI tasks, introducing Structured Self-Consistency (SSC) to improve performance, showing complementary strengths between the models.
tldr_zh: 该论文评估了两个7B LLM（OPENPANGU-7B 和 QWEN2.5-7B）在VirtualHome基准上执行具身AI任务的能力，引入了结构化自洽性(SSC)以提高性能，并展示了这些模型之间的互补优势。

title: Scalable Generative Game Engine: Breaking the Resolution Wall via Hardware-Algorithm Co-Design
summary: Real-time generative game engines represent a paradigm shift in interactive simulation, promising to replace traditional graphics pipelines with neural world models. However, existing approaches are fundamentally constrained by the ``Memory Wall,'' restricting practical deployments to low resolutions (e.g., $64 \times 64$). This paper bridges the gap between generative models and high-resolution neural simulations by introducing a scalable \textit{Hardware-Algorithm Co-Design} framework. We identify that high-resolution generation suffers from a critical resource mismatch: the World Model is compute-bound while the Decoder is memory-bound. To address this, we propose a heterogeneous architecture that intelligently decouples these components across a cluster of AI accelerators. Our system features three core innovations: (1) an asymmetric resource allocation strategy that optimizes throughput under sequence parallelism constraints; (2) a memory-centric operator fusion scheme that minimizes off-chip bandwidth usage; and (3) a manifold-aware latent extrapolation mechanism that exploits temporal redundancy to mask latency. We validate our approach on a cluster of programmable AI accelerators, enabling real-time generation at $720 \times 480$ resolution -- a $50\times$ increase in pixel throughput over prior baselines. Evaluated on both continuous 3D racing and discrete 2D platformer benchmarks, our system delivers fluid 26.4 FPS and 48.3 FPS respectively, with an amortized effective latency of 2.7 ms. This work demonstrates that resolving the ``Memory Wall'' via architectural co-design is not merely an optimization, but a prerequisite for enabling high-fidelity, responsive neural gameplay.
summary_zh: 实时生成式游戏引擎代表了交互式模拟领域的一次范式转变，有望用神经世界模型取代传统的图形流水线。然而，现有方法从根本上受到“内存墙”的限制，导致实际部署只能在低分辨率（例如，$64 \times 64$）下进行。本文通过引入一种可扩展的*硬件-算法协同设计*框架，弥合了生成模型和高分辨率神经模拟之间的差距。我们发现，高分辨率生成面临着一个关键的资源错配问题：世界模型受计算约束，而解码器受内存约束。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种异构架构，将这些组件智能地解耦到 AI 加速器集群中。我们的系统具有三个核心创新：（1）一种非对称资源分配策略，可在序列并行约束下优化吞吐量；（2）一种以内存为中心的算子融合方案，可最大限度地减少片外带宽的使用；以及（3）一种流形感知的潜在空间外推机制，利用时间冗余来掩盖延迟。我们在一个可编程 AI 加速器集群上验证了我们的方法，实现了 $720 \times 480$ 分辨率的实时生成——像素吞吐量比之前的基线提高了 50 倍。在连续的 3D 赛车和离散的 2D 平台游戏基准测试中，我们的系统分别提供了流畅的 26.4 FPS 和 48.3 FPS，摊销后的有效延迟为 2.7 毫秒。这项工作表明，通过架构协同设计解决“内存墙”不仅是一种优化，而且是实现高保真、响应式神经游戏玩法的先决条件。
tldr: This paper presents a hardware-algorithm co-design framework that addresses the memory bottleneck in generative game engines, enabling real-time generation at significantly higher resolutions than previous approaches.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个硬件-算法协同设计框架，旨在解决生成游戏引擎中的内存瓶颈问题，从而能够以比以往方法明显更高的分辨率进行实时生成。

title: Learning Modal-Mixed Chain-of-Thought Reasoning with Latent Embeddings
summary: We study how to extend chain-of-thought (CoT) beyond language to better handle multimodal reasoning. While CoT helps LLMs and VLMs articulate intermediate steps, its text-only form often fails on vision-intensive problems where key intermediate states are inherently visual. We introduce modal-mixed CoT, which interleaves textual tokens with compact visual sketches represented as latent embeddings. To bridge the modality gap without eroding the original knowledge and capability of the VLM, we use the VLM itself as an encoder and train the language backbone to reconstruct its own intermediate vision embeddings, to guarantee the semantic alignment of the visual latent space. We further attach a diffusion-based latent decoder, invoked by a special control token and conditioned on hidden states from the VLM. In this way, the diffusion head carries fine-grained perceptual details while the VLM specifies high-level intent, which cleanly disentangles roles and reduces the optimization pressure of the VLM. Training proceeds in two stages: supervised fine-tuning on traces that interleave text and latents with a joint next-token and latent-reconstruction objective, followed by reinforcement learning that teaches when to switch modalities and how to compose long reasoning chains. Extensive experiments across 11 diverse multimodal reasoning tasks, demonstrate that our method yields better performance than language-only and other CoT methods. Our code will be publicly released.
summary_zh: 我们研究如何将思维链（CoT）扩展到语言之外，以更好地处理多模态推理。虽然CoT能够帮助LLM和VLM阐明中间步骤，但其纯文本形式在视觉密集型问题上往往失效，因为关键的中间状态本质上是视觉的。我们引入了模态混合CoT，它将文本token与表示为潜在嵌入的紧凑视觉草图交错排列。为了弥合模态差距，同时又不削弱VLM原有的知识和能力，我们使用VLM自身作为编码器，并训练语言骨干网络来重建其自身的中间视觉嵌入，从而保证视觉潜在空间的语义对齐。我们进一步附加了一个基于扩散的潜在解码器，该解码器由一个特殊的控制token触发，并以VLM的隐藏状态为条件。通过这种方式，扩散头携带细粒度的感知细节，而VLM指定高层意图，从而干净地解耦了角色并降低了VLM的优化压力。训练分两个阶段进行：首先是在文本和潜在向量交错的轨迹上进行监督微调，目标是联合预测下一个token和重建潜在向量；然后是强化学习，以学习何时切换模态以及如何组合长的推理链。在11个不同的多模态推理任务上进行的大量实验表明，我们的方法比纯语言和其他CoT方法产生了更好的性能。我们的代码将公开发布。
tldr: The paper introduces modal-mixed Chain-of-Thought reasoning, interleaving textual tokens with visual embeddings in VLMs, trained with a reconstruction objective and RL, achieving strong performance on multimodal tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种混合模态的CoT推理方法，将文本和视觉嵌入交织到VLM中，通过重建目标和强化学习进行训练，在多模态任务上表现出色。

title: Learning to Decode Against Compositional Hallucination in Video Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Current research on video hallucination mitigation primarily focuses on isolated error types, leaving compositional hallucinations, arising from incorrect reasoning over multiple interacting spatial and temporal factors largely underexplored. We introduce OmniVCHall, a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate both isolated and compositional hallucinations in video multimodal large language models (VLLMs). OmniVCHall spans diverse video domains, introduces a novel camera-based hallucination type, and defines a fine-grained taxonomy, together with adversarial answer options (e.g., "All are correct" and "None of the above") to prevent shortcut reasoning. The evaluations of 39 representative VLLMs reveal that even advanced models (e.g., Qwen3-VL and GPT-5) exhibit substantial performance degradation. We propose TriCD, a contrastive decoding framework with a triple-pathway calibration mechanism. An adaptive perturbation controller dynamically selects distracting operations to construct negative video variants, while a saliency-guided enhancement module adaptively reinforces grounded token-wise visual evidences. These components are optimized via reinforcement learning to encourage precise decision-making under compositional hallucination settings. Experimental results show that TriCD consistently improves performance across two representative backbones, achieving an average accuracy improvement of over 10%. The data and code can be find at https://github.com/BMRETURN/OmniVCHall.
summary_zh: 当前关于视频幻觉缓解的研究主要集中在孤立的错误类型上，而对于由多个相互作用的空间和时间因素上的错误推理所引起的组合幻觉，在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们引入了OmniVCHall，这是一个旨在系统评估视频多模态大型语言模型（VLLMs）中孤立和组合幻觉的基准。OmniVCHall涵盖了不同的视频领域，引入了一种新颖的基于相机的幻觉类型，并定义了一个包含对抗性答案选项（例如，“全部正确”和“以上皆非”）的细粒度分类体系，以防止捷径推理。对39个具有代表性的VLLM的评估表明，即使是先进的模型（例如，Qwen3-VL和GPT-5）也表现出显著的性能下降。我们提出TriCD，这是一个具有三路径校准机制的对比解码框架。一个自适应扰动控制器动态选择干扰操作来构建负视频变体，而一个显著性引导的增强模块自适应地增强基于token的视觉证据。这些组件通过强化学习进行优化，以鼓励在组合幻觉设置下做出精确的决策。实验结果表明，TriCD始终如一地提高了两种具有代表性的骨干网络的性能，平均准确率提高了10%以上。数据和代码可以在https://github.com/BMRETURN/OmniVCHall找到。
tldr: The paper introduces OmniVCHall, a benchmark for evaluating compositional hallucinations in video VLLMs, and proposes TriCD, a contrastive decoding framework that improves performance on this benchmark, achieving over 10% accuracy improvement.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了OmniVCHall，一个用于评估视频VLLM中组合幻觉的基准，并提出了TriCD，一种对比解码框架，可提高在此基准上的性能，实现超过10%的准确率提升。

title: How Far Are LLMs from Professional Poker Players? Revisiting Game-Theoretic Reasoning with Agentic Tool Use
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in high-stakes domains, their ability to reason strategically under uncertainty becomes critical. Poker provides a rigorous testbed, requiring not only strong actions but also principled, game-theoretic reasoning. In this paper, we conduct a systematic study of LLMs in multiple realistic poker tasks, evaluating both gameplay outcomes and reasoning traces. Our analysis reveals LLMs fail to compete against traditional algorithms and identifies three recurring flaws: reliance on heuristics, factual misunderstandings, and a "knowing-doing" gap where actions diverge from reasoning. An initial attempt with behavior cloning and step-level reinforcement learning improves reasoning style but remains insufficient for accurate game-theoretic play. Motivated by these limitations, we propose ToolPoker, a tool-integrated reasoning framework that combines external solvers for GTO-consistent actions with more precise professional-style explanations. Experiments demonstrate that ToolPoker achieves state-of-the-art gameplay while producing reasoning traces that closely reflect game-theoretic principles.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地应用于高风险领域，它们在不确定性下进行战略推理的能力变得至关重要。扑克提供了一个严格的测试平台，不仅需要强大的行动，还需要有原则的、博弈论的推理。在本文中，我们对LLM在多个真实的扑克任务中进行了系统研究，评估了游戏结果和推理轨迹。我们的分析表明，LLM无法与传统算法竞争，并发现了三个反复出现的缺陷：依赖启发式方法、对事实的误解以及行动与推理背离的“知行”差距。一个使用行为克隆和步进式强化学习的初步尝试改进了推理风格，但对于准确的博弈论玩法仍然不足。受这些限制的启发，我们提出了ToolPoker，一个工具集成的推理框架，它将用于GTO一致性行动的外部求解器与更精确的专业级解释相结合。实验表明，ToolPoker实现了最先进的玩法，同时产生的推理轨迹能够密切反映博弈论原则。
tldr: This paper investigates LLMs' strategic reasoning abilities in poker, finding limitations but showing improved performance with a tool-integrated framework (ToolPoker) that uses external solvers to guide actions and explanations.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了LLM在扑克中的策略推理能力，发现其存在局限性，但通过使用工具集成框架（ToolPoker），利用外部求解器来指导行动和解释，从而提高了性能。

title: Sparse Shortcuts: Facilitating Efficient Fusion in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: With the remarkable success of large language models (LLMs) in natural language understanding and generation, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have rapidly advanced in their ability to process data across multiple modalities. While most existing efforts focus on scaling up language models or constructing higher-quality training data, limited attention has been paid to effectively integrating cross-modal knowledge into the language space. In vision-language models, for instance, aligning modalities using only high-level visual features often discards the rich semantic information present in mid- and low-level features, limiting the model's ability of cross-modality understanding. To address this issue, we propose SparseCut, a general cross-modal fusion architecture for MLLMs, introducing sparse shortcut connections between the cross-modal encoder and the LLM. These shortcut connections enable the efficient and hierarchical integration of visual features at multiple levels, facilitating richer semantic fusion without increasing computational overhead. We further introduce an efficient multi-grained feature fusion module, which performs the fusion of visual features before routing them through the shortcuts. This preserves the original language context and does not increase the overall input length, thereby avoiding an increase in computational complexity for the LLM. Experiments demonstrate that SparseCut significantly enhances the performance of MLLMs across various multimodal benchmarks with generality and scalability for different base LLMs.
summary_zh: 在自然语言理解和生成领域，大型语言模型（LLMs）取得了显著成功，受此推动，多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在处理跨模态数据方面的能力也得到了快速发展。 虽然现有的大部分工作都集中在扩展语言模型或构建更高质量的训练数据上，但有效整合跨模态知识到语言空间中这一方面却鲜少受到关注。 例如，在视觉-语言模型中，仅使用高层视觉特征对齐模态通常会丢弃中低层特征中存在的丰富语义信息，从而限制了模型跨模态理解能力。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出SparseCut，一种通用的MLLM跨模态融合架构，它在跨模态编码器和LLM之间引入了稀疏快捷连接。 这些快捷连接能够高效且分层地整合多层级的视觉特征，从而促进更丰富的语义融合，同时不增加计算开销。 我们进一步引入了一种高效的多粒度特征融合模块，该模块在将视觉特征通过快捷连接路由之前执行特征融合。 这保留了原始语言上下文，并且不会增加整体输入长度，从而避免了 LLM 计算复杂性的增加。 实验表明，SparseCut 显著提高了 MLLMs 在各种多模态基准测试中的性能，并且对不同的基础 LLMs 具有通用性和可扩展性。
tldr: The paper introduces SparseCut, a novel cross-modal fusion architecture for MLLMs that utilizes sparse shortcut connections to efficiently integrate visual features at multiple levels, improving performance on various multimodal benchmarks without increasing computational overhead.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 SparseCut 的新型 MLLM 跨模态融合架构，它利用稀疏快捷连接来有效地整合多层次的视觉特征，从而在各种多模态基准测试中提高性能，且不增加计算开销。

title: Dual Latent Memory for Visual Multi-agent System
summary: While Visual Multi-Agent Systems (VMAS) promise to enhance comprehensive abilities through inter-agent collaboration, empirical evidence reveals a counter-intuitive "scaling wall": increasing agent turns often degrades performance while exponentially inflating token costs. We attribute this failure to the information bottleneck inherent in text-centric communication, where converting perceptual and thinking trajectories into discrete natural language inevitably induces semantic loss. To this end, we propose L$^{2}$-VMAS, a novel model-agnostic framework that enables inter-agent collaboration with dual latent memories. Furthermore, we decouple the perception and thinking while dynamically synthesizing dual latent memories. Additionally, we introduce an entropy-driven proactive triggering that replaces passive information transmission with efficient, on-demand memory access. Extensive experiments among backbones, sizes, and multi-agent structures demonstrate that our method effectively breaks the "scaling wall" with superb scalability, improving average accuracy by 2.7-5.4% while reducing token usage by 21.3-44.8%. Codes: https://github.com/YU-deep/L2-VMAS.
summary_zh: 视觉多智能体系统（VMAS）有望通过智能体间的协作来增强综合能力，但经验证据揭示了一种反直觉的“扩展壁垒”：增加智能体的轮数通常会降低性能，同时呈指数级地增加token成本。我们将这种失败归因于以文本为中心的通信中固有的信息瓶颈，其中将感知和思维轨迹转换为离散的自然语言不可避免地会导致语义损失。为此，我们提出L$^{2}$-VMAS，这是一种新颖的、与模型无关的框架，它通过双重潜在记忆实现智能体间的协作。此外，我们解耦了感知和思维，同时动态地合成双重潜在记忆。另外，我们引入了一种熵驱动的主动触发机制，用高效的、按需的记忆访问来取代被动的信息传输。在大规模的骨干网络、大小和多智能体结构方面的广泛实验表明，我们的方法有效地打破了“扩展壁垒”，具有出色的可扩展性，将平均准确率提高了2.7-5.4%，同时将token使用量降低了21.3-44.8%。代码：https://github.com/YU-deep/L2-VMAS.
tldr: The paper introduces L$^{2}$-VMAS, a framework that uses dual latent memories and entropy-driven proactive triggering to improve scalability and reduce token usage in visual multi-agent systems by addressing the information bottleneck in text-centric communication.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了L$^{2}$-VMAS，一种使用双重潜在记忆和熵驱动的主动触发框架，通过解决文本中心通信中的信息瓶颈，提高视觉多智能体系统的可扩展性并减少token使用量。

title: PolarMem: A Training-Free Polarized Latent Graph Memory for Verifiable Multimodal Agents
summary: As multimodal agents evolve from passive observers to long-horizon decision-makers, they require memory systems that provide not just information availability but logical verifiability. A fundamental limitation of current architectures is the epistemic asymmetry inherent in probabilistic vision-language models and dense associative memories: they conflate semantic affinity with factual existence and structurally fail to encode negative constraints. To this end, we introduce PolarMem, a training-free Polarized Latent Graph Memory designed to ground agent reasoning in verifiable evidence. PolarMem transforms fuzzy perceptual likelihoods into discrete logical constraints through non-parametric distributional partitioning. Furthermore, it employs a polarized graph topology with orthogonal inhibitory connections to explicitly store verified negation as a primary cognitive state. At inference time, we enforce a logic-dominant retrieval paradigm, suppressing hallucinatory patterns that violate negative constraints. Extensive evaluation across eight frozen Vision--Language Models and six benchmarks demonstrates that PolarMem functions as a robust cognitive system, establishing a foundation for verifiable multimodal agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/czs-ict/PolarMem.
summary_zh: 随着多模态智能体从被动观察者演变为长程决策者，它们需要不仅提供信息可用性，而且提供逻辑可验证性的记忆系统。当前架构的一个根本限制在于概率视觉-语言模型和密集关联记忆中固有的认知不对称性：它们混淆了语义亲和性与事实存在性，并且在结构上无法编码否定约束。为此，我们提出PolarMem，一种无需训练的极化潜在图记忆，旨在将智能体推理扎根于可验证的证据中。PolarMem通过非参数分布划分将模糊的感知可能性转化为离散的逻辑约束。此外，它采用具有正交抑制连接的极化图拓扑，以显式地将已验证的否定作为主要的认知状态进行存储。在推理时，我们强制执行一种逻辑主导的检索范式，抑制违反否定约束的幻觉模式。在八个冻结视觉-语言模型和六个基准测试上的广泛评估表明，PolarMem作为一个强大的认知系统发挥作用，为可验证的多模态智能体奠定了基础。我们的代码可在https://github.com/czs-ict/PolarMem获取。
tldr: PolarMem introduces a training-free polarized latent graph memory that grounds agent reasoning in verifiable evidence by explicitly modeling negative constraints, improving the logical consistency of multimodal agents.
tldr_zh: PolarMem 引入了一种无需训练的极化潜在图记忆，通过显式建模负约束，将agent推理建立在可验证的证据之上，从而提高多模态agent的逻辑一致性。

title: KEPO: Knowledge-Enhanced Preference Optimization for Reinforcement Learning with Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for inducing explicit reasoning behaviors in large language and vision-language models. However, reasoning-oriented RL post-training remains fundamentally challenging due to sparse trajectory-level rewards, leading to ambiguous credit assignment and severe exploration failures that can trap the policy in a ``learning cliff.'' Recent on-policy distillation methods introduce dense teacher supervision to stabilize optimization, but apply it uniformly across all generated trajectories. We argue that such uniform distillation is ill-suited for reasoning-intensive tasks, as low-quality on-policy trajectories often originate from early logical errors, and distillation under flawed contexts injects noisy and misaligned gradients. To address these challenges, we propose Knowledge-Enhanced Preference Optimization (KEPO), a unified post-training framework that integrates: (i) a quality-gated on-policy distillation objective that selectively applies dense teacher guidance only to high-quality trajectories, and (ii) a knowledge-enhanced exploration strategy that leverages hints learned from a teacher model to rejectively sample reward-positive on-policy trajectories for RL, thereby mitigating exploration collapse. Evaluated on a challenging medical visual question answering benchmark under single-source generalization, KEPO demonstrates improved training stability, more coherent reasoning behaviors, and superior out-of-distribution performance over reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation baselines.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）已经成为一种有前景的范式，用于在大语言和视觉-语言模型中诱导显式的推理行为。然而，面向推理的RL后训练仍然面临根本性的挑战，因为稀疏的轨迹级别奖励会导致模糊的信用分配和严重的探索失败，从而将策略困在“学习悬崖”中。最近的在线策略蒸馏方法引入了密集的教师监督以稳定优化，但将其均匀地应用于所有生成的轨迹。我们认为，这种均匀蒸馏不适合于推理密集型任务，因为低质量的在线策略轨迹通常源于早期的逻辑错误，在有缺陷的环境下进行蒸馏会注入噪声和错位的梯度。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了知识增强偏好优化（KEPO），这是一种统一的后训练框架，集成了：（i）一种质量门控的在线策略蒸馏目标，该目标仅选择性地将密集的教师指导应用于高质量的轨迹；（ii）一种知识增强的探索策略，该策略利用从教师模型中学到的提示，以拒绝性地采样奖励为正的在线策略轨迹进行RL，从而减轻探索崩溃。在具有挑战性的单源泛化医学视觉问答基准测试中进行评估，KEPO展示了优于强化学习和在线策略蒸馏基线的训练稳定性、更连贯的推理行为以及更优越的分布外性能。
tldr: The paper introduces KEPO, a new reinforcement learning framework that improves reasoning in vision-language models by selectively distilling knowledge from high-quality trajectories and using teacher hints for better exploration, leading to improved stability and performance in medical visual question answering.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了KEPO，一种新的强化学习框架，通过选择性地从高质量轨迹中提取知识，并使用教师提示进行更好的探索，从而提高视觉语言模型中的推理能力，从而提高了医学视觉问答的稳定性和性能。

title: When RAG Hurts: Diagnosing and Mitigating Attention Distraction in Retrieval-Augmented LVLMs
summary: While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is one of the dominant paradigms for enhancing Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) on knowledge-based VQA tasks, recent work attributes RAG failures to insufficient attention towards the retrieved context, proposing to reduce the attention allocated to image tokens. In this work, we identify a distinct failure mode that previous study overlooked: Attention Distraction (AD). When the retrieved context is sufficient (highly relevant or including the correct answer), the retrieved text suppresses the visual attention globally, and the attention on image tokens shifts away from question-relevant regions. This leads to failures on questions the model could originally answer correctly without the retrieved text. To mitigate this issue, we propose MAD-RAG, a training-free intervention that decouples visual grounding from context integration through a dual-question formulation, combined with attention mixing to preserve image-conditioned evidence. Extensive experiments on OK-VQA, E-VQA, and InfoSeek demonstrate that MAD-RAG consistently outperforms existing baselines across different model families, yielding absolute gains of up to 4.76%, 9.20%, and 6.18% over the vanilla RAG baseline. Notably, MAD-RAG rectifies up to 74.68% of failure cases with negligible computational overhead.
summary_zh: 虽然检索增强生成 (RAG) 是增强大型视觉语言模型 (LVLMs) 在基于知识的视觉问答 (VQA) 任务上的主流范式之一，但最近的研究将 RAG 的失败归因于对检索上下文的关注不足，并提出减少分配给图像标记的注意力。 在这项工作中，我们识别出之前研究忽略的一个明显的失败模式：注意力分散 (AD)。 当检索到的上下文足够充分（高度相关或包含正确答案）时，检索到的文本会全局抑制视觉注意力，并且图像标记上的注意力会从与问题相关的区域转移开。这导致模型原本可以在没有检索文本的情况下正确回答的问题上出现失败。 为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了 MAD-RAG，这是一种无需训练的干预方法，它通过双重问题公式将视觉定位与上下文整合解耦，并结合注意力混合来保留图像条件下的证据。 在 OK-VQA、E-VQA 和 InfoSeek 上的大量实验表明，MAD-RAG 在不同的模型系列中始终优于现有基线，与原始 RAG 基线相比，分别产生了高达 4.76%、9.20% 和 6.18% 的绝对增益。 值得注意的是，MAD-RAG 纠正了高达 74.68% 的失败案例，且计算开销可忽略不计。
tldr: This paper identifies and mitigates 'Attention Distraction' in RAG-enhanced LVLMs, where retrieved context negatively impacts visual attention and reduces performance on knowledge-based VQA tasks. They propose a training-free method, MAD-RAG, to address this.
tldr_zh: 该论文识别并缓解了RAG增强的LVLMs中的“注意力分散”问题，即检索到的上下文负面影响视觉注意力并降低知识型VQA任务的性能。他们提出了一种无需训练的方法MAD-RAG来解决这个问题。

title: TimeBlind: A Spatio-Temporal Compositionality Benchmark for Video LLMs
summary: Fine-grained spatio-temporal understanding is essential for video reasoning and embodied AI. Yet, while Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) master static semantics, their grasp of temporal dynamics remains brittle. We present TimeBlind, a diagnostic benchmark for compositional spatio-temporal understanding. Inspired by cognitive science, TimeBlind categorizes fine-grained temporal understanding into three levels: recognizing atomic events, characterizing event properties, and reasoning about event interdependencies. Unlike benchmarks that conflate recognition with temporal reasoning, TimeBlind leverages a minimal-pairs paradigm: video pairs share identical static visual content but differ solely in temporal structure, utilizing complementary questions to neutralize language priors. Evaluating over 20 state-of-the-art MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5, Gemini 3 Pro) on 600 curated instances (2400 video-question pairs), reveals that the Instance Accuracy (correctly distinguishing both videos in a pair) of the best performing MLLM is only 48.2%, far below the human performance (98.2%). These results demonstrate that even frontier models rely heavily on static visual shortcuts rather than genuine temporal logic, positioning TimeBlind as a vital diagnostic tool for next-generation video understanding. Dataset and code are available at https://baiqi-li.github.io/timeblind_project/ .
summary_zh: 精确的时空理解对于视频推理和具身人工智能至关重要。然而，尽管多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）精通静态语义，但它们对时间动态的掌握仍然脆弱。我们提出了TimeBlind，一个用于组合时空理解的诊断基准。受到认知科学的启发，TimeBlind将精确的时间理解分为三个层次：识别原子事件、描述事件属性以及推理事件相互依赖关系。与将识别与时间推理混淆的基准不同，TimeBlind利用了最小对范式：视频对共享相同的静态视觉内容，但仅在时间结构上有所不同，并使用互补问题来消除语言先验的影响。在600个精心策划的实例（2400个视频-问题对）上评估了超过20个最先进的MLLM（例如，GPT-5、Gemini 3 Pro），结果表明，性能最佳的MLLM的实例准确率（正确区分一对视频）仅为48.2%，远低于人类的表现（98.2%）。这些结果表明，即使是前沿模型也严重依赖静态视觉捷径，而不是真正的时间逻辑，这使得TimeBlind成为下一代视频理解的重要诊断工具。数据集和代码可在https://baiqi-li.github.io/timeblind_project/ 上获得。
tldr: The paper introduces TimeBlind, a new benchmark for evaluating the spatio-temporal reasoning capabilities of Video LLMs, revealing their deficiency in genuine temporal logic despite strong performance in static semantics.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 TimeBlind，一个新的基准测试，用于评估视频 LLM 的时空推理能力，揭示了它们在真正的时序逻辑方面的不足，尽管在静态语义方面表现出色。

title: Localizing and Correcting Errors for LLM-based Planners
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities on math and coding, but frequently fail on symbolic classical planning tasks. Our studies, as well as prior work, show that LLM-generated plans routinely violate domain constraints given in their instructions (e.g., walking through walls). To address this failure, we propose iteratively augmenting instructions with Localized In-Context Learning (L-ICL) demonstrations: targeted corrections for specific failing steps. Specifically, L-ICL identifies the first constraint violation in a trace and injects a minimal input-output example giving the correct behavior for the failing step. Our proposed technique of L-ICL is much effective than explicit instructions or traditional ICL, which adds complete problem-solving trajectories, and many other baselines. For example, on an 8x8 gridworld, L-ICL produces valid plans 89% of the time with only 60 training examples, compared to 59% for the best baseline, an increase of 30%. L-ICL also shows dramatic improvements in other domains (gridworld navigation, mazes, Sokoban, and BlocksWorld), and on several LLM architectures.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在数学和编程领域展现了强大的推理能力，但在符号经典规划任务中却常常失败。我们的研究以及先前的工作表明，LLM生成的计划经常违反指令中给出的领域约束（例如，穿墙而过）。为了解决这个问题，我们提出通过局部化上下文学习（L-ICL）演示来迭代地增强指令：针对特定失败步骤的有针对性的修正。具体而言，L-ICL识别轨迹中的第一个约束违例，并注入一个最小的输入-输出示例，给出失败步骤的正确行为。我们提出的L-ICL技术比显式指令或传统的上下文学习（ICL）（添加完整的解决问题轨迹）以及其他许多基线都更有效。例如，在8x8网格世界中，仅使用60个训练示例，L-ICL就能在89%的时间内生成有效的计划，而最佳基线的这一比例为59%，提高了30%。L-ICL还在其他领域（网格世界导航、迷宫、推箱子和积木世界）以及几种LLM架构上都显示出显著的改进。
tldr: This paper introduces Localized In-Context Learning (L-ICL) to improve LLM-based planners by iteratively correcting specific failing steps through targeted demonstrations, outperforming other methods in classical planning tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了局部上下文学习（L-ICL），通过针对性演示迭代纠正特定失败步骤，从而改进基于LLM的规划器，并在经典规划任务中优于其他方法。

title: VIZOR: Viewpoint-Invariant Zero-Shot Scene Graph Generation for 3D Scene Reasoning
summary: Scene understanding and reasoning has been a fundamental problem in 3D computer vision, requiring models to identify objects, their properties, and spatial or comparative relationships among the objects. Existing approaches enable this by creating scene graphs using multiple inputs such as 2D images, depth maps, object labels, and annotated relationships from specific reference view. However, these methods often struggle with generalization and produce inaccurate spatial relationships like "left/right", which become inconsistent across different viewpoints. To address these limitations, we propose Viewpoint-Invariant Zero-shot scene graph generation for 3D scene Reasoning (VIZOR). VIZOR is a training-free, end-to-end framework that constructs dense, viewpoint-invariant 3D scene graphs directly from raw 3D scenes. The generated scene graph is unambiguous, as spatial relationships are defined relative to each object's front-facing direction, making them consistent regardless of the reference view. Furthermore, it infers open-vocabulary relationships that describe spatial and proximity relationships among scene objects without requiring annotated training data. We conduct extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations to assess the effectiveness of VIZOR in scene graph generation and downstream tasks, such as query-based object grounding. VIZOR outperforms state-of-the-art methods, showing clear improvements in scene graph generation and achieving 22% and 4.81% gains in zero-shot grounding accuracy on the Replica and Nr3D datasets, respectively.
summary_zh: 场景理解和推理一直是3D计算机视觉领域的一个基本问题，它要求模型能够识别物体、它们的属性以及物体之间的空间或比较关系。 现有的方法通过使用诸如2D图像、深度图、物体标签以及来自特定参考视角的标注关系等多种输入来构建场景图，从而实现这一目标。然而，这些方法通常在泛化方面表现不佳，并且会产生不准确的空间关系，例如“左/右”，这些关系在不同的视点之间变得不一致。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了一种用于3D场景推理的视点不变零样本场景图生成方法(VIZOR)。 VIZOR是一个无需训练的端到端框架，它可以直接从原始3D场景构建密集的、视点不变的3D场景图。 生成的场景图是明确的，因为空间关系是相对于每个物体的前向方向来定义的，这使得它们与参考视角无关，始终保持一致。 此外，它还能推断出开放词汇关系，这些关系描述了场景物体之间的空间和邻近关系，而无需标注训练数据。 我们进行了广泛的定量和定性评估，以评估VIZOR在场景图生成和下游任务（例如基于查询的物体定位）中的有效性。 VIZOR优于最先进的方法，在场景图生成方面表现出明显的改进，并在Replica和Nr3D数据集上分别实现了22%和4.81%的零样本定位精度提升。
tldr: The paper introduces VIZOR, a training-free framework for generating viewpoint-invariant 3D scene graphs from raw 3D scenes, achieving improved performance in scene graph generation and zero-shot grounding.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 VIZOR，一个无需训练的框架，用于从原始 3D 场景生成视角不变的 3D 场景图，并在场景图生成和零样本 grounding 方面取得了改进的性能。

title: GLAD: Generative Language-Assisted Visual Tracking for Low-Semantic Templates
summary: Vision-language tracking has gained increasing attention in many scenarios. This task simultaneously deals with visual and linguistic information to localize objects in videos. Despite its growing utility, the development of vision-language tracking methods remains in its early stage. Current vision-language trackers usually employ Transformer architectures for interactive integration of template, search, and text features. However, persistent challenges about low-semantic images including prevalent image blurriness, low resolution and so on, may compromise model performance through degraded cross-modal understanding. To solve this problem, language assistance is usually used to deal with the obstacles posed by low-semantic images. However, due to the existing gap between current textual and visual features, direct concatenation and fusion of these features may have limited effectiveness. To address these challenges, we introduce a pioneering Generative Language-AssisteD tracking model, GLAD, which utilizes diffusion models for the generative multi-modal fusion of text description and template image to bolster compatibility between language and image and enhance template image semantic information. Our approach demonstrates notable improvements over the existing fusion paradigms. Blurry and semantically ambiguous template images can be restored to improve multi-modal features in the generative fusion paradigm. Experiments show that our method establishes a new state-of-the-art on multiple benchmarks and achieves an impressive inference speed. The code and models will be released at: https://github.com/Confetti-lxy/GLAD
summary_zh: 视觉-语言跟踪在许多场景中日益受到关注。此任务同时处理视觉和语言信息，以在视频中定位目标。尽管其应用日益广泛，但视觉-语言跟踪方法的开发仍处于早期阶段。当前的视觉-语言跟踪器通常采用Transformer架构来交互式地整合模板、搜索和文本特征。然而，包括普遍存在的图像模糊、低分辨率等低语义图像带来的持续挑战，可能会通过降低跨模态理解来损害模型性能。为了解决这个问题，通常利用语言辅助来处理低语义图像带来的障碍。然而，由于当前文本和视觉特征之间存在差距，直接连接和融合这些特征可能效果有限。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了一种开创性的生成式语言辅助跟踪模型，GLAD，该模型利用扩散模型对文本描述和模板图像进行生成式多模态融合，以增强语言和图像之间的兼容性，并提升模板图像的语义信息。我们的方法展示了优于现有融合范式的显著改进。模糊和语义模糊的模板图像可以被恢复，以在生成式融合范式中改善多模态特征。实验表明，我们的方法在多个基准测试上建立了新的最优性能，并实现了令人印象深刻的推理速度。代码和模型将在以下网址发布： https://github.com/Confetti-lxy/GLAD
tldr: GLAD introduces a generative language-assisted visual tracking model using diffusion models to enhance cross-modal understanding by improving the compatibility between language and blurry, low-resolution template images, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: GLAD 提出了一种生成式语言辅助视觉跟踪模型，利用扩散模型通过提高语言和模糊、低分辨率模板图像之间的兼容性来增强跨模态理解，从而实现最先进的结果。

title: DuoGen: Towards General Purpose Interleaved Multimodal Generation
summary: Interleaved multimodal generation enables capabilities beyond unimodal generation models, such as step-by-step instructional guides, visual planning, and generating visual drafts for reasoning. However, the quality of existing interleaved generation models under general instructions remains limited by insufficient training data and base model capacity.
