We present DuoGen, a general-purpose interleaved generation framework that systematically addresses data curation, architecture design, and evaluation. On the data side, we build a large-scale, high-quality instruction-tuning dataset by combining multimodal conversations rewritten from curated raw websites, and diverse synthetic examples covering everyday scenarios. Architecturally, DuoGen leverages the strong visual understanding of a pretrained multimodal LLM and the visual generation capabilities of a diffusion transformer (DiT) pretrained on video generation, avoiding costly unimodal pretraining and enabling flexible base model selection. A two-stage decoupled strategy first instruction-tunes the MLLM, then aligns DiT with it using curated interleaved image-text sequences. Across public and newly proposed benchmarks, DuoGen outperforms prior open-source models in text quality, image fidelity, and image-context alignment, and also achieves state-of-the-art performance on text-to-image and image editing among unified generation models. Data and code will be released at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/dir/duetgen/.
summary_zh: 交错式多模态生成使得模型能够实现超出单模态生成模型的能力，例如逐步操作指南、视觉规划以及生成用于推理的视觉草图。然而，现有交错式生成模型在通用指令下的质量仍然受到训练数据不足和基础模型容量的限制。我们提出了DuoGen，一个通用的交错式生成框架，系统地解决了数据管理、架构设计和评估问题。在数据方面，我们构建了一个大规模、高质量的指令微调数据集，其结合了从精选原始网站重写的多模态对话以及涵盖日常场景的多样化合成示例。在架构上，DuoGen利用了预训练多模态LLM强大的视觉理解能力和预训练于视频生成的扩散Transformer（DiT）的视觉生成能力，避免了代价高昂的单模态预训练，并实现了灵活的基础模型选择。一个两阶段解耦策略首先对MLLM进行指令微调，然后使用精心设计的交错式图文序列将其与DiT进行对齐。在公共和新提出的基准测试中，DuoGen在文本质量、图像保真度和图像-上下文对齐方面均优于先前的开源模型，并且在统一生成模型中，还在文本到图像和图像编辑方面实现了最先进的性能。 数据和代码将在https://research.nvidia.com/labs/dir/duetgen/上发布。
tldr: DuoGen is a general-purpose interleaved multimodal generation framework that uses a large-scale instruction-tuning dataset and a two-stage training process to achieve state-of-the-art performance in various multimodal generation tasks.
tldr_zh: DuoGen是一个通用多模态交错生成框架，它使用大规模指令调整数据集和两阶段训练过程在各种多模态生成任务中实现了最先进的性能。

title: RGBX-R1: Visual Modality Chain-of-Thought Guided Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Grounding
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLM) are primarily pre-trained on the RGB modality, thereby limiting their performance on other modalities, such as infrared, depth, and event data, which are crucial for complex scenarios. To address this, we propose RGBX-R1, a framework to enhance MLLM's perception and reasoning capacities across various X visual modalities. Specifically, we employ an Understand-Associate-Validate (UAV) prompting strategy to construct the Visual Modality Chain-of-Thought (VM-CoT), which aims to expand the MLLMs' RGB understanding capability into X modalities. To progressively enhance reasoning capabilities, we introduce a two-stage training paradigm: Cold-Start Supervised Fine-Tuning (CS-SFT) and Spatio-Temporal Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (ST-RFT). CS-SFT supervises the reasoning process with the guidance of VM-CoT, equipping the MLLM with fundamental modality cognition. Building upon GRPO, ST-RFT employs a Modality-understanding Spatio-Temporal (MuST) reward to reinforce modality reasoning. Notably, we construct the first RGBX-Grounding benchmark, and extensive experiments verify our superiority in multimodal understanding and spatial perception, outperforming baselines by 22.71% on three RGBX grounding tasks.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）主要基于RGB模态进行预训练，这限制了它们在其他模态上的性能，如红外、深度和事件数据，这些模态对于复杂场景至关重要。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了RGBX-R1，一个旨在增强MLLM在各种X视觉模态上的感知和推理能力的框架。具体来说，我们采用一种理解-关联-验证（UAV）提示策略来构建视觉模态思维链（VM-CoT），旨在将MLLM的RGB理解能力扩展到X模态。为了逐步增强推理能力，我们引入了一个两阶段训练范式：冷启动监督微调（CS-SFT）和时空强化微调（ST-RFT）。CS-SFT在VM-CoT的指导下监督推理过程，赋予MLLM基础的模态认知能力。基于GRPO，ST-RFT采用一种模态理解时空（MuST）奖励来强化模态推理。值得注意的是，我们构建了第一个RGBX-Grounding基准，并通过广泛的实验验证了我们在多模态理解和空间感知方面的优越性，在三个RGBX grounding任务上优于基线22.71%。
tldr: The paper introduces RGBX-R1, a framework that enhances MLLM's perception and reasoning across different visual modalities using Visual Modality Chain-of-Thought guided Reinforcement Learning, demonstrating improved performance on RGBX grounding tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RGBX-R1，一个框架，利用视觉模态链式思考引导的强化学习来增强MLLM在不同视觉模态中的感知和推理能力，并在RGBX接地的任务中展示了性能的提升。

title: PSGS: Text-driven Panorama Sliding Scene Generation via Gaussian Splatting
summary: Generating realistic 3D scenes from text is crucial for immersive applications like VR, AR, and gaming. While text-driven approaches promise efficiency, existing methods suffer from limited 3D-text data and inconsistent multi-view stitching, resulting in overly simplistic scenes. To address this, we propose PSGS, a two-stage framework for high-fidelity panoramic scene generation. First, a novel two-layer optimization architecture generates semantically coherent panoramas: a layout reasoning layer parses text into structured spatial relationships, while a self-optimization layer refines visual details via iterative MLLM feedback. Second, our panorama sliding mechanism initializes globally consistent 3D Gaussian Splatting point clouds by strategically sampling overlapping perspectives. By incorporating depth and semantic coherence losses during training, we greatly improve the quality and detail fidelity of rendered scenes. Our experiments demonstrate that PSGS outperforms existing methods in panorama generation and produces more appealing 3D scenes, offering a robust solution for scalable immersive content creation.
summary_zh: 从文本生成逼真的3D场景对于虚拟现实、增强现实和游戏等沉浸式应用至关重要。虽然文本驱动的方法具有高效的潜力，但现有方法受限于3D文本数据的匮乏以及多视角拼接的不一致性，导致场景过于简单。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了PSGS，一个用于高保真全景场景生成的两阶段框架。首先，一种新颖的双层优化架构生成语义连贯的全景图：布局推理层将文本解析成结构化的空间关系，而自优化层通过迭代的MLLM反馈来细化视觉细节。其次，我们的全景滑动机制通过策略性地采样重叠的视角，初始化全局一致的3D高斯泼溅点云。通过在训练过程中加入深度和语义一致性损失，我们极大地提高了渲染场景的质量和细节保真度。我们的实验表明，PSGS在全景图生成方面优于现有方法，并且能够生成更吸引人的3D场景，为可扩展的沉浸式内容创作提供了一个强大的解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces PSGS, a two-stage framework using Gaussian Splatting to generate high-fidelity panoramic 3D scenes from text, addressing limitations of existing text-to-3D methods by improving panorama generation and 3D scene quality.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 PSGS，一个两阶段框架，它使用高斯溅射从文本生成高保真全景 3D 场景，通过改进全景生成和 3D 场景质量来解决现有文本到 3D 方法的局限性。

title: Toward Autonomous Laboratory Safety Monitoring with Vision Language Models: Learning to See Hazards Through Scene Structure
summary: Laboratories are prone to severe injuries from minor unsafe actions, yet continuous safety monitoring -- beyond mandatory pre-lab safety training -- is limited by human availability. Vision language models (VLMs) offer promise for autonomous laboratory safety monitoring, but their effectiveness in realistic settings is unclear due to the lack of visual evaluation data, as most safety incidents are documented primarily as unstructured text. To address this gap, we first introduce a structured data generation pipeline that converts textual laboratory scenarios into aligned triples of (image, scene graph, ground truth), using large language models as scene graph architects and image generation models as renderers. Our experiments on the synthetic dataset of 1,207 samples across 362 unique scenarios and seven open- and closed-source models show that VLMs perform effectively given textual scene graph, but degrade substantially in visual-only settings indicating difficulty in extracting structured object relationships directly from pixels. To overcome this, we propose a post-training context-engineering approach, scene-graph-guided alignment, to bridge perceptual gaps in VLMs by translating visual inputs into structured scene graphs better aligned with VLM reasoning, improving hazard detection performance in visual only settings.
summary_zh: 实验室易因微小的不安全行为而发生严重事故，然而，除了强制性的实验前安全培训外，持续的安全监控因人力资源的限制而受到限制。视觉语言模型（VLM）为自主实验室安全监控提供了希望，但由于缺乏视觉评估数据，它们在实际环境中的有效性尚不明确，因为大多数安全事故主要以非结构化文本形式记录。为了弥补这一差距，我们首先引入了一个结构化数据生成流程，该流程使用大型语言模型作为场景图架构师，图像生成模型作为渲染器，将文本实验室场景转换为对齐的（图像、场景图、真值）三元组。我们对包含362个独特场景和七个开源及闭源模型的1,207个合成样本数据集进行的实验表明，VLMs在给定文本场景图的情况下表现有效，但在纯视觉设置中性能显著下降，这表明它们在直接从像素中提取结构化对象关系方面存在困难。为了克服这一点，我们提出了一种后训练上下文工程方法，即场景图引导的对齐，通过将视觉输入转换为与VLM推理更好地对齐的结构化场景图来弥合VLMs的感知差距，从而提高纯视觉设置中的危害检测性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a pipeline to generate synthetic data for training VLMs to detect safety hazards in lab environments and proposes a scene-graph-guided alignment method to improve VLM performance in visual-only settings.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个生成合成数据的流程，用于训练视觉语言模型来检测实验室环境中的安全隐患，并提出了一种场景图引导的对齐方法，以提高视觉语言模型在纯视觉环境中的性能。

title: Equilibrium of Feasible Zone and Uncertain Model in Safe Exploration
summary: Ensuring the safety of environmental exploration is a critical problem in reinforcement learning (RL). While limiting exploration to a feasible zone has become widely accepted as a way to ensure safety, key questions remain unresolved: what is the maximum feasible zone achievable through exploration, and how can it be identified? This paper, for the first time, answers these questions by revealing that the goal of safe exploration is to find the equilibrium between the feasible zone and the environment model. This conclusion is based on the understanding that these two components are interdependent: a larger feasible zone leads to a more accurate environment model, and a more accurate model, in turn, enables exploring a larger zone. We propose the first equilibrium-oriented safe exploration framework called safe equilibrium exploration (SEE), which alternates between finding the maximum feasible zone and the least uncertain model. Using a graph formulation of the uncertain model, we prove that the uncertain model obtained by SEE is monotonically refined, the feasible zones monotonically expand, and both converge to the equilibrium of safe exploration. Experiments on classic control tasks show that our algorithm successfully expands the feasible zones with zero constraint violation, and achieves the equilibrium of safe exploration within a few iterations.
summary_zh: 保障环境探索的安全性是强化学习(RL)中的一个关键问题。虽然将探索限制在可行区域内已成为确保安全性的广泛接受的方法，但关键问题仍然悬而未决：通过探索可以实现的最大可行区域是什么？以及如何识别该区域？本文首次解答了这些问题，揭示了安全探索的目标是找到可行区域和环境模型之间的平衡。该结论基于对这两个组成部分之间相互依赖性的理解：更大的可行区域会带来更准确的环境模型，而更准确的模型反过来又能够探索更大的区域。我们提出了第一个面向平衡的安全探索框架，称为安全平衡探索 (SEE)，它在寻找最大可行区域和最小不确定性模型之间交替进行。利用不确定模型的图表示，我们证明了通过 SEE 获得的不确定模型是单调精化的，可行区域是单调扩张的，并且两者都收敛到安全探索的平衡。对经典控制任务的实验表明，我们的算法成功地扩展了可行区域，且约束违反为零，并在几个迭代内实现了安全探索的平衡。
tldr: This paper proposes a Safe Equilibrium Exploration (SEE) framework for reinforcement learning that alternates between finding the maximum feasible zone and the least uncertain environment model to achieve safe exploration with zero constraint violations. They theoretically prove convergence and demonstrate it empirically on classic control tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种安全均衡探索（SEE）框架，用于强化学习，该框架交替寻找最大可行区域和最不确定的环境模型，以实现零约束违反的安全探索。他们从理论上证明了收敛性，并在经典控制任务上进行了经验验证。

title: AREAL-DTA: Dynamic Tree Attention for Efficient Reinforcement Learning of Large Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) based post-training for large language models (LLMs) is computationally expensive, as it generates many rollout sequences that could frequently share long token prefixes. Existing RL frameworks usually process these sequences independently, repeatedly recomputing identical prefixes during forward and backward passes during policy model training, leading to substantial inefficiencies in computation and memory usage. Although prefix sharing naturally induces a tree structure over rollouts, prior tree-attention-based solutions rely on fully materialized attention masks and scale poorly in RL settings. In this paper, we introduce AREAL-DTA to efficiently exploit prefix sharing in RL training. AREAL-DTA employs a depth-first-search (DFS)-based execution strategy that dynamically traverses the rollout prefix tree during both forward and backward computation, materializing only a single root-to-leaf path at a time. To further improve scalability, AREAL-DTA incorporates a load-balanced distributed batching mechanism that dynamically constructs and processes prefix trees across multiple GPUs. Across the popular RL post-training workload, AREAL-DTA achieves up to $8.31\times$ in $τ^2$-bench higher training throughput.
summary_zh: 基于强化学习（RL）的大语言模型（LLM）后训练计算代价高昂，因为它生成了大量可能频繁共享长token前缀的展开序列。现有的RL框架通常独立处理这些序列，在策略模型训练期间的前向和反向传播过程中重复计算相同的前缀，导致计算和内存使用效率低下。虽然前缀共享自然地在展开序列上产生树结构，但先前的基于树注意力（tree-attention）的解决方案依赖于完全物化的注意力掩码，并且在RL设置中扩展性差。在本文中，我们引入了AREAL-DTA，以有效利用RL训练中的前缀共享。AREAL-DTA采用基于深度优先搜索（DFS）的执行策略，在正向和反向计算期间动态遍历展开前缀树，一次只物化一条从根到叶的路径。为了进一步提高可扩展性，AREAL-DTA 整合了一种负载均衡的分布式批处理机制，该机制跨多个GPU动态构建和处理前缀树。在流行的RL后训练工作负载上，AREAL-DTA 在$τ^2$-bench中实现了高达$8.31\times$ 的更高训练吞吐量。
tldr: The paper introduces AREAL-DTA, a method to efficiently train LLMs via Reinforcement Learning by exploiting prefix sharing in rollout sequences using a dynamic tree attention mechanism, achieving significant throughput improvements.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 AREAL-DTA，一种通过利用rollout序列中的前缀共享，使用动态树注意力机制来高效训练 LLM 的方法，从而显著提高训练吞吐量。

title: Search Inspired Exploration in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Exploration in environments with sparse rewards remains a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning (RL). Existing approaches such as curriculum learning and Go-Explore often rely on hand-crafted heuristics, while curiosity-driven methods risk converging to suboptimal policies. We propose Search-Inspired Exploration in Reinforcement Learning (SIERL), a novel method that actively guides exploration by setting sub-goals based on the agent's learning progress. At the beginning of each episode, SIERL chooses a sub-goal from the \textit{frontier} (the boundary of the agent's known state space), before the agent continues exploring toward the main task objective. The key contribution of our method is the sub-goal selection mechanism, which provides state-action pairs that are neither overly familiar nor completely novel. Thus, it assures that the frontier is expanded systematically and that the agent is capable of reaching any state within it. Inspired by search, sub-goals are prioritized from the frontier based on estimates of cost-to-come and cost-to-go, effectively steering exploration towards the most informative regions. In experiments on challenging sparse-reward environments, SIERL outperforms dominant baselines in both achieving the main task goal and generalizing to reach arbitrary states in the environment.
summary_zh: 在稀疏奖励环境中探索仍然是强化学习（RL）的一项根本挑战。现有的方法，如课程学习和Go-Explore，通常依赖于手工设计的启发式算法，而好奇心驱动的方法则有收敛到次优策略的风险。我们提出了一种在强化学习中受搜索启发的探索方法（SIERL），该方法通过基于智能体的学习进度设置子目标来主动引导探索。在每个episode开始时，SIERL从\textit{frontier}（智能体已知状态空间的边界）中选择一个子目标，然后智能体继续探索以实现主要任务目标。我们方法的主要贡献是子目标选择机制，该机制提供了既不太熟悉也不完全新颖的状态-动作对。因此，它确保了frontier被系统地扩展，并且智能体能够到达其中的任何状态。受搜索的启发，子目标根据达到当前状态的代价（cost-to-come）和达到目标的代价（cost-to-go）的估计值，从frontier中优先级排序，从而有效地将探索引导向信息量最大的区域。在具有挑战性的稀疏奖励环境中的实验表明，SIERL在实现主要任务目标和泛化到环境中的任意状态方面都优于主要的基线方法。
tldr: The paper introduces SIERL, a novel RL exploration method that leverages search-inspired sub-goal selection to efficiently explore sparse-reward environments by systematically expanding the agent's known state space.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SIERL，一种新颖的RL探索方法，它利用受搜索启发的子目标选择来有效地探索稀疏奖励环境，并通过系统地扩展智能体已知的状态空间。

title: SyNeT: Synthetic Negatives for Traversability Learning
summary: Reliable traversability estimation is crucial for autonomous robots to navigate complex outdoor environments safely. Existing self-supervised learning frameworks primarily rely on positive and unlabeled data; however, the lack of explicit negative data remains a critical limitation, hindering the model's ability to accurately identify diverse non-traversable regions. To address this issue, we introduce a method to explicitly construct synthetic negatives, representing plausible but non-traversable, and integrate them into vision-based traversability learning. Our approach is formulated as a training strategy that can be seamlessly integrated into both Positive-Unlabeled (PU) and Positive-Negative (PN) frameworks without modifying inference architectures. Complementing standard pixel-wise metrics, we introduce an object-centric FPR evaluation approach that analyzes predictions in regions where synthetic negatives are inserted. This evaluation provides an indirect measure of the model's ability to consistently identify non-traversable regions without additional manual labeling. Extensive experiments on both public and self-collected datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances robustness and generalization across diverse environments. The source code and demonstration videos are publicly available at the project page: https://anonymous-synet.github.io/SyNet.github.io/
summary_zh: 可靠的可通行性估计对于自主机器人在复杂户外环境中安全导航至关重要。 现有的自监督学习框架主要依赖于正例和未标记数据；然而，缺乏显式的负例数据仍然是一个关键限制，阻碍了模型准确识别各种不可通行区域的能力。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出一种方法来显式地构建合成负例，代表看似合理但不可通行的区域，并将它们整合到基于视觉的可通行性学习中。 我们的方法被设计为一种训练策略，可以无缝地集成到正例-未标记（PU）和正例-负例（PN）框架中，而无需修改推理架构。 作为对标准像素级指标的补充，我们引入了一种以对象为中心的FPR评估方法，该方法分析合成负例插入区域的预测。 这种评估提供了一种间接度量，可以衡量模型在没有额外手动标注的情况下一致识别不可通行区域的能力。 在公共数据集和自采集数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法显著提高了在不同环境中的鲁棒性和泛化能力。 源代码和演示视频可在项目页面公开获取：https://anonymous-synet.github.io/SyNet.github.io/
tldr: The paper introduces SyNeT, a training strategy that uses synthetic negative data to improve the accuracy of vision-based traversability learning for autonomous robots, demonstrating enhanced robustness and generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SyNeT，一种使用合成负数据的训练策略，旨在提高自主机器人中基于视觉的可通行性学习的准确性，并展示了更强的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: Factored Reasoning with Inner Speech and Persistent Memory for Evidence-Grounded Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Dialogue-based human-robot interaction requires robot cognitive assistants to maintain persistent user context, recover from underspecified requests, and ground responses in external evidence, while keeping intermediate decisions verifiable. In this paper we introduce JANUS, a cognitive architecture for assistive robots that models interaction as a partially observable Markov decision process and realizes control as a factored controller with typed interfaces. To this aim, Janus (i) decomposes the overall behavior into specialized modules, related to scope detection, intent recognition, memory, inner speech, query generation, and outer speech, and (ii) exposes explicit policies for information sufficiency, execution readiness, and tool grounding. A dedicated memory agent maintains a bounded recent-history buffer, a compact core memory, and an archival store with semantic retrieval, coupled through controlled consolidation and revision policies. Models inspired by the notion of inner speech in cognitive theories provide a control-oriented internal textual flow that validates parameter completeness and triggers clarification before grounding, while a faithfulness constraint ties robot-to-human claims to an evidence bundle combining working context and retrieved tool outputs. We evaluate JANUS through module-level unit tests in a dietary assistance domain grounded on a knowledge graph, reporting high agreement with curated references and practical latency profiles. These results support factored reasoning as a promising path to scalable, auditable, and evidence-grounded robot assistance over extended interaction horizons.
summary_zh: 基于对话的人机交互要求机器人认知助手维持持久的用户上下文，从欠规格请求中恢复，并将响应锚定于外部证据，同时保持中间决策的可验证性。在本文中，我们介绍JANUS，一种用于辅助机器人的认知架构，它将交互建模为部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程，并将控制实现为具有类型化接口的分解控制器。为此，Janus (i) 将整体行为分解为专门的模块，涉及范围检测、意图识别、记忆、内心言语、查询生成和外部言语，以及 (ii) 公开了用于信息充分性、执行准备就绪和工具锚定的显式策略。一个专门的记忆代理维护一个有界限的近期历史缓冲区、一个紧凑的核心记忆和一个带有语义检索的存档存储，通过受控的整合和修订策略进行耦合。受认知理论内心言语概念启发的模型提供了一个面向控制的内部文本流，该文本流验证参数完整性并在锚定之前触发澄清，同时真实性约束将机器人对人类的声明与一个证据包绑定，该证据包结合了工作上下文和检索到的工具输出。我们在基于知识图谱的膳食辅助领域中通过模块级单元测试评估JANUS，报告了与精选参考资料的高度一致性和实际的延迟配置文件。这些结果表明，分解推理是实现可扩展、可审计且基于证据的机器人辅助的一种有前景的途径，尤其是在较长的交互时间范围内。
tldr: The paper introduces JANUS, a cognitive architecture for assistive robots that uses factored reasoning, inner speech, and persistent memory to enable evidence-grounded and auditable human-robot interaction, evaluated in a dietary assistance domain.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为JANUS的认知架构，用于辅助机器人。该架构利用分解推理、内在语音和持久记忆，以实现基于证据且可审计的人机交互。该架构已在膳食辅助领域进行了评估。

title: Stealthy Coverage Control for Human-enabled Real-Time 3D Reconstruction
summary: In this paper, we propose a novel semi-autonomous image sampling strategy, called stealthy coverage control, for human-enabled 3D structure reconstruction. The present mission involves a fundamental problem: while the number of images required to accurately reconstruct a 3D model depends on the structural complexity of the target scene to be reconstructed, it is not realistic to assume prior knowledge of the spatially non-uniform structural complexity. We approach this issue by leveraging human flexible reasoning and situational recognition capabilities. Specifically, we design a semi-autonomous system that leaves identification of regions that need more images and navigation of the drones to such regions to a human operator. To this end, we first present a way to reflect the human intention in autonomous coverage control. Subsequently, in order to avoid operational conflicts between manual control and autonomous coverage control, we develop the stealthy coverage control that decouples the drone motion for efficient image sampling from navigation by the human. Simulation studies on a Unity/ROS2-based simulator demonstrate that the present semi-autonomous system outperforms the one without human interventions in the sense of the reconstructed model quality.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的半自主图像采样策略，称为隐蔽覆盖控制，用于人机协同的3D结构重建。当前的任务涉及一个根本问题：准确重建三维模型所需的图像数量取决于待重建目标场景的结构复杂性，但假设预先了解空间上非均匀的结构复杂性是不现实的。我们通过利用人类灵活的推理和情境识别能力来解决这个问题。具体而言，我们设计了一个半自主系统，将识别需要更多图像的区域以及引导无人机到这些区域的任务留给人工操作员。为此，我们首先提出了一种在自主覆盖控制中反映人类意图的方法。随后，为了避免人工控制与自主覆盖控制之间的操作冲突，我们开发了隐蔽覆盖控制，将无人机用于高效图像采样的运动与人工导航分离。基于Unity/ROS2的模拟器上的仿真研究表明，在重建模型质量方面，本文提出的半自主系统优于没有人工干预的系统。
tldr: This paper presents a semi-autonomous drone system for 3D reconstruction that leverages human input to guide image sampling ensuring adequate coverage of structurally complex regions without prior knowledge. The system features 'stealthy coverage control' to decouple the human input from the autonomous image sampling process.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种半自主无人机系统，用于3D重建，该系统利用人工输入引导图像采样，确保充分覆盖结构复杂的区域，无需先验知识。该系统具有“隐蔽覆盖控制”，可将人为输入与自主图像采样过程分离。

title: IRL-DAL: Safe and Adaptive Trajectory Planning for Autonomous Driving via Energy-Guided Diffusion Models
summary: This paper proposes a novel inverse reinforcement learning framework using a diffusion-based adaptive lookahead planner (IRL-DAL) for autonomous vehicles. Training begins with imitation from an expert finite state machine (FSM) controller to provide a stable initialization. Environment terms are combined with an IRL discriminator signal to align with expert goals. Reinforcement learning (RL) is then performed with a hybrid reward that combines diffuse environmental feedback and targeted IRL rewards. A conditional diffusion model, which acts as a safety supervisor, plans safe paths. It stays in its lane, avoids obstacles, and moves smoothly. Then, a learnable adaptive mask (LAM) improves perception. It shifts visual attention based on vehicle speed and nearby hazards. After FSM-based imitation, the policy is fine-tuned with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Training is run in the Webots simulator with a two-stage curriculum. A 96\% success rate is reached, and collisions are reduced to 0.05 per 1k steps, marking a new benchmark for safe navigation. By applying the proposed approach, the agent not only drives in lane but also handles unsafe conditions at an expert level, increasing robustness.We make our code publicly available.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于扩散的自适应前瞻规划器的逆强化学习框架（IRL-DAL），用于自动驾驶车辆。训练始于模仿专家有限状态机（FSM）控制器，以提供稳定的初始化。环境项与IRL判别器信号相结合，使其与专家目标对齐。然后，使用混合奖励执行强化学习（RL），该混合奖励结合了扩散环境反馈和目标明确的IRL奖励。条件扩散模型充当安全监督器，规划安全路径，保持在车道内，避开障碍物，并平稳移动。此外，可学习自适应掩码（LAM）改进了感知，根据车辆速度和附近危险转移视觉注意力。在基于FSM的模仿之后，使用近端策略优化（PPO）对策略进行微调。训练在Webots模拟器中以两阶段课程进行。成功率达到96％，碰撞次数降低至每千步0.05次，标志着安全导航的新基准。通过应用所提出的方法，智能体不仅能在车道内行驶，还能专家级地处理不安全状况，从而提高鲁棒性。我们公开了我们的代码。
tldr: This paper introduces IRL-DAL, a novel inverse reinforcement learning framework using diffusion models for safe and adaptive autonomous driving, achieving high success rates and reduced collisions in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的逆强化学习框架IRL-DAL，它使用扩散模型进行安全和自适应的自动驾驶，在模拟中实现了高成功率并减少了碰撞。

title: Multi-Objective Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization with Causal Priors
summary: Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization (MFBO) accelerates the search for the global optimum of black-box functions by integrating inexpensive, low-fidelity approximations. The central task of an MFBO policy is to balance the cost-efficiency of low-fidelity proxies against their reduced accuracy to ensure effective progression toward the high-fidelity optimum. Existing MFBO methods primarily capture associational dependencies between inputs, fidelities, and objectives, rather than causal mechanisms, and can perform poorly when lower-fidelity proxies are poorly aligned with the target fidelity. We propose RESCUE (REducing Sampling cost with Causal Understanding and Estimation), a multi-objective MFBO method that incorporates causal calculus to systematically address this challenge. RESCUE learns a structural causal model capturing causal relationships between inputs, fidelities, and objectives, and uses it to construct a probabilistic multi-fidelity (MF) surrogate that encodes intervention effects. Exploiting the causal structure, we introduce a causal hypervolume knowledge-gradient acquisition strategy to select input-fidelity pairs that balance expected multi-objective improvement and cost. We show that RESCUE improves sample efficiency over state-of-the-art MF optimization methods on synthetic and real-world problems in robotics, machine learning (AutoML), and healthcare.
summary_zh: 多保真度贝叶斯优化（MFBO）通过整合廉价的低保真度近似，加速对黑盒函数全局最优值的搜索。MFBO策略的核心任务是在低保真度代理的成本效益与其降低的精度之间取得平衡，以确保有效逼近高保真度最优值。现有的MFBO方法主要捕捉输入、保真度和目标之间的关联依赖关系，而不是因果机制，并且当较低保真度代理与目标保真度对齐较差时，其性能可能不佳。我们提出RESCUE（通过因果理解和估计降低采样成本），这是一种多目标MFBO方法，它结合了因果微积分来系统地应对这一挑战。RESCUE学习一个结构因果模型，捕捉输入、保真度和目标之间的因果关系，并利用它构建一个编码干预效应的概率多保真度（MF）代理模型。通过利用因果结构，我们引入了一种因果超体积知识梯度获取策略，用于选择平衡预期多目标改进和成本的输入-保真度对。我们证明，在机器人、机器学习（AutoML）和医疗保健领域的合成和实际问题中，RESCUE比最先进的MF优化方法提高了样本效率。
tldr: This paper introduces RESCUE, a multi-objective multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization method that uses causal calculus to improve sample efficiency by learning causal relationships between inputs, fidelities, and objectives, and demonstrates its effectiveness in robotics, AutoML, and healthcare.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 RESCUE 的多目标多精度贝叶斯优化方法，该方法利用因果微积分，通过学习输入、精度和目标之间的因果关系来提高样本效率，并在机器人、AutoML 和医疗保健等领域展示了其有效性。

title: Action-Free Offline-to-Online RL via Discretised State Policies
summary: Most existing offline RL methods presume the availability of action labels within the dataset, but in many practical scenarios, actions may be missing due to privacy, storage, or sensor limitations. We formalise the setting of action-free offline-to-online RL, where agents must learn from datasets consisting solely of $(s,r,s')$ tuples and later leverage this knowledge during online interaction. To address this challenge, we propose learning state policies that recommend desirable next-state transitions rather than actions. Our contributions are twofold. First, we introduce a simple yet novel state discretisation transformation and propose Offline State-Only DecQN (\algo), a value-based algorithm designed to pre-train state policies from action-free data. \algo{} integrates the transformation to scale efficiently to high-dimensional problems while avoiding instability and overfitting associated with continuous state prediction. Second, we propose a novel mechanism for guided online learning that leverages these pre-trained state policies to accelerate the learning of online agents. Together, these components establish a scalable and practical framework for leveraging action-free datasets to accelerate online RL. Empirical results across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that our approach improves convergence speed and asymptotic performance, while analyses reveal that discretisation and regularisation are critical to its effectiveness.
summary_zh: 大多数现有的离线强化学习方法假定数据集中存在动作标签，但在许多实际场景中，由于隐私、存储或传感器限制，动作可能会缺失。我们形式化了无动作离线到在线强化学习的设定，其中智能体必须从仅包含 (s,r,s') 元组的数据集学习，并在后续的在线交互中利用这些知识。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出学习状态策略，该策略推荐期望的下一个状态转移，而不是动作。我们的贡献有两方面。首先，我们引入了一种简单但新颖的状态离散化变换，并提出了离线状态唯一DecQN（\algo），一种基于价值的算法，旨在从无动作数据中预训练状态策略。\algo{}集成了该变换，以高效地扩展到高维问题，同时避免与连续状态预测相关的非稳定性和过拟合。其次，我们提出了一种新颖的引导式在线学习机制，该机制利用这些预训练的状态策略来加速在线智能体的学习。这些组件共同建立了一个可扩展且实用的框架，用于利用无动作数据集来加速在线强化学习。在各种基准测试上的经验结果表明，我们的方法提高了收敛速度和渐近性能，而分析表明离散化和正则化对其有效性至关重要。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel offline-to-online RL approach, Offline State-Only DecQN (OSDecQN), that learns from action-free datasets by predicting desirable next states and uses this knowledge to accelerate online learning, demonstrating improved convergence and performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新颖的离线到在线强化学习方法，Offline State-Only DecQN (OSDecQN)，该方法通过预测期望的下一个状态从无动作数据集中学习，并利用这些知识来加速在线学习，实验结果表明收敛速度和性能均有所提高。

title: Convergent World Representations and Divergent Tasks
summary: While neural representations are central to modern deep learning, the conditions governing their geometry and their roles in downstream adaptability remain poorly understood. We develop a framework clearly separating the underlying world, the data generation process and the resulting model representations to study these questions in a controlled setup. 5,075 city coordinates define the world and 7 geometric tasks generate the training data for autoregressive training. We find that different tasks give rise to qualitatively and quantitatively distinct world representation geometries. However, multi-task training drives convergence of world representations: models trained on non-overlapping tasks develop aligned geometric representations, providing controlled evidence for the Multitask Scaling Hypothesis of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis. To study adaptation, we pretrain models on all tasks, then test whether new entities (cities) can be consistently integrated into the representation space via fine-tuning. Surprisingly, we find that despite multi-task pretraining, some tasks, which we call divergent, actively harm the representational integration of new entities and harm generalization. Our results show that training on multiple relational tasks reliably produces convergent world representations, but lurking divergent tasks can catastrophically harm new entity integration via fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 虽然神经表征是现代深度学习的核心，但控制其几何性质及其在下游适应性中的作用的条件仍然知之甚少。我们开发了一个框架，明确地将底层世界、数据生成过程和最终模型表征分离，以便在一个受控的设置中研究这些问题。5075个城市坐标定义了这个世界，7个几何任务生成用于自回归训练的训练数据。我们发现，不同的任务会产生在质量和数量上都不同的世界表征几何性质。然而，多任务训练驱动世界表征的收敛：在非重叠任务上训练的模型会发展出对齐的几何表征，为柏拉图式表征假设的多任务缩放假设提供了受控证据。为了研究适应性，我们首先在所有任务上预训练模型，然后测试是否可以通过微调将新的实体（城市）一致地集成到表征空间中。令人惊讶的是，我们发现，尽管进行了多任务预训练，但一些任务（我们称之为发散任务）会积极损害新实体的表征集成，并损害泛化能力。我们的结果表明，在多个关系型任务上进行训练可以可靠地产生收敛的世界表征，但潜伏的发散任务可能会通过微调灾难性地损害新实体的集成。
tldr: The paper studies how different tasks influence the geometry of world representations learned by neural networks. It identifies convergent and divergent tasks, where divergent tasks can negatively impact the integration of new entities into the representation space.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了不同的任务如何影响神经网络学习到的世界表征的几何结构。它识别了收敛和发散的任务，其中发散的任务会对新实体整合到表征空间中产生负面影响。

title: Quality-Diversity Optimization as Multi-Objective Optimization
summary: The Quality-Diversity (QD) optimization aims to discover a collection of high-performing solutions that simultaneously exhibit diverse behaviors within a user-defined behavior space. This paradigm has stimulated significant research interest and demonstrated practical utility in domains including robot control, creative design, and adversarial sample generation. A variety of QD algorithms with distinct design principles have been proposed in recent years. Instead of proposing a new QD algorithm, this work introduces a novel reformulation by casting the QD optimization as a multi-objective optimization (MOO) problem with a huge number of optimization objectives. By establishing this connection, we enable the direct adoption of well-established MOO methods, particularly set-based scalarization techniques, to solve QD problems through a collaborative search process. We further provide a theoretical analysis demonstrating that our approach inherits theoretical guarantees from MOO while providing desirable properties for the QD optimization. Experimental studies across several QD applications confirm that our method achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art QD algorithms.
summary_zh: 质量-多样性(QD)优化旨在发现一组高性能的解决方案，这些方案在用户定义的行为空间内同时展现出多样的行为。这种范式激发了显著的研究兴趣，并在机器人控制、创意设计和对抗样本生成等领域展示了实用价值。近年来，已经提出了各种具有不同设计原则的QD算法。本文并未提出一种新的QD算法，而是引入了一种新的重构方法，将QD优化转化为一个具有大量优化目标的多目标优化(MOO)问题。通过建立这种联系，我们可以直接采用成熟的MOO方法，特别是基于集合的标量化技术，通过协作搜索过程来解决QD问题。我们进一步提供了理论分析，表明我们的方法继承了MOO的理论保证，同时为QD优化提供了理想的属性。在几个QD应用中的实验研究证实，我们的方法实现了与最先进的QD算法具有竞争力的性能。
tldr: This paper reformulates Quality-Diversity (QD) optimization as a multi-objective optimization (MOO) problem, enabling the use of MOO techniques for QD and demonstrating competitive performance with existing QD algorithms.
tldr_zh: 本文将质量多样性（QD）优化重新表述为多目标优化（MOO）问题，从而可以使用MOO技术来解决QD问题，并展示了与现有QD算法相比具有竞争力的性能。

title: Variational Approach for Job Shop Scheduling
summary: This paper proposes a novel Variational Graph-to-Scheduler (VG2S) framework for solving the Job Shop Scheduling Problem (JSSP), a critical task in manufacturing that directly impacts operational efficiency and resource utilization. Conventional Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) approaches often face challenges such as non-stationarity during training and limited generalization to unseen problem instances because they optimize representation learning and policy execution simultaneously. To address these issues, we introduce variational inference to the JSSP domain for the first time and derive a probabilistic objective based on the Evidence of Lower Bound (ELBO) with maximum entropy reinforcement learning. By mathematically decoupling representation learning from policy optimization, the VG2S framework enables the agent to learn robust structural representations of scheduling instances through a variational graph encoder. This approach significantly enhances training stability and robustness against hyperparameter variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method exhibits superior zero-shot generalization compared with state-of-the-art DRL baselines and traditional dispatching rules, particularly on large-scale and challenging benchmark instances such as DMU and SWV.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的变分图到调度器（VG2S）框架，用于解决作业车间调度问题（JSSP），这是制造业中的一项关键任务，直接影响运营效率和资源利用率。传统的深度强化学习（DRL）方法通常面临训练期间的非平稳性以及对未见问题实例的泛化能力受限等挑战，因为它们同时优化表示学习和策略执行。为了解决这些问题，我们首次将变分推断引入JSSP领域，并基于证据下界（ELBO）推导出一个具有最大熵强化学习的概率目标。通过在数学上将表示学习与策略优化解耦，VG2S框架使智能体能够通过变分图编码器学习调度实例的鲁棒结构表示。这种方法显著提高了训练的稳定性和对超参数变化的鲁棒性。大量实验表明，与最先进的DRL基线和传统的调度规则相比，所提出的方法表现出卓越的零样本泛化能力，尤其是在大规模和具有挑战性的基准实例（如DMU和SWV）上。
tldr: The paper introduces a Variational Graph-to-Scheduler (VG2S) framework for Job Shop Scheduling, using variational inference and maximum entropy RL to decouple representation learning from policy optimization, achieving superior zero-shot generalization compared to DRL baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于作业车间调度的变分图到调度器 (VG2S) 框架，使用变分推理和最大熵 RL 将表征学习与策略优化分离，与 DRL 基线相比，实现了卓越的零样本泛化。

title: Sample Complexity Analysis for Constrained Bilevel Reinforcement Learning
summary: Several important problem settings within the literature of reinforcement learning (RL), such as meta-learning, hierarchical learning, and RL from human feedback (RL-HF), can be modelled as bilevel RL problems. A lot has been achieved in these domains empirically; however, the theoretical analysis of bilevel RL algorithms hasn't received a lot of attention. In this work, we analyse the sample complexity of a constrained bilevel RL algorithm, building on the progress in the unconstrained setting. We obtain an iteration complexity of $O(ε^{-2})$ and sample complexity of $\tilde{O}(ε^{-4})$ for our proposed algorithm, Constrained Bilevel Subgradient Optimization (CBSO). We use a penalty-based objective function to avoid the issue of primal-dual gap and hyper-gradient in the context of a constrained bilevel problem setting. The penalty-based formulation to handle constraints requires analysis of non-smooth optimization. We are the first ones to analyse the generally parameterized policy gradient-based RL algorithm with a non-smooth objective function using the Moreau envelope.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）文献中的几个重要问题设置，例如元学习、分层学习以及从人类反馈中进行强化学习（RL-HF），可以建模为双层RL问题。这些领域在经验上已经取得了很大进展；然而，双层RL算法的理论分析并未受到太多关注。在这项工作中，我们在非约束设置的基础上，分析了一种约束双层RL算法的样本复杂度。对于我们提出的算法，即约束双层次梯度优化（CBSO），我们获得了$O(ε^{-2})$的迭代复杂度和$\tilde{O}(ε^{-4})$的样本复杂度。我们使用基于惩罚的目标函数，以避免在约束双层问题设置中出现原始-对偶间隙和超梯度的问题。处理约束的基于惩罚的公式需要对非光滑优化进行分析。我们是第一个使用Moreau包络分析具有非光滑目标函数的一般参数化策略梯度强化学习算法的。
tldr: This paper provides a sample complexity analysis for a constrained bilevel reinforcement learning algorithm (CBSO), achieving an iteration complexity of $O(ε^{-2})$ and a sample complexity of $\tilde{O}(ε^{-4})$. It addresses the challenge of non-smooth optimization inherent in penalty-based constraint handling.
tldr_zh: 本文针对约束双层强化学习算法(CBSO) 进行了样本复杂度分析，实现了$O(ε^{-2})$的迭代复杂度和$\tilde{O}(ε^{-4})$的样本复杂度。 该研究解决了基于惩罚的约束处理中固有的非光滑优化问题。

title: Model Optimization for Multi-Camera 3D Detection and Tracking
summary: Outside-in multi-camera perception is increasingly important in indoor environments, where networks of static cameras must support multi-target tracking under occlusion and heterogeneous viewpoints. We evaluate Sparse4D, a query-based spatiotemporal 3D detection and tracking framework that fuses multi-view features in a shared world frame and propagates sparse object queries via instance memory. We study reduced input frame rates, post-training quantization (INT8 and FP8), transfer to the WILDTRACK benchmark, and Transformer Engine mixed-precision fine-tuning. To better capture identity stability, we report Average Track Duration (AvgTrackDur), which measures identity persistence in seconds. Sparse4D remains stable under moderate FPS reductions, but below 2 FPS, identity association collapses even when detections are stable. Selective quantization of the backbone and neck offers the best speed-accuracy trade-off, while attention-related modules are consistently sensitive to low precision. On WILDTRACK, low-FPS pretraining yields large zero-shot gains over the base checkpoint, while small-scale fine-tuning provides limited additional benefit. Transformer Engine mixed precision reduces latency and improves camera scalability, but can destabilize identity propagation, motivating stability-aware validation.
summary_zh: 多视角由外向内的感知技术在室内环境中日益重要，在这些环境中，静态相机网络必须支持遮挡和异构视角下的多目标跟踪。我们评估了Sparse4D，这是一个基于查询的空时三维检测和跟踪框架，该框架在共享的世界坐标系中融合多视角特征，并通过实例记忆传播稀疏的对象查询。我们研究了降低的输入帧率、后训练量化（INT8和FP8）、迁移到WILDTRACK基准以及Transformer Engine混合精度微调。为了更好地捕捉身份稳定性，我们报告了平均轨迹持续时间（AvgTrackDur），它以秒为单位测量身份持久性。Sparse4D在中等程度的FPS降低下保持稳定，但低于2 FPS时，即使检测结果稳定，身份关联也会崩溃。骨干网络和颈部的选择性量化提供了最佳的速度-精度权衡，而与注意力相关的模块对低精度始终敏感。在WILDTRACK上，低FPS预训练相对于基础检查点产生了很大的零样本增益，而小规模微调提供的额外收益有限。Transformer Engine混合精度降低了延迟并提高了相机可扩展性，但可能会破坏身份传播，从而促使进行稳定性感知验证。
tldr: The paper explores model optimization techniques (frame rate reduction, quantization, transfer learning, mixed-precision fine-tuning) for a multi-camera 3D detection and tracking framework (Sparse4D), focusing on identity stability challenges in indoor environments.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了多相机3D检测和跟踪框架（Sparse4D）的模型优化技术（帧率降低、量化、迁移学习、混合精度微调），重点关注室内环境中身份识别稳定性挑战。

title: User Prompting Strategies and Prompt Enhancement Methods for Open-Set Object Detection in XR Environments
summary: Open-set object detection (OSOD) localizes objects while identifying and rejecting unknown classes at inference. While recent OSOD models perform well on benchmarks, their behavior under realistic user prompting remains underexplored. In interactive XR settings, user-generated prompts are often ambiguous, underspecified, or overly detailed. To study prompt-conditioned robustness, we evaluate two OSOD models, GroundingDINO and YOLO-E, on real-world XR images and simulate diverse user prompting behaviors using vision-language models. We consider four prompt types: standard, underdetailed, overdetailed, and pragmatically ambiguous, and examine the impact of two enhancement strategies on these prompts. Results show that both models exhibit stable performance under underdetailed and standard prompts, while they suffer degradation under ambiguous prompts. Overdetailed prompts primarily affect GroundingDINO. Prompt enhancement substantially improves robustness under ambiguity, yielding gains exceeding 55% mIoU and 41% average confidence. Based on the findings, we propose several prompting strategies and prompt enhancement methods for OSOD models in XR environments.
summary_zh: 开放集目标检测(OSOD)在推理时定位目标的同时识别并拒绝未知类别。虽然近期的OSOD模型在基准测试上表现良好，但它们在现实用户提示下的行为仍然欠缺研究。在交互式XR环境中，用户生成的提示通常是模糊的、欠规格的或过度详细的。为了研究提示条件下的鲁棒性，我们评估了两个OSOD模型，GroundingDINO和YOLO-E，在真实世界的XR图像上，并使用视觉-语言模型模拟了多样化的用户提示行为。我们考虑了四种提示类型：标准、欠细节、过细节和语用上模糊，并考察了两种增强策略对这些提示的影响。结果表明，两个模型在欠细节和标准提示下表现出稳定的性能，而在模糊提示下性能下降。过细节提示主要影响GroundingDINO。提示增强显着提高了在模糊性下的鲁棒性，产生了超过55% mIoU和41%平均置信度的增益。基于这些发现，我们为XR环境中的OSOD模型提出了一些提示策略和提示增强方法。
tldr: This paper investigates the impact of different user prompting strategies on open-set object detection models in XR environments, finding that ambiguous prompts degrade performance and enhancement strategies can improve robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了不同用户提示策略对XR环境中开放集目标检测模型的影响，发现模糊提示会降低性能，而增强策略可以提高鲁棒性。

title: Fast Non-Episodic Finite-Horizon RL with K-Step Lookahead Thresholding
summary: Online reinforcement learning in non-episodic, finite-horizon MDPs remains underexplored and is challenged by the need to estimate returns to a fixed terminal time. Existing infinite-horizon methods, which often rely on discounted contraction, do not naturally account for this fixed-horizon structure. We introduce a modified Q-function: rather than targeting the full-horizon, we learn a K-step lookahead Q-function that truncates planning to the next K steps. To further improve sample efficiency, we introduce a thresholding mechanism: actions are selected only when their estimated K-step lookahead value exceeds a time-varying threshold. We provide an efficient tabular learning algorithm for this novel objective, proving it achieves fast finite-sample convergence: it achieves minimax optimal constant regret for $K=1$ and $\mathcal{O}(\max((K-1),C_{K-1})\sqrt{SAT\log(T)})$ regret for any $K \geq 2$. We numerically evaluate the performance of our algorithm under the objective of maximizing reward. Our implementation adaptively increases K over time, balancing lookahead depth against estimation variance. Empirical results demonstrate superior cumulative rewards over state-of-the-art tabular RL methods across synthetic MDPs and RL environments: JumpRiverswim, FrozenLake and AnyTrading.
summary_zh: 非情节性、有限视野MDP中的在线强化学习仍然未被充分探索，并且面临着估计到固定终止时间的收益的挑战。现有的无限视野方法，通常依赖于折扣收缩，无法自然地解释这种固定视野结构。我们引入了一种改进的Q函数：我们不以整个视野为目标，而是学习一个K步前瞻Q函数，将规划截断到接下来的K步。为了进一步提高样本效率，我们引入了一种阈值机制：只有当动作的估计K步前瞻值超过一个随时间变化的阈值时才会被选择。我们为这个新颖的目标提供了一个高效的表格学习算法，证明它可以实现快速的有限样本收敛：对于$K=1$，它实现了极小极大最优的常数后悔值；对于任何$K \geq 2$，它实现了$\mathcal{O}(\max((K-1),C_{K-1})\sqrt{SAT\log(T)})$的后悔值。我们在最大化奖励的目标下，数值评估了我们算法的性能。我们的实现自适应地随时间增加K，以平衡前瞻深度与估计方差。经验结果表明，在合成MDP和强化学习环境（JumpRiverswim, FrozenLake和AnyTrading）中，我们提出的算法相比于最先进的表格RL方法，具有更优越的累积奖励。
tldr: The paper introduces a K-step lookahead thresholding Q-learning algorithm for non-episodic, finite-horizon RL, achieving strong theoretical regret bounds and demonstrated empirical improvements over existing tabular methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于非情节、有限视界强化学习的 K 步前瞻阈值 Q 学习算法，实现了强大的理论遗憾界限，并在经验上证明了比现有表格方法的改进。

title: Communications-Incentivized Collaborative Reasoning in NetGPT through Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: The evolution of next-Generation (xG) wireless networks marks a paradigm shift from connectivity-centric architectures to Artificial Intelligence (AI)-native designs that tightly integrate data, computing, and communication. Yet existing AI deployments in communication systems remain largely siloed, offering isolated optimizations without intrinsic adaptability, dynamic task delegation, or multi-agent collaboration. In this work, we propose a unified agentic NetGPT framework for AI-native xG networks, wherein a NetGPT core can either perform autonomous reasoning or delegate sub-tasks to domain-specialized agents via agentic communication. The framework establishes clear modular responsibilities and interoperable workflows, enabling scalable, distributed intelligence across the network. To support continual refinement of collaborative reasoning strategies, the framework is further enhanced through Agentic reinforcement learning under partially observable conditions and stochastic external states. The training pipeline incorporates masked loss against external agent uncertainty, entropy-guided exploration, and multi-objective rewards that jointly capture task quality, coordination efficiency, and resource constraints. Through this process, NetGPT learns when and how to collaborate, effectively balancing internal reasoning with agent invocation. Overall, this work provides a foundational architecture and training methodology for self-evolving, AI-native xG networks capable of autonomous sensing, reasoning, and action in complex communication environments.
summary_zh: 下一代(xG)无线网络的演进标志着一个范式转变，即从以连通性为中心的架构转变为原生人工智能(AI)的设计，该设计将数据、计算和通信紧密集成。然而，目前通信系统中部署的AI在很大程度上仍然是孤立的，提供的优化是独立的，缺乏内在的适应性、动态任务委托或多智能体协作。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种统一的代理式NetGPT框架，用于原生AI的xG网络，其中NetGPT核心可以执行自主推理，或通过代理式通信将子任务委托给领域专业智能体。该框架建立了明确的模块化职责和可互操作的工作流程，从而在整个网络中实现可扩展的分布式智能。为了支持协作推理策略的持续改进，该框架通过部分可观测条件和随机外部状态下的代理式强化学习得到进一步增强。训练流程结合了针对外部智能体不确定性的掩码损失、熵引导的探索以及联合捕获任务质量、协调效率和资源约束的多目标奖励。通过这个过程，NetGPT学会了何时以及如何协作，从而有效地平衡了内部推理和智能体调用。总体而言，这项工作为能够自主感知、推理和行动的复杂通信环境中的自进化、原生AI的xG网络提供了一个基础架构和训练方法。
tldr: This paper introduces NetGPT, an agentic reinforcement learning framework for AI-native xG networks, enabling collaborative reasoning among domain-specialized agents through communication and learning. It explores balancing internal reasoning with agent invocation for autonomous sensing, reasoning, and action.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了NetGPT，一个用于AI原生xG网络的基于智能体的强化学习框架，通过通信和学习，实现领域专用智能体之间的协同推理。该框架探索了在自主感知、推理和行动中，平衡内部推理和智能体调用的策略。

title: Safe Langevin Soft Actor Critic
summary: Balancing reward and safety in constrained reinforcement learning remains challenging due to poor generalization from sharp value minima and inadequate handling of heavy-tailed risk distribution. We introduce Safe Langevin Soft Actor-Critic (SL-SAC), a principled algorithm that addresses both issues through parameter-space exploration and distributional risk control. Our approach combines three key mechanisms: (1) Adaptive Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (aSGLD) for reward critics, promoting ensemble diversity and escape from poor optima; (2) distributional cost estimation via Implicit Quantile Networks (IQN) with Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) optimization for tail-risk mitigation; and (3) a reactive Lagrangian relaxation scheme that adapts constraint enforcement based on the empirical CVaR of episodic costs. We provide theoretical guarantees on CVaR estimation error and demonstrate that CVaR-based Lagrange updates yield stronger constraint violation signals than expected-cost updates. On Safety-Gymnasium benchmarks, SL-SAC achieves the lowest cost in 7 out of 10 tasks while maintaining competitive returns, with cost reductions of 19-63% in velocity tasks compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
summary_zh: 受限强化学习中，在奖励和安全性之间取得平衡仍然充满挑战，原因在于尖锐值极小点带来的泛化能力不足，以及对重尾风险分布处理的不充分。我们提出了安全朗之万软演员-评论家算法（SL-SAC），一种原则性算法，通过参数空间探索和分布式的风险控制来解决这两个问题。我们的方法结合了三个关键机制：（1）奖励评论家的自适应随机梯度朗之万动力学（aSGLD），以促进集成多样性并摆脱较差的最优解；（2）通过隐式分位数网络（IQN）进行分布式的成本估计，并采用条件风险价值（CVaR）优化来降低尾部风险；以及（3）一种反应式的拉格朗日松弛方案，该方案基于片段成本的经验CVaR来调整约束执行。我们提供了关于CVaR估计误差的理论保证，并证明了基于CVaR的拉格朗日更新比基于期望成本的更新产生更强的约束违反信号。在Safety-Gymnasium基准测试中，SL-SAC在10个任务中的7个任务中实现了最低成本，同时保持了有竞争力的回报，与最先进的基线相比，速度任务中的成本降低了19-63%。
tldr: The paper introduces Safe Langevin Soft Actor-Critic (SL-SAC), a novel constrained reinforcement learning algorithm using parameter-space exploration and distributional risk control to achieve improved safety and returns in safety-critical environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了安全Langevin软Actor-Critic（SL-SAC），一种新颖的约束强化学习算法，它使用参数空间探索和分布风险控制，以在安全关键环境中实现更好的安全性和回报。

title: Surrogate Ensemble in Expensive Multi-Objective Optimization via Deep Q-Learning
summary: Surrogate-assisted Evolutionary Algorithms~(SAEAs) have shown promising robustness in solving expensive optimization problems. A key aspect that impacts SAEAs' effectiveness is surrogate model selection, which in existing works is predominantly decided by human developer. Such human-made design choice introduces strong bias into SAEAs and may hurt their expected performance on out-of-scope tasks. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning-assisted ensemble framework, termed as SEEMOO, which is capable of scheduling different surrogate models within a single optimization process, hence boosting the overall optimization performance in a cooperative paradigm. Specifically, we focus on expensive multi-objective optimization problems, where multiple objective functions shape a compositional landscape and hence challenge surrogate selection. SEEMOO comprises following core designs: 1) A pre-collected model pool that maintains different surrogate models; 2) An attention-based state-extractor supports universal optimization state representation of problems with varied objective numbers; 3) a deep Q-network serves as dynamic surrogate selector: Given the optimization state, it selects desired surrogate model for current-step evaluation. SEEMOO is trained to maximize the overall optimization performance under a training problem distribution. Extensive benchmark results demonstrate SEEMOO's surrogate ensemble paradigm boosts the optimization performance of single-surrogate baselines. Further ablation studies underscore the importance of SEEMOO's design components.
summary_zh: 基于代理模型的进化算法~(SAEAs) 在解决高代价优化问题方面展现出良好的鲁棒性。影响SAEAs有效性的一个关键方面是代理模型选择，而现有工作主要由人类开发者决定。这种人为设计选择会给SAEAs带来很强的偏差，并可能损害其在范围外任务上的预期性能。在本文中，我们提出了一种强化学习辅助的集成框架，称为SEEMOO，它能够在单个优化过程中调度不同的代理模型，从而以一种协同范式提高整体优化性能。具体来说，我们关注高代价多目标优化问题，其中多个目标函数塑造了一个复合式的景观，从而对代理模型选择提出挑战。SEEMOO包含以下核心设计：1) 一个预先收集的模型池，维护不同的代理模型；2) 一个基于注意力的状态提取器，支持具有不同目标数量的问题的通用优化状态表示；3) 一个深度Q网络，用作动态代理选择器：给定优化状态，它选择当前步骤评估所需的代理模型。SEEMOO经过训练，以最大化训练问题分布下的整体优化性能。大量的基准测试结果表明，SEEMOO的代理集成范式提高了单代理基线的优化性能。进一步的消融研究强调了SEEMOO设计组件的重要性。
tldr: The paper proposes SEEMOO, a reinforcement learning-assisted ensemble framework for dynamic surrogate model selection in expensive multi-objective optimization problems, demonstrating performance improvements over single-surrogate baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 SEEMOO，一个利用强化学习辅助的集成框架，用于在昂贵的多目标优化问题中进行动态代理模型选择，并展示了相对于单代理基线的性能提升。

title: Stabilizing Fixed-Point Iteration for Markov Chain Poisson Equations
summary: Poisson equations underpin average-reward reinforcement learning, but beyond ergodicity they can be ill-posed, meaning that solutions are non-unique and standard fixed point iterations can oscillate on reducible or periodic chains. We study finite-state Markov chains with $n$ states and transition matrix $P$. We show that all non-decaying modes are captured by a real peripheral invariant subspace $\mathcal{K}(P)$, and that the induced operator on the quotient space $\mathbb{R}^n/\mathcal{K}(P)$ is strictly contractive, yielding a unique quotient solution. Building on this viewpoint, we develop an end-to-end pipeline that learns the chain structure, estimates an anchor based gauge map, and runs projected stochastic approximation to estimate a gauge-fixed representative together with an associated peripheral residual. We prove $\widetilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$ convergence up to projection estimation error, enabling stable Poisson equation learning for multichain and periodic regimes with applications to performance evaluation of average-reward reinforcement learning beyond ergodicity.
summary_zh: 泊松方程是平均奖励强化学习的基础，但超越遍历性后，它们可能会变成不适定的，这意味着解是非唯一的，并且标准的不动点迭代可能会在可约或周期链上振荡。我们研究了具有$n$个状态和转移矩阵$P$的有限状态马尔可夫链。我们表明，所有非衰减模式都被一个实周边不变子空间$\mathcal{K}(P)$所捕获，并且在商空间$\mathbb{R}^n/\mathcal{K}(P)$上诱导的算子是严格收缩的，从而产生一个唯一的商解。基于这个观点，我们开发了一个端到端的流程，该流程学习链结构，估计基于锚点的规范映射，并运行投影随机逼近来估计规范固定的代表以及相关的周边残差。我们证明了$\widetilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$的收敛速度，直至投影估计误差，从而实现了多链和周期性状态下泊松方程的稳定学习，并将其应用于超越遍历性的平均奖励强化学习的性能评估。
tldr: This paper presents a method to stabilize fixed-point iterations for solving Poisson equations in average-reward RL, addressing ill-posedness issues in non-ergodic Markov chains by using a spectral approach and projected stochastic approximation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种稳定不动点迭代的方法，用于解决平均奖励强化学习中泊松方程的问题。该方法通过使用谱方法和投影随机逼近，解决了非遍历马尔可夫链中泊松方程不适定的问题。

title: DROGO: Default Representation Objective via Graph Optimization in Reinforcement Learning
summary: In computational reinforcement learning, the default representation (DR) and its principal eigenvector have been shown to be effective for a wide variety of applications, including reward shaping, count-based exploration, option discovery, and transfer. However, in prior investigations, the eigenvectors of the DR were computed by first approximating the DR matrix, and then performing an eigendecomposition. This procedure is computationally expensive and does not scale to high-dimensional spaces. In this paper, we derive an objective for directly approximating the principal eigenvector of the DR with a neural network. We empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of the objective in a number of environments, and apply the learned eigenvectors for reward shaping.
summary_zh: 在计算强化学习中，默认表示（DR）及其主特征向量已被证明在各种应用中有效，包括奖励塑造、基于计数的探索、选项发现和迁移。然而，在之前的研究中，DR的特征向量是通过首先近似DR矩阵，然后进行特征分解来计算的。这个过程计算成本高昂，且无法扩展到高维空间。在本文中，我们推导出一个目标函数，用于直接使用神经网络近似DR的主特征向量。我们通过实验证明了该目标函数在多个环境中的有效性，并将学习到的特征向量应用于奖励塑造。
tldr: This paper introduces a computationally efficient neural network-based method for directly approximating the principal eigenvector of the Default Representation in reinforcement learning, demonstrating its effectiveness for reward shaping.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于神经网络的高效方法，用于直接逼近强化学习中默认表示 (DR) 的主特征向量，并证明了其在奖励塑造方面的有效性。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Control Systems with Time Delays: A Comprehensive Survey
summary: In the last decade, Reinforcement Learning (RL) has achieved remarkable success in the control and decision-making of complex dynamical systems. However, most RL algorithms rely on the Markov Decision Process assumption, which is violated in practical cyber-physical systems affected by sensing delays, actuation latencies, and communication constraints. Such time delays introduce memory effects that can significantly degrade performance and compromise stability, particularly in networked and multi-agent environments. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of RL methods designed to address time delays in control systems. We first formalize the main classes of delays and analyze their impact on the Markov property. We then systematically categorize existing approaches into five major families: state augmentation and history-based representations, recurrent policies with learned memory, predictor-based and model-aware methods, robust and domain-randomized training strategies, and safe RL frameworks with explicit constraint handling. For each family, we discuss underlying principles, practical advantages, and inherent limitations. A comparative analysis highlights key trade-offs among these approaches and provides practical guidelines for selecting suitable methods under different delay characteristics and safety requirements. Finally, we identify open challenges and promising research directions, including stability certification, large-delay learning, multi-agent communication co-design, and standardized benchmarking. This survey aims to serve as a unified reference for researchers and practitioners developing reliable RL-based controllers in delay-affected cyber-physical systems.
summary_zh: 在过去的十年里，强化学习（RL）在复杂动力系统的控制和决策方面取得了显著成功。然而，大多数强化学习算法依赖于马尔可夫决策过程假设，但在实际受传感延迟、执行器延迟和通信约束影响的信息物理系统中，该假设是不成立的。这些时间延迟引入了记忆效应，可能会显著降低性能并损害稳定性，尤其是在网络化和多智能体环境中。本文对旨在解决控制系统中时间延迟的强化学习方法进行了全面的综述。我们首先形式化了延迟的主要类别，并分析了它们对马尔可夫性质的影响。然后，我们将现有方法系统地分为五个主要类别：状态增强和基于历史的表示、具有学习记忆的循环策略、基于预测器和模型感知的方法、鲁棒性和域随机化训练策略，以及具有显式约束处理的安全强化学习框架。对于每个类别，我们讨论了其基本原理、实际优势和固有局限性。对比分析突出了这些方法之间的关键权衡，并为在不同延迟特性和安全要求下选择合适的方法提供了实用的指导。最后，我们确定了开放的挑战和有前景的研究方向，包括稳定性认证、大延迟学习、多智能体通信协同设计以及标准化基准测试。本综述旨在作为研究人员和从业人员在受延迟影响的信息物理系统中开发可靠的基于强化学习的控制器的统一参考。
tldr: This paper surveys reinforcement learning methods designed to handle time delays in control systems, categorizing approaches and outlining future research directions.
tldr_zh: 本文综述了用于处理控制系统中时间延迟的强化学习方法，对各种方法进行了分类，并概述了未来的研究方向。

title: RVDebloater: Mode-based Adaptive Firmware Debloating for Robotic Vehicles
summary:
As the number of embedded devices grows and their functional requirements increase, embedded firmware is becoming increasingly larger, thereby expanding its attack surface. Despite the increase in firmware size, many embedded devices, such as robotic vehicles (RVs), operate in distinct modes, each requiring only a small subset of the firmware code at runtime. We refer to such devices as mode-based embedded devices. Debloating is an approach to reduce attack surfaces by removing or restricting unneeded code, but existing techniques suffer from significant limitations, such as coarse granularity and irreversible code removal, limiting their applicability.
  To address these limitations, we propose RVDebloater, a novel adaptive debloating technique for mode-based embedded devices that automatically identifies unneeded firmware code for each mode using either static or dynamic analysis, and dynamically debloats the firmware for each mode at the function level at runtime. RVDebloater introduces a new software-based enforcement approach that supports diverse mode-based embedded devices. We implemented RVDebloater using the LLVM compiler and evaluated its efficiency and effectiveness on six different RVs, including both simulated and real ones, with different real-world missions. We find that device requirements change throughout its lifetime for each mode, and that many critical firmware functions can be restricted in other modes, with an average of 85% of functions not being required. The results showed that none of the missions failed after debloating with RVDebloater, indicating that it neither incurred false positives nor false negatives. Further, RVDebloater prunes the firmware call graph by an average of 45% across different firmware. Finally, RVDebloater incurred an average performance overhead of 3.9% and memory overhead of 4% (approximately 0.25 MB) on real RVs.
summary_zh:
随着嵌入式设备数量的增长和功能需求的提高，嵌入式固件变得越来越大，从而扩大了其攻击面。尽管固件尺寸增加，但许多嵌入式设备，例如机器人车辆（RV），以不同的模式运行，每种模式在运行时仅需要固件代码的一小部分。我们将此类设备称为基于模式的嵌入式设备。“减负”（Debloating）是一种通过删除或限制不需要的代码来减少攻击面的方法，但现有技术存在显著局限性，例如粒度粗糙和不可逆的代码删除，限制了其适用性。

为了解决这些局限性，我们提出RVDebloater，一种新颖的自适应“减负”技术，用于基于模式的嵌入式设备，该技术使用静态或动态分析自动识别每种模式下不需要的固件代码，并在运行时在函数级别动态地对每种模式的固件进行“减负”。RVDebloater引入了一种新的基于软件的强制执行方法，该方法支持各种基于模式的嵌入式设备。我们使用LLVM编译器实现了RVDebloater，并在六种不同的RV（包括模拟的和真实的RV）上评估了其效率和有效性，这些RV具有不同的现实世界任务。我们发现设备需求在每个模式的整个生命周期中都会发生变化，并且许多关键固件功能可以在其他模式下受到限制，平均有85%的函数是不需要的。结果表明，在使用RVDebloater进行“减负”后，没有任何任务失败，表明它既没有产生误报也没有产生漏报。此外，RVDebloater将不同固件的固件调用图平均修剪了45%。最后，在真实的RV上，RVDebloater平均产生了3.9%的性能开销和4%的内存开销（约0.25 MB）。
tldr: The paper introduces RVDebloater, a novel adaptive firmware debloating technique for robotic vehicles that dynamically removes unneeded code based on the vehicle's operating mode, resulting in reduced attack surface with minimal performance overhead.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为RVDebloater 的新型自适应机器人车辆固件精简技术，该技术可根据车辆的运行模式动态删除不需要的代码，从而在最小的性能开销下减少攻击面。

title: Pareto-Conditioned Diffusion Models for Offline Multi-Objective Optimization
summary: Multi-objective optimization (MOO) arises in many real-world applications where trade-offs between competing objectives must be carefully balanced. In the offline setting, where only a static dataset is available, the main challenge is generalizing beyond observed data. We introduce Pareto-Conditioned Diffusion (PCD), a novel framework that formulates offline MOO as a conditional sampling problem. By conditioning directly on desired trade-offs, PCD avoids the need for explicit surrogate models. To effectively explore the Pareto front, PCD employs a reweighting strategy that focuses on high-performing samples and a reference-direction mechanism to guide sampling towards novel, promising regions beyond the training data. Experiments on standard offline MOO benchmarks show that PCD achieves highly competitive performance and, importantly, demonstrates greater consistency across diverse tasks than existing offline MOO approaches.
summary_zh: 多目标优化(MOO)出现在许多实际应用中，在这些应用中，需要在相互竞争的目标之间仔细权衡。在离线 setting 中，仅有静态数据集可用，主要挑战在于对观测数据之外进行泛化。我们提出帕累托条件扩散(PCD)，这是一个将离线 MOO 形式化为条件采样问题的新框架。通过直接以期望的权衡为条件，PCD 避免了对显式代理模型的需求。为了有效地探索帕累托前沿，PCD 采用一种重加权策略，该策略专注于高性能样本，并且采用一种参考方向机制来引导采样朝向训练数据之外的新颖、有希望的区域。在标准离线 MOO 基准上的实验表明，PCD 实现了极具竞争力的性能，并且更重要的是，与现有的离线 MOO 方法相比，在各种任务中表现出更大的一致性。
tldr: The paper introduces Pareto-Conditioned Diffusion (PCD) for offline multi-objective optimization, conditioning on desired trade-offs using a reweighting and reference-direction mechanism, showing competitive performance on benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于离线多目标优化的Pareto条件扩散模型 (PCD)，该模型通过重加权和参考方向机制来调节所需的权衡，并在基准测试中表现出强大的竞争力。

title: PCBSchemaGen: Constraint-Guided Schematic Design via LLM for Printed Circuit Boards (PCB)
summary: Printed Circuit Board (PCB) schematic design plays an essential role in all areas of electronic industries. Unlike prior works that focus on digital or analog circuits alone, PCB design must handle heterogeneous digital, analog, and power signals while adhering to real-world IC packages and pin constraints. Automated PCB schematic design remains unexplored due to the scarcity of open-source data and the absence of simulation-based verification. We introduce PCBSchemaGen, the first training-free framework for PCB schematic design that comprises LLM agent and Constraint-guided synthesis. Our approach makes three contributions: 1. an LLM-based code generation paradigm with iterative feedback with domain-specific prompts. 2. a verification framework leveraging a real-world IC datasheet derived Knowledge Graph (KG) and Subgraph Isomorphism encoding pin-role semantics and topological constraints. 3. an extensive experiment on 23 PCB schematic tasks spanning digital, analog, and power domains. Results demonstrate that PCBSchemaGen significantly improves design accuracy and computational efficiency.
summary_zh: 印刷电路板（PCB）原理图设计在所有电子工业领域都扮演着至关重要的角色。与以往仅关注数字或模拟电路的工作不同，PCB设计必须处理异构的数字、模拟和电源信号，同时遵守实际的IC封装和引脚约束。由于缺乏开源数据和基于仿真的验证手段，自动化的PCB原理图设计仍有待探索。我们提出了PCBSchemaGen，这是首个用于PCB原理图设计的无训练框架，它包括LLM代理和约束引导的综合。我们的方法有三项贡献：1. 一种基于LLM的代码生成范例，以迭代反馈和领域特定的提示作为支撑。2. 一种验证框架，利用从真实IC数据手册中提取的知识图谱（KG）和子图同构编码引脚角色语义和拓扑约束。3. 在跨越数字、模拟和电源领域的23个PCB原理图任务上进行了广泛的实验。结果表明，PCBSchemaGen显著提高了设计精度和计算效率。
tldr: The paper introduces PCBSchemaGen, a training-free LLM-based framework for automated PCB schematic design, addressing heterogeneous circuit types and pin constraints using a knowledge graph and subgraph isomorphism for verification, showing improved accuracy and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PCBSchemaGen，一个免训练的，基于LLM的PCB原理图自动设计框架。该框架通过知识图谱和子图同构来处理异构电路类型和引脚约束，实现验证，并展示了准确性和效率的提升。

title: V2X-DSC: Multi-Agent Collaborative Perception with Distributed Source Coding Guided Communication
summary: Collaborative perception improves 3D understanding by fusing multi-agent observations, yet intermediate-feature sharing faces strict bandwidth constraints as dense BEV features saturate V2X links. We observe that collaborators view the same physical world, making their features strongly correlated; thus receivers only need innovation beyond their local context. Revisiting this from a distributed source coding perspective, we propose V2X-DSC, a framework with a Conditional Codec (DCC) for bandwidth-constrained fusion. The sender compresses BEV features into compact codes, while the receiver performs conditional reconstruction using its local features as side information, allocating bits to complementary cues rather than redundant content. This conditional structure regularizes learning, encouraging incremental representation and yielding lower-noise features. Experiments on DAIR-V2X, OPV2V, and V2X-Real demonstrate state-of-the-art accuracy-bandwidth trade-offs under KB-level communication, and generalizes as a plug-and-play communication layer across multiple fusion backbones.
summary_zh: 协作感知通过融合多智能体观测来提升三维理解，但中间特征共享面临着严格的带宽限制，因为密集的BEV特征会使V2X链路饱和。我们观察到，协作方观察的是相同的物理世界，使得它们的特征高度相关；因此，接收方只需要超出其本地上下文的创新信息。从分布式源编码的角度重新审视这一点，我们提出了V2X-DSC，一个具有条件编解码器（DCC）的框架，用于带宽受限的融合。发送方将BEV特征压缩成紧凑的代码，而接收方利用其本地特征作为边信息进行条件重建，将比特分配给互补的线索而不是冗余的内容。这种条件结构规范了学习过程，鼓励增量式表示，并产生更低噪声的特征。在DAIR-V2X、OPV2V和V2X-Real上的实验表明，在KB级别的通信条件下，实现了最先进的精度-带宽权衡，并且可以作为即插即用的通信层推广到多个融合骨干网络中。
tldr: The paper proposes V2X-DSC, a distributed source coding framework for bandwidth-constrained collaborative perception in autonomous vehicles, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy-bandwidth trade-offs by leveraging local features as side information for conditional reconstruction.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了V2X-DSC，一个用于自动驾驶车辆中带宽受限的协同感知的分布式信源编码框架。该框架通过利用本地特征作为边信息进行条件重建，实现了最先进的精度-带宽权衡。

title: MRAD: Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection with Memory-Driven Retrieval
summary: Zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) often leverages pretrained vision or vision-language models, but many existing methods use prompt learning or complex modeling to fit the data distribution, resulting in high training or inference cost and limited cross-domain stability. To address these limitations, we propose Memory-Retrieval Anomaly Detection method (MRAD), a unified framework that replaces parametric fitting with a direct memory retrieval. The train-free base model, MRAD-TF, freezes the CLIP image encoder and constructs a two-level memory bank (image-level and pixel-level) from auxiliary data, where feature-label pairs are explicitly stored as keys and values. During inference, anomaly scores are obtained directly by similarity retrieval over the memory bank. Based on the MRAD-TF, we further propose two lightweight variants as enhancements: (i) MRAD-FT fine-tunes the retrieval metric with two linear layers to enhance the discriminability between normal and anomaly; (ii) MRAD-CLIP injects the normal and anomalous region priors from the MRAD-FT as dynamic biases into CLIP's learnable text prompts, strengthening generalization to unseen categories. Across 16 industrial and medical datasets, the MRAD framework consistently demonstrates superior performance in anomaly classification and segmentation, under both train-free and training-based settings. Our work shows that fully leveraging the empirical distribution of raw data, rather than relying only on model fitting, can achieve stronger anomaly detection performance. The code will be publicly released at https://github.com/CROVO1026/MRAD.
summary_zh: 零样本异常检测(ZSAD)通常利用预训练的视觉或视觉-语言模型，但许多现有方法使用提示学习或复杂的建模来拟合数据分布，导致训练或推理成本高昂，且跨域稳定性有限。 为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种记忆检索异常检测方法(MRAD)，这是一个统一的框架，用直接的记忆检索代替参数拟合。 免训练的基础模型MRAD-TF冻结了CLIP图像编码器，并从辅助数据构建了一个两级记忆库（图像级和像素级），其中特征-标签对被显式地存储为键和值。 在推理过程中，通过对记忆库进行相似性检索直接获得异常分数。 基于MRAD-TF，我们进一步提出了两种轻量级变体作为增强：（i）MRAD-FT使用两个线性层对检索度量进行微调，以增强正常和异常之间的可区分性；（ii）MRAD-CLIP将来自MRAD-FT的正常和异常区域先验作为动态偏差注入到CLIP的可学习文本提示中，从而增强了对未见类别的泛化能力。 在16个工业和医学数据集上，MRAD框架在免训练和基于训练的设置下，在异常分类和分割方面始终表现出优越的性能。 我们的工作表明，充分利用原始数据的经验分布，而不是仅仅依赖模型拟合，可以实现更强的异常检测性能。 代码将在https://github.com/CROVO1026/MRAD上公开发布。
tldr: The paper introduces MRAD, a memory-retrieval based zero-shot anomaly detection method that uses CLIP and a two-level memory bank for efficient and accurate anomaly detection, outperforming existing methods on various datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MRAD，一种基于记忆检索的零样本异常检测方法，该方法使用CLIP和一个两级记忆库来实现高效和准确的异常检测，并在各种数据集上优于现有方法。

title: Actor-Dual-Critic Dynamics for Zero-sum and Identical-Interest Stochastic Games
summary: We propose a novel independent and payoff-based learning framework for stochastic games that is model-free, game-agnostic, and gradient-free. The learning dynamics follow a best-response-type actor-critic architecture, where agents update their strategies (actors) using feedback from two distinct critics: a fast critic that intuitively responds to observed payoffs under limited information, and a slow critic that deliberatively approximates the solution to the underlying dynamic programming problem. Crucially, the learning process relies on non-equilibrium adaptation through smoothed best responses to observed payoffs. We establish convergence to (approximate) equilibria in two-agent zero-sum and multi-agent identical-interest stochastic games over an infinite horizon. This provides one of the first payoff-based and fully decentralized learning algorithms with theoretical guarantees in both settings. Empirical results further validate the robustness and effectiveness of the proposed approach across both classes of games.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的、独立的且基于回报的学习框架，用于随机博弈。该框架是无模型的、博弈无关的，并且是无梯度的。学习动态遵循一种最佳响应类型的行动者-评论家架构，其中智能体使用来自两个不同评论家的反馈来更新他们的策略（行动者）：一个快速评论家，在有限信息下直观地响应观察到的回报；以及一个慢速评论家，审慎地逼近底层动态规划问题的解。至关重要的是，学习过程依赖于通过对观察到的回报进行平滑的最佳响应进行的非均衡适应。我们证明了在无限时域下，对于双智能体零和以及多智能体利益一致的随机博弈，均可收敛到（近似）均衡。这为在这两种场景下均具有理论保证的首批基于回报且完全去中心化的学习算法之一。实证结果进一步验证了所提出的方法在这些博弈类别中的鲁棒性和有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel payoff-based, gradient-free actor-critic algorithm with convergence guarantees for zero-sum and identical-interest stochastic games, using two distinct critics for strategy updates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的基于收益、无梯度的actor-critic算法，该算法使用两个不同的critic进行策略更新，并具有零和博弈和利益一致博弈中的收敛保证。

title: VVLoc: Prior-free 3-DoF Vehicle Visual Localization
summary: Localization is a critical technology in autonomous driving, encompassing both topological localization, which identifies the most similar map keyframe to the current observation, and metric localization, which provides precise spatial coordinates. Conventional methods typically address these tasks independently, rely on single-camera setups, and often require additional 3D semantic or pose priors, while lacking mechanisms to quantify the confidence of localization results, making them less feasible for real industrial applications. In this paper, we propose VVLoc, a unified pipeline that employs a single neural network to concurrently achieve topological and metric vehicle localization using multi-camera system. VVLoc first evaluates the geo-proximity between visual observations, then estimates their relative metric poses using a matching strategy, while also providing a confidence measure. Additionally, the training process for VVLoc is highly efficient, requiring only pairs of visual data and corresponding ground-truth poses, eliminating the need for complex supplementary data. We evaluate VVLoc not only on the publicly available datasets, but also on a more challenging self-collected dataset, demonstrating its ability to deliver state-of-the-art localization accuracy across a wide range of localization tasks.
summary_zh: 定位是自动驾驶中的一项关键技术，包含拓扑定位（识别与当前观测最相似的地图关键帧）和度量定位（提供精确的空间坐标）。传统方法通常独立地处理这些任务，依赖于单摄像头设置，并且经常需要额外的3D语义或姿态先验，同时缺乏量化定位结果置信度的机制，使其在实际工业应用中的可行性降低。在本文中，我们提出了一种统一的流水线VVLoc，它采用单个神经网络，利用多摄像头系统同时实现拓扑和度量车辆定位。VVLoc首先评估视觉观测之间的地理接近度，然后使用匹配策略估计它们的相对度量姿态，同时提供置信度度量。此外，VVLoc的训练过程非常高效，只需要视觉数据和相应的地面真实姿态对，消除了对复杂补充数据的需求。我们不仅在公开可用的数据集上评估了VVLoc，还在一个更具挑战性的自采集数据集上评估了它，证明了其在各种定位任务中提供最先进定位精度的能力。
tldr: VVLoc is a unified, prior-free pipeline that uses a single neural network and multi-camera input for topological and metric vehicle localization, providing state-of-the-art accuracy and a confidence measure, while also being data-efficient.
tldr_zh: VVLoc是一个统一的，无需先验知识的流程，它使用单个神经网络和多摄像头输入进行拓扑和度量车辆定位，提供最先进的精度和置信度量，同时还具有数据效率。

title: FISC: A Fluid-Inspired Framework for Decentralized and Scalable Swarm Control
summary: Achieving scalable coordination in large robotic swarms is often constrained by reliance on inter-agent communication, which introduces latency, bandwidth limitations, and vulnerability to failure. To address this gap, a decentralized approach for outer-loop control of large multi-agent systems based on the paradigm of how a fluid moves through a volume is proposed and evaluated. A relationship between fundamental fluidic element properties and individual robotic agent states is developed such that the corresponding swarm "flows" through a space, akin to a fluid when forced via a pressure boundary condition. By ascribing fluid-like properties to subsets of agents, the swarm evolves collectively while maintaining desirable structure and coherence without explicit communication of agent states within or outside of the swarm. The approach is evaluated using simulations involving $O(10^3)$ quadcopter agents and compared against Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) solutions for a converging-diverging domain. Quantitative agreement between swarm-derived and CFD fields is assessed using Root-Mean-Square Error (RMSE), yielding normalized errors of 0.15-0.9 for velocity, 0.61-0.98 for density, 0-0.937 for pressure. These results demonstrate the feasibility of treating large robotic swarms as continuum systems that retain the macroscopic structure derived from first principles, providing a basis for scalable and decentralized control.
summary_zh: 在大型机器人集群中实现可扩展的协同控制常常受限于对智能体间通信的依赖，这会导致延迟、带宽限制以及易受故障影响。为了弥补这一不足，本文提出并评估了一种基于流体在体积内运动范式的、用于大型多智能体系统外环控制的去中心化方法。建立了基本流体单元属性与单个机器人智能体状态之间的关系，使得相应的集群“流”过一个空间，类似于通过压力边界条件强制流动的流体。通过将类流体属性赋予智能体子集，集群集体演化，同时保持理想的结构和连贯性，而无需在集群内部或外部显式通信智能体状态。该方法通过涉及 $O(10^3)$ 架四旋翼无人机智能体的仿真进行评估，并与收敛-发散域的计算流体动力学 (CFD) 解决方案进行比较。使用均方根误差 (RMSE) 评估集群推导场与 CFD 场之间的定量一致性，得到归一化速度误差为 0.15-0.9，密度误差为 0.61-0.98，压力误差为 0-0.937。这些结果证明了将大型机器人集群视为连续体系统的可行性，这些系统保留了源自第一性原理的宏观结构，从而为可扩展的去中心化控制奠定了基础。
tldr: The paper proposes a decentralized control framework for large robotic swarms inspired by fluid dynamics, achieving scalable coordination without direct inter-agent communication, and validated with simulations of thousands of quadcopters.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种受流体动力学启发的用于大型机器人集群的去中心化控制框架，实现了无需直接智能体间通信的可扩展协调，并通过数千架四旋翼无人机的仿真进行了验证。

title: Motion Planning with Metric Temporal Logic Using Reachability Analysis and Hybrid Zonotopes
summary: Metric temporal logic (MTL) provides a formal framework for defining time-dependent mission requirements on autonomous vehicles. However, optimizing control decisions subject to these constraints is often computationally expensive. This article presents a method that uses reachability analysis to implicitly express the set of states satisfying an MTL specification and then optimizes to find a motion plan. The hybrid zonotope set representation is used to efficiently and conveniently encode MTL specifications into reachable sets. A numerical benchmark highlights the proposed method's computational advantages as compared to existing methods in the literature. Further numerical examples and an experimental application demonstrate the ability to address time-varying environments, region-dependent disturbances, and multi-agent coordination.
summary_zh: 度量时序逻辑(MTL)为定义自主车辆的时间相关任务需求提供了一个正式的框架。然而，在这些约束条件下优化控制决策通常计算成本很高。本文提出了一种方法，该方法利用可达性分析来隐式地表达满足MTL规范的状态集合，然后进行优化以找到运动规划。混合zonotope集合表示被用于高效且便捷地将MTL规范编码为可达集。一个数值基准测试突出了与文献中现有方法相比，所提出方法的计算优势。进一步的数值例子和一个实验应用演示了处理时变环境、区域相关扰动和多智能体协调的能力。
tldr: This paper presents a computationally efficient motion planning method using reachability analysis and hybrid zonotopes to satisfy Metric Temporal Logic (MTL) specifications for autonomous vehicles, demonstrating advantages in time-varying environments, disturbances, and multi-agent coordination.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种计算效率高的运动规划方法，该方法使用可达性分析和混合 zonotopes 来满足自动驾驶车辆的度量时序逻辑 (MTL) 规范，并在时变环境、扰动和多智能体协调方面表现出优势。

title: Dual Quaternion SE(3) Synchronization with Recovery Guarantees
summary: Synchronization over the special Euclidean group SE(3) aims to recover absolute poses from noisy pairwise relative transformations and is a core primitive in robotics and 3D vision. Standard approaches often require multi-step heuristic procedures to recover valid poses, which are difficult to analyze and typically lack theoretical guarantees. This paper adopts a dual quaternion representation and formulates SE(3) synchronization directly over the unit dual quaternion. A two-stage algorithm is developed: A spectral initializer computed via the power method on a Hermitian dual quaternion measurement matrix, followed by a dual quaternion generalized power method (DQGPM) that enforces feasibility through per-iteration projection. The estimation error bounds are established for spectral estimators, and DQGPM is shown to admit a finite-iteration error bound and achieves linear error contraction up to an explicit noise-dependent threshold. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and real-world multi-scan point-set registration demonstrate that the proposed pipeline improves both accuracy and efficiency over representative matrix-based methods.
summary_zh: 在特殊欧几里得群SE(3)上的同步旨在从带噪声的成对相对变换中恢复绝对位姿，是机器人学和3D视觉中的核心基元。标准方法通常需要多步启发式程序来恢复有效的位姿，这些程序难以分析且通常缺乏理论保证。本文采用双四元数表示，并直接在单位双四元数上建立SE(3)同步。开发了一种两阶段算法：第一阶段是谱初始化器，通过在Hermitian双四元数测量矩阵上使用幂法计算；第二阶段是双四元数广义幂法（DQGPM），通过每次迭代的投影来强制可行性。建立了谱估计器的估计误差界限，并证明DQGPM具有有限迭代误差界限，并且可以实现线性误差收缩，直至显式的噪声相关阈值。在合成基准和真实世界的多扫描点云配准上的实验表明，与具有代表性的基于矩阵的方法相比，所提出的流程提高了精度和效率。
tldr: This paper proposes a dual quaternion-based approach for SE(3) synchronization, offering improved accuracy and efficiency with theoretical guarantees compared to traditional matrix-based methods. It contributes a two-stage algorithm with provable error bounds.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于双四元数的SE(3)同步方法，与传统的基于矩阵的方法相比，该方法提供了更高的精度和效率，并具有理论保证。它贡献了一种两阶段算法，并具有可证明的误差界限。

title: DockSmith: Scaling Reliable Coding Environments via an Agentic Docker Builder
summary: Reliable Docker-based environment construction is a dominant bottleneck for scaling execution-grounded training and evaluation of software engineering agents. We introduce DockSmith, a specialized agentic Docker builder designed to address this challenge. DockSmith treats environment construction not only as a preprocessing step, but as a core agentic capability that exercises long-horizon tool use, dependency reasoning, and failure recovery, yielding supervision that transfers beyond Docker building itself. DockSmith is trained on large-scale, execution-grounded Docker-building trajectories produced by a SWE-Factory-style pipeline augmented with a loop-detection controller and a cross-task success memory. Training a 30B-A3B model on these trajectories achieves open-source state-of-the-art performance on Multi-Docker-Eval, with 39.72% Fail-to-Pass and 58.28% Commit Rate. Moreover, DockSmith improves out-of-distribution performance on SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, and Terminal-Bench 2.0, demonstrating broader agentic benefits of environment construction.
summary_zh: 可靠的基于 Docker 的环境构建是扩展软件工程 agent 基于执行的训练和评估的主要瓶颈。我们引入 DockSmith，一个专门的 agentic Docker 构建器，旨在解决这一挑战。DockSmith 不仅将环境构建视为一个预处理步骤，而且将其视为一种核心的 agentic 能力，能够进行长时程工具使用、依赖关系推理和故障恢复，从而产生超越 Docker 构建本身的监督信息。DockSmith 在大规模、基于执行的 Docker 构建轨迹上进行训练，这些轨迹由 SWE-Factory 风格的流水线增强，并配备了循环检测控制器和跨任务成功记忆。在这些轨迹上训练一个 30B-A3B 模型，在 Multi-Docker-Eval 上实现了开源的最先进性能，Fail-to-Pass 率为 39.72%，Commit Rate 为 58.28%。此外，DockSmith 改善了在 SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Multilingual 和 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上的分布外性能，证明了环境构建更广泛的 agentic 优势。
tldr: DockSmith is an agentic Docker builder that uses long-horizon tool use and failure recovery to improve environment construction for software engineering agents, achieving SOTA performance on Multi-Docker-Eval and improved out-of-distribution performance on other benchmarks.
tldr_zh: DockSmith是一个基于代理的Docker构建器，它使用长程工具使用和故障恢复来改进软件工程代理的环境构建，在Multi-Docker-Eval上实现了SOTA性能，并在其他基准测试上改进了分布外的性能。

title: Small Shifts, Large Gains: Unlocking Traditional TSP Heuristic Guided-Sampling via Unsupervised Neural Instance Modification
summary: The Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) is one of the most representative NP-hard problems in route planning and a long-standing benchmark in combinatorial optimization.
