Unfortunately, robot software is intrinsically hard to test compared to traditional software, mainly since the software needs to closely interact with hardware, account for uncertainty in its operational environment, handle disturbances, and act highly autonomously. However, given the large space in which robots operate, anticipating possible failures when designing tests is challenging. This paper presents a mapping study by considering robotics testing papers and relating them to the software testing theory. We consider 247 robotics testing papers and map them to software testing, discussing the state-of-the-art software testing in robotics with an illustrated example, and discuss current challenges. Forming the basis to introduce both the robotics and software engineering communities to software testing challenges. Finally, we identify open questions and lessons learned.
summary_zh: 机器人系统是复杂且安全性至关重要的软件系统，因此需要进行彻底的测试。不幸的是，与传统软件相比，机器人软件本质上更难测试，这主要是因为软件需要与硬件紧密交互，考虑其运行环境中的不确定性，处理扰动，并高度自主地行动。然而，鉴于机器人运行的巨大空间，在设计测试时预测可能的故障极具挑战性。本文通过考虑机器人测试论文并将它们与软件测试理论联系起来，提出了一项映射研究。我们考虑了247篇机器人测试论文并将它们映射到软件测试之上，通过一个示例说明了机器人技术中最新的软件测试技术，并讨论了当前的挑战。这为向机器人和软件工程社区介绍软件测试挑战奠定了基础。最后，我们确定了未解决的问题和经验教训。
tldr: This paper presents a mapping study of robotics testing papers, relating them to software testing theory to identify challenges and open questions in robotics software testing.
tldr_zh: 本文对机器人测试论文进行了一次映射研究，将它们与软件测试理论联系起来，以识别机器人软件测试中的挑战和未决问题。

title: A Unified Control Architecture for Macro-Micro Manipulation using a Active Remote Center of Compliance for Manufacturing Applications
summary: Macro-micro manipulators combine a macro manipulator with a large workspace, such as an industrial robot, with a lightweight, high-bandwidth micro manipulator. This enables highly dynamic interaction control while preserving the wide workspace of the robot. Traditionally, position control is assigned to the macro manipulator, while the micro manipulator handles the interaction with the environment, limiting the achievable interaction control bandwidth. To solve this, we propose a novel control architecture that incorporates the macro manipulator into the active interaction control. This leads to a increase in control bandwidth by a factor of 2.1 compared to the state of the art architecture, based on the leader-follower approach and factor 12.5 compared to traditional robot-based force control. Further we propose surrogate models for a more efficient controller design and easy adaptation to hardware changes. We validate our approach by comparing it against the other control schemes in different experiments, like collision with an object, following a force trajectory and industrial assembly tasks.
summary_zh: 宏-微操控器结合了具有大工作空间的宏操控器（例如工业机器人）和轻量级、高带宽的微操控器。这使得在保持机器人宽广工作空间的同时，能够实现高度动态的交互控制。传统上，位置控制被分配给宏操控器，而微操控器处理与环境的交互，这限制了可实现的交互控制带宽。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的控制架构，该架构将宏操控器纳入主动交互控制中。与基于主从方法的现有技术架构相比，这使得控制带宽提高了2.1倍，与传统的基于机器人的力控制相比提高了12.5倍。此外，我们提出了替代模型，以便更高效地进行控制器设计并轻松适应硬件更改。我们通过在不同的实验中将其与其他控制方案进行比较来验证我们的方法，例如与物体碰撞、跟随力轨迹和工业装配任务。
tldr: This paper presents a novel control architecture for macro-micro manipulators using an active Remote Center of Compliance, achieving significant bandwidth improvements in interaction control for manufacturing applications, validated through various experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用主动遥控柔顺中心的宏微型机械臂的新型控制架构，在制造应用中实现了交互控制带宽的显着提升，并通过各种实验进行了验证。

title: Tilt-Ropter: A Novel Hybrid Aerial and Terrestrial Vehicle with Tilt Rotors and Passive Wheels
summary: In this work, we present Tilt-Ropter, a novel hybrid aerial-terrestrial vehicle (HATV) that combines tilt rotors with passive wheels to achieve energy-efficient multi-mode locomotion. Unlike existing under-actuated HATVs, the fully actuated design of Tilt-Ropter enables decoupled force and torque control, greatly enhancing its mobility and environmental adaptability. A nonlinear model predictive controller (NMPC) is developed to track reference trajectories and handle contact constraints across locomotion modes, while a dedicated control allocation module exploits actuation redundancy to achieve energy-efficient control of actuators. Additionally, to enhance robustness during ground contact, we introduce an external wrench estimation algorithm that estimates environmental interaction forces and torques in real time. The system is validated through both simulation and real-world experiments, including seamless air-ground transitions and trajectory tracking. Results show low tracking errors in both modes and highlight a 92.8% reduction in power consumption during ground locomotion, demonstrating the system's potential for long-duration missions across large-scale and energy-constrained environments.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种新型的空陆混合飞行器（HATV）Tilt-Ropter，它结合了倾转旋翼和被动轮，实现了节能的多模式运动。与现有的欠驱动HATV不同，Tilt-Ropter的全驱动设计使其能够实现解耦的力和力矩控制，从而大大提高了其机动性和环境适应性。我们开发了一种非线性模型预测控制器（NMPC）来跟踪参考轨迹并处理跨运动模式的接触约束，同时，一个专门的控制分配模块利用驱动冗余来实现对执行器进行节能控制。此外，为了增强地面接触过程中的鲁棒性，我们引入了一种外部wrench估计算法，用于实时估计环境交互作用力和力矩。通过仿真和真实世界的实验验证了该系统，包括无缝的空地转换和轨迹跟踪。结果表明，该系统在两种模式下都具有较低的跟踪误差，并强调了地面运动过程中功耗降低了92.8%，证明了该系统在大型和能源受限环境中执行长时任务的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces Tilt-Ropter, a fully actuated hybrid aerial-terrestrial vehicle with tilt rotors and passive wheels, demonstrating energy-efficient locomotion through a novel control system and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新型混合空中-地面车辆Tilt-Ropter，它结合了倾转旋翼和被动轮，通过新型控制系统和真实世界实验展示了节能的运动方式。

title: Towards Autonomous Instrument Tray Assembly for Sterile Processing Applications
summary: The Sterile Processing and Distribution (SPD) department is responsible for cleaning, disinfecting, inspecting, and assembling surgical instruments between surgeries. Manual inspection and preparation of instrument trays is a time-consuming, error-prone task, often prone to contamination and instrument breakage. In this work, we present a fully automated robotic system that sorts and structurally packs surgical instruments into sterile trays, focusing on automation of the SPD assembly stage. A custom dataset comprising 31 surgical instruments and 6,975 annotated images was collected to train a hybrid perception pipeline using YOLO12 for detection and a cascaded ResNet-based model for fine-grained classification. The system integrates a calibrated vision module, a 6-DOF Staubli TX2-60L robotic arm with a custom dual electromagnetic gripper, and a rule-based packing algorithm that reduces instrument collisions during transport. The packing framework uses 3D printed dividers and holders to physically isolate instruments, reducing collision and friction during transport. Experimental evaluations show high perception accuracy and statistically significant reduction in tool-to-tool collisions compared to human-assembled trays. This work serves as the scalable first step toward automating SPD workflows, improving safety, and consistency of surgical preparation while reducing SPD processing times.
summary_zh: 无菌处理和配送（SPD）部门负责在手术间隙对手术器械进行清洁、消毒、检查和组装。人工检查和准备器械托盘既耗时又容易出错，而且经常容易发生污染和器械损坏。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种全自动机器人系统，用于将手术器械分拣并结构化地装入无菌托盘，重点关注SPD组装阶段的自动化。我们收集了一个包含31种手术器械和6,975个标注图像的定制数据集，用于训练一个混合感知流水线，该流水线使用YOLO12进行检测，并使用基于ResNet的级联模型进行细粒度分类。该系统集成了校准的视觉模块、带有定制双电磁夹具的6自由度Staubli TX2-60L机械臂，以及基于规则的打包算法，该算法可减少运输过程中器械之间的碰撞。打包框架使用3D打印的隔板和支架来物理隔离器械，从而减少运输过程中的碰撞和摩擦。实验评估表明，与人工组装的托盘相比，该系统具有高感知精度，并且工具之间的碰撞在统计学上得到了显著减少。这项工作是实现SPD工作流程自动化、提高手术准备的安全性和一致性，以及缩短SPD处理时间的可扩展第一步。
tldr: This paper presents an automated robotic system for surgical instrument tray assembly, utilizing computer vision, a 6-DOF robot arm, and a rule-based packing algorithm to improve safety and efficiency in sterile processing departments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于外科器械托盘组装的自动化机器人系统，该系统利用计算机视觉、六自由度机器人手臂和基于规则的打包算法来提高消毒处理部门的安全性和效率。

title: Efficiently Solving Mixed-Hierarchy Games with Quasi-Policy Approximations
summary: Multi-robot coordination often exhibits hierarchical structure, with some robots' decisions depending on the planned behaviors of others. While game theory provides a principled framework for such interactions, existing solvers struggle to handle mixed information structures that combine simultaneous (Nash) and hierarchical (Stackelberg) decision-making. We study N-robot forest-structured mixed-hierarchy games, in which each robot acts as a Stackelberg leader over its subtree while robots in different branches interact via Nash equilibria. We derive the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) first-order optimality conditions for this class of games and show that they involve increasingly high-order derivatives of robots' best-response policies as the hierarchy depth grows, rendering a direct solution intractable. To overcome this challenge, we introduce a quasi-policy approximation that removes higher-order policy derivatives and develop an inexact Newton method for efficiently solving the resulting approximated KKT systems. We prove local exponential convergence of the proposed algorithm for games with non-quadratic objectives and nonlinear constraints. The approach is implemented in a highly optimized Julia library (MixedHierarchyGames.jl) and evaluated in simulated experiments, demonstrating real-time convergence for complex mixed-hierarchy information structures.
summary_zh: 多机器人协同常常呈现出层级结构，其中一些机器人的决策依赖于其他机器人已规划的行为。虽然博弈论为这种交互提供了原则性的框架，但现有的求解器难以处理混合信息结构，即同时包含同时（纳什）和层级（斯塔克尔伯格）决策。我们研究了N机器人森林结构混合层级博弈，其中每个机器人在其子树上充当斯塔克尔伯格领导者，而不同分支中的机器人通过纳什均衡进行交互。我们推导了这类博弈的Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT)一阶最优性条件，并表明随着层级深度的增加，它们涉及机器人最优响应策略的越来越高阶的导数，使得直接求解变得难以处理。为了克服这一挑战，我们引入了一种准策略近似，它消除了更高阶的策略导数，并开发了一种非精确牛顿法，用于高效地求解由此产生的近似KKT系统。我们证明了所提出的算法对于具有非二次目标和非线性约束的博弈具有局部指数收敛性。该方法已在一个高度优化的Julia库(MixedHierarchyGames.jl)中实现，并在模拟实验中进行了评估，展示了复杂混合层级信息结构的实时收敛性。
tldr: This paper introduces a quasi-policy approximation method and an inexact Newton method for efficiently solving forest-structured mixed-hierarchy games, which are relevant to multi-robot coordination with both Nash and Stackelberg equilibria.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种准策略近似方法和一种非精确牛顿方法，用于有效解决森林结构的混合层级博弈，该博弈与具有纳什均衡和斯塔克尔伯格均衡的多机器人协调相关。

title: VQ-Style: Disentangling Style and Content in Motion with Residual Quantized Representations
summary: Human motion data is inherently rich and complex, containing both semantic content and subtle stylistic features that are challenging to model. We propose a novel method for effective disentanglement of the style and content in human motion data to facilitate style transfer. Our approach is guided by the insight that content corresponds to coarse motion attributes while style captures the finer, expressive details. To model this hierarchy, we employ Residual Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoders (RVQ-VAEs) to learn a coarse-to-fine representation of motion. We further enhance the disentanglement by integrating contrastive learning and a novel information leakage loss with codebook learning to organize the content and the style across different codebooks. We harness this disentangled representation using our simple and effective inference-time technique Quantized Code Swapping, which enables motion style transfer without requiring any fine-tuning for unseen styles. Our framework demonstrates strong versatility across multiple inference applications, including style transfer, style removal, and motion blending.
summary_zh: 人体运动数据本质上是丰富而复杂的，包含着语义内容和微妙的风格特征，建模极具挑战性。我们提出一种新颖的方法，可以有效地解耦人体运动数据中的风格和内容，从而促进风格迁移。我们的方法基于以下洞见：内容对应于粗略的运动属性，而风格则捕捉更精细、更具表现力的细节。为了对这种层次结构进行建模，我们采用残差向量量化变分自编码器（RVQ-VAEs）来学习运动数据的由粗到精的表征。我们通过整合对比学习和一种新颖的信息泄漏损失与码本学习，来增强解耦能力，从而组织不同码本之间的内容和风格。我们利用这种解耦后的表征，通过我们简单有效的推理时技术“量化码交换”来实现运动风格迁移，而无需针对未见的风格进行任何微调。我们的框架在包括风格迁移、风格移除和运动混合在内的多种推理应用中表现出很强的通用性。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for disentangling style and content in human motion data using RVQ-VAEs, contrastive learning, and a novel information leakage loss, enabling style transfer without fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用RVQ-VAEs、对比学习和一种新的信息泄漏损失来解耦人体运动数据中的风格和内容的方法，从而无需微调即可实现风格迁移。

title: Spark: Modular Spiking Neural Networks
summary: Nowadays, neural networks act as a synonym for artificial intelligence. Present neural network models, although remarkably powerful, are inefficient both in terms of data and energy. Several alternative forms of neural networks have been proposed to address some of these problems. Specifically, spiking neural networks are suitable for efficient hardware implementations. However, effective learning algorithms for spiking networks remain elusive, although it is suspected that effective plasticity mechanisms could alleviate the problem of data efficiency. Here, we present a new framework for spiking neural networks - Spark - built upon the idea of modular design, from simple components to entire models. The aim of this framework is to provide an efficient and streamlined pipeline for spiking neural networks. We showcase this framework by solving the sparse-reward cartpole problem with simple plasticity mechanisms. We hope that a framework compatible with traditional ML pipelines may accelerate research in the area, specifically for continuous and unbatched learning, akin to the one animals exhibit.
summary_zh: 如今，神经网络几乎已成为人工智能的代名词。当前的神经网络模型虽然功能强大，但在数据和能源方面效率低下。为了解决其中的一些问题，人们提出了几种替代形式的神经网络。特别是，脉冲神经网络非常适合高效的硬件实现。然而，有效的脉冲网络学习算法仍然难以捉摸，尽管人们猜测有效的可塑性机制可以缓解数据效率问题。在此，我们提出了一个用于脉冲神经网络的新框架——Spark——其建立在模块化设计理念之上，从简单的组件到完整的模型。该框架旨在为脉冲神经网络提供高效且精简的流程。我们展示了这个框架，通过简单的可塑性机制解决了稀疏奖励的倒立摆问题。我们希望与传统机器学习流程兼容的框架可以加速该领域的研究，特别是针对连续和非批量学习，类似于动物表现出的那种学习方式。
tldr: This paper introduces Spark, a modular spiking neural network framework, and demonstrates its application to the sparse-reward cartpole problem using simple plasticity mechanisms, aiming for compatibility with traditional ML pipelines to accelerate research in continuous and unbatched learning.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了一个名为Spark的模块化脉冲神经网络框架，并展示了其在稀疏奖励倒立摆问题中的应用，该框架使用简单的可塑性机制，旨在与传统的机器学习流程兼容，以加速在连续和非批量学习领域的研究。

title: DomusFM: A Foundation Model for Smart-Home Sensor Data
summary: Smart-home sensor data holds significant potential for several applications, including healthcare monitoring and assistive technologies. Existing approaches, however, face critical limitations. Supervised models require impractical amounts of labeled data. Foundation models for activity recognition focus only on inertial sensors, failing to address the unique characteristics of smart-home binary sensor events: their sparse, discrete nature combined with rich semantic associations. LLM-based approaches, while tested in this domain, still raise several issues regarding the need for natural language descriptions or prompting, and reliance on either external services or expensive hardware, making them infeasible in real-life scenarios due to privacy and cost concerns. We introduce DomusFM, the first foundation model specifically designed and pretrained for smart-home sensor data. DomusFM employs a self-supervised dual contrastive learning paradigm to capture both token-level semantic attributes and sequence-level temporal dependencies. By integrating semantic embeddings from a lightweight language model and specialized encoders for temporal patterns and binary states, DomusFM learns generalizable representations that transfer across environments and tasks related to activity and event analysis. Through leave-one-dataset-out evaluation across seven public smart-home datasets, we demonstrate that DomusFM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on different downstream tasks, achieving superior performance even with only 5% of labeled training data available for fine-tuning. Our approach addresses data scarcity while maintaining practical deployability for real-world smart-home systems.
summary_zh: 智能家居传感器数据在包括医疗保健监测和辅助技术等多个应用领域具有巨大的潜力。然而，现有方法面临着关键的局限性。监督模型需要不切实际的大量标记数据。用于活动识别的基础模型仅关注惯性传感器，未能解决智能家居二元传感器事件的独特特征：其稀疏、离散的性质以及丰富的语义关联。基于LLM的方法虽然已在此领域进行了测试，但仍然存在一些问题，例如需要自然语言描述或提示，以及依赖外部服务或昂贵的硬件，这使得它们由于隐私和成本方面的考虑而在实际场景中不可行。我们引入了DomusFM，这是第一个专门为智能家居传感器数据设计和预训练的基础模型。DomusFM采用自监督双重对比学习范式，以捕获token级别的语义属性和序列级别的时间依赖性。通过集成来自轻量级语言模型的语义嵌入以及用于时间模式和二元状态的专用编码器，DomusFM学习可泛化的表示，这些表示可以跨环境和任务转移，从而进行活动和事件分析。通过在七个公共智能家居数据集上进行留一数据集法评估，我们证明DomusFM在不同的下游任务上优于最先进的基线模型，即使只有5%的标记训练数据可用于微调，也能实现卓越的性能。我们的方法解决了数据稀缺的问题，同时保持了实际智能家居系统的可部署性。
tldr: DomusFM, a foundation model for smart-home sensor data, uses self-supervised contrastive learning to achieve state-of-the-art performance in activity and event analysis while addressing data scarcity and practical deployability.
tldr_zh: DomusFM 是一个用于智能家居传感器数据的基础模型，它采用自监督对比学习方法，在活动和事件分析中实现了最先进的性能，同时解决了数据稀缺性和实际部署问题。

title: CloDS: Visual-Only Unsupervised Cloth Dynamics Learning in Unknown Conditions
summary: Deep learning has demonstrated remarkable capabilities in simulating complex dynamic systems. However, existing methods require known physical properties as supervision or inputs, limiting their applicability under unknown conditions. To explore this challenge, we introduce Cloth Dynamics Grounding (CDG), a novel scenario for unsupervised learning of cloth dynamics from multi-view visual observations. We further propose Cloth Dynamics Splatting (CloDS), an unsupervised dynamic learning framework designed for CDG. CloDS adopts a three-stage pipeline that first performs video-to-geometry grounding and then trains a dynamics model on the grounded meshes. To cope with large non-linear deformations and severe self-occlusions during grounding, we introduce a dual-position opacity modulation that supports bidirectional mapping between 2D observations and 3D geometry via mesh-based Gaussian splatting in video-to-geometry grounding stage. It jointly considers the absolute and relative position of Gaussian components. Comprehensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that CloDS effectively learns cloth dynamics from visual data while maintaining strong generalization capabilities for unseen configurations. Our code is available at https://github.com/whynot-zyl/CloDS. Visualization results are available at https://github.com/whynot-zyl/CloDS_video}.%\footnote{As in this example.
summary_zh: 深度学习在模拟复杂动态系统方面表现出了卓越的能力。然而，现有方法需要已知的物理属性作为监督或输入，限制了其在未知条件下的适用性。为了探索这一挑战，我们引入了布料动力学接地（CDG），这是一个从多视角视觉观察中无监督学习布料动力学的新颖场景。我们进一步提出了布料动力学溅射（CloDS），一个专为CDG设计的无监督动态学习框架。CloDS采用三阶段流程，首先执行视频到几何的接地，然后在接地的网格上训练一个动力学模型。为了应对接地过程中大型非线性变形和严重的自遮挡，我们引入了一种双位置不透明度调制，该调制支持 2D 观察和 3D 几何之间通过基于网格的高斯溅射进行双向映射。它联合考虑了高斯分量的绝对位置和相对位置。全面的实验评估表明，CloDS有效地从视觉数据中学习布料动力学，同时保持了对未见配置的强大泛化能力。我们的代码可在https://github.com/whynot-zyl/CloDS 获取。可视化结果可在https://github.com/whynot-zyl/CloDS_video 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces CloDS, an unsupervised framework for learning cloth dynamics from multi-view visual observations using a novel three-stage pipeline and a dual-position opacity modulation technique for improved video-to-geometry grounding.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为CloDS的无监督学习框架，用于从多视角视觉观察中学习布料动力学。该框架采用了一个新的三阶段流程，并使用一种双位置不透明度调制技术来改进视频到几何的接合。

title: Controlling Exploration-Exploitation in GFlowNets via Markov Chain Perspectives
summary: Generative Flow Network (GFlowNet) objectives implicitly fix an equal mixing of forward and backward policies, potentially constraining the exploration-exploitation trade-off during training. By further exploring the link between GFlowNets and Markov chains, we establish an equivalence between GFlowNet objectives and Markov chain reversibility, thereby revealing the origin of such constraints, and provide a framework for adapting Markov chain properties to GFlowNets. Building on these theoretical findings, we propose $α$-GFNs, which generalize the mixing via a tunable parameter $α$. This generalization enables direct control over exploration-exploitation dynamics to enhance mode discovery capabilities, while ensuring convergence to unique flows. Across various benchmarks, including Set, Bit Sequence, and Molecule Generation, $α$-GFN objectives consistently outperform previous GFlowNet objectives, achieving up to a $10 \times$ increase in the number of discovered modes.
summary_zh: 生成流网络（GFlowNet）目标函数隐式地固定了正向策略和反向策略的均等混合，这可能会限制训练期间的探索-利用权衡。通过进一步探索GFlowNet与马尔可夫链之间的联系，我们确立了GFlowNet目标函数与马尔可夫链可逆性之间的等价关系，从而揭示了此类约束的根源，并提供了一个将马尔可夫链性质应用于GFlowNets的框架。基于这些理论发现，我们提出了$α$-GFNs，它通过可调节参数$α$来推广混合。这种概括能够直接控制探索-利用动态，从而增强模式发现能力，同时确保收敛到唯一的流。在包括集合、位序列和分子生成在内的各种基准测试中，$α$-GFN目标函数始终优于之前的GFlowNet目标函数，在发现的模式数量上实现了高达10倍的增长。
tldr: This paper introduces α-GFNs, a generalization of GFlowNets that allows for tunable control over exploration-exploitation dynamics, leading to improved mode discovery in generative tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了α-GFN，一种GFlowNets的推广，它允许对探索-利用动态进行可调控制，从而改进生成任务中的模式发现。

title: UrbanGS: A Scalable and Efficient Architecture for Geometrically Accurate Large-Scene Reconstruction
summary: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality, real-time rendering for bounded scenes, its extension to large-scale urban environments gives rise to critical challenges in terms of geometric consistency, memory efficiency, and computational scalability. To address these issues, we present UrbanGS, a scalable reconstruction framework that effectively tackles these challenges for city-scale applications. First, we propose a Depth-Consistent D-Normal Regularization module. Unlike existing approaches that rely solely on monocular normal estimators, which can effectively update rotation parameters yet struggle to update position parameters, our method integrates D-Normal constraints with external depth supervision. This allows for comprehensive updates of all geometric parameters. By further incorporating an adaptive confidence weighting mechanism based on gradient consistency and inverse depth deviation, our approach significantly enhances multi-view depth alignment and geometric coherence, which effectively resolves the issue of geometric accuracy in complex large-scale scenes. To improve scalability, we introduce a Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Pruning (SAGP) strategy, which dynamically adjusts Gaussian density based on local geometric complexity and visibility to reduce redundancy. Additionally, a unified partitioning and view assignment scheme is designed to eliminate boundary artifacts and optimize computational load. Extensive experiments on multiple urban datasets demonstrate that UrbanGS achieves superior performance in rendering quality, geometric accuracy, and memory efficiency, providing a systematic solution for high-fidelity large-scale scene reconstruction.
summary_zh: 3D高斯溅射(3DGS)虽然能够对有限场景实现高质量的实时渲染，但将其扩展到大规模城市环境中，却在几何一致性、内存效率和计算可扩展性方面带来了严峻挑战。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了UrbanGS，一个可扩展的重建框架，可以有效地应对城市级应用中的这些挑战。首先，我们提出了一种深度一致性D-法线正则化模块。与仅依赖于单目法线估计器的现有方法不同，这些方法可以有效地更新旋转参数，但在更新位置参数方面表现不佳，我们的方法将D-法线约束与外部深度监督相结合。这允许对所有几何参数进行全面更新。通过进一步整合基于梯度一致性和逆深度偏差的自适应置信度加权机制，我们的方法显著增强了多视图深度对齐和几何连贯性，从而有效地解决了复杂大规模场景中的几何精度问题。为了提高可扩展性，我们引入了一种空间自适应高斯剪枝（SAGP）策略，该策略根据局部几何复杂性和可见性动态调整高斯密度，以减少冗余。此外，设计了一种统一的分区和视图分配方案，以消除边界伪影并优化计算负载。对多个城市数据集进行的大量实验表明，UrbanGS在渲染质量、几何精度和内存效率方面都取得了优异的性能，为高保真大规模场景重建提供了一个系统的解决方案。
tldr: UrbanGS introduces a scalable and efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting architecture for geometrically accurate large-scene reconstruction by incorporating depth-consistent regularization and adaptive Gaussian pruning.
tldr_zh: UrbanGS 提出了一种可扩展且高效的 3D 高斯溅射架构，用于几何精确的大场景重建，通过结合深度一致性正则化和自适应高斯修剪。

title: Ultrafast On-chip Online Learning via Spline Locality in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary: Ultrafast online learning is essential for high-frequency systems, such as controls for quantum computing and nuclear fusion, where adaptation must occur on sub-microsecond timescales. Meeting these requirements demands low-latency, fixed-precision computation under strict memory constraints, a regime in which conventional Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) are both inefficient and numerically unstable. We identify key properties of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) that align with these constraints. Specifically, we show that: (i) KAN updates exploiting B-spline locality are sparse, enabling superior on-chip resource scaling, and (ii) KANs are inherently robust to fixed-point quantization. By implementing fixed-point online training on Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), a representative platform for on-chip computation, we demonstrate that KAN-based online learners are significantly more efficient and expressive than MLPs across a range of low-latency and resource-constrained tasks. To our knowledge, this work is the first to demonstrate model-free online learning at sub-microsecond latencies.
summary_zh: 超快的在线学习对于高频系统至关重要，例如量子计算和核聚变的控制，这些系统中的自适应必须在亚微秒的时间尺度上进行。满足这些需求需要在严格的内存约束下进行低延迟、定点精度计算，而传统的 多层感知机 (MLP) 在这种情况下既低效又数值不稳定。我们确定了 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络 (KAN) 的关键特性，这些特性与上述约束相符。具体而言，我们证明了：（i）利用 B 样条局部性的 KAN 更新是稀疏的，从而实现卓越的片上资源扩展，以及（ii）KAN 本质上对定点量化具有鲁棒性。通过在现场可编程门阵列 (FPGA) 上实现定点在线训练，作为片上计算的代表性平台，我们证明了基于 KAN 的在线学习器在一系列低延迟和资源受限的任务中，比 MLP 显著更为高效和富有表现力。据我们所知，这项工作首次演示了亚微秒延迟下的无模型在线学习。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel application of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) for ultrafast, low-latency online learning on FPGAs, demonstrating superior efficiency and expressiveness compared to MLPs in resource-constrained environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种Kolmogorov-Arnold网络(KANs)的新应用，用于在FPGA上进行超快、低延迟的在线学习，与在资源受限环境中MLP相比，KANs表现出更高的效率和表现力。

title: Logic-Guided Vector Fields for Constrained Generative Modeling
summary: Neuro-symbolic systems aim to combine the expressive structure of symbolic logic with the flexibility of neural learning; yet, generative models typically lack mechanisms to enforce declarative constraints at generation time. We propose Logic-Guided Vector Fields (LGVF), a neuro-symbolic framework that injects symbolic knowledge, specified as differentiable relaxations of logical constraints, into flow matching generative models. LGVF couples two complementary mechanisms: (1) a training-time logic loss that penalizes constraint violations along continuous flow trajectories, with weights that emphasize correctness near the target distribution; and (2) an inference-time adjustment that steers sampling using constraint gradients, acting as a lightweight, logic-informed correction to the learned dynamics. We evaluate LGVF on three constrained generation case studies spanning linear, nonlinear, and multi-region feasibility constraints. Across all settings, LGVF reduces constraint violations by 59-82% compared to standard flow matching and achieves the lowest violation rates in each case. In the linear and ring settings, LGVF also improves distributional fidelity as measured by MMD, while in the multi-obstacle setting, we observe a satisfaction-fidelity trade-off, with improved feasibility but increased MMD. Beyond quantitative gains, LGVF yields constraint-aware vector fields exhibiting emergent obstacle-avoidance behavior, routing samples around forbidden regions without explicit path planning.
summary_zh: 神经符号系统旨在结合符号逻辑的表达结构与神经学习的灵活性；然而，生成模型通常缺乏在生成时强制执行声明性约束的机制。我们提出逻辑引导向量场（LGVF），这是一个神经符号框架，它将符号知识（指定为逻辑约束的可微松弛）注入到流匹配生成模型中。LGVF耦合了两种互补机制：（1）训练时逻辑损失，其惩罚沿连续流轨迹的约束违反，并使用权重来强调目标分布附近的正确性；（2）推理时调整，其利用约束梯度来引导采样，充当对学习动态的轻量级、逻辑驱动的校正。我们在三个跨越线性、非线性和多区域可行性约束的约束生成案例研究中评估LGVF。在所有设置中，与标准流匹配相比，LGVF将约束违反减少了59-82%，并在每种情况下都实现了最低的违反率。在线性和环形设置中，LGVF还提高了由MMD衡量的分布保真度，而在多障碍物设置中，我们观察到一种满足-保真度权衡，即可行性得到改善，但MMD增加。除了量化收益之外，LGVF还产生具有涌现的避障行为的约束感知向量场，无需明确的路径规划即可绕过禁区来路由样本。
tldr: The paper introduces Logic-Guided Vector Fields (LGVF), a neuro-symbolic framework that integrates logical constraints into flow matching generative models, demonstrating improved constraint satisfaction in various generation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了逻辑引导向量场 (LGVF)，这是一种将逻辑约束集成到流匹配生成模型中的神经符号框架，并在各种生成任务中展示了改进的约束满足。

title: Observation-dependent Bayesian active learning via input-warped Gaussian processes
summary: Bayesian active learning relies on the precise quantification of predictive uncertainty to explore unknown function landscapes. While Gaussian process surrogates are the standard for such tasks, an underappreciated fact is that their posterior variance depends on the observed outputs only through the hyperparameters, rendering exploration largely insensitive to the actual measurements. We propose to inject observation-dependent feedback by warping the input space with a learned, monotone reparameterization. This mechanism allows the design policy to expand or compress regions of the input space in response to observed variability, thereby shaping the behavior of variance-based acquisition functions. We demonstrate that while such warps can be trained via marginal likelihood, a novel self-supervised objective yields substantially better performance. Our approach improves sample efficiency across a range of active learning benchmarks, particularly in regimes where non-stationarity challenges traditional methods.
summary_zh: 贝叶斯主动学习依赖于预测不确定性的精确量化来探索未知的函数空间。 虽然高斯过程代理是此类任务的标准，但一个未被充分认识的事实是，其后验方差仅通过超参数依赖于观测到的输出，从而导致探索对实际测量结果在很大程度上不敏感。我们建议通过使用学习到的单调重参数化来扭曲输入空间，从而注入依赖于观测值的反馈。 这种机制允许设计策略根据观察到的变异性来扩展或压缩输入空间的区域，从而塑造基于方差的采集函数的行为。 我们证明了虽然可以通过边缘似然训练这种扭曲，但一种新的自监督目标可以产生明显更好的性能。 我们的方法提高了各种主动学习基准测试的样本效率，尤其是在非平稳状态挑战传统方法的场景中。
tldr: This paper proposes a novel method for Bayesian active learning that uses an observation-dependent input space warping to improve sample efficiency, particularly in non-stationary environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的贝叶斯主动学习方法，该方法利用依赖于观测的输入空间扭曲来提高采样效率，尤其是在非平稳环境中。

title: Designing Time Series Experiments in A/B Testing with Transformer Reinforcement Learning
summary: A/B testing has become a gold standard for modern technological companies to conduct policy evaluation. Yet, its application to time series experiments, where policies are sequentially assigned over time, remains challenging. Existing designs suffer from two limitations: (i) they do not fully leverage the entire history for treatment allocation; (ii) they rely on strong assumptions to approximate the objective function (e.g., the mean squared error of the estimated treatment effect) for optimizing the design. We first establish an impossibility theorem showing that failure to condition on the full history leads to suboptimal designs, due to the dynamic dependencies in time series experiments. To address both limitations simultaneously, we next propose a transformer reinforcement learning (RL) approach which leverages transformers to condition allocation on the entire history and employs RL to directly optimize the MSE without relying on restrictive assumptions. Empirical evaluations on synthetic data, a publicly available dispatch simulator, and a real-world ridesharing dataset demonstrate that our proposal consistently outperforms existing designs.
summary_zh: A/B测试已成为现代技术公司进行政策评估的黄金标准。然而，将其应用于时序实验，即策略随时间依次分配，仍然具有挑战性。现有的设计存在两个局限性：（i）它们没有充分利用整个历史数据进行处理分配；（ii）它们依赖于强假设来近似目标函数（例如，估计的处理效应的均方误差），以优化设计。我们首先建立一个不可能定理，表明由于时序实验中的动态依赖关系，未能以完整历史数据为条件会导致次优设计。为了同时解决这两个局限性，我们接下来提出一种Transformer强化学习（RL）方法，该方法利用Transformer以整个历史数据为条件进行分配，并采用RL直接优化MSE，而无需依赖于限制性假设。在合成数据、公开可用的调度模拟器和真实世界的网约车数据集上的实证评估表明，我们的方案始终优于现有设计。
tldr: This paper introduces a transformer reinforcement learning approach for A/B testing in time series experiments, addressing limitations of existing methods by leveraging the entire history for treatment allocation and directly optimizing the mean squared error.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于时间序列实验中A/B测试的Transformer强化学习方法。该方法利用Transformer根据整个历史记录进行分配，并直接优化均方误差，从而解决了现有方法的局限性。

title: Learning Sequential Decisions from Multiple Sources via Group-Robust Markov Decision Processes
summary: We often collect data from multiple sites (e.g., hospitals) that share common structure but also exhibit heterogeneity. This paper aims to learn robust sequential decision-making policies from such offline, multi-site datasets. To model cross-site uncertainty, we study distributionally robust MDPs with a group-linear structure: all sites share a common feature map, and both the transition kernels and expected reward functions are linear in these shared features. We introduce feature-wise (d-rectangular) uncertainty sets, which preserve tractable robust Bellman recursions while maintaining key cross-site structure. Building on this, we then develop an offline algorithm based on pessimistic value iteration that includes: (i) per-site ridge regression for Bellman targets, (ii) feature-wise worst-case (row-wise minimization) aggregation, and (iii) a data-dependent pessimism penalty computed from the diagonals of the inverse design matrices. We further propose a cluster-level extension that pools similar sites to improve sample efficiency, guided by prior knowledge of site similarity. Under a robust partial coverage assumption, we prove a suboptimality bound for the resulting policy. Overall, our framework addresses multi-site learning with heterogeneous data sources and provides a principled approach to robust planning without relying on strong state-action rectangularity assumptions.
summary_zh: 我们经常从具有共同结构但也表现出异质性的多个站点（例如，医院）收集数据。本文旨在从此类离线、多站点数据集中学习稳健的序贯决策策略。为了对跨站点的 不确定性进行建模，我们研究了具有群线性结构的分布鲁棒MDP：所有站点共享一个通用的特征映射，并且转移核和期望奖励函数都是这些共享特征的线性函数。我们引入了特征维度的（d-矩形）不确定集，它在保持关键的跨站点结构的同时，保留了易处理的鲁棒贝尔曼递归。在此基础上，我们开发了一种基于悲观值迭代的离线算法，该算法包括：（i）用于贝尔曼目标的逐站点岭回归；（ii）特征维度的最坏情况（按行最小化）聚合；以及（iii）从逆设计矩阵的对角线计算的依赖于数据的悲观惩罚。我们进一步提出了一个集群级别的扩展，它利用站点相似性的先验知识，将类似的站点进行池化以提高样本效率。在鲁棒的部分覆盖假设下，我们证明了由此产生的策略的次优性界限。总而言之，我们的框架解决了具有异构数据源的多站点学习问题，并提供了一种无需依赖强状态-动作矩形假设的鲁棒规划的原则性方法。
tldr: This paper proposes a group-robust Markov Decision Process framework for learning robust sequential decision-making policies from heterogeneous multi-site datasets, using feature-wise uncertainty sets and pessimism in value iteration to ensure robust planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种组鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程框架，用于从异构的多站点数据集中学习鲁棒的序贯决策策略，使用特征方面的置信集和悲观值迭代来确保鲁棒规划。

title: Mapping-Guided Task Discovery and Allocation for Robotic Inspection of Underwater Structures
summary: Task generation for underwater multi-robot inspections without prior knowledge of existing geometry can be achieved and optimized through examination of simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) data. By considering hardware parameters and environmental conditions, a set of tasks is generated from SLAM meshes and optimized through expected keypoint scores and distance-based pruning. In-water tests are used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm and determine the appropriate parameters. These results are compared to simulated Voronoi partitions and boustrophedon patterns for inspection coverage on a model of the test environment. The key benefits of the presented task discovery method include adaptability to unexpected geometry and distributions that maintain coverage while focusing on areas more likely to present defects or damage.
summary_zh: 在不预先了解现有几何结构的情况下，可以通过检查同步定位与建图（SLAM）数据实现对水下多机器人检查任务的生成和优化。通过考虑硬件参数和环境条件，从SLAM网格中生成一组任务，并通过期望关键点得分和基于距离的剪枝进行优化。水下测试用于验证算法的有效性并确定合适的参数。这些结果将与模拟的Voronoi划分和往复路径（boustrophedon）模式进行比较，以评估在测试环境模型上的检查覆盖率。提出的任务发现方法的主要优点包括对意外几何结构的适应性以及保持覆盖范围的同时专注于更可能出现缺陷或损坏的区域的分布。
tldr: This paper presents a SLAM-based task generation and allocation method for underwater multi-robot inspection, optimizing task selection based on geometry, hardware, and environmental conditions to improve inspection coverage and focus on potential defect areas.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于SLAM的水下多机器人检测的任务生成和分配方法，通过几何形状、硬件和环境条件优化任务选择，以提高检测覆盖率并专注于潜在缺陷区域。

title: Real-Time 2D LiDAR Object Detection Using Three-Frame RGB Scan Encoding
summary: Indoor service robots need perception that is robust, more privacy-friendly than RGB video, and feasible on embedded hardware. We present a camera-free 2D LiDAR object detection pipeline that encodes short-term temporal context by stacking three consecutive scans as RGB channels, yielding a compact YOLOv8n input without occupancy-grid construction while preserving angular structure and motion cues. Evaluated in Webots across 160 randomized indoor scenarios with strict scenario-level holdout, the method achieves 98.4% mAP@0.5 (0.778 mAP@0.5:0.95) with 94.9% precision and 94.7% recall on four object classes. On a Raspberry Pi 5, it runs in real time with a mean post-warm-up end-to-end latency of 47.8ms per frame, including scan encoding and postprocessing. Relative to a closely related occupancy-grid LiDAR-YOLO pipeline reported on the same platform, the proposed representation is associated with substantially lower reported end-to-end latency. Although results are simulation-based, they suggest that lightweight temporal encoding can enable accurate and real-time LiDAR-only detection for embedded indoor robotics without capturing RGB appearance.
summary_zh: 室内服务机器人需要鲁棒性强、比RGB视频更具隐私性且能在嵌入式硬件上运行的感知系统。我们提出了一种无需摄像头的2D LiDAR物体检测流水线，该流水线通过将三个连续扫描堆叠为RGB通道来编码短期时间上下文，从而生成紧凑的YOLOv8n输入，无需构建占据栅格，同时保留角度结构和运动线索。在Webots中，对160个随机室内场景进行了严格的场景级别留出评估，该方法在四个物体类别上实现了98.4%的mAP@0.5 (0.778 mAP@0.5:0.95)，精度为94.9%，召回率为94.7%。在Raspberry Pi 5上，它以平均47.8ms/帧的预热后端到端延迟实时运行，包括扫描编码和后处理。相对于在同一平台上报告的密切相关的占据栅格LiDAR-YOLO流水线，所提出的表示具有显著更低的端到端延迟。虽然结果基于仿真，但它们表明，轻量级时间编码可以实现精确和实时的纯LiDAR检测，用于嵌入式室内机器人，而无需捕获RGB外观信息。
tldr: This paper presents a real-time 2D LiDAR object detection pipeline for indoor robots that encodes temporal context by stacking three consecutive LiDAR scans as RGB channels, achieving high mAP and real-time performance on a Raspberry Pi 5 in simulated indoor scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于室内机器人的实时2D激光雷达物体检测方案，通过将三个连续的激光雷达扫描堆叠为RGB通道来编码时间上下文，并在模拟室内环境中，在Raspberry Pi 5上实现了高mAP和实时性能。

title: Frictional Contact Solving for Material Point Method
summary: Accurately handling contact with friction remains a core bottleneck for Material Point Method (MPM), from reliable contact point detection to enforcing frictional contact laws (non-penetration, Coulomb friction, and maximum dissipation principle). In this paper, we introduce a frictional-contact pipeline for implicit MPM that is both precise and robust. During the collision detection phase, contact points are localized with particle-centric geometric primitives; during the contact resolution phase, we cast frictional contact as a Nonlinear Complementarity Problem (NCP) over contact impulses and solve it with an Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) scheme. Crucially, the formulation reuses the same implicit MPM linearization, yielding efficiency and numerical stability. The method integrates seamlessly into the implicit MPM loop and is agnostic to modeling choices, including material laws, interpolation functions, and transfer schemes. We evaluate it across seven representative scenes that span elastic and elasto-plastic responses, simple and complex deformable geometries, and a wide range of contact conditions. Overall, the proposed method enables accurate contact localization, reliable frictional handling, and broad generality, making it a practical solution for MPM-based simulations in robotics and related domains.
summary_zh: 准确处理带摩擦的接触仍然是物质点法（MPM）的一个核心瓶颈，从可靠的接触点检测到执行摩擦接触定律（非穿透、库仑摩擦和最大耗散原理）。在本文中，我们为隐式MPM引入了一种精确且稳健的摩擦接触流程。在碰撞检测阶段，接触点通过以粒子为中心的几何图元来定位；在接触求解阶段，我们将摩擦接触转化为基于接触冲量的非线性互补问题（NCP），并用交替方向乘子法（ADMM）方案求解。至关重要的是，该公式重用了相同的隐式MPM线性化，从而提高了效率和数值稳定性。该方法无缝集成到隐式MPM循环中，并且与建模选择无关，包括材料定律、插值函数和传递方案。我们在七个具有代表性的场景中评估了它，这些场景涵盖了弹性和弹塑性响应、简单和复杂的可变形几何体以及广泛的接触条件。总体而言，所提出的方法实现了精确的接触定位、可靠的摩擦处理和广泛的通用性，使其成为机器人和相关领域中基于MPM仿真的实用解决方案。
tldr: This paper presents a robust and accurate frictional contact pipeline for the Material Point Method (MPM) using an ADMM scheme, improving MPM simulations for robotics and related fields.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于 ADMM 算法的，适用于 Material Point Method (MPM) 的鲁棒且精确的摩擦接触管线，从而提升了 MPM 在机器人及相关领域的仿真能力。

title: Path Tracking with Dynamic Control Point Blending for Autonomous Vehicles: An Experimental Study
summary: This paper presents an experimental study of a path-tracking framework for autonomous vehicles in which the lateral control command is applied to a dynamic control point along the wheelbase. Instead of enforcing a fixed reference at either the front or rear axle, the proposed method continuously interpolates between both, enabling smooth adaptation across driving contexts, including low-speed maneuvers and reverse motion. The lateral steering command is obtained by barycentric blending of two complementary controllers: a front-axle Stanley formulation and a rear-axle curvature-based geometric controller, yielding continuous transitions in steering behavior and improved tracking stability. In addition, we introduce a curvature-aware longitudinal control strategy based on virtual track borders and ray-tracing, which converts upcoming geometric constraints into a virtual obstacle distance and regulates speed accordingly. The complete approach is implemented in a unified control stack and validated in simulation and on a real autonomous vehicle equipped with GPS-RTK, radar, odometry, and IMU. The results in closed-loop tracking and backward maneuvers show improved trajectory accuracy, smoother steering profiles, and increased adaptability compared to fixed control-point baselines.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种用于自动驾驶汽车的路径跟踪框架的实验研究，其中横向控制指令被施加于沿轴距分布的动态控制点。与在前后轴上强制固定参考点不同，本文提出的方法能够在这两者之间连续插值，从而实现驾驶场景下的平稳适应，包括低速机动和倒车运动。横向转向指令通过两个互补控制器的重心混合获得：一个是前轴Stanley公式，另一个是基于后轴曲率的几何控制器，从而产生转向行为的连续过渡并提高跟踪稳定性。此外，我们引入了一种基于虚拟轨道边界和光线追踪的曲率感知纵向控制策略，该策略将即将到来的几何约束转换为虚拟障碍物距离，并相应地调节速度。完整的控制方法在一个统一的控制栈中实现，并在仿真和配备GPS-RTK、雷达、里程计和IMU的真实自动驾驶汽车上进行了验证。闭环跟踪和倒车机动的结果表明，与固定控制点基线相比，该方法具有更高的轨迹精度、更平滑的转向曲线和更强的适应性。
tldr: This paper presents a path-tracking framework for autonomous vehicles that dynamically blends front- and rear-axle control for improved accuracy, smoothness, and adaptability compared to fixed control-point methods, validated through simulations and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶车辆的路径跟踪框架，该框架动态融合了前轴和后轴控制，与固定控制点方法相比，提高了精度、平滑度和适应性，并通过仿真和实际实验进行了验证。

title: Co-Design of Rover Wheels and Control using Bayesian Optimization and Rover-Terrain Simulations
summary: While simulation is vital for optimizing robotic systems, the cost of modeling deformable terrain has long limited its use in full-vehicle studies of off-road autonomous mobility. For example, Discrete Element Method (DEM) simulations are often confined to single-wheel tests, which obscures coupled wheel-vehicle-controller interactions and prevents joint optimization of mechanical design and control. This paper presents a Bayesian optimization framework that co-designs rover wheel geometry and steering controller parameters using high-fidelity, full-vehicle closed-loop simulations on deformable terrain. Using the efficiency and scalability of a continuum-representation model (CRM) for terramechanics, we evaluate candidate designs on trajectories of varying complexity while towing a fixed load. The optimizer tunes wheel parameters (radius, width, and grouser features) and steering PID gains under a multi-objective formulation that balances traversal speed, tracking error, and energy consumption. We compare two strategies: simultaneous co-optimization of wheel and controller parameters versus a sequential approach that decouples mechanical and control design. We analyze trade-offs in performance and computational cost. Across 3,000 full-vehicle simulations, campaigns finish in five to nine days, versus months with the group's earlier DEM-based workflow. Finally, a preliminary hardware study suggests the simulation-optimized wheel designs preserve relative performance trends on the physical rover. Together, these results show that scalable, high-fidelity simulation can enable practical co-optimization of wheel design and control for off-road vehicles on deformable terrain without relying on prohibitively expensive DEM studies. The simulation infrastructure (scripts and models) is released as open source in a public repository to support reproducibility and further research.
summary_zh: 虽然仿真对于优化机器人系统至关重要，但模拟可变形地形的成本长期以来限制了其在越野自主移动的全车研究中的应用。例如，离散单元法（DEM）仿真通常仅限于单轮测试，这掩盖了耦合的轮-车-控制器交互，并阻碍了机械设计和控制的联合优化。本文提出了一种贝叶斯优化框架，该框架利用高保真、全车闭环仿真在可变形地形上共同设计漫游车车轮几何形状和转向控制器参数。利用连续介质力学模型（CRM）在地形力学方面的效率和可扩展性，我们评估了在牵引固定负载下，候选设计在不同复杂程度轨迹上的表现。优化器调整车轮参数（半径、宽度和防滑齿特征）和转向PID增益，采用多目标优化方法，平衡了行驶速度、跟踪误差和能量消耗。我们比较了两种策略：车轮和控制器参数的同步联合优化，以及机械和控制设计解耦的顺序方法。我们分析了性能和计算成本之间的权衡。在3000次全车仿真中，优化过程在五到九天内完成，相比于该团队早期基于DEM的工作流程，减少到数月。最后，一项初步的硬件研究表明，经过仿真优化的车轮设计保留了物理漫游车上的相对性能趋势。总之，这些结果表明，可扩展的高保真仿真能够实现越野车辆在可变形地形上车轮设计和控制的实际联合优化，而无需依赖成本高昂的DEM研究。仿真基础设施（脚本和模型）以开源形式发布在公共存储库中，以支持可重复性和进一步的研究。
tldr: This paper presents a Bayesian optimization framework for co-designing rover wheel geometry and steering controller parameters using high-fidelity simulations on deformable terrain, demonstrating significant speedups compared to traditional DEM methods and releasing the simulation infrastructure as open source.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种贝叶斯优化框架，用于协同设计漫游车轮几何形状和转向控制器参数，该框架使用高保真模拟在可变形地形上进行设计。与传统的离散元方法相比，该方法显著提高了速度，并将模拟基础设施作为开源发布。

title: TriphiBot: A Triphibious Robot Combining FOC-based Propulsion with Eccentric Design
summary: Triphibious robots capable of multi-domain motion and cross-domain transitions are promising to handle complex tasks across diverse environments. However, existing designs primarily focus on dual-mode platforms, and some designs suffer from high mechanical complexity or low propulsion efficiency, which limits their application. In this paper, we propose a novel triphibious robot capable of aerial, terrestrial, and aquatic motion, by a minimalist design combining a quadcopter structure with two passive wheels, without extra actuators. To address inefficiency of ground-support motion (moving on land/seabed) for quadcopter based designs, we introduce an eccentric Center of Gravity (CoG) design that inherently aligns thrust with motion, enhancing efficiency without specialized mechanical transformation designs. Furthermore, to address the drastic differences in motion control caused by different fluids (air and water), we develop a unified propulsion system based on Field-Oriented Control (FOC). This method resolves torque matching issues and enables precise, rapid bidirectional thrust across different mediums. Grounded in the perspective of living condition and ground support, we analyse the robot's dynamics and propose a Hybrid Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (HNMPC)-PID control system to ensure stable multi-domain motion and seamless transitions. Experimental results validate the robot's multi-domain motion and cross-mode transition capability, along with the efficiency and adaptability of the proposed propulsion system.
summary_zh: 能够进行多域运动和跨域转换的三栖机器人，有望胜任跨越不同环境的复杂任务。然而，现有设计主要集中在双模式平台，且部分设计存在机械复杂度高或推进效率低的问题，限制了其应用范围。本文提出了一种新型三栖机器人，它通过将四旋翼结构与两个无源轮相结合的极简设计，无需额外执行器，即可实现空中、陆地和水下运动。为了解决基于四旋翼的设计在地面支撑运动（在陆地/海底移动）中的效率低下问题，我们引入了一种偏心重心（CoG）设计，该设计能够固有地将推力与运动对齐，从而在无需专门机械结构转换设计的情况下提高效率。此外，为了解决不同流体（空气和水）引起的运动控制的巨大差异，我们开发了一种基于磁场定向控制（FOC）的统一推进系统。该方法解决了扭矩匹配问题，并能实现跨不同介质的精确、快速的双向推力。基于生存状态和地面支撑的视角，我们分析了机器人的动力学特性，并提出了一种混合非线性模型预测控制（HNMPC）-PID控制系统，以确保稳定的多域运动和无缝转换。实验结果验证了机器人的多域运动和跨模式转换能力，以及所提出的推进系统的效率和适应性。
tldr: This paper presents a triphibious robot (aerial, terrestrial, aquatic) design using a minimalist approach with an eccentric CoG and FOC-based propulsion for efficient and stable multi-domain motion and transitions.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种三栖机器人（空中、陆地、水上）设计，采用极简方法，利用偏心重心和基于FOC的推进系统，实现了高效稳定的多域运动和转换。

title: SOPRAG: Multi-view Graph Experts Retrieval for Industrial Standard Operating Procedures
summary: Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are essential for ensuring operational safety and consistency in industrial environments. However, retrieving and following these procedures presents unique challenges, such as rigid proprietary structures, condition-dependent relevance, and actionable execution requirement, which standard semantic-driven Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) paradigms fail to address. Inspired by the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm, we propose SOPRAG, a novel framework specifically designed to address the above pain points in SOP retrieval. SOPRAG replaces flat chunking with specialized Entity, Causal, and Flow graph experts to resolve industrial structural and logical complexities. To optimize and coordinate these experts, we propose a Procedure Card layer that prunes the search space to eliminate computational noise, and an LLM-Guided gating mechanism that dynamically weights these experts to align retrieval with operator intent. To address the scarcity of domain-specific data, we also introduce an automated, multi-agent workflow for benchmark construction. Extensive experiments across four industrial domains demonstrate that SOPRAG significantly outperforms strong lexical, dense, and graph-based RAG baselines in both retrieval accuracy and response utility, achieving perfect execution scores in real-world critical tasks.
summary_zh: 标准操作规程（SOPs）对于确保工业环境中的操作安全和一致性至关重要。然而，检索和遵循这些规程面临着独特的挑战，例如僵化的专有结构、条件依赖的相关性以及可执行的操作要求，这些挑战是标准语义驱动的检索增强生成（RAG）范式无法解决的。受到专家混合（MoE）范式的启发，我们提出SOPRAG，一种专门为解决上述SOP检索痛点而设计的新型框架。SOPRAG利用专业的实体图、因果图和流程图专家取代扁平分块，以解决工业中的结构和逻辑复杂性。为了优化和协调这些专家，我们提出了一个规程卡层，该层通过裁剪搜索空间来消除计算噪声，以及一个LLM引导的门控机制，该机制动态地加权这些专家，使检索与操作员的意图对齐。为了解决领域特定数据的稀缺问题，我们还引入了一种用于基准构建的自动化多智能体工作流程。在四个工业领域进行的大量实验表明，SOPRAG在检索准确性和响应效用方面都显著优于强大的词汇、密集和基于图的RAG基线，并在实际的关键任务中实现了完美的执行分数。
tldr: The paper introduces SOPRAG, a Mixture-of-Experts RAG framework utilizing specialized graph experts and LLM-guided gating to improve SOP retrieval in industrial settings, demonstrating superior performance over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SOPRAG的基于专家混合的RAG框架，它利用专门的图专家和LLM引导的门控机制来改进工业环境中的SOP检索，并展示出优于现有方法的性能。

title: Time2Vec Transformer for Robust Gesture Recognition from Low-Density sEMG
summary: Accurate and responsive myoelectric prosthesis control typically relies on complex, dense multi-sensor arrays, which limits consumer accessibility. This paper presents a novel, data-efficient deep learning framework designed to achieve precise and accurate control using minimal sensor hardware. Leveraging an external dataset of 8 subjects, our approach implements a hybrid Transformer optimized for sparse, two-channel surface electromyography (sEMG). Unlike standard architectures that use fixed positional encodings, we integrate Time2Vec learnable temporal embeddings to capture the stochastic temporal warping inherent in biological signals. Furthermore, we employ a normalized additive fusion strategy that aligns the latent distributions of spatial and temporal features, preventing the destructive interference common in standard implementations. A two-stage curriculum learning protocol is utilized to ensure robust feature extraction despite data scarcity. The proposed architecture achieves a state-of-the-art multi-subject F1-score of 95.7% $\pm$ 0.20% for a 10-class movement set, statistically outperforming both a standard Transformer with fixed encodings and a recurrent CNN-LSTM model. Architectural optimization reveals that a balanced allocation of model capacity between spatial and temporal dimensions yields the highest stability. Furthermore, while direct transfer to a new unseen subject led to poor accuracy due to domain shifts, a rapid calibration protocol utilizing only two trials per gesture recovered performance from 21.0% $\pm$ 2.98% to 96.9% $\pm$ 0.52%. By validating that high-fidelity temporal embeddings can compensate for low spatial resolution, this work challenges the necessity of high-density sensing. The proposed framework offers a robust, cost-effective blueprint for next-generation prosthetic interfaces capable of rapid personalization.
summary_zh: 准确且响应迅速的肌电假肢控制通常依赖于复杂、密集的多元传感器阵列，这限制了消费者的可及性。本文提出了一种新型的、数据高效的深度学习框架，旨在使用最少的传感器硬件实现精确的控制。利用包含8个受试者的数据集，我们的方法实现了一种针对稀疏、双通道表面肌电（sEMG）优化的混合Transformer。与使用固定位置编码的标准架构不同，我们集成了Time2Vec可学习的时间嵌入，以捕捉生物信号中固有的随机时间扭曲。此外，我们采用标准化的加性融合策略，对齐空间和时间特征的潜在分布，从而避免标准实现中常见的破坏性干扰。采用两阶段课程学习协议，以确保在数据稀缺的情况下能够进行稳健的特征提取。对于10类运动集合，所提出的架构实现了最先进的多受试者F1分数95.7% $\pm$ 0.20%，在统计学上优于具有固定编码的标准Transformer和循环 CNN-LSTM模型。 架构优化表明，在空间和时间维度之间平衡分配模型容量可产生最高的稳定性。 此外，虽然直接转移到新的未见受试者会导致因域偏移而造成的准确度下降，但仅利用每个手势两次试验的快速校准协议将性能从21.0% $\pm$ 2.98% 恢复到96.9% $\pm$ 0.52%。通过验证高保真时间嵌入可以补偿低空间分辨率，这项工作挑战了高密度传感的必要性。 所提出的框架为下一代具有快速个性化能力的假肢界面提供了一个稳健且经济高效的蓝图。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel Transformer-based architecture for robust gesture recognition from sparse sEMG data by using Time2Vec embeddings and curriculum learning, achieving state-of-the-art performance with minimal sensors and rapid personalization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的基于Transformer的架构，通过使用Time2Vec嵌入和课程学习从稀疏的sEMG数据中实现鲁棒的手势识别，以最少的传感器和快速个性化实现了最先进的性能。

title: Mitigating loss of control in advanced AI systems through instrumental goal trajectories
summary: Researchers at artificial intelligence labs and universities are concerned that highly capable artificial intelligence (AI) systems may erode human control by pursuing instrumental goals. Existing mitigations remain largely technical and system-centric: tracking capability in advanced systems, shaping behaviour through methods such as reinforcement learning from human feedback, and designing systems to be corrigible and interruptible. Here we develop instrumental goal trajectories to expand these options beyond the model. Gaining capability typically depends on access to additional technical resources, such as compute, storage, data and adjacent services, which in turn requires access to monetary resources. In organisations, these resources can be obtained through three organisational pathways. We label these pathways the procurement, governance and finance instrumental goal trajectories (IGTs). Each IGT produces a trail of organisational artefacts that can be monitored and used as intervention points when a systems capabilities or behaviour exceed acceptable thresholds. In this way, IGTs offer concrete avenues for defining capability levels and for broadening how corrigibility and interruptibility are implemented, shifting attention from model properties alone to the organisational systems that enable them.
summary_zh: 人工智能实验室和大学的研究人员担心，能力极强的人工智能（AI）系统可能会通过追求工具性目标来削弱人类的控制权。现有的缓解措施主要集中在技术和系统层面，包括跟踪高级系统的能力、通过诸如基于人类反馈的强化学习等方法塑造行为，以及将系统设计为可纠正和可中断的。本文提出工具性目标轨迹，以将上述选择扩展到模型之外。获得能力通常依赖于获取额外的技术资源，如计算、存储、数据和相关服务，而这些又需要获取货币资源。在组织机构中，这些资源可以通过三种组织途径获得。我们将这些途径分别标记为采购、治理和财务工具性目标轨迹（IGTs）。每条IGT都会产生一系列组织产物，可以对其进行监控，并将其用作干预点，当某个系统的能力或行为超过可接受的阈值时，即可进行干预。通过这种方式，IGT为定义能力水平和扩展可纠正性和可中断性的实施方式提供了具体途径，从而将关注点从模型属性本身转移到支持它们的组织系统上。
tldr: This paper proposes instrumental goal trajectories (IGTs), focusing on organizational pathways (procurement, governance, finance) to monitor and intervene in AI capability development, shifting focus from model-centric solutions to broader organizational systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出工具性目标轨迹 (IGTs)，侧重于组织路径（采购、治理、财务）以监控和干预人工智能能力发展，将重点从以模型为中心的解决方案转移到更广泛的组织系统。

title: PRISM: Festina Lente Proactivity -- Risk-Sensitive, Uncertainty-Aware Deliberation for Proactive Agents
summary: Proactive agents must decide not only what to say but also whether and when to intervene. Many current systems rely on brittle heuristics or indiscriminate long reasoning, which offers little control over the benefit-burden tradeoff. We formulate the problem as cost-sensitive selective intervention and present PRISM, a novel framework that couples a decision-theoretic gate with a dual-process reasoning architecture. At inference time, the agent intervenes only when a calibrated probability of user acceptance exceeds a threshold derived from asymmetric costs of missed help and false alarms. Inspired by festina lente (Latin: "make haste slowly"), we gate by an acceptance-calibrated, cost-derived threshold and invoke a resource-intensive Slow mode with counterfactual checks only near the decision boundary, concentrating computation on ambiguous and high-stakes cases. Training uses gate-aligned, schema-locked distillation: a teacher running the full PRISM pipeline provides dense, executable supervision on unlabeled interaction traces, while the student learns a response policy that is explicitly decoupled from the intervention gate to enable tunable and auditable control. On ProactiveBench, PRISM reduces false alarms by 22.78% and improves F1 by 20.14% over strong baselines. These results show that principled decision-theoretic gating, paired with selective slow reasoning and aligned distillation, yields proactive agents that are precise, computationally efficient, and controllable. To facilitate reproducibility, we release our code, models, and resources at https://prism-festinalente.github.io/; all experiments use the open-source ProactiveBench benchmark.
summary_zh: 主动代理不仅必须决定说什么，还必须决定是否以及何时进行干预。许多现有系统依赖于脆弱的启发式方法或不加区分的长时间推理，这对于收益-负担权衡几乎没有控制。我们将该问题表述为成本敏感的选择性干预，并提出了PRISM，一个将决策理论门控与双过程推理架构相结合的新颖框架。在推理时，代理仅在用户接受的校准概率超过从错过帮助和误报的不对称成本得出的阈值时才进行干预。受 Festina lente（拉丁语：“欲速则不达”）的启发，我们通过一个接受度校准的、成本导出的阈值进行门控，并且仅在决策边界附近调用资源密集型的慢速模式进行反事实检查，从而将计算集中于模棱两可和高风险的案例。训练使用门控对齐、模式锁定的蒸馏：运行完整 PRISM 流程的教师在未标记的交互轨迹上提供密集的、可执行的监督，而学生学习一种响应策略，该策略与干预门控显式解耦，从而实现可调和可审计的控制。在 ProactiveBench 上，PRISM 将误报率降低了 22.78%，并将 F1 值提高了 20.14%，优于强大的基线模型。这些结果表明，有原则的决策理论门控与选择性慢速推理和对齐蒸馏相结合，可以产生精确、计算高效且可控的主动代理。为了方便重现，我们在 https://prism-festinalente.github.io/ 上发布了我们的代码、模型和资源；所有实验均使用开源 ProactiveBench 基准。
tldr: The paper presents PRISM, a decision-theoretic framework for proactive agents that selectively invoke resource-intensive reasoning based on calibrated cost-benefit analysis, reducing false alarms and improving performance on the ProactiveBench benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了PRISM， 一种基于决策理论的先动代理框架，它根据校准的成本效益分析选择性地调用资源密集型推理，从而减少了误报并提高了ProactiveBench基准上的性能。

title: White-Box Neural Ensemble for Vehicular Plasticity: Quantifying the Efficiency Cost of Symbolic Auditability in Adaptive NMPC
summary: We present a white-box adaptive NMPC architecture that resolves vehicular plasticity (adaptation to varying operating regimes without retraining) by arbitrating among frozen, regime-specific neural specialists using a Modular Sovereignty paradigm. The ensemble dynamics are maintained as a fully traversable symbolic graph in CasADi, enabling maximal runtime auditability. Synchronous simulation validates rapid adaptation (~7.3 ms) and near-ideal tracking fidelity under compound regime shifts (friction, mass, drag) where non-adaptive baselines fail. Empirical benchmarking quantifies the transparency cost: symbolic graph maintenance increases solver latency by 72-102X versus compiled parametric physics models, establishing the efficiency price of strict white-box implementation.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种白盒自适应NMPC架构，该架构通过使用模块化主权范式在冻结的、特定于工况的神经专家之间进行仲裁，从而解决车辆可塑性问题（无需重新训练即可适应不同的运行状态）。集成动力学系统被维护为CasADi中完全可遍历的符号图，从而实现最大程度的运行时可审计性。同步仿真验证了在复合状态转变（摩擦、质量、阻力）下快速适应（约7.3毫秒）和接近理想的跟踪保真度，而非自适应基线方法则无法实现。经验基准测试量化了透明度成本：与编译的参数化物理模型相比，符号图维护将求解器延迟增加了72-102倍，从而确定了严格白盒实现的效率代价。
tldr: This paper introduces a white-box adaptive NMPC architecture for vehicular plasticity using a neural ensemble with symbolic auditability, quantifying the computational cost of this transparency versus traditional methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于车辆可塑性的白盒自适应NMPC架构，该架构使用具有符号可审计性的神经集成，并量化了这种透明度相对于传统方法的计算成本。

title: LiFlow: Flow Matching for 3D LiDAR Scene Completion
summary: In autonomous driving scenarios, the collected LiDAR point clouds can be challenged by occlusion and long-range sparsity, limiting the perception of autonomous driving systems. Scene completion methods can infer the missing parts of incomplete 3D LiDAR scenes. Recent methods adopt local point-level denoising diffusion probabilistic models, which require predicting Gaussian noise, leading to a mismatch between training and inference initial distributions. This paper introduces the first flow matching framework for 3D LiDAR scene completion, improving upon diffusion-based methods by ensuring consistent initial distributions between training and inference. The model employs a nearest neighbor flow matching loss and a Chamfer distance loss to enhance both local structure and global coverage in the alignment of point clouds. LiFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple metrics. Code: https://github.com/matteandre/LiFlow.
summary_zh: 在自动驾驶场景中，采集到的激光雷达点云会面临遮挡和远距离稀疏性的挑战，从而限制自动驾驶系统的感知能力。场景补全方法可以推断不完整3D激光雷达场景中缺失的部分。最近的方法采用局部点级别去噪扩散概率模型，这需要预测高斯噪声，导致训练和推理之间的初始分布不匹配。本文提出了首个用于3D激光雷达场景补全的流匹配框架，通过确保训练和推理之间一致的初始分布，改进了基于扩散的方法。该模型采用最近邻流匹配损失和倒角距离损失，以增强点云对齐的局部结构和全局覆盖率。"LiFlow"在多个指标上实现了最先进的性能。代码：https://github.com/matteandre/LiFlow。
tldr: LiFlow introduces a flow matching framework for 3D LiDAR scene completion, addressing the distribution mismatch in diffusion-based methods and achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: LiFlow 引入了一种用于 3D LiDAR 场景补全的流匹配框架，解决了基于扩散的方法中的分布不匹配问题，并取得了最先进的性能。

title: WS-IMUBench: Can Weakly Supervised Methods from Audio, Image, and Video Be Adapted for IMU-based Temporal Action Localization?
summary: IMU-based Human Activity Recognition (HAR) has enabled a wide range of ubiquitous computing applications, yet its dominant clip classification paradigm cannot capture the rich temporal structure of real-world behaviors. This motivates a shift toward IMU Temporal Action Localization (IMU-TAL), which predicts both action categories and their start/end times in continuous streams. However, current progress is strongly bottlenecked by the need for dense, frame-level boundary annotations, which are costly and difficult to scale. To address this bottleneck, we introduce WS-IMUBench, a systematic benchmark study of weakly supervised IMU-TAL (WS-IMU-TAL) under only sequence-level labels. Rather than proposing a new localization algorithm, we evaluate how well established weakly supervised localization paradigms from audio, image, and video transfer to IMU-TAL under only sequence-level labels. We benchmark seven representative weakly supervised methods on seven public IMU datasets, resulting in over 3,540 model training runs and 7,080 inference evaluations. Guided by three research questions on transferability, effectiveness, and insights, our findings show that (i) transfer is modality-dependent, with temporal-domain methods generally more stable than image-derived proposal-based approaches; (ii) weak supervision can be competitive on favorable datasets (e.g., with longer actions and higher-dimensional sensing); and (iii) dominant failure modes arise from short actions, temporal ambiguity, and proposal quality. Finally, we outline concrete directions for advancing WS-IMU-TAL (e.g., IMU-specific proposal generation, boundary-aware objectives, and stronger temporal reasoning). Beyond individual results, WS-IMUBench establishes a reproducible benchmarking template, datasets, protocols, and analyses, to accelerate community-wide progress toward scalable WS-IMU-TAL.
summary_zh: 基于IMU的人体活动识别（HAR）已经促成了广泛的普适计算应用，但其主导的片段分类范式无法捕捉现实世界行为中丰富的时序结构。这推动了向IMU时序动作定位（IMU-TAL）的转变，其在连续数据流中预测动作类别及其开始/结束时间。然而，当前的进展受到对密集、帧级别边界标注需求的强烈制约，这些标注成本高昂且难以扩展。为了解决这个瓶颈，我们引入了WS-IMUBench，一项对仅使用序列级别标签的弱监督IMU-TAL（WS-IMU-TAL）的系统性基准研究。我们没有提出新的定位算法，而是评估了来自音频、图像和视频的已建立的弱监督定位范式在仅使用序列级别标签的情况下，如何转移到IMU-TAL中。我们 benchmark 了七种具有代表性的弱监督方法在七个公开IMU数据集上的表现，共进行了超过3540次模型训练运行和7080次推理评估。在关于可迁移性、有效性和洞察力的三个研究问题的指导下，我们的发现表明：（i）迁移是模态相关的，时域方法通常比基于图像的 proposal 方法更稳定；（ii）在有利的数据集上（例如，具有较长动作和更高维度传感的数据集），弱监督可能具有竞争力；以及（iii）主要的失效模式源于短动作、时序模糊性和 proposal 质量。最后，我们概述了推进WS-IMU-TAL的具体方向（例如，IMU特定的 proposal 生成、边界感知目标和更强的时序推理）。除了单个结果之外，WS-IMUBench 还建立了一个可复现的基准测试模板、数据集、协议和分析，以加速社区范围内朝着可扩展的WS-IMU-TAL 的进展。
tldr: This paper introduces WS-IMUBench, a benchmark for weakly supervised IMU-based temporal action localization, evaluating the transferability of methods from other modalities and identifying key challenges for future research.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了WS-IMUBench，一个用于弱监督的基于IMU的时间动作定位的基准，评估了来自其他模态的方法的可转移性，并确定了未来研究的关键挑战。

title: DenVisCoM: Dense Vision Correspondence Mamba for Efficient and Real-time Optical Flow and Stereo Estimation
summary: In this work, we propose a novel Mamba block DenVisCoM, as well as a novel hybrid architecture specifically tailored for accurate and real-time estimation of optical flow and disparity estimation. Given that such multi-view geometry and motion tasks are fundamentally related, we propose a unified architecture to tackle them jointly. Specifically, the proposed hybrid architecture is based on DenVisCoM and a Transformer-based attention block that efficiently addresses real-time inference, memory footprint, and accuracy at the same time for joint estimation of motion and 3D dense perception tasks. We extensively analyze the benchmark trade-off of accuracy and real-time processing on a large number of datasets. Our experimental results and related analysis suggest that our proposed model can accurately estimate optical flow and disparity estimation in real time. All models and associated code are available at https://github.com/vimstereo/DenVisCoM.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新型Mamba块DenVisCoM，以及一种专门为准确和实时估计光流和视差而设计的混合架构。鉴于这种多视图几何和运动任务本质上相关，我们提出了一种统一的架构来共同解决它们。 具体来说，所提出的混合架构基于DenVisCoM和一个基于Transformer的注意力块，该注意力块能有效地解决实时推理、内存占用和准确性问题，从而实现运动和3D密集感知任务的联合估计。 我们在大量数据集上广泛分析了准确性和实时处理的基准权衡。实验结果和相关分析表明，我们提出的模型可以实时准确地估计光流和视差。 所有模型和相关代码均可在https://github.com/vimstereo/DenVisCoM上获得。
tldr: This paper introduces DenVisCoM, a novel Mamba-based block and hybrid architecture for real-time, accurate optical flow and stereo (disparity) estimation, tackling these tasks jointly.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的基于Mamba的块DenVisCoM以及一种混合架构，用于实时、精确地估计光流和立体（视差），并联合处理这些任务。

title: VRGaussianAvatar: Integrating 3D Gaussian Avatars into VR
summary: We present VRGaussianAvatar, an integrated system that enables real-time full-body 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) avatars in virtual reality using only head-mounted display (HMD) tracking signals. The system adopts a parallel pipeline with a VR Frontend and a GA Backend. The VR Frontend uses inverse kinematics to estimate full-body pose and streams the resulting pose along with stereo camera parameters to the backend. The GA Backend stereoscopically renders a 3DGS avatar reconstructed from a single image. To improve stereo rendering efficiency, we introduce Binocular Batching, which jointly processes left and right eye views in a single batched pass to reduce redundant computation and support high-resolution VR displays. We evaluate VRGaussianAvatar with quantitative performance tests and a within-subject user study against image- and video-based mesh avatar baselines. Results show that VRGaussianAvatar sustains interactive VR performance and yields higher perceived appearance similarity, embodiment, and plausibility. Project page and source code are available at https://vrgaussianavatar.github.io.
summary_zh: 我们提出了VRGaussianAvatar，一个集成的系统，仅使用头戴式显示器（HMD）跟踪信号即可在虚拟现实中实现实时的全身3D高斯溅射（3DGS）化身。该系统采用并行流水线，包含一个VR前端和一个GA后端。VR前端使用逆运动学估计全身姿势，并将结果姿势连同立体相机参数流式传输至后端。GA后端立体渲染一个从单张图像重建的3DGS化身。为了提高立体渲染效率，我们引入了双目批处理，在一个批处理过程中联合处理左右眼的视图，以减少冗余计算并支持高分辨率的VR显示。我们通过定量性能测试和与基于图像和视频的网格化身基线进行受试者内用户研究来评估VRGaussianAvatar。结果表明，VRGaussianAvatar能够维持交互式VR性能，并产生更高的感知外观相似性、身体感和可信度。项目页面和源代码可在https://vrgaussianavatar.github.io 获取。
tldr: VRGaussianAvatar introduces a system for real-time full-body 3D Gaussian Splatting avatars in VR using only HMD tracking, demonstrating improved performance and user experience compared to mesh-based avatars. It uses binocular batching for efficient stereo rendering.
tldr_zh: VRGaussianAvatar 提出了一个系统，仅使用头戴式显示器跟踪，即可在 VR 中实现实时全身 3D Gaussian Splatting 头像，与基于网格的头像相比，性能和用户体验均得到改善。 它使用双目批处理来实现高效的立体渲染。

title: HandMCM: Multi-modal Point Cloud-based Correspondence State Space Model for 3D Hand Pose Estimation
summary: 3D hand pose estimation that involves accurate estimation of 3D human hand keypoint locations is crucial for many human-computer interaction applications such as augmented reality. However, this task poses significant challenges due to self-occlusion of the hands and occlusions caused by interactions with objects. In this paper, we propose HandMCM to address these challenges. Our HandMCM is a novel method based on the powerful state space model (Mamba). By incorporating modules for local information injection/filtering and correspondence modeling, the proposed correspondence Mamba effectively learns the highly dynamic kinematic topology of keypoints across various occlusion scenarios. Moreover, by integrating multi-modal image features, we enhance the robustness and representational capacity of the input, leading to more accurate hand pose estimation. Empirical evaluations on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, particularly in challenging scenarios involving severe occlusions. These results highlight the potential of our approach to advance the accuracy and reliability of 3D hand pose estimation in practical applications.
summary_zh:
摘要：
三维手部姿态估计，涉及精确估计三维人体手部关键点位置，对于增强现实等许多人机交互应用至关重要。然而，由于手部的自遮挡以及与物体交互引起的遮挡，这项任务面临着重大挑战。在本文中，我们提出了 HandMCM 以应对这些挑战。我们的 HandMCM 是一种基于强大的状态空间模型（Mamba）的新方法。通过结合用于局部信息注入/过滤和对应关系建模的模块，所提出的对应关系 Mamba 有效地学习了各种遮挡场景下关键点的高度动态的运动学拓扑结构。此外，通过整合多模态图像特征，我们增强了输入的鲁棒性和表征能力，从而实现更精确的手部姿态估计。在三个基准数据集上的经验评估表明，我们的模型显著优于当前最先进的方法，尤其是在涉及严重遮挡的具有挑战性的场景中。这些结果突显了我们的方法在提高实际应用中三维手部姿态估计的准确性和可靠性方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes HandMCM, a multi-modal point cloud-based correspondence state space model using Mamba for 3D hand pose estimation, demonstrating improved accuracy in occlusion scenarios compared to state-of-the-art methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 HandMCM，一种基于 Mamba 的多模态点云对应状态空间模型，用于 3D 手部姿势估计，与最先进的方法相比，在遮挡场景中表现出更高的准确性。

title: Visible Light Positioning With Lamé Curve LEDs: A Generic Approach for Camera Pose Estimation
summary: Camera-based visible light positioning (VLP) is a promising technique for accurate and low-cost indoor camera pose estimation (CPE). To reduce the number of required light-emitting diodes (LEDs), advanced methods commonly exploit LED shape features for positioning. Although interesting, they are typically restricted to a single LED geometry, leading to failure in heterogeneous LED-shape scenarios. To address this challenge, this paper investigates Lamé curves as a unified representation of common LED shapes and proposes a generic VLP algorithm using Lamé curve-shaped LEDs, termed LC-VLP. In the considered system, multiple ceiling-mounted Lamé curve-shaped LEDs periodically broadcast their curve parameters via visible light communication, which are captured by a camera-equipped receiver. Based on the received LED images and curve parameters, the receiver can estimate the camera pose using LC-VLP. Specifically, an LED database is constructed offline to store the curve parameters, while online positioning is formulated as a nonlinear least-squares problem and solved iteratively. To provide a reliable initialization, a correspondence-free perspective-\textit{n}-points (FreeP\textit{n}P) algorithm is further developed, enabling approximate CPE without any pre-calibrated reference points. The performance of LC-VLP is verified by both simulations and experiments. Simulations show that LC-VLP outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both circular- and rectangular-LED scenarios, achieving reductions of over 40% in position error and 25% in rotation error. Experiments further show that LC-VLP can achieve an average position accuracy of less than 4 cm.
summary_zh: 基于摄像头的可见光定位(VLP)是一种有前景的精确且低成本的室内相机姿态估计(CPE)技术。为了减少所需发光二极管(LED)的数量，先进的方法通常利用LED形状特征进行定位。虽然很有趣，但它们通常局限于单一的LED几何形状，导致在异构LED形状场景中失效。为了解决这个挑战，本文研究了Lamé曲线作为常见LED形状的统一表示，并提出了一种使用Lamé曲线形LED的通用VLP算法，称为LC-VLP。在此考虑的系统中，多个天花板安装的Lamé曲线形LED通过可见光通信定期广播它们的曲线参数，这些参数由配备摄像头的接收器捕获。基于接收到的LED图像和曲线参数，接收器可以使用LC-VLP估计相机姿态。具体而言，离线构建LED数据库以存储曲线参数，而在线定位被表述为非线性最小二乘问题并迭代求解。为了提供可靠的初始化，进一步开发了一种无对应关系的透视-\textit{n}-点(FreeP\textit{n}P)算法，无需任何预校准的参考点即可实现近似的CPE。LC-VLP的性能通过仿真和实验验证。仿真表明，LC-VLP在圆形和矩形LED场景中均优于最先进的方法，位置误差降低超过40%，旋转误差降低超过25%。实验进一步表明，LC-VLP可以实现小于4厘米的平均位置精度。
tldr: The paper introduces LC-VLP, a novel camera-based visible light positioning algorithm using Lamé curve-shaped LEDs for robust and accurate camera pose estimation in indoor environments, outperforming existing methods in heterogeneous LED setups.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新型的基于相机的可见光定位算法LC-VLP，该算法使用Lamé曲线形状的LED，用于室内环境中鲁棒且精确的相机姿态估计，胜过现有方法。

title: Training-free score-based diffusion for parameter-dependent stochastic dynamical systems
summary: Simulating parameter-dependent stochastic differential equations (SDEs) presents significant computational challenges, as separate high-fidelity simulations are typically required for each parameter value of interest. Despite the success of machine learning methods in learning SDE dynamics, existing approaches either require expensive neural network training for score function estimation or lack the ability to handle continuous parameter dependence. We present a training-free conditional diffusion model framework for learning stochastic flow maps of parameter-dependent SDEs, where both drift and diffusion coefficients depend on physical parameters. The key technical innovation is a joint kernel-weighted Monte Carlo estimator that approximates the conditional score function using trajectory data sampled at discrete parameter values, enabling interpolation across both state space and the continuous parameter domain. Once trained, the resulting generative model produces sample trajectories for any parameter value within the training range without retraining, significantly accelerating parameter studies, uncertainty quantification, and real-time filtering applications. The performance of the proposed approach is demonstrated via three numerical examples of increasing complexity, showing accurate approximation of conditional distributions across varying parameter values.
summary_zh: 模拟参数相关的随机微分方程(SDEs)带来显著的计算挑战，因为通常需要为每个感兴趣的参数值进行单独的高精度模拟。尽管机器学习方法在学习SDE动力学方面取得了成功，但现有方法要么需要昂贵的神经网络训练来进行得分函数估计，要么缺乏处理连续参数依赖性的能力。我们提出了一个无训练的条件扩散模型框架，用于学习参数相关SDEs的随机流映射，其中漂移项和扩散系数都依赖于物理参数。关键的技术创新是一种联合核加权蒙特卡罗估计器，它使用在离散参数值下采样的轨迹数据来近似条件得分函数，从而能够跨越状态空间和连续参数域进行插值。一旦训练完成，生成的模型就可以为训练范围内的任何参数值生成样本轨迹而无需重新训练，从而显著加速参数研究、不确定性量化和实时滤波应用。通过三个复杂度递增的数值例子展示了所提出方法的性能，表明了其对不同参数值下的条件分布的准确近似。
tldr: This paper introduces a training-free diffusion model for simulating parameter-dependent stochastic differential equations (SDEs), enabling efficient generation of trajectories across a continuous parameter space without retraining.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种无需训练的扩散模型，用于模拟参数相关的随机微分方程（SDEs），能够有效地生成跨连续参数空间的轨迹，而无需重新训练。

title: Data- and Variance-dependent Regret Bounds for Online Tabular MDPs
summary: This work studies online episodic tabular Markov decision processes (MDPs) with known transitions and develops best-of-both-worlds algorithms that achieve refined data-dependent regret bounds in the adversarial regime and variance-dependent regret bounds in the stochastic regime. We quantify MDP complexity using a first-order quantity and several new data-dependent measures for the adversarial regime, including a second-order quantity and a path-length measure, as well as variance-based measures for the stochastic regime. To adapt to these measures, we develop algorithms based on global optimization and policy optimization, both built on optimistic follow-the-regularized-leader with log-barrier regularization. For global optimization, our algorithms achieve first-order, second-order, and path-length regret bounds in the adversarial regime, and in the stochastic regime, they achieve a variance-aware gap-independent bound and a variance-aware gap-dependent bound that is polylogarithmic in the number of episodes. For policy optimization, our algorithms achieve the same data- and variance-dependent adaptivity, up to a factor of the episode horizon, by exploiting a new optimistic $Q$-function estimator. Finally, we establish regret lower bounds in terms of data-dependent complexity measures for the adversarial regime and a variance measure for the stochastic regime, implying that the regret upper bounds achieved by the global-optimization approach are nearly optimal.
summary_zh: 本文研究了具有已知转移概率的在线情境式表格型马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并开发了兼具最佳性能的算法，这些算法在对抗性机制下实现了精细的、数据相关的后悔界，在随机机制下实现了方差相关的后悔界。我们利用一阶量化以及几种新的数据相关度量来量化对抗性机制下的MDP复杂度，包括二阶量化和路径长度度量，以及随机机制下的基于方差的度量。为了适应这些度量，我们开发了基于全局优化和策略优化的算法，两者都建立在乐观正则化领导者跟随算法的基础上，并采用对数障碍型正则化。对于全局优化，我们的算法在对抗性机制下实现了基于一阶、二阶和路径长度的后悔界；在随机机制下，它们实现了方差感知、与间隙无关的界，以及一个关于情境数多项式对数的方差感知、与间隙相关的界。对于策略优化，我们的算法通过利用一种新的乐观$Q$函数估计器，在情境周期的范围内实现了相同的数据和方差相关自适应性。最后，我们建立了对抗性机制下数据相关复杂度度量以及随机机制下方差度量的后悔下界，这意味着全局优化方法实现的后悔上界几乎是最优的。
tldr: This paper develops best-of-both-worlds algorithms for online tabular MDPs with known transitions, achieving refined data-dependent and variance-dependent regret bounds in adversarial and stochastic regimes, respectively, and demonstrates near optimality through regret lower bounds.
tldr_zh: 本文针对具有已知转移的在线表格MDP，开发了兼顾对抗性和随机性 regimes 的算法，实现了 refined 的数据相关和方差相关的 regret bounds，并通过 regret 下界证明了算法的近似最优性。

title: Cost-Aware Bayesian Optimization for Prototyping Interactive Devices
summary: Deciding which idea is worth prototyping is a central concern in iterative design. A prototype should be produced when the expected improvement is high and the cost is low. However, this is hard to decide, because costs can vary drastically: a simple parameter tweak may take seconds, while fabricating hardware consumes material and energy. Such asymmetries, can discourage a designer from exploring the design space. In this paper, we present an extension of cost-aware Bayesian optimization to account for diverse prototyping costs. The method builds on the power of Bayesian optimization and requires only a minimal modification to the acquisition function. The key idea is to use designer-estimated costs to guide sampling toward more cost-effective prototypes. In technical evaluations, the method achieved comparable utility to a cost-agnostic baseline while requiring only ${\approx}70\%$ of the cost; under strict budgets, it outperformed the baseline threefold. A within-subjects study with 12 participants in a realistic joystick design task demonstrated similar benefits. These results show that accounting for prototyping costs can make Bayesian optimization more compatible with real-world design projects.
summary_zh: 在迭代设计中，决定哪个想法值得制作原型是一个核心问题。当预期改进较高且成本较低时，应该生成原型。然而，这很难决定，因为成本可能差异巨大：一个简单的参数调整可能只需几秒钟，而制造硬件则会消耗材料和能源。这种不对称性可能会阻碍设计师探索设计空间。在本文中，我们提出了一种成本感知贝叶斯优化的扩展，以考虑不同的原型制作成本。该方法建立在贝叶斯优化的强大功能之上，只需要对采集函数进行最小的修改。关键思想是使用设计师估计的成本来引导采样，从而获得更具成本效益的原型。在技术评估中，该方法在仅需 ${\approx}70\%$ 成本的情况下，获得了与成本无关的基线方法相当的效用；在严格的预算下，该方法的性能是基线方法的三倍。一项针对 12 名参与者在真实的操纵杆设计任务中进行的受试者内研究也表明了类似的优势。这些结果表明，考虑原型制作成本可以使贝叶斯优化更适用于现实世界的设计项目。
tldr: This paper introduces a cost-aware Bayesian optimization method for prototyping interactive devices, demonstrating improved cost-effectiveness compared to cost-agnostic approaches in both technical evaluations and a user study.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于交互式设备原型设计的成本感知贝叶斯优化方法，在技术评估和用户研究中均显示出比成本无关方法更高的成本效益。

title: TreeLoc: 6-DoF LiDAR Global Localization in Forests via Inter-Tree Geometric Matching
summary: Reliable localization is crucial for navigation in forests, where GPS is often degraded and LiDAR measurements are repetitive, occluded, and structurally complex. These conditions weaken the assumptions of traditional urban-centric localization methods, which assume that consistent features arise from unique structural patterns, necessitating forest-centric solutions to achieve robustness in these environments. To address these challenges, we propose TreeLoc, a LiDAR-based global localization framework for forests that handles place recognition and 6-DoF pose estimation. We represent scenes using tree stems and their Diameter at Breast Height (DBH), which are aligned to a common reference frame via their axes and summarized using the tree distribution histogram (TDH) for coarse matching, followed by fine matching with a 2D triangle descriptor. Finally, pose estimation is achieved through a two-step geometric verification. On diverse forest benchmarks, TreeLoc outperforms baselines, achieving precise localization. Ablation studies validate the contribution of each component. We also propose applications for long-term forest management using descriptors from a compact global tree database. TreeLoc is open-sourced for the robotics community at https://github.com/minwoo0611/TreeLoc.
summary_zh: 可靠的定位对于森林中的导航至关重要，在森林中，GPS信号通常会降级，而激光雷达（LiDAR）测量数据具有重复性、遮挡性和结构复杂性。这些条件削弱了传统以城市为中心的定位方法的假设，这些方法假设一致的特征来自于独特的结构模式，因此需要以森林为中心的解决方案来实现在这些环境中的鲁棒性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了TreeLoc，一种基于激光雷达的森林全局定位框架，用于处理地点识别和六自由度（6-DoF）位姿估计。我们使用树干及其胸径（DBH）来表示场景，这些树干通过其轴线对齐到一个共同的参考框架，并使用树木分布直方图（TDH）进行粗略匹配，然后使用二维三角形描述符进行精细匹配。最后，通过两步几何验证实现位姿估计。在不同的森林基准测试中，TreeLoc优于基线方法，实现了精确的定位。消融研究验证了每个组件的贡献。我们还提出了使用来自紧凑型全局树木数据库的描述符进行长期森林管理的应用。TreeLoc已在 https://github.com/minwoo0611/TreeLoc 上开源，供机器人社区使用。
