tldr: The paper introduces TreeLoc, a LiDAR-based global localization framework for forests using inter-tree geometric matching, outperforming baselines on diverse forest benchmarks. It uses tree stems and their DBH for localization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TreeLoc，一个基于激光雷达的森林全局定位框架，通过树木间的几何匹配实现定位，并在不同的森林基准测试中优于基线。它使用树干及其胸径进行定位。

title: Towards a Novel Wearable Robotic Vest for Hemorrhage Suppression
summary: This paper introduces a novel robotic system designed to manage severe bleeding in emergency scenarios, including unique environments like space stations. The robot features a shape-adjustable "ring mechanism", transitioning from a circular to an elliptical configuration to adjust wound coverage across various anatomical regions. We developed various arms for this ring mechanism with varying flexibilities to improve adaptability when applied to non-extremities of the body (abdomen, back, neck, etc.). To apply equal and constant pressure across the wound, we developed an inflatable ring and airbag balloon that are compatible with this shape-changing ring mechanism. A series of experiments focused on evaluating various ring arm configurations to characterize their bending stiffness. Subsequent experiments measured the force exerted by the airbag balloon system using a digital scale. Despite its promising performance, certain limitations related to coverage area are identified. The shape-changing effect of the device is limited to scenarios involving partially inflated or deflated airbag balloons, and cannot fully conform to complex anatomical regions. Finally, the device was tested on casualty simulation kits, where it successfully demonstrated its ability to control simulated bleeding.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种新型机器人系统，旨在处理紧急情况下的严重出血，包括诸如空间站等特殊环境。该机器人采用一种形状可调的“环形机构”，其能够从圆形过渡到椭圆形，以调整对不同解剖区域的伤口覆盖。我们为该环形机构开发了具有不同灵活性的多种臂，以提高其在应用于非肢体部位（腹部、背部、颈部等）时的适应性。为了在伤口上施加均匀且恒定的压力，我们开发了一种充气环和气囊，它们与这种形状可变的环形机构兼容。一系列实验的重点是评估各种环形臂配置，以表征其弯曲刚度。随后的实验使用数字秤测量了气囊系统施加的力。尽管其性能表现出前景，但仍存在与覆盖面积相关的某些局限性。该设备的形状改变效果仅限于涉及部分充气或放气的气囊的情况，无法完全适应复杂的解剖区域。最后，该设备已在伤员模拟套件上进行了测试，成功展示了其控制模拟出血的能力。
tldr: This paper presents a wearable robotic vest with a shape-adjustable ring mechanism and inflatable airbag system for hemorrhage suppression, demonstrating successful bleeding control in casualty simulation kits but acknowledging limitations in anatomical conformity.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种可穿戴机器人背心，它具有形状可调的环形机构和充气气囊系统，用于止血，在伤亡模拟套件中成功地展示了出血控制能力，但也承认了在解剖学一致性方面的局限性

title: Traffic-Aware Navigation in Road Networks
summary: This project compares three graph search approaches for the task of traffic-aware navigation in Kingston's road network. These approaches include a single-run multi-query preprocessing algorithm (Floyd-Warshall-Ingerman), continuous single-query real-time search (Dijkstra's and A*), and an algorithm combining both approaches to balance between their trade-offs by first finding the top K shortest paths then iterating over them in real time (Yen's). Dijkstra's and A* resulted in the most traffic-aware optimal solutions with minimal preprocessing required. Floyd-Warshall-Ingerman was the fastest in real time but provided distance based paths with no traffic awareness. Yen's algorithm required significant preprocessing but balanced between the other two approaches in terms of runtime speed and optimality. Each approach presents advantages and disadvantages that need to be weighed depending on the circumstances of specific deployment contexts to select the best custom solution. *This project was completed as part of ELEC 844 (Search and Planning Algorithms for Robotics) in the Fall 2025 term.
summary_zh: 本项目比较了三种图搜索方法在金斯顿道路网络交通感知导航任务中的应用。这些方法包括单次运行的多查询预处理算法（Floyd-Warshall-Ingerman）、连续单查询实时搜索（Dijkstra算法和A*算法）以及一种结合这两种方法以平衡其权衡的算法，该算法首先找到前K条最短路径，然后在实时环境中对它们进行迭代（Yen算法）。Dijkstra算法和A*算法产生了最佳交通感知解决方案，并且所需预处理最少。Floyd-Warshall-Ingerman在实时环境中速度最快，但提供的是基于距离的路径，不具备交通感知能力。Yen算法需要大量的预处理，但在运行时速度和最优性方面，它在这两种方法之间取得了平衡。每种方法都具有优点和缺点，需要在特定的部署环境的具体情况下进行权衡，以选择最佳的定制解决方案。*本项目是2025年秋季学期ELEC 844（机器人搜索与规划算法）课程的一部分。
tldr: This paper compares three graph search algorithms (Floyd-Warshall-Ingerman, Dijkstra's/A*, and Yen's) for traffic-aware navigation in a road network, evaluating their trade-offs between preprocessing time, real-time speed, and traffic awareness.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了三种图搜索算法（Floyd-Warshall-Ingerman、Dijkstra/A* 和 Yen 算法）在道路网络中进行交通感知导航的效果，评估了它们在预处理时间、实时速度和交通感知之间的权衡。

title: A Semi-Supervised Pipeline for Generalized Behavior Discovery from Animal-Borne Motion Time Series
summary: Learning behavioral taxonomies from animal-borne sensors is challenging because labels are scarce, classes are highly imbalanced, and behaviors may be absent from the annotated set. We study generalized behavior discovery in short multivariate motion snippets from gulls, where each sample is a sequence with 3-axis IMU acceleration (20 Hz) and GPS speed, spanning nine expert-annotated behavior categories. We propose a semi-supervised discovery pipeline that (i) learns an embedding function from the labeled subset, (ii) performs label-guided clustering over embeddings of both labeled and unlabeled samples to form candidate behavior groups, and (iii) decides whether a discovered group is truly novel using a containment score. Our key contribution is a KDE + HDR (highest-density region) containment score that measures how much a discovered cluster distribution is contained within, or contains, each known-class distribution; the best-match containment score serves as an interpretable novelty statistic. In experiments where an entire behavior is withheld from supervision and appears only in the unlabeled pool, the method recovers a distinct cluster and the containment score flags novelty via low overlap, while a negative-control setting with no novel behavior yields consistently higher overlaps. These results suggest that HDR-based containment provides a practical, quantitative test for generalized class discovery in ecological motion time series under limited annotation and severe class imbalance.
summary_zh: 从动物佩戴的传感器中学习行为分类体系具有挑战性，因为标签稀缺、类别高度不平衡，并且行为可能在标注集中缺失。我们研究了海鸥短多元运动片段中的广义行为发现，其中每个样本都是一个包含三轴IMU加速度（20 Hz）和GPS速度的序列，跨越九个专家标注的行为类别。我们提出了一种半监督发现流程，该流程 (i) 从标记的子集中学习一个嵌入函数，(ii) 对标记和未标记样本的嵌入执行标签引导的聚类，以形成候选行为组，以及 (iii) 使用包含分数来决定已发现的组是否真正新颖。我们的主要贡献是一个KDE + HDR（最高密度区域）包含分数，用于衡量一个发现的聚类分布在多大程度上被包含在每个已知类别分布中或包含它；最佳匹配包含分数用作可解释的新颖性统计量。在实验中，当整个行为从监督中被移除且仅出现在未标记池中时，该方法会恢复一个独特的聚类，并且包含分数通过低重叠标记新颖性，而没有新颖行为的阴性对照设置则产生始终较高的重叠。这些结果表明，基于HDR的包含为在受限标注和严重类别不平衡下的生态运动时间序列中进行广义类别发现提供了一种实用、定量的测试。
tldr: This paper presents a semi-supervised method for discovering novel animal behaviors from motion sensor data, using a containment score based on KDE and HDR to identify behaviors absent from the labeled training set.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种半监督方法，用于从运动传感器数据中发现新的动物行为，使用基于KDE和HDR的包含得分来识别训练集中没有标注的行为。

title: Cross-Modal Alignment and Fusion for RGB-D Transmission-Line Defect Detection
summary: Transmission line defect detection remains challenging for automated UAV inspection due to the dominance of small-scale defects, complex backgrounds, and illumination variations. Existing RGB-based detectors, despite recent progress, struggle to distinguish geometrically subtle defects from visually similar background structures under limited chromatic contrast. This paper proposes CMAFNet, a Cross-Modal Alignment and Fusion Network that integrates RGB appearance and depth geometry through a principled purify-then-fuse paradigm. CMAFNet consists of a Semantic Recomposition Module that performs dictionary-based feature purification via a learned codebook to suppress modality-specific noise while preserving defect-discriminative information, and a Contextual Semantic Integration Framework that captures global spatial dependencies using partial-channel attention to enhance structural semantic reasoning. Position-wise normalization within the purification stage enforces explicit reconstruction-driven cross-modal alignment, ensuring statistical compatibility between heterogeneous features prior to fusion. Extensive experiments on the TLRGBD benchmark, where 94.5% of instances are small objects, demonstrate that CMAFNet achieves 32.2% mAP@50 and 12.5% APs, outperforming the strongest baseline by 9.8 and 4.0 percentage points, respectively. A lightweight variant reaches 24.8% mAP50 at 228 FPS with only 4.9M parameters, surpassing all YOLO-based detectors while matching transformer-based methods at substantially lower computational cost.
summary_zh: 输电线路缺陷检测对于无人机自动化巡检仍然具有挑战性，原因在于小尺度缺陷占据主导地位、背景复杂且光照变化剧烈。现有基于RGB的检测器虽然取得了一些进展，但在色度对比度有限的情况下，很难区分几何形状细微的缺陷和视觉上相似的背景结构。本文提出了一种跨模态对齐与融合网络CMAFNet，该网络通过一种有原则的“净化-融合”范式集成RGB外观和深度几何信息。CMAFNet由语义重组模块和上下文语义集成框架组成。语义重组模块通过学习到的码本执行基于字典的特征净化，以抑制模态特定的噪声，同时保留区分缺陷的信息。上下文语义集成框架使用部分通道注意力捕捉全局空间依赖关系，以增强结构语义推理。净化阶段的位置式归一化强制执行显式的重建驱动的跨模态对齐，确保融合前异构特征之间的统计兼容性。在TLRGBD基准数据集上的大量实验表明，CMAFNet实现了32.2%的mAP@50和12.5%的APs，超越了最强的基线方法9.8和4.0个百分点，该数据集中94.5%的实例都是小目标。一个轻量级变体以228 FPS的速度和仅4.9M的参数达到了24.8%的mAP50，超过了所有基于YOLO的检测器，并在显著降低计算成本的同时与基于Transformer的方法相匹配。
tldr: The paper proposes CMAFNet, a cross-modal alignment and fusion network for detecting transmission line defects in RGB-D images, achieving state-of-the-art results on a small object-dominated benchmark with a lightweight, real-time capable variant.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了CMAFNet，一个用于检测RGB-D图像中输电线路缺陷的跨模态对齐和融合网络，在以小物体为主的基准测试上取得了最先进的结果，并且提供了一个轻量级的、可实时运行的变体。

title: Governance at the Edge of Architecture: Regulating NeuroAI and Neuromorphic Systems
summary: Current AI governance frameworks, including regulatory benchmarks for accuracy, latency, and energy efficiency, are built for static, centrally trained artificial neural networks on von Neumann hardware. NeuroAI systems, embodied in neuromorphic hardware and implemented via spiking neural networks, break these assumptions. This paper examines the limitations of current AI governance frameworks for NeuroAI, arguing that assurance and audit methods must co-evolve with these architectures, aligning traditional regulatory metrics with the physics, learning dynamics, and embodied efficiency of brain-inspired computation to enable technically grounded assurance.
summary_zh: 当前的人工智能治理框架，包括针对准确率、延迟和能效的监管基准，都是为冯·诺依曼架构硬件上静态、集中训练的人工神经网络而建立的。神经形态人工智能（NeuroAI）系统，具体表现为神经形态硬件并由脉冲神经网络实现，打破了这些假设。本文探讨了当前人工智能治理框架对NeuroAI的局限性，论证了保证和审计方法必须与这些架构共同演进，将传统的监管指标与受大脑启发计算的物理特性、学习动态和具身效率对齐，从而实现技术上扎实的保证。
tldr: The paper discusses the inadequacy of current AI governance frameworks for NeuroAI systems (neuromorphic hardware, spiking neural networks) and argues for the co-evolution of assurance/audit methods with these architectures.
tldr_zh: 本文讨论了当前人工智能治理框架在神经人工智能系统（神经形态硬件、脉冲神经网络）方面的不足，并认为保证/审计方法应与这些架构共同发展。

title: Draw2Learn: A Human-AI Collaborative Tool for Drawing-Based Science Learning
summary: Drawing supports learning by externalizing mental models, but providing timely feedback at scale remains challenging. We present Draw2Learn, a system that explores how AI can act as a supportive teammate during drawing-based learning. The design translates learning principles into concrete interaction patterns: AI generates structured drawing quests, provides optional visual scaffolds, monitors progress, and delivers multidimensional feedback. We collected formative user feedback during system development and open-ended comments. Feedback showed positive ratings for usability, usefulness, and user experience, with themes highlighting AI scaffolding value and learner autonomy. This work contributes a design framework for teammate-oriented AI in generative learning and identifies key considerations for future research.
summary_zh: 通过将心理模型外化，绘画能够支持学习，但在大规模教学中提供及时的反馈仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了 Draw2Learn，一个探索人工智能如何在
tldr: Draw2Learn is a human-AI collaborative tool providing structured drawing quests and feedback for science learning, demonstrating positive user feedback on usability and AI scaffolding.
tldr_zh: Draw2Learn 是一个人机协作工具，为科学学习提供结构化的绘画任务和反馈，用户对其可用性和 AI 支架给予了积极的反馈。

title: Semi-supervised CAPP Transformer Learning via Pseudo-labeling
summary: High-level Computer-Aided Process Planning (CAPP) generates manufacturing process plans from part specifications. It suffers from limited dataset availability in industry, reducing model generalization. We propose a semi-supervised learning approach to improve transformer-based CAPP transformer models without manual labeling. An oracle, trained on available transformer behaviour data, filters correct predictions from unseen parts, which are then used for one-shot retraining. Experiments on small-scale datasets with simulated ground truth across the full data distribution show consistent accuracy gains over baselines, demonstrating the method's effectiveness in data-scarce manufacturing environments.
summary_zh: 高级计算机辅助工艺规划（CAPP）可以从零件规格生成制造工艺计划。然而，工业领域中可用的数据集有限，降低了模型的泛化能力。我们提出一种半监督学习方法，以改进基于Transformer的CAPP模型，而无需手动标注。一个在已有的Transformer行为数据上训练的“先知”会对来自未见零件的正确预测进行过滤，然后将其用于单次重训练。在具有模拟真实值的完整数据分布的小规模数据集上进行的实验表明，该方法相对于基准线具有持续的精度提升，证明了其在数据稀缺的制造环境中的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes a semi-supervised learning approach using pseudo-labeling to improve transformer-based Computer-Aided Process Planning (CAPP) models in data-scarce manufacturing environments. An oracle filters predictions to retrain the model.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种半监督学习方法，使用伪标签来改进数据稀缺制造环境中的基于Transformer的计算机辅助工艺规划(CAPP)模型。通过一个oracle来过滤预测结果，从而重新训练模型。

title: Evaluating OCR Performance for Assistive Technology: Effects of Walking Speed, Camera Placement, and Camera Type
summary: Optical character recognition (OCR), which converts printed or handwritten text into machine-readable form, is widely used in assistive technology for people with blindness and low vision. Yet, most evaluations rely on static datasets that do not reflect the challenges of mobile use. In this study, we systematically evaluated OCR performance under both static and dynamic conditions. Static tests measured detection range across distances of 1-7 meters and viewing angles of 0-75 degrees horizontally. Dynamic tests examined the impact of motion by varying walking speed from slow (0.8 m/s) to very fast (1.8 m/s) and comparing three camera mounting positions: head-mounted, shoulder-mounted, and hand-held. We evaluated both a smartphone and smart glasses, using the phone's main and ultra-wide cameras. Four OCR engines were benchmarked to assess accuracy at different distances and viewing angles: Google Vision, PaddleOCR 3.0, EasyOCR, and Tesseract. PaddleOCR 3.0 was then used to evaluate accuracy at different walking speeds. Accuracy was computed at the character level using the Levenshtein ratio against manually defined ground truth. Results showed that recognition accuracy declined with increased walking speed and wider viewing angles. Google Vision achieved the highest overall accuracy, with PaddleOCR close behind as the strongest open-source alternative. Across devices, the phone's main camera achieved the highest accuracy, and a shoulder-mounted placement yielded the highest average among body positions; however, differences among shoulder, head, and hand were not statistically significant.
summary_zh: 光学字符识别 (OCR) 将印刷或手写文本转换为机器可读形式，并在盲人和低视力人群的辅助技术中得到广泛应用。然而，大多数评估依赖于静态数据集，无法反映移动使用的挑战。在本研究中，我们系统地评估了 OCR 在静态和动态条件下的性能。静态测试测量了 1-7 米距离和 0-75 度水平视角范围内的检测范围。动态测试通过改变行走速度（从慢速的 0.8 米/秒到极快的 1.8 米/秒）并比较三种相机安装位置（头戴式、肩戴式和手持式）来考察运动的影响。我们评估了智能手机和智能眼镜，并使用了手机的主摄像头和超广角摄像头。我们对四个 OCR 引擎进行了基准测试，以评估不同距离和视角下的准确率：Google Vision、PaddleOCR 3.0、EasyOCR 和 Tesseract。随后，使用 PaddleOCR 3.0 评估了不同行走速度下的准确率。准确率以字符级别计算，采用莱文斯坦比率与手动定义的真值进行比较。结果表明，识别准确率随着行走速度的增加和视角范围的扩大而下降。Google Vision 获得了最高的总体准确率，PaddleOCR 紧随其后，是最好的开源替代方案。在所有设备中，手机的主摄像头获得了最高的准确率，而肩戴式位置在身体位置中获得了最高的平均准确率；然而，肩部、头部和手部之间的差异没有达到统计显著性。
tldr: This paper evaluates the performance of several OCR engines under various conditions relevant to assistive technology, including static tests of range and viewing angle, as well as dynamic tests manipulating walking speed and camera placement. The results identify Google Vision and PaddleOCR as strong performers and suggest phone cameras in shoulder-mounted positions are generally optimal.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了几种OCR引擎在与辅助技术相关的各种条件下的性能，包括范围和视角的静态测试，以及操纵步行速度和相机位置的动态测试。结果表明，Google Vision和PaddleOCR表现出色，并表明手机摄像头在肩挂位置通常是最佳的。

title: GDPR-Compliant Person Recognition in Industrial Environments Using MEMS-LiDAR and Hybrid Data
summary: The reliable detection of unauthorized individuals in safety-critical industrial indoor spaces is crucial to avoid plant shutdowns, property damage, and personal hazards. Conventional vision-based methods that use deep-learning approaches for person recognition provide image information but are sensitive to lighting and visibility conditions and often violate privacy regulations, such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) in the European Union. Typically, detection systems based on deep learning require annotated data for training. Collecting and annotating such data, however, is highly time-consuming and due to manual treatments not necessarily error free. Therefore, this paper presents a privacy-compliant approach based on Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems LiDAR (MEMS-LiDAR), which exclusively captures anonymized 3D point clouds and avoids personal identification features. To compensate for the large amount of time required to record real LiDAR data and for post-processing and annotation, real recordings are augmented with synthetically generated scenes from the CARLA simulation framework. The results demonstrate that the hybrid data improves the average precision by 44 percentage points compared to a model trained exclusively with real data while reducing the manual annotation effort by 50 %. Thus, the proposed approach provides a scalable, cost-efficient alternative to purely real-data-based methods and systematically shows how synthetic LiDAR data can combine high performance in person detection with GDPR compliance in an industrial environment.
summary_zh: 在安全攸关的工业室内空间中，可靠地检测未经授权的人员对于避免工厂停工、财产损失和人身危害至关重要。传统的基于视觉的方法，利用深度学习进行人员识别，虽然提供图像信息，但对光照和可见度条件敏感，并且常常违反隐私法规，如欧盟的《通用数据保护条例 (GDPR)》。通常，基于深度学习的检测系统需要标注的数据进行训练。然而，收集和标注此类数据非常耗时，并且由于人工处理，不一定没有错误。因此，本文提出了一种基于微机电系统激光雷达 (MEMS-LiDAR) 的合规隐私保护方法，该方法仅捕获匿名化3D点云，并避免了个人身份识别特征。为了弥补记录真实的激光雷达数据以及后期处理和标注所需的大量时间，本文使用CARLA模拟框架中生成的合成场景来增强真实记录。结果表明，与仅使用真实数据训练的模型相比，混合数据将平均精度提高了44个百分点，同时减少了50%的人工标注工作量。因此，所提出的方法提供了一种可扩展、具有成本效益的替代纯粹基于真实数据的方法，并系统地展示了合成激光雷达数据如何在工业环境中将人员检测的高性能与GDPR合规性相结合。
tldr: This paper proposes a GDPR-compliant person recognition system for industrial environments using MEMS-LiDAR and a hybrid real/synthetic data approach, demonstrating improved average precision and reduced annotation effort compared to real-data-only methods. It leverages CARLA for synthetic data generation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种GDPR合规的工业环境人员识别系统，该系统使用MEMS-LiDAR和混合的真实/合成数据方法，与仅使用真实数据的方法相比，该方法展示了更高的平均精度和更少的标注工作。它利用CARLA生成合成数据。

title: Spot-Wise Smart Parking: An Edge-Enabled Architecture with YOLOv11 and Digital Twin Integration
summary: Smart parking systems help reduce congestion and minimize users' search time, thereby contributing to smart city adoption and enhancing urban mobility. In previous works, we presented a system developed on a university campus to monitor parking availability by estimating the number of free spaces from vehicle counts within a region of interest. Although this approach achieved good accuracy, it restricted the system's ability to provide spot-level insights and support more advanced applications. To overcome this limitation, we extend the system with a spot-wise monitoring strategy based on a distance-aware matching method with spatial tolerance, enhanced through an Adaptive Bounding Box Partitioning method for challenging spaces. The proposed approach achieves a balanced accuracy of 98.80% while maintaining an inference time of 8 seconds on a resource-constrained edge device, enhancing the capabilities of YOLOv11m, a model that has a size of 40.5 MB. In addition, two new components were introduced: (i) a Digital Shadow that visually represents parking lot entities as a base to evolve to a full Digital Twin, and (ii) an application support server based on a repurposed TV box. The latter not only enables scalable communication among cloud services, the parking totem, and a bot that provides detailed spot occupancy statistics, but also promotes hardware reuse as a step towards greater sustainability.
authors: Gustavo P. C. P. da Luz
summary_zh: 智能停车系统有助于减少交通拥堵，最大限度地缩短用户搜索时间，从而促进智慧城市的普及，并提升城市交通的流动性。在之前的工作中，我们展示了一个在大学校园中开发的系统，该系统通过估计感兴趣区域内车辆的数量来监测停车位可用性。虽然这种方法实现了良好的准确性，但它限制了系统提供点位级洞察和支持更高级应用的能力。为了克服这个限制，我们扩展了该系统，采用了一种基于距离感知匹配策略和带有空间容差的点位监测方法，并通过一种针对具有挑战性空间的自适应边界框划分方法进行了增强。所提出的方法实现了98.80%的平衡准确率，同时在资源受限的边缘设备上保持了8秒的推理时间，提升了YOLOv11m（一个大小为40.5MB的模型）的性能。此外，还引入了两个新组件：（i）一个数字阴影，以视觉化地表示停车场实体，作为发展成完整数字孪生的基础；（ii）一个基于重新利用的电视盒的应用支持服务器。后者不仅实现了云服务、停车引导牌和一个提供详细点位占用统计信息的机器人之间的可扩展通信，而且促进了硬件再利用，从而朝着更大的可持续性迈进。
tldr: This paper introduces an edge-enabled smart parking system using YOLOv11 and a digital twin integration for spot-wise monitoring, achieving high accuracy and low latency while emphasizing hardware reuse for sustainability.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于YOLOv11和数字孪生集成的边缘智能停车系统，用于点位监控，实现了高精度和低延迟，同时强调硬件重用以实现可持续性。

title: SpikingGamma: Surrogate-Gradient Free and Temporally Precise Online Training of Spiking Neural Networks with Smoothed Delays
summary: Neuromorphic hardware implementations of Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) promise energy-efficient, low-latency AI through sparse, event-driven computation. Yet, training SNNs under fine temporal discretization remains a major challenge, hindering both low-latency responsiveness and the mapping of software-trained SNNs to efficient hardware. In current approaches, spiking neurons are modeled as self-recurrent units, embedded into recurrent networks to maintain state over time, and trained with BPTT or RTRL variants based on surrogate gradients. These methods scale poorly with temporal resolution, while online approximations often exhibit instability for long sequences and tend to fail at capturing temporal patterns precisely. To address these limitations, we develop spiking neurons with internal recursive memory structures that we combine with sigma-delta spike-coding. We show that this SpikingGamma model supports direct error backpropagation without surrogate gradients, can learn fine temporal patterns with minimal spiking in an online manner, and scale feedforward SNNs to complex tasks and benchmarks with competitive accuracy, all while being insensitive to the temporal resolution of the model. Our approach offers both an alternative to current recurrent SNNs trained with surrogate gradients, and a direct route for mapping SNNs to neuromorphic hardware.
summary_zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNNs）的神经形态硬件实现有望通过稀疏、事件驱动的计算实现节能、低延迟的人工智能。然而，在精细时间离散化下训练SNN仍然是一个主要的挑战，阻碍了低延迟响应和软件训练SNN到高效硬件的映射。在目前的方法中，脉冲神经元被建模为自循环单元，嵌入到循环网络中以维持随时间变化的状态，并使用基于替代梯度的BPTT或RTRL变体进行训练。这些方法在时间分辨率上扩展性差，而在线近似通常表现出长序列的不稳定性，并且往往无法精确捕捉时间模式。为了解决这些局限性，我们开发了具有内部递归记忆结构的脉冲神经元，并将其与sigma-delta脉冲编码相结合。我们证明了这种SpikingGamma模型支持直接误差反向传播而无需替代梯度，可以以在线方式用最少的脉冲学习精细的时间模式，并将前馈SNN扩展到复杂的任务和基准测试，并具有竞争力的准确性，同时对模型的时间分辨率不敏感。我们的方法既为当前使用替代梯度训练的循环SNN提供了一种替代方案，也为将SNN映射到神经形态硬件提供了直接途径。
tldr: This paper introduces SpikingGamma, a novel spiking neural network model with internal memory structures and sigma-delta spike-coding, enabling surrogate-gradient-free, temporally precise online training, which offers a direct route for mapping SNNs to neuromorphic hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为SpikingGamma的新型脉冲神经网络模型，该模型具有内部存储结构和sigma-delta脉冲编码，实现了无需代理梯度的、时间精确的在线训练，为将SNN映射到神经形态硬件提供了直接途径。

title: Extending the Law of Intersegmental Coordination: Implications for Powered Prosthetic Controls
summary: Powered prostheses are capable of providing net positive work to amputees and have advanced in the past two decades. However, reducing amputee metabolic cost of walking remains an open problem. The Law of Intersegmental Coordination (ISC) has been observed across gaits and has been previously implicated in energy expenditure of walking, yet it has rarely been analyzed or applied within the context of lower-limb amputee gait. This law states that the elevation angles of the thigh, shank and foot over the gait cycle are not independent. In this work, we developed a method to analyze intersegmental coordination for lower-limb 3D kinematic data, to simplify ISC analysis. Moreover, inspired by motor control, biomechanics and robotics literature, we used our method to broaden ISC toward a new law of coordination of moments. We find these Elevation Space Moments (ESM), and present results showing a moment-based coordination for able bodied gait. We also analyzed ISC for amputee gait walking with powered and passive prosthesis, and found that while elevation angles remained planar, the ESM showed less coordination. We use ISC as a constraint to predict the shank angles/moments that would compensate for alterations due to a passive foot so as to mimic a healthy thigh angle/moment profile. This may have implications for improving powered prosthetic control. We developed the ISC3d toolbox that is freely available online, which may be used to compute kinematic and kinetic ISC in 3D. This provides a means to further study the role of coordination in gait and may help address fundamental questions of the neural control of human movement.
summary_zh: 动力假肢能够为截肢者提供净正功，并在过去二十年中取得了进步。然而，降低截肢者步行的代谢成本仍然是一个未决问题。“节段间协调定律”（ISC）已在各种步态中观察到，并已被认为与步行的能量消耗有关，但它很少在下肢截肢者步态的背景下进行分析或应用。该定律表明，大腿、小腿和足部在步态周期内的仰角并非相互独立的。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种分析下肢三维运动学数据节段间协调性的方法，以简化ISC分析。此外，受到运动控制、生物力学和机器人学文献的启发，我们使用我们的方法将ISC扩展到新的力矩协调定律。我们发现了这些仰角空间力矩（ESM），并呈现了结果，显示了健全人体步态的基于力矩的协调性。我们还分析了使用动力和被动假肢行走的截肢者步态的ISC，发现虽然仰角保持在平面内，但ESM显示出较少的协调性。我们使用ISC作为约束条件来预测小腿的角度/力矩，该角度/力矩可以补偿由于被动足部引起的改变，从而模拟健康的大腿角度/力矩曲线。这可能对改进动力假肢控制具有重要意义。我们开发了ISC3d工具箱，该工具箱可在线免费获取，可用于计算三维运动学和动力学ISC。这提供了一种进一步研究协调性在步态中作用的手段，并可能有助于解决人类运动神经控制的基本问题。
tldr: This paper introduces a method to analyze intersegmental coordination (ISC) in gait, extends it to include moments, and applies it to analyze amputee gait with powered and passive prostheses, suggesting its potential for improving prosthetic control.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种分析步态中节段间协调（ISC）的方法，将其扩展到包括力矩，并将其应用于分析具有动力和被动假肢的截肢者步态，表明其具有改善假肢控制的潜力。

title: Automated Discontinuity Set Characterisation in Enclosed Rock Face Point Clouds Using Single-Shot Filtering and Cyclic Orientation Transformation
summary: Characterisation of structural discontinuity sets in exposed rock faces of underground mine cavities is essential for assessing rock-mass stability, excavation safety, and operational efficiency. UAV and other mobile laser-scanning techniques provide efficient means of collecting point clouds from rock faces. However, the development of a robust and efficient approach for automatic characterisation of discontinuity sets in real-world scenarios, like fully enclosed rock faces in cavities, remains an open research problem. In this study, a new approach is proposed for automatic discontinuity set characterisation that uses a single-shot filtering strategy, an innovative cyclic orientation transformation scheme and a hierarchical clustering technique. The single-shot filtering step isolates planar regions while robustly suppressing noise and high-curvature artefacts in one pass using a signal-processing technique. To address the limitations of Cartesian clustering on polar orientation data, a cyclic orientation transformation scheme is developed, enabling accurate representation of dip angle and dip direction in Cartesian space. The transformed orientations are then characterised into sets using a hierarchical clustering technique, which handles varying density distributions and identifies clusters without requiring user-defined set numbers. The accuracy of the method is validated on real-world mine stope and against ground truth obtained using manually handpicked discontinuity planes identified with the Virtual Compass tool, as well as widely used automated structure mapping techniques. The proposed approach outperforms the other techniques by exhibiting the lowest mean absolute error in estimating discontinuity set orientations in real-world stope data with errors of 1.95° and 2.20° in nominal dip angle and dip direction, respectively, and dispersion errors lying below 3°.
summary_zh: 地下矿山巷道暴露岩壁上结构不连续性集合的特征描述对于评估岩体稳定性、挖掘安全和运营效率至关重要。无人机和其他移动激光扫描技术为从岩壁收集点云提供了有效手段。然而，开发一种稳健、高效的方法来实现真实场景（如巷道内完全封闭岩壁）中不连续性集合的自动特征描述，仍然是一个开放的研究问题。在本研究中，提出了一种新的自动不连续性集合特征描述方法，该方法采用单次滤波策略、一种创新的循环方向变换方案和一种分层聚类技术。单次滤波步骤使用信号处理技术，通过一次处理即可隔离平面区域，同时可靠地抑制噪声和高曲率伪影。为了解决笛卡尔聚类在极坐标方向数据上的局限性，开发了一种循环方向变换方案，从而能够在笛卡尔空间中准确表示倾角和倾向。然后，使用分层聚类技术将变换后的方向数据划分为集合，该技术可以处理不同的密度分布，并在不需要用户定义集合数量的情况下识别集群。该方法的准确性在真实的矿山采场中进行了验证，并与使用虚拟罗盘工具手动选择的不连续面以及广泛使用的自动结构映射技术获得的地面真值进行了对比。所提出的方法优于其他技术，在估计真实采场数据中不连续性集合方向时表现出最低的平均绝对误差，标称倾角和倾向的误差分别为1.95°和2.20°，且离散误差低于3°。
tldr: The paper presents a novel automated method for characterizing discontinuity sets in rock faces using single-shot filtering, cyclic orientation transformation, and hierarchical clustering, validated in real-world mine stopes with improved accuracy compared to existing techniques.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的自动化方法，用于表征岩面中的不连续性集合，该方法使用单次过滤、循环方向变换和分层聚类。该方法在真实的矿山采场中进行了验证，与现有技术相比具有更高的准确性。

title: TQL: Scaling Q-Functions with Transformers by Preventing Attention Collapse
summary: Despite scale driving substantial recent advancements in machine learning, reinforcement learning (RL) methods still primarily use small value functions. Naively scaling value functions -- including with a transformer architecture, which is known to be highly scalable -- often results in learning instability and worse performance. In this work, we ask what prevents transformers from scaling effectively for value functions? Through empirical analysis, we identify the critical failure mode in this scaling: attention scores collapse as capacity increases. Our key insight is that we can effectively prevent this collapse and stabilize training by controlling the entropy of the attention scores, thereby enabling the use of larger models. To this end, we propose Transformer Q-Learning (TQL), a method that unlocks the scaling potential of transformers in learning value functions in RL. Our approach yields up to a 43% improvement in performance when scaling from the smallest to the largest network sizes, while prior methods suffer from performance degradation.

title: QVLA: Not All Channels Are Equal in Vision-Language-Action Model's Quantization
summary: The advent of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models represents a significant leap for embodied intelligence, yet their immense computational demands critically hinder deployment on resource-constrained robotic platforms. Intuitively, low-bit quantization is a prevalent and preferred technique for large-scale model compression. However, we find that a systematic analysis of VLA model's quantization is fundamentally lacking. We argue that naively applying uniform-bit quantization from Large Language Models (LLMs) to robotics is flawed, as these methods prioritize passive data fidelity while ignoring how minor action deviations compound into catastrophic task failures. To bridge this gap, we introduce QVLA, the first action-centric quantization framework specifically designed for embodied control. In a sharp departure from the rigid, uniform-bit quantization of LLM-based methods, QVLA introduces a highly granular, channel-wise bit allocation strategy. Its core mechanism is to directly measure the final action-space sensitivity when quantizing each individual channel to various bit-widths. This process yields a precise, per-channel importance metric that guides a global optimization, which elegantly unifies quantization and pruning (0-bit) into a single, cohesive framework. Extensive evaluations on different baselines demonstrate the superiority of our approach. In the LIBERO, the quantization version of OpenVLA-OFT with our method requires only 29.2% of the original model's VRAM while maintaining 98.9% of its original performance and achieving a 1.49x speedup. This translates to a 22.6% performance improvement over the LLM-derived method SmoothQuant. Our work establishes a new, principled foundation for compressing VLA models in robotics, paving the way for deploying powerful, large-scale models on real-world hardware. Code will be released.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的出现代表了具身智能领域的一次重大飞跃，但其巨大的计算需求严重阻碍了在资源受限的机器人平台上的部署。直观上，低比特量化是一种流行且首选的大规模模型压缩技术。然而，我们发现对VLA模型量化的系统性分析非常缺乏。我们认为，将大型语言模型（LLM）中的统一比特量化直接应用于机器人是存在缺陷的，因为这些方法侧重于被动的数据忠诚度，而忽略了微小的动作偏差如何累积成灾难性的任务失败。为了弥合这一差距，我们推出了QVLA，这是第一个专门为具身控制设计的以动作为中心的量化框架。与基于LLM方法的刚性、统一比特量化截然不同的是，QVLA引入了一种高度精细的、通道级的比特分配策略。其核心机制是直接测量将每个通道量化到不同比特宽度时最终动作空间的敏感度。这个过程产生了一个精确的、逐通道的重要性度量，它指导一个全局最优化过程，优雅地将量化和剪枝（0比特）统一到一个单一的、有凝聚力的框架中。对不同基线的大量评估证明了我们方法的优越性。在LIBERO中，使用我们方法的OpenVLA-OFT量化版本仅需要原始模型29.2%的VRAM，同时保持原始性能的98.9%，并实现1.49倍的加速。与LLM派生的SmoothQuant方法相比，这转化为22.6%的性能提升。我们的工作为压缩机器人中的VLA模型建立了一个新的、有原则的基础，从而为在现实世界硬件上部署强大的、大规模模型铺平了道路。代码将会发布。
tldr: This paper introduces QVLA, an action-centric quantization framework for Vision-Language-Action models, which uses channel-wise bit allocation based on action-space sensitivity to achieve significant model compression and speedup while maintaining performance compared to directly applying LLM quantization methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 QVLA，一个面向视觉-语言-动作模型的动作中心量化框架。该框架使用基于动作空间敏感性的通道式比特分配，与直接应用 LLM 量化方法相比，在保持性能的同时实现了显著的模型压缩和加速。

title: CRL-VLA: Continual Vision-Language-Action Learning
summary: Lifelong learning is critical for embodied agents in open-world environments, where reinforcement learning fine-tuning has emerged as an important paradigm to enable Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to master dexterous manipulation through environmental interaction. Thus, Continual Reinforcement Learning (CRL) is a promising pathway for deploying VLA models in lifelong robotic scenarios, yet balancing stability (retaining old skills) and plasticity (learning new ones) remains a formidable challenge for existing methods. We introduce CRL-VLA, a framework for continual post-training of VLA models with rigorous theoretical bounds. We derive a unified performance bound linking the stability-plasticity trade-off to goal-conditioned advantage magnitude, scaled by policy divergence. CRL-VLA resolves this dilemma via asymmetric regulation: constraining advantage magnitudes on prior tasks while enabling controlled growth on new tasks. This is realized through a simple but effective dual-critic architecture with novel Goal-Conditioned Value Formulation (GCVF), where a frozen critic anchors semantic consistency and a trainable estimator drives adaptation. Experiments on the LIBERO benchmark demonstrate that CRL-VLA effectively harmonizes these conflicting objectives, outperforming baselines in both anti-forgetting and forward adaptation.
summary_zh: 终身学习对于开放世界环境中具身智能体至关重要，其中强化学习微调已成为一种重要的范式，使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够通过环境交互掌握灵巧操作。因此，持续强化学习（CRL）是VLA模型部署在终身机器人场景中的一条有希望的途径，然而，平衡稳定性（保持旧技能）和可塑性（学习新技能）对于现有方法来说仍然是一个巨大的挑战。我们引入了CRL-VLA，一个用于VLA模型持续后训练的框架，并具有严格的理论界限。我们推导出一个统一的性能界限，该界限将稳定性-可塑性权衡与目标条件优势幅度联系起来，并按策略散度进行缩放。CRL-VLA通过非对称调控来解决这个困境：约束先前任务的优势幅度，同时允许新任务上受控的增长。这通过一个简单但有效的双重评论家架构以及新颖的目标条件价值公式（GCVF）来实现，其中冻结的评论家锚定语义一致性，而可训练的估计器驱动适应。在LIBERO基准上的实验表明，CRL-VLA有效地协调了这些冲突的目标，在抗遗忘和正向适应方面均优于基线。
tldr: The paper introduces CRL-VLA, a framework for continual post-training of Vision-Language-Action models that addresses the stability-plasticity trade-off in lifelong robotic scenarios using a dual-critic architecture with goal-conditioned value formulation, achieving state-of-the-art results on the LIBERO benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CRL-VLA，一个用于持续后训练视觉-语言-动作模型的框架。该框架通过使用具有目标条件价值公式的双重评论家架构，解决了终身机器人场景中的稳定性-可塑性权衡问题，并在LIBERO基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。

title: RDT2: Exploring the Scaling Limit of UMI Data Towards Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Generalization
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models hold promise for generalist robotics but currently struggle with data scarcity, architectural inefficiencies, and the inability to generalize across different hardware platforms. We introduce RDT2, a robotic foundation model built upon a 7B parameter VLM designed to enable zero-shot deployment on novel embodiments for open-vocabulary tasks. To achieve this, we collected one of the largest open-source robotic datasets--over 10,000 hours of demonstrations in diverse families--using an enhanced, embodiment-agnostic Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI). Our approach employs a novel three-stage training recipe that aligns discrete linguistic knowledge with continuous control via Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ), flow-matching, and distillation for real-time inference. Consequently, RDT2 becomes one of the first models that simultaneously zero-shot generalizes to unseen objects, scenes, instructions, and even robotic platforms. Besides, it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in dexterous, long-horizon, and dynamic downstream tasks like playing table tennis. See https://rdt-robotics.github.io/rdt2/ for more information.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型展现了通用机器人技术的潜力，但目前面临数据稀缺、架构效率低下以及无法跨不同硬件平台泛化的问题。我们提出了 RDT2，一个基于 70 亿参数 VLM 构建的机器人基础模型，旨在实现对新型具身机器人进行零样本部署，以完成开放词汇任务。为了实现这一目标，我们使用增强的、与具身无关的通用操作界面 (UMI) 收集了最大的开源机器人数据集之一，其中包含超过 10,000 小时的各种类型的演示数据。我们的方法采用了一种新颖的三阶段训练方案，该方案通过残差矢量量化 (RVQ)、流匹配和蒸馏将离散的语言知识与连续控制对齐，以实现实时推理。因此，RDT2 成为首批能够同时零样本泛化到未见过的物体、场景、指令，甚至机器人平台的模型之一。此外，在灵巧、长时程和动态的下游任务中，例如打乒乓球，它也优于最先进的基线模型。更多信息请访问 https://rdt-robotics.github.io/rdt2/ 。
tldr: RDT2 is a VLA model trained on a large, diverse robotics dataset using a novel three-stage training recipe to enable zero-shot cross-embodiment generalization, outperforming SOTA baselines in several tasks.
tldr_zh: RDT2是一个VLA模型，它使用一种新的三阶段训练方法，在一个大型的、多样化的机器人数据集上进行训练，从而实现零样本跨平台泛化，并在多个任务中优于SOTA基线。

title: TIC-VLA: A Think-in-Control Vision-Language-Action Model for Robot Navigation in Dynamic Environments
summary: Robots in dynamic, human-centric environments must follow language instructions while maintaining real-time reactive control. Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a promising framework, but they assume temporally aligned reasoning and control, despite semantic inference being inherently delayed relative to real-time action. We introduce Think-in-Control (TIC)-VLA, a latency-aware framework that explicitly models delayed semantic reasoning during action generation. TIC-VLA defines a delayed semantic-control interface that conditions action generation on delayed vision-language semantic states and explicit latency metadata, in addition to current observations, enabling policies to compensate for asynchronous reasoning. We further propose a latency-consistent training pipeline that injects reasoning inference delays during imitation learning and online reinforcement learning, aligning training with asynchronous deployment. To support realistic evaluation, we present DynaNav, a physics-accurate, photo-realistic simulation suite for language-guided navigation in dynamic environments. Extensive experiments in simulation and on a real robot show that TIC-VLA consistently outperforms prior VLA models while maintaining robust real-time control under multi-second reasoning latency. Project website: https://ucla-mobility.github.io/TIC-VLA/
summary_zh: 在动态、以人为中心的环境中，机器人必须遵循语言指令，同时保持实时的反应式控制。视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型提供了一个有前景的框架，但它们假设时间上对齐的推理和控制，尽管语义推理相对于实时动作而言具有固有的延迟。我们引入了 Think-in-Control (TIC)-VLA，这是一个延迟感知框架，它在动作生成过程中显式地建模了延迟的语义推理。TIC-VLA 定义了一个延迟的语义-控制接口，该接口将动作生成建立在延迟的视觉-语言语义状态和显式延迟元数据之上，以及当前观察结果，从而使策略能够补偿异步推理。我们进一步提出了一个延迟一致的训练流程，该流程在模仿学习和在线强化学习期间注入推理推导延迟，使训练与异步部署保持一致。为了支持真实的评估，我们提出了 DynaNav，这是一个物理精确、照片级真实的仿真套件，用于动态环境中受语言引导的导航。在模拟和真实机器人上的大量实验表明，TIC-VLA始终优于先前的 VLA 模型，同时在数秒推理延迟下保持了强大的实时控制。项目网站：https://ucla-mobility.github.io/TIC-VLA/
tldr: The paper introduces Think-in-Control (TIC)-VLA, a novel vision-language-action model that explicitly addresses the issue of latency between semantic reasoning and real-time action generation for robot navigation in dynamic environments, along with a new simulation environment, DynaNav.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了Think-in-Control (TIC)-VLA，一种新型的视觉-语言-动作模型，它显式地解决了动态环境中机器人导航时语义推理与实时动作生成之间的延迟问题，并提出了一个新的仿真环境DynaNav。

title: World-Gymnast: Training Robots with Reinforcement Learning in a World Model
summary: Robot learning from interacting with the physical world is fundamentally bottlenecked by the cost of physical interaction. The two alternatives, supervised finetuning (SFT) from expert demonstrations and reinforcement learning (RL) in a software-based simulator, are limited by the amount of expert data available and the sim-to-real gap for manipulation. With the recent emergence of world models learned from real-world video-action data, we ask the question of whether training a policy in a world model can be more effective than supervised learning or software simulation in achieving better real-robot performance. We propose World-Gymnast, which performs RL finetuning of a vision-language-action (VLA) policy by rolling out the policy in an action-conditioned video world model and rewarding the rollouts with a vision-language model (VLM). On the Bridge robot setup, World-Gymnast outperforms SFT by as much as 18x and outperforms software simulator by as much as 2x. More importantly, World-Gymnast demonstrates intriguing capabilities of RL with a world model, including training on diverse language instructions and novel scenes from the world model, test-time training in a novel scene, and online iterative world model and policy improvement. Our results suggest learning a world model and training robot policies in the cloud could be the key to bridging the gap between robots that work in demonstrations and robots that can work in anyone's household.
summary_zh: 从与物理世界交互中进行机器人学习，其根本瓶颈在于物理交互的成本。两种替代方案，即从专家演示中进行监督微调（SFT）和在基于软件的模拟器中进行强化学习（RL），都受限于可用的专家数据量和操作的模拟到真实差距。随着最近从真实世界视频-动作数据中学习的世界模型的出现，我们提出这样一个问题：在世界模型中训练策略是否比监督学习或软件仿真更能有效地实现更好的真实机器人性能。我们提出了 World-Gymnast，它通过在动作条件视频世界模型中执行策略来进行视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的强化学习微调，并使用视觉-语言模型（VLM）奖励这些rollout。在 Bridge 机器人设置上，World-Gymnast 的性能超越 SFT 高达 18 倍，超越软件模拟器高达 2 倍。更重要的是，World-Gymnast 展示了强化学习与世界模型结合的有趣能力，包括在来自世界模型的多样化语言指令和新场景上进行训练、在新场景中进行测试时训练，以及在线迭代的世界模型和策略改进。我们的结果表明，学习世界模型并在云端训练机器人策略可能是弥合仅能根据演示工作和能服务于任何人家庭的机器人之间差距的关键。
tldr: The paper introduces World-Gymnast, a method for training robots using reinforcement learning within a world model, achieving significant performance improvements over supervised finetuning and software simulation in real-world robotic tasks. It demonstrates the potential of cloud-based robot training to bridge the gap to more adaptable robots.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 World-Gymnast，一种在世界模型中使用强化学习训练机器人的方法，在真实机器人任务中，该方法比监督微调和软件模拟实现了显著的性能提升。它展示了基于云的机器人训练在弥合机器人与更具适应性的机器人之间差距的潜力。

title: Agentic Proposing: Enhancing Large Language Model Reasoning via Compositional Skill Synthesis
summary: Advancing complex reasoning in large language models relies on high-quality, verifiable datasets, yet human annotation remains cost-prohibitive and difficult to scale. Current synthesis paradigms often face a recurring trade-off: maintaining structural validity typically restricts problem complexity, while relaxing constraints to increase difficulty frequently leads to inconsistent or unsolvable instances. To address this, we propose Agentic Proposing, a framework that models problem synthesis as a goal-driven sequential decision process where a specialized agent dynamically selects and composes modular reasoning skills. Through an iterative workflow of internal reflection and tool-use, we develop the Agentic-Proposer-4B using Multi-Granularity Policy Optimization (MGPO) to generate high-precision, verifiable training trajectories across mathematics, coding, and science. Empirical results demonstrate that downstream solvers trained on agent-synthesized data significantly outperform leading baselines and exhibit robust cross-domain generalization. Notably, a 30B solver trained on only 11,000 synthesized trajectories achieves a state-of-the-art 91.6% accuracy on AIME25, rivaling frontier-scale proprietary models such as GPT-5 and proving that a small volume of high-quality synthetic signals can effectively substitute for massive human-curated datasets.
summary_zh: 为了提升大型语言模型中的复杂推理能力，需要高质量、可验证的数据集，然而人工标注成本高昂且难以规模化。现有的合成范式常常面临一个反复出现的权衡：保持结构有效性通常会限制问题的复杂度，而放宽约束以增加难度则常常导致不一致或无解的实例。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种名为Agentic Proposing的框架，该框架将问题合成建模为一个目标驱动的序列决策过程，其中一个专门的智能体动态地选择和组合模块化的推理技能。通过内部反思和工具使用的迭代工作流程，我们使用多粒度策略优化（MGPO）开发了Agentic-Proposer-4B，以生成跨数学、编码和科学的高精度、可验证的训练轨迹。实验结果表明，在智能体合成的数据上训练的下游求解器显著优于领先的基线，并表现出强大的跨领域泛化能力。值得注意的是，一个仅在11,000条合成轨迹上训练的30B求解器在AIME25上实现了91.6%的最新准确率，与GPT-5等前沿规模的专有模型相媲美，证明少量高质量的合成信号可以有效地替代大规模的人工策划数据集。
tldr: This paper introduces Agentic Proposing, a framework for generating high-quality, verifiable training data for LLMs by using an agent to dynamically compose reasoning skills, achieving state-of-the-art results on AIME25 with significantly less data than human-curated datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 Agentic Proposing，一个通过使用智能体动态组合推理技能，为大型语言模型生成高质量、可验证训练数据的框架。该框架在 AIME25 上取得了最先进的结果，且所需数据量远少于人工管理的数据集。

title: CSR-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating the Cross-modal Safety and Reliability of MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) enable interaction over both text and images, but their safety behavior can be driven by unimodal shortcuts instead of true joint intent understanding. We introduce CSR-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating cross-modal reliability through four stress-testing interaction patterns spanning Safety, Over-rejection, Bias, and Hallucination, covering 61 fine-grained types. Each instance is constructed to require integrated image-text interpretation, and we additionally provide paired text-only controls to diagnose modality-induced behavior shifts. We evaluate 16 state-of-the-art MLLMs and observe systematic cross-modal alignment gaps. Models show weak safety awareness, strong language dominance under interference, and consistent performance degradation from text-only controls to multimodal inputs. We also observe a clear trade-off between reducing over-rejection and maintaining safe, non-discriminatory behavior, suggesting that some apparent safety gains may come from refusal-oriented heuristics rather than robust intent understanding. WARNING: This paper contains unsafe contents.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型(MLLMs)能够实现基于文本和图像的交互，但其安全行为可能受限于单模态捷径，而非真正的联合意图理解。我们推出了CSR-Bench，一个用于评估跨模态可靠性的基准，通过涵盖安全、过度拒绝、偏见和幻觉这四个压力测试交互模式，共计61种细粒度类型。每个实例都旨在要求综合的图像-文本解读，并且我们额外提供了配对的纯文本控制，以诊断模态诱导的行为转变。我们评估了16个最先进的MLLMs，并观察到系统的跨模态对齐差距。模型表现出较弱的安全意识、干扰下的强语言主导地位，以及从纯文本控制到多模态输入的一致性性能下降。我们还观察到减少过度拒绝和维持安全、非歧视行为之间存在明显的权衡，表明一些表面上的安全提升可能来源于面向拒绝的启发式方法，而不是稳健的意图理解。警告：本文包含不安全内容。
tldr: The paper introduces CSR-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating the cross-modal reliability (safety, over-rejection, bias, hallucination) of MLLMs, highlighting their weaknesses in joint intent understanding and showcasing performance degradation compared to text-only inputs.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CSR-Bench，一个用于评估多模态大型语言模型(MLLMs)的跨模态可靠性（安全性，过度拒绝，偏见，幻觉）的基准，强调了它们在联合意图理解方面的弱点，并展示了它们与纯文本输入相比的性能下降。

title: ConsisDrive: Identity-Preserving Driving World Models for Video Generation by Instance Mask
summary: Autonomous driving relies on robust models trained on large-scale, high-quality multi-view driving videos. Although world models provide a cost-effective solution for generating realistic driving data, they often suffer from identity drift, where the same object changes its appearance or category across frames due to the absence of instance-level temporal constraints. We introduce ConsisDrive, an identity-preserving driving world model designed to enforce temporal consistency at the instance level. Our framework incorporates two key components: (1) Instance-Masked Attention, which applies instance identity masks and trajectory masks within attention blocks to ensure that visual tokens interact only with their corresponding instance features across spatial and temporal dimensions, thereby preserving object identity consistency; and (2) Instance-Masked Loss, which adaptively emphasizes foreground regions with probabilistic instance masking, reducing background noise while maintaining overall scene fidelity. By integrating these mechanisms, ConsisDrive achieves state-of-the-art driving video generation quality and demonstrates significant improvements in downstream autonomous driving tasks on the nuScenes dataset. Our project page is https://shanpoyang654.github.io/ConsisDrive/page.html.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶依赖于在大型高质量多视角驾驶视频上训练的鲁棒模型。尽管世界模型为生成逼真的驾驶数据提供了一种经济高效的解决方案，但它们通常会受到身份漂移的影响，即由于缺乏实例级别的时序约束，同一物体在不同帧之间会改变其外观或类别。我们提出了 ConsisDrive，一种身份保持的驾驶世界模型，旨在在实例级别强制执行时间一致性。我们的框架包含两个关键组件：（1）实例掩码注意力，它在注意力模块中应用实例身份掩码和轨迹掩码，以确保视觉令牌仅与其对应的实例特征在空间和时间维度上进行交互，从而保持对象身份一致性；及（2）实例掩码损失，它通过概率实例掩码自适应地强调前景区域，减少背景噪声，同时保持整体场景的逼真度。通过整合这些机制，ConsisDrive 实现了最先进的驾驶视频生成质量，并在 nuScenes 数据集上的下游自动驾驶任务中表现出显著的改进。我们的项目主页是 https://shanpoyang654.github.io/ConsisDrive/page.html。
tldr: ConsisDrive improves driving video generation by enforcing instance-level temporal consistency using instance-masked attention and loss, leading to better performance on downstream autonomous driving tasks.
tldr_zh: ConsisDrive 通过使用实例掩码注意力机制和损失函数，增强实例级别的时序一致性，从而改进驾驶视频生成，并在下游自动驾驶任务中表现更佳。

title: BridgeV2W: Bridging Video Generation Models to Embodied World Models via Embodiment Masks
summary: Embodied world models have emerged as a promising paradigm in robotics, most of which leverage large-scale Internet videos or pretrained video generation models to enrich visual and motion priors. However, they still face key challenges: a misalignment between coordinate-space actions and pixel-space videos, sensitivity to camera viewpoint, and non-unified architectures across embodiments. To this end, we present BridgeV2W, which converts coordinate-space actions into pixel-aligned embodiment masks rendered from the URDF and camera parameters. These masks are then injected into a pretrained video generation model via a ControlNet-style pathway, which aligns the action control signals with predicted videos, adds view-specific conditioning to accommodate camera viewpoints, and yields a unified world model architecture across embodiments. To mitigate overfitting to static backgrounds, BridgeV2W further introduces a flow-based motion loss that focuses on learning dynamic and task-relevant regions. Experiments on single-arm (DROID) and dual-arm (AgiBot-G1) datasets, covering diverse and challenging conditions with unseen viewpoints and scenes, show that BridgeV2W improves video generation quality compared to prior state-of-the-art methods. We further demonstrate the potential of BridgeV2W on downstream real-world tasks, including policy evaluation and goal-conditioned planning. More results can be found on our project website at https://BridgeV2W.github.io .
summary_zh: 具身世界模型已成为机器人领域一种很有前景的范式，其中大多数利用大规模互联网视频或预训练的视频生成模型来丰富视觉和运动先验。然而，它们仍然面临着关键挑战：坐标空间动作与像素空间视频之间的不对齐、对相机视角的敏感性以及跨具身非统一架构。为此，我们提出了BridgeV2W，它将坐标空间动作转换为从URDF和相机参数渲染的像素对齐具身掩码。然后，这些掩码通过ControlNet风格的路径注入到预训练的视频生成模型中，从而将动作控制信号与预测的视频对齐，添加特定于视角的条件以适应相机视角，并产生跨具身的统一世界模型架构。为了减轻对静态背景的过度拟合，BridgeV2W进一步引入了一种基于光流的运动损失，该损失侧重于学习动态和任务相关的区域。在单臂（DROID）和双臂（AgiBot-G1）数据集上的实验，涵盖了具有未见视角和场景的各种具有挑战性的条件，表明BridgeV2W相比于先前的最先进方法，提高了视频生成质量。我们进一步展示了BridgeV2W在下游真实世界任务上的潜力，包括策略评估和目标条件下的规划。更多结果可在我们的项目网站https://BridgeV2W.github.io上找到。
tldr: The paper introduces BridgeV2W, a method for aligning action control signals with predicted videos in embodied world models by converting coordinate-space actions into pixel-aligned embodiment masks and injecting them into a video generation model. Experiments show improved video generation quality and potential for real-world robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了BridgeV2W，一种将坐标空间动作转换为像素对齐的实体模型掩码，并将其注入视频生成模型的方法，用于对齐实体世界模型中的动作控制信号与预测视频。实验表明，与现有方法相比，视频生成质量得到提高，并具有应用于真实世界机器人任务的潜力。

title: A Scene Graph Backed Approach to Open Set Semantic Mapping
summary:
While Open Set Semantic Mapping and 3D Semantic Scene Graphs (3DSSGs) are established paradigms in robotic perception, deploying them effectively to support high-level reasoning in large-scale, real-world environments remains a significant challenge. Most existing approaches decouple perception from representation, treating the scene graph as a derivative layer generated post hoc. This limits both consistency and scalability. In contrast, we propose a mapping architecture where the 3DSSG serves as the foundational backend, acting as the primary knowledge representation for the entire mapping process.
  Our approach leverages prior work on incremental scene graph prediction to infer and update the graph structure in real-time as the environment is explored. This ensures that the map remains topologically consistent and computationally efficient, even during extended operations in large-scale settings. By maintaining an explicit, spatially grounded representation that supports both flat and hierarchical topologies, we bridge the gap between sub-symbolic raw sensor data and high-level symbolic reasoning. Consequently, this provides a stable, verifiable structure that knowledge-driven frameworks, ranging from knowledge graphs and ontologies to Large Language Models (LLMs), can directly exploit, enabling agents to operate with enhanced interpretability, trustworthiness, and alignment to human concepts.
summary_zh:
开放集语义地图构建和3D语义场景图（3DSSG）是机器人感知领域中成熟的范例，但如何有效部署它们以支持大规模真实环境中的高级推理仍然是一个重大挑战。现有的大多数方法将感知与表征分离，将场景图视为事后生成的衍生层。这限制了其一致性和可扩展性。 与此相反，我们提出了一种将3DSSG作为基础后端的地图构建架构，将其作为整个地图构建过程的主要知识表征。
  我们的方法利用了先前在增量式场景图预测方面的工作，以在探索环境时实时推断和更新图结构。这确保了即使在大规模环境中进行长时间操作，地图也能保持拓扑一致性和计算效率。 通过维护一个支持扁平化和分层拓扑的显式、空间定位的表征，我们弥合了亚符号原始传感器数据与高级符号推理之间的差距。 因此，这提供了一个稳定、可验证的结构，从知识图谱和本体到大型语言模型（LLM）的各种知识驱动框架可以直接利用它，从而使智能体能够以增强的可解释性、可信度和与人类概念的一致性进行操作。
tldr: This paper proposes a scene graph-backed mapping architecture for robotics that addresses the challenge of scaling semantic mapping to large, real-world environments by using a 3DSSG as the primary knowledge representation. It aims to bridge the gap between raw sensor data and high-level reasoning, enabling integration with knowledge-driven frameworks like LLMs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于场景图的机器人制图架构，通过使用3DSSG作为主要知识表示，解决了语义地图扩展到大型真实世界环境的挑战。它旨在弥合原始传感器数据和高级推理之间的差距，从而能够与LLM等知识驱动框架集成。

title: MVP-LAM: Learning Action-Centric Latent Action via Cross-Viewpoint Reconstruction
summary: Learning \emph{latent actions} from diverse human videos enables scaling robot learning beyond embodiment-specific robot datasets, and these latent actions have recently been used as pseudo-action labels for vision-language-action (VLA) model pretraining. To make VLA pretraining effective, latent actions should contain information about the underlying agent's actions despite the absence of ground-truth labels. We propose \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{V}iew\textbf{P}oint \textbf{L}atent \textbf{A}ction \textbf{M}odel (\textbf{MVP-LAM}), which learns discrete latent actions that are highly informative about ground-truth actions from time-synchronized multi-view videos. MVP-LAM trains latent actions with a \emph{cross-viewpoint reconstruction} objective, so that a latent action inferred from one view must explain the future in another view, reducing reliance on viewpoint-specific cues. On Bridge V2, MVP-LAM produces more action-centric latent actions, achieving higher mutual information with ground-truth actions and improved action prediction, including under out-of-distribution evaluation. Finally, pretraining VLAs with MVP-LAM latent actions improves downstream manipulation performance on the SIMPLER and LIBERO-Long benchmarks.
summary_zh: 从多样化的人类视频中学习\emph{隐式动作}，能够将机器人学习扩展到特定于具体机器人的数据集之外，并且这些隐式动作最近已被用作视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型预训练的伪标签。为了使VLA预训练有效，即使在没有真实标签的情况下，隐式动作也应该包含关于底层代理动作的信息。我们提出了\textbf{多}视点\textbf{隐式}动作\textbf{模}型 (\textbf{MVP-LAM})，该模型学习来自时间同步的多视角视频的离散隐式动作，这些动作高度包含关于真实动作的信息。MVP-LAM以\emph{跨视点重建}为目标训练隐式动作，使得从一个视点推断的隐式动作必须能够解释另一个视点中的未来，从而减少对视点特定线索的依赖。在Bridge V2上，MVP-LAM产生了更多以动作为中心的隐式动作，实现了与真实动作更高的互信息和改进的动作预测，包括在分布外评估下。最后，使用MVP-LAM隐式动作预训练VLA可以提高在SIMPLER和LIBERO-Long基准上的下游操作性能。
tldr: The paper introduces MVP-LAM, a method for learning action-centric latent actions from multi-view videos using a cross-viewpoint reconstruction objective, improving VLA pretraining and downstream robotic manipulation performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MVP-LAM，一种通过交叉视点重建目标从多视角视频中学习以动作为中心的潜在动作的方法，从而改进了VLA预训练和下游机器人操作性能。

title: AffordanceGrasp-R1:Leveraging Reasoning-Based Affordance Segmentation with Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Grasping
summary: We introduce AffordanceGrasp-R1, a reasoning-driven affordance segmentation framework for robotic grasping that combines a chain-of-thought (CoT) cold-start strategy with reinforcement learning to enhance deduction and spatial grounding. In addition, we redesign the grasping pipeline to be more context-aware by generating grasp candidates from the global scene point cloud and subsequently filtering them using instruction-conditioned affordance masks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AffordanceGrasp-R1 consistently outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods on benchmark datasets, and real-world robotic grasping evaluations further validate its robustness and generalization under complex language-conditioned manipulation scenarios.
summary_zh: 我们提出了AffordanceGrasp-R1，一个基于推理的用于机器人抓取的示能分割框架，它结合了思维链（CoT）冷启动策略和强化学习，以增强推理能力和空间定位。此外，我们重新设计了抓取流程，使其更具上下文感知能力，通过从全局场景点云生成抓取候选，并随后使用指令条件示能掩码对其进行过滤。大量实验表明，AffordanceGrasp-R1在基准数据集上始终优于最先进（SOTA）方法，并且真实世界机器人抓取评估进一步验证了其在复杂的语言条件操作场景下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
tldr: AffordanceGrasp-R1 enhances robotic grasping by integrating reasoning-based affordance segmentation with reinforcement learning and a context-aware grasping pipeline, achieving SOTA performance in both benchmark datasets and real-world scenarios.
tldr_zh: AffordanceGrasp-R1通过结合基于推理的认知分割、强化学习以及上下文感知的抓取流程来改进机器人抓取，在基准数据集和实际场景中均实现了SOTA性能。

title: CMR: Contractive Mapping Embeddings for Robust Humanoid Locomotion on Unstructured Terrains
summary: Robust disturbance rejection remains a longstanding challenge in humanoid locomotion, particularly on unstructured terrains where sensing is unreliable and model mismatch is pronounced. While perception information, such as height map, enhances terrain awareness, sensor noise and sim-to-real gaps can destabilize policies in practice. In this work, we provide theoretical analysis that bounds the return gap under observation noise, when the induced latent dynamics are contractive. Furthermore, we present Contractive Mapping for Robustness (CMR) framework that maps high-dimensional, disturbance-prone observations into a latent space, where local perturbations are attenuated over time. Specifically, this approach couples contrastive representation learning with Lipschitz regularization to preserve task-relevant geometry while explicitly controlling sensitivity. Notably, the formulation can be incorporated into modern deep reinforcement learning pipelines as an auxiliary loss term with minimal additional technical effort required. Further, our extensive humanoid experiments show that CMR potently outperforms other locomotion algorithms under increased noise.
summary_zh: 在人形机器人运动中，鲁棒的抗扰能力一直是一个长期存在的挑战，尤其是在非结构化地形上，那里的感知往往不可靠且模型失配明显。虽然像高度图这样的感知信息可以增强对地形的感知，但传感器噪声和模拟到现实的差距会在实践中 destabilize 策略。在这项工作中，我们提供了理论分析，在诱导潜在动力学具有收缩性时，限定了观测噪声下的回报差距。此外，我们提出了一种用于提升鲁棒性的收缩映射（CMR）框架，该框架将高维的、易受扰动的观测映射到一个潜在空间，在这个空间中局部扰动会随着时间的推移而衰减。具体而言，这种方法将对比表示学习与 Lipschitz 正则化相结合，以保留任务相关的几何结构，同时显式地控制灵敏度。值得注意的是，该公式可以作为辅助损失项整合到现代深度强化学习流程中，而无需额外的技术投入。此外，我们广泛的人形机器人实验表明，在噪声增加的情况下，CMR 显著优于其他运动算法。
tldr: This paper introduces a Contractive Mapping for Robustness (CMR) framework that leverages contrastive representation learning and Lipschitz regularization to improve humanoid locomotion robustness on unstructured terrains by mapping noisy observations into a contractive latent space.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种鲁棒性契约映射（CMR）框架，该框架利用对比表示学习和Lipschitz正则化，通过将带噪声的观察映射到契约潜在空间，从而提高人形机器人在非结构化地形上的运动鲁棒性。

title: ProAct: A Benchmark and Multimodal Framework for Structure-Aware Proactive Response
summary: While passive agents merely follow instructions, proactive agents align with higher-level objectives, such as assistance and safety by continuously monitoring the environment to determine when and how to act. However, developing proactive agents is hindered by the lack of specialized resources. To address this, we introduce ProAct-75, a benchmark designed to train and evaluate proactive agents across diverse domains, including assistance, maintenance, and safety monitoring. Spanning 75 tasks, our dataset features 91,581 step-level annotations enriched with explicit task graphs. These graphs encode step dependencies and parallel execution possibilities, providing the structural grounding necessary for complex decision-making. Building on this benchmark, we propose ProAct-Helper, a reference baseline powered by a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) that grounds decision-making in state detection, and leveraging task graphs to enable entropy-driven heuristic search for action selection, allowing agents to execute parallel threads independently rather than mirroring the human's next step. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ProAct-Helper outperforms strong closed-source models, improving trigger detection mF1 by 6.21%, saving 0.25 more steps in online one-step decision, and increasing the rate of parallel actions by 15.58%.
summary_zh: 被动式智能体仅遵循指令，而主动式智能体则会与更高级别的目标对齐，例如通过持续监控环境来确定何时以及如何行动，以实现协助和安全。然而，缺乏专门的资源阻碍了主动式智能体的开发。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了ProAct-75，这是一个旨在训练和评估主动式智能体在不同领域（包括协助、维护和安全监控）表现的基准。我们的数据集涵盖75个任务，包含91,581个步骤级别的标注，并附有明确的任务图。这些图编码了步骤依赖关系和平行执行的可能性，为复杂的决策提供了必要的结构性基础。在此基准的基础上，我们提出了ProAct-Helper，一个由多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）驱动的参考基线，它将决策建立在状态检测的基础上，并利用任务图来实现基于熵驱动的启发式搜索来进行动作选择，从而使得智能体能够独立执行平行的线程，而不是镜像人类的下一步。大量的实验表明，ProAct-Helper优于强大的闭源模型，触发检测的mF1提高了6.21%，在线一步决策中节省了0.25个步骤，并将并行动作的比例提高了15.58%。
tldr: The paper introduces ProAct-75, a benchmark dataset for training and evaluating proactive agents, along with ProAct-Helper, a multimodal LLM-based baseline, demonstrating improved performance in trigger detection and parallel action execution.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ProAct-75，一个用于训练和评估主动代理的基准数据集，以及ProAct-Helper，一个基于多模态LLM的基线模型，展示了在触发检测和并行动作执行方面的改进性能。

title: Learning-based Initialization of Trajectory Optimization for Path-following Problems of Redundant Manipulators
summary: Trajectory optimization (TO) is an efficient tool to generate a redundant manipulator's joint trajectory following a 6-dimensional Cartesian path. The optimization performance largely depends on the quality of initial trajectories. However, the selection of a high-quality initial trajectory is non-trivial and requires a considerable time budget due to the extremely large space of the solution trajectories and the lack of prior knowledge about task constraints in configuration space. To alleviate the issue, we present a learning-based initial trajectory generation method that generates high-quality initial trajectories in a short time budget by adopting example-guided reinforcement learning. In addition, we suggest a null-space projected imitation reward to consider null-space constraints by efficiently learning kinematically feasible motion captured in expert demonstrations. Our statistical evaluation in simulation shows the improved optimality, efficiency, and applicability of TO when we plug in our method's output, compared with three other baselines. We also show the performance improvement and feasibility via real-world experiments with a seven-degree-of-freedom manipulator.
summary_zh: 轨迹优化 (TO) 是一种高效的工具，用于生成冗余机械臂跟随六维笛卡尔路径的关节轨迹。 优化性能很大程度上取决于初始轨迹的质量。 然而，由于解轨迹空间极其庞大，且缺乏构型空间中任务约束的先验知识，选择高质量的初始轨迹并非易事，需要可观的时间预算。 为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了一种基于学习的初始轨迹生成方法，该方法通过采用示例引导的强化学习，在较短的时间预算内生成高质量的初始轨迹。 此外，我们提出了一种零空间投影的模仿奖励，通过有效地学习专家演示中捕获的运动学可行运动，来考虑零空间约束。 我们的仿真统计评估表明，与另外三种基线方法相比，当我们使用我们方法的输出时，TO 的最优性、效率和适用性都得到了提高。 我们还通过七自由度机械臂的真实世界实验展示了性能的提升和可行性。
tldr: This paper proposes a learning-based approach using reinforcement learning and imitation learning to generate high-quality initial trajectories for trajectory optimization of redundant manipulators, improving optimality and efficiency compared to other baselines in both simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于学习的方法，使用强化学习和模仿学习来为冗余机械臂的轨迹优化生成高质量的初始轨迹，与模拟和现实世界实验中的其他基线相比，提高了最优性和效率。

title: PlanTRansformer: Unified Prediction and Planning with Goal-conditioned Transformer
summary: Trajectory prediction and planning are fundamental yet disconnected components in autonomous driving. Prediction models forecast surrounding agent motion under unknown intentions, producing multimodal distributions, while planning assumes known ego objectives and generates deterministic trajectories. This mismatch creates a critical bottleneck: prediction lacks supervision for agent intentions, while planning requires this information. Existing prediction models, despite strong benchmarking performance, often remain disconnected from planning constraints such as collision avoidance and dynamic feasibility. We introduce Plan TRansformer (PTR), a unified Gaussian Mixture Transformer framework integrating goal-conditioned prediction, dynamic feasibility, interaction awareness, and lane-level topology reasoning. A teacher-student training strategy progressively masks surrounding agent commands during training to align with inference conditions where agent intentions are unavailable. PTR achieves 4.3%/3.5% improvement in marginal/joint mAP compared to the baseline Motion Transformer (MTR) and 15.5% planning error reduction at 5s horizon compared to GameFormer. The architecture-agnostic design enables application to diverse Transformer-based prediction models. Project Website: https://github.com/SelzerConst/PlanTRansformer
summary_zh: 轨迹预测和规划是自动驾驶中基础但又相互脱节的组成部分。预测模型在未知意图下预测周围智能体的运动，产生多模态分布，而规划则假定已知的自车目标并生成确定性的轨迹。这种不匹配造成了一个关键瓶颈：预测缺乏对智能体意图的监督，而规划需要这些信息。现有的预测模型，尽管具有强大的基准测试性能，但通常与避撞和动态可行性等规划约束保持脱节。我们引入了Plan TRansformer (PTR)，一个统一的高斯混合Transformer框架，集成了目标条件预测、动态可行性、交互感知和车道级拓扑推理。一种师生训练策略在训练期间逐步掩盖周围智能体的指令，以与智能体意图不可用的推理条件对齐。与基线Motion Transformer (MTR)相比，PTR在边缘/联合mAP上分别实现了4.3%/3.5%的提升，与GameFormer相比，在5秒时程上实现了15.5%的规划误差降低。与架构无关的设计使其能够应用于各种基于Transformer的预测模型。项目网站：https://github.com/SelzerConst/PlanTRansformer
tldr: The paper introduces PlanTRansformer (PTR), a unified Transformer framework for trajectory prediction and planning in autonomous driving that integrates goal-conditioned prediction with planning constraints, achieving improved performance compared to baselines. It bridges the gap between intention-unaware prediction and intention-aware planning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PlanTRansformer (PTR)，一个用于自动驾驶中轨迹预测和规划的统一Transformer框架，它将目标条件预测与规划约束相结合，与基线相比实现了性能提升。它弥合了不考虑意图的预测和考虑意图的规划之间的差距。

title: When Attention Betrays: Erasing Backdoor Attacks in Robotic Policies by Reconstructing Visual Tokens
summary: Downstream fine-tuning of vision-language-action (VLA) models enhances robotics, yet exposes the pipeline to backdoor risks. Attackers can pretrain VLAs on poisoned data to implant backdoors that remain stealthy but can trigger harmful behavior during inference. However, existing defenses either lack mechanistic insight into multimodal backdoors or impose prohibitive computational costs via full-model retraining. To this end, we uncover a deep-layer attention grabbing mechanism: backdoors redirect late-stage attention and form compact embedding clusters near the clean manifold. Leveraging this insight, we introduce Bera, a test-time backdoor erasure framework that detects tokens with anomalous attention via latent-space localization, masks suspicious regions using deep-layer cues, and reconstructs a trigger-free image to break the trigger-unsafe-action mapping while restoring correct behavior. Unlike prior defenses, Bera requires neither retraining of VLAs nor any changes to the training pipeline. Extensive experiments across multiple embodied platforms and tasks show that Bera effectively maintains nominal performance, significantly reduces attack success rates, and consistently restores benign behavior from backdoored outputs, thereby offering a robust and practical defense mechanism for securing robotic systems.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型下游微调增强了机器人技术，但也使流程面临后门风险。攻击者可以预训练具有中毒数据的 VLA，植入后门，这些后门保持隐蔽，但可以在推理过程中触发有害行为。然而，现有的防御方法要么缺乏对多模态后门机制的深入了解，要么通过完整模型重新训练带来巨大的计算成本。为此，我们揭示了一种深层注意力抓取机制：后门重定向了后期注意力，并在接近干净流形的区域形成了紧凑的嵌入簇。基于这一洞察，我们提出 Bera，一个测试时后门擦除框架，它通过潜在空间定位检测具有异常注意力的token，使用深层线索屏蔽可疑区域，并重建一个无触发图像以打破触发-不安全-动作的映射，同时恢复正确的行为。与之前的防御方法不同，Bera既不需要重新训练VLA，也不需要对训练流程进行任何更改。在多个具身平台和任务上的大量实验表明，Bera有效地保持了名义性能，显著降低了攻击成功率，并持续地从后门输出中恢复良性行为，从而为确保机器人系统的安全提供了一种稳健且实用的防御机制。
tldr: This paper introduces Bera, a novel test-time backdoor defense framework for robotic vision-language-action models that leverages attention analysis and image reconstruction to mitigate trigger effects without retraining, showcasing effectiveness across multiple robotic platforms and tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为Bera的新型测试时后门防御框架，用于机器人视觉-语言-动作模型。该框架利用注意力分析和图像重建来减轻触发效果，无需重新训练，并在多个机器人平台和任务中展示了有效性。

title: RPL: Learning Robust Humanoid Perceptive Locomotion on Challenging Terrains
summary: Humanoid perceptive locomotion has made significant progress and shows great promise, yet achieving robust multi-directional locomotion on complex terrains remains underexplored. To tackle this challenge, we propose RPL, a two-stage training framework that enables multi-directional locomotion on challenging terrains, and remains robust with payloads. RPL first trains terrain-specific expert policies with privileged height map observations to master decoupled locomotion and manipulation skills across different terrains, and then distills them into a transformer policy that leverages multiple depth cameras to cover a wide range of views. During distillation, we introduce two techniques to robustify multi-directional locomotion, depth feature scaling based on velocity commands and random side masking, which are critical for asymmetric depth observations and unseen widths of terrains. For scalable depth distillation, we develop an efficient multi-depth system that ray-casts against both dynamic robot meshes and static terrain meshes in massively parallel environments, achieving a 5-times speedup over the depth rendering pipelines in existing simulators while modeling realistic sensor latency, noise, and dropout. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate robust multi-directional locomotion with payloads (2kg) across challenging terrains, including 20° slopes, staircases with different step lengths (22 cm, 25 cm, 30 cm), and 25 cm by 25 cm stepping stones separated by 60 cm gaps.
summary_zh: 人形机器人的感知运动已经取得了显著进展并展现出巨大潜力，但在复杂地形上实现鲁棒的多方向运动仍然有待探索。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了RPL，一个两阶段训练框架，能够在具有挑战性的地形上实现多方向运动，并且在负载情况下保持鲁棒性。 RPL 首先利用特权高度图观测训练特定地形的专家策略，以掌握不同地形上解耦的运动和操作技能，然后将它们提炼成一个Transformer策略，该策略利用多个深度相机来覆盖广泛的视角。在知识提炼过程中，我们引入了两项技术来增强多方向运动的鲁棒性：基于速度指令的深度特征缩放和随机侧面掩蔽，这对于不对称深度观测和未见过的地形宽度至关重要。为了实现可扩展的深度知识提炼，我们开发了一个高效的多深度系统，该系统在大规模并行环境中针对动态机器人网格和静态地形网格进行光线投射，在模拟真实传感器延迟、噪声和dropout的同时，与现有模拟器中的深度渲染流程相比，速度提高了5倍。 广泛的真实世界实验证明了在具有挑战性的地形上的鲁棒多方向运动，以及携带载荷（2千克）的情况，包括20°斜坡、具有不同步长（22厘米、25厘米、30厘米）的楼梯，以及间距为60厘米的25厘米x25厘米的踏脚石。
tldr: The paper introduces RPL, a two-stage training framework using terrain-specific expert policies and depth distillation to enable robust multi-directional humanoid locomotion on challenging terrains, validated with real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为RPL的两阶段训练框架，该框架使用特定地形的专家策略和深度蒸馏，以实现类人机器人在复杂地形上鲁棒的多向运动，并通过真实世界的实验进行了验证。

title: Embodiment-Aware Generalist Specialist Distillation for Unified Humanoid Whole-Body Control
summary: Humanoid Whole-Body Controllers trained with reinforcement learning (RL) have recently achieved remarkable performance, yet many target a single robot embodiment. Variations in dynamics, degrees of freedom (DoFs), and kinematic topology still hinder a single policy from commanding diverse humanoids. Moreover, obtaining a generalist policy that not only transfers across embodiments but also supports richer behaviors-beyond simple walking to squatting, leaning-remains especially challenging. In this work, we tackle these obstacles by introducing EAGLE, an iterative generalist-specialist distillation framework that produces a single unified policy that controls multiple heterogeneous humanoids without per-robot reward tuning. During each cycle, embodiment-specific specialists are forked from the current generalist, refined on their respective robots, and new skills are distilled back into the generalist by training on the pooled embodiment set. Repeating this loop until performance convergence produces a robust Whole-Body Controller validated on robots such as Unitree H1, G1, and Fourier N1. We conducted experiments on five different robots in simulation and four in real-world settings. Through quantitative evaluations, EAGLE achieves high tracking accuracy and robustness compared to other methods, marking a step toward scalable, fleet-level humanoid control. See more details at https://eagle-wbc.github.io/
summary_zh:
摘要：
利用强化学习(RL)训练的人形机器人全身控制器最近取得了显著的性能，但许多控制器都针对单一机器人形态。动力学、自由度(DoFs)和运动学拓扑的差异仍然阻碍了单一策略控制不同的人形机器人。此外，获得一种通用的策略，不仅可以跨形态转移，还能支持更丰富的行为——超越简单的行走，扩展到如蹲姿，倾斜姿态——仍然极具挑战性。本文中，我们通过引入EAGLE，一种迭代的通用-专用知识蒸馏框架来解决这些障碍，该框架生成一个统一的策略，无需针对每个机器人进行奖励调整即可控制多个异构人形机器人。在每个循环中，特定形态的专家模型从当前的通用模型中分离出来，在其各自的机器人上进行精细化，并通过在汇集的形态数据集上训练将其新技能蒸馏回通用模型。重复这个循环直到性能收敛，从而产生一个鲁棒的全身控制器，并在如宇树H1、G1和傅里叶N1等机器人上得到验证。我们在仿真环境中对五种不同的机器人和在真实环境中对四种机器人进行了实验。通过定量评估，EAGLE相较于其他方法实现了高跟踪精度和鲁棒性，标志着朝着可扩展、机群级的人形机器人控制迈出了一步。更多细节请见 https://eagle-wbc.github.io/
tldr: The paper introduces EAGLE, an iterative generalist-specialist distillation framework for training a single unified policy that controls multiple heterogeneous humanoid robots without robot-specific reward tuning, validated on both simulated and real-world robots.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为EAGLE的迭代通用-专用知识提炼框架，用于训练能够控制多种异构人形机器人的统一策略，无需针对每个机器人进行奖励调整，已在模拟和真实世界的机器人上验证。

title: Moving On, Even When You're Broken: Fail-Active Trajectory Generation via Diffusion Policies Conditioned on Embodiment and Task
summary: Robot failure is detrimental and disruptive, often requiring human intervention to recover. Maintaining safe operation under impairment to achieve task completion, i.e. fail-active operation, is our target. Focusing on actuation failures, we introduce DEFT, a diffusion-based trajectory generator conditioned on the robot's current embodiment and task constraints. DEFT generalizes across failure types, supports constrained and unconstrained motions, and enables task completion under arbitrary failure. We evaluated DEFT in both simulation and real-world scenarios using a 7-DoF robotic arm. In simulation over thousands of joint-failure cases across multiple tasks, DEFT outperformed the baseline by up to 2 times. On failures unseen during training, it continued to outperform the baseline, indicating robust generalization in simulation. Further, we performed real-world evaluations on two multi-step tasks, drawer manipulation and whiteboard erasing. These experiments demonstrated DEFT succeeding on tasks where classical methods failed. Our results show that DEFT achieves fail-active manipulation across arbitrary failure configurations and real-world deployments.
summary_zh: 机器人故障是有害且具有破坏性的，通常需要人工干预才能恢复。我们的目标是在受损情况下维持安全操作以完成任务，即故障激活操作。针对驱动失效，我们引入 DEFT，这是一种基于扩散的轨迹生成器，其条件设定为机器人的当前形态和任务约束。DEFT 可以泛化到各种故障类型，支持约束和无约束运动，并能够在任意故障下完成任务。我们使用一个 7-自由度机械臂在模拟和真实场景中评估了 DEFT。在模拟中对数千个跨多个任务的关节失效案例进行评估，DEFT 的性能优于基线方法高达 2 倍。在训练期间未见过的失效情况下，DEFT 仍然优于基线方法，表明其在模拟中具有强大的泛化能力。此外，我们还在两个多步骤任务中进行了真实世界的评估：抽屉操作和白板擦除。这些实验证明 DEFT 成功地完成了经典方法失败的任务。我们的结果表明，DEFT 可以在任意故障配置和真实世界部署中实现故障激活的操控。
tldr: This paper introduces DEFT, a diffusion-based trajectory generator conditioned on robot embodiment and task, enabling fail-active robotic manipulation by completing tasks even with actuation failures, demonstrated in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了DEFT，一种基于扩散的轨迹生成器，它以机器人形态和任务为条件，通过在发生驱动故障时完成任务来实现失效激活的机器人操作，并在模拟和现实世界实验中进行了演示。

title: Accelerating Structured Chain-of-Thought in Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning enhances the decision-making capabilities of vision-language-action models in autonomous driving, but its autoregressive nature introduces significant inference latency, making it impractical for real-time applications. To address this, we introduce FastDriveCoT, a novel parallel decoding method that accelerates template-structured CoT. Our approach decomposes the reasoning process into a dependency graph of distinct sub-tasks, such as identifying critical objects and summarizing traffic rules, some of which can be generated in parallel. By generating multiple independent reasoning steps concurrently within a single forward pass, we significantly reduce the number of sequential computations. Experiments demonstrate a 3-4$\times$ speedup in CoT generation and a substantial reduction in end-to-end latency across various model architectures, all while preserving the original downstream task improvements brought by incorporating CoT reasoning.
summary_zh: 思维链（CoT）推理增强了视觉-语言-动作模型在自动驾驶中的决策能力，但其自回归特性引入了显著的推理延迟，使其无法在实时应用中使用。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了FastDriveCoT，一种新颖的并行解码方法，用于加速模板结构的CoT。我们的方法将推理过程分解为一系列具有依赖关系的子任务，例如识别关键物体和总结交通规则，其中的一些子任务可以并行生成。通过在单个前向传播过程中并发地生成多个独立的推理步骤，我们显著减少了顺序计算的次数。实验表明，在各种模型架构上，CoT生成速度提升3-4倍，并且显著降低了端到端延迟，同时保留了整合CoT推理所带来的原始下游任务改进。
tldr: The paper introduces FastDriveCoT, a method for parallel decoding of structured Chain-of-Thought reasoning, achieving significant speedups in autonomous driving applications without sacrificing performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了FastDriveCoT，一种用于并行解码结构化思维链推理的方法，在不牺牲性能的情况下，显著提高了自动驾驶应用的推理速度。

title: IMAGINE: Intelligent Multi-Agent Godot-based Indoor Networked Exploration
summary: The exploration of unknown, Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) denied environments by an autonomous communication-aware and collaborative group of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) presents significant challenges in coordination, perception, and decentralized decision-making. This paper implements Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) to address these challenges in a 2D indoor environment, using high-fidelity game-engine simulations (Godot) and continuous action spaces. Policy training aims to achieve emergent collaborative behaviours and decision-making under uncertainty using Network-Distributed Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (ND-POMDPs). Each UAV is equipped with a Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensor and can share data (sensor measurements and a local occupancy map) with neighbouring agents. Inter-agent communication constraints include limited range, bandwidth and latency. Extensive ablation studies evaluated MARL training paradigms, reward function, communication system, neural network (NN) architecture, memory mechanisms, and POMDP formulations. This work jointly addresses several key limitations in prior research, namely reliance on discrete actions, single-agent or centralized formulations, assumptions of a priori knowledge and permanent connectivity, inability to handle dynamic obstacles, short planning horizons and architectural complexity in Recurrent NNs/Transformers. Results show that the scalable training paradigm, combined with a simplified architecture, enables rapid autonomous exploration of an indoor area. The implementation of Curriculum-Learning (five increasingly complex levels) also enabled faster, more robust training. This combination of high-fidelity simulation, MARL formulation, and computational efficiency establishes a strong foundation for deploying learned cooperative strategies in physical robotic systems.
summary_zh: 由自主的、具有通信感知能力和协同能力的无人机（UAV）群探索未知的、全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）受限环境，在协调、感知和去中心化决策方面提出了重大挑战。本文采用多智能体强化学习（MARL）来解决这些挑战，环境设定为一个二维室内环境，并使用高保真游戏引擎仿真（Godot）和连续动作空间。策略训练旨在实现新兴的协同行为以及在使用网络分布式部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（ND-POMDPs）条件下的不确定性决策。每个无人机配备一部激光雷达（LiDAR）传感器，并可以与相邻智能体共享数据（传感器测量值和局部占据栅格地图）。智能体间通信约束包括有限的范围、带宽和延迟。通过广泛的消融研究评估了MARL训练范式、奖励函数、通信系统、神经网络（NN）架构、记忆机制和POMDP公式。本工作共同解决了先前研究中的几个关键局限性，即依赖于离散动作、单智能体或集中式公式、先验知识和永久连接的假设、无法处理动态障碍物、短规划范围以及循环神经网络/Transformer的架构复杂性。结果表明，可扩展的训练范式与简化的架构相结合，能够快速自主地探索室内区域。课程学习（五个复杂度递增的等级）的实施也实现了更快、更稳健的训练。这种高保真仿真、MARL公式和计算效率的结合，为在物理机器人系统中部署学习到的协同策略奠定了坚实的基础。
