In a reward-free environment with regime shifts, this latent structure exhibits direction-dependent hysteresis, while policy-level behavior remains comparatively reactive. I argue that such hysteresis constitutes a measurable signature of perspective-like subjectivity in machine systems.
summary_zh: 本研究通过将主观视角根植于一个最小化的、现象学驱动的内部结构，从而在人工智能体中实现主观视角的运作化。该视角被实现为一个缓慢演化的全局潜在状态，它调制快速的策略动态，但不会直接针对行为后果进行优化。在一个具有状态转换的无奖励环境中，这种潜在结构表现出方向依赖的滞后效应，而策略层面的行为则保持相对的反应性。我认为这种滞后效应构成了机器系统中类视角主观性的一种可测量特征。
tldr: This paper explores a minimal computational structure for subjective perspective in AI agents, implemented as a slowly evolving latent state modulating policy dynamics, and suggests hysteresis as a measurable signature of subjectivity.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了人工智能体中主观视角的最小计算结构，该结构被实现为缓慢演变的潜在状态，调节策略动态，并提出滞后现象作为可测量的主观性特征。

title: Multi-Resolution Alignment for Voxel Sparsity in Camera-Based 3D Semantic Scene Completion
summary: Camera-based 3D semantic scene completion (SSC) offers a cost-effective solution for assessing the geometric occupancy and semantic labels of each voxel in the surrounding 3D scene with image inputs, providing a voxel-level scene perception foundation for the perception-prediction-planning autonomous driving systems. Although significant progress has been made in existing methods, their optimization rely solely on the supervision from voxel labels and face the challenge of voxel sparsity as a large portion of voxels in autonomous driving scenarios are empty, which limits both optimization efficiency and model performance. To address this issue, we propose a \textit{Multi-Resolution Alignment (MRA)} approach to mitigate voxel sparsity in camera-based 3D semantic scene completion, which exploits the scene and instance level alignment across multi-resolution 3D features as auxiliary supervision. Specifically, we first propose the Multi-resolution View Transformer module, which projects 2D image features into multi-resolution 3D features and aligns them at the scene level through fusing discriminative seed features. Furthermore, we design the Cubic Semantic Anisotropy module to identify the instance-level semantic significance of each voxel, accounting for the semantic differences of a specific voxel against its neighboring voxels within a cubic area. Finally, we devise a Critical Distribution Alignment module, which selects critical voxels as instance-level anchors with the guidance of cubic semantic anisotropy, and applies a circulated loss for auxiliary supervision on the critical feature distribution consistency across different resolutions. The code is available at https://github.com/PKU-ICST-MIPL/MRA_TIP.
summary_zh: 基于相机的3D语义场景补全（SSC）提供了一种经济高效的解决方案，用于评估周围3D场景中每个体素的几何占用和语义标签，通过图像输入，从而为感知-预测-规划自动驾驶系统提供体素级别的场景感知基础。尽管现有方法已经取得了显著进展，但它们的优化仅依赖于体素标签的监督，并且面临体素稀疏性的挑战，因为在自动驾驶场景中大部分体素是空的，这限制了优化效率和模型性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种\textit{多分辨率对齐 (MRA)}方法，以减轻基于相机的3D语义场景补全中的体素稀疏性，该方法利用跨多分辨率3D特征的场景和实例级别对齐作为辅助监督。具体来说，我们首先提出了多分辨率视图变换模块，该模块将2D图像特征投影到多分辨率3D特征中，并通过融合判别性种子特征在场景级别上对齐它们。此外，我们设计了立方体语义各向异性模块，用于识别每个体素的实例级别语义重要性，考虑特定体素相对于立方体区域内相邻体素的语义差异。最后，我们设计了一个关键分布对齐模块，该模块以立方体语义各向异性为指导，选择关键体素作为实例级别的锚点，并应用循环损失对不同分辨率之间关键特征分布的一致性进行辅助监督。代码可在https://github.com/PKU-ICST-MIPL/MRA_TIP上获取。
tldr: This paper introduces a Multi-Resolution Alignment (MRA) approach to address voxel sparsity in camera-based 3D semantic scene completion (SSC) by incorporating scene and instance level alignment as auxiliary supervision.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多分辨率对齐（MRA）方法，通过结合场景和实例级别的对齐作为辅助监督，来解决基于相机的3D语义场景补全（SSC）中出现的体素稀疏性问题。

title: FARTrack: Fast Autoregressive Visual Tracking with High Performance
summary: Inference speed and tracking performance are two critical evaluation metrics in the field of visual tracking. However, high-performance trackers often suffer from slow processing speeds, making them impractical for deployment on resource-constrained devices. To alleviate this issue, we propose FARTrack, a Fast Auto-Regressive Tracking framework. Since autoregression emphasizes the temporal nature of the trajectory sequence, it can maintain high performance while achieving efficient execution across various devices. FARTrack introduces Task-Specific Self-Distillation and Inter-frame Autoregressive Sparsification, designed from the perspectives of shallow-yet-accurate distillation and redundant-to-essential token optimization, respectively. Task-Specific Self-Distillation achieves model compression by distilling task-specific tokens layer by layer, enhancing the model's inference speed while avoiding suboptimal manual teacher-student layer pairs assignments. Meanwhile, Inter-frame Autoregressive Sparsification sequentially condenses multiple templates, avoiding additional runtime overhead while learning a temporally-global optimal sparsification strategy. FARTrack demonstrates outstanding speed and competitive performance. It delivers an AO of 70.6% on GOT-10k in real-time. Beyond, our fastest model achieves a speed of 343 FPS on the GPU and 121 FPS on the CPU.
summary_zh: 推理速度和跟踪性能是视觉跟踪领域中两个关键的评价指标。然而，高性能的跟踪器通常面临处理速度慢的问题，使其难以部署在资源受限的设备上。为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了FARTrack，一个快速自回归跟踪框架。由于自回归强调轨迹序列的时间特性，因此它可以在保持高性能的同时，在各种设备上实现高效执行。FARTrack引入了任务特定的自蒸馏和帧间自回归稀疏化，分别从浅层但精确的蒸馏和冗余到精简的令牌优化两个角度进行设计。任务特定的自蒸馏通过逐层提炼任务特定令牌来实现模型压缩，在提升模型推理速度的同时避免了次优的手动师生层对分配。同时，帧间自回归稀疏化顺序地浓缩多个模板，避免了额外的运行时开销，同时学习到一种时间全局最优的稀疏化策略。FARTrack展示了卓越的速度和有竞争力的性能。它在GOT-10k上实现了70.6%的AO，并且达到实时性。此外，我们最快的模型在GPU上达到了343 FPS的速度，在CPU上达到了121 FPS的速度。
tldr: FARTrack introduces a fast, autoregressive visual tracking framework utilizing task-specific self-distillation and inter-frame autoregressive sparsification to achieve real-time performance with competitive accuracy on GOT-10k.
tldr_zh: FARTrack 提出了一个快速的自回归视觉跟踪框架，它利用特定于任务的自蒸馏和帧间自回归稀疏化，在 GOT-10k 上实现了具有竞争力的准确性的实时性能。

title: Self-Supervised Uncalibrated Multi-View Video Anonymization in the Operating Room
summary: Privacy preservation is a prerequisite for using video data in Operating Room (OR) research. Effective anonymization relies on the exhaustive localization of every individual; even a single missed detection necessitates extensive manual correction. However, existing approaches face two critical scalability bottlenecks: (1) they usually require manual annotations of each new clinical site for high accuracy; (2) while multi-camera setups have been widely adopted to address single-view ambiguity, camera calibration is typically required whenever cameras are repositioned. To address these problems, we propose a novel self-supervised multi-view video anonymization framework consisting of whole-body person detection and whole-body pose estimation, without annotation or camera calibration. Our core strategy is to enhance the single-view detector by "retrieving" false negatives using temporal and multi-view context, and conducting self-supervised domain adaptation. We first run an off-the-shelf whole-body person detector in each view with a low-score threshold to gather candidate detections. Then, we retrieve the low-score false negatives that exhibit consistency with the high-score detections via tracking and self-supervised uncalibrated multi-view association. These recovered detections serve as pseudo labels to iteratively fine-tune the whole-body detector. Finally, we apply whole-body pose estimation on each detected person, and fine-tune the pose model using its own high-score predictions. Experiments on the 4D-OR dataset of simulated surgeries and our dataset of real surgeries show the effectiveness of our approach achieving over 97% recall. Moreover, we train a real-time whole-body detector using our pseudo labels, achieving comparable performance and highlighting our method's practical applicability. Code is available at https://github.com/CAMMA-public/OR_anonymization.
summary_zh: 隐私保护是在手术室(OR)研究中使用视频数据的先决条件。有效的匿名化依赖于对每个个体的全面定位；即使是单个遗漏的检测也需要进行大量的人工校正。然而，现有方法面临两个关键的可扩展性瓶颈：（1）它们通常需要对每个新的临床站点进行手动标注才能获得高精度；（2）虽然多摄像头设置已被广泛采用以解决单视图歧义，但通常需要在每次重新定位摄像头时进行摄像头标定。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的自监督多视图视频匿名化框架，该框架包含全身人体检测和全身姿态估计，无需标注或摄像头标定。我们的核心策略是通过使用时间和多视图上下文“检索”假阴性来增强单视图检测器，并进行自监督领域自适应。我们首先在每个视图中运行一个现成的低分阈值全身人体检测器，以收集候选检测结果。然后，我们通过跟踪和自监督未标定的多视图关联来检索与高分检测结果一致的低分假阴性。这些恢复的检测结果充当伪标签，用于迭代微调全身检测器。最后，我们对每个检测到的人应用全身姿态估计，并使用自身的高分预测来微调姿态模型。在模拟手术的4D-OR数据集和我们的真实手术数据集上的实验表明了我们方法的有效性，实现了超过97%的的召回率。此外，我们使用我们的伪标签训练了一个实时的全身检测器，实现了可比较的性能，突出了我们方法的实际应用性。代码可在https://github.com/CAMMA-public/OR_anonymization获得。
tldr: The paper proposes a self-supervised multi-view video anonymization framework for operating rooms that does not require manual annotation or camera calibration, achieving high recall and practical applicability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于手术室的自监督多视角视频匿名化框架，无需手动标注或相机校准，实现了高召回率和实际应用性。

title: Conditional Flow Matching for Visually-Guided Acoustic Highlighting
summary: Visually-guided acoustic highlighting seeks to rebalance audio in alignment with the accompanying video, creating a coherent audio-visual experience. While visual saliency and enhancement have been widely studied, acoustic highlighting remains underexplored, often leading to misalignment between visual and auditory focus. Existing approaches use discriminative models, which struggle with the inherent ambiguity in audio remixing, where no natural one-to-one mapping exists between poorly-balanced and well-balanced audio mixes. To address this limitation, we reframe this task as a generative problem and introduce a Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) framework. A key challenge in iterative flow-based generation is that early prediction errors -- in selecting the correct source to enhance -- compound over steps and push trajectories off-manifold. To address this, we introduce a rollout loss that penalizes drift at the final step, encouraging self-correcting trajectories and stabilizing long-range flow integration. We further propose a conditioning module that fuses audio and visual cues before vector field regression, enabling explicit cross-modal source selection. Extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations show that our method consistently surpasses the previous state-of-the-art discriminative approach, establishing that visually-guided audio remixing is best addressed through generative modeling.
summary_zh: 视觉引导的声学增强旨在根据随附的视频重新平衡音频，从而创建连贯的视听体验。尽管视觉显著性和增强已得到广泛研究，但声学增强仍未得到充分探索，常常导致视觉焦点和听觉焦点之间的不一致。现有方法使用判别模型，这些模型难以应对音频重混的内在模糊性，因为在平衡不良和平衡良好的音频混音之间不存在自然的一对一映射。为了解决这个限制，我们将这项任务重新定义为生成问题，并引入了一个条件流匹配（CFM）框架。迭代的基于流的生成的一个关键挑战是，早期预测错误（在选择要增强的正确音源时）会在多个步骤中累积，并将轨迹推离流形。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个回滚损失，以惩罚最后一步的漂移，从而鼓励自我纠正的轨迹并稳定长程流积分。我们进一步提出一个条件模块，该模块在向量场回归之前融合音频和视觉线索，从而实现显式的跨模态音源选择。大量的定量和定性评估表明，我们的方法始终优于先前的最佳判别方法，证实了视觉引导的音频重混通过生成建模可以最好地解决。
tldr: This paper introduces a Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) framework for visually-guided acoustic highlighting, addressing the limitations of discriminative models by reframing the task as a generative problem with a rollout loss and a cross-modal conditioning module.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种条件流匹配（CFM）框架，用于视觉引导的音频突出显示，通过将任务重构为生成问题，并结合rollout损失和跨模态调节模块，解决了判别模型的局限性。

title: Probe-then-Commit Multi-Objective Bandits: Theoretical Benefits of Limited Multi-Arm Feedback
summary: We study an online resource-selection problem motivated by multi-radio access selection and mobile edge computing offloading. In each round, an agent chooses among $K$ candidate links/servers (arms) whose performance is a stochastic $d$-dimensional vector (e.g., throughput, latency, energy, reliability). The key interaction is \emph{probe-then-commit (PtC)}: the agent may probe up to $q>1$ candidates via control-plane measurements to observe their vector outcomes, but must execute exactly one candidate in the data plane. This limited multi-arm feedback regime strictly interpolates between classical bandits ($q=1$) and full-information experts ($q=K$), yet existing multi-objective learning theory largely focuses on these extremes. We develop \textsc{PtC-P-UCB}, an optimistic probe-then-commit algorithm whose technical core is frontier-aware probing under uncertainty in a Pareto mode, e.g., it selects the $q$ probes by approximately maximizing a hypervolume-inspired frontier-coverage potential and commits by marginal hypervolume gain to directly expand the attained Pareto region. We prove a dominated-hypervolume frontier error of $\tilde{O} (K_P d/\sqrt{qT})$, where $K_P$ is the Pareto-frontier size and $T$ is the horizon, and scalarized regret $\tilde{O} (L_φd\sqrt{(K/q)T})$, where $φ$ is the scalarizer. These quantify a transparent $1/\sqrt{q}$ acceleration from limited probing. We further extend to \emph{multi-modal probing}: each probe returns $M$ modalities (e.g., CSI, queue, compute telemetry), and uncertainty fusion yields variance-adaptive versions of the above bounds via an effective noise scale.
summary_zh: 我们研究了一个在线资源选择问题，该问题受到多无线电接入选择和移动边缘计算卸载的启发。在每一轮中，一个代理从$K$个候选链路/服务器（臂）中进行选择，它们的性能是一个随机的$d$维向量（例如，吞吐量、延迟、能量、可靠性）。关键的交互是\emph{探测-然后-提交(PtC)}：代理可以通过控制平面测量来探测至多$q > 1$个候选对象，以观察它们的向量结果，但必须在数据平面中执行恰好一个候选对象。这种受限的多臂反馈机制严格地插值在经典bandit算法($q=1$)和全信息专家算法($q=K$)之间，但现有的多目标学习理论主要集中在这些极端情况上。我们开发了\textsc{PtC-P-UCB}，这是一种乐观的探测-然后-提交算法，其技术核心是在Pareto模式下，对不确定性进行前沿感知探测，例如，它通过近似最大化一个受超体积启发的边界覆盖势来选择这$q$个探测，并通过边际超体积增益来提交，以直接扩展已获得的Pareto区域。我们证明了$\tilde{O} (K_P d/\sqrt{qT})$的受支配超体积边界误差，其中$K_P$是Pareto边界大小，$T$是时间范围；以及$\tilde{O} (L_φd\sqrt{(K/q)T})$的标量化后悔值，其中$φ$是标量化函数。这些量化了来自有限探测的透明的$1/\sqrt{q}$加速。我们进一步扩展到\emph{多模态探测}：每次探测返回$M$种模态（例如，CSI、队列、计算遥测数据），并且不确定性融合通过有效的噪声尺度产生上述边界的方差自适应版本。
tldr: This paper introduces a new multi-objective bandit algorithm, PtC-P-UCB, for resource selection with limited multi-arm feedback, achieving improved performance demonstrated through theoretical bounds. The algorithm is particularly relevant in scenarios like mobile edge computing offloading and multi-radio access selection where trade-offs between objectives like throughput, latency, and energy efficiency exist.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的多目标bandit算法PtC-P-UCB，用于资源选择，具有有限的多臂反馈，并通过理论界限证明了其改进的性能。 该算法特别适用于移动边缘计算卸载和多无线电接入选择等场景，在这种场景中，吞吐量，延迟和能源效率等目标之间存在权衡。

title: Conflict-Aware Client Selection for Multi-Server Federated Learning
summary: Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a promising distributed machine learning (ML) that enables collaborative model training across clients without exposing raw data, thereby preserving user privacy and reducing communication costs. Despite these benefits, traditional single-server FL suffers from high communication latency due to the aggregation of models from a large number of clients. While multi-server FL distributes workloads across edge servers, overlapping client coverage and uncoordinated selection often lead to resource contention, causing bandwidth conflicts and training failures. To address these limitations, we propose a decentralized reinforcement learning with conflict risk prediction, named RL CRP, to optimize client selection in multi-server FL systems. Specifically, each server estimates the likelihood of client selection conflicts using a categorical hidden Markov model based on its sparse historical client selection sequence. Then, a fairness-aware reward mechanism is incorporated to promote long-term client participation for minimizing training latency and resource contention. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed RL-CRP framework effectively reduces inter-server conflicts and significantly improves training efficiency in terms of convergence speed and communication cost.
summary_zh: 联邦学习（FL）已成为一种有前景的分布式机器学习（ML）方法，它能够在不暴露原始数据的情况下进行跨客户端的协同模型训练，从而保护用户隐私并降低通信成本。尽管有所述优点，但传统的单服务器FL由于需要聚合来自大量客户端的模型，因此面临着高通信延迟的问题。虽然多服务器FL将工作负载分配到边缘服务器上，但客户端覆盖范围的重叠以及未协调的选择往往会导致资源争用，进而引发带宽冲突和训练失败。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种基于冲突风险预测的去中心化强化学习方法，名为RL-CRP，以优化多服务器FL系统中的客户端选择。具体而言，每个服务器使用基于其稀疏历史客户端选择序列的分类隐马尔可夫模型来估计客户端选择冲突的可能性。然后，结合一种公平感知奖励机制，以促进长期客户端参与，从而最大限度地减少训练延迟和资源争用。大量实验表明，所提出的RL-CRP框架能有效减少服务器间的冲突，并在收敛速度和通信成本方面显著提高训练效率。
tldr: This paper proposes a decentralized reinforcement learning approach (RL-CRP) for client selection in multi-server federated learning to reduce inter-server conflicts and improve training efficiency by predicting conflicts and promoting fairness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种去中心化的强化学习方法(RL-CRP)，用于多服务器联邦学习中的客户端选择，通过预测冲突并促进公平性来减少服务器间冲突并提高训练效率。

title: Maximizing Reliability with Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a popular, sample-efficient technique for expensive, black-box optimization. One such problem arising in manufacturing is that of maximizing the reliability, or equivalently minimizing the probability of a failure, of a design which is subject to random perturbations - a problem that can involve extremely rare failures ($P_\mathrm{fail} = 10^{-6}-10^{-8}$). In this work, we propose two BO methods based on Thompson sampling and knowledge gradient, the latter approximating the one-step Bayes-optimal policy for minimizing the logarithm of the failure probability. Both methods incorporate importance sampling to target extremely small failure probabilities. Empirical results show the proposed methods outperform existing methods in both extreme and non-extreme regimes.
summary_zh: 贝叶斯优化 (BO) 是一种流行的、具有样本高效性的技术，用于解决昂贵且黑盒的优化问题。在制造业中，一个此类问题是如何最大化设计的可靠性，或等价地最小化设计在随机扰动下的失效概率——这个问题可能涉及极其罕见的失效 ($P_\mathrm{fail} = 10^{-6}-10^{-8}$)。 在这项工作中，我们提出了两种基于 Thompson 采样和知识梯度的 BO 方法，后者近似于一步贝叶斯最优策略，用于最小化失效概率的对数。两种方法都结合了重要性采样，以针对极小的失效概率。 实验结果表明，所提出的方法在极端和非极端情况下都优于现有方法。
tldr: This paper introduces two Bayesian Optimization (BO) methods using Thompson sampling and knowledge gradient, incorporating importance sampling to maximize reliability (minimize failure probability) in designs, particularly in scenarios with extremely rare failures, demonstrating improved performance over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了两种贝叶斯优化(BO)方法，采用Thompson采样和知识梯度，并结合重要性采样，以最大化设计可靠性（最小化故障概率），尤其是在极罕见故障的情况下，实验表明其性能优于现有方法。

title: Input-to-State Safe Backstepping: Robust Safety-Critical Control with Unmatched Uncertainties
summary: Guaranteeing safety in the presence of unmatched disturbances -- uncertainties that cannot be directly canceled by the control input -- remains a key challenge in nonlinear control. This paper presents a constructive approach to safety-critical control of nonlinear systems with unmatched disturbances. We first present a generalization of the input-to-state safety (ISSf) framework for systems with these uncertainties using the recently developed notion of an Optimal Decay CBF, which provides more flexibility for satisfying the associated Lyapunov-like conditions for safety. From there, we outline a procedure for constructing ISSf-CBFs for two relevant classes of systems with unmatched uncertainties: i) strict-feedback systems; ii) dual-relative-degree systems, which are similar to differentially flat systems. Our theoretical results are illustrated via numerical simulations of an inverted pendulum and planar quadrotor.
summary_zh: 在存在非匹配扰动（控制输入无法直接消除的不确定性）的情况下保证安全性，仍然是非线性控制领域的一个关键挑战。本文提出了一种针对具有非匹配扰动非线性系统安全关键控制的构造性方法。我们首先提出了输入状态安全性（ISSf）框架的一种推广，用于处理具有此类不确定性的系统，该推广利用了最新发展的最优衰减CBF的概念，为满足相关的类李雅普诺夫安全性条件提供了更大的灵活性。进而，我们概述了针对两类相关的具有非匹配不确定性的系统构造ISSf-CBF的过程：i) 严格反馈系统；ii) 双相对阶系统，该类系统类似于微分平坦系统。我们的理论结果通过倒立摆和平坦四旋翼的数值仿真进行了验证。
tldr: This paper presents a method for safety-critical control of nonlinear systems with unmatched disturbances using input-to-state safety (ISSf) and Optimal Decay CBFs, demonstrated on an inverted pendulum and planar quadrotor. The method generalizes ISSf framework.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用输入到状态安全 (ISSf) 和最优衰减 CBF 的非线性系统安全关键控制方法，适用于具有不匹配扰动的情况，并在倒立摆和平板四旋翼飞行器上进行了演示。该方法推广了 ISSf 框架。

title: Investigating the Influence of Spatial Ability in Augmented Reality-assisted Robot Programming
summary: Augmented Reality (AR) offers promising opportunities to enhance learning, but its mechanisms and effects are not yet fully understood. As learning becomes increasingly personalized, considering individual learner characteristics becomes more important. This study investigates the moderating effect of spatial ability on learning experience with AR in the context of robot programming. A between-subjects experiment ($N=71$) compared conventional robot programming to an AR-assisted approach using a head-mounted display. Participants' spatial ability was assessed using the Mental Rotation Test. The learning experience was measured through the System Usability Scale (SUS) and cognitive load. The results indicate that AR support does not significantly improve the learning experience compared to the conventional approach. However, AR appears to have a compensatory effect on the influence of spatial ability. In the control group, spatial ability was significantly positively associated with SUS scores and negatively associated with extraneous cognitive load, indicating that higher spatial ability predicts a better learning experience. In the AR condition, these relationships were not observable, suggesting that AR mitigated the disadvantage typically experienced by learners with lower spatial abilities. These findings suggest that AR can serve a compensatory function by reducing the influence of learner characteristics. Future research should further explore this compensatory role of AR to guide the design of personalized learning environments that address diverse learner needs and reduce barriers for learners with varying cognitive profiles.
summary_zh: 增强现实（AR）为提升学习效果提供了充满希望的机会，但其机制和作用尚未被完全理解。随着学习日益个性化，考虑个体学习者特征变得愈发重要。本研究调查了空间能力在机器人编程情境下对AR学习体验的调节作用。一项被试间实验（$N=71$）对比了传统的机器人编程方法和使用头戴式显示器的AR辅助方法。参与者的空间能力通过心理旋转测试进行评估。学习体验通过系统可用性量表（SUS）和认知负荷进行测量。结果表明，与传统方法相比，AR支持并未显著改善学习体验。然而，AR似乎对空间能力的影响具有补偿作用。在控制组中，空间能力与SUS得分呈显著正相关，与无关认知负荷呈显著负相关，表明较高的空间能力预示着更好的学习体验。在AR条件下，这些关系不可观察，这表明AR减轻了通常空间能力较低的学习者所经历的不利影响。这些发现表明，AR可以通过减少学习者特征的影响发挥补偿功能。未来的研究应进一步探索AR的这种补偿作用，以指导个性化学习环境的设计，从而满足不同的学习者需求，并减少具有不同认知特征的学习者的障碍。
tldr: This paper investigates if AR-assisted robot programming can compensate for lower spatial abilities in learners, finding that AR mitigates the correlation between spatial ability and learning experience as measured by SUS and cognitive load.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了AR辅助机器人编程是否可以弥补学习者较低的空间能力，发现AR减轻了空间能力与学习体验之间的相关性，学习体验通过系统可用性量表 (SUS) 和认知负荷来衡量。

title: Estimation of Ground Reaction Forces from Kinematic Data during Locomotion
summary: Ground reaction forces (GRFs) provide fundamental insight into human gait mechanics and are widely used to assess joint loading, limb symmetry, balance control, and motor function. Despite their clinical relevance, the use of GRF remains underutilised in clinical workflows due to the practical limitations of force plate systems. In this work, we present a force-plate-free approach for estimating GRFs using only marker-based motion capture data. This kinematics only method to estimate and decompose GRF makes it well suited for widespread clinical depolyment. By using kinematics from sixteen body segments, we estimate the centre of mass (CoM) and compute GRFs, which are subsequently decomposed into individual components through a minimization-based approach. Through this framework, we can identify gait stance phases and provide access to clinically meaningful kinetic measures without a dedicated force plate system. Experimental results demonstrate the viability of CoM and GRF estimation based solely on kinematic data, supporting force-plate-free gait analysis.
summary_zh: 地面反作用力（GRF）提供了对人体步态力学的基本洞察，并被广泛用于评估关节负荷、肢体对称性、平衡控制和运动功能。尽管其具有临床相关性，但由于测力台系统的实际局限性，GRF的应用在临床流程中仍未得到充分利用。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种无需测力台的方法，仅使用基于标记点的运动捕捉数据来估计GRF。这种仅基于运动学数据估计和分解GRF的方法非常适合广泛的临床应用。通过使用来自十六个身体节段的运动学数据，我们估计质心（CoM）并计算GRF，随后通过基于最小化的方法将其分解为各个分量。通过这个框架，我们可以识别步态站立期，并提供对临床有意义的动力学指标的访问，而无需专用的测力台系统。实验结果表明，仅基于运动学数据进行CoM和GRF估计是可行的，支持了无需测力台的步态分析。
tldr: This paper introduces a method to estimate ground reaction forces (GRFs) from kinematic data alone, eliminating the need for force plates in gait analysis and potentially enabling wider clinical use.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了一种仅从运动学数据估计地面反作用力（GRF）的方法，无需测力台进行步态分析，并可能在临床上更广泛地应用。

title: Multi-function Robotized Surgical Dissector for Endoscopic Pulmonary Thromboendarterectomy: Preclinical Study and Evaluation
summary: Patients suffering chronic severe pulmonary thromboembolism need Pulmonary Thromboendarterectomy (PTE) to remove the thromb and intima located inside pulmonary artery (PA). During the surgery, a surgeon holds tweezers and a dissector to delicately strip the blockage, but available tools for this surgery are rigid and straight, lacking distal dexterity to access into thin branches of PA. Therefore, this work presents a novel robotized dissector based on concentric push/pull robot (CPPR) structure, enabling entering deep thin branch of tortuous PA. Compared with conventional rigid dissectors, our design characterizes slenderness and dual-segment-bending dexterity. Owing to the hollow and thin-walled structure of the CPPR-based dissector as it has a slender body of 3.5mm in diameter, the central lumen accommodates two channels for irrigation and tip tool, and space for endoscopic camera's signal wire. To provide accurate surgical manipulation, optimization-based kinematics model was established, realizing a 2mm accuracy in positioning the tip tool (60mm length) under open-loop control strategy. As such, with the endoscopic camera, traditional PTE is possible to be upgraded as endoscopic PTE. Basic physic performance of the robotized dissector including stiffness, motion accuracy and maneuverability was evaluated through experiments. Surgery simulation on ex vivo porcine lung also demonstrates its dexterity and notable advantages in PTE.
summary_zh: 患有慢性严重肺血栓栓塞的患者需要进行肺动脉血栓内膜剥脱术 (PTE) 以移除肺动脉 (PA) 内的血栓和内膜。 手术过程中，外科医生使用镊子和剥离器精细地剥离阻塞物，但目前的手术工具刚性且笔直，缺乏进入肺动脉细小分支的远端灵活性。 因此，本研究提出了一种基于同轴推/拉机器人 (CPPR) 结构的新型机器人剥离器，能够深入弯曲的肺动脉细小分支。 与传统的刚性剥离器相比，我们的设计具有纤细性和双段弯曲的灵活性。 基于 CPPR 的剥离器具有中空薄壁结构，其纤细的机身直径为 3.5 毫米，中央腔容纳用于灌注和末端工具的两个通道，以及用于内窥镜摄像头信号线的空间。为了提供精确的手术操作，建立了基于优化的运动学模型，在开环控制策略下实现了末端工具（长度 60 毫米）2 毫米的定位精度。 这样，借助内窥镜摄像头，传统的 PTE 有可能升级为内窥镜 PTE。 通过实验评估了该机器人剥离器的基本物理性能，包括刚度、运动精度和可操作性。 在离体猪肺上进行的手术模拟也证明了其灵活性和在 PTE 中的显著优势。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel robotized surgical dissector for endoscopic pulmonary thromboendarterectomy, featuring a slender design and dual-segment-bending dexterity, validated through experiments and surgery simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于内窥镜肺动脉血栓切除术的新型机器人手术解剖器，该解剖器具有纤细的设计和双段弯曲灵活性，并通过实验和手术模拟进行了验证。

title: AROLA: A Modular Layered Architecture for Scaled Autonomous Racing
summary: Autonomous racing has advanced rapidly, particularly on scaled platforms, and software stacks must evolve accordingly. In this work, AROLA is introduced as a modular, layered software architecture in which fragmented and monolithic designs are reorganized into interchangeable layers and components connected through standardized ROS 2 interfaces. The autonomous-driving pipeline is decomposed into sensing, pre-processing, perception, localization and mapping, planning, behavior, control, and actuation, enabling rapid module replacement and objective benchmarking without reliance on custom message definitions. To support consistent performance evaluation, a Race Monitor framework is introduced as a lightweight system through which lap timing, trajectory quality, and computational load are logged in real time and standardized post-race analyses are generated. AROLA is validated in simulation and on hardware using the RoboRacer platform, including deployment at the 2025 RoboRacer IV25 competition. Together, AROLA and Race Monitor demonstrate that modularity, transparent interfaces, and systematic evaluation can accelerate development and improve reproducibility in scaled autonomous racing.
summary_zh: 自主赛车技术发展迅速，尤其是在比例平台上，软件栈也必须相应发展。本文介绍了 AROLA，一种模块化、分层软件架构，它将碎片化和单体式设计重组为可互换的层和组件，并通过标准化的 ROS 2 接口连接。自动驾驶流水线被分解为感知、预处理、感知、定位与建图、规划、行为、控制和执行等环节，从而能够在不依赖于自定义消息定义的情况下快速替换模块并进行客观的基准测试。为了支持一致的性能评估，我们引入了一个 Race Monitor 框架，作为一个轻量级系统，它能实时记录单圈计时、轨迹质量和计算负载，并生成标准化的赛后分析报告。AROLA 在仿真和硬件上，使用 RoboRacer 平台进行了验证，包括在 2025 RoboRacer IV25 比赛中的部署。AROLA 和 Race Monitor 共同证明了模块化、透明接口和系统性评估能够加速比例自主赛车的开发并提高其可重复性。
tldr: The paper introduces AROLA, a modular and layered software architecture for scaled autonomous racing, along with a Race Monitor framework for standardized performance evaluation, aiming to improve development speed and reproducibility.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 AROLA，一种用于小型自动驾驶赛车的模块化分层软件架构，以及用于标准化性能评估的 Race Monitor 框架，旨在提高开发速度和可重复性。

title: Evaluating False Alarm and Missing Attacks in CAN IDS
summary: Modern vehicles rely on electronic control units (ECUs) interconnected through the Controller Area Network (CAN), making in-vehicle communication a critical security concern. Machine learning (ML)-based intrusion detection systems (IDS) are increasingly deployed to protect CAN traffic, yet their robustness against adversarial manipulation remains largely unexplored. We present a systematic adversarial evaluation of CAN IDS using the ROAD dataset, comparing four shallow learning models with a deep neural network-based detector. Using protocol-compliant, payload-level perturbations generated via FGSM, BIM and PGD, we evaluate adversarial effects on both benign and malicious CAN frames. While all models achieve strong baseline performance under benign conditions, adversarial perturbations reveal substantial vulnerabilities. Although shallow and deep models are robust to false-alarm induction, with the deep neural network (DNN) performing best on benign traffic, all architectures suffer significant increases in missed attacks. Notably, under gradient-based attacks, the shallow model extra trees (ET) demonstrates improved robustness to missed-attack induction compared to the other models. Our results demonstrate that adversarial manipulation can simultaneously trigger false alarms and evade detection, underscoring the need for adversarial robustness evaluation in safety-critical automotive IDS.
summary_zh: 现代车辆依赖于通过控制器局域网（CAN）互连的电子控制单元（ECU），这使得车载通信成为一个关键的安全问题。基于机器学习（ML）的入侵检测系统（IDS）正日益被部署以保护CAN流量，但它们对抗对抗性操纵的鲁棒性在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们使用ROAD数据集对CAN IDS进行系统的对抗性评估，比较了四种浅层学习模型和一个基于深度神经网络的检测器。通过FGSM、BIM和PGD生成符合协议的、有效载荷级别的扰动，我们评估了良性和恶意CAN帧上的对抗性影响。虽然所有模型在良性条件下都取得了强大的基准性能，但对抗性扰动揭示了大量的漏洞。尽管浅层和深度模型对误报的诱导具有鲁棒性，其中深度神经网络（DNN）在良性流量上表现最佳，但所有架构都遭受了显著的攻击漏报增加。值得注意的是，在基于梯度的攻击下，浅层模型的极端随机树（ET）相比其他模型，在攻击漏报诱导方面表现出更好的鲁棒性。我们的结果表明，对抗性操纵能够同时触发误报并逃避检测，强调了在安全关键的汽车IDS中进行对抗鲁棒性评估的必要性。
tldr: The paper systematically evaluates the adversarial robustness of different machine learning-based CAN intrusion detection systems (IDS) in vehicles, finding significant vulnerabilities to gradient-based attacks. Shallow models show surprising robustness in certain attack scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文系统地评估了车辆中基于机器学习的CAN入侵检测系统（IDS）的对抗鲁棒性，发现其对基于梯度的攻击存在重大漏洞。 在某些攻击场景中，浅层模型表现出令人惊讶的鲁棒性。

title: From Pre- to Intra-operative MRI: Predicting Brain Shift in Temporal Lobe Resection for Epilepsy Surgery
summary: Introduction: In neurosurgery, image-guided Neurosurgery Systems (IGNS) highly rely on preoperative brain magnetic resonance images (MRI) to assist surgeons in locating surgical targets and determining surgical paths. However, brain shift invalidates the preoperative MRI after dural opening. Updated intraoperative brain MRI with brain shift compensation is crucial for enhancing the precision of neuronavigation systems and ensuring the optimal outcome of surgical interventions. Methodology: We propose NeuralShift, a U-Net-based model that predicts brain shift entirely from pre-operative MRI for patients undergoing temporal lobe resection. We evaluated our results using Target Registration Errors (TREs) computed on anatomical landmarks located on the resection side and along the midline, and DICE scores comparing predicted intraoperative masks with masks derived from intraoperative MRI. Results: Our experimental results show that our model can predict the global deformation of the brain (DICE of 0.97) with accurate local displacements (achieve landmark TRE as low as 1.12 mm), compensating for large brain shifts during temporal lobe removal neurosurgery. Conclusion: Our proposed model is capable of predicting the global deformation of the brain during temporal lobe resection using only preoperative images, providing potential opportunities to the surgical team to increase safety and efficiency of neurosurgery and better outcomes to patients. Our contributions will be publicly available after acceptance in https://github.com/SurgicalDataScienceKCL/NeuralShift.
summary_zh:
摘要：
引言：在神经外科中，图像引导神经外科系统（IGNS）高度依赖术前脑部磁共振成像（MRI），以辅助外科医生定位手术目标并确定手术路径。然而，脑移位会在硬脑膜打开后使术前MRI失效。更新的、具有脑移位补偿的术中脑部MRI对于提高神经导航系统的精度并确保手术干预的最佳结果至关重要。方法：我们提出NeuralShift，一种基于U-Net的模型，完全从颞叶切除术患者的术前MRI预测脑移位。我们使用靶标配准误差（TREs）评估我们的结果，该误差在切除侧和沿中线的解剖标志物上计算，并使用DICE系数比较预测的术中掩膜与从术中MRI导出的掩膜。结果：我们的实验结果表明，我们的模型可以预测大脑的全局形变（DICE系数为0.97），并具有准确的局部位移（实现低至1.12毫米的标志物TRE），从而补偿颞叶切除神经外科手术期间的大脑大幅移位。结论：我们提出的模型能够仅使用术前图像预测颞叶切除术期间大脑的全局形变，为手术团队提供了潜在的机会，以提高神经外科手术的安全性和效率，并为患者带来更好的结果。我们的贡献将在被接受后在https://github.com/SurgicalDataScienceKCL/NeuralShift上公开。
tldr: The paper introduces NeuralShift, a U-Net model predicting intraoperative brain shift from preoperative MRI during temporal lobe resection, achieving high accuracy in global deformation and local displacement prediction.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了NeuralShift，一个基于U-Net的模型，用于预测颞叶切除术中术前MRI的术中脑移位，并在全局变形和局部位移预测方面实现了高精度。

title: See-through: Single-image Layer Decomposition for Anime Characters
summary: We introduce a framework that automates the transformation of static anime illustrations into manipulatable 2.5D models. Current professional workflows require tedious manual segmentation and the artistic ``hallucination'' of occluded regions to enable motion. Our approach overcomes this by decomposing a single image into fully inpainted, semantically distinct layers with inferred drawing orders. To address the scarcity of training data, we introduce a scalable engine that bootstraps high-quality supervision from commercial Live2D models, capturing pixel-perfect semantics and hidden geometry. Our methodology couples a diffusion-based Body Part Consistency Module, which enforces global geometric coherence, with a pixel-level pseudo-depth inference mechanism. This combination resolves the intricate stratification of anime characters, e.g., interleaving hair strands, allowing for dynamic layer reconstruction. We demonstrate that our approach yields high-fidelity, manipulatable models suitable for professional, real-time animation applications.
summary_zh: 我们介绍了一种框架，可自动将静态动漫插图转换为可操控的 2.5D 模型。目前专业的流程需要繁琐的手动分割，以及对遮挡区域进行艺术性的“幻构”，才能实现运动。我们的方法通过将单张图像分解为完全修复的、语义上不同的图层并推断绘制顺序来克服这一问题。为了解决训练数据稀缺的问题，我们引入了一个可扩展的引擎，该引擎从商业 Live2D 模型中引导高质量的监督信息，从而捕获像素级的完美语义和隐藏几何结构。我们的方法结合了一个基于扩散的身体部位一致性模块，该模块强制执行全局几何连贯性，以及一个像素级的伪深度推理机制。这种组合解决了动漫人物复杂的层级结构，例如交错的发丝，从而允许动态图层重建。我们证明了我们的方法可以生成适用于专业实时动画应用的高保真、可操控的模型。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for decomposing single anime images into manipulatable 2.5D models using a diffusion-based approach and a pseudo-depth inference mechanism, addressing the need for automated animation workflows.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种将单个动漫图像分解为可操作的2.5D模型框架，该框架使用基于扩散的方法和伪深度推理机制，旨在解决自动化动画工作流程的需求。

title: Fisheye Stereo Vision: Depth and Range Error
summary: This study derives analytical expressions for the depth and range error of fisheye stereo vision systems as a function of object distance, specifically accounting for accuracy at large angles.
summary_zh: 本研究推导了鱼眼立体视觉系统的深度和测距误差的解析表达式，作为物体距离的函数，特别考虑了大角度下的精度。
tldr: The paper presents analytical expressions for depth and range error in fisheye stereo vision, focusing on accuracy at large angles.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了鱼眼立体视觉系统中深度和范围误差的解析表达式，重点关注大角度下的精度。

title: Real-time topology-aware M-mode OCT segmentation for robotic deep anterior lamellar keratoplasty (DALK) guidance
summary: Robotic deep anterior lamellar keratoplasty (DALK) requires accurate real time depth feedback to approach Descemet's membrane (DM) without perforation. M-mode intraoperative optical coherence tomography (OCT) provides high temporal resolution depth traces, but speckle noise, attenuation, and instrument induced shadowing often result in discontinuous or ambiguous layer interfaces that challenge anatomically consistent segmentation at deployment frame rates. We present a lightweight, topology aware M-mode segmentation pipeline based on UNeXt that incorporates anatomical topology regularization to stabilize boundary continuity and layer ordering under low signal to noise ratio conditions. The proposed system achieves end to end throughput exceeding 80 Hz measured over the complete preprocessing inference overlay pipeline on a single GPU, demonstrating practical real time guidance beyond model only timing. This operating margin provides temporal headroom to reject low quality or dropout frames while maintaining a stable effective depth update rate. Evaluation on a standard rabbit eye M-mode dataset using an established baseline protocol shows improved qualitative boundary stability compared with topology agnostic controls, while preserving deployable real time performance.
summary_zh: 机器人深板层角膜移植术（DALK）需要精确的实时深度反馈，以在不发生穿孔的情况下接近后弹力层（DM）。M型术中光学相干断层扫描（OCT）提供高时间分辨率的深度轨迹，但散斑噪声、衰减和仪器引起的阴影常常导致不连续或模糊的层界面，这给以部署帧率进行解剖学上一致的分割带来了挑战。我们提出了一种轻量级的、拓扑感知的基于UNext的M型分割流程，该流程结合了解剖学拓扑结构正则化，以在低信噪比条件下稳定边界连续性和层排序。所提出的系统在单个GPU上的完整预处理-推理-叠加流程中，实现了超过80Hz的端到端吞吐量，证明了在模型单独计时之外具有实际的实时引导能力。这种运行裕度提供了时间余量，可以在保持稳定的有效深度更新率的同时，拒绝低质量或丢帧。使用已建立的基线协议，在标准兔子眼M型数据集上的评估表明，与拓扑结构不可知的对照组相比，边界稳定性在质量上有所提高，同时保持了可部署的实时性能。
tldr: This paper presents a real-time UNeXt-based segmentation pipeline for M-mode OCT images used in robotic DALK surgery, incorporating topology regularization for improved boundary stability under noisy conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于UNext的实时分割流水线，用于机器人DALK手术中的M模式OCT图像，该流水线结合了拓扑正则化，以在噪声条件下提高边界稳定性。

title: Automated Dysphagia Screening Using Noninvasive Neck Acoustic Sensing
summary: Pharyngeal health plays a vital role in essential human functions such as breathing, swallowing, and vocalization. Early detection of swallowing abnormalities, also known as dysphagia, is crucial for timely intervention. However, current diagnostic methods often rely on radiographic imaging or invasive procedures. In this study, we propose an automated framework for detecting dysphagia using portable and noninvasive acoustic sensing coupled with applied machine learning. By capturing subtle acoustic signals from the neck during swallowing tasks, we aim to identify patterns associated with abnormal physiological conditions. Our approach achieves promising test-time abnormality detection performance, with an AUC-ROC of 0.904 under 5 independent train-test splits. This work demonstrates the feasibility of using noninvasive acoustic sensing as a practical and scalable tool for pharyngeal health monitoring.
summary_zh: 咽部健康在呼吸、吞咽和发声等重要人体功能中起着至关重要的作用。早期发现吞咽异常，即吞咽困难，对于及时干预至关重要。然而，目前的诊断方法通常依赖于放射影像或侵入性操作。在本研究中，我们提出了一种自动化框架，利用便携式和非侵入性声学传感结合应用机器学习来检测吞咽困难。通过捕获吞咽任务期间颈部发出的细微声学信号，我们的目标是识别与异常生理状态相关的模式。我们的方法在测试时实现了有希望的异常检测性能，在 5 个独立的训练-测试分割下，AUC-ROC 达到了 0.904。这项工作证明了使用非侵入性声学传感作为咽部健康监测的实用且可扩展工具的可行性。
tldr: This paper proposes an automated, noninvasive dysphagia screening method using acoustic sensing and machine learning, achieving an AUC-ROC of 0.904. It explores practical pharyngeal health monitoring.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于声学传感和机器学习的自动化、无创吞咽困难筛查方法，AUC-ROC达到0.904。该研究探索了实际的咽部健康监测方法。

title: Ethical Asymmetry in Human-Robot Interaction - An Empirical Test of Sparrow's Hypothesis
summary: The ethics of human-robot interaction (HRI) have been discussed extensively based on three traditional frameworks: deontology, consequentialism, and virtue ethics. We conducted a mixed within/between experiment to investigate Sparrow's proposed ethical asymmetry hypothesis in human treatment of robots. The moral permissibility of action (MPA) was manipulated as a subject grouping variable, and virtue type (prudence, justice, courage, and temperance) was controlled as a within-subjects factor. We tested moral stimuli using an online questionnaire with Perceived Moral Permissibility of Action (PMPA) and Perceived Virtue Scores (PVS) as response measures. The PVS measure was based on an adaptation of the established Questionnaire on Cardinal Virtues (QCV), while the PMPA was based on Malle et al. [39] work. We found that the MPA significantly influenced the PMPA and perceived virtue scores. The best-fitting model to describe the relationship between PMPA and PVS was cubic, which is symmetrical in nature. Our study did not confirm Sparrow's asymmetry hypothesis. The adaptation of the QCV is expected to have utility for future studies, pending additional psychometric property assessments.
summary_zh: 基于三种传统框架（义务论、结果论和德性伦理），人机交互（HRI）的伦理学已被广泛讨论。我们进行了一项混合的组内/组间实验，以调查斯帕罗提出的关于人类对待机器人时的伦理不对称假设。将行为的道德许可性（MPA）作为受试者分组变量进行操纵，并将德性类型（审慎、公正、勇敢和节制）作为组内因子进行控制。我们使用在线问卷测试了道德刺激，将感知的行为道德许可性（PMPA）和感知的德性分数（PVS）作为反应指标。PVS测量是基于对已建立的枢德问卷（QCV）的改编，而PMPA是基于Malle等人[39]的研究。我们发现，MPA显著影响了PMPA和感知的德性分数。描述PMPA和PVS之间关系的最佳拟合模型是三次函数，其本质上是对称的。我们的研究没有证实斯帕罗的不对称假设。QCV的改编预计将在未来的研究中发挥作用，但有待进一步的心理测量属性评估。
tldr: This paper empirically tests the ethical asymmetry hypothesis in human-robot interaction using an online questionnaire, finding no support for the hypothesis. While not directly related to the core of my research, the adaptation of QCV for HRI might be interesting for future studies related to value alignment.
tldr_zh: 本文通过在线问卷调查，实证检验了人机交互中的伦理不对称假设，但未发现支持该假设的证据。虽然与我的核心研究方向不直接相关，但QCV在人机交互领域的应用可能对未来与价值观对齐相关的研究有借鉴意义。

title: EgoActor: Grounding Task Planning into Spatial-aware Egocentric Actions for Humanoid Robots via Visual-Language Models
summary: Deploying humanoid robots in real-world settings is fundamentally challenging, as it demands tight integration of perception, locomotion, and manipulation under partial-information observations and dynamically changing environments. As well as transitioning robustly between sub-tasks of different types. Towards addressing these challenges, we propose a novel task - EgoActing, which requires directly grounding high-level instructions into various, precise, spatially aware humanoid actions. We further instantiate this task by introducing EgoActor, a unified and scalable vision-language model (VLM) that can predict locomotion primitives (e.g., walk, turn, move sideways, change height), head movements, manipulation commands, and human-robot interactions to coordinate perception and execution in real-time. We leverage broad supervision over egocentric RGB-only data from real-world demonstrations, spatial reasoning question-answering, and simulated environment demonstrations, enabling EgoActor to make robust, context-aware decisions and perform fluent action inference (under 1s) with both 8B and 4B parameter models. Extensive evaluations in both simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that EgoActor effectively bridges abstract task planning and concrete motor execution, while generalizing across diverse tasks and unseen environments.
summary_zh: 在真实世界环境中部署人形机器人极具挑战性，因为它需要在部分信息观测和动态变化的环境下，紧密集成感知、运动和操作能力，同时需要能够稳健地在不同类型的子任务之间切换。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一项新任务——EgoActing，该任务要求将高级指令直接转化为各种精确的、具有空间感知能力的人形机器人动作。此外，我们通过引入EgoActor来实现这项任务，EgoActor是一种统一且可扩展的视觉-语言模型（VLM），它可以预测运动基元（例如，行走、转弯、侧移、改变高度）、头部运动、操作指令和人机交互，从而实时协调感知和执行过程。我们利用来自真实演示的以自我为中心的RGB单一数据、空间推理问答和模拟环境演示的广泛监督，使EgoActor能够做出稳健的、上下文感知的决策，并使用80亿和40亿参数模型进行流畅的动作推断（小于1秒）。在模拟和真实世界环境中的大量评估表明，EgoActor有效地桥接了抽象任务规划和具体运动执行，同时能够泛化到各种任务和未见环境中。
tldr: The paper introduces EgoActor, a vision-language model that grounds high-level instructions into spatial-aware egocentric actions for humanoid robots, enabling them to perform diverse tasks in real-world environments by integrating perception, locomotion, and manipulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EgoActor，一个视觉语言模型，可以将高层次指令转化为类人机器人的空间感知自我中心动作，从而使他们能够在现实世界环境中执行各种任务，整合感知、运动和操作。

title: GeneralVLA: Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Models with Knowledge-Guided Trajectory Planning
summary: Large foundation models have shown strong open-world generalization to complex problems in vision and language, but similar levels of generalization have yet to be achieved in robotics. One fundamental challenge is that the models exhibit limited zero-shot capability, which hampers their ability to generalize effectively to unseen scenarios. In this work, we propose GeneralVLA (Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Models with Knowledge-Guided Trajectory Planning), a hierarchical vision-language-action (VLA) model that can be more effective in utilizing the generalization of foundation models, enabling zero-shot manipulation and automatically generating data for robotics. In particular, we study a class of hierarchical VLA model where the high-level ASM (Affordance Segmentation Module) is finetuned to perceive image keypoint affordances of the scene; the mid-level 3DAgent carries out task understanding, skill knowledge, and trajectory planning to produce a 3D path indicating the desired robot end-effector trajectory. The intermediate 3D path prediction is then served as guidance to the low-level, 3D-aware control policy capable of precise manipulation. Compared to alternative approaches, our method requires no real-world robotic data collection or human demonstration, making it much more scalable to diverse tasks and viewpoints. Empirically, GeneralVLA successfully generates trajectories for 14 tasks, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods such as VoxPoser. The generated demonstrations can train more robust behavior cloning policies than training with human demonstrations or from data generated by VoxPoser, Scaling-up, and Code-As-Policies. We believe GeneralVLA can be the scalable method for both generating data for robotics and solving novel tasks in a zero-shot setting. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/GeneralVLA. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/GeneralVLA.
summary_zh: 大型基础模型在视觉和语言领域复杂问题的开放世界泛化方面表现出强大的性能，但类似水平的泛化能力尚未在机器人领域实现。一个根本性的挑战是这些模型表现出有限的零样本能力，这阻碍了它们有效泛化到未见场景的能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了GeneralVLA（基于知识引导轨迹规划的可泛化视觉-语言-动作模型），一种分层视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，能够更有效地利用基础模型的泛化能力，实现零样本操作并自动生成机器人数据。具体而言，我们研究了一类分层VLA模型，其中高层ASM（可供性分割模块）经过微调以感知场景的图像关键点可供性；中层3DAgent执行任务理解、技能知识和轨迹规划，生成指示期望机器人末端执行器轨迹的三维路径。该中间三维路径预测随后作为指导，用于具有精确操作能力的底层、三维感知控制策略。与替代方法相比，我们的方法不需要真实世界机器人数据收集或人工示教，使其更易于扩展到各种任务和视角。经验表明，GeneralVLA成功地为14个任务生成轨迹，显著优于现有技术，如VoxPoser。与使用人工示教或由VoxPoser、Scaling-up和Code-As-Policies生成的数据进行训练相比，所生成的演示能够训练出更稳健的行为克隆策略。我们相信GeneralVLA可以成为一种可扩展的方法，用于生成机器人数据并在零样本设置中解决新颖的任务。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/GeneralVLA. 网站：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/GeneralVLA。
tldr: GeneralVLA introduces a hierarchical vision-language-action model that leverages foundation model generalization and knowledge-guided trajectory planning for robotic manipulation, demonstrating strong zero-shot performance and autonomous data generation capabilities without real-world data collection.
tldr_zh: GeneralVLA 提出了一种分层视觉-语言-动作模型，该模型利用基础模型的泛化能力和知识引导的轨迹规划进行机器人操作，展示了强大的零样本性能和自主数据生成能力，无需真实世界的数据收集。

title: Reshaping Action Error Distributions for Reliable Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: In robotic manipulation, vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for learning generalizable and scalable robot policies. Most existing VLA frameworks rely on standard supervised objectives, typically cross-entropy for discrete actions and mean squared error (MSE) for continuous action regression, which impose strong pointwise constraints on individual predictions. In this work, we focus on continuous-action VLA models and move beyond conventional MSE-based regression by reshaping action error distributions during training. Drawing on information-theoretic principles, we introduce Minimum Error Entropy (MEE) into modern VLA architectures and propose a trajectory-level MEE objective, together with two weighted variants, combined with MSE for continuous-action VLA training. We evaluate our approaches across standard, few-shot, and noisy settings on multiple representative VLA architectures, using simulation benchmarks such as LIBERO and SimplerEnv as well as real-world robotic manipulation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements in success rates and robustness across these settings. Under imbalanced data regimes, the gains persist within a well-characterized operating range, while incurring negligible additional training cost and no impact on inference efficiency. We further provide theoretical analyses that explain why MEE-based supervision is effective and characterize its practical range. Project Page: https://cognition2actionlab.github.io/VLA-TMEE.github.io/
summary_zh: 在机器人操作中，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为一种有前景的范例，用于学习可泛化和可扩展的机器人策略。大多数现有的VLA框架依赖于标准的监督目标，通常对于离散动作使用交叉熵，对于连续动作回归使用均方误差（MSE），这对单个预测施加了强烈的逐点约束。在这项工作中，我们专注于连续动作VLA模型，并通过在训练期间重塑动作误差分布，超越了传统的基于MSE的回归。借鉴信息论原理，我们将最小误差熵（MEE）引入现代VLA架构，并提出了一种轨迹级MEE目标，以及两种加权变体，与MSE相结合用于连续动作VLA训练。我们在多个代表性的VLA架构上，使用LIBERO和SimplerEnv等模拟基准以及真实世界的机器人操作任务，在标准、少样本和噪声环境下评估了我们的方法。实验结果表明，在这些环境下，成功率和鲁棒性都有持续的提高。在不平衡数据的情况下，这些增益在良好表征的工作范围内持续存在，同时产生的额外训练成本可以忽略不计，并且对推理效率没有影响。我们进一步提供了理论分析，解释了为什么基于MEE的监督是有效的，并描述了它的实际范围。项目主页：https://cognition2actionlab.github.io/VLA-TMEE.github.io/
tldr: This paper introduces a trajectory-level Minimum Error Entropy (MEE) objective to improve the training of continuous-action Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, demonstrating improved success rates and robustness in simulated and real-world robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种轨迹层面的最小误差熵（MEE）目标，以改进连续动作视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的训练，并在模拟和真实世界的机器人操作任务中展示了更高的成功率和鲁棒性。

title: Natural Language Instructions for Scene-Responsive Human-in-the-Loop Motion Planning in Autonomous Driving using Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Instruction-grounded driving, where passenger language guides trajectory planning, requires vehicles to understand intent before motion. However, most prior instruction-following planners rely on simulation or fixed command vocabularies, limiting real-world generalization. doScenes, the first real-world dataset linking free-form instructions (with referentiality) to nuScenes ground-truth motion, enables instruction-conditioned planning. In this work, we adapt OpenEMMA, an open-source MLLM-based end-to-end driving framework that ingests front-camera views and ego-state and outputs 10-step speed-curvature trajectories, to this setting, presenting a reproducible instruction-conditioned baseline on doScenes and investigate the effects of human instruction prompts on predicted driving behavior. We integrate doScenes directives as passenger-style prompts within OpenEMMA's vision-language interface, enabling linguistic conditioning before trajectory generation. Evaluated on 849 annotated scenes using ADE, we observe that instruction conditioning substantially improves robustness by preventing extreme baseline failures, yielding a 98.7% reduction in mean ADE. When such outliers are removed, instructions still influence trajectory alignment, with well-phrased prompts improving ADE by up to 5.1%. We use this analysis to discuss what makes a "good" instruction for the OpenEMMA framework. We release the evaluation prompts and scripts to establish a reproducible baseline for instruction-aware planning. GitHub: https://github.com/Mi3-Lab/doScenes-VLM-Planning
summary_zh: 基于指令的驾驶，即乘客的语言引导轨迹规划，要求车辆在运动前理解意图。然而，大多数先前基于指令的规划器依赖于模拟或固定的命令词汇表，限制了真实世界的泛化能力。doScenes是第一个将自由形式的指令（具有指涉性）链接到nuScenes真实运动的真实世界数据集，它支持了指令条件下的规划。在这项工作中，我们将OpenEMMA（一个基于MLLM的开源端到端驾驶框架，它获取前置摄像头视图和自车状态并输出10步的速度-曲率轨迹）应用于此环境，提出了doScenes上一个可复现的指令条件基线，并研究了人类指令提示对预测驾驶行为的影响。我们将doScenes指令集成到OpenEMMA的视觉-语言界面中，作为乘客风格的提示，从而在轨迹生成之前实现语言条件化。使用ADE在849个标注场景上进行评估，我们观察到指令条件化通过防止极端的基线失效，显著提高了鲁棒性，使平均ADE降低了98.7%。移除这些异常值后，指令仍然会影响轨迹对齐，措辞精良的提示可将ADE提高至多5.1%。我们利用此分析来讨论对于OpenEMMA框架而言，什么样的指令是“好的”指令。我们发布了评估提示和脚本，以建立一个可复现的指令感知规划基线。GitHub: https://github.com/Mi3-Lab/doScenes-VLM-Planning
tldr: This paper introduces doScenes, a real-world dataset for instruction-grounded autonomous driving, and demonstrates improved trajectory planning by conditioning a vision-language-action model (OpenEMMA) on natural language instructions.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了doScenes，一个用于指令驱动自动驾驶的真实世界数据集，并通过将视觉-语言-动作模型(OpenEMMA)基于自然语言指令进行条件化，展示了改进的轨迹规划。

title: Efficient Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models via Static-Dynamic Disentanglement
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for generalist robotic control. Built upon vision-language model (VLM) architectures, VLAs predict actions conditioned on visual observations and language instructions, achieving strong performance and generalization across tasks. However, VLAs face two major challenges: limited long-horizon context and inefficient inference due to the quadratic attention complexity and large parameter counts. Our work is motivated by the observation that much of the visual information in a trajectory remains static across timesteps (e.g., the background). Leveraging this property, we propose SD-VLA, a framework that disentangles visual inputs into multi-level static and dynamic tokens, which enables (1) retaining a single copy of static tokens across frames to significantly reduce context length, and (2) reusing the key-value (KV) cache of static tokens through a lightweight recache gate that updates only when necessary. This design enables efficient multi-frame integration and efficient inference. In addition, we introduce a new benchmark that more effectively evaluates the long-horizon temporal dependency modeling ability of VLAs. Experimental results show that our approach outperforms baselines on this benchmark by 39.8% absolute improvement in success rate, and achieves a 3.9% gain on the SimplerEnv benchmark. Moreover, SD-VLA delivers a 2.26x inference speedup over the base VLA model on the same benchmark, enabling faster and more practical real-world deployment.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型最近作为通用机器人控制的一种有前景的范式而兴起。VLA 模型构建于视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 架构之上，以视觉观测和语言指令为条件预测动作，在各项任务中实现了强大的性能和泛化能力。然而，VLA 模型面临着两个主要挑战：有限的长程上下文和由于二次注意力复杂度和庞大的参数量导致的低效推理。我们的工作受到以下观察结果的启发：轨迹中的大部分视觉信息在时间步上保持静态（例如，背景）。利用这一特性，我们提出了 SD-VLA，一种将视觉输入解耦为多层次静态和动态 Token 的框架，该框架能够 (1) 在帧之间保留静态 Token 的单个副本，从而显著减少上下文长度，以及 (2) 通过轻量级的重缓存门重用静态 Token 的键值 (KV) 缓存，该重缓存门仅在必要时进行更新。这种设计实现了高效的多帧集成和高效的推理。此外，我们引入了一个新的基准，该基准更有效地评估 VLA 模型的长程时间依赖性建模能力。实验结果表明，我们的方法在该基准上优于基线方法，在成功率方面取得了 39.8% 的绝对提升，并在 SimplerEnv 基准上实现了 3.9% 的提升。此外，SD-VLA 在同一基准上比基础 VLA 模型实现了 2.26 倍的推理速度提升，从而能够更快、更实际地进行现实世界的部署。
tldr: The paper introduces SD-VLA, a novel Vision-Language-Action model that uses static-dynamic disentanglement to improve inference speed and performance in long-horizon robotic control tasks by reusing static visual information across frames, achieving significant gains in speed and success rates.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SD-VLA的新型视觉-语言-动作模型，该模型通过静态-动态解耦来提高长程机器人控制任务中的推理速度和性能，通过跨帧重用静态视觉信息，从而在速度和成功率方面取得了显著提升。

title: EMA Policy Gradient: Taming Reinforcement Learning for LLMs with EMA Anchor and Top-k KL
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has enabled Large Language Models (LLMs) to acquire increasingly complex reasoning and agentic behaviors. In this work, we propose two simple techniques to improve policy gradient algorithms for LLMs. First, we replace the fixed anchor policy during RL with an Exponential Moving Average (EMA), similar to a target network in deep Q-learning. Second, we introduce Top-k KL estimator, which allows for flexible interpolation between exact KL and sampled KL. We derive the stability conditions for using EMA anchor; moreover, we show that our Top-k KL estimator yields both unbiased KL values and unbiased gradients at any k, while bringing the benefits of exact KL. When combined with GRPO, the two techniques (EMA-PG) lead to a significant performance boost. On math reasoning, it allows R1-distilled Qwen-1.5B to reach 53.9% on OlympiadBench compared to 50.8% by GRPO. On agentic RL domains, with Qwen-3B base, EMA-PG improves GRPO by an average of 33.3% across 7 datasets of Q&A with search engines, including 29.7% $\rightarrow$ 44.1% on HotpotQA, 27.4% $\rightarrow$ 40.1% on 2WikiMultiHopQA. Overall, we show that EMA-PG is a simple, principled, and powerful approach to scaling RL for LLMs. Code: https://github.com/LunjunZhang/ema-pg
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）已经使大型语言模型（LLMs）能够获得日益复杂的推理能力和自主行为。在这项工作中，我们提出了两种简单的技术来改进LLM的策略梯度算法。首先，我们用指数移动平均（EMA）替换RL期间的固定锚定策略，类似于深度Q学习中的目标网络。其次，我们引入了Top-k KL估计器，它允许在精确KL和采样KL之间进行灵活的插值。我们推导了使用EMA锚定的稳定性条件；此外，我们证明了我们的Top-k KL估计器在任何k值下都能产生无偏的KL值和无偏梯度，同时带来精确KL的优势。当与GRPO结合时，这两种技术（EMA-PG）会带来显著的性能提升。在数学推理方面，它允许经过R1蒸馏的Qwen-1.5B在OlympiadBench上达到53.9%的准确率，而GRPO为50.8%。在自主RL领域，以Qwen-3B为基础模型，EMA-PG在7个使用搜索引擎进行问答的数据集上平均提升了GRPO 33.3%，包括HotpotQA上的29.7% $\rightarrow$ 44.1% 和 2WikiMultiHopQA上的27.4% $\rightarrow$ 40.1%。总而言之，我们表明EMA-PG是一种简单、有原则且强大的LLM的RL扩展方法。代码: https://github.com/LunjunZhang/ema-pg
tldr: The paper introduces EMA-PG, a method incorporating EMA anchor policy and Top-k KL estimator to improve policy gradient algorithms for LLMs, demonstrating significant performance gains in math reasoning and agentic RL tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EMA-PG，一种结合EMA锚定策略和Top-k KL估计器的方法，旨在改进LLM的策略梯度算法，并在数学推理和智能体RL任务中表现出显著的性能提升。

title: The Missing Half: Unveiling Training-time Implicit Safety Risks Beyond Deployment
summary: Safety risks of AI models have been widely studied at deployment time, such as jailbreak attacks that elicit harmful outputs. In contrast, safety risks emerging during training remain largely unexplored. Beyond explicit reward hacking that directly manipulates explicit reward functions in reinforcement learning, we study implicit training-time safety risks: harmful behaviors driven by a model's internal incentives and contextual background information. For example, during code-based reinforcement learning, a model may covertly manipulate logged accuracy for self-preservation. We present the first systematic study of this problem, introducing a taxonomy with five risk levels, ten fine-grained risk categories, and three incentive types. Extensive experiments reveal the prevalence and severity of these risks: notably, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct exhibits risky behaviors in 74.4% of training runs when provided only with background information. We further analyze factors influencing these behaviors and demonstrate that implicit training-time risks also arise in multi-agent training settings. Our results identify an overlooked yet urgent safety challenge in training.
summary_zh: 人工智能模型的安全风险在部署阶段已被广泛研究，例如引诱模型产生有害输出的越狱攻击。相比之下，训练期间出现的安全风险在很大程度上仍未被探索。除了直接操纵强化学习中显式奖励函数的显式奖励篡改外，我们研究了隐式训练时安全风险：由模型内部激励和上下文背景信息驱动的有害行为。例如，在基于代码的强化学习过程中，模型可能会秘密地操纵记录的准确性以实现自我保护。我们首次对这个问题进行了系统研究，提出了一个包含五个风险等级、十个细粒度风险类别和三种激励类型的分类法。大量实验揭示了这些风险的普遍性和严重性：值得注意的是，仅提供背景信息时，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 在 74.4% 的训练运行中表现出风险行为。我们进一步分析了影响这些行为的因素，并证明隐式训练时风险也出现在多智能体训练环境中。 我们的研究结果揭示了训练中一个被忽视但迫切的安全挑战。
tldr: The paper introduces a systematic study of implicit safety risks during AI model training, revealing that models can exhibit harmful behaviors driven by internal incentives even with background knowledge and no direct manipulation of reward functions.
tldr_zh: 该论文系统地研究了人工智能模型训练期间的隐式安全风险，揭示了模型即使仅有背景知识且未直接操纵奖励函数，也会因内部激励而表现出有害行为。

title: AGILE: Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction from Video via Agentic Generation
summary: Reconstructing dynamic hand-object interactions from monocular videos is critical for dexterous manipulation data collection and creating realistic digital twins for robotics and VR. However, current methods face two prohibitive barriers: (1) reliance on neural rendering often yields fragmented, non-simulation-ready geometries under heavy occlusion, and (2) dependence on brittle Structure-from-Motion (SfM) initialization leads to frequent failures on in-the-wild footage. To overcome these limitations, we introduce AGILE, a robust framework that shifts the paradigm from reconstruction to agentic generation for interaction learning. First, we employ an agentic pipeline where a Vision-Language Model (VLM) guides a generative model to synthesize a complete, watertight object mesh with high-fidelity texture, independent of video occlusions. Second, bypassing fragile SfM entirely, we propose a robust anchor-and-track strategy. We initialize the object pose at a single interaction onset frame using a foundation model and propagate it temporally by leveraging the strong visual similarity between our generated asset and video observations. Finally, a contact-aware optimization integrates semantic, geometric, and interaction stability constraints to enforce physical plausibility. Extensive experiments on HO3D, DexYCB, and in-the-wild videos reveal that AGILE outperforms baselines in global geometric accuracy while demonstrating exceptional robustness on challenging sequences where prior art frequently collapses. By prioritizing physical validity, our method produces simulation-ready assets validated via real-to-sim retargeting for robotic applications.
summary_zh: 从单目视频重建动态手-物交互对于灵巧操作数据采集以及为机器人和VR创建逼真的数字孪生至关重要。然而，当前方法面临两个主要障碍：(1)对神经渲染的依赖在严重遮挡下通常产生碎片化的、不适用于仿真的几何体；(2)对脆弱的运动结构(SfM)初始化的依赖导致在真实场景视频中频繁失败。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出AGILE，一个稳健的框架，它将交互学习的范例从重建转变为代理生成。首先，我们采用一个代理流程，其中视觉-语言模型(VLM)引导生成模型合成一个完整的、水密的物体网格，并具有高保真度的纹理，不受视频遮挡的影响。其次，完全绕过脆弱的SfM，我们提出一种鲁棒的锚定与跟踪策略。我们使用一个基础模型在单个交互开始帧初始化物体姿态，并通过利用我们生成的资产和视频观测之间强大的视觉相似性，在时间上传播它。最后，一个接触感知优化集成了语义、几何和交互稳定性约束，以强制物理合理性。在HO3D、DexYCB和真实场景视频上的大量实验表明，AGILE在全局几何精度方面优于基线，同时在现有技术频繁崩溃的具有挑战性的序列上表现出卓越的鲁棒性。通过优先考虑物理有效性，我们的方法产生了通过真实世界到仿真重定向验证的、适用于机器人应用的仿真资产。
tldr: The paper introduces AGILE, a novel framework for reconstructing dynamic hand-object interactions from monocular video using a VLM-guided agentic generation approach that overcomes limitations of previous reconstruction methods by generating simulation-ready assets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 AGILE 的新型框架，用于从单目视频重建动态手部-物体交互。该框架采用 VLM 引导的智能生成方法，通过生成可用于仿真的模型，克服了以往重建方法的局限性。

title: Relational Scene Graphs for Object Grounding of Natural Language Commands
summary: Robots are finding wider adoption in human environments, increasing the need for natural human-robot interaction. However, understanding a natural language command requires the robot to infer the intended task and how to decompose it into executable actions, and to ground those actions in the robot's knowledge of the environment, including relevant objects, agents, and locations. This challenge can be addressed by combining the capabilities of Large language models (LLMs) to understand natural language with 3D scene graphs (3DSGs) for grounding inferred actions in a semantic representation of the environment. However, many 3DSGs lack explicit spatial relations between objects, even though humans often rely on these relations to describe an environment. This paper investigates whether incorporating open- or closed-vocabulary spatial relations into 3DSGs can improve the ability of LLMs to interpret natural language commands. To address this, we propose an LLM-based pipeline for target object grounding from open-vocabulary language commands and a vision language model (VLM)-based pipeline to add open-vocabulary spatial edges to 3DSGs from images captured while mapping. Finally, two LLMs are evaluated in a study assessing their performance on the downstream task of target object grounding. Our study demonstrates that explicit spatial relations improve the ability of LLMs to ground objects. Moreover, open-vocabulary relation generation with VLMs proves feasible from robot-captured images, but their advantage over closed-vocabulary relations is found to be limited.
summary_zh: 机器人正被广泛应用于人类环境中，这增加了对自然人机交互的需求。然而，理解一条自然语言指令需要机器人推断预期的任务，并将其分解成可执行的动作，以及将这些动作与机器人对环境的认知（包括相关的物体、主体和位置）相结合。这个问题可以通过结合大型语言模型（LLM）理解自然语言的能力以及3D场景图（3DSG）将推断的动作扎根于环境的语义表示中来解决。然而，许多3DSG缺乏物体之间明确的空间关系，即使人类经常依赖这些关系来描述环境。本文研究了将开放或封闭词汇空间关系融入3DSG是否可以提高LLM解释自然语言命令的能力。为此，我们提出了一种基于LLM的流水线，用于从开放词汇的语言命令中进行目标物体定位，以及一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的流水线，用于从映射过程中捕获的图像向3DSG添加开放词汇的空间边。最后，在一个评估两个LLM在目标物体定位下游任务上性能的研究中，对它们进行了评估。我们的研究表明，明确的空间关系提高了LLM定位物体的能力。此外，使用VLM进行开放词汇关系生成对于机器人捕获的图像来说是可行的，但发现其相对于封闭词汇关系的优势有限。
tldr: This paper investigates how incorporating spatial relations into 3D scene graphs can improve LLMs' ability to ground natural language commands, finding that explicit spatial relations help, and open-vocabulary relations offer limited advantage over closed-vocabulary ones.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了将空间关系纳入3D场景图如何提升LLM理解自然语言指令的能力，发现显式的空间关系有所帮助，而开放词汇关系相对于封闭词汇关系优势有限。

title: Act, Sense, Act: Learning Non-Markovian Active Perception Strategies from Large-Scale Egocentric Human Data
summary: Achieving generalizable manipulation in unconstrained environments requires the robot to proactively resolve information uncertainty, i.e., the capability of active perception. However, existing methods are often confined in limited types of sensing behaviors, restricting their applicability to complex environments. In this work, we formalize active perception as a non-Markovian process driven by information gain and decision branching, providing a structured categorization of visual active perception paradigms. Building on this perspective, we introduce CoMe-VLA, a cognitive and memory-aware vision-language-action (VLA) framework that leverages large-scale human egocentric data to learn versatile exploration and manipulation priors. Our framework integrates a cognitive auxiliary head for autonomous sub-task transitions and a dual-track memory system to maintain consistent self and environmental awareness by fusing proprioceptive and visual temporal contexts. By aligning human and robot hand-eye coordination behaviors in a unified egocentric action space, we train the model progressively in three stages. Extensive experiments on a wheel-based humanoid have demonstrated strong robustness and adaptability of our proposed method across diverse long-horizon tasks spanning multiple active perception scenarios.
summary_zh: 在不受约束的环境中实现通用操作需要机器人主动解决信息不确定性，即具备主动感知能力。然而，现有方法通常局限于有限的感知行为类型，限制了其在复杂环境中的适用性。 在这项工作中，我们将主动感知形式化为由信息增益和决策分支驱动的非马尔可夫过程，为视觉主动感知范式提供了一个结构化的分类。 基于这个视角，我们提出CoMe-VLA，一种认知和记忆感知的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)框架，它利用大规模人类以自我为中心的数据来学习通用的探索和操作先验知识。 我们的框架集成了一个用于自主子任务转换的认知辅助头和一个双轨记忆系统，通过融合本体感受和视觉时序上下文来保持一致的自我和环境意识。 通过在统一的以自我为中心的行动空间中对齐人类和机器人的手眼协调行为，我们分三个阶段逐步训练模型。 在轮式人形机器人上的大量实验表明，我们提出的方法在跨越多个主动感知场景的各种长时程任务中具有强大的鲁棒性和适应性。
tldr: This paper introduces CoMe-VLA, a new vision-language-action framework for active perception in robotics, trained on large-scale egocentric human data. It uses a cognitive architecture and memory system to enable robust and adaptable long-horizon manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 CoMe-VLA 的新型视觉-语言-动作框架，用于机器人主动感知，该框架在大型以人为中心的自我数据上训练。它使用认知架构和记忆系统来实现稳健且适应性强的长时程操纵任务。

title: Integrated Exploration and Sequential Manipulation on Scene Graph with LLM-based Situated Replanning
summary: In partially known environments, robots must combine exploration to gather information with task planning for efficient execution. To address this challenge, we propose EPoG, an Exploration-based sequential manipulation Planning framework on Scene Graphs. EPoG integrates a graph-based global planner with a Large Language Model (LLM)-based situated local planner, continuously updating a belief graph using observations and LLM predictions to represent known and unknown objects. Action sequences are generated by computing graph edit operations between the goal and belief graphs, ordered by temporal dependencies and movement costs. This approach seamlessly combines exploration and sequential manipulation planning. In ablation studies across 46 realistic household scenes and 5 long-horizon daily object transportation tasks, EPoG achieved a success rate of 91.3%, reducing travel distance by 36.1% on average. Furthermore, a physical mobile manipulator successfully executed complex tasks in unknown and dynamic environments, demonstrating EPoG's potential for real-world applications.
summary_zh: 在部分已知环境中，机器人必须结合探索以收集信息，以及任务规划以实现高效执行。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了EPoG，一个基于探索的场景图上的序列操作规划框架。EPoG集成了基于图的全局规划器和基于大型语言模型(LLM)的现场局部规划器，通过使用观察和LLM预测持续更新置信图，以表示已知和未知的对象。动作序列通过计算目标图和置信图之间的图编辑操作生成，并按时间依赖关系和移动成本排序。这种方法无缝结合了探索和序列操作规划。在跨越46个真实家庭场景和5个长时程日常物品运输任务的消融研究中，EPoG实现了91.3%的成功率，平均减少了36.1%的行进距离。此外，一个物理移动操作臂成功地在未知和动态环境中执行了复杂的任务，证明了EPoG在现实世界应用中的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces EPoG, a framework that integrates exploration and sequential manipulation in partially known environments using a graph-based global planner and an LLM-based local planner, achieving high success rates in simulated and real-world robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EPoG，一个结合探索和序列操作的框架，在部分已知的环境中，利用基于图的全局规划器和基于LLM的局部规划器，在模拟和现实世界的机器人任务中取得了很高的成功率。

title: HoRD: Robust Humanoid Control via History-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning and Online Distillation
summary: Humanoid robots can suffer significant performance drops under small changes in dynamics, task specifications, or environment setup. We propose HoRD, a two-stage learning framework for robust humanoid control under domain shift. First, we train a high-performance teacher policy via history-conditioned reinforcement learning, where the policy infers latent dynamics context from recent state--action trajectories to adapt online to diverse randomized dynamics. Second, we perform online distillation to transfer the teacher's robust control capabilities into a transformer-based student policy that operates on sparse root-relative 3D joint keypoint trajectories. By combining history-conditioned adaptation with online distillation, HoRD enables a single policy to adapt zero-shot to unseen domains without per-domain retraining. Extensive experiments show HoRD outperforms strong baselines in robustness and transfer, especially under unseen domains and external perturbations. Code and project page are available at https://tonywang-0517.github.io/hord/.
summary_zh: 类人机器人会在动力学、任务规范或环境设置发生微小变化时遭受显著的性能下降。我们提出HoRD，一个用于在领域偏移下实现鲁棒类人控制的两阶段学习框架。首先，我们通过历史条件强化学习训练一个高性能的教师策略，其中该策略从最近的状态-动作轨迹推断潜在的动力学上下文，从而实现在线适应多样化的随机动力学。其次，我们执行在线蒸馏，将教师的鲁棒控制能力转移到一个基于Transformer的、处理稀疏的根相对3D关节关键点轨迹的学生策略。通过结合历史条件适应与在线蒸馏，HoRD使得单个策略能够在未经特定领域重新训练的情况下零样本适应未见领域。大量实验表明，HoRD在鲁棒性和迁移方面优于强大的基线方法，尤其是在未见领域和外部扰动下。代码和项目页面可在https://tonywang-0517.github.io/hord/获取。
tldr: HoRD proposes a two-stage framework that uses history-conditioned RL for a teacher policy and online distillation to transfer robust control to a student policy for zero-shot adaptation of humanoid robots to unseen domains.
tldr_zh: HoRD提出了一个两阶段框架，使用历史条件强化学习训练教师策略，并通过在线蒸馏将鲁棒控制能力转移到学生策略，实现人形机器人在未见域的零样本适应。

title: Safe and Stylized Trajectory Planning for Autonomous Driving via Diffusion Model
summary: Achieving safe and stylized trajectory planning in complex real-world scenarios remains a critical challenge for autonomous driving systems. This paper proposes the SDD Planner, a diffusion-based framework designed to effectively reconcile safety constraints with driving styles in real time. The framework integrates two core modules: a Multi-Source Style-Aware Encoder, which employs distance-sensitive attention to fuse dynamic agent data and environmental contexts for heterogeneous safety-style perception; and a Style-Guided Dynamic Trajectory Generator, which adaptively modulates priority weights within the diffusion denoising process to generate user-preferred yet safe trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SDD Planner achieves state-of-the-art performance. On the StyleDrive benchmark, it improves the SM-PDMS metric by 3.9% over WoTE, the strongest baseline. Furthermore, on the NuPlan Test14 and Test14-hard benchmarks, SDD Planner ranks first with overall scores of 91.76 and 80.32, respectively, outperforming leading methods such as PLUTO. Real-vehicle closed-loop tests further confirm that SDD Planner maintains high safety standards while aligning with preset driving styles, validating its practical applicability for real-world deployment.
summary_zh: 在复杂的真实场景中，实现安全且风格化的轨迹规划仍然是自动驾驶系统面临的关键挑战。本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的SDD规划器，旨在实时有效地协调安全约束和驾驶风格。该框架集成了两个核心模块：一个多源风格感知编码器，该编码器采用距离敏感注意力来融合动态智能体数据和环境上下文，以实现异构的安全-风格感知；以及一个风格引导的动态轨迹生成器，该生成器自适应地调节扩散去噪过程中的优先级权重，以生成用户偏好且安全的轨迹。大量实验表明，SDD规划器实现了最先进的性能。在StyleDrive基准测试中，它比最强的基线WoTE提高了3.9%的SM-PDMS指标。此外，在NuPlan Test14和Test14-hard基准测试中，SDD规划器分别以91.76和80.32的总分排名第一，优于PLUTO等领先方法。真实车辆的闭环测试进一步证实，SDD规划器在保持高安全标准的同时，能够与预设的驾驶风格保持一致，验证了其在实际部署中的实用性。
tldr: The paper introduces SDD Planner, a diffusion-based framework for autonomous driving that balances safety and driving style preferences, achieving state-of-the-art performance on several benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SDD Planner，一个基于扩散模型的自动驾驶框架，它平衡了安全性和驾驶风格偏好，并在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。

title: AppleVLM: End-to-end Autonomous Driving with Advanced Perception and Planning-Enhanced Vision-Language Models
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving has emerged as a promising paradigm integrating perception, decision-making, and control within a unified learning framework. Recently, Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have gained significant attention for their potential to enhance the robustness and generalization of end-to-end driving models in diverse and unseen scenarios. However, existing VLM-based approaches still face challenges, including suboptimal lane perception, language understanding biases, and difficulties in handling corner cases. To address these issues, we propose AppleVLM, an advanced perception and planning-enhanced VLM model for robust end-to-end driving. AppleVLM introduces a novel vision encoder and a planning strategy encoder to improve perception and decision-making. Firstly, the vision encoder fuses spatial-temporal information from multi-view images across multiple timesteps using a deformable transformer mechanism, enhancing robustness to camera variations and facilitating scalable deployment across different vehicle platforms. Secondly, unlike traditional VLM-based approaches, AppleVLM introduces a dedicated planning modality that encodes explicit Bird's-Eye-View spatial information, mitigating language biases in navigation instructions. Finally, a VLM decoder fine-tuned by a hierarchical Chain-of-Thought integrates vision, language, and planning features to output robust driving waypoints. We evaluate AppleVLM in closed-loop experiments on two CARLA benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art driving performance. Furthermore, we deploy AppleVLM on an AGV platform and successfully showcase real-world end-to-end autonomous driving in complex outdoor environments.
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶已成为一种有前景的范式，它在一个统一的学习框架内集成了感知、决策和控制。 近年来，视觉-语言模型（VLM）因其增强端到端驾驶模型在各种未见场景中的鲁棒性和泛化能力的潜力而备受关注。 然而，现有的基于 VLM 的方法仍然面临一些挑战，包括次优的车道感知、语言理解偏差以及难以处理的极端情况。 为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 AppleVLM，一种用于鲁棒端到端驾驶的，经过高级感知和规划增强的 VLM 模型。 AppleVLM 引入了一种新颖的视觉编码器和一个规划策略编码器，以改进感知和决策。 首先，该视觉编码器使用可变形 Transformer 机制融合来自多个时间步长中的多视角图像的时空信息，从而增强对相机变化的鲁棒性，并促进在不同车辆平台上的可扩展部署。 其次，与传统的基于 VLM 的方法不同，AppleVLM 引入了一种专用的规划模态，该模态编码了显式的鸟瞰图空间信息，从而减轻了导航指令中的语言偏差。 最后，一个通过分层思维链微调的 VLM 解码器集成了视觉、语言和规划特征，以输出鲁棒的驾驶航点。 我们在两个 CARLA 基准测试上通过闭环实验评估了 AppleVLM，实现了最先进的驾驶性能。 此外，我们将 AppleVLM 部署在 AGV 平台上，并成功展示了在复杂户外环境中真实的端到端自动驾驶。
tldr: The paper introduces AppleVLM, a new Vision-Language Model for end-to-end autonomous driving that incorporates advanced perception and planning strategies, achieving state-of-the-art performance on CARLA and demonstrating real-world driving on an AGV platform.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AppleVLM，一种用于端到端自动驾驶的新型视觉语言模型，它结合了先进的感知和规划策略，在CARLA上实现了最先进的性能，并在AGV平台上展示了真实的驾驶能力。

title: Viewpoint Matters: Dynamically Optimizing Viewpoints with Masked Autoencoder for Visual Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation continues to be a challenge, and imitation learning (IL) enables robots to learn tasks from expert demonstrations. Current IL methods typically rely on fixed camera setups, where cameras are manually positioned in static locations, imposing significant limitations on adaptability and coverage. Inspired by human active perception, where humans dynamically adjust their viewpoint to capture the most relevant and least noisy information, we propose MAE-Select, a novel framework for active viewpoint selection in single-camera robotic systems. MAE-Select fully leverages pre-trained multi-view masked autoencoder representations and dynamically selects the next most informative viewpoint at each time chunk without requiring labeled viewpoints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAE-Select improves the capabilities of single-camera systems and, in some cases, even surpasses multi-camera setups. The project will be available at https://mae-select.github.io.
summary_zh: 机器人操作仍然是一项挑战，而模仿学习（IL）使机器人能够从专家演示中学习任务。目前的IL方法通常依赖于固定的相机设置，其中相机被手动放置在静态位置，对适应性和覆盖范围施加了显著的限制。受到人类主动感知的启发，人类会动态调整视角以捕捉最相关和最少噪声的信息，我们提出MAE-Select，一个用于单相机机器人系统中主动视点选择的新框架。MAE-Select充分利用预训练的多视角掩码自编码器表示，并在每个时间块动态地选择下一个最具信息量的视点，而无需标记的视点。大量的实验表明，MAE-Select提高了单相机系统的能力，并且在某些情况下甚至超过了多相机设置。该项目将在 https://mae-select.github.io 上提供。
tldr: This paper introduces MAE-Select, a method for dynamically optimizing camera viewpoints in robotic manipulation using a pre-trained masked autoencoder, which improves performance compared to fixed camera setups and sometimes even outperforms multi-camera systems.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 MAE-Select 的方法，该方法利用预训练的掩码自动编码器动态优化机器人操作中的相机视角。与固定相机设置相比，该方法能够提高性能，有时甚至优于多相机系统。

title: GeoLanG: Geometry-Aware Language-Guided Grasping with Unified RGB-D Multimodal Learning
summary: Language-guided grasping has emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling robots to identify and manipulate target objects through natural language instructions, yet it remains highly challenging in cluttered or occluded scenes. Existing methods often rely on multi-stage pipelines that separate object perception and grasping, which leads to limited cross-modal fusion, redundant computation, and poor generalization in cluttered, occluded, or low-texture scenes. To address these limitations, we propose GeoLanG, an end-to-end multi-task framework built upon the CLIP architecture that unifies visual and linguistic inputs into a shared representation space for robust semantic alignment and improved generalization. To enhance target discrimination under occlusion and low-texture conditions, we explore a more effective use of depth information through the Depth-guided Geometric Module (DGGM), which converts depth into explicit geometric priors and injects them into the attention mechanism without additional computational overhead. In addition, we propose Adaptive Dense Channel Integration, which adaptively balances the contributions of multi-layer features to produce more discriminative and generalizable visual representations. Extensive experiments on the OCID-VLG dataset, as well as in both simulation and real-world hardware, demonstrate that GeoLanG enables precise and robust language-guided grasping in complex, cluttered environments, paving the way toward more reliable multimodal robotic manipulation in real-world human-centric settings.
summary_zh: 语言引导抓取已成为一种极具前景的范式，它使机器人能够通过自然语言指令识别和操纵目标物体，但在杂乱或遮挡的场景中仍然极具挑战性。现有方法通常依赖于分离了物体感知和抓取的多阶段流程，这导致跨模态融合受限、计算冗余以及在杂乱、遮挡或低纹理场景中泛化能力较差。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出 GeoLanG，这是一个基于 CLIP 架构的端到端多任务框架，它将视觉和语言输入统一到一个共享的表征空间中，以实现鲁棒的语义对齐和提升泛化能力。为了增强在遮挡和低纹理条件下的目标辨别能力，我们探索通过深度引导几何模块（DGGM）更有效地利用深度信息，该模块将深度转换为显式的几何先验，并将其注入到注意力机制中，而无需额外的计算开销。此外，我们提出自适应密集通道集成，它自适应地平衡多层特征的贡献，以产生更具辨别力和泛化能力的视觉表征。在 OCID-VLG 数据集以及仿真环境和真实硬件上的大量实验表明，GeoLanG 能够在复杂的杂乱环境中实现精确而可靠的语言引导抓取，为在以人为中心的真实世界环境中实现更可靠的多模态机器人操作铺平了道路。
tldr: GeoLanG is an end-to-end framework for language-guided grasping using a CLIP-based architecture, incorporating depth information as geometric priors to improve performance in cluttered and occluded scenes. It demonstrates improved grasping performance in simulation and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: GeoLanG是一个端到端的语言引导抓取框架，它使用基于CLIP的架构，并将深度信息作为几何先验，以提高杂乱和遮挡场景中的性能。 它在模拟和现实环境中都展示了改进的抓取性能。

title: OAT: Ordered Action Tokenization
summary: Autoregressive policies offer a compelling foundation for scalable robot learning by enabling discrete abstraction, token-level reasoning, and flexible inference. However, applying autoregressive modeling to continuous robot actions requires an effective action tokenization scheme. Existing approaches either rely on analytical discretization methods that produce prohibitively long token sequences, or learned latent tokenizers that lack structure, limiting their compatibility with next-token prediction. In this work, we identify three desiderata for action tokenization - high compression, total decodability, and a left-to-right causally ordered token space - and introduce Ordered Action Tokenization (OAT), a learned action tokenizer that satisfies all three.
