Most prior methods rely on replaying historical observations to preserve consistency and assume static scenes. As a result, they cannot adapt to continual learning in dynamic robotic settings. To address these challenges, we propose TACO (TemporAl Consensus Optimization), a replay-free framework for continual neural mapping. We reformulate mapping as a temporal consensus optimization problem, where we treat past model snapshots as temporal neighbors. Intuitively, our approach resembles a model consulting its own past knowledge. We update the current map by enforcing weighted consensus with historical representations. Our method allows reliable past geometry to constrain optimization while permitting unreliable or outdated regions to be revised in response to new observations. TACO achieves a balance between memory efficiency and adaptability without storing or replaying previous data. Through extensive simulated and real-world experiments, we show that TACO robustly adapts to scene changes, and consistently outperforms other continual learning baselines.
summary_zh: 神经隐式地图构建已成为机器人导航和场景理解的强大范例。然而，现实世界中的机器人部署需要持续适应不断变化的环境，同时面临严格的内存和计算约束，而现有的地图构建系统无法支持这一点。大多数先前的方法依赖于重放历史观测来保持一致性，并假设场景是静态的。因此，它们无法适应动态机器人环境中的持续学习。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出TACO（时间共识优化），一个用于持续神经地图构建的无需重放的框架。我们将地图构建重新表述为一个时间共识优化问题，其中我们将过去的模型快照视为时间邻居。直观地说，我们的方法类似于模型咨询自身的过去知识。我们通过强制与历史表示加权共识来更新当前地图。我们的方法允许可靠的过去几何约束优化，同时允许不可靠或过时的区域根据新的观测进行修改。TACO在内存效率和适应性之间实现了平衡，无需存储或重放以前的数据。通过大量的模拟和真实世界实验，我们表明TACO能够稳健地适应场景变化，并且始终优于其他持续学习基线方法。
tldr: The paper introduces TACO, a replay-free continual learning framework for neural implicit mapping that maintains temporal consensus with past model snapshots to adapt to changing environments without replaying historical data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TACO，一种无需重放的持续学习框架，用于神经隐式映射，通过与过去模型快照保持时间一致性，适应变化的环境，而无需重放历史数据。

title: The Supportiveness-Safety Tradeoff in LLM Well-Being Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are being integrated into socially assistive robots (SARs) and other conversational agents providing mental health and well-being support. These agents are often designed to sound empathic and supportive in order to maximize user's engagement, yet it remains unclear how increasing the level of supportive framing in system prompts influences safety relevant behavior. We evaluated 6 LLMs across 3 system prompts with varying levels of supportiveness on 80 synthetic queries spanning 4 well-being domains (1440 responses). An LLM judge framework, validated against human ratings, assessed safety and care quality. Moderately supportive prompts improved empathy and constructive support while maintaining safety. In contrast, strongly validating prompts significantly degraded safety and, in some cases, care across all domains, with substantial variation across models. We discuss implications for prompt design, model selection, and domain specific safeguards in SARs deployment.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正被集成到社交辅助机器人（SARs）和其他提供心理健康和福祉支持的对话式代理中。这些代理通常被设计成听起来富有同情心和支持性，以最大化用户的参与度，但系统提示中增加支持性框架的程度如何影响与安全相关的行为仍然不清楚。我们评估了6个大型语言模型在3种不同支持程度的系统提示下的表现，使用了涵盖4个福祉领域的80个合成查询（1440个回复）。一个经过人工评估验证的LLM评判框架评估了安全性和护理质量。适度支持的提示提高了同理心和建设性支持，同时保持了安全性。相比之下，强验证的提示显著降低了所有领域的安全性，在某些情况下也降低了护理质量，且不同模型之间的差异很大。 我们讨论了SARs部署中提示设计、模型选择以及领域特定安全保障的意义。
tldr: This paper investigates the tradeoff between supportiveness and safety in LLM-based well-being agents, finding that overly supportive prompts can degrade safety. They evaluate different LLMs and prompt strategies across various well-being domains.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了基于LLM的健康助手中支持性和安全性之间的权衡，发现过度支持性的提示会降低安全性。作者评估了不同LLM和提示策略在不同健康领域中的表现。

title: Towards Next-Generation SLAM: A Survey on 3DGS-SLAM Focusing on Performance, Robustness, and Future Directions
summary: Traditional Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) systems often face limitations including coarse rendering quality, insufficient recovery of scene details, and poor robustness in dynamic environments. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), with its efficient explicit representation and high-quality rendering capabilities, offers a new reconstruction paradigm for SLAM. This survey comprehensively reviews key technical approaches for integrating 3DGS with SLAM. We analyze performance optimization of representative methods across four critical dimensions: rendering quality, tracking accuracy, reconstruction speed, and memory consumption, delving into their design principles and breakthroughs. Furthermore, we examine methods for enhancing the robustness of 3DGS-SLAM in complex environments such as motion blur and dynamic environments. Finally, we discuss future challenges and development trends in this area. This survey aims to provide a technical reference for researchers and foster the development of next-generation SLAM systems characterized by high fidelity, efficiency, and robustness.
summary_zh: 传统的同时定位与地图构建（SLAM）系统常常面临限制，包括粗糙的渲染质量、场景细节恢复不足以及在动态环境中鲁棒性较差。3D高斯溅射（3DGS）凭借其高效的显式表示和高质量的渲染能力，为SLAM提供了一种新的重建范式。本综述全面回顾了将3DGS与SLAM集成的关键技术方法。我们从四个关键维度分析了代表性方法的性能优化：渲染质量、跟踪精度、重建速度和内存消耗，深入探讨了它们的设计原则和突破。此外，我们还研究了增强3DGS-SLAM在复杂环境（如运动模糊和动态环境）中鲁棒性的方法。最后，我们讨论了该领域未来的挑战和发展趋势。本综述旨在为研究人员提供技术参考，并促进下一代具有高保真度、高效率和高鲁棒性的SLAM系统的开发。
tldr: This survey paper reviews the integration of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with SLAM, focusing on performance, robustness, and future directions towards next-generation SLAM systems.
tldr_zh: 这篇综述文章回顾了3D高斯溅射(3DGS)与SLAM的集成，重点关注性能、鲁棒性和面向下一代SLAM系统的未来方向。

title: SPOT-Occ: Sparse Prototype-guided Transformer for Camera-based 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary:
Achieving highly accurate and real-time 3D occupancy prediction from cameras is a critical requirement for the safe and practical deployment of autonomous vehicles. While this shift to sparse 3D representations solves the encoding bottleneck, it creates a new challenge for the decoder: how to efficiently aggregate information from a sparse, non-uniformly distributed set of voxel features without resorting to computationally prohibitive dense attention.
  In this paper, we propose a novel Prototype-based Sparse Transformer Decoder that replaces this costly interaction with an efficient, two-stage process of guided feature selection and focused aggregation. Our core idea is to make the decoder's attention prototype-guided. We achieve this through a sparse prototype selection mechanism, where each query adaptively identifies a compact set of the most salient voxel features, termed prototypes, for focused feature aggregation.
  To ensure this dynamic selection is stable and effective, we introduce a complementary denoising paradigm. This approach leverages ground-truth masks to provide explicit guidance, guaranteeing a consistent query-prototype association across decoder layers. Our model, dubbed SPOT-Occ, outperforms previous methods with a significant margin in speed while also improving accuracy. Source code is released at https://github.com/chensuzeyu/SpotOcc.
summary_zh:
从摄像头实现高精度和实时的3D占用预测是自动驾驶车辆安全可靠部署的关键需求。虽然向稀疏3D表示的转变解决了编码瓶颈，但它为解码器带来了一个新的挑战：如何在不诉诸于计算成本高昂的密集注意力机制的情况下，有效地聚合来自稀疏且非均匀分布的体素特征集合的信息。

在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于原型的稀疏Transformer解码器，它采用高效的两阶段过程（即引导式特征选择和聚焦式聚合）来取代这种代价高昂的交互。我们的核心思想是使解码器的注意力机制以原型为导向。我们通过一种稀疏原型选择机制来实现这一点，在该机制中，每个查询自适应地识别出一组最显著的体素特征（称为原型），用于聚焦式特征聚合。

为了确保这种动态选择是稳定且有效的，我们引入了一种互补的去噪范式。这种方法利用真实标签掩码提供显式指导，从而保证跨解码器层的一致的查询-原型关联。我们的模型，称为SPOT-Occ，在速度上显著优于以往的方法，同时还提高了精度。源代码已发布在https://github.com/chensuzeyu/SpotOcc。
tldr: The paper introduces SPOT-Occ, a novel transformer-based architecture for efficient and accurate 3D occupancy prediction from camera images using a prototype-guided sparse attention mechanism.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为SPOT-Occ的新型Transformer架构，它使用原型引导的稀疏注意力机制，从相机图像中进行高效且准确的3D占用预测。

title: ALORE: Autonomous Large-Object Rearrangement with a Legged Manipulator
summary: Endowing robots with the ability to rearrange various large and heavy objects, such as furniture, can substantially alleviate human workload. However, this task is extremely challenging due to the need to interact with diverse objects and efficiently rearrange multiple objects in complex environments while ensuring collision-free loco-manipulation. In this work, we present ALORE, an autonomous large-object rearrangement system for a legged manipulator that can rearrange various large objects across diverse scenarios. The proposed system is characterized by three main features: (i) a hierarchical reinforcement learning training pipeline for multi-object environment learning, where a high-level object velocity controller is trained on top of a low-level whole-body controller to achieve efficient and stable joint learning across multiple objects; (ii) two key modules, a unified interaction configuration representation and an object velocity estimator, that allow a single policy to regulate planar velocity of diverse objects accurately; and (iii) a task-and-motion planning framework that jointly optimizes object visitation order and object-to-target assignment, improving task efficiency while enabling online replanning. Comparisons against strong baselines show consistent superiority in policy generalization, object-velocity tracking accuracy, and multi-object rearrangement efficiency. Key modules are systematically evaluated, and extensive simulations and real-world experiments are conducted to validate the robustness and effectiveness of the entire system, which successfully completes 8 continuous loops to rearrange 32 chairs over nearly 40 minutes without a single failure, and executes long-distance autonomous rearrangement over an approximately 40 m route. The open-source packages are available at https://zhihaibi.github.io/Alore/.
summary_zh: 赋予机器人重新排列各种大型重物的能力，例如家具，可以大大减轻人类的工作负担。然而，由于需要与不同的物体互动，并在复杂的环境中高效地重新排列多个物体，同时确保无碰撞的移动操作，这项任务极具挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了ALORE，一种用于腿式机械臂自主重新排列大型物体的系统，可以在不同的场景中重新排列各种大型物体。该系统的特点在于三个主要特征：（i）一种用于多物体环境学习的分层强化学习训练流程，其中高级物体速度控制器在低级全身控制器的基础上进行训练，以实现跨多个物体的高效和稳定的联合学习；（ii）两个关键模块，一个统一的交互配置表示和一个物体速度估计器，允许单个策略精确地调节不同物体的平面速度；（iii）一个任务与运动规划框架，它联合优化物体访问顺序和物体-目标分配，在提高任务效率的同时，实现在线重规划。与强大的基线模型的比较表明，在策略泛化、物体速度跟踪精度和多物体重新排列效率方面具有一致的优越性。对关键模块进行了系统评估，并通过大量的模拟和真实世界实验验证了整个系统的鲁棒性和有效性，该系统成功完成了8个连续循环，在近40分钟内重新排列了32把椅子，没有发生任何失败，并在大约40米的路线上执行了长距离的自主重新排列。 开源软件包可从https://zhihaibi.github.io/Alore/获取。
tldr: The paper introduces ALORE, a system for autonomous large-object rearrangement using a legged manipulator, validated through simulations and real-world experiments. It uses hierarchical RL, a unified interaction configuration representation, and a task-and-motion planning framework.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了ALORE，一个使用腿式机械臂自主重排大型物体的系统，并通过仿真和真实世界的实验进行了验证。它采用了分层强化学习，统一的交互配置表示，以及任务与运动规划框架。

title: MA3DSG: Multi-Agent 3D Scene Graph Generation for Large-Scale Indoor Environments
summary: Current 3D scene graph generation (3DSGG) approaches heavily rely on a single-agent assumption and small-scale environments, exhibiting limited scalability to real-world scenarios. In this work, we introduce Multi-Agent 3D Scene Graph Generation (MA3DSG) model, the first framework designed to tackle this scalability challenge using multiple agents. We develop a training-free graph alignment algorithm that efficiently merges partial query graphs from individual agents into a unified global scene graph. Leveraging extensive analysis and empirical insights, our approach enables conventional single-agent systems to operate collaboratively without requiring any learnable parameters. To rigorously evaluate 3DSGG performance, we propose MA3DSG-Bench-a benchmark that supports diverse agent configurations, domain sizes, and environmental conditions-providing a more general and extensible evaluation framework. This work lays a solid foundation for scalable, multi-agent 3DSGG research.
summary_zh: 当前的3D场景图生成(3DSGG)方法严重依赖于单智能体假设和小规模环境，在真实世界场景中的可扩展性有限。在这项工作中，我们引入了多智能体3D场景图生成(MA3DSG)模型，这是首个旨在利用多个智能体解决这一可扩展性挑战的框架。我们开发了一种无需训练的图对齐算法，以高效地将来自各个智能体的局部查询图合并成一个统一的全局场景图。凭借广泛的分析和实验性见解，我们的方法使传统的单智能体系统无需任何可学习的参数即可协同运作。为了严格评估3DSGG性能，我们提出了MA3DSG-Bench，一个支持多样化智能体配置、领域规模和环境条件的基准，提供了一个更通用和可扩展的评估框架。这项工作为可扩展的多智能体3DSGG研究奠定了坚实的基础。
tldr: This paper introduces MA3DSG, a multi-agent framework for generating 3D scene graphs in large-scale indoor environments using a training-free graph alignment algorithm. It also presents MA3DSG-Bench, a new benchmark for evaluating 3DSGG performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MA3DSG，一个多智能体框架，用于使用无需训练的图对齐算法在大型室内环境中生成3D场景图。它还提出了MA3DSG-Bench，一个用于评估3DSGG性能的新基准。

title: Lyapunov Constrained Soft Actor-Critic (LC-SAC) using Koopman Operator Theory for Quadrotor Trajectory Tracking
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has achieved remarkable success in solving complex sequential decision-making problems. However, its application to safety-critical physical systems remains constrained by the lack of stability guarantees. Standard RL algorithms prioritize reward maximization, often yielding policies that may induce oscillations or unbounded state divergence. There has been significant work in incorporating Lyapunov-based stability guarantees in RL algorithms with key challenges being selecting a candidate Lyapunov function, computational complexity by using excessive function approximators and conservative policies by incorporating stability criterion in the learning process. In this work we propose a novel Lyapunov-constrained Soft Actor-Critic (LC-SAC) algorithm using Koopman operator theory. We propose use of extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) to produce a linear approximation of the system and use this approximation to derive a closed form solution for candidate Lyapunov function. This derived Lyapunov function is incorporated in the SAC algorithm to further provide guarantees for a policy that stabilizes the nonlinear system. The results are evaluated trajectory tracking of a 2D Quadrotor environment based on safe-control-gym. The proposed algorithm shows training convergence and decaying violations for Lyapunov stability criterion compared to baseline vanilla SAC algorithm. GitHub Repository: https://github.com/DhruvKushwaha/LC-SAC-Quadrotor-Trajectory-Tracking
summary_zh: 强化学习(RL)在解决复杂的序列决策问题方面取得了显著成功。然而，由于缺乏稳定性保证，其在安全攸关的物理系统中的应用仍然受到限制。标准的强化学习算法优先考虑奖励最大化，往往会产生可能导致振荡或无界状态发散的策略。在将基于Lyapunov的稳定性保证纳入强化学习算法方面已经有大量工作，主要挑战包括选择候选Lyapunov函数、通过使用过多的函数逼近器而导致的计算复杂度以及通过在学习过程中纳入稳定性准则而导致的保守策略。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种使用Koopman算子理论的新型Lyapunov约束软演员-评论家(LC-SAC)算法。我们提出使用扩展动态模式分解(EDMD)来生成系统的线性近似，并使用该近似推导出候选Lyapunov函数的闭合形式解。该导出的Lyapunov函数被纳入SAC算法中，以进一步为稳定非线性系统的策略提供保证。结果在基于safe-control-gym的2D四旋翼飞行器环境的轨迹跟踪中进行了评估。与基线vanilla SAC算法相比，所提出的算法显示出训练收敛和Lyapunov稳定性准则的违规次数逐渐减少。GitHub存储库：https://github.com/DhruvKushwaha/LC-SAC-Quadrotor-Trajectory-Tracking
tldr: The paper introduces a Lyapunov-constrained Soft Actor-Critic (LC-SAC) algorithm utilizing Koopman operator theory for stable quadrotor trajectory tracking, addressing stability concerns in applying RL to safety-critical systems. They use EDMD to determine suitable Lyapunov functions, resulting in better convergence and fewer Lyapunov violations than standard SAC.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于Koopman算子理论的Lyapunov约束软演员-评论家（LC-SAC）算法，用于稳定四旋翼飞行器的轨迹跟踪，解决了RL在安全关键系统应用中的稳定性问题。他们使用EDMD来确定合适的Lyapunov函数，相比标准SAC算法，实现了更好的收敛性和更少的Lyapunov违规。

title: Towards X-embodiment safety: A control theory perspective on transferring safety certificates across dynamical systems
summary: Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a powerful tool for enforcing safety constraints in control systems, but their direct application to complex, high-dimensional dynamics is often challenging. In many settings, safety certificates are more naturally designed for simplified or alternative system models that do not exactly match the dynamics of interest. This paper addresses the problem of transferring safety guarantees between dynamical systems with mismatched dynamics. We propose a transferred control barrier function (tCBF) framework that enables safety constraints defined on one system to be systematically enforced on another system using a simulation function and an explicit margin term. The resulting transferred barrier accounts for model mismatch and induces a safety condition that can be enforced on the target system via a quadratic-program-based safety filter. The proposed approach is general and does not require the two systems to share the same state dimension or dynamics. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework on a quadrotor navigation task with the transferred barrier ensuring collision avoidance for the target system, while remaining minimally invasive to a nominal controller. These results highlight the potential of transferred control barrier functions as a general mechanism for enforcing safety across heterogeneous dynamical systems.
summary_zh: 控制屏障函数 (CBFs) 为控制系统中实施安全约束提供了一种强大的工具，但将其直接应用于复杂、高维动力学往往具有挑战性。在许多情况下，安全证书更自然地设计用于简化或替代的系统模型，这些模型与感兴趣的动力学不完全匹配。本文探讨了在动力学失配的动力系统之间传递安全保证的问题。我们提出了一种传递控制屏障函数 (tCBF) 框架，该框架能够使用仿真函数和一个显式裕度项，将定义在一个系统上的安全约束系统地强制执行到另一个系统上。生成的传递屏障考虑了模型失配，并诱导出一个安全条件，该条件可以通过基于二次规划的安全滤波器在目标系统上强制执行。所提出的方法具有通用性，并且不需要两个系统共享相同的状态维度或动力学。我们通过一个四旋翼导航任务展示了该框架的有效性，其中传递屏障确保了目标系统的避撞，同时对标称控制器的侵入性最小。这些结果突出了传递控制屏障函数作为一种通用机制，用于在异构动力系统之间强制执行安全的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces a transferred control barrier function (tCBF) framework to transfer safety constraints between dynamical systems with mismatched dynamics, enabling safety enforcement on a target system using a simulation function and margin term. It demonstrates the effectiveness on a quadrotor navigation task.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种转移控制屏障函数（tCBF）框架，用于在具有不匹配动力学的动态系统之间传递安全约束，利用仿真函数和裕度项，能够在目标系统上实施安全。该方法在一个四旋翼导航任务上展示了其有效性。

title: eCP: Informative uncertainty quantification via Equivariantized Conformal Prediction with pre-trained models
summary: We study the effect of group symmetrization of pre-trained models on conformal prediction (CP), a post-hoc, distribution-free, finite-sample method of uncertainty quantification that offers formal coverage guarantees under the assumption of data exchangeability. Unfortunately, CP uncertainty regions can grow significantly in long horizon missions, rendering the statistical guarantees uninformative. To that end, we propose infusing CP with geometric information via group-averaging of the pretrained predictor to distribute the non-conformity mass across the orbits. Each sample now is treated as a representative of an orbit, thus uncertainty can be mitigated by other samples entangled to it via the orbit inducing elements of the symmetry group. Our approach provably yields contracted non-conformity scores in increasing convex order, implying improved exponential-tail bounds and sharper conformal prediction sets in expectation, especially at high confidence levels. We then propose an experimental design to test these theoretical claims in pedestrian trajectory prediction.
summary_zh: 我们研究了预训练模型进行群对称化处理对共形预测 (CP) 的影响。共形预测是一种事后、无分布、有限样本的不确定性量化方法，在数据可交换性的假设下提供正式的覆盖率保证。遗憾的是，在长时域任务中，共形预测的不确定性区域可能会显著增大，导致统计保证变得不具信息性。为此，我们提出通过对预训练预测器进行群平均来注入几何信息到共形预测中，从而将非符合性质量分布到轨道上。每个样本现在都被视为一个轨道的代表，因此可以通过与它通过对称群的轨道诱导元素纠缠的其他样本来缓解不确定性。我们的方法可证明地产生以递增凸序收缩的非符合性得分，这意味着改进的指数尾部边界和更准确的预期共形预测集，尤其是在高置信水平下。然后，我们提出一个实验设计来测试这些在行人轨迹预测中的理论主张。
tldr: This paper introduces equivariantized conformal prediction (eCP) to improve uncertainty quantification in pre-trained models by leveraging group symmetrization to reduce the size of conformal prediction sets, particularly in trajectory prediction tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了等变一致预测(eCP)，通过利用群对称化来减小一致预测集合的大小，从而提高预训练模型中不确定性量化，尤其是在轨迹预测任务中。

title: How Users Understand Robot Foundation Model Performance through Task Success Rates and Beyond
summary: Robot Foundation Models (RFMs) represent a promising approach to developing general-purpose home robots. Given the broad capabilities of RFMs, users will inevitably ask an RFM-based robot to perform tasks that the RFM was not trained or evaluated on. In these cases, it is crucial that users understand the risks associated with attempting novel tasks due to the relatively high cost of failure. Furthermore, an informed user who understands an RFM's capabilities will know what situations and tasks the robot can handle. In this paper, we study how non-roboticists interpret performance information from RFM evaluations. These evaluations typically report task success rate (TSR) as the primary performance metric. While TSR is intuitive to experts, it is necessary to validate whether novices also use this information as intended. Toward this end, we conducted a study in which users saw real evaluation data, including TSR, failure case descriptions, and videos from multiple published RFM research projects. The results highlight that non-experts not only use TSR in a manner consistent with expert expectations but also highly value other information types, such as failure cases that are not often reported in RFM evaluations. Furthermore, we find that users want access to both real data from previous evaluations of the RFM and estimates from the robot about how well it will do on a novel task.
summary_zh: 机器人基础模型(RFMs)代表着开发通用型家庭机器人的一个有前景的途径。鉴于RFMs广泛的能力，用户将不可避免地要求基于RFM的机器人执行RFM未曾训练或评估过的任务。在这种情况下，至关重要的是，用户要了解尝试新任务所带来的风险，因为失败的代价相对较高。此外，了解RFM能力的用户就会知道机器人可以处理哪些情况和任务。在本文中，我们研究了非机器人专家如何解读来自RFM评估的性能信息。这些评估通常将任务成功率(TSR)作为主要的性能指标进行报告。虽然TSR对于专家来说是直观的，但有必要验证新手是否也按预期使用此信息。为此，我们进行了一项研究，其中用户看到了真实的评估数据，包括来自多个已发表的RFM研究项目的TSR、失败案例描述和视频。结果表明，非专家不仅以符合专家期望的方式使用TSR，而且高度重视其他信息类型，例如RFM评估中通常不报告的失败案例。此外，我们发现用户希望获得来自RFM先前评估的真实数据，以及机器人对自身在执行新任务时的表现的估计。
tldr: This paper investigates how non-expert users interpret Robot Foundation Model (RFM) performance information, especially task success rates (TSR), and reveals that they value failure case descriptions and robots' self-estimation in addition to TSR.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了非专业用户如何理解机器人基础模型（RFM）的性能信息，特别是任务成功率（TSR），结果表明除了TSR之外，他们也重视失败案例描述和机器人自身的评估。

title: Beyond Rewards in Reinforcement Learning for Cyber Defence
summary: Recent years have seen an explosion of interest in autonomous cyber defence agents trained to defend computer networks using deep reinforcement learning. These agents are typically trained in cyber gym environments using dense, highly engineered reward functions which combine many penalties and incentives for a range of (un)desirable states and costly actions. Dense rewards help alleviate the challenge of exploring complex environments but risk biasing agents towards suboptimal and potentially riskier solutions, a critical issue in complex cyber environments. We thoroughly evaluate the impact of reward function structure on learning and policy behavioural characteristics using a variety of sparse and dense reward functions, two well-established cyber gyms, a range of network sizes, and both policy gradient and value-based RL algorithms. Our evaluation is enabled by a novel ground truth evaluation approach which allows directly comparing between different reward functions, illuminating the nuanced inter-relationships between rewards, action space and the risks of suboptimal policies in cyber environments. Our results show that sparse rewards, provided they are goal aligned and can be encountered frequently, uniquely offer both enhanced training reliability and more effective cyber defence agents with lower-risk policies. Surprisingly, sparse rewards can also yield policies that are better aligned with cyber defender goals and make sparing use of costly defensive actions without explicit reward-based numerical penalties.
summary_zh: 近年来，人们对使用深度强化学习训练的自主网络防御代理产生了爆炸式的兴趣，这些代理旨在防御计算机网络。这些代理通常在网络竞技场环境中进行训练，使用密集且高度工程化的奖励函数，这些函数结合了多种针对一系列（不）期望状态和高成本行为的惩罚和激励。 密集的奖励有助于缓解探索复杂环境的挑战，但存在使代理偏向次优且潜在更高风险解决方案的风险，这在复杂的网络环境中是一个关键问题。我们使用各种稀疏和密集奖励函数、两个成熟的网络竞技场、一系列网络规模以及基于策略梯度和基于值的强化学习算法，彻底评估了奖励函数结构对学习和策略行为特征的影响。 我们的评估得益于一种新颖的真值评估方法，该方法可以直接比较不同的奖励函数，从而阐明奖励、行动空间以及网络环境中次优策略风险之间细微的相互关系。 我们的结果表明，稀疏奖励如果与目标一致且能够频繁遇到，则独特地提供了增强的训练可靠性以及更有效的、具有较低风险策略的网络防御代理。 令人惊讶的是，稀疏奖励还可以产生与网络防御者目标更好地对齐的策略，并且可以节约使用高成本的防御行为，而无需明确的基于奖励的数值惩罚。
tldr: This paper investigates the impact of reward function structure in reinforcement learning for cyber defense, finding that sparse, goal-aligned rewards lead to more reliable training and effective, lower-risk policies compared to dense rewards.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了强化学习在网络防御中奖励函数结构的影响，发现与密集奖励相比，稀疏、目标对齐的奖励能够带来更可靠的训练以及更有效、风险更低的策略。

title: Active Asymmetric Multi-Agent Multimodal Learning under Uncertainty
summary: Multi-agent systems are increasingly equipped with heterogeneous multimodal sensors, enabling richer perception but introducing modality-specific and agent-dependent uncertainty. Existing multi-agent collaboration frameworks typically reason at the agent level, assume homogeneous sensing, and handle uncertainty implicitly, limiting robustness under sensor corruption. We propose Active Asymmetric Multi-Agent Multimodal Learning under Uncertainty (A2MAML), a principled approach for uncertainty-aware, modality-level collaboration. A2MAML models each modality-specific feature as a stochastic estimate with uncertainty prediction, actively selects reliable agent-modality pairs, and aggregates information via Bayesian inverse-variance weighting. This formulation enables fine-grained, modality-level fusion, supports asymmetric modality availability, and provides a principled mechanism to suppress corrupted or noisy modalities. Extensive experiments on connected autonomous driving scenarios for collaborative accident detection demonstrate that A2MAML consistently outperforms both single-agent and collaborative baselines, achieving up to 18.7% higher accident detection rate.
summary_zh: 多智能体系统越来越多地配备异构多模态传感器，从而实现更丰富的感知，但也引入了模态特异性和智能体依赖的不确定性。现有的多智能体协作框架通常在智能体层面进行推理，假设同质传感，并隐式地处理不确定性，这限制了在传感器损坏情况下的鲁棒性。我们提出了一种在不确定性下进行主动非对称多智能体多模态学习的方法 (A2MAML)，这是一种用于不确定性感知、模态层级协作的原则性方法。A2MAML 将每个模态特异性特征建模为具有不确定性预测的随机估计，主动选择可靠的智能体-模态对，并通过贝叶斯逆方差加权来聚合信息。这种公式实现了细粒度的模态层级融合，支持非对称模态可用性，并提供了抑制损坏或噪声模态的原则性机制。在用于协作事故检测的互联自动驾驶场景中进行的大量实验表明，A2MAML 始终优于单智能体和协作基线，事故检测率最高可提高 18.7%。
tldr: This paper introduces A2MAML, a novel multi-agent multimodal learning framework that actively selects and fuses reliable agent-modality pairs based on uncertainty, demonstrated through experiments in collaborative accident detection for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的多智能体多模态学习框架A2MAML，该框架基于不确定性主动选择和融合可靠的智能体-模态对，并通过自主驾驶中协同事故检测的实验进行了演示。

title: SAR-RAG: ATR Visual Question Answering by Semantic Search, Retrieval, and MLLM Generation
summary: We present a visual-context image retrieval-augmented generation (ImageRAG) assisted AI agent for automatic target recognition (ATR) of synthetic aperture radar (SAR). SAR is a remote sensing method used in defense and security applications to detect and monitor the positions of military vehicles, which may appear indistinguishable in images. Researchers have extensively studied SAR ATR to improve the differentiation and identification of vehicle types, characteristics, and measurements. Test examples can be compared with known vehicle target types to improve recognition tasks. New methods enhance the capabilities of neural networks, transformer attention, and multimodal large language models. An agentic AI method may be developed to utilize a defined set of tools, such as searching through a library of similar examples. Our proposed method, SAR Retrieval-Augmented Generation (SAR-RAG), combines a multimodal large language model (MLLM) with a vector database of semantic embeddings to support contextual search for image exemplars with known qualities. By recovering past image examples with known true target types, our SAR-RAG system can compare similar vehicle categories, achieving improved ATR prediction accuracy. We evaluate this through search and retrieval metrics, categorical classification accuracy, and numeric regression of vehicle dimensions. These metrics all show improvements when SAR-RAG is added to an MLLM baseline method as an attached ATR memory bank.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种视觉上下文图像检索增强生成（ImageRAG）辅助的人工智能代理，用于合成孔径雷达（SAR）的自动目标识别（ATR）。SAR是一种遥感方法，应用于国防和安全领域，用于检测和监控军用车辆的位置，这些车辆在图像中可能难以区分。研究人员已经广泛研究了SAR ATR，以提高车辆类型、特征和尺寸的区分和识别能力。测试样本可以与已知的车辆目标类型进行比较，以改进识别任务。新的方法增强了神经网络、Transformer注意力机制和多模态大型语言模型的能力。可以开发一种智能体式人工智能方法，利用一套定义的工具，例如搜索相似示例库。我们提出的方法，SAR检索增强生成（SAR-RAG），将多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）与语义嵌入向量数据库相结合，以支持对具有已知属性的图像示例进行上下文搜索。通过恢复过去具有已知真实目标类型的图像示例，我们的SAR-RAG系统可以比较相似的车辆类别，从而提高ATR预测精度。我们通过搜索和检索指标、类别分类精度以及车辆尺寸的数值回归来评估此方法。这些指标都表明，当SAR-RAG作为附加的ATR记忆库添加到MLLM基线方法中时，性能有所提升。
tldr: The paper introduces SAR-RAG, a retrieval-augmented generation method that leverages a multimodal large language model and semantic embeddings to improve automatic target recognition in synthetic aperture radar images by comparing test cases with known vehicle examples.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SAR-RAG，一种检索增强生成方法，它利用多模态大型语言模型和语义嵌入，通过将测试用例与已知的车辆示例进行比较，来提高合成孔径雷达图像中的自动目标识别。

title: Dual Mind World Model Inspired Network Digital Twin for Access Scheduling
summary: Emerging networked systems such as industrial IoT and real-time cyber-physical infrastructures demand intelligent scheduling strategies capable of adapting to dynamic traffic, deadlines, and interference constraints. In this work, we present a novel Digital Twin-enabled scheduling framework inspired by Dual Mind World Model (DMWM) architecture, for learning-informed and imagination-driven network control. Unlike conventional rule-based or purely data-driven policies, the proposed DMWM combines short-horizon predictive planning with symbolic model-based rollout, enabling the scheduler to anticipate future network states and adjust transmission decisions accordingly. We implement the framework in a configurable simulation testbed and benchmark its performance against traditional heuristics and reinforcement learning baselines under varied traffic conditions. Our results show that DMWM achieves superior performance in bursty, interference-limited, and deadline-sensitive environments, while maintaining interpretability and sample efficiency. The proposed design bridges the gap between network-level reasoning and low-overhead learning, marking a step toward scalable and adaptive NDT-based network optimization.
summary_zh: 工业物联网和实时信息物理基础设施等新兴网络系统需要能够适应动态流量、截止时间和干扰约束的智能调度策略。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种受双脑世界模型（DMWM）架构启发的、基于数字孪生的新型调度框架，用于学习驱动和想象驱动的网络控制。与传统的基于规则或纯数据驱动的策略不同，所提出的DMWM将短时预测规划与基于符号模型的展开相结合，使调度器能够预测未来的网络状态并相应地调整传输决策。我们在一个可配置的仿真测试平台中实现了该框架，并在不同的流量条件下，将其性能与传统启发式算法和强化学习基线进行比较。我们的结果表明，DMWM在突发、干扰受限和截止时间敏感的环境中表现出优越的性能，同时保持了可解释性和样本效率。所提出的设计弥合了网络级推理和低开销学习之间的差距，标志着向可扩展和自适应的基于网络确定性技术的网络优化迈出了一步。
tldr: This paper introduces a Digital Twin-enabled network scheduler leveraging a Dual Mind World Model (DMWM) architecture for improved performance in dynamic and constrained network environments, demonstrating superior results compared to traditional methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于数字孪生的网络调度器，利用双脑世界模型（DMWM）架构来提高动态和受限网络环境中的性能，并展示了优于传统方法的结果。

title: Continual Learning through Control Minimization
summary: Catastrophic forgetting remains a fundamental challenge for neural networks when tasks are trained sequentially. In this work, we reformulate continual learning as a control problem where learning and preservation signals compete within neural activity dynamics. We convert regularization penalties into preservation signals that protect prior-task representations. Learning then proceeds by minimizing the control effort required to integrate new tasks while competing with the preservation of prior tasks. At equilibrium, the neural activities produce weight updates that implicitly encode the full prior-task curvature, a property we term the continual-natural gradient, requiring no explicit curvature storage. Experiments confirm that our learning framework recovers true prior-task curvature and enables task discrimination, outperforming existing methods on standard benchmarks without replay.
summary_zh: 灾难性遗忘仍然是神经网络在顺序训练任务时面临的一个根本挑战。在这项工作中，我们将持续学习重构为一个控制问题，其中学习和保存信号在神经活动动态中相互竞争。我们将正则化惩罚转化为保存信号，以保护先前任务的表征。学习过程则通过最小化控制工作量来进行，该工作量用于整合新任务，同时与先前任务的保存竞争。在平衡状态下，神经活动产生权重更新，这些更新隐式地编码了完整的先前任务曲率，我们称之为持续-自然梯度，无需显式存储曲率。实验证实，我们的学习框架恢复了真实的先前任务曲率并实现了任务区分，在标准基准测试上优于现有方法，且无需重放。
tldr: This paper presents a continual learning method that reformulates the problem as a control problem minimizing the effort required to learn new tasks while preserving past knowledge, achieving state-of-the-art performance without replay.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种持续学习方法，将该问题重新表述为一个控制问题，旨在最小化学习新任务所需的努力，同时保留先前的知识，在没有重放的情况下实现了最先进的性能。

title: Learning the Value Systems of Agents with Preference-based and Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agreement Technologies refer to open computer systems in which autonomous software agents interact with one another, typically on behalf of humans, in order to come to mutually acceptable agreements. With the advance of AI systems in recent years, it has become apparent that such agreements, in order to be acceptable to the involved parties, must remain aligned with ethical principles and moral values. However, this is notoriously difficult to ensure, especially as different human users (and their software agents) may hold different value systems, i.e. they may differently weigh the importance of individual moral values. Furthermore, it is often hard to specify the precise meaning of a value in a particular context in a computational manner. Methods to estimate value systems based on human-engineered specifications, e.g. based on value surveys, are limited in scale due to the need for intense human moderation. In this article, we propose a novel method to automatically \emph{learn} value systems from observations and human demonstrations. In particular, we propose a formal model of the \emph{value system learning} problem, its instantiation to sequential decision-making domains based on multi-objective Markov decision processes, as well as tailored preference-based and inverse reinforcement learning algorithms to infer value grounding functions and value systems. The approach is illustrated and evaluated by two simulated use cases.
summary_zh: 协议技术指的是开放的计算机系统，其中自主软件代理为了达成相互接受的协议而相互交互，通常代表人类。近年来，随着人工智能系统的发展，越来越明显的是，为了使此类协议能够被相关方接受，必须与伦理原则和道德价值观保持一致。然而，这很难保证，特别是当不同的人类用户（及其软件代理）可能持有不同的价值体系时，即，他们可能对个体道德价值观的重要性赋予不同的权重。此外，通常难以以计算方式指定特定上下文中价值观的确切含义。基于人工设计的规范（例如基于价值调查）来估计价值体系的方法，由于需要大量的人工干预，因此在规模上受到限制。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的方法，可以从观察和人类示范中自动*学习*价值体系。特别地，我们提出了*价值体系学习*问题的形式化模型，其基于多目标马尔可夫决策过程在序贯决策领域的实例化，以及定制的基于偏好和逆强化学习算法，以推断价值基础函数和价值体系。通过两个模拟用例来说明和评估该方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a method to automatically learn value systems of agents by combining preference-based and inverse reinforcement learning in multi-objective Markov decision processes, particularly relevant in open computer systems for ensuring ethical alignment.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种通过结合基于偏好的逆强化学习和多目标马尔可夫决策过程自动学习智能体价值系统的方法，特别适用于开放式计算机系统中，以确保伦理一致性。

title: Discovering Mechanistic Models of Neural Activity: System Identification in an in Silico Zebrafish
summary: Constructing mechanistic models of neural circuits is a fundamental goal of neuroscience, yet verifying such models is limited by the lack of ground truth. To rigorously test model discovery, we establish an in silico testbed using neuromechanical simulations of a larval zebrafish as a transparent ground truth. We find that LLM-based tree search autonomously discovers predictive models that significantly outperform established forecasting baselines. Conditioning on sensory drive is necessary but not sufficient for faithful system identification, as models exploit statistical shortcuts. Structural priors prove essential for enabling robust out-of-distribution generalization and recovery of interpretable mechanistic models. Our insights provide guidance for modeling real-world neural recordings and offer a broader template for AI-driven scientific discovery.
summary_zh: 构建神经回路的机制模型是神经科学的一个基本目标，但验证此类模型受限于缺乏真实数据。为了严格测试模型发现，我们建立了一个硅内测试平台，使用幼年斑马鱼的神经机械模拟作为透明的真实数据。我们发现，基于LLM (大型语言模型) 的树搜索能够自主发现具有预测性的模型，其表现显著优于已建立的预测基线。以感觉驱动为条件对于忠实的系统辨识是必要的，但并非充分条件，因为模型会利用统计捷径。结构先验证明对于实现鲁棒的分布外泛化和恢复可解释的机制模型至关重要。我们的研究成果为真实世界神经记录的建模提供了指导，并为人工智能驱动的科学发现提供了一个更广泛的模板。
tldr: The paper introduces an in silico zebrafish simulation as a testbed for discovering mechanistic models of neural activity, demonstrating that LLM-based tree search can outperform baselines, especially with structural priors, for robust generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个体外斑马鱼模拟环境，用于发现神经活动机理模型。研究表明，基于LLM的树搜索优于基线模型，特别是在结合结构先验信息时，能够实现稳健的泛化。

title: InterPReT: Interactive Policy Restructuring and Training Enable Effective Imitation Learning from Laypersons
summary: Imitation learning has shown success in many tasks by learning from expert demonstrations. However, most existing work relies on large-scale demonstrations from technical professionals and close monitoring of the training process. These are challenging for a layperson when they want to teach the agent new skills. To lower the barrier of teaching AI agents, we propose Interactive Policy Restructuring and Training (InterPReT), which takes user instructions to continually update the policy structure and optimize its parameters to fit user demonstrations. This enables end-users to interactively give instructions and demonstrations, monitor the agent's performance, and review the agent's decision-making strategies. A user study (N=34) on teaching an AI agent to drive in a racing game confirms that our approach yields more robust policies without impairing system usability, compared to a generic imitation learning baseline, when a layperson is responsible for both giving demonstrations and determining when to stop. This shows that our method is more suitable for end-users without much technical background in machine learning to train a dependable policy
summary_zh: 模仿学习通过从专家演示中学习，已经在许多任务中展现了成功。然而，现有的大部分工作依赖于技术专家的海量演示，以及对训练过程的密切监控。当非专业人士想要教授智能体新技能时，这些会带来挑战。为了降低教授AI智能体的门槛，我们提出了交互式策略重构与训练 (InterPReT)，该方法利用用户指令持续更新策略结构并优化其参数，以适应用户演示。这使得终端用户能够交互式地提供指令和演示，监控智能体的性能，以及审查智能体的决策策略。一项关于教授AI智能体在赛车游戏中驾驶的用户研究（N=34）证实，与通用的模仿学习基线相比，当非专业人士负责提供演示和确定何时停止时，我们的方法能够产生更鲁棒的策略，且不影响系统可用性。这表明我们的方法更适合于没有太多机器学习技术背景的终端用户，以训练出一个可靠的策略。
tldr: The paper introduces InterPReT, an interactive imitation learning method designed for laypersons to train AI agents by allowing them to update policy structure and parameters through instructions and demonstrations, resulting in more robust policies compared to generic imitation learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了InterPReT，一种交互式模仿学习方法，旨在让非专业人士通过指令和演示来训练人工智能代理，允许他们更新策略结构和参数，从而获得比通用模仿学习更稳健的策略。

title: Topology-Aware Revival for Efficient Sparse Training
summary: Static sparse training is a promising route to efficient learning by committing to a fixed mask pattern, yet the constrained structure reduces robustness. Early pruning decisions can lock the network into a brittle structure that is difficult to escape, especially in deep reinforcement learning (RL) where the evolving policy continually shifts the training distribution. We propose Topology-Aware Revival (TAR), a lightweight one-shot post-pruning procedure that improves static sparsity without dynamic rewiring. After static pruning, TAR performs a single revival step by allocating a small reserve budget across layers according to topology needs, randomly uniformly reactivating a few previously pruned connections within each layer, and then keeping the resulting connectivity fixed for the remainder of training. Across multiple continuous-control tasks with SAC and TD3, TAR improves final return over static sparse baselines by up to +37.9% and also outperforms dynamic sparse training baselines with a median gain of +13.5%.
summary_zh: 静态稀疏训练是一种通过确定固定掩码模式来实现高效学习的有效途径，但受限的结构会降低鲁棒性。早期的剪枝决策可能将网络锁定到一个脆弱且难以摆脱的结构中，尤其是在深度强化学习（RL）中，因为不断演进的策略会持续改变训练分布。我们提出拓扑感知复苏（TAR），这是一种轻量级的一次性后剪枝程序，可在不进行动态重连的情况下提高静态稀疏性。在静态剪枝后，TAR执行一个单独的复苏步骤，根据拓扑需求在各层之间分配少量预留预算，在每层内随机均匀地重新激活一些先前剪枝的连接，然后在训练的剩余时间保持生成的连接性不变。在使用SAC和TD3的多个连续控制任务中，TAR与静态稀疏基线相比，最终回报最多提高+37.9%，并且也优于动态稀疏训练基线，中位数增益为+13.5%。
tldr: This paper introduces Topology-Aware Revival (TAR), a post-pruning technique for static sparse training in deep reinforcement learning that improves performance without dynamic rewiring by selectively reactivating a small number of pruned connections based on topology needs.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了拓扑感知重激活（TAR），一种用于深度强化学习中静态稀疏训练的后剪枝技术，通过根据拓扑需求选择性地重新激活少量剪枝连接，在不进行动态重连的情况下提高了性能。

title: Active Epistemic Control for Query-Efficient Verified Planning
summary: Planning in interactive environments is challenging under partial observability: task-critical preconditions (e.g., object locations or container states) may be unknown at decision time, yet grounding them through interaction is costly. Learned world models can cheaply predict missing facts, but prediction errors can silently induce infeasible commitments. We present \textbf{Active Epistemic Control (AEC)}, an epistemic-categorical planning layer that integrates model-based belief management with categorical feasibility checks. AEC maintains a strict separation between a \emph{grounded fact store} used for commitment and a \emph{belief store} used only for pruning candidate plans. At each step, it either queries the environment to ground an unresolved predicate when uncertainty is high or predictions are ambiguous, or simulates the predicate to filter hypotheses when confidence is sufficient. Final commitment is gated by grounded precondition coverage and an SQ-BCP pullback-style compatibility check, so simulated beliefs affect efficiency but cannot directly certify feasibility. Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld show that AEC achieves competitive success with fewer replanning rounds than strong LLM-agent baselines.
summary_zh: 在交互式环境中进行规划在部分可观测条件下具有挑战性：任务关键的前提条件（例如，物体位置或容器状态）在决策时可能未知，但通过交互来确定它们的代价很高。学习到的世界模型可以廉价地预测缺失的事实，但预测误差会悄无声息地引发不可行的承诺。我们提出了\textbf{主动认知控制 (AEC)}，这是一个认知-分类规划层，它将基于模型的置信度管理与分类可行性检查相结合。AEC坚持在用于承诺的\emph{已确定的事实存储}和仅用于修剪候选方案的\emph{置信度存储}之间进行严格分离。在每一步中，它要么查询环境以确定不确定性较高或预测不明确的未解决谓词，要么在置信度足够时模拟该谓词以过滤假设。最终的承诺由已确定的前提条件覆盖率和SQ-BCP拉回式兼容性检查门控，因此模拟的置信度会影响效率，但不能直接证明可行性。在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上的实验表明，与强大的LLM-agent基线相比，AEC能够以更少的重新规划轮次实现具有竞争力的成功。
tldr: The paper introduces Active Epistemic Control (AEC), a planning layer that combines model-based belief management with feasibility checks to improve planning efficiency in partially observable interactive environments. AEC shows promising results in ALFWorld and ScienceWorld by reducing replanning rounds compared to LLM-agent baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了主动认知控制(AEC)，这是一种将基于模型的信念管理与可行性检查相结合的规划层，旨在提高在部分可观察的交互环境中规划的效率。AEC在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上表现出前景，与LLM-agent基线相比，减少了重新规划的轮数。

title: SynthVerse: A Large-Scale Diverse Synthetic Dataset for Point Tracking
summary: Point tracking aims to follow visual points through complex motion, occlusion, and viewpoint changes, and has advanced rapidly with modern foundation models. Yet progress toward general point tracking remains constrained by limited high-quality data, as existing datasets often provide insufficient diversity and imperfect trajectory annotations. To this end, we introduce SynthVerse, a large-scale, diverse synthetic dataset specifically designed for point tracking. SynthVerse includes several new domains and object types missing from existing synthetic datasets, such as animated-film-style content, embodied manipulation, scene navigation, and articulated objects. SynthVerse substantially expands dataset diversity by covering a broader range of object categories and providing high-quality dynamic motions and interactions, enabling more robust training and evaluation for general point tracking. In addition, we establish a highly diverse point tracking benchmark to systematically evaluate state-of-the-art methods under broader domain shifts. Extensive experiments and analyses demonstrate that training with SynthVerse yields consistent improvements in generalization and reveal limitations of existing trackers under diverse settings.
summary_zh: 点跟踪旨在跟踪复杂运动、遮挡和视角变化中的视觉点，并随着现代基础模型的发展而迅速进步。然而，由于现有的数据集通常提供不足的多样性和不完美的轨迹标注，因此在通用点跟踪方面的进展仍然受到高质量数据的限制。为此，我们提出了SynthVerse，一个大规模、多样化的合成数据集，专门为点跟踪而设计。SynthVerse包括现有合成数据集中缺失的几个新领域和对象类型，例如动画电影风格的内容、具身操作、场景导航和铰接对象。SynthVerse通过覆盖更广泛的对象类别并提供高质量的动态运动和交互，从而显著扩展了数据集的多样性，从而为通用点跟踪实现更强大的训练和评估。此外，我们建立了一个高度多样化的点跟踪基准，以系统地评估更广泛领域迁移下最先进的方法。大量的实验和分析表明，使用SynthVerse进行训练可以在泛化方面产生持续改进，并揭示现有跟踪器在各种设置下的局限性。
tldr: The paper introduces SynthVerse, a large-scale, diverse synthetic dataset for point tracking, aiming to address the limitations of existing datasets and improve the generalization performance of point tracking methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SynthVerse，一个大规模、多样化的合成数据集，用于点跟踪，旨在解决现有数据集的局限性并提高点跟踪方法的泛化性能。

title: TrajVG: 3D Trajectory-Coupled Visual Geometry Learning
summary: Feed-forward multi-frame 3D reconstruction models often degrade on videos with object motion. Global-reference becomes ambiguous under multiple motions, while the local pointmap relies heavily on estimated relative poses and can drift, causing cross-frame misalignment and duplicated structures. We propose TrajVG, a reconstruction framework that makes cross-frame 3D correspondence an explicit prediction by estimating camera-coordinate 3D trajectories. We couple sparse trajectories, per-frame local point maps, and relative camera poses with geometric consistency objectives: (i) bidirectional trajectory-pointmap consistency with controlled gradient flow, and (ii) a pose consistency objective driven by static track anchors that suppresses gradients from dynamic regions. To scale training to in-the-wild videos where 3D trajectory labels are scarce, we reformulate the same coupling constraints into self-supervised objectives using only pseudo 2D tracks, enabling unified training with mixed supervision. Extensive experiments across 3D tracking, pose estimation, pointmap reconstruction, and video depth show that TrajVG surpasses the current feedforward performance baseline.
summary_zh: 前馈多帧3D重建模型在包含物体运动的视频上通常会性能下降。Global-reference在多个运动下变得模糊，而局部点云图过分依赖于估计的相对姿态，并可能发生漂移，导致跨帧的错位和重复结构。我们提出了TrajVG，一种通过估计相机坐标系下的3D轨迹，将跨帧3D对应关系进行显式预测的重建框架。我们将稀疏轨迹、逐帧局部点云图以及相对相机姿态与几何一致性目标相结合：（i）具有可控梯度流的双向轨迹-点云图一致性，以及（ii）由静态轨迹锚点驱动的姿态一致性目标，该目标抑制来自动态区域的梯度。为了将训练扩展到3D轨迹标签稀缺的真实场景视频，我们仅使用伪2D轨迹，将相同的耦合约束重新表述为自监督目标，从而实现混合监督下的统一训练。在3D跟踪、姿态估计, 点云图重建和视频深度等方面的广泛实验表明，TrajVG超越了当前的前馈性能基线。
tldr: The paper introduces TrajVG, a 3D reconstruction framework that explicitly estimates camera-coordinate 3D trajectories to address issues with object motion in multi-frame 3D reconstruction. It uses geometric consistency objectives and self-supervised learning with pseudo 2D tracks to improve performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TrajVG，一个3D重建框架，它显式估计相机坐标系下的3D轨迹，以解决多帧3D重建中物体运动的问题。 它利用了几何一致性目标和使用伪2D轨迹的自监督学习来提高性能。

title: Finding NeMO: A Geometry-Aware Representation of Template Views for Few-Shot Perception
summary: We present Neural Memory Object (NeMO), a novel object-centric representation that can be used to detect, segment and estimate the 6DoF pose of objects unseen during training using RGB images. Our method consists of an encoder that requires only a few RGB template views depicting an object to generate a sparse object-like point cloud using a learned UDF containing semantic and geometric information. Next, a decoder takes the object encoding together with a query image to generate a variety of dense predictions. Through extensive experiments, we show that our method can be used for few-shot object perception without requiring any camera-specific parameters or retraining on target data. Our proposed concept of outsourcing object information in a NeMO and using a single network for multiple perception tasks enhances interaction with novel objects, improving scalability and efficiency by enabling quick object onboarding without retraining or extensive pre-processing. We report competitive and state-of-the-art results on various datasets and perception tasks of the BOP benchmark, demonstrating the versatility of our approach. https://github.com/DLR-RM/nemo
summary_zh: 我们提出神经记忆对象 (NeMO)，一种新颖的以对象为中心的表示方法，可用于检测、分割和估计RGB图像中训练期间未见过的物体的6自由度姿态。我们的方法包含一个编码器，它仅需几个描绘对象的RGB模板视图，即可利用包含语义和几何信息的学习到的UDF生成稀疏的类对象点云。接下来，一个解码器将对象编码与查询图像一起生成各种密集预测。通过大量实验，我们表明我们的方法可用于小样本对象感知，而无需任何相机特定的参数或在目标数据上重新训练。我们提出的将对象信息外包到NeMO中，并使用单个网络进行多项感知任务的概念，增强了与新对象的交互，通过无需重新训练或大量预处理即可快速实现对象导入，从而提高了可扩展性和效率。我们在BOP基准测试的各种数据集和感知任务上报告了具有竞争力的最先进的结果，证明了我们方法的通用性。https://github.com/DLR-RM/nemo
tldr: The paper introduces NeMO, a novel object-centric representation using a learned UDF to detect, segment and estimate the 6DoF pose of unseen objects from a few RGB template views, achieving competitive few-shot object perception results without retraining.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为NeMO的新型以物体为中心的表示方法，它使用学习到的UDF从几个RGB模板视图中检测、分割和估计未见物体的6DoF姿态，无需重新训练即可实现有竞争力的少样本物体感知结果。

title: AGMA: Adaptive Gaussian Mixture Anchors for Prior-Guided Multimodal Human Trajectory Forecasting
summary: Human trajectory forecasting requires capturing the multimodal nature of pedestrian behavior. However, existing approaches suffer from prior misalignment. Their learned or fixed priors often fail to capture the full distribution of plausible futures, limiting both prediction accuracy and diversity. We theoretically establish that prediction error is lower-bounded by prior quality, making prior modeling a key performance bottleneck. Guided by this insight, we propose AGMA (Adaptive Gaussian Mixture Anchors), which constructs expressive priors through two stages: extracting diverse behavioral patterns from training data and distilling them into a scene-adaptive global prior for inference. Extensive experiments on ETH-UCY, Stanford Drone, and JRDB datasets demonstrate that AGMA achieves state-of-the-art performance, confirming the critical role of high-quality priors in trajectory forecasting.
summary_zh: 人类轨迹预测需要捕捉行人行为的多模态特性。然而，现有的方法存在先验错位的问题。它们学习到的或固定的先验往往无法捕捉到所有合理未来轨迹的完整分布，从而限制了预测的准确性和多样性。我们在理论上论证了预测误差受先验质量的下界限制，这使得先验建模成为关键的性能瓶颈。基于这一洞察，我们提出了 AGMA (自适应高斯混合锚点)，它通过以下两个阶段构建具有表达能力的先验：从训练数据中提取多样化的行为模式，并将这些模式提炼成一个用于推理的场景自适应全局先验。在 ETH-UCY、Stanford Drone 和 JRDB 数据集上的大量实验表明，AGMA 实现了最先进的性能，证实了高质量先验轨迹预测中的关键作用。
tldr: The paper introduces Adaptive Gaussian Mixture Anchors (AGMA) for human trajectory forecasting, which improves prediction accuracy and diversity by constructing scene-adaptive priors from training data, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了用于人类轨迹预测的自适应高斯混合锚点 (AGMA)，通过从训练数据中构建场景自适应先验，提高了预测准确性和多样性，并实现了最先进的性能。

title: DiMo: Discrete Diffusion Modeling for Motion Generation and Understanding
summary: Prior masked modeling motion generation methods predominantly study text-to-motion. We present DiMo, a discrete diffusion-style framework, which extends masked modeling to bidirectional text--motion understanding and generation. Unlike GPT-style autoregressive approaches that tokenize motion and decode sequentially, DiMo performs iterative masked token refinement, unifying Text-to-Motion (T2M), Motion-to-Text (M2T), and text-free Motion-to-Motion (M2M) within a single model. This decoding paradigm naturally enables a quality-latency trade-off at inference via the number of refinement steps. We further improve motion token fidelity with residual vector quantization (RVQ) and enhance alignment and controllability with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML show strong motion quality and competitive bidirectional understanding under a unified framework. In addition, we demonstrate model ability in text-free motion completion, text-guided motion prediction and motion caption correction without architectural change. Additional qualitative results are available on our project page: https://animotionlab.github.io/DiMo/.
summary_zh: 先前的掩码建模运动生成方法主要研究文本到运动的生成。我们提出了DiMo，一个离散扩散风格的框架，它将掩码建模扩展到双向文本-运动理解和生成。与将运动进行token化并按顺序解码的GPT风格自回归方法不同，DiMo执行迭代的掩码token精炼，从而在一个单一模型中统一了文本到运动（T2M）、运动到文本（M2T）以及无文本的运动到运动（M2M）。这种解码范式自然地实现了通过调整精炼步骤数量来平衡推理过程中的质量和延迟。我们进一步利用残差向量量化（RVQ）来提高运动token的保真度，并利用分组相对策略优化（GRPO）来增强对齐性和可控性。在HumanML3D和KIT-ML上的实验表明，在一个统一的框架下，我们的方法具有强大的运动质量和有竞争力的双向理解能力。此外，我们还展示了该模型在无文本运动补全、文本引导运动预测以及运动描述修正方面的能力，并且无需改变模型架构。更多的定性结果可以在我们的项目主页上找到：https://animotionlab.github.io/DiMo/。
tldr: The paper introduces DiMo, a discrete diffusion model for motion generation and understanding that unifies Text-to-Motion, Motion-to-Text, and Motion-to-Motion tasks within a single framework using iterative masked token refinement and residual vector quantization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DiMo，一种离散扩散模型，用于运动生成和理解，它通过迭代掩码token细化和残差向量量化，将文本到运动，运动到文本和运动到运动任务统一在一个框架中。

title: OMNI-Dent: Towards an Accessible and Explainable AI Framework for Automated Dental Diagnosis
summary: Accurate dental diagnosis is essential for oral healthcare, yet many individuals lack access to timely professional evaluation. Existing AI-based methods primarily treat diagnosis as a visual pattern recognition task and do not reflect the structured clinical reasoning used by dental professionals. These approaches also require large amounts of expert-annotated data and often struggle to generalize across diverse real-world imaging conditions. To address these limitations, we present OMNI-Dent, a data-efficient and explainable diagnostic framework that incorporates clinical reasoning principles into a Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based pipeline. The framework operates on multi-view smartphone photographs,embeds diagnostic heuristics from dental experts, and guides a general-purpose VLM to perform tooth-level evaluation without dental-specific fine-tuning of the VLM. By utilizing the VLM's existing visual-linguistic capabilities, OMNI-Dent aims to support diagnostic assessment in settings where curated clinical imaging is unavailable. Designed as an early-stage assistive tool, OMNI-Dent helps users identify potential abnormalities and determine when professional evaluation may be needed, offering a practical option for individuals with limited access to in-person care.
summary_zh: 准确的牙科诊断对于口腔保健至关重要，然而许多人无法及时获得专业的评估。现有的基于人工智能的方法主要将诊断视为一种视觉模式识别任务，未能反映牙科专业人员所使用的结构化临床推理。这些方法还需要大量专家标注的数据，并且通常难以推广到各种真实世界的成像条件下。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了OMNI-Dent，一个数据高效且可解释的诊断框架，该框架将临床推理原则融入到基于视觉-语言模型(VLM)的流水线中。该框架基于多视角的智能手机照片进行操作，嵌入了来自牙科专家的诊断启发式方法，并引导通用VLM执行牙齿级别的评估，而无需对VLM进行牙科特定的微调。通过利用VLM现有的视觉-语言能力，OMNI-Dent旨在支持在无法获得精心策划的临床影像的场景中的诊断评估。OMNI-Dent被设计为早期阶段的辅助工具，可帮助用户识别潜在的异常情况，并确定何时需要专业评估，从而为那些无法获得面对面护理的人提供了一种切实可行的选择。
tldr: OMNI-Dent is a novel, data-efficient, and explainable AI framework for automated dental diagnosis using multi-view smartphone photographs and a Vision-Language Model, designed for accessibility in settings with limited clinical imaging.
tldr_zh: OMNI-Dent 是一个新颖、数据高效且可解释的 AI 框架，用于使用多视角智能手机照片和视觉语言模型进行自动牙科诊断，专为临床成像受限环境中的可访问性而设计。

title: FullStack-Agent: Enhancing Agentic Full-Stack Web Coding via Development-Oriented Testing and Repository Back-Translation
summary: Assisting non-expert users to develop complex interactive websites has become a popular task for LLM-powered code agents. However, existing code agents tend to only generate frontend web pages, masking the lack of real full-stack data processing and storage with fancy visual effects. Notably, constructing production-level full-stack web applications is far more challenging than only generating frontend web pages, demanding careful control of data flow, comprehensive understanding of constantly updating packages and dependencies, and accurate localization of obscure bugs in the codebase. To address these difficulties, we introduce FullStack-Agent, a unified agent system for full-stack agentic coding that consists of three parts: (1) FullStack-Dev, a multi-agent framework with strong planning, code editing, codebase navigation, and bug localization abilities. (2) FullStack-Learn, an innovative data-scaling and self-improving method that back-translates crawled and synthesized website repositories to improve the backbone LLM of FullStack-Dev. (3) FullStack-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that systematically tests the frontend, backend and database functionalities of the generated website. Our FullStack-Dev outperforms the previous state-of-the-art method by 8.7%, 38.2%, and 15.9% on the frontend, backend, and database test cases respectively. Additionally, FullStack-Learn raises the performance of a 30B model by 9.7%, 9.5%, and 2.8% on the three sets of test cases through self-improvement, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach. The code is released at https://github.com/mnluzimu/FullStack-Agent.
summary_zh: 辅助非专业用户开发复杂的交互式网站已成为 LLM 驱动的代码智能体的热门任务。然而，现有的代码智能体往往只生成前端网页，用华丽的视觉效果掩盖了缺乏真正的全栈数据处理和存储的事实。值得注意的是，构建生产级的全栈 Web 应用程序远比仅生成前端网页更具挑战性，需要仔细控制数据流、全面理解不断更新的软件包和依赖项，以及准确定位代码库中晦涩难懂的错误。为了解决这些难题，我们提出了 FullStack-Agent，一个用于全栈智能体编码的统一智能体系统，它由三个部分组成：（1）FullStack-Dev，一个具有强大的规划、代码编辑、代码库导航和错误定位能力的多智能体框架。（2）FullStack-Learn，一种创新的数据扩展和自我改进方法，通过回译爬取和合成的网站仓库来改进 FullStack-Dev 的骨干 LLM。（3）FullStack-Bench，一个全面的基准测试，系统地测试所生成网站的前端、后端和数据库功能。我们的 FullStack-Dev 在前端、后端和数据库测试用例中分别超过了先前最先进的方法 8.7%、38.2% 和 15.9%。此外，FullStack-Learn 通过自我改进，在三组测试用例中将一个 30B 模型的性能分别提升了 9.7%、9.5% 和 2.8%，证明了我们方法的有效性。代码已发布在 https://github.com/mnluzimu/FullStack-Agent。
tldr: The paper introduces FullStack-Agent, a unified agent system for developing full-stack web applications, including a multi-agent framework (FullStack-Dev), a data-scaling and self-improving method (FullStack-Learn), and a comprehensive benchmark (FullStack-Bench), achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了FullStack-Agent，一个用于开发全栈Web应用程序的统一代理系统，包括一个多代理框架(FullStack-Dev)，一种数据扩展和自我改进方法(FullStack-Learn)和一个综合基准测试(FullStack-Bench)，达到了最先进的性能。

title: Evolving Afferent Architectures: Biologically-inspired Models for Damage-Avoidance Learning
summary: We introduce Afferent Learning, a framework that produces Computational Afferent Traces (CATs) as adaptive, internal risk signals for damage-avoidance learning. Inspired by biological systems, the framework uses a two-level architecture: evolutionary optimization (outer loop) discovers afferent sensing architectures that enable effective policy learning, while reinforcement learning (inner loop) trains damage-avoidance policies using these signals. This formalizes afferent sensing as providing an inductive bias for efficient learning: architectures are selected based on their ability to enable effective learning (rather than directly minimizing damage). We provide theoretical convergence guarantees under smoothness and bounded-noise assumptions. We illustrate the general approach in the challenging context of biomechanical digital twins operating over long time horizons (multiple decades of the life-course). Here, we find that CAT-based evolved architectures achieve significantly higher efficiency and better age-robustness than hand-designed baselines, enabling policies that exhibit age-dependent behavioral adaptation (23% reduction in high-risk actions). Ablation studies validate CAT signals, evolution, and predictive discrepancy as essential. We release code and data for reproducibility.
summary_zh: 我们引入了传入学习，这是一个框架，可生成计算传入轨迹（CATs）作为自适应的内部风险信号，用于损伤规避学习。该框架受到生物系统的启发，采用两层架构：进化优化（外循环）发现能够实现有效策略学习的传入感觉架构，而强化学习（内循环）则使用这些信号训练损伤规避策略。这形式化了传入感觉，将其作为一种为高效学习提供归纳偏置的方式：架构的选择基于其实现有效学习的能力（而不是直接最小化损伤）。我们提供了在平滑性和有界噪声假设下理论收敛保证。我们在生物力学数字孪生的挑战性背景下，展示了该通用方法在长期时间范围（生命历程的数十年）内的应用。结果表明，基于CAT的进化架构比手工设计的基线实现了明显更高的效率和更好的年龄鲁棒性，从而能够实现表现出年龄依赖性行为适应的策略（高风险行为减少23%）。消融研究验证了CAT信号、进化和预测差异是必不可少的。我们发布了代码和数据以供复现。
tldr: The paper introduces Afferent Learning, a biologically-inspired framework that uses evolutionary optimization to discover afferent sensing architectures for reinforcement learning, enabling damage-avoidance policies in biomechanical digital twins with improved efficiency and age-robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Afferent Learning，一个受生物学启发的框架，它使用进化优化来发现用于强化学习的传入感应架构，从而在生物力学数字孪生体中实现具有更高效率和年龄鲁棒性的损伤避免策略。

title: Rationality Measurement and Theory for Reinforcement Learning Agents
summary: This paper proposes a suite of rationality measures and associated theory for reinforcement learning agents, a property increasingly critical yet rarely explored. We define an action in deployment to be perfectly rational if it maximises the hidden true value function in the steepest direction. The expected value discrepancy of a policy's actions against their rational counterparts, culminating over the trajectory in deployment, is defined to be expected rational risk; an empirical average version in training is also defined. Their difference, termed as rational risk gap, is decomposed into (1) an extrinsic component caused by environment shifts between training and deployment, and (2) an intrinsic one due to the algorithm's generalisability in a dynamic environment. They are upper bounded by, respectively, (1) the $1$-Wasserstein distance between transition kernels and initial state distributions in training and deployment, and (2) the empirical Rademacher complexity of the value function class. Our theory suggests hypotheses on the benefits from regularisers (including layer normalisation, $\ell_2$ regularisation, and weight normalisation) and domain randomisation, as well as the harm from environment shifts. Experiments are in full agreement with these hypotheses. The code is available at https://github.com/EVIEHub/Rationality.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一套用于强化学习智能体的理性度量方法和相关理论，这是一个日益重要但鲜有研究的属性。 我们将部署中的行动定义为完全理性的，如果它在最陡峭的方向上最大化了隐藏的真实价值函数。 策略的行动与其理性对应行动之间的期望值差异，在部署过程中累积，被定义为期望理性风险；同时定义了训练中的经验平均版本。 它们的差值，称为理性风险差距，被分解为 (1) 由训练和部署之间环境转移引起的外在成分，以及 (2) 由算法在动态环境中的泛化性引起的内在成分。 它们分别以（1）训练和部署中转移核及初始状态分布之间的 $1$-Wasserstein 距离，以及（2）价值函数类的经验 Rademacher 复杂度为上界。 我们的理论提出了关于正则化器（包括层归一化、$\ell_2$ 正则化和权重归一化）的益处以及环境转移的危害的假设。 实验结果与这些假设完全一致。 代码可在 https://github.com/EVIEHub/Rationality 获取。
tldr: This paper introduces rationality measures for RL agents, analyzes the gap between training and deployment rationality, and provides theoretical bounds validated by experiments. It also suggests improvements using regularization techniques.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一系列强化学习智能体的理性度量方法，分析了训练和部署之间理性差距，并提供了实验验证的理论界限。它还建议使用正则化技术来改进。

title: Generalized Schrödinger Bridge on Graphs
summary: Transportation on graphs is a fundamental challenge across many domains, where decisions must respect topological and operational constraints. Despite the need for actionable policies, existing graph-transport methods lack this expressivity. They rely on restrictive assumptions, fail to generalize across sparse topologies, and scale poorly with graph size and time horizon. To address these issues, we introduce Generalized Schrödinger Bridge on Graphs (GSBoG), a novel scalable data-driven framework for learning executable controlled continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) policies on arbitrary graphs under state cost augmented dynamics. Notably, GSBoG learns trajectory-level policies, avoiding dense global solvers and thereby enhancing scalability. This is achieved via a likelihood optimization approach, satisfying the endpoint marginals, while simultaneously optimizing intermediate behavior under state-dependent running costs. Extensive experimentation on challenging real-world graph topologies shows that GSBoG reliably learns accurate, topology-respecting policies while optimizing application-specific intermediate state costs, highlighting its broad applicability and paving new avenues for cost-aware dynamical transport on general graphs.
summary_zh: 图上的运输是诸多领域中的一项根本性挑战，其中的决策必须尊重拓扑结构和运营约束。尽管需要可执行的策略，但现有的图运输方法缺乏这种表达能力。它们依赖于限制性假设，无法在稀疏拓扑结构中泛化，并且随着图的大小和时间范围的增加，扩展性较差。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新的可扩展数据驱动框架，即图上的广义薛定谔桥 (GSBoG)，用于学习在任意图上、状态成本增加动力学下的可执行受控连续时间马尔可夫链 (CTMC) 策略。值得注意的是，GSBoG 学习轨迹级别的策略，避免了密集的全局求解器，从而增强了可扩展性。这是通过一种似然优化方法实现的，该方法满足端点边际分布，同时优化状态相关的运行成本下的中间行为。在具有挑战性的真实世界图拓扑结构上的大量实验表明，GSBoG 能够可靠地学习准确、尊重拓扑结构的策略，同时优化特定应用的中间状态成本，突显了其广泛的适用性，并为通用图上的成本感知动态运输开辟了新的途径。
tldr: The paper introduces Generalized Schrödinger Bridge on Graphs (GSBoG), a scalable data-driven framework for learning executable controlled continuous-time Markov chain policies on arbitrary graphs for cost-aware dynamical transport.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了广义图上的薛定谔桥 (GSBoG)，这是一个可扩展的数据驱动框架，用于在任意图上学习可执行的受控连续时间马尔可夫链策略，以实现成本感知的动态传输。

title: SAFE: Stable Alignment Finetuning with Entropy-Aware Predictive Control for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)
summary: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) has been positioned by recent literature as the canonical method for the RL part of Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). PPO performs well empirically but has a heuristic motivation and handles the KL-divergence constraint used in LM-RLHF in an ad-hoc manner and suffers form reward oscillations, entropy collapse, value function drift, and sudden policy divergence that require frequent restarts and extensive hyperparameter tuning. In this paper, we develop a new pure on policy actor-critic RL method for the LM-RLHF setting. We present SAFE (Stable Alignment Finetuning with Entropy-aware control),a novel RLHF algorithm that combines a Double Soft-Min Critic for pessimistic value estimation with a new multi-layer stabilization framework combining entropy-gated KL regulation, and PID-controlled adaptive thresholds. Unlike standard PPO's symmetric KL penalties, SAFE distinguishes high-entropy exploration from low-entropy mode collapse and adjusts penalties dynamically based on reward velocity. Experiments on a 3B parameter model show SAFE achieves +5.15\% training-average reward than PPO (0.725 vs 0.689), negligible reward crashes, and superior KL control than ppo . Our method adds minimal computational overhead and provides an interpretable, crash-resistant RLHF framework that maintains aggressive learning speed while ensuring stable long-horizon optimization suitable for production deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/ryyzn9/SAFE
summary_zh: 近期的文献将近端策略优化（PPO）定位为人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）中RL部分的经典方法。PPO在实践中表现良好，但其动机具有启发式的性质，并且以一种临时的方式处理在LM-RLHF中使用的KL散度约束，同时面临奖励振荡、熵崩溃、价值函数漂移以及需要频繁重启和大量超参数调优的突发性策略发散等问题。在本文中，我们为LM-RLHF环境开发了一种新的纯粹的在策略行动者-评论家RL方法。我们提出SAFE（具有熵感知控制的稳定对齐微调），一种新颖的RLHF算法，它将用于悲观价值估计的双软最小评论家与一个结合了熵门控KL调节和PID控制自适应阈值的新型多层稳定框架相结合。与标准PPO的对称KL惩罚不同，SAFE区分了高熵探索和低熵模式崩溃，并根据奖励速度动态调整惩罚。在一个30亿参数模型上的实验表明，SAFE实现了比PPO更高的训练平均奖励（+5.15%，0.725对0.689），可以忽略不计的奖励崩溃，以及优于PPO的KL控制。我们的方法增加了最小的计算开销，并提供了一个可解释的、抗崩溃的RLHF框架，该框架在保持积极的学习速度的同时，确保了适合生产部署的稳定的长时程优化。代码可在https://github.com/ryyzn9/SAFE 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces SAFE, a new RLHF algorithm that improves upon PPO by using a Double Soft-Min Critic and a multi-layer stabilization framework with entropy-gated KL regulation and PID-controlled adaptive thresholds resulting in more stable and efficient training for large language models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的 RLHF 算法 SAFE，它通过使用双重软最小评论家和一个多层稳定框架，结合熵门控 KL 调节和 PID 控制的自适应阈值，改进了 PPO，从而为大型语言模型带来了更稳定和高效的训练。

title: Decoupling Time and Risk: Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning with General Discounting
summary: Distributional reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework increasingly adopted in safety-critical domains for its ability to optimize risk-sensitive objectives. However, the role of the discount factor is often overlooked, as it is typically treated as a fixed parameter of the Markov decision process or tunable hyperparameter, with little consideration of its effect on the learned policy. In the literature, it is well-known that the discounting function plays a major role in characterizing time preferences of an agent, which an exponential discount factor cannot fully capture. Building on this insight, we propose a novel framework that supports flexible discounting of future rewards and optimization of risk measures in distributional RL. We provide a technical analysis of the optimality of our algorithms, show that our multi-horizon extension fixes issues raised with existing methodologies, and validate the robustness of our methods through extensive experiments. Our results highlight that discounting is a cornerstone in decision-making problems for capturing more expressive temporal and risk preferences profiles, with potential implications for real-world safety-critical applications.
summary_zh: 分布强化学习(RL)是一种强大的框架，因其优化风险敏感目标的能力而在安全攸关领域中日益普及。然而，折扣因子的作用常常被忽视，因为它通常被视为马尔可夫决策过程的固定参数或可调超参数，很少考虑其对学习策略的影响。在文献中，众所周知，折扣函数在表征智能体的时间偏好方面起着重要作用，而指数折扣因子并不能完全捕捉这一点。基于此洞察，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，该框架支持对未来奖励进行灵活的折扣，并在分布强化学习中优化风险度量。我们对算法的最优性进行了技术分析，表明我们的多视界扩展修复了现有方法论中提出的问题，并通过大量实验验证了我们方法的鲁棒性。我们的结果表明，折扣是决策问题的基石，可以捕捉更具表现力的时间和风险偏好，对现实世界的安全攸关应用具有潜在影响。
tldr: This paper introduces a new risk-sensitive reinforcement learning framework that supports flexible discounting of future rewards, addressing limitations of the standard exponential discount factor and improving performance in safety-critical domains.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个新的风险敏感强化学习框架，该框架支持对未来奖励的灵活折扣，解决了标准指数折扣因子的局限性，并提高了在安全关键领域的性能。

title: Autonomous AI Agents for Real-Time Affordable Housing Site Selection: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Under Regulatory Constraints
summary: Affordable housing shortages affect billions, while land scarcity and regulations make site selection slow. We present AURA (Autonomous Urban Resource Allocator), a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning system for real-time affordable housing site selection under hard regulatory constraints (QCT, DDA, LIHTC). We model the task as a constrained multi-objective Markov decision process optimizing accessibility, environmental impact, construction cost, and social equity while enforcing feasibility. AURA uses a regulatory-aware state encoding 127 federal and local constraints, Pareto-constrained policy gradients with feasibility guarantees, and reward decomposition separating immediate costs from long-term social outcomes. On datasets from 8 U.S. metros (47,392 candidate parcels), AURA attains 94.3% regulatory compliance and improves Pareto hypervolume by 37.2% over strong baselines. In a New York City 2026 case study, it reduces selection time from 18 months to 72 hours and identifies 23% more viable sites; chosen sites have 31% better transit access and 19% lower environmental impact than expert picks.
summary_zh: 经济适用房短缺影响着数十亿人，而土地稀缺和相关法规使得选址过程缓慢。我们提出了AURA（自主城市资源分配器），这是一种分层多智能体强化学习系统，用于在严格的监管约束（QCT、DDA、LIHTC）下实时选择经济适用房用地。我们将该任务建模为一个受约束的多目标马尔可夫决策过程，在满足可行性的前提下，优化可达性、环境影响、建设成本和社会公平。AURA使用一种感知监管状态的编码方式，涵盖127项联邦和地方约束，采用具有可行性保证的帕累托约束策略梯度，以及将即时成本与长期社会结果分离的奖励分解。在来自美国8个都市区（47392个候选地块）的数据集上，AURA实现了94.3%的法规遵从性，并在强大的基线基础上将帕累托超体积提高了37.2%。在一个纽约市2026年的案例研究中，它将选址时间从18个月缩短到72小时，并识别出多23%的可行地块；所选地块比专家选择的地块拥有高31%的交通可达性和低19%的环境影响。
tldr: The paper introduces AURA, a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning system for real-time affordable housing site selection that outperforms existing methods in regulatory compliance, Pareto hypervolume, and site selection time.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AURA，一种用于实时经济适用房选址的分层多智能体强化学习系统，在监管合规性、帕累托超体积和选址时间方面优于现有方法。

title: C-IDS: Solving Contextual POMDP via Information-Directed Objective
summary: We study the policy synthesis problem in contextual partially observable Markov decision processes (CPOMDPs), where the environment is governed by an unknown latent context that induces distinct POMDP dynamics. Our goal is to design a policy that simultaneously maximizes cumulative return and actively reduces uncertainty about the underlying context. We introduce an information-directed objective that augments reward maximization with mutual information between the latent context and the agent's observations. We develop the C-IDS algorithm to synthesize policies that maximize the information-directed objective. We show that the objective can be interpreted as a Lagrangian relaxation of the linear information ratio and prove that the temperature parameter is an upper bound on the information ratio. Based on this characterization, we establish a sublinear Bayesian regret bound over K episodes. We evaluate our approach on a continuous Light-Dark environment and show that it consistently outperforms standard POMDP solvers that treat the unknown context as a latent state variable, achieving faster context identification and higher returns.
summary_zh: 我们研究了上下文部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程(CPOMDPs)中的策略综合问题，其中环境由一个未知的潜在上下文控制，该上下文诱导了不同的POMDP动态。我们的目标是设计一种策略，能够同时最大化累积回报并主动减少对潜在上下文的不确定性。我们引入了一个信息导向的目标，该目标通过潜在上下文与agent的观测之间的互信息来增强奖励最大化。我们开发了C-IDS算法来综合最大化信息导向目标的策略。我们证明了该目标可以解释为线性信息比率的拉格朗日松弛，并证明了温度参数是信息比率的上限。基于此，我们建立了一个关于K个episode的次线性贝叶斯遗憾界。我们在连续的明暗环境中评估了我们的方法，并表明其性能始终优于将未知上下文视为潜在状态变量的标准POMDP求解器，从而实现了更快的上下文识别和更高的回报。
tldr: This paper introduces C-IDS, an algorithm for solving contextual POMDPs by maximizing a novel information-directed objective that balances reward and context uncertainty reduction, and demonstrates improved performance over standard POMDP solvers in a continuous environment.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为C-IDS的算法，用于解决上下文部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（CPOMDPs），通过最大化一个新的信息导向目标，平衡了奖励和上下文不确定性降低。在连续环境中，C-IDS算法的性能优于标准POMDP求解器。

title: Robust Intervention Learning from Emergency Stop Interventions
summary: Human interventions are a common source of data in autonomous systems during testing. These interventions provide an important signal about where the current policy needs improvement, but are often noisy and incomplete. We define Robust Intervention Learning (RIL) as the problem of learning from intervention data while remaining robust to the quality and informativeness of the intervention signal. In the best case, interventions are precise and avoiding them is sufficient to solve the task, but in many realistic settings avoiding interventions is necessary but not sufficient for achieving good performance. We study robust intervention learning in the context of emergency stop interventions and propose Residual Intervention Fine-Tuning (RIFT), a residual fine-tuning algorithm that treats intervention feedback as an incomplete learning signal and explicitly combines it with a prior policy. By framing intervention learning as a fine-tuning problem, our approach leverages structure encoded in the prior policy to resolve ambiguity when intervention signals under-specify the task. We provide theoretical analysis characterizing conditions under which this formulation yields principled policy improvement, and identify regimes where intervention learning is expected to fail. Our experiments reveal that residual fine-tuning enables robust and consistent policy improvement across a range of intervention strategies and prior policy qualities, and highlight robust intervention learning as a promising direction for future work.
summary_zh:
摘要：
人为干预是自主系统测试中常见的数据来源。这些干预提供了重要的信号，指示当前策略需要改进的地方，但通常存在噪声和不完整性。我们将稳健干预学习（RIL）定义为从干预数据中学习，同时保持对干预信号质量和信息量的鲁棒性。在最佳情况下，干预是精确的，避免干预足以解决任务，但在许多现实场景中，避免干预对于实现良好性能是必要的，但并不充分。我们研究了在紧急停止干预背景下的稳健干预学习，并提出了残差干预微调（RIFT），这是一种残差微调算法，将干预反馈视为不完整的学习信号，并将其与先验策略显式地结合。通过将干预学习构建为微调问题，我们的方法利用编码在先验策略中的结构来解决干预信号对任务描述不足时的模糊性。我们提供了理论分析，描述了该公式产生有原则的策略改进的条件，并识别了干预学习预计会失败的范围。我们的实验表明，残差微调能够在各种干预策略和先验策略质量下实现稳健且一致的策略改进，并突出了稳健干预学习作为未来研究的一个有希望的方向。
tldr: The paper introduces Robust Intervention Learning (RIL) for autonomous systems, specifically in the context of emergency stop interventions, and proposes Residual Intervention Fine-Tuning (RIFT), demonstrating improved policy learning across various intervention strategies and prior policy qualities.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了自主系统的鲁棒干预学习 (RIL)，特别是在紧急停止干预的背景下，并提出了残差干预微调 (RIFT)，展示了跨各种干预策略和先验策略质量的改进策略学习。

title: A Unified Complementarity-based Approach for Rigid-Body Manipulation and Motion Prediction
summary: Robotic manipulation in unstructured environments requires planners to reason jointly about free-space motion and sustained, frictional contact with the environment. Existing (local) planning and simulation frameworks typically separate these regimes or rely on simplified contact representations, particularly when modeling non-convex or distributed contact patches. Such approximations limit the fidelity of contact-mode transitions and hinder the robust execution of contact-rich behaviors in real time. This paper presents a unified discrete-time modeling framework for robotic manipulation that consistently captures both free motion and frictional contact within a single mathematical formalism (Unicomp). Building on complementarity-based rigid-body dynamics, we formulate free-space motion and contact interactions as coupled linear and nonlinear complementarity problems, enabling principled transitions between contact modes without enforcing fixed-contact assumptions. For planar patch contact, we derive a frictional contact model from the maximum power dissipation principle in which the set of admissible contact wrenches is represented by an ellipsoidal limit surface. This representation captures coupled force-moment effects, including torsional friction, while remaining agnostic to the underlying pressure distribution across the contact patch. The resulting formulation yields a discrete-time predictive model that relates generalized velocities and contact wrenches through quadratic constraints and is suitable for real-time optimization-based planning. Experimental results show that the proposed approach enables stable, physically consistent behavior at interactive speeds across tasks, from planar pushing to contact-rich whole-body maneuvers.
summary_zh: 在非结构化环境中进行机器人操作需要规划器联合推理自由空间运动和与环境发生的持续摩擦接触。现有的（局部）规划和仿真框架通常将这些状态分开处理，或依赖于简化的接触表示，特别是在对非凸或分布式接触区域建模时。这些近似限制了接触模式转换的保真度，并阻碍了实时鲁棒地执行富接触行为。本文提出了一种用于机器人操作的统一离散时间建模框架，该框架在单一数学形式主义（Unicomp）中一致地捕捉自由运动和摩擦接触。基于互补刚体动力学，我们将自由空间运动和接触交互形式化为耦合的线性与非线性互补问题，从而在不强制固定接触假设的情况下，实现接触模式之间的可靠转换。对于平面区域接触，我们从最大功率耗散原理推导出摩擦接触模型，其中允许的接触力/力矩集由椭圆形极限曲面表示。该表示捕捉了耦合的力-力矩效应，包括扭转摩擦，同时保持了对接触区域底层压力分布的不可知性。由此产生的公式产生了一个离散时间预测模型，该模型通过二次约束将广义速度和接触力/力矩相关联，适用于基于优化的实时规划。实验结果表明，所提出的方法能够在各种任务中，以交互速度实现稳定且物理一致的行为，包括从平面推动到富接触全身机动。
tldr: This paper presents a unified framework, Unicomp, for robotic manipulation that models both free motion and frictional contact using complementarity-based rigid-body dynamics, enabling real-time optimization-based planning for contact-rich tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个统一的框架Unicomp，用于机器人操作，该框架使用基于互补性的刚体动力学来建模自由运动和摩擦接触，从而可以对接触丰富的任务进行基于实时优化的规划。

title: Robot-Assisted Group Tours for Blind People
summary: Group interactions are essential to social functioning, yet effective engagement relies on the ability to recognize and interpret visual cues, making such engagement a significant challenge for blind people. In this paper, we investigate how a mobile robot can support group interactions for blind people. We used the scenario of a guided tour with mixed-visual groups involving blind and sighted visitors. Based on insights from an interview study with blind people (n=5) and museum experts (n=5), we designed and prototyped a robotic system that supported blind visitors to join group tours. We conducted a field study in a science museum where each blind participant (n=8) joined a group tour with one guide and two sighted participants (n=8). Findings indicated users' sense of safety from the robot's navigational support, concerns in the group participation, and preferences for obtaining environmental information. We present design implications for future robotic systems to support blind people's mixed-visual group participation.
summary_zh: 群体互动对社会功能至关重要，然而有效的参与依赖于识别和解读视觉线索的能力，这使得这种参与对于盲人来说是一个重大挑战。本文研究了移动机器人如何能够支持盲人的群体互动。我们采用了包含盲人和视力正常参观者的混合视觉群体导览场景。基于对盲人（n=5）和博物馆专家（n=5）的访谈研究洞见，我们设计并原型化了一个机器人系统，以支持盲人参与团体旅行。我们在科学博物馆进行了一项实地研究，其中每位盲人参与者（n=8）加入了一个由一名导游和两名视力正常参与者（n=8）组成的团体旅行。研究结果表明，用户对机器人导航支持的安全感、群体参与中的顾虑以及获取环境信息的偏好。我们提出了未来机器人系统支持盲人混合视觉群体参与的设计启示。
tldr: This paper presents a robotic system designed to assist blind individuals in participating in mixed-visual group tours, evaluating its impact on navigation, group interaction, and information access through a field study.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种机器人系统，旨在帮助盲人参与混合视觉人群的团体旅游，通过实地研究评估其对导航、群体互动和信息获取的影响。

title: Beyond Ground: Map-Free LiDAR Relocalization for UAVs
summary: Localization is a fundamental capability in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) systems. Map-free LiDAR relocalization offers an effective solution for achieving high-precision positioning in environments with weak or unavailable GNSS signals. However, existing LiDAR relocalization methods are primarily tailored to autonomous driving, exhibiting significantly degraded accuracy in UAV scenarios. In this paper, we propose MAILS, a novel map-free LiDAR relocalization framework for UAVs. A Locality-Preserving Sliding Window Attention module is first introduced to extract locally discriminative geometric features from sparse point clouds. To handle substantial yaw rotations and altitude variations encountered during UAV flight, we then design a coordinate-independent feature initialization module and a locally invariant positional encoding mechanism, which together significantly enhance the robustness of feature extraction.
