Beyond the need for specialized manipulation skills, effective information gathering is important in completing these assignments. To address this component of the problem, we formalize the information-gathering process in a fully cooperative setting as an underexplored multi-agent multi-task Embodied Question Answering (MM-EQA) problem, which is a novel extension of canonical Embodied Question Answering (EQA), where effective communication is crucial for coordinating efforts without redundancy. To address this problem, we propose CommCP, a novel LLM-based decentralized communication framework designed for MM-EQA. Our framework employs conformal prediction to calibrate the generated messages, thereby minimizing receiver distractions and enhancing communication reliability. To evaluate our framework, we introduce an MM-EQA benchmark featuring diverse, photo-realistic household scenarios with embodied questions. Experimental results demonstrate that CommCP significantly enhances the task success rate and exploration efficiency over baselines. The experiment videos, code, and dataset are available on our project website: https://comm-cp.github.io.
summary_zh: 为了完成人类以自然语言提供的任务，机器人必须理解指令，生成并回答与场景理解相关的提问，并操纵目标物体。现实世界的部署通常需要多个具有不同操作能力的异构机器人协同合作来处理不同的任务。除了需要专门的操作技能外，有效的信息收集对于完成这些任务也很重要。为了解决这一问题，我们将完全合作环境下的信息收集过程形式化为一个尚未充分探索的多智能体多任务具身问答（MM-EQA）问题，这是经典具身问答（EQA）的一个新的扩展，其中有效的沟通对于协调工作，避免冗余至关重要。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了CommCP，一种基于大型语言模型（LLM）的新型去中心化通信框架，专为MM-EQA设计。 我们的框架采用保角预测来校准生成的消息，从而最大限度地减少接收者的干扰，并提高通信的可靠性。为了评估我们的框架，我们引入了一个MM-EQA基准，其中包含具有具身问题的多样化、逼真的家庭场景。实验结果表明，与基线相比，CommCP显著提高了任务成功率和探索效率。 实验视频、代码和数据集可在我们的项目网站上找到：https://comm-cp.github.io。
tldr: The paper introduces CommCP, a novel LLM-based decentralized communication framework using conformal prediction for multi-agent multi-task Embodied Question Answering (MM-EQA), and demonstrates its effectiveness on a new benchmark with improved task success and exploration efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CommCP，一种新颖的基于LLM的分布式通信框架，它使用共形预测来进行多智能体多任务具身问答（MM-EQA）。实验结果表明，在新的benchmark上，CommCP能显著提高任务成功率和探索效率。

title: InterPrior: Scaling Generative Control for Physics-Based Human-Object Interactions
summary: Humans rarely plan whole-body interactions with objects at the level of explicit whole-body movements. High-level intentions, such as affordance, define the goal, while coordinated balance, contact, and manipulation can emerge naturally from underlying physical and motor priors. Scaling such priors is key to enabling humanoids to compose and generalize loco-manipulation skills across diverse contexts while maintaining physically coherent whole-body coordination. To this end, we introduce InterPrior, a scalable framework that learns a unified generative controller through large-scale imitation pretraining and post-training by reinforcement learning. InterPrior first distills a full-reference imitation expert into a versatile, goal-conditioned variational policy that reconstructs motion from multimodal observations and high-level intent. While the distilled policy reconstructs training behaviors, it does not generalize reliably due to the vast configuration space of large-scale human-object interactions. To address this, we apply data augmentation with physical perturbations, and then perform reinforcement learning finetuning to improve competence on unseen goals and initializations. Together, these steps consolidate the reconstructed latent skills into a valid manifold, yielding a motion prior that generalizes beyond the training data, e.g., it can incorporate new behaviors such as interactions with unseen objects. We further demonstrate its effectiveness for user-interactive control and its potential for real robot deployment.
summary_zh: 人类极少在显式全身运动的层面上规划与物体的全身交互。诸如可供性之类的高层意图定义了目标，而协调的平衡、接触和操控则可以自然地从潜在的物理和运动先验中涌现。扩展这些先验是使人形机器人能够在各种环境中组合和泛化loco-manipulation（移动操作）技能，同时保持物理上连贯的全身协调的关键。为此，我们引入了InterPrior，这是一个可扩展的框架，通过大规模模仿预训练和强化学习后训练来学习统一的生成控制器。InterPrior首先将一个全参考模仿专家提炼成一个通用的、目标条件化的变分策略，该策略从多模态观察和高层意图中重建运动。虽然提炼出的策略重建了训练行为，但由于大规模人-物交互的巨大配置空间，它不能可靠地泛化。为了解决这个问题，我们应用带有物理扰动的数据增强，然后进行强化学习微调，以提高在未见过的目标和初始化条件下的能力。总而言之，这些步骤将重建的潜在技能整合到一个有效的流形中，产生一个超越训练数据的运动先验，例如，它可以整合新的行为，如与未见过的物体的交互。我们进一步证明了其在用户交互控制中的有效性以及在真实机器人部署中的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces InterPrior, a framework for learning a unified generative controller for physics-based human-object interactions, using imitation pretraining and reinforcement learning finetuning to achieve scalable and generalizable loco-manipulation skills.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为InterPrior的框架，用于学习基于物理的人-物交互的统一生成控制器，通过模仿预训练和强化学习微调来实现可扩展和可泛化的loco-manipulation技能。

title: Visuo-Tactile World Models
summary: We introduce multi-task Visuo-Tactile World Models (VT-WM), which capture the physics of contact through touch reasoning. By complementing vision with tactile sensing, VT-WM better understands robot-object interactions in contact-rich tasks, avoiding common failure modes of vision-only models under occlusion or ambiguous contact states, such as objects disappearing, teleporting, or moving in ways that violate basic physics. Trained across a set of contact-rich manipulation tasks, VT-WM improves physical fidelity in imagination, achieving 33% better performance at maintaining object permanence and 29% better compliance with the laws of motion in autoregressive rollouts. Moreover, experiments show that grounding in contact dynamics also translates to planning. In zero-shot real-robot experiments, VT-WM achieves up to 35% higher success rates, with the largest gains in multi-step, contact-rich tasks. Finally, VT-WM demonstrates significant downstream versatility, effectively adapting its learned contact dynamics to a novel task and achieving reliable planning success with only a limited set of demonstrations.
summary_zh: 我们引入了多任务视觉-触觉世界模型（VT-WM），它通过触觉推理来捕捉接触物理特性。通过利用触觉感知补充视觉，VT-WM更好地理解了富接触任务中的机器人-物体交互，避免了纯视觉模型在遮挡或模糊接触状态下的常见失效模式，例如物体消失、瞬移或以违反基本物理规律的方式移动。通过在一系列富接触操作任务中进行训练，VT-WM提高了想象中的物理保真度，在自回归展开中，保持物体永久性的性能提高了33%，对运动定律的遵守程度提高了29%。此外，实验表明，基于接触动力学的决策规划也有效。在零样本真实机器人实验中，VT-WM的成功率提高了35%，在多步骤、富接触任务中增益最为显著。最后，VT-WM表现出显著的下游通用性，能够有效地将其学习到的接触动力学适应于新任务，并仅通过少量演示即可实现可靠的规划成功。
tldr: The paper introduces Visuo-Tactile World Models (VT-WM) that integrate tactile sensing with vision to improve robot-object interaction in contact-rich tasks, demonstrating better physical fidelity, planning, and zero-shot transfer to real robots.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了视觉-触觉世界模型 (VT-WM)，通过结合触觉感知和视觉来改善机器人在接触丰富的任务中的对象交互，展示了更好的物理保真度、规划能力和到真实机器人的零样本迁移能力。

title: Extended to Reality: Prompt Injection in 3D Environments
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced the capabilities to interpret and act on visual input in 3D environments, empowering diverse applications such as robotics and situated conversational agents. When MLLMs reason over camera-captured views of the physical world, a new attack surface emerges: an attacker can place text-bearing physical objects in the environment to override MLLMs' intended task. While prior work has studied prompt injection in the text domain and through digitally edited 2D images, it remains unclear how these attacks function in 3D physical environments. To bridge the gap, we introduce PI3D, a prompt injection attack against MLLMs in 3D environments, realized through text-bearing physical object placement rather than digital image edits. We formulate and solve the problem of identifying an effective 3D object pose (position and orientation) with injected text, where the attacker's goal is to induce the MLLM to perform the injected task while ensuring that the object placement remains physically plausible. Experiments demonstrate that PI3D is an effective attack against multiple MLLMs under diverse camera trajectories. We further evaluate existing defenses and show that they are insufficient to defend against PI3D.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）已在理解和作用于3D环境中的视觉输入方面取得了进展，从而推动了机器人和情境会话代理等多种应用。当MLLM推理物理世界的摄像头捕获视图时，出现了一个新的攻击面：攻击者可以在环境中放置带有文本的物理对象，以覆盖MLLM的预期任务。虽然先前的工作已经研究了文本领域以及通过数字编辑的2D图像的提示注入攻击，但这些攻击如何在3D物理环境中发挥作用仍不清楚。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了PI3D，这是一种针对3D环境中MLLM的提示注入攻击，通过带有文本的物理对象放置而非数字图像编辑来实现。我们制定并解决了识别带有注入文本的有效3D对象姿态（位置和方向）的问题，其中攻击者的目标是诱导MLLM执行注入的任务，同时确保对象放置在物理上是合理的。实验表明，PI3D是一种有效的攻击，能够对抗多种在不同摄像头轨迹下的MLLM。我们进一步评估了现有的防御措施，并表明它们不足以防御PI3D。
tldr: This paper introduces PI3D, a novel prompt injection attack that leverages text-bearing physical objects in 3D environments to manipulate multimodal LLMs, demonstrating its effectiveness and the limitations of current defenses.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了PI3D，一种新型的提示注入攻击，它利用3D环境中的文本物理对象来操纵多模态LLM，证明了其有效性以及当前防御措施的局限性。

title: From Features to Actions: Explainability in Traditional and Agentic AI Systems
summary:
Over the last decade, explainable AI has primarily focused on interpreting individual model predictions, producing post-hoc explanations that relate inputs to outputs under a fixed decision structure. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agentic AI systems whose behaviour unfolds over multi-step trajectories. In these settings, success and failure are determined by sequences of decisions rather than a single output. While useful, it remains unclear how explanation approaches designed for static predictions translate to agentic settings where behaviour emerges over time. In this work, we bridge the gap between static and agentic explainability by comparing attribution-based explanations with trace-based diagnostics across both settings. To make this distinction explicit, we empirically compare attribution-based explanations used in static classification tasks with trace-based diagnostics used in agentic benchmarks (TAU-bench Airline and AssistantBench). Our results show that while attribution methods achieve stable feature rankings in static settings (Spearman $ρ= 0.86$), they cannot be applied reliably to diagnose execution-level failures in agentic trajectories. In contrast, trace-grounded rubric evaluation for agentic settings consistently localizes behaviour breakdowns and reveals that state tracking inconsistency is 2.7$\times$ more prevalent in failed runs and reduces success probability by 49\%. These findings motivate a shift towards trajectory-level explainability for agentic systems when evaluating and diagnosing autonomous AI behaviour.
  Resources:
  https://github.com/VectorInstitute/unified-xai-evaluation-framework https://vectorinstitute.github.io/unified-xai-evaluation-framework
summary_zh:
过去十年中，可解释人工智能主要集中于解释单个模型预测，产生后验解释，这些解释在固定的决策结构下将输入与输出联系起来。大型语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展推动了智能体AI系统的发展，其行为在多步轨迹中展开。在这种情境下，成功和失败取决于一系列决策，而非单一输出。虽然有价值，但为静态预测设计的解释方法如何转化为智能体情境，行为随时间推移而涌现，仍然不清楚。在这项工作中，我们通过比较基于归因的解释和基于轨迹的诊断，弥合了静态和智能体可解释性之间的差距。为了明确区分这一点，我们实证性地比较了用于静态分类任务的基于归因的解释和用于智能体基准测试（TAU-bench Airline 和 AssistantBench）的基于轨迹的诊断。我们的结果表明，虽然归因方法在静态环境中实现了稳定的特征排序（Spearman $ρ= 0.86$），但它们不能可靠地应用于诊断智能体轨迹中的执行级故障。相比之下，智能体情境下基于轨迹的评估能够一致地定位行为崩溃，并揭示状态跟踪不一致在失败运行中更为普遍（占比2.7倍），并降低成功概率达49%。这些发现推动了在评估和诊断自主AI行为时，转向智能体系统的轨迹级可解释性。
  资源：
  https://github.com/VectorInstitute/unified-xai-evaluation-framework https://vectorinstitute.github.io/unified-xai-evaluation-framework
tldr: This paper compares attribution-based explanations in static classification with trace-based diagnostics in agentic AI systems, finding that attribution methods are unreliable for diagnosing execution failures in agentic trajectories, motivating a shift towards trajectory-level explainability.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了静态分类中基于属性的解释与智能体AI系统中基于轨迹的诊断，发现属性方法无法可靠地诊断智能体轨迹中的执行故障，从而推动了向智能体系统的轨迹级别可解释性的转变。

title: ScaleEnv: Scaling Environment Synthesis from Scratch for Generalist Interactive Tool-Use Agent Training
summary: Training generalist agents capable of adapting to diverse scenarios requires interactive environments for self-exploration. However, interactive environments remain critically scarce, and existing synthesis methods suffer from significant limitations regarding environmental diversity and scalability. To address these challenges, we introduce ScaleEnv, a framework that constructs fully interactive environments and verifiable tasks entirely from scratch. Specifically, ScaleEnv ensures environment reliability through procedural testing, and guarantees task completeness and solvability via tool dependency graph expansion and executable action verification. By enabling agents to learn through exploration within ScaleEnv, we demonstrate significant performance improvements on unseen, multi-turn tool-use benchmarks such as $τ^2$-Bench and VitaBench, highlighting strong generalization capabilities. Furthermore, we investigate the relationship between increasing number of domains and model generalization performance, providing empirical evidence that scaling environmental diversity is critical for robust agent learning.
summary_zh: 训练能够适应各种场景的通用智能体需要用于自我探索的交互式环境。然而，交互式环境仍然极度稀缺，并且现有的合成方法在环境多样性和可扩展性方面存在显著限制。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了ScaleEnv，一个从头构建完全交互式环境和可验证任务的框架。具体而言，ScaleEnv通过程序化测试确保环境的可靠性，并通过工具依赖关系图扩展和可执行动作验证保证任务的完整性和可解性。通过使智能体在ScaleEnv中探索学习，我们在未见过的多轮工具使用基准测试（例如$τ^2$-Bench和VitaBench）上展示了显著的性能提升，突出了强大的泛化能力。此外，我们研究了增加领域数量与模型泛化性能之间的关系，提供了经验证据表明，扩展环境多样性对于鲁棒的智能体学习至关重要。
tldr: The paper introduces ScaleEnv, a framework for generating diverse and scalable interactive environments from scratch, enabling the training of generalist agents with improved generalization on tool-use benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ScaleEnv，一个从零开始生成多样化且可扩展的交互式环境的框架，从而能够训练在工具使用基准测试中具有改进泛化能力的通用智能体。

title: Generating Data-Driven Reasoning Rubrics for Domain-Adaptive Reward Modeling
summary: An impediment to using Large Language Models (LLMs) for reasoning output verification is that LLMs struggle to reliably identify errors in thinking traces, particularly in long outputs, domains requiring expert knowledge, and problems without verifiable rewards. We propose a data-driven approach to automatically construct highly granular reasoning error taxonomies to enhance LLM-driven error detection on unseen reasoning traces. Our findings indicate that classification approaches that leverage these error taxonomies, or "rubrics", demonstrate strong error identification compared to baseline methods in technical domains like coding, math, and chemical engineering. These rubrics can be used to build stronger LLM-as-judge reward functions for reasoning model training via reinforcement learning. Experimental results show that these rewards have the potential to improve models' task accuracy on difficult domains over models trained by general LLMs-as-judges by +45%, and approach performance of models trained by verifiable rewards while using as little as 20% as many gold labels. Through our approach, we extend the usage of reward rubrics from assessing qualitative model behavior to assessing quantitative model correctness on tasks typically learned via RLVR rewards. This extension opens the door for teaching models to solve complex technical problems without a full dataset of gold labels, which are often highly costly to procure.
summary_zh: 使用大型语言模型(LLM)进行推理输出验证的一个障碍是，LLM难以可靠地识别思维轨迹中的错误，尤其是在长输出、需要专家知识的领域以及没有可验证奖励的问题中。我们提出了一种数据驱动的方法，用于自动构建高度精细化的推理错误分类法，以增强LLM驱动的对未见推理轨迹的错误检测能力。我们的研究结果表明，与基线方法相比，利用这些错误分类法，或“评分标准”，的分类方法在编码、数学和化学工程等技术领域表现出强大的错误识别能力。这些评分标准可用于构建更强大的LLM作为裁判的奖励函数，以通过强化学习进行推理模型训练。实验结果表明，与通过通用LLM作为裁判训练的模型相比，这些奖励函数有潜力将模型在困难领域上的任务准确率提高+45%，并且在使用仅20%的黄金标签的情况下，接近通过可验证奖励训练的模型的性能。通过我们的方法，我们将奖励评分标准的使用从评估定性模型行为扩展到评估通常通过RLVR奖励学习的任务中的定量模型正确性。这种扩展为在没有完整黄金标签数据集的情况下，教授模型解决复杂技术问题打开了大门，而这些黄金标签的获取通常成本高昂。
tldr: The paper introduces a data-driven approach to generate reasoning rubrics for improving LLM-based error detection in reasoning traces, leading to better reward modeling and performance in complex technical domains. The method reduces the reliance on costly labeled data for reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种数据驱动的方法来生成用于改进LLM推理轨迹中错误检测的推理规则，从而在复杂技术领域实现更好的奖励建模和性能。该方法减少了对强化学习中昂贵标记数据的依赖。

title: SPARC: Separating Perception And Reasoning Circuits for Test-time Scaling of VLMs
summary: Despite recent successes, test-time scaling - i.e., dynamically expanding the token budget during inference as needed - remains brittle for vision-language models (VLMs): unstructured chains-of-thought about images entangle perception and reasoning, leading to long, disorganized contexts where small perceptual mistakes may cascade into completely wrong answers. Moreover, expensive reinforcement learning with hand-crafted rewards is required to achieve good performance. Here, we introduce SPARC (Separating Perception And Reasoning Circuits), a modular framework that explicitly decouples visual perception from reasoning. Inspired by sequential sensory-to-cognitive processing in the brain, SPARC implements a two-stage pipeline where the model first performs explicit visual search to localize question-relevant regions, then conditions its reasoning on those regions to produce the final answer. This separation enables independent test-time scaling with asymmetric compute allocation (e.g., prioritizing perceptual processing under distribution shift), supports selective optimization (e.g., improving the perceptual stage alone when it is the bottleneck for end-to-end performance), and accommodates compressed contexts by running global search at lower image resolutions and allocating high-resolution processing only to selected regions, thereby reducing total visual tokens count and compute. Across challenging visual reasoning benchmarks, SPARC outperforms monolithic baselines and strong visual-grounding approaches. For instance, SPARC improves the accuracy of Qwen3VL-4B on the $V^*$ VQA benchmark by 6.7 percentage points, and it surpasses "thinking with images" by 4.6 points on a challenging OOD task despite requiring a 200$\times$ lower token budget.
summary_zh: 尽管近期取得了一些成功，但测试时缩放——即在推理过程中根据需要动态扩展token预算——对于视觉语言模型（VLMs）而言仍然很脆弱：关于图像的非结构化思维链会纠缠感知和推理，导致冗长、无序的上下文，其中微小的感知错误可能会级联成完全错误的答案。此外，获得良好的性能，还需要通过手工设计的奖励进行昂贵的强化学习。在此，我们介绍SPARC（分离感知和推理回路），这是一个模块化框架，它显式地将视觉感知与推理解耦。受到大脑中顺序感觉-认知处理的启发，SPARC实现了一个两阶段流程：模型首先执行显式视觉搜索以定位与问题相关的区域，然后基于这些区域进行推理，以产生最终答案。这种分离能够实现独立的测试时缩放，具有非对称的计算资源分配（例如，在分布偏移下优先考虑感知处理），支持选择性优化（例如，当感知阶段是端到端性能的瓶颈时，单独改进它），并且通过在较低图像分辨率下运行全局搜索并将高分辨率处理仅分配给选定区域来适应压缩上下文，从而降低总视觉token数量和计算量。在具有挑战性的视觉推理基准测试中，SPARC优于单体基线模型和强大的视觉 grounding 方法。例如，SPARC在$V^*$ VQA基准测试中将Qwen3VL-4B的准确率提高了6.7个百分点，并且在一个具有挑战性的OOD任务中，它超越了“图像思考” 4.6个点，尽管它需要的token预算降低了200倍。
tldr: The paper introduces SPARC, a modular VLM framework that separates visual perception and reasoning into a two-stage pipeline, enabling test-time scaling, selective optimization, and reduced compute, achieving strong performance on visual reasoning benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为SPARC的模块化视觉语言模型框架，该框架将视觉感知和推理分离为两阶段流程，从而实现测试时扩展、选择性优化和降低计算需求，并在视觉推理基准测试中实现了强大的性能。

title: SeeUPO: Sequence-Level Agentic-RL with Convergence Guarantees
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as the predominant paradigm for training large language model (LLM)-based AI agents. However, existing backbone RL algorithms lack verified convergence guarantees in agentic scenarios, especially in multi-turn settings, which can lead to training instability and failure to converge to optimal policies.
  In this paper, we systematically analyze how different combinations of policy update mechanisms and advantage estimation methods affect convergence properties in single/multi-turn scenarios. We find that REINFORCE with Group Relative Advantage Estimation (GRAE) can converge to the globally optimal under undiscounted conditions, but the combination of PPO & GRAE breaks PPO's original monotonic improvement property. Furthermore, we demonstrate that mainstream backbone RL algorithms cannot simultaneously achieve both critic-free and convergence guarantees in multi-turn scenarios.
  To address this, we propose SeeUPO (Sequence-level Sequential Update Policy Optimization), a critic-free approach with convergence guarantees for multi-turn interactions. SeeUPO models multi-turn interaction as sequentially executed multi-agent bandit problems. Through turn-by-turn sequential policy updates in reverse execution order, it ensures monotonic improvement and convergence to global optimal solution via backward induction.
  Experiments on AppWorld and BFCL v4 demonstrate SeeUPO's substantial improvements over existing backbone algorithms: relative gains of 43.3%-54.6% on Qwen3-14B and 24.1%-41.9% on Qwen2.5-14B (averaged across benchmarks), along with superior training stability.
summary_zh:
强化学习（RL）已成为训练基于大型语言模型（LLM）的人工智能代理的主要范例。然而，现有的主干强化学习算法在代理场景中缺乏经过验证的收敛性保证，尤其是在多轮设置中，这可能导致训练不稳定和未能收敛到最佳策略。

  在本文中，我们系统地分析了不同的策略更新机制和优势估计方法如何影响单轮/多轮场景中的收敛特性。我们发现，使用分组相对优势估计（GRAE）的REINFORCE算法可以在非折扣条件下收敛到全局最优解，但PPO与GRAE的结合打破了PPO最初的单调改进特性。此外，我们证明了主流主干强化学习算法无法在多轮场景中同时实现无评论家和收敛性保证。

  为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种具有多轮交互收敛性保证的无评论家方法：SeeUPO（序列级序贯更新策略优化）。SeeUPO将多轮交互建模为顺序执行的多智能体bandit问题。通过以反向执行顺序逐轮地进行序列策略更新，它利用反向归纳确保了单调改进并收敛到全局最优解。

  在AppWorld和BFCL v4上的实验表明，SeeUPO对现有主干算法有显著改进：在Qwen3-14B上相对提升了43.3%-54.6%，在Qwen2.5-14B上相对提升了24.1%-41.9%（跨基准测试的平均值），同时具有卓越的训练稳定性。
tldr: The paper introduces SeeUPO, a novel critic-free reinforcement learning algorithm with convergence guarantees for LLM-based agents in multi-turn settings, demonstrating significant performance improvements over existing methods. It addresses training instability issues found in mainstream RL algorithms in agentic scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 SeeUPO 的新型无评论家强化学习算法，该算法为基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体在多轮交互中提供了收敛保证，并显示出比现有方法显着的性能改进。它解决了主流 RL 算法在智能体场景中发现的训练不稳定问题。

title: Progress Constraints for Reinforcement Learning in Behavior Trees
summary: Behavior Trees (BTs) provide a structured and reactive framework for decision-making, commonly used to switch between sub-controllers based on environmental conditions. Reinforcement Learning (RL), on the other hand, can learn near-optimal controllers but sometimes struggles with sparse rewards, safe exploration, and long-horizon credit assignment. Combining BTs with RL has the potential for mutual benefit: a BT design encodes structured domain knowledge that can simplify RL training, while RL enables automatic learning of the controllers within BTs. However, naive integration of BTs and RL can lead to some controllers counteracting other controllers, possibly undoing previously achieved subgoals, thereby degrading the overall performance. To address this, we propose progress constraints, a novel mechanism where feasibility estimators constrain the allowed action set based on theoretical BT convergence results. Empirical evaluations in a 2D proof-of-concept and a high-fidelity warehouse environment demonstrate improved performance, sample efficiency, and constraint satisfaction, compared to prior methods of BT-RL integration.
summary_zh: 行为树 (BTs) 为决策提供了一个结构化和反应式的框架，通常用于根据环境条件在子控制器之间切换。另一方面，强化学习 (RL) 可以学习接近最优的控制器，但有时会面临稀疏奖励、安全探索和长时程信用分配的挑战。将 BTs 与 RL 结合具有互惠互利的可能性：BT 设计可以编码结构化的领域知识，从而简化 RL 训练，而 RL 能够自动学习 BTs 内部的控制器。然而，BTs 和 RL 的简单集成可能会导致一些控制器相互对抗，可能撤销先前实现的子目标，从而降低整体性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种名为进度约束的新机制，其中可行性估计器根据理论上的 BT 收敛结果来约束允许的动作集。在二维概念验证和高保真仓库环境中的实证评估表明，与以前的 BT-RL 集成方法相比，我们的方法在性能、样本效率和约束满足方面都有所提高。
tldr: This paper introduces progress constraints for Reinforcement Learning in Behavior Trees to prevent controller counteraction and improve performance, sample efficiency, and constraint satisfaction, demonstrated in 2D and warehouse environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于行为树中强化学习的进度约束方法，旨在防止控制器之间的相互抵消，并提高性能、样本效率和约束满足度。该方法在2D和仓库环境中得到了验证。

title: AgentCPM-Explore: Realizing Long-Horizon Deep Exploration for Edge-Scale Agents
summary: While Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have shown remarkable potential for solving complex tasks, existing systems remain heavily reliant on large-scale models, leaving the capabilities of edge-scale models largely underexplored. In this paper, we present the first systematic study on training agentic models at the 4B-parameter scale. We identify three primary bottlenecks hindering the performance of edge-scale models: catastrophic forgetting during Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), sensitivity to reward signal noise during Reinforcement Learning (RL), and reasoning degradation caused by redundant information in long-context scenarios. To address the issues, we propose AgentCPM-Explore, a compact 4B agent model with high knowledge density and strong exploration capability. We introduce a holistic training framework featuring parameter-space model fusion, reward signal denoising, and contextual information refinement. Through deep exploration, AgentCPM-Explore achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance among 4B-class models, matches or surpasses 8B-class SOTA models on four benchmarks, and even outperforms larger-scale models such as Claude-4.5-Sonnet or DeepSeek-v3.2 in five benchmarks. Notably, AgentCPM-Explore achieves 97.09% accuracy on GAIA text-based tasks under pass@64. These results provide compelling evidence that the bottleneck for edge-scale models is not their inherent capability ceiling, but rather their inference stability. Based on our well-established training framework, AgentCPM-Explore effectively unlocks the significant, yet previously underestimated, potential of edge-scale models.
summary_zh: 虽然基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体在解决复杂任务方面展现出卓越的潜力，但现有系统仍然严重依赖大规模模型，边缘规模模型的能力在很大程度上未被探索。在本文中，我们首次对训练40亿参数规模的智能体模型进行了系统性研究。我们确定了阻碍边缘规模模型性能的三个主要瓶颈：监督微调（SFT）期间的灾难性遗忘、强化学习（RL）期间对奖励信号噪声的敏感性，以及长上下文场景中冗余信息导致的推理退化。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了AgentCPM-Explore，一种紧凑的40亿参数智能体模型，具有高知识密度和强大的探索能力。我们引入了一个整体训练框架，包括参数空间模型融合、奖励信号去噪和上下文信息提炼。通过深度探索，AgentCPM-Explore在40亿参数级别模型中实现了最先进 (SOTA) 的性能，在四个基准测试中匹配或超越了 80 亿参数级别 SOTA 模型，甚至在五个基准测试中优于更大规模的模型，如 Claude-4.5-Sonnet 或 DeepSeek-v3.2。值得注意的是，AgentCPM-Explore在 pass@64 下的 GAIA 基于文本的任务上实现了 97.09% 的准确率。这些结果提供了令人信服的证据，表明边缘规模模型的瓶颈不是其固有的能力上限，而是其推理稳定性。基于我们完善的训练框架，AgentCPM-Explore 有效地释放了边缘规模模型显著但以前被低估的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces AgentCPM-Explore, a 4B-parameter agent model with a novel training framework that achieves SOTA performance on several benchmarks, demonstrating the potential of edge-scale models.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了AgentCPM-Explore，一个具有新型训练框架的40亿参数规模的代理模型，在多个基准测试上实现了SOTA性能，展示了边缘设备模型的潜力。

title: TrajAD: Trajectory Anomaly Detection for Trustworthy LLM Agents
summary: We address the problem of runtime trajectory anomaly detection, a critical capability for enabling trustworthy LLM agents. Current safety measures predominantly focus on static input/output filtering. However, we argue that ensuring LLM agents reliability requires auditing the intermediate execution process. In this work, we formulate the task of Trajectory Anomaly Detection. The goal is not merely detection, but precise error localization. This capability is essential for enabling efficient rollback-and-retry. To achieve this, we construct TrajBench, a dataset synthesized via a perturb-and-complete strategy to cover diverse procedural anomalies. Using this benchmark, we investigate the capability of models in process supervision. We observe that general-purpose LLMs, even with zero-shot prompting, struggle to identify and localize these anomalies. This reveals that generalized capabilities do not automatically translate to process reliability. To address this, we propose TrajAD, a specialized verifier trained with fine-grained process supervision. Our approach outperforms baselines, demonstrating that specialized supervision is essential for building trustworthy agents.
summary_zh: 本文探讨了运行时轨迹异常检测问题，这是实现可信赖的大语言模型 (LLM) 代理的关键能力。当前的安全性措施主要集中在静态的输入/输出过滤上。然而，我们认为确保 LLM 代理的可靠性需要审计中间执行过程。本文正式提出了轨迹异常检测任务。目标不仅是检测，更是精确定位错误。这种能力对于实现高效的回滚重试机制至关重要。为了实现这一目标，我们构建了 TrajBench，一个通过扰动补全策略合成的数据集，以涵盖各种程序性异常。利用这一基准，我们研究了模型在过程监督方面的能力。我们观察到，即使使用零样本提示，通用 LLM 也难以识别和定位这些异常。这表明通用能力并不会自动转化为过程可靠性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 TrajAD，一个经过细粒度过程监督训练的专门验证器。我们的方法优于基线方法，证明了专门的监督对于构建可信赖的代理至关重要。
tldr: The paper introduces TrajAD, a method for runtime anomaly detection in LLM agent trajectories, addressing the limitations of current static safety measures and the poor performance of general LLMs in process supervision. They also introduce TrajBench, a dataset synthesized for this purpose.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TrajAD，一种用于LLM Agent轨迹运行时异常检测的方法，解决了当前静态安全措施的局限性以及通用LLM在过程监督方面的表现不佳。同时他们引入了TrajBench，一个为此目的合成的数据集。

title: TrailBlazer: History-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Black-Box LLM Jailbreaking
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become integral to many domains, making their safety a critical priority. Prior jailbreaking research has explored diverse approaches, including prompt optimization, automated red teaming, obfuscation, and reinforcement learning (RL) based methods. However, most existing techniques fail to effectively leverage vulnerabilities revealed in earlier interaction turns, resulting in inefficient and unstable attacks. Since jailbreaking involves sequential interactions in which each response influences future actions, reinforcement learning provides a natural framework for this problem. Motivated by this, we propose a history-aware RL-based jailbreak framework that analyzes and reweights vulnerability signals from prior steps to guide future decisions. We show that incorporating historical information alone improves jailbreak success rates. Building on this insight, we introduce an attention-based reweighting mechanism that highlights critical vulnerabilities within the interaction history, enabling more efficient exploration with fewer queries. Extensive experiments on AdvBench and HarmBench demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art jailbreak performance while significantly improving query efficiency. These results underscore the importance of historical vulnerability signals in reinforcement learning-driven jailbreak strategies and offer a principled pathway for advancing adversarial research on LLM safeguards.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已经成为许多领域不可或缺的一部分，其安全性至关重要。先前的越狱研究已经探索了多种方法，包括提示优化、自动化红队、混淆和基于强化学习（RL）的方法。然而，大多数现有技术未能有效利用在早期交互轮次中暴露的漏洞，导致攻击效率低下且不稳定。由于越狱涉及顺序交互，其中每个响应都会影响未来的行动，因此强化学习为该问题提供了一个自然的框架。受此启发，我们提出了一种历史感知的基于RL的越狱框架，该框架分析并重新加权来自先前步骤的漏洞信号，以指导未来的决策。我们证明，仅纳入历史信息就能提高越狱成功率。基于这一洞察，我们 introduce了一种基于注意力的重新加权机制，该机制突出显示交互历史中的关键漏洞，从而能够以更少的查询进行更有效的探索。在AdvBench和HarmBench上的大量实验表明，我们的方法实现了最先进的越狱性能，同时显著提高了查询效率。这些结果强调了历史漏洞信号在强化学习驱动的越狱策略中的重要性，并为推进LLM安全防护方面的对抗性研究提供了一条有原则的途径。
tldr: The paper introduces TrailBlazer, a history-aware reinforcement learning framework for jailbreaking LLMs, which leverages vulnerability signals from past interactions to improve jailbreak success rates and query efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为TrailBlazer的、基于历史信息的强化学习框架，用于破解大型语言模型。该框架利用过去交互中的漏洞信号来提高破解成功率和查询效率。

title: MosaicThinker: On-Device Visual Spatial Reasoning for Embodied AI via Iterative Construction of Space Representation
summary: When embodied AI is expanding from traditional object detection and recognition to more advanced tasks of robot manipulation and actuation planning, visual spatial reasoning from the video inputs is necessary to perceive the spatial relationships of objects and guide device actions. However, existing visual language models (VLMs) have very weak capabilities in spatial reasoning due to the lack of knowledge about 3D spatial information, especially when the reasoning task involve complex spatial relations across multiple video frames. In this paper, we present a new inference-time computing technique for on-device embodied AI, namely \emph{MosaicThinker}, which enhances the on-device small VLM's spatial reasoning capabilities on difficult cross-frame reasoning tasks. Our basic idea is to integrate fragmented spatial information from multiple frames into a unified space representation of global semantic map, and further guide the VLM's spatial reasoning over the semantic map via a visual prompt. Experiment results show that our technique can greatly enhance the accuracy of cross-frame spatial reasoning on resource-constrained embodied AI devices, over reasoning tasks with diverse types and complexities.
summary_zh: 当具身人工智能从传统的物体检测和识别扩展到机器人操作和执行规划等更高级的任务时，从视频输入中进行视觉空间推理对于感知物体的空间关系和指导设备动作至关重要。然而，由于缺乏关于3D空间信息的知识，现有的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在空间推理方面能力非常薄弱，尤其是在推理任务涉及跨越多个视频帧的复杂空间关系时。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于端侧具身人工智能的新的推理时计算技术，即{\emph{MosaicThinker}}，它增强了端侧小型VLM在困难的跨帧推理任务上的空间推理能力。我们的基本思想是将来自多个帧的碎片化空间信息整合到全局语义地图的统一空间表示中，并通过视觉提示进一步引导VLM在语义地图上进行空间推理。实验结果表明，我们的技术可以极大地提高资源受限的具身AI设备上跨帧空间推理的准确性，适用于具有不同类型和复杂性的推理任务。
tldr: The paper introduces MosaicThinker, a method to improve spatial reasoning in VLMs for on-device embodied AI by creating a unified space representation from multiple frames and guiding VLM reasoning with visual prompts.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 MosaicThinker 的方法，通过从多个帧创建统一的空间表示，并使用视觉提示引导 VLM 推理，来提高 VLM 在设备上进行具身 AI 的空间推理能力。

title: Trifuse: Enhancing Attention-Based GUI Grounding via Multimodal Fusion
summary: GUI grounding maps natural language instructions to the correct interface elements, serving as the perception foundation for GUI agents. Existing approaches predominantly rely on fine-tuning multimodal large language models (MLLMs) using large-scale GUI datasets to predict target element coordinates, which is data-intensive and generalizes poorly to unseen interfaces. Recent attention-based alternatives exploit localization signals in MLLMs attention mechanisms without task-specific fine-tuning, but suffer from low reliability due to the lack of explicit and complementary spatial anchors in GUI images. To address this limitation, we propose Trifuse, an attention-based grounding framework that explicitly integrates complementary spatial anchors. Trifuse integrates attention, OCR-derived textual cues, and icon-level caption semantics via a Consensus-SinglePeak (CS) fusion strategy that enforces cross-modal agreement while retaining sharp localization peaks. Extensive evaluations on four grounding benchmarks demonstrate that Trifuse achieves strong performance without task-specific fine-tuning, substantially reducing the reliance on expensive annotated data. Moreover, ablation studies reveal that incorporating OCR and caption cues consistently improves attention-based grounding performance across different backbones, highlighting its effectiveness as a general framework for GUI grounding.
summary_zh: GUI接合（Grounding）将自然语言指令映射到正确的界面元素，作为GUI代理的感知基础。现有方法主要依赖于使用大规模GUI数据集对多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）进行微调，以预测目标元素的坐标，但这数据密集，且对未见过界面的泛化能力较差。最近基于注意力机制的替代方案利用MLLM注意力机制中的定位信号，而无需进行特定任务的微调，但由于GUI图像中缺乏明确且互补的空间锚点，导致可靠性较低。为了解决这个局限性，我们提出了Trifuse，一种基于注意力的接合框架，它显式地集成了互补的空间锚点。Trifuse通过共识-单峰（CS）融合策略整合注意力、OCR衍生的文本线索以及图标级描述语义，该策略强制执行跨模态一致性，同时保留清晰的定位峰值。在四个接合基准上的广泛评估表明，Trifuse在没有特定任务微调的情况下实现了强大的性能，大大降低了对昂贵标注数据的依赖。此外，消融研究表明，整合OCR和描述线索能够持续提高基于注意力的接合性能，适用于不同的骨干网络，突显了其作为GUI接合通用框架的有效性。
tldr: The paper proposes Trifuse, a novel attention-based framework for GUI grounding that integrates attention, OCR, and icon-level caption semantics to improve localization reliability without task-specific fine-tuning, achieving strong performance on several benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 Trifuse，一种新颖的基于注意力的 GUI grounding 框架，它整合了注意力机制、OCR 和图标级标题语义，以提高定位可靠性，无需针对特定任务进行微调，并在多个基准测试中取得了良好的性能。

title: The Optimal Token Baseline: Variance Reduction for Long-Horizon LLM-RL
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Large Language Models (LLMs) often suffers from training collapse in long-horizon tasks due to exploding gradient variance. To mitigate this, a baseline is commonly introduced for advantage computation; however, traditional value models remain difficult to optimize, and standard group-based baselines overlook sequence heterogeneity. Although classic optimal baseline theory can achieve global variance reduction, it neglects token heterogeneity and requires prohibitive gradient-based computation. In this work, we derive the Optimal Token Baseline (OTB) from first principles, proving that gradient updates should be weighted inversely to their cumulative gradient norm. To ensure efficiency, we propose the Logit-Gradient Proxy that approximates the gradient norm using only forward-pass probabilities. Our method achieves training stability and matches the performance of large group sizes ($N=32$) with only $N=4$, reducing token consumption by over 65% across single-turn and tool-integrated reasoning tasks.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的强化学习（RL）由于梯度方差爆炸，经常在长程任务中遭遇训练崩溃。为了缓解这个问题，通常引入基线来计算优势函数；然而，传统价值模型仍然难以优化，并且标准的分组基线忽略了序列异质性。虽然经典的最佳基线理论可以实现全局方差缩减，但它忽略了token异质性，并需要高昂的基于梯度的计算。在这项工作中，我们从第一性原理推导了最佳Token基线（OTB），证明梯度更新应该与其累积梯度范数成反比加权。为了确保效率，我们提出了Logit梯度代理，它仅使用前向传递概率来近似梯度范数。我们的方法实现了训练稳定性，并在单轮和工具集成推理任务中，以仅为N=4的分组大小匹配了大型分组（N=32）的性能，从而减少了超过65%的token消耗。
tldr: This paper introduces the Optimal Token Baseline (OTB) for LLM-RL, which reduces gradient variance during long-horizon tasks by weighting gradient updates inversely to their cumulative gradient norm, achieving improved training stability and efficiency compared to traditional methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了用于LLM-RL的Optimal Token Baseline (OTB)，通过对梯度更新进行加权，权重与累积梯度范数成反比，从而降低了长程任务中的梯度方差，与传统方法相比，实现了更好的训练稳定性和效率。

title: RuleSmith: Multi-Agent LLMs for Automated Game Balancing
summary: Game balancing is a longstanding challenge requiring repeated playtesting, expert intuition, and extensive manual tuning. We introduce RuleSmith, the first framework that achieves automated game balancing by leveraging the reasoning capabilities of multi-agent LLMs. It couples a game engine, multi-agent LLMs self-play, and Bayesian optimization operating over a multi-dimensional rule space. As a proof of concept, we instantiate RuleSmith on CivMini, a simplified civilization-style game containing heterogeneous factions, economy systems, production rules, and combat mechanics, all governed by tunable parameters. LLM agents interpret textual rulebooks and game states to generate actions, to conduct fast evaluation of balance metrics such as win-rate disparities. To search the parameter landscape efficiently, we integrate Bayesian optimization with acquisition-based adaptive sampling and discrete projection: promising candidates receive more evaluation games for accurate assessment, while exploratory candidates receive fewer games for efficient exploration. Experiments show that RuleSmith converges to highly balanced configurations and provides interpretable rule adjustments that can be directly applied to downstream game systems. Our results illustrate that LLM simulation can serve as a powerful surrogate for automating design and balancing in complex multi-agent environments.
summary_zh: 游戏平衡是一个长期存在的挑战，需要反复的试玩、专家直觉和大量的手动调整。我们引入 RuleSmith，这是第一个通过利用多智能体 LLM 的推理能力来实现游戏自动平衡的框架。它将游戏引擎、多智能体 LLM 自博弈以及在多维度规则空间上运行的贝叶斯优化相结合。作为概念验证，我们在 CivMini 上实例化了 RuleSmith，这是一个简化的文明风格游戏，包含异构派系、经济系统、生产规则和战斗机制，所有这些都受可调参数控制。LLM 智能体解释文字规则手册和游戏状态以生成行动，从而快速评估如胜率差异等平衡指标。为了有效地搜索参数空间，我们将贝叶斯优化与基于采集的自适应采样和离散投影相结合：有希望的候选者会收到更多的评估游戏以进行准确评估，而探索性候选者会收到较少的游戏以进行高效探索。实验表明，RuleSmith 收敛于高度平衡的配置，并提供可解释的规则调整，这些调整可以直接应用于下游游戏系统。我们的结果表明，LLM 模拟可以作为自动化复杂多智能体环境中设计和平衡的强大替代方案。
tldr: RuleSmith uses multi-agent LLMs and Bayesian optimization to automatically balance complex games like CivMini, showing LLMs can simulate and optimize multi-agent environments.
tldr_zh: RuleSmith 使用多智能体 LLM 和贝叶斯优化来自动平衡像 CivMini 这样复杂的游戏，表明 LLM 可以模拟和优化多智能体环境。

title: Learning Rate Scaling across LoRA Ranks and Transfer to Full Finetuning
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a standard tool for parameter-efficient finetuning of large models. While it induces a small memory footprint, its training dynamics can be surprisingly complex as they depend on several hyperparameters such as initialization, adapter rank, and learning rate. In particular, it is unclear how the optimal learning rate scales with adapter rank, which forces practitioners to re-tune the learning rate whenever the rank is changed. In this paper, we introduce Maximal-Update Adaptation ($μ$A), a theoretical framework that characterizes how the "optimal" learning rate should scale with model width and adapter rank to produce stable, non-vanishing feature updates under standard configurations. $μ$A is inspired from the Maximal-Update Parametrization ($μ$P) in pretraining. Our analysis leverages techniques from hyperparameter transfer and reveals that the optimal learning rate exhibits different scaling patterns depending on initialization and LoRA scaling factor. Specifically, we identify two regimes: one where the optimal learning rate remains roughly invariant across ranks, and another where it scales inversely with rank. We further identify a configuration that allows learning rate transfer from LoRA to full finetuning, drastically reducing the cost of learning rate tuning for full finetuning. Experiments across language, vision, vision--language, image generation, and reinforcement learning tasks validate our scaling rules and show that learning rates tuned on LoRA transfer reliably to full finetuning.
summary_zh: 低秩适配(LoRA)是大型模型参数高效微调的标准工具。虽然它引入了较小的内存占用，但其训练动态可能出人意料地复杂，因为它依赖于诸如初始化、适配器秩和学习率等多个超参数。特别是，目前尚不清楚最佳学习率如何随适配器秩变化，这迫使实践者在每次更改秩时都必须重新调整学习率。在本文中，我们介绍最大更新适配($μ$A)，这是一个理论框架，它描述了“最佳”学习率应如何随模型宽度和适配器秩变化，以在标准配置下产生稳定、非消失的特征更新。$μ$A的灵感来自预训练中的最大更新参数化($μ$P)。我们的分析利用了超参数迁移技术，并且揭示了最佳学习率根据初始化和LoRA缩放因子的不同而表现出不同的缩放模式。具体来说，我们确定了两种情况：一种是最佳学习率在不同秩之间大致不变，另一种是它与秩成反比。我们进一步确定了一种配置，允许从LoRA到全量微调的学习率迁移，从而大大降低了全量微调的学习率调整成本。在语言、视觉、视觉-语言、图像生成和强化学习任务中的实验验证了我们的缩放规则，并表明在LoRA上调整的学习率可以可靠地迁移到全量微调。
tldr: This paper introduces Maximal-Update Adaptation (μA), a theoretical framework for scaling learning rates with LoRA rank, and identifies configurations for transferring learning rates from LoRA to full finetuning, validated across multiple tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了最大更新适应（μA），这是一个将学习率与LoRA秩缩放的理论框架，并确定了将学习率从LoRA转移到完整微调的配置，并在多个任务中进行了验证。

title: Self-Improving World Modelling with Latent Actions
summary: Internal modelling of the world -- predicting transitions between previous states $X$ and next states $Y$ under actions $Z$ -- is essential to reasoning and planning for LLMs and VLMs. Learning such models typically requires costly action-labelled trajectories. We propose SWIRL, a self-improvement framework that learns from state-only sequences by treating actions as a latent variable and alternating between Forward World Modelling (FWM) $P_θ(Y|X,Z)$ and an Inverse Dynamics Modelling (IDM) $Q_φ(Z|X,Y)$. SWIRL iterates two phases: (1) Variational Information Maximisation, which updates the FWM to generate next states that maximise conditional mutual information with latent actions given prior states, encouraging identifiable consistency; and (2) ELBO Maximisation, which updates the IDM to explain observed transitions, effectively performing coordinate ascent. Both models are trained with reinforcement learning (specifically, GRPO) with the opposite frozen model's log-probability as a reward signal. We provide theoretical learnability guarantees for both updates, and evaluate SWIRL on LLMs and VLMs across multiple environments: single-turn and multi-turn open-world visual dynamics and synthetic textual environments for physics, web, and tool calling. SWIRL achieves gains of 16% on AURORABench, 28% on ByteMorph, 16% on WorldPredictionBench, and 14% on StableToolBench.
summary_zh: 世界内部建模——即预测在动作 $Z$ 作用下，从先前状态 $X$ 到下一状态 $Y$ 的转移——对于 LLM 和 VLM 的推理和规划至关重要。学习此类模型通常需要耗费巨大的标注动作轨迹。我们提出了 SWIRL，一个自我改进框架，它通过将动作视为潜变量，从仅包含状态的序列中学习，并在前向世界建模 (FWM) $P_θ(Y|X,Z)$ 和逆动力学建模 (IDM) $Q_φ(Z|X,Y)$ 之间交替进行。SWIRL 迭代两个阶段：（1）变分信息最大化，更新 FWM 以生成下一状态，从而最大化给定先前状态的潜变量动作的条件互信息，鼓励可识别一致性；(2) ELBO 最大化，更新 IDM 以解释观察到的转移，有效地执行坐标上升。两个模型都通过强化学习（特别是 GRPO）进行训练，使用相反的冻结模型的对数概率作为奖励信号。我们为这两个更新提供了理论上的可学习性保证，并在横跨多个环境的 LLM 和 VLM 上评估了 SWIRL：单轮和多轮开放世界视觉动力学，以及用于物理、网络和工具调用的合成文本环境。SWIRL 在 AURORABench 上实现了 16% 的增长，在 ByteMorph 上实现了 28% 的增长，在 WorldPredictionBench 上实现了 16% 的增长，在 StableToolBench 上实现了 14% 的增长。
tldr: The paper introduces SWIRL, a self-improvement framework for learning world models from state-only sequences by alternating between Forward World Modelling (FWM) and Inverse Dynamics Modelling (IDM) using reinforcement learning, showing performance gains across diverse LLM and VLM tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SWIRL的自提升框架，用于从仅包含状态的序列中学习世界模型。该方法通过交替使用前向世界建模(FWM)和逆动力学建模(IDM)，并结合强化学习，在各种LLM和VLM任务中表现出性能提升。

title: DyTopo: Dynamic Topology Routing for Multi-Agent Reasoning via Semantic Matching
summary: Multi-agent systems built from prompted large language models can improve multi-round reasoning, yet most existing pipelines rely on fixed, trajectory-wide communication patterns that are poorly matched to the stage-dependent needs of iterative problem solving. We introduce DyTopo, a manager-guided multi-agent framework that reconstructs a sparse directed communication graph at each round. Conditioned on the manager's round goal, each agent outputs lightweight natural-language query (need) and \key (offer) descriptors; DyTopo embeds these descriptors and performs semantic matching, routing private messages only along the induced edges. Across code generation and mathematical reasoning benchmarks and four LLM backbones, DyTopo consistently outperforms over the strongest baseline (avg. +6.2). Beyond accuracy, DyTopo yields an interpretable coordination trace via the evolving graphs, enabling qualitative inspection of how communication pathways reconfigure across rounds.
summary_zh: 由提示的大型语言模型构建的多智能体系统能够提升多轮推理能力，然而，现有的大部分流程依赖于固定的、贯穿整个轨迹的通信模式，这与迭代问题求解中阶段相关的需求不匹配。我们引入了 DyTopo，一种由管理器引导的多智能体框架，它在每一轮次重构一个稀疏的有向通信图。基于管理器设定的轮次目标，每个智能体输出轻量级的自然语言查询（需求）和\关键词（供应）描述符；DyTopo 会嵌入这些描述符并执行语义匹配，仅沿着诱导的边路由私有消息。在代码生成和数学推理基准测试以及四个大型语言模型后端上，DyTopo 始终优于最强的基线（平均 +6.2）。除了准确率之外，DyTopo 还通过不断演化的图产生可解释的协调轨迹，从而能够对通信路径如何在各个轮次之间重新配置进行定性检查。
tldr: The paper introduces DyTopo, a manager-guided multi-agent framework using semantic matching to dynamically reconstruct a sparse communication graph at each round for improved multi-agent reasoning, demonstrating superior performance on code generation and mathematical reasoning tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DyTopo，一个由管理者引导的多智能体框架，它利用语义匹配在每一轮动态地重建一个稀疏的通信图，以提高多智能体推理的能力。实验表明，该框架在代码生成和数学推理任务上具有优越的性能。

title: Learning Query-Aware Budget-Tier Routing for Runtime Agent Memory
summary: Memory is increasingly central to Large Language Model (LLM) agents operating beyond a single context window, yet most existing systems rely on offline, query-agnostic memory construction that can be inefficient and may discard query-critical information. Although runtime memory utilization is a natural alternative, prior work often incurs substantial overhead and offers limited explicit control over the performance-cost trade-off. In this work, we present \textbf{BudgetMem}, a runtime agent memory framework for explicit, query-aware performance-cost control. BudgetMem structures memory processing as a set of memory modules, each offered in three budget tiers (i.e., \textsc{Low}/\textsc{Mid}/\textsc{High}). A lightweight router performs budget-tier routing across modules to balance task performance and memory construction cost, which is implemented as a compact neural policy trained with reinforcement learning. Using BudgetMem as a unified testbed, we study three complementary strategies for realizing budget tiers: implementation (method complexity), reasoning (inference behavior), and capacity (module model size). Across LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and HotpotQA, BudgetMem surpasses strong baselines when performance is prioritized (i.e., high-budget setting), and delivers better accuracy-cost frontiers under tighter budgets. Moreover, our analysis disentangles the strengths and weaknesses of different tiering strategies, clarifying when each axis delivers the most favorable trade-offs under varying budget regimes.
summary_zh: 记忆对于在单个上下文窗口之外运行的大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理变得日益重要，但现有的大多数系统依赖于离线、与查询无关的记忆构建方法，这种方法效率低下，并且可能丢弃对查询至关重要的信息。虽然运行时记忆利用是一种自然的替代方案，但之前的工作常常产生大量的开销，并且对性能-成本的权衡提供有限的显式控制。在这项工作中，我们提出了 \textbf{BudgetMem}，一个用于显式、查询感知的性能-成本控制的运行时代理记忆框架。BudgetMem 将记忆处理构建为一组记忆模块，每个模块提供三个预算等级（即 \textsc{Low}/\textsc{Mid}/\textsc{High}）。一个轻量级的路由器执行跨模块的预算等级路由，以平衡任务性能和记忆构建成本，该路由器被实现为一个使用强化学习训练的紧凑型神经网络策略。我们将 BudgetMem 作为一个统一的测试平台，研究了实现预算等级的三个互补策略：实现（方法复杂度）、推理（推理行为）和容量（模块模型大小）。在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval 和 HotpotQA 上，当性能优先时（即高预算设置），BudgetMem 超越了强大的基线，并且在更严格的预算下提供了更好的准确率-成本前沿。此外，我们的分析解开了不同分层策略的优点和缺点，阐明了在不同的预算机制下，每个维度何时能提供最有利的权衡。
tldr: The paper introduces BudgetMem, a runtime agent memory framework that uses reinforcement learning to dynamically allocate memory resources based on query relevance and budget constraints, achieving better performance-cost trade-offs in LLM agents.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了BudgetMem，一个运行时代理内存框架，它使用强化学习根据查询相关性和预算约束动态分配内存资源，从而在LLM代理中实现更好的性能-成本权衡。

title: Jackpot: Optimal Budgeted Rejection Sampling for Extreme Actor-Policy Mismatch Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs) remains expensive, particularly because the rollout is expensive. Decoupling rollout generation from policy optimization (e.g., leveraging a more efficient model to rollout) could enable substantial efficiency gains, yet doing so introduces a severe distribution mismatch that destabilizes learning. We propose Jackpot, a framework that leverages Optimal Budget Rejection Sampling (OBRS) to directly reduce the discrepancy between the rollout model and the evolving policy. Jackpot integrates a principled OBRS procedure, a unified training objective that jointly updates the policy and rollout models, and an efficient system implementation enabled by top-$k$ probability estimation and batch-level bias correction. Our theoretical analysis shows that OBRS consistently moves the rollout distribution closer to the target distribution under a controllable acceptance budget. Empirically, \sys substantially improves training stability compared to importance-sampling baselines, achieving performance comparable to on-policy RL when training Qwen3-8B-Base for up to 300 update steps of batchsize 64. Taken together, our results show that OBRS-based alignment brings us a step closer to practical and effective decoupling of rollout generation from policy optimization for RL for LLMs.
summary_zh: 针对大型语言模型 (LLM) 的强化学习 (RL) 仍然成本高昂，尤其是由于 rollout 过程的耗费巨大。将 rollout 生成与策略优化解耦（例如，利用更高效的模型进行 rollout）可以带来显著的效率提升，然而这样做会引入严重的分布不匹配，从而导致学习不稳定。我们提出了 Jackpot，一种利用最优预算拒绝采样 (OBRS) 直接减少 rollout 模型与演化策略之间差异的框架。Jackpot 集成了一个基于原则的 OBRS 程序、一个联合更新策略和 rollout 模型的统一训练目标，以及一个通过 top-$k$ 概率估计和批次级偏差校正实现的高效系统实现。我们的理论分析表明，OBRS 在可控的接受预算下始终能使 rollout 分布更接近目标分布。实验结果表明，相比于基于重要性采样的基线方法，\sys 显著提高了训练稳定性，在使用批大小为 64 的 Qwen3-8B-Base 进行最多 300 步更新时，实现了与在线策略 RL 相当的性能。总而言之，我们的结果表明，基于 OBRS 的对齐使我们朝着 LLM 的 RL 中 rollout 生成与策略优化的实际且有效的解耦迈进了一步。
tldr: This paper introduces Jackpot, a reinforcement learning framework that uses Optimal Budget Rejection Sampling (OBRS) to address the distribution mismatch problem when decoupling rollout generation from policy optimization in LLMs, achieving improved training stability.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Jackpot，一个强化学习框架，它使用最优预算拒绝采样(OBRS)来解决LLM中将 rollout 生成与策略优化分离时出现的分布不匹配问题，从而提高了训练稳定性。

title: PlanViz: Evaluating Planning-Oriented Image Generation and Editing for Computer-Use Tasks
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have shown impressive capabilities in generating natural images and supporting multimodal reasoning. However, their potential in supporting computer-use planning tasks, which are closely related to our lives, remain underexplored. Image generation and editing in computer-use tasks require capabilities like spatial reasoning and procedural understanding, and it is still unknown whether UMMs have these capabilities to finish these tasks or not. Therefore, we propose PlanViz, a new benchmark designed to evaluate image generation and editing for computer-use tasks. To achieve the goal of our evaluation, we focus on sub-tasks which frequently involve in daily life and require planning steps. Specifically, three new sub-tasks are designed: route planning, work diagramming, and web&UI displaying. We address challenges in data quality ensuring by curating human-annotated questions and reference images, and a quality control process. For challenges of comprehensive and exact evaluation, a task-adaptive score, PlanScore, is proposed. The score helps understanding the correctness, visual quality and efficiency of generated images. Through experiments, we highlight key limitations and opportunities for future research on this topic.
summary_zh: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）在生成自然图像和支持多模态推理方面表现出令人印象深刻的能力。然而，它们在支持计算机使用规划任务方面的潜力，即与我们的生活密切相关的任务，仍未得到充分探索。计算机使用任务中的图像生成和编辑需要空间推理和程序理解等能力，而UMMs是否具备完成这些任务的能力仍然未知。因此，我们提出了PlanViz，这是一个新的基准，旨在评估计算机使用任务中的图像生成和编辑。为了实现我们的评估目标，我们专注于日常生活中经常涉及并需要规划步骤的子任务。具体而言，我们设计了三个新的子任务：路线规划、工作流程图绘制和网页&UI显示。我们通过收集人工标注的问题和参考图像，并采用质量控制流程，来应对数据质量保证方面的挑战。针对全面而精确的评估挑战，我们提出了一种任务自适应评分方法PlanScore。该评分方法有助于理解生成图像的正确性、视觉质量和效率。通过实验，我们强调了该主题未来研究中的关键局限性与机遇。
tldr: The paper introduces PlanViz, a new benchmark for evaluating the ability of unified multimodal models to generate and edit images for computer-use tasks requiring spatial reasoning and procedural understanding, focusing on route planning, work diagramming, and web&UI displaying.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个新的基准测试PlanViz，用于评估统一多模态模型在为计算机使用任务生成和编辑图像方面的能力，这些任务需要空间推理和程序理解，重点是路线规划、工作图表和Web&UI显示。

title: CauCLIP: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap in Surgical Video Understanding via Causality-Inspired Vision-Language Modeling
summary: Surgical phase recognition is a critical component for context-aware decision support in intelligent operating rooms, yet training robust models is hindered by limited annotated clinical videos and large domain gaps between synthetic and real surgical data. To address this, we propose CauCLIP, a causality-inspired vision-language framework that leverages CLIP to learn domain-invariant representations for surgical phase recognition without access to target domain data. Our approach integrates a frequency-based augmentation strategy to perturb domain-specific attributes while preserving semantic structures, and a causal suppression loss that mitigates non-causal biases and reinforces causal surgical features. These components are combined in a unified training framework that enables the model to focus on stable causal factors underlying surgical workflows. Experiments on the SurgVisDom hard adaptation benchmark demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms all competing approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of causality-guided vision-language models for domain-generalizable surgical video understanding.
summary_zh: 手术阶段识别是智能手术室中上下文感知决策支持的关键组成部分，然而，训练稳健的模型受到带标注的临床视频数据有限以及合成手术数据与真实手术数据之间存在巨大领域差异的阻碍。为了解决这个问题，我们提出CauCLIP，一个受因果关系启发的视觉-语言框架，它利用CLIP学习领域不变表示，用于手术阶段识别，且无需访问目标领域数据。我们的方法集成了一种基于频率的增强策略，用于扰动领域特定的属性，同时保持语义结构；以及一个因果抑制损失，用于缓解非因果性偏差并强化因果性手术特征。这些组件被整合到一个统一的训练框架中，使模型能够专注于手术工作流程中稳定的因果因素。在SurgVisDom硬适应基准上的实验表明，我们的方法显著优于所有竞争方法，突出了因果关系引导的视觉-语言模型在领域泛化的手术视频理解中的有效性。
tldr: CauCLIP uses a causality-inspired vision-language approach with frequency-based augmentation and causal suppression loss to improve surgical phase recognition by leveraging CLIP for domain-invariant representations, achieving state-of-the-art performance on a hard adaptation benchmark.
tldr_zh: CauCLIP 采用了一种因果关系启发的视觉语言方法，结合基于频率的增强和因果抑制损失，利用 CLIP 学习领域不变的表示，从而提高手术阶段识别能力，并在一个困难的适应性基准上实现了最先进的性能。

title: LAB-Det: Language as a Domain-Invariant Bridge for Training-Free One-Shot Domain Generalization in Object Detection
summary: Foundation object detectors such as GLIP and Grounding DINO excel on general-domain data but often degrade in specialized and data-scarce settings like underwater imagery or industrial defects. Typical cross-domain few-shot approaches rely on fine-tuning scarce target data, incurring cost and overfitting risks. We instead ask: Can a frozen detector adapt with only one exemplar per class without training? To answer this, we introduce training-free one-shot domain generalization for object detection, where detectors must adapt to specialized domains with only one annotated exemplar per class and no weight updates. To tackle this task, we propose LAB-Det, which exploits Language As a domain-invariant Bridge. Instead of adapting visual features, we project each exemplar into a descriptive text that conditions and guides a frozen detector. This linguistic conditioning replaces gradient-based adaptation, enabling robust generalization in data-scarce domains. We evaluate on UODD (underwater) and NEU-DET (industrial defects), two widely adopted benchmarks for data-scarce detection, where object boundaries are often ambiguous, and LAB-Det achieves up to 5.4 mAP improvement over state-of-the-art fine-tuned baselines without updating a single parameter. These results establish linguistic adaptation as an efficient and interpretable alternative to fine-tuning in specialized detection settings.
summary_zh: 诸如GLIP和Grounding DINO的基础目标检测器在通用领域数据上表现出色，但在水下图像或工业缺陷等专业化和数据稀缺的环境中，性能通常会下降。典型的跨域少样本方法依赖于对稀缺的目标数据进行微调，从而产生开销和过拟合风险。我们转而提出疑问：是否可以在不进行训练的情况下，仅用每个类别的一个样本让一个冻结的检测器进行适应？为了回答这个问题，我们引入了一种免训练的单样本域泛化目标检测方法，其中检测器必须适应专业领域，每个类别仅有一个带标注的样本，且没有权重更新。为了解决这个任务，我们提出了LAB-Det，它利用语言作为一种领域不变的桥梁。LAB-Det不适应视觉特征，而是将每个样本投影到一个描述性的文本中，这个文本对冻结的检测器进行条件约束和引导。这种语言条件约束取代了基于梯度的适应，从而在数据稀缺的领域中实现鲁棒的泛化。我们在UODD（水下）和NEU-DET（工业缺陷）这两个广泛采用的数据稀缺检测基准上进行了评估，这些基准中目标边界通常是模糊的，LAB-Det在不更新任何参数的情况下，实现了比最先进的微调基线最多5.4 mAP的提升。这些结果确立了在专业检测环境中，语言适应是微调的一种高效且可解释的替代方案。
tldr: The paper introduces LAB-Det, a training-free one-shot domain generalization method for object detection that leverages language as a domain-invariant bridge to adapt a frozen detector to specialized domains with only one annotated exemplar per class, achieving improved mAP over fine-tuned baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LAB-Det，一种无需训练的单样本域泛化目标检测方法，它利用语言作为领域不变的桥梁，使冻结的检测器能够适应特定领域，每个类别仅需一个带注释的样本，并且比微调的基线实现了改进的mAP。

title: POINTS-GUI-G: GUI-Grounding Journey
summary: The rapid advancement of vision-language models has catalyzed the emergence of GUI agents, which hold immense potential for automating complex tasks, from online shopping to flight booking, thereby alleviating the burden of repetitive digital workflows. As a foundational capability, GUI grounding is typically established as a prerequisite for end-to-end task execution. It enables models to precisely locate interface elements, such as text and icons, to perform accurate operations like clicking and typing. Unlike prior works that fine-tune models already possessing strong spatial awareness (e.g., Qwen3-VL), we aim to master the full technical pipeline by starting from a base model with minimal grounding ability, such as POINTS-1.5. We introduce POINTS-GUI-G-8B, which achieves state-of-the-art performance with scores of 59.9 on ScreenSpot-Pro, 66.0 on OSWorld-G, 95.7 on ScreenSpot-v2, and 49.9 on UI-Vision. Our model's success is driven by three key factors: (1) Refined Data Engineering, involving the unification of diverse open-source datasets format alongside sophisticated strategies for augmentation, filtering, and difficulty grading; (2) Improved Training Strategies, including continuous fine-tuning of the vision encoder to enhance perceptual accuracy and maintaining resolution consistency between training and inference; and (3) Reinforcement Learning (RL) with Verifiable Rewards. While RL is traditionally used to bolster reasoning, we demonstrate that it significantly improves precision in the perception-intensive GUI grounding task. Furthermore, GUI grounding provides a natural advantage for RL, as rewards are easily verifiable and highly accurate.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型的快速发展催化了图形用户界面代理的出现，这些代理在自动化复杂任务（从在线购物到机票预订）方面具有巨大的潜力，从而减轻了重复性数字工作流程的负担。作为一项基础能力，GUI定位通常被确立为端到端任务执行的先决条件。它使模型能够精确定位界面元素，如文本和图标，以执行诸如点击和打字等精确操作。与以往微调已经具有强大空间感知能力的模型（例如，Qwen3-VL）的研究不同，我们旨在通过从一个具有最少定位能力的基础模型（例如，POINTS-1.5）开始，来掌握完整的技术流程。我们推出了POINTS-GUI-G-8B，它实现了最先进的性能，在ScreenSpot-Pro上的得分为59.9，在OSWorld-G上的得分为66.0，在ScreenSpot-v2上的得分为95.7，在UI-Vision上的得分为49.9。我们模型的成功归功于三个关键因素：（1）精细的数据工程，包括统一各种开源数据集格式，以及复杂的增强、过滤和难度分级策略；（2）改进的训练策略，包括持续微调视觉编码器以提高感知精度，并在训练和推理之间保持分辨率一致性；（3）带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RL）。虽然RL传统上用于增强推理能力，但我们证明它可以显著提高感知密集型的GUI定位任务的精度。此外，GUI定位为RL提供了一个天然的优势，因为奖励易于验证并且高度准确。
tldr: The paper introduces POINTS-GUI-G-8B, a GUI grounding model built from a base model (POINTS-1.5) with minimal initial grounding ability. It utilizes refined data engineering, improved training strategies (including vision encoder fine-tuning and resolution consistency), and reinforcement learning to achieve state-of-the-art performance on several GUI grounding benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了POINTS-GUI-G-8B，一个GUI定位模型，它从一个初始定位能力很弱的基础模型(POINTS-1.5)构建而来。该模型利用精炼的数据工程、改进的训练策略(包括视觉编码器微调和分辨率一致性)以及强化学习，在多个GUI定位基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

title: Driving with DINO: Vision Foundation Features as a Unified Bridge for Sim-to-Real Generation in Autonomous Driving
summary: Driven by the emergence of Controllable Video Diffusion, existing Sim2Real methods for autonomous driving video generation typically rely on explicit intermediate representations to bridge the domain gap. However, these modalities face a fundamental Consistency-Realism Dilemma. Low-level signals (e.g., edges, blurred images) ensure precise control but compromise realism by "baking in" synthetic artifacts, whereas high-level priors (e.g., depth, semantics, HDMaps) facilitate photorealism but lack the structural detail required for consistent guidance. In this work, we present Driving with DINO (DwD), a novel framework that leverages Vision Foundation Module (VFM) features as a unified bridge between the simulation and real-world domains. We first identify that these features encode a spectrum of information, from high-level semantics to fine-grained structure. To effectively utilize this, we employ Principal Subspace Projection to discard the high-frequency elements responsible for "texture baking," while concurrently introducing Random Channel Tail Drop to mitigate the structural loss inherent in rigid dimensionality reduction, thereby reconciling realism with control consistency. Furthermore, to fully leverage DINOv3's high-resolution capabilities for enhancing control precision, we introduce a learnable Spatial Alignment Module that adapts these high-resolution features to the diffusion backbone. Finally, we propose a Causal Temporal Aggregator employing causal convolutions to explicitly preserve historical motion context when integrating frame-wise DINO features, which effectively mitigates motion blur and guarantees temporal stability. Project page: https://albertchen98.github.io/DwD-project/
summary_zh: 受控视频扩散技术的兴起推动了自动驾驶视频生成的现有Sim2Real方法，这些方法通常依赖于显式的中间表示来弥合领域差距。然而，这些模式面临着一个根本性的“一致性-真实性困境”。低层次信号（例如，边缘、模糊图像）确保了精确的控制，但通过“烘焙”合成伪影损害了真实性，而高层次先验（例如，深度、语义、高清地图）有助于照片般的真实感，但缺乏一致性引导所需的结构细节。在这项工作中，我们提出了“基于DINO的驾驶”（DwD），这是一种新颖的框架，利用视觉基础模块（VFM）特征作为仿真和真实世界领域之间的统一桥梁。我们首先确定这些特征编码着一系列信息，从高层次语义到精细结构。为了有效地利用这一点，我们采用主子空间投影来丢弃负责“纹理烘焙”的高频元素，同时引入随机通道尾部丢弃，以减轻刚性降维中固有的结构损失，从而协调真实性和控制一致性。此外，为了充分利用DINOv3的高分辨率能力来增强控制精度，我们引入了一个可学习的空间对齐模块，该模块将这些高分辨率特征适配到扩散骨干网络。最后，我们提出了一个因果时间聚合器，该聚合器采用因果卷积来显式地保留历史运动上下文，以便在集成逐帧DINO特征时，从而有效地减轻运动模糊并保证时间稳定性。项目主页：https://albertchen98.github.io/DwD-project/
tldr: The paper introduces Driving with DINO (DwD), a novel Sim2Real video generation framework for autonomous driving that leverages Vision Foundation Module (VFM) features from DINO as a unified bridge, using techniques to reconcile realism with control consistency and enhance control precision and temporal stability.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Driving with DINO (DwD)，一个新颖的Sim2Real自动驾驶视频生成框架，该框架利用DINO的视觉基础模块(VFM)特征作为一个统一的桥梁，并采用多种技术来协调真实感与控制一致性，同时增强控制精度和时间稳定性。

title: EgoAVU: Egocentric Audio-Visual Understanding
summary: Understanding egocentric videos plays a vital role for embodied intelligence. Recent multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) can accept both visual and audio inputs. However, due to the challenge of obtaining text labels with coherent joint-modality information, whether MLLMs can jointly understand both modalities in egocentric videos remains under-explored. To address this problem, we introduce EgoAVU, a scalable data engine to automatically generate egocentric audio-visual narrations, questions, and answers. EgoAVU enriches human narrations with multimodal context and generates audio-visual narrations through cross-modal correlation modeling. Token-based video filtering and modular, graph-based curation ensure both data diversity and quality. Leveraging EgoAVU, we construct EgoAVU-Instruct, a large-scale training dataset of 3M samples, and EgoAVU-Bench, a manually verified evaluation split covering diverse tasks. EgoAVU-Bench clearly reveals the limitations of existing MLLMs: they bias heavily toward visual signals, often neglecting audio cues or failing to correspond audio with the visual source. Finetuning MLLMs on EgoAVU-Instruct effectively addresses this issue, enabling up to 113% performance improvement on EgoAVU-Bench. Such benefits also transfer to other benchmarks such as EgoTempo and EgoIllusion, achieving up to 28% relative performance gain. Code will be released to the community.
summary_zh: 理解以自我为中心的视频对于具身智能至关重要。 近期多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）可以接受视觉和音频输入。 然而，由于获取具有连贯联合模态信息的文本标签存在挑战，MLLMs是否能联合理解以自我为中心的视频中的两种模态仍有待探索。 为了解决这个问题，我们引入了EgoAVU，一个可扩展的数据引擎，用于自动生成以自我为中心的音视频叙述、问题和答案。 EgoAVU通过多模态上下文丰富人类叙述，并通过跨模态相关性建模生成音视频叙述。 基于令牌的视频过滤和模块化的、基于图的整理确保了数据的多样性和质量。 利用EgoAVU，我们构建了EgoAVU-Instruct，一个包含300万个样本的大规模训练数据集，以及EgoAVU-Bench，一个涵盖各种任务的手动验证评估集。 EgoAVU-Bench清晰地揭示了现有MLLMs的局限性：它们严重偏向视觉信号，经常忽略音频线索或无法将音频与视觉来源对应。 在EgoAVU-Instruct上微调MLLMs有效解决了这个问题，从而在EgoAVU-Bench上实现了高达113%的性能提升。 这种优势也转移到了其他基准测试，例如EgoTempo和EgoIllusion，实现了高达28%的相对性能提升。 代码将向社区发布。
tldr: The paper introduces EgoAVU, a data engine for generating egocentric audio-visual datasets for training and evaluating MLLMs and demonstrates finetuning on the generated dataset improves MLLM performance in understanding audio-visual cues in egocentric videos.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EgoAVU，一个用于生成以自我为中心的音频-视觉数据集的数据引擎，用于训练和评估MLLM，并证明在生成的数据集上进行微调可以提高MLLM在理解以自我为中心的视频中的音频-视觉线索方面的性能。

title: Predicting Camera Pose from Perspective Descriptions for Spatial Reasoning
summary: Multi-image spatial reasoning remains challenging for current multimodal large language models (MLLMs). While single-view perception is inherently 2D, reasoning over multiple views requires building a coherent scene understanding across viewpoints. In particular, we study perspective taking, where a model must build a coherent 3D understanding from multi-view observations and use it to reason from a new, language-specified viewpoint. We introduce CAMCUE, a pose-aware multi-image framework that uses camera pose as an explicit geometric anchor for cross-view fusion and novel-view reasoning. CAMCUE injects per-view pose into visual tokens, grounds natural-language viewpoint descriptions to a target camera pose, and synthesizes a pose-conditioned imagined target view to support answering. To support this setting, we curate CAMCUE-DATA with 27,668 training and 508 test instances pairing multi-view images and poses with diverse target-viewpoint descriptions and perspective-shift questions. We also include human-annotated viewpoint descriptions in the test split to evaluate generalization to human language. CAMCUE improves overall accuracy by 9.06% and predicts target poses from natural-language viewpoint descriptions with over 90% rotation accuracy within 20° and translation accuracy within a 0.5 error threshold. This direct grounding avoids expensive test-time search-and-match, reducing inference time from 256.6s to 1.45s per example and enabling fast, interactive use in real-world scenarios.
summary_zh: 多图像空间推理对于当前的多模态大型语言模型(MLLMs)来说仍然具有挑战性。单视角的感知本质上是二维的，而对多个视角的推理需要跨视角构建连贯的场景理解。特别是，我们研究了透视转换，即模型必须从多视角观察中建立连贯的三维理解，并用它来从新的、语言指定的视点进行推理。我们提出了CAMCUE，一个姿态感知的多图像框架，它使用相机姿态作为明确的几何锚点，进行跨视图融合和新视图推理。CAMCUE将每个视角的姿态注入视觉标记中，将自然语言的视点描述与目标相机姿态关联起来，并合成一个姿态条件下的想象目标视图以支持回答。为了支持这个设置，我们整理了CAMCUE-DATA，其中包含27,668个训练实例和508个测试实例，它们将多视角图像和姿态与不同的目标视点描述和透视转换问题配对。我们还在测试集中包含了人工标注的视点描述，以评估对人类语言的泛化能力。CAMCUE将总体准确率提高了9.06%，并能根据自然语言视点描述预测目标姿态，其旋转精度在20°以内超过90%，平移精度在0.5误差阈值内。这种直接关联避免了昂贵的测试时搜索匹配，将每个示例的推理时间从256.6秒减少到1.45秒，从而能够在现实场景中实现快速、交互式的使用。
tldr: The paper introduces CAMCUE, a pose-aware multi-image framework using camera pose as a geometric anchor for cross-view fusion, enabling novel-view reasoning and achieving state-of-the-art results in predicting camera pose from perspective descriptions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CAMCUE，一个姿态感知的多图像框架，它使用相机姿态作为几何锚点来进行跨视图融合，从而实现新视角推理，并在从视角描述预测相机姿态方面取得了最先进的结果。

title: Thinking with Geometry: Active Geometry Integration for Spatial Reasoning
summary: Recent progress in spatial reasoning with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly leverages geometric priors from 3D encoders. However, most existing integration strategies remain passive: geometry is exposed as a global stream and fused in an indiscriminate manner, which often induces semantic-geometry misalignment and redundant signals. We propose GeoThinker, a framework that shifts the paradigm from passive fusion to active perception. Instead of feature mixing, GeoThinker enables the model to selectively retrieve geometric evidence conditioned on its internal reasoning demands. GeoThinker achieves this through Spatial-Grounded Fusion applied at carefully selected VLM layers, where semantic visual priors selectively query and integrate task-relevant geometry via frame-strict cross-attention, further calibrated by Importance Gating that biases per-frame attention toward task-relevant structures. Comprehensive evaluation results show that GeoThinker sets a new state-of-the-art in spatial intelligence, achieving a peak score of 72.6 on the VSI-Bench. Furthermore, GeoThinker demonstrates robust generalization and significantly improved spatial perception across complex downstream scenarios, including embodied referring and autonomous driving. Our results indicate that the ability to actively integrate spatial structures is essential for next-generation spatial intelligence. Code can be found at https://github.com/Li-Hao-yuan/GeoThinker.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型(MLLMs)在空间推理方面的最新进展越来越多地利用来自3D编码器的几何先验。然而，目前大多数的集成策略仍然是被动的：几何信息被作为全局流暴露出来并以不加区分的方式融合，这常常会导致语义-几何对齐偏差和冗余信号。我们提出了GeoThinker，一个将范式从被动融合转变为主动感知的框架。GeoThinker并非进行特征混合，而是使模型能够根据其内部推理需求选择性地检索几何证据。 GeoThinker通过在精心选择的VLM层应用空间对齐融合来实现这一点，在此过程中，语义视觉先验通过帧严格交叉注意力选择性地查询和集成任务相关的几何信息，并通过重要性门控进一步校准，从而将每帧注意力偏向于任务相关的结构。全面评估结果表明，GeoThinker在空间智能方面建立了新的技术水平，在VSI-Bench上实现了高达72.6的峰值分数。此外，GeoThinker展示了强大的泛化能力，并显著提高了复杂下游场景中的空间感知能力，包括具身指代和自动驾驶。我们的结果表明，主动集成空间结构的能力对于下一代空间智能至关重要。代码可在https://github.com/Li-Hao-yuan/GeoThinker找到。
tldr: The paper introduces GeoThinker, a framework for MLLMs that actively integrates geometric information for spatial reasoning using spatial-grounded fusion and importance gating, achieving state-of-the-art performance on spatial intelligence benchmarks and demonstrating improved generalization in complex scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GeoThinker，一个用于多模态大型语言模型的框架，通过空间锚定融合和重要性门控主动整合几何信息以进行空间推理，在空间智能基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，并在复杂的场景中展示了更好的泛化能力。

title: V-Retrver: Evidence-Driven Agentic Reasoning for Universal Multimodal Retrieval
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently been applied to universal multimodal retrieval, where Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning improves candidate reranking. However, existing approaches remain largely language-driven, relying on static visual encodings and lacking the ability to actively verify fine-grained visual evidence, which often leads to speculative reasoning in visually ambiguous cases. We propose V-Retrver, an evidence-driven retrieval framework that reformulates multimodal retrieval as an agentic reasoning process grounded in visual inspection. V-Retrver enables an MLLM to selectively acquire visual evidence during reasoning via external visual tools, performing a multimodal interleaved reasoning process that alternates between hypothesis generation and targeted visual verification.To train such an evidence-gathering retrieval agent, we adopt a curriculum-based learning strategy combining supervised reasoning activation, rejection-based refinement, and reinforcement learning with an evidence-aligned objective. Experiments across multiple multimodal retrieval benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in retrieval accuracy (with 23.0% improvements on average), perception-driven reasoning reliability, and generalization.
summary_zh: 最近，多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）已被应用于通用多模态检索，其中思维链（CoT）推理提高了候选重新排序的性能。然而，现有方法在很大程度上仍然是语言驱动的，依赖于静态的视觉编码，并且缺乏主动验证细粒度视觉证据的能力，这通常会导致在视觉模糊情况下出现推测性推理。我们提出了一种证据驱动的检索框架V-Retrver，它将多模态检索重塑为一种基于视觉检查的 Agentic 推理过程。V-Retrver 使 MLLM 能够在推理过程中通过外部视觉工具选择性地获取视觉证据，从而执行一个在假设生成和目标视觉验证之间交替进行的多模态交错推理过程。为了训练这种证据收集检索 Agent，我们采用了一种基于课程的学习策略，该策略结合了有监督的推理激活、基于拒绝的细化以及具有证据对齐目标的强化学习。在多个多模态检索基准上的实验表明，在检索准确率（平均提升 23.0%）、感知驱动的推理可靠性和泛化性方面均有持续提高。
tldr: V-Retrver introduces an evidence-driven agentic reasoning framework for multimodal retrieval, using visual tools to actively verify visual evidence during reasoning, achieving significant improvements in retrieval accuracy and generalization.
tldr_zh: V-Retrver 引入了一个证据驱动的智能体推理框架用于多模态检索，通过视觉工具主动验证推理过程中的视觉证据，从而显著提高了检索准确性和泛化能力。

title: VisRefiner: Learning from Visual Differences for Screenshot-to-Code Generation
summary: Screenshot-to-code generation aims to translate user interface screenshots into executable frontend code that faithfully reproduces the target layout and style. Existing multimodal large language models perform this mapping directly from screenshots but are trained without observing the visual outcomes of their generated code. In contrast, human developers iteratively render their implementation, compare it with the design, and learn how visual differences relate to code changes. Inspired by this process, we propose VisRefiner, a training framework that enables models to learn from visual differences between rendered predictions and reference designs. We construct difference-aligned supervision that associates visual discrepancies with corresponding code edits, allowing the model to understand how appearance variations arise from implementation changes. Building on this, we introduce a reinforcement learning stage for self-refinement, where the model improves its generated code by observing both the rendered output and the target design, identifying their visual differences, and updating the code accordingly. Experiments show that VisRefiner substantially improves single-step generation quality and layout fidelity, while also endowing models with strong self-refinement ability. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of learning from visual differences for advancing screenshot-to-code generation.
summary_zh: 截图到代码生成旨在将用户界面截图翻译成可执行的前端代码，忠实地再现目标布局和样式。现有的多模态大型语言模型直接从截图中执行此映射，但训练时未观察到其生成代码的视觉结果。相比之下，人类开发者会迭代地渲染他们的实现，将其与设计进行比较，并学习视觉差异如何与代码更改相关联。受此过程的启发，我们提出了 VisRefiner，一个训练框架，使模型能够从渲染的预测和参考设计之间的视觉差异中学习。我们构建了差异对齐的监督，将视觉差异与相应的代码编辑相关联，从而使模型能够理解外观变化如何由实现更改引起。在此基础上，我们引入了一个用于自我精炼的强化学习阶段，在该阶段，模型通过观察渲染的输出和目标设计，识别它们的视觉差异，并相应地更新代码，从而改进其生成的代码。实验表明，VisRefiner 大幅度提高了单步生成质量和布局保真度，同时也赋予模型强大的自我精炼能力。这些结果证明了从视觉差异中学习对于推进截图到代码生成的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces VisRefiner, a training framework that allows screenshot-to-code generation models to learn from visual differences between rendered code and target designs, enhancing generation quality and layout fidelity through reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VisRefiner，一个训练框架，使截图到代码生成模型能够从渲染代码和目标设计之间的视觉差异中学习，通过强化学习提高生成质量和布局保真度。

title: Can vision language models learn intuitive physics from interaction?
summary: Pre-trained vision language models do not have good intuitions about the physical world. Recent work has shown that supervised fine-tuning can improve model performance on simple physical tasks. However, fine-tuned models do not appear to learn robust physical rules that can generalize to new contexts. Based on research in cognitive science, we hypothesize that models need to interact with an environment to properly learn its physical dynamics. We train models that learn through interaction with the environment using reinforcement learning. While learning from interaction allows models to improve their within-task performance, it fails to produce models with generalizable physical intuitions. We find that models trained on one task do not reliably generalize to related tasks, even if the tasks share visual statistics and physical principles, and regardless of whether the models are trained through interaction.
summary_zh: 预训练的视觉-语言模型对物理世界的直觉不足。 近期研究表明，有监督的微调可以提高模型在简单物理任务上的性能。 然而，经过微调的模型似乎并没有学习到能够泛化到新环境中的稳健物理规则。 基于认知科学的研究，我们假设模型需要与环境交互才能正确学习其物理动力学。 我们训练了通过强化学习与环境交互来学习的模型。 虽然从交互中学习能让模型提高其任务内的性能，但它无法产生具有可泛化物理直觉的模型。 我们发现，即使任务共享视觉统计和物理原理，且无论模型是否通过交互进行训练，在一个任务上训练的模型也无法可靠地泛化到相关任务。
tldr: This paper investigates whether reinforcement learning-based interaction can help vision-language models learn generalizable intuitive physics, finding that it improves within-task performance but not generalization across related tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了基于强化学习的交互是否能帮助视觉语言模型学习可泛化的直观物理学，发现它提高了任务内的性能，但不能泛化到相关任务。

title: On the Role of Iterative Computation in Reinforcement Learning
summary: How does the amount of compute available to a reinforcement learning (RL) policy affect its learning? Can policies using a fixed amount of parameters, still benefit from additional compute? The standard RL framework does not provide a language to answer these questions formally. Empirically, deep RL policies are often parameterized as neural networks with static architectures, conflating the amount of compute and the number of parameters. In this paper, we formalize compute bounded policies and prove that policies which use more compute can solve problems and generalize to longer-horizon tasks that are outside the scope of policies with less compute. Building on prior work in algorithmic learning and model-free planning, we propose a minimal architecture that can use a variable amount of compute. Our experiments complement our theory. On a set 31 different tasks spanning online and offline RL, we show that $(1)$ this architecture achieves stronger performance simply by using more compute, and $(2)$ stronger generalization on longer-horizon test tasks compared to standard feedforward networks or deep residual network using up to 5 times more parameters.
summary_zh: 强化学习(RL)策略可用的计算量如何影响其学习过程？使用固定数量参数的策略是否仍然可以从额外的计算量中获益？标准的RL框架没有提供一种正式回答这些问题的语言。在实践中，深度RL策略通常被参数化为具有静态架构的神经网络，这将计算量与参数量混淆。在本文中，我们形式化了计算量受限的策略，并证明了使用更多计算量的策略可以解决那些超出计算量较少策略范围的问题，并且能够泛化到更长视野的任务上。基于算法学习和无模型规划方面的先前工作，我们提出了一种可以使用可变计算量的最小架构。我们的实验补充了我们的理论。在一组涵盖在线和离线RL的31个不同任务上，我们表明 $(1)$ 这种架构仅仅通过使用更多的计算量就能获得更强的性能，并且 $(2)$ 与使用多达5倍参数的标准前馈网络或深度残差网络相比，在更长视野的测试任务上具有更强的泛化能力。
tldr: This paper formalizes compute-bounded policies in RL and demonstrates that increased computation, even with fixed parameters, improves performance and generalization on longer-horizon tasks compared to standard architectures with significantly more parameters.
tldr_zh: 该论文形式化了强化学习中计算受限策略的概念，并证明即使在参数固定的情况下，增加计算量也能提高性能和泛化能力，尤其是在长时间跨度的任务中，效果优于使用更多参数的传统架构。

title: f-GRPO and Beyond: Divergence-Based Reinforcement Learning Algorithms for General LLM Alignment
summary: Recent research shows that Preference Alignment (PA) objectives act as divergence estimators between aligned (chosen) and unaligned (rejected) response distributions. In this work, we extend this divergence-based perspective to general alignment settings, such as reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), where only environmental rewards are available. Within this unified framework, we propose f-Group Relative Policy Optimization (f-GRPO), a class of on-policy reinforcement learning, and f-Hybrid Alignment Loss (f-HAL), a hybrid on/off policy objectives, for general LLM alignment based on variational representation of f-divergences. We provide theoretical guarantees that these classes of objectives improve the average reward after alignment. Empirically, we validate our framework on both RLVR (Math Reasoning) and PA tasks (Safety Alignment), demonstrating superior performance and flexibility compared to current methods.
summary_zh: 近期研究表明，偏好对齐（PA）目标本质上是已对齐（选中）和未对齐（拒绝）响应分布之间的散度估计器。在这项工作中，我们将这种基于散度的视角扩展到一般的对齐设置，例如具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），其中只提供环境奖励。在这种统一框架下，我们提出了f-组相对策略优化（f-GRPO），一种基于f-散度变分表示的，用于通用LLM对齐的on-policy强化学习方法；以及f-混合对齐损失（f-HAL），一种混合on/off-policy目标。我们提供理论保证，证明这些目标函数类能够提升对齐后的平均奖励。在实验方面，我们在RLVR（数学推理）和PA任务（安全对齐）上验证了我们框架的有效性，结果表明与现有方法相比，我们的框架具有更优越的性能和灵活性。
tldr: This paper introduces divergence-based reinforcement learning algorithms (f-GRPO and f-HAL) for aligning LLMs in various settings (RLVR and Preference Alignment), offering theoretical guarantees and empirical validation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于散度的强化学习算法（f-GRPO 和 f-HAL），用于在各种设置（RLVR 和偏好对齐）中对齐 LLM，并提供了理论保证和经验验证。

title: SURE: Safe Uncertainty-Aware Robot-Environment Interaction using Trajectory Optimization
