summary: Robotic tasks involving contact interactions pose significant challenges for trajectory optimization due to discontinuous dynamics. Conventional formulations typically assume deterministic contact events, which limit robustness and adaptability in real-world settings. In this work, we propose SURE, a robust trajectory optimization framework that explicitly accounts for contact timing uncertainty. By allowing multiple trajectories to branch from possible pre-impact states and later rejoin a shared trajectory, SURE achieves both robustness and computational efficiency within a unified optimization framework. We evaluate SURE on two representative tasks with unknown impact times. In a cart-pole balancing task involving uncertain wall location, SURE achieves an average improvement of 21.6% in success rate when branch switching is enabled during control. In an egg-catching experiment using a robotic manipulator, SURE improves the success rate by 40%. These results demonstrate that SURE substantially enhances robustness compared to conventional nominal formulations.
summary_zh: 涉及接触交互的机器人任务由于动力学的不连续性，对轨迹优化提出了重大挑战。传统的公式通常假设确定性的接触事件，这限制了在实际环境中的鲁棒性和适应性。在这项工作中，我们提出了SURE，一种鲁棒的轨迹优化框架，它明确考虑了接触时间的不确定性。通过允许多条轨迹从可能的碰撞前状态分支，并在之后重新汇合到一条共享的轨迹上，SURE在一个统一的优化框架内实现了鲁棒性和计算效率。我们通过两个具有未知冲击时间的代表性任务评估SURE。在一个涉及不确定墙体位置的倒立摆平衡任务中，当在控制过程中启用分支切换时，SURE的成功率平均提高了21.6%。 在一个使用机器人机械臂的抓蛋实验中，SURE将成功率提高了40%。这些结果表明，与传统的标称公式相比，SURE大大提高了鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces SURE, a trajectory optimization framework for robot-environment interaction that handles contact timing uncertainty by branching trajectories, demonstrating improved success rates in cart-pole balancing and egg-catching tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SURE的轨迹优化框架，用于机器人与环境的交互，通过分支轨迹来处理接触时间的不确定性，并在推车-杆平衡和抓蛋任务中展示了更高的成功率。

title: SuReNav: Superpixel Graph-based Constraint Relaxation for Navigation in Over-constrained Environments
summary: We address the over-constrained planning problem in semi-static environments. The planning objective is to find a best-effort solution that avoids all hard constraint regions while minimally traversing the least risky areas. Conventional methods often rely on pre-defined area costs, limiting generalizations. Further, the spatial continuity of navigation spaces makes it difficult to identify regions that are passable without overestimation. To overcome these challenges, we propose SuReNav, a superpixel graph-based constraint relaxation and navigation method that imitates human-like safe and efficient navigation. Our framework consists of three components: 1) superpixel graph map generation with regional constraints, 2) regional-constraint relaxation using graph neural network trained on human demonstrations for safe and efficient navigation, and 3) interleaving relaxation, planning, and execution for complete navigation. We evaluate our method against state-of-the-art baselines on 2D semantic maps and 3D maps from OpenStreetMap, achieving the highest human-likeness score of complete navigation while maintaining a balanced trade-off between efficiency and safety. We finally demonstrate its scalability and generalization performance in real-world urban navigation with a quadruped robot, Spot.
summary_zh: 我们研究半静态环境下的超约束规划问题。规划目标是找到一个尽力而为的解决方案，既要避开所有硬约束区域，又要尽可能少地穿越风险最小的区域。传统方法通常依赖于预定义的区域代价，限制了泛化能力。此外，导航空间的连续性使得难以识别在不产生过度估计的情况下能够通过的区域。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出SuReNav，一种基于超像素图的约束松弛和导航方法，旨在模仿人类的安全性及效率的导航方式。我们的框架包含三个组成部分：1）带有区域约束的超像素图地图生成；2）利用图神经网络，基于人类安全高效导航的演示数据进行训练，以实现区域约束的松弛；3）交错进行松弛、规划和执行，以完成整个导航过程。我们在来自OpenStreetMap的2D语义地图和3D地图上，将我们的方法与最先进的基线方法进行比较，在保证效率和安全之间的平衡折衷下，实现了最高的完整导航人类相似度得分。最后，我们在一只四足机器人Spot上，通过真实世界的城市导航，展示了它的可扩展性和泛化性能。
tldr: The paper presents SuReNav, a superpixel graph-based navigation method that uses GNNs trained on human demonstrations to relax constraints and navigate efficiently in over-constrained environments, demonstrated on both simulated and real-world robotic platforms.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了SuReNav，一种基于超像素图的导航方法，利用在人类演示上训练的GNN来放宽约束并在过度约束的环境中有效地导航，并在模拟和真实的机器人平台上进行了演示。

title: Crowd-FM: Learned Optimal Selection of Conditional Flow Matching-generated Trajectories for Crowd Navigation
summary: Safe and computationally efficient local planning for mobile robots in dense, unstructured human crowds remains a fundamental challenge. Moreover, ensuring that robot trajectories are similar to how a human moves will increase the acceptance of the robot in human environments. In this paper, we present Crowd-FM, a learning-based approach to address both safety and human-likeness challenges. Our approach has two novel components. First, we train a Conditional Flow-Matching (CFM) policy over a dataset of optimally controlled trajectories to learn a set of collision-free primitives that a robot can choose at any given scenario. The chosen optimal control solver can generate multi-modal collision-free trajectories, allowing the CFM policy to learn a diverse set of maneuvers. Secondly, we learn a score function over a dataset of human demonstration trajectories that provides a human-likeness score for the flow primitives. At inference time, computing the optimal trajectory requires selecting the one with the highest score. Our approach improves the state-of-the-art by showing that our CFM policy alone can produce collision-free navigation with a higher success rate than existing learning-based baselines. Furthermore, when augmented with inference-time refinement, our approach can outperform even expensive optimisation-based planning approaches. Finally, we validate that our scoring network can select trajectories closer to the expert data than a manually designed cost function.
summary_zh: 在稠密、非结构化的人群中，为移动机器人进行安全且计算高效的局部规划仍然是一个根本性的挑战。此外，确保机器人轨迹类似于人类的移动方式将提高机器人在人类环境中的接受度。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于学习的方法 Crowd-FM，以应对安全性和类人性的挑战。我们的方法有两个新的组成部分。首先，我们在最优控制轨迹的数据集上训练一个条件流匹配（CFM）策略，以学习一组机器人可以在任何给定场景中选择的无碰撞原语。所选的最优控制求解器可以生成多模态的无碰撞轨迹，从而使CFM策略能够学习各种各样的机动动作。其次，我们在人类演示轨迹的数据集上学习一个评分函数，该函数为流原语提供类人性得分。在推理时，计算最优轨迹需要选择得分最高的轨迹。我们的方法改进了现有技术水平，表明我们的CFM策略本身就能产生比现有基于学习的基线方法更高成功率的无碰撞导航。此外，当通过推理时优化进行增强时，我们的方法甚至可以优于昂贵的基于优化的规划方法。最后，我们验证了我们的评分网络可以选择比手动设计的代价函数更接近专家数据的轨迹。
tldr: This paper introduces Crowd-FM, a learning-based approach for safe and human-like robot navigation in crowded environments, using conditional flow matching to generate collision-free primitives and a learned score function to select human-like trajectories.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Crowd-FM，一种基于学习的方法，用于在拥挤环境中实现安全且类人的机器人导航。该方法使用条件流匹配生成无碰撞的运动基元，并使用学习的评分函数来选择类人的轨迹。

title: RAPID: Reconfigurable, Adaptive Platform for Iterative Design
summary: Developing robotic manipulation policies is iterative and hypothesis-driven: researchers test tactile sensing, gripper geometries, and sensor placements through real-world data collection and training. Yet even minor end-effector changes often require mechanical refitting and system re-integration, slowing iteration. We present RAPID, a full-stack reconfigurable platform designed to reduce this friction. RAPID is built around a tool-free, modular hardware architecture that unifies handheld data collection and robot deployment, and a matching software stack that maintains real-time awareness of the underlying hardware configuration through a driver-level Physical Mask derived from USB events. This modular hardware architecture reduces reconfiguration to seconds and makes systematic multi-modal ablation studies practical, allowing researchers to sweep diverse gripper and sensing configurations without repeated system bring-up. The Physical Mask exposes modality presence as an explicit runtime signal, enabling auto-configuration and graceful degradation under sensor hot-plug events, so policies can continue executing when sensors are physically added or removed. System-centric experiments show that RAPID reduces the setup time for multi-modal configurations by two orders of magnitude compared to traditional workflows and preserves policy execution under runtime sensor hot-unplug events. The hardware designs, drivers, and software stack are open-sourced at https://rapid-kit.github.io/ .
summary_zh: 开发机器人操作策略是迭代且假设驱动的：研究人员通过真实世界的数据收集和训练来测试触觉传感、夹爪几何形状以及传感器放置。然而，即使是末端执行器的微小改动通常也需要机械重新装配和系统重新集成，从而减缓迭代速度。我们提出了RAPID，一个旨在减少这种摩擦的全栈可重构平台。RAPID围绕一个无工具、模块化的硬件架构构建，该架构统一了手持数据收集和机器人部署，以及一个与之匹配的软件栈，该软件栈通过源自USB事件的驱动级物理掩码，保持对底层硬件配置的实时感知。这种模块化硬件架构将重新配置时间缩短到几秒钟，并使系统的多模态消融研究成为可能，从而允许研究人员在无需重复系统启动的情况下扫描不同的夹爪和传感配置。物理掩码将模态存在性作为显式的运行时信号暴露出来，从而在传感器带电插拔事件下实现自动配置和优雅降级，以便策略可以在传感器被物理添加或移除时继续执行。以系统为中心的实验表明，与传统工作流程相比，RAPID将多模态配置的设置时间缩短了两个数量级，并可以在运行时传感器热插拔事件下保持策略执行。硬件设计、驱动程序和软件栈已在https://rapid-kit.github.io/开源。
tldr: The paper introduces RAPID, a reconfigurable robotics platform aimed at significantly reducing the setup time for robotic manipulation experiments and enabling more efficient iterative design, featuring tool-free hardware and auto-configuring software.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为RAPID的可重构机器人平台，旨在显著减少机器人操作实验的设置时间，并实现更高效的迭代设计，其特点是免工具硬件和自动配置软件。

title: Humanoid Manipulation Interface: Humanoid Whole-Body Manipulation from Robot-Free Demonstrations
summary: Current approaches for humanoid whole-body manipulation, primarily relying on teleoperation or visual sim-to-real reinforcement learning, are hindered by hardware logistics and complex reward engineering. Consequently, demonstrated autonomous skills remain limited and are typically restricted to controlled environments. In this paper, we present the Humanoid Manipulation Interface (HuMI), a portable and efficient framework for learning diverse whole-body manipulation tasks across various environments. HuMI enables robot-free data collection by capturing rich whole-body motion using portable hardware. This data drives a hierarchical learning pipeline that translates human motions into dexterous and feasible humanoid skills. Extensive experiments across five whole-body tasks--including kneeling, squatting, tossing, walking, and bimanual manipulation--demonstrate that HuMI achieves a 3x increase in data collection efficiency compared to teleoperation and attains a 70% success rate in unseen environments.
summary_zh: 目前人形机器人全身操作的方法，主要依赖于遥操作或基于视觉的模拟到真实强化学习，但受到硬件物流和复杂奖励函数设计的限制。因此，所展示的自主技能仍然有限，并且通常局限于受控环境。在本文中，我们提出了一种人形操作交互界面（HuMI），这是一种便携且高效的框架，用于学习各种环境中多样的全身操作任务。HuMI 通过使用便携式硬件捕获丰富的全身运动，从而实现无需机器人的数据采集。这些数据驱动一个分层学习流程，将人类运动转化为灵巧且可行的人形机器人技能。横跨五个全身任务——包括跪姿、深蹲、抛掷、行走和双手动灵巧操作——的大量实验表明，与遥操作相比，HuMI 在数据采集效率方面实现了 3 倍的提升，并在未见环境中实现了 70% 的成功率。
tldr: The paper introduces HuMI, a system for learning humanoid whole-body manipulation skills from robot-free human demonstrations, achieving better data collection efficiency and success rates in unseen environments compared to teleoperation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为HuMI的系统，该系统可以通过无机器人的动作捕捉学习人形机器人的全身操控技能，与远程操控相比，在数据收集效率和在未见环境中的成功率方面都有所提高。

title: Force Generative Imitation Learning: Bridging Position Trajectory and Force Commands through Control Technique
summary: In contact-rich tasks, while position trajectories are often easy to obtain, appropriate force commands are typically unknown. Although it is conceivable to generate force commands using a pretrained foundation model such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, force control is highly dependent on the specific hardware of the robot, which makes the application of such models challenging. To bridge this gap, we propose a force generative model that estimates force commands from given position trajectories. However, when dealing with unseen position trajectories, the model struggles to generate accurate force commands. To address this, we introduce a feedback control mechanism. Our experiments reveal that feedback control does not converge when the force generative model has memory. We therefore adopt a model without memory, enabling stable feedback control. This approach allows the system to generate force commands effectively, even for unseen position trajectories, improving generalization for real-world robot writing tasks.
summary_zh: 在接触丰富的任务中，虽然位置轨迹通常容易获取，但合适的力指令通常是未知的。虽然可以想象使用预训练的基础模型，如视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型来生成力指令，但力控制高度依赖于机器人的特定硬件，这使得此类模型的应用具有挑战性。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种力生成模型，该模型从给定的位置轨迹估计力指令。然而，在处理未见过的位置轨迹时，该模型难以生成准确的力指令。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种反馈控制机制。我们的实验表明，当力生成模型具有记忆时，反馈控制不会收敛。因此，我们采用了一种没有记忆的模型，从而实现稳定的反馈控制。这种方法允许系统有效地生成力指令，即使对于未见过的位置轨迹，从而提高了真实世界机器人书写任务的泛化能力。
tldr: This paper proposes a force generative model with feedback control to estimate force commands from position trajectories, addressing the challenge of applying foundation models to hardware-specific robot force control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种带有反馈控制的力生成模型，用于从位置轨迹估计力指令，旨在解决将基础模型应用于特定硬件的机器人力控制的难题。

title: The Law of Task-Achieving Body Motion: Axiomatizing Success of Robot Manipulation Actions
summary: Autonomous agents that perform everyday manipulation actions need to ensure that their body motions are semantically correct with respect to a task request, causally effective within their environment, and feasible for their embodiment. In order to enable robots to verify these properties, we introduce the Law of Task-Achieving Body Motion as an axiomatic correctness specification for body motions. To that end we introduce scoped Task-Environment-Embodiment (TEE) classes that represent world states as Semantic Digital Twins (SDTs) and define applicable physics models to decompose task achievement into three predicates: SatisfiesRequest for semantic request satisfaction over SDT state evolution; Causes for causal sufficiency under the scoped physics model; and CanPerform for safety and feasibility verification at the embodiment level. This decomposition yields a reusable, implementation-independent interface that supports motion synthesis and the verification of given body motions. It also supports typed failure diagnosis (semantic, causal, embodiment and out-of-scope), feasibility across robots and environments, and counterfactual reasoning about robot body motions. We demonstrate the usability of the law in practice by instantiating it for articulated container manipulation in kitchen environments on three contrasting mobile manipulation platforms
summary_zh: 执行日常操作的自主Agent需要确保它们的身体运动在语义上与任务请求相符、在环境中具有因果效力，并且对其自身机体而言是可行的。为了使机器人能够验证这些属性，我们引入了“任务实现身体运动法则”作为身体运动的公理化正确性规范。为此，我们引入了作用域限定的任务-环境-机体 (TEE) 类，将世界状态表示为语义数字孪生 (SDT)，并定义适用的物理模型，将任务实现分解为三个谓词：用于在SDT状态演化中实现语义请求的SatisfiesRequest；用于在作用域限定的物理模型下实现因果充分性的Causes；以及用于在机体层面进行安全性和可行性验证的CanPerform。这种分解产生了一个可重用、与实现无关的接口，支持运动合成和给定身体运动的验证。它还支持类型化的故障诊断（语义、因果、机体以及超出范围）、跨机器人和环境的可行性，以及关于机器人身体运动的反事实推理。我们通过在厨房环境中对三个对比鲜明的移动操作平台上的铰接容器操作进行实例化，来演示该法则在实践中的可用性。
tldr: The paper introduces the "Law of Task-Achieving Body Motion," an axiomatic specification for robot body motions, decomposed into semantic, causal, and embodiment predicates for verification and diagnosis of manipulation actions across different robots and environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了“任务实现型身体运动定律”，这是一个机器人身体运动的公理化规范，分解为语义、因果和体现谓词，用于验证和诊断不同机器人和环境中操作行为。

title: MultiGraspNet: A Multitask 3D Vision Model for Multi-gripper Robotic Grasping
summary: Vision-based models for robotic grasping automate critical, repetitive, and draining industrial tasks. Existing approaches are typically limited in two ways: they either target a single gripper and are potentially applied on costly dual-arm setups, or rely on custom hybrid grippers that require ad-hoc learning procedures with logic that cannot be transferred across tasks, restricting their general applicability. In this work, we present MultiGraspNet, a novel multitask 3D deep learning method that predicts feasible poses simultaneously for parallel and vacuum grippers within a unified framework, enabling a single robot to handle multiple end effectors. The model is trained on the richly annotated GraspNet-1Billion and SuctionNet-1Billion datasets, which have been aligned for the purpose, and generates graspability masks quantifying the suitability of each scene point for successful grasps. By sharing early-stage features while maintaining gripper-specific refiners, MultiGraspNet effectively leverages complementary information across grasping modalities, enhancing robustness and adaptability in cluttered scenes. We characterize MultiGraspNet's performance with an extensive experimental analysis, demonstrating its competitiveness with single-task models on relevant benchmarks. We run real-world experiments on a single-arm multi-gripper robotic setup showing that our approach outperforms the vacuum baseline, grasping 16% percent more seen objects and 32% more of the novel ones, while obtaining competitive results for the parallel task.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的机器人抓取模型能够自动化关键、重复且耗费精力的工业任务。现有的方法通常在两个方面受到限制：它们要么针对单个夹爪，并可能应用于昂贵的双臂设置；要么依赖于定制的混合夹爪，这些夹爪需要特定的学习流程和逻辑，无法跨任务转移，从而限制了它们的一般适用性。在这项工作中，我们提出了MultiGraspNet，一种新颖的多任务3D深度学习方法，它在一个统一的框架内同时预测平行夹爪和真空吸盘的可行姿态，使单个机器人能够处理多个末端执行器。该模型在经过对齐的富含标注的GraspNet-1Billion和SuctionNet-1Billion数据集上进行训练，并生成可抓取性掩膜，量化场景中每个点成功抓取的适用性。通过共享早期阶段的特征，同时保持特定于夹爪的精炼器，MultiGraspNet有效地利用了跨抓取模式的互补信息，从而提高了在杂乱场景中的鲁棒性和适应性。我们通过广泛的实验分析来表征MultiGraspNet的性能，表明其在相关基准测试中与单任务模型具有竞争力。我们在单臂多夹爪机器人设置上进行了真实世界的实验，表明我们的方法优于真空吸盘基线，在已见过的物体上的抓取成功率高出16%，在未见过的物体上的抓取成功率高出32%，同时在平行抓取任务上获得了具有竞争力的结果。
tldr: MultiGraspNet is a multitask 3D vision model that predicts feasible poses for parallel and vacuum grippers, demonstrating improved grasping performance in real-world robotic settings compared to single-gripper baselines.
tldr_zh: MultiGraspNet是一个多任务3D视觉模型，可以预测平行和真空吸盘的可行姿势。与单吸盘基线相比，该模型在真实机器人环境中展现出更好的抓取性能。

title: Internalized Morphogenesis: A Self-Organizing Model for Growth, Replication, and Regeneration via Local Token Exchange in Modular Systems
summary: This study presents an internalized morphogenesis model for autonomous systems, such as swarm robotics and micro-nanomachines, that eliminates the need for external spatial computation. Traditional self-organizing models often require calculations across the entire coordinate space, including empty areas, which is impractical for resource-constrained physical modules. Our proposed model achieves complex morphogenesis through strictly local interactions between adjacent modules within the "body." By extending the "Ishida token model," modules exchange integer values using an RD-inspired discrete analogue without solving differential equations. The internal potential, derived from token accumulation and aging, guides autonomous growth, shrinkage, and replication. Simulations on a hexagonal grid demonstrated the emergence of limb-like extensions, self-division, and robust regeneration capabilities following structural amputation. A key feature is the use of the body boundary as a natural sink for information entropy (tokens) to maintain a dynamic equilibrium. These results indicate that sophisticated morphological behaviors can emerge from minimal, internal-only rules. This framework offers a computationally efficient and biologically plausible approach to developing self-repairing, adaptive, and autonomous hardware.
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种用于自主系统的内化形态发生模型，例如集群机器人和微纳米机器，该模型消除了对外部空间计算的需求。传统的自组织模型通常需要在整个坐标空间（包括空白区域）进行计算，这对于资源受限的物理模块来说是不切实际的。我们提出的模型通过“身体”内相邻模块之间的严格局部交互来实现复杂的形态发生。通过扩展“石田令牌模型”，模块使用受RD（反应扩散）启发的离散类似物交换整数值，而无需求解微分方程。源自令牌累积和老化的内部势能引导自主生长、收缩和复制。在六边形网格上的仿真表明，肢状延伸的出现、自我分裂以及结构截肢后的强大再生能力。一个关键特征是利用身体边界作为信息熵（令牌）的天然汇，以维持动态平衡。这些结果表明，复杂的形态行为可以从最小的、仅限内部的规则中涌现。该框架为开发自修复、自适应和自主硬件提供了一种计算高效且生物学上合理的途径。
tldr: The paper proposes an "internalized morphogenesis" model allowing autonomous systems to grow, replicate, and regenerate through local interactions of modules, demonstrating these capabilities in simulations and claiming biological plausibility and computational efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种“内在形态发生”模型，允许自治系统通过模块的局部交互来实现生长、复制和再生。该模型在模拟中展示了这些能力，并声称具有生物合理性和计算效率。

title: Robots That Generate Planarity Through Geometry
summary: Constraining motion to a flat surface is a fundamental requirement for equipment across science and engineering. Modern precision robotic motion systems, such as gantries, rely on the flatness of components, including guide rails and granite surface plates. However, translating this static flatness into motion requires precise internal alignment and tight-tolerance components that create long, error-sensitive reference chains. Here, we show that by using the geometric inversion of a sphere into a plane, we can produce robotic motion systems that derive planarity entirely from link lengths and connectivity. This allows planar motion to emerge from self-referencing geometric constraints, and without external metrology. We demonstrate these Flat-Plane Mechanisms (FPMs) from micron to meter scales and show that fabrication errors can be attenuated by an order of magnitude in the resulting flatness. Finally, we present a robotic FPM-based 3-axis positioning system that can be used for metrology surface scans ($\pm 12$-mm) and 3D printing inside narrow containers. This work establishes an alternative geometric foundation for planar motion that can be realized across size scales and opens new possibilities in metrology, fabrication, and micro-positioning.
summary_zh: 将运动限制在平面上是科学和工程领域设备的基本要求。现代精密机器人运动系统，如龙门架，依赖于包括导轨和花岗岩表面平板等组件的平面度。然而，将这种静态平面度转化为运动需要精密的内部对准和严格公差的组件，这会产生冗长且对误差敏感的参考链。在此，我们展示了通过使用球体到平面的几何反演，我们可以生产出完全从连杆长度和连接性推导出平面性的机器人运动系统。这使得平面运动能够从自参考几何约束中产生，而无需外部计量。我们展示了从微米到米级别的这些平面机构（FPM），并表明制造误差可以在最终的平面度中衰减一个数量级。最后，我们展示了一种基于机器人FPM的三轴定位系统，该系统可用于计量表面扫描（$\pm 12$ 毫米）和在狭窄容器内进行3D打印。这项工作为平面运动建立了一种替代的几何基础，该基础可以在各种尺寸尺度上实现，并为计量、制造和微定位开辟了新的可能性。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel robotic motion system (Flat-Plane Mechanisms) that achieves planar motion through geometric constraints, minimizing the need for precise alignment and high-tolerance components. The system demonstrates error attenuation and potential applications in metrology and 3D printing.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新型机器人运动系统（平面机构），该系统通过几何约束实现平面运动，最大限度地减少了对精确对准和高精度组件的需求。该系统展示了误差衰减以及在计量和3D打印中的潜在应用。

title: MORPH Wheel: A Passive Variable-Radius Wheel Embedding Mechanical Behavior Logic for Input-Responsive Transformation
summary: This paper introduces the Mechacnially prOgrammed Radius-adjustable PHysical (MORPH) wheel, a fully passive variable-radius wheel that embeds mechanical behavior logic for torque-responsive transformation. Unlike conventional variable transmission systems relying on actuators, sensors, and active control, the MORPH wheel achieves passive adaptation solely through its geometry and compliant structure. The design integrates a torque-response coupler and spring-loaded connecting struts to mechanically adjust the wheel radius between 80 mm and 45 mm in response to input torque, without any electrical components. The MORPH wheel provides three unique capabilities rarely achieved simultaneously in previous passive designs: (1) bidirectional operation with unlimited rotation through a symmetric coupler; (2) high torque capacity exceeding 10 N with rigid power transmission in drive mode; and (3) precise and repeatable transmission ratio control governed by deterministic kinematics. A comprehensive analytical model was developed to describe the wheel's mechanical behavior logic, establishing threshold conditions for mode switching between direct drive and radius transformation. Experimental validation confirmed that the measured torque-radius and force-displacement characteristics closely follow theoretical predictions across wheel weights of 1.8-2.8kg. Robot-level demonstrations on varying loads (0-25kg), slopes, and unstructured terrains further verified that the MORPH wheel passively adjusts its radius to provide optimal transmission ratio. The MORPH wheel exemplifies a mechanically programmed structure, embedding intelligent, context-dependent behavior directly into its physical design. This approach offers a new paradigm for passive variable transmission and mechanical intelligence in robotic mobility systems operating in unpredictable or control-limited environments.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种机械编程半径可调物理轮（MORPH轮），它是一种完全被动的可变半径轮，嵌入了机械行为逻辑，用于响应扭矩的转换。与依赖于执行器、传感器和主动控制的传统变速系统不同，MORPH轮仅通过其几何结构和柔性结构实现被动适应。该设计集成了扭矩响应耦合器和弹簧加载的连接支柱，以机械方式在80毫米和45毫米之间调整车轮半径，从而响应输入扭矩，而无需任何电气元件。MORPH轮提供了三种独特的性能，这些性能很少在以前的被动设计中同时实现：（1）通过对称耦合器实现双向操作和无限旋转；（2）高扭矩容量，在驱动模式下超过10牛顿，并具有刚性动力传输；（3）精确且可重复的传动比控制，由确定的运动学控制。建立了一个全面的分析模型来描述车轮的机械行为逻辑，从而确定了直接驱动和半径转换之间模式切换的阈值条件。实验验证证实，在1.8-2.8公斤的车轮重量范围内，测量的扭矩-半径和力-位移特性与理论预测非常吻合。在不同负载（0-25公斤）、坡度和非结构化地形上的机器人层面的演示进一步验证了MORPH轮能够被动地调整其半径，从而提供最佳的传动比。MORPH轮例证了一种机械编程结构，将智能的、依赖于上下文的行为直接嵌入到其物理设计中。这种方法为被动可变速传动和在不可预测或控制受限环境中运行的机器人移动系统中的机械智能提供了新的范例。
tldr: The paper presents a passive variable-radius wheel (MORPH wheel) that adjusts its radius in response to input torque, offering a novel solution for robotic mobility in unpredictable environments without requiring active control.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种被动式变半径轮（MORPH轮），它可以根据输入扭矩调整其半径，为在不可预测环境中运行的机器人移动提供了一种无需主动控制的新颖解决方案。

title: A Dialogue-Based Human-Robot Interaction Protocol for Wheelchair and Robotic Arm Integrated Control
summary: People with lower and upper body disabilities can benefit from wheelchairs and robotic arms to improve mobility and independence. Prior assistive interfaces, such as touchscreens and voice-driven predefined commands, often remain unintuitive and struggle to capture complex user intent. We propose a natural, dialogue based human robot interaction protocol that simulates an intelligent agent capable of communicating with users to understand intent and execute assistive actions. In a pilot study, five participants completed five assistive tasks (cleaning, drinking, feeding, drawer opening, and door opening) through dialogue-based interaction with a wheelchair and robotic arm. As a baseline, participants were required to open a door using the manual control (a wheelchair joystick and a game controller for the arm) and complete a questionnaire to gather their feedback. By analyzing the post-study questionnaires, we found that most participants enjoyed the dialogue-based interaction and assistive robot autonomy.
summary_zh: 肢体残疾人士可借助轮椅和机械臂来提高行动能力和独立性。现有的辅助界面，如触摸屏和语音驱动的预定义命令，通常不够直观，且难以捕捉复杂的用户意图。我们提出了一种自然的、基于对话的人机交互协议，该协议模拟了一个能够与用户通信以理解意图并执行辅助动作的智能代理。在一项初步研究中，五名参与者通过与轮椅和机械臂的基于对话的交互完成了五项辅助任务（清洁、饮水、喂食、抽屉开启和开门）。作为基线，参与者需要使用手动控制（轮椅操纵杆和机械臂游戏控制器）打开一扇门，并完成一份问卷调查以收集他们的反馈。通过分析研究后的问卷调查，我们发现大多数参与者喜欢基于对话的交互和辅助机器人的自主性。
tldr: This paper presents a dialogue-based human-robot interaction protocol for controlling a wheelchair and robotic arm, demonstrating improved user experience compared to manual control in assistive tasks.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文提出了一种基于对话的人机交互协议，用于控制轮椅和机械臂，并证明在辅助任务中，与手动控制相比，用户体验有所改善。

title: Addressing the Waypoint-Action Gap in End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Vehicle Motion Models
summary: End-to-End Autonomous Driving (E2E-AD) systems are typically grouped by the nature of their outputs: (i) waypoint-based models that predict a future trajectory, and (ii) action-based models that directly output throttle, steer and brake. Most recent benchmark protocols and training pipelines are waypoint-based, which makes action-based policies harder to train and compare, slowing their progress. To bridge this waypoint-action gap, we propose a novel, differentiable vehicle-model framework that rolls out predicted action sequences to their corresponding ego-frame waypoint trajectories while supervising in waypoint space. Our approach enables action-based architectures to be trained and evaluated, for the first time, within waypoint-based benchmarks without modifying the underlying evaluation protocol. We extensively evaluate our framework across multiple challenging benchmarks and observe consistent improvements over the baselines. In particular, on NAVSIM \texttt{navhard} our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶(E2E-AD)系统通常根据其输出的性质进行分组：(i) 基于航路点的模型，预测未来的轨迹，以及 (ii) 基于动作的模型，直接输出油门、转向和刹车。最近的大多数基准协议和训练流程都是基于航路点的，这使得基于动作的策略更难训练和比较，从而减缓了它们的进展。为了弥合航路点-动作之间的差距，我们提出了一种新的、可微分的车辆模型框架，该框架将预测的动作序列展开为其相应的自车坐标系航路点轨迹，同时在航路点空间中进行监督。我们的方法首次使基于动作的架构能够在基于航路点的基准测试中进行训练和评估，而无需修改底层评估协议。我们广泛地评估了我们的框架在多个具有挑战性的基准测试中，并观察到相对于基线的持续改进。特别是在NAVSIM \texttt{navhard} 上，我们的方法实现了最先进的性能。我们的代码将在被接受后公开。
tldr: The paper introduces a differentiable vehicle model framework that bridges the gap between action-based and waypoint-based end-to-end autonomous driving systems, enabling action-based models to be trained and evaluated on waypoint-based benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art results on NAVSIM. The approach facilitates a more direct comparison of action-based models and waypoint-based models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种可微分的车辆模型框架，弥合了基于动作和基于航点的端到端自动驾驶系统之间的差距，使得基于动作的模型可以在基于航点的基准上进行训练和评估，并在 NAVSIM 上实现了最先进的结果。该方法有助于更直接地比较基于动作的模型和基于航点的模型。

title: AnyThermal: Towards Learning Universal Representations for Thermal Perception
summary: We present AnyThermal, a thermal backbone that captures robust task-agnostic thermal features suitable for a variety of tasks such as cross-modal place recognition, thermal segmentation, and monocular depth estimation using thermal images. Existing thermal backbones that follow task-specific training from small-scale data result in utility limited to a specific environment and task. Unlike prior methods, AnyThermal can be used for a wide range of environments (indoor, aerial, off-road, urban) and tasks, all without task-specific training. Our key insight is to distill the feature representations from visual foundation models such as DINOv2 into a thermal encoder using thermal data from these multiple environments. To bridge the diversity gap of the existing RGB-Thermal datasets, we introduce the TartanRGBT platform, the first open-source data collection platform with synced RGB-Thermal image acquisition. We use this payload to collect the TartanRGBT dataset - a diverse and balanced dataset collected in 4 environments. We demonstrate the efficacy of AnyThermal and TartanRGBT, achieving state-of-the-art results with improvements of up to 36% across diverse environments and downstream tasks on existing datasets.
summary_zh: 我们提出了AnyThermal，一个热成像骨干网络，它能捕捉鲁棒的、任务无关的热成像特征，适用于各种任务，例如跨模态位置识别、热成像分割以及利用热成像的单目深度估计。现有的热成像骨干网络遵循从小规模数据中进行的任务特定训练，导致其效用仅限于特定环境和任务。与现有方法不同，AnyThermal可以用于广泛的环境（室内、航空、越野、城市）和任务，而无需进行任务特定的训练。我们的关键洞见是利用来自这些多种环境的热成像数据，将来自例如DINOv2等视觉基础模型的特征表示提炼到热成像编码器中。为了弥合现有RGB-Thermal数据集的多样性差距，我们引入了TartanRGBT平台，这是第一个具有同步RGB-Thermal图像采集的开源数据收集平台。我们利用此有效载荷收集了TartanRGBT数据集——一个在四种环境中收集的多元且平衡的数据集。我们展示了AnyThermal和TartanRGBT的有效性，在现有数据集上，在各种环境和下游任务中取得了最先进的结果，提高了高达36%。
tldr: The paper introduces AnyThermal, a thermal backbone trained via distillation from visual foundation models on a new diverse RGB-Thermal dataset (TartanRGBT) for various tasks like place recognition, segmentation, and depth estimation, achieving state-of-the-art results without task-specific training.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AnyThermal，一个通过视觉基础模型知识蒸馏训练的热成像骨干网络，使用新的多样化RGB-Thermal数据集(TartanRGBT)，用于各种任务，如地点识别，分割和深度估计，在没有特定任务训练的情况下实现了最先进的结果。

title: Learning Event-Based Shooter Models from Virtual Reality Experiments
summary: Virtual reality (VR) has emerged as a powerful tool for evaluating school security measures in high-risk scenarios such as school shootings, offering experimental control and high behavioral fidelity. However, assessing new interventions in VR requires recruiting new participant cohorts for each condition, making large-scale or iterative evaluation difficult. These limitations are especially restrictive when attempting to learn effective intervention strategies, which typically require many training episodes. To address this challenge, we develop a data-driven discrete-event simulator (DES) that models shooter movement and in-region actions as stochastic processes learned from participant behavior in VR studies. We use the simulator to examine the impact of a robot-based shooter intervention strategy. Once shown to reproduce key empirical patterns, the DES enables scalable evaluation and learning of intervention strategies that are infeasible to train directly with human subjects. Overall, this work demonstrates a high-to-mid fidelity simulation workflow that provides a scalable surrogate for developing and evaluating autonomous school-security interventions.
summary_zh: 虚拟现实(VR)已成为评估高风险场景（如校园枪击案）中校园安全措施的强大工具，它提供了实验控制和高度的行为逼真度。然而，在VR中评估新的干预措施需要为每个条件招募新的参与者群体，这使得大规模或迭代评估变得困难。当试图学习有效的干预策略时，这些限制尤其突出，这些策略通常需要多次训练。为了应对这一挑战，我们开发了一种数据驱动的离散事件模拟器 (DES)，该模拟器将枪击者 movement 和区域内行为建模为从 VR 研究中参与者行为学习到的随机过程。我们利用该模拟器来检验一种基于机器人的枪击者干预策略的影响。一旦证明能够重现关键的经验模式，DES就能对干预策略进行可扩展的评估和学习，而这些策略直接用人类受试者进行训练是不可行的。总的来说，这项工作展示了一个高到中等逼真度的模拟工作流程，为开发和评估自主校园安全干预措施提供了一种可扩展的替代方案。
tldr: This paper presents a data-driven discrete-event simulator (DES) learned from VR experiments of school shootings to evaluate and learn effective intervention strategies, particularly robot-based interventions, addressing the limitations of human-subject VR studies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的离散事件模拟器（DES），该模拟器通过对校园枪击案的VR实验进行学习，以评估和学习有效的干预策略，特别是基于机器人的干预，从而解决了人类受试者VR研究的局限性。

title: AEGPO: Adaptive Entropy-Guided Policy Optimization for Diffusion Models
summary:
Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) shows promise for aligning diffusion and flow models, yet policy optimization methods such as GRPO suffer from inefficient and static sampling strategies. These methods treat all prompts and denoising steps uniformly, ignoring substantial variations in sample learning value as well as the dynamic nature of critical exploration moments.
  To address this issue, we conduct a detailed analysis of the internal attention dynamics during GRPO training and uncover a key insight: attention entropy can serve as a powerful dual-signal proxy. First, across different samples, the relative change in attention entropy (ΔEntropy), which reflects the divergence between the current policy and the base policy, acts as a robust indicator of sample learning value. Second, during the denoising process, the peaks of absolute attention entropy (Entropy(t)), which quantify attention dispersion, effectively identify critical timesteps where high-value exploration occurs.
  Building on this observation, we propose Adaptive Entropy-Guided Policy Optimization (AEGPO), a novel dual-signal, dual-level adaptive optimization strategy. At the global level, AEGPO uses ΔEntropy to dynamically allocate rollout budgets, prioritizing prompts with higher learning value. At the local level, it exploits the peaks of Entropy(t) to guide exploration selectively at critical high-dispersion timesteps rather than uniformly across all denoising steps.
  By focusing computation on the most informative samples and the most critical moments, AEGPO enables more efficient and effective policy optimization. Experiments on text-to-image generation tasks demonstrate that AEGPO significantly accelerates convergence and achieves superior alignment performance compared to standard GRPO variants.
summary_zh:
从人类反馈中进行强化学习（RLHF）在对齐扩散模型和流模型方面展现出前景，然而，诸如GRPO之类的策略优化方法却受到低效且静态的采样策略的困扰。这些方法对所有提示词和去噪步骤一视同仁，忽略了样本学习价值的显著差异以及关键探索时刻的动态特性。

为了解决这个问题，我们对GRPO训练期间的内部注意力动态进行了详细分析，并揭示了一个关键见解：注意力熵可以作为一种强大的双信号代理。首先，在不同的样本中，注意力熵的相对变化（ΔEntropy），它反映了当前策略和基线策略之间的差异，可以作为样本学习价值的可靠指标。其次，在去噪过程中，绝对注意力熵的峰值（Entropy(t)），它量化了注意力的分散程度，可以有效地识别关键时间步，即发生高价值探索的时间点。

基于这一观察，我们提出了一种新颖的双信号、双层自适应优化策略，即自适应熵引导策略优化（AEGPO）。在全局层面上，AEGPO使用ΔEntropy来动态分配回滚预算，优先考虑具有更高学习价值的提示词。 在局部层面上，它利用Entropy(t)的峰值来选择性地引导在关键高分散时间步的探索，而不是均匀地跨越所有去噪步骤。

通过将计算集中在信息量最大的样本和最关键的时刻，AEGPO能够实现更高效和有效的策略优化。在文本到图像生成任务上的实验表明，与标准GRPO变体相比，AEGPO显著加速了收敛速度，并实现了卓越的对齐性能。
tldr: The paper introduces AEGPO, an adaptive policy optimization method for diffusion models that uses attention entropy to prioritize prompts with high learning value and guide exploration at critical denoising timesteps, leading to faster convergence and better alignment performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AEGPO，一种用于扩散模型的自适应策略优化方法，它利用注意力熵来优先处理具有高学习价值的提示语，并在关键的去噪时间步指导探索，从而实现更快的收敛和更好的对齐性能。

title: Semantically Labelled Automata for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning with LTL Instructions
summary: We study multi-task reinforcement learning (RL), a setting in which an agent learns a single, universal policy capable of generalising to arbitrary, possibly unseen tasks. We consider tasks specified as linear temporal logic (LTL) formulae, which are commonly used in formal methods to specify properties of systems, and have recently been successfully adopted in RL. In this setting, we present a novel task embedding technique leveraging a new generation of semantic LTL-to-automata translations, originally developed for temporal synthesis. The resulting semantically labelled automata contain rich, structured information in each state that allow us to (i) compute the automaton efficiently on-the-fly, (ii) extract expressive task embeddings used to condition the policy, and (iii) naturally support full LTL. Experimental results in a variety of domains demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance and is able to scale to complex specifications where existing methods fail.
summary_zh: 我们研究多任务强化学习（RL），其中智能体学习一种通用的策略，能够泛化到任意的、可能未见过的任务。我们考虑以线性时序逻辑（LTL）公式指定的任务，这些公式常用于形式化方法中指定系统的属性，并且最近已成功应用于强化学习。在此背景下，我们提出了一种新颖的任务嵌入技术，该技术利用了新一代的语义化的LTL到自动机翻译，最初是为时间合成而开发的。由此产生的语义标记自动机在每个状态中包含丰富的、结构化的信息，这使得我们能够（i）有效地动态计算自动机，（ii）提取用于调节策略的富有表现力的任务嵌入，以及（iii）自然地支持完整的LTL。在各种领域中的实验结果表明，我们的方法实现了最先进的性能，并且能够扩展到现有方法失败的复杂规范。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel task embedding technique using semantically labelled automata for multi-task reinforcement learning with LTL instructions, achieving state-of-the-art performance and scaling to complex specifications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的任务嵌入技术，该技术使用语义标记的自动机来进行带有LTL指令的多任务强化学习，从而实现了最先进的性能并可扩展到复杂的规范。

title: Pairwise is Not Enough: Hypergraph Neural Networks for Multi-Agent Pathfinding
summary: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) is a representative multi-agent coordination problem, where multiple agents are required to navigate to their respective goals without collisions. Solving MAPF optimally is known to be NP-hard, leading to the adoption of learning-based approaches to alleviate the online computational burden. Prevailing approaches, such as Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), are typically constrained to pairwise message passing between agents. However, this limitation leads to suboptimal behaviours and critical issues, such as attention dilution, particularly in dense environments where group (i.e. beyond just two agents) coordination is most critical. Despite the importance of such higher-order interactions, existing approaches have not been able to fully explore them. To address this representational bottleneck, we introduce HMAGAT (Hypergraph Multi-Agent Attention Network), a novel architecture that leverages attentional mechanisms over directed hypergraphs to explicitly capture group dynamics. Empirically, HMAGAT establishes a new state-of-the-art among learning-based MAPF solvers: e.g., despite having just 1M parameters and being trained on 100$\times$ less data, it outperforms the current SoTA 85M parameter model. Through detailed analysis of HMAGAT's attention values, we demonstrate how hypergraph representations mitigate the attention dilution inherent in GNNs and capture complex interactions where pairwise methods fail. Our results illustrate that appropriate inductive biases are often more critical than the training data size or sheer parameter count for multi-agent problems.
summary_zh: 多智能体路径规划（MAPF）是一个具有代表性的多智能体协调问题，其要求多个智能体在无碰撞的情况下导航到各自的目标。MAPF的最优求解已知是NP-难的，这促使人们采用基于学习的方法来减轻在线计算负担。目前主流的方法，例如图神经网络（GNNs），通常局限于智能体间的两两消息传递。然而，这种限制会导致次优行为和关键问题，例如注意力稀释，尤其是在密集环境中，此时群体（即超越仅两个智能体）协调最为关键。尽管这种高阶交互非常重要，但现有的方法未能充分探索它们。为了解决这个表征瓶颈，我们引入了HMAGAT（超图多智能体注意力网络），一种新型架构，它利用有向超图上的注意力机制来显式地捕获群体动态。在实验上，HMAGAT在基于学习的MAPF求解器中建立了一个新的最先进水平：例如，尽管只有100万个参数并且在减少100倍的数据上进行训练，但它优于当前最先进的具有8500万个参数的模型。通过对HMAGAT注意力值的详细分析，我们证明了超图表示如何缓解GNN中固有的注意力稀释，并捕获成对方法无法处理的复杂交互。我们的结果表明，对于多智能体问题，适当的归纳偏置通常比训练数据的大小或单纯的参数数量更为关键。
tldr: The paper introduces HMAGAT, a hypergraph neural network for multi-agent pathfinding that captures group dynamics and outperforms existing pairwise GNN approaches, achieving state-of-the-art results with fewer parameters and less training data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于多智能体路径规划的超图神经网络 HMAGAT，它能够捕捉群体动态，并优于现有的成对 GNN 方法，以更少的参数和更少的数据实现了最先进的结果。

title: F-GRPO: Don't Let Your Policy Learn the Obvious and Forget the Rare
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is commonly based on group sampling to estimate advantages and stabilize policy updates. In practice, large group sizes are not feasible due to computational limits, which biases learning toward trajectories that are already likely. Smaller groups often miss rare-correct trajectories while still containing mixed rewards, concentrating probability on common solutions. We derive the probability that updates miss rare-correct modes as a function of group size, showing non-monotonic behavior, and characterize how updates redistribute mass within the correct set, revealing that unsampled-correct mass can shrink even as total correct mass grows. Motivated by this analysis, we propose a difficulty-aware advantage scaling coefficient, inspired by Focal loss, that down-weights updates on high-success prompts. The lightweight modification can be directly integrated into any group-relative RLVR algorithm such as GRPO, DAPO, and CISPO. On Qwen2.5-7B across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, our method improves pass@256 from 64.1 $\rightarrow$ 70.3 (GRPO), 69.3 $\rightarrow$ 72.5 (DAPO), and 73.2 $\rightarrow$ 76.8 (CISPO), while preserving or improving pass@1, without increasing group size or computational cost.
summary_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习(RLVR)通常依赖于分组采样来估计优势函数并稳定策略更新。但在实践中，由于计算限制，大的组规模是不可行的，这导致学习偏向于已经很可能的轨迹。较小的组规模常常会遗漏罕见且正确的轨迹，同时依然包含混合奖励，从而将概率集中在常见的解决方案上。我们推导了更新遗漏罕见正确模式的概率作为组规模的函数，展示了非单调行为，并描述了更新如何在正确集合内重新分配概率质量，揭示了即使总的正确质量增长，未被采样的正确质量也会缩减。受此分析的启发，我们提出了一种难度感知的优势缩放系数，灵感来源于Focal loss，该系数降低了对高成功提示的更新权重。这种轻量级的修改可以直接集成到任何组相对的RLVR算法中，如GRPO、DAPO和CISPO。在使用通义千问2.5-7B模型，在领域内和领域外基准测试中，我们的方法将pass@256从64.1提升至 70.3 (GRPO)，从69.3提升至72.5 (DAPO)，以及从73.2提升至76.8 (CISPO)，同时保持或提高了pass@1，而没有增加组规模或计算成本。
tldr: The paper introduces F-GRPO, a modification to Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that addresses the bias towards common trajectories in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) by down-weighting high-success prompts. It achieves significant pass@k improvements on Qwen2.5-7B without increased computational cost.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了F-GRPO，一种对Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)的改进，通过降低高成功率提示的权重来解决可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中对常见轨迹的偏差。它在Qwen2.5-7B上实现了显著的pass@k改进，且没有增加计算成本。

title: Trust Regions Sell, But Who's Buying? Overlap Geometry as an Alternative Trust Region for Policy Optimization
summary: Standard trust-region methods constrain policy updates via Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. However, KL controls only an average divergence and does not directly prevent rare, large likelihood-ratio excursions that destabilize training--precisely the failure mode that motivates heuristics such as PPO's clipping. We propose overlap geometry as an alternative trust region, constraining distributional overlap via the Bhattacharyya coefficient (closely related to the Hellinger/Renyi-1/2 geometry). This objective penalizes separation in the ratio tails, yielding tighter control over likelihood-ratio excursions without relying on total variation bounds that can be loose in tail regimes. We derive Bhattacharyya-TRPO (BTRPO) and Bhattacharyya-PPO (BPPO), enforcing overlap constraints via square-root ratio updates: BPPO clips the square-root ratio q = sqrt(r), and BTRPO applies a quadratic Hellinger/Bhattacharyya penalty. Empirically, overlap-based updates improve robustness and aggregate performance as measured by RLiable under matched training budgets, suggesting overlap constraints as a practical, principled alternative to KL for stable policy optimization.
summary_zh: 标准信赖域方法通过Kullback-Leibler (KL) 散度约束策略更新。然而，KL 仅控制平均散度，并不能直接阻止罕见且较大的似然比偏离——而这正是导致训练不稳定的因素，并催生了PPO的裁剪等启发式方法。 我们提出将重叠几何作为一种替代信赖域，通过Bhattacharyya系数（与Hellinger/Renyi-1/2几何密切相关）来约束分布重叠。该目标惩罚比例尾部的分离，从而更严格地控制似然比偏离，而无需依赖在尾部区域可能较为宽松的全变差界限。 我们推导了Bhattacharyya-TRPO (BTRPO) 和 Bhattacharyya-PPO (BPPO)，通过平方根比例更新来强制执行重叠约束：BPPO裁剪平方根比例 q = sqrt(r)，而 BTRPO 应用二次 Hellinger/Bhattacharyya 惩罚。 经验表明，基于重叠的更新在匹配的训练预算下，提高了鲁棒性并改进了 RLiable 衡量的整体性能，表明重叠约束是一种实用、有原则的 KL 替代方案，可用于稳定策略优化。
tldr: The paper proposes using overlap geometry based on the Bhattacharyya coefficient as an alternative trust region for policy optimization, aiming to improve robustness and performance by directly controlling likelihood-ratio excursions. They develop BTRPO and BPPO and demonstrate improved results under matched training budgets.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出使用基于Bhattacharyya系数的重叠几何作为策略优化的一种替代信任区域，旨在通过直接控制可能性比率偏移来提高鲁棒性和性能。他们开发了BTRPO和BPPO，并证明在匹配的训练预算下结果有所改善。

title: Sample-Efficient Policy Space Response Oracles with Joint Experience Best Response
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) offers a scalable alternative to exact game-theoretic analysis but suffers from non-stationarity and the need to maintain diverse populations of strategies that capture non-transitive interactions. Policy Space Response Oracles (PSRO) address these issues by iteratively expanding a restricted game with approximate best responses (BRs), yet per-agent BR training makes it prohibitively expensive in many-agent or simulator-expensive settings. We introduce Joint Experience Best Response (JBR), a drop-in modification to PSRO that collects trajectories once under the current meta-strategy profile and reuses this joint dataset to compute BRs for all agents simultaneously. This amortizes environment interaction and improves the sample efficiency of best-response computation. Because JBR converts BR computation into an offline RL problem, we propose three remedies for distribution-shift bias: (i) Conservative JBR with safe policy improvement, (ii) Exploration-Augmented JBR that perturbs data collection and admits theoretical guarantees, and (iii) Hybrid BR that interleaves JBR with periodic independent BR updates. Across benchmark multi-agent environments, Exploration-Augmented JBR achieves the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off, while Hybrid BR attains near-PSRO performance at a fraction of the sample cost. Overall, JBR makes PSRO substantially more practical for large-scale strategic learning while preserving equilibrium robustness.
summary_zh: 多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 为精确的博弈论分析提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但受到非平稳性和需要维持捕获非传递性交互的多样化策略群体的困扰。策略空间响应预言机 (PSRO) 通过迭代地使用近似最优应对 (BR) 扩展受限博弈来解决这些问题，然而，每个智能体的 BR 训练使得其在多智能体或模拟器代价高昂的设置中望而却步。我们引入了联合经验最优应对 (JBR)，这是 PSRO 的一个即插即用修改，它在当前元策略剖面下一次性收集轨迹，并重用这个联合数据集来同时计算所有智能体的 BR。这分摊了环境交互的成本，并提高了最优应对计算的样本效率。由于 JBR 将 BR 计算转化为离线强化学习问题，我们提出了三种针对分布偏移偏差的补救措施：（i）采用安全策略改进的保守 JBR，（ii）扰动数据收集并允许理论保障的探索增强 JBR，以及（iii）将 JBR 与周期性独立 BR 更新交错的混合 BR。在基准多智能体环境中，探索增强 JBR 实现了最佳的准确性-效率权衡，而混合 BR 以一小部分样本成本获得了接近 PSRO 的性能。总的来说，JBR 使 PSRO 在大规模战略学习中更具实用性，同时保持了均衡的稳健性。
tldr: The paper introduces Joint Experience Best Response (JBR), a modification to Policy Space Response Oracles (PSRO) that improves sample efficiency by reusing joint trajectory data for computing best responses for all agents simultaneously in multi-agent reinforcement learning. They propose and evaluate several fixes for distribution-shift bias introduced by JBR.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了联合经验最佳响应 (JBR)，这是对策略空间响应预言 (PSRO) 的一项改进，通过重用联合轨迹数据来同时计算多智能体强化学习中所有智能体的最佳响应，从而提高样本效率。他们提出并评估了几种针对 JBR 引入的分布偏移偏差的修复方法。

title: Dynamics-Aligned Shared Hypernetworks for Zero-Shot Actuator Inversion
summary: Zero-shot generalization in contextual reinforcement learning remains a core challenge, particularly when the context is latent and must be inferred from data. A canonical failure mode is actuator inversion, where identical actions produce opposite physical effects under a latent binary context. We propose DMA*-SH, a framework where a single hypernetwork, trained solely via dynamics prediction, generates a small set of adapter weights shared across the dynamics model, policy, and action-value function. This shared modulation imparts an inductive bias matched to actuator inversion, while input/output normalization and random input masking stabilize context inference, promoting directionally concentrated representations. We provide theoretical support via an expressivity separation result for hypernetwork modulation, and a variance decomposition with policy-gradient variance bounds that formalize how within-mode compression improves learning under actuator inversion. For evaluation, we introduce the Actuator Inversion Benchmark (AIB), a suite of environments designed to isolate discontinuous context-to-dynamics interactions. On AIB's held-out actuator-inversion tasks, DMA*-SH achieves zero-shot generalization, outperforming domain randomization by 111.8% and surpassing a standard context-aware baseline by 16.1%.
summary_zh: 情境强化学习中的零样本泛化仍然是一个核心挑战，尤其是在情境是潜在的并且必须从数据中推断时。一个典型的失效模式是执行器反转，即在潜在的二元情境下，相同的动作会产生相反的物理效果。我们提出了DMA*-SH，一个框架，其中单个超网络仅通过动力学预测进行训练，生成一组小的适配器权重，这些权重在动力学模型、策略和动作值函数之间共享。这种共享的调制赋予了一种与执行器反转相匹配的归纳偏置，同时输入/输出归一化和随机输入掩码稳定了情境推断，促进了方向集中的表达。我们通过超网络调制的表达性分离结果提供了理论支持，以及一个具有策略梯度方差界限的方差分解，后者形式化了模式内压缩如何改善执行器反转下的学习。为了评估，我们引入了执行器反转基准（AIB），一套旨在隔离不连续的情境到动态交互的环境。在AIB的保留执行器反转任务上，DMA*-SH实现了零样本泛化，性能比域随机化提升了111.8%，并且超过了一个标准的情境感知基线16.1%。
tldr: This paper introduces DMA*-SH, a hypernetwork-based framework for zero-shot actuator inversion in contextual RL, achieving significant performance gains on a novel benchmark (AIB). The approach uses dynamics prediction for training and shared adapter weights across dynamics model, policy, and value function.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于超网络的框架DMA*-SH，用于情境强化学习中的零样本执行器反演问题。该方法通过动态预测进行训练，并在动态模型、策略和价值函数之间共享自适应权重，在一个新的基准测试（AIB）上实现了显著的性能提升。

title: BEAGLE: Behavior-Enforced Agent for Grounded Learner Emulation
summary: Simulating student learning behaviors in open-ended problem-solving environments holds potential for education research, from training adaptive tutoring systems to stress-testing pedagogical interventions. However, collecting authentic data is challenging due to privacy concerns and the high cost of longitudinal studies. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising path to student simulation, they suffer from competency bias, optimizing for efficient correctness rather than the erratic, iterative struggle characteristic of novice learners. We present BEAGLE, a neuro-symbolic framework that addresses this bias by incorporating Self-Regulated Learning (SRL) theory into a novel architecture. BEAGLE integrates three key technical innovations: (1) a semi-Markov model that governs the timing and transitions of cognitive behaviors and metacognitive behaviors; (2) Bayesian Knowledge Tracing with explicit flaw injection to enforce realistic knowledge gaps and "unknown unknowns"; and (3) a decoupled agent design that separates high-level strategy use from code generation actions to prevent the model from silently correcting its own intentional errors. In evaluations on Python programming tasks, BEAGLE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in reproducing authentic trajectories. In a human Turing test, users were unable to distinguish synthetic traces from real student data, achieving an accuracy indistinguishable from random guessing (52.8%).
summary_zh: 在开放式问题解决环境中模拟学生学习行为，对于教育研究具有潜力，从训练自适应辅导系统到压力测试教学干预措施皆可受益。然而，由于隐私问题和纵向研究的高成本，收集真实数据颇具挑战。虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）为学生模拟提供了一条有希望的途径，但它们存在能力偏差，优化了高效的正确性，而非新手学习者特有的不规律、迭代式挣扎。 我们提出了BEAGLE，一个神经符号框架，它通过将自我调节学习（SRL）理论融入一种新颖的架构中来解决这种偏差。 BEAGLE集成了三项关键技术创新：（1）一个半马尔可夫模型，用于控制认知行为和元认知行为的时间和转换；（2）具有显式缺陷注入的贝叶斯知识追踪，以强制执行真实的知识缺口和“未知的未知” ；（3）一种解耦的代理设计，将高层策略使用与代码生成动作分离，以防止模型静默地纠正其自身有意的错误。 在Python编程任务的评估中，BEAGLE在重现真实轨迹方面显著优于最先进的基线。在一个人工图灵测试中，用户无法区分合成轨迹与真实学生数据，达到的准确率与随机猜测无异(52.8%)。
tldr: BEAGLE is a neuro-symbolic framework that simulates realistic student learning behaviors by incorporating Self-Regulated Learning theory and addressing competency bias in LLMs, showing promising results in mimicking human student performance on Python programming tasks.
tldr_zh: BEAGLE是一个神经符号框架，通过结合自我调节学习理论并解决LLM中的能力偏差来模拟真实的学生的学习行为，并在模拟人类学生在Python编程任务中的表现方面显示出令人鼓舞的结果。

title: Prism: Spectral Parameter Sharing for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Parameter sharing is a key strategy in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for improving scalability, yet conventional fully shared architectures often collapse into homogeneous behaviors. Recent methods introduce diversity through clustering, pruning, or masking, but typically compromise resource efficiency. We propose Prism, a parameter sharing framework that induces inter-agent diversity by representing shared networks in the spectral domain via singular value decomposition (SVD). All agents share the singular vector directions while learning distinct spectral masks on singular values. This mechanism encourages inter-agent diversity and preserves scalability. Extensive experiments on both homogeneous (LBF, SMACv2) and heterogeneous (MaMuJoCo) benchmarks show that Prism achieves competitive performance with superior resource efficiency.
summary_zh: 参数共享是多智能体强化学习（MARL）中提高可扩展性的关键策略，然而，传统的完全共享架构常常会崩溃到同质化行为。最近的方法通过聚类、剪枝或掩码引入多样性，但通常会牺牲资源效率。我们提出 Prism，一个参数共享框架，通过奇异值分解（SVD）在谱域中表示共享网络来诱导智能体间的差异性。所有智能体共享奇异向量方向，同时学习奇异值上的不同谱掩码。这种机制鼓励了智能体间的多样性，并保留了可扩展性。在同构（LBF, SMACv2）和异构（MaMuJoCo）基准测试上的大量实验表明，Prism 在实现具有竞争力的性能的同时，具有卓越的资源效率。
tldr: The paper introduces Prism, a parameter sharing framework for MARL that uses spectral decomposition to induce diversity among agents while maintaining resource efficiency, achieving competitive performance on various benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Prism，一个用于多智能体强化学习的参数共享框架，它使用谱分解来诱导智能体之间的多样性，同时保持资源效率，并在各种基准测试中取得了具有竞争力的性能。

title: Agentic Unlearning: When LLM Agent Meets Machine Unlearning
summary: In this paper, we introduce \textbf{agentic unlearning} which removes specified information from both model parameters and persistent memory in agents with closed-loop interaction. Existing unlearning methods target parameters alone, leaving two critical gaps: (i) parameter-memory backflow, where retrieval reactivates parametric remnants or memory artifacts reintroduce sensitive content, and (ii) the absence of a unified strategy that covers both parameter and memory pathways. We present Synchronized Backflow Unlearning (SBU), a framework that unlearns jointly across parameter and memory pathways. The memory pathway performs dependency closure-based unlearning that prunes isolated entities while logically invalidating shared artifacts. The parameter pathway employs stochastic reference alignment to guide model outputs toward a high-entropy prior. These pathways are integrated via a synchronized dual-update protocol, forming a closed-loop mechanism where memory unlearning and parametric suppression reinforce each other to prevent cross-pathway recontamination. Experiments on medical QA benchmarks show that SBU reduces traces of targeted private information across both pathways with limited degradation on retained data.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种**主动式卸学**方法，该方法可以从具有闭环交互的智能体的模型参数和持久化记忆中移除指定信息。现有的卸学方法仅针对参数，留下了两个关键缺口：（i）参数-记忆回流，其中检索会重新激活参数残留，或记忆伪影会重新引入敏感内容，以及（ii）缺乏覆盖参数和记忆路径的统一策略。我们提出了一种同步回流卸学(SBU)框架，该框架可以在参数和记忆路径上协同卸学。记忆路径执行基于依赖闭包的卸学，该卸学方法修剪孤立的实体，同时在逻辑上使共享伪影失效。参数路径采用随机参考对齐，以引导模型输出趋向于高熵先验。这些路径通过同步双更新协议集成，形成闭环机制，其中记忆卸学和参数抑制相互增强，以防止跨路径再污染。在医学问答基准上的实验表明，SBU可以减少目标私有信息在两个路径上的痕迹，同时对保留数据的退化限制在较小程度。
tldr: This paper introduces "agentic unlearning" via Synchronized Backflow Unlearning (SBU), which jointly removes specified information from both model parameters and persistent memory in LLM agents with closed-loop interaction, addressing the limitations of existing parameter-alone unlearning methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了“代理式卸载学习”(agentic unlearning)的概念，并通过同步回流卸载学习(SBU)在具有闭环交互的LLM代理中，联合移除模型参数和持久内存中特定的信息，解决了现有仅针对参数的卸载学习方法的局限性。

title: Do It for HER: First-Order Temporal Logic Reward Specification in Reinforcement Learning (Extended Version)
summary: In this work, we propose a novel framework for the logical specification of non-Markovian rewards in Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) with large state spaces. Our approach leverages Linear Temporal Logic Modulo Theories over finite traces (LTLfMT), a more expressive extension of classical temporal logic in which predicates are first-order formulas of arbitrary first-order theories rather than simple Boolean variables. This enhanced expressiveness enables the specification of complex tasks over unstructured and heterogeneous data domains, promoting a unified and reusable framework that eliminates the need for manual predicate encoding. However, the increased expressive power of LTLfMT introduces additional theoretical and computational challenges compared to standard LTLf specifications. We address these challenges from a theoretical standpoint, identifying a fragment of LTLfMT that is tractable but sufficiently expressive for reward specification in an infinite-state-space context. From a practical perspective, we introduce a method based on reward machines and Hindsight Experience Replay (HER) to translate first-order logic specifications and address reward sparsity. We evaluate this approach to a continuous-control setting using Non-Linear Arithmetic Theory, showing that it enables natural specification of complex tasks. Experimental results show how a tailored implementation of HER is fundamental in solving tasks with complex goals.
summary_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种新型框架，用于马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP) 中具有大状态空间的非马尔可夫奖励的逻辑规范。 我们的方法利用有限轨迹上的线性时序逻辑模理论 (LTLfMT)，这是经典时序逻辑的一种更具表现力的扩展，其中谓词是任意一阶理论的一阶公式，而不是简单的布尔变量。 这种增强的表现力能够在非结构化和异构数据域上指定复杂的任务，从而促进统一且可重用的框架，并消除了手动谓词编码的需要。 然而，与标准 LTLf 规范相比，LTLfMT 增强的表现力引入了额外的理论和计算挑战。 我们从理论角度解决了这些挑战，确定了 LTLfMT 的一个易处理但具有足够表现力的片段，用于在无限状态空间上下文中进行奖励规范。 从实践角度来看，我们引入了一种基于奖励机器和事后经验回放 (HER) 的方法来转换一阶逻辑规范并解决奖励稀疏性问题。 我们使用非线性算术理论，在连续控制环境中评估了这种方法，结果表明它可以自然地指定复杂的任务。 实验结果表明，量身定制的 HER 实现对于解决具有复杂目标的任务至关重要。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel reinforcement learning framework using Linear Temporal Logic Modulo Theories over finite traces (LTLfMT) for specifying complex, non-Markovian rewards and addresses associated theoretical and practical challenges in continuous control with Hindsight Experience Replay.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的强化学习框架，使用有限迹上的线性时序逻辑模理论（LTLfMT）来指定复杂的非马尔可夫奖励，并使用后见之明经验回放解决了连续控制中相关的理论和实践挑战。

title: Diamond Maps: Efficient Reward Alignment via Stochastic Flow Maps
summary: Flow and diffusion models produce high-quality samples, but adapting them to user preferences or constraints post-training remains costly and brittle, a challenge commonly called reward alignment. We argue that efficient reward alignment should be a property of the generative model itself, not an afterthought, and redesign the model for adaptability. We propose "Diamond Maps", stochastic flow map models that enable efficient and accurate alignment to arbitrary rewards at inference time. Diamond Maps amortize many simulation steps into a single-step sampler, like flow maps, while preserving the stochasticity required for optimal reward alignment. This design makes search, sequential Monte Carlo, and guidance scalable by enabling efficient and consistent estimation of the value function. Our experiments show that Diamond Maps can be learned efficiently via distillation from GLASS Flows, achieve stronger reward alignment performance, and scale better than existing methods. Our results point toward a practical route to generative models that can be rapidly adapted to arbitrary preferences and constraints at inference time.
summary_zh: 流模型和扩散模型能够生成高质量的样本，但使它们在训练后适应用户偏好或约束仍然代价高昂且脆弱，这种挑战通常被称为奖励对齐。我们认为，高效的奖励对齐应该是生成模型本身的一个属性，而不是事后诸葛亮，因此我们重新设计了模型以提高适应性。我们提出了“钻石地图”（Diamond Maps），这是一种随机流图模型，能够在推理时高效且准确地对齐任意奖励。与流图类似，钻石地图将许多模拟步骤摊销到一个单步采样器中，同时保留了最佳奖励对齐所需的随机性。这种设计使得搜索、序列蒙特卡罗和引导变得可扩展，因为它能够高效且一致地估计价值函数。我们的实验表明，钻石地图可以通过从GLASS Flows进行蒸馏来高效学习，实现更强的奖励对齐性能，并且比现有方法更好地扩展。我们的结果指向了一种实用的途径，即生成模型能够在推理时快速适应任意偏好和约束。
tldr: The paper introduces Diamond Maps, a stochastic flow map model for efficient and accurate reward alignment in generative models, enabling rapid adaptation to arbitrary preferences and constraints at inference time.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Diamond Maps，一种随机流图模型，用于在生成模型中实现高效且准确的奖励对齐，从而能够在推理时快速适应任意偏好和约束。

title: LSA: Localized Semantic Alignment for Enhancing Temporal Consistency in Traffic Video Generation
summary: Controllable video generation has emerged as a versatile tool for autonomous driving, enabling realistic synthesis of traffic scenarios. However, existing methods depend on control signals at inference time to guide the generative model towards temporally consistent generation of dynamic objects, limiting their utility as scalable and generalizable data engines. In this work, we propose Localized Semantic Alignment (LSA), a simple yet effective framework for fine-tuning pre-trained video generation models. LSA enhances temporal consistency by aligning semantic features between ground-truth and generated video clips. Specifically, we compare the output of an off-the-shelf feature extraction model between the ground-truth and generated video clips localized around dynamic objects inducing a semantic feature consistency loss. We fine-tune the base model by combining this loss with the standard diffusion loss. The model fine-tuned for a single epoch with our novel loss outperforms the baselines in common video generation evaluation metrics. To further test the temporal consistency in generated videos we adapt two additional metrics from object detection task, namely mAP and mIoU. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and KITTI datasets show the effectiveness of our approach in enhancing temporal consistency in video generation without the need for external control signals during inference and any computational overheads.
summary_zh: 可控视频生成已成为自动驾驶领域的多用途工具，能够逼真地合成交通场景。然而，现有方法依赖于推理时的控制信号来引导生成模型，从而实现对动态对象在时间上一致的生成，这限制了其作为可扩展和通用数据引擎的效用。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种局部语义对齐（LSA）方法，一个简单而有效的框架，用于微调预训练的视频生成模型。LSA通过对齐真实视频片段和生成视频片段之间的语义特征，来增强时间一致性。具体来说，我们比较了现成的特征提取模型在真实视频片段和生成视频片段中，围绕动态对象局部区域的输出，从而引入语义特征一致性损失。我们通过将此损失与标准扩散损失相结合来微调基础模型。仅用一个epoch通过我们的新颖损失进行微调的模型，在常见的视频生成评估指标上优于基线模型。为了进一步测试生成视频中的时间一致性，我们从目标检测任务中调整了两个额外的指标，即mAP和mIoU。在nuScenes和KITTI数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在增强视频生成的时间一致性方面是有效的，同时无需在推理期间使用外部控制信号，也无需任何计算开销。
tldr: The paper introduces Localized Semantic Alignment (LSA), a fine-tuning framework for pre-trained video generation models that enhances temporal consistency by aligning semantic features between ground-truth and generated videos around dynamic objects, improving performance without inference-time control signals.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为局部语义对齐（LSA）的微调框架，用于预训练的视频生成模型。它通过对齐真实视频和生成视频中动态对象周围的语义特征来增强时间一致性，从而在没有推理时控制信号的情况下提高性能。

title: Learning to Share: Selective Memory for Efficient Parallel Agentic Systems
summary: Agentic systems solve complex tasks by coordinating multiple agents that iteratively reason, invoke tools, and exchange intermediate results. To improve robustness and solution quality, recent approaches deploy multiple agent teams running in parallel to explore diverse reasoning trajectories. However, parallel execution comes at a significant computational cost: when different teams independently reason about similar sub-problems or execute analogous steps, they repeatedly perform substantial overlapping computation. To address these limitations, in this paper, we propose Learning to Share (LTS), a learned shared-memory mechanism for parallel agentic frameworks that enables selective cross-team information reuse while controlling context growth. LTS introduces a global memory bank accessible to all teams and a lightweight controller that decides whether intermediate agent steps should be added to memory or not. The controller is trained using stepwise reinforcement learning with usage-aware credit assignment, allowing it to identify information that is globally useful across parallel executions. Experiments on the AssistantBench and GAIA benchmarks show that LTS significantly reduces overall runtime while matching or improving task performance compared to memory-free parallel baselines, demonstrating that learned memory admission is an effective strategy for improving the efficiency of parallel agentic systems. Project page: https://joefioresi718.github.io/LTS_webpage/
summary_zh: 自主系统通过协调多个智能体迭代推理、调用工具和交换中间结果来解决复杂任务。为了提高鲁棒性和解决方案质量，最近的方法部署多个并行运行的智能体团队，以探索不同的推理轨迹。然而，并行执行带来了巨大的计算成本：当不同的团队独立推理类似的子问题或执行相似的步骤时，它们会重复执行大量的重叠计算。为了解决这些限制，在本文中，我们提出了一种用于并行自主框架的学习共享（LTS）机制，该机制是一种学习型的共享内存机制，能够在控制上下文增长的同时，实现选择性的跨团队信息重用。LTS引入了一个所有团队都可以访问的全局内存库和一个轻量级的控制器，用于决定是否将中间智能体步骤添加到内存中。该控制器使用步进式强化学习进行训练，并进行使用感知的信用分配，使其能够识别在并行执行中全局有用的信息。在AssistantBench和GAIA基准测试上的实验表明，与无内存的并行基线相比，LTS显著减少了总体运行时间，同时匹配甚至提高了任务性能，这表明学习型内存准入是提高并行自主系统效率的有效策略。项目页面：https://joefioresi718.github.io/LTS_webpage/
tldr: The paper introduces Learning to Share (LTS), a learned shared-memory mechanism for parallel agentic frameworks that significantly reduces runtime and improves task performance by selectively reusing information across agent teams.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Learning to Share (LTS)，一个用于并行代理框架的学习型共享内存机制，通过选择性地重用跨代理团队的信息，显著减少运行时间并提高任务性能。

title: RFDM: Residual Flow Diffusion Model for Efficient Causal Video Editing
summary: Instructional video editing applies edits to an input video using only text prompts, enabling intuitive natural-language control. Despite rapid progress, most methods still require fixed-length inputs and substantial compute. Meanwhile, autoregressive video generation enables efficient variable-length synthesis, yet remains under-explored for video editing. We introduce a causal, efficient video editing model that edits variable-length videos frame by frame. For efficiency, we start from a 2D image-to-image (I2I) diffusion model and adapt it to video-to-video (V2V) editing by conditioning the edit at time step t on the model's prediction at t-1. To leverage videos' temporal redundancy, we propose a new I2I diffusion forward process formulation that encourages the model to predict the residual between the target output and the previous prediction. We call this Residual Flow Diffusion Model (RFDM), which focuses the denoising process on changes between consecutive frames. Moreover, we propose a new benchmark that better ranks state-of-the-art methods for editing tasks. Trained on paired video data for global/local style transfer and object removal, RFDM surpasses I2I-based methods and competes with fully spatiotemporal (3D) V2V models, while matching the compute of image models and scaling independently of input video length. More content can be found in: https://smsd75.github.io/RFDM_page/
summary_zh: 教学视频编辑仅使用文本提示对输入视频进行编辑，从而实现直观的自然语言控制。尽管进展迅速，但大多数方法仍然需要固定长度的输入和大量的计算。同时，自回归视频生成能够实现高效的可变长度合成，但在视频编辑方面仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了一种因果的、高效的视频编辑模型，该模型能够逐帧编辑可变长度的视频。为了提高效率，我们从2D图像到图像（I2I）的扩散模型出发，并通过在时间步t根据模型在t-1的预测来调节编辑，从而将其适配到视频到视频（V2V）的编辑。为了利用视频的时间冗余，我们提出了一种新的I2I扩散正向过程公式，该公式鼓励模型预测目标输出与先前预测之间的残差。我们称之为残差流扩散模型（RFDM），它将去噪过程集中在连续帧之间的变化上。此外，我们提出了一个新的基准测试，可以更好地对最先进的方法进行任务编辑排名。RFDM在配对视频数据上进行全局/局部风格迁移和物体移除的训练，超越了基于I2I的方法，并与完全时空（3D）的V2V模型相媲美，同时保持了图像模型的计算量，并且可以独立于输入视频长度进行缩放。更多内容请访问：https://smsd75.github.io/RFDM_page/
tldr: This paper introduces a novel Residual Flow Diffusion Model (RFDM) for efficient, causal, and variable-length video editing using text prompts, achieving competitive performance with image model compute and outperforming I2I methods. The authors also propose a new benchmark for evaluating video editing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为剩余流扩散模型（RFDM）的新模型，用于高效、因果地编辑变长视频，通过文本提示实现，以图像模型的计算成本取得了与最先进水平相当的性能，并优于 I2I 方法。作者还提出了一个新的用于评估视频编辑方法的基准。

title: NECromancer: Breathing Life into Skeletons via BVH Animation
summary: Motion tokenization is a key component of generalizable motion models, yet most existing approaches are restricted to species-specific skeletons, limiting their applicability across diverse morphologies. We propose NECromancer (NEC), a universal motion tokenizer that operates directly on arbitrary BVH skeletons. NEC consists of three components: (1) an Ontology-aware Skeletal Graph Encoder (OwO) that encodes structural priors from BVH files, including joint semantics, rest-pose offsets, and skeletal topology, into skeletal embeddings; (2) a Topology-Agnostic Tokenizer (TAT) that compresses motion sequences into a universal, topology-invariant discrete representation; and (3) the Unified BVH Universe (UvU), a large-scale dataset aggregating BVH motions across heterogeneous skeletons. Experiments show that NEC achieves high-fidelity reconstruction under substantial compression and effectively disentangles motion from skeletal structure. The resulting token space supports cross-species motion transfer, composition, denoising, generation with token-based models, and text-motion retrieval, establishing a unified framework for motion analysis and synthesis across diverse morphologies. Demo page: https://animotionlab.github.io/NECromancer/
summary_zh: 运动标记化是可泛化运动模型的关键组成部分，然而，现有的大多数方法都局限于特定物种的骨骼，限制了其在不同形态上的应用。我们提出了NECromancer (NEC)，一种直接在任意BVH骨骼上操作的通用运动标记器。NEC由三个部分组成：（1）本体感知骨骼图编码器 (OwO)，它将来自BVH文件的结构先验，包括关节语义、静止姿势偏移和骨骼拓扑，编码成骨骼嵌入；（2）拓扑无关标记器 (TAT)，它将运动序列压缩成一个通用的、拓扑不变的离散表示；以及（3）统一的BVH宇宙 (UvU)，一个大规模数据集，聚合了来自异构骨骼的BVH运动。实验表明，NEC在显著压缩下实现了高保真度的重建，并有效地将运动与骨骼结构解耦。由此产生的标记空间支持跨物种的运动迁移、组合、去噪、基于标记模型的生成以及文本-运动检索，为不同形态的运动分析和合成建立了一个统一的框架。演示页面：https://animotionlab.github.io/NECromancer/
tldr: The paper introduces NECromancer, a universal motion tokenizer for BVH skeletons that enables cross-species motion transfer, composition, and generation by encoding skeletal structures and motion sequences into a topology-invariant discrete representation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种通用的BVH骨骼运动分词器NECromancer，通过将骨骼结构和运动序列编码为拓扑不变的离散表示，从而实现跨物种的运动迁移、组合和生成。

title: Learning Human Visual Attention on 3D Surfaces through Geometry-Queried Semantic Priors
summary: Human visual attention on three-dimensional objects emerges from the interplay between bottom-up geometric processing and top-down semantic recognition. Existing 3D saliency methods rely on hand-crafted geometric features or learning-based approaches that lack semantic awareness, failing to explain why humans fixate on semantically meaningful but geometrically unremarkable regions. We introduce SemGeo-AttentionNet, a dual-stream architecture that explicitly formalizes this dichotomy through asymmetric cross-modal fusion, leveraging diffusion-based semantic priors from geometry-conditioned multi-view rendering and point cloud transformers for geometric processing. Cross-attention ensures geometric features query semantic content, enabling bottom-up distinctiveness to guide top-down retrieval. We extend our framework to temporal scanpath generation through reinforcement learning, introducing the first formulation respecting 3D mesh topology with inhibition-of-return dynamics. Evaluation on SAL3D, NUS3D and 3DVA datasets demonstrates substantial improvements, validating how cognitively motivated architectures effectively model human visual attention on three-dimensional surfaces.
summary_zh: 人类对三维物体的视觉注意力源于自底向上的几何处理与自顶向下的语义识别之间的相互作用。现有的3D显著性方法依赖于手工设计的几何特征或缺乏语义感知的基于学习的方法，无法解释为什么人类会注视于语义上有意义但几何上不显著的区域。我们提出了SemGeo-AttentionNet，一个双流架构，通过非对称跨模态融合明确地形式化了这种二分法，利用基于扩散的语义先验，该先验来自几何条件下的多视角渲染和用于几何处理的点云Transformer。交叉注意力确保了几何特征查询语义内容，从而使自底向上的独特性可以引导自顶向下的检索。我们通过强化学习将我们的框架扩展到时间扫描路径生成，引入了第一个尊重3D网格拓扑并具有返回抑制动态的公式。在SAL3D、NUS3D和3DVA数据集上的评估表明，性能得到了显著提升，验证了认知驱动的架构如何有效地建模人类对三维表面的视觉注意力。
tldr: This paper introduces SemGeo-AttentionNet, a novel architecture that combines geometric and semantic information to model human visual attention on 3D surfaces, outperforming existing methods on several datasets. It also extends to temporal scanpath generation via reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SemGeo-AttentionNet，一种结合了几何和语义信息的新型架构，用于建模3D表面上的人类视觉注意力，并在多个数据集上优于现有方法。它还通过强化学习扩展到时间扫描路径生成。

title: SPDA-SAM: A Self-prompted Depth-Aware Segment Anything Model for Instance Segmentation
summary: Recently, Segment Anything Model (SAM) has demonstrated strong generalizability in various instance segmentation tasks. However, its performance is severely dependent on the quality of manual prompts. In addition, the RGB images that instance segmentation methods normally use inherently lack depth information. As a result, the ability of these methods to perceive spatial structures and delineate object boundaries is hindered. To address these challenges, we propose a Self-prompted Depth-Aware SAM (SPDA-SAM) for instance segmentation. Specifically, we design a Semantic-Spatial Self-prompt Module (SSSPM) which extracts the semantic and spatial prompts from the image encoder and the mask decoder of SAM, respectively. Furthermore, we introduce a Coarse-to-Fine RGB-D Fusion Module (C2FFM), in which the features extracted from a monocular RGB image and the depth map estimated from it are fused. In particular, the structural information in the depth map is used to provide coarse-grained guidance to feature fusion, while local variations in depth are encoded in order to fuse fine-grained feature representations. To our knowledge, SAM has not been explored in such self-prompted and depth-aware manners. Experimental results demonstrate that our SPDA-SAM outperforms its state-of-the-art counterparts across twelve different data sets. These promising results should be due to the guidance of the self-prompts and the compensation for the spatial information loss by the coarse-to-fine RGB-D fusion operation.
summary_zh: 近来，Segment Anything Model (SAM) 在各种实例分割任务中展现出强大的泛化能力。然而，其性能严重依赖于人工提示的质量。此外，实例分割方法通常使用的 RGB 图像本身缺乏深度信息。因此，这些方法感知空间结构和描绘物体边界的能力受到阻碍。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种自提示深度感知 SAM (SPDA-SAM) 用于实例分割。具体而言，我们设计了一个语义-空间自提示模块 (SSSPM)，其从 SAM 图像编码器和掩码解码器中分别提取语义和空间提示。此外，我们引入了一个粗到精 RGB-D 融合模块 (C2FFM)，其中融合了从单目 RGB 图像及其估计的深度图像中提取的特征。特别地，深度图中的结构信息用于为特征融合提供粗粒度指导，而深度中的局部变化被编码以融合细粒度的特征表示。据我们所知，SAM 尚未以这种自提示和深度感知的方式进行探索。实验结果表明，我们的 SPDA-SAM 在十二个不同的数据集上优于其最先进的同类方法。这些有希望的结果应归功于自提示的指导以及粗到精 RGB-D 融合操作对空间信息损失的补偿。
tldr: The paper introduces SPDA-SAM, a self-prompted and depth-aware Segment Anything Model (SAM) for instance segmentation, which enhances SAM's performance by using semantic-spatial self-prompts and coarse-to-fine RGB-D fusion, demonstrating state-of-the-art results across twelve datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SPDA-SAM，一个自提示和深度感知的分割一切模型（SAM）用于实例分割。通过使用语义-空间自提示和粗到细的RGB-D融合，增强了SAM的性能，并在十二个数据集上展示了最先进的结果。

title: Soft Forward-Backward Representations for Zero-shot Reinforcement Learning with General Utilities
summary: Recent advancements in zero-shot reinforcement learning (RL) have facilitated the extraction of diverse behaviors from unlabeled, offline data sources. In particular, forward-backward algorithms (FB) can retrieve a family of policies that can approximately solve any standard RL problem (with additive rewards, linear in the occupancy measure), given sufficient capacity. While retaining zero-shot properties, we tackle the greater problem class of RL with general utilities, in which the objective is an arbitrary differentiable function of the occupancy measure. This setting is strictly more expressive, capturing tasks such as distribution matching or pure exploration, which may not be reduced to additive rewards. We show that this additional complexity can be captured by a novel, maximum entropy (soft) variant of the forward-backward algorithm, which recovers a family of stochastic policies from offline data. When coupled with zero-order search over compact policy embeddings, this algorithm can sidestep iterative optimization schemes, and optimizes general utilities directly at test-time. Across both didactic and high-dimensional experiments, we demonstrate that our method retains favorable properties of FB algorithms, while also extending their range to more general RL problems.
summary_zh: 零样本强化学习（RL）的最新进展促进了从无标签离线数据源中提取多样化行为。 特别是，前向-后向算法（FB）可以在给定足够容量的情况下，检索出一系列策略，这些策略可以近似地解决任何标准的强化学习问题（具有可加奖励，且奖励在线性占用度量中）。 在保持零样本特性的同时，我们处理了具有更广义效用函数的强化学习问题类别，其中目标是占用度量的任意可微函数。 这种设置具有更强的表达能力，能够捕捉诸如分布匹配或纯粹探索等任务，这些任务可能无法简化为可加奖励。 我们证明了这种额外的复杂性可以被一种新颖的、最大熵（soft）变体的前向-后向算法所捕获，该算法从离线数据中恢复出一系列随机策略。 当与紧凑策略嵌入上的零阶搜索结合使用时，该算法可以绕过迭代优化方案，并在测试时直接优化广义效用函数。 在教学实验和高维实验中，我们证明了我们的方法保留了FB算法的有利特性，同时将其范围扩展到更广泛的强化学习问题。
tldr: This paper introduces a soft forward-backward algorithm to extend zero-shot reinforcement learning to handle general utility functions in RL, enabling solutions for tasks beyond additive rewards, such as distribution matching and pure exploration, using offline data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种软前向-后向算法，以扩展零样本强化学习，使其能够处理RL中的通用效用函数，从而可以使用离线数据解决超出加性奖励的任务，例如分布匹配和纯探索。

title: Disentanglement by means of action-induced representations
summary: Learning interpretable representations with variational autoencoders (VAEs) is a major goal of representation learning. The main challenge lies in obtaining disentangled representations, where each latent dimension corresponds to a distinct generative factor. This difficulty is fundamentally tied to the inability to perform nonlinear independent component analysis. Here, we introduce the framework of action-induced representations (AIRs) which models representations of physical systems given experiments (or actions) that can be performed on them. We show that, in this framework, we can provably disentangle degrees of freedom w.r.t. their action dependence. We further introduce a variational AIR architecture (VAIR) that can extract AIRs and therefore achieve provable disentanglement where standard VAEs fail. Beyond state representation, VAIR also captures the action dependence of the underlying generative factors, directly linking experiments to the degrees of freedom they influence.
summary_zh: 使用变分自编码器（VAE）学习可解释的表示是表示学习的一个主要目标。主要的挑战在于获得解耦的表示，其中每个潜在维度对应一个不同的生成因子。这种困难从根本上与无法执行非线性独立成分分析有关。在此，我们引入了动作诱导表示（AIRs）的框架，该框架对给定可以对其执行的实验（或动作）的物理系统的表示进行建模。我们证明，在这个框架中，我们可以根据自由度对动作的依赖性进行可证明的解耦。我们进一步引入了一种变分AIR架构（VAIR），它可以提取AIRs，从而实现标准VAE无法实现的可证明的解耦。除了状态表示之外，VAIR还捕获了底层生成因子的动作依赖性，直接将实验与它们所影响的自由度联系起来。
tldr: This paper introduces Action-Induced Representations (AIRs) which provably disentangle latent representations in VAEs based on the action dependence of generative factors, potentially improving interpretability and linking experiments to degrees of freedom.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了动作诱导表示 (AIR)，它根据生成因子的动作依赖性，可证明地解开 VAE 中潜在表示的纠缠，从而可能提高可解释性并将实验与自由度关联起来。

title: Diffusion-State Policy Optimization for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models generate by iteratively filling masked tokens over multiple denoising steps, so learning only from a terminal reward on the final completion yields coarse credit assignment over intermediate decisions. We propose DiSPO (Diffusion-State Policy Optimization), a plug-in credit-assignment layer that directly optimizes intermediate filling decisions. At selected intermediate masked states, DiSPO branches by resampling fillings for the currently masked positions from rollout-cached logits, scores the resulting completions, and updates only the newly filled tokens -- without additional multi-step diffusion rollouts. We formalize a fixed-state objective for branched completions and derive a policy-gradient estimator that can be combined with terminal-feedback policy optimization using the same rollouts. On LLaDA-8B-Instruct, DiSPO consistently improves over the terminal-feedback diffu-GRPO baseline on math and planning benchmarks under matched rollout compute and optimizer steps. Our code will be available at https://daioba.github.io/dispo .
summary_zh: 掩码扩散语言模型通过在多个去噪步骤中迭代填充掩码标记来生成文本，因此仅从最终完成时的终端奖励进行学习，会导致对中间决策的粗略信用分配。我们提出 DiSPO (Diffusion-State Policy Optimization，扩散状态策略优化)，这是一个插件式信用分配层，可以直接优化中间填充决策。在选定的中间掩码状态，DiSPO 通过从 rollout 缓存的 logits 重采样当前掩码位置的填充来生成分支，对生成的完成结果进行评分，并且仅更新新填充的标记——无需额外的多步扩散 rollout。我们正式确定了分支完成的固定状态目标，并推导出一个策略梯度估计器，该估计器可以与使用相同 rollout 的终端反馈策略优化相结合。在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 上，在匹配的 rollout 计算和优化器步骤下，DiSPO 在数学和规划基准测试中始终优于终端反馈 diffu-GRPO 基线。我们的代码将在 https://daioba.github.io/dispo 上提供。
tldr: The paper introduces DiSPO, a method for improving credit assignment in masked diffusion language models by optimizing intermediate filling decisions using a fixed-state objective and policy-gradient estimator. DiSPO improves performance on math and planning benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为DiSPO的方法，通过优化中间填充决策，改进了掩码扩散语言模型中的信用分配，使用固定状态目标和策略梯度估计器。DiSPO在数学和规划基准测试中提高了性能。

title: Online Adaptive Reinforcement Learning with Echo State Networks for Non-Stationary Dynamics
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies trained in simulation often suffer from severe performance degradation when deployed in real-world environments due to non-stationary dynamics.
