While Domain Randomization (DR) and meta-RL have been proposed to address this issue, they typically rely on extensive pretraining, privileged information, or high computational cost, limiting their applicability to real-time and edge systems. In this paper, we propose a lightweight online adaptation framework for RL based on Reservoir Computing. Specifically, we integrate an Echo State Networks (ESNs) as an adaptation module that encodes recent observation histories into a latent context representation, and update its readout weights online using Recursive Least Squares (RLS). This design enables rapid adaptation without backpropagation, pretraining, or access to privileged information. We evaluate the proposed method on CartPole and HalfCheetah tasks with severe and abrupt environment changes, including periodic external disturbances and extreme friction variations. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly outperforms DR and representative adaptive baselines under out-of-distribution dynamics, achieving stable adaptation within a few control steps. Notably, the method successfully handles intra-episode environment changes without resetting the policy. Due to its computational efficiency and stability, the proposed framework provides a practical solution for online adaptation in non-stationary environments and is well suited for real-world robotic control and edge deployment.
summary_zh: 在模拟环境中训练的强化学习（RL）策略在部署到真实世界环境时，由于非平稳动态特性，通常会遭受严重的性能下降。虽然领域随机化（DR）和元强化学习（meta-RL）已被提出用于解决这个问题，但它们通常依赖于大量的预训练、特权信息或高昂的计算成本，从而限制了它们在实时和边缘系统中的适用性。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于储层计算的轻量级强化学习在线自适应框架。具体来说，我们集成了一个回声状态网络（ESN）作为自适应模块，将最近的观测历史编码为潜在的上下文表示，并使用递归最小二乘法（RLS）在线更新其读出权重。这种设计无需反向传播、预训练或访问特权信息即可实现快速适应。我们通过CartPole和HalfCheetah任务评估了所提出的方法在剧烈和突发环境变化下的性能，包括周期性的外部干扰和极端的摩擦变化。实验结果表明，所提出的方法在分布外动态特性下明显优于领域随机化和具有代表性的自适应基线，在几个控制步骤内实现了稳定的适应。值得注意的是，该方法成功处理了情节内的环境变化，而无需重置策略。由于其计算效率和稳定性，所提出的框架为非平稳环境中的在线自适应提供了一种实用的解决方案，并且非常适合于现实世界的机器人控制和边缘部署。
tldr: This paper introduces a lightweight online adaptive RL framework using Echo State Networks for faster adaptation to non-stationary environments, outperforming domain randomization without pretraining.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种轻量级的在线自适应强化学习框架，使用回声状态网络，可以更快地适应非平稳环境，优于领域随机化，且无需预训练。

title: Flow Matching for Offline Reinforcement Learning with Discrete Actions
summary: Generative policies based on diffusion models and flow matching have shown strong promise for offline reinforcement learning (RL), but their applicability remains largely confined to continuous action spaces. To address a broader range of offline RL settings, we extend flow matching to a general framework that supports discrete action spaces with multiple objectives. Specifically, we replace continuous flows with continuous-time Markov chains, trained using a Q-weighted flow matching objective. We then extend our design to multi-agent settings, mitigating the exponential growth of joint action spaces via a factorized conditional path. We theoretically show that, under idealized conditions, optimizing this objective recovers the optimal policy. Extensive experiments further demonstrate that our method performs robustly in practical scenarios, including high-dimensional control, multi-modal decision-making, and dynamically changing preferences over multiple objectives. Our discrete framework can also be applied to continuous-control problems through action quantization, providing a flexible trade-off between representational complexity and performance.
summary_zh: 基于扩散模型和流匹配的生成策略在离线强化学习（RL）中展现出强劲潜力，但其适用性仍然主要局限于连续动作空间。为了应对更广泛的离线强化学习环境，我们将流匹配扩展到一个支持离散动作空间和多目标的通用框架。具体而言，我们用连续时间马尔可夫链取代连续流，并使用Q值加权的流匹配目标进行训练。然后，我们将我们的设计扩展到多智能体环境，通过分解的条件路径来缓解联合动作空间的指数增长。我们在理论上证明，在理想条件下，优化该目标可以恢复最优策略。大量的实验进一步表明，我们的方法在实际场景中表现稳健，包括高维控制、多模态决策以及对多个目标动态变化的偏好。我们的离散框架也可以通过动作量化应用于连续控制问题，从而在表示复杂性和性能之间提供灵活的权衡。
tldr: This paper extends flow matching for offline RL to discrete action spaces using continuous-time Markov chains and demonstrates its effectiveness in single and multi-agent settings, showcasing its applicability to various scenarios, including continuous control via action quantization.
tldr_zh: 本文将基于流匹配的离线强化学习扩展到离散动作空间，使用连续时间马尔可夫链，并在单智能体和多智能体环境中展示了其有效性，并证明了其在各种场景中的适用性，包括通过动作量化实现的连续控制。

title: Pragmatic Curiosity: A Hybrid Learning-Optimization Paradigm via Active Inference
summary: Many engineering and scientific workflows depend on expensive black-box evaluations, requiring decision-making that simultaneously improves performance and reduces uncertainty. Bayesian optimization (BO) and Bayesian experimental design (BED) offer powerful yet largely separate treatments of goal-seeking and information-seeking, providing limited guidance for hybrid settings where learning and optimization are intrinsically coupled. We propose "pragmatic curiosity," a hybrid learning-optimization paradigm derived from active inference, in which actions are selected by minimizing the expected free energy--a single objective that couples pragmatic utility with epistemic information gain. We demonstrate the practical effectiveness and flexibility of pragmatic curiosity on various real-world hybrid tasks, including constrained system identification, targeted active search, and composite optimization with unknown preferences. Across these benchmarks, pragmatic curiosity consistently outperforms strong BO-type and BED-type baselines, delivering higher estimation accuracy, better critical-region coverage, and improved final solution quality.
summary_zh: 许多工程和科学工作流程依赖于昂贵的黑盒评估，因此需要进行兼顾性能提升和不确定性降低的决策。 贝叶斯优化（BO）和贝叶斯实验设计（BED）为目标导向和信息导向提供了强大的但很大程度上独立的处理方法，对于学习和优化固有耦合的混合设置，所提供的指导有限。我们提出了一种源自主动推断的混合学习-优化范式——“功利性好奇心”，其中行动的选择通过最小化期望自由能来完成，这是一个将实用效用与认知信息增益耦合在一起的单一目标。我们在一系列现实世界的混合任务中展示了功利性好奇心的实用有效性和灵活性，包括约束系统辨识、定向主动搜索以及具有未知偏好的复合优化。在这些基准测试中，功利性好奇心始终优于强大的BO型和BED型基线方法，实现了更高的估计精度、更好的临界区域覆盖和改进的最终解质量。
tldr: This paper introduces "pragmatic curiosity," a hybrid learning-optimization paradigm based on active inference, outperforming Bayesian Optimization and Bayesian Experimental Design methods in real-world tasks that combine learning and optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于主动推理的混合学习-优化范式“实用好奇心”，在结合学习和优化的真实世界任务中优于贝叶斯优化和贝叶斯实验设计方法。

title: Perception-Control Coupled Visual Servoing for Textureless Objects Using Keypoint-Based EKF
summary: Visual servoing is fundamental to robotic applications, enabling precise positioning and control. However, applying it to textureless objects remains a challenge due to the absence of reliable visual features. Moreover, adverse visual conditions, such as occlusions, often corrupt visual feedback, leading to reduced accuracy and instability in visual servoing. In this work, we build upon learning-based keypoint detection for textureless objects and propose a method that enhances robustness by tightly integrating perception and control in a closed loop. Specifically, we employ an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) that integrates per-frame keypoint measurements to estimate 6D object pose, which drives pose-based visual servoing (PBVS) for control. The resulting camera motion, in turn, enhances the tracking of subsequent keypoints, effectively closing the perception-control loop. Additionally, unlike standard PBVS, we propose a probabilistic control law that computes both camera velocity and its associated uncertainty, enabling uncertainty-aware control for safe and reliable operation. We validate our approach on real-world robotic platforms using quantitative metrics and grasping experiments, demonstrating that our method outperforms traditional visual servoing techniques in both accuracy and practical application.
summary_zh: 视觉伺服是机器人应用的基础，能够实现精确定位和控制。然而，由于缺乏可靠的视觉特征，将其应用于无纹理物体仍然是一个挑战。此外，诸如遮挡等不利的视觉条件经常会破坏视觉反馈，导致视觉伺服的精度降低和不稳定。在这项工作中，我们基于用于无纹理物体的基于学习的关键点检测，并提出一种通过在闭环中紧密集成感知和控制来增强鲁棒性的方法。具体而言，我们采用扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）来整合每帧关键点测量值，以估计6D物体姿态，从而驱动基于姿态的视觉伺服（PBVS）进行控制。由此产生的相机运动反过来又增强了后续关键点的跟踪，从而有效地闭合了感知-控制环路。此外，与标准PBVS不同，我们提出了一种概率控制律，该控制律计算相机速度及其相关的不确定性，从而实现不确定性感知控制，以实现安全可靠的操作。我们使用定量指标和抓取实验在真实世界的机器人平台上验证了我们的方法，证明了我们的方法在精度和实际应用方面都优于传统的视觉伺服技术。
tldr: This paper proposes a perception-control coupled visual servoing method using an EKF and probabilistic control law to improve the accuracy and robustness of robotic manipulation for textureless objects, validated through real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种感知-控制耦合的视觉伺服方法，该方法使用扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）和概率控制律，提高了机器人操作纹理缺失物体的精确性和鲁棒性，并通过真实世界的实验进行了验证。

title: A 26-Gram Butterfly-Inspired Robot Achieving Autonomous Tailless Flight
summary: Flapping-wing micro air vehicles (FWMAVs) have demonstrated remarkable bio-inspired agility, yet tailless two-winged configurations remain largely unexplored due to their complex fluid-structure and wing-body coupling. Here we present \textit{AirPulse}, a 26-gram butterfly-inspired FWMAV that achieves fully onboard, closed-loop, untethered flight without auxiliary control surfaces. The AirPulse robot replicates key biomechanical traits of butterfly flight, including low wing aspect ratio, compliant carbon-fiber-reinforced wings, and low-frequency, high-amplitude flapping that induces cyclic variations in the center of gravity and moment of inertia, producing characteristic body undulation. We establish a quantitative mapping between flapping modulation parameters and force-torque generation, and introduce the Stroke Timing Asymmetry Rhythm (STAR) generator, enabling smooth, stable, and linearly parameterized wingstroke asymmetry for flapping control. Integrating these with an attitude controller, the AirPulse robot maintains pitch and yaw stability despite strong oscillatory dynamics. Free-flight experiments demonstrate stable climbing and turning maneuvers via either angle offset or stroke timing modulation, marking the first onboard controlled flight of the lightest two-winged, tailless butterfly-inspired FWMAV reported in peer-reviewed literature. This work corroborates a foundational platform for lightweight, collision-proof FWMAVs, bridging biological inspiration with practical aerial robotics. Their non-invasive maneuverability is ideally suited for real-world applications, such as confined-space inspection and ecological monitoring, inaccessible to traditional drones, while their biomechanical fidelity provides a physical model to decode the principles underlying the erratic yet efficient flight of real butterflies.
summary_zh: 扑翼微型飞行器（FWMAV）已展现出卓越的仿生灵活性，然而由于其复杂的流固耦合以及机翼-机身耦合，无尾双翼构型在很大程度上仍未被探索。本文介绍 \textit{AirPulse}，一款 26 克重的蝴蝶仿生 FWMAV，无需辅助控制面即可实现完全机载、闭环式、无系绳飞行。AirPulse 机器人复制了蝴蝶飞行的关键生物力学特征，包括低翼展比、柔性碳纤维增强机翼，以及低频、高振幅的扑动，从而引起重心和转动惯量的周期性变化，产生特征性的机身波动。我们建立了扑翼调制参数与力-力矩生成之间的定量映射关系，并引入了冲程时间不对称节奏（STAR）生成器，从而实现平滑、稳定且线性参数化的翼冲不对称性，以进行扑翼控制。通过将这些与姿态控制器集成，AirPulse 机器人能够在强烈的振荡动力学下保持俯仰和偏航稳定性。自由飞行实验表明，该机器人可以通过角度偏移或冲程时间调制来实现稳定的爬升和转弯机动，这标志着在同行评审文献中首次报道了最轻的采用机载控制的两翼、无尾蝴蝶仿生 FWMAV 的受控飞行。这项工作证实了轻质、防撞 FWMAV 的基础平台，将生物灵感与实际的空中机器人技术相结合。其非侵入式机动性非常适合现实应用，例如传统无人机无法进入的狭小空间检查和生态监测，而其生物力学保真度则提供了一个物理模型来解码真实蝴蝶不规则但高效飞行的背后的原理。
tldr: This paper presents a 26-gram tailless butterfly-inspired robot, AirPulse, that achieves stable and autonomous flight using a novel control method based on wing stroke asymmetry, demonstrating its potential for applications in confined spaces.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一款26克的无尾蝴蝶仿生机器人AirPulse，它利用基于机翼冲程不对称的新型控制方法实现了稳定自主飞行，展示了其在狭小空间应用中的潜力。

title: Efficient and Robust Modeling of Nonlinear Mechanical Systems
summary: The development of efficient and robust dynamic models is fundamental in the field of systems and control engineering. In this paper, a new formulation for the dynamic model of nonlinear mechanical systems, that can be applied to different automotive and robotic case studies, is proposed, together with a modeling procedure allowing to automatically obtain the model formulation. Compared with the Euler-Lagrange formulation, the proposed model is shown to give superior performances in terms of robustness against measurement noise for systems exhibiting dependence on some external variables, as well as in terms of execution time when computing the inverse dynamics of the system.
summary_zh: 高效且鲁棒的动态模型开发是系统与控制工程领域的基础。本文提出了一种新的非线性机械系统动态模型公式，可应用于不同的汽车和机器人案例研究，并提供了一种建模程序，可以自动获得模型公式。与 Euler-Lagrange 公式相比，对于依赖某些外部变量的系统，所提出的模型在抗测量噪声方面表现出更优越的性能，并且在计算系统逆动力学时，执行时间也更短。
tldr: This paper presents a novel dynamic model formulation for nonlinear mechanical systems, claiming improved robustness against measurement noise and faster inverse dynamics computation compared to the Euler-Lagrange method, with automotive and robotic applications.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于非线性机械系统的新型动态模型公式，声称与欧拉-拉格朗日方法相比，在测量噪声方面具有更高的鲁棒性，并且逆动力学计算速度更快，适用于汽车和机器人领域。

title: TFusionOcc: Student's t-Distribution Based Object-Centric Multi-Sensor Fusion Framework for 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary: 3D semantic occupancy prediction enables autonomous vehicles (AVs) to perceive fine-grained geometric and semantic structure of their surroundings from onboard sensors, which is essential for safe decision-making and navigation. Recent models for 3D semantic occupancy prediction have successfully addressed the challenge of describing real-world objects with varied shapes and classes. However, the intermediate representations used by existing methods for 3D semantic occupancy prediction rely heavily on 3D voxel volumes or a set of 3D Gaussians, hindering the model's ability to efficiently and effectively capture fine-grained geometric details in the 3D driving environment. This paper introduces TFusionOcc, a novel object-centric multi-sensor fusion framework for predicting 3D semantic occupancy. By leveraging multi-stage multi-sensor fusion, Student's t-distribution, and the T-Mixture model (TMM), together with more geometrically flexible primitives, such as the deformable superquadric (superquadric with inverse warp), the proposed method achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the nuScenes benchmark. In addition, extensive experiments were conducted on the nuScenes-C dataset to demonstrate the robustness of the proposed method in different camera and lidar corruption scenarios. The code will be available at: https://github.com/DanielMing123/TFusionOcc
summary_zh: 3D语义占据预测使自动驾驶车辆 (AVs) 能够利用车载传感器感知周围环境的精细几何和语义结构，这对于安全决策和导航至关重要。 近期用于3D语义占据预测的模型已经成功地解决了描述具有不同形状和类别的真实世界物体的挑战。 然而，现有3D语义占据预测方法使用的中间表示形式严重依赖于3D体素卷或一组3D高斯分布，从而阻碍了模型高效且有效地捕捉3D驾驶环境中精细几何细节的能力。 本文介绍了一种新颖的、以对象为中心的3D语义占据预测多传感器融合框架TFusionOcc。 通过利用多阶段多传感器融合、学生t分布和T-混合模型 (TMM)，以及更具几何灵活性的基元，例如可变形超二次曲面（具有逆向扭曲的超二次曲面），所提出的方法在nuScenes基准测试上实现了最先进 (SOTA) 的性能。 此外，在nuScenes-C数据集上进行了大量实验，以证明所提出的方法在不同的相机和激光雷达损坏场景中的鲁棒性。 代码将在以下地址开放获取：https://github.com/DanielMing123/TFusionOcc
tldr: This paper introduces TFusionOcc, a novel multi-sensor fusion framework using Student's t-distribution and deformable superquadrics for 3D semantic occupancy prediction, achieving SOTA results on nuScenes and showing robustness to sensor corruption.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为TFusionOcc的新型多传感器融合框架，该框架使用Student's t分布和可变形超二次曲面进行3D语义占用预测，在nuScenes上实现了SOTA结果，并显示出对传感器损坏的鲁棒性。

title: A High-Fidelity Robotic Manipulator Teleoperation Framework for Human-Centered Augmented Reality Evaluation
summary: Validating Augmented Reality (AR) tracking and interaction models requires precise, repeatable ground-truth motion. However, human users cannot reliably perform consistent motion due to biomechanical variability. Robotic manipulators are promising to act as human motion proxies if they can mimic human movements. In this work, we design and implement ARBot, a real-time teleoperation platform that can effectively capture natural human motion and accurately replay the movements via robotic manipulators. ARBot includes two capture models: stable wrist motion capture via a custom CV and IMU pipeline, and natural 6-DOF control via a mobile application. We design a proactively-safe QP controller to ensure smooth, jitter-free execution of the robotic manipulator, enabling it to function as a high-fidelity record and replay physical proxy. We open-source ARBot and release a benchmark dataset of 132 human and synthetic trajectories captured using ARBot to support controllable and scalable AR evaluation.
summary_zh: 验证增强现实 (AR) 追踪和交互模型需要精确且可重复的真值运动。然而，由于生物力学变异性，人类用户无法可靠地执行一致的运动。如果机器人机械臂能够模仿人类运动，它们有望充当人类运动代理。在这项工作中，我们设计并实现了 ARBot，一个实时遥操作平台，可以有效地捕捉自然的人类运动，并通过机器人机械臂精确地重放这些运动。 ARBot 包含两种捕捉模型：通过定制的 CV 和 IMU 流水线实现的稳定腕部运动捕捉，以及通过移动应用程序实现的自然 6 自由度控制。我们设计了一个主动安全的 QP 控制器，以确保机器人机械臂平稳、无抖动地执行运动，使其能够作为高保真记录和重放物理代理发挥作用。我们开源了 ARBot，并发布了一个包含 132 条使用 ARBot 捕捉的人类和合成轨迹的基准数据集，以支持可控且可扩展的 AR 评估。
tldr: The paper introduces ARBot, a teleoperation platform for robotic manipulators using AR-based human motion capture, and releases a benchmark dataset for AR evaluation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为ARBot的遥操作平台，该平台使用基于AR的人体运动捕捉技术控制机器人机械臂，并发布了一个用于AR评估的基准数据集。

title: Active Localization of Unstable Systems with Coarse Information
summary: We study localization and control for unstable systems under coarse, single-bit sensing. Motivated by understanding the fundamental limitations imposed by such minimal feedback, we identify sufficient conditions under which the initial state can be recovered despite instability and extremely sparse measurements. Building on these conditions, we develop an active localization algorithm that integrates a set-based estimator with a control strategy derived from Voronoi partitions, which provably estimates the initial state while ensuring the agent remains in informative regions. Under the derived conditions, the proposed approach guarantees exponential contraction of the initial-state uncertainty, and the result is further supported by numerical experiments. These findings can offer theoretical insight into localization in robotics, where sensing is often limited to coarse abstractions such as keyframes, segmentations, or line-based features.
summary_zh: 我们研究了在粗糙的、单比特感知下不稳定系统的定位与控制问题。出于理解这种极简反馈所带来的根本性限制，我们确定了在不稳定性和极其稀疏的测量条件下，初始状态可以被恢复的充分条件。基于这些条件，我们开发了一种主动定位算法，该算法将基于集合的估计器与源于Voronoi划分的控制策略相结合，可证明地估计初始状态，同时确保智能体保持在信息丰富的区域。在推导出的条件下，所提出的方法保证了初始状态不确定性的指数收缩，并且该结果得到了数值实验的进一步支持。这些发现可以为机器人领域的定位提供理论见解，在该领域中，感知通常仅限于粗糙的抽象，例如关键帧、分割或基于线条的特征。
tldr: This paper presents an active localization algorithm for unstable systems with coarse sensing, demonstrating provable exponential contraction of initial-state uncertainty.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对具有粗略感测的不稳定系统的主动定位算法，证明了初始状态不确定性的指数收缩。

title: The SLAM Confidence Trap
summary: The SLAM community has fallen into a "Confidence Trap" by prioritizing benchmark scores over principled uncertainty estimation. This yields systems that are geometrically accurate but probabilitistically inconsistent and brittle. We advocate for a paradigm shift where the consistent, real-time computation of uncertainty becomes a primary metric of success.
summary_zh: SLAM领域因过度追求基准测试高分而忽略了有原则性的不确定性估计，已陷入“置信陷阱”。 这导致系统在几何精度上表现良好，但在概率上不一致且脆弱。 我们提倡一种范式转变，将不确定性的持续、实时计算作为衡量成功的首要指标。
tldr: This paper critiques the SLAM community's over-reliance on benchmark scores at the expense of robust uncertainty estimation, advocating for a paradigm shift towards prioritizing probabilistic consistency in real-time SLAM systems.
tldr_zh: 本文批评了SLAM领域过度依赖基准测试分数而忽略了鲁棒的不确定性估计，并倡导一种范式转变，即优先考虑实时SLAM系统中概率一致性。

title: Rebenchmarking Unsupervised Monocular 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary: Inferring the 3D structure from a single image, particularly in occluded regions, remains a fundamental yet unsolved challenge in vision-centric autonomous driving. Existing unsupervised approaches typically train a neural radiance field and treat the network outputs as occupancy probabilities during evaluation, overlooking the inconsistency between training and evaluation protocols. Moreover, the prevalent use of 2D ground truth fails to reveal the inherent ambiguity in occluded regions caused by insufficient geometric constraints. To address these issues, this paper presents a reformulated benchmark for unsupervised monocular 3D occupancy prediction. We first interpret the variables involved in the volume rendering process and identify the most physically consistent representation of the occupancy probability. Building on these analyses, we improve existing evaluation protocols by aligning the newly identified representation with voxel-wise 3D occupancy ground truth, thereby enabling unsupervised methods to be evaluated in a manner consistent with that of supervised approaches. Additionally, to impose explicit constraints in occluded regions, we introduce an occlusion-aware polarization mechanism that incorporates multi-view visual cues to enhance discrimination between occupied and free spaces in these regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach not only significantly outperforms existing unsupervised approaches but also matches the performance of supervised ones. Our source code and evaluation protocol will be made available upon publication.
summary_zh: 以下是一个单张图像中推断3D结构，尤其是在遮挡区域，仍然是基于视觉的自动驾驶中一个根本却未解决的挑战。现有的无监督方法通常训练一个神经辐射场，并在评估过程中将网络输出视为占用概率，忽略了训练和评估规程之间的不一致性。此外，2D真值的普遍使用未能揭示由几何约束不足引起的遮挡区域中固有的模糊性。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了一个改进的无监督单目3D占用预测基准。我们首先解释了体渲染过程中涉及的变量，并确定了占用概率的最物理一致的表示。基于这些分析，我们通过将新确定的表示与体素化的3D占用真值对齐，从而改进了现有的评估协议，使无监督方法能够以与监督方法一致的方式进行评估。此外，为了在遮挡区域施加显式约束，我们引入了一种遮挡感知极化机制，该机制结合了多视角的视觉线索，以增强这些区域中占用空间和自由空间之间的辨别能力。大量实验表明，我们的方法不仅显著优于现有的无监督方法，而且还达到了与监督方法相当的性能。我们的源代码和评估协议将在发布后公开。
tldr: The paper re-benchmarks unsupervised monocular 3D occupancy prediction by identifying a more physically consistent occupancy representation, improving evaluation protocols with voxel-wise 3D ground truth, and introducing an occlusion-aware polarization mechanism, achieving performance comparable to supervised methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文重新评估了无监督单目3D占据预测，通过识别更符合物理的占据表示，改进了具有体素级3D真实数据的评估协议，并引入了一种考虑遮挡的极化机制，实现了与有监督方法相当的性能。

title: Instance-Free Domain Adaptive Object Detection
summary: While Domain Adaptive Object Detection (DAOD) has made significant strides, most methods rely on unlabeled target data that is assumed to contain sufficient foreground instances. However, in many practical scenarios (e.g., wildlife monitoring, lesion detection), collecting target domain data with objects of interest is prohibitively costly, whereas background-only data is abundant. This common practical constraint introduces a significant technical challenge: the difficulty of achieving domain alignment when target instances are unavailable, forcing adaptation to rely solely on the target background information. We formulate this challenge as the novel problem of Instance-Free Domain Adaptive Object Detection. To tackle this, we propose the Relational and Structural Consistency Network (RSCN) which pioneers an alignment strategy based on background feature prototypes while simultaneously encouraging consistency in the relationship between the source foreground features and the background features within each domain, enabling robust adaptation even without target instances. To facilitate research, we further curate three specialized benchmarks, including simulative auto-driving detection, wildlife detection, and lung nodule detection. Extensive experiments show that RSCN significantly outperforms existing DAOD methods across all three benchmarks in the instance-free scenario. The code and benchmarks will be released soon.
summary_zh: 域自适应目标检测（DAOD）已经取得了显著进展，但大多数方法依赖于假定包含足够前景实例的未标注目标域数据。然而，在许多实际场景中（例如，野生动物监测、病灶检测），收集包含感兴趣对象的目标域数据成本高昂，而仅包含背景的数据则非常丰富。这种常见的实际约束带来了一个重大的技术挑战：当目标实例不可用时，域对齐的难度，迫使自适应完全依赖于目标背景信息。我们把这个挑战定义为实例无关域自适应目标检测这一新问题。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了关系和结构一致性网络（RSCN），它率先提出了一种基于背景特征原型对齐的策略，同时鼓励源域前景特征和每个域内的背景特征之间关系的一致性，从而即使没有目标实例也能实现稳健的自适应。为了方便研究，我们进一步策划了三个专门的基准测试，包括模拟自动驾驶检测、野生动物检测和肺结节检测。大量实验表明，在实例无关场景下，RSCN在所有三个基准测试中都显著优于现有的DAOD方法。代码和基准测试即将发布。
tldr: The paper introduces Instance-Free Domain Adaptive Object Detection, a novel problem where target domain object detection must adapt without foreground instances, and proposes a Relational and Structural Consistency Network (RSCN) to address it.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的问题，即无实例领域自适应目标检测，其中目标域目标检测必须在没有前景实例的情况下进行自适应，并提出了一种关系和结构一致性网络 (RSCN) 来解决这个问题。

title: A neuromorphic model of the insect visual system for natural image processing
summary: Insect vision supports complex behaviors including associative learning, navigation, and object detection, and has long motivated computational models for understanding biological visual processing. However, many contemporary models prioritize task performance while neglecting biologically grounded processing pathways. Here, we introduce a bio-inspired vision model that captures principles of the insect visual system to transform dense visual input into sparse, discriminative codes. The model is trained using a fully self-supervised contrastive objective, enabling representation learning without labeled data and supporting reuse across tasks without reliance on domain-specific classifiers. We evaluated the resulting representations on flower recognition tasks and natural image benchmarks. The model consistently produced reliable sparse codes that distinguish visually similar inputs. To support different modelling and deployment uses, we have implemented the model as both an artificial neural network and a spiking neural network. In a simulated localization setting, our approach outperformed a simple image downsampling comparison baseline, highlighting the functional benefit of incorporating neuromorphic visual processing pathways. Collectively, these results advance insect computational modelling by providing a generalizable bio-inspired vision model capable of sparse computation across diverse tasks.
summary_zh: 昆虫视觉支持复杂的行为，包括联想学习、导航和物体检测，长期以来一直激励着用于理解生物视觉处理的计算模型。然而，许多当代模型优先考虑任务性能，而忽略了生物学基础的处理通路。在此，我们介绍了一种受生物启发的视觉模型，该模型捕捉了昆虫视觉系统的原理，将密集的视觉输入转化为稀疏且具有区分性的编码。该模型使用完全自监督的对比目标进行训练，无需标记数据即可实现表征学习，并支持跨任务的重用，而无需依赖于特定领域的分类器。我们评估了所得表征在花朵识别任务和自然图像基准上的表现。该模型始终如一地产生可靠的稀疏编码，从而区分视觉上相似的输入。为了支持不同的建模和部署用途，我们已将该模型实现为人工神经网络和脉冲神经网络。在模拟的定位环境中，我们的方法优于简单的图像下采样比较基线，突出了结合神经形态视觉处理通路的功能优势。总的来说，这些结果通过提供一种通用的、受生物启发的视觉模型，该模型能够在各种任务中进行稀疏计算，从而推进了昆虫计算建模。
tldr: This paper introduces a biologically-inspired, self-supervised neuromorphic vision model based on insect visual systems, demonstrating sparse and discriminative representation learning for flower recognition and natural image tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种受生物学启发的、基于昆虫视觉系统的自监督神经形态视觉模型，展示了用于花朵识别和自然图像任务的稀疏和区分性表示学习。

title: ForeHOI: Feed-forward 3D Object Reconstruction from Daily Hand-Object Interaction Videos
summary: The ubiquity of monocular videos capturing daily hand-object interactions presents a valuable resource for embodied intelligence. While 3D hand reconstruction from in-the-wild videos has seen significant progress, reconstructing the involved objects remains challenging due to severe occlusions and the complex, coupled motion of the camera, hands, and object. In this paper, we introduce ForeHOI, a novel feed-forward model that directly reconstructs 3D object geometry from monocular hand-object interaction videos within one minute of inference time, eliminating the need for any pre-processing steps. Our key insight is that, the joint prediction of 2D mask inpainting and 3D shape completion in a feed-forward framework can effectively address the problem of severe occlusion in monocular hand-held object videos, thereby achieving results that outperform the performance of optimization-based methods. The information exchanges between the 2D and 3D shape completion boosts the overall reconstruction quality, enabling the framework to effectively handle severe hand-object occlusion. Furthermore, to support the training of our model, we contribute the first large-scale, high-fidelity synthetic dataset of hand-object interactions with comprehensive annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ForeHOI achieves state-of-the-art performance in object reconstruction, significantly outperforming previous methods with around a 100x speedup. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/Tao-11-chen/ForeHOI.
summary_zh: 捕捉日常手部与物体交互的单目视频随处可见，为具身智能提供了宝贵的资源。虽然从真实场景的视频中进行3D手部重建已取得显著进展，但由于严重的遮挡以及相机、手部和物体复杂的耦合运动，重建涉及的物体仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的前馈模型ForeHOI，该模型可以直接从单目手部-物体交互视频中重建3D物体几何形状，且推理时间在一分钟内，无需任何预处理步骤。我们的核心思想是，在前馈框架中联合预测2D掩模修复和3D形状补全可以有效地解决单目手持物体视频中严重的遮挡问题，从而实现优于基于优化方法的效果。2D和3D形状补全的信息交换提高了整体重建质量，使该框架能够有效地处理严重的手部-物体遮挡。此外，为了支持我们模型的训练，我们贡献了第一个大规模、高保真的手部-物体交互合成数据集，其中包含全面的标注。大量实验表明，ForeHOI在物体重建方面实现了最先进的性能，相比以往的方法，速度提升了约100倍。代码和数据可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/Tao-11-chen/ForeHOI。
tldr: The paper introduces ForeHOI, a feed-forward model for fast 3D object reconstruction from monocular hand-object interaction videos, achieving state-of-the-art performance and a significant speedup compared to existing methods, along with a new synthetic dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ForeHOI，一种用于从单目手-物体交互视频中快速进行3D物体重建的前馈模型，与现有方法相比实现了最先进的性能和显著的加速，并提供了一个新的合成数据集。

title: DroneKey++: A Size Prior-free Method and New Benchmark for Drone 3D Pose Estimation from Sequential Images
summary: Accurate 3D pose estimation of drones is essential for security and surveillance systems. However, existing methods often rely on prior drone information such as physical sizes or 3D meshes. At the same time, current datasets are small-scale, limited to single models, and collected under constrained environments, which makes reliable validation of generalization difficult. We present DroneKey++, a prior-free framework that jointly performs keypoint detection, drone classification, and 3D pose estimation. The framework employs a keypoint encoder for simultaneous keypoint detection and classification, and a pose decoder that estimates 3D pose using ray-based geometric reasoning and class embeddings. To address dataset limitations, we construct 6DroneSyn, a large-scale synthetic benchmark with over 50K images covering 7 drone models and 88 outdoor backgrounds, generated using 360-degree panoramic synthesis. Experiments show that DroneKey++ achieves MAE 17.34 deg and MedAE 17.1 deg for rotation, MAE 0.135 m and MedAE 0.242 m for translation, with inference speeds of 19.25 FPS (CPU) and 414.07 FPS (GPU), demonstrating both strong generalization across drone models and suitability for real-time applications. The dataset is publicly available.
summary_zh: 无人机的精确3D姿态估计对于安全和监控系统至关重要。然而，现有方法通常依赖于无人机的先验信息，例如物理尺寸或3D网格模型。同时，目前的数据集规模较小，仅限于单一模型，并且是在受限环境下收集的，这使得可靠的泛化验证变得困难。我们提出了DroneKey++，一个无需先验信息的框架，可联合执行关键点检测、无人机分类和3D姿态估计。该框架采用关键点编码器，用于同步进行关键点检测和分类，以及一个姿态解码器，该解码器利用基于射线几何推理和类别嵌入来估计3D姿态。为了解决数据集的局限性，我们构建了6DroneSyn，一个大规模合成基准，包含超过5万张图像，涵盖7种无人机模型和88种室外背景，该基准是使用360度全景合成生成的。实验表明，DroneKey++在旋转上的平均绝对误差(MAE)为17.34度，中值绝对误差(MedAE)为17.1度，在平移上的平均绝对误差(MAE)为0.135米，中值绝对误差(MedAE)为0.242米，推理速度为19.25 FPS (CPU)和414.07 FPS (GPU)，这证明了其在不同无人机模型上的强大泛化能力以及适用于实时应用的能力。该数据集已公开。
tldr: The paper introduces DroneKey++, a prior-free framework for 3D drone pose estimation from sequential images, along with a large-scale synthetic dataset (6DroneSyn) to address generalization limitations of existing methods. The method shows good performance and real-time capabilities.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DroneKey++，一个无需先验信息的无人机三维姿态估计框架，以及一个大型合成数据集（6DroneSyn），旨在解决现有方法的泛化局限性。该方法表现出良好的性能和实时性。

title: A first realization of reinforcement learning-based closed-loop EEG-TMS
summary: Background: Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) is a powerful tool to investigate neurophysiology of the human brain and treat brain disorders. Traditionally, therapeutic TMS has been applied in a one-size-fits-all approach, disregarding inter- and intra-individual differences. Brain state-dependent EEG-TMS, such as coupling TMS with a pre-specified phase of the sensorimotor mu-rhythm, enables the induction of differential neuroplastic effects depending on the targeted phase. But this approach is still user-dependent as it requires defining an a-priori target phase. Objectives: To present a first realization of a machine-learning-based, closed-loop real-time EEG-TMS setup to identify user-independently the individual mu-rhythm phase associated with high- vs. low-corticospinal excitability states. Methods: We applied EEG-TMS to 25 participants targeting the supplementary motor area-primary motor cortex network and used a reinforcement learning algorithm to identify the mu-rhythm phase associated with high- vs. low corticospinal excitability. We employed linear mixed effects models and Bayesian analysis to determine effects of reinforced learning on corticospinal excitability indexed by motor evoked potential amplitude, and functional connectivity indexed by the imaginary part of resting-state EEG coherence. Results: Reinforcement learning effectively identified the mu-rhythm phase associated with high- vs. low-excitability states, and their repetitive stimulation resulted in long-term increases vs. decreases in functional connectivity in the stimulated sensorimotor network. Conclusions: We demonstrated for the first time the feasibility of closed-loop EEG-TMS in humans, a critical step towards individualized treatment of brain disorders.
summary_zh: 背景：经颅磁刺激（TMS）是一种研究人脑神经生理学和治疗脑部疾病的强大工具。传统上，治疗性TMS采用一刀切的方法，忽略了个体间和个体内的差异。脑状态依赖性EEG-TMS，例如将TMS与感觉运动μ节律的预定相位耦合，能够根据靶向相位诱导不同的神经可塑性效应。但这种方法仍然依赖于用户，因为它需要预先定义目标相位。目的：展示一种基于机器学习的闭环实时EEG-TMS设置的首次实现，以用户独立的方式识别与高皮质脊髓兴奋性状态与低皮质脊髓兴奋性状态相关的个体μ节律相位。方法：我们对25名参与者应用EEG-TMS，靶向辅助运动区-初级运动皮层网络，并使用强化学习算法来识别与高/低皮质脊髓兴奋性相关的μ节律相位。我们采用线性混合效应模型和贝叶斯分析来确定强化学习对皮质脊髓兴奋性的影响，通过运动诱发电位幅度进行评估，以及对静息态脑电相干性的虚部进行评估的功能连接。结果：强化学习有效地识别了与高/低兴奋性状态相关的μ节律相位，并且它们的重复刺激导致刺激的感觉运动网络中功能连接的长期增加与减少。结论：我们首次证明了闭环EEG-TMS在人类中的可行性，这是实现脑部疾病个性化治疗的关键一步。
tldr: This paper presents a closed-loop EEG-TMS system using reinforcement learning to personalize brain stimulation, achieving long-term modulation of functional connectivity in the sensorimotor network.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于强化学习的闭环脑电-TMS系统，用于个性化脑刺激，实现了感觉运动网络功能连接的长期调节。

title: The hidden risks of temporal resampling in clinical reinforcement learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (ORL) has shown potential for improving decision-making in healthcare. However, contemporary research typically aggregates patient data into fixed time intervals, simplifying their mapping to standard ORL frameworks. The impact of these temporal manipulations on model safety and efficacy remains poorly understood. In this work, using both a gridworld navigation task and the UVA/Padova clinical diabetes simulator, we demonstrate that temporal resampling significantly degrades the performance of offline reinforcement learning algorithms during live deployment. We propose three mechanisms that drive this failure: (i) the generation of counterfactual trajectories, (ii) the distortion of temporal expectations, and (iii) the compounding of generalisation errors. Crucially, we find that standard off-policy evaluation metrics can fail to detect these drops in performance. Our findings reveal a fundamental risk in current healthcare ORL pipelines and emphasise the need for methods that explicitly handle the irregular timing of clinical decision-making.
summary_zh: 离线强化学习(ORL)已显示出在提升医疗保健决策方面的潜力。然而，当前的研究通常将患者数据聚合到固定的时间间隔内，从而简化了其到标准ORL框架的映射。这些时间操纵对模型安全性和有效性的影响仍然知之甚少。 在这项工作中，我们使用网格世界导航任务和UVA/Padova临床糖尿病模拟器，证明了时间重采样会显著降低离线强化学习算法在实时部署期间的性能。我们提出了导致这种失败的三个机制：（i）反事实轨迹的生成，（ii）时间期望的扭曲，以及（iii）泛化误差的累积。 关键是，我们发现标准的离策略评估指标可能无法检测到这些性能下降。我们的研究结果揭示了当前医疗保健ORL流程中的一个根本风险，并强调了对明确处理临床决策不规则时间问题的方法的需求。
tldr: This paper identifies and analyzes the risks of temporal resampling in offline reinforcement learning within healthcare, showing performance degradation and evaluation metric failures, highlighting the need for handling irregular clinical data timing.
tldr_zh: 该论文识别并分析了医疗保健领域离线强化学习中时间重采样的风险，展示了性能下降和评估指标失效的问题，强调了处理不规则临床数据时间的需求。

title: Curiosity is Knowledge: Self-Consistent Learning and No-Regret Optimization with Active Inference
summary: Active inference (AIF) unifies exploration and exploitation by minimizing the Expected Free Energy (EFE), balancing epistemic value (information gain) and pragmatic value (task performance) through a curiosity coefficient. Yet it has been unclear when this balance yields both coherent learning and efficient decision-making: insufficient curiosity can drive myopic exploitation and prevent uncertainty resolution, while excessive curiosity can induce unnecessary exploration and regret. We establish the first theoretical guarantee for EFE-minimizing agents, showing that a single requirement--sufficient curiosity--simultaneously ensures self-consistent learning (Bayesian posterior consistency) and no-regret optimization (bounded cumulative regret). Our analysis characterizes how this mechanism depends on initial uncertainty, identifiability, and objective alignment, thereby connecting AIF to classical Bayesian experimental design and Bayesian optimization within one theoretical framework. We further translate these theories into practical design guidelines for tuning the epistemic-pragmatic trade-off in hybrid learning-optimization problems, validated through real-world experiments.
summary_zh: 主动推理 (AIF) 通过最小化期望自由能 (EFE) 来统一探索和利用，并通过好奇心系数来平衡认知价值（信息增益）和实用价值（任务表现）。然而，这种平衡何时能够产生连贯的学习和高效的决策，一直不清楚：不足的好奇心会导致短视的利用并阻止不确定性的解决，而过度的好奇心会导致不必要的探索和后悔。 我们为最小化期望自由能的智能体建立了第一个理论保证，表明一个单一的要求 —— 足够的好奇心 —— 同时确保了自洽的学习（贝叶斯后验一致性）和无悔优化（有界累积后悔）。 我们的分析刻画了这种机制如何依赖于初始不确定性、可识别性和目标对齐，从而将 AIF 连接到经典贝叶斯实验设计和贝叶斯优化，并将其置于一个理论框架中。 我们进一步将这些理论转化为实际的设计指南，以调整混合学习-优化问题中的认知-实用权衡，并通过真实世界的实验进行验证。
tldr: This paper provides theoretical guarantees for Active Inference (AIF) agents, showing that sufficient curiosity ensures both self-consistent learning and no-regret optimization, and validates these findings with real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文为主动推理 (AIF) 智能体提供了理论保证，证明了足够的求知欲可以确保自我一致的学习和无悔优化，并通过真实世界的实验验证这些发现。

title: Airspace-aware Contingency Landing Planning
summary: This paper develops a real-time, search-based aircraft contingency landing planner that minimizes traffic disruptions while accounting for ground risk. The airspace model captures dense air traffic departure and arrival flows, helicopter corridors, and prohibited zones and is demonstrated with a Washington, D.C., area case study. Historical Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) data are processed to estimate air traffic density. A low-latency computational geometry algorithm generates proximity-based heatmaps around high-risk corridors and restricted regions. Airspace risk is quantified as the cumulative exposure time of a landing trajectory within congested regions, while ground risk is assessed from overflown population density to jointly guide trajectory selection. A landing site selection module further mitigates disruption to nominal air traffic operations. Benchmarking against minimum-risk Dubins solutions demonstrates that the proposed planner achieves lower joint risk and reduced airspace disruption while maintaining real-time performance. Under airspace-risk-only conditions, the planner generates trajectories within an average of 2.9 seconds on a laptop computer. Future work will incorporate dynamic air traffic updates to enable spatiotemporal contingency landing planning that minimizes the need for real-time traffic rerouting.
summary_zh: 本文开发了一种基于搜索的飞机应急着陆实时规划器，该规划器在考虑地面风险的同时，最大限度地减少交通中断。空域模型捕获了密集的空中交通起降流量、直升机走廊和禁飞区，并以华盛顿特区区域案例研究为例进行了演示。历史自动相关监视广播（ADS-B）数据经过处理，用于估计空中交通密度。一种低延迟的计算几何算法生成基于邻近度的高风险走廊和限制区域热图。空域风险被量化为着陆轨迹在拥堵区域内的累积暴露时间，而地面风险则根据飞越的人口密度进行评估，从而共同指导轨迹选择。着陆点选择模块进一步减轻了对正常空中交通运营的干扰。与最小风险杜宾斯解的基准测试表明，所提出的规划器实现了更低的联合风险和减少的空域中断，同时保持了实时性能。在仅考虑空域风险的条件下，该规划器在一台笔记本电脑上平均用时2.9秒生成轨迹。未来的工作将结合动态空中交通更新，以实现时空应急着陆规划，从而最大限度地减少实时交通重新规划的需求。
tldr: This paper presents a real-time contingency landing planner that minimizes traffic disruptions and ground risk using historical ADS-B data and computational geometry to model airspace risk. It could provide a useful environment or test-bed for robotics applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种实时应急着陆规划器，该规划器利用历史 ADS-B 数据和计算几何来模拟空域风险，从而最大限度地减少交通中断和地面风险。它可以为机器人应用提供有用的环境或测试平台。

title: ASMa: Asymmetric Spatio-temporal Masking for Skeleton Action Representation Learning
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has shown remarkable success in skeleton-based action recognition by leveraging data augmentations to learn meaningful representations. However, existing SSL methods rely on data augmentations that predominantly focus on masking high-motion frames and high-degree joints such as joints with degree 3 or 4. This results in biased and incomplete feature representations that struggle to generalize across varied motion patterns. To address this, we propose Asymmetric Spatio-temporal Masking (ASMa) for Skeleton Action Representation Learning, a novel combination of masking to learn a full spectrum of spatio-temporal dynamics inherent in human actions. ASMa employs two complementary masking strategies: one that selectively masks high-degree joints and low-motion, and another that masks low-degree joints and high-motion frames. These masking strategies ensure a more balanced and comprehensive skeleton representation learning. Furthermore, we introduce a learnable feature alignment module to effectively align the representations learned from both masked views. To facilitate deployment in resource-constrained settings and on low-resource devices, we compress the learned and aligned representation into a lightweight model using knowledge distillation. Extensive experiments on NTU RGB+D 60, NTU RGB+D 120, and PKU-MMD datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing SSL methods with an average improvement of 2.7-4.4% in fine-tuning and up to 5.9% in transfer learning to noisy datasets and achieves competitive performance compared to fully supervised baselines. Our distilled model achieves 91.4% parameter reduction and 3x faster inference on edge devices while maintaining competitive accuracy, enabling practical deployment in resource-constrained scenarios.
summary_zh: 自监督学习(SSL)通过利用数据增强来学习有意义的表征，在基于骨骼的动作识别中表现出了显著的成功。然而，现有的SSL方法依赖于主要集中于掩蔽高运动帧和高阶关节（例如度数为3或4的关节）的数据增强。这导致了有偏且不完整的特征表征，难以泛化到各种运动模式中。为了解决这个问题，我们提出用于骨骼动作表征学习的非对称时空掩蔽(ASMa)，这是一种新颖的掩蔽组合方法，用于学习人类动作中固有的完整时空动力学。ASMa采用两种互补的掩蔽策略：一种选择性地掩蔽高阶关节和低运动，另一种掩蔽低阶关节和高运动帧。这些掩蔽策略确保了更平衡和全面的骨骼表征学习。此外，我们引入了一个可学习的特征对齐模块，以有效地对齐从两个掩蔽视图学习到的表征。为了便于在资源受限的环境和低资源设备上的部署，我们使用知识蒸馏将学习和对齐后的表征压缩成一个轻量级模型。在NTU RGB+D 60, NTU RGB+D 120和PKU-MMD数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法优于现有的SSL方法，在微调中平均提高了2.7-4.4%，在迁移学习到噪声数据集时最高提高了5.9%，并且与完全监督的基线相比取得了有竞争力的性能。我们蒸馏后的模型实现了91.4%的参数缩减和在边缘设备上3倍的推理速度提升，同时保持了有竞争力的准确率，从而能够在资源受限的场景中进行实际部署。
tldr: The paper introduces ASMa, a self-supervised learning method for skeleton-based action recognition that uses asymmetric spatio-temporal masking to learn more robust representations, and demonstrates strong performance and efficient deployment capabilities.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ASMa，一种用于基于骨骼的动作识别的自监督学习方法，该方法采用非对称时空掩蔽来学习更鲁棒的表示，并展示了强大的性能和高效的部署能力。

title: Urban Spatio-Temporal Foundation Models for Climate-Resilient Housing: Scaling Diffusion Transformers for Disaster Risk Prediction
summary: Climate hazards increasingly disrupt urban transportation and emergency-response operations by damaging housing stock, degrading infrastructure, and reducing network accessibility. This paper presents Skjold-DiT, a diffusion-transformer framework that integrates heterogeneous spatio-temporal urban data to forecast building-level climate-risk indicators while explicitly incorporating transportation-network structure and accessibility signals relevant to intelligent vehicles (e.g., emergency reachability and evacuation-route constraints). Concretely, Skjold-DiT enables hazard-conditioned routing constraints by producing calibrated, uncertainty-aware accessibility layers (reachability, travel-time inflation, and route redundancy) that can be consumed by intelligent-vehicle routing and emergency dispatch systems. Skjold-DiT combines: (1) Fjell-Prompt, a prompt-based conditioning interface designed to support cross-city transfer; (2) Norrland-Fusion, a cross-modal attention mechanism unifying hazard maps/imagery, building attributes, demographics, and transportation infrastructure into a shared latent representation; and (3) Valkyrie-Forecast, a counterfactual simulator for generating probabilistic risk trajectories under intervention prompts. We introduce the Baltic-Caspian Urban Resilience (BCUR) dataset with 847,392 building-level observations across six cities, including multi-hazard annotations (e.g., flood and heat indicators) and transportation accessibility features. Experiments evaluate prediction quality, cross-city generalization, calibration, and downstream transportation-relevant outcomes, including reachability and hazard-conditioned travel times under counterfactual interventions.
summary_zh: 气候灾害日益扰乱城市交通和应急响应行动，具体表现为破坏房屋存量、降低基础设施质量以及降低网络可达性。本文提出 Skjold-DiT，一种扩散-Transformer框架，该框架整合了异构时空城市数据以预测建筑层面的气候风险指标，同时显式地纳入了与智能车辆相关的交通网络结构和可达性信号（例如，应急可达性和疏散路线约束）。具体而言，Skjold-DiT通过生成校准的、具有不确定性意识的可达性层（可达性、旅行时间膨胀和路线冗余）来实现灾害条件下的路径约束，这些可达性层可供智能车辆路径规划和紧急调度系统使用。Skjold-DiT结合了：（1）Fjell-Prompt，一种基于提示的条件接口，旨在支持跨城市迁移；（2）Norrland-Fusion，一种跨模态注意力机制，将灾害地图/图像、建筑属性、人口统计数据和交通基础设施统一到一个共享的潜在表示中；以及（3）Valkyrie-Forecast，一种反事实模拟器，用于生成干预提示下的概率风险轨迹。我们引入了波罗的海-里海城市韧性（BCUR）数据集，该数据集包含六个城市的 847,392 个建筑层面的观测数据，包括多灾害注释（例如，洪水和高温指标）以及交通可达性特征。实验评估了预测质量、跨城市泛化能力、校准以及下游与交通相关的结果，包括可达性和反事实干预下的灾害条件旅行时间。
tldr: The paper introduces Skjold-DiT, a diffusion-transformer framework for forecasting building-level climate risk by integrating spatio-temporal urban data and transportation network information, and presents a new dataset for urban resilience research.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Skjold-DiT，一个扩散转换器框架，通过整合时空城市数据和交通网络信息来预测建筑级别的气候风险，并提出了一个新的城市韧性研究数据集。

title: POPL-KF: A Pose-Only Geometric Representation-Based Kalman Filter for Point-Line-Based Visual-Inertial Odometry
summary:
Mainstream Visual-inertial odometry 
(VIO) systems rely on point features for motion estimation and localization. However, their performance degrades in challenging scenarios. Moreover, the localization accuracy of multi-state constraint Kalman filter (MSCKF)-based VIO systems suffers from linearization errors associated with feature 3D coordinates and delayed measurement updates. To improve the performance of VIO in challenging scenes, we first propose a pose-only geometric representation for line features. Building on this, we develop POPL-KF, a Kalman filter-based VIO system that employs a pose-only geometric representation for both point and line features. POPL-KF mitigates linearization errors by explicitly eliminating both point and line feature coordinates from the measurement equations, while enabling immediate update of visual measurements. We also design a unified base-frames selection algorithm for both point and line features to ensure optimal constraints on camera poses within the pose-only measurement model. To further improve line feature quality, a line feature filter based on image grid segmentation and bidirectional optical flow consistency is proposed. Our system is evaluated on public datasets and real-world experiments, demonstrating that POPL-KF outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) filter-based methods (OpenVINS, PO-KF) and optimization-based methods (PL-VINS, EPLF-VINS), while maintaining real-time performance.
summary_zh: 主流的视觉惯性里程计(VIO)系统依赖于点特征进行运动估计和定位。然而，它们在具有挑战性的场景中性能会下降。此外，基于多状态约束卡尔曼滤波器(MSCKF)的VIO系统的定位精度会受到与特征3D坐标和延迟测量更新相关的线性化误差的影响。为了提高VIO在具有挑战性场景中的性能，我们首先提出了一种仅姿态的几何表示用于线特征。在此基础上，我们开发了POPL-KF，一个基于卡尔曼滤波器的VIO系统，它采用仅姿态的几何表示用于点和线特征。POPL-KF通过显式消除测量方程中的点和线特征坐标来减轻线性化误差，同时能够立即更新视觉测量。我们还为点和线特征设计了一种统一的基帧选择算法，以确保仅姿态测量模型中相机姿态的最佳约束。为了进一步提高线特征质量，提出了一种基于图像网格分割和双向光流一致性的线特征滤波器。我们的系统在公共数据集和真实世界实验中进行了评估，结果表明POPL-KF优于最先进的（SOTA）基于滤波的方法（OpenVINS、PO-KF）和基于优化的方法（PL-VINS、EPLF-VINS），同时保持了实时性能。
tldr: The paper presents POPL-KF, a novel Kalman filter-based VIO system that uses a pose-only geometric representation for both point and line features, improving accuracy and robustness in challenging environments compared to SOTA methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的基于卡尔曼滤波的VIO系统POPL-KF，该系统利用点和线的位姿几何表示，与现有技术相比，提高了在复杂环境中的准确性和鲁棒性。

title: MetaSSP: Enhancing Semi-supervised Implicit 3D Reconstruction through Meta-adaptive EMA and SDF-aware Pseudo-label Evaluation
summary: Implicit SDF-based methods for single-view 3D reconstruction achieve high-quality surfaces but require large labeled datasets, limiting their scalability. We propose MetaSSP, a novel semi-supervised framework that exploits abundant unlabeled images. Our approach introduces gradient-based parameter importance estimation to regularize adaptive EMA updates and an SDF-aware pseudo-label weighting mechanism combining augmentation consistency with SDF variance. Beginning with a 10% supervised warm-up, the unified pipeline jointly refines labeled and unlabeled data. On the Pix3D benchmark, our method reduces Chamfer Distance by approximately 20.61% and increases IoU by around 24.09% compared to existing semi-supervised baselines, setting a new state of the art.
summary_zh: 基于隐式SDF的单视角3D重建方法能够实现高质量的表面重建，但需要大量的标注数据集，限制了其可扩展性。我们提出MetaSSP，一种新颖的半监督框架，可以利用大量的无标注图像。我们的方法引入了基于梯度的参数重要性估计来规范自适应EMA更新，以及结合了增强一致性和SDF方差的SDF感知伪标签加权机制。从10%的监督预热开始，统一的流水线联合优化标注和无标注数据。在Pix3D基准测试中，与现有的半监督基线方法相比，我们的方法将倒角距离降低了约20.61%，并将IoU提高了约24.09%，刷新了当前最佳水平。
tldr: MetaSSP introduces a semi-supervised method for 3D reconstruction using implicit SDFs, achieving state-of-the-art results on Pix3D by leveraging unlabeled data with meta-adaptive EMA and SDF-aware pseudo-labeling.
tldr_zh: MetaSSP提出了一种半监督的隐式SDF三维重建方法，通过使用元自适应EMA和SDF感知伪标签对无标签数据进行利用，在Pix3D数据集上实现了最先进的结果。

title: MambaVF: State Space Model for Efficient Video Fusion
summary: Video fusion is a fundamental technique in various video processing tasks. However, existing video fusion methods heavily rely on optical flow estimation and feature warping, resulting in severe computational overhead and limited scalability. This paper presents MambaVF, an efficient video fusion framework based on state space models (SSMs) that performs temporal modeling without explicit motion estimation. First, by reformulating video fusion as a sequential state update process, MambaVF captures long-range temporal dependencies with linear complexity while significantly reducing computation and memory costs. Second, MambaVF proposes a lightweight SSM-based fusion module that replaces conventional flow-guided alignment via a spatio-temporal bidirectional scanning mechanism. This module enables efficient information aggregation across frames. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our MambaVF achieves state-of-the-art performance in multi-exposure, multi-focus, infrared-visible, and medical video fusion tasks. We highlight that MambaVF enjoys high efficiency, reducing up to 92.25% of parameters and 88.79% of computational FLOPs and a 2.1x speedup compared to existing methods. Project page: https://mambavf.github.io
summary_zh: 视频融合是各种视频处理任务中的一项基础技术。然而，现有的视频融合方法严重依赖光流估计和特征扭曲，导致严重的计算开销和有限的可扩展性。本文提出了一种高效的视频融合框架MambaVF，该框架基于状态空间模型(SSM)，可在没有显式运动估计的情况下执行时间建模。首先，通过将视频融合重新表述为一个连续的状态更新过程，MambaVF能够以线性复杂度捕获长距离时间依赖关系，同时显著降低计算和内存成本。其次，MambaVF提出了一种轻量级的基于SSM的融合模块，该模块通过时空双向扫描机制取代了传统的流引导对齐，从而能够高效地聚合跨帧信息。在多个基准测试上的大量实验表明，我们的MambaVF在多曝光、多焦点、红外-可见光和医学视频融合任务中均取得了最先进的性能。我们重点强调MambaVF具有很高的效率，与现有方法相比，参数量减少高达92.25%，计算量减少高达88.79%，速度提升2.1倍。项目主页：https://mambavf.github.io
tldr: MambaVF is a novel video fusion framework based on state space models that achieves state-of-the-art performance with significantly reduced computational overhead by replacing flow-guided alignment with a spatio-temporal bidirectional scanning mechanism. It shows impressive efficiency gains across several video fusion tasks.
tldr_zh: MambaVF是一个基于状态空间模型的新颖视频融合框架， 通过用时空双向扫描机制取代基于光流的对齐，实现了最先进的性能，并显著降低了计算开销。它在多个视频融合任务中表现出令人印象深刻的效率提升。

title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Dynamic Management of Structured Parallel Farm Skeletons on Serverless Platforms
summary: We present a framework for dynamic management of structured parallel processing skeletons on serverless platforms. Our goal is to bring HPC-like performance and resilience to serverless and continuum environments while preserving the programmability benefits of skeletons. As a first step, we focus on the well known Farm pattern and its implementation on the open-source OpenFaaS platform, treating autoscaling of the worker pool as a QoS-aware resource management problem. The framework couples a reusable farm template with a Gymnasium-based monitoring and control layer that exposes queue, timing, and QoS metrics to both reactive and learning-based controllers. We investigate the effectiveness of AI-driven dynamic scaling for managing the farm's degree of parallelism via the scalability of serverless functions on OpenFaaS. In particular, we discuss the autoscaling model and its training, and evaluate two reinforcement learning (RL) policies against a baseline of reactive management derived from a simple farm performance model. Our results show that AI-based management can better accommodate platform-specific limitations than purely model-based performance steering, improving QoS while maintaining efficient resource usage and stable scaling behaviour.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种在Serverless平台上动态管理结构化并行处理骨架的框架。我们的目标是在Serverless和连续统环境中实现类HPC的性能和弹性，同时保留骨架的可编程性优势。作为第一步，我们专注于著名的Farm模式及其在开源OpenFaaS平台上的实现，将工作池的自动扩展视为一个具有服务质量感知（QoS-aware）的资源管理问题。该框架将一个可重用的Farm模板与一个基于Gymnasium的监控和控制层相结合，该层向反应式和基于学习的控制器暴露队列、时间和QoS指标。我们通过OpenFaaS上Serverless函数的可扩展性，研究了AI驱动的动态扩展在管理Farm并行度方面的有效性。特别地，我们讨论了自动扩展模型及其训练，并针对一个源自简单Farm性能模型的反应式管理基线，评估了两种强化学习（RL）策略。我们的结果表明，与纯粹基于模型的性能调优相比，基于AI的管理能够更好地适应平台特定的限制，在保持高效资源利用率和稳定扩展行为的同时，提高服务质量。
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning framework for dynamically managing parallel 'Farm' skeletons on serverless platforms like OpenFaaS to improve performance, resilience, and resource usage compared to reactive methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个基于强化学习的框架，用于动态管理无服务器平台（如OpenFaaS）上的并行“Farm”骨架，从而与反应式方法相比，提高性能、弹性和资源利用率。

title: Constraint Manifold Exploration for Efficient Continuous Coverage Estimation
summary: Many automated manufacturing processes rely on industrial robot arms to move process-specific tools along workpiece surfaces. In applications like grinding, sanding, spray painting, or inspection, they need to cover a workpiece fully while keeping their tools perpendicular to its surface. While there are approaches to generate trajectories for these applications, there are no sufficient methods for analyzing the feasibility of full surface coverage. This work proposes a sampling-based approach for continuous coverage estimation that explores reachable surface regions in the configuration space. We define an extended ambient configuration space that allows for the representation of tool position and orientation constraints. A continuation-based approach is used to explore it using two different sampling strategies. A thorough evaluation across different kinematics and environments analyzes their runtime and efficiency. This validates our ability to accurately and efficiently calculate surface coverage for complex surfaces in complicated environments.
summary_zh: 许多自动化制造过程依赖于工业机器人手臂，将特定工艺的工具沿着工件表面移动。在诸如研磨、打磨、喷漆或检测等应用中，它们需要完全覆盖工件表面，同时保持工具与其表面垂直。虽然存在生成这些应用轨迹的方法，但尚无充分的手段来分析表面完全覆盖的可行性。本文提出了一种基于采样的连续覆盖估计方法，该方法探索构型空间中可达的表面区域。我们定义了一个扩展的环境构型空间，允许表示工具的位置和姿态约束。采用基于连续化的方法，使用两种不同的采样策略来探索该空间。通过对不同运动学和环境的全面评估，分析了它们的运行时间和效率。这验证了我们能够准确高效地计算复杂环境中复杂表面的表面覆盖率。
tldr: This paper introduces a sampling-based method to estimate continuous surface coverage for industrial robots, addressing the problem of feasibility analysis for full surface coverage in automated manufacturing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于采样的连续表面覆盖估计方法，用于工业机器人，解决了自动化制造中全面表面覆盖可行性分析的问题。

title: Feasible Static Workspace Optimization of Tendon Driven Continuum Robot based on Euclidean norm
summary: This paper focuses on the optimal design of a tendon-driven continuum robot (TDCR) based on its feasible static workspace (FSW). The TDCR under consideration is a two-segment robot driven by eight tendons, with four tendon actuators per segment. Tendon forces are treated as design variables, while the feasible static workspace (FSW) serves as the optimization objective. To determine the robot's feasible static workspace, a genetic algorithm optimization approach is employed to maximize a Euclidian norm of the TDCR's tip position over the workspace. During the simulations, the robot is subjected to external loads, including torques and forces. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in identifying optimal tendon forces to maximize the feasible static workspace, even under the influence of external forces and torques.
summary_zh: 本文着重研究基于可行静态工作空间(FSW)的腱驱动连续体机器人(TDCR)的优化设计。所考虑的TDCR是一个由八根腱驱动的两段式机器人，每段由四个腱驱动器控制。腱力被视为设计变量，而可行静态工作空间(FSW)则作为优化目标。为了确定机器人的可行静态工作空间，采用遗传算法优化方法，以最大化TDCR末端位置在工作空间内的欧几里得范数。在仿真过程中，机器人受到包括扭矩和力在内的外部载荷作用。结果表明，即使在外部力和扭矩的作用下，所提出的方法也能有效地识别出最佳腱力，从而最大限度地扩大可行静态工作空间。
tldr: This paper presents a method for optimizing the tendon forces of a tendon-driven continuum robot (TDCR) to maximize its feasible static workspace (FSW) using a genetic algorithm while considering external loads.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种优化肌腱驱动连续体机器人（TDCR）肌腱力的方法，利用遗传算法在考虑外部载荷的同时，最大化其可行静态工作空间（FSW）。

title: A Consistency-Improved LiDAR-Inertial Bundle Adjustment
summary: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) using 3D LiDAR has emerged as a cornerstone for autonomous navigation in robotics. While feature-based SLAM systems have achieved impressive results by leveraging edge and planar structures, they often suffer from the inconsistent estimator associated with feature parameterization and estimated covariance. In this work, we present a consistency-improved LiDAR-inertial bundle adjustment (BA) with tailored parameterization and estimator. First, we propose a stereographic-projection representation parameterizing the planar and edge features, and conduct a comprehensive observability analysis to support its integrability with consistent estimator. Second, we implement a LiDAR-inertial BA with Maximum a Posteriori (MAP) formulation and First-Estimate Jacobians (FEJ) to preserve the accurate estimated covariance and observability properties of the system. Last, we apply our proposed BA method to a LiDAR-inertial odometry.
summary_zh: 使用3D激光雷达的同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）已成为机器人自主导航的基石。尽管基于特征的SLAM系统通过利用边缘和平面结构取得了令人瞩目的成果，但它们通常受到与特征参数化和估计协方差相关的不一致估计器的影响。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种一致性改进的激光雷达惯性捆绑调整（BA），采用了定制的参数化和估计器。首先，我们提出了一种用立体投影表示参数化平面和边缘特征的方法，并进行了全面的可观测性分析，以支持其与一致性估计器的可集成性。其次，我们采用最大后验（MAP）公式和首次估计雅可比矩阵（FEJ）来实现激光雷达惯性BA，以保留系统精确的估计协方差和可观测性属性。最后，我们将提出的BA方法应用于激光雷达惯性里程计。
tldr: This paper introduces a consistency-improved LiDAR-inertial bundle adjustment method using stereographic-projection representation and First-Estimate Jacobians to address the inconsistent estimator problem in feature-based LiDAR SLAM.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种改进一致性的LiDAR-惯性束调整方法，该方法使用立体投影表示和First-Estimate Jacobians来解决基于特征的LiDAR SLAM中不一致的估计器问题。

title: Bioinspired Kirigami Capsule Robot for Minimally Invasive Gastrointestinal Biopsy
summary: Wireless capsule endoscopy (WCE) has transformed gastrointestinal (GI) diagnostics by enabling noninvasive visualization of the digestive tract, yet its diagnostic yield remains constrained by the absence of biopsy capability, as histological analysis is still the gold standard for confirming disease. Conventional biopsy using forceps, needles, or rotating blades is invasive, limited in reach, and carries risks of perforation or mucosal trauma, while fluid- or microbiota-sampling capsules cannot provide structured tissue for pathology, leaving a critical gap in swallowable biopsy solutions. Here we present the Kiri-Capsule, a kirigami-inspired capsule robot that integrates deployable PI-film flaps actuated by a compact dual-cam mechanism to achieve minimally invasive and repeatable tissue collection. The kirigami surface remains flat during locomotion but transforms into sharp protrusions upon cam-driven stretching, enabling controlled penetration followed by rotary scraping, with specimens retained in internal fan-shaped cavities. Bench tests confirmed that PI films exhibit a Young's modulus of approximately 20 MPa and stable deployment angles (about 34$^\circ$ at 15% strain), while ex vivo porcine studies demonstrated shallow penetration depths (median $\sim$0.61 mm, range 0.46--0.66 mm) and biopsy yields comparable to standard forceps (mean $\sim$10.9 mg for stomach and $\sim$18.9 mg for intestine), with forces within safe ranges reported for GI biopsy. These findings demonstrate that the Kiri-Capsule bridges passive imaging and functional biopsy, providing a swallowable, depth-controlled, and histology-ready solution that advances capsule-based diagnostics toward safe and effective clinical application.
summary_zh: 无线胶囊内窥镜(WCE)通过实现消化道的无创可视化，革新了胃肠道(GI)诊断技术，但由于缺乏活检能力，其诊断率仍然受到限制，组织学分析仍然是确认疾病的金标准。 传统的利用钳子、针头或旋转刀片的活检方法具有侵入性，到达范围有限，并存在穿孔或黏膜损伤的风险，而液体或微生物群采样胶囊无法提供用于病理学的结构化组织，这在可吞咽活检解决方案中留下了一个关键空白。 在此，我们介绍了 Kiri-Capsule，一种受剪纸启发设计的胶囊机器人，它集成了可展开的 PI 薄膜翼片，由紧凑型双凸轮机构驱动，以实现微创且可重复的组织采集。 剪纸表面在运动过程中保持平坦，但在凸轮驱动的拉伸下转变为锋利的突起，从而实现可控的穿透，随后进行旋转刮取，并将样本保留在内部扇形腔体内。 台架试验证实，PI 薄膜的杨氏模量约为 20 MPa，且具有稳定的展开角度（在 15% 应变下约为 34$^\circ$），而离体猪研究表明其穿透深度较浅（中位数$\sim$0.61 mm，范围 0.46--0.66 mm），活检产量与标准活检钳相当（胃的平均值$\sim$10.9 mg，肠的平均值$\sim$18.9 mg），且作用力在胃肠道活检报告的安全范围内。 这些发现表明，Kiri-Capsule 连接了被动成像和功能性活检，提供了一种可吞咽、深度可控且可用于组织学分析的解决方案，从而推动了基于胶囊的诊断技术朝着安全有效的临床应用方向发展。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel kirigami-inspired capsule robot (Kiri-Capsule) for minimally invasive gastrointestinal biopsy, offering a swallowable solution for tissue collection comparable to standard forceps but with depth control.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新型的基于剪纸灵感的胶囊机器人（Kiri-Capsule），用于微创胃肠活检，提供了一种可吞咽的组织收集解决方案，该方案与标准活检钳相当，但可以控制深度。

title: Orientation-Robust Latent Motion Trajectory Learning for Annotation-free Cardiac Phase Detection in Fetal Echocardiography
summary: Fetal echocardiography is essential for detecting congenital heart disease (CHD), facilitating pregnancy management, optimized delivery planning, and timely postnatal interventions. Among standard imaging planes, the four-chamber (4CH) view provides comprehensive information for CHD diagnosis, where clinicians carefully inspect the end-diastolic (ED) and end-systolic (ES) phases to evaluate cardiac structure and motion. Automated detection of these cardiac phases is thus a critical component toward fully automated CHD analysis. Yet, in the absence of fetal electrocardiography (ECG), manual identification of ED and ES frames remains a labor-intensive bottleneck. We present ORBIT (Orientation-Robust Beat Inference from Trajectories), a self-supervised framework that identifies cardiac phases without manual annotations under various fetal heart orientation. ORBIT employs registration as self-supervision task and learns a latent motion trajectory of cardiac deformation, whose turning points capture transitions between cardiac relaxation and contraction, enabling accurate and orientation-robust localization of ED and ES frames across diverse fetal positions. Trained exclusively on normal fetal echocardiography videos, ORBIT achieves consistent performance on both normal (MAE = 1.9 frames for ED and 1.6 for ES) and CHD cases (MAE = 2.4 frames for ED and 2.1 for ES), outperforming existing annotation-free approaches constrained by fixed orientation assumptions. These results highlight the potential of ORBIT to facilitate robust cardiac phase detection directly from 4CH fetal echocardiography.
summary_zh: 胎儿超声心动图对于检测先天性心脏病（CHD）至关重要，有助于妊娠管理、优化分娩计划以及及时进行产后干预。在标准成像切面中，四腔心（4CH）切面为CHD诊断提供全面的信息，临床医生会仔细检查舒张末期（ED）和收缩末期（ES）阶段，以评估心脏结构和运动。因此，自动检测这些心脏相位是实现全自动CHD分析的关键组成部分。然而，在缺乏胎儿心电图（ECG）的情况下，手动识别ED和ES帧仍然是一项劳动密集型的瓶颈。我们提出ORBIT（基于轨迹的方向鲁棒搏动推断），这是一个自监督框架，可在各种胎儿心脏方向下识别心脏相位，而无需手动标注。ORBIT采用配准作为自监督任务，并学习心脏变形的潜在运动轨迹，其转折点捕捉心脏松弛和收缩之间的过渡，从而能够在不同的胎儿位置实现ED和ES帧的精确且方向鲁棒的定位。ORBIT仅在正常的胎儿超声心动图视频上进行训练，在正常（ED的MAE = 1.9帧，ES的MAE = 1.6帧）和CHD病例（ED的MAE = 2.4帧，ES的MAE = 2.1帧）上均实现了稳定性能，优于现有受固定方向假设限制的无标注方法。这些结果突显了ORBIT直接从4CH胎儿超声心动图促进稳健的心脏相位检测的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces ORBIT, a self-supervised framework for annotation-free cardiac phase detection in fetal echocardiography, achieving orientation-robust and accurate localization of end-diastolic and end-systolic frames for both normal and CHD cases.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为ORBIT的自监督框架，用于在胎儿超声心动图中进行免注释的心脏相位检测。该框架实现了对心脏舒张末期和收缩末期帧的 Orientierungs-Robust 及精确定位，适用于正常和先天性心脏病 (CHD) 病例。

title: Clinical-Prior Guided Multi-Modal Learning with Latent Attention Pooling for Gait-Based Scoliosis Screening
summary: Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis (AIS) is a prevalent spinal deformity whose progression can be mitigated through early detection. Conventional screening methods are often subjective, difficult to scale, and reliant on specialized clinical expertise. Video-based gait analysis offers a promising alternative, but current datasets and methods frequently suffer from data leakage, where performance is inflated by repeated clips from the same individual, or employ oversimplified models that lack clinical interpretability. To address these limitations, we introduce ScoliGait, a new benchmark dataset comprising 1,572 gait video clips for training and 300 fully independent clips for testing. Each clip is annotated with radiographic Cobb angles and descriptive text based on clinical kinematic priors. We propose a multi-modal framework that integrates a clinical-prior-guided kinematic knowledge map for interpretable feature representation, alongside a latent attention pooling mechanism to fuse video, text, and knowledge map modalities. Our method establishes a new state-of-the-art, demonstrating a significant performance gap on a realistic, non-repeating subject benchmark. Our approach establishes a new state of the art, showing a significant performance gain on a realistic, subject-independent benchmark. This work provides a robust, interpretable, and clinically grounded foundation for scalable, non-invasive AIS assessment.
summary_zh: 青少年特发性脊柱侧弯 (AIS) 是一种常见的脊柱畸形，通过早期检测可以减轻其进展。传统的筛查方法通常具有主观性、难以规模化，且依赖于专业的临床知识。基于视频的步态分析提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但当前的数据集和方法通常存在数据泄露问题，同一受试者的重复片段会虚增性能，或者采用过于简化的模型，缺乏临床可解释性。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入 ScoliGait，这是一个新的benchmark数据集，包含 1,572 个用于训练的步态视频片段和 300 个完全独立的用于测试的片段。每个片段都标注了放射科 Cobb 角和基于临床运动学先验的描述性文本。我们提出了一种多模态框架，该框架集成了临床先验指导的运动学知识图谱以实现可解释的特征表示，以及一个潜在注意力池化机制来融合视频、文本和知识图谱模态。我们的方法建立了一个新的最先进水平，在真实的、非重复受试者的基准测试中表现出显著的性能提升。这项工作为可扩展的、非侵入性的 AIS 评估提供了稳健、可解释且具有临床基础的基础。
tldr: The paper introduces ScoliGait, a new benchmark dataset and multi-modal framework for gait-based scoliosis screening, addressing data leakage issues and improving clinical interpretability with a clinical-prior-guided knowledge map.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ScoliGait，一个新的基于步态的脊柱侧弯筛查基准数据集和多模态框架，通过临床先验引导的知识图谱解决数据泄漏问题并提高临床可解释性。

title: A Fast and Generalizable Fourier Neural Operator-Based Surrogate for Melt-Pool Prediction in Laser Processing
summary: High-fidelity simulations of laser welding capture complex thermo-fluid phenomena, including phase change, free-surface deformation, and keyhole dynamics, however their computational cost limits large-scale process exploration and real-time use. In this work we present the Laser Processing Fourier Neural Operator (LP-FNO), a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) based surrogate model that learns the parametric solution operator of various laser processes from multiphysics simulations generated with FLOW-3D WELD (registered trademark). Through a novel approach of reformulating the transient problem in the moving laser frame and applying temporal averaging, the system results in a quasi-steady state setting suitable for operator learning, even in the keyhole welding regime. The proposed LP-FNO maps process parameters to three-dimensional temperature fields and melt-pool boundaries across a broad process window spanning conduction and keyhole regimes using the non-dimensional normalized enthalpy formulation. The model achieves temperature prediction errors on the order of 1% and intersection-over-union scores for melt-pool segmentation over 0.9. We demonstrate that a LP-FNO model trained on coarse-resolution data can be evaluated on finer grids, yielding accurate super-resolved predictions in mesh-converged conduction regimes, whereas discrepancies in keyhole regimes reflect unresolved dynamics in the coarse-mesh training data. These results indicate that the LP-FNO provides an efficient surrogate modeling framework for laser welding, enabling prediction of full three-dimensional fields and phase interfaces over wide parameter ranges in just tens of milliseconds, up to a hundred thousand times faster than traditional Finite Volume multi-physics software.
summary_zh: 激光焊接的高保真模拟能够捕捉复杂的热流体现象，包括相变、自由表面变形和匙孔动力学，但其计算成本限制了大规模工艺探索和实时应用。本文提出了一种激光加工傅里叶神经算子（LP-FNO），这是一种基于傅里叶神经算子（FNO）的替代模型，它从用FLOW-3D WELD（注册商标）生成的多物理场模拟中学习各种激光工艺的参数化解算子。通过一种新颖的方法，在移动激光坐标系中重新表述瞬态问题并应用时间平均，该系统产生了一种适用于算子学习的准稳态设置，即使在匙孔焊接状态下也是如此。所提出的LP-FNO使用无量纲归一化焓公式，将工艺参数映射到跨越传导和匙孔状态的广泛工艺窗口中的三维温度场和熔池边界。该模型实现的温度预测误差约为1%，熔池分割的交并比得分超过0.9。我们证明了在粗分辨率数据上训练的LP-FNO模型可以在更精细的网格上进行评估，从而在网格收敛的传导状态下产生准确的超分辨率预测，而在匙孔状态下的差异反映了粗网格训练数据中未解析的动力学。这些结果表明，LP-FNO为激光焊接提供了一个高效的替代建模框架，能够在短短几十毫秒内预测宽参数范围内的完整三维场和相界面，比传统的有限体积多物理场软件快达十万倍。
tldr: This paper introduces a Fourier Neural Operator (LP-FNO) based surrogate model for fast and accurate melt-pool prediction in laser welding, achieving significant speedups compared to traditional simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于傅里叶神经算子（LP-FNO）的替代模型，用于快速准确地预测激光焊接中的熔池，与传统仿真相比实现了显著的加速。

title: A Hybrid Data-Driven Algorithm for Real-Time Friction Force Estimation in Hydraulic Cylinders
summary: Hydraulic systems are widely utilized in industrial applications due to their high force generation, precise control, and ability to function in harsh environments. Hydraulic cylinders, as actuators in these systems, apply force and position through the displacement of hydraulic fluid, but their operation is significantly influenced by friction force. Achieving precision in hydraulic cylinders requires an accurate friction model under various operating conditions. Existing analytical models, often derived from experimental tests, necessitate the identification or estimation of influencing factors but are limited in adaptability and computational efficiency. This research introduces a data-driven, hybrid algorithm based on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks and Random Forests for nonlinear friction force estimation. The algorithm effectively combines feature detection and estimation processes using training data acquired from an experimental hydraulic test setup. It achieves a consistent and stable model error of less than 10% across diverse operating conditions and external load variations, ensuring robust performance in complex situations. The computational cost of the algorithm is 1.51 milliseconds per estimation, making it suitable for real-time applications. The proposed method addresses the limitations of analytical models by delivering high precision and computational efficiency. The algorithm's performance is validated through detailed analysis and experimental results, including direct comparisons with the LuGre model. The comparison highlights that while the LuGre model offers a theoretical foundation for friction modeling, its performance is limited by its inability to dynamically adjust to varying operational conditions of the hydraulic cylinder, further emphasizing the advantages of the proposed hybrid approach in real-time applications.
summary_zh: 液压系统因其高力生成、精确控制以及在恶劣环境中工作的能力而被广泛应用于工业领域。液压缸作为这些系统中的执行器，通过液压流体的位移来施加力和定位，但其运行受摩擦力的显著影响。在液压缸中实现精度需要一种在各种工况下准确的摩擦模型。现有的分析模型通常从实验测试中推导出，需要识别或估计影响因素，但在适应性和计算效率方面受到限制。本研究引入了一种基于长短期记忆（LSTM）网络和随机森林的用于非线性摩擦力估计的数据驱动混合算法。该算法有效地结合了特征检测和估计过程，利用从实验性液压测试装置获取的训练数据。它在各种工况和外部载荷变化下实现了低于10%的一致且稳定的模型误差，确保了在复杂情况下的鲁棒性能。该算法的计算成本为每次估计1.51毫秒，使其适用于实时应用。所提出的方法通过提供高精度和计算效率，解决了分析模型的局限性。该算法的性能通过详细分析和实验结果进行验证，包括与LuGre模型的直接比较。比较结果表明，虽然LuGre模型为摩擦建模提供了理论基础，但其性能受到无法动态调整液压缸各种工况的限制，进一步强调了所提出的混合方法在实时应用中的优势。
tldr: This paper introduces a hybrid LSTM and Random Forest data-driven algorithm for real-time friction force estimation in hydraulic cylinders, demonstrating improved accuracy and computational efficiency compared to the LuGre model.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合LSTM和随机森林的数据驱动算法，用于液压缸中的实时摩擦力估计，与LuGre模型相比，该算法具有更高的精度和计算效率。

title: Optimization of an Augmented R-CUBE mechanism for Cervical Surgery
summary: In some surgical operations targeting the spine, it is required to drill cavities in the vertebrae for the insertion of pedicle screws. A new mechanical architecture is proposed for this application. It is based on an augmented version of the full translational R-CUBE mechanism, with improved linkages to implement additional rotational motion. Using this concept, a mechanism presented with a 3T2R motion that is required for the manipulation of the surgical drill. It is mainly composed three stages: one translational, one transmitting and one rotational. Their respective kinematic and velocity models are separately derived, then combined. Based on the drilling trajectories obtained from a real patient case, the mechanism is optimized for generating the highest kinematic performances.
summary_zh: 在一些针对脊柱的外科手术中，需要在椎骨上钻孔以便植入椎弓根螺钉。针对此应用，本文提出了一种新的机械结构。该结构基于完整的平移R-CUBE机构的增强版本，并改进了连杆机构以实现额外的旋转运动。基于此概念，提出了一种具有3T2R运动机构，该运动对于外科手术钻的操作至关重要。该机构主要由三个阶段组成：一个是平移阶段，一个是传递阶段，一个是旋转阶段。分别推导了它们各自的运动学和速度模型，然后将其组合。基于从真实患者病例中获得的钻孔轨迹，对该机构进行了优化，以产生最高的运动学性能。
tldr: The paper proposes an augmented R-CUBE mechanism for cervical surgery, specifically for drilling cavities in vertebrae. It focuses on kinematic modeling and optimization for real patient case trajectories.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于颈椎手术的增强型R-CUBE机构，专门用于在椎骨上钻孔。它侧重于针对真实患者病例轨迹的运动学建模和优化。

title: A novel Integrated Motion Tracking Device (IMTD) for Objective Laparoscopic Training Assessment: Development and Validation
summary: This paper presents a novel, compact four-degree-of-freedom motion-tracking device (IMTD) designed for training and evaluation in laparoscopic surgery. The device's kinematics, mechanical design, instrumentation, and prototypes are developed and presented to meet the specific requirements of laparoscopic training context, including movement around a fixed center of motion and seamless integration into standard box trainers. The system IMTD's tracking accuracy and reliability are compared to a motion capture system (MoCap), assessing its ability to capture both angular and translational motions of surgical instruments. The study then focuses on key performance parameters including precision, fluidity, speed, and overall motion efficiency. The results highlight the system's effectiveness in tracking surgical gestures, providing valuable insights into its potential as a tool for training and performance evaluation in minimally invasive surgery. Additionally, IMTD's low cost and integrated design allow for easy integration and implementation in training rooms, offering a practical and accessible solution for general use. By offering objective, real-time feedback, the system can significantly contribute to improving surgical skills and shortening the learning curve for novice students, while also providing a foundation for future development of gesture scoring algorithms and standardized training protocols.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新型紧凑型四自由度运动跟踪装置（IMTD），专为腹腔镜手术的训练和评估而设计。针对腹腔镜训练环境的特殊要求，包括围绕固定运动中心的运动以及与标准箱式训练器的无缝集成，本文对该装置的运动学、机械设计、仪器仪表和原型进行了开发和展示。将该IMTD系统的跟踪精度和可靠性与运动捕捉系统（MoCap）进行比较，评估其捕捉手术器械角度和线性运动的能力。随后，研究重点关注关键性能参数，包括精度、流畅性、速度和整体运动效率。结果表明，该系统能有效跟踪手术动作，为将其作为微创手术训练和性能评估工具提供了有价值的见解。此外，IMTD的低成本和集成设计使其易于集成和部署在训练室中，为通用提供了一种实用且易于使用的解决方案。通过提供客观的实时反馈，该系统可以显著提高手术技能，缩短新手学生的学习曲线，同时为未来手势评分算法和标准化培训协议的开发奠定基础。
tldr: The paper presents a novel integrated motion tracking device (IMTD) for objective assessment in laparoscopic surgical training, demonstrating its accuracy and potential for improving surgical skills through real-time feedback.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了一种新型集成运动跟踪设备 (IMTD)，用于客观评估腹腔镜手术培训，展示了其准确性以及通过实时反馈提高手术技能的潜力。

title: Primary Experimental Feedback on a Co-manipulated Robotic System for Assisted Cervical Surgery
summary: Robotic-assisted surgery has emerged as a promising approach to improve surgical ergonomics, precision, and workflow efficiency, particularly in complex procedures such as cervical spine surgery. In this study, we evaluate the performance of a collaborative robotic system designed to assist surgeons in drilling tasks by assessing its accuracy in executing predefined trajectories. A total of 14 drillings were performed by eight experienced cervical surgeons, utilizing a robotic-assisted setup aimed at ensuring stability and alignment. The primary objective of this study is to quantify the deviations in the position and orientation of the drilling tool relative to the planned trajectory, providing insights into the system's reliability and potential impact on clinical outcomes. While the primary function of robotic assistance in surgery is to enhance surgeon comfort and procedural guidance rather than solely optimizing precision, understanding the system's accuracy remains crucial for its effective integration into surgical practices part of this primary experimental feedback, the study offers an in-depth analysis of the co-manipulated robotic system's performance, focusing on the experimental setup and error evaluation methods. The findings of this study will contribute to the ongoing development of robotic-assisted cervical surgery, highlighting both its advantages and areas for improvement in achieving safer and more efficient surgical workflows
summary_zh: 机器人辅助手术已成为一种有前景的方法，可以提高手术的人体工程学、精确度和工作流程效率，尤其是在颈椎手术等复杂手术中。在本研究中，我们评估了一种协作机器人系统的性能，该系统旨在通过评估其执行预定义轨迹的准确性来辅助外科医生进行钻孔任务。共有八位经验丰富的颈椎外科医生进行了14次钻孔，他们使用了一种机器人辅助装置，旨在确保稳定性和对齐。本研究的主要目标是量化钻孔工具相对于计划轨迹的位置和方向的偏差，从而深入了解系统的可靠性以及对临床结果的潜在影响。虽然机器人辅助手术的主要功能是增强外科医生的舒适度和程序指导，而不是仅仅优化精度，但了解系统的准确性对于其有效整合到外科实践中仍然至关重要。作为主要实验反馈的一部分，该研究提供了对共操控机器人系统性能的深入分析，重点关注实验设置和误差评估方法。本研究的结果将有助于机器人辅助颈椎手术的持续发展，突出其优势以及在实现更安全、更高效的手术工作流程方面需要改进的领域。
tldr: This study evaluates the accuracy of a co-manipulated robotic system assisting surgeons in cervical spine drilling tasks, focusing on trajectory deviation to assess system reliability and potential clinical impact.
tldr_zh: 该研究评估了一种协助外科医生进行颈椎钻孔操作的协同机器人系统的准确性，重点关注轨迹偏差，以评估系统的可靠性和潜在的临床影响。

title: Location-Aware Dispersion on Anonymous Graphs
summary:
The well-studied DISPERSION problem is a fundamental coordination problem in distributed robotics, where a set of mobile robots must relocate so that each occupies a distinct node of a network. DISPERSION assumes that a robot can settle at any node as long as no other robot settles on that node. In this work, we introduce LOCATION-AWARE DISPERSION, a novel generalization of DISPERSION that incorporates location awareness: Let $G = (V, E)$ be an anonymous, connected, undirected graph with $n = |V|$ nodes, each labeled with a color $\sf{col}(v) \in C = \{c_1, \dots, c_t\}, t\leq n$. A set $R = \{r_1, \dots, r_k\}$ of $k \leq n$ mobile robots is given, where each robot $r_i$ has an associated color $\mathsf{col}(r_i) \in C$. Initially placed arbitrarily on the graph, the goal is to relocate the robots so that each occupies a distinct node of the same color. When $|C|=1$, LOCATION-AWARE DISPERSION reduces to DISPERSION. There is a solution to DISPERSION in graphs with any $k\leq n$ without knowing $k,n$.
  Like DISPERSION, the goal is to solve LOCATION-AWARE DISPERSION minimizing both time and memory requirement at each agent. We develop several deterministic algorithms with guaranteed bounds on both time and memory requirement. We also give an impossibility and a lower bound for any deterministic algorithm for LOCATION-AWARE DISPERSION. To the best of our knowledge, the presented results collectively establish the algorithmic feasibility of LOCATION-AWARE DISPERSION in anonymous networks and also highlight the challenges on getting an efficient solution compared to the solutions for DISPERSION.
summary_zh:
分散问题（DISPERSION）是分布式机器人领域中一个被广泛研究的基础协调问题，其中一组移动机器人必须重新定位，使得每个机器人占据网络中一个不同的节点。分散问题假设机器人可以停留在任何节点上，只要没有其他机器人停留在该节点上。 在本工作中，我们引入了位置感知分散问题（LOCATION-AWARE DISPERSION），这是分散问题的一种新颖推广，它结合了位置感知能力：设 $G = (V, E)$ 是一个匿名、连通、无向图，其中 $n = |V|$ 个节点，每个节点被标记为一种颜色 $\sf{col}(v) \in C = \{c_1, \dots, c_t\}, t\leq n$。给定一组 $R = \{r_1, \dots, r_k\}$ 共 $k \leq n$ 个移动机器人，其中每个机器人 $r_i$ 具有相关联的颜色 $\mathsf{col}(r_i) \in C$。初始时，机器人任意放置在图上，目标是重新定位这些机器人，使得每个机器人占据一个相同颜色的不同节点。当 $|C|=1$ 时，位置感知分散问题退化为分散问题。在任何 $k\leq n$ 的图上，分散问题都存在解，且无需知道 $k,n$。
