  与分散问题类似，位置感知分散问题的目标是在最小化每个代理所需的时间和存储需求的前提下求解。我们开发了几种具有时间和存储需求保证界限的确定性算法。 我们还给出了位置感知分散问题的任何确定性算法的不可能性和下界。据我们所知，目前的结果共同证明了在匿名网络中位置感知分散问题的算法可行性，并且突出了相对于分散问题的现有解决方案而言，获得有效解决方案所面临的挑战。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel generalization of the DISPERSION problem called LOCATION-AWARE DISPERSION, where robots with distinct colors must relocate to distinct nodes of the same color on an anonymous graph, and provides algorithms, impossibility results, and lower bounds.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的DISPERSION问题泛化，称为LOCATION-AWARE DISPERSION，其中具有不同颜色的机器人必须重新定位到匿名图上相同颜色的不同节点，并提供了算法、否定性结果和下界。

title: Unsupervised MR-US Multimodal Image Registration with Multilevel Correlation Pyramidal Optimization
summary: Surgical navigation based on multimodal image registration has played a significant role in providing intraoperative guidance to surgeons by showing the relative position of the target area to critical anatomical structures during surgery. However, due to the differences between multimodal images and intraoperative image deformation caused by tissue displacement and removal during the surgery, effective registration of preoperative and intraoperative multimodal images faces significant challenges. To address the multimodal image registration challenges in Learn2Reg 2025, an unsupervised multimodal medical image registration method based on Multilevel Correlation Pyramidal Optimization (MCPO) is designed to solve these problems. First, the features of each modality are extracted based on the modality independent neighborhood descriptor, and the multimodal images is mapped to the feature space. Second, a multilevel pyramidal fusion optimization mechanism is designed to achieve global optimization and local detail complementation of the displacement field through dense correlation analysis and weight-balanced coupled convex optimization for input features at different scales. Our method focuses on the ReMIND2Reg task in Learn2Reg 2025. Based on the results, our method achieved the first place in the validation phase and test phase of ReMIND2Reg. The MCPO is also validated on the Resect dataset, achieving an average TRE of 1.798 mm. This demonstrates the broad applicability of our method in preoperative-to-intraoperative image registration. The code is available at https://github.com/wjiazheng/MCPO.
summary_zh: 基于多模态图像配准的手术导航在术中为外科医生提供指导方面发挥了重要作用，它能够显示目标区域与关键解剖结构在手术中的相对位置。然而，由于多模态图像之间的差异以及手术过程中组织移位和切除造成的术中图像形变，术前和术中多模态图像的有效配准面临着重大挑战。 为解决Learn2Reg 2025中多模态图像配准的挑战，我们设计了一种基于多层相关金字塔优化的（MCPO）的无监督多模态医学图像配准方法来解决这些问题。首先，基于模态独立的邻域描述符提取每种模态的特征，并将多模态图像映射到特征空间。其次，设计了一种多层金字塔融合优化机制，通过对不同尺度输入特征进行密集相关性分析和权重平衡的耦合凸优化，实现位移场的全局优化和局部细节补充。我们的方法主要关注Learn2Reg 2025中的ReMIND2Reg任务。根据结果显示，我们的方法在ReMIND2Reg的验证阶段和测试阶段均取得了第一名。MCPO还在Resect数据集上进行了验证，实现了1.798毫米的平均目标配准误差（TRE）。这证明了我们的方法在术前到术中图像配准中的广泛适用性。代码可在https://github.com/wjiazheng/MCPO获取。
tldr: The paper introduces an unsupervised multimodal medical image registration method called Multilevel Correlation Pyramidal Optimization (MCPO) that placed first in the Learn2Reg 2025 ReMIND2Reg challenge, demonstrating strong performance in preoperative-to-intraoperative image registration.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为多级相关金字塔优化（MCPO）的无监督多模态医学图像配准方法，该方法在Learn2Reg 2025 ReMIND2Reg挑战赛中名列第一，展示了术前到术中图像配准的强大性能。

title: Topography scanning as a part of process monitoring in power cable insulation process
summary: We present a novel topography scanning system developed to XLPE cable core monitoring. Modern measurement technology is utilized together with embedded high-performance computing to build a complete and detailed 3D surface map of the insulated core. Cross sectional and lengthwise geometry errors are studied, and melt homogeneity is identified as one major factor for these errors. A surface defect detection system has been developed utilizing deep learning methods. Our results show that convolutional neural networks are well suited for real time analysis of surface measurement data enabling reliable detection of surface defects.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新型地形扫描系统，用于XLPE电缆芯线监测。该系统利用现代测量技术与嵌入式高性能计算相结合，构建绝缘芯线的完整而详细的3D表面图。我们研究了横截面和长度方向上的几何误差，并将熔体均质性确定为这些误差的主要因素之一。同时，开发了一种利用深度学习方法的表面缺陷检测系统。我们的结果表明，卷积神经网络非常适合表面测量数据的实时分析，从而能够可靠地检测表面缺陷。
tldr: This paper introduces a topography scanning system for real-time defect detection in XLPE cable core insulation using deep learning, specifically convolutional neural networks. The system aims to build detailed 3D surface maps and identify geometry errors and surface defects.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种地形扫描系统，该系统使用深度学习（特别是卷积神经网络）实时检测XLPE电缆芯绝缘层中的缺陷。该系统旨在构建详细的3D表面图，并识别几何误差和表面缺陷。

title: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos
summary: Being able to simulate the outcomes of actions in varied environments will revolutionize the development of generalist agents at scale. However, modeling these world dynamics, especially for dexterous robotics tasks, poses significant challenges due to limited data coverage and scarce action labels. As an endeavor towards this end, we introduce DreamDojo, a foundation world model that learns diverse interactions and dexterous controls from 44k hours of egocentric human videos. Our data mixture represents the largest video dataset to date for world model pretraining, spanning a wide range of daily scenarios with diverse objects and skills. To address the scarcity of action labels, we introduce continuous latent actions as unified proxy actions, enhancing interaction knowledge transfer from unlabeled videos. After post-training on small-scale target robot data, DreamDojo demonstrates a strong understanding of physics and precise action controllability. We also devise a distillation pipeline that accelerates DreamDojo to a real-time speed of 10.81 FPS and further improves context consistency. Our work enables several important applications based on generative world models, including live teleoperation, policy evaluation, and model-based planning. Systematic evaluation on multiple challenging out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks verifies the significance of our method for simulating open-world, contact-rich tasks, paving the way for general-purpose robot world models.
summary_zh: 能够在各种环境中模拟动作的结果将会彻底改变通用智能体的大规模发展。然而，对这些世界动态进行建模，特别是对于灵巧机器人任务而言，由于有限的数据覆盖范围和稀缺的动作标签，带来了巨大的挑战。为了实现这一目标，我们引入了DreamDojo，一个基础世界模型，它从4.4万小时的以自我为中心的视角的人类视频中学习各种交互和灵巧控制。我们的数据混合代表了迄今为止用于世界模型预训练的最大视频数据集，涵盖了具有各种物体和技能的广泛的日常场景。为了解决动作标签的稀缺性，我们引入了连续潜在动作作为统一的代理动作，从而增强了从无标签视频中获得的交互知识传递。在小规模目标机器人数据上进行后训练后，DreamDojo展现出对物理学的深刻理解和精确的动作可控性。我们还设计了一个蒸馏流程，将DreamDojo加速到10.81 FPS的实时速度，并进一步提高了上下文一致性。我们的工作实现了基于生成式世界模型的若干重要应用，包括实时遥操作、策略评估和基于模型的规划。在多个具有挑战性的分布外（OOD）基准上的系统评估验证了我们方法在模拟开放世界、富接触任务中的重要性，为通用机器人世界模型铺平了道路。
tldr: DreamDojo introduces a foundation world model for robotics trained on a massive dataset of human videos, enabling robot control and planning via learning diverse interactions and dexterous control.
tldr_zh: DreamDojo 提出了一个机器人基础世界模型，该模型通过大规模人类视频训练，通过学习多样化的交互和灵巧的控制，从而实现机器人控制与规划。

title: LCLA: Language-Conditioned Latent Alignment for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: We propose LCLA (Language-Conditioned Latent Alignment), a framework for vision-language navigation that learns modular perception-action interfaces by aligning sensory observations to a latent representation of an expert policy. The expert is first trained with privileged state information, inducing a latent space sufficient for control, after which its latent interface and action head are frozen. A lightweight adapter is then trained to map raw visual-language observations, via a frozen vision-language model, into the expert's latent space, reducing the problem of visuomotor learning to supervised latent alignment rather than end-to-end policy optimization. This decoupling enforces a stable contract between perception and control, enabling expert behavior to be reused across sensing modalities and environmental variations. We instantiate LCLA and evaluate it on a vision-language indoor navigation task, where aligned latent spaces yield strong in-distribution performance and robust zero-shot generalization to unseen environments, lighting conditions, and viewpoints while remaining lightweight at inference time.
summary_zh: 我们提出LCLA（语言条件潜在对齐），一个用于视觉-语言导航的框架，通过将感觉观测与专家策略的潜在表示对齐，来学习模块化的感知-动作接口。首先，专家利用特权状态信息进行训练，从而诱导出一个足以进行控制的潜在空间，之后其潜在接口和动作头被冻结。然后，训练一个轻量级适配器，通过一个冻结的视觉-语言模型，将原始的视觉-语言观测映射到专家的潜在空间中，从而将视觉运动学习的问题简化为监督潜在对齐，而不是端到端的策略优化。这种解耦在感知和控制之间建立了一个稳定的契约，使得专家行为能够在不同的感知模式和环境变化中被重用。我们实例化了LCLA，并在一个视觉-语言室内导航任务上对其进行评估，结果表明，对齐的潜在空间产生了强大的分布内性能，以及对未见环境、光照条件和视点的鲁棒零样本泛化能力，同时在推理时保持轻量级。
tldr: The paper introduces LCLA, a vision-language navigation framework that aligns sensory observations with a latent representation of an expert policy, improving generalization and robustness in unseen environments by decoupling perception and control.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为LCLA的视觉语言导航框架，该框架通过将感官观察与专家策略的潜在表示对齐，并通过解耦感知和控制来提高在未知环境中的泛化和鲁棒性。

title: MedMO: Grounding and Understanding Multimodal Large Language Model for Medical Images
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have rapidly advanced, yet their adoption in medicine remains limited by gaps in domain coverage, modality alignment, and grounded reasoning. In this work, we introduce MedMO, a medical foundation model built upon a generalized MLLM architecture and trained exclusively on large-scale, domain-specific data. MedMO follows a multi-stage training recipe: (i) cross-modal pretraining to align heterogeneous visual encoders with a medical language backbone; (ii) instruction tuning on multi-task supervision that spans captioning, VQA, report generation, retrieval, and grounded disease localization with bounding boxes; and (iii) reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards that combine factuality checks with a box-level GIoU reward to strengthen spatial grounding and step-by-step reasoning in complex clinical scenarios. MedMO consistently outperforms strong open-source medical MLLMs across multiple modalities and tasks. On VQA benchmarks, MedMO achieves an average accuracy improvement of +13.7% over the baseline and performs within 1.9% of the SOTA Fleming-VL. For text-based QA, it attains +6.9% over the baseline and +14.5% over Fleming-VL. In medical report generation, MedMO delivers significant gains in both semantic and clinical accuracy. Moreover, it exhibits strong grounding capability, achieving an IoU improvement of +40.4 over the baseline and +37.0% over Fleming-VL, underscoring its robust spatial reasoning and localization performance. Evaluations across radiology, ophthalmology, and pathology-microscopy confirm MedMO's broad cross-modality generalization. We release two versions of MedMO: 4B and 8B. Project is available at https://genmilab.github.io/MedMO-Page
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）发展迅速，但由于在领域覆盖、模态对齐和有依据的推理方面存在差距，其在医学领域的应用仍然受限。在这项工作中，我们介绍了MedMO，一个基于通用MLLM架构构建的医学基础模型，并专门使用大规模、特定领域的数据进行训练。MedMO遵循一个多阶段训练方案：（i）跨模态预训练，将异构视觉编码器与医学语言骨干对齐；（ii）在多任务监督下进行指令调优，任务范围涵盖图像描述、视觉问答（VQA）、报告生成、检索以及具有边界框的有依据的疾病定位；（iii）通过可验证奖励进行强化学习，该奖励将事实性检查与框级GIoU奖励相结合，以加强复杂临床场景中的空间定位和逐步推理。MedMO在多种模态和任务中始终优于强大的开源医学MLLM。在视觉问答（VQA）基准测试中，MedMO的平均准确率比基线提高了+13.7%，并且达到了距SOTA Fleming-VL 1.9%以内的水平。对于基于文本的问答，它比基线提高了+6.9%，比Fleming-VL提高了+14.5%。在医学报告生成方面，MedMO在语义和临床准确性方面均取得了显著提升。此外，它表现出强大的定位能力，IoU比基线提高了+40.4%，比Fleming-VL提高了+37.0%，突显了其强大的空间推理和定位性能。在放射学、眼科学和病理学-显微镜检查方面的评估证实了MedMO广泛的跨模态泛化能力。我们发布了MedMO的两个版本：4B和8B。项目地址为https://genmilab.github.io/MedMO-Page
tldr: The paper introduces MedMO, a medical multimodal foundation model grounded on large-scale medical data, demonstrating superior performance in tasks like VQA, report generation, and disease localization within medical images, across multiple modalities.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 MedMO，一个基于大规模医疗数据的医学多模态基础模型，在医学图像中的VQA，报告生成和疾病定位等任务中表现出卓越的性能，并支持多种模态。

title: Differentiate-and-Inject: Enhancing VLAs via Functional Differentiation Induced by In-Parameter Structural Reasoning
summary: As robots are expected to perform increasingly diverse tasks, they must understand not only low-level actions but also the higher-level structure that determines how a task should unfold. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) models struggle with this form of task-level reasoning. They either depend on prompt-based in-context decomposition, which is unstable and sensitive to linguistic variations, or end-to-end long-horizon training, which requires large-scale demonstrations and entangles task-level reasoning with low-level control. We present in-parameter structured task reasoning (iSTAR), a framework for enhancing VLA models via functional differentiation induced by in-parameter structural reasoning. Instead of treating VLAs as monolithic policies, iSTAR embeds task-level semantic structure directly into model parameters, enabling differentiated task-level inference without external planners or handcrafted prompt inputs. This injected structure takes the form of implicit dynamic scene-graph knowledge that captures object relations, subtask semantics, and task-level dependencies in parameter space. Across diverse manipulation benchmarks, iSTAR achieves more reliable task decompositions and higher success rates than both in-context and end-to-end VLA baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of parameter-space structural reasoning for functional differentiation and improved generalization across task variations.
summary_zh: 随着机器人被期望执行日益多样化的任务，它们不仅必须理解底层动作，还要理解决定任务如何展开的更高层结构。现有的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型难以进行这种任务级推理。它们要么依赖于基于提示的上下文分解，这种分解不稳定且对语言变化敏感，要么依赖于端到端长期训练，这需要大规模的演示数据，并且将任务级推理与底层控制相混淆。我们提出了参数内结构化任务推理 (iSTAR)，这是一个通过参数内结构化推理引起的函数微分来增强VLA模型的框架。iSTAR 不将 VLA 视为单一策略，而是将任务级语义结构直接嵌入到模型参数中，从而实现差异化的任务级推理，而无需外部规划器或手工制作的提示输入。这种注入的结构以隐式动态场景图知识的形式存在，该知识捕获了参数空间中的对象关系、子任务语义和任务级依赖关系。在各种操作基准测试中，iSTAR 比上下文和端到端 VLA 基线都实现了更可靠的任务分解和更高的成功率，证明了参数空间结构化推理在函数微分和提高跨任务变化的泛化能力方面的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces iSTAR, a framework that enhances Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by embedding task-level semantic structure into model parameters for improved task decomposition and generalization, outperforming in-context and end-to-end VLA baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 iSTAR，一个通过将任务级语义结构嵌入到模型参数中来增强视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的框架，以改善任务分解和泛化能力，优于上下文学习和端到端 VLA 基线。

title: TextOp: Real-time Interactive Text-Driven Humanoid Robot Motion Generation and Control
summary: Recent advances in humanoid whole-body motion tracking have enabled the execution of diverse and highly coordinated motions on real hardware. However, existing controllers are commonly driven either by predefined motion trajectories, which offer limited flexibility when user intent changes, or by continuous human teleoperation, which requires constant human involvement and limits autonomy. This work addresses the problem of how to drive a universal humanoid controller in a real-time and interactive manner. We present TextOp, a real-time text-driven humanoid motion generation and control framework that supports streaming language commands and on-the-fly instruction modification during execution. TextOp adopts a two-level architecture in which a high-level autoregressive motion diffusion model continuously generates short-horizon kinematic trajectories conditioned on the current text input, while a low-level motion tracking policy executes these trajectories on a physical humanoid robot. By bridging interactive motion generation with robust whole-body control, TextOp unlocks free-form intent expression and enables smooth transitions across multiple challenging behaviors such as dancing and jumping, within a single continuous motion execution. Extensive real-robot experiments and offline evaluations demonstrate instant responsiveness, smooth whole-body motion, and precise control. The project page and the open-source code are available at https://text-op.github.io/
summary_zh: 人形机器人全身运动跟踪技术的最新进展使得在真实硬件上执行多样化和高度协调的运动成为可能。然而，现有的控制器通常由预定义的运动轨迹驱动，这在用户意图改变时灵活性有限，或者由持续的人工遥操作驱动，这需要持续的人工参与并限制了自主性。本研究旨在解决如何以实时和交互方式驱动通用人形机器人控制器的问题。我们提出了TextOp，一个实时的文本驱动的人形机器人运动生成和控制框架，该框架支持流式语言命令和执行期间的即时指令修改。TextOp采用两层架构，其中高层的自回归运动扩散模型根据当前文本输入连续生成短时程的运动学轨迹，而低层的运动跟踪策略在物理人形机器人上执行这些轨迹。通过将交互式运动生成与鲁棒的全身控制相结合，TextOp解锁了自由形式的意图表达，并实现了在单个连续运动执行中跨多个具有挑战性的行为（如跳舞和跳跃）的平滑过渡。大量的真实机器人实验和离线评估表明了其即时响应、流畅的全身运动和精确控制。项目页面和开源代码可在https://text-op.github.io/上获取。
tldr: The paper introduces TextOp, a framework for real-time text-driven humanoid robot control using a two-level architecture that combines a motion diffusion model for trajectory generation with a low-level tracking policy for physical execution, demonstrated through real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为TextOp的框架，用于实时文本驱动的人形机器人控制。该框架采用双层架构，结合了运动扩散模型用于轨迹生成，以及低层跟踪策略用于物理执行。通过真实的机器人实验进行了验证。

title: Bridging Speech, Emotion, and Motion: a VLM-based Multimodal Edge-deployable Framework for Humanoid Robots
summary: Effective human-robot interaction requires emotionally rich multimodal expressions, yet most humanoid robots lack coordinated speech, facial expressions, and gestures. Meanwhile, real-world deployment demands on-device solutions that can operate autonomously without continuous cloud connectivity. To bridging \underline{\textit{S}}peech, \underline{\textit{E}}motion, and \underline{\textit{M}}otion, we present \textit{SeM$^2$}, a Vision Language Model-based framework that orchestrates emotionally coherent multimodal interactions through three key components: a multimodal perception module capturing user contextual cues, a Chain-of-Thought reasoning for response planning, and a novel Semantic-Sequence Aligning Mechanism (SSAM) that ensures precise temporal coordination between verbal content and physical expressions. We implement both cloud-based and \underline{\textit{e}}dge-deployed versions (\textit{SeM$^2_e$}), with the latter knowledge distilled to operate efficiently on edge hardware while maintaining 95\% of the relative performance. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms unimodal baselines in naturalness, emotional clarity, and modal coherence, advancing socially expressive humanoid robotics for diverse real-world environments.
summary_zh: 为了实现有效的人机交互，需要具有丰富情感的多模态表达，然而大多数人形机器人缺乏协调一致的语音、面部表情和手势。与此同时，实际部署需要能够自主运行而无需持续云连接的端侧解决方案。为了弥合\underline{语}\textit{音}、 \underline{情}\textit{感}和\underline{动}\textit{作}之间的鸿沟，我们提出了\textit{SeM$^2$}，一个基于视觉语言模型的框架，通过三个关键组件来协调情感连贯的多模态交互：一个捕捉用户上下文线索的多模态感知模块，一个用于响应规划的思维链推理过程，以及一种新型的语义序列对齐机制（SSAM），该机制确保了言语内容和肢体表达之间精确的时间协调。我们实现了基于云和\underline{边}\textit{缘}部署的版本（\textit{SeM$^2_e$}），其中后者的知识经过提炼，能够在边缘硬件上高效运行，同时保持95%的相对性能。全面的评估表明，我们的方法在自然度、情感清晰度和模态一致性方面显著优于单模态基线，从而推进了在各种真实世界环境下具有社会表达能力的人形机器人技术。
tldr: This paper introduces SeM$^2$, a VLM-based framework for humanoid robots that coordinates speech, emotion, and motion on edge devices, achieving emotionally coherent multimodal interactions with high efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SeM$^2$，一个基于VLM的人形机器人框架，可在边缘设备上协调语音、情感和动作，实现具有高效率的情感连贯的多模态交互。

title: Going with the Flow: Koopman Behavioral Models as Implicit Planners for Visuo-Motor Dexterity
summary: There has been rapid and dramatic progress in robots' ability to learn complex visuo-motor manipulation skills from demonstrations, thanks in part to expressive policy classes that employ diffusion- and transformer-based backbones. However, these design choices require significant data and computational resources and remain far from reliable, particularly within the context of multi-fingered dexterous manipulation. Fundamentally, they model skills as reactive mappings and rely on fixed-horizon action chunking to mitigate jitter, creating a rigid trade-off between temporal coherence and reactivity. In this work, we introduce Unified Behavioral Models (UBMs), a framework that learns to represent dexterous skills as coupled dynamical systems that capture how visual features of the environment (visual flow) and proprioceptive states of the robot (action flow) co-evolve. By capturing such behavioral dynamics, UBMs can ensure temporal coherence by construction rather than by heuristic averaging. To operationalize these models, we propose Koopman-UBM, a first instantiation of UBMs that leverages Koopman Operator theory to effectively learn a unified representation in which the joint flow of latent visual and proprioceptive features is governed by a structured linear system. We demonstrate that Koopman-UBM can be viewed as an implicit planner: given an initial condition, it analytically computes the desired robot behavior while simultaneously ''imagining'' the resulting flow of visual features over the entire skill horizon. To enable reactivity and adaptation, we introduce an online replanning strategy in which the model acts as its own runtime monitor that automatically triggers replanning when predicted and observed visual flow diverge beyond a threshold. Across seven simulated tasks and two real-world tasks, we demonstrate that K-UBM matches or exceeds the performance of state-of-the-art baselines, while offering considerably faster inference, smooth execution, robustness to occlusions, and flexible replanning.
summary_zh: 在机器人从演示中学习复杂视觉-运动操作技能方面，已经取得了快速而显著的进展，这部分归功于采用了基于扩散和Transformer的主干网络的高表现力策略类。然而，这些设计选择需要大量的数据和计算资源，并且仍然远未达到可靠的程度，尤其是在多指灵巧操作的背景下。从根本上说，它们将技能建模为反应式映射，并依靠固定时间范围的动作分块来减轻抖动，从而在时间连贯性和反应性之间形成僵硬的权衡。在这项工作中，我们引入了统一行为模型（UBMs），这是一个学习将灵巧技能表示为耦合动力系统的框架，该系统捕捉环境的视觉特征（视觉流）和机器人的本体感受状态（动作流）如何共同演化。通过捕捉这种行为动力学，UBMs可以通过构造来确保时间连贯性，而不是通过启发式平均。为了实现这些模型的可操作性，我们提出了Koopman-UBM，这是UBMs的第一个实例化，它利用Koopman算子理论来有效地学习一种统一的表示，其中潜在视觉和本体感受特征的联合流由一个结构化的线性系统控制。我们证明了Koopman-UBM可以被视为一个隐式规划器：给定一个初始条件，它可以分析地计算出期望的机器人行为，同时“想象”整个技能范围内产生的视觉特征流。为了实现反应性和适应性，我们引入了一种在线重规划策略，其中模型充当其自身的运行时监视器，当预测的和观察到的视觉流超出阈值时，会自动触发重规划。通过七个模拟任务和两个真实世界任务，我们证明了K-UBM在性能上与最先进的基线模型相匹配甚至超越，同时提供了明显更快的推理速度、平滑的执行、对遮挡的鲁棒性以及灵活的重规划。
tldr: This paper introduces Koopman-UBM, a framework that learns dexterous skills as coupled dynamical systems using Koopman Operator theory. It achieves state-of-the-art performance with faster inference, smoother execution, and robustness to occlusions, while also allowing for online replanning.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为Koopman-UBM的框架，该框架使用Koopman算子理论将灵巧技能学习为耦合动力系统。它具有最先进的性能，更快的推理速度，更流畅的执行效果和对遮挡的鲁棒性，并且还支持在线重规划。

title: Trace-Focused Diffusion Policy for Multi-Modal Action Disambiguation in Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
summary: Generative model-based policies have shown strong performance in imitation-based robotic manipulation by learning action distributions from demonstrations. However, in long-horizon tasks, visually similar observations often recur across execution stages while requiring distinct actions, which leads to ambiguous predictions when policies are conditioned only on instantaneous observations, termed multi-modal action ambiguity (MA2). To address this challenge, we propose the Trace-Focused Diffusion Policy (TF-DP), a simple yet effective diffusion-based framework that explicitly conditions action generation on the robot's execution history. TF-DP represents historical motion as an explicit execution trace and projects it into the visual observation space, providing stage-aware context when current observations alone are insufficient. In addition, the induced trace-focused field emphasizes task-relevant regions associated with historical motion, improving robustness to background visual disturbances. We evaluate TF-DP on real-world robotic manipulation tasks exhibiting pronounced multi-modal action ambiguity and visually cluttered conditions. Experimental results show that TF-DP improves temporal consistency and robustness, outperforming the vanilla diffusion policy by 80.56 percent on tasks with multi-modal action ambiguity and by 86.11 percent under visual disturbances, while maintaining inference efficiency with only a 6.4 percent runtime increase. These results demonstrate that execution-trace conditioning offers a scalable and principled approach for robust long-horizon robotic manipulation within a single policy.
summary_zh: 基于生成模型的策略已在基于模仿的机器人操作中表现出强大的性能，通过从演示中学习动作分布。然而，在长时程任务中，视觉上相似的观测结果经常在执行阶段中重复出现，但需要不同的动作，这会导致仅在瞬时观测上调节策略时出现模糊的预测，称为多模态动作歧义（MA2）。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种简单而有效的基于扩散的框架，即轨迹聚焦扩散策略（TF-DP），该框架明确地基于机器人的执行历史来调节动作生成。TF-DP将历史运动表示为显式的执行轨迹，并将其投影到视觉观测空间中，从而在仅凭当前观测不足时提供阶段感知的上下文。此外，所诱导的轨迹聚焦场强调与历史运动相关的任务相关区域，提高了对背景视觉干扰的鲁棒性。我们在真实的机器人操作任务中评估了TF-DP，这些任务表现出明显的多模态动作歧义和视觉杂乱的条件。实验结果表明，TF-DP提高了时间一致性和鲁棒性，在具有多模态动作歧义的任务上比原始扩散策略提高了80.56%，在视觉干扰下提高了86.11%，同时仅以6.4%的运行时增加保持了推理效率。这些结果表明，执行轨迹调节为在单个策略中实现鲁棒的长时程机器人操作提供了一种可扩展且有原则的方法。
tldr: This paper introduces Trace-Focused Diffusion Policy (TF-DP) to address multi-modal action ambiguity in long-horizon robotic manipulation by conditioning action generation on the robot's execution history, demonstrating significant performance improvements in real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Trace-Focused Diffusion Policy (TF-DP)，通过将动作生成建立在机器人执行历史的基础上，解决了长程机器人操作中多模态动作歧义的问题，并在实际任务中展示了显著的性能提升。

title: UEREBot: Learning Safe Quadrupedal Locomotion under Unstructured Environments and High-Speed Dynamic Obstacles
summary: Quadruped robots are increasingly deployed in unstructured environments. Safe locomotion in these settings requires long-horizon goal progress, passability over uneven terrain and static constraints, and collision avoidance against high-speed dynamic obstacles. A single system cannot fully satisfy all three objectives simultaneously: planning-based decisions can be too slow, while purely reactive decisions can sacrifice goal progress and passability. To resolve this conflict, we propose UEREBot (Unstructured-Environment Reflexive Evasion Robot), a hierarchical framework that separates slow planning from instantaneous reflexive evasion and coordinates them during execution. UEREBot formulates the task as a constrained optimal control problem blueprint. It adopts a spatial--temporal planner that provides reference guidance toward the goal and threat signals. It then uses a threat-aware handoff to fuse navigation and reflex actions into a nominal command, and a control barrier function shield as a final execution safeguard. We evaluate UEREBot in Isaac Lab simulation and deploy it on a Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with onboard perception. Across diverse environments with complex static structure and high-speed dynamic obstacles, UEREBot achieves higher avoidance success and more stable locomotion while maintaining goal progress than representative baselines, demonstrating improved safety--progress trade-offs.
summary_zh:
摘要：
四足机器人正越来越多地部署在非结构化环境中。在这些环境中安全移动需要长程目标推进、跨越不平坦地形和静态约束的能力，以及躲避高速动态障碍的能力。一个单一系统无法同时完全满足这三个目标：基于规划的决策可能过于缓慢，而纯粹反应式的决策可能牺牲目标推进和通过性。为了解决这个冲突，我们提出了UEREBot（非结构化环境反射式避让机器人），这是一个分层框架，它将缓慢的规划与瞬时的反射式避让分离，并在执行期间协调它们。UEREBot将任务建模为一个约束最优控制问题蓝图。它采用一个时空规划器，该规划器提供朝向目标的参考引导和威胁信号。然后，它使用一个威胁感知的切换机制，将导航和反射动作融合为一个标称指令，并使用控制屏障函数盾作为最终的执行保障。我们在Isaac Lab仿真环境中评估了UEREBot，并将其部署在配备板载感知单元的宇树Go2四足机器人上。在具有复杂静态结构和高速动态障碍的各种环境中，UEREBot与代表性基线相比，实现了更高的避障成功率和更稳定的运动，同时保持了目标推进，展示了改进的安全-推进权衡。
tldr: The paper presents UEREBot, a hierarchical framework for safe quadrupedal locomotion in unstructured environments with high-speed dynamic obstacles, combining planning, reactive evasion, and control barrier functions for improved safety-progress trade-offs.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了UEREBot，一个用于在非结构化环境中具有高速动态障碍物的安全四足运动的分层框架，结合了规划、反应性回避和控制屏障函数，以实现改进的安全-进步权衡。

title: Scalable Dexterous Robot Learning with AR-based Remote Human-Robot Interactions
summary: This paper focuses on the scalable robot learning for manipulation in the dexterous robot arm-hand systems, where the remote human-robot interactions via augmented reality (AR) are established to collect the expert demonstration data for improving efficiency. In such a system, we present a unified framework to address the general manipulation task problem. Specifically, the proposed method consists of two phases: i) In the first phase for pretraining, the policy is created in a behavior cloning (BC) manner, through leveraging the learning data from our AR-based remote human-robot interaction system; ii) In the second phase, a contrastive learning empowered reinforcement learning (RL) method is developed to obtain more efficient and robust policy than the BC, and thus a projection head is designed to accelerate the learning progress. An event-driven augmented reward is adopted for enhancing the safety. To validate the proposed method, both the physics simulations via PyBullet and real-world experiments are carried out. The results demonstrate that compared to the classic proximal policy optimization and soft actor-critic policies, our method not only significantly speeds up the inference, but also achieves much better performance in terms of the success rate for fulfilling the manipulation tasks. By conducting the ablation study, it is confirmed that the proposed RL with contrastive learning overcomes policy collapse. Supplementary demonstrations are available at https://cyberyyc.github.io/.
summary_zh: 本文着重研究灵巧型机器人手臂-手系统中的可扩展机器人操作学习，其中通过增强现实（AR）建立远程人机交互，以收集专家演示数据，从而提高效率。 在这样的系统中，我们提出了一个统一的框架来解决通用操作任务问题。 具体而言，所提出的方法包括两个阶段：i）在预训练的第一阶段，通过利用我们基于AR的远程人机交互系统中的学习数据，以行为克隆（BC）的方式创建策略；ii）在第二阶段，开发了一种对比学习增强的强化学习（RL）方法，以获得比BC更有效、更鲁棒的策略，因此设计了一个投影头来加速学习进度。 采用事件驱动的增强奖励来提高安全性。 为了验证所提出的方法，进行了基于PyBullet的物理模拟和真实世界的实验。 结果表明，与经典的近端策略优化和软演员-评论家策略相比，我们的方法不仅显著加快了推理速度，而且在完成操作任务的成功率方面也取得了更好的性能。 通过进行消融研究，证实了所提出的具有对比学习的强化学习克服了策略崩溃。 补充演示可在https://cyberyyc.github.io/获取。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for scalable dexterous robot manipulation learning using AR-based remote human demonstrations and contrastive learning-enhanced reinforcement learning, demonstrating improved performance and efficiency compared to existing methods in both simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于增强现实远程人机演示和对比学习增强强化学习的可扩展灵巧机器人操作学习框架，并在仿真和真实实验中证明了其相对于现有方法的性能和效率的提升。

title: RAPiD: Real-time Deterministic Trajectory Planning via Diffusion Behavior Priors for Safe and Efficient Autonomous Driving
summary: Diffusion-based trajectory planners have demonstrated strong capability for modeling the multimodal nature of human driving behavior, but their reliance on iterative stochastic sampling poses critical challenges for real-time, safety-critical deployment. In this work, we present RAPiD, a deterministic policy extraction framework that distills a pretrained diffusion-based planner into an efficient policy while eliminating diffusion sampling. Using score-regularized policy optimization, we leverage the score function of a pre-trained diffusion planner as a behavior prior to regularize policy learning. To promote safety and passenger comfort, the policy is optimized using a critic trained to imitate a predictive driver controller, providing dense, safety-focused supervision beyond conventional imitation learning. Evaluations demonstrate that RAPiD achieves competitive performance on closed-loop nuPlan scenarios with an 8x speedup over diffusion baselines, while achieving state-of-the-art generalization among learning-based planners on the interPlan benchmark. The official website of this work is: https://github.com/ruturajreddy/RAPiD.
summary_zh: 基于扩散的轨迹规划器展现了对人类驾驶行为多模态本质的强大建模能力，但它们对迭代随机采样的依赖对实时、安全攸关的部署提出了严峻挑战。本文提出了RAPiD，一个确定性策略提取框架，它将预训练的基于扩散的规划器提炼成一个高效的策略，同时消除了扩散采样。通过使用分数正则化策略优化，我们利用预训练扩散规划器的分数函数作为行为先验来正则化策略学习。为了提高安全性和乘客舒适度，该策略通过一个经过训练以模仿预测性驾驶员控制器的评估器进行优化，从而提供了超越传统模仿学习的密集、以安全为中心的监督。评估结果表明，RAPiD在闭环nuPlan场景中取得了具有竞争力的性能，速度比基于扩散的基线提高了8倍，同时在interPlan基准测试中实现了学习型规划器中最先进的泛化能力。该工作的官方网站是：https://github.com/ruturajreddy/RAPiD。
tldr: The paper introduces RAPiD, a deterministic policy extraction framework that distills a diffusion-based trajectory planner into an efficient and safe policy for autonomous driving, achieving significant speedups and state-of-the-art generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RAPiD，一个确定性的策略提取框架，它将基于扩散的轨迹规划器提炼成一个高效且安全的自动驾驶策略，实现了显著的加速和最先进的泛化。

title: Action-to-Action Flow Matching
summary: Diffusion-based policies have recently achieved remarkable success in robotics by formulating action prediction as a conditional denoising process. However, the standard practice of sampling from random Gaussian noise often requires multiple iterative steps to produce clean actions, leading to high inference latency that incurs a major bottleneck for real-time control. In this paper, we challenge the necessity of uninformed noise sampling and propose Action-to-Action flow matching (A2A), a novel policy paradigm that shifts from random sampling to initialization informed by the previous action. Unlike existing methods that treat proprioceptive action feedback as static conditions, A2A leverages historical proprioceptive sequences, embedding them into a high-dimensional latent space as the starting point for action generation. This design bypasses costly iterative denoising while effectively capturing the robot's physical dynamics and temporal continuity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that A2A exhibits high training efficiency, fast inference speed, and improved generalization. Notably, A2A enables high-quality action generation in as few as a single inference step (0.56 ms latency), and exhibits superior robustness to visual perturbations and enhanced generalization to unseen configurations. Lastly, we also extend A2A to video generation, demonstrating its broader versatility in temporal modeling. Project site: https://lorenzo-0-0.github.io/A2A_Flow_Matching.
summary_zh: 基于扩散的策略最近在机器人学中取得了显著成功，其通过将动作预测公式化为条件去噪过程来实现。然而，从随机高斯噪声中采样的标准做法通常需要多个迭代步骤才能生成干净的动作，从而导致高推理延迟，这为实时控制带来了主要的瓶颈。在本文中，我们对无信息噪声采样的必要性提出了挑战，并提出了动作到动作流匹配 (A2A)，一种新颖的策略范式，它将从随机采样转变为由先前动作驱动的初始化。与现有将本体感觉动作反馈视为静态条件的方法不同，A2A利用历史本体感觉序列，将其嵌入到高维潜在空间中作为动作生成的起点。这种设计绕过了代价高昂的迭代去噪，同时有效地捕捉了机器人的物理动力学和时间连续性。大量实验表明，A2A 表现出更高的训练效率、更快的推理速度和更好的泛化能力。值得注意的是，A2A 能够仅用一步推理 (0.56 毫秒延迟) 就能实现高质量的动作生成，并且对视觉扰动表现出卓越的鲁棒性，并增强了对未见配置的泛化能力。最后，我们还将 A2A 扩展到视频生成，展示了其在时间建模方面更广泛的通用性。项目网站：https://lorenzo-0-0.github.io/A2A_Flow_Matching。
tldr: The paper introduces Action-to-Action flow matching (A2A), a diffusion-based policy that uses the previous action to inform the initialization of action generation, enabling fast and efficient robotic control with improved generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为Action-to-Action flow matching (A2A) 的扩散策略，它利用之前的动作来指导动作生成的初始化，从而实现快速高效的机器人控制，并具有更好的泛化能力。

title: aerial-autonomy-stack -- a Faster-than-real-time, Autopilot-agnostic, ROS2 Framework to Simulate and Deploy Perception-based Drones
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles are rapidly transforming multiple applications, from agricultural and infrastructure monitoring to logistics and defense. Introducing greater autonomy to these systems can simultaneously make them more effective as well as reliable. Thus, the ability to rapidly engineer and deploy autonomous aerial systems has become of strategic importance. In the 2010s, a combination of high-performance compute, data, and open-source software led to the current deep learning and AI boom, unlocking decades of prior theoretical work. Robotics is on the cusp of a similar transformation. However, physical AI faces unique hurdles, often combined under the umbrella term "simulation-to-reality gap". These span from modeling shortcomings to the complexity of vertically integrating the highly heterogeneous hardware and software systems typically found in field robots. To address the latter, we introduce aerial-autonomy-stack, an open-source, end-to-end framework designed to streamline the pipeline from (GPU-accelerated) perception to (flight controller-based) action. Our stack allows the development of aerial autonomy using ROS2 and provides a common interface for two of the most popular autopilots: PX4 and ArduPilot. We show that it supports over 20x faster-than-real-time, end-to-end simulation of a complete development and deployment stack -- including edge compute and networking -- significantly compressing the build-test-release cycle of perception-based autonomy.
summary_zh: 无人机正迅速改变着农业、基础设施监控、物流和国防等多种应用。为这些系统引入更高的自主性，能够同时提高它们的效率和可靠性。因此，快速设计和部署自主飞行系统的能力已具有战略意义。在2010年代，高性能计算、数据和开源软件的结合催生了当前深度学习和人工智能的蓬勃发展，释放了先前数十年理论研究的潜力。机器人技术正处于类似变革的前沿。然而，物理人工智能面临着独特的挑战，通常统称为“仿真到现实差距”。这些挑战涵盖了从建模缺陷到垂直整合现场机器人中常见的高度异构的硬件和软件系统的复杂性。为了解决后者，我们引入了aerial-autonomy-stack，这是一个开源的端到端框架，旨在简化从（GPU加速的）感知到（基于飞控的）动作的流水线。我们的栈允许使用ROS2开发飞行自主性，并为两个最流行的自动驾驶仪：PX4和ArduPilot，提供了一个通用接口。我们证明它支持超过20倍实时速度的、完整的开发和部署栈的端到端仿真——包括边缘计算和网络——从而显著缩短了基于感知的自主性的构建-测试-发布周期。
tldr: The paper presents aerial-autonomy-stack, an open-source ROS2 framework that streamlines the development and deployment of perception-based drone autonomy with faster-than-real-time simulation capabilities.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为aerial-autonomy-stack的开源ROS2框架，它简化了基于感知的无人机自主性的开发和部署，并具有快于实时的仿真能力。

title: Realistic Synthetic Household Data Generation at Scale
summary:
Advancements in foundation models have catalyzed research in Embodied AI to develop interactive agents capable of environmental reasoning and interaction. Developing such agents requires diverse, large-scale datasets. Prior frameworks generate synthetic data for long-term human-robot interactions but fail to model the bidirectional influence between human behavior and household environments. Our proposed generative framework creates household datasets at scale through loosely coupled generation of long-term human-robot interactions and environments. Human personas influence environment generation, while environment schematics and semantics shape human-robot interactions.
  The generated 3D data includes rich static context such as object and environment semantics, and temporal context capturing human and agent behaviors over extended periods. Our flexible tool allows users to define dataset characteristics via natural language prompts, enabling configuration of environment and human activity data through natural language specifications. The tool creates variations of user-defined configurations, enabling scalable data generation.
  We validate our framework through statistical evaluation using multi-modal embeddings and key metrics: cosine similarity, mutual information gain, intervention analysis, and iterative improvement validation. Statistical comparisons show good alignment with real-world datasets (HOMER) with cosine similarity (0.60), while synthetic datasets (Wang et al.) show moderate alignment (0.27). Intervention analysis across age, organization, and sleep pattern changes shows statistically significant effects (p < 0.001) with large effect sizes (Cohen's d = 0.51-1.12), confirming bidirectional coupling translates persona traits into measurable environmental and behavioral differences. These contributions enable development and testing of household smart devices at scale.
summary_zh:
基础模型的发展催化了具身智能领域的研究，旨在开发能够进行环境推理和交互的交互式智能体。开发此类智能体需要多样化的大规模数据集。先前的框架为长期人机交互生成合成数据，但未能对人类行为与家庭环境之间的双向影响进行建模。我们提出的生成式框架通过长期人机交互和环境的松耦合生成，大规模地创建家庭数据集。人类角色影响环境生成，而环境模式和语义则塑造人机交互。

生成的 3D 数据包括丰富的静态上下文，如物体和环境语义，以及随时间变化的上下文，捕捉人类和智能体在较长时间内的行为。我们灵活的工具允许用户通过自然语言提示定义数据集特征，从而能够通过自然语言规范配置环境和人类活动数据。该工具创建用户定义配置的变体，从而实现可扩展的数据生成。

我们通过使用多模态嵌入和关键指标（包括余弦相似度、互信息增益、干预分析和迭代改进验证）的统计评估来验证我们的框架。统计比较显示，与真实世界数据集（HOMER）具有良好的对齐性（余弦相似度 0.60），而合成数据集（Wang et al.）显示中等对齐性（0.27）。跨年龄、组织和睡眠模式变化的干预分析显示出具有统计学意义的显著影响（p < 0.001），且效应量较大（Cohen's d = 0.51-1.12），证实了双向耦合将角色特征转化为可测量的环境和行为差异。这些贡献使得能够大规模地开发和测试家用智能设备。
tldr: This paper presents a generative framework that creates realistic synthetic household datasets at scale, modeling bidirectional influence between human behavior and the environment for training embodied AI agents.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种生成框架，可以大规模创建逼真的合成家庭数据集，对人类行为和环境之间的双向影响进行建模，用于训练具身人工智能代理。

title: Fine-R1: Make Multi-modal LLMs Excel in Fine-Grained Visual Recognition by Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Any entity in the visual world can be hierarchically grouped based on shared characteristics and mapped to fine-grained sub-categories. While Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on coarse-grained visual tasks, they often struggle with Fine-Grained Visual Recognition (FGVR). Adapting general-purpose MLLMs to FGVR typically requires large amounts of annotated data, which is costly to obtain, leaving a substantial performance gap compared to contrastive CLIP models dedicated for discriminative tasks. Moreover, MLLMs tend to overfit to seen sub-categories and generalize poorly to unseen ones. To address these challenges, we propose Fine-R1, an MLLM tailored for FGVR through an R1-style training framework: (1) Chain-of-Thought Supervised Fine-tuning, where we construct a high-quality FGVR CoT dataset with rationales of "visual analysis, candidate sub-categories, comparison, and prediction", transition the model into a strong open-world classifier; and (2) Triplet Augmented Policy Optimization, where Intra-class Augmentation mixes trajectories from anchor and positive images within the same category to improve robustness to intra-class variance, while Inter-class Augmentation maximizes the response distinction conditioned on images across sub-categories to enhance discriminative ability. With only 4-shot training, Fine-R1 outperforms existing general MLLMs, reasoning MLLMs, and even contrastive CLIP models in identifying both seen and unseen sub-categories, showing promise in working in knowledge-intensive domains where gathering expert annotations for all sub-categories is arduous. Code is available at https://github.com/PKU-ICST-MIPL/FineR1_ICLR2026.
summary_zh: 视觉世界中的任何实体都可以根据共享特征进行分层分组，并映射到细粒度的子类别。虽然多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 在粗粒度视觉任务上取得了强大的性能，但它们在细粒度视觉识别 (FGVR) 方面常常表现不佳。 将通用 MLLM 应用于 FGVR 通常需要大量的标注数据，而获取标注数据成本高昂，这导致其性能与专用于判别任务的对比学习 CLIP 模型相比存在显著差距。此外，MLLM 倾向于过度拟合已见过的子类别，并且对未见过的子类别泛化能力较差。 为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种通过 R1 风格训练框架为 FGVR 量身定制的 MLLM： Fine-R1，其包含：(1) 思维链监督微调：我们构建了一个高质量的 FGVR CoT 数据集，其中包含“视觉分析、候选子类别、比较和预测”的推理过程，将模型转变为一个强大的开放世界分类器； 以及 (2) 三元组增强策略优化：其中，类内增强混合同一类别中锚点图像和正样本图像的轨迹，以提高对类内差异的鲁棒性，而类间增强则最大化跨子类别图像的响应区分度，以增强判别能力。 仅通过 4-shot 训练，Fine-R1 在识别已见和未见子类别方面均优于现有的通用 MLLM、推理 MLLM，甚至对比学习 CLIP 模型，这表明其在为所有子类别收集专家标注数据非常困难的知识密集型领域中具有广阔的应用前景。 代码可在 https://github.com/PKU-ICST-MIPL/FineR1_ICLR2026 获得。
tldr: The paper introduces Fine-R1, a multi-modal LLM trained with Chain-of-Thought and triplet augmented policy optimization for fine-grained visual recognition, achieving state-of-the-art performance with limited data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Fine-R1，一个多模态LLM，通过思维链（Chain-of-Thought）和三元组增强策略优化进行训练，用于细粒度视觉识别，并在有限数据下实现了最先进的性能。

title: VERIFY-RL: Verifiable Recursive Decomposition for Reinforcement Learning in Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Training language models to solve complex mathematical problems benefits from curriculum learning progressively training on simpler subproblems. However, existing decomposition methods are often heuristic, offering no guarantees that subproblems are simpler, that solving them aids the parent task, or that their relationships are mathematically grounded. We observe that symbolic differentiation provides a natural structure for verified decomposition: calculus rules explicitly define how expressions reduce to simpler components with provable properties. We introduce Verify-RL, a framework where every parent-child decomposition satisfies three verifiable conditions: strictly decreasing structural complexity, solution containment, and formal rule derivation. Unlike heuristic methods where a significant fraction of decompositions are invalid our properties admit automatic verification through symbolic computation, achieving "verification by construction" Experiments demonstrate that eliminating invalid decompositions yields sizable gains, accuracy on the hardest problems more than doubles from 32% to 68%, with a 40% relative improvement overall.
summary_zh: 训练语言模型解决复杂的数学问题受益于课程学习，该方法通过逐步训练较简单的子问题来完成任务。然而，现有的分解方法通常是启发式的，既不能保证子问题更简单，也不能保证解决它们有助于父任务，或者它们之间的关系在数学上是合理的。我们观察到符号微分为可验证分解提供了一种自然的结构：微积分规则明确地定义了表达式如何简化为具有可证明性质的更简单的组成部分。我们引入Verify-RL，这是一个框架，其中每个父子分解都满足三个可验证的条件：严格递减的结构复杂度、解的包含性和形式化的规则推导。不同于启发式方法中大部分分解无效的情况，我们的性质允许通过符号计算自动验证，实现“通过构造验证”。实验表明，消除无效分解可以带来显著的收益，最难问题的准确率从32%提高到68%，提高了一倍以上，总体上实现了40%的相对改进。
tldr: Verify-RL uses symbolic differentiation to ensure mathematical reasoning decomposition in RL leads to simpler, valid subproblems, achieving significant accuracy gains compared to heuristic methods.
tldr_zh: Verify-RL使用符号微分来确保RL中的数学推理分解产生更简单、有效的子问题，与启发式方法相比，实现了显著的准确率提升。

title: VISOR: VIsual Spatial Object Reasoning for Language-driven Object Navigation
summary: Language-driven object navigation requires agents to interpret natural language descriptions of target objects, which combine intrinsic and extrinsic attributes for instance recognition and commonsense navigation. Existing methods either (i) use end-to-end trained models with vision-language embeddings, which struggle to generalize beyond training data and lack action-level explainability, or (ii) rely on modular zero-shot pipelines with large language models (LLMs) and open-set object detectors, which suffer from error propagation, high computational cost, and difficulty integrating their reasoning back into the navigation policy. To this end, we propose a compact 3B-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) agent that performs human-like embodied reasoning for both object recognition and action selection, removing the need for stitched multi-model pipelines. Instead of raw embedding matching, our agent employs explicit image-grounded reasoning to directly answer "Is this the target object?" and "Why should I take this action?" The reasoning process unfolds in three stages: "think", "think summary", and "action", yielding improved explainability, stronger generalization, and more efficient navigation. Code and dataset available upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 语言驱动的物体导航要求智能体能够理解目标物体的自然语言描述，其中结合了内在和外在属性来进行实例识别和常识导航。现有的方法要么 (i) 使用端到端训练的、具有视觉-语言嵌入的模型，这种模型难以泛化到训练数据之外，并且缺乏动作级别的可解释性；要么 (ii) 依赖于模块化的零样本流水线，利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 和开放集物体检测器，这种流水线会遭受误差传播、高计算成本以及难以将其推理整合回导航策略的问题。为此，我们提出了一种紧凑的30亿参数视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 智能体，它可以执行类似于人类的有身推理，用于物体识别和动作选择，从而无需缝合的多模型流水线。我们的智能体没有采用原始嵌入匹配，而是采用显式的图像-接地推理，直接回答 “这是目标物体吗？” 和 “我为什么应该采取这个动作？” 这一过程。推理过程分为三个阶段：“思考”、“思考总结” 和 “行动”，从而提高了可解释性，增强了泛化能力，并提高了导航效率。代码和数据集将在接收后提供。
tldr: This paper introduces a compact Vision-Language-Action agent (VISOR) for language-driven object navigation that performs explicit, image-grounded reasoning to improve generalization, explainability, and efficiency compared to existing end-to-end or modular approaches.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种紧凑的视觉-语言-动作智能体（VISOR），用于语言驱动的物体导航。它执行显式的、基于图像的推理，与现有的端到端或模块化方法相比，提高了泛化性、可解释性和效率。

title: Joint Reward Modeling: Internalizing Chain-of-Thought for Efficient Visual Reward Models
summary: Reward models are critical for reinforcement learning from human feedback, as they determine the alignment quality and reliability of generative models. For complex tasks such as image editing, reward models are required to capture global semantic consistency and implicit logical constraints beyond local similarity. Existing reward modeling approaches have clear limitations. Discriminative reward models align well with human preferences but struggle with complex semantics due to limited reasoning supervision. Generative reward models offer stronger semantic understanding and reasoning, but they are costly at inference time and difficult to align directly with human preferences. To this end, we propose Joint Reward Modeling (JRM), which jointly optimizes preference learning and language modeling on a shared vision-language backbone. This approach internalizes the semantic and reasoning capabilities of generative models into efficient discriminative representations, enabling fast and accurate evaluation. JRM achieves state-of-the-art results on MMRB2 and EditReward-Bench, and significantly improves stability and performance in downstream online reinforcement learning. These results show that joint training effectively bridges efficiency and semantic understanding in reward modeling.
summary_zh: 奖励模型对于基于人类反馈的强化学习至关重要，因为它们决定了生成模型的对齐质量和可靠性。对于诸如图像编辑等复杂任务，奖励模型需要捕捉全局语义一致性和超越局部相似性的隐式逻辑约束。现有的奖励建模方法存在明显的局限性。判别式奖励模型与人类偏好对齐良好，但由于推理监督有限，难以处理复杂的语义。生成式奖励模型提供更强的语义理解和推理能力，但它们在推理时成本高昂，且难以直接与人类偏好对齐。为此，我们提出了联合奖励建模（JRM），它在共享的视觉-语言骨干网络上联合优化偏好学习和语言建模。这种方法将生成模型的语义和推理能力内化到高效的判别式表示中，从而实现快速且准确的评估。JRM 在 MMRB2 和 EditReward-Bench 上取得了最先进的结果，并显著提高了下游在线强化学习的稳定性和性能。这些结果表明，联合训练能够有效地在奖励建模中桥接效率和语义理解。
tldr: The paper introduces Joint Reward Modeling (JRM), a method that combines preference learning and language modeling for efficient and accurate visual reward models, achieving SOTA results in image editing and improving RL stability.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了联合奖励建模（JRM），这是一种结合偏好学习和语言建模以实现高效准确的视觉奖励模型的方法，在图像编辑方面取得了SOTA成果，并提高了强化学习的稳定性。

title: Secure Code Generation via Online Reinforcement Learning with Vulnerability Reward Model
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software development, yet their tendency to generate insecure code remains a major barrier to real-world deployment. Existing secure code alignment methods often suffer from a functionality--security paradox, improving security at the cost of substantial utility degradation. We propose SecCoderX, an online reinforcement learning framework for functionality-preserving secure code generation. SecCoderX first bridges vulnerability detection and secure code generation by repurposing mature detection resources in two ways: (i) synthesizing diverse, reality-grounded vulnerability-inducing coding tasks for online RL rollouts, and (ii) training a reasoning-based vulnerability reward model that provides scalable and reliable security supervision. Together, these components are unified in an online RL loop to align code LLMs to generate secure and functional code. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SecCoderX achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving Effective Safety Rate (ESR) by approximately 10% over unaligned models, whereas prior methods often degrade ESR by 14-54%. We release our code, dataset and model checkpoints at https://github.com/AndrewWTY/SecCoderX.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地应用于软件开发，但其生成不安全代码的倾向仍然是实际部署的主要障碍。现有的安全代码对齐方法通常面临功能性与安全性悖论，即提高安全性的同时会显著降低实用性。我们提出 SecCoderX，一种用于保持功能性的安全代码生成的在线强化学习框架。SecCoderX 首先通过两种方式重用成熟的检测资源，从而桥接漏洞检测和安全代码生成：(i) 合成多样化的、基于现实的诱发漏洞编码任务，用于在线 RL 推演；(ii) 训练基于推理的漏洞奖励模型，该模型提供可扩展且可靠的安全监督。这些组件共同在一个在线 RL 循环中统一起来，以对齐代码 LLM，从而生成安全且功能性的代码。大量实验表明，SecCoderX 实现了最先进的性能，与未对齐的模型相比，有效安全率 (ESR) 提高了约 10%，而先前的方法通常会使 ESR 降低 14-54%。我们将在 https://github.com/AndrewWTY/SecCoderX 发布我们的代码、数据集和模型检查点。
tldr: The paper introduces SecCoderX, an online reinforcement learning framework to improve the security of code generated by LLMs without sacrificing functionality, by using a vulnerability reward model and synthesizing vulnerability-inducing coding tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 SecCoderX，一个在线强化学习框架，通过使用漏洞奖励模型和合成漏洞诱导编码任务，来提高 LLM 生成代码的安全性，同时不牺牲功能性。

title: VGAS: Value-Guided Action-Chunk Selection for Few-Shot Vision-Language-Action Adaptation
summary: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models bridge multimodal reasoning with physical control, but adapting them to new tasks with scarce demonstrations remains unreliable. While fine-tuned VLA policies often produce semantically plausible trajectories, failures often arise from unresolved geometric ambiguities, where near-miss action candidates lead to divergent execution outcomes under limited supervision. We study few-shot VLA adaptation from a \emph{generation--selection} perspective and propose a novel framework \textbf{VGAS} (\textbf{V}alue-\textbf{G}uided \textbf{A}ction-chunk \textbf{S}election). It performs inference-time best-of-$N$ selection to identify action chunks that are both semantically faithful and geometrically precise. Specifically, \textbf{VGAS} employs a finetuned VLA as a high-recall proposal generator and introduces the \textrm{Q-Chunk-Former}, a geometrically grounded Transformer critic to resolve fine-grained geometric ambiguities. In addition, we propose \textit{Explicit Geometric Regularization} (\texttt{EGR}), which explicitly shapes a discriminative value landscape to preserve action ranking resolution among near-miss candidates while mitigating value instability under scarce supervision. Experiments and theoretical analysis demonstrate that \textbf{VGAS} consistently improves success rates and robustness under limited demonstrations and distribution shifts. Our code is available at https://github.com/Jyugo-15/VGAS.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型连接了多模态推理与物理控制，但使用少量演示数据将其适配到新任务仍然不可靠。虽然微调后的VLA策略通常产生语义上合理的轨迹，但由于未解决的几何歧义，经常出现失败，在这种情况下，近失动作候选会导致在有限监督下执行结果的发散。我们从\emph{生成--选择}的角度研究小样本VLA适配，并提出一种新颖的框架\textbf{VGAS}（\textbf{V}alue-\textbf{G}uided \textbf{A}ction-chunk \textbf{S}election，值引导的动作块选择）。它执行推理时最优-$N$选择，以识别既在语义上忠实又几何上精确的动作块。具体来说，\textbf{VGAS}采用微调的VLA作为高召回率的提案生成器，并引入了 \textrm{Q-Chunk-Former}，这是一种几何基础的Transformer评论家，用于解决细粒度的几何歧义。此外，我们提出了\textit{显式几何正则化}（\texttt{EGR}），它显式地塑造判别性值景观，以在少量监督下减轻值不稳定性的同时，保持近失候选动作之间的排序分辨率。实验和理论分析表明，在有限的演示和分布转移下，\textbf{VGAS}始终如一地提高了成功率和鲁棒性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Jyugo-15/VGAS 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces VGAS, a value-guided action-chunk selection framework for adapting Vision-Language-Action models to new tasks with few demonstrations, using a Q-Chunk-Former and explicit geometric regularization to improve success rates and robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VGAS，一种价值引导的动作块选择框架，用于在少量演示下将视觉-语言-动作模型适应于新任务，使用Q-Chunk-Former和显式几何正则化来提高成功率和鲁棒性。

title: AgentSys: Secure and Dynamic LLM Agents Through Explicit Hierarchical Memory Management
summary:
Indirect prompt injection threatens LLM agents by embedding malicious instructions in external content, enabling unauthorized actions and data theft. LLM agents maintain working memory through their context window, which stores interaction history for decision-making. Conventional agents indiscriminately accumulate all tool outputs and reasoning traces in this memory, creating two critical vulnerabilities: (1) injected instructions persist throughout the workflow, granting attackers multiple opportunities to manipulate behavior, and (2) verbose, non-essential content degrades decision-making capabilities. Existing defenses treat bloated memory as given and focus on remaining resilient, rather than reducing unnecessary accumulation to prevent the attack.
  We present AgentSys, a framework that defends against indirect prompt injection through explicit memory management. Inspired by process memory isolation in operating systems, AgentSys organizes agents hierarchically: a main agent spawns worker agents for tool calls, each running in an isolated context and able to spawn nested workers for subtasks. External data and subtask traces never enter the main agent's memory; only schema-validated return values can cross boundaries through deterministic JSON parsing. Ablations show isolation alone cuts attack success to 2.19%, and adding a validator/sanitizer further improves defense with event-triggered checks whose overhead scales with operations rather than context length.
  On AgentDojo and ASB, AgentSys achieves 0.78% and 4.25% attack success while slightly improving benign utility over undefended baselines. It remains robust to adaptive attackers and across multiple foundation models, showing that explicit memory management enables secure, dynamic LLM agent architectures. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ruoyaow/agentsys-memory.
summary_zh:
间接提示注入通过在外部内容中嵌入恶意指令威胁LLM代理，从而实现未经授权的操作和数据窃取。LLM代理通过其上下文窗口维护工作记忆，该窗口存储交互历史以供决策。传统的代理不加区分地将所有工具输出和推理轨迹累积到这个记忆中，从而产生两个关键漏洞：（1）注入的指令在整个工作流程中持续存在，赋予攻击者多次操纵行为的机会，以及（2）冗长、非必要的内容会降低决策能力。现有的防御将膨胀的记忆视为既定事实，侧重于保持弹性，而不是减少不必要的积累来预防攻击。

我们提出了AgentSys，一个通过显式内存管理防御间接提示注入的框架。受到操作系统中进程内存隔离的启发，AgentSys以分层方式组织代理：主代理为工具调用生成工作代理，每个代理运行在隔离的上下文中，并且能够生成嵌套的工作代理来执行子任务。外部数据和子任务轨迹永远不会进入主代理的内存；只有经过模式验证的返回值才能通过确定性的JSON解析跨越边界。消融实验表明，仅隔离就能将攻击成功率降低到2.19%，而添加验证器/清理器则通过由事件触发的检查进一步改善防御，其开销随操作而非上下文长度而扩展。

在AgentDojo和ASB上，AgentSys实现了0.78%和4.25%的攻击成功率，同时略微提高了良性效用，优于未防御的基线。它对自适应攻击者和多个基础模型仍然具有鲁棒性，表明显式的内存管理能够实现安全、动态的LLM代理架构。我们的代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/ruoyaow/agentsys-memory.
tldr: The paper introduces AgentSys, a framework that utilizes explicit hierarchical memory management to defend against indirect prompt injection attacks in LLM agents by isolating agent contexts and validating data flow. It demonstrates improved security and utility compared to undefended baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AgentSys，一个通过显式分层内存管理防御LLM代理中间接提示注入攻击的框架，通过隔离代理上下文和验证数据流，相比未防御的基线，展示了改进的安全性和效用。

title: NAAMSE: Framework for Evolutionary Security Evaluation of Agents
summary: AI agents are increasingly deployed in production, yet their security evaluations remain bottlenecked by manual red-teaming or static benchmarks that fail to model adaptive, multi-turn adversaries. We propose NAAMSE, an evolutionary framework that reframes agent security evaluation as a feedback-driven optimization problem. Our system employs a single autonomous agent that orchestrates a lifecycle of genetic prompt mutation, hierarchical corpus exploration, and asymmetric behavioral scoring. By using model responses as a fitness signal, the framework iteratively compounds effective attack strategies while simultaneously ensuring "benign-use correctness", preventing the degenerate security of blanket refusal. Our experiments on Gemini 2.5 Flash demonstrate that evolutionary mutation systematically amplifies vulnerabilities missed by one-shot methods, with controlled ablations revealing that the synergy between exploration and targeted mutation uncovers high-severity failure modes. We show that this adaptive approach provides a more realistic and scalable assessment of agent robustness in the face of evolving threats. The code for NAAMSE is open source and available at https://github.com/HASHIRU-AI/NAAMSE.
summary_zh: 人工智能代理正日益部署于生产环境中，然而，它们的安全评估仍然受限于人工红队测试或静态基准，这些方法无法对自适应的、多回合的对抗模型进行建模。我们提出NAAMSE，一种将代理安全评估重新定义为反馈驱动的优化问题的进化框架。我们的系统采用单个自主代理，该代理协调基因提示变异、分层语料探索和非对称行为评分的生命周期。通过使用模型响应作为适应度信号，该框架迭代地复合有效的攻击策略，同时确保“良性使用正确性”，从而防止全面拒绝所造成的退化安全。我们在Gemini 2.5 Flash上的实验表明，进化变异能够系统地放大单次方法遗漏的漏洞，受控的消融实验揭示了探索和目标变异之间的协同作用能够发现高危失效模式。我们证明，这种自适应方法能够为不断演变的威胁面前的代理鲁棒性提供更现实和可扩展的评估。NAAMSE的代码已开源，可在https://github.com/HASHIRU-AI/NAAMSE获取。
tldr: The paper introduces NAAMSE, an evolutionary framework for automatically evaluating the security robustness of AI agents against adaptive attacks, demonstrating its effectiveness on Gemini 2.5 Flash. This framework uses genetic prompt mutation and behavioral scoring to find vulnerabilities.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为NAAMSE的进化框架，用于自动评估人工智能主体在面对自适应攻击时的安全鲁棒性。实验表明，该框架在Gemini 2.5 Flash上有效，通过遗传提示突变和行为评分来发现漏洞。

title: TermiGen: High-Fidelity Environment and Robust Trajectory Synthesis for Terminal Agents
summary: Executing complex terminal tasks remains a significant challenge for open-weight LLMs, constrained by two fundamental limitations. First, high-fidelity, executable training environments are scarce: environments synthesized from real-world repositories are not diverse and scalable, while trajectories synthesized by LLMs suffer from hallucinations. Second, standard instruction tuning uses expert trajectories that rarely exhibit simple mistakes common to smaller models. This creates a distributional mismatch, leaving student models ill-equipped to recover from their own runtime failures. To bridge these gaps, we introduce TermiGen, an end-to-end pipeline for synthesizing verifiable environments and resilient expert trajectories. Termi-Gen first generates functionally valid tasks and Docker containers via an iterative multi-agent refinement loop. Subsequently, we employ a Generator-Critic protocol that actively injects errors during trajectory collection, synthesizing data rich in error-correction cycles. Fine-tuned on this TermiGen-generated dataset, our TermiGen-Qwen2.5-Coder-32B achieves a 31.3% pass rate on TerminalBench. This establishes a new open-weights state-of-the-art, outperforming existing baselines and notably surpassing capable proprietary models such as o4-mini. Dataset is avaiable at https://github.com/ucsb-mlsec/terminal-bench-env.
summary_zh: 执行复杂的终端任务对于开放权重的大型语言模型而言仍然是一个重大挑战，这受到两个根本性限制的制约。首先，高保真、可执行的训练环境稀缺：从真实世界仓库合成的环境缺乏多样性和可扩展性，而由大型语言模型合成的轨迹则存在幻觉问题。其次，标准的指令微调使用专家轨迹，这些轨迹很少展现出小型模型常见的简单错误。 这导致了分布不匹配，使得学生模型无法很好地从其自身的运行时故障中恢复。 为了弥合这些差距，我们引入了TermiGen，一个用于合成可验证环境和具有弹性的专家轨迹的端到端流程。 TermiGen首先通过迭代的多代理精炼循环生成功能有效的任务和Docker容器。 随后，我们采用生成器-评论家协议，在轨迹收集期间主动注入错误，从而合成出富含错误修正循环的数据。 在这种由TermiGen生成的数据集上进行微调后，我们的TermiGen-Qwen2.5-Coder-32B在TerminalBench上实现了31.3%的通过率。 这确立了一个新的开放权重最先进水平，优于现有的基线，并显著超过了有能力的专有模型，如o4-mini。 数据集可在https://github.com/ucsb-mlsec/terminal-bench-env获取。
tldr: TermiGen is presented as a method for generating high-fidelity terminal environments and robust trajectories for training open-weight LLMs, improving performance on complex terminal tasks by addressing environment scarcity and distributional mismatch issues.
tldr_zh: TermiGen 是一种用于生成高保真终端环境和鲁棒轨迹的方法，用于训练开放权重的大语言模型，通过解决环境稀缺和分布不匹配的问题，从而提高其在复杂终端任务上的性能。

title: PreFlect: From Retrospective to Prospective Reflection in Large Language Model Agents
summary: Advanced large language model agents typically adopt self-reflection for improving performance, where agents iteratively analyze past actions to correct errors. However, existing reflective approaches are inherently retrospective: agents act, observe failure, and only then attempt to recover. In this work, we introduce PreFlect, a prospective reflection mechanism that shifts the paradigm from post hoc correction to pre-execution foresight by criticizing and refining agent plans before execution. To support grounded prospective reflection, we distill planning errors from historical agent trajectories, capturing recurring success and failure patterns observed across past executions. Furthermore, we complement prospective reflection with a dynamic re-planning mechanism that provides execution-time plan update in case the original plan encounters unexpected deviation. Evaluations on different benchmarks demonstrate that PreFlect significantly improves overall agent utility on complex real-world tasks, outperforming strong reflection-based baselines and several more complex agent architectures. Code will be updated at https://github.com/wwwhy725/PreFlect.
summary_zh: 高级大型语言模型智能体通常采用自我反思来提升性能，通过迭代分析过去的行动以纠正错误。然而，现有的反思方法本质上是追溯性的：智能体先行动，观察到失败，然后才尝试恢复。在这项工作中，我们引入了PreFlect，一种前瞻性反思机制，它将范式从事后纠正转变为预执行的先见之明，通过在执行前批判和改进智能体计划。为了支持基于现实的前瞻性反思，我们从历史智能体轨迹中提取规划错误，捕捉在过去执行过程中观察到的重复性成功和失败模式。此外，我们利用动态重规划机制来补充前瞻性反思，以在原始计划遇到意外偏差的情况下，提供执行时的计划更新。在不同基准测试上的评估表明，PreFlect显著提高了智能体在复杂真实世界任务中的整体效用，优于强大的基于反思的基线和几种更复杂的智能体架构。代码将在https://github.com/wwwhy725/PreFlect 上更新。
tldr: The paper introduces PreFlect, a prospective reflection mechanism for LLM agents that refines plans *before* execution by learning from past planning errors, and dynamically replans during execution if needed, showing improved performance over retrospective reflection.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了PreFlect，一种用于大型语言模型代理的前瞻性反思机制，通过学习过去的规划错误在执行*之前*改进计划，并在执行期间根据需要动态地重新规划，表现出比回顾性反思更好的性能。

title: ANCHOR: Branch-Point Data Generation for GUI Agents
summary: End-to-end GUI agents for real desktop environments require large amounts of high-quality interaction data, yet collecting human demonstrations is expensive and existing synthetic pipelines often suffer from limited task diversity or noisy, goal-drifting trajectories. We present a trajectory expansion framework Anchor that bootstraps scalable desktop supervision from a small set of verified seed demonstrations. Starting from each seed, we identify branch points that correspond to meaningful state changes and propose new, state-grounded task variants conditioned on the current GUI context. An executing agent then follows the proposed instructions to generate new trajectories, while a verifier enforces task completion via state-aware checks and trajectory-level consistency. To improve supervision quality, we further apply task-conditioned step-level filtering to remove ungrounded actions and denoise post-branch segments to maintain coherent intent. Experiments on standard desktop benchmarks, OSWorld and WindowsAgentArena, show that models fine-tuned on our expanded corpus achieve consistent improvements over zero-shot agents and representative synthesis baselines, and generalize across applications and operating systems.
summary_zh: 用于真实桌面环境的端到端GUI智能体需要大量高质量的交互数据，然而，收集人工演示成本高昂，且现有的合成流水线经常面临任务多样性受限或存在噪声、目标漂移的轨迹等问题。我们提出了一种轨迹扩展框架Anchor，其可以从一小部分经过验证的种子演示中自举生成可扩展的桌面监督数据。从每个种子开始，我们识别出与有意义的状态变化相对应的分支点，并提出基于当前GUI上下文的新的、状态关联的任务变体。执行智能体随后按照提出的指令生成新的轨迹，同时验证器通过状态感知检查和轨迹级一致性来强制执行任务完成。为了提高监督数据的质量，我们进一步应用任务条件下的步骤级过滤来移除无关联的操作，并对分支后的片段进行去噪，以保持连贯的意图。在标准桌面基准测试OSWorld和WindowsAgentArena上的实验表明，在我们的扩展语料库上进行微调的模型，相对于零样本智能体和代表性的合成基线，取得了持续的改进，并且可以跨应用程序和操作系统进行泛化。
tldr: The paper presents Anchor, a method for generating synthetic GUI interaction data by expanding from seed demonstrations, addressing the challenge of obtaining high-quality data for training GUI agents. It shows improvements in model performance on desktop benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为Anchor的方法，通过从种子演示中扩展，生成合成GUI交互数据，以解决获取高质量数据以训练GUI代理的挑战。它表明，在桌面基准测试中，模型性能得到了改进。

title: On Randomness in Agentic Evals
summary: Agentic systems are evaluated on benchmarks where agents interact with environments to solve tasks. Most papers report a pass@1 score computed from a single run per task, assuming this gives a reliable performance estimate. We test this assumption by collecting 60,000 agentic trajectories on SWE-Bench-Verified, spanning three models and two scaffolds. We find substantial variance: single-run pass@1 estimates vary by 2.2 to 6.0 percentage points depending on which run is selected, with standard deviations exceeding 1.5 percentage points even at temperature 0. This variance has critical implications: reported improvements of 2--3 percentage points may reflect evaluation noise rather than genuine algorithmic progress. Through token-level analysis, we show that trajectories diverge early, often within the first few percent of tokens, and that these small differences cascade into different solution strategies. To enable reliable evaluation of agentic systems, we recommend three concrete practices: (1) estimate pass@1 from multiple independent runs per task, especially when measuring small improvements, (2) use statistical power analysis to determine the number of runs needed to detect expected effect sizes, and (3) consider metrics like pass@k (optimistic bound) and pass^k (pessimistic bound) with k>1 to better characterize the full performance envelope. While these practices increase evaluation cost, they are essential for distinguishing genuine scientific progress from statistical noise.
summary_zh: 自主智能体系统在基准测试中根据智能体与环境交互解决任务的能力进行评估。大多数论文报告了基于每个任务单次运行计算出的 pass@1 分数，并假设这可以提供可靠的性能估计。我们通过在 SWE-Bench-Verified 上收集 60,000 条自主智能体轨迹来测试这一假设，这些轨迹涵盖三个模型和两个支架。我们发现存在显著的方差：单次运行的 pass@1 估计值变化范围在 2.2 到 6.0 个百分点之间，具体取决于选择的运行，即使在温度为 0 时标准差也超过 1.5 个百分点。这种方差具有重要的意义：报告的 2-3 个百分点的改进可能反映的是评估噪声，而不是真正的算法进步。通过令牌级别的分析，我们表明轨迹早期就已发散，通常在令牌的前几个百分点内，并且这些微小的差异会级联到不同的解决方案策略中。为了可靠地评估自主智能体系统，我们推荐三种具体做法：（1）根据每个任务的多次独立运行来估计 pass@1，尤其是在衡量微小改进时，（2）使用统计功效分析来确定检测预期效应量所需的运行次数，以及（3）考虑使用带有 k>1 的 pass@k（乐观上限）和 pass^k（悲观下限）等指标，以更好地表征完整的性能范围。虽然这些做法增加了评估成本，但它们对于区分真正的科学进步与统计噪声至关重要。
tldr: This paper investigates the randomness in agentic evaluation benchmarks and finds significant variance in pass@1 scores, suggesting that many reported improvements might be statistical noise. It recommends multiple runs, power analysis, and alternative metrics for reliable evaluation.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了Agent系统中评估基准的随机性，发现pass@1得分存在显著差异，表明许多报告的改进可能只是统计噪声。它建议进行多次运行、功效分析和使用替代指标，以实现可靠的评估。

title: InftyThink+: Effective and Efficient Infinite-Horizon Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance by scaling inference-time chain-of-thought, but this paradigm suffers from quadratic cost, context length limits, and degraded reasoning due to lost-in-the-middle effects. Iterative reasoning mitigates these issues by periodically summarizing intermediate thoughts, yet existing methods rely on supervised learning or fixed heuristics and fail to optimize when to summarize, what to preserve, and how to resume reasoning. We propose InftyThink+, an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework that optimizes the entire iterative reasoning trajectory, building on model-controlled iteration boundaries and explicit summarization. InftyThink+ adopts a two-stage training scheme with supervised cold-start followed by trajectory-level reinforcement learning, enabling the model to learn strategic summarization and continuation decisions. Experiments on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B show that InftyThink+ improves accuracy by 21% on AIME24 and outperforms conventional long chain-of-thought reinforcement learning by a clear margin, while also generalizing better to out-of-distribution benchmarks. Moreover, InftyThink+ significantly reduces inference latency and accelerates reinforcement learning training, demonstrating improved reasoning efficiency alongside stronger performance.
summary_zh: 大型推理模型通过扩展推理时思维链来实现强大的性能，但这种范式存在二次方成本、上下文长度限制以及因“迷失中间”效应而导致的推理能力下降等问题。迭代推理通过定期总结中间思想来缓解这些问题，但现有方法依赖于监督学习或固定启发式方法，并且无法优化何时总结、保留什么以及如何恢复推理。我们提出了InftyThink+，一个端到端的强化学习框架，它在模型控制的迭代边界和显式总结的基础上，优化整个迭代推理轨迹。InftyThink+采用两阶段训练方案，首先进行监督冷启动，然后进行轨迹级强化学习，使模型能够学习战略性总结和继续决策。在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B上的实验表明，InftyThink+在AIME24上将准确率提高了21%，并且明显优于传统的长思维链强化学习，同时也能更好地泛化到分布外基准。此外，InftyThink+显著降低了推理延迟并加速了强化学习训练，在提升性能的同时也提高了推理效率。
tldr: The paper introduces InftyThink+, a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes iterative reasoning in large reasoning models by learning strategic summarization and continuation decisions, demonstrating improved accuracy and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了InftyThink+，一个通过学习策略性总结和继续决策来优化大型推理模型中迭代推理的强化学习框架，展示了更高的准确性和效率。

title: Cochain Perspectives on Temporal-Difference Signals for Learning Beyond Markov Dynamics
summary: Non-Markovian dynamics are commonly found in real-world environments due to long-range dependencies, partial observability, and memory effects. The Bellman equation that is the central pillar of Reinforcement learning (RL) becomes only approximately valid under Non-Markovian. Existing work often focus on practical algorithm designs and offer limited theoretical treatment to address key questions, such as what dynamics are indeed capturable by the Bellman framework and how to inspire new algorithm classes with optimal approximations. In this paper, we present a novel topological viewpoint on temporal-difference (TD) based RL. We show that TD errors can be viewed as 1-cochain in the topological space of state transitions, while Markov dynamics are then interpreted as topological integrability. This novel view enables us to obtain a Hodge-type decomposition of TD errors into an integrable component and a topological residual, through a Bellman-de Rham projection. We further propose HodgeFlow Policy Search (HFPS) by fitting a potential network to minimize the non-integrable projection residual in RL, achieving stability/sensitivity guarantees. In numerical evaluations, HFPS is shown to significantly improve RL performance under non-Markovian.
summary_zh: 非马尔可夫动力学由于其长程依赖性、部分可观测性和记忆效应，在真实世界环境中普遍存在。作为强化学习（RL）核心支柱的贝尔曼方程在非马尔可夫条件下仅近似有效。现有工作通常侧重于实际算法设计，对解决关键问题（例如，哪些动力学能够被贝尔曼框架捕获，以及如何以最佳近似启发新的算法类别）的理论处理有限。在本文中，我们提出了一种关于基于时序差分（TD）的强化学习的新颖拓扑视角。我们证明了TD误差可以被视为状态转移拓扑空间中的1-链，而马尔可夫动力学则被解释为拓扑可积性。这种新颖的视角使我们能够通过贝尔曼-德拉姆投影，将TD误差分解为一个可积分量和一个拓扑残差。我们进一步提出通过拟合一个势网络来最小化强化学习中不可积的投影残差的HodgeFlow策略搜索（HFPS），从而实现稳定性和灵敏度保证。在数值评估中，HFPS被证明能够显著提高非马尔可夫下的强化学习性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a topological perspective on temporal-difference learning to address non-Markovian dynamics in reinforcement learning, proposing HodgeFlow Policy Search to minimize non-integrable TD error residuals.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种时序差分学习的拓扑视角，旨在解决强化学习中的非马尔可夫动力学问题，并提出了HodgeFlow策略搜索方法来最小化不可积的TD误差残差。

title: From Kepler to Newton: Inductive Biases Guide Learned World Models in Transformers
summary: Can general-purpose AI architectures go beyond prediction to discover the physical laws governing the universe? True intelligence relies on "world models" -- causal abstractions that allow an agent to not only predict future states but understand the underlying governing dynamics. While previous "AI Physicist" approaches have successfully recovered such laws, they typically rely on strong, domain-specific priors that effectively "bake in" the physics. Conversely, Vafa et al. recently showed that generic Transformers fail to acquire these world models, achieving high predictive accuracy without capturing the underlying physical laws. We bridge this gap by systematically introducing three minimal inductive biases. We show that ensuring spatial smoothness (by formulating prediction as continuous regression) and stability (by training with noisy contexts to mitigate error accumulation) enables generic Transformers to surpass prior failures and learn a coherent Keplerian world model, successfully fitting ellipses to planetary trajectories. However, true physical insight requires a third bias: temporal locality. By restricting the attention window to the immediate past -- imposing the simple assumption that future states depend only on the local state rather than a complex history -- we force the model to abandon curve-fitting and discover Newtonian force representations. Our results demonstrate that simple architectural choices determine whether an AI becomes a curve-fitter or a physicist, marking a critical step toward automated scientific discovery.
summary_zh: 通用人工智能架构能否超越预测，发现支配宇宙的物理定律？真正的智能依赖于“世界模型”—— 一种因果抽象，它不仅允许智能体预测未来状态，还能理解底层的支配力学。虽然先前的“AI物理学家”方法已成功恢复这类定律，但它们通常依赖于强大的、领域特定的先验知识，这些知识实际上“嵌入”了物理学。相反，Vafa等人最近表明，通用Transformer无法获得这些世界模型，在获得高预测精度的同时未能捕捉到潜在的物理定律。我们通过系统地引入三个最小的归纳偏置来弥合这一差距。我们证明，确保空间平滑性（通过将预测公式化为连续回归）和稳定性（通过使用噪声上下文进行训练以减轻误差累积）使通用Transformer能够超越先前的失败，并学习连贯的开普勒世界模型，成功地将椭圆拟合到行星轨迹。然而，真正的物理洞察力需要第三种偏置：时间局部性。通过将注意力窗口限制在最近的过去——强加一个简单的假设，即未来状态仅依赖于局部状态，而不是复杂的历史——我们迫使模型放弃曲线拟合，并发现牛顿力的表示。我们的结果表明，简单的架构选择决定了人工智能是成为曲线拟合者还是物理学家，标志着朝着自动科学发现迈出的关键一步。
tldr: This paper shows that Transformers can learn Newtonian physics from planetary trajectories by introducing spatial smoothness, stability, and temporal locality inductive biases, highlighting the importance of architectural choices in enabling AI to discover underlying physical laws.
tldr_zh: 本文表明，通过引入空间平滑性、稳定性和时间局部性的归纳偏置，Transformer可以从行星轨迹中学习牛顿物理学，突出了架构选择在使AI能够发现潜在物理定律方面的重要性。

title: ViCA: Efficient Multimodal LLMs with Vision-Only Cross-Attention
summary: Modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) adopt a unified self-attention design that processes visual and textual tokens at every Transformer layer, incurring substantial computational overhead. In this work, we revisit the necessity of such dense visual processing and show that projected visual embeddings are already well-aligned with the language space, while effective vision-language interaction occurs in only a small subset of layers. Based on these insights, we propose ViCA (Vision-only Cross-Attention), a minimal MLLM architecture in which visual tokens bypass all self-attention and feed-forward layers, interacting with text solely through sparse cross-attention at selected layers. Extensive evaluations across three MLLM backbones, nine multimodal benchmarks, and 26 pruning-based baselines show that ViCA preserves 98% of baseline accuracy while reducing visual-side computation to 4%, consistently achieving superior performance-efficiency trade-offs. Moreover, ViCA provides a regular, hardware-friendly inference pipeline that yields over 3.5x speedup in single-batch inference and over 10x speedup in multi-batch inference, reducing visual grounding to near-zero overhead compared with text-only LLMs. It is also orthogonal to token pruning methods and can be seamlessly combined for further efficiency gains. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/ViCA.
summary_zh: 现代多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）采用统一的自注意力设计，在每个Transformer层处理视觉和文本token，导致大量的计算开销。 本文重新审视了这种密集视觉处理的必要性，并表明投影后的视觉嵌入与语言空间已经很好地对齐，而有效的视觉-语言交互仅发生在少数几层中。 基于这些洞见，我们提出ViCA（仅视觉交叉注意力），一种极简的MLLM架构，其中视觉token绕过所有自注意力和前馈层，仅通过选定层上的稀疏交叉注意力与文本交互。 对三种MLLM骨干网络、九个多模态基准和26个基于剪枝的基线的广泛评估表明，ViCA保留了98%的基线准确率，同时将视觉侧计算量降低到4%，持续实现了卓越的性能-效率权衡。 此外，ViCA提供了一种规则的、硬件友好的推理管道，在单批次推理中实现了超过3.5倍的加速，在多批次推理中实现了超过10倍的加速，与纯文本LLM相比，将视觉基础降至接近零的开销。 它也正交于token剪枝方法，可以无缝结合以获得进一步的效率提升。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/EIT-NLP/ViCA获取。
tldr: The paper introduces ViCA, a more efficient MLLM architecture that reduces visual computation by primarily using cross-attention between visual and text tokens at specific layers, achieving significant speedups with minimal accuracy loss. This method substantially reduces the computational overhead usually associated with multi-modal models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ViCA，一种更高效的MLLM架构，通过仅在特定层使用视觉和文本token之间的交叉注意力来减少视觉计算，从而在几乎不损失准确性的情况下显著提高了速度。这种方法大大降低了与多模态模型相关的计算开销。

title: SpatialReward: Bridging the Perception Gap in Online RL for Image Editing via Explicit Spatial Reasoning
summary: Online Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers a promising avenue for complex image editing but is currently constrained by the scarcity of reliable and fine-grained reward signals. Existing evaluators frequently struggle with a critical perception gap we term "Attention Collapse," where models neglect cross-image comparisons and fail to capture fine-grained details, resulting in inaccurate perception and miscalibrated scores. To address these limitations, we propose SpatialReward, a reward model that enforces precise verification via explicit spatial reasoning. By anchoring reasoning to predicted edit regions, SpatialReward grounds semantic judgments in pixel-level evidence, significantly enhancing evaluative accuracy. Trained on a curated 260k spatial-aware dataset, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on MMRB2 and EditReward-Bench, and outperforms proprietary evaluators on our proposed MultiEditReward-Bench. Furthermore, SpatialReward serves as a robust signal in online RL, boosting OmniGen2 by +0.90 on GEdit-Bench--surpassing the leading discriminative model and doubling the gain of GPT-4.1 (+0.45). These results demonstrate that spatial reasoning is essential for unlocking effective alignment in image editing.
summary_zh: 在线强化学习（RL）为复杂的图像编辑提供了一个有前景的途径，但目前受到可靠且细粒度奖励信号稀缺的限制。现有的评估器经常面临一个我们称之为 "注意力崩溃 "的关键感知差距，即模型忽略了跨图像比较，并且无法捕捉到细粒度的细节，从而导致不准确的感知和失调的评分。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 SpatialReward，一种通过显式空间推理来强制执行精确验证的奖励模型。通过将推理锚定到预测的编辑区域，SpatialReward 将语义判断扎根于像素级的证据，从而显著提高评估准确性。我们的模型在经过精心策划的 26 万个空间感知数据集上训练后，在 MMRB2 和 EditReward-Bench 上实现了最先进的性能，并且在我们提出的 MultiEditReward-Bench 上优于专有评估器。此外，SpatialReward 作为在线 RL 中的一个稳健信号，在 GEdit-Bench 上使 OmniGen2 提升了 +0.90，超过了领先的判别模型，并且使 GPT-4.1 的增益翻倍（+0.45）。这些结果表明，空间推理对于在图像编辑中解锁有效的对齐至关重要。
tldr: The paper introduces SpatialReward, a reward model that uses explicit spatial reasoning to improve the accuracy of reward signals in online RL for image editing, demonstrating significant performance gains over existing evaluators and language models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SpatialReward，一种通过显式空间推理来提高图像编辑在线强化学习中奖励信号准确性的奖励模型，并在现有评估器和语言模型上实现了显著的性能提升。

title: Cross-View World Models
summary: World models enable agents to plan by imagining future states, but existing approaches operate from a single viewpoint, typically egocentric, even when other perspectives would make planning easier; navigation, for instance, benefits from a bird's-eye view. We introduce Cross-View World Models (XVWM), trained with a cross-view prediction objective: given a sequence of frames from one viewpoint, predict the future state from the same or a different viewpoint after an action is taken. Enforcing cross-view consistency acts as geometric regularization: because the input and output views may share little or no visual overlap, to predict across viewpoints, the model must learn view-invariant representations of the environment's 3D structure. We train on synchronized multi-view gameplay data from Aimlabs, an aim-training platform providing precisely aligned multi-camera recordings with high-frequency action labels. The resulting model gives agents parallel imagination streams across viewpoints, enabling planning in whichever frame of reference best suits the task while executing from the egocentric view. Our results show that multi-view consistency provides a strong learning signal for spatially grounded representations. Finally, predicting the consequences of one's actions from another viewpoint may offer a foundation for perspective-taking in multi-agent settings.
