In practice, deployment requirements often vary across scenarios, necessitating a single policy that can adapt zero-shot to different cost thresholds. However, most existing offline safe RL methods are trained under a pre-specified threshold, yielding policies with limited generalization and deployment flexibility across cost thresholds. Motivated by recent progress in conditional sequence modeling (CSM), which enables flexible goal-conditioned control by specifying target returns, we propose RCDT, a CSM-based method that supports zero-shot deployment across multiple cost thresholds within a single trained policy. RCDT is the first CSM-based offline safe RL algorithm that integrates a Lagrangian-style cost penalty with an auto-adaptive penalty coefficient. To avoid overly conservative behavior and achieve a more favorable return--cost trade-off, a reward--cost-aware trajectory reweighting mechanism and Q-value regularization are further incorporated. Extensive experiments on the DSRL benchmark demonstrate that RCDT consistently improves return--cost trade-offs over representative baselines, advancing the state-of-the-art in offline safe RL.
summary_zh: 离线安全强化学习（RL）旨在从固定数据集中学习策略，同时在累积成本约束下最大化性能。在实践中，部署需求通常因场景而异，因此需要一种能够零样本适应不同成本阈值的单一策略。然而，大多数现有的离线安全RL方法都是在预先指定的阈值下训练的，导致策略在不同成本阈值下的泛化和部署灵活性受到限制。受到条件序列建模（CSM）最新进展的启发，CSM通过指定目标回报来实现灵活的目标条件控制，我们提出了RCDT，这是一种基于CSM的方法，它支持单个训练策略在多个成本阈值下的零样本部署。RCDT是第一个基于CSM的离线安全RL算法，它结合了拉格朗日风格的成本惩罚和一个自适应的惩罚系数。为了避免过于保守的行为并实现更有利的回报-成本权衡，我们进一步集成了一个奖励-成本感知的轨迹重加权机制和Q值正则化。在DSRL基准上的大量实验表明，RCDT始终优于代表性基线，从而改进了离线安全RL的最新技术水平，并在回报-成本权衡方面取得了进步。
tldr: The paper introduces RCDT, a Conditional Sequence Modeling (CSM)-based offline safe RL algorithm that adapts to varying cost thresholds zero-shot by incorporating a Lagrangian cost penalty, trajectory reweighting, and Q-value regularization to improve return-cost trade-offs.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为RCDT的基于条件序列建模（CSM）的离线安全强化学习算法，通过结合拉格朗日成本惩罚、轨迹重加权和Q值正则化，实现对不同成本阈值的零样本适应，从而改善回报-成本的权衡。

title: Beyond Correctness: Learning Robust Reasoning via Transfer
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has recently strengthened LLM reasoning, but its focus on final answer correctness leaves a critical gap: it does not ensure the robustness of the reasoning process itself. We adopt a simple philosophical view, robust reasoning should remain useful beyond the mind that produced it, and treat reasoning as a form of meaning transfer that must survive truncation, reinterpretation, and continuation. Building on this principle, we introduce Reinforcement Learning with Transferable Reward (RLTR), which operationalizes robustness via transfer reward that tests whether a partial reasoning prefix from one model can guide a separate model to the correct answer. This encourages LLMs to produce reasoning that is stable, interpretable, and genuinely generalizable. Our approach improves sampling consistency while improving final answer accuracy, and it reaches comparable performance in substantially fewer training steps. For example, on MATH500, RLTR achieves a +3.6%p gain in Maj@64 compared to RLVR and matches RLVR's average accuracy with roughly 2.5x fewer training steps, providing both more reliable reasoning and significantly more sample efficient.
summary_zh: 经验证奖励的强化学习 (RLVR) 近期提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但其关注点在于最终答案的正确性，这留下了一个关键缺口：它无法确保推理过程本身的稳健性。我们采纳了一种简单的哲学观点，即稳健的推理应该在产生它的心智之外仍然有用，并将推理视为一种必须经受截断、重新解释和延续的意义传递形式。基于此原则，我们引入了可转移奖励的强化学习 (RLTR)，它通过转移奖励来实现稳健性，该转移奖励测试一个模型的局部推理前缀是否能够引导另一个独立的模型获得正确的答案。这鼓励大语言模型产生稳定、可解释且真正可泛化的推理。我们的方法在提高最终答案准确率的同时，也提高了采样一致性，并以明显更少的训练步数达到了相当的性能。例如，在 MATH500 上，与 RLVR 相比，RLTR 在 Maj@64 上实现了 +3.6 个百分点的增益，并以大约 2.5 倍更少的训练步数达到了 RLVR 的平均准确率，从而提供了更可靠的推理和显著更高的样本效率。
tldr: The paper introduces Reinforcement Learning with Transferable Reward (RLTR), a method to improve the robustness of LLM reasoning by ensuring that partial reasoning prefixes can guide other models to the correct answer, leading to more stable, interpretable, and generalizable reasoning with improved sample efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了具有可迁移奖励的强化学习 (RLTR)，这是一种通过确保部分推理前缀可以引导其他模型获得正确答案来提高 LLM 推理鲁棒性的方法，从而产生更稳定、可解释和可泛化的推理，并提高样本效率。

title: SkillRL: Evolving Agents via Recursive Skill-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown stunning results in complex tasks, yet they often operate in isolation, failing to learn from past experiences. Existing memory-based methods primarily store raw trajectories, which are often redundant and noise-heavy. This prevents agents from extracting high-level, reusable behavioral patterns that are essential for generalization. In this paper, we propose SkillRL, a framework that bridges the gap between raw experience and policy improvement through automatic skill discovery and recursive evolution. Our approach introduces an experience-based distillation mechanism to build a hierarchical skill library SkillBank, an adaptive retrieval strategy for general and task-specific heuristics, and a recursive evolution mechanism that allows the skill library to co-evolve with the agent's policy during reinforcement learning. These innovations significantly reduce the token footprint while enhancing reasoning utility. Experimental results on ALFWorld, WebShop and seven search-augmented tasks demonstrate that SkillRL achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming strong baselines over 15.3% and maintaining robustness as task complexity increases. Code is available at this https://github.com/aiming-lab/SkillRL.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在复杂任务中展现出令人惊叹的成果，但它们通常独立运行，无法从过往经验中学习。现有的基于记忆的方法主要存储原始轨迹，这些轨迹通常冗余且噪声较大。这阻碍了智能体提取高层次、可重用的行为模式，而这些模式对于泛化至关重要。在本文中，我们提出SkillRL，一个通过自动技能发现和递归演化来弥合原始经验和策略改进之间差距的框架。我们的方法引入了一种基于经验的提炼机制来构建一个分层技能库SkillBank，一种用于通用和特定任务启发式的自适应检索策略，以及一种允许技能库在强化学习期间与智能体策略协同演化的递归演化机制。这些创新显著减少了token占用空间，同时增强了推理效用。在ALFWorld、WebShop和七个搜索增强任务上的实验结果表明，SkillRL实现了最先进的性能，超越了强基线15.3%以上，并且在任务复杂度增加时保持了鲁棒性。代码可在 https://github.com/aiming-lab/SkillRL 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces SkillRL, a framework that uses skill discovery and recursive evolution to improve LLM agent performance by building a hierarchical skill library and co-evolving it with the agent's policy, demonstrating state-of-the-art results on several tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SkillRL，一个通过技能发现和递归演化来提升LLM Agent性能的框架。它通过构建分层技能库并使其与Agent策略共同演化，在多个任务上展示了最先进的结果。

title: Modeling 3D Pedestrian-Vehicle Interactions for Vehicle-Conditioned Pose Forecasting
summary: Accurately predicting pedestrian motion is crucial for safe and reliable autonomous driving in complex urban environments. In this work, we present a 3D vehicle-conditioned pedestrian pose forecasting framework that explicitly incorporates surrounding vehicle information. To support this, we enhance the Waymo-3DSkelMo dataset with aligned 3D vehicle bounding boxes, enabling realistic modeling of multi-agent pedestrian-vehicle interactions. We introduce a sampling scheme to categorize scenes by pedestrian and vehicle count, facilitating training across varying interaction complexities. Our proposed network adapts the TBIFormer architecture with a dedicated vehicle encoder and pedestrian-vehicle interaction cross-attention module to fuse pedestrian and vehicle features, allowing predictions to be conditioned on both historical pedestrian motion and surrounding vehicles. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial improvements in forecasting accuracy and validate different approaches for modeling pedestrian-vehicle interactions, highlighting the importance of vehicle-aware 3D pose prediction for autonomous driving. Code is available at: https://github.com/GuangxunZhu/VehCondPose3D
summary_zh: 精确预测行人运动对于在复杂城市环境中实现安全可靠的自动驾驶至关重要。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个以3D车辆为条件的行人姿态预测框架，该框架明确地整合了周围车辆的信息。为了支持这一点，我们通过对齐的3D车辆边界框增强了Waymo-3DSkelMo数据集，从而能够对多智能体行人-车辆交互进行逼真建模。我们引入了一种采样方案，通过行人和车辆数量对场景进行分类，从而促进了跨不同交互复杂性的训练。我们提出的网络采用了TBIFormer架构，并具有专用的车辆编码器和行人-车辆交互跨注意力模块，以融合行人和车辆特征，从而使预测能够以历史行人运动和周围车辆为条件。大量的实验表明，预测准确性得到了显著提高，并验证了用于建模行人-车辆交互的不同方法，突出了车辆感知的3D姿态预测对于自动驾驶的重要性。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/GuangxunZhu/VehCondPose3D
tldr: This paper presents a 3D vehicle-conditioned pedestrian pose forecasting framework using a modified TBIFormer architecture and a new dataset enhancement for pedestrian-vehicle interactions, demonstrating improved forecasting accuracy for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于3D车辆条件下的行人姿态预测框架，使用改进的TBIFormer架构，并增强了一个新的数据集，用于行人与车辆的交互，展示了自动驾驶中预测准确性的提高。

title: Legs Over Arms: On the Predictive Value of Lower-Body Pose for Human Trajectory Prediction from Egocentric Robot Perception
summary: Predicting human trajectory is crucial for social robot navigation in crowded environments. While most existing approaches treat human as point mass, we present a study on multi-agent trajectory prediction that leverages different human skeletal features for improved forecast accuracy. In particular, we systematically evaluate the predictive utility of 2D and 3D skeletal keypoints and derived biomechanical cues as additional inputs. Through a comprehensive study on the JRDB dataset and another new dataset for social navigation with 360-degree panoramic videos, we find that focusing on lower-body 3D keypoints yields a 13% reduction in Average Displacement Error and augmenting 3D keypoint inputs with corresponding biomechanical cues provides a further 1-4% improvement. Notably, the performance gain persists when using 2D keypoint inputs extracted from equirectangular panoramic images, indicating that monocular surround vision can capture informative cues for motion forecasting. Our finding that robots can forecast human movement efficiently by watching their legs provides actionable insights for designing sensing capabilities for social robot navigation.
summary_zh: 预测人类轨迹对于拥挤环境中的社交机器人导航至关重要。虽然现有的大多数方法将人类视为质点，但我们提出了一项关于多智能体轨迹预测的研究，该研究利用不同的人体骨骼特征来提高预测精度。具体而言，我们系统地评估了二维和三维骨骼关键点以及导出的生物力学线索作为额外输入的预测效用。通过对 JRDB 数据集和另一个包含 360 度全景视频的社交导航新型数据集的全面研究，我们发现关注下半身三维关键点可使平均位移误差降低 13%，并且通过相应的生物力学线索增强三维关键点输入可进一步提高 1-4%。值得注意的是，当使用从等距柱状投影全景图像中提取的二维关键点输入时，性能增益仍然存在，表明单目环视可以捕获用于运动预测的信息线索。我们发现机器人可以通过观察人类腿部来有效地预测其运动，这为设计社交机器人导航的感知能力提供了可操作的见解。
tldr: This paper investigates the predictive power of lower-body skeletal features for human trajectory prediction in social robot navigation, finding 3D lower-body keypoints and biomechanical cues most effective using both standard and 360-degree panoramic imagery.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了下半身骨骼特征对社交机器人导航中人体轨迹预测的预测能力， 发现在标准图像和360度全景图像中使用3D下半身关键点和生物力学线索最有效。

title: GaussianCaR: Gaussian Splatting for Efficient Camera-Radar Fusion
summary: Robust and accurate perception of dynamic objects and map elements is crucial for autonomous vehicles performing safe navigation in complex traffic scenarios. While vision-only methods have become the de facto standard due to their technical advances, they can benefit from effective and cost-efficient fusion with radar measurements. In this work, we advance fusion methods by repurposing Gaussian Splatting as an efficient universal view transformer that bridges the view disparity gap, mapping both image pixels and radar points into a common Bird's-Eye View (BEV) representation. Our main contribution is GaussianCaR, an end-to-end network for BEV segmentation that, unlike prior BEV fusion methods, leverages Gaussian Splatting to map raw sensor information into latent features for efficient camera-radar fusion. Our architecture combines multi-scale fusion with a transformer decoder to efficiently extract BEV features. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves performance on par with, or even surpassing, the state of the art on BEV segmentation tasks (57.3%, 82.9%, and 50.1% IoU for vehicles, roads, and lane dividers) on the nuScenes dataset, while maintaining a 3.2x faster inference runtime. Code and project page are available online.
summary_zh: 对动态物体和地图元素的稳健且精确的感知对于自动驾驶车辆在复杂交通场景中安全导航至关重要。尽管纯视觉方法由于其技术进步已成为事实标准，但它们可以受益于与雷达测量有效且经济高效的融合。在这项工作中，我们通过重新调整高斯溅射作为一种高效的通用视角转换器来弥合视角差异，将图像像素和雷达点都映射到共同的鸟瞰图(BEV)表示中，从而推进融合方法。 我们的主要贡献是GaussianCaR，一种用于BEV分割的端到端网络，与先前的BEV融合方法不同，它利用高斯溅射将原始传感器信息映射到潜在特征，以实现高效的相机-雷达融合。 我们的架构将多尺度融合与Transformer解码器相结合，以高效地提取BEV特征。 实验结果表明，我们的方法在nuScenes数据集上，在BEV分割任务中实现了与最先进技术相当甚至超越的性能（车辆、道路和车道分隔线的IoU分别为57.3%、82.9%和50.1%），同时保持了3.2倍的更快推理运行时间。 代码和项目主页已在线提供。
tldr: The paper introduces GaussianCaR, a novel camera-radar fusion method leveraging Gaussian Splatting for efficient Bird's-Eye View (BEV) segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art performance with faster inference.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 GaussianCaR，一种新颖的相机-雷达融合方法，利用高斯溅射进行高效的鸟瞰图 (BEV) 分割，实现了最先进的性能和更快的推理速度。

title: Mind the Gap: Learning Implicit Impedance in Visuomotor Policies via Intent-Execution Mismatch
summary: Teleoperation inherently relies on the human operator acting as a closed-loop controller to actively compensate for hardware imperfections, including latency, mechanical friction, and lack of explicit force feedback. Standard Behavior Cloning (BC), by mimicking the robot's executed trajectory, fundamentally ignores this compensatory mechanism. In this work, we propose a Dual-State Conditioning framework that shifts the learning objective to "Intent Cloning" (master command). We posit that the Intent-Execution Mismatch, the discrepancy between master command and slave response, is not noise, but a critical signal that physically encodes implicit interaction forces and algorithmically reveals the operator's strategy for overcoming system dynamics. By predicting the master intent, our policy learns to generate a "virtual equilibrium point", effectively realizing implicit impedance control. Furthermore, by explicitly conditioning on the history of this mismatch, the model performs implicit system identification, perceiving tracking errors as external forces to close the control loop. To bridge the temporal gap caused by inference latency, we further formulate the policy as a trajectory inpainter to ensure continuous control. We validate our approach on a sensorless, low-cost bi-manual setup. Empirical results across tasks requiring contact-rich manipulation and dynamic tracking reveal a decisive gap: while standard execution-cloning fails due to the inability to overcome contact stiffness and tracking lag, our mismatch-aware approach achieves robust success. This presents a minimalist behavior cloning framework for low-cost hardware, enabling force perception and dynamic compensation without relying on explicit force sensing. Videos are available on the \href{https://xucj98.github.io/mind-the-gap-page/}{project page}.
summary_zh: 遥操作本质上依赖于人类操作员作为闭环控制器来主动补偿硬件的缺陷，包括延迟、机械摩擦和缺乏明确的力反馈。标准的行为克隆（BC）通过模仿机器人执行的轨迹，从根本上忽略了这种补偿机制。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种双状态条件框架，将学习目标转移到“意图克隆”（主控指令）。我们认为，意图-执行不匹配，即主控指令和从动响应之间的差异，不是噪声，而是一个关键信号，它在物理上编码了隐式的交互力，并在算法上揭示了操作员克服系统动力学的策略。通过预测主控意图，我们的策略学习生成一个“虚拟平衡点”，有效地实现了隐式阻抗控制。此外，通过显式地以这种不匹配的历史为条件，该模型执行隐式系统识别，将跟踪误差感知为外部力，从而闭合控制环路。为了弥合推理延迟引起的时间差距，我们进一步将策略表述为一种轨迹修复器，以确保连续控制。我们在一个无传感器、低成本的双手动控制装置上验证了我们的方法。需要密集接触操作和动态跟踪的任务中的经验结果揭示了一个决定性的差距：虽然标准执行克隆由于无法克服接触刚度和跟踪滞后而失败，但我们感知不匹配的方法实现了稳健的成功。这为低成本硬件提供了一个极简的行为克隆框架，无需依赖显式的力传感即可实现力感知和动态补偿。视频可在\href{https://xucj98.github.io/mind-the-gap-page/}{项目页面}上找到。
tldr: The paper proposes a 'Dual-State Conditioning' framework for behavior cloning that learns implicit impedance control by leveraging the 'Intent-Execution Mismatch' between master commands and robot response, enabling robust manipulation on low-cost hardware without force sensors.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于行为克隆的“双状态条件”框架，通过利用主控指令和机器人响应之间的“意图-执行不匹配”来学习隐式阻抗控制，从而在低成本硬件上实现稳健的操作，而无需力传感器。

title: Head-to-Head autonomous racing at the limits of handling in the A2RL challenge
summary: Autonomous racing presents a complex challenge involving multi-agent interactions between vehicles operating at the limit of performance and dynamics. As such, it provides a valuable research and testing environment for advancing autonomous driving technology and improving road safety. This article presents the algorithms and deployment strategies developed by the TUM Autonomous Motorsport team for the inaugural Abu Dhabi Autonomous Racing League (A2RL). We showcase how our software emulates human driving behavior, pushing the limits of vehicle handling and multi-vehicle interactions to win the A2RL. Finally, we highlight the key enablers of our success and share our most significant learnings.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶赛车带来了一项复杂挑战，涉及在性能和动力学极限下运行的车辆之间的多智能体交互。因此，它为推进自动驾驶技术和提高道路安全提供了一个有价值的研究和测试环境。本文介绍了慕尼黑工业大学自动驾驶赛车队（TUM Autonomous Motorsport team）为首届阿布扎比自动驾驶赛车联盟（A2RL）开发的算法和部署策略。我们展示了我们的软件如何模拟人类驾驶行为，突破车辆操控和多车辆交互的极限，最终赢得A2RL冠军。最后，我们重点介绍了我们成功的关键因素，并分享了我们最重要的经验教训。
tldr: This paper describes the algorithms and deployment strategies used by the TUM Autonomous Motorsport team to win the Abu Dhabi Autonomous Racing League (A2RL), focusing on pushing the limits of vehicle handling and multi-vehicle interactions.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了慕尼黑工业大学自动赛车队在阿布扎比自动赛车联盟（A2RL）比赛中获胜所使用的算法和部署策略，重点在于突破车辆操控极限和多车辆交互。

title: UAV-Supported Maritime Search System: Experience from Valun Bay Field Trials
summary: This paper presents the integration of flow field reconstruction, dynamic probabilistic modeling, search control, and machine vision detection in a system for autonomous maritime search operations. Field experiments conducted in Valun Bay (Cres Island, Croatia) involved real-time drifter data acquisition, surrogate flow model fitting based on computational fluid dynamics and numerical optimization, advanced multi-UAV search control and vision sensing, as well as deep learning-based object detection. The results demonstrate that a tightly coupled approach enables reliable detection of floating targets under realistic uncertainties and complex environmental conditions, providing concrete insights for future autonomous maritime search and rescue applications.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于自主海上搜索行动的系统，该系统集成了流场重构、动态概率建模、搜索控制和机器视觉检测。在瓦伦湾（克罗地亚克雷斯岛）进行的实地实验包括实时漂流器数据采集、基于计算流体动力学和数值优化的代理流动模型拟合、先进的多无人机搜索控制和视觉感知，以及基于深度学习的目标检测。结果表明，紧密耦合的方法能够在真实的不确定性和复杂的环境条件下可靠地检测漂浮目标，为未来的自主海上搜索和救援应用提供具体的见解。
tldr: This paper presents an integrated UAV-based maritime search system using flow field reconstruction, probabilistic modeling, search control, and machine vision, validated through field trials for floating target detection under realistic conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种集成了流场重建、概率建模、搜索控制和机器视觉的无人机海上搜索系统，并通过现场试验验证了在真实条件下检测漂浮目标的能力。

title: Learning Human-Like Badminton Skills for Humanoid Robots
summary: Realizing versatile and human-like performance in high-demand sports like badminton remains a formidable challenge for humanoid robotics. Unlike standard locomotion or static manipulation, this task demands a seamless integration of explosive whole-body coordination and precise, timing-critical interception. While recent advances have achieved lifelike motion mimicry, bridging the gap between kinematic imitation and functional, physics-aware striking without compromising stylistic naturalness is non-trivial. To address this, we propose Imitation-to-Interaction, a progressive reinforcement learning framework designed to evolve a robot from a "mimic" to a capable "striker." Our approach establishes a robust motor prior from human data, distills it into a compact, model-based state representation, and stabilizes dynamics via adversarial priors. Crucially, to overcome the sparsity of expert demonstrations, we introduce a manifold expansion strategy that generalizes discrete strike points into a dense interaction volume. We validate our framework through the mastery of diverse skills, including lifts and drop shots, in simulation. Furthermore, we demonstrate the first zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of anthropomorphic badminton skills to a humanoid robot, successfully replicating the kinetic elegance and functional precision of human athletes in the physical world.
summary_zh: 在羽毛球等高要求体育运动中，实现通用且类人的性能仍然是人形机器人面临的巨大挑战。与标准的移动或静态操作不同，该任务需要对爆发性的全身协调和精确的、时间关键型的拦截进行无缝整合。虽然最近的进展已经实现了逼真的动作模仿，但在不影响文体自然性的前提下，弥合运动学模仿和功能性的、物理感知的击球之间的差距并非易事。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了模仿到交互（Imitation-to-Interaction），一个渐进式的强化学习框架，旨在将机器人从“模仿者”进化为有能力的“击球手”。我们的方法从人类数据中建立一个鲁棒的运动先验，将其提炼成一个紧凑的、基于模型的状态表示，并通过对抗先验来稳定动力学。至关重要的是，为了克服专家演示的稀疏性，我们引入了一种流形扩展策略，将离散的击球点推广为密集的交互体积。我们通过精通多种技能（包括挑球和放网）在仿真中验证了我们的框架。此外，我们展示了拟人化羽毛球技能首次的零样本sim-to-real迁移到人形机器人，成功地在物理世界中复制了人类运动员的动力学优雅和功能精度。
tldr: This paper introduces an Imitation-to-Interaction reinforcement learning framework for humanoid robots to master badminton skills, demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and achieving human-like performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个模仿到交互的强化学习框架，使人形机器人能够掌握羽毛球技能，展示了零样本的模拟到现实的迁移，并实现了类似人类的性能。

title: Controlled Flight of an Insect-Scale Flapping-Wing Robot via Integrated Onboard Sensing and Computation
summary: Aerial insects can effortlessly navigate dense vegetation, whereas similarly sized aerial robots typically depend on offboard sensors and computation to maintain stable flight. This disparity restricts insect-scale robots to operation within motion capture environments, substantially limiting their applicability to tasks such as search-and-rescue and precision agriculture. In this work, we present a 1.29-gram aerial robot capable of hovering and tracking trajectories with solely onboard sensing and computation. The combination of a sensor suite, estimators, and a low-level controller achieved centimeter-scale positional flight accuracy. Additionally, we developed a hierarchical controller in which a human operator provides high-level commands to direct the robot's motion. In a 30-second flight experiment conducted outside a motion capture system, the robot avoided obstacles and ultimately landed on a sunflower. This level of sensing and computational autonomy represents a significant advancement for the aerial microrobotics community, further opening opportunities to explore onboard planning and power autonomy.
summary_zh: 空中昆虫可以毫不费力地在茂密的植被中导航，而同样大小的空中机器人通常依赖于离线传感器和计算来维持稳定的飞行。这种差异限制了昆虫级机器人在运动捕捉环境中运行，大大限制了它们在搜索救援和精准农业等任务中的适用性。在这项工作中，我们展示了一种重1.29克的空中机器人，该机器人仅依靠机载传感和计算即可实现悬停和轨迹跟踪。传感器套件、估计器和低层控制器的结合实现了厘米级的定位飞行精度。此外，我们开发了一种分层控制器，其中人类操作员提供高层指令来指导机器人的运动。在一项于运动捕捉系统之外进行的30秒飞行实验中，该机器人避开了障碍物并最终降落在向日葵上。这种传感和计算自主性代表了空中微型机器人领域的一项重大进步，进一步开启了探索机载规划和电源自主性的机会。
tldr: This paper presents a 1.29-gram insect-scale robot capable of autonomous flight via onboard sensing and computation, demonstrating centimeter-scale accuracy and obstacle avoidance, marking a significant advancement for microrobotics.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种1.29克的昆虫级机器人，它可以通过板载传感和计算实现自主飞行，展示了厘米级的精度和避障能力，标志着微型机器人技术的重大进步。

title: Benchmarking Autonomous Vehicles: A Driver Foundation Model Framework
summary: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) are poised to revolutionize global transportation systems. However, its widespread acceptance and market penetration remain significantly below expectations. This gap is primarily driven by persistent challenges in safety, comfort, commuting efficiency and energy economy when compared to the performance of experienced human drivers. We hypothesize that these challenges can be addressed through the development of a driver foundation model (DFM). Accordingly, we propose a framework for establishing DFMs to comprehensively benchmark AVs. Specifically, we describe a large-scale dataset collection strategy for training a DFM, discuss the core functionalities such a model should possess, and explore potential technical solutions to realize these functionalities. We further present the utility of the DFM across the operational spectrum, from defining human-centric safety envelopes to establishing benchmarks for energy economy. Overall, We aim to formalize the DFM concept and introduce a new paradigm for the systematic specification, verification and validation of AVs.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶汽车（AVs）有望彻底改变全球交通运输系统。然而，其广泛接受度和市场渗透率仍远低于预期。造成这种差距的主要原因是，与经验丰富的人类驾驶员相比，自动驾驶汽车在安全性、舒适性、通勤效率和能源经济性方面仍面临持续挑战。我们假设可以通过开发驾驶员基础模型（DFM）来解决这些挑战。因此，我们提出了一个建立DFM的框架，以全面评估自动驾驶汽车的性能。具体来说，我们描述了一种用于训练DFM的大规模数据集收集策略，讨论了此类模型应具备的核心功能，并探讨了实现这些功能的潜在技术解决方案。我们进一步展示了DFM在整个运行范围内的效用，从定义以人为本的安全范围到建立能源经济性基准。总而言之，我们的目标是正式确立DFM的概念，并为自动驾驶汽车的系统规范、验证和确认引入一种新的范例。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework for benchmarking autonomous vehicles using a Driver Foundation Model (DFM) trained on a large-scale dataset, aiming to address challenges in safety, comfort, efficiency, and energy economy compared to human drivers.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个使用驾驶员基础模型（DFM）来评估自动驾驶汽车性能的框架。该框架基于大型数据集训练DFM，旨在解决自动驾驶汽车在安全性、舒适性、效率和节能方面与人类驾驶员相比存在的挑战。

title: Informative Object-centric Next Best View for Object-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting in Cluttered Scenes
summary: In cluttered scenes with inevitable occlusions and incomplete observations, selecting informative viewpoints is essential for building a reliable representation. In this context, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offers a distinct advantage, as it can explicitly guide the selection of subsequent viewpoints and then refine the representation with new observations. However, existing approaches rely solely on geometric cues, neglect manipulation-relevant semantics, and tend to prioritize exploitation over exploration. To tackle these limitations, we introduce an instance-aware Next Best View (NBV) policy that prioritizes underexplored regions by leveraging object features. Specifically, our object-aware 3DGS distills instancelevel information into one-hot object vectors, which are used to compute confidence-weighted information gain that guides the identification of regions associated with erroneous and uncertain Gaussians. Furthermore, our method can be easily adapted to an object-centric NBV, which focuses view selection on a target object, thereby improving reconstruction robustness to object placement. Experiments demonstrate that our NBV policy reduces depth error by up to 77.14% on the synthetic dataset and 34.10% on the real-world GraspNet dataset compared to baselines. Moreover, compared to targeting the entire scene, performing NBV on a specific object yields an additional reduction of 25.60% in depth error for that object. We further validate the effectiveness of our approach through real-world robotic manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 在充满遮挡和不完整观测的复杂场景中，选择信息丰富的视点对于构建可靠的表示至关重要。在此背景下，3D高斯溅射（3DGS）提供了一个独特的优势，因为它能够明确地引导后续视点的选择，然后利用新的观测细化表示。然而，现有方法仅依赖于几何线索，忽略了与操作相关的语义信息，并且倾向于过度利用而非探索。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种实例感知的下一个最佳视点（NBV）策略，该策略通过利用对象特征来优先考虑未充分探索的区域。具体来说，我们的对象感知3DGS将实例级信息提炼成独热对象向量，这些向量用于计算置信度加权的信息增益，从而指导识别与错误和不确定高斯相关的区域。此外，我们的方法可以很容易地适应以对象为中心的NBV，将视点选择集中在目标对象上，从而提高重建对对象放置的鲁棒性。实验表明，与基线方法相比，我们的NBV策略在合成数据集上减少了高达77.14%的深度误差，在真实世界的GraspNet数据集上减少了34.10%的深度误差。此外，与针对整个场景相比，对特定对象执行NBV可以使该对象的深度误差进一步减少25.60%。我们还通过真实的机器人操作任务验证了我们方法的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces an object-aware Next Best View (NBV) policy for 3D Gaussian Splatting in cluttered scenes, leveraging instance-level information to prioritize underexplored regions and improve object reconstruction, demonstrating significant depth error reduction in both synthetic and real-world datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向杂乱场景中三维高斯溅射的、目标感知的最佳视角选择策略（NBV）。该策略利用实例级别的信息来优先探索未充分探索的区域，并改进目标重建，在合成数据集和真实世界数据集中均显著降低了深度误差。

title: Aerial Manipulation with Contact-Aware Onboard Perception and Hybrid Control
summary: Aerial manipulation (AM) promises to move Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) beyond passive inspection to contact-rich tasks such as grasping, assembly, and in-situ maintenance. Most prior AM demonstrations rely on external motion capture (MoCap) and emphasize position control for coarse interactions, limiting deployability. We present a fully onboard perception-control pipeline for contact-rich AM that achieves accurate motion tracking and regulated contact wrenches without MoCap. The main components are (1) an augmented visual-inertial odometry (VIO) estimator with contact-consistency factors that activate only during interaction, tightening uncertainty around the contact frame and reducing drift, and (2) image-based visual servoing (IBVS) to mitigate perception-control coupling, together with a hybrid force-motion controller that regulates contact wrenches and lateral motion for stable contact. Experiments show that our approach closes the perception-to-wrench loop using only onboard sensing, yielding an velocity estimation improvement of 66.01% at contact, reliable target approach, and stable force holding-pointing toward deployable, in-the-wild aerial manipulation.
summary_zh: 空中操作(AM)有望推动无人机(UAV)超越被动检查，进入诸如抓取、装配和原位维护等富含接触的任务领域。 大多数先前的空中操作演示依赖于外部运动捕捉(MoCap)系统，并侧重于位置控制以进行粗略交互，从而限制了可部署性。 我们提出了一种完全基于机载感知-控制的管道，用于富含接触的空中操作，该管道可在没有MoCap的情况下实现精确的运动跟踪和受控的接触力/力矩。 其中主要组成部分包括：（1）一种增强型的视觉惯性里程计(VIO)估算器，具有仅在交互期间激活的接触一致性因子，从而收紧围绕接触坐标系的未知性并减少漂移；（2）基于图像的视觉伺服(IBVS)，以减轻感知与控制的耦合，以及一个混合力/运动控制器，用于调节接触力/力矩和横向运动，以实现稳定的接触。实验表明，我们的方法仅使用机载传感即可闭环感知到力/力矩，在接触时速度估计的性能提升了66.01%，实现了可靠的目标接近，并保持了稳定的力控制，这指向了可部署的、野外空中操作。
tldr: This paper presents a fully onboard perception-control pipeline for aerial manipulation that achieves accurate motion tracking and regulated contact wrenches without external motion capture, using augmented VIO and image-based visual servoing with hybrid force-motion control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于空中操作的全板载感知控制流程，该流程无需外部运动捕捉即可实现精确的运动跟踪和可调节的接触扳手，使用了增强的视觉惯性里程计（VIO）和基于图像的视觉伺服与混合力-运动控制。

title: Chamelion: Reliable Change Detection for Long-Term LiDAR Mapping in Transient Environments
summary: Online change detection is crucial for mobile robots to efficiently navigate through dynamic environments. Detecting changes in transient settings, such as active construction sites or frequently reconfigured indoor spaces, is particularly challenging due to frequent occlusions and spatiotemporal variations. Existing approaches often struggle to detect changes and fail to update the map across different observations. To address these limitations, we propose a dual-head network designed for online change detection and long-term map maintenance. A key difficulty in this task is the collection and alignment of real-world data, as manually registering structural differences over time is both labor-intensive and often impractical. To overcome this, we develop a data augmentation strategy that synthesizes structural changes by importing elements from different scenes, enabling effective model training without the need for extensive ground-truth annotations. Experiments conducted at real-world construction sites and in indoor office environments demonstrate that our approach generalizes well across diverse scenarios, achieving efficient and accurate map updates.\resubmit{Our source code and additional material are available at: https://chamelion-pages.github.io/.
summary_zh: 在线变化检测对于移动机器人在动态环境中高效导航至关重要。在瞬态环境中检测变化，例如活跃的建筑工地或频繁重新配置的室内空间，由于频繁的遮挡和时空变化而特别具有挑战性。现有方法常常难以检测变化，并且无法在不同观测结果之间更新地图。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种双头网络，专门用于在线变化检测和长期地图维护。此任务的一个关键难点是真实世界数据的收集和对齐，因为手动注册随时间推移的结构差异既费力又不切实际。为了克服这个问题，我们开发了一种数据增强策略，通过导入不同场景的元素来合成结构变化，从而无需大量的地面真实标注即可实现有效的模型训练。在真实建筑工地和室内办公环境中进行的实验表明，我们的方法在各种场景中都能很好地泛化，从而实现高效且准确的地图更新。\resubmit{我们的源代码和附加材料可在以下网址获得：https://chamelion-pages.github.io/.
tldr: The paper introduces a dual-head network and data augmentation strategy for online change detection and long-term LiDAR mapping in dynamic environments, demonstrating strong generalization in real-world settings.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种双头网络和数据增强策略，用于动态环境中在线变化检测和长期激光雷达地图构建，并在现实场景中表现出良好的泛化能力。

title: MotionCrafter: Dense Geometry and Motion Reconstruction with a 4D VAE
summary: We introduce MotionCrafter, a video diffusion-based framework that jointly reconstructs 4D geometry and estimates dense motion from a monocular video. The core of our method is a novel joint representation of dense 3D point maps and 3D scene flows in a shared coordinate system, and a novel 4D VAE to effectively learn this representation. Unlike prior work that forces the 3D value and latents to align strictly with RGB VAE latents-despite their fundamentally different distributions-we show that such alignment is unnecessary and leads to suboptimal performance. Instead, we introduce a new data normalization and VAE training strategy that better transfers diffusion priors and greatly improves reconstruction quality. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that MotionCrafter achieves state-of-the-art performance in both geometry reconstruction and dense scene flow estimation, delivering 38.64% and 25.0% improvements in geometry and motion reconstruction, respectively, all without any post-optimization. Project page: https://ruijiezhu94.github.io/MotionCrafter_Page
summary_zh: 我们提出了MotionCrafter，一个基于视频扩散的框架，用于联合重建单目视频中的4D几何结构并估计密集运动。我们方法的核心在于一种新颖的联合表示，它在共享坐标系中表达了密集的3D点云图和3D场景流，以及一个新颖的4D VAE，以有效地学习这种表示。与以往的工作不同，那些工作强制3D值和潜在变量与RGB VAE的潜在变量严格对齐——尽管它们具有根本不同的分布——我们表明这种对齐是不必要的，并且会导致次优的性能。相反，我们引入了一种新的数据归一化和VAE训练策略，可以更好地转移扩散先验，并显著提高重建质量。在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，MotionCrafter在几何结构重建和密集场景流估计方面均实现了最先进的性能，分别在几何结构和运动重建方面带来了38.64%和25.0%的提升，且无需任何后处理优化。项目主页：https://ruijiezhu94.github.io/MotionCrafter_Page
tldr: MotionCrafter is a video diffusion framework that reconstructs 4D geometry and estimates dense motion from monocular video using a novel 4D VAE and a new training strategy, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: MotionCrafter是一个基于视频扩散的框架，它使用一种新的4D VAE和训练策略，从单目视频中重建4D几何结构并估计稠密运动，实现了最先进的性能。

title: Gesturing Toward Abstraction: Multimodal Convention Formation in Collaborative Physical Tasks
summary: A quintessential feature of human intelligence is the ability to create ad hoc conventions over time to achieve shared goals efficiently. We investigate how communication strategies evolve through repeated collaboration as people coordinate on shared procedural abstractions. To this end, we conducted an online unimodal study (n = 98) using natural language to probe abstraction hierarchies. In a follow-up lab study (n = 40), we examined how multimodal communication (speech and gestures) changed during physical collaboration. Pairs used augmented reality to isolate their partner's hand and voice; one participant viewed a 3D virtual tower and sent instructions to the other, who built the physical tower. Participants became faster and more accurate by establishing linguistic and gestural abstractions and using cross-modal redundancy to emphasize key changes from previous interactions. Based on these findings, we extend probabilistic models of convention formation to multimodal settings, capturing shifts in modality preferences. Our findings and model provide building blocks for designing convention-aware intelligent agents situated in the physical world.
summary_zh: 人类智能的一个典型特征是能够随着时间的推移创造出临时的约定俗成，从而高效地实现共同目标。我们研究了当人们在共享的程序抽象上进行协调时，沟通策略如何通过重复协作而演变。为此，我们进行了一项使用自然语言的在线单模态研究（n = 98），以探索抽象层级结构。 在一项后续的实验室研究（n = 40）中，我们考察了物理协作期间多模态交流（语音和手势）的变化。参与者使用增强现实技术来隔离其伙伴的手和声音；一位参与者观察一个3D虚拟塔，并向另一位建造物理塔的参与者发送指令。 参与者通过建立语言和手势抽象，并使用跨模态冗余来强调与之前交互的关键变化，从而变得更快和更准确。基于这些发现，我们将约定俗成形成的概率模型扩展到多模态环境，以捕捉模态偏好的转变。我们的发现和模型为设计位于物理世界中、具有约定感知的智能体提供了构建模块。
tldr: This paper investigates how people develop multimodal communication strategies (speech and gestures) to improve efficiency in collaborative physical tasks, using AR to isolate communication. It extends probabilistic models of convention formation to multimodal settings, offering insights for designing convention-aware intelligent agents.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了人们如何发展多模态沟通策略（语音和手势）以提高协作物理任务的效率，使用增强现实技术隔离沟通。它将概率约定形成模型扩展到多模态环境，为设计具有约定意识的智能体提供见解。

title: Learning the Value Systems of Societies with Preference-based Multi-objective Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Value-aware AI should recognise human values and adapt to the value systems (value-based preferences) of different users. This requires operationalization of values, which can be prone to misspecification. The social nature of values demands their representation to adhere to multiple users while value systems are diverse, yet exhibit patterns among groups. In sequential decision making, efforts have been made towards personalization for different goals or values from demonstrations of diverse agents. However, these approaches demand manually designed features or lack value-based interpretability and/or adaptability to diverse user preferences.
  We propose algorithms for learning models of value alignment and value systems for a society of agents in Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), based on clustering and preference-based multi-objective reinforcement learning (PbMORL). We jointly learn socially-derived value alignment models (groundings) and a set of value systems that concisely represent different groups of users (clusters) in a society. Each cluster consists of a value system representing the value-based preferences of its members and an approximately Pareto-optimal policy that reflects behaviours aligned with this value system. We evaluate our method against a state-of-the-art PbMORL algorithm and baselines on two MDPs with human values.
summary_zh:
价值感知型人工智能应识别人类价值观，并适应不同用户的价值体系（基于价值的偏好）。这需要价值观的操作化，而这可能容易出现错误规范。价值观的社会属性要求其表示符合多个用户，同时价值体系是多样化的，但在群体之间又表现出模式。在序列决策中，人们已经尝试从不同智能体的示范中，针对不同的目标或价值观进行个性化定制。然而，这些方法需要手动设计特征，或者缺乏基于价值的可解释性，以及/或者对多样化用户偏好的适应性。

我们提出了一种算法，用于学习马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中智能体社群的价值观对齐和价值体系模型，该算法基于聚类和基于偏好的多目标强化学习（PbMORL）。我们联合学习社会衍生的价值观对齐模型（基础）和一组价值体系，这些体系简洁地代表了社群中不同的用户群体（聚类）。每个聚类都包含一个价值体系，代表其成员基于价值的偏好，以及一个近似帕累托最优策略，该策略反映了与该价值体系对齐的行为。我们在两个带有人类价值观的MDP上，针对最先进的PbMORL算法和基线算法评估了我们的方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for learning value systems within a society of agents using preference-based multi-objective reinforcement learning (PbMORL) and clustering, aiming to create value-aligned AI that adapts to diverse user preferences.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用基于偏好的多目标强化学习（PbMORL）和聚类来学习社会中智能体价值体系的方法，旨在创建与价值观对齐的AI，以适应不同的用户偏好。

title: GOT-Edit: Geometry-Aware Generic Object Tracking via Online Model Editing
summary: Human perception for effective object tracking in a 2D video stream arises from the implicit use of prior 3D knowledge combined with semantic reasoning. In contrast, most generic object tracking (GOT) methods primarily rely on 2D features of the target and its surroundings while neglecting 3D geometric cues, which makes them susceptible to partial occlusion, distractors, and variations in geometry and appearance. To address this limitation, we introduce GOT-Edit, an online cross-modality model editing approach that integrates geometry-aware cues into a generic object tracker from a 2D video stream. Our approach leverages features from a pre-trained Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer to enable geometric cue inference from only a few 2D images. To tackle the challenge of seamlessly combining geometry and semantics, GOT-Edit performs online model editing with null-space constrained updates that incorporate geometric information while preserving semantic discrimination, yielding consistently better performance across diverse scenarios. Extensive experiments on multiple GOT benchmarks demonstrate that GOT-Edit achieves superior robustness and accuracy, particularly under occlusion and clutter, establishing a new paradigm for combining 2D semantics with 3D geometric reasoning for generic object tracking.
summary_zh: 人体在二维视频流中进行有效目标跟踪的感知能力，源于对先验三维知识的隐式运用以及语义推理。 相比之下，大多数通用目标跟踪（GOT）方法主要依赖目标及其周围环境的二维特征，而忽略了三维几何线索，这使得它们容易受到部分遮挡、干扰物以及几何和外观变化的影响。 为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了 GOT-Edit，一种在线跨模态模型编辑方法，它将几何感知线索从二维视频流集成到通用目标跟踪器中。 我们的方法利用预训练的可视几何基础Transformer的特征，仅从少数二维图像中即可实现几何线索的推断。 为了解决几何和语义无缝结合的挑战，GOT-Edit 使用零空间约束更新执行在线模型编辑，该更新在包含几何信息的同时保持语义区分能力，从而在各种场景中始终如一地获得更好的性能。 在多个 GOT 基准测试上的大量实验表明，GOT-Edit 实现了卓越的鲁棒性和准确性，尤其是在遮挡和杂乱情况下，为通用目标跟踪中 2D 语义与 3D 几何推理的结合建立了一个新范例。
tldr: The paper introduces GOT-Edit, a novel generic object tracking method that integrates 3D geometric cues derived from a pre-trained transformer into a 2D tracker via online model editing, demonstrating improved robustness and accuracy especially under occlusion. It leverages geometric information while preserving semantic discrimination.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GOT-Edit，一种新颖的通用目标跟踪方法，它通过在线模型编辑将从预训练transformer中提取的3D几何线索整合到2D跟踪器中，特别是在遮挡情况下表现出更高的鲁棒性和准确性。它在保留语义判别的同时利用了几何信息。

title: Dialogue Model Optimization via Agent Game and Adaptive Tree-based GRPO
summary: Open-ended dialogue agents aim to deliver engaging, personalized interactions by adapting to users' traits, but existing methods face critical limitations: over-reliance on pre-collected user data, and short-horizon biases in reinforcement learning (RL) that neglect long-term dialogue value. To address these, we propose a novel long-horizon RL framework integrating online personalization with Adaptive Tree-based Group Relative Policy Optimization (AT-GRPO). Adopting a two-agent game paradigm, a user agent constructs dynamic environments via style mimicry (learning user-specific conversational traits) and active termination (predicting turn-level termination probabilities as immediate rewards), forming an iterative cycle that drives the dialogue agent to deepen interest exploration. AT-GRPO reinterprets dialogue trajectories as trees and introduces adaptive observation ranges. Unlike full tree expansion that incurs exponential overhead, it limits each node to aggregate rewards from a stage-aware range: larger ranges support early-stage topic exploration, while smaller ranges facilitate late-stage dialogue maintenance. This design reduces rollout budgets from exponential to polynomial in the dialogue length, while preserving long-term reward capture. Extensive experiments show our framework's superior performance, sample efficiency, and robustness.
summary_zh: 开放式对话代理旨在通过适应用户的特征来提供引人入胜的个性化互动，但现有方法面临着关键的局限性：过度依赖预先收集的用户数据，以及强化学习（RL）中的短视偏差，这忽略了长期对话价值。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新型的长期强化学习框架，该框架集成了在线个性化和自适应树状分组相对策略优化（AT-GRPO）。采用双智能体博弈范式，用户代理通过风格模仿（学习用户特定的对话特征）和主动终止（预测回合级的终止概率作为即时奖励）构建动态环境，形成一个迭代循环，驱动对话代理深入探索兴趣点。AT-GRPO将对话轨迹重新解释为树，并引入自适应观察范围。与产生指数级开销的完整树展开不同，它限制每个节点聚合来自阶段感知范围的奖励：较大的范围支持早期阶段的主题探索，而较小的范围则有利于后期阶段的对话维护。这种设计将rollout预算从对话长度的指数级别降低到多项式级别，同时保留了长期奖励的捕获。大量的实验表明，我们的框架具有卓越的性能、样本效率和鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper proposes a long-horizon reinforcement learning framework for dialogue agents using a two-agent game paradigm and adaptive tree-based policy optimization to improve personalization and long-term dialogue value.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种长程强化学习框架，用于对话代理，采用双智能体博弈范式和自适应树状策略优化，以提高个性化和长期对话价值。

title: CLEAR: A Knowledge-Centric Vessel Trajectory Analysis Platform
summary: Vessel trajectory data from the Automatic Identification System (AIS) is used widely in maritime analytics. Yet, analysis is difficult for non-expert users due to the incompleteness and complexity of AIS data. We present CLEAR, a knowledge-centric vessel trajectory analysis platform that aims to overcome these barriers. By leveraging the reasoning and generative capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), CLEAR transforms raw AIS data into complete, interpretable, and easily explorable vessel trajectories through a Structured Data-derived Knowledge Graph (SD-KG). As part of the demo, participants can configure parameters to automatically download and process AIS data, observe how trajectories are completed and annotated, inspect both raw and imputed segments together with their SD-KG evidence, and interactively explore the SD-KG through a dedicated graph viewer, gaining an intuitive and transparent understanding of vessel movements.
summary_zh: 自动识别系统(AIS)的船舶轨迹数据被广泛应用于海事分析。然而，由于AIS数据的不完整性和复杂性，非专业用户难以进行分析。我们提出了CLEAR，一个以知识为中心的船舶轨迹分析平台，旨在克服这些障碍。通过利用大型语言模型(LLMs)的推理和生成能力，CLEAR将原始AIS数据转化为完整、可解释且易于探索的船舶轨迹，这归功于一个从结构化数据派生的知识图谱(SD-KG)。作为演示的一部分，参与者可以配置参数来自动下载和处理AIS数据，观察轨迹如何被补全和标注，检查原始和推算出的航段及其SD-KG证据，并通过专门的图谱查看器交互式地探索SD-KG，从而获得对船舶运动的直观和透明的理解。
tldr: CLEAR is a knowledge-centric platform leveraging LLMs and Structured Data-derived Knowledge Graphs (SD-KG) to transform raw AIS data into interpretable vessel trajectories, addressing incompleteness issues and facilitating user-friendly maritime analytics.
tldr_zh: CLEAR是一个以知识为中心的平台，利用大型语言模型（LLM）和结构化数据知识图谱（SD-KG）将原始AIS数据转换为可解释的船舶轨迹，解决了数据不完整的问题，并促进了用户友好的海事分析。

title: PISCO: Precise Video Instance Insertion with Sparse Control
summary: The landscape of AI video generation is undergoing a pivotal shift: moving beyond general generation - which relies on exhaustive prompt-engineering and "cherry-picking" - towards fine-grained, controllable generation and high-fidelity post-processing. In professional AI-assisted filmmaking, it is crucial to perform precise, targeted modifications. A cornerstone of this transition is video instance insertion, which requires inserting a specific instance into existing footage while maintaining scene integrity. Unlike traditional video editing, this task demands several requirements: precise spatial-temporal placement, physically consistent scene interaction, and the faithful preservation of original dynamics - all achieved under minimal user effort. In this paper, we propose PISCO, a video diffusion model for precise video instance insertion with arbitrary sparse keyframe control. PISCO allows users to specify a single keyframe, start-and-end keyframes, or sparse keyframes at arbitrary timestamps, and automatically propagates object appearance, motion, and interaction. To address the severe distribution shift induced by sparse conditioning in pretrained video diffusion models, we introduce Variable-Information Guidance for robust conditioning and Distribution-Preserving Temporal Masking to stabilize temporal generation, together with geometry-aware conditioning for realistic scene adaptation. We further construct PISCO-Bench, a benchmark with verified instance annotations and paired clean background videos, and evaluate performance using both reference-based and reference-free perceptual metrics. Experiments demonstrate that PISCO consistently outperforms strong inpainting and video editing baselines under sparse control, and exhibits clear, monotonic performance improvements as additional control signals are provided. Project page: xiangbogaobarry.github.io/PISCO.
summary_zh: 人工智能视频生成领域正经历着一个关键性的转变：从依赖详尽的提示工程和“精挑细选”的通用生成，转向细粒度、可控生成和高保真后处理。 在专业的人工智能辅助电影制作中，执行精确的、有针对性的修改至关重要。 这一转变的基石是视频实例插入，它需要在保持场景完整性的前提下，将特定的实例插入到现有的素材中。 与传统的视频编辑不同，这项任务需要满足多个要求：精确的时空位置放置、物理上一致的场景交互以及原始动态的忠实保留——所有这些都需要在最小的用户工作量下实现。 在本文中，我们提出了PISCO，一个用于精确视频实例插入的视频扩散模型，并具备任意稀疏关键帧控制能力。 PISCO允许用户指定单个关键帧、起始和结束关键帧，或任意时间戳处的稀疏关键帧，并自动传播对象外观、运动和交互。 为了解决预训练视频扩散模型中由稀疏条件引起的严重分布偏移问题，我们引入了用于稳健条件化的可变信息指导（Variable-Information Guidance）和用于稳定时间生成的分布保持时间掩码（Distribution-Preserving Temporal Masking），以及用于真实场景适应的几何感知条件化（geometry-aware conditioning）。 我们进一步构建了PISCO-Bench，一个具有经过验证的实例注释和配对的干净背景视频的基准，并使用基于参考和无参考的感知指标来评估性能。 实验表明，在稀疏控制下，PISCO始终优于强大的图像修复和视频编辑基线，并且随着提供更多控制信号，表现出清晰的、单调的性能提升。 项目主页：xiangbogaobarry.github.io/PISCO.
tldr: The paper introduces PISCO, a video diffusion model for precise video instance insertion into existing footage with sparse keyframe control, addressing challenges in spatial-temporal placement, physical consistency, and preservation of original dynamics. It features novel Variable-Information Guidance and Distribution-Preserving Temporal Masking techniques, and is evaluated using a new benchmark PISCO-Bench.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为PISCO的视频扩散模型，用于将特定视频实例精确地插入现有视频素材中，并通过稀疏关键帧控制来实现。该模型解决了时间空间定位、物理一致性以及保持原始动态等方面的挑战。它采用了新的可变信息引导和分布保持时间掩蔽技术，并使用新基准PISCO-Bench进行了评估。

title: Designing Multi-Robot Ground Video Sensemaking with Public Safety Professionals
summary: Videos from fleets of ground robots can advance public safety by providing scalable situational awareness and reducing professionals' burden. Yet little is known about how to design and integrate multi-robot videos into public safety workflows. Collaborating with six police agencies, we examined how such videos could be made practical. In Study 1, we presented the first testbed for multi-robot ground video sensemaking. The testbed includes 38 events-of-interest (EoI) relevant to public safety, a dataset of 20 robot patrol videos (10 day/night pairs) covering EoI types, and 6 design requirements aimed at improving current video sensemaking practices. In Study 2, we built MRVS, a tool that augments multi-robot patrol video streams with a prompt-engineered video understanding model. Participants reported reduced manual workload and greater confidence with LLM-based explanations, while noting concerns about false alarms and privacy. We conclude with implications for designing future multi-robot video sensemaking tools.
summary_zh: 来自地面机器人群的视频可以通过提供可扩展的态势感知能力和减轻专业人员的负担来提升公共安全。然而，关于如何设计和将多机器人视频集成到公共安全工作流程中的研究还很少。通过与六个警察机构合作，我们研究了如何使此类视频更具实用性。在研究1中，我们提出了首个用于多机器人地面视频理解的测试平台。该测试平台包括38个与公共安全相关的关注事件（EoI），一个包含20个机器人巡逻视频（10个白天/夜晚对）的数据集，涵盖EoI类型，以及旨在改进当前视频理解实践的6项设计要求。在研究2中，我们构建了MRVS，该工具通过提示工程视频理解模型来增强多机器人巡逻视频流。参与者报告说，基于LLM的解释减少了人工工作量并提高了信心，同时也注意到对误报和隐私的担忧。最后，我们总结了设计未来多机器人视频理解工具的启示。
tldr: This paper explores the design considerations for integrating multi-robot ground video into public safety workflows, presenting a testbed and a tool (MRVS) that uses an LLM-based video understanding model to reduce workload and increase confidence, while acknowledging concerns about false alarms and privacy.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了将多机器人地面视频集成到公共安全工作流程中的设计考虑因素，提出了一个测试平台和一个工具（MRVS），该工具使用基于LLM的视频理解模型来减少工作量并提高信心，同时承认了对误报和隐私的担忧。

title: TriC-Motion: Tri-Domain Causal Modeling Grounded Text-to-Motion Generation
summary: Text-to-motion generation, a rapidly evolving field in computer vision, aims to produce realistic and text-aligned motion sequences. Current methods primarily focus on spatial-temporal modeling or independent frequency domain analysis, lacking a unified framework for joint optimization across spatial, temporal, and frequency domains. This limitation hinders the model's ability to leverage information from all domains simultaneously, leading to suboptimal generation quality. Additionally, in motion generation frameworks, motion-irrelevant cues caused by noise are often entangled with features that contribute positively to generation, thereby leading to motion distortion. To address these issues, we propose Tri-Domain Causal Text-to-Motion Generation (TriC-Motion), a novel diffusion-based framework integrating spatial-temporal-frequency-domain modeling with causal intervention. TriC-Motion includes three core modeling modules for domain-specific modeling, namely Temporal Motion Encoding, Spatial Topology Modeling, and Hybrid Frequency Analysis. After comprehensive modeling, a Score-guided Tri-domain Fusion module integrates valuable information from the triple domains, simultaneously ensuring temporal consistency, spatial topology, motion trends, and dynamics. Moreover, the Causality-based Counterfactual Motion Disentangler is meticulously designed to expose motion-irrelevant cues to eliminate noise, disentangling the real modeling contributions of each domain for superior generation. Extensive experimental results validate that TriC-Motion achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, attaining an outstanding R@1 of 0.612 on the HumanML3D dataset. These results demonstrate its capability to generate high-fidelity, coherent, diverse, and text-aligned motion sequences. Code is available at: https://caoyiyang1105.github.io/TriC-Motion/.
summary_zh: 文本到运动生成是计算机视觉中一个快速发展的领域，旨在生成逼真且与文本对齐的运动序列。目前的方法主要集中在时空建模或独立的频域分析上，缺乏一个跨空间、时间和频率域进行联合优化的统一框架。这种局限性阻碍了模型同时利用来自所有域的信息的能力，从而导致次优的生成质量。此外，在运动生成框架中，噪声引起的与运动无关的线索常常与对生成有积极贡献的特征纠缠在一起，从而导致运动失真。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了Tri-Domain Causal Text-to-Motion Generation (TriC-Motion)，这是一个新颖的基于扩散的框架，集成了时空频域建模和因果干预。TriC-Motion包括三个用于特定领域建模的核心模块，即时间运动编码、空间拓扑建模和混合频率分析。在全面建模后，一个基于评分引导的三域融合模块整合来自三个域的有价值的信息，同时确保时间一致性、空间拓扑、运动趋势和动态。此外，基于因果关系的逆事实运动解耦器经过精心设计，暴露与运动无关的线索以消除噪声，从而解耦每个域的真实建模贡献，以实现卓越的生成效果。大量的实验结果验证了TriC-Motion相比最先进的方法实现了卓越的性能，在HumanML3D数据集上实现了0.612的出色的R@1指标。这些结果表明了它生成高保真度、连贯性、多样性和与文本对齐的运动序列的能力。代码可在https://caoyiyang1105.github.io/TriC-Motion/获取。
tldr: The paper introduces TriC-Motion, a novel diffusion-based text-to-motion generation framework that integrates spatial-temporal-frequency domain modeling with causal intervention, achieving state-of-the-art results on the HumanML3D dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TriC-Motion，一种新颖的基于扩散的文本到动作生成框架，它集成了空间-时间-频率域建模和因果干预，并在HumanML3D数据集上取得了最先进的结果。

title: Learning To Sample From Diffusion Models Via Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Diffusion models generate samples through an iterative denoising process, guided by a neural network. While training the denoiser on real-world data is computationally demanding, the sampling procedure itself is more flexible. This adaptability serves as a key lever in practice, enabling improvements in both the quality of generated samples and the efficiency of the sampling process. In this work, we introduce an inverse reinforcement learning framework for learning sampling strategies without retraining the denoiser. We formulate the diffusion sampling procedure as a discrete-time finite-horizon Markov Decision Process, where actions correspond to optional modifications of the sampling dynamics. To optimize action scheduling, we avoid defining an explicit reward function. Instead, we directly match the target behavior expected from the sampler using policy gradient techniques. We provide experimental evidence that this approach can improve the quality of samples generated by pretrained diffusion models and automatically tune sampling hyperparameters.
summary_zh: 扩散模型通过神经网路引导的迭代去噪过程生成样本。虽然在真实世界数据上训练去噪器计算成本很高，但采样过程本身更加灵活。这种适应性在实践中是一个关键杠杆，能够提升生成样本的质量和采样过程的效率。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个逆强化学习框架，用于学习采样策略，而无需重新训练去噪器。我们将扩散采样过程建模为离散时间有限视界马尔可夫决策过程，其中动作对应于采样动态的可选修改。为了优化动作调度，我们避免定义显式的奖励函数。相反，我们使用策略梯度技术直接匹配采样器预期的目标行为。我们提供的实验证据表明，这种方法可以提升预训练扩散模型生成 samples 的质量，并自动调整采样超参数。
tldr: This paper introduces an inverse reinforcement learning framework to optimize the sampling strategy of pretrained diffusion models without retraining the denoiser, potentially improving sample quality and tuning sampling hyperparameters.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种逆强化学习框架，用于优化预训练扩散模型的采样策略，无需重新训练去噪器，从而可能提高样本质量并调整采样超参数。

title: The Theory and Practice of MAP Inference over Non-Convex Constraints
summary: In many safety-critical settings, probabilistic ML systems have to make predictions subject to algebraic constraints, e.g., predicting the most likely trajectory that does not cross obstacles. These real-world constraints are rarely convex, nor the densities considered are (log-)concave. This makes computing this constrained maximum a posteriori (MAP) prediction efficiently and reliably extremely challenging. In this paper, we first investigate under which conditions we can perform constrained MAP inference over continuous variables exactly and efficiently and devise a scalable message-passing algorithm for this tractable fragment. Then, we devise a general constrained MAP strategy that interleaves partitioning the domain into convex feasible regions with numerical constrained optimization. We evaluate both methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks, showing our approaches outperform constraint-agnostic baselines, and scale to complex densities intractable for SoTA exact solvers.
summary_zh: 在许多安全攸关的环境中，概率机器学习系统必须在代数约束的条件下进行预测，例如，预测最有可能且不穿越障碍物的轨迹。这些现实世界的约束很少是凸的，所考虑的密度也并非（对数）凹的。这使得高效且可靠地计算这种约束最大后验(MAP)预测变得极具挑战性。在本文中，我们首先研究在何种条件下可以精确且高效地对连续变量执行约束MAP推断，并为此可处理的片段设计了一种可扩展的消息传递算法。然后，我们设计了一种通用的约束MAP策略，该策略将域划分为凸可行区域，并同时进行数值约束优化。我们在合成和真实世界的基准测试中评估了这两种方法，表明我们的方法优于与约束无关的基线，并且可以扩展到对于最先进的精确求解器来说难以处理的复杂密度。
tldr: This paper addresses the challenging problem of constrained MAP inference with non-convex constraints, developing a scalable message-passing algorithm for a tractable fragment and a general partitioning-based optimization strategy, demonstrating improved performance on synthetic and real-world benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文解决了非凸约束下受限最大后验概率（MAP）推断的难题，开发了一个可扩展的消息传递算法用于可处理的部分，以及一个通用的基于分区的优化策略，并在合成和真实世界的基准测试中展示了改进的性能。

title: From Robotics to Sepsis Treatment: Offline RL via Geometric Pessimism
summary: Offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) promises the recovery of optimal policies from static datasets, yet it remains susceptible to the overestimation of out-of-distribution (OOD) actions, particularly in fractured and sparse data manifolds.Current solutions necessitates a trade off between computational efficiency and performance. Methods like CQL offers rigorous conservatism but require tremendous compute power while efficient expectile-based methods like IQL often fail to correct OOD errors on pathological datasets, collapsing to Behavioural Cloning. In this work, we propose Geometric Pessimism, a modular, compute-efficient framework that augments standard IQL with density-based penalty derived from k-nearest-neighbour distances in the state-action embedding space. By pre-computing the penalties applied to each state-action pair our method injects OOD conservatism via reward shaping with a O(1) training overhead. Evaluated on the D4Rl MuJoCo benchmark, our method, Geo-IQL outperforms standard IQL on sensitive and unstable medium-replay tasks by over 18 points, while reducing inter-seed variance by 4x. Furthermore, Geo-IQL does not degrade performance on stable manifolds. Crucially, we validate our algorithm on the MIMIC-III Sepsis critical care dataset. While standard IQL collapses to behaviour cloning, Geo-IQL demonstrates active policy improvement. Maintaining safety constraints, achieving 86.4% terminal agreement with clinicians compared to IQL's 75%. Our results suggest that geometric pessimism provides the necessary regularisation to safely overcome local optima in critical, real-world decision systems.
summary_zh: 离线强化学习 (RL) 承诺从静态数据集中恢复最优策略，但它仍然容易高估分布外 (OOD) 动作，特别是在破碎和稀疏的数据流形中。目前的解决方案需要在计算效率和性能之间进行权衡。像 CQL 这样的方法提供了严格的保守性，但需要巨大的计算能力，而像 IQL 这样的高效基于期望分位的方法通常无法纠正在病态数据集上的 OOD 错误，最终退化为行为克隆。在这项工作中，我们提出了几何悲观主义，一种模块化、计算高效的框架，它通过状态-动作嵌入空间中基于 k 近邻距离的密度惩罚来增强标准 IQL。通过预先计算应用于每个状态-动作对的惩罚，我们的方法通过奖励塑造注入 OOD 保守性，训练开销为 O(1)。在 D4RL MuJoCo 基准测试中，我们的方法 Geo-IQL 在敏感和不稳定的 medium-replay 任务上优于标准 IQL 超过 18 个点，同时将种子间方差降低了 4 倍。此外，Geo-IQL 不会降低在稳定流形上的性能。至关重要的是，我们在 MIMIC-III 脓毒症重症监护数据集上验证了我们的算法。虽然标准 IQL 退化为行为克隆，但 Geo-IQL 展示了积极的策略改进。在保持安全约束的同时，与 IQL 的 75% 相比，我们实现了与临床医生 86.4% 的最终协议。我们的结果表明，几何悲观主义提供了必要的正则化，可以安全地克服关键的、现实世界决策系统中的局部最优。
tldr: The paper introduces Geometric Pessimism, a compute-efficient offline RL method that improves upon IQL by incorporating a density-based penalty, demonstrating superior performance on D4RL and MIMIC-III datasets, particularly in sparse data scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为几何悲观主义的高效离线强化学习方法，通过结合基于密度的惩罚项改进了 IQL 算法。该方法在 D4RL 和 MIMIC-III 数据集上表现出更优越的性能，尤其是在稀疏数据场景中。

title: Interaction-Grounded Learning for Contextual Markov Decision Processes with Personalized Feedback
summary: In this paper, we study Interaction-Grounded Learning (IGL) [Xie et al., 2021], a paradigm designed for realistic scenarios where the learner receives indirect feedback generated by an unknown mechanism, rather than explicit numerical rewards. While prior work on IGL provides efficient algorithms with provable guarantees, those results are confined to single-step settings, restricting their applicability to modern sequential decision-making systems such as multi-turn Large Language Model (LLM) deployments. To bridge this gap, we propose a computationally efficient algorithm that achieves a sublinear regret guarantee for contextual episodic Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) with personalized feedback. Technically, we extend the reward-estimator construction of Zhang et al. [2024a] from the single-step to the multi-step setting, addressing the unique challenges of decoding latent rewards under MDPs. Building on this estimator, we design an Inverse-Gap-Weighting (IGW) algorithm for policy optimization. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in learning personalized objectives from multi-turn interactions through experiments on both a synthetic episodic MDP and a real-world user booking dataset.
summary_zh: 本文研究交互引导学习（IGL）[Xie et al., 2021]，这是一种为真实场景设计的范式，其中学习者接收由未知机制生成的间接反馈，而不是显式的数值奖励。 尽管先前关于IGL的工作提供了具有可证明保证的高效算法，但这些结果仅限于单步设置，限制了它们在现代序贯决策系统中的应用，例如多轮大型语言模型（LLM）部署。 为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种计算上高效的算法，该算法实现了具有个性化反馈的上下文情景马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的亚线性遗憾保证。 在技术上，我们将Zhang et al. [2024a]的奖励估计器构建从单步扩展到多步设置，解决了在MDP下解码潜在奖励的独特挑战。 在此估计器的基础上，我们设计了一种用于策略优化的逆差距加权（IGW）算法。 最后，我们通过在合成情景MDP和真实世界用户预订数据集上的实验，证明了我们的方法在从多轮交互中学习个性化目标方面的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes an algorithm for Interaction-Grounded Learning in contextual episodic MDPs with personalized feedback, achieving sublinear regret and demonstrating effectiveness in learning from multi-turn interactions, applicable to scenarios like LLM deployments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于上下文情景MDP中基于交互学习的算法，该算法具有个性化反馈，实现了亚线性遗憾，并证明了其在从多轮交互中学习的有效性，适用于大型语言模型（LLM）部署等场景。

title: CADO: From Imitation to Cost Minimization for Heatmap-based Solvers in Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Heatmap-based solvers have emerged as a promising paradigm for Combinatorial Optimization (CO). However, we argue that the dominant Supervised Learning (SL) training paradigm suffers from a fundamental objective mismatch: minimizing imitation loss (e.g., cross-entropy) does not guarantee solution cost minimization. We dissect this mismatch into two deficiencies: Decoder-Blindness (being oblivious to the non-differentiable decoding process) and Cost-Blindness (prioritizing structural imitation over solution quality). We empirically demonstrate that these intrinsic flaws impose a hard performance ceiling. To overcome this limitation, we propose CADO (Cost-Aware Diffusion models for Optimization), a streamlined Reinforcement Learning fine-tuning framework that formulates the diffusion denoising process as an MDP to directly optimize the post-decoded solution cost. We introduce Label-Centered Reward, which repurposes ground-truth labels as unbiased baselines rather than imitation targets, and Hybrid Fine-Tuning for parameter-efficient adaptation. CADO achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse benchmarks, validating that objective alignment is essential for unlocking the full potential of heatmap-based solvers.
summary_zh: 基于热图的求解器已经成为组合优化（CO）领域中一种有前景的范式。然而，我们认为主流的监督学习（SL）训练范式存在根本性的目标不匹配：最小化模仿损失（例如，交叉熵）并不能保证最小化解的成本。我们将这种不匹配分解为两个缺陷：解码器盲视（对不可微的解码过程漠不关心）和成本盲视（将结构模仿置于解的质量之上）。我们通过实验证明，这些内在缺陷设置了严格的性能上限。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了CADO（用于优化的成本感知扩散模型），这是一个简化的强化学习微调框架，它将扩散去噪过程形式化为一个MDP，以直接优化解码后的解的成本。我们引入了标签中心奖励，它将ground-truth标签重新用作无偏基线，而不是模仿目标，并引入了混合微调以实现参数高效的适配。CADO在多个基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，验证了目标对齐对于释放基于热图的求解器的全部潜力至关重要。
tldr: The paper introduces CADO, a reinforcement learning fine-tuning framework for heatmap-based combinatorial optimization solvers that addresses the objective mismatch in supervised learning by directly optimizing solution cost, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CADO，一种用于基于热图的组合优化求解器的强化学习微调框架，通过直接优化解的成本来解决监督学习中的目标不匹配问题，并实现了最先进的性能。

title: Reliability-aware Execution Gating for Near-field and Off-axis Vision-guided Robotic Alignment
summary: Vision-guided robotic systems are increasingly deployed in precision alignment tasks that require reliable execution under near-field and off-axis configurations. While recent advances in pose estimation have significantly improved numerical accuracy, practical robotic systems still suffer from frequent execution failures even when pose estimates appear accurate. This gap suggests that pose accuracy alone is insufficient to guarantee execution-level reliability. In this paper, we reveal that such failures arise from a deterministic geometric error amplification mechanism, in which small pose estimation errors are magnified through system structure and motion execution, leading to unstable or failed alignment. Rather than modifying pose estimation algorithms, we propose a Reliability-aware Execution Gating mechanism that operates at the execution level. The proposed approach evaluates geometric consistency and configuration risk before execution, and selectively rejects or scales high-risk pose updates. We validate the proposed method on a real UR5 robotic platform performing single-step visual alignment tasks under varying camera-target distances and off-axis configurations. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed execution gating significantly improves task success rates, reduces execution variance, and suppresses tail-risk behavior, while leaving average pose accuracy largely unchanged. Importantly, the proposed mechanism is estimator-agnostic and can be readily integrated with both classical geometry-based and learning-based pose estimation pipelines. These results highlight the importance of execution-level reliability modeling and provide a practical solution for improving robustness in near-field vision-guided robotic systems.
summary_zh: 视觉引导的机器人系统越来越多地被部署在需要近场和离轴配置下可靠执行的精密对准任务中。尽管姿态估计的最新进展显著提高了数值精度，但实际的机器人系统即使在姿态估计看起来准确的情况下，仍然会频繁出现执行失败。这种差距表明，仅靠姿态精度不足以保证执行层面的可靠性。在本文中，我们揭示了这种失败是由于一种确定的几何误差放大机制引起的，其中小的姿态估计误差通过系统结构和运动执行被放大，导致不稳定或失败的对准。我们没有修改姿态估计算法，而是提出了一种在执行层面运行的可靠性感知执行门控机制。所提出的方法在执行前评估几何一致性和配置风险，并有选择地拒绝或缩放高风险的姿态更新。我们在一个真实的UR5机器人平台上验证了所提出的方法，该平台在不同的相机-目标距离和离轴配置下执行单步视觉对准任务。实验结果表明，所提出的执行门控显著提高了任务成功率，降低了执行方差，并抑制了尾部风险行为，同时平均姿态精度基本保持不变。重要的是，所提出的机制与估计器无关，可以很容易地与经典的基于几何的姿态估计和基于学习的姿态估计流程集成。这些结果强调了执行层可靠性建模的重要性，并为提高近场视觉引导机器人系统的鲁棒性提供了一个实用的解决方案。
tldr: This paper introduces a reliability-aware execution gating mechanism for vision-guided robotic alignment that selectively rejects or scales high-risk pose updates based on geometric consistency and configuration risk, improving task success rates in near-field and off-axis scenarios. It's estimator-agnostic and can be easily integrated with various pose estimation pipelines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种可靠性感知的执行门控机制，用于视觉引导的机器人对准，该机制基于几何一致性和配置风险选择性地拒绝或缩放高风险的姿态更新，从而提高了近场和离轴场景中的任务成功率。该机制与估计器无关，可以轻松地与各种姿态估计管道集成。

title: Gesture Matters: Pedestrian Gesture Recognition for AVs Through Skeleton Pose Evaluation
summary: Gestures are a key component of non-verbal communication in traffic, often helping pedestrian-to-driver interactions when formal traffic rules may be insufficient. This problem becomes more apparent when autonomous vehicles (AVs) struggle to interpret such gestures. In this study, we present a gesture classification framework using 2D pose estimation applied to real-world video sequences from the WIVW dataset. We categorise gestures into four primary classes (Stop, Go, Thank & Greet, and No Gesture) and extract 76 static and dynamic features from normalised keypoints. Our analysis demonstrates that hand position and movement velocity are especially discriminative in distinguishing between gesture classes, achieving a classification accuracy score of 87%. These findings not only improve the perceptual capabilities of AV systems but also contribute to the broader understanding of pedestrian behaviour in traffic contexts.
summary_zh: 手势是交通中非语言交流的关键组成部分，通常在正式交通规则不足时帮助行人与驾驶员进行互动。当自动驾驶汽车（AV）难以识别这些手势时，这个问题变得更加明显。在本研究中，我们提出了一种手势分类框架，该框架使用2D姿态估计应用于来自WIVW数据集的真实世界视频序列。我们将手势分为四个主要类别（停止，通行，感谢与问候，以及无手势），并从归一化的关键点中提取76个静态和动态特征。我们的分析表明，手的位置和移动速度在区分手势类别方面特别具有区分性，达到了87%的分类准确率。这些发现不仅提高了AV系统的感知能力，也有助于更广泛地理解交通情境下行人的行为。
tldr: This paper presents a gesture classification framework using 2D pose estimation to improve autonomous vehicles' understanding of pedestrian gestures, achieving 87% accuracy in classifying four gesture classes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用2D姿态估计的手势分类框架，旨在提高自动驾驶汽车对行人手势的理解。该框架在对手势进行四类（停止、前进、感谢和问候、无手势）分类时，准确率达到87%。

title: Intelligent support for Human Oversight: Integrating Reinforcement Learning with Gaze Simulation to Personalize Highlighting
summary: Interfaces for human oversight must effectively support users' situation awareness under time-critical conditions. We explore reinforcement learning (RL)-based UI adaptation to personalize alerting strategies that balance the benefits of highlighting critical events against the cognitive costs of interruptions. To enable learning without real-world deployment, we integrate models of users' gaze behavior to simulate attentional dynamics during monitoring. Using a delivery-drone oversight scenario, we present initial results suggesting that RL-based highlighting can outperform static, rule-based approaches and discuss challenges of intelligent oversight support.
summary_zh:
以下是中文摘要：

人机协同监督的交互界面必须能有效支持用户在时间紧迫情况下的情境感知。我们探索基于强化学习 (RL) 的用户界面自适应，以个性化警报策略，从而平衡突出关键事件的益处和中断带来的认知成本。为了在没有真实部署的情况下进行学习，我们整合了用户视线行为模型，以模拟监控过程中的注意力动态。 通过无人机配送监管场景，我们展示了初步结果，表明基于强化学习的突出显示优于静态的、基于规则的方法，并讨论了智能监管支持所面临的挑战。
tldr: This paper explores using Reinforcement Learning to personalize UI highlighting in human oversight tasks. They leverage gaze simulation for training and show initial improvements over static approaches in a drone oversight scenario.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用强化学习来个性化人机监督任务中的UI高亮显示。 他们利用眼动模拟进行训练，并在无人机监督场景中展示了相对于静态方法的初步改进。

title: Altruism and Fair Objective in Mixed-Motive Markov games
summary: Cooperation is fundamental for society's viability, as it enables the emergence of structure within heterogeneous groups that seek collective well-being. However, individuals are inclined to defect in order to benefit from the group's cooperation without contributing the associated costs, thus leading to unfair situations. In game theory, social dilemmas entail this dichotomy between individual interest and collective outcome. The most dominant approach to multi-agent cooperation is the utilitarian welfare which can produce efficient highly inequitable outcomes. This paper proposes a novel framework to foster fairer cooperation by replacing the standard utilitarian objective with Proportional Fairness. We introduce a fair altruistic utility for each agent, defined on the individual log-payoff space and derive the analytical conditions required to ensure cooperation in classic social dilemmas. We then extend this framework to sequential settings by defining a Fair Markov Game and deriving novel fair Actor-Critic algorithms to learn fair policies. Finally, we evaluate our method in various social dilemma environments.
summary_zh: 合作是社会生存能力的基础，因为它能使寻求集体福祉的异质群体内部涌现结构。然而，个体倾向于背叛，以便从群体的合作中获益而不承担相关的成本，从而导致不公平的局面。在博弈论中，社会困境就包含了个人利益与集体结果之间的这种二分法。多智能体合作中最主流的方法是功利主义福利，但它可能产生高效却高度不公平的结果。本文提出了一种新的框架，通过用比例公平取代标准的功利主义目标来促进更公平的合作。我们为每个智能体引入了一种公平的利他主义效用，定义在个体的对数收益空间上，并推导出确保在经典社会困境中实现合作所需的解析条件。然后，我们将这个框架扩展到序贯设置，定义了一个公平马尔可夫博弈，并推导出新的公平Actor-Critic算法来学习公平策略。最后，我们在各种社会困境环境中评估了我们的方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel framework for fostering fairer cooperation in multi-agent systems by replacing the utilitarian objective with Proportional Fairness, specifically in Markov games, using fair Actor-Critic algorithms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的框架，通过用比例公平取代功利主义目标，从而在多智能体系统中促进更公平的合作，特别是在马尔可夫博弈中，并使用公平的Actor-Critic算法。

title: Thegra: Graph-based SLAM for Thermal Imagery
summary: Thermal imaging provides a practical sensing modality for visual SLAM in visually degraded environments such as low illumination, smoke, or adverse weather. However, thermal imagery often exhibits low texture, low contrast, and high noise, complicating feature-based SLAM. In this work, we propose a sparse monocular graph-based SLAM system for thermal imagery that leverages general-purpose learned features -- the SuperPoint detector and LightGlue matcher, trained on large-scale visible-spectrum data to improve cross-domain generalization. To adapt these components to thermal data, we introduce a preprocessing pipeline to enhance input suitability and modify core SLAM modules to handle sparse and outlier-prone feature matches. We further incorporate keypoint confidence scores from SuperPoint into a confidence-weighted factor graph to improve estimation robustness. Evaluations on public thermal datasets demonstrate that the proposed system achieves reliable performance without requiring dataset-specific training or fine-tuning a desired feature detector, given the scarcity of quality thermal data. Code will be made available upon publication.
summary_zh: 热成像技术为在视觉受损环境（如低照度、烟雾或恶劣天气）中进行视觉SLAM提供了一种实用的传感方式。然而，热成像图像常常呈现出低纹理、低对比度和高噪声等特点，这使得基于特征的SLAM变得复杂。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种稀疏的单目图优化SLAM系统，用于处理热成像图像，该系统利用了通用的学习特征——SuperPoint检测器和LightGlue匹配器，这些特征是在大规模可见光谱数据上训练得到的，以提高跨域泛化能力。为了使这些组件适应热数据，我们引入了一种预处理流程来增强输入的适用性，并修改了核心SLAM模块以处理稀疏且易受离群值影响的特征匹配。我们进一步将SuperPoint的关键点置信度分数融入到置信度加权因子图中，以提高估计的鲁棒性。在公共热数据集上的评估表明，在缺乏高质量热数据的情况下，该系统无需数据集特定的训练或微调所需的特征检测器，即可实现可靠的性能。代码将在发表后公开。
tldr: The paper presents a graph-based SLAM system for thermal imagery using learned features from visible-spectrum data, adapted to handle the challenges of thermal images via preprocessing and confidence weighting. It achieves reliable performance on public thermal datasets without dataset-specific training.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于图的 SLAM 系统，用于热成像，利用从可见光谱数据中学习到的特征，并通过预处理和置信度加权来适应热图像的挑战。它在公共热数据集上实现了可靠的性能，而无需特定于数据集的训练。

title: MambaFusion: Adaptive State-Space Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection
summary: Reliable 3D object detection is fundamental to autonomous driving, and multimodal fusion algorithms using cameras and LiDAR remain a persistent challenge. Cameras provide dense visual cues but ill posed depth; LiDAR provides a precise 3D structure but sparse coverage. Existing BEV-based fusion frameworks have made good progress, but they have difficulties including inefficient context modeling, spatially invariant fusion, and reasoning under uncertainty. We introduce MambaFusion, a unified multi-modal detection framework that achieves efficient, adaptive, and physically grounded 3D perception. MambaFusion interleaves selective state-space models (SSMs) with windowed transformers to propagate the global context in linear time while preserving local geometric fidelity. A multi-modal token alignment (MTA) module and reliability-aware fusion gates dynamically re-weight camera-LiDAR features based on spatial confidence and calibration consistency. Finally, a structure-conditioned diffusion head integrates graph-based reasoning with uncertainty-aware denoising, enforcing physical plausibility, and calibrated confidence. MambaFusion establishes new state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes benchmarks while operating with linear-time complexity. The framework demonstrates that coupling SSM-based efficiency with reliability-driven fusion yields robust, temporally stable, and interpretable 3D perception for real-world autonomous driving systems.
summary_zh: 可靠的三维物体检测是自动驾驶的基础，而使用摄像头和激光雷达的多模态融合算法仍然是一个持续的挑战。摄像头提供密集的视觉线索，但深度估计不准确；激光雷达提供精确的三维结构，但覆盖范围稀疏。现有的基于BEV的融合框架取得了良好的进展，但它们在以下方面存在困难：低效的上下文建模、空间不变的融合以及不确定性下的推理。我们引入了MambaFusion，一个统一的多模态检测框架，实现了高效、自适应和物理上合理的3D感知。MambaFusion将选择性状态空间模型（SSM）与窗口化Transformer交错使用，以线性时间传播全局上下文，同时保持局部几何保真度。一个多模态Token对齐（MTA）模块和可靠性感知融合门基于空间置信度和标定一致性动态地重新加权摄像头-激光雷达特征。最后，一个结构条件扩散头将基于图的推理与不确定性感知的去噪相结合，以强制物理合理性和校准后的置信度。MambaFusion在nuScenes基准测试上建立了新的最先进性能，同时以线性时间复杂度运行。该框架表明，将基于SSM的效率与可靠性驱动的融合相结合，可以为现实世界的自动驾驶系统带来鲁棒、时间上稳定且可解释的3D感知。
tldr: MambaFusion introduces a novel multimodal 3D object detection framework that leverages selective state-space models (SSMs) for efficient context modeling and reliability-aware fusion for robust autonomous driving perception, achieving state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes. It appears to offer a more efficient and reliable fusion approach.
tldr_zh: MambaFusion 引入了一种新颖的多模态 3D 物体检测框架，利用选择性状态空间模型 (SSM) 实现高效的上下文建模，并利用可靠性感知融合实现强大的自动驾驶感知，在 nuScenes 上实现了最先进的性能。它似乎提供了一种更高效、更可靠的融合方法。

title: SoK: The Pitfalls of Deep Reinforcement Learning for Cybersecurity
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has achieved remarkable success in domains requiring sequential decision-making, motivating its application to cybersecurity problems. However, transitioning DRL from laboratory simulations to bespoke cyber environments can introduce numerous issues. This is further exacerbated by the often adversarial, non-stationary, and partially-observable nature of most cybersecurity tasks. In this paper, we identify and systematize 11 methodological pitfalls that frequently occur in DRL for cybersecurity (DRL4Sec) literature across the stages of environment modeling, agent training, performance evaluation, and system deployment. By analyzing 66 significant DRL4Sec papers (2018-2025), we quantify the prevalence of each pitfall and find an average of over five pitfalls per paper. We demonstrate the practical impact of these pitfalls using controlled experiments in (i) autonomous cyber defense, (ii) adversarial malware creation, and (iii) web security testing environments. Finally, we provide actionable recommendations for each pitfall to support the development of more rigorous and deployable DRL-based security systems.
summary_zh: 深度强化学习 (DRL) 在需要序贯决策的领域取得了显著成功，这推动了其在网络安全问题中的应用。然而，将 DRL 从实验室模拟过渡到定制的网络环境中可能会引入诸多问题。网络安全任务通常具有对抗性、非平稳性和部分可观测性，这进一步加剧了问题的复杂性。在本文中，我们识别并系统化了在深度强化学习网络安全应用 (DRL4Sec) 文献中常见的11个方法论陷阱，这些陷阱贯穿环境建模、智能体训练、性能评估和系统部署等阶段。通过分析66篇重要的 DRL4Sec 论文（2018-2025），我们量化了每个陷阱的普遍程度，发现平均每篇文章存在超过五个陷阱。我们通过在 (i) 自主网络防御、(ii) 对抗性恶意软件创建和 (iii) Web 安全测试环境中的受控实验，证明了这些陷阱的实际影响。最后，我们针对每个陷阱提供了可操作的建议，以支持开发更严谨和可部署的基于 DRL 的安全系统。
tldr: This paper analyzes common pitfalls in applying Deep Reinforcement Learning to cybersecurity, quantifies their prevalence in existing literature, demonstrates their impact through experiments, and provides actionable recommendations for improvement.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了将深度强化学习应用于网络安全时常见的陷阱，量化了它们在现有文献中的普遍性，通过实验证明了它们的影响，并为改进提供了可操作的建议。

title: A Generic Service-Oriented Function Offloading Framework for Connected Automated Vehicles
summary: Function offloading is a promising solution to address limitations concerning computational capacity and available energy of Connected Automated Vehicles~(CAVs) or other autonomous robots by distributing computational tasks between local and remote computing devices in form of distributed services. This paper presents a generic function offloading framework that can be used to offload an arbitrary set of computational tasks with a focus on autonomous driving. To provide flexibility, the function offloading framework is designed to incorporate different offloading decision making algorithms and quality of service~(QoS) requirements that can be adjusted to different scenarios or the objectives of the CAVs. With a focus on the applicability, we propose an efficient location-based approach, where the decision whether tasks are processed locally or remotely depends on the location of the CAV. We apply the proposed framework on the use case of service-oriented trajectory planning, where we offload the trajectory planning task of CAVs to a Multi-Access Edge Computing~(MEC) server. The evaluation is conducted in both simulation and real-world application. It demonstrates the potential of the function offloading framework to guarantee the QoS for trajectory planning while improving the computational efficiency of the CAVs. Moreover, the simulation results also show the adaptability of the framework to diverse scenarios involving simultaneous offloading requests from multiple CAVs.
summary_zh: 函数卸载是一种有前景的解决方案，旨在通过以分布式服务的形式在本地和远程计算设备之间分配计算任务，来解决互联自动驾驶汽车（CAV）或其他自动机器人计算能力和可用能量方面的限制。本文提出了一种通用的函数卸载框架，该框架可用于卸载任意一组计算任务，重点是自动驾驶。为了提供灵活性，该函数卸载框架被设计为包含不同的卸载决策算法和可以根据不同场景或CAV目标进行调整的服务质量（QoS）要求。着眼于适用性，我们提出了一种高效的基于位置的方法，其中任务是在本地处理还是远程处理的决策取决于CAV的位置。我们将提出的框架应用于面向服务的轨迹规划用例，其中我们将CAV的轨迹规划任务卸载到多接入边缘计算（MEC）服务器。评估在仿真和实际应用中进行。它证明了函数卸载框架在保证轨迹规划QoS的同时提高CAV计算效率的潜力。此外，仿真结果还表明该框架对涉及来自多个CAV的同时卸载请求的各种场景的适应性。
tldr: This paper introduces a service-oriented function offloading framework for connected automated vehicles (CAVs), using a location-based approach to determine whether tasks like trajectory planning are processed locally or remotely, demonstrating QoS improvements and computational efficiency through simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向互联自动驾驶汽车(CAV)的面向服务的函数卸载框架，该框架使用基于位置的方法来确定诸如轨迹规划之类的任务是在本地还是远程处理，通过仿真和实际实验证明了QoS的提高以及计算效率的提高。

title: A Precise Real-Time Force-Aware Grasping System for Robust Aerial Manipulation
summary: Aerial manipulation requires force-aware capabilities to enable safe and effective grasping and physical interaction. Previous works often rely on heavy, expensive force sensors unsuitable for typical quadrotor platforms, or perform grasping without force feedback, risking damage to fragile objects. To address these limitations, we propose a novel force-aware grasping framework incorporating six low-cost, sensitive skin-like tactile sensors. We introduce a magnetic-based tactile sensing module that provides high-precision three-dimensional force measurements. We eliminate geomagnetic interference through a reference Hall sensor and simplify the calibration process compared to previous work. The proposed framework enables precise force-aware grasping control, allowing safe manipulation of fragile objects and real-time weight measurement of grasped items.
