Although it is important for robots to account for these preferences to increase personalization and user satisfaction, they remain largely underexplored in robotic manipulation, particularly in the context of deformable objects like garments and fabrics. In this work, we study how to adapt pretrained visuomotor diffusion policies to reflect preferred behaviors using limited demonstrations. We introduce RKO, a novel preference-alignment method that combines the benefits of two recent frameworks: RPO and KTO. We evaluate RKO against common preference learning frameworks, including these two, as well as a baseline vanilla diffusion policy, on real-world cloth-folding tasks spanning multiple garments and preference settings. We show that preference-aligned policies (particularly RKO) achieve superior performance and sample efficiency compared to standard diffusion policy fine-tuning. These results highlight the importance and feasibility of structured preference learning for scaling personalized robot behavior in complex deformable object manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 人类在执行操作任务时，会自然而然地形成关于如何操作的偏好，这些偏好通常是微妙的、个人的，且难以明确表达。虽然机器人考虑这些偏好对于提高个性化程度和用户满意度至关重要，但它们在机器人操作中仍然很大程度上未被探索，尤其是在像服装和织物这样的可变形物体的操作中。在这项工作中，我们研究了如何使用有限的演示来调整预训练的视觉运动扩散策略，以反映首选的行为。我们提出了一种新颖的偏好对齐方法RKO，它结合了两个最近框架RPO和KTO的优点。我们在现实世界的衣物折叠任务中，针对多种服装和偏好设置，将RKO与常见的偏好学习框架（包括RPO和KTO）以及一个基线原始扩散策略进行了评估。我们表明，偏好对齐的策略（尤其是RKO）与标准的扩散策略微调相比，实现了卓越的性能和样本效率。这些结果突出了结构化偏好学习在复杂的可变形物体操作任务中扩展个性化机器人行为的重要性和可行性。
tldr: The paper presents RKO, a preference-alignment method that adapts visuomotor diffusion policies for deformable object manipulation based on human preferences demonstrated through limited demonstrations, showing improved performance and sample efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为RKO的偏好对齐方法，该方法基于少量示范数据，调整视觉运动扩散策略以适应可变形物体操作中的人类偏好，结果表明其性能和样本效率均有所提高。

title: Sample-Efficient Real-World Dexterous Policy Fine-Tuning via Action-Chunked Critics and Normalizing Flows
summary: Real-world fine-tuning of dexterous manipulation policies remains challenging due to limited real-world interaction budgets and highly multimodal action distributions. Diffusion-based policies, while expressive, do not permit conservative likelihood-based updates during fine-tuning because action probabilities are intractable. In contrast, conventional Gaussian policies collapse under multimodality, particularly when actions are executed in chunks, and standard per-step critics fail to align with chunked execution, leading to poor credit assignment. We present SOFT-FLOW, a sample-efficient off-policy fine-tuning framework with normalizing flow (NF) to address these challenges. The normalizing flow policy yields exact likelihoods for multimodal action chunks, allowing conservative, stable policy updates through likelihood regularization and thereby improving sample efficiency. An action-chunked critic evaluates entire action sequences, aligning value estimation with the policy's temporal structure and improving long-horizon credit assignment. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of a likelihood-based, multimodal generative policy combined with chunk-level value learning on real robotic hardware. We evaluate SOFT-FLOW on two challenging dexterous manipulation tasks in the real world: cutting tape with scissors retrieved from a case, and in-hand cube rotation with a palm-down grasp -- both of which require precise, dexterous control over long horizons. On these tasks, SOFT-FLOW achieves stable, sample-efficient adaptation where standard methods struggle.
summary_zh: 由于现实世界交互预算有限以及高度多模态的动作分布，灵巧操作策略的真实世界微调仍然具有挑战性。基于扩散模型的策略虽然具有表现力，但由于动作概率难以处理，因此不允许在微调期间进行保守的基于似然的更新。相反，传统的 Gaussian 策略在多模态下会崩溃，特别是当动作以块状执行时，并且标准的逐步骤评论家无法与块状执行对齐，导致较差的信用分配。我们提出了 SOFT-FLOW，一个采用归一化流 (NF) 的样本高效的离线策略微调框架来解决这些挑战。归一化流策略为多模态动作块产生精确的似然，从而允许通过似然正则化进行保守、稳定的策略更新，进而提高样本效率。一个动作块评论家评估整个动作序列，使价值估计与策略的时间结构对齐，并改善长时程信用分配。据我们所知，这是首次在真实机器人硬件上演示基于似然的、多模态生成策略与块级价值学习相结合。我们在现实世界中两个具有挑战性的灵巧操作任务上评估了 SOFT-FLOW：用从盒中取出的剪刀切割胶带，以及手掌朝下的抓取姿势下的手内魔方旋转，这两者都需要在长时程内进行精确、灵巧的控制。在这些任务上，SOFT-FLOW 实现了稳定、样本高效的自适应，而标准方法则难以实现。
tldr: The paper introduces SOFT-FLOW, a sample-efficient off-policy fine-tuning framework for dexterous manipulation. It uses normalizing flows for multimodal action representation and action-chunked critics for improved credit assignment, demonstrating strong real-world performance in complex tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SOFT-FLOW，一个用于灵巧操作的采样高效的离线策略微调框架。它使用归一化流进行多模态动作表示，并使用动作块状评论器来改进信用分配，在复杂的现实世界任务中表现出强大的性能。

title: LLM-Grounded Dynamic Task Planning with Hierarchical Temporal Logic for Human-Aware Multi-Robot Collaboration
summary: While Large Language Models (LLM) enable non-experts to specify open-world multi-robot tasks, the generated plans often lack kinematic feasibility and are not efficient, especially in long-horizon scenarios. Formal methods like Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) offer correctness and optimal guarantees, but are typically confined to static, offline settings and struggle with computational scalability. To bridge this gap, we propose a neuro-symbolic framework that grounds LLM reasoning into hierarchical LTL specifications and solves the corresponding Simultaneous Task Allocation and Planning (STAP) problem. Unlike static approaches, our system resolves stochastic environmental changes, such as moving users or updated instructions via a receding horizon planning (RHP) loop with real-time perception, which dynamically refines plans through a hierarchical state space. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms baseline methods in success rate and interaction fluency while minimizing planning latency.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 虽然能够让非专业人士指定开放环境下的多机器人任务，但生成的规划方案常常缺乏运动学可行性，效率也不高，尤其是在长时域场景中。线性时序逻辑 (LTL) 等形式化方法能够提供正确性和最优性保证，但通常局限于静态、离线设置，且难以实现计算上的可伸缩性。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种神经符号框架，将 LLM 的推理融入到分层 LTL 规范中，并求解相应的同步任务分配与规划 (STAP) 问题。与静态方法不同，我们的系统能够应对随机环境变化，例如移动的用户或通过实时感知更新的指令，这通过带有实时感知的后退视界规划 (RHP) 循环来实现，该循环通过分层状态空间动态地细化规划。大量的真实世界实验表明，我们的方法在成功率和交互流畅性方面显著优于基线方法，同时最大限度地减少了规划延迟。
tldr: This paper presents a neuro-symbolic framework that combines LLMs and hierarchical LTL for dynamic task planning in multi-robot systems, enabling human-aware collaboration in stochastic environments through real-time perception and receding horizon planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种神经符号框架，结合了LLM和分层LTL，用于多机器人系统中的动态任务规划，通过实时感知和后退范围规划，实现随机环境中以人为本的协作。

title: Sci-VLA: Agentic VLA Inference Plugin for Long-Horizon Tasks in Scientific Experiments
summary: Robotic laboratories play a critical role in autonomous scientific discovery by enabling scalable, continuous experimental execution. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a promising foundation for robotic laboratories. However, scientific experiments typically involve long-horizon tasks composed of multiple atomic tasks, posing a fundamental challenge to existing VLA models. While VLA models fine-tuned for scientific tasks can reliably execute atomic experimental actions seen during training, they often fail to perform composite tasks formed by reordering and composing these known atomic actions. This limitation arises from a distributional mismatch between training-time atomic tasks and inference-time composite tasks, which prevents VLA models from executing necessary transitional operations between atomic tasks. To address this challenge, we propose an Agentic VLA Inference Plugin for Long-Horizon Tasks in Scientific Experiments. It introduces an LLM-based agentic inference mechanism that intervenes when executing sequential manipulation tasks. By performing explicit transition inference and generating transitional robotic action code, the proposed plugin guides VLA models through missing transitional steps, enabling reliable execution of composite scientific workflows without any additional training. This inference-only intervention makes our method computationally efficient, data-efficient, and well-suited for open-ended and long-horizon robotic laboratory tasks. We build 3D assets of scientific instruments and common scientific operating scenes within an existing simulation environment. In these scenes, we have verified that our method increases the average success rate per atomic task by 42\% during inference. Furthermore, we show that our method can be easily transferred from the simulation to real scientific laboratories.
summary_zh: 机器人实验室在自主科学发现中发挥着关键作用，它们能够实现可扩展、连续的实验执行。 近年来，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人实验室提供了一个有前景的基础。 然而，科学实验通常涉及由多个原子任务组成的长程任务，这对现有的VLA模型提出了根本性的挑战。 虽然针对科学任务微调的VLA模型能够可靠地执行训练期间见过的原子实验动作，但它们通常无法执行通过重新排序和组合这些已知原子动作而形成的复合任务。 这种局限性源于训练时的原子任务和推理时的复合任务之间的分布不匹配，这阻碍了VLA模型执行原子任务之间必要的过渡操作。 为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种用于科学实验中长程任务的基于代理的VLA推理插件。 它引入了一种基于LLM（大型语言模型）的代理推理机制，在执行顺序操作任务时进行干预。 通过执行显式过渡推理并生成过渡性的机器人动作代码，所提出的插件引导VLA模型完成缺失的过渡步骤，从而无需任何额外的训练即可可靠地执行复合科学工作流程。 这种仅推理的干预使我们的方法在计算上高效、数据高效，并且非常适合开放式和长程机器人实验室任务。 我们在现有的仿真环境中构建了科学仪器和常见科学操作场景的3D资产。 在这些场景中，我们验证了我们的方法在推理期间将每个原子任务的平均成功率提高了42%。 此外，我们证明了我们的方法可以很容易地从仿真转移到真实的科学实验室。
tldr: The paper introduces an LLM-based agentic plugin that enhances VLA models' performance in long-horizon scientific experiments by inferring and generating transitional actions, enabling the reliable execution of composite tasks without retraining.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于LLM的代理插件，它通过推断和生成过渡动作来增强VLA模型在长周期科学实验中的性能，从而无需重新训练即可可靠地执行复合任务。

title: Certified Gradient-Based Contact-Rich Manipulation via Smoothing-Error Reachable Tubes
summary: Gradient-based methods can efficiently optimize controllers using physical priors and differentiable simulators, but contact-rich manipulation remains challenging due to discontinuous or vanishing gradients from hybrid contact dynamics. Smoothing the dynamics yields continuous gradients, but the resulting model mismatch can cause controller failures when executed on real systems. We address this trade-off by planning with smoothed dynamics while explicitly quantifying and compensating for the induced errors, providing formal guarantees of constraint satisfaction and goal reachability on the true hybrid dynamics. Our method smooths both contact dynamics and geometry via a novel differentiable simulator based on convex optimization, which enables us to characterize the discrepancy from the true dynamics as a set-valued deviation. This deviation constrains the optimization of time-varying affine feedback policies through analytical bounds on the system's reachable set, enabling robust constraint satisfaction guarantees for the true closed-loop hybrid dynamics, while relying solely on informative gradients from the smoothed dynamics. We evaluate our method on several contact-rich tasks, including planar pushing, object rotation, and in-hand dexterous manipulation, achieving guaranteed constraint satisfaction with lower safety violation and goal error than baselines. By bridging differentiable physics with set-valued robust control, our method is the first certifiable gradient-based policy synthesis method for contact-rich manipulation.
summary_zh: 基于梯度的优化方法可以利用物理先验知识和可微模拟器高效地优化控制器，但由于混合接触动力学产生的不连续或消失梯度，富接触操作仍然具有挑战性。平滑动力学可以产生连续梯度，但是由此产生的模型失配会在真实系统上执行时导致控制器失效。我们通过使用平滑动力学进行规划，同时显式量化和补偿由此产生的误差来解决这种权衡，为真实混合动力学系统提供约束满足和目标可达性的形式保证。我们的方法通过一种基于凸优化的新型可微模拟器来平滑接触动力学和几何，这使我们能够将与真实动力学的差异描述为集值偏差。这种偏差通过系统可达集的解析界限约束了时变仿射反馈策略的优化，从而为真实闭环混合动力学系统提供鲁棒的约束满足保证，同时仅依赖于来自平滑动力学的有效梯度。我们在几个富接触任务（包括平面推动、物体旋转和手内灵巧操作）上评估了我们的方法，实现了比基线方法更低的安全性违反和目标误差的保证约束满足。通过连接可微物理学和集值鲁棒控制，我们的方法是首个用于富接触操作的可认证基于梯度的策略综合方法。
tldr: The paper presents a method for gradient-based control of contact-rich manipulation that guarantees constraint satisfaction by quantifying and compensating for errors introduced by smoothing the dynamics. They achieve this through a novel differentiable simulator and set-valued robust control.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于梯度的接触式操作控制方法，通过量化和补偿由平滑动力学引入的误差来保证约束满足。他们通过一种新颖的可微模拟器和集值鲁棒控制来实现这一点。

title: CAPER: Constrained and Procedural Reasoning for Robotic Scientific Experiments
summary: Robotic assistance in scientific laboratories requires procedurally correct long-horizon manipulation, reliable execution under limited supervision, and robustness in low-demonstration regimes. Such conditions greatly challenge end-to-end vision-language-action (VLA) models, whose assumptions of recoverable errors and data-driven policy learning often break down in protocol-sensitive experiments. We propose CAPER, a framework for Constrained And ProcEdural Reasoning for robotic scientific experiments, which explicitly restricts where learning and reasoning occur in the planning and control pipeline. Rather than strengthening end-to-end policies, CAPER enforces a responsibility-separated structure: task-level reasoning generates procedurally valid action sequences under explicit constraints, mid-level multimodal grounding realizes subtasks without delegating spatial decision-making to large language models, and low-level control adapts to physical uncertainty via reinforcement learning with minimal demonstrations. By encoding procedural commitments through interpretable intermediate representations, CAPER prevents execution-time violations of experimental logic, improving controllability, robustness, and data efficiency. Experiments on a scientific workflow benchmark and a public long-horizon manipulation dataset demonstrate consistent improvements in success rate and procedural correctness, particularly in low-data and long-horizon settings.
summary_zh: 在科学实验室中，机器人辅助需要程序上正确的长时程操作、在有限监督下的可靠执行以及在低样本量下的鲁棒性。这些条件对端到端视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型提出了巨大挑战，这些模型的错误可恢复性和数据驱动策略学习的假设在协议敏感的实验中通常会崩溃。我们提出了 CAPER，一个用于机器人科学实验的约束式和程序化推理框架，它显式地限制了学习和推理在规划和控制流程中发生的位置。CAPER 并非加强端到端策略，而是强制执行一种责任分离的结构：任务级推理在显式约束下生成程序上有效的动作序列；中间层多模态接地元实现子任务，而不将空间决策委托给大型语言模型; 底层控制通过强化学习适应物理不确定性，且只需少量演示。通过可解释的中间表示对程序承诺进行编码，CAPER 可防止执行时违反实验逻辑，从而提高可控性、鲁棒性和数据效率。在科学工作流程基准和公开的长时程操作数据集上的实验表明，成功率和程序正确性得到了持续的提高，尤其是在低数据和长时程设置中。
tldr: The paper introduces CAPER, a framework for robotic scientific experiments that combines constrained task-level reasoning, multimodal grounding, and low-level RL to improve robustness and data efficiency in long-horizon manipulation tasks, especially in low-data regimes.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 CAPER，一个用于机器人科学实验的框架，它结合了约束的任务级推理、多模态基础和低级强化学习，以提高长时程操作任务的鲁棒性和数据效率，尤其是在低数据情况下。

title: STaR: Scalable Task-Conditioned Retrieval for Long-Horizon Multimodal Robot Memory
summary: Mobile robots are often deployed over long durations in diverse open, dynamic scenes, including indoor setting such as warehouses and manufacturing facilities, and outdoor settings such as agricultural and roadway operations. A core challenge is to build a scalable long-horizon memory that supports an agentic workflow for planning, retrieval, and reasoning over open-ended instructions at variable granularity, while producing precise, actionable answers for navigation. We present STaR, an agentic reasoning framework that (i) constructs a task-agnostic, multimodal long-term memory that generalizes to unseen queries while preserving fine-grained environmental semantics (object attributes, spatial relations, and dynamic events), and (ii) introduces a Scalable Task Conditioned Retrieval algorithm based on the Information Bottleneck principle to extract from long-term memory a compact, non-redundant, information-rich set of candidate memories for contextual reasoning. We evaluate STaR on NaVQA (mixed indoor/outdoor campus scenes) and WH-VQA, a customized warehouse benchmark with many visually similar objects built with Isaac Sim, emphasizing contextual reasoning. Across the two datasets, STaR consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving higher success rates and markedly lower spatial error. We further deploy STaR on a real Husky wheeled robot in both indoor and outdoor environments, demonstrating robust long horizon reasoning, scalability, and practical utility. Project Website: https://trailab.github.io/STaR-website/
summary_zh: 移动机器人通常会在各种开放、动态的场景中长时间部署，包括仓库和制造设施等室内环境，以及农业和道路作业等室外环境。一个核心挑战是构建可扩展的长周期记忆，以支持智能体的工作流程，用于规划、检索和推理各种粒度的开放式指令，同时为导航产生精确、可操作的答案。我们提出了STaR，一个智能体推理框架，该框架 (i) 构建了一个与任务无关的多模态长期记忆，该记忆可以推广到未见过的查询，同时保留细粒度的环境语义（对象属性、空间关系和动态事件），并且 (ii) 引入了一种基于信息瓶颈原理的可扩展任务条件检索算法，可以从长期记忆中提取一个紧凑、非冗余、信息丰富的候选记忆集合，用于上下文推理。我们在 NaVQA（混合室内/室外校园场景）和 WH-VQA（一个使用 Isaac Sim 构建的、具有许多视觉上相似对象的定制仓库基准测试，强调上下文推理）上评估了 STaR。在两个数据集上，STaR 始终优于强大的基线，实现了更高的成功率和明显更低的空间误差。我们进一步将 STaR 部署在室内和室外环境中的真实 Husky 轮式机器人上，展示了强大的长周期推理、可扩展性和实用性。项目网站：https://trailab.github.io/STaR-website/
tldr: The paper introduces STaR, a framework for scalable, task-conditioned retrieval of multimodal long-term memory for robots, enabling long-horizon reasoning and navigation in diverse environments. It demonstrates strong performance on simulated and real-world robotic platforms.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了STaR，一个用于可扩展的、任务条件下的多模态长期记忆检索的框架，旨在支持机器人在各种环境中进行长期的推理和导航。该框架在模拟和真实机器人平台上都表现出强大的性能。

title: $χ_{0}$: Resource-Aware Robust Manipulation via Taming Distributional Inconsistencies
summary: High-reliability long-horizon robotic manipulation has traditionally relied on large-scale data and compute to understand complex real-world dynamics. However, we identify that the primary bottleneck to real-world robustness is not resource scale alone, but the distributional shift among the human demonstration distribution, the inductive bias learned by the policy, and the test-time execution distribution -- a systematic inconsistency that causes compounding errors in multi-stage tasks. To mitigate these inconsistencies, we propose $χ_{0}$, a resource-efficient framework with effective modules designated to achieve production-level robustness in robotic manipulation. Our approach builds off three technical pillars: (i) Model Arithmetic, a weight-space merging strategy that efficiently soaks up diverse distributions of different demonstrations, varying from object appearance to state variations; (ii) Stage Advantage, a stage-aware advantage estimator that provides stable, dense progress signals, overcoming the numerical instability of prior non-stage approaches; and (iii) Train-Deploy Alignment, which bridges the distribution gap via spatio-temporal augmentation, heuristic DAgger corrections, and temporal chunk-wise smoothing. $χ_{0}$ enables two sets of dual-arm robots to collaboratively orchestrate long-horizon garment manipulation, spanning tasks from flattening, folding, to hanging different clothes. Our method exhibits high-reliability autonomy; we are able to run the system from arbitrary initial state for consecutive 24 hours non-stop. Experiments validate that $χ_{0}$ surpasses the state-of-the-art $π_{0.5}$ in success rate by nearly 250%, with only 20-hour data and 8 A100 GPUs. Code, data and models will be released to facilitate the community.
summary_zh: 高可靠性的长时程机器人操作传统上依赖于大规模数据和计算来理解复杂的真实世界动力学。然而，我们发现实现真实世界鲁棒性的主要瓶颈不仅仅是资源规模，而是人类演示分布、策略学习的归纳偏置以及测试时执行分布之间的分布偏移——这种系统性的不一致会导致多阶段任务中的误差累积。为了缓解这些不一致，我们提出了$χ_{0}$，一个资源高效的框架，其包含有效模块，旨在实现机器人操作中生产级别的鲁棒性。我们的方法基于三个技术支柱：（i）模型算术，一种权重空间合并策略，可以有效地吸收不同演示的多样化分布，包括物体外观到状态变化的不同；（ii）阶段优势，一种阶段感知的优势估计器，提供稳定的、密集的进度信号，克服了先前非阶段方法的数值不稳定性；（iii）训练-部署对齐，通过时空增强、启发式DAgger校正以及时间块状平滑来弥合分布差距。$χ_{0}$使两组双臂机器人能够协同编排长时程的服装操作，涵盖从展平、折叠到悬挂不同衣服的任务。我们的方法表现出高可靠性的自主性；我们能够从任意初始状态连续运行系统24小时不间断。实验验证表明，$χ_{0}$在成功率方面超越了最先进的$π_{0.5}$近250%，仅使用20小时的数据和8个A100 GPU。代码、数据和模型将被发布以方便社区。
tldr: This paper introduces $χ_{0}$, a resource-efficient framework for robust long-horizon robotic manipulation that addresses distributional shifts between demonstration data, learned policy, and test-time execution by using techniques like model arithmetic, stage advantage estimation, and train-deploy alignment. The approach enables reliable dual-arm garment manipulation and significantly outperforms existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种资源高效的鲁棒性长期机器人操作框架$χ_{0}$，该框架通过模型算术、阶段优势估计和训练-部署对齐等技术，解决了演示数据、学习策略和测试时执行之间的分布偏移问题。该方法实现了可靠的双臂服装操作，并显著优于现有方法。

title: Robustness Is a Function, Not a Number: A Factorized Comprehensive Study of OOD Robustness in Vision-Based Driving
summary: Out of distribution (OOD) robustness in autonomous driving is often reduced to a single number, hiding what breaks a policy. We decompose environments along five axes: scene (rural/urban), season, weather, time (day/night), and agent mix; and measure performance under controlled $k$-factor perturbations ($k \in \{0,1,2,3\}$). Using closed loop control in VISTA, we benchmark FC, CNN, and ViT policies, train compact ViT heads on frozen foundation-model (FM) features, and vary ID support in scale, diversity, and temporal context. (1) ViT policies are markedly more OOD-robust than comparably sized CNN/FC, and FM features yield state-of-the-art success at a latency cost. (2) Naive temporal inputs (multi-frame) do not beat the best single-frame baseline. (3) The largest single factor drops are rural $\rightarrow$ urban and day $\rightarrow$ night ($\sim 31\%$ each); actor swaps $\sim 10\%$, moderate rain $\sim 7\%$; season shifts can be drastic, and combining a time flip with other changes further degrades performance. (4) FM-feature policies stay above $85\%$ under three simultaneous changes; non-FM single-frame policies take a large first-shift hit, and all no-FM models fall below $50\%$ by three changes. (5) Interactions are non-additive: some pairings partially offset, whereas season-time combinations are especially harmful. (6) Training on winter/snow is most robust to single-factor shifts, while a rural+summer baseline gives the best overall OOD performance. (7) Scaling traces/views improves robustness ($+11.8$ points from $5$ to $14$ traces), yet targeted exposure to hard conditions can substitute for scale. (8) Using multiple ID environments broadens coverage and strengthens weak cases (urban OOD $60.6\% \rightarrow 70.1\%$) with a small ID drop; single-ID preserves peak performance but in a narrow domain. These results yield actionable design rules for OOD-robust driving policies.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶中的分布外 (OOD) 鲁棒性通常被简化为一个单一的数字，掩盖了策略失效的原因。我们沿着五个轴分解环境：场景（乡村/城市）、季节、天气、时间（白天/夜晚）和智能体混合；并测量在受控的 $k$ 因子扰动下（$k \in \{0,1,2,3\}$）的性能。使用 VISTA 中的闭环控制，我们对 FC、CNN 和 ViT 策略进行基准测试，在冻结的预训练模型（FM）特征上训练紧凑的 ViT 头，并改变规模、多样性和时间上下文中的 ID 支持。（1）ViT 策略明显比同等规模的 CNN/FC 策略更具有 OOD 鲁棒性，并且 FM 特征以延迟为代价实现了最先进的成功率。（2）朴素的时间输入（多帧）无法击败最佳单帧基线。（3）最大的单因素下降是乡村 $\rightarrow$ 城市和白天 $\rightarrow$ 夜晚（各约 $31\%$）；智能体交换约 $10\%$，中等降雨约 $7\%$；季节变化可能非常剧烈，并且将时间翻转与其他变化结合会进一步降低性能。（4）在三个同时变化下，FM 特征策略保持在 $85\%$ 以上；非 FM 单帧策略在第一次变化时受到较大影响，并且所有非 FM 模型在三个变化下都降至 $50\%$ 以下。（5）交互作用是非加性的：一些配对部分抵消，而季节-时间组合尤其有害。（6）在冬季/雪地训练对单因素变化最鲁棒，而乡村+夏季基线则提供最佳的整体 OOD 性能。（7）缩放轨迹/视图可以提高鲁棒性（从 $5$ 个到 $14$ 个轨迹增加 $+11.8$ 个点），但有针对性地暴露于困难条件下可以替代规模。（8）使用多个 ID 环境可以扩大覆盖范围并加强薄弱案例（城市 OOD 从 $60.6\%$ 提高到 $70.1\%$），但 ID 下降幅度较小；单 ID 保留了峰值性能，但仅限于狭窄的领域。这些结果可以为 OOD 鲁棒驾驶策略提供可操作的设计规则。
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates the OOD robustness of vision-based driving policies across various environmental factors, revealing insights into model architectures, training data composition, and feature representations that contribute to improved performance in unseen conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文系统地评估了基于视觉的驾驶策略在各种环境因素下的OOD鲁棒性，揭示了模型架构、训练数据组成和特征表示方面的见解，这些特性有助于提高在未见条件下的性能。

title: Contact-Anchored Policies: Contact Conditioning Creates Strong Robot Utility Models
summary: The prevalent paradigm in robot learning attempts to generalize across environments, embodiments, and tasks with language prompts at runtime. A fundamental tension limits this approach: language is often too abstract to guide the concrete physical understanding required for robust manipulation. In this work, we introduce Contact-Anchored Policies (CAP), which replace language conditioning with points of physical contact in space. Simultaneously, we structure CAP as a library of modular utility models rather than a monolithic generalist policy. This factorization allows us to implement a real-to-sim iteration cycle: we build EgoGym, a lightweight simulation benchmark, to rapidly identify failure modes and refine our models and datasets prior to real-world deployment. We show that by conditioning on contact and iterating via simulation, CAP generalizes to novel environments and embodiments out of the box on three fundamental manipulation skills while using only 23 hours of demonstration data, and outperforms large, state-of-the-art VLAs in zero-shot evaluations by 56%. All model checkpoints, codebase, hardware, simulation, and datasets will be open-sourced. Project page: https://cap-policy.github.io/
summary_zh: 在机器人学习领域，目前流行的范式试图通过在运行时使用语言提示来泛化到不同的环境、具身和任务。这种方法存在一个根本性的制约：语言通常过于抽象，难以指导实现稳健操作所需的具体物理理解。在这项工作中，我们引入了接触锚定策略（CAP），它用空间中的物理接触点来取代语言条件化。同时，我们将CAP构建为一个模块化的效用模型库，而不是一个单一的通用策略。这种分解使我们能够实现一个真实到仿真的迭代循环：我们构建了一个轻量级的仿真基准EgoGym，以快速识别故障模式，并在实际部署之前改进我们的模型和数据集。我们表明，通过接触条件化和仿真迭代，CAP能够在仅使用23小时的演示数据的情况下，即刻泛化到新的环境和具身，并在三个基本操作技能上优于大型、最先进的视觉-语言代理（VLA），在零样本评估中性能提升了56%。所有模型检查点、代码库、硬件、仿真和数据集都将开源。项目主页：https://cap-policy.github.io/
tldr: The paper introduces Contact-Anchored Policies (CAP), which condition on physical contact points instead of language for robot manipulation, achieving better generalization and performance with less data compared to VLAs.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了接触锚定策略（CAP），它使用物理接触点代替语言作为机器人操作的条件，与视觉语言动作模型相比，在更少数据的情况下实现了更好的泛化和性能。

title: From Obstacles to Etiquette: Robot Social Navigation with VLM-Informed Path Selection
summary: Navigating socially in human environments requires more than satisfying geometric constraints, as collision-free paths may still interfere with ongoing activities or conflict with social norms. Addressing this challenge calls for analyzing interactions between agents and incorporating common-sense reasoning into planning. This paper presents a social robot navigation framework that integrates geometric planning with contextual social reasoning. The system first extracts obstacles and human dynamics to generate geometrically feasible candidate paths, then leverages a fine-tuned vision-language model (VLM) to evaluate these paths, informed by contextually grounded social expectations, selecting a socially optimized path for the controller. This task-specific VLM distills social reasoning from large foundation models into a smaller and efficient model, allowing the framework to perform real-time adaptation in diverse human-robot interaction contexts. Experiments in four social navigation contexts demonstrate that our method achieves the best overall performance with the lowest personal space violation duration, the minimal pedestrian-facing time, and no social zone intrusions. Project page: https://path-etiquette.github.io
summary_zh: 在人类环境中进行社交导航不仅需要满足几何约束，因为即使是无碰撞的路径也可能干扰正在进行的活动或与社会规范相冲突。应对这一挑战需要分析智能体之间的互动，并将常识推理融入规划中。本文提出了一种融合几何规划与情境化社会推理的社交机器人导航框架。该系统首先提取障碍物和人类动态信息，生成几何上可行的候选路径，然后利用一个微调的视觉-语言模型（VLM），根据情境化的社会期望评估这些路径，从而为控制器选择一条社会优化路径。这种特定任务的VLM将大型基础模型中的社会推理提炼成一个更小、更高效的模型，使该框架能够在各种人机交互情境中进行实时适应。在四个社交导航情境中的实验表明，我们的方法实现了最佳的整体性能，具有最短的个人空间侵犯持续时间、最少的面向行人时间，并且没有社交区域入侵。项目主页：https://path-etiquette.github.io
tldr: This paper presents a social robot navigation framework that uses a fine-tuned vision-language model to select socially appropriate paths for robots in human environments, minimizing social norm violations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种社交机器人导航框架，该框架使用微调的视觉语言模型来为机器人在人类环境中选择适合社交规范的路径，从而最大限度地减少社交规范违规。

title: CLUE: Crossmodal disambiguation via Language-vision Understanding with attEntion
summary: With the increasing integration of robots into daily life, human-robot interaction has become more complex and multifaceted. A critical component of this interaction is Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG), through which robots must interpret human intentions and resolve ambiguity. Existing IVG models generally lack a mechanism to determine when to ask clarification questions, as they implicitly rely on their learned representations. CLUE addresses this gap by converting the VLM's cross-modal attention into an explicit, spatially grounded signal for deciding when to ask. We extract text to image attention maps and pass them to a lightweight CNN to detect referential ambiguity, while a LoRA fine-tuned decoder conducts the dialog and emits grounding location tokens. We train on a real-world interactive dataset for IVG, and a mixed ambiguity set for the detector. With InViG-only supervision, our model surpasses a state-of-the-art method while using parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Similarly, the ambiguity detector outperforms prior baselines. Overall, CLUE turns the internal cross-modal attention of a VLM into an explicit, spatially grounded signal for deciding when to ask. The data and code are publicly available at: mouadabrini.github.io/clue
summary_zh: 随着机器人日益融入日常生活，人机交互变得更加复杂和多元化。交互式视觉定位（IVG）是这种交互的关键组成部分，它要求机器人能够理解人类意图并消除歧义。现有的IVG模型通常缺乏一种机制来确定何时提出澄清问题，因为它们隐式地依赖于其学习到的表征。CLUE通过将视觉语言模型（VLM）的跨模态注意力转化为显式的、空间定位的信号来弥补这一差距，从而决定何时提问。我们提取文本到图像的注意力图，并将其传递给一个轻量级CNN，以检测指代歧义，同时利用LoRA微调的解码器进行对话并发出定位的token。我们在一个真实的交互式IVG数据集和一个混合的歧义数据集上训练检测器。仅使用InViG监督，我们的模型就超过了最先进的方法，同时采用了参数高效的微调。同样，歧义检测器也优于之前的基线。总的来说，CLUE将VLM的内部跨模态注意力转化为显式的、空间定位的信号，用于决定何时提问。数据和代码可在以下网址公开获取：mouadabrini.github.io/clue
tldr: The paper introduces CLUE, a model that leverages cross-modal attention in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to explicitly detect referential ambiguity in Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG), enabling robots to ask clarification questions more effectively, and achieves SOTA results using parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为CLUE的模型，该模型利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）中的跨模态注意力来显式地检测交互式视觉定位（IVG）中的引用歧义，使机器人能够更有效地提出澄清问题，并且使用参数高效的微调实现了SOTA结果。

title: Reduced-order Control and Geometric Structure of Learned Lagrangian Latent Dynamics
summary: Model-based controllers can offer strong guarantees on stability and convergence by relying on physically accurate dynamic models. However, these are rarely available for high-dimensional mechanical systems such as deformable objects or soft robots. While neural architectures can learn to approximate complex dynamics, they are either limited to low-dimensional systems or provide only limited formal control guarantees due to a lack of embedded physical structure. This paper introduces a latent control framework based on learned structure-preserving reduced-order dynamics for high-dimensional Lagrangian systems. We derive a reduced tracking law for fully actuated systems and adopt a Riemannian perspective on projection-based model-order reduction to study the resulting latent and projected closed-loop dynamics. By quantifying the sources of modeling error, we derive interpretable conditions for stability and convergence. We extend the proposed controller and analysis to underactuated systems by introducing learned actuation patterns. Experimental results on simulated and real-world systems validate our theoretical investigation and the accuracy of our controllers.
summary_zh: 基于模型的控制器可以通过依赖物理上精确的动力学模型来提供强大的稳定性和收敛性保证。然而，对于高维机械系统，例如可变形物体或软体机器人，这种模型很难获得。尽管神经架构可以学习逼近复杂的动力学，但它们要么局限于低维系统，要么由于缺乏嵌入的物理结构，只能提供有限的形式化控制保证。本文介绍了一种基于学习的保结构降阶动力学的潜在控制框架，用于高维拉格朗日系统。我们为全驱动系统推导出了一种降阶跟踪律，并采用基于投影的模型降阶的黎曼视角来研究由此产生的潜在和投影闭环动力学。通过量化建模误差的来源，我们推导出了可解释的稳定性和收敛条件。我们通过引入学习的驱动模式，将所提出的控制器和分析扩展到欠驱动系统。在仿真和真实世界系统上的实验结果验证了我们的理论研究和控制器的准确性。
tldr: This paper introduces a latent control framework using learned structure-preserving reduced-order dynamics for controlling high-dimensional Lagrangian systems, offering stability guarantees even for underactuated systems, validated through simulations and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个潜在控制框架，该框架使用学习到的保结构降阶动力学来控制高维拉格朗日系统，为欠驱动系统提供稳定性保证，并通过仿真和现实世界的实验进行了验证。

title: ADORA: Training Reasoning Models with Dynamic Advantage Estimation on Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning has become a cornerstone technique for developing reasoning models in complex tasks, ranging from mathematical problem-solving to imaginary reasoning. The optimization of these models typically relies on policy gradient methods, whose efficacy hinges on the accurate estimation of an advantage function. However, prevailing methods typically employ static advantage estimation, a practice that leads to inefficient credit assignment by neglecting the dynamic utility of training samples over time. This limitation results in suboptimal policy updates, which in turn manifest as slower convergence rates and increased learning instability, as models fail to adapt to evolving sample utilities effectively. To address this problem, we introduce \textbf{ADORA} (\textbf{A}dvantage \textbf{D}ynamics via \textbf{O}nline \textbf{R}ollout \textbf{A}daptation), a novel framework for policy optimization. ADORA dynamically adjusts the advantage function's weighting by adaptively categorizing training data into temporarily advantageous and disadvantageous samples, based on their evolving utility during online model rollouts. This tailored data differentiation strategy allows ADORA to be seamlessly integrated into existing policy optimization algorithms without significant architectural modifications, enabling the policy to prioritize learning from more informative experiences and thereby achieve more efficient policy updates. Extensive evaluations across diverse model families and varying data scales demonstrate that ADORA is a robust and efficient framework. It significantly enhances long reasoning in both geometric and mathematical tasks, consistently achieving notable performance gains without requiring sensitive hyperparameter tuning.
summary_zh: 强化学习已成为开发复杂任务中推理模型（从数学问题求解到想象推理）的基石技术。这些模型的优化通常依赖于策略梯度方法，其有效性取决于对优势函数的准确估计。然而，目前流行的方法通常采用静态优势估计，这种做法忽略了训练样本随时间的动态效用，从而导致低效的信用分配。这种局限性导致次优的策略更新，进而表现为较慢的收敛速度和增加的学习不稳定性，因为模型无法有效地适应不断变化的样本效用。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 \textbf{ADORA} (基于\textbf{在}线\textbf{展}开\textbf{适}应的\textbf{优}势\textbf{动}态)，这是一种新颖的策略优化框架。ADORA通过基于在线模型展开期间的演变效用，自适应地将训练数据分类为暂时有利和不利的样本，从而动态调整优势函数的权重。这种定制的数据区分策略使ADORA能够无缝集成到现有的策略优化算法中，而无需进行重大的架构修改，从而使策略能够优先从更有价值的经验中学习，并因此实现更有效的策略更新。在不同的模型族和不同数据规模上的广泛评估表明，ADORA是一个强大而高效的框架。它显著增强了几何和数学任务中的长期推理能力，始终如一地取得了显著的性能提升，而无需进行敏感的超参数调整。
tldr: The paper introduces ADORA, a novel reinforcement learning framework that dynamically adjusts the advantage function by categorizing training data based on its evolving utility, leading to more efficient policy updates and improved performance in reasoning tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ADORA，一种新颖的强化学习框架，通过根据训练数据的演变效用对其进行分类，动态调整优势函数，从而实现更有效的策略更新并提高推理任务中的性能。

title: Discovering High Level Patterns from Simulation Traces
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents embedded in environments with physics-based interaction face many challenges including reasoning, planning, summarization, and question answering. This problem is exacerbated when a human user wishes to either guide or interact with the agent in natural language. Although the use of Language Models (LMs) is the default choice, as an AI tool, they struggle with tasks involving physics. The LM's capability for physical reasoning is learned from observational data, rather than being grounded in simulation. A common approach is to include simulation traces as context, but this suffers from poor scalability as simulation traces contain larger volumes of fine-grained numerical and semantic data. In this paper, we propose a natural language guided method to discover coarse-grained patterns (e.g., 'rigid-body collision', 'stable support', etc.) from detailed simulation logs. Specifically, we synthesize programs that operate on simulation logs and map them to a series of high level activated patterns. We show, through two physics benchmarks, that this annotated representation of the simulation log is more amenable to natural language reasoning about physical systems. We demonstrate how this method enables LMs to generate effective reward programs from goals specified in natural language, which may be used within the context of planning or supervised learning.
summary_zh: 嵌入在具有基于物理交互环境中的人工智能（AI）代理面临诸多挑战，包括推理、规划、概括和问答。当人类用户希望以自然语言引导或与代理交互时，这个问题会更加严重。尽管使用语言模型（LM）是默认选择，但作为一种AI工具，它们在涉及物理的任务中表现不佳。LM的物理推理能力是从观察数据中学习的，而不是基于模拟的。一种常见的方法是将模拟轨迹作为上下文包含进来，但这存在可扩展性差的问题，因为模拟轨迹包含大量的细粒度数值和语义数据。在本文中，我们提出了一种自然语言引导的方法，用于从详细的模拟日志中发现粗粒度的模式（例如，“刚体碰撞”、“稳定支撑”等）。具体来说，我们合成在模拟日志上运行的程序，并将它们映射到一系列高级激活模式。我们通过两个物理基准测试表明，这种带有注释的模拟日志表示更适合于对物理系统进行自然语言推理。我们展示了这种方法如何使LM能够从自然语言指定的目标中生成有效的奖励程序，这些奖励程序可以在规划或监督学习的上下文中使用。
tldr: This paper introduces a method to extract high-level patterns from physics simulation logs using natural language guidance, enhancing language models' ability to reason about physical systems and generate effective reward programs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用自然语言引导，从物理仿真日志中提取高层模式的方法，从而增强语言模型对物理系统进行推理和生成有效奖励程序的能力。

title: Code2World: A GUI World Model via Renderable Code Generation
summary: Autonomous GUI agents interact with environments by perceiving interfaces and executing actions. As a virtual sandbox, the GUI World model empowers agents with human-like foresight by enabling action-conditioned prediction. However, existing text- and pixel-based approaches struggle to simultaneously achieve high visual fidelity and fine-grained structural controllability. To this end, we propose Code2World, a vision-language coder that simulates the next visual state via renderable code generation. Specifically, to address the data scarcity problem, we construct AndroidCode by translating GUI trajectories into high-fidelity HTML and refining synthesized code through a visual-feedback revision mechanism, yielding a corpus of over 80K high-quality screen-action pairs. To adapt existing VLMs into code prediction, we first perform SFT as a cold start for format layout following, then further apply Render-Aware Reinforcement Learning which uses rendered outcome as the reward signal by enforcing visual semantic fidelity and action consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Code2World-8B achieves the top-performing next UI prediction, rivaling the competitive GPT-5 and Gemini-3-Pro-Image. Notably, Code2World significantly enhances downstream navigation success rates in a flexible manner, boosting Gemini-2.5-Flash by +9.5% on AndroidWorld navigation. The code is available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/Code2World.
summary_zh: 自主图形用户界面（GUI）智能体通过感知界面和执行动作与环境交互。作为一种虚拟沙盒，GUI World模型通过支持动作条件预测，赋予智能体类似人类的远见能力。然而，现有的基于文本和像素的方法难以同时实现高视觉保真度和细粒度的结构可控性。为此，我们提出了Code2World，一种视觉-语言编码器，它通过可渲染的代码生成来模拟下一个视觉状态。具体而言，为了解决数据稀缺问题，我们构建了AndroidCode，通过将GUI轨迹翻译成高保真HTML，并通过视觉反馈修正机制来改进合成代码，从而生成了一个包含超过8万个高质量屏幕-动作对的语料库。为了使现有的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）适应代码预测，我们首先执行有监督微调（SFT）作为格式布局遵循的冷启动，然后进一步应用渲染感知强化学习，该方法使用渲染结果作为奖励信号，以保证视觉语义保真度和动作一致性。大量实验表明，Code2World-8B实现了最佳的下一UI预测性能，可与极具竞争力的GPT-5和Gemini-3-Pro-Image相媲美。值得注意的是，Code2World以一种灵活的方式显著提高了下游导航成功率，在AndroidWorld导航中使Gemini-2.5-Flash提升了+9.5%。代码已在https://github.com/AMAP-ML/Code2World上提供。
tldr: The paper introduces Code2World, a vision-language coder that generates renderable code to simulate the next visual state of GUI environments, achieving state-of-the-art UI prediction and improving downstream navigation. It overcomes data scarcity by creating AndroidCode, a large dataset of GUI trajectories translated into HTML.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Code2World，一种通过生成可渲染代码来模拟GUI环境的下一个视觉状态的视觉-语言编码器，实现了最先进的UI预测并提高了下游导航性能。它通过创建AndroidCode，一个将GUI轨迹转换为HTML的大型数据集，克服了数据稀缺问题。

title: Flexible Entropy Control in RLVR with Gradient-Preserving Perspective
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a critical method for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, continuous training often leads to policy entropy collapse, characterized by a rapid decay in entropy that results in premature overconfidence, reduced output diversity, and vanishing gradient norms that inhibit learning. Gradient-Preserving Clipping is a primary factor influencing these dynamics, but existing mitigation strategies are largely static and lack a framework connecting clipping mechanisms to precise entropy control. This paper proposes reshaping entropy control in RL from the perspective of Gradient-Preserving Clipping. We first theoretically and empirically verify the contributions of specific importance sampling ratio regions to entropy growth and reduction. Leveraging these findings, we introduce a novel regulation mechanism using dynamic clipping threshold to precisely manage entropy. Furthermore, we design and evaluate dynamic entropy control strategies, including increase-then-decrease, decrease-increase-decrease, and oscillatory decay. Experimental results demonstrate that these strategies effectively mitigate entropy collapse, and achieve superior performance across multiple benchmarks.
summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为增强大型语言模型（LLMs）推理能力的关键方法。然而，持续训练通常会导致策略熵坍塌，其特征是熵快速衰减，从而导致过早的过度自信、输出多样性降低以及抑制学习的梯度范数消失。梯度保持剪裁是影响这些动态的主要因素，但现有的缓解策略大多是静态的，并且缺乏将剪裁机制与精确熵控制联系起来的框架。本文从梯度保持剪裁的角度提出了重塑RL中的熵控制。我们首先从理论和实验上验证了特定重要性采样比率区域对熵增长和减少的贡献。利用这些发现，我们引入了一种使用动态剪裁阈值来精确管理熵的新型调节机制。此外，我们设计并评估了动态熵控制策略，包括先增后减、先减后增再减以及振荡衰减。实验结果表明，这些策略能有效缓解熵坍塌，并在多个基准测试中取得了优异的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a dynamic entropy control mechanism for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to prevent policy entropy collapse, using a gradient-preserving clipping perspective. Experiments demonstrate superior performance across multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的动态熵控制机制，以防止策略熵坍塌，该机制采用梯度保持裁剪视角。实验结果表明，该方法在多个基准测试中表现出色。

title: Grounding LTL Tasks in Sub-Symbolic RL Environments for Zero-Shot Generalization
summary: In this work we address the problem of training a Reinforcement Learning agent to follow multiple temporally-extended instructions expressed in Linear Temporal Logic in sub-symbolic environments. Previous multi-task work has mostly relied on knowledge of the mapping between raw observations and symbols appearing in the formulae. We drop this unrealistic assumption by jointly training a multi-task policy and a symbol grounder with the same experience. The symbol grounder is trained only from raw observations and sparse rewards via Neural Reward Machines in a semi-supervised fashion. Experiments on vision-based environments show that our method achieves performance comparable to using the true symbol grounding and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods for sub-symbolic environments.
summary_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了在亚符号环境中训练强化学习智能体以遵循用线性时序逻辑表达的多个时间扩展指令的问题。以往的多任务工作主要依赖于对原始观察和公式中出现的符号之间的映射关系的了解。我们通过利用相同的经验联合训练多任务策略和符号接地器，从而放弃了这种不切实际的假设。符号接地器仅通过神经奖励机，以半监督的方式，从原始观察和稀疏奖励中进行训练。在基于视觉的环境中的实验表明，我们的方法获得了与使用真实符号接地相似的性能，并且显著优于亚符号环境下的现有先进方法。
tldr: This paper proposes a method for training RL agents to follow LTL instructions in sub-symbolic environments without requiring a known mapping between observations and symbols, achieving performance comparable to using ground truth symbols.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种训练强化学习智能体在亚符号环境中遵循线性时序逻辑指令的方法，该方法不需要已知的观察和符号之间的映射，并且性能与使用真实标签的符号时效果相当。

title: GenSeg-R1: RL-Driven Vision-Language Grounding for Fine-Grained Referring Segmentation
summary:
We study fine-grained referring image segmentation via a decoupled reason-then-segment pipeline. A vision-language model (VLM) receives an image and a natural-language query, reasons about the scene, and emits structured spatial prompts: a bounding box plus two interior keypoints for every referred instance. A frozen promptable segmenter (SAM 2) converts these prompts into high-quality masks.
  Within our GenSeg-R1 framework we finetune Qwen3-VL models (4B and 8B parameters) using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), requiring no supervised reasoning-chain annotations. On RefCOCOg validation our best model (GenSeg-R1-8B) achieves 0.7127 cIoU and 0.7382 mIoU, substantially outperforming the corresponding Qwen3-VL Instruct baselines (+15.3 and +21.9 points, respectively) and surpassing Seg-Zero-7B [3] by +3.3 cIoU under identical evaluation.
  We further introduce GenSeg-R1-G, a variant trained on GRefCOCO [9] with a SAM 2 in-the-loop reward that directly optimizes mask quality. On GRefCOCO validation GenSeg-R1-G achieves 76.69% target mIoU with 82.40% accuracy on negative (no-target) prompts, substantially outperforming Seg-R1-7B and Seg-Zero-7B, which lack no-target detection capability. On ReasonSeg test, GenSeg-R1-4B reaches 68.40% mIoU, surpassing Seg-Zero-7B by +7.0 and Seg-R1-7B by +10.7 points.
summary_zh:
我们研究了通过解耦的推理-分割流水线进行细粒度指称图像分割。一个视觉-语言模型（VLM）接收图像和自然语言查询，对场景进行推理，并生成结构化的空间提示：每个指称实例的边界框加上两个内部关键点。一个冻结的可提示分割器（SAM 2）将这些提示转换为高质量的掩码。
  在我们的GenSeg-R1框架内，我们使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）微调Qwen3-VL模型（4B和8B参数），无需监督的推理链标注。在RefCOCOg验证集上，我们最好的模型（GenSeg-R1-8B）实现了0.7127的cIoU和0.7382的mIoU，显著优于相应的Qwen3-VL Instruct基线（分别提升+15.3和+21.9个点），并在相同的评估条件下超过Seg-Zero-7B [3] +3.3个cIoU。
  我们进一步推出了GenSeg-R1-G，它是基于GRefCOCO [9]训练的变体，采用循环内的SAM 2奖励机制，直接优化掩码质量。在GRefCOCO验证集上，GenSeg-R1-G在负（无目标）提示上实现76.69%的目标mIoU和82.40%的准确率，显著优于缺乏无目标检测能力的Seg-R1-7B和Seg-Zero-7B。在ReasonSeg测试集上，GenSeg-R1-4B达到68.40%的mIoU，相较于Seg-Zero-7B和Seg-R1-7B分别提升+7.0和+10.7个点。
tldr: The paper presents GenSeg-R1, a reinforcement learning-driven framework that uses a vision-language model to generate spatial prompts for fine-grained referring image segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art performance on several benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 GenSeg-R1，一个由强化学习驱动的框架，利用视觉-语言模型生成空间提示，用于细粒度的指代图像分割，并在多个基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

title: EcoGym: Evaluating LLMs for Long-Horizon Plan-and-Execute in Interactive Economies
summary: Long-horizon planning is widely recognized as a core capability of autonomous LLM-based agents; however, current evaluation frameworks suffer from being largely episodic, domain-specific, or insufficiently grounded in persistent economic dynamics. We introduce EcoGym, a generalizable benchmark for continuous plan-and-execute decision making in interactive economies. EcoGym comprises three diverse environments: Vending, Freelance, and Operation, implemented in a unified decision-making process with standardized interfaces, and budgeted actions over an effectively unbounded horizon (1000+ steps if 365 day-loops for evaluation). The evaluation of EcoGym is based on business-relevant outcomes (e.g., net worth, income, and DAU), targeting long-term strategic coherence and robustness under partial observability and stochasticity. Experiments across eleven leading LLMs expose a systematic tension: no single model dominates across all three scenarios. Critically, we find that models exhibit significant suboptimality in either high-level strategies or efficient actions executions. EcoGym is released as an open, extensible testbed for transparent long-horizon agent evaluation and for studying controllability-utility trade-offs in realistic economic settings.
summary_zh: 长程规划被广泛认为是基于大型语言模型（LLM）的自主智能体的核心能力；然而，当前的评估框架主要存在情景性、领域特定性或未能充分扎根于持续的经济动态等问题。我们推出了EcoGym，这是一个为交互式经济体中连续规划与执行决策设计的通用基准。EcoGym包含三个多样化的环境：自动售货（Vending）、自由职业（Freelance）和运营（Operation），以统一的决策过程和标准化的接口实现，并在有效无限的时间跨度（如果采用365天循环进行评估，则超过1000+步）内进行预算行动。EcoGym的评估基于与业务相关的结果（例如，净资产、收入和日活跃用户数），旨在评估长期战略连贯性以及在部分可观察性和随机性下的稳健性。对11个领先LLM的实验揭示了一种系统性的矛盾：没有单一模型在所有三个场景中都占据主导地位。至关重要的是，我们发现模型在高层战略或有效行动执行方面都表现出显著的次优性。EcoGym作为一个开放的可扩展测试平台发布，用于透明的长程智能体评估，以及研究现实经济环境中可控性-效用之间的权衡。
tldr: The paper introduces EcoGym, a new benchmark for evaluating long-horizon plan-and-execute capabilities of LLM-based agents in interactive economic environments, highlighting the trade-offs between strategic coherence and efficient action execution across diverse scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EcoGym，一个新的基准测试，用于评估基于LLM的智能体在交互式经济环境中长期规划和执行能力，强调了在各种场景中战略一致性和高效行动执行之间的权衡。

title: Bridging Efficiency and Transparency: Explainable CoT Compression in Multimodal Large Reasoning Models
summary: Long chains of thought (Long CoTs) are widely employed in multimodal reasoning models to tackle complex tasks by capturing detailed visual information. However, these Long CoTs are often excessively lengthy and contain redundant reasoning steps, which can hinder inference efficiency. Compressing these long CoTs is a natural solution, yet existing approaches face two major challenges: (1) they may compromise the integrity of visual-textual reasoning by removing essential alignment cues, and (2) the compression process lacks explainability, making it difficult to discern which information is critical. To address these problems, we propose XMCC, an eXplainable Multimodal CoT Compressor that formulates compression as a sequential decision-making process optimized via reinforcement learning. XMCC can effectively shorten reasoning trajectories while preserving key reasoning steps and answer correctness, and simultaneously generates natural-language explanations for its compression decisions. Extensive experiments on representative multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that XMCC not only reduces reasoning length but also provides explainable explanations, validating its effectiveness.
summary_zh: 多模态推理模型广泛采用长链思考 (Long CoTs) 来处理复杂任务，通过捕获详细的视觉信息。然而，这些长链思考通常过于冗长并包含多余的推理步骤，这会阻碍推理效率。压缩这些长链思考是一个自然的解决方案，但现有方法面临两个主要挑战：（1）它们可能通过移除关键对齐线索来损害视觉-文本推理的完整性；（2）压缩过程缺乏可解释性，难以辨别哪些信息至关重要。为了解决这些问题，我们提出XMCC，一种可解释多模态链思考压缩器 (eXplainable Multimodal CoT Compressor)，它将压缩过程建模为通过强化学习优化的序列决策过程。XMCC 可以有效地缩短推理轨迹，同时保持关键的推理步骤和答案的正确性，并为其压缩决策生成自然语言解释。在具有代表性的多模态推理基准测试上的大量实验表明，XMCC 不仅减少了推理长度，而且提供了可解释的解释，验证了其有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces XMCC, a reinforcement learning based method for compressing chains of thought in multimodal reasoning models, while preserving reasoning accuracy and providing explanations for compression decisions.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了XMCC，一种基于强化学习的方法，用于压缩多模态推理模型中的思维链，同时保持推理准确性并提供压缩决策的解释。

title: SpotAgent: Grounding Visual Geo-localization in Large Vision-Language Models through Agentic Reasoning
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities in geo-localization, yet they often struggle in real-world scenarios where visual cues are sparse, long-tailed, and highly ambiguous. Previous approaches, bound by internal knowledge, often fail to provide verifiable results, yielding confident but ungrounded predictions when faced with confounded evidence. To address these challenges, we propose SpotAgent, a framework that formalizes geo-localization into an agentic reasoning process that leverages expert-level reasoning to synergize visual interpretation with tool-assisted verification. SpotAgent actively explores and verifies visual cues by leveraging external tools (e.g., web search, maps) through a ReAct diagram. We introduce a 3-stage post-training pipeline starting with a Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) stage for basic alignment, followed by an Agentic Cold Start phase utilizing high-quality trajectories synthesized via a Multi-Agent framework, aiming to instill tool-calling expertise. Subsequently, the model's reasoning capabilities are refined through Reinforcement Learning. We propose a Spatially-Aware Dynamic Filtering strategy to enhance the efficiency of the RL stage by prioritizing learnable samples based on spatial difficulty. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that SpotAgent achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively mitigating hallucinations while delivering precise and verifiable geo-localization.
summary_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在地理定位方面展现了强大的推理能力，但它们在视觉线索稀疏、长尾且高度模糊的真实世界场景中常常表现不佳。以往的方法受限于内部知识，在面对混淆的证据时，往往无法提供可验证的结果，从而产生自信但无根据的预测。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了SpotAgent，一个将地理定位形式化为智能体推理过程的框架，该框架利用专家级推理，将视觉解释与工具辅助验证协同起来。SpotAgent通过ReAct图，借助外部工具（例如，网络搜索、地图）主动探索和验证视觉线索。我们引入了一个三阶段的后训练流程，从用于基本对齐的监督式微调（SFT）阶段开始，紧随其后的是利用通过多智能体框架合成的高质量轨迹的智能体冷启动阶段，旨在灌输工具调用方面的专业知识。随后，通过强化学习来完善模型的推理能力。我们提出了一种空间感知动态过滤策略，通过基于空间难度的可学习样本优先级排序，来提高RL阶段的效率。在标准基准上的大量实验表明，SpotAgent实现了最先进的性能，有效地减轻了幻觉，同时提供了精确且可验证的地理定位。
tldr: The paper introduces SpotAgent, a framework that uses agentic reasoning with external tools and a novel three-stage post-training pipeline to improve the geo-localization accuracy and verifiability of LVLMs, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SpotAgent，一个利用智能体推理、外部工具和新型三阶段后训练流程的框架，旨在提高LVLMs的地理定位精度和可验证性，并实现了最先进的性能。

title: P1-VL: Bridging Visual Perception and Scientific Reasoning in Physics Olympiads
summary: The transition from symbolic manipulation to science-grade reasoning represents a pivotal frontier for Large Language Models (LLMs), with physics serving as the critical test anchor for binding abstract logic to physical reality. Physics demands that a model maintain physical consistency with the laws governing the universe, a task that fundamentally requires multimodal perception to ground abstract logic in reality. At the Olympiad level, diagrams are often constitutive rather than illustrative, containing essential constraints, such as boundary conditions and spatial symmetries, that are absent from the text. To bridge this visual-logical gap, we introduce P1-VL, a family of open-source vision-language models engineered for advanced scientific reasoning. Our method harmonizes Curriculum Reinforcement Learning, which employs progressive difficulty expansion to stabilize post-training, with Agentic Augmentation, enabling iterative self-verification at inference. Evaluated on HiPhO, a rigorous benchmark of 13 exams from 2024-2025, our flagship P1-VL-235B-A22B becomes the first open-source Vision-Language Model (VLM) to secure 12 gold medals and achieves the state-of-the-art performance in the open-source models. Our agent-augmented system achieves the No.2 overall rank globally, trailing only Gemini-3-Pro. Beyond physics, P1-VL demonstrates remarkable scientific reasoning capacity and generalizability, establishing significant leads over base models in STEM benchmarks. By open-sourcing P1-VL, we provide a foundational step toward general-purpose physical intelligence to better align visual perceptions with abstract physical laws for machine scientific discovery.
summary_zh: 从符号操作到科学级推理的转变是大型语言模型（LLMs）的关键前沿，而物理学是连接抽象逻辑与物理现实这一过程的重要测试基准。物理学要求模型与支配宇宙的定律保持物理一致性，这从根本上需要多模态感知，才能将抽象逻辑置于现实基础之上。在奥林匹克竞赛级别，图表通常是构成性的，而非说明性的，其中包含文本中没有的基本约束，例如边界条件和空间对称性。为了弥合这种视觉-逻辑差距，我们推出了 P1-VL 系列开源视觉语言模型，专为高级科学推理而设计。我们的方法结合了课程强化学习（采用渐进式难度扩展来稳定训练后效果）和智能体增强（在推理时实现迭代自验证）。在 HiPhO（一个严格的基准，包含 2024-2025 年的 13 个考试）上的评估表明，我们的旗舰模型 P1-VL-235B-A22B 成为首个获得 12 枚金牌的开源视觉语言模型 (VLM)，并在开源模型中实现了最先进的性能。我们的智能体增强系统取得了全球排名第二的总成绩，仅次于 Gemini-3-Pro。除了物理学，P1-VL 还展示了卓越的科学推理能力和泛化性，在 STEM 基准测试中显著领先于基础模型。通过开源 P1-VL，我们为通用物理智能提供了一个基础性步骤，从而更好地将视觉感知与抽象物理定律对齐，以实现机器科学发现。
tldr: The paper introduces P1-VL, a vision-language model for scientific reasoning, particularly in physics Olympiads. It achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source VLMs on HiPhO and demonstrates strong generalizability across STEM benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了P1-VL，一种用于科学推理的视觉语言模型，尤其是在物理奥林匹克竞赛中。它在HiPhO上实现了开源VLM中最先进的性能，并展示了在STEM基准测试中的强大泛化能力。

title: Beyond Uniform Credit: Causal Credit Assignment for Policy Optimization
summary: Policy gradient methods for language model reasoning, such as GRPO and DAPO, assign uniform credit to all generated tokens - the filler phrase "Let me think" receives the same gradient update as the critical calculation "23 + 45 = 68." We propose counterfactual importance weighting: mask reasoning spans, measure the drop in answer probability, and upweight tokens accordingly during policy gradient updates. Our method requires no auxiliary models or external annotation, instead importance is estimated directly from the policy model's own probability shifts. Experiments on GSM8K across three models spanning the Qwen and Llama families demonstrate consistent improvements over uniform baselines and faster convergence to equivalent accuracy. Inverting the importance signal hurts performance, confirming we capture genuine causal structure rather than noise. Analysis shows the method correctly prioritizes calculation steps over scaffolding text. We view these findings as establishing counterfactual importance weighting as a foundation for further research rather than a complete solution.
summary_zh: 用于语言模型推理的策略梯度方法，如GRPO和DAPO，对所有生成的token赋予统一的信用——填充短语“Let me think”与关键计算“23 + 45 = 68”接收相同的梯度更新。我们提出反事实重要性加权：屏蔽推理跨度，测量答案概率的下降，并在策略梯度更新期间相应地提高token的权重。我们的方法不需要辅助模型或外部标注，而是直接从策略模型自身的概率变化中估计重要性。在跨越Qwen和Llama系列的三个模型上进行的GSM8K实验表明，该方法相比于统一基线实现了持续的改进，并更快地收敛到等效的精度。反转重要性信号会损害性能，这证实了我们捕获的是真实的因果结构，而不是噪声。分析表明，该方法正确地将计算步骤优先于脚手架文本。我们认为这些发现将反事实重要性加权确立为进一步研究的基础，而不是一个完整的解决方案。
tldr: This paper introduces a counterfactual importance weighting method for policy gradient optimization in language model reasoning. It improves credit assignment by weighting tokens based on their causal impact on the answer probability and demonstrates performance gains and faster convergence on GSM8K.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在语言模型推理中用于策略梯度优化的反事实重要性加权方法。它通过根据token对答案概率的因果影响来加权token，从而改进了信用分配，并在GSM8K上展示了性能提升和更快的收敛速度。

title: SnareNet: Flexible Repair Layers for Neural Networks with Hard Constraints
summary: Neural networks are increasingly used as surrogate solvers and control policies, but unconstrained predictions can violate physical, operational, or safety requirements. We propose SnareNet, a feasibility-controlled architecture for learning mappings whose outputs must satisfy input-dependent nonlinear constraints. SnareNet appends a differentiable repair layer that navigates in the constraint map's range space, steering iterates toward feasibility and producing a repaired output that satisfies constraints to a user-specified tolerance. To stabilize end-to-end training, we introduce adaptive relaxation, which designs a relaxed feasible set that snares the neural network at initialization and shrinks it into the feasible set, enabling early exploration and strict feasibility later in training. On optimization-learning and trajectory planning benchmarks, SnareNet consistently attains improved objective quality while satisfying constraints more reliably than prior work.
summary_zh: 神经网络越来越多地被用作替代求解器和控制策略，但无约束的预测可能会违反物理、操作或安全要求。我们提出SnareNet，这是一种可行性控制架构，用于学习输出必须满足输入相关非线性约束的映射。SnareNet附加一个可微修复层，该层在约束图的范围空间中导航，引导迭代朝着可行性方向发展，并生成满足用户指定容差约束的修复输出。为了稳定端到端训练，我们引入了自适应松弛，它设计了一个松弛的可行集，该可行集在初始化时会捕捉住神经网络，并将其缩小到可行集中，从而在训练早期实现探索并在后期实现严格可行性。在优化学习和轨迹规划基准上，SnareNet始终比先前的工作在满足约束的同时，获得改进的目标质量。
tldr: SnareNet introduces a differentiable repair layer and adaptive relaxation to enable neural networks to satisfy input-dependent nonlinear constraints, improving objective quality and constraint satisfaction in optimization-learning and trajectory planning.
tldr_zh: SnareNet 引入了一个可微修复层和自适应松弛方法，使神经网络能够满足输入相关的非线性约束，从而在优化学习和轨迹规划中提高目标质量和约束满足。

title: VLM-Guided Iterative Refinement for Surgical Image Segmentation with Foundation Models
summary: Surgical image segmentation is essential for robot-assisted surgery and intraoperative guidance. However, existing methods are constrained to predefined categories, produce one-shot predictions without adaptive refinement, and lack mechanisms for clinician interaction. We propose IR-SIS, an iterative refinement system for surgical image segmentation that accepts natural language descriptions. IR-SIS leverages a fine-tuned SAM3 for initial segmentation, employs a Vision-Language Model to detect instruments and assess segmentation quality, and applies an agentic workflow that adaptively selects refinement strategies. The system supports clinician-in-the-loop interaction through natural language feedback. We also construct a multi-granularity language-annotated dataset from EndoVis2017 and EndoVis2018 benchmarks. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on both in-domain and out-of-distribution data, with clinician interaction providing additional improvements. Our work establishes the first language-based surgical segmentation framework with adaptive self-refinement capabilities.
summary_zh: 手术图像分割对于机器人辅助手术和术中引导至关重要。然而，现有方法受限于预定义的类别，产生缺乏自适应精化的单次预测，并且缺乏临床医生交互机制。我们提出IR-SIS，一种接受自然语言描述的手术图像分割迭代精化系统。IR-SIS利用微调的SAM3进行初始分割，采用视觉-语言模型来检测器械并评估分割质量，并应用一种能够自适应选择精化策略的智能体工作流。该系统支持通过自然语言反馈进行临床医生在环交互。我们还构建了一个来自EndoVis2017和EndoVis2018基准的多粒度语言标注数据集。实验表明，该系统在领域内和领域外数据上均表现出最先进的性能，临床医生交互可提供额外的改进。我们的工作建立了首个具有自适应自我精化能力的基于语言的手术分割框架。
tldr: The paper presents IR-SIS, a novel surgical image segmentation framework using vision-language models for iterative refinement and clinician interaction, achieving state-of-the-art results on surgical datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了IR-SIS，一种新型的手术图像分割框架，它使用视觉-语言模型进行迭代改进和临床医生交互，并在手术数据集上实现了最先进的结果。

title: MUZZLE: Adaptive Agentic Red-Teaming of Web Agents Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks
summary: Large language model (LLM) based web agents are increasingly deployed to automate complex online tasks by directly interacting with web sites and performing actions on users' behalf. While these agents offer powerful capabilities, their design exposes them to indirect prompt injection attacks embedded in untrusted web content, enabling adversaries to hijack agent behavior and violate user intent. Despite growing awareness of this threat, existing evaluations rely on fixed attack templates, manually selected injection surfaces, or narrowly scoped scenarios, limiting their ability to capture realistic, adaptive attacks encountered in practice. We present MUZZLE, an automated agentic framework for evaluating the security of web agents against indirect prompt injection attacks. MUZZLE utilizes the agent's trajectories to automatically identify high-salience injection surfaces, and adaptively generate context-aware malicious instructions that target violations of confidentiality, integrity, and availability. Unlike prior approaches, MUZZLE adapts its attack strategy based on the agent's observed execution trajectory and iteratively refines attacks using feedback from failed executions. We evaluate MUZZLE across diverse web applications, user tasks, and agent configurations, demonstrating its ability to automatically and adaptively assess the security of web agents with minimal human intervention. Our results show that MUZZLE effectively discovers 37 new attacks on 4 web applications with 10 adversarial objectives that violate confidentiality, availability, or privacy properties. MUZZLE also identifies novel attack strategies, including 2 cross-application prompt injection attacks and an agent-tailored phishing scenario.
summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的Web代理正日益被部署，以通过直接与网站交互并代表用户执行操作来自动化复杂的在线任务。尽管这些代理提供了强大的能力，但它们的设计使其暴露于嵌入在不受信任的Web内容中的间接提示注入攻击，使得攻击者能够劫持代理行为并违反用户意图。尽管人们对这种威胁的认识日益提高，但现有的评估依赖于固定的攻击模板、手动选择的注入表面或范围狭窄的场景，从而限制了它们捕获实践中遇到的真实、自适应攻击的能力。我们提出了MUZZLE，一个用于评估Web代理针对间接提示注入攻击的安全性的自动化代理框架。MUZZLE利用代理的轨迹来自动识别高显著性的注入表面，并自适应地生成针对违反机密性、完整性和可用性的上下文感知恶意指令。与先前的方法不同，MUZZLE会根据代理的观察到的执行轨迹调整其攻击策略，并使用来自失败执行的反馈迭代地改进攻击。我们在不同的Web应用程序、用户任务和代理配置中评估了MUZZLE，证明了它能够在最少的人工干预下自动且自适应地评估Web代理的安全性。我们的结果表明，MUZZLE有效地发现了针对4个Web应用程序的37个新攻击，这些攻击具有10个违反机密性、可用性或隐私属性的对抗性目标。MUZZLE还识别了新的攻击策略，包括2个跨应用程序的提示注入攻击和一个为代理量身定制的网络钓鱼场景。
tldr: The paper introduces MUZZLE, an adaptive framework for automated red-teaming of web agents against indirect prompt injection attacks, discovering new attacks and vulnerabilities across various web applications.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MUZZLE，一个自适应框架，用于对 Web 代理进行自动红队测试，以防御间接提示注入攻击，并在各种 Web 应用程序中发现新的攻击和漏洞。

title: PRISM-XR: Empowering Privacy-Aware XR Collaboration with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) enhance collaboration in Extended Reality (XR) environments by enabling flexible object and animation creation through the combination of natural language and visual inputs. However, visual data captured by XR headsets includes real-world backgrounds that may contain irrelevant or sensitive user information, such as credit cards left on the table or facial identities of other users. Uploading those frames to cloud-based MLLMs poses serious privacy risks, particularly when such data is processed without explicit user consent. Additionally, existing colocation and synchronization mechanisms in commercial XR APIs rely on time-consuming, privacy-invasive environment scanning and struggle to adapt to the highly dynamic nature of MLLM-integrated XR environments. In this paper, we propose PRISM-XR, a novel framework that facilitates multi-user collaboration in XR by providing privacy-aware MLLM integration. PRISM-XR employs intelligent frame preprocessing on the edge server to filter sensitive data and remove irrelevant context before communicating with cloud generative AI models. Additionally, we introduce a lightweight registration process and a fully customizable content-sharing mechanism to enable efficient, accurate, and privacy-preserving content synchronization among users. Our numerical evaluation results indicate that the proposed platform achieves nearly 90% accuracy in fulfilling user requests and less than 0.27 seconds registration time while maintaining spatial inconsistencies of less than 3.5 cm. Furthermore, we conducted an IRB-approved user study with 28 participants, demonstrating that our system could automatically filter highly sensitive objects in over 90% of scenarios while maintaining strong overall usability.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）通过结合自然语言和视觉输入，实现灵活的对象和动画创建，从而增强扩展现实（XR）环境中的协作。然而，XR头显捕获的视觉数据包含真实世界的背景，可能包含无关或敏感的用户信息，例如遗落在桌上的信用卡或其他用户的面部身份。将这些帧上传到基于云的MLLM存在严重的隐私风险，特别是当这些数据在没有明确用户同意的情况下被处理时。此外，商业XR API中现有的共址和同步机制依赖于耗时且侵犯隐私的环境扫描，难以适应集成MLLM的XR环境的高度动态性。在本文中，我们提出PRISM-XR，一种通过提供隐私感知的MLLM集成来促进XR中多用户协作的新型框架。PRISM-XR在边缘服务器上采用智能帧预处理，在与云端生成式AI模型通信之前，过滤敏感数据并移除无关上下文。此外，我们引入了一个轻量级的注册过程和一个完全可定制的内容共享机制，以实现用户之间高效、准确且保护隐私的内容同步。我们的数值评估结果表明，所提出的平台在满足用户请求方面达到了近90%的准确率，注册时间少于0.27秒，同时保持空间不一致性小于3.5厘米。此外，我们进行了一项经机构审查委员会（IRB）批准的用户研究，共有28名参与者，结果表明我们的系统可以在超过90%的场景中自动过滤高度敏感的对象，同时保持强大的整体可用性。
tldr: PRISM-XR is a framework for privacy-aware multi-user XR collaboration that uses edge-based preprocessing to filter sensitive data before sending to cloud-based MLLMs, along with a lightweight registration and content-sharing mechanism for efficient synchronization.
tldr_zh: PRISM-XR是一个支持隐私保护的多用户XR协作框架，它利用边缘预处理来过滤敏感数据，然后再将其发送到基于云端的MLLM，并配备了轻量级的注册和内容共享机制，以实现高效同步。

title: CausalGDP: Causality-Guided Diffusion Policies for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved remarkable success in a wide range of sequential decision-making problems. Recent diffusion-based policies further improve RL by modeling complex, high-dimensional action distributions. However, existing diffusion policies primarily rely on statistical associations and fail to explicitly account for causal relationships among states, actions, and rewards, limiting their ability to identify which action components truly cause high returns. In this paper, we propose Causality-guided Diffusion Policy (CausalGDP), a unified framework that integrates causal reasoning into diffusion-based RL. CausalGDP first learns a base diffusion policy and an initial causal dynamical model from offline data, capturing causal dependencies among states, actions, and rewards. During real-time interaction, the causal information is continuously updated and incorporated as a guidance signal to steer the diffusion process toward actions that causally influence future states and rewards. By explicitly considering causality beyond association, CausalGDP focuses policy optimization on action components that genuinely drive performance improvements. Experimental results demonstrate that CausalGDP consistently achieves competitive or superior performance over state-of-the-art diffusion-based and offline RL methods, especially in complex, high-dimensional control tasks.
summary_zh: 强化学习(RL)在广泛的序列决策问题中取得了显著成功。最近的基于扩散的策略通过建模复杂、高维的动作分布进一步改进了RL。然而，现有的扩散策略主要依赖于统计关联，而未能显式地考虑状态、动作和奖励之间的因果关系，限制了它们识别哪些动作成分真正导致高回报的能力。在本文中，我们提出了一种因果引导的扩散策略（CausalGDP），这是一个统一的框架，将因果推理集成到基于扩散的RL中。CausalGDP首先从离线数据中学习一个基础扩散策略和一个初始的因果动力学模型，以捕获状态、动作和奖励之间的因果依赖关系。在实时交互过程中，因果信息被持续更新并作为一个引导信号被整合进来，以引导扩散过程朝着那些因果地影响未来状态和奖励的动作前进。通过显式地考虑因果关系而非仅关注关联，CausalGDP将策略优化集中在那些真正驱动性能提升的动作成分上。实验结果表明，在复杂的、高维的控制任务中，CausalGDP始终能够获得优于或至少与最先进的基于扩散的和离线RL方法相媲美的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces CausalGDP, a novel reinforcement learning framework that integrates causal reasoning into diffusion-based policies to improve performance by focusing on action components that causally influence future rewards, achieving superior results in complex control tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了CausalGDP，一种新型的强化学习框架，它将因果推理融入到基于扩散的策略中，通过关注因果影响未来奖励的动作组件来提高性能，并在复杂的控制任务中取得了优越的结果。

title: $n$-Musketeers: Reinforcement Learning Shapes Collaboration Among Language Models
summary: Recent progress in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) shows that small, specialized language models (SLMs) can exhibit structured reasoning without relying on large monolithic LLMs. We introduce soft hidden-state collaboration, where multiple heterogeneous frozen SLM experts are integrated through their internal representations via a trainable attention interface. Experiments on Reasoning Gym and GSM8K show that this latent integration is competitive with strong single-model RLVR baselines. Ablations further reveal a dual mechanism of expert utilization: for simpler arithmetic domains, performance gains can largely be explained by static expert preferences, whereas more challenging settings induce increasingly concentrated and structured expert attention over training, indicating emergent specialization in how the router connects to relevant experts. Overall, hidden-state collaboration provides a compact mechanism for leveraging frozen experts, while offering an observational window into expert utilization patterns and their evolution under RLVR.
summary_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）的最新进展表明，小型、专用的语言模型（SLM）无需依赖大型单体 LLM，就可以展现出结构化的推理能力。我们引入了软隐藏状态协作，其中多个异构的冻结 SLM 专家通过可训练的注意力接口，经由其内部表示进行集成。在 Reasoning Gym 和 GSM8K 上的实验表明，这种潜在的集成与强大的单模型 RLVR 基线具有竞争力。消融实验进一步揭示了专家利用的双重机制：对于简单的算术领域，性能提升可以通过静态的专家偏好来解释，而更具挑战性的环境中，则会在训练过程中诱导出越来越集中和结构化的专家注意力，表明路由在连接相关专家的方式上出现了新兴的专业化。总体而言，隐藏状态协作为利用冻结专家提供了一个紧凑的机制，同时也提供了一个观察窗口，用于观察专家利用模式及其在 RLVR 下的演变。
tldr: This paper introduces a method called soft hidden-state collaboration, where multiple specialized language models are integrated using a trainable attention interface within a Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) framework, showing competitive results on reasoning tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为软隐状态协作的方法，该方法在可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）框架中，通过可训练的注意力接口集成多个专门的语言模型，并在推理任务上表现出竞争性的结果。

title: PABU: Progress-Aware Belief Update for Efficient LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents commonly condition actions on full action-observation histories, which introduce task-irrelevant information that easily leads to redundant actions and higher inference cost. We propose Progress-Aware Belief Update (PABU), a belief-state framework that compactly represents an agent's state by explicitly modeling task progress and selectively retaining past actions and observations. At each step, the agent predicts its relative progress since the previous round and decides whether the newly encountered interaction should be stored, conditioning future decisions only on the retained subset. Across eight environments in the AgentGym benchmark, and using identical training trajectories, PABU achieves an 81.0% task completion rate, outperforming previous State of the art (SoTA) models with full-history belief by 23.9%. Additionally, PABU's progress-oriented action selection improves efficiency, reducing the average number of interaction steps to 9.5, corresponding to a 26.9% reduction. Ablation studies show that both explicit progress prediction and selective retention are necessary for robust belief learning and performance gains.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通常基于完整的行动-观察历史来决定行动，这引入了与任务无关的信息，容易导致冗余行动和更高的推理成本。我们提出了进度感知信念更新（PABU），这是一个信念状态框架，通过显式建模任务进度并选择性地保留过去的行动和观察，来紧凑地表示智能体的状态。在每个步骤中，智能体预测自上一轮以来的相对进度，并决定是否应该存储新遇到的交互，仅基于保留的子集来决定未来的决策。在AgentGym基准测试的八个环境中，使用相同的训练轨迹，PABU实现了81.0%的任务完成率，比先前具有完整历史信念的SoTA模型高出23.9%。此外，PABU的以进度为导向的行动选择提高了效率，将平均交互步骤数减少到9.5，相当于减少了26.9%。消融实验表明，显式的进度预测和选择性保留对于稳健的信念学习和性能提升都是必要的。
tldr: The paper introduces PABU, a progress-aware belief update framework for LLM agents that selectively retains past actions and observations based on predicted task progress, leading to improved task completion rates and reduced interaction steps compared to full-history belief methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为PABU的进展感知信念更新框架，用于LLM智能体。该框架基于预测的任务进展选择性地保留过去的行动和观察，与完全历史信念方法相比，提高了任务完成率并减少了交互步骤。

title: UI-Venus-1.5 Technical Report
summary: GUI agents have emerged as a powerful paradigm for automating interactions in digital environments, yet achieving both broad generality and consistently strong task performance remains challenging.In this report, we present UI-Venus-1.5, a unified, end-to-end GUI Agent designed for robust real-world applications.The proposed model family comprises two dense variants (2B and 8B) and one mixture-of-experts variant (30B-A3B) to meet various downstream application scenarios.Compared to our previous version, UI-Venus-1.5 introduces three key technical advances: (1) a comprehensive Mid-Training stage leveraging 10 billion tokens across 30+ datasets to establish foundational GUI semantics; (2) Online Reinforcement Learning with full-trajectory rollouts, aligning training objectives with long-horizon, dynamic navigation in large-scale environments; and (3) a single unified GUI Agent constructed via Model Merging, which synthesizes domain-specific models (grounding, web, and mobile) into one cohesive checkpoint. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that UI-Venus-1.5 establishes new state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks such as ScreenSpot-Pro (69.6%), VenusBench-GD (75.0%), and AndroidWorld (77.6%), significantly outperforming previous strong baselines. In addition, UI-Venus-1.5 demonstrates robust navigation capabilities across a variety of Chinese mobile apps, effectively executing user instructions in real-world scenarios. Code: https://github.com/inclusionAI/UI-Venus; Model: https://huggingface.co/collections/inclusionAI/ui-venus
summary_zh: GUI代理已成为在数字环境中自动化交互的一种强大范式，但要实现广泛的通用性和始终如一的强大任务性能仍然具有挑战性。在本报告中，我们提出了UI-Venus-1.5，一种统一的、端到端的GUI代理，专为稳健的真实世界应用而设计。所提出的模型家族包括两个密集型变体（2B和8B）以及一个混合专家型变体（30B-A3B），以满足各种下游应用场景。与我们以前的版本相比，UI-Venus-1.5引入了三个关键的技术进步：（1）一个全面的中期训练阶段，利用跨30多个数据集的100亿个token来建立基础的GUI语义；（2）采用全轨迹rollout的在线强化学习，将训练目标与大规模环境中的长程、动态导航对齐；（3）通过模型融合构建的单一统一GUI代理，它将领域特定模型（grounding, web, and mobile）合成为一个有凝聚力的检查点。广泛的评估表明，UI-Venus-1.5在诸如ScreenSpot-Pro (69.6%)、VenusBench-GD (75.0%)和AndroidWorld (77.6%)等基准测试上建立了新的最先进性能，显著优于以前的强大基线。此外，UI-Venus-1.5展示了在各种中文移动应用中强大的导航能力，有效地执行了真实世界场景中的用户指令。代码：https://github.com/inclusionAI/UI-Venus；模型：https://huggingface.co/collections/inclusionAI/ui-venus
tldr: UI-Venus-1.5 is a unified GUI agent that achieves state-of-the-art performance on GUI interaction benchmarks by leveraging mid-training, online reinforcement learning, and model merging. It demonstrates robust navigation in real-world Chinese mobile apps.
tldr_zh: UI-Venus-1.5是一个统一的GUI代理，通过利用中期训练、在线强化学习和模型合并，在GUI交互基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。它展示了在真实中文移动应用程序中强大的导航能力。

title: InternAgent-1.5: A Unified Agentic Framework for Long-Horizon Autonomous Scientific Discovery
summary: We introduce InternAgent-1.5, a unified system designed for end-to-end scientific discovery across computational and empirical domains. The system is built on a structured architecture composed of three coordinated subsystems for generation, verification, and evolution. These subsystems are supported by foundational capabilities for deep research, solution optimization, and long horizon memory. The architecture allows InternAgent-1.5 to operate continuously across extended discovery cycles while maintaining coherent and improving behavior. It also enables the system to coordinate computational modeling and laboratory experimentation within a single unified system. We evaluate InternAgent-1.5 on scientific reasoning benchmarks such as GAIA, HLE, GPQA, and FrontierScience, and the system achieves leading performance that demonstrates strong foundational capabilities. Beyond these benchmarks, we further assess two categories of discovery tasks. In algorithm discovery tasks, InternAgent-1.5 autonomously designs competitive methods for core machine learning problems. In empirical discovery tasks, it executes complete computational or wet lab experiments and produces scientific findings in earth, life, biological, and physical domains. Overall, these results show that InternAgent-1.5 provides a general and scalable framework for autonomous scientific discovery.
summary_zh: 我们介绍了 InternAgent-1.5，一个为跨计算和经验领域而设计的端到端科学发现统一系统。该系统构建于一个结构化架构之上，由三个协同的子系统组成：生成、验证和演化。这些子系统由深度研究、解决方案优化和长时程记忆的基础能力所支持。该架构允许 InternAgent-1.5 在扩展的发现周期中持续运行，同时保持连贯并改进其行为。它还使系统能够在一个统一系统中协调计算建模和实验室实验。我们在科学推理基准测试（如 GAIA、HLE、GPQA 和 FrontierScience）上评估了 InternAgent-1.5，该系统取得了领先的性能，证明了其强大的基础能力。除了这些基准测试之外，我们还进一步评估了两类发现任务。在算法发现任务中，InternAgent-1.5 自主设计了用于核心机器学习问题的有竞争力的方法。在经验发现任务中，它执行完整的计算或湿实验室实验，并在地球、生命、生物和物理领域产生科学发现。总体而言，这些结果表明 InternAgent-1.5 为自主科学发现提供了一个通用且可扩展的框架。
tldr: InternAgent-1.5 is a unified system for autonomous scientific discovery, combining computational modeling and lab experimentation, and achieving strong performance across several scientific reasoning benchmarks and discovery tasks.
tldr_zh: InternAgent-1.5 是一个用于自主科学发现的统一系统，它结合了计算建模和实验室实验，并在多个科学推理基准和发现任务中取得了强大的性能。

title: Red-teaming the Multimodal Reasoning: Jailbreaking Vision-Language Models via Cross-modal Entanglement Attacks
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with multimodal reasoning capabilities are high-value attack targets, given their potential for handling complex multimodal harmful tasks. Mainstream black-box jailbreak attacks on VLMs work by distributing malicious clues across modalities to disperse model attention and bypass safety alignment mechanisms. However, these adversarial attacks rely on simple and fixed image-text combinations that lack attack complexity scalability, limiting their effectiveness for red-teaming VLMs' continuously evolving reasoning capabilities. We propose \textbf{CrossTALK} (\textbf{\underline{Cross}}-modal en\textbf{\underline{TA}}ng\textbf{\underline{L}}ement attac\textbf{\underline{K}}), which is a scalable approach that extends and entangles information clues across modalities to exceed VLMs' trained and generalized safety alignment patterns for jailbreak. Specifically, {knowledge-scalable reframing} extends harmful tasks into multi-hop chain instructions, {cross-modal clue entangling} migrates visualizable entities into images to build multimodal reasoning links, and {cross-modal scenario nesting} uses multimodal contextual instructions to steer VLMs toward detailed harmful outputs. Experiments show our COMET achieves state-of-the-art attack success rate.
summary_zh: 具有多模态推理能力的可视语言模型(VLMs)是高价值的攻击目标，因为它们有可能处理复杂的多模态有害任务。主流的针对VLMs的黑盒越狱攻击通过跨模态分布恶意线索来分散模型注意力并绕过安全对齐机制。然而，这些对抗性攻击依赖于简单且固定的图像-文本组合，缺乏攻击复杂性的可扩展性，限制了它们对VLM不断发展的推理能力进行红队测试的有效性。我们提出\textbf{CrossTALK}（\textbf{\underline{Cross}}-模态纠\textbf{\underline{TA}}缠攻\textbf{\underline{L}}击），这是一种可扩展的方法，它扩展并纠缠跨模态的信息线索，以超出VLMs训练和泛化的安全对齐模式，从而实现越狱。具体来说，{知识可扩展的重构}将有害任务扩展为多跳链式指令，{跨模态线索纠缠}将可视化的实体迁移到图像中以构建多模态推理链接，{跨模态场景嵌套}使用多模态上下文指令来引导VLMs生成详细的有害输出。实验表明，我们的COMET实现了最先进的攻击成功率。
tldr: The paper introduces CrossTALK, a novel jailbreaking method for Vision-Language Models that uses cross-modal entanglement to bypass safety alignments, achieving state-of-the-art attack success rates.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为CrossTALK的新型视觉语言模型越狱方法，该方法通过跨模态纠缠绕过安全对齐，实现了最先进的攻击成功率。

title: stable-worldmodel-v1: Reproducible World Modeling Research and Evaluation
summary: World Models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning compact, predictive representations of environment dynamics, enabling agents to reason, plan, and generalize beyond direct experience. Despite recent interest in World Models, most available implementations remain publication-specific, severely limiting their reusability, increasing the risk of bugs, and reducing evaluation standardization. To mitigate these issues, we introduce stable-worldmodel (SWM), a modular, tested, and documented world-model research ecosystem that provides efficient data-collection tools, standardized environments, planning algorithms, and baseline implementations. In addition, each environment in SWM enables controllable factors of variation, including visual and physical properties, to support robustness and continual learning research. Finally, we demonstrate the utility of SWM by using it to study zero-shot robustness in DINO-WM.
summary_zh: 世界模型已成为一种强大的范式，用于学习环境动态的紧凑型预测性表示，使智能体能够推理、规划并泛化超出直接经验。尽管近期人们对世界模型的兴趣日益浓厚，但大多数可用的实现仍然是特定于论文的，这严重限制了它们的可重用性，增加了出现错误的风险，并降低了评估标准化程度。为了缓解这些问题，我们推出了stable-worldmodel (SWM)，这是一个模块化、经过测试且文档完善的世界模型研究生态系统，它提供了高效的数据收集工具、标准化环境、规划算法和基线实现。此外，SWM中的每个环境都启用了可控的变异因素，包括视觉和物理属性，以支持鲁棒性和持续学习研究。最后，我们通过使用SWM研究DINO-WM中的零样本鲁棒性，来展示SWM的实用性。
