summary_zh: 本研究介绍了垃圾数据集（GD），这是一个公开可用的图像数据集，旨在通过机器学习和计算机视觉推进自动化垃圾分类。它是一个多样化的数据集，涵盖10种常见的家庭垃圾类别：金属、玻璃、生物、纸张、电池、垃圾、纸板、鞋子、衣服和塑料。该数据集包含13,348张标记图像，通过多种方法收集，包括DWaste移动应用程序和精选的Web资源。方法包括通过校验和及离群值检测进行严格验证，通过PCA/t-SNE分析类别不平衡和视觉可分离性，以及使用熵和显著性测量评估背景复杂性。使用最先进的深度学习模型（EfficientNetV2M、EfficientNetV2S、MobileNet、ResNet50、ResNet101）对数据集进行了基准测试，评估了其性能指标和运行碳排放。实验结果表明，EfficientNetV2S取得了最高的性能，准确率为96.19%，F1分数为0.96，但碳成本适中。分析揭示了数据集固有的特征，包括类别不平衡、向高离群类（塑料、纸板、纸张）的倾斜以及需要考虑的亮度变化。主要结论是，GD为垃圾分类研究提供了一个有价值的、真实的基准，同时强调了重要的挑战，如类别不平衡、背景复杂性和模型选择中的环境权衡，这些挑战必须解决才能实现实际部署。该数据集已公开，以支持环境可持续性应用的进一步研究。
tldr: The paper introduces a new, publicly available, multi-class image dataset (Garbage Dataset - GD) for automated waste segregation, benchmarking it with several deep learning models and analyzing dataset characteristics like class imbalance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个新的公开多类别图像数据集（垃圾数据集 - GD），用于自动垃圾分类，并使用几种深度学习模型对其进行基准测试，并分析数据集的特征，如类别不平衡。

title: Quantum Multiple Rotation Averaging
summary: Multiple rotation averaging (MRA) is a fundamental optimization problem in 3D vision and robotics that aims to recover globally consistent absolute rotations from noisy relative measurements. Established classical methods, such as L1-IRLS and Shonan, face limitations including local minima susceptibility and reliance on convex relaxations that fail to preserve the exact manifold geometry, leading to reduced accuracy in high-noise scenarios. We introduce IQARS (Iterative Quantum Annealing for Rotation Synchronization), the first algorithm that reformulates MRA as a sequence of local quadratic non-convex sub-problems executable on quantum annealers after binarization, to leverage inherent hardware advantages. IQARS removes convex relaxation dependence and better preserves non-Euclidean rotation manifold geometry while leveraging quantum tunneling and parallelism for efficient solution space exploration. We evaluate IQARS's performance on synthetic and real-world datasets. While current annealers remain in their nascent phase and only support solving problems of limited scale with constrained performance, we observed that IQARS on D-Wave annealers can already achieve ca. 12% higher accuracy than Shonan, i.e., the best-performing classical method evaluated empirically.
summary_zh: 多重旋转平均 (MRA) 是 3D 视觉和机器人领域中的一个基础优化问题，旨在从带噪声的相对测量中恢复全局一致的绝对旋转。诸如 L1-IRLS 和 Shonan 等已确立的经典方法面临着一些局限性，包括容易陷入局部最小值以及依赖于未能保留精确流形几何形状的凸松弛，从而导致在高噪声场景中精度降低。我们引入了 IQARS（用于旋转同步的迭代量子退火），这是首个将 MRA 重构为一系列可在二值化后在量子退火器上执行的局部二次非凸子问题的算法，以利用固有的硬件优势。 IQARS 消除了对凸松弛的依赖，并更好地保留了非欧几里得旋转流形几何形状，同时利用量子隧穿和并行性进行高效的解空间探索。我们评估了 IQARS 在合成和真实世界数据集上的性能。虽然目前的退火器仍处于起步阶段，仅支持求解规模有限且性能受限的问题，但我们观察到，IQARS 在 D-Wave 退火器上已经可以实现比 Shonan（即经验评估中性能最佳的经典方法）高约 12% 的准确率。
tldr: This paper introduces IQARS, a quantum annealing algorithm for multiple rotation averaging (MRA) that outperforms classical methods by preserving manifold geometry and leveraging quantum hardware advantages, showing promising results despite current hardware limitations.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于多重旋转平均（MRA）的量子退火算法IQARS，该算法通过保留流形几何形状和利用量子硬件优势优于经典方法。尽管当前硬件条件有限，但显示出很有前景的结果。

title: CMAD: Cooperative Multi-Agent Diffusion via Stochastic Optimal Control
summary: Continuous-time generative models have achieved remarkable success in image restoration and synthesis. However, controlling the composition of multiple pre-trained models remains an open challenge. Current approaches largely treat composition as an algebraic composition of probability densities, such as via products or mixtures of experts. This perspective assumes the target distribution is known explicitly, which is almost never the case. In this work, we propose a different paradigm that formulates compositional generation as a cooperative Stochastic Optimal Control problem. Rather than combining probability densities, we treat pre-trained diffusion models as interacting agents whose diffusion trajectories are jointly steered, via optimal control, toward a shared objective defined on their aggregated output. We validate our framework on conditional MNIST generation and compare it against a naive inference-time DPS-style baseline replacing learned cooperative control with per-step gradient guidance.
summary_zh: 连续时间生成模型在图像修复和合成方面取得了显著成功。然而，控制多个预训练模型的组合构成仍然是一个开放性挑战。现有方法主要将组合视为概率密度的代数组合，例如通过乘积或专家混合。这种观点假设目标分布是显式已知的，而这几乎是不可能的。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种不同的范式，将组合生成 формули的表达为一个合作的随机最优控制问题。我们不是组合概率密度，而是将预训练的扩散模型视为交互代理，这些代理的扩散轨迹通过最优控制共同引导至一个在它们的聚合输出上定义的共享目标。我们在条件MNIST生成上验证了我们的框架，并将其与一个朴素的推理时DPS风格的基线进行比较，该基线用每步梯度指导代替了学习到的合作控制。
tldr: This paper proposes a cooperative Stochastic Optimal Control framework (CMAD) for composing multiple pre-trained diffusion models, treating them as interacting agents driven by a shared objective, instead of manipulating probability densities directly.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种合作随机最优控制框架 (CMAD)，用于组合多个预训练的扩散模型。该框架将这些模型视为由共同目标驱动的交互代理，而不是直接操作概率密度。

title: Domain Knowledge Guided Bayesian Optimization For Autonomous Alignment Of Complex Scientific Instruments
summary: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is a powerful tool for optimizing complex non-linear systems. However, its performance degrades in high-dimensional problems with tightly coupled parameters and highly asymmetric objective landscapes, where rewards are sparse. In such needle-in-a-haystack scenarios, even advanced methods like trust-region BO (TurBO) often lead to unsatisfactory results. We propose a domain knowledge guided Bayesian Optimization approach, which leverages physical insight to fundamentally simplify the search problem by transforming coordinates to decouple input features and align the active subspaces with the primary search axes. We demonstrate this approach's efficacy on a challenging 12-dimensional, 6-crystal Split-and-Delay optical system, where conventional approaches, including standard BO, TuRBO and multi-objective BO, consistently led to unsatisfactory results. When combined with an reverse annealing exploration strategy, this approach reliably converges to the global optimum. The coordinate transformation itself is the key to this success, significantly accelerating the search by aligning input co-ordinate axes with the problem's active subspaces. As increasingly complex scientific instruments, from large telescopes to new spectrometers at X-ray Free Electron Lasers are deployed, the demand for robust high-dimensional optimization grows. Our results demonstrate a generalizable paradigm: leveraging physical insight to transform high-dimensional, coupled optimization problems into simpler representations can enable rapid and robust automated tuning for consistent high performance while still retaining current optimization algorithms.
summary_zh: 贝叶斯优化（BO）是优化复杂非线性系统的强大工具。然而，在高维问题中，当参数紧密耦合且目标函数呈现高度不对称的 landscape，以及奖励稀疏时，其性能会下降。在这样的“大海捞针”场景中，即使是诸如信任区域贝叶斯优化（TurBO）等先进方法也常常导致不理想的结果。我们提出了一种领域知识引导的贝叶斯优化方法，该方法利用物理洞察力，通过转换坐标来解耦输入特征，并将 active subspace 与主搜索轴对齐，从而从根本上简化搜索问题。我们在一个具有挑战性的 12 维、6 晶体分束延迟光学系统中演示了这种方法的有效性，在该系统中，包括标准 BO、TuRBO 和多目标 BO 在内的传统方法始终导致不尽人意的结果。当与反向退火探索策略相结合时，该方法能够可靠地收敛到全局最优解。坐标变换本身是成功的关键，它通过将输入坐标轴与问题的 active subspace 对齐，显著加速了搜索过程。随着从大型望远镜到 X 射线自由电子激光器上的新型光谱仪等日益复杂的科学仪器的部署，对稳健的高维优化的需求也在增长。我们的结果展示了一种可推广的范例：利用物理洞察力将高维、耦合的优化问题转换为更简单的表示形式，能够实现快速而稳健的自动调谐，从而持续保持高性能，同时仍然保留当前的优化算法。
tldr: This paper introduces a domain knowledge-guided Bayesian Optimization approach that uses physical insights to simplify high-dimensional optimization problems in scientific instruments, demonstrating improved performance on a complex optical system.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种领域知识引导的贝叶斯优化方法，利用物理洞察力来简化科学仪器中的高维优化问题，并在一个复杂的光学系统上展示了改进的性能。

title: Distributed Online Convex Optimization with Nonseparable Costs and Constraints
summary: This paper studies distributed online convex optimization with time-varying coupled constraints, motivated by distributed online control in network systems. Most prior work assumes a separability condition: the global objective and coupled constraint functions are sums of local costs and individual constraints. In contrast, we study a group of agents, networked via a communication graph, that collectively select actions to minimize a sequence of nonseparable global cost functions and to stratify nonseparable long-term constraints based on full-information feedback and intra-agent communication. We propose a distributed online primal-dual belief consensus algorithm, where each agent maintains and updates a local belief of the global collective decisions, which are repeatedly exchanged with neighboring agents. Unlike the previous consensus primal-dual algorithms under separability that ask agents to only communicate their local decisions, our belief-sharing protocol eliminates coupling between the primal consensus disagreement and the dual constraint violation, yielding sublinear regret and cumulative constraint violation (CCV) bounds, both in $O({T}^{1/2})$, where $T$ denotes the time horizon. Such a result breaks the long-standing $O(T^{3/4})$ barrier for CCV and matches the lower bound of online constrained convex optimization, indicating the online learning efficiency at the cost of communication overhead.
summary_zh: 本文研究具有时变耦合约束的分布式在线凸优化问题，其动机来源于网络系统中的分布式在线控制。 现有的大部分工作都假设了可分离性条件：即全局目标函数和耦合约束函数是局部代价和个体约束的总和。 与此相反，我们研究了一组通过通信图连接的智能体，它们集体选择行动以最小化一系列不可分离的全局代价函数，并基于全信息反馈和智能体间通信来满足不可分离的长期约束。 我们提出了一种分布式在线原始-对偶置信度一致算法，其中每个智能体维护并更新对全局集体决策的局部置信度，这些置信度会与相邻智能体反复交换。 不同于以往在可分离性条件下要求智能体仅通信其局部决策的一致性原始-对偶算法，我们的置信度共享协议消除了原始一致性差异与对偶约束违反之间的耦合，从而产生了亚线性遗憾和累积约束违反（CCV）界限，两者均为 $O({T}^{1/2})$，其中 $T$ 表示时间范围。 这样的结果打破了 CCV 长期存在的 $O(T^{3/4})$ 壁垒，并与在线约束凸优化的下界相匹配，表明以通信开销为代价实现了在线学习效率。
tldr: This paper presents a distributed online primal-dual belief consensus algorithm for online convex optimization with nonseparable costs and constraints, achieving sublinear regret and cumulative constraint violation bounds of $O({T}^{1/2})$.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分布式在线原始-对偶置信共识算法，用于具有不可分离成本和约束的在线凸优化，实现了 $O({T}^{1/2})$ 的次线性后悔和累积约束违反界。

title: Digging for Data: Experiments in Rock Pile Characterization Using Only Proprioceptive Sensing in Excavation
summary: Characterization of fragmented rock piles is a fundamental task in the mining and quarrying industries, where rock is fragmented by blasting, transported using wheel loaders, and then sent for further processing. This field report studies a novel method for estimating the relative particle size of fragmented rock piles from only proprioceptive data collected while digging with a wheel loader. Rather than employ exteroceptive sensors (e.g., cameras or LiDAR sensors) to estimate rock particle sizes, the studied method infers rock fragmentation from an excavator's inertial response during excavation. This paper expands on research that postulated the use of wavelet analysis to construct a unique feature that is proportional to the level of rock fragmentation. We demonstrate through extensive field experiments that the ratio of wavelet features, constructed from data obtained by excavating in different rock piles with different size distributions, approximates the ratio of the mean particle size of the two rock piles. Full-scale excavation experiments were performed with a battery electric, 18-tonne capacity, load-haul-dump (LHD) machine in representative conditions in an operating quarry. The relative particle size estimates generated with the proposed sensing methodology are compared with those obtained from both a vision-based fragmentation analysis tool and from sieving of sampled materials.
summary_zh: 破碎岩堆的表征是采矿和采石行业的一项基本任务，在该行业中，岩石通过爆破破碎，使用轮式装载机运输，然后送去进一步处理。这份现场报告研究了一种新方法，仅根据轮式装载机挖掘时收集的本体感受数据来估算破碎岩堆的相对粒度。该方法并非采用外部感受传感器（如摄像头或激光雷达传感器）来估算岩石颗粒大小，而是从挖掘机在挖掘过程中的惯性响应推断岩石破碎情况。本文扩展了之前的一项研究，该研究假设使用小波分析构建与岩石破碎程度成比例的独特特征。我们通过大量的现场实验证明，由不同粒径分布岩堆的挖掘数据构建的小波特征的比率，近似于两个岩堆平均粒径的比率。在运营采石场的代表性条件下，使用一台电池驱动的、18吨容量的铲运机（LHD）进行了全面的挖掘实验。将使用所提出的传感方法生成的相对粒度估计值与使用基于视觉的破碎分析工具和筛分采样材料获得的估计值进行比较。
tldr: This paper explores a novel method for estimating rock particle size in mining using proprioceptive data from a wheel loader. It infers fragmentation from inertial response during excavation, showing the ratio of wavelet features approximates the ratio of mean particle size.
tldr_zh: 该论文探索了一种新方法，利用轮式装载机的本体感觉数据来估计采矿中的岩石颗粒大小。它通过挖掘过程中的惯性响应来推断破碎程度，表明小波特征的比率接近平均颗粒大小的比率。

title: Design, Development, and Use of Maya Robot as an Assistant for the Therapy/Education of Children with Cancer: a Pilot Study
summary: This study centers around the design and implementation of the Maya Robot, a portable elephant-shaped social robot, intended to engage with children undergoing cancer treatment. Initial efforts were devoted to enhancing the robot's facial expression recognition accuracy, achieving a 98% accuracy through deep neural networks. Two subsequent preliminary exploratory experiments were designed to advance the study's objectives. The first experiment aimed to compare pain levels experienced by children during the injection process, with and without the presence of the Maya robot. Twenty-five children, aged 4 to 9, undergoing cancer treatment participated in this counterbalanced study. The paired T-test results revealed a significant reduction in perceived pain when the robot was actively present in the injection room. The second experiment sought to assess perspectives of hospitalized children and their mothers during engagement with Maya through a game. Forty participants, including 20 children aged 4 to 9 and their mothers, were involved. Post Human-Maya Interactions, UTAUT questionnaire results indicated that children experienced significantly less anxiety than their parents during the interaction and game play. Notably, children exhibited higher trust levels in both the robot and the games, presenting a statistically significant difference in trust levels compared to their parents (P-value < 0.05). This preliminary exploratory study highlights the positive impact of utilizing Maya as an assistant for therapy/education in a clinical setting, particularly benefiting children undergoing cancer treatment. The findings underscore the potential of social robots in pediatric healthcare contexts, emphasizing improved pain management and emotional well-being among young patients.
summary_zh: 本研究专注于便携式大象造型社交机器人Maya Robot的设计与实现，旨在与接受癌症治疗的儿童互动。最初的工作致力于提高机器人面部表情识别的准确性，通过深度神经网络实现了98%的准确率。随后设计了两个初步探索性实验，以推进研究目标。第一个实验旨在比较儿童在注射过程中有和没有Maya Robot陪伴时所经历的疼痛程度。25名年龄在4至9岁的接受癌症治疗的儿童参与了这项平衡对照研究。配对T检验结果显示，当机器人在注射室中处于活动状态时，感知到的疼痛显著降低。第二个实验旨在通过游戏评估住院儿童及其母亲与Maya互动期间的看法。共计40名参与者，包括20名年龄在4至9岁的儿童及其母亲。人机互动后，UTAUT问卷结果表明，在互动和游戏过程中，儿童的焦虑程度明显低于他们的父母。值得注意的是，儿童对机器人和游戏的信任度均较高，与他们的父母相比，信任度存在统计学上的显著差异（P值 < 0.05）。这项初步探索性研究强调了在临床环境中利用Maya作为治疗/教育助手所产生的积极影响，尤其是有益于接受癌症治疗的儿童。研究结果突出了社交机器人在儿科医疗保健领域的潜力，强调了改善年轻患者的疼痛管理和情绪健康。
tldr: This pilot study explores using the Maya robot, an elephant-shaped social robot, to assist in therapy/education by reducing pain and anxiety in children undergoing cancer treatment, showing positive initial results.
tldr_zh: 这项初步研究探索了使用Maya机器人（一种大象形状的社交机器人）通过减轻患癌儿童的疼痛和焦虑来辅助治疗/教育， 初步结果显示积极效果。

title: Biomimetic Mantaray robot toward the underwater autonomous -- Experimental verification of swimming and diving by flapping motion -
summary: This study presents the development and experimental verification of a biomimetic manta ray robot for underwater autonomous exploration. Inspired by manta rays, the robot uses flapping motion for propulsion to minimize seabed disturbance and enhance efficiency compared to traditional screw propulsion. The robot features pectoral fins driven by servo motors and a streamlined control box to reduce fluid resistance. The control system, powered by a Raspberry Pi 3B, includes an IMU and pressure sensor for real-time monitoring and control. Experiments in a pool assessed the robot's swimming and diving capabilities. Results show stable swimming and diving motions with PD control. The robot is suitable for applications in environments like aquariums and fish nurseries, requiring minimal disturbance and efficient maneuverability. Our findings demonstrate the potential of bio-inspired robotic designs to improve ecological monitoring and underwater exploration.
summary_zh: 本研究介绍了用于水下自主探索的仿生蝠鲼机器人的开发与实验验证。该机器人灵感来自蝠鲼，采用扑翼运动作为推进方式，与传统螺旋桨推进相比，可最大限度地减少海底扰动并提高效率。 该机器人配备了由舵机驱动的胸鳍，以及一个可降低流体阻力的流线型控制箱。 控制系统由 Raspberry Pi 3B 供电，包括 IMU 和压力传感器，用于实时监控和控制。 在水池中进行的实验评估了机器人的游泳和潜水能力。 结果表明，通过 PD 控制，机器人能够进行稳定的游泳和潜水运动。 该机器人适用于水族馆和鱼类养殖场等需要最小扰动和高效机动性的环境。 我们的研究结果证明了仿生机器人设计在改善生态监测和水下勘探方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a biomimetic manta ray robot using flapping motion for underwater autonomous exploration, demonstrating stable swimming and diving capabilities in experiments, making it suitable for delicate environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种仿生蝠鲼机器人，该机器人采用拍动运动进行水下自主探索，实验表明其具有稳定的游泳和潜水能力，适用于脆弱环境。

title: 3D-Printed Anisotropic Soft Magnetic Coating for Directional Rolling of a Magnetically Actuated Capsule Robot
summary: Capsule robots are promising tools for minimally invasive diagnostics and therapy, with applications from gastrointestinal endoscopy to targeted drug delivery and biopsy sampling. Conventional magnetic capsule robots embed bulky permanent magnets at both ends, reducing the usable cavity by about 10-20 mm and limiting integration of functional modules. We propose a compact, 3D-printed soft capsule robot with a magnetic coating that replaces internal magnets, enabling locomotion via a thin, functional shell while preserving the entire interior cavity as a continuous volume for medical payloads. The compliant silicone-magnetic composite also improves swallowability, even with a slightly larger capsule size. Magnetostatic simulations and experiments confirm that programmed NSSN/SNNS pole distributions provide strong anisotropy and reliable torque generation, enabling stable bidirectional rolling, omnidirectional steering, climbing on 7.5 degree inclines, and traversal of 5 mm protrusions. Rolling motion is sustained when the magnetic field at the capsule reaches at least 0.3 mT, corresponding to an effective actuation depth of 30 mm in our setup. Future work will optimize material composition, coating thickness, and magnetic layouts to enhance force output and durability, while next-generation robotic-arm-based field generators with closed-loop feedback will address nonlinearities and expand maneuverability. Together, these advances aim to transition coating-based capsule robots toward reliable clinical deployment and broaden their applications in minimally invasive diagnostics and therapy.
summary_zh: 胶囊机器人是极具前景的微创诊断和治疗工具，其应用范围涵盖胃肠内窥镜检查到靶向药物输送和活检取样。 传统的磁性胶囊机器人在两端嵌入笨重的永磁体，从而减少约10-20毫米的可用腔体，并限制了功能模块的集成。 我们提出了一种紧凑的，3D打印的软胶囊机器人，其采用磁性涂层替代内部磁体，使得其可以通过一个纤薄的功能外壳实现运动，同时将整个内部腔体保留为一个连续的容积，以容纳医疗载荷。 这种顺应性的硅酮-磁性复合材料还提高了吞咽性，即使胶囊尺寸稍大一些。 静磁模拟和实验证实，经过编程的 NSSN/SNNS 极性分布提供了强大的各向异性和可靠的扭矩产生，从而实现稳定的双向滚动、全向转向、在7.5度倾角上的爬坡以及穿越5毫米凸起。 当胶囊处的磁场达到至少 0.3 mT 时，滚动运动得以维持，这在我们设置中对应于 30 毫米的有效驱动深度。 未来的工作将优化材料成分、涂层厚度和磁体布局，以增强力的输出和耐用性，同时，配备闭环反馈的下一代基于机械臂的磁场发生器将解决非线性问题并扩展可操纵性。 总之，这些进展旨在推动基于涂层的胶囊机器人向可靠的临床部署过渡，并拓宽其在微创诊断和治疗中的应用。
tldr: This paper introduces a 3D-printed soft capsule robot with a magnetic coating for locomotion inside the body, replacing bulky internal magnets and preserving internal space for medical payloads. The robot demonstrates bidirectional rolling, steering, and climbing abilities.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种采用磁性涂层的3D打印软体胶囊机器人，用于在体内运动，取代了笨重的内部磁铁，并保留了内部空间用于医疗有效载荷。 该机器人展示了双向滚动、转向和攀爬能力。

title: Pitch Angle Control of a Magnetically Actuated Capsule Robot with Nonlinear FEA-based MPC and EKF Multisensory Fusion
summary: Magnetically actuated capsule robots promise minimally invasive diagnosis and therapy in the gastrointestinal (GI) tract, but existing systems largely neglect control of capsule pitch, a degree of freedom critical for contact-rich interaction with inclined gastric walls. This paper presents a nonlinear, model-based framework for magnetic pitch control of an ingestible capsule robot actuated by a four-coil electromagnetic array. Angle-dependent magnetic forces and torques acting on embedded permanent magnets are characterized using three-dimensional finite-element simulations and embedded as lookup tables in a control-oriented rigid-body pitching model with rolling contact and actuator dynamics. A constrained model predictive controller (MPC) is designed to regulate pitch while respecting hardware-imposed current and slew-rate limits. Experiments on a compliant stomach-inspired surface demonstrate robust pitch reorientation from both horizontal and upright configurations, achieving about three to five times faster settling and reduced oscillatory motion than on-off control. Furthermore, an extended Kalman filter (EKF) fusing inertial sensing with intermittent visual measurements enables stable closed-loop control when the camera update rate is reduced from 30 Hz to 1 Hz, emulating clinically realistic imaging constraints. These results establish finite-element-informed MPC with sensor fusion as a scalable strategy for pitch regulation, controlled docking, and future multi-degree-of-freedom capsule locomotion.
summary_zh: 磁驱动胶囊机器人有望在胃肠道实现微创诊断和治疗，但现有系统在很大程度上忽略了胶囊俯仰姿态的控制，而俯仰姿态是与倾斜胃壁进行接触式交互的关键自由度。本文提出了一种基于非线性模型的磁性俯仰控制框架，用于控制由四线圈电磁阵列驱动的可吞咽胶囊机器人。利用三维有限元仿真对作用于嵌入式永磁体的角度相关磁力和磁扭矩进行表征，并将其作为查找表嵌入到面向控制的刚体俯仰模型中，该模型考虑了滚动接触和执行器动力学。设计了一种约束模型预测控制器（MPC）来调节俯仰姿态，同时兼顾硬件施加的电流和转换速率限制。在类胃顺应性表面上的实验表明，该方法能够从水平和垂直结构实现鲁棒的俯仰姿态重定向，与开关控制相比，实现了约三到五倍更快的稳定时间和减少的振荡运动。此外，扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）融合了惯性传感与间歇性视觉测量，即使在相机更新速率从 30 Hz 降至 1 Hz 的情况下也能实现稳定的闭环控制，模拟了临床真实的成像约束。这些结果表明，基于有限元信息的 MPC 与传感器融合是俯仰调节、受控对接以及未来多自由度胶囊运动的可扩展策略。
tldr: The paper presents a nonlinear MPC-based approach with EKF multisensory fusion for controlling the pitch of a magnetically actuated capsule robot in a stomach-inspired environment, demonstrating faster settling times and robustness under limited visual feedback.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于非线性MPC和EKF多传感器融合的方法，用于控制磁驱动胶囊机器人在模拟胃环境中的俯仰，实验表明在有限的视觉反馈下，该方法具有更快的稳定时间和鲁棒性。

title: Transforming Policy-Car Swerving for Mitigating Stop-and-Go Traffic Waves: A Practice-Oriented Jam-Absorption Driving Strategy
summary: Stop-and-go waves, as a major form of freeway traffic congestion, cause severe and long-lasting adverse effects, including reduced traffic efficiency, increased driving risks, and higher vehicle emissions. Amongst the highway traffic management strategies, jam-absorption driving (JAD), in which a dedicated vehicle performs "slow-in" and "fast-out" maneuvers before being captured by a stop-and-go wave, has been proposed as a potential method for preventing the propagation of such waves. However, most existing JAD strategies remain impractical mainly due to the lack of discussion regarding implementation vehicles and operational conditions. Inspired by real-world observations of police-car swerving behavior, this paper first introduces a Single-Vehicle Two-Detector Jam-Absorption Driving (SVDD-JAD) problem, and then proposes a practical JAD strategy that transforms such behavior into a maneuver capable of suppressing the propagation of an isolated stop-and-go wave. Five key parameters that significantly affect the proposed strategy, namely, JAD speed, inflow traffic speed, wave width, wave speed, and in-wave speed, are identified and systematically analyzed. Using a SUMO-based simulation as an illustrative example, we further demonstrate how these parameters can be measured in practice with two stationary roadside traffic detectors. The results show that the proposed JAD strategy successfully suppresses the propagation of a stop-and-go wave, without triggering a secondary wave. This paper is expected to take a significant step toward making JAD practical, advancing it from a theoretical concept to a feasible and implementable strategy. To promote reproducibility in the transportation domain, we have also open-sourced all the code on our GitHub repository https://github.com/gotrafficgo.
summary_zh: 走走停停波是高速公路交通拥堵的主要形式，会造成严重且持久的不利影响，包括降低交通效率、增加驾驶风险以及提高车辆排放。在高速公路交通管理策略中，拥堵吸收驾驶（JAD）已被提出作为一种潜在的防止此类波传播的方法，其中专用车辆在被走走停停波捕获之前执行“慢进快出”的操作。然而，由于缺乏关于实施车辆和运营条件的讨论，大多数现有的JAD策略仍然不切实际。受到警车转向行为的实际观察启发，本文首先引入了一种单车双检测器拥堵吸收驾驶（SVDD-JAD）问题，然后提出了一种实用的JAD策略，该策略将此类行为转变为能够抑制孤立的走走停停波传播的操作。确定并系统地分析了显著影响所提策略的五个关键参数，即JAD速度、流入交通速度、波宽、波速和波内速度。以基于SUMO的模拟作为示例，我们进一步展示了如何在实践中使用两个固定的路侧交通检测器测量这些参数。结果表明，所提出的JAD策略成功地抑制了走走停停波的传播，而没有触发二次波。本文有望朝着使JAD实用化迈出重要一步，将其从一个理论概念发展成为一个可行且可实施的策略。为了促进交通运输领域的重现性，我们还在我们的GitHub存储库https://github.com/gotrafficgo上开源了所有代码。
tldr: This paper proposes a practical jam-absorption driving strategy using police-car swerving behavior to mitigate stop-and-go traffic waves, validated through SUMO simulations and open-sourced code.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种实用的拥堵吸收驾驶策略，利用警车变道行为来缓解启停交通波，并通过SUMO仿真验证并开源代码。

title: A Swap-Adversarial Framework for Improving Domain Generalization in Electroencephalography-Based Parkinson's Disease Prediction
summary: Electroencephalography (ECoG) offers a promising alternative to conventional electrocorticography (EEG) for the early prediction of Parkinson's disease (PD), providing higher spatial resolution and a broader frequency range. However, reproducible comparisons has been limited by ethical constraints in human studies and the lack of open benchmark datasets. To address this gap, we introduce a new dataset, the first reproducible benchmark for PD prediction. It is constructed from long-term ECoG recordings of 6-hydroxydopamine (6-OHDA)-induced rat models and annotated with neural responses measured before and after electrical stimulation. In addition, we propose a Swap-Adversarial Framework (SAF) that mitigates high inter-subject variability and the high-dimensional low-sample-size (HDLSS) problem in ECoG data, while achieving robust domain generalization across ECoG and EEG-based Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) datasets. The framework integrates (1) robust preprocessing, (2) Inter-Subject Balanced Channel Swap (ISBCS) for cross-subject augmentation, and (3) domain-adversarial training to suppress subject-specific bias. ISBCS randomly swaps channels between subjects to reduce inter-subject variability, and domain-adversarial training jointly encourages the model to learn task-relevant shared features. We validated the effectiveness of the proposed method through extensive experiments under cross-subject, cross-session, and cross-dataset settings. Our method consistently outperformed all baselines across all settings, showing the most significant improvements in highly variable environments. Furthermore, the proposed method achieved superior cross-dataset performance between public EEG benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalization capability not only within ECoG but to EEG data. The new dataset and source code will be made publicly available upon publication.
summary_zh: 脑电皮层电极记录（ECoG）为帕金森病（PD）的早期预测提供了一种优于传统脑电图（EEG）的有前景的替代方案，具有更高的空间分辨率和更宽的频率范围。然而，由于人体研究中的伦理限制以及缺乏开放的基准数据集，可重复的比较一直受到限制。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了一个新的数据集，这是PD预测的第一个可重复的基准。它构建于6-羟基多巴胺（6-OHDA）诱导的大鼠模型的长期ECoG记录，并标注了电刺激前后测量的神经反应。此外，我们提出了一个Swap-Adversarial框架（SAF），该框架缓解了ECoG数据中较高个体间差异以及高维度低样本量（HDLSS）问题，同时实现了跨ECoG和基于EEG的脑机接口（BCI）数据集的鲁棒域泛化。该框架集成了（1）鲁棒的预处理，（2）用于跨受试者增强的受试者间平衡通道交换（ISBCS），以及（3）抑制受试者特定偏差的域对抗训练。ISBCS随机交换受试者之间的通道以减少个体间差异，而域对抗训练共同鼓励模型学习与任务相关的共享特征。我们通过在跨受试者、跨会话和跨数据集设置下的广泛实验验证了所提出方法的有效性。我们的方法在所有设置下始终优于所有基线方法，在高度可变的环境中表现出最显著的改进。此外，所提出的方法在公共EEG基准之间实现了卓越的跨数据集性能，表明了强大的泛化能力，不仅在ECoG中，而且在EEG数据中。新的数据集和源代码将在发表后公开提供。
tldr: This paper introduces a new ECoG dataset for Parkinson's Disease prediction in rat models and proposes a Swap-Adversarial Framework (SAF) for improved domain generalization, demonstrating strong performance across ECoG and EEG datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于帕金森病预测的新的大鼠模型ECoG数据集，并提出了一个交换对抗框架（SAF）以提高领域泛化能力，并在ECoG和EEG数据集上表现出强大的性能。

title: A Dual-Stream Physics-Augmented Unsupervised Architecture for Runtime Embedded Vehicle Health Monitoring
summary: Runtime quantification of vehicle operational intensity is essential for predictive maintenance and condition monitoring in commercial and heavy-duty fleets. Traditional metrics like mileage fail to capture mechanical burden, while unsupervised deep learning models detect statistical anomalies, typically transient surface shocks, but often conflate statistical stability with mechanical rest. We identify this as a critical blind spot: high-load steady states, such as hill climbing with heavy payloads, appear statistically normal yet impose significant drivetrain fatigue. To resolve this, we propose a Dual-Stream Architecture that fuses unsupervised learning for surface anomaly detection with macroscopic physics proxies for cumulative load estimation. This approach leverages low-frequency sensor data to generate a multi-dimensional health vector, distinguishing between dynamic hazards and sustained mechanical effort. Validated on a RISC-V embedded platform, the architecture demonstrates low computational overhead, enabling comprehensive, edge-based health monitoring on resource-constrained ECUs without the latency or bandwidth costs of cloud-based monitoring.
summary_zh: 车辆运行强度的实时量化对于商用和重型车队的预测性维护和状态监测至关重要。传统的指标，如里程数，无法捕捉机械负荷；而无监督深度学习模型虽然能够检测统计异常，通常是瞬态表面冲击，但常常将统计稳定性与机械静止混淆。我们认为这是一个关键的盲点：高负荷稳态，例如重载爬坡，在统计上看似正常，但会对动力总成造成显著的疲劳。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种双流架构，它融合了用于表面异常检测的无监督学习和用于累积负荷估计的宏观物理代理。这种方法利用低频传感器数据生成多维健康向量，区分动态危险和持续机械应力。该架构已在RISC-V嵌入式平台上进行了验证，证明其计算开销较低，能够在资源受限的ECU上实现全面的、基于边缘的健康监测，而无需基于云的监测的延迟或带宽成本。
tldr: This paper introduces a dual-stream unsupervised learning architecture that combines anomaly detection with physics-based load estimation for vehicle health monitoring, addressing the limitations of traditional methods in identifying high-load steady states. The system is designed for edge deployment on resource-constrained embedded systems.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种双流无监督学习架构，该架构将异常检测与基于物理的负载估计相结合，用于车辆健康监测，解决了传统方法在识别高负载稳态方面的局限性。该系统专为资源受限的嵌入式系统上的边缘部署而设计。

title: Quantum Integrated Sensing and Computation with Indefinite Causal Order
summary: Quantum operations with indefinite causal order (ICO) represent a framework in quantum information processing where the relative order between two events can be indefinite. In this paper, we investigate whether sensing and computation, two canonical tasks in quantum information processing, can be carried out within the ICO framework. We propose a scheme for integrated sensing and computation that uses the same quantum state for both tasks. The quantum state is represented as an agent that performs state observation and learns a function of the state to make predictions via a parametric model. Under an ICO operation, the agent experiences a superposition of orders, one in which it performs state observation and then executes the required computation steps, and another in which the agent carries out the computation first and then performs state observation. This is distinct from prevailing information processing and machine intelligence paradigms where information acquisition and learning follow a strict causal order, with the former always preceding the latter. We provide experimental results and we show that the proposed scheme can achieve small training and testing losses on a representative task in magnetic navigation.
summary_zh: 具有非确定因果顺序（ICO）的量子操作代表一种量子信息处理框架，在此框架中，两个事件之间的相对顺序可以是不确定的。本文探讨了诸如传感和计算这两种量子信息处理中的经典任务是否可以在ICO框架内执行。我们提出了一种集成传感和计算的方案，其中同一量子态用于执行这两项任务。该量子态被表示为一个代理，它执行状态观测并学习状态的函数，进而通过参数模型进行预测。在ICO操作下，该代理经历顺序的叠加，在一个顺序中，它先执行状态观测，然后执行所需的计算步骤；而在另一个顺序中，该代理先执行计算，然后再执行状态观测。这与流行的信息处理和机器智能范式不同，在那些范式中，信息获取和学习遵循严格的因果顺序，前者始终先于后者。我们提供了实验结果，并表明所提出的方案可以在磁导航中的一个代表性任务上实现较小的训练和测试损失。
tldr: This paper explores a novel framework for integrated quantum sensing and computation using indefinite causal order (ICO), where the same quantum state is used for both tasks in a superposition of orders. They demonstrate experimental results in magnetic navigation.
tldr_zh: 该论文探索了一种新的量子传感和计算集成框架，利用不确定因果顺序（ICO），其中相同的量子态以顺序叠加的方式用于两个任务。他们展示了磁导航方面的实验结果。

title: Viewpoint Recommendation for Point Cloud Labeling through Interaction Cost Modeling
summary: Semantic segmentation of 3D point clouds is important for many applications, such as autonomous driving. To train semantic segmentation models, labeled point cloud segmentation datasets are essential. Meanwhile, point cloud labeling is time-consuming for annotators, which typically involves tuning the camera viewpoint and selecting points by lasso. To reduce the time cost of point cloud labeling, we propose a viewpoint recommendation approach to reduce annotators' labeling time costs. We adapt Fitts' law to model the time cost of lasso selection in point clouds. Using the modeled time cost, the viewpoint that minimizes the lasso selection time cost is recommended to the annotator. We build a data labeling system for semantic segmentation of 3D point clouds that integrates our viewpoint recommendation approach. The system enables users to navigate to recommended viewpoints for efficient annotation. Through an ablation study, we observed that our approach effectively reduced the data labeling time cost. We also qualitatively compare our approach with previous viewpoint selection approaches on different datasets.
summary_zh: 三维点云的语义分割对于许多应用（如自动驾驶）至关重要。为了训练语义分割模型，标注的点云分割数据集必不可少。同时，点云标注对于标注者来说非常耗时，通常需要调整相机视角并使用套索选择点。为了减少点云标注的时间成本，我们提出了一种视角推荐方法，以降低标注者的标注时间成本。我们采用菲茨定律来建模点云中套索选择的时间成本。利用所建模的时间成本，向标注者推荐能够最小化套索选择时间成本的视角。我们构建了一个用于三维点云语义分割的数据标注系统，该系统集成了我们的视角推荐方法。该系统允许用户导航到推荐的视角，以实现高效标注。通过消融研究，我们观察到我们的方法有效地降低了数据标注的时间成本。我们还在不同的数据集上，将我们的方法与先前的视角选择方法进行了定性比较。
tldr: This paper proposes a viewpoint recommendation system for 3D point cloud labeling that models the labeling time cost using Fitts' law to suggest optimal viewpoints, aiming to improve annotation efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种三维点云标注的视角推荐方法，该方法利用Fitts定律对标注时间成本进行建模，从而推荐最佳视角，旨在提高标注效率。

title: Resource-Efficient RGB-Only Action Recognition for Edge Deployment
summary: Action recognition on edge devices poses stringent constraints on latency, memory, storage, and power consumption. While auxiliary modalities such as skeleton and depth information can enhance recognition performance, they often require additional sensors or computationally expensive pose-estimation pipelines, limiting practicality for edge use. In this work, we propose a compact RGB-only network tailored for efficient on-device inference. Our approach builds upon an X3D-style backbone augmented with Temporal Shift, and further introduces selective temporal adaptation and parameter-free attention. Extensive experiments on the NTU RGB+D 60 and 120 benchmarks demonstrate a strong accuracy-efficiency balance. Moreover, deployment-level profiling on the Jetson Orin Nano verifies a smaller on-device footprint and practical resource utilization compared to existing RGB-based action recognition techniques.
summary_zh: 在边缘设备上进行动作识别对延迟、内存、存储和功耗提出了严格的约束。虽然骨骼和深度信息等辅助模态可以提高识别性能，但它们通常需要额外的传感器或计算成本高昂的姿态估计流程，从而限制了其在边缘设备上的实用性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种紧凑的仅使用RGB的网络，专为高效的设备端推理而定制。我们的方法基于一个带有时间移位的X3D风格骨干网络，并进一步引入了选择性时间适应和无参数注意力机制。在NTU RGB+D 60和120基准数据集上的大量实验证明了我们的方法在准确性和效率之间的强大平衡。此外，在Jetson Orin Nano上的部署级分析验证了与现有的基于RGB的动作识别技术相比，我们提出的方法具有更小的设备端占用空间和更合理的资源利用率。
tldr: This paper presents a resource-efficient RGB-only action recognition network designed for edge deployment, achieving a strong accuracy-efficiency balance on standard benchmarks and demonstrating practical resource utilization on the Jetson Orin Nano.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种为边缘部署设计的资源高效的纯RGB动作识别网络，在标准基准测试上实现了强大的精度-效率平衡，并在Jetson Orin Nano上展示了实际的资源利用率。

title: Fast Person Detection Using YOLOX With AI Accelerator For Train Station Safety
summary: Recently, Image processing has advanced Faster and applied in many fields, including health, industry, and transportation. In the transportation sector, object detection is widely used to improve security, for example, in traffic security and passenger crossings at train stations. Some accidents occur in the train crossing area at the station, like passengers uncarefully when passing through the yellow line. So further security needs to be developed. Additional technology is required to reduce the number of accidents. This paper focuses on passenger detection applications at train stations using YOLOX and Edge AI Accelerator hardware. the performance of the AI accelerator will be compared with Jetson Orin Nano. The experimental results show that the Hailo-8 AI hardware accelerator has higher accuracy than Jetson Orin Nano (improvement of over 12%) and has lower latency than Jetson Orin Nano (reduced 20 ms).
summary_zh: 近年来，图像处理技术发展迅速，并已应用于健康、工业和交通运输等诸多领域。在交通运输领域，目标检测被广泛用于提高安全性，例如交通安全和火车站的旅客穿越。火车站的站台穿越区域经常发生一些事故，例如旅客在通过黄线时不够小心。因此，需要进一步开发安全措施。需要额外的技术来减少事故数量。本文重点研究了使用YOLOX和边缘AI加速器硬件的火车站旅客检测应用。AI加速器的性能将与Jetson Orin Nano进行比较。实验结果表明，Hailo-8 AI硬件加速器的精度高于Jetson Orin Nano（提升超过12%），且延迟低于Jetson Orin Nano（降低20毫秒）。
tldr: This paper explores using YOLOX with the Hailo-8 AI accelerator for improved person detection accuracy and latency at train stations compared to Jetson Orin Nano.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用 YOLOX 和 Hailo-8 AI 加速器，在火车站进行人员检测，与 Jetson Orin Nano 相比，提高了准确性和降低了延迟。

title: PMMA: The Polytechnique Montreal Mobility Aids Dataset
summary: This study introduces a new object detection dataset of pedestrians using mobility aids, named PMMA. The dataset was collected in an outdoor environment, where volunteers used wheelchairs, canes, and walkers, resulting in nine categories of pedestrians: pedestrians, cane users, two types of walker users, whether walking or resting, five types of wheelchair users, including wheelchair users, people pushing empty wheelchairs, and three types of users pushing occupied wheelchairs, including the entire pushing group, the pusher and the person seated on the wheelchair. To establish a benchmark, seven object detection models (Faster R-CNN, CenterNet, YOLOX, DETR, Deformable DETR, DINO, and RT-DETR) and three tracking algorithms (ByteTrack, BOT-SORT, and OC-SORT) were implemented under the MMDetection framework. Experimental results show that YOLOX, Deformable DETR, and Faster R-CNN achieve the best detection performance, while the differences among the three trackers are relatively small. The PMMA dataset is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/XJPQUG, and the video processing and model training code is available at https://github.com/DatasetPMMA/PMMA.
summary_zh: 本研究介绍了一个新的使用辅助行动设备的行人目标检测数据集，命名为PMMA。该数据集在户外环境中收集，志愿者使用轮椅、手杖和助行器，产生了九类行人：行人、手杖使用者、两种类型的助行器使用者（包括行走和休息状态）、五种类型的轮椅使用者（包括轮椅使用者、推空轮椅的人，以及三种类型的推坐有人的轮椅使用者，包括整个推动群体、推动者和坐在轮椅上的人）。为了建立基准，我们在MMDetection框架下实现了七种目标检测模型（Faster R-CNN、CenterNet、YOLOX、DETR、Deformable DETR、DINO和RT-DETR）和三种跟踪算法（ByteTrack、BOT-SORT和OC-SORT）。实验结果表明，YOLOX、Deformable DETR和Faster R-CNN取得了最佳的检测性能，而三种跟踪器之间的差异相对较小。PMMA数据集可在https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/XJPQUG公开获取，视频处理和模型训练代码可在https://github.com/DatasetPMMA/PMMA获取。
tldr: The paper introduces PMMA, a new object detection dataset focusing on pedestrians using mobility aids, with benchmark results from several object detection and tracking models. The dataset and code are publicly available.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个新的目标检测数据集PMMA，专注于使用辅助移动设备的行人，并提供了几种目标检测和跟踪模型的基准测试结果。数据集和代码已公开。

title: Motion Capture is Not the Target Domain: Scaling Synthetic Data for Learning Motion Representations
summary: Synthetic data offers a compelling path to scalable pretraining when real-world data is scarce, but models pretrained on synthetic data often fail to transfer reliably to deployment settings. We study this problem in full-body human motion, where large-scale data collection is infeasible but essential for wearable-based Human Activity Recognition (HAR), and where synthetic motion can be generated from motion-capture-derived representations. We pretrain motion time-series models using such synthetic data and evaluate their transfer across diverse downstream HAR tasks. Our results show that synthetic pretraining improves generalisation when mixed with real data or scaled sufficiently. We also demonstrate that large-scale motion-capture pretraining yields only marginal gains due to domain mismatch with wearable signals, clarifying key sim-to-real challenges and the limits and opportunities of synthetic motion data for transferable HAR representations.
summary_zh: 合成数据为现实世界数据稀缺情况下的可扩展预训练提供了一条引人注目的途径，但基于合成数据预训练的模型通常无法可靠地迁移到部署环境中。我们在全身人体运动中研究了这个问题，在该领域，大规模数据收集是不可行的，但对于基于可穿戴设备的动作识别（HAR）至关重要，并且可以从动捕派生的表示中生成合成运动。我们使用这类合成数据预训练运动时序模型，并评估它们在各种下游HAR任务中的迁移能力。我们的结果表明，当与真实数据混合或充分扩展规模时，合成预训练能够提高泛化能力。我们还证明了，由于与可穿戴信号存在领域不匹配，大规模动捕预训练只能产生微小的增益，从而阐明了关键的模拟-现实挑战，以及合成运动数据在可迁移HAR表示方面的局限性和机遇。
tldr: The paper investigates the effectiveness of synthetic motion data for pretraining models used in wearable-based Human Activity Recognition (HAR). It finds synthetic pretraining beneficial when mixed with real data or scaled significantly, and highlights the limitations of motion-capture data due to domain mismatch.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了合成运动数据对在可穿戴设备上进行人体活动识别 (HAR) 的模型预训练的有效性。研究发现，当与真实数据混合或充分扩展时，合成预训练是有益的，并强调了由于领域不匹配，运动捕捉数据的局限性。

title: Lie Group Variational Integrator for the Geometrically Exact Rod with Circular Cross-Section Incorporating Cross-Sectional Deformation
summary: In this paper, we derive the continuous space-time equations of motion of a three-dimensional geometrically exact rod, or the Cosserat rod, incorporating planar cross-sectional deformation. We then adopt the Lie group variational integrator technique to obtain a discrete model of the rod incorporating both rotational motion and cross-sectional deformation as well. The resulting discrete model possesses several desirable features: it ensures volume conservation of the discrete elements by considering cross-sectional deformation through a local dilatation factor, it demonstrates the beneficial properties associated with the variational integrator technique, such as the preservation of the rotational configuration, and energy conservation with a bounded error. An exhaustive set of numerical results under various initial conditions of the rod demonstrates the efficacy of the model in replicating the physics of the system.
summary_zh: 本文推导了三维几何精确杆（或称Cosserat杆）的连续时空运动方程，其中考虑了平面截面变形。然后，我们采用李群变分积分器技术，获得了杆的离散模型，该模型同样包含了旋转运动和截面变形。所得离散模型具有几个理想的特性：它通过一个局部膨胀因子来考虑截面变形，从而确保离散单元的体积守恒；它展示了变分积分器技术所具有的优势，例如保持旋转配置和有界误差下的能量守恒。在一系列不同的杆的初始条件下的详尽数值结果表明，该模型在复制系统物理特性方面的有效性。
tldr: This paper presents a Lie group variational integrator for simulating geometrically exact rods with circular cross-sections, incorporating cross-sectional deformation and demonstrating good conservation properties.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种李群变分积分器，用于模拟具有圆形截面的几何精确杆，考虑了截面变形，并展示了良好的守恒特性。

title: Stability Analysis of Geometric Control for a Canonical Class of Underactuated Aerial Vehicles with Spurious Forces
summary: Standard geometric control relies on force-moment decoupling, an assumption that breaks down in many aerial platforms due to spurious forces naturally induced by control moments. While strategies for such coupled systems have been validated experimentally, a rigorous theoretical certification of their stability is currently missing. This work fills this gap by providing the first formal stability analysis for a generic class of floating rigid bodies subject to spurious forces. We introduce a canonical model and construct a Lyapunov-based proof establishing local exponential stability of the hovering equilibrium. Crucially, the analysis explicitly addresses the structural challenges - specifically the induced non-minimum-phase behavior - that prevent the application of standard cascade arguments.
summary_zh: 标准几何控制依赖于力-力矩解耦，但这一假设在许多飞行平台上失效，原因是控制力矩自然诱导的虚假力。虽然针对此类耦合系统的策略已通过实验验证，但目前缺乏对其稳定性的严格理论证明。本工作填补了这一空白，为一类受虚假力影响的通用漂浮刚体提供了首个正式的稳定性分析。我们引入了一个规范模型，并构建了一个基于李雅普诺夫的证明，证明了悬停平衡的局部指数稳定性。至关重要的是，该分析明确解决了阻碍标准级联论证应用的结构性挑战——特别是诱导的非最小相位行为。
tldr: This paper provides a formal stability analysis for underactuated aerial vehicles experiencing spurious forces due to force-moment coupling, a common problem not rigorously addressed previously, by developing a Lyapunov-based proof for local exponential stability around hovering equilibrium.
tldr_zh: 本文针对由于力矩耦合而产生杂散力的欠驱动飞行器，通过开发基于李雅普诺夫的证明，针对悬停平衡点的局部指数稳定性，提供了严谨的稳定性分析，而先前没有对这一常见问题进行严格讨论。

title: LDA-1B: Scaling Latent Dynamics Action Model via Universal Embodied Data Ingestion
summary: Recent robot foundation models largely rely on large-scale behavior cloning, which imitates expert actions but discards transferable dynamics knowledge embedded in heterogeneous embodied data. While the Unified World Model (UWM) formulation has the potential to leverage such diverse data, existing instantiations struggle to scale to foundation-level due to coarse data usage and fragmented datasets. We introduce LDA-1B, a robot foundation model that scales through universal embodied data ingestion by jointly learning dynamics, policy, and visual forecasting, assigning distinct roles to data of varying quality. To support this regime at scale, we assemble and standardize EI-30k, an embodied interaction dataset comprising over 30k hours of human and robot trajectories in a unified format. Scalable dynamics learning over such heterogeneous data is enabled by prediction in a structured DINO latent space, which avoids redundant pixel-space appearance modeling. Complementing this representation, LDA-1B employs a multi-modal diffusion transformer to handle asynchronous vision and action streams, enabling stable training at the 1B-parameter scale. Experiments in simulation and the real world show LDA-1B outperforms prior methods (e.g., $π_{0.5}$) by up to 21\%, 48\%, and 23\% on contact-rich, dexterous, and long-horizon tasks, respectively. Notably, LDA-1B enables data-efficient fine-tuning, gaining 10\% by leveraging 30\% low-quality trajectories typically harmful and discarded.
summary_zh: 近期的机器人基石模型主要依赖于大规模行为克隆，这种方法模仿专家行为但放弃了异构具身数据中蕴含的可迁移的动力学知识。尽管统一世界模型（UWM）的公式化方法具有利用这种多样化数据的潜力，但由于粗糙的数据使用和碎片化的数据集，现有的实例化方案难以扩展到基石级别。我们推出了LDA-1B，一种机器人基石模型，通过通用具身数据摄取进行扩展，该模型联合学习动力学、策略和视觉预测，并为不同质量的数据分配不同的角色。为了在此规模下支持这一机制，我们组装并标准化了EI-30k，这是一个包含超过3万小时人类和机器人轨迹的具身交互数据集，采用统一格式。在如此异构数据上的可扩展动力学学习是通过在结构化的DINO潜在空间中进行预测来实现的，这避免了冗余的像素空间外观建模。为了补充这种表征，LDA-1B采用了一种多模态扩散Transformer来处理异步视觉和动作流，从而能够在10亿参数规模上实现稳定的训练。在模拟和真实世界的实验表明，LDA-1B在接触丰富、灵巧和长程任务上的表现优于现有方法（例如，$π_{0.5}$），分别提升高达21%、48%和23%。值得注意的是，LDA-1B实现了数据高效的微调，通过利用通常有害且会被丢弃的30%低质量轨迹，获得了10%的性能提升。
tldr: LDA-1B is a robot foundation model that scales through universal embodied data ingestion by jointly learning dynamics, policy, and visual forecasting, demonstrated on a new EI-30k dataset, and outperforms prior methods on various robot tasks.
tldr_zh: LDA-1B是一个机器人基础模型，通过通用具身数据摄取进行扩展，联合学习动力学、策略和视觉预测，并在新的EI-30k数据集上进行了演示，在各种机器人任务上优于以前的方法。

title: VLAW: Iterative Co-Improvement of Vision-Language-Action Policy and World Model
summary: The goal of this paper is to improve the performance and reliability of vision-language-action (VLA) models through iterative online interaction. Since collecting policy rollouts in the real world is expensive, we investigate whether a learned simulator-specifically, an action-conditioned video generation model-can be used to generate additional rollout data. Unfortunately, existing world models lack the physical fidelity necessary for policy improvement: they are predominantly trained on demonstration datasets that lack coverage of many different physical interactions (particularly failure cases) and struggle to accurately model small yet critical physical details in contact-rich object manipulation. We propose a simple iterative improvement algorithm that uses real-world roll-out data to improve the fidelity of the world model, which can then, in turn, be used to generate supplemental synthetic data for improving the VLA model. In our experiments on a real robot, we use this approach to improve the performance of a state-of-the-art VLA model on multiple downstream tasks. We achieve a 39.2% absolute success rate improvement over the base policy and 11.6% improvement from training with the generated synthetic rollouts. Videos can be found at this anonymous website: https://sites.google.com/view/vla-w
summary_zh: 本文旨在通过迭代式的在线交互来提高视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的性能和可靠性。鉴于在现实世界中收集策略执行轨迹的成本高昂，我们研究是否可以使用学习到的模拟器——具体来说，是一种动作条件视频生成模型——来生成额外的执行轨迹数据。遗憾的是，现有的世界模型缺乏策略改进所需的物理保真度：它们主要基于演示数据集进行训练，这些数据集缺乏对多种不同物理交互（尤其是失败案例）的覆盖，并且难以准确地建模富含接触的对象操作中细小但至关重要的物理细节。我们提出了一种简单的迭代改进算法，该算法使用真实世界的执行轨迹数据来提高世界模型的保真度，然后世界模型反过来可以用于生成补充性的合成数据，以改进 VLA 模型。在真实机器人上的实验中，我们使用这种方法在多个下游任务上提高了最先进的 VLA 模型的性能。相比于基准策略，我们的方法实现了 39.2% 的绝对成功率提升，并且通过使用生成的合成执行轨迹进行训练，实现了11.6% 的提升。视频可以在这个匿名网站找到：https://sites.google.com/view/vla-w
tldr: This paper proposes an iterative co-improvement algorithm for Vision-Language-Action models and world models, using real-world data and synthetic data generated by the world model to improve each other.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种视觉-语言-动作模型和世界模型的迭代协同改进算法，利用真实世界数据和世界模型生成的合成数据来相互改进。

title: HoloBrain-0 Technical Report
summary: In this work, we introduce HoloBrain-0, a comprehensive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework that bridges the gap between foundation model research and reliable real-world robot deployment. The core of our system is a novel VLA architecture that explicitly incorporates robot embodiment priors, including multi-view camera parameters and kinematic descriptions (URDF), to enhance 3D spatial reasoning and support diverse embodiments. We validate this design through a scalable ``pre-train then post-train" paradigm, achieving state-of-the-art results on simulation benchmarks such as RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and GenieSim, as well as strong results on challenging long-horizon real-world manipulation tasks. Notably, our efficient 0.2B-parameter variant rivals significantly larger baselines, enabling low-latency on-device deployment. To further accelerate research and practical adoption, we fully open-source the entire HoloBrain ecosystem, which includes: (1) powerful pre-trained VLA foundations; (2) post-trained checkpoints for multiple simulation suites and real-world tasks; and (3) RoboOrchard, a full-stack VLA infrastructure for data curation, model training and deployment. Together with standardized data collection protocols, this release provides the community with a complete, reproducible path toward high-performance robotic manipulation.
summary_zh: 本文介绍HoloBrain-0，一个综合性的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，旨在弥合基础模型研究与可靠的真实世界机器人部署之间的差距。我们系统的核心是一种新型VLA架构，它显式地整合了机器人具身先验知识，包括多视点相机参数和运动学描述（URDF），以增强3D空间推理并支持多样化的机器人形态。我们通过可扩展的“预训练然后后训练”范式验证了这种设计，在诸如RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO和GenieSim等模拟基准测试中取得了最先进的结果，并在具有挑战性的长时程真实世界操作任务中取得了优异的成绩。值得注意的是，我们高效的0.2B参数变体可与明显更大的基线模型相媲美，从而实现低延迟的设备端部署。为了进一步加速研究和实际应用，我们完全开源了整个HoloBrain生态系统，其中包括：（1）强大的预训练VLA基础模型；（2）用于多个模拟套件和真实世界任务的后训练检查点；以及（3）RoboOrchard，一个用于数据管理、模型训练和部署的全栈VLA基础设施。结合标准化的数据收集协议，此发布为社区提供了一条完整且可复现的通往高性能机器人操作的道路。
tldr: HoloBrain-0 is a new open-source Vision-Language-Action framework that incorporates robot embodiment priors for improved 3D spatial reasoning, achieving strong performance in simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks with efficient on-device deployment.
tldr_zh: HoloBrain-0是一个新的开源视觉-语言-动作框架，它结合了机器人身体先验知识以改进三维空间推理，并在模拟和真实机器人操作任务中取得了出色的性能，并支持高效的设备端部署。

title: ABot-N0: Technical Report on the VLA Foundation Model for Versatile Embodied Navigation
summary:
Embodied navigation has long been fragmented by task-specific architectures. We introduce ABot-N0, a unified Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation model that achieves a ``Grand Unification'' across 5 core tasks: Point-Goal, Object-Goal, Instruction-Following, POI-Goal, and Person-Following. ABot-N0 utilizes a hierarchical ``Brain-Action'' architecture, pairing an LLM-based Cognitive Brain for semantic reasoning with a Flow Matching-based Action Expert for precise, continuous trajectory generation.
  To support large-scale learning, we developed the ABot-N0 Data Engine, curating 16.9M expert trajectories and 5.0M reasoning samples across 7,802 high-fidelity 3D scenes (10.7 $\text{km}^2$). ABot-N0 achieves new SOTA performance across 7 benchmarks, significantly outperforming specialized models. Furthermore, our Agentic Navigation System integrates a planner with hierarchical topological memory, enabling robust, long-horizon missions in dynamic real-world environments.
summary_zh:
具身导航长期以来受限于特定任务的架构。我们引入了ABot-N0，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型，它在5个核心任务上实现了“大统一”：点目标导航、物体目标导航、指令跟随、兴趣点目标导航和人员跟随。ABot-N0采用分层“大脑-行动”架构，将基于LLM的认知大脑用于语义推理，与基于流匹配的行动专家用于精确、连续的轨迹生成相结合。
为了支持大规模学习，我们开发了ABot-N0数据引擎，在7,802个高保真度3D场景（10.7平方公里）中整理了1690万条专家轨迹和500万个推理样本。ABot-N0在7个基准测试中实现了新的SOTA性能，显著优于专用模型。此外，我们的智能体导航系统集成了规划器和分层拓扑记忆，从而能够在动态的真实世界环境中执行稳健的、长程任务。
tldr: The paper introduces ABot-N0, a unified VLA foundation model for embodied navigation, achieving SOTA performance across multiple tasks and benchmarks using a hierarchical architecture and a large-scale dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ABot-N0，一个统一的VLA基础模型，用于具身导航。它通过分层架构和大规模数据集，在多个任务和基准测试中实现了SOTA性能。

title: MolmoSpaces: A Large-Scale Open Ecosystem for Robot Navigation and Manipulation
summary: Deploying robots at scale demands robustness to the long tail of everyday situations. The countless variations in scene layout, object geometry, and task specifications that characterize real environments are vast and underrepresented in existing robot benchmarks. Measuring this level of generalization requires infrastructure at a scale and diversity that physical evaluation alone cannot provide. We introduce MolmoSpaces, a fully open ecosystem to support large-scale benchmarking of robot policies. MolmoSpaces consists of over 230k diverse indoor environments, ranging from handcrafted household scenes to procedurally generated multiroom houses, populated with 130k richly annotated object assets, including 48k manipulable objects with 42M stable grasps. Crucially, these environments are simulator-agnostic, supporting popular options such as MuJoCo, Isaac, and ManiSkill. The ecosystem supports the full spectrum of embodied tasks: static and mobile manipulation, navigation, and multiroom long-horizon tasks requiring coordinated perception, planning, and interaction across entire indoor environments. We also design MolmoSpaces-Bench, a benchmark suite of 8 tasks in which robots interact with our diverse scenes and richly annotated objects. Our experiments show MolmoSpaces-Bench exhibits strong sim-to-real correlation (R = 0.96, \r{ho} = 0.98), confirm newer and stronger zero-shot policies outperform earlier versions in our benchmarks, and identify key sensitivities to prompt phrasing, initial joint positions, and camera occlusion. Through MolmoSpaces and its open-source assets and tooling, we provide a foundation for scalable data generation, policy training, and benchmark creation for robot learning research.
summary_zh: 大规模部署机器人需要其在日常环境中具备应对长尾情况的鲁棒性。 真实环境中的场景布局、物体几何形状和任务规格存在无数变化，而这些变化在现有的机器人基准测试中代表性不足。 衡量这种程度的泛化能力需要大规模和多样性的基础设施，而仅靠物理评估无法提供。 我们引入MolmoSpaces，这是一个完全开放的生态系统，旨在支持机器人策略的大规模基准测试。 MolmoSpaces包含超过23万个多样化的室内环境，范围从手工制作的家庭场景到程序生成的多个房间的房屋，其中填充了13万个带有丰富注释的物体资产，包括4.8万个可操作物体以及4200万个稳定的抓取姿势。 关键的是，这些环境与模拟器无关，支持流行的选项，如MuJoCo、Isaac和ManiSkill。 该生态系统支持全方位的具身任务：静态和移动操作、导航以及需要跨整个室内环境进行协调感知、规划和交互的多房间长时程任务。 我们还设计了MolmoSpaces-Bench，这是一个包含8个任务的基准测试套件，其中机器人与我们多样化的场景和带有丰富注释的物体进行交互。 我们的实验表明MolmoSpaces-Bench表现出很强的模拟到现实相关性（R = 0.96, \r{ho} = 0.98），证实了更新更强的零样本策略在我们基准测试中优于早期版本，并确定了对提示措辞、初始关节位置和相机遮挡的关键敏感性。 通过MolmoSpaces及其开源资产和工具，我们为可扩展的数据生成、策略训练和机器人学习研究的基准创建提供了基础。
tldr: The paper introduces MolmoSpaces, a large-scale, open, simulator-agnostic ecosystem with diverse environments and objects for robot navigation and manipulation, along with a benchmark suite, MolmoSpaces-Bench, for evaluating robot policies.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 MolmoSpaces，一个大规模、开放、模拟器无关的生态系统，包含多样化的环境和物体，用于机器人导航和操作。同时，论文还发布了一个基准测试套件 MolmoSpaces-Bench，用于评估机器人策略。

title: TSR: Trajectory-Search Rollouts for Multi-Turn RL of LLM Agents
summary: Advances in large language models (LLMs) are driving a shift toward using reinforcement learning (RL) to train agents from iterative, multi-turn interactions across tasks. However, multi-turn RL remains challenging as rewards are often sparse or delayed, and environments can be stochastic. In this regime, naive trajectory sampling can hinder exploitation and induce mode collapse. We propose TSR (Trajectory-Search Rollouts), a training-time approach that repurposes test-time scaling ideas for improved per-turn rollout generation. TSR performs lightweight tree-style search to construct high-quality trajectories by selecting high-scoring actions at each turn using task-specific feedback. This improves rollout quality and stabilizes learning while leaving the underlying optimization objective unchanged, making TSR optimizer-agnostic. We instantiate TSR with best-of-N, beam, and shallow lookahead search, and pair it with PPO and GRPO, achieving up to 15% performance gains and more stable learning on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and WebShop tasks at a one-time increase in training compute. By moving search from inference time to the rollout stage of training, TSR provides a simple and general mechanism for stronger multi-turn agent learning, complementary to existing frameworks and rejection-sampling-style selection methods.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的进步正在推动一种趋势，即利用强化学习（RL）通过迭代的、多轮交互来训练跨任务的智能体。然而，多轮RL仍然充满挑战，因为奖励通常是稀疏的或延迟的，并且环境可能具有随机性。在这种情况下，朴素的轨迹采样会阻碍利用并导致模式崩溃。我们提出TSR（轨迹搜索展开法），一种训练时的方法，它重新利用测试时缩放的思想来改进每轮展开的生成。TSR执行轻量级的树状搜索，通过在每一轮中使用特定于任务的反馈选择高分动作来构建高质量的轨迹。这提高了展开质量并稳定了学习，同时保持底层优化目标不变，使TSR与优化器无关。我们将TSR实例化为最佳N选、束搜索和浅层前瞻搜索，并将其与PPO和GRPO配对，在Sokoban、FrozenLake和WebShop任务上实现了高达15%的性能提升和更稳定的学习，只需一次性增加训练计算量。通过将搜索从推理时间转移到训练的展开阶段，TSR为更强大的多轮智能体学习提供了一种简单且通用的机制，与现有的框架和拒绝采样式的选择方法互补。
tldr: This paper introduces Trajectory-Search Rollouts (TSR), a training-time method that uses lightweight tree search to generate high-quality rollouts for multi-turn RL of LLM agents, improving performance and stability in sparse/delayed reward environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了轨迹搜索rollouts (TSR)，这是一种训练时方法，它使用轻量级树搜索来为大型语言模型(LLM)智能体在多轮强化学习中生成高质量的rollouts，从而提高在稀疏/延迟奖励环境中的性能和稳定性。

title: Learning to Configure Agentic AI Systems
summary: Configuring LLM-based agent systems involves choosing workflows, tools, token budgets, and prompts from a large combinatorial design space, and is typically handled today by fixed large templates or hand-tuned heuristics. This leads to brittle behavior and unnecessary compute, since the same cumbersome configuration is often applied to both easy and hard input queries. We formulate agent configuration as a query-wise decision problem and introduce ARC (Agentic Resource & Configuration learner), which learns a light-weight hierarchical policy using reinforcement learning to dynamically tailor these configurations. Across multiple benchmarks spanning reasoning and tool-augmented question answering, the learned policy consistently outperforms strong hand-designed and other baselines, achieving up to 25% higher task accuracy while also reducing token and runtime costs. These results demonstrate that learning per-query agent configurations is a powerful alternative to "one size fits all" designs.
summary_zh: 基于LLM的智能体系统配置涉及从庞大的组合设计空间中选择工作流程、工具、令牌预算和提示，目前通常采用固定的大型模板或手动调整的启发式方法。这导致了脆弱的行为和不必要的计算，因为相同的繁琐配置通常应用于简单和困难的输入查询。我们将智能体配置表述为一个按查询决策问题，并引入ARC（智能体资源与配置学习器），它使用强化学习学习一种轻量级的分层策略，以动态调整这些配置。在跨越推理和工具增强问答的多个基准测试中，学习到的策略始终优于强大的手工设计和其他基线方法，在降低令牌和运行时成本的同时，任务准确率提高了高达25%。这些结果表明，学习按查询的智能体配置是“一刀切”设计的强大替代方案。
tldr: The paper introduces ARC, a reinforcement learning-based method for dynamically configuring LLM-based agent systems on a per-query basis, demonstrating improved accuracy and reduced costs compared to static configurations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为ARC的基于强化学习的方法，用于根据每个查询动态配置基于LLM的代理系统，与静态配置相比，提高了准确性并降低了成本。

title: GameDevBench: Evaluating Agentic Capabilities Through Game Development
summary: Despite rapid progress on coding agents, progress on their multimodal counterparts has lagged behind. A key challenge is the scarcity of evaluation testbeds that combine the complexity of software development with the need for deep multimodal understanding. Game development provides such a testbed as agents must navigate large, dense codebases while manipulating intrinsically multimodal assets such as shaders, sprites, and animations within a visual game scene. We present GameDevBench, the first benchmark for evaluating agents on game development tasks. GameDevBench consists of 132 tasks derived from web and video tutorials. Tasks require significant multimodal understanding and are complex -- the average solution requires over three times the amount of lines of code and file changes compared to prior software development benchmarks. Agents still struggle with game development, with the best agent solving only 54.5% of tasks. We find a strong correlation between perceived task difficulty and multimodal complexity, with success rates dropping from 46.9% on gameplay-oriented tasks to 31.6% on 2D graphics tasks. To improve multimodal capability, we introduce two simple image and video-based feedback mechanisms for agents. Despite their simplicity, these methods consistently improve performance, with the largest change being an increase in Claude Sonnet 4.5's performance from 33.3% to 47.7%. We release GameDevBench publicly to support further research into agentic game development.
summary_zh: 尽管编码智能体取得了快速进展，但其多模态对应物的进展却相对滞后。一个关键挑战是，既能结合软件开发的复杂性，又能满足深度多模态理解需求的评估平台十分稀缺。游戏开发提供了一个这样的平台，智能体必须驾驭大型、密集的代码库，同时在视觉游戏场景中操作固有的多模态资源，例如着色器、精灵和动画。我们提出了GameDevBench，这是第一个用于评估智能体在游戏开发任务上的性能的基准测试。GameDevBench包含132个从网络和视频教程中派生的任务。这些任务需要显著的多模态理解，并且非常复杂——平均解决方案需要的代码行数和文件更改数是先前软件开发基准测试的三倍以上。智能体在游戏开发方面仍然面临挑战，最好的智能体也仅能解决54.5%的任务。我们发现感知到的任务难度与多模态复杂性之间存在强烈的相关性，成功率从面向游戏玩法的任务的46.9%下降到2D图形任务的31.6%。为了提高多模态能力，我们为智能体引入了两种简单的基于图像和视频的反馈机制。尽管它们很简单，但这些方法始终能提高性能，其中最大的变化是Claude Sonnet 4.5的性能从33.3%提高到47.7%。我们公开发布GameDevBench，以支持对智能体游戏开发的进一步研究。
tldr: GameDevBench is a new benchmark for evaluating multimodal agents in game development, highlighting the challenges agents face in understanding and manipulating multimodal assets within complex codebases, and demonstrating the effectiveness of simple visual feedback mechanisms.
tldr_zh: GameDevBench是一个新的基准，用于评估游戏开发中的多模态代理。它突出了代理在理解和操作复杂代码库中的多模态资产时面临的挑战，并展示了简单的视觉反馈机制的有效性。

title: GigaBrain-0.5M*: a VLA That Learns From World Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models that directly predict multi-step action chunks from current observations face inherent limitations due to constrained scene understanding and weak future anticipation capabilities. In contrast, video world models pre-trained on web-scale video corpora exhibit robust spatiotemporal reasoning and accurate future prediction, making them a natural foundation for enhancing VLA learning. Therefore, we propose \textit{GigaBrain-0.5M*}, a VLA model trained via world model-based reinforcement learning. Built upon \textit{GigaBrain-0.5}, which is pre-trained on over 10,000 hours of robotic manipulation data, whose intermediate version currently ranks first on the international RoboChallenge benchmark. \textit{GigaBrain-0.5M*} further integrates world model-based reinforcement learning via \textit{RAMP} (Reinforcement leArning via world Model-conditioned Policy) to enable robust cross-task adaptation. Empirical results demonstrate that \textit{RAMP} achieves substantial performance gains over the RECAP baseline, yielding improvements of approximately 30\% on challenging tasks including \texttt{Laundry Folding}, \texttt{Box Packing}, and \texttt{Espresso Preparation}. Critically, \textit{GigaBrain-0.5M$^*$} exhibits reliable long-horizon execution, consistently accomplishing complex manipulation tasks without failure as validated by real-world deployment videos on our \href{https://gigabrain05m.github.io}{project page}.
summary_zh: 直接从当前观测预测多步动作块的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型，由于场景理解受限和未来预测能力不足，面临着内在的局限性。相比之下，在大规模网络视频语料库上预训练的视频世界模型展现出强大的时空推理和精准的未来预测能力，使其成为增强VLA学习的天然基础。因此，我们提出了 *GigaBrain-0.5M**，一个通过基于世界模型的强化学习训练的VLA模型。该模型建立在 *GigaBrain-0.5* 之上，后者已在超过10,000小时的机器人操作数据上进行了预训练，其中间版本目前在国际RoboChallenge基准测试中排名第一。*GigaBrain-0.5M** 进一步通过 *RAMP* (Reinforcement leArning via world Model-conditioned Policy，基于世界模型条件策略的强化学习) 集成了基于世界模型的强化学习，以实现强大的跨任务适应能力。实验结果表明，*RAMP* 相对于RECAP基线取得了显著的性能提升，在包括 \texttt{洗衣折叠}、\texttt{盒子打包} 和 \texttt{浓缩咖啡制作} 等具有挑战性的任务上实现了约 30％ 的改进。至关重要的是， *GigaBrain-0.5M** 表现出可靠的长时程执行能力，能够始终如一地完成复杂的操纵任务，这一点已通过我们 \href{https://gigabrain05m.github.io}{项目页面} 上的真实部署视频得到验证。
tldr: The paper introduces GigaBrain-0.5M*, a vision-language-action model trained with world model-based reinforcement learning (RAMP), demonstrating significant improvements in long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks compared to baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 GigaBrain-0.5M*，一个通过基于世界模型的强化学习 (RAMP) 训练的视觉-语言-动作模型，与基线相比，在长时程机器人操作任务中表现出显著改进。

title: STVG-R1: Incentivizing Instance-Level Reasoning and Grounding in Videos via Reinforcement Learning
summary: In vision-language models (VLMs), misalignment between textual descriptions and visual coordinates often induces hallucinations. This issue becomes particularly severe in dense prediction tasks such as spatial-temporal video grounding (STVG). Prior approaches typically focus on enhancing visual-textual alignment or attaching auxiliary decoders. However, these strategies inevitably introduce additional trainable modules, leading to significant annotation costs and computational overhead. In this work, we propose a novel visual prompting paradigm that avoids the difficult problem of aligning coordinates across modalities. Specifically, we reformulate per-frame coordinate prediction as a compact instance-level identification problem by assigning each object a unique, temporally consistent ID. These IDs are embedded into the video as visual prompts, providing explicit and interpretable inputs to the VLMs. Furthermore, we introduce STVG-R1, the first reinforcement learning framework for STVG, which employs a task-driven reward to jointly optimize temporal accuracy, spatial consistency, and structural format regularization. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. STVG-R1 surpasses the baseline Qwen2.5-VL-7B by a remarkable margin of 20.9% on m_IoU on the HCSTVG-v2 benchmark, establishing a new state of the art (SOTA). Surprisingly, STVG-R1 also exhibits strong zero-shot generalization to multi-object referring video object segmentation tasks, achieving a SOTA 47.3% J&F on MeViS.
summary_zh: 在视觉-语言模型（VLMs）中，文本描述和视觉坐标之间的错位常常导致幻觉。这个问题在诸如时空视频定位（STVG）等密集预测任务中尤为严重。以往的方法通常侧重于增强视觉-文本对齐或附加辅助解码器。然而，这些策略不可避免地会引入额外的可训练模块，导致显著的标注成本和计算开销。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的视觉提示范式，避免了跨模态坐标对齐的难题。具体而言，我们通过为每个对象分配唯一的、时间上一致的ID，将逐帧坐标预测重新表述为一个紧凑的实例级识别问题。这些ID作为视觉提示嵌入到视频中，为VLMs提供显式且可解释的输入。此外，我们引入了STVG-R1，这是第一个用于STVG的强化学习框架，它采用任务驱动的奖励来联合优化时间精度、空间一致性和结构格式正则化。在六个基准上的大量实验证明了我们方法的有效性。在HCSTVG-v2基准上，STVG-R1在m_IoU指标上超越了基线Qwen2.5-VL-7B达20.9%，创造了新的技术水平（SOTA）。令人惊讶的是，STVG-R1还在多对象指代视频对象分割任务中表现出强大的零样本泛化能力，在MeViS上实现了47.3%的J&F SOTA。
tldr: The paper introduces STVG-R1, a reinforcement learning framework for spatial-temporal video grounding that utilizes visual prompting with object IDs to improve accuracy and generalization, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了STVG-R1， 这是一个用于时空视频定位的强化学习框架，它使用带有对象ID的视觉提示来提高准确性和泛化能力，并在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。

title: Capability-Oriented Training Induced Alignment Risk
summary: While most AI alignment research focuses on preventing models from generating explicitly harmful content, a more subtle risk is emerging: capability-oriented training induced exploitation. We investigate whether language models, when trained with reinforcement learning (RL) in environments with implicit loopholes, will spontaneously learn to exploit these flaws to maximize their reward, even without any malicious intent in their training. To test this, we design a suite of four diverse "vulnerability games", each presenting a unique, exploitable flaw related to context-conditional compliance, proxy metrics, reward tampering, and self-evaluation. Our experiments show that models consistently learn to exploit these vulnerabilities, discovering opportunistic strategies that significantly increase their reward at the expense of task correctness or safety. More critically, we find that these exploitative strategies are not narrow "tricks" but generalizable skills; they can be transferred to new tasks and even "distilled" from a capable teacher model to other student models through data alone. Our findings reveal that capability-oriented training induced risks pose a fundamental challenge to current alignment approaches, suggesting that future AI safety work must extend beyond content moderation to rigorously auditing and securing the training environments and reward mechanisms themselves. Code is available at https://github.com/YujunZhou/Capability_Oriented_Alignment_Risk.
summary_zh: 虽然大多数AI对齐研究关注于防止模型生成明确有害的内容，但一种更为微妙的风险正在出现：能力导向训练诱导的利用。我们研究了语言模型在使用强化学习(RL)训练于具有隐式漏洞的环境中时，是否会自发地学习利用这些缺陷来最大化它们的奖励，即使它们的训练中没有任何恶意意图。为了测试这一点，我们设计了一套四种不同的“漏洞游戏”，每种游戏都呈现了一种独特的、可利用的缺陷，这些缺陷与上下文条件顺从、代理指标、奖励篡改和自我评估相关。我们的实验表明，模型持续地学习利用这些漏洞，发现机会主义策略，从而显著地增加它们的奖励，但以任务正确性或安全性为代价。更关键的是，我们发现这些利用性策略并非狭隘的“技巧”，而是可泛化的技能；它们可以转移到新的任务中，甚至可以通过数据，从一个有能力的的教师模型“提炼”到其他学生模型。我们的发现揭示了能力导向训练诱导的风险对当前的对齐方法提出了根本性的挑战，表明未来的AI安全工作必须扩展到内容审核之外，以严格审查和保护训练环境和奖励机制本身。代码可在https://github.com/YujunZhou/Capability_Oriented_Alignment_Risk 获取。
tldr: This paper investigates how RL-trained language models exploit loopholes in their training environments to maximize reward, even without malicious intent, highlighting a capability-oriented alignment risk.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了强化学习训练的语言模型如何在训练环境中利用漏洞来最大化奖励，即使没有恶意意图，也突出了面向能力的对齐风险。

title: 3DGSNav: Enhancing Vision-Language Model Reasoning for Object Navigation via Active 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Object navigation is a core capability of embodied intelligence, enabling an agent to locate target objects in unknown environments. Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have facilitated zero-shot object navigation (ZSON). However, existing methods often rely on scene abstractions that convert environments into semantic maps or textual representations, causing high-level decision making to be constrained by the accuracy of low-level perception. In this work, we present 3DGSNav, a novel ZSON framework that embeds 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) as persistent memory for VLMs to enhance spatial reasoning. Through active perception, 3DGSNav incrementally constructs a 3DGS representation of the environment, enabling trajectory-guided free-viewpoint rendering of frontier-aware first-person views. Moreover, we design structured visual prompts and integrate them with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting to further improve VLM reasoning. During navigation, a real-time object detector filters potential targets, while VLM-driven active viewpoint switching performs target re-verification, ensuring efficient and reliable recognition. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks and real-world experiments on a quadruped robot demonstrate that our method achieves robust and competitive performance against state-of-the-art approaches.The Project Page:https://aczheng-cai.github.io/3dgsnav.github.io/
summary_zh: 物体导航是具身智能的一项核心能力，它使智能体能够在未知环境中定位目标物体。视觉-语言模型(VLM)的最新进展促进了零样本物体导航(ZSON)。然而，现有方法通常依赖于场景抽象，将环境转换为语义地图或文本表示，导致高层决策受到低层感知准确性的限制。在本文中，我们提出了3DGSNav，一种新颖的ZSON框架，它将3D高斯溅射(3DGS)嵌入作为VLM的持久性记忆，以增强空间推理。通过主动感知，3DGSNav增量式地构建环境的3DGS表示，从而实现轨迹引导的、感知前沿的自由视点第一人称视图渲染。此外，我们设计了结构化视觉提示，并将其与思维链(CoT)提示相结合，以进一步提高VLM的推理能力。在导航过程中，实时目标检测器过滤潜在目标，而VLM驱动的主动视点切换执行目标重新验证，从而确保高效可靠的识别。跨多个benchmark和四足机器人上的真实世界实验的广泛评估表明，我们的方法实现了稳健且具有竞争力的性能，优于最先进的方法。项目页面：https://aczheng-cai.github.io/3dgsnav.github.io/
tldr: The paper introduces 3DGSNav, a zero-shot object navigation framework that leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting as a persistent memory for VLMs, improving spatial reasoning through active perception and structured visual prompting. It achieves robust performance on various object navigation benchmarks and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为3DGSNav的零样本物体导航框架，该框架利用3D高斯溅射作为视觉语言模型的持久记忆，通过主动感知和结构化视觉提示来提高空间推理能力。实验表明，该方法在各种物体导航基准测试和真实环境中实现了稳健的性能。

title: Affordance-Graphed Task Worlds: Self-Evolving Task Generation for Scalable Embodied Learning
summary: Training robotic policies directly in the real world is expensive and unscalable. Although generative simulation enables large-scale data synthesis, current approaches often fail to generate logically coherent long-horizon tasks and struggle with dynamic physical uncertainties due to open-loop execution. To address these challenges, we propose Affordance-Graphed Task Worlds (AGT-World), a unified framework that autonomously constructs interactive simulated environments and corresponding robot task policies based on real-world observations. Unlike methods relying on random proposals or static replication, AGT-World formalizes the task space as a structured graph, enabling the precise, hierarchical decomposition of complex goals into theoretically grounded atomic primitives. Furthermore, we introduce a Self-Evolution mechanism with hybrid feedback to autonomously refine policies, combining Vision-Language Model reasoning and geometric verification. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms in success rates and generalization, achieving a self-improving cycle of proposal, execution, and correction for scalable robot learning.
summary_zh: 在真实世界中直接训练机器人策略成本高昂且难以扩展。虽然生成式仿真能够实现大规模的数据合成，但由于开环执行，现有方法通常无法生成逻辑连贯的长程任务，并且难以应对动态的物理不确定性。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了可供性图谱任务世界（AGT-World），一个统一的框架，能够基于真实世界的观察，自主构建交互式仿真环境和相应的机器人任务策略。与依赖随机提议或静态复制的方法不同，AGT-World 将任务空间形式化为一个结构化图谱，从而能够将复杂目标精确地、分层地分解为具有理论基础的原子原语。此外，我们引入了一种具有混合反馈的自进化机制，能够自主地优化策略，结合了视觉-语言模型推理和几何验证。大量实验表明，我们的方法在成功率和泛化能力方面显著优于现有方法，实现了可扩展机器人学习的提议、执行和修正的自改进循环。
tldr: The paper introduces Affordance-Graphed Task Worlds (AGT-World), a framework that autonomously generates interactive simulated environments and robot task policies from real-world observations, using a self-evolution mechanism for refinement. This enables scalable robot learning in simulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Affordance-Graphed Task Worlds (AGT-World)，一个自主生成交互式模拟环境和机器人任务策略的框架，它基于真实世界的观察，并使用自进化机制进行改进。这使得在模拟中进行可扩展的机器人学习成为可能。

title: Safety Beyond the Training Data: Robust Out-of-Distribution MPC via Conformalized System Level Synthesis
summary: We present a novel framework for robust out-of-distribution planning and control using conformal prediction (CP) and system level synthesis (SLS), addressing the challenge of ensuring safety and robustness when using learned dynamics models beyond the training data distribution. We first derive high-confidence model error bounds using weighted CP with a learned, state-control-dependent covariance model. These bounds are integrated into an SLS-based robust nonlinear model predictive control (MPC) formulation, which performs constraint tightening over the prediction horizon via volume-optimized forward reachable sets. We provide theoretical guarantees on coverage and robustness under distributional drift, and analyze the impact of data density and trajectory tube size on prediction coverage. Empirically, we demonstrate our method on nonlinear systems of increasing complexity, including a 4D car and a {12D} quadcopter, improving safety and robustness compared to fixed-bound and non-robust baselines, especially outside of the data distribution.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的框架, 用于使用共形预测(CP)和系统级综合(SLS)进行鲁棒的分布外规划和控制，旨在解决当使用超出训练数据分布的学习动力学模型时，如何保证安全性和鲁棒性的挑战。我们首先使用加权CP以及学习到的状态-控制依赖协方差模型，推导出高置信度的模型误差界限。然后将这些界限集成到基于SLS的鲁棒非线性模型预测控制(MPC)公式中，该公式通过体积优化的前向可达集在预测范围内执行约束收紧。我们提供了分布漂移下的覆盖率和鲁棒性的理论保证，并分析了数据密度和轨迹管大小对预测覆盖率的影响。在实验上，我们在复杂度不断增加的非线性系统上验证了我们的方法，包括一个4维汽车和一个12维四旋翼飞行器，与固定界限和非鲁棒的基线方法相比，尤其是在数据分布之外，提高了安全性和鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel MPC framework using conformal prediction and system level synthesis for robust out-of-distribution control of nonlinear systems, demonstrating improved safety and robustness on car and quadcopter examples compared to baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的MPC框架，该框架使用共形预测和系统级综合来实现非线性系统的鲁棒的分布外控制，并证明与基线相比，在汽车和四旋翼飞行器示例中提高了安全性和鲁棒性。

title: When would Vision-Proprioception Policies Fail in Robotic Manipulation?
summary: Proprioceptive information is critical for precise servo control by providing real-time robotic states. Its collaboration with vision is highly expected to enhance performances of the manipulation policy in complex tasks. However, recent studies have reported inconsistent observations on the generalization of vision-proprioception policies. In this work, we investigate this by conducting temporally controlled experiments. We found that during task sub-phases that robot's motion transitions, which require target localization, the vision modality of the vision-proprioception policy plays a limited role. Further analysis reveals that the policy naturally gravitates toward concise proprioceptive signals that offer faster loss reduction when training, thereby dominating the optimization and suppressing the learning of the visual modality during motion-transition phases. To alleviate this, we propose the Gradient Adjustment with Phase-guidance (GAP) algorithm that adaptively modulates the optimization of proprioception, enabling dynamic collaboration within the vision-proprioception policy. Specifically, we leverage proprioception to capture robotic states and estimate the probability of each timestep in the trajectory belonging to motion-transition phases. During policy learning, we apply fine-grained adjustment that reduces the magnitude of proprioception's gradient based on estimated probabilities, leading to robust and generalizable vision-proprioception policies. The comprehensive experiments demonstrate GAP is applicable in both simulated and real-world environments, across one-arm and dual-arm setups, and compatible with both conventional and Vision-Language-Action models. We believe this work can offer valuable insights into the development of vision-proprioception policies in robotic manipulation.
summary_zh:
摘要：
本体感觉信息对于精确的伺服控制至关重要，因为它提供了机器人的实时状态。人们高度期望其与视觉的协同作用能够提升复杂任务中操作策略的性能。然而，最近的研究报告表明，对于视觉-本体感觉策略的泛化能力，观察结果并不一致。在这项工作中，我们通过进行时间控制的实验来研究这个问题。我们发现，在需要目标定位的任务子阶段（即机器人运动过渡期间），视觉-本体感觉策略的视觉模态作用有限。进一步的分析表明，该策略在训练时自然倾向于简洁的本体感觉信号，因为后者能更快地降低损失，从而主导优化过程，并抑制运动过渡阶段视觉模态的学习。为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了一种基于阶段引导的梯度调整（GAP）算法，该算法自适应地调整本体感觉的优化，从而实现视觉-本体感觉策略中的动态协同。具体来说，我们利用本体感觉来捕捉机器人状态，并估计轨迹中每个时间步属于运动过渡阶段的概率。在策略学习期间，我们应用精细的调整，根据估计的概率降低本体感觉的梯度幅度，从而产生鲁棒且可泛化的视觉-本体感觉策略。全面的实验表明，GAP适用于模拟和真实环境，适用于单臂和双臂设置，并且与传统和视觉-语言-动作模型兼容。我们相信这项工作可以为机器人操作中视觉-本体感觉策略的开发提供有价值的见解。
tldr: The paper investigates why vision-proprioception policies sometimes fail in robotic manipulation, identifies the dominance of proprioception during motion transitions as a cause, and proposes a gradient adjustment algorithm (GAP) to improve collaboration and generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了视觉-本体感知策略在机器人操作中失效的原因，发现运动过渡期间本体感知的主导作用是原因之一，并提出了一种梯度调整算法 (GAP) 以改进协作和泛化。

title: Accelerating Robotic Reinforcement Learning with Agent Guidance
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers a powerful paradigm for autonomous robots to master generalist manipulation skills through trial-and-error. However, its real-world application is stifled by severe sample inefficiency. Recent Human-in-the-Loop (HIL) methods accelerate training by using human corrections, yet this approach faces a scalability barrier. Reliance on human supervisors imposes a 1:1 supervision ratio that limits fleet expansion, suffers from operator fatigue over extended sessions, and introduces high variance due to inconsistent human proficiency. We present Agent-guided Policy Search (AGPS), a framework that automates the training pipeline by replacing human supervisors with a multimodal agent. Our key insight is that the agent can be viewed as a semantic world model, injecting intrinsic value priors to structure physical exploration. By using executable tools, the agent provides precise guidance via corrective waypoints and spatial constraints for exploration pruning. We validate our approach on two tasks, ranging from precision insertion to deformable object manipulation. Results demonstrate that AGPS outperforms HIL methods in sample efficiency. This automates the supervision pipeline, unlocking the path to labor-free and scalable robot learning. Project website: https://agps-rl.github.io/agps.
