summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）为自主机器人通过试错掌握通用操作技能提供了一个强大的范式。然而，其现实世界的应用受到严重的样本低效性所阻碍。最近的人在环（HIL）方法通过使用人工纠正来加速训练，但这种方法面临着可扩展性的障碍。对人类监督者的依赖施加了1:1 的监督比例，限制了机器人集群的扩展，导致操作员长时间工作后的疲劳，并因人类熟练程度的不一致而引入了高方差。我们提出了Agent引导的策略搜索（AGPS），这是一个通过用多模态智能体替换人类监督者来自动化训练流程的框架。我们的关键洞察是，智能体可以被视为一个语义世界模型，注入内在价值先验来构建物理探索。通过使用可执行工具，智能体通过纠正航点和空间约束为探索剪枝提供精确的指导。我们在两个任务上验证了我们的方法，范围从精密插入到可变形物体操作。结果表明，AGPS在样本效率方面优于HIL方法。这自动化了监督流程，开启了通往无需人工且可扩展的机器人学习的道路。项目网站：https://agps-rl.github.io/agps.
tldr: The paper introduces Agent-guided Policy Search (AGPS), a framework that automates robotic reinforcement learning by using a multimodal agent as a supervisor, replacing human involvement and improving sample efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Agent引导的策略搜索 (AGPS), 一个通过使用多模态智能体作为监督者来自动化机器人强化学习的框架，取代了人工干预并提高了样本效率。

title: Robot-DIFT: Distilling Diffusion Features for Geometrically Consistent Visuomotor Control
summary: We hypothesize that a key bottleneck in generalizable robot manipulation is not solely data scale or policy capacity, but a structural mismatch between current visual backbones and the physical requirements of closed-loop control. While state-of-the-art vision encoders (including those used in VLAs) optimize for semantic invariance to stabilize classification, manipulation typically demands geometric sensitivity the ability to map millimeter-level pose shifts to predictable feature changes. Their discriminative objective creates a "blind spot" for fine-grained control, whereas generative diffusion models inherently encode geometric dependencies within their latent manifolds, encouraging the preservation of dense multi-scale spatial structure. However, directly deploying stochastic diffusion features for control is hindered by stochastic instability, inference latency, and representation drift during fine-tuning. To bridge this gap, we propose Robot-DIFT, a framework that decouples the source of geometric information from the process of inference via Manifold Distillation. By distilling a frozen diffusion teacher into a deterministic Spatial-Semantic Feature Pyramid Network (S2-FPN), we retain the rich geometric priors of the generative model while ensuring temporal stability, real-time execution, and robustness against drift. Pretrained on the large-scale DROID dataset, Robot-DIFT demonstrates superior geometric consistency and control performance compared to leading discriminative baselines, supporting the view that how a model learns to see dictates how well it can learn to act.
summary_zh: 我们假设，通用机器人操作的一个关键瓶颈不仅仅在于数据规模或策略容量，而在于当前视觉骨干网络与闭环控制的物理需求之间的结构性不匹配。虽然最先进的视觉编码器（包括视觉语言动作模型中使用的编码器）优化语义不变性以稳定分类，但操作通常需要几何敏感性，即能够将毫米级的姿态变化映射到可预测的特征变化。它们的判别性目标为细粒度控制创造了一个“盲点”，而生成式扩散模型则固有地在其潜在流形中编码几何依赖关系，从而鼓励保留密集的多尺度空间结构。然而，直接部署随机扩散特征进行控制会受到随机不稳定、推理延迟和微调期间的表示漂移的阻碍。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了Robot-DIFT，一个通过流形蒸馏将几何信息的来源与推理过程分离的框架。通过将冻结的扩散模型教师蒸馏到一个确定性的空间-语义特征金字塔网络 (S2-FPN) 中，我们保留了生成模型的丰富几何先验，同时确保了时间稳定性、实时执行和抗漂移的鲁棒性。经过大规模 DROID 数据集的预训练，Robot-DIFT 显示出比领先的判别性基线更优越的几何一致性和控制性能，支持了模型如何学习观看决定了它如何学习行动的观点。
tldr: The paper introduces Robot-DIFT, a method that distills geometric knowledge from diffusion models into a deterministic feature pyramid network for improved geometric consistency and visuomotor control in robotics.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Robot-DIFT，这是一种将扩散模型中的几何知识提炼成确定性特征金字塔网络的方法，以提高机器人技术中的几何一致性和视觉运动控制。

title: General Humanoid Whole-Body Control via Pretraining and Fast Adaptation
summary: Learning a general whole-body controller for humanoid robots remains challenging due to the diversity of motion distributions, the difficulty of fast adaptation, and the need for robust balance in high-dynamic scenarios. Existing approaches often require task-specific training or suffer from performance degradation when adapting to new motions. In this paper, we present FAST, a general humanoid whole-body control framework that enables Fast Adaptation and Stable Motion Tracking. FAST introduces Parseval-Guided Residual Policy Adaptation, which learns a lightweight delta action policy under orthogonality and KL constraints, enabling efficient adaptation to out-of-distribution motions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. To further improve physical robustness, we propose Center-of-Mass-Aware Control, which incorporates CoM-related observations and objectives to enhance balance when tracking challenging reference motions. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world deployment demonstrate that FAST consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in robustness, adaptation efficiency, and generalization.
summary_zh: 由于运动分布的多样性、快速适应的困难以及在高动态场景中对稳健平衡的需求，为人形机器人学习通用的全身控制器仍然充满挑战。现有的方法通常需要特定任务的训练，或者在适应新的运动时性能会下降。在本文中，我们提出了FAST，一个通用的人形机器人全身控制框架，它能实现快速适应和稳定的运动跟踪。FAST引入了Parseval引导的残差策略自适应，该方法在正交性和KL约束下学习一个轻量级的增量动作策略，从而能够高效地适应超出分布范围的运动，同时减轻灾难性遗忘。为了进一步提高物理鲁棒性，我们提出了质心感知控制，该方法融合了与质心相关的观测和目标，以增强跟踪具有挑战性的参考运动时的平衡能力。在仿真和真实世界部署中的大量实验表明，FAST在鲁棒性、自适应效率和泛化性方面均优于最先进的基线方法。
tldr: The paper introduces FAST, a novel framework for general humanoid whole-body control that uses pretraining and a Parseval-Guided Residual Policy Adaptation scheme to enable fast adaptation and stable motion tracking, demonstrating superior performance in simulations and real-world scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为FAST的通用人形全身控制框架，该框架利用预训练和Parseval引导的残差策略适应方案，以实现快速适应和稳定的运动跟踪，并在模拟和现实场景中表现出卓越的性能。

title: Learning to Manipulate Anything: Revealing Data Scaling Laws in Bounding-Box Guided Policies
summary: Diffusion-based policies show limited generalization in semantic manipulation, posing a key obstacle to the deployment of real-world robots. This limitation arises because relying solely on text instructions is inadequate to direct the policy's attention toward the target object in complex and dynamic environments. To solve this problem, we propose leveraging bounding-box instruction to directly specify target object, and further investigate whether data scaling laws exist in semantic manipulation tasks. Specifically, we design a handheld segmentation device with an automated annotation pipeline, Label-UMI, which enables the efficient collection of demonstration data with semantic labels. We further propose a semantic-motion-decoupled framework that integrates object detection and bounding-box guided diffusion policy to improve generalization and adaptability in semantic manipulation. Throughout extensive real-world experiments on large-scale datasets, we validate the effectiveness of the approach, and reveal a power-law relationship between generalization performance and the number of bounding-box objects. Finally, we summarize an effective data collection strategy for semantic manipulation, which can achieve 85\% success rates across four tasks on both seen and unseen objects. All datasets and code will be released to the community.
summary_zh: 基于扩散模型的策略在语义操控中表现出有限的泛化能力，这对现实世界机器人的部署构成了一个关键障碍。这种局限性源于仅仅依赖文本指令不足以引导策略将注意力集中在复杂和动态环境中的目标对象上。为了解决这个问题，我们提出利用边界框指令来直接指定目标对象，并进一步研究语义操控任务中是否存在数据缩放定律。具体来说，我们设计了一种配备了自动标注流程的手持分割设备Label-UMI，能够有效收集带有语义标签的演示数据。我们还提出了一种语义-运动解耦框架，该框架集成了目标检测和边界框引导的扩散策略，以提高语义操控的泛化性和适应性。通过对大规模数据集进行的大量真实世界实验，我们验证了该方法的有效性，并揭示了泛化性能与边界框对象数量之间的幂律关系。最后，我们总结了一种有效的语义操控数据收集策略，该策略在已见和未见对象的四个任务上均可实现85%的成功率。所有数据集和代码将向社区公开。
tldr: This paper addresses the limited generalization of diffusion-based policies in semantic manipulation by introducing bounding-box guided policies and a data collection pipeline. They demonstrate a power-law relationship between performance and the number of bounding-box objects and report high success rates on real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文通过引入边界框引导策略和数据收集流程，解决了基于扩散的策略在语义操作中泛化能力有限的问题。他们证明了性能和边界框对象的数量之间存在幂律关系，并报告了现实世界任务中的高成功率。

title: LAMP: Implicit Language Map for Robot Navigation
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models have made zero-shot navigation feasible, enabling robots to follow natural language instructions without requiring labeling. However, existing methods that explicitly store language vectors in grid or node-based maps struggle to scale to large environments due to excessive memory requirements and limited resolution for fine-grained planning. We introduce LAMP (Language Map), a novel neural language field-based navigation framework that learns a continuous, language-driven map and directly leverages it for fine-grained path generation. Unlike prior approaches, our method encodes language features as an implicit neural field rather than storing them explicitly at every location. By combining this implicit representation with a sparse graph, LAMP supports efficient coarse path planning and then performs gradient-based optimization in the learned field to refine poses near the goal. This coarse-to-fine pipeline, language-driven, gradient-guided optimization is the first application of an implicit language map for precise path generation. This refinement is particularly effective at selecting goal regions not directly observed by leveraging semantic similarities in the learned feature space. To further enhance robustness, we adopt a Bayesian framework that models embedding uncertainty via the von Mises-Fisher distribution, thereby improving generalization to unobserved regions. To scale to large environments, LAMP employs a graph sampling strategy that prioritizes spatial coverage and embedding confidence, retaining only the most informative nodes and substantially reducing computational overhead. Our experimental results, both in NVIDIA Isaac Sim and on a real multi-floor building, demonstrate that LAMP outperforms existing explicit methods in both memory efficiency and fine-grained goal-reaching accuracy.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型的最新进展使得零样本导航成为可能，从而能够让机器人在无需标注的情况下遵循自然语言指令。然而，现有方法通常将语言向量显式地存储在基于栅格或节点的地图中，但由于过高的内存需求和对精细规划的有限分辨率，导致难以扩展到大型环境。我们引入了LAMP (Language Map)，一种新颖的基于神经语言场的导航框架，它学习一个连续的、语言驱动的地图，并直接利用它进行精细路径生成。与先前的方法不同，我们的方法将语言特征编码为隐式神经场，而不是将它们显式地存储在每个位置。通过将这种隐式表示与稀疏图相结合，LAMP 支持高效的粗略路径规划，然后在学习到的场中执行基于梯度的优化，以细化目标附近的姿态。这种粗到精的流水线、语言驱动的梯度引导优化是隐式语言地图首次应用于精确路径生成。这种细化在选择未直接观察到的目标区域时特别有效，因为它利用了学习到的特征空间中的语义相似性。为了进一步提高鲁棒性，我们采用了一种贝叶斯框架，通过 von Mises-Fisher 分布对嵌入不确定性进行建模，从而提高了对未观察区域的泛化能力。为了扩展到大型环境，LAMP 采用了一种图采样策略，该策略优先考虑空间覆盖范围和嵌入置信度，仅保留信息量最大的节点，并大大降低了计算开销。我们的实验结果，无论是在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 还是在真实的多层建筑中，都表明 LAMP 在内存效率和精细目标到达精度方面都优于现有的显式方法。
tldr: LAMP introduces a novel neural language field-based navigation framework that uses an implicit neural field to encode language features for efficient and accurate robot navigation in large environments, outperforming explicit methods in memory efficiency and goal-reaching accuracy.
tldr_zh: LAMP 提出了一种新颖的基于神经语言场的导航框架，该框架使用隐式神经场对语言特征进行编码，从而在大型环境中实现高效且准确的机器人导航，在内存效率和目标到达精度方面优于显式方法。

title: JEPA-VLA: Video Predictive Embedding is Needed for VLA Models
summary: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models built upon pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved significant improvements in robotic manipulation. However, current VLAs still suffer from low sample efficiency and limited generalization. This paper argues that these limitations are closely tied to an overlooked component, pretrained visual representation, which offers insufficient knowledge on both aspects of environment understanding and policy prior. Through an in-depth analysis, we find that commonly used visual representations in VLAs, whether pretrained via language-image contrastive learning or image-based self-supervised learning, remain inadequate at capturing crucial, task-relevant environment information and at inducing effective policy priors, i.e., anticipatory knowledge of how the environment evolves under successful task execution. In contrast, we discover that predictive embeddings pretrained on videos, in particular V-JEPA 2, are adept at flexibly discarding unpredictable environment factors and encoding task-relevant temporal dynamics, thereby effectively compensating for key shortcomings of existing visual representations in VLAs. Building on these observations, we introduce JEPA-VLA, a simple yet effective approach that adaptively integrates predictive embeddings into existing VLAs. Our experiments demonstrate that JEPA-VLA yields substantial performance gains across a range of benchmarks, including LIBERO, LIBERO-plus, RoboTwin2.0, and real-robot tasks.
summary_zh: 基于预训练视觉-语言模型(VLMs)构建的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型，最近在机器人操作中取得了显著进展。然而，当前的VLA仍然存在样本效率低和泛化能力有限的问题。本文认为这些限制与一个被忽视的组件——预训练视觉表示——密切相关，该组件在环境理解和策略先验两方面都提供了不足的知识。通过深入分析，我们发现VLA中常用的视觉表示，无论是通过图像-语言对比学习还是基于图像的自监督学习进行预训练，都无法充分捕捉关键的、与任务相关的环境信息，也无法诱导有效的策略先验，即对成功任务执行下环境如何演化的预期知识。相比之下，我们发现基于视频预训练的预测嵌入，特别是V-JEPA 2，能够灵活地丢弃不可预测的环境因素，并编码与任务相关的时间动态，从而有效地弥补了现有VLA中视觉表示的关键缺陷。基于这些观察，我们提出了JEPA-VLA，一种简单而有效的方法，可以将预测嵌入自适应地集成到现有的VLA中。我们的实验表明，JEPA-VLA在一系列基准测试中产生了显著的性能提升，包括LIBERO、LIBERO-plus、RoboTwin2.0和真实机器人任务。
tldr: This paper introduces JEPA-VLA, which integrates video predictive embeddings (V-JEPA 2) into Vision-Language-Action models, showing significant performance gains in robotic manipulation tasks by improving environment understanding and policy priors.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了JEPA-VLA，它将视频预测嵌入（V-JEPA 2）集成到视觉-语言-动作模型中，通过改进环境理解和策略先验，在机器人操作任务中显示出显著的性能提升。

title: HAIC: Humanoid Agile Object Interaction Control via Dynamics-Aware World Model
summary: Humanoid robots show promise for complex whole-body tasks in unstructured environments. Although Human-Object Interaction (HOI) has advanced, most methods focus on fully actuated objects rigidly coupled to the robot, ignoring underactuated objects with independent dynamics and non-holonomic constraints. These introduce control challenges from coupling forces and occlusions. We present HAIC, a unified framework for robust interaction across diverse object dynamics without external state estimation. Our key contribution is a dynamics predictor that estimates high-order object states (velocity, acceleration) solely from proprioceptive history. These predictions are projected onto static geometric priors to form a spatially grounded dynamic occupancy map, enabling the policy to infer collision boundaries and contact affordances in blind spots. We use asymmetric fine-tuning, where a world model continuously adapts to the student policy's exploration, ensuring robust state estimation under distribution shifts. Experiments on a humanoid robot show HAIC achieves high success rates in agile tasks (skateboarding, cart pushing/pulling under various loads) by proactively compensating for inertial perturbations, and also masters multi-object long-horizon tasks like carrying a box across varied terrain by predicting the dynamics of multiple objects.
summary_zh: 人形机器人展现了在非结构化环境中执行复杂全身任务的潜力。尽管人-物交互(HOI)取得了进展，但大多数方法侧重于与机器人刚性耦合的完全驱动对象，忽略了具有独立动力学和非完整约束的欠驱动对象。这些会因耦合力和遮挡而带来控制挑战。我们提出了HAIC，一个统一框架，用于在无需外部状态估计的情况下，实现跨各种对象动力学的鲁棒交互。我们的关键贡献是一个动力学预测器，它仅从本体感受历史估计高阶对象状态（速度、加速度）。这些预测被投射到静态几何先验上，以形成空间定位的动态占据地图，使策略能够在盲点中推断碰撞边界和接触可供性。我们使用非对称微调，其中世界模型持续适应学生策略的探索，确保在分布偏移下鲁棒的状态估计。在人形机器人上的实验表明，HAIC通过主动补偿惯性扰动，在敏捷任务（滑板、推动/拉动不同负载的推车）中实现了高成功率，并且通过预测多个对象的动力学，掌握了跨越不同地形携带箱子等多对象长时程任务。
tldr: The paper presents HAIC, a framework for controlling humanoid robots to interact with underactuated objects with independent dynamics, using a dynamics-aware world model for robust state estimation and agile manipulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了HAIC，一个用于控制人形机器人与具有独立动态的欠驱动物体进行交互的框架，它使用一个动态感知的世界模型来实现鲁棒的状态估计和敏捷操作。

title: Counterfactual Conditional Likelihood Rewards for Multiagent Exploration
summary: Efficient exploration is critical for multiagent systems to discover coordinated strategies, particularly in open-ended domains such as search and rescue or planetary surveying. However, when exploration is encouraged only at the individual agent level, it often leads to redundancy, as agents act without awareness of how their teammates are exploring. In this work, we introduce Counterfactual Conditional Likelihood (CCL) rewards, which score each agent's exploration by isolating its unique contribution to team exploration. Unlike prior methods that reward agents solely for the novelty of their individual observations, CCL emphasizes observations that are informative with respect to the joint exploration of the team. Experiments in continuous multiagent domains show that CCL rewards accelerate learning for domains with sparse team rewards, where most joint actions yield zero rewards, and are particularly effective in tasks that require tight coordination among agents.
summary_zh: 高效探索对于多智能体系统发现协同策略至关重要，尤其是在搜索救援或行星勘测等开放域中。然而，当仅在个体智能体层面鼓励探索时，往往会导致冗余，因为智能体的行为没有意识到其队友的探索情况。本文提出反事实条件似然（CCL）奖励，通过隔离每个智能体对团队探索的独特贡献来评估其探索得分。不同于以往仅奖励智能体个体观测的新颖性的方法，CCL强调对团队联合探索具有信息性的观测。在连续多智能体领域的实验表明， CCL奖励能够加速稀疏团队奖励场景下的学习，且在大多数联合动作产生零奖励的情况下尤为有效，并且在需要智能体之间紧密协调的任务中特别有效。
tldr: This paper introduces Counterfactual Conditional Likelihood (CCL) rewards for multi-agent exploration, which encourage agents to explore in a way that maximizes the team's collective information gain, particularly in sparse reward environments. The method shows promise in improving coordination among agents.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多智能体探索的反事实条件似然（CCL）奖励，该奖励鼓励智能体以最大化团队集体信息增益的方式进行探索，尤其是在稀疏奖励环境中。该方法在改善智能体之间的协调方面显示出希望。

title: LLM-Driven 3D Scene Generation of Agricultural Simulation Environments
summary: Procedural generation techniques in 3D rendering engines have revolutionized the creation of complex environments, reducing reliance on manual design. Recent approaches using Large Language Models (LLMs) for 3D scene generation show promise but often lack domain-specific reasoning, verification mechanisms, and modular design. These limitations lead to reduced control and poor scalability. This paper investigates the use of LLMs to generate agricultural synthetic simulation environments from natural language prompts, specifically to address the limitations of lacking domain-specific reasoning, verification mechanisms, and modular design. A modular multi-LLM pipeline was developed, integrating 3D asset retrieval, domain knowledge injection, and code generation for the Unreal rendering engine using its API. This results in a 3D environment with realistic planting layouts and environmental context, all based on the input prompt and the domain knowledge. To enhance accuracy and scalability, the system employs a hybrid strategy combining LLM optimization techniques such as few-shot prompting, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), finetuning, and validation. Unlike monolithic models, the modular architecture enables structured data handling, intermediate verification, and flexible expansion. The system was evaluated using structured prompts and semantic accuracy metrics. A user study assessed realism and familiarity against real-world images, while an expert comparison demonstrated significant time savings over manual scene design. The results confirm the effectiveness of multi-LLM pipelines in automating domain-specific 3D scene generation with improved reliability and precision. Future work will explore expanding the asset hierarchy, incorporating real-time generation, and adapting the pipeline to other simulation domains beyond agriculture.
summary_zh: 3D渲染引擎中的程序化生成技术彻底改变了复杂环境的创建，降低了对人工设计的依赖。 近年来，使用大型语言模型（LLMs）进行3D场景生成的方法显示出潜力，但通常缺乏领域特定的推理、验证机制和模块化设计。 这些局限性导致控制力降低和可扩展性差。 本文研究了使用LLMs从自然语言提示生成农业合成模拟环境，特别是为了解决缺乏领域特定推理、验证机制和模块化设计的局限性。 开发了一个模块化的多LLM流程，集成了3D资产检索、领域知识注入和使用Unreal渲染引擎API的代码生成。 这产生了一个具有逼真种植布局和环境背景的3D环境，所有这些都基于输入提示和领域知识。 为了提高准确性和可扩展性，该系统采用了一种混合策略，结合了LLM优化技术，例如少样本提示、检索增强生成（RAG）、微调和验证。 与单体模型不同，模块化架构支持结构化数据处理、中间验证和灵活扩展。 该系统使用结构化提示和语义准确性指标进行评估。 一项用户研究评估了其相对于真实世界图像的真实性和熟悉度，而专家对比演示了其相比手动场景设计的显著时间节省。 结果证实了多LLM流程在自动化领域特定3D场景生成方面的有效性，并提高了可靠性和精度。 未来的工作将探索扩展资产层级，加入实时生成，并将该流程适应到农业以外的其他模拟领域。
tldr: This paper presents a modular, multi-LLM pipeline for generating realistic 3D agricultural simulation environments from natural language prompts, addressing limitations of existing LLM-based scene generation approaches regarding domain-specific reasoning and scalability. The system combines LLM optimization techniques and demonstrates improved reliability and precision compared to manual design.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种模块化的多LLM流水线，用于从自然语言提示生成逼真的3D农业模拟环境，解决了现有基于LLM的场景生成方法在领域专用推理和可扩展性方面的局限性。该系统结合了LLM优化技术，并证明了与手动设计相比，具有更高的可靠性和精度。

title: Clutt3R-Seg: Sparse-view 3D Instance Segmentation for Language-grounded Grasping in Cluttered Scenes
summary: Reliable 3D instance segmentation is fundamental to language-grounded robotic manipulation. Its critical application lies in cluttered environments, where occlusions, limited viewpoints, and noisy masks degrade perception. To address these challenges, we present Clutt3R-Seg, a zero-shot pipeline for robust 3D instance segmentation for language-grounded grasping in cluttered scenes. Our key idea is to introduce a hierarchical instance tree of semantic cues. Unlike prior approaches that attempt to refine noisy masks, our method leverages them as informative cues: through cross-view grouping and conditional substitution, the tree suppresses over- and under-segmentation, yielding view-consistent masks and robust 3D instances. Each instance is enriched with open-vocabulary semantic embeddings, enabling accurate target selection from natural language instructions. To handle scene changes during multi-stage tasks, we further introduce a consistency-aware update that preserves instance correspondences from only a single post-interaction image, allowing efficient adaptation without rescanning. Clutt3R-Seg is evaluated on both synthetic and real-world datasets, and validated on a real robot. Across all settings, it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in cluttered and sparse-view scenarios. Even on the most challenging heavy-clutter sequences, Clutt3R-Seg achieves an AP@25 of 61.66, over 2.2x higher than baselines, and with only four input views it surpasses MaskClustering with eight views by more than 2x. The code is available at: https://github.com/jeonghonoh/clutt3r-seg.
summary_zh: 可靠的3D实例分割是基于语言的机器人操作的基础。其关键应用在于杂乱环境中，在这些环境中，遮挡、有限视角和噪声掩码会降低感知能力。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Clutt3R-Seg，一种用于在杂乱场景中进行基于语言的抓取的鲁棒3D实例分割的零样本流水线。 我们的核心思想是引入一个语义线索的层级实例树。 与尝试优化噪声掩码的先前方法不同，我们的方法将它们用作信息提示：通过跨视角分组和条件替换，树抑制了过度分割和欠分割，从而产生视角一致的掩码和鲁棒的3D实例。 每个实例都通过开放词汇语义嵌入进行丰富，从而能够从自然语言指令中准确地选择目标。 为了处理多阶段任务期间的场景变化，我们进一步引入了一种一致性感知更新，该更新仅从单个交互后图像中保留实例对应关系，从而无需重新扫描即可实现高效适应。 Clutt3R-Seg 在合成和真实世界数据集上进行了评估，并在真实机器人上进行了验证。 在所有设置中，它在杂乱和稀疏视角场景中始终优于最先进的基线。 即使在最具挑战性的重度杂乱序列上，Clutt3R-Seg 也实现了 61.66 的 AP@25，比基线高出 2.2 倍以上，并且仅使用四个输入视角就超过了使用八个视角的 MaskClustering 两倍以上。 代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/jeonghonoh/clutt3r-seg。
tldr: Clutt3R-Seg is a zero-shot pipeline for robust 3D instance segmentation in cluttered scenes using a hierarchical instance tree and consistency-aware updates, achieving state-of-the-art results for language-grounded grasping with sparse views.
tldr_zh: Clutt3R-Seg 是一种zero-shot pipeline，利用分层实例树和一致性感知更新来实现复杂场景中鲁棒的3D实例分割，在稀疏视图下针对语言引导的抓取实现了最先进的结果。

title: SToRM: Supervised Token Reduction for Multi-modal LLMs toward efficient end-to-end autonomous driving
summary:
In autonomous driving, end-to-end (E2E) driving systems that predict control commands directly from sensor data have achieved significant advancements. For safe driving in unexpected scenarios, these systems may additionally rely on human interventions such as natural language instructions. Using a multi-modal large language model (MLLM) facilitates human-vehicle interaction and can improve performance in such scenarios. However, this approach requires substantial computational resources due to its reliance on an LLM and numerous visual tokens from sensor inputs, which are limited in autonomous vehicles. Many MLLM studies have explored reducing visual tokens, but often suffer end-task performance degradation compared to using all tokens.
  To enable efficient E2E driving while maintaining performance comparable to using all tokens, this paper proposes the first Supervised Token Reduction framework for multi-modal LLMs (SToRM). The proposed framework consists of three key elements. First, a lightweight importance predictor with short-term sliding windows estimates token importance scores. Second, a supervised training approach uses an auxiliary path to obtain pseudo-supervision signals from an all-token LLM pass. Third, an anchor-context merging module partitions tokens into anchors and context tokens, and merges context tokens into relevant anchors to reduce redundancy while minimizing information loss. Experiments on the LangAuto benchmark show that SToRM outperforms state-of-the-art E2E driving MLLMs under the same reduced-token budget, maintaining all-token performance while reducing computational cost by up to 30x.
summary_zh:
在自动驾驶领域，直接从传感器数据预测控制指令的端到端（E2E）驾驶系统取得了显著进展。为了在意外情况下安全驾驶，这些系统可能还需要依赖人为干预，例如自然语言指令。使用多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）有助于人车交互，并能提升此类场景下的性能。然而，由于其对LLM的依赖以及来自传感器输入的众多视觉tokens，这种方法需要大量的计算资源，而这些资源在自动驾驶汽车中是有限的。 许多MLLM研究已经探索了减少视觉tokens的方法，但与使用所有tokens相比，常常导致下游任务的性能下降。

  为了在保持与使用所有tokens相当的性能的同时，实现高效的E2E驾驶，本文提出了第一个用于多模态LLMs的监督式Token缩减框架（SToRM）。所提出的框架由三个关键要素组成。首先，一个轻量级的、带有短期滑动窗口的重要性预测器估计tokens的重要性得分。其次，一种监督式训练方法使用辅助路径，从完整tokens的LLM传递中获取伪监督信号。第三，一个锚点-上下文融合模块将tokens划分为锚点tokens和上下文tokens，并将上下文tokens融合到相关的锚点中，以减少冗余并最大程度地减少信息丢失。在LangAuto基准上的实验表明，在相同的缩减token预算下，SToRM优于最先进的E2E驾驶MLLMs，在降低高达30倍的计算成本的同时，保持了完整tokens的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces SToRM, a supervised token reduction framework for multi-modal LLMs in autonomous driving, which maintains performance while significantly reducing computational cost by intelligently merging less important tokens.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SToRM，一个用于自动驾驶中多模态LLM的监督式令牌减少框架。该框架通过智能地合并不重要的令牌来保持性能，并显著降低计算成本。

title: ViTaS: Visual Tactile Soft Fusion Contrastive Learning for Visuomotor Learning
summary: Tactile information plays a crucial role in human manipulation tasks and has recently garnered increasing attention in robotic manipulation. However, existing approaches mostly focus on the alignment of visual and tactile features and the integration mechanism tends to be direct concatenation. Consequently, they struggle to effectively cope with occluded scenarios due to neglecting the inherent complementary nature of both modalities and the alignment may not be exploited enough, limiting the potential of their real-world deployment. In this paper, we present ViTaS, a simple yet effective framework that incorporates both visual and tactile information to guide the behavior of an agent. We introduce Soft Fusion Contrastive Learning, an advanced version of conventional contrastive learning method and a CVAE module to utilize the alignment and complementarity within visuo-tactile representations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in 12 simulated and 3 real-world environments, and our experiments show that ViTaS significantly outperforms existing baselines. Project page: https://skyrainwind.github.io/ViTaS/index.html.
summary_zh: 触觉信息在人类操作任务中起着至关重要的作用，并且最近在机器人操作领域受到了越来越多的关注。然而，现有方法主要集中在视觉和触觉特征的对齐上，并且融合机制倾向于直接拼接。因此，由于忽略了两种模态固有的互补性，它们难以有效地应对遮挡场景，并且对齐可能没有得到充分利用，从而限制了它们在现实世界的部署潜力。在本文中，我们提出 ViTaS，一个简单而有效的框架，它结合了视觉和触觉信息来指导智能体的行为。我们引入了软融合对比学习，一种传统对比学习方法的改进版本，以及一个CVAE模块，以利用视觉-触觉表示中的对齐和互补性。我们通过12个模拟环境和3个真实世界环境证明了我们方法的有效性，实验表明ViTaS 显著优于现有的基线方法。项目主页：https://skyrainwind.github.io/ViTaS/index.html。
tldr: The paper introduces ViTaS, a visuomotor learning framework that uses Soft Fusion Contrastive Learning and a CVAE to effectively integrate visual and tactile information, demonstrating improved performance in simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks, especially in occluded scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ViTaS，一个视觉运动学习框架，它使用软融合对比学习和一个CVAE来有效地整合视觉和触觉信息，并在模拟和真实世界的机器人操作任务中，尤其是在遮挡场景中，展示了改进的性能。

title: ReaDy-Go: Real-to-Sim Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting Simulation for Environment-Specific Visual Navigation with Moving Obstacles
summary: Visual navigation models often struggle in real-world dynamic environments due to limited robustness to the sim-to-real gap and the difficulty of training policies tailored to target deployment environments (e.g., households, restaurants, and factories). Although real-to-sim navigation simulation using 3D Gaussian Splatting (GS) can mitigate this gap, prior works have assumed only static scenes or unrealistic dynamic obstacles, despite the importance of safe navigation in dynamic environments. To address these issues, we propose ReaDy-Go, a novel real-to-sim simulation pipeline that synthesizes photorealistic dynamic scenarios for target environments. ReaDy-Go generates photorealistic navigation datasets for dynamic environments by combining a reconstructed static GS scene with dynamic human GS obstacles, and trains policies robust to both the sim-to-real gap and moving obstacles. The pipeline consists of three components: (1) a dynamic GS simulator that integrates scene GS with a human animation module, enabling the insertion of animatable human GS avatars and the synthesis of plausible human motions from 2D trajectories, (2) navigation dataset generation for dynamic environments that leverages the simulator, a robot expert planner designed for dynamic GS representations, and a human planner, and (3) policy learning using the generated datasets. ReaDy-Go outperforms baselines across target environments in both simulation and real-world experiments, demonstrating improved navigation performance even after sim-to-real transfer and in the presence of moving obstacles. Moreover, zero-shot sim-to-real deployment in an unseen environment indicates its generalization potential. Project page: https://syeon-yoo.github.io/ready-go-site/.
summary_zh: 视觉导航模型通常难以在真实世界的动态环境中发挥作用，原因在于其对“模拟到真实”（sim-to-real）差距的鲁棒性有限，以及难以训练出专门针对目标部署环境（例如，家庭、餐厅和工厂）定制的策略。尽管使用3D高斯溅射（GS）的“真实到模拟”导航仿真可以缓解这一差距，但先前的工作假定场景是静态的或存在不切实际的动态障碍物，而安全导航在动态环境中至关重要。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了ReaDy-Go，一种新颖的“真实到模拟”仿真流水线，用于合成目标环境的光写实动态场景。ReaDy-Go通过将重建的静态GS场景与动态人体GS障碍物相结合，生成动态环境的光写实导航数据集，并训练出对“模拟到真实”差距和移动障碍物都具有鲁棒性的策略。该流水线包含三个组成部分：（1）一个动态GS模拟器，它将场景GS与人体动画模块集成，从而能够插入可动画的人体GS化身，并从2D轨迹合成合理的人体动作；（2）利用该模拟器、专为动态GS表示设计的机器人专家规划器和人体规划器，为动态环境生成导航数据集；（3）使用生成的数据集进行策略学习。ReaDy-Go在模拟和真实世界的实验中均优于目标环境的基线方法，表明即使在经过“模拟到真实”的迁移后，以及在存在移动障碍物的情况下，导航性能也得到了改善。此外，在未见环境中进行零样本“模拟到真实”部署表明了其泛化潜力。项目主页：https://syeon-yoo.github.io/ready-go-site/。
tldr: The paper introduces ReaDy-Go, a real-to-sim pipeline using dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting to generate photorealistic navigation datasets with moving obstacles for training robust visual navigation policies, showing promising sim-to-real transfer results.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ReaDy-Go，一个使用动态3D高斯溅射的真实到模拟的流程，用于生成具有移动障碍物的逼真导航数据集，以训练鲁棒的视觉导航策略，并展示了有前景的模拟到真实转换结果。

title: Effective Task Planning with Missing Objects using Learning-Informed Object Search
summary: Task planning for mobile robots often assumes full environment knowledge and so popular approaches, like planning via the PDDL, cannot plan when the locations of task-critical objects are unknown. Recent learning-driven object search approaches are effective, but operate as standalone tools and so are not straightforwardly incorporated into full task planners, which must additionally determine both what objects are necessary and when in the plan they should be sought out. To address this limitation, we develop a planning framework centered around novel model-based LIOS actions: each a policy that aims to find and retrieve a single object. High-level planning treats LIOS actions as deterministic and so -- informed by model-based calculations of the expected cost of each -- generates plans that interleave search and execution for effective, sound, and complete learning-informed task planning despite uncertainty. Our work effectively reasons about uncertainty while maintaining compatibility with existing full-knowledge solvers. In simulated ProcTHOR homes and in the real world, our approach outperforms non-learned and learned baselines on tasks including retrieval and meal prep.
summary_zh: 移动机器人的任务规划通常假设环境知识完备，因此像通过PDDL规划等常用方法在任务关键对象的具体位置未知时无法进行规划。近年来，基于学习的物体搜索方法效果显著，但它们作为独立的工具运行，因此不能直接融入完整的任务规划器中，而任务规划器必须额外确定哪些物体是必需的，以及在规划中的哪个时间点应该进行搜索。为了解决这个局限性，我们开发了一个以新型基于模型的LIOS动作为中心的规划框架：每个LIOS动作都是一个旨在查找和检索单个物体的策略。高层规划将LIOS动作视为确定性的，并因此——在基于模型的对每个动作预期成本的计算指导下——生成穿插搜索和执行的规划，从而实现有效、可靠且完整的基于学习的任务规划，即使存在不确定性。我们的工作在保持与现有全知解算器兼容性的同时，有效地推理了不确定性。在模拟的ProcTHOR家庭和真实世界中，我们的方法在包括检索和膳食准备等任务上优于非学习和基于学习的基线方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a task planning framework that integrates learning-informed object search (LIOS) into high-level planning, enabling robots to effectively plan and execute tasks even when object locations are unknown. It combines search and execution strategies while maintaining compatibility with existing solvers.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种任务规划框架，该框架将学习型对象搜索 (LIOS) 集成到高级规划中，使机器人即使在对象位置未知的情况下也能有效地规划和执行任务。 它结合了搜索和执行策略，同时保持与现有求解器的兼容性。

title: Can We Really Learn One Representation to Optimize All Rewards?
summary: As machine learning has moved towards leveraging large models as priors for downstream tasks, the community has debated the right form of prior for solving reinforcement learning (RL) problems. If one were to try to prefetch as much computation as possible, they would attempt to learn a prior over the policies for some yet-to-be-determined reward function. Recent work (forward-backward (FB) representation learning) has tried this, arguing that an unsupervised representation learning procedure can enable optimal control over arbitrary rewards without further fine-tuning. However, FB's training objective and learning behavior remain mysterious. In this paper, we demystify FB by clarifying when such representations can exist, what its objective optimizes, and how it converges in practice. We draw connections with rank matching, fitted Q-evaluation, and contraction mapping. Our analysis suggests a simplified unsupervised pre-training method for RL that, instead of enabling optimal control, performs one step of policy improvement. We call our proposed method $\textbf{one-step forward-backward representation learning (one-step FB)}$. Experiments in didactic settings, as well as in $10$ state-based and image-based continuous control domains, demonstrate that one-step FB converges to errors $10^5$ smaller and improves zero-shot performance by $+24\%$ on average. Our project website is available at https://chongyi-zheng.github.io/onestep-fb.
summary_zh: 随着机器学习转向利用大型模型作为下游任务的先验，学界一直在争论解决强化学习（RL）问题的正确先验形式。如果试图预先进行尽可能多的计算，他们会尝试学习针对某些尚未确定的奖励函数的策略先验。最近的工作（前向-后向（FB）表示学习）已经尝试了这一点，他们认为一种无监督表示学习过程能够在无需进一步微调的情况下实现对任意奖励的最优控制。然而，FB的训练目标和学习行为仍然很神秘。在本文中，我们通过阐明这种表示何时存在、其目标优化了什么以及它在实践中如何收敛来揭示FB的神秘之处。我们建立了与排序匹配、拟合Q值估计和压缩映射的联系。我们的分析提出了一种简化的强化学习无监督预训练方法，该方法不是实现最优控制，而是执行一步策略改进。我们将我们提出的方法称为$\textbf{一步前向-后向表示学习（one-step FB）}$。在教学场景以及10个基于状态和基于图像的连续控制领域中的实验表明，one-step FB收敛到 $10^5$ 倍更小的误差，并平均提高 +24％ 的零样本性能。我们的项目网站位于 https://chongyi-zheng.github.io/onestep-fb。
tldr: This paper analyzes Forward-Backward (FB) representation learning, proposes a simplified version called one-step FB that performs one-step policy improvement, and demonstrates its improved performance over FB in various RL tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了前向-后向 (FB) 表征学习，提出了一种简化的版本，称为单步 FB，它可以执行单步策略改进，并证明其在各种 RL 任务中优于 FB 的性能。

title: H-WM: Robotic Task and Motion Planning Guided by Hierarchical World Model
summary: World models are becoming central to robotic planning and control, as they enable prediction of future state transitions. Existing approaches often emphasize video generation or natural language prediction, which are difficult to directly ground in robot actions and suffer from compounding errors over long horizons. Traditional task and motion planning relies on symbolic logic world models, such as planning domains, that are robot-executable and robust for long-horizon reasoning. However, these methods typically operate independently of visual perception, preventing synchronized symbolic and perceptual state prediction. We propose a Hierarchical World Model (H-WM) that jointly predicts logical and visual state transitions within a unified bilevel framework. H-WM combines a high-level logical world model with a low-level visual world model, integrating the robot-executable, long-horizon robustness of symbolic reasoning with perceptual grounding from visual observations. The hierarchical outputs provide stable and consistent intermediate guidance for long-horizon tasks, mitigating error accumulation and enabling robust execution across extended task sequences. To train H-WM, we introduce a robotic dataset that aligns robot motion with symbolic states, actions, and visual observations. Experiments across vision-language-action (VLA) control policies demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of the approach.
summary_zh: 世界模型正逐渐成为机器人规划与控制的核心，因为它们能够预测未来的状态转移。现有的方法通常侧重于视频生成或自然语言预测，这些方法难以直接与机器人动作相关联，并且会遭受长时程上的误差累积。传统的任务与运动规划依赖于符号逻辑世界模型，例如规划域，它们是机器人可执行的，并且在长时程推理中具有鲁棒性。然而，这些方法通常独立于视觉感知进行操作，从而阻碍了同步的符号和感知状态预测。我们提出了一种分层世界模型（H-WM），它在一个统一的双层框架内联合预测逻辑和视觉状态转移。H-WM结合了一个高层逻辑世界模型和一个低层视觉世界模型，将符号推理的机器人可执行性和长时程鲁棒性与视觉观察的感知基础相结合。分层输出为长时程任务提供了稳定且一致的中间指导，减轻了误差累积，并能够在扩展的任务序列中实现稳健的执行。为了训练H-WM，我们引入了一个机器人数据集，它将机器人运动与符号状态、动作和视觉观察对齐。跨视觉-语言-动作（VLA）控制策略的实验证明了该方法的有效性和通用性。
tldr: The paper introduces a Hierarchical World Model (H-WM) that combines symbolic and visual representations for improved robot task and motion planning, addressing limitations of existing world models and planning approaches by integrating long-horizon reasoning with perceptual grounding.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种分层世界模型(H-WM)，它结合了符号和视觉表示，以改进机器人任务和运动规划。该模型通过将长程推理与感知基础集成来解决现有世界模型和规划方法的局限性。

title: Data-Efficient Hierarchical Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning via Normalizing Flows
summary: Hierarchical goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (H-GCRL) provides a powerful framework for tackling complex, long-horizon tasks by decomposing them into structured subgoals. However, its practical adoption is hindered by poor data efficiency and limited policy expressivity, especially in offline or data-scarce regimes. In this work, Normalizing flow-based hierarchical implicit Q-learning (NF-HIQL), a novel framework that replaces unimodal gaussian policies with expressive normalizing flow policies at both the high- and low-levels of the hierarchy is introduced. This design enables tractable log-likelihood computation, efficient sampling, and the ability to model rich multimodal behaviors. New theoretical guarantees are derived, including explicit KL-divergence bounds for Real-valued non-volume preserving (RealNVP) policies and PAC-style sample efficiency results, showing that NF-HIQL preserves stability while improving generalization. Empirically, NF-HIQL is evaluted across diverse long-horizon tasks in locomotion, ball-dribbling, and multi-step manipulation from OGBench. NF-HIQL consistently outperforms prior goal-conditioned and hierarchical baselines, demonstrating superior robustness under limited data and highlighting the potential of flow-based architectures for scalable, data-efficient hierarchical reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: 分层目标条件强化学习 (H-GCRL) 提供了一个强大的框架，通过将复杂、长程任务分解为结构化的子目标来解决这些任务。然而，其在实际应用中受到数据效率低和策略表达能力有限的阻碍，尤其是在离线或数据稀缺的情况下。为此，本文提出了一种新的框架，基于归一化流的分层隐式Q学习 (NF-HIQL)，该框架在高层和低层都用表达能力强的归一化流策略取代了单峰高斯策略。这种设计实现了可处理的对数似然计算、高效采样，以及对丰富多模态行为进行建模的能力。本文推导了新的理论保证，包括实值非体积保持 (RealNVP) 策略的显式KL散度界限和PAC风格的样本效率结果，表明NF-HIQL在提高泛化能力的同时保持了稳定性。通过OGBench中的运动、运球和多步操作等各种长程任务对NF-HIQL进行了评估。实验结果表明，NF-HIQL始终优于先前基于目标条件和分层的基线方法，证明了其在有限数据下的优越鲁棒性，并突显了基于流的架构在可扩展、数据高效的分层强化学习中的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces Normalizing flow-based hierarchical implicit Q-learning (NF-HIQL) for data-efficient hierarchical goal-conditioned reinforcement learning, demonstrating improved performance and robustness in long-horizon tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于归一化流的分层隐式 Q 学习（NF-HIQL），用于数据高效的分层目标条件强化学习，并在长程任务中展示了改进的性能和鲁棒性。

title: The Observer Effect in World Models: Invasive Adaptation Corrupts Latent Physics
summary: Determining whether neural models internalize physical laws as world models, rather than exploiting statistical shortcuts, remains challenging, especially under out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts. Standard evaluations often test latent capability via downstream adaptation (e.g., fine-tuning or high-capacity probes), but such interventions can change the representations being measured and thus confound what was learned during self-supervised learning (SSL). We propose a non-invasive evaluation protocol, PhyIP. We test whether physical quantities are linearly decodable from frozen representations, motivated by the linear representation hypothesis. Across fluid dynamics and orbital mechanics, we find that when SSL achieves low error, latent structure becomes linearly accessible. PhyIP recovers internal energy and Newtonian inverse-square scaling on OOD tests (e.g., $ρ> 0.90$). In contrast, adaptation-based evaluations can collapse this structure ($ρ\approx 0.05$). These findings suggest that adaptation-based evaluation can obscure latent structures and that low-capacity probes offer a more accurate evaluation of physical world models.
summary_zh: 确定神经模型是否将物理定律内化为世界模型，而非利用统计捷径，仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在分布外（OOD）偏移下。标准评估通常通过下游适应（例如，微调或高容量探针）来测试潜在能力，但这种干预会改变所测量的表示形式，从而混淆自监督学习（SSL）期间所学到的内容。我们提出了一种非侵入式评估协议，PhyIP。我们基于线性表示假说，测试物理量是否可以从冻结的表示中线性解码。在流体动力学和轨道力学中，我们发现当SSL达到低误差时，潜在结构变得线性可访问。在OOD测试中，PhyIP恢复了内能和牛顿平方反比定律缩放（例如，$ρ> 0.90$）。相比之下，基于适应的评估可能会使这种结构崩溃（$ρ\approx 0.05$）。这些发现表明，基于适应的评估可能会掩盖潜在结构，而低容量探针可以更准确地评估物理世界模型。
tldr: The paper introduces PhyIP, a non-invasive evaluation protocol, to assess whether neural models internalize physical laws, finding that adaptation-based evaluations can obscure latent physical structures in world models, while low-capacity probes offer a more accurate evaluation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种非侵入式评估协议PhyIP，用于评估神经模型是否内化了物理定律。研究发现，基于调整的评估可能会掩盖世界模型中潜在的物理结构，而低容量探针则提供了更准确的评估。

title: Gaia2: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Dynamic and Asynchronous Environments
summary: We introduce Gaia2, a benchmark for evaluating large language model agents in realistic, asynchronous environments. Unlike prior static or synchronous evaluations, Gaia2 introduces scenarios where environments evolve independently of agent actions, requiring agents to operate under temporal constraints, adapt to noisy and dynamic events, resolve ambiguity, and collaborate with other agents. Each scenario is paired with a write-action verifier, enabling fine-grained, action-level evaluation and making Gaia2 directly usable for reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source models shows that no model dominates across capabilities: GPT-5 (high) reaches the strongest overall score of 42% pass@1 but fails on time-sensitive tasks, Claude-4 Sonnet trades accuracy and speed for cost, Kimi-K2 leads among open-source models with 21% pass@1. These results highlight fundamental trade-offs between reasoning, efficiency, robustness, and expose challenges in closing the "sim2real" gap. Gaia2 is built on a consumer environment with the open-source Agents Research Environments platform and designed to be easy to extend. By releasing Gaia2 alongside the foundational ARE framework, we aim to provide the community with a flexible infrastructure for developing, benchmarking, and training the next generation of practical agent systems.
summary_zh: 我们引入Gaia2，一个用于评估大型语言模型智能体在真实、异步环境中的基准。不同于以往的静态或同步评估，Gaia2引入了环境独立于智能体行为演进的场景，要求智能体在时间约束下运行，适应嘈杂和动态事件，解决歧义，并与其他智能体协作。每个场景都配有一个写入行为验证器，支持细粒度的行为级别评估，并使Gaia2可以直接用于从可验证奖励中进行的强化学习。我们对最先进的专有和开源模型的评估表明，没有一个模型在各项能力上占据主导地位：GPT-5（高）获得了42%的pass@1最高总体评分，但在时间敏感型任务上表现不佳，Claude-4 Sonnet牺牲了准确性和速度来换取成本效益，Kimi-K2在开源模型中处于领先地位，pass@1为21%。这些结果突出了推理、效率、鲁棒性之间的根本权衡，并暴露了缩小“sim2real”差距的挑战。Gaia2建立在具有开源智能体研究环境平台的消费者环境中，并且被设计成易于扩展。通过发布Gaia2以及基础性的ARE框架，我们旨在为社区提供一个灵活的基础设施，用于开发、基准测试和训练下一代实用智能体系统。
tldr: The paper introduces Gaia2, a new benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in dynamic, asynchronous environments, highlighting performance trade-offs between different models and open-sourcing the evaluation platform and scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Gaia2，一个用于评估LLM Agent在动态、异步环境下的新基准，突出了不同模型之间的性能权衡，并开源了评估平台和场景。

title: DynaHOI: Benchmarking Hand-Object Interaction for Dynamic Target
summary: Most existing hand motion generation benchmarks for hand-object interaction (HOI) focus on static objects, leaving dynamic scenarios with moving targets and time-critical coordination largely untested. To address this gap, we introduce the DynaHOI-Gym, a unified online closed-loop platform with parameterized motion generators and rollout-based metrics for dynamic capture evaluation. Built on DynaHOI-Gym, we release DynaHOI-10M, a large-scale benchmark with 10M frames and 180K hand capture trajectories, whose target motions are organized into 8 major categories and 22 fine-grained subcategories. We also provide a simple observe-before-act baseline (ObAct) that integrates short-term observations with the current frame via spatiotemporal attention to predict actions, achieving an 8.1% improvement in location success rate.
summary_zh: 现有的大多数针对手-物体交互（HOI）的手部动作生成基准测试，主要关注静态物体，而对于具有移动目标和时间敏感协调的动态场景，则缺乏充分的测试。为了弥补这一空白，我们引入了DynaHOI-Gym，一个统一的在线闭环平台，具有参数化的运动生成器和基于rollout的指标，用于动态捕捉评估。基于DynaHOI-Gym，我们发布了DynaHOI-10M，一个大规模基准测试，包含1000万帧和18万条手部捕捉轨迹，其目标动作被组织成8个主要类别和22个细粒度子类别。我们还提供了一个简单的观察-再行动（ObAct）基线方法，该方法通过时空注意力将短期观察与当前帧相结合来预测动作，从而在位置成功率方面实现了8.1%的提升。
tldr: The paper introduces DynaHOI, a new benchmark (DynaHOI-Gym and DynaHOI-10M) for hand-object interaction with dynamic objects, addressing the limitations of existing benchmarks that focus on static objects. It also provides a baseline model for performance evaluation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DynaHOI，一个新的用于手部-物体交互的基准测试 (DynaHOI-Gym 和 DynaHOI-10M)，该基准测试针对动态对象，解决了现有基准测试侧重于静态对象的局限性。 它还提供了一个基线模型用于性能评估。

title: Talk2DM: Enabling Natural Language Querying and Commonsense Reasoning for Vehicle-Road-Cloud Integrated Dynamic Maps with Large Language Models
summary: Dynamic maps (DM) serve as the fundamental information infrastructure for vehicle-road-cloud (VRC) cooperative autonomous driving in China and Japan. By providing comprehensive traffic scene representations, DM overcome the limitations of standalone autonomous driving systems (ADS), such as physical occlusions. Although DM-enhanced ADS have been successfully deployed in real-world applications in Japan, existing DM systems still lack a natural-language-supported (NLS) human interface, which could substantially enhance human-DM interaction. To address this gap, this paper introduces VRCsim, a VRC cooperative perception (CP) simulation framework designed to generate streaming VRC-CP data. Based on VRCsim, we construct a question-answering data set, VRC-QA, focused on spatial querying and reasoning in mixed-traffic scenes. Building upon VRCsim and VRC-QA, we further propose Talk2DM, a plug-and-play module that extends VRC-DM systems with NLS querying and commonsense reasoning capabilities. Talk2DM is built upon a novel chain-of-prompt (CoP) mechanism that progressively integrates human-defined rules with the commonsense knowledge of large language models (LLMs). Experiments on VRC-QA show that Talk2DM can seamlessly switch across different LLMs while maintaining high NLS query accuracy, demonstrating strong generalization capability. Although larger models tend to achieve higher accuracy, they incur significant efficiency degradation. Our results reveal that Talk2DM, powered by Qwen3:8B, Gemma3:27B, and GPT-oss models, achieves over 93\% NLS query accuracy with an average response time of only 2-5 seconds, indicating strong practical potential.
summary_zh: 动态地图 (DM) 作为中日车路云 (VRC) 协同自动驾驶的基础信息设施。通过提供全面的交通场景表示，DM 克服了诸如物理遮挡等单机自动驾驶系统 (ADS) 的局限性。尽管 DM 增强型 ADS 已在日本的实际应用中成功部署，但现有的 DM 系统仍然缺乏自然语言支持 (NLS) 的人机界面，这可以显著增强人与 DM 之间的交互。为了弥补这一差距，本文介绍了 VRCsim，一个旨在生成流式 VRC-CP 数据的 VRC 协同感知 (CP) 仿真框架。基于 VRCsim，我们构建了一个问题回答数据集 VRC-QA，专注于混合交通场景中的空间查询和推理。在 VRCsim 和 VRC-QA 的基础上，我们进一步提出了 Talk2DM，一个即插即用的模块，它通过 NLS 查询和常识推理能力扩展了 VRC-DM 系统。Talk2DM 构建于一种新型的链式提示 (CoP) 机制之上，该机制逐步将人定义的规则与大型语言模型 (LLM) 的常识知识相结合。在 VRC-QA 上的实验表明，Talk2DM 可以在不同的 LLM 之间无缝切换，同时保持较高的 NLS 查询准确率，展现出强大的泛化能力。虽然更大的模型往往能获得更高的准确率，但它们会造成显著的效率下降。我们的结果表明，由 Qwen3:8B、Gemma3:27B 和 GPT-oss 模型驱动的 Talk2DM 可以实现超过 93% 的 NLS 查询准确率，平均响应时间仅为 2-5 秒，表明其具有强大的实际应用潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces Talk2DM, a plug-and-play module that empowers vehicle-road-cloud dynamic maps with natural language querying and commonsense reasoning capabilities using large language models and a chain-of-prompt mechanism, achieving high accuracy and reasonable response times on a new spatial reasoning dataset, VRC-QA, built upon a new simulator, VRCsim.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Talk2DM，一个即插即用的模块，它利用大型语言模型和链式提示机制，使车路云动态地图具备自然语言查询和常识推理能力。该模块在一个新的空间推理数据集VRC-QA上实现了高精度和合理的响应时间，该数据集建立在一个新的模拟器VRCsim之上。

title: Zooming without Zooming: Region-to-Image Distillation for Fine-Grained Multimodal Perception
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at broad visual understanding but still struggle with fine-grained perception, where decisive evidence is small and easily overwhelmed by global context. Recent "Thinking-with-Images" methods alleviate this by iteratively zooming in and out regions of interest during inference, but incur high latency due to repeated tool calls and visual re-encoding. To address this, we propose Region-to-Image Distillation, which transforms zooming from an inference-time tool into a training-time primitive, thereby internalizing the benefits of agentic zooming into a single forward pass of an MLLM. In particular, we first zoom in to micro-cropped regions to let strong teacher models generate high-quality VQA data, and then distill this region-grounded supervision back to the full image. After training on such data, the smaller student model improves "single-glance" fine-grained perception without tool use. To rigorously evaluate this capability, we further present ZoomBench, a hybrid-annotated benchmark of 845 VQA data spanning six fine-grained perceptual dimensions, together with a dual-view protocol that quantifies the global--regional "zooming gap". Experiments show that our models achieve leading performance across multiple fine-grained perception benchmarks, and also improve general multimodal cognition on benchmarks such as visual reasoning and GUI agents. We further discuss when "Thinking-with-Images" is necessary versus when its gains can be distilled into a single forward pass. Our code is available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/Zooming-without-Zooming.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型(MLLMs)擅长广泛的视觉理解，但在细粒度感知方面仍存在不足，因为在这种场景下，决定性的证据很小，容易被全局上下文所淹没。 近期提出的“图像思考”方法通过在推理过程中迭代式地放大和缩小感兴趣区域来缓解这一问题，但由于重复的工具调用和视觉重编码，导致了高延迟。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了区域到图像的蒸馏方法，将放大操作从推理时工具转变为训练时原语，从而将代理式放大的优势内化到 MLLM 的单次前向传播中。 具体而言，我们首先放大到微裁剪区域，使强大的教师模型生成高质量的 VQA 数据，然后将这种以区域为基础的监督知识蒸馏回完整图像。 在使用此类数据进行训练后，较小的学生模型无需使用工具即可提高“单次浏览”的细粒度感知能力。 为了严格评估这种能力，我们进一步提出了 ZoomBench，这是一个混合标注的基准，包含 845 个 VQA 数据，涵盖六个细粒度感知维度，以及量化全局-区域“放大差距”的双视图协议。 实验表明，我们的模型在多个细粒度感知基准上取得了领先的性能，并且还在视觉推理和 GUI 代理等基准上提高了通用多模态认知能力。 我们进一步讨论了何时“图像思考”是必要的，以及何时可以将它的收益提炼成单次前向传播。 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/inclusionAI/Zooming-without-Zooming 上获取。
tldr: This paper introduces Region-to-Image Distillation, a method to train MLLMs to perform fine-grained visual understanding in a single forward pass by distilling knowledge from zoomed-in regions, and introduces a new benchmark, ZoomBench, for evaluating this capability.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了区域到图像蒸馏方法，通过从放大区域中提取知识，训练MLLM在单次前向传递中执行细粒度视觉理解，并引入了一个新的基准ZoomBench，用于评估这种能力。

title: FlowMind: Execute-Summarize for Structured Workflow Generation from LLM Reasoning
summary: LLMs can solve complex tasks through reasoning and tool use, but accurately translating these solutions into structured workflows remains challenging. We model workflows as sequences of tool use and reformulate the problem as designing a mechanism that can both solve tasks and reliably construct workflows. Prior approaches that build workflows during execution often suffer from inaccuracies due to interference between the two processes. We propose an Execute-Summarize(ES) framework that decouples task execution from workflow construction: the model first completes the task using available tools, then independently reconstructs a structured workflow from execution traces. This separation improves workflow accuracy and robustness. We introduce FlowBench and show through extensive experiments that our approach outperforms existing methods, providing a reliable paradigm for grounding free-form LLM reasoning into structured workflows.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型可以通过推理和工具使用来解决复杂的任务，但将这些解决方案准确地转化为结构化的工作流仍然具有挑战性。我们将工作流建模为工具使用序列，并将问题重新定义为设计一种机制，该机制既能解决任务，又能可靠地构建工作流。以往在执行过程中构建工作流的方法通常会由于这两个过程之间的干扰而导致不准确。我们提出了一种执行-总结（ES）框架，该框架将任务执行与工作流构建解耦：模型首先使用可用工具完成任务，然后独立地从执行轨迹中重建结构化的工作流。这种分离提高了工作流的准确性和鲁棒性。我们引入了FlowBench，并通过大量的实验表明，我们的方法优于现有的方法，为将自由形式的大型语言模型推理转化为结构化的工作流提供了一种可靠的范例。
tldr: The paper introduces FlowMind, an Execute-Summarize framework that decouples task execution and workflow construction for more accurate and robust workflow generation from LLM reasoning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了FlowMind，一个“执行-总结”框架，它将任务执行和工作流程构建分离，从而从LLM推理中生成更准确、更健壮的工作流程。

title: AmbiBench: Benchmarking Mobile GUI Agents Beyond One-Shot Instructions in the Wild
summary: Benchmarks are paramount for gauging progress in the domain of Mobile GUI Agents. In practical scenarios, users frequently fail to articulate precise directives containing full task details at the onset, and their expressions are typically ambiguous. Consequently, agents are required to converge on the user's true intent via active clarification and interaction during execution. However, existing benchmarks predominantly operate under the idealized assumption that user-issued instructions are complete and unequivocal. This paradigm focuses exclusively on assessing single-turn execution while overlooking the alignment capability of the agent. To address this limitation, we introduce AmbiBench, the first benchmark incorporating a taxonomy of instruction clarity to shift evaluation from unidirectional instruction following to bidirectional intent alignment. Grounded in Cognitive Gap theory, we propose a taxonomy of four clarity levels: Detailed, Standard, Incomplete, and Ambiguous. We construct a rigorous dataset of 240 ecologically valid tasks across 25 applications, subject to strict review protocols. Furthermore, targeting evaluation in dynamic environments, we develop MUSE (Mobile User Satisfaction Evaluator), an automated framework utilizing an MLLM-as-a-judge multi-agent architecture. MUSE performs fine-grained auditing across three dimensions: Outcome Effectiveness, Execution Quality, and Interaction Quality. Empirical results on AmbiBench reveal the performance boundaries of SoTA agents across different clarity levels, quantify the gains derived from active interaction, and validate the strong correlation between MUSE and human judgment. This work redefines evaluation standards, laying the foundation for next-generation agents capable of truly understanding user intent.
summary_zh: 基准测试对于衡量移动 GUI 代理领域的进展至关重要。在实际场景中，用户通常无法在开始时清晰地表达包含完整任务细节的精确指令，并且他们的表达通常是含糊不清的。因此，代理需要通过执行过程中的主动澄清和交互来收敛到用户的真实意图。然而，现有的基准测试主要在用户发布的指令完整明确的理想假设下运作。这种范式只关注评估单轮执行，而忽略了代理的对齐能力。为了解决这个局限性，我们引入了 AmbiBench，这是第一个包含指令清晰度分类法的基准测试，旨在将评估从单向指令跟随转变为双向意图对齐。基于认知差距理论，我们提出了一个包含四个清晰度级别的分类法：详细、标准、不完整和模糊。我们构建了一个严格的数据集，包含 25 个应用程序中 240 个生态有效的任务，并经过严格的审查协议。此外，针对动态环境中的评估，我们开发了 MUSE (移动用户满意度评估器)，这是一个利用 MLLM 即评判的多代理架构的自动化框架。MUSE 在三个维度上执行细粒度的审计：结果有效性、执行质量和交互质量。在 AmbiBench 上的经验结果揭示了 SoTA 代理在不同清晰度级别下的性能边界，量化了从主动交互中获得的收益，并验证了 MUSE 和人类判断之间的高度相关性。这项工作重新定义了评估标准，为能够真正理解用户意图的下一代代理奠定了基础。
tldr: The paper introduces AmbiBench, a new benchmark for mobile GUI agents that focuses on evaluating their ability to handle ambiguous user instructions and engage in interactive clarification, along with MUSE, an automated evaluation framework.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AmbiBench，一个新的移动GUI代理的基准测试，专注于评估它们处理模糊用户指令并进行交互式澄清的能力，以及MUSE，一个自动评估框架。

title: AIR: Improving Agent Safety through Incident Response
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in practice across a wide range of autonomous applications. Yet current safety mechanisms for LLM agents focus almost exclusively on preventing failures in advance, providing limited capabilities for responding to, containing, or recovering from incidents after they inevitably arise. In this work, we introduce AIR, the first incident response framework for LLM agent systems. AIR defines a domain-specific language for managing the incident response lifecycle autonomously in LLM agent systems, and integrates it into the agent's execution loop to (1) detect incidents via semantic checks grounded in the current environment state and recent context, (2) guide the agent to execute containment and recovery actions via its tools, and (3) synthesize guardrail rules during eradication to block similar incidents in future executions. We evaluate AIR on three representative agent types. Results show that AIR achieves detection, remediation, and eradication success rates all exceeding 90%. Extensive experiments further confirm the necessity of AIR's key design components, show the timeliness and moderate overhead of AIR, and demonstrate that LLM-generated rules can approach the effectiveness of developer-authored rules across domains. These results show that incident response is both feasible and essential as a first-class mechanism for improving agent safety.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体正日益广泛地应用于各种自主应用领域。然而，目前针对LLM智能体的安全机制几乎完全侧重于提前预防故障，对于在事故不可避免地发生后进行响应、遏制或恢复的能力有限。在这项工作中，我们提出了AIR，这是首个用于LLM智能体系统的事件响应框架。AIR定义了一种特定领域的语言，用于在LLM智能体系统中自主管理事件响应生命周期，并将其集成到智能体的执行循环中，以（1）通过基于当前环境状态和近期上下文的语义检查来检测事件，（2）指导智能体通过其工具执行遏制和恢复行动，以及（3）在根除阶段合成防护规则，以阻止未来执行中发生类似事件。我们在三种具有代表性的智能体类型上评估了AIR。结果表明，AIR在检测、补救和根除方面的成功率均超过90%。广泛的实验进一步证实了AIR关键设计组件的必要性，展示了AIR的及时性和适度开销，并表明LLM生成的规则可以接近开发者编写的规则在各个领域的效果。这些结果表明，事件响应作为一种一流机制对于提高智能体安全性是可行的，而且至关重要。
tldr: The paper introduces AIR, a framework for incident response in LLM agents, enabling detection, containment, recovery, and eradication of failures after they occur, with high success rates demonstrated across various agent types.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AIR，一个用于LLM代理中事件响应的框架，能够检测、遏制、恢复和消除故障发生后发生的错误，并在各种代理类型中展现出高成功率。

title: Beyond Pixels: Vector-to-Graph Transformation for Reliable Schematic Auditing
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown remarkable progress in visual understanding, yet they suffer from a critical limitation: structural blindness. Even state-of-the-art models fail to capture topology and symbolic logic in engineering schematics, as their pixel-driven paradigm discards the explicit vector-defined relations needed for reasoning. To overcome this, we propose a Vector-to-Graph (V2G) pipeline that converts CAD diagrams into property graphs where nodes represent components and edges encode connectivity, making structural dependencies explicit and machine-auditable. On a diagnostic benchmark of electrical compliance checks, V2G yields large accuracy gains across all error categories, while leading MLLMs remain near chance level. These results highlight the systemic inadequacy of pixel-based methods and demonstrate that structure-aware representations provide a reliable path toward practical deployment of multimodal AI in engineering domains. To facilitate further research, we release our benchmark and implementation at https://github.com/gm-embodied/V2G-Audit.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉理解方面取得了显著进展，但它们存在一个关键的局限：结构盲视。即使是最先进的模型也无法捕获工程原理图中的拓扑结构和符号逻辑，因为它们以像素驱动的范式抛弃了推理所需的明确的矢量定义关系。为了克服这一点，我们提出了一种矢量到图（V2G）的管道，该管道将CAD图转换为属性图，其中节点表示组件，边编码连接性，从而使结构依赖关系显式化且机器可审计。在一个电气合规性检查的诊断基准上，V2G在所有错误类别中都获得了显著的精度提升，而领先的MLLM仍然接近随机水平。这些结果突出了基于像素的方法的系统性不足，并表明结构感知表示法为多模态人工智能在工程领域的实际部署提供了一条可靠的途径。为了促进进一步的研究，我们发布了我们的基准和实现，网址为https://github.com/gm-embodied/V2G-Audit。
tldr: The paper introduces a Vector-to-Graph (V2G) pipeline to address the structural blindness of MLLMs in understanding engineering schematics, demonstrating significant accuracy gains in electrical compliance checks by converting CAD diagrams into property graphs.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种向量到图 (V2G) 管道，旨在解决多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 在理解工程示意图方面的结构盲点，通过将 CAD 图转换为属性图，在电气合规性检查中实现了显著的准确性提升。

title: ScalSelect: Scalable Training-Free Multimodal Data Selection for Efficient Visual Instruction Tuning
summary: Large-scale Visual Instruction Tuning (VIT) has become a key paradigm for advancing the performance of vision-language models (VLMs) across various multimodal tasks. However, training on the large-scale datasets is computationally expensive and inefficient due to redundancy in the data, which motivates the need for multimodal data selection to improve training efficiency. Existing data selection methods for VIT either require costly training or gradient computation. Training-free alternatives often depend on proxy models or datasets, instruction-agnostic representations, and pairwise similarity with quadratic complexity, limiting scalability and representation fidelity. In this work, we propose ScalSelect, a scalable training-free multimodal data selection method with linear-time complexity with respect to the number of samples, eliminating the need for external models or auxiliary datasets. ScalSelect first constructs sample representations by extracting visual features most attended by instruction tokens in the target VLM, capturing instruction-relevant information. It then identifies samples whose representations best approximate the dominant subspace of the full dataset representations, enabling scalable importance scoring without pairwise comparisons. Extensive experiments across multiple VLMs, datasets, and selection budgets demonstrate that ScalSelect achieves over 97.5% of the performance of training on the full dataset using only 16% of the data, and even outperforms full-data training in some settings. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/ChangtiWu/ScalSelect}{ScalSelect}.
summary_zh: 大规模视觉指令调优（VIT）已成为提升视觉-语言模型（VLM）在各种多模态任务中性能的关键范式。然而，由于数据的冗余性，在大规模数据集上进行训练的计算成本高昂且效率低下，这推动了对多模态数据选择的需求，以提高训练效率。现有的VIT数据选择方法要么需要昂贵的训练，要么需要梯度计算。无需训练的替代方案通常依赖于代理模型或数据集、与指令无关的表示以及具有二次复杂度的成对相似性，从而限制了可扩展性和表示保真度。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种可扩展的无需训练的多模态数据选择方法ScalSelect，它具有关于样本数量的线性时间复杂度，消除了对外部模型或辅助数据集的需求。ScalSelect首先通过提取目标VLM中指令令牌最关注的视觉特征来构建样本表示，从而捕获与指令相关的信息。然后，它识别出其表示最接近完整数据集表示的优势子空间的样本，从而实现可扩展的重要性评分，而无需进行成对比较。在多个VLM、数据集和选择预算上的大量实验表明，ScalSelect仅使用16%的数据即可达到使用完整数据集训练性能的97.5%以上，甚至在某些情况下优于完整数据训练。 代码可在\href{https://github.com/ChangtiWu/ScalSelect}{ScalSelect}获得。
tldr: The paper introduces ScalSelect, a scalable and training-free method for multimodal data selection in Visual Instruction Tuning (VIT). It efficiently selects crucial data subsets achieving comparable or better performance than training on the full dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为ScalSelect的可扩展且无需训练的多模态数据选择方法，用于视觉指令调优（VIT）。它能够高效地选择关键数据子集，达到与在完整数据集上训练相当甚至更好的性能。

title: When Agents Disagree With Themselves: Measuring Behavioral Consistency in LLM-Based Agents
summary: Run the same LLM agent on the same task twice: do you get the same behavior? We find the answer is often no. In a study of 3,000 agent runs across three models (Llama 3.1 70B, GPT-4o, and Claude Sonnet 4.5) on HotpotQA, we observe that ReAct-style agents produce 2.0--4.2 distinct action sequences per 10 runs on average, even with identical inputs. More importantly, this variance predicts failure: tasks with consistent behavior ($\leq$2 unique paths) achieve 80--92% accuracy, while highly inconsistent tasks ($\geq$6 unique paths) achieve only 25--60%, a 32--55 percentage point gap depending on model. We trace variance to early decisions: 69% of divergence occurs at step 2, the first search query. Our results suggest that monitoring behavioral consistency during execution could enable early error detection and improve agent reliability.
summary_zh: 在同一任务上运行同一个 LLM 智能体两次：你会得到相同的行为吗？我们的研究发现答案通常是否定的。在一项对 HotpotQA 上三个模型（Llama 3.1 70B、GPT-4o 和 Claude Sonnet 4.5）进行的 3000 次智能体运行的实验中，我们观察到，即使输入完全相同，ReAct 风格的智能体平均每次运行 10 次也会产生 2.0-4.2 个不同的行动序列。更重要的是，这种差异预示着失败：行为一致的任务（≤2 条唯一路径）的准确率达到 80-92%，而高度不一致的任务（≥6 条唯一路径）的准确率仅为 25-60%，具体取决于模型，差距为 32-55 个百分点。我们追溯差异的来源，发现差异主要来自早期决策：69% 的差异发生在第二步，即第一次搜索查询。我们的结果表明，在执行期间监控行为一致性可以尽早发现错误并提高智能体的可靠性。
tldr: This paper investigates the behavioral consistency of LLM agents on a task and finds that inconsistency in action sequences is a strong predictor of task failure, suggesting a method for early error detection.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了LLM智能体在任务中的行为一致性，发现动作序列的不一致性是任务失败的强预测指标，为早期错误检测提供了一种方法。

title: MAPLE: Modality-Aware Post-training and Learning Ecosystem
summary: Multimodal language models now integrate text, audio, and video for unified reasoning. Yet existing RL post-training pipelines treat all input signals as equally relevant, ignoring which modalities each task actually requires. This modality-blind training inflates policy-gradient variance, slows convergence, and degrades robustness to real-world distribution shifts where signals may be missing, added, or reweighted. We introduce MAPLE, a complete modality-aware post-training and learning ecosystem comprising: (1) MAPLE-bench, the first benchmark explicitly annotating minimal signal combinations required per task; (2) MAPO, a modality-aware policy optimization framework that stratifies batches by modality requirement to reduce gradient variance from heterogeneous group advantages; (3) Adaptive weighting and curriculum scheduling that balances and prioritizes harder signal combinations. Systematic analysis across loss aggregation, clipping, sampling, and curriculum design establishes MAPO's optimal training strategy. Adaptive weighting and curriculum focused learning further boost performance across signal combinations. MAPLE narrows uni/multi-modal accuracy gaps by 30.24%, converges 3.18x faster, and maintains stability across all modality combinations under realistic reduced signal access. MAPLE constitutes a complete recipe for deployment-ready multimodal RL post-training.
summary_zh: 多模态语言模型目前集成了文本、音频和视频，以实现统一的推理。然而，现有的强化学习后训练流程将所有输入信号视为同等重要，忽略了每个任务实际所需的模态。这种模态盲训练会增大策略梯度方差，减缓收敛速度，并降低对真实世界分布偏移的鲁棒性，在真实世界中，信号可能缺失、添加或重新加权。我们引入了MAPLE，一个完整的模态感知后训练和学习生态系统，包括：（1）MAPLE-bench，这是第一个明确标注每个任务所需最小信号组合的基准；（2）MAPO，一个模态感知策略优化框架，通过模态需求对批次进行分层，以减少来自异构组收益的梯度方差；（3）自适应权重和课程调度，平衡并优先处理更难的信号组合。对损失聚合、裁剪、采样和课程设计的系统分析确立了MAPO的最佳训练策略。自适应权重和聚焦于学习的课程进一步提升了跨信号组合的性能。MAPLE将单/多模态准确率差距缩小了30.24%，收敛速度提高了3.18倍，并在现实中减少信号访问的情况下，保持了跨所有模态组合的稳定性。MAPLE构成了一个完整的可部署多模态强化学习后训练方案。
tldr: The paper introduces MAPLE, a modality-aware RL post-training ecosystem that includes a benchmark, a policy optimization framework (MAPO), and adaptive weighting/curriculum scheduling, demonstrating improved performance and robustness in multimodal RL tasks with varying signal availability.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MAPLE，一个模态感知的强化学习后训练生态系统，包括一个基准测试、一个策略优化框架（MAPO）和自适应权重/课程安排，展示了在具有不同信号可用性的多模态强化学习任务中改进的性能和鲁棒性。

title: The Five Ws of Multi-Agent Communication: Who Talks to Whom, When, What, and Why -- A Survey from MARL to Emergent Language and LLMs
summary: Multi-agent sequential decision-making powers many real-world systems, from autonomous vehicles and robotics to collaborative AI assistants. In dynamic, partially observable environments, communication is often what reduces uncertainty and makes collaboration possible. This survey reviews multi-agent communication (MA-Comm) through the Five Ws: who communicates with whom, what is communicated, when communication occurs, and why communication is beneficial. This framing offers a clean way to connect ideas across otherwise separate research threads. We trace how communication approaches have evolved across three major paradigms. In Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), early methods used hand-designed or implicit protocols, followed by end-to-end learned communication optimized for reward and control. While successful, these protocols are frequently task-specific and hard to interpret, motivating work on Emergent Language (EL), where agents can develop more structured or symbolic communication through interaction. EL methods, however, still struggle with grounding, generalization, and scalability, which has fueled recent interest in large language models (LLMs) that bring natural language priors for reasoning, planning, and collaboration in more open-ended settings. Across MARL, EL, and LLM-based systems, we highlight how different choices shape communication design, where the main trade-offs lie, and what remains unsolved. We distill practical design patterns and open challenges to support future hybrid systems that combine learning, language, and control for scalable and interpretable multi-agent collaboration.
summary_zh: 多智能体序列决策驱动着许多现实世界的系统，从自动驾驶汽车和机器人技术到协作式AI助手。在动态、部分可观察的环境中，通信通常是减少不确定性并使协作成为可能的关键。本综述通过五个“W”来回顾多智能体通信（MA-Comm）：谁与谁通信(Who)、通信的内容(What)、通信发生的时间(When)以及为什么通信是有益的(Why)。这种框架提供了一种清晰的方式，可以将各个独立的研究思路联系起来。我们追溯了通信方法在三个主要范式中的演变历程。 在多智能体强化学习（MARL）中，早期方法使用手工设计或隐式协议，随后是为奖励和控制而优化的端到端学习得到的通信。 虽然这些方法取得了成功，但这些协议通常是特定于任务的并且难以解释，这促使了涌现语言（EL）的研究，在该领域中，智能体可以通过交互来发展更结构化或符号化的通信。 然而，EL方法仍然在语义扎根、泛化和可扩展性方面存在困难，这推动了最近对大型语言模型（LLMs）的兴趣，这些模型将自然语言先验知识带入更开放环境中的推理、规划和协作中。 在MARL、EL和基于LLM的系统中，我们强调了不同的选择如何塑造通信设计、主要的权衡取舍以及仍然未解决的问题。 我们提炼出实用的设计模式和开放的挑战，以支持未来的混合系统，这些系统将学习、语言和控制相结合，以实现可扩展和可解释的多智能体协作。
tldr: This survey paper reviews multi-agent communication through the lens of the 'Five Ws' (Who, What, When, Why), tracing its evolution across MARL, Emergent Language, and LLM-based systems, and highlighting design trade-offs and open challenges.
tldr_zh: 这篇综述论文从“五个W”（谁、什么、何时、为什么）的角度回顾了多智能体通信，追溯了它在MARL、Emergent Language和基于LLM的系统中的演变，并强调了设计权衡和未解决的挑战。

title: Budget-Constrained Agentic Large Language Models: Intention-Based Planning for Costly Tool Use
summary: We study budget-constrained tool-augmented agents, where a large language model must solve multi-step tasks by invoking external tools under a strict monetary budget. We formalize this setting as sequential decision making in context space with priced and stochastic tool executions, making direct planning intractable due to massive state-action spaces, high variance of outcomes and prohibitive exploration cost. To address these challenges, we propose INTENT, an inference-time planning framework that leverages an intention-aware hierarchical world model to anticipate future tool usage, risk-calibrated cost, and guide decisions online. Across cost-augmented StableToolBench, INTENT strictly enforces hard budget feasibility while substantially improving task success over baselines, and remains robust under dynamic market shifts such as tool price changes and varying budgets.
summary_zh: 我们研究了预算约束的工具增强型智能体，其中大型语言模型必须通过在严格的资金预算下调用外部工具来解决多步骤任务。我们将此设定形式化为上下文空间中的序列决策，其中工具执行的价格是确定的且具有随机性，这使得直接规划由于巨大的状态-动作空间、结果的高度方差和过高的探索成本而变得难以处理。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出 INTENT，一种推理时规划框架，它利用具有意图感知的分层世界模型来预测未来的工具使用、经过风险校准的成本，并在线指导决策。在成本增强的 StableToolBench 上，INTENT 严格执行硬预算可行性，同时大幅提高了任务成功率，并且在工具价格变化和预算变化等动态市场变化下保持稳健性。
tldr: The paper introduces INTENT, a planning framework for budget-constrained LLM agents that use external tools by employing a hierarchical world model to anticipate costs and guide decisions, demonstrating improved task success and robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为INTENT的规划框架，用于在预算约束下使用外部工具的LLM智能体。该框架通过使用分层世界模型来预测成本并指导决策，从而提高了任务成功率和鲁棒性。

title: Adaptive Milestone Reward for GUI Agents
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a mainstream paradigm for training Mobile GUI Agents, yet it struggles with the temporal credit assignment problem inherent in long-horizon tasks. A primary challenge lies in the trade-off between reward fidelity and density: outcome reward offers high fidelity but suffers from signal sparsity, while process reward provides dense supervision but remains prone to bias and reward hacking. To resolve this conflict, we propose the Adaptive Milestone Reward (ADMIRE) mechanism. ADMIRE constructs a verifiable, adaptive reward system by anchoring trajectory to milestones, which are dynamically distilled from successful explorations. Crucially, ADMIRE integrates an asymmetric credit assignment strategy that denoises successful trajectories and scaffolds failed trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ADMIRE consistently yields over 10% absolute improvement in success rate across different base models on AndroidWorld. Moreover, the method exhibits robust generalizability, achieving strong performance across diverse RL algorithms and heterogeneous environments such as web navigation and embodied tasks.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）已经成为训练移动GUI Agent的主流范式，但它在长时程任务中难以处理固有的时间信用分配问题。一个主要的挑战在于奖励忠实度和密度之间的权衡：结果奖励提供高忠实度，但存在信号稀疏问题，而过程奖励提供密集监督，但仍然容易产生偏差和奖励操纵。为了解决这一冲突，我们提出了自适应里程碑奖励（ADMIRE）机制。ADMIRE通过将轨迹锚定到里程碑来构建可验证的自适应奖励系统，这些里程碑是从成功的探索中动态提炼出来的。至关重要的是，ADMIRE集成了一种非对称信用分配策略，该策略对成功的轨迹进行去噪，并为失败的轨迹提供支架。大量实验表明，ADMIRE在AndroidWorld上的不同基准模型上，成功率始终能带来超过10%的绝对提升。此外，该方法表现出强大的泛化能力，在不同的RL算法和异构环境中（例如Web导航和具身任务）都取得了良好的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces Adaptive Milestone Reward (ADMIRE), a novel reinforcement learning method that uses dynamically distilled milestones and asymmetric credit assignment to improve long-horizon GUI agent performance, showing significant gains in AndroidWorld and generalization to other environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为自适应里程碑奖励（ADMIRE）的新型强化学习方法，该方法利用动态提取的里程碑和不对称的信用分配来提高长时程GUI代理的性能，并在AndroidWorld中显示出显著的改进，并推广到其他环境。

title: Credit Where It is Due: Cross-Modality Connectivity Drives Precise Reinforcement Learning for MLLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced the reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), yet how visual evidence is integrated during reasoning remains poorly understood. We explore multimodal RLVR through the lens of cross-modal attention connectivity and find that only a small fraction of tokens (approximately 15%) exhibit strong visual-textual coupling. These high-connectivity tokens act as anchors that ground reasoning in the image, while the majority follow linguistic patterns. During RLVR training, credit assignment naturally concentrates on these anchors, sharpening their visual grounding over time. Building on this insight, we propose Anchor-Token Reinforcement Learning (AT-RL), a lightweight framework that selectively reinforces high-connectivity tokens via graph-based clustering of attention topology. Evaluated across the series (3B-32B), AT-RL introduces only 1.2% overhead yet enables the 32B model to surpass the 72B-Instruct baseline on MathVista (80.2), with consistent gains observed across STEM, video and general tasks. Conversely, training solely on low-connectivity tokens causes severe degradation, confirming that effective multimodal RL hinges on precise credit assignment to visual anchors. Our work reveals that reasoning quality is governed not by token quantity but by the fidelity of cross-modal anchoring.
summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）显著提升了多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）的推理能力，然而，视觉证据如何在推理过程中整合仍不甚明了。我们通过跨模态注意力连通性的视角探索多模态RLVR，发现只有一小部分token（约15%）表现出强烈的视觉-文本耦合。这些高连通性的token充当锚点，将推理锚定在图像中，而大多数token遵循语言模式。在RLVR训练期间，信用分配自然集中在这些锚点上，随着时间的推移，增强了它们的视觉基础。基于这一洞察，我们提出了锚定Token强化学习（AT-RL），这是一个轻量级框架，通过基于图的注意力拓扑聚类选择性地强化高连通性token。经过对一系列模型（3B-32B）的评估，AT-RL仅引入1.2%的开销，却使得32B模型在MathVista上超越了72B-Instruct基线（80.2），并在STEM、视频和通用任务中观察到一致的收益。相反，仅对低连通性token进行训练会导致严重的性能下降，证实了有效的多模态强化学习依赖于对视觉锚点的精确信用分配。我们的工作表明，推理质量并非由token数量决定，而是由跨模态锚定的保真度决定。
tldr: This paper identifies and leverages high cross-modal connectivity tokens in MLLMs for more efficient and effective reinforcement learning, achieving significant performance gains with minimal overhead.
tldr_zh: 该论文发现并利用MLLM中高跨模态连接的tokens，以实现更高效和有效的强化学习，并以最小的开销实现了显著的性能提升。

title: Causal-JEPA: Learning World Models through Object-Level Latent Interventions
summary: World models require robust relational understanding to support prediction, reasoning, and control. While object-centric representations provide a useful abstraction, they are not sufficient to capture interaction-dependent dynamics. We therefore propose C-JEPA, a simple and flexible object-centric world model that extends masked joint embedding prediction from image patches to object-centric representations. By applying object-level masking that requires an object's state to be inferred from other objects, C-JEPA induces latent interventions with counterfactual-like effects and prevents shortcut solutions, making interaction reasoning essential. Empirically, C-JEPA leads to consistent gains in visual question answering, with an absolute improvement of about 20\% in counterfactual reasoning compared to the same architecture without object-level masking. On agent control tasks, C-JEPA enables substantially more efficient planning by using only 1\% of the total latent input features required by patch-based world models, while achieving comparable performance. Finally, we provide a formal analysis demonstrating that object-level masking induces a causal inductive bias via latent interventions. Our code is available at https://github.com/galilai-group/cjepa.
summary_zh: 世界模型需要稳健的关系理解来支持预测、推理和控制。虽然以对象为中心的表征提供了一种有用的抽象，但它们不足以捕捉依赖于交互的动态。因此，我们提出了C-JEPA，一种简单而灵活的以对象为中心的世界模型，它将掩码联合嵌入预测从图像块扩展到以对象为中心的表征。通过应用对象级别的掩码，要求从其他对象推断一个对象的状态，C-JEPA诱导具有反事实效应的潜在干预，并防止捷径解决方案，使得交互推理至关重要。在经验上，C-JEPA在视觉问答中带来了持续的收益，与没有对象级别掩码的相同架构相比，在反事实推理方面取得了大约20%的绝对改进。在智能体控制任务中，C-JEPA通过仅使用基于图像块的世界模型所需总潜在输入特征的1%来实现更高效的规划，同时获得可比较的性能。最后，我们提供了一个正式的分析，证明了对象级别的掩码通过潜在干预诱导了一种因果归纳偏置。我们的代码可在https://github.com/galilai-group/cjepa 上找到。
tldr: C-JEPA, a new object-centric world model, uses object-level masking to encourage interaction reasoning, leading to improvements in visual question answering and agent control with better efficiency.
tldr_zh: C-JEPA是一种新的以对象为中心的世界模型，它利用对象级别的掩蔽来促进交互推理, 从而在视觉问答和智能体控制方面获得了改进，并提高了效率。

title: Pushing Forward Pareto Frontiers of Proactive Agents with Behavioral Agentic Optimization
summary: Proactive large language model (LLM) agents aim to actively plan, query, and interact over multiple turns, enabling efficient task completion beyond passive instruction following and making them essential for real-world, user-centric applications. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has recently emerged as a promising solution for training such agents in multi-turn settings, allowing interaction strategies to be learned from feedback. However, existing pipelines face a critical challenge in balancing task performance with user engagement, as passive agents can not efficiently adapt to users' intentions while overuse of human feedback reduces their satisfaction. To address this trade-off, we propose BAO, an agentic RL framework that combines behavior enhancement to enrich proactive reasoning and information-gathering capabilities with behavior regularization to suppress inefficient or redundant interactions and align agent behavior with user expectations. We evaluate BAO on multiple tasks from the UserRL benchmark suite, and demonstrate that it substantially outperforms proactive agentic RL baselines while achieving comparable or even superior performance to commercial LLM agents, highlighting its effectiveness for training proactive, user-aligned LLM agents in complex multi-turn scenarios. Our website: https://proactive-agentic-rl.github.io/.
summary_zh: 主动大型语言模型 (LLM) 智能体旨在主动规划、查询和进行多轮交互，从而实现超越被动指令执行的高效任务完成，使其对以用户为中心的实际应用至关重要。智能体强化学习 (RL) 近期已成为一种有前景的解决方案，用于在多轮环境中训练此类智能体，从而允许交互策略从反馈中学习。然而，现有的流程面临着在任务性能和用户参与度之间取得平衡的关键挑战，因为被动智能体无法有效地适应用户的意图，而过度使用人工反馈会降低他们的满意度。为了解决这种权衡，我们提出了一种智能体 RL 框架 BAO，该框架结合了行为增强以丰富主动推理和信息收集能力，以及行为正则化以抑制低效或冗余的交互并使智能体的行为与用户的期望保持一致。我们在 UserRL 基准测试套件中的多个任务上评估了 BAO，并证明它大幅优于主动智能体 RL 基线，同时实现了与商业 LLM 智能体相当甚至更优越的性能，突显了其在复杂多轮场景中训练主动、用户对齐 LLM 智能体的有效性。我们的网站：https://proactive-agentic-rl.github.io/。
tldr: This paper introduces BAO, an agentic RL framework that balances task performance and user engagement for proactive LLM agents by combining behavior enhancement and regularization. It shows improved performance compared to other RL and commercial LLM agent baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为BAO的智能体强化学习框架，该框架通过结合行为增强和正则化，平衡了主动LLM智能体的任务性能和用户参与度。结果表明，相较于其他RL和商业LLM智能体基线，其性能有所提高。

title: AgentNoiseBench: Benchmarking Robustness of Tool-Using LLM Agents Under Noisy Condition
summary: Recent advances in large language models have enabled LLM-based agents to achieve strong performance on a variety of benchmarks. However, their performance in real-world deployments often that observed on benchmark settings, especially in complex and imperfect environments. This discrepancy largely arises because prevailing training and evaluation paradigms are typically built on idealized assumptions, overlooking the inherent stochasticity and noise present in real-world interactions.
