To bridge this gap, we introduce AgentNoiseBench, a framework for systematically evaluating the robustness of agentic models under noisy environments. We first conduct an in-depth analysis of biases and uncertainties in real-world scenarios and categorize environmental noise into two primary types: user-noise and tool-noise. Building on this analysis, we develop an automated pipeline that injects controllable noise into existing agent-centric benchmarks while preserving task solvability. Leveraging this pipeline, we perform extensive evaluations across a wide range of models with diverse architectures and parameter scales. Our results reveal consistent performance variations under different noise conditions, highlighting the sensitivity of current agentic models to realistic environmental perturbations.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型近期的进展使得基于大语言模型的智能体在各种基准测试中取得了优异的表现。然而，它们在现实世界部署中的表现通常低于在基准测试环境中所观察到的水平，尤其是在复杂和不完善的环境中。这种差异很大程度上源于当前主流的训练和评估范例通常基于理想化的假设，忽略了现实世界交互中固有的随机性和噪声。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了AgentNoiseBench，这是一个系统性地评估智能体模型在噪声环境下鲁棒性的框架。我们首先对现实场景中的偏差和不确定性进行了深入分析，并将环境噪声分为两种主要类型：用户噪声和工具噪声。基于这一分析，我们开发了一个自动化的管道，可以将可控噪声注入到现有的以智能体为中心的基准测试中，同时保持任务的可解性。利用该管道，我们对各种架构和参数规模的模型进行了广泛的评估。我们的结果表明，在不同的噪声条件下，性能存在持续的变化，突显了当前智能体模型对现实环境扰动的敏感性。
tldr: The paper introduces AgentNoiseBench, a framework to benchmark the robustness of tool-using LLM agents under noisy conditions by injecting controllable noise into existing benchmarks. The results show current agents are sensitive to realistic environmental perturbations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AgentNoiseBench，一个用于评估工具型LLM智能体在噪声条件下鲁棒性的框架，通过向现有基准测试注入可控噪声。结果表明，当前的智能体对现实环境中的扰动非常敏感。

title: Beyond VLM-Based Rewards: Diffusion-Native Latent Reward Modeling
summary: Preference optimization for diffusion and flow-matching models relies on reward functions that are both discriminatively robust and computationally efficient. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have emerged as the primary reward provider, leveraging their rich multimodal priors to guide alignment. However, their computation and memory cost can be substantial, and optimizing a latent diffusion generator through a pixel-space reward introduces a domain mismatch that complicates alignment. In this paper, we propose DiNa-LRM, a diffusion-native latent reward model that formulates preference learning directly on noisy diffusion states. Our method introduces a noise-calibrated Thurstone likelihood with diffusion-noise-dependent uncertainty. DiNa-LRM leverages a pretrained latent diffusion backbone with a timestep-conditioned reward head, and supports inference-time noise ensembling, providing a diffusion-native mechanism for test-time scaling and robust rewarding. Across image alignment benchmarks, DiNa-LRM substantially outperforms existing diffusion-based reward baselines and achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art VLMs at a fraction of the computational cost. In preference optimization, we demonstrate that DiNa-LRM improves preference optimization dynamics, enabling faster and more resource-efficient model alignment.
summary_zh: 扩散模型和流匹配模型的偏好优化依赖于具有判别鲁棒性和计算效率的奖励函数。视觉-语言模型（VLMs）已成为主要的奖励提供者，利用其丰富的多模态先验来指导对齐。然而，它们的计算和内存成本可能相当高昂，并且通过像素空间的奖励优化一个潜在扩散生成器引入了域不匹配，这使得对齐变得复杂。在本文中，我们提出了 DiNa-LRM，一种扩散原生潜在奖励模型，它直接在噪声扩散状态上制定偏好学习。我们的方法引入了一种噪声校准的 Thurstone 似然，其中包含扩散噪声相关的置信度。DiNa-LRM 利用预训练的潜在扩散主干网络和一个时间步条件奖励头，并支持推理时噪声集成，从而为测试时缩放和稳健奖励提供了一种扩散原生机制。在图像对齐基准测试中，DiNa-LRM 显著优于现有的基于扩散的奖励基线，并且以极低的计算成本实现了与最先进的 VLM 相当的性能。在偏好优化方面，我们证明 DiNa-LRM 改善了偏好优化动态，从而实现了更快、资源效率更高的模型对齐。
tldr: The paper introduces DiNa-LRM, a diffusion-native reward model that operates in the latent space of diffusion models, improving efficiency and performance compared to VLM-based rewards in preference optimization for image alignment.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为DiNa-LRM的扩散原生奖励模型，该模型在扩散模型的潜在空间中运行，与基于VLM的奖励相比，提高了图像对齐偏好优化中的效率和性能。

title: FormalJudge: A Neuro-Symbolic Paradigm for Agentic Oversight
summary: As LLM-based agents increasingly operate in high-stakes domains with real-world consequences, ensuring their behavioral safety becomes paramount. The dominant oversight paradigm, LLM-as-a-Judge, faces a fundamental dilemma: how can probabilistic systems reliably supervise other probabilistic systems without inheriting their failure modes? We argue that formal verification offers a principled escape from this dilemma, yet its adoption has been hindered by a critical bottleneck: the translation from natural language requirements to formal specifications. This paper bridges this gap by proposing , a neuro-symbolic framework that employs a bidirectional Formal-of-Thought architecture: LLMs serve as specification compilers that top-down decompose high-level human intent into atomic, verifiable constraints, then bottom-up prove compliance using Dafny specifications and Z3 Satisfiability modulo theories solving, which produces mathematical guarantees rather than probabilistic scores. We validate across three benchmarks spanning behavioral safety, multi-domain constraint adherence, and agentic upward deception detection. Experiments on 7 agent models demonstrate that achieves an average improvement of 16.6% over LLM-as-a-Judge baselines, enables weak-to-strong generalization where a 7B judge achieves over 90% accuracy detecting deception from 72B agents, and provides near-linear safety improvement through iterative refinement.
summary_zh: 随着基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体越来越多地在高风险、具有现实世界后果的领域中运行，确保其行为安全性变得至关重要。目前主流的监督范式，即“LLM-即-法官”，面临一个根本性的困境：概率系统如何在不继承其自身失效模式的情况下，可靠地监督其他概率系统？我们认为，形式化验证提供了一种摆脱这种困境的原则性方法，但其应用受到一个关键瓶颈的阻碍：从自然语言需求到形式化规范的转换。本文通过提出，一个神经符号框架，来弥合这一差距。采用双向思维链架构：LLM充当规范编译器，自上而下地将高层人类意图分解为原子性的、可验证的约束，然后自下而上地使用Dafny规范和Z3可满足性模理论（SMT）求解来证明合规性，从而产生数学保证而非概率分数。我们在涵盖行为安全、多域约束遵守以及智能体向上欺骗检测的三个基准测试中进行了验证。针对7个智能体模型的实验表明，相比“LLM-即-法官”基线，平均提高了16.6%，实现了弱到强的泛化，即一个7B的法官能够以超过90%的准确率检测来自72B智能体的欺骗行为，并通过迭代精化实现了近乎线性的安全提升。
tldr: The paper introduces FormalJudge, a neuro-symbolic framework that uses formal verification (Dafny, Z3) to improve the behavioral safety and reliability of LLM-based agents, achieving better performance than LLM-as-a-Judge baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍FormalJudge，一个神经符号框架，使用形式化验证（Dafny, Z3）来提高基于LLM的代理的行为安全性和可靠性，并实现了比LLM-as-a-Judge基线更好的性能。

title: Learning to Compose for Cross-domain Agentic Workflow Generation
summary: Automatically generating agentic workflows -- executable operator graphs or codes that orchestrate reasoning, verification, and repair -- has become a practical way to solve complex tasks beyond what single-pass LLM generation can reliably handle. Yet what constitutes a good workflow depends heavily on the task distribution and the available operators. Under domain shift, current systems typically rely on iterative workflow refinement to discover a feasible workflow from a large workflow space, incurring high iteration costs and yielding unstable, domain-specific behavior. In response, we internalize a decompose-recompose-decide mechanism into an open-source LLM for cross-domain workflow generation. To decompose, we learn a compact set of reusable workflow capabilities across diverse domains. To recompose, we map each input task to a sparse composition over these bases to generate a task-specific workflow in a single pass. To decide, we attribute the success or failure of workflow generation to counterfactual contributions from learned capabilities, thereby capturing which capabilities actually drive success by their marginal effects. Across stringent multi-domain, cross-domain, and unseen-domain evaluations, our 1-pass generator surpasses SOTA refinement baselines that consume 20 iterations, while substantially reducing generation latency and cost.
summary_zh: 自动生成具有自主行动性的工作流（即编排推理、验证和修复的可执行算子图或代码）已经成为解决复杂任务的实用方法，这些任务超出了单次LLM生成能够可靠处理的范围。然而，什么构成一个好的工作流在很大程度上取决于任务分布和可用的算子。在领域迁移下，目前的系统通常依赖于迭代式工作流优化，以从庞大的工作流空间中发现一个可行的工作流，这导致了高迭代成本，并产生不稳定的、特定领域的行为。为了解决这个问题，我们将分解-重组-决策机制内置到一个开源LLM中，用于跨领域工作流生成。为了分解，我们学习了一组紧凑且可重用的、跨越不同领域的工作流能力。为了重组，我们将每个输入任务映射到这些基础能力的稀疏组合，从而单次生成一个特定于任务的工作流。为了决策，我们将工作流生成成功或失败归因于学习到的能力的逆事实贡献，从而通过它们的边际效应来捕获哪些能力实际上驱动了成功。在严格的多领域、跨领域和未见领域评估中，我们的单次生成器超越了消耗20次迭代的SOTA优化基线，同时显著降低了生成延迟和成本。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for generating agentic workflows that can generalize across different domains, using a decompose-recompose-decide mechanism to improve efficiency and reduce iteration costs compared to current state-of-the-art refinement-based approaches.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种生成代理工作流的方法，该方法可以通过分解-重组-决策机制跨不同领域泛化，与当前最先进的基于改进的方法相比，提高了效率并降低了迭代成本。

title: Can Local Vision-Language Models improve Activity Recognition over Vision Transformers? -- Case Study on Newborn Resuscitation
summary: Accurate documentation of newborn resuscitation is essential for quality improvement and adherence to clinical guidelines, yet remains underutilized in practice. Previous work using 3D-CNNs and Vision Transformers (ViT) has shown promising results in detecting key activities from newborn resuscitation videos, but also highlighted the challenges in recognizing such fine-grained activities. This work investigates the potential of generative AI (GenAI) methods to improve activity recognition from such videos. Specifically, we explore the use of local vision-language models (VLMs), combined with large language models (LLMs), and compare them to a supervised TimeSFormer baseline. Using a simulated dataset comprising 13.26 hours of newborn resuscitation videos, we evaluate several zero-shot VLM-based strategies and fine-tuned VLMs with classification heads, including Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). Our results suggest that small (local) VLMs struggle with hallucinations, but when fine-tuned with LoRA, the results reach F1 score at 0.91, surpassing the TimeSformer results of 0.70.
summary_zh: 新生儿复苏过程的准确记录对于质量改进和临床指南的遵循至关重要，但在实践中仍然未得到充分利用。先前使用3D-CNN和视觉Transformer（ViT）的工作在检测新生儿复苏视频中的关键活动方面已显示出前景，但也突出了识别此类细粒度活动的挑战。本研究探讨了生成式人工智能（GenAI）方法在提高此类视频活动识别方面的潜力。具体而言，我们探索了局部视觉-语言模型（VLM）与大型语言模型（LLM）的结合使用，并将它们与监督学习的TimeSFormer基线进行比较。我们使用包含13.26小时新生儿复苏视频的模拟数据集，评估了几种基于零样本VLM的策略以及带有分类头的微调VLM，包括低秩自适应（LoRA）。我们的结果表明，小型（局部）VLM存在幻觉问题，但当使用LoRA进行微调时，结果的F1分数达到0.91，超过了TimeSformer的结果0.70。
tldr: This paper explores the use of local vision-language models (VLMs) for newborn resuscitation activity recognition, finding that fine-tuned VLMs outperform TimeSformer baselines on a simulated dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文探索了局部视觉-语言模型（VLM）在新生儿复苏活动识别中的应用，发现经过微调的VLM在模拟数据集上的表现优于TimeSformer基线。

title: Code2Worlds: Empowering Coding LLMs for 4D World Generation
summary: Achieving spatial intelligence requires moving beyond visual plausibility to build world simulators grounded in physical laws. While coding LLMs have advanced static 3D scene generation, extending this paradigm to 4D dynamics remains a critical frontier. This task presents two fundamental challenges: multi-scale context entanglement, where monolithic generation fails to balance local object structures with global environmental layouts; and a semantic-physical execution gap, where open-loop code generation leads to physical hallucinations lacking dynamic fidelity. We introduce Code2Worlds, a framework that formulates 4D generation as language-to-simulation code generation. First, we propose a dual-stream architecture that disentangles retrieval-augmented object generation from hierarchical environmental orchestration. Second, to ensure dynamic fidelity, we establish a physics-aware closed-loop mechanism in which a PostProcess Agent scripts dynamics, coupled with a VLM-Motion Critic that performs self-reflection to iteratively refine simulation code. Evaluations on the Code4D benchmark show Code2Worlds outperforms baselines with a 41% SGS gain and 49% higher Richness, while uniquely generating physics-aware dynamics absent in prior static methods. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/Code2Worlds. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/Code2Worlds.
summary_zh: 实现空间智能需要超越视觉合理性，构建基于物理定律的世界模拟器。尽管编码大语言模型在静态3D场景生成方面取得了进展，但将这种范式扩展到4D动态仍然是一个关键前沿。这项任务提出了两个根本性挑战：多尺度上下文纠缠，其中单体生成无法平衡局部对象结构与全局环境布局；以及语义-物理执行鸿沟，其中开环代码生成导致缺乏动态保真度的物理幻觉。我们引入了Code2Worlds，一个将4D生成形式化为语言到模拟代码生成的框架。首先，我们提出了一种双流架构，将检索增强的对象生成与分层环境编排分离。其次，为了确保动态保真度，我们建立了一个物理感知闭环机制，其中一个后处理代理编写动力学脚本，并结合一个VLM-运动评论家执行自我反思以迭代地细化模拟代码。在Code4D基准上的评估表明，Code2Worlds优于基线，SGS增益高达41%，丰富度提高了49%，同时独特地生成了现有静态方法中不存在的物理感知动态。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/Code2Worlds。网站：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/Code2Worlds。
tldr: The paper introduces Code2Worlds, a framework that uses coding LLMs to generate physically plausible 4D dynamic scenes via a dual-stream architecture and a physics-aware closed-loop refinement mechanism.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Code2Worlds，一个使用编码 LLM 通过双流架构和物理感知闭环细化机制来生成物理上合理的 4D 动态场景的框架。

title: What if Agents Could Imagine? Reinforcing Open-Vocabulary HOI Comprehension through Generation
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models have shown promising capabilities in bridging visual and textual reasoning, yet their reasoning capabilities in Open-Vocabulary Human-Object Interaction (OV-HOI) are limited by cross-modal hallucinations and occlusion-induced ambiguity. To address this, we propose \textbf{ImagineAgent}, an agentic framework that harmonizes cognitive reasoning with generative imagination for robust visual understanding. Specifically, our method innovatively constructs cognitive maps that explicitly model plausible relationships between detected entities and candidate actions. Subsequently, it dynamically invokes tools including retrieval augmentation, image cropping, and diffusion models to gather domain-specific knowledge and enriched visual evidence, thereby achieving cross-modal alignment in ambiguous scenarios. Moreover, we propose a composite reward that balances prediction accuracy and tool efficiency. Evaluations on SWIG-HOI and HICO-DET datasets demonstrate our SOTA performance, requiring approximately 20\% of training data compared to existing methods, validating our robustness and efficiency.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型在桥接视觉和文本推理方面展现出令人鼓舞的能力，但它们在开放词汇人类-物体交互(OV-HOI)中的推理能力受到跨模态幻觉和遮挡引起的歧义性的限制。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 \textbf{ImagineAgent}，一个代理框架，它协调认知推理和生成想象，以实现稳健的视觉理解。具体而言，我们的方法创新性地构建了认知地图，该地图显式地建模了检测到的实体与候选动作之间可能的关系。随后，它动态地调用包括检索增强、图像裁剪和扩散模型在内的工具，以收集特定领域的知识和丰富的视觉证据，从而在模糊场景中实现跨模态对齐。此外，我们提出了一种复合奖励，以平衡预测准确性和工具效率。 在SWIG-HOI和HICO-DET数据集上的评估表明我们实现了SOTA性能，与现有方法相比，只需要约20\%的训练数据，验证了我们的鲁棒性和效率。
tldr: The paper introduces ImagineAgent, a framework that uses cognitive maps and generative tools to improve multimodal large language model reasoning for open-vocabulary human-object interaction, achieving SOTA performance with less training data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 ImagineAgent，一个使用认知地图和生成工具来提升多模态大型语言模型在开放词汇人类-物体交互方面推理能力的框架，以更少的数据实现了 SOTA 性能。

title: PhyCritic: Multimodal Critic Models for Physical AI
summary: With the rapid development of large multimodal models, reliable judge and critic models have become essential for open-ended evaluation and preference alignment, providing pairwise preferences, numerical scores, and explanatory justifications for assessing model-generated responses. However, existing critics are primarily trained in general visual domains such as captioning or image question answering, leaving physical AI tasks involving perception, causal reasoning, and planning largely underexplored. We introduce PhyCritic, a multimodal critic model optimized for physical AI through a two-stage RLVR pipeline: a physical skill warmup stage that enhances physically oriented perception and reasoning, followed by self-referential critic finetuning, where the critic generates its own prediction as an internal reference before judging candidate responses, improving judgment stability and physical correctness. Across both physical and general-purpose multimodal judge benchmarks, PhyCritic achieves strong performance gains over open-source baselines and, when applied as a policy model, further improves perception and reasoning in physically grounded tasks.
summary_zh: 随着大型多模态模型的飞速发展，可靠的评判模型和评论模型对于开放式评估和偏好对齐变得至关重要，它们为评估模型生成的回应提供成对偏好、数值评分和解释性理由。然而，现有的评论模型主要在一般的视觉领域进行训练，例如图像描述或图像问答，使得涉及感知、因果推理和规划的物理人工智能任务在很大程度上未被探索。我们引入了PhyCritic，一种针对物理人工智能优化的多模态评论模型，通过两阶段的RLVR流程实现：一个物理技能预热阶段，增强面向物理的感知和推理能力；随后是自指式的评论微调，评论模型在评判候选回应之前，首先生成其自身的预测作为内部参考，从而提高评判的稳定性和物理正确性。在物理和通用多模态评判基准测试中，PhyCritic相较于开源基线取得了显著的性能提升，并且当应用于策略模型时，进一步提升了物理具身任务中的感知和推理能力。
tldr: PhyCritic is a multimodal critic model tailored for physical AI tasks, trained using a two-stage RLVR pipeline, demonstrating performance gains in both physical and general domains.
tldr_zh: PhyCritic是一个为物理人工智能任务定制的多模态评论模型，通过一个两阶段的RLVR流程进行训练，在物理和通用领域都表现出性能提升。

title: Geometry of Uncertainty: Learning Metric Spaces for Multimodal State Estimation in RL
summary: Estimating the state of an environment from high-dimensional, multimodal, and noisy observations is a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning (RL). Traditional approaches rely on probabilistic models to account for the uncertainty, but often require explicit noise assumptions, in turn limiting generalization. In this work, we contribute a novel method to learn a structured latent representation, in which distances between states directly correlate with the minimum number of actions required to transition between them. The proposed metric space formulation provides a geometric interpretation of uncertainty without the need for explicit probabilistic modeling. To achieve this, we introduce a multimodal latent transition model and a sensor fusion mechanism based on inverse distance weighting, allowing for the adaptive integration of multiple sensor modalities without prior knowledge of noise distributions. We empirically validate the approach on a range of multimodal RL tasks, demonstrating improved robustness to sensor noise and superior state estimation compared to baseline methods. Our experiments show enhanced performance of an RL agent via the learned representation, eliminating the need of explicit noise augmentation. The presented results suggest that leveraging transition-aware metric spaces provides a principled and scalable solution for robust state estimation in sequential decision-making.
summary_zh: 从高维、多模态和噪声观测中估计环境状态是强化学习（RL）中的一个根本挑战。传统方法依赖概率模型来处理不确定性，但通常需要显式的噪声假设，反过来限制了泛化能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的方法来学习结构化的潜在表示，其中状态之间的距离直接与状态间转换所需的最少动作次数相关。所提出的度量空间公式提供了不确定性的几何解释，而无需显式的概率建模。为了实现这一点，我们引入了一种多模态潜在转换模型和一个基于反距离加权的传感器融合机制，允许自适应地整合多种传感器模态，而无需预先了解噪声分布。我们在一系列多模态RL任务上进行了实证验证，证明了该方法在传感器噪声方面的改进的鲁棒性，并且与基准方法相比具有更优越的状态估计能力。我们的实验表明，通过学习到的表示，强化学习智能体的性能得到了提升，消除了对显式噪声增强的需求。提出的结果表明，利用转换感知度量空间为顺序决策中的鲁棒状态估计提供了一种有原则且可扩展的解决方案。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel method for learning a metric space representation for state estimation in RL, where state distances correlate with transition costs, improving robustness to sensor noise and eliminating the need for explicit noise augmentation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的方法，用于在强化学习中学习状态估计的度量空间表示，其中状态距离与转换成本相关，从而提高了对传感器噪声的鲁棒性，并消除了对显式噪声增强的需求。

title: From Path Signatures to Sequential Modeling: Incremental Signature Contributions for Offline RL
summary: Path signatures embed trajectories into tensor algebra and constitute a universal, non-parametric representation of paths; however, in the standard form, they collapse temporal structure into a single global object, which limits their suitability for decision-making problems that require step-wise reactivity. We propose the Incremental Signature Contribution (ISC) method, which decomposes truncated path signatures into a temporally ordered sequence of elements in the tensor-algebra space, corresponding to incremental contributions induced by last path increments. This reconstruction preserves the algebraic structure and expressivity of signatures, while making their internal temporal evolution explicit, enabling processing signature-based representations via sequential modeling approaches. In contrast to full signatures, ISC is inherently sensitive to instantaneous trajectory updates, which is critical for sensitive and stability-requiring control dynamics. Building on this representation, we introduce ISC-Transformer (ISCT), an offline reinforcement learning model that integrates ISC into a standard Transformer architecture without further architectural modification. We evaluate ISCT on HalfCheetah, Walker2d, Hopper, and Maze2d, including settings with delayed rewards and downgraded datasets. The results demonstrate that ISC method provides a theoretically grounded and practically effective alternative to path processing for temporally sensitive control tasks.
summary_zh: 路径签名将轨迹嵌入到张量代数中，构成了一种通用的非参数路径表示；然而，在标准形式下，它们将时间结构折叠成单个全局对象，这限制了它们在需要逐步反应的决策问题中的适用性。我们提出增量签名贡献（ISC）方法，该方法将截断的路径签名分解为张量代数空间中按时间排序的元素序列，对应于由最后路径增量引起的增量贡献。这种重构保留了签名的代数结构和表达能力，同时使其内部时间演化显式化，从而能够通过序列建模方法处理基于签名的表示。与完整签名相比，ISC本质上对瞬时轨迹更新敏感，这对于敏感和需要稳定性的控制动力学至关重要。在此表示的基础上，我们引入了ISC-Transformer（ISCT），这是一种离线强化学习模型，它将ISC集成到标准的Transformer架构中，而无需进一步的架构修改。我们在HalfCheetah、Walker2d、Hopper和Maze2d上评估了ISCT，包括具有延迟奖励和降级数据集的设置。结果表明，ISC方法为时间敏感的控制任务提供了一种理论上有根据且实践中有效的路径处理替代方案。
tldr: The paper introduces Incremental Signature Contribution (ISC), a method to decompose path signatures into a temporally ordered sequence, and applies it to offline reinforcement learning with an ISC-Transformer (ISCT) model, showing improved performance on temporally sensitive control tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了增量签名贡献(ISC)方法，将路径签名分解为时间排序的序列，并将其应用于离线强化学习中，通过ISC-Transformer (ISCT)模型在时间敏感的控制任务上展现了性能提升。

title: Temperature as a Meta-Policy: Adaptive Temperature in LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Temperature is a crucial hyperparameter in large language models (LLMs), controlling the trade-off between exploration and exploitation during text generation. High temperatures encourage diverse but noisy outputs, while low temperatures produce focused outputs but may cause premature convergence. Yet static or heuristic temperature schedules fail to adapt to the dynamic demands of reinforcement learning (RL) throughout training, often limiting policy improvement. We propose Temperature Adaptive Meta Policy Optimization (TAMPO), a new framework that recasts temperature control as a learnable meta-policy. TAMPO operates through a hierarchical two-loop process. In the inner loop, the LLM policy is updated (e.g., using GRPO) with trajectories sampled at the temperature selected by the meta-policy. In the outer loop, meta-policy updates the distribution over candidate temperatures by rewarding those that maximize the likelihood of high-advantage trajectories. This trajectory-guided, reward-driven mechanism enables online adaptation without additional rollouts, directly aligning exploration with policy improvement. On five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, TAMPO outperforms baselines using fixed or heuristic temperatures, establishing temperature as an effective learnable meta-policy for adaptive exploration in LLM reinforcement learning. Accepted at ICLR 2026.
summary_zh: 温度是大型语言模型 (LLM) 中的一个关键超参数，它控制文本生成过程中探索与利用之间的权衡。高温鼓励生成多样但嘈杂的输出，而低温产生聚焦的输出，但可能导致过早收敛。然而，静态或启发式温度调整策略无法适应强化学习 (RL) 在整个训练过程中的动态需求，通常会限制策略改进。我们提出了温度自适应元策略优化 (TAMPO)，这是一个新的框架，将温度控制重新定义为一个可学习的元策略。TAMPO 通过一个分层的双循环过程运行。在内循环中，LLM 策略（例如，使用 GRPO）会根据由元策略选择的温度采样的轨迹进行更新。在外循环中，元策略通过奖励那些最大化高优势轨迹可能性的温度来更新候选温度的分布。这种轨迹引导的、奖励驱动的机制能够实现在线自适应，而无需额外的 rollout，从而直接将探索与策略改进对齐。在五个数学推理基准测试中，TAMPO 优于使用固定或启发式温度的基线，确立了温度作为 LLM 强化学习中自适应探索的有效可学习元策略的地位。文章已被 ICLR 2026 接收。
tldr: The paper introduces Temperature Adaptive Meta Policy Optimization (TAMPO), a framework that learns to dynamically adjust the temperature hyperparameter in LLM reinforcement learning via a meta-policy, outperforming fixed or heuristic temperature baselines on mathematical reasoning tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为温度自适应元策略优化 (TAMPO) 的框架，该框架通过元策略学习动态调整 LLM 强化学习中的温度超参数，在数学推理任务中优于固定或启发式温度基线。

title: SkillRater: Untangling Capabilities in Multimodal Data
summary: Data curation methods typically assign samples a single quality score. We argue this scalar framing is fundamentally limited: when training requires multiple distinct capabilities, a monolithic scorer cannot maximize useful signals for all of them simultaneously. Quality is better understood as multidimensional, with each dimension corresponding to a capability the model must acquire. We introduce SkillRater, a framework that decomposes data filtering into specialized raters - one per capability, each trained via meta-learning on a disjoint validation objective - and composes their scores through a progressive selection rule: at each training stage, a sample is retained if any rater ranks it above a threshold that tightens over time, preserving diversity early while concentrating on high-value samples late. We validate this approach on vision language models, decomposing quality into three capability dimensions: visual understanding, OCR, and STEM reasoning. At 2B parameters, SkillRater improves over unfiltered baselines by 5.63% on visual understanding, 2.00% on OCR, and 3.53% on STEM on held out benchmarks. The learned rater signals are near orthogonal, confirming that the decomposition captures genuinely independent quality dimensions and explaining why it outperforms both unfiltered training and monolithic learned filtering.
summary_zh: 数据整理方法通常为样本分配一个单一的质量评分。我们认为这种标量框架具有根本性的局限性：当训练需要多种不同的能力时，一个单一的评分器无法同时最大化所有这些能力的有用信号。质量最好被理解为多维的，其中每个维度对应于模型必须获得的一种能力。我们引入了SkillRater，一个将数据过滤分解为专门的评分器的框架——每个能力对应一个评分器，每个评分器通过元学习在不相交的验证目标上进行训练——并通过逐步选择规则组合它们的得分：在每个训练阶段，如果任何评分器将样本的排名置于随着时间推移而收紧的阈值之上，则保留该样本，从而在早期保持多样性，同时在后期集中于高价值的样本。我们在视觉语言模型上验证了这种方法，将质量分解为三个能力维度：视觉理解、光学字符识别(OCR)和科学、技术、工程和数学(STEM)推理。在20亿参数规模下，SkillRater在保留的基准测试集上，相比于未过滤的基线，在视觉理解方面提升了5.63%，在OCR方面提升了2.00%，在STEM方面提升了3.53%。学习到的评分器信号近乎正交，证实了这种分解捕捉到了真正独立的质量维度，并解释了为什么它优于未过滤的训练和单体的学习型过滤。
tldr: The paper introduces SkillRater, a meta-learning framework for data filtering in multimodal contexts that decomposes quality into capability-specific raters and progressively selects data based on these ratings, demonstrating improved performance on vision-language tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍 SkillRater，一个用于多模态数据过滤的元学习框架，它将数据质量分解为特定于能力的评分器，并根据这些评分逐步选择数据，从而在视觉语言任务中表现出改进的性能。

title: Unifying Stable Optimization and Reference Regularization in RLHF
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has advanced alignment capabilities significantly but remains hindered by two core challenges: \textbf{reward hacking} and \textbf{stable optimization}. Current solutions independently address these issues through separate regularization strategies, specifically a KL-divergence penalty against a supervised fine-tuned model ($π_0$) to mitigate reward hacking, and policy ratio clipping towards the current policy ($π_t$) to promote stable alignment. However, the implicit trade-off arising from simultaneously regularizing towards both $π_0$ and $π_t$ remains under-explored. In this paper, we introduce a unified regularization approach that explicitly balances the objectives of preventing reward hacking and maintaining stable policy updates. Our simple yet principled alignment objective yields a weighted supervised fine-tuning loss with a superior trade-off, which demonstrably improves both alignment results and implementation complexity. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks validate that our method consistently outperforms RLHF and online preference learning methods, achieving enhanced alignment performance and stability.
summary_zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）显著提升了对齐能力，但仍然受到两个核心挑战的制约：\textbf{奖励入侵}和\textbf{稳定优化}。目前的解决方案通过独立的正则化策略分别解决这些问题，具体来说，使用相对于监督式微调模型（$π_0$）的KL散度惩罚来缓解奖励入侵，并使用相对于当前策略（$π_t$）的策略比例裁剪来促进稳定的对齐。然而，同时向$π_0$和$π_t$正则化所产生的隐式权衡仍未得到充分探讨。在本文中，我们提出了一种统一的正则化方法，该方法明确地平衡了防止奖励入侵和维持稳定策略更新的目标。我们简单而有原则的对齐目标产生了一种具有更优权衡的加权监督式微调损失，这明显改善了对齐结果和实现复杂性。跨多个基准的大量实验验证了我们的方法始终优于RLHF和在线偏好学习方法，实现了增强的对齐性能和稳定性。
tldr: This paper proposes a unified regularization approach for RLHF that balances reward hacking prevention and stable policy updates, outperforming existing methods in alignment performance and stability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于RLHF的统一正则化方法，该方法平衡了防止奖励黑客行为和稳定策略更新，在对齐性能和稳定性方面优于现有方法。

title: Asymmetric Prompt Weighting for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has driven recent advances in LLM post-training, in particular for reasoning. Policy optimization algorithms generate a number of responses for a given prompt and then effectively weight the corresponding gradients depending on the rewards. The most popular algorithms including GRPO, DAPO, and RLOO focus on ambiguous prompts, i.e., prompts with intermediate success probability, while downgrading gradients with very easy and very hard prompts. In this paper, we consider asymmetric prompt weightings that assign higher weights to prompts with low, or even zero, empirical success probability. We find that asymmetric weighting particularly benefits from-scratch RL (as in R1-Zero), where training traverses a wide accuracy range, and less so in post-SFT RL where the model already starts at high accuracy. We also provide theory that characterizes prompt weights which minimize the time needed to raise success probability from an initial level to a target accuracy under a fixed update budget. In low-success regimes, where informative responses are rare and response cost dominates, these optimal weights become asymmetric, upweighting low success probabilities and thereby accelerating effective-time convergence.
summary_zh: 使用可验证奖励的强化学习推动了LLM后训练的最新进展，尤其是在推理方面。策略优化算法为给定的提示生成多个回复，然后根据奖励有效地加权相应的梯度。包括GRPO、DAPO和RLOO在内的最流行的算法专注于具有中间成功概率的模糊提示，同时降低非常容易和非常困难的提示的梯度。在本文中，我们考虑了不对称的提示加权，该加权方式为具有较低甚至零经验成功概率的提示分配更高的权重。我们发现不对称加权特别有利于从头开始的强化学习（如R1-Zero），其中训练遍历了广泛的准确率范围，而在后SFT强化学习中，由于模型已经从高准确率开始，效果较小。我们还提供了理论，用于表征在固定更新预算下，将成功概率从初始水平提高到目标精度所需时间最小化的提示权重。在低成功率的情况下，信息丰富的回复很少且回复成本占主导地位，这些最优权重变为不对称，提高低成功概率的权重，从而加速有效时间的收敛。
tldr: This paper explores asymmetric prompt weighting in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, showing performance improvements, especially in from-scratch RL settings where initial success rates are low, and providing theory to justify their approach.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了在带有可验证奖励的强化学习中采用非对称提示权重，结果表明此方法，特别是在初始成功率较低的从零开始强化学习设置中，能提高性能，并提供了理论依据来支持他们的方法。

title: Pack it in: Packing into Partially Filled Containers Through Contact
summary: The automation of warehouse operations is crucial for improving productivity and reducing human exposure to hazardous environments. One operation frequently performed in warehouses is bin-packing where items need to be placed into containers, either for delivery to a customer, or for temporary storage in the warehouse. Whilst prior bin-packing works have largely been focused on packing items into empty containers and have adopted collision-free strategies, it is often the case that containers will already be partially filled with items, often in suboptimal arrangements due to transportation about a warehouse. This paper presents a contact-aware packing approach that exploits purposeful interactions with previously placed objects to create free space and enable successful placement of new items. This is achieved by using a contact-based multi-object trajectory optimizer within a model predictive controller, integrated with a physics-aware perception system that estimates object poses even during inevitable occlusions, and a method that suggests physically-feasible locations to place the object inside the container.
summary_zh: 仓库运营的自动化对于提高生产效率和减少人员在危险环境中的暴露至关重要。装箱是仓库中经常执行的一项操作，需要将物品放入容器中，以便交付给客户，或在仓库中进行临时存储。 虽然先前的装箱工作主要集中在将物品装入空容器，并采用无碰撞策略，但实际情况往往是容器已经部分装填了物品，而且由于在仓库中运输，这些物品通常以次优方式排列。本文提出了一种接触感知的装箱方法，该方法利用与先前放置的物体进行有目的的交互来创造自由空间，从而能够成功放置新的物品。 这是通过在模型预测控制器中，采用一个基于接触的多目标轨迹优化器实现的，该控制器与一个具备物理感知能力的感知系统集成，该系统即使在不可避免的遮挡情况下也能估计物体姿态，并且采用一种方法来建议在容器内部放置物体的物理可行位置。
tldr: This paper presents a contact-aware bin-packing approach for partially filled containers using a multi-object trajectory optimizer and physics-aware perception, addressing a common problem in warehouse automation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于部分填充容器的接触感知式装箱方法，该方法使用多目标轨迹优化器和具有物理感知能力的感知系统，解决了仓库自动化中的一个常见问题。

title: RF-Modulated Adaptive Communication Improves Multi-Agent Robotic Exploration
summary: Reliable coordination and efficient communication are critical challenges for multi-agent robotic exploration of environments where communication is limited. This work introduces Adaptive-RF Transmission (ART), a novel communication-aware planning algorithm that dynamically modulates transmission location based on signal strength and data payload size, enabling heterogeneous robot teams to share information efficiently without unnecessary backtracking. We further explore an extension to this approach called ART-SST, which enforces signal strength thresholds for high-fidelity data delivery. Through over 480 simulations across three cave-inspired environments, ART consistently outperforms existing strategies, including full rendezvous and minimum-signal heuristic approaches, achieving up to a 58% reduction in distance traveled and up to 52% faster exploration times compared to baseline methods. These results demonstrate that adaptive, payload-aware communication significantly improves coverage efficiency and mission speed in complex, communication-constrained environments, offering a promising foundation for future planetary exploration and search-and-rescue missions.
summary_zh: 以下是在环境受限的通信条件下，多智能体机器人探索中可靠的协调和高效的通信所面临的关键挑战。本文介绍了一种名为自适应射频传输(ART)的新型通信感知规划算法，该算法基于信号强度和数据负载大小动态地调节传输位置，使异构机器人团队能够高效地共享信息，而无需不必要的回溯。我们进一步探索了这种方法的扩展版本ART-SST，它对高保真数据传输强制执行信号强度阈值。通过在三个受洞穴启发的环境中进行的480多次模拟，ART始终优于现有的策略，包括完全汇合和最小信号启发式方法，与基线方法相比，行程距离最多减少58%，探索时间最多缩短52%。这些结果表明，自适应的、负载感知的通信显著提高了复杂、通信受限环境中的覆盖效率和任务速度，为未来的行星探索和搜索救援任务提供了一个有希望的基础。
tldr: The paper introduces Adaptive-RF Transmission (ART), a communication-aware planning algorithm that dynamically modulates transmission for multi-agent robotic exploration in communication-limited environments, achieving significant improvements in exploration efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种自适应射频传输（ART）算法，该算法是一种通信感知规划算法，可动态调节多智能体机器人在通信受限环境中进行探索的传输，从而显著提高探索效率。

title: Where Bits Matter in World Model Planning: A Paired Mixed-Bit Study for Efficient Spatial Reasoning
summary: Efficient spatial reasoning requires world models that remain reliable under tight precision budgets. We study whether low-bit planning behavior is determined mostly by total bitwidth or by where bits are allocated across modules. Using DINO-WM on the Wall planning task, we run a paired-goal mixed-bit evaluation across uniform, mixed, asymmetric, and layerwise variants under two planner budgets. We observe a consistent three-regime pattern: 8-bit and 6-bit settings remain close to FP16, 3-bit settings collapse, and 4-bit settings are allocation-sensitive. In that transition region, preserving encoder precision improves planning relative to uniform quantization, and near-size asymmetric variants show the same encoder-side direction. In a later strict 22-cell replication with smaller per-cell episode count, the mixed-versus-uniform INT4 sign becomes budget-conditioned, which further highlights the sensitivity of this transition regime. These findings motivate module-aware, budget-aware quantization policies as a broader research direction for efficient spatial reasoning. Code and run artifacts are available at https://github.com/suraj-ranganath/DINO-MBQuant.
summary_zh: 高效的空间推理需要能在严格的精度预算下保持可靠性的世界模型。我们研究了低比特规划行为主要由总比特宽度决定，还是由比特在模块之间的分配方式决定。在使用DINO-WM进行Wall规划任务时，我们在两种规划器预算下，对均匀、混合、不对称和逐层变体进行了配对目标混合比特评估。我们观察到了一致的三种模式：8比特和6比特设置与FP16保持接近，3比特设置崩溃，而4比特设置对分配敏感。在那个过渡区域中，与均匀量化相比，保留编码器精度可以改善规划，并且近似大小的不对称变体显示出相同的编码器侧方向。在之后一个更严格的、每个单元格episode计数更少的22单元格复制实验中，混合与均匀INT4的符号变得受预算限制，这进一步突出了该过渡区域的敏感性。这些发现激发了模块感知、预算感知的量化策略作为高效空间推理更广泛的研究方向。代码和运行结果已在https://github.com/suraj-ranganath/DINO-MBQuant 提供。
tldr: This paper investigates the impact of bit allocation strategies on the performance of world model-based planning, finding that encoder precision is crucial in low-bit regimes and highlighting the need for budget-aware quantization policies.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了比特分配策略对基于世界模型的规划性能的影响，发现编码器精度在低比特机制中至关重要，并强调了需求预算感知量化策略的必要性。

title: DiffPlace: Street View Generation via Place-Controllable Diffusion Model Enhancing Place Recognition
summary: Generative models have advanced significantly in realistic image synthesis, with diffusion models excelling in quality and stability. Recent multi-view diffusion models improve 3D-aware street view generation, but they struggle to produce place-aware and background-consistent urban scenes from text, BEV maps, and object bounding boxes. This limits their effectiveness in generating realistic samples for place recognition tasks. To address these challenges, we propose DiffPlace, a novel framework that introduces a place-ID controller to enable place-controllable multi-view image generation. The place-ID controller employs linear projection, perceiver transformer, and contrastive learning to map place-ID embeddings into a fixed CLIP space, allowing the model to synthesize images with consistent background buildings while flexibly modifying foreground objects and weather conditions. Extensive experiments, including quantitative comparisons and augmented training evaluations, demonstrate that DiffPlace outperforms existing methods in both generation quality and training support for visual place recognition. Our results highlight the potential of generative models in enhancing scene-level and place-aware synthesis, providing a valuable approach for improving place recognition in autonomous driving
summary_zh: 生成模型在逼真图像合成方面取得了显著进展，其中扩散模型在质量和稳定性方面表现出色。近期的多视角扩散模型改进了3D感知的街景生成，但它们难以从文本、鸟瞰图（BEV）和物体边界框生成具有场所感知和背景一致的城市场景。这限制了它们在为场所识别任务生成逼真样本方面的有效性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出DiffPlace，一种新颖的框架，引入了一个场所ID控制器，以实现场所可控的多视角图像生成。场所ID控制器采用线性投影、感知器Transformer和对比学习，将场所ID嵌入映射到固定的CLIP空间中，从而使模型能够合成具有一致背景建筑物的图像，同时灵活地修改前景物体和天气条件。包括定量比较和增强训练评估在内的大量实验表明，DiffPlace在生成质量和视觉场所识别的训练支持方面均优于现有方法。我们的结果突显了生成模型在增强场景级别和场所感知合成方面的潜力，为改进自动驾驶中的场所识别提供了一种有价值的方法。
tldr: DiffPlace introduces a place-ID controller for diffusion models to generate place-aware street view images, improving both generation quality and place recognition performance.
tldr_zh: DiffPlace 引入了一个 place-ID 控制器，用于扩散模型生成具有地点感知的街景图像，从而提高生成质量和地点识别性能。

title: AC-MASAC: An Attentive Curriculum Learning Framework for Heterogeneous UAV Swarm Coordination
summary: Cooperative path planning for heterogeneous UAV swarms poses significant challenges for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), particularly in handling asymmetric inter-agent dependencies and addressing the risks of sparse rewards and catastrophic forgetting during training. To address these issues, this paper proposes an attentive curriculum learning framework (AC-MASAC). The framework introduces a role-aware heterogeneous attention mechanism to explicitly model asymmetric dependencies. Moreover, a structured curriculum strategy is designed, integrating hierarchical knowledge transfer and stage-proportional experience replay to address the issues of sparse rewards and catastrophic forgetting. The proposed framework is validated on a custom multi-agent simulation platform, and the results show that our method has significant advantages over other advanced methods in terms of Success Rate, Formation Keeping Rate, and Success-weighted Mission Time. The code is available at \textcolor{red}{https://github.com/Wanhao-Liu/AC-MASAC}.
summary_zh: 异构无人机集群的协同路径规划对多智能体强化学习(MARL)提出了重大挑战，尤其是在处理非对称智能体间依赖关系以及解决训练过程中稀疏奖励和灾难性遗忘的风险方面。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了一种基于注意力机制的课程学习框架(AC-MASAC)。该框架引入了一种角色感知的异构注意力机制来显式地建模非对称依赖关系。此外，设计了一种结构化的课程策略，集成了分层知识迁移和阶段比例经验回放，以解决稀疏奖励和灾难性遗忘的问题。所提出的框架在一个定制的多智能体仿真平台上得到了验证，结果表明，在成功率、队形保持率和成功加权任务时间方面，我们的方法优于其他先进方法。代码可在\textcolor{red}{https://github.com/Wanhao-Liu/AC-MASAC}获取。
tldr: This paper introduces AC-MASAC, an attentive curriculum learning framework for cooperative path planning of heterogeneous UAV swarms, addressing asymmetric inter-agent dependencies, sparse rewards, and catastrophic forgetting using a role-aware attention mechanism and a structured curriculum strategy.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为AC-MASAC的注意力课程学习框架，用于异构无人机群的协同路径规划，通过角色感知的注意力机制和结构化课程策略，解决了非对称智能体间依赖、稀疏奖励和灾难性遗忘的问题。

title: Human-Like Gaze Behavior in Social Robots: A Deep Learning Approach Integrating Human and Non-Human Stimuli
summary: Nonverbal behaviors, particularly gaze direction, play a crucial role in enhancing effective communication in social interactions. As social robots increasingly participate in these interactions, they must adapt their gaze based on human activities and remain receptive to all cues, whether human-generated or not, to ensure seamless and effective communication. This study aims to increase the similarity between robot and human gaze behavior across various social situations, including both human and non-human stimuli (e.g., conversations, pointing, door openings, and object drops). A key innovation in this study, is the investigation of gaze responses to non-human stimuli, a critical yet underexplored area in prior research. These scenarios, were simulated in the Unity software as a 3D animation and a 360-degree real-world video. Data on gaze directions from 41 participants were collected via virtual reality (VR) glasses. Preprocessed data, trained two neural networks-LSTM and Transformer-to build predictive models based on individuals' gaze patterns. In the animated scenario, the LSTM and Transformer models achieved prediction accuracies of 67.6% and 70.4%, respectively; In the real-world scenario, the LSTM and Transformer models achieved accuracies of 72% and 71.6%, respectively. Despite the gaze pattern differences among individuals, our models outperform existing approaches in accuracy while uniquely considering non-human stimuli, offering a significant advantage over previous literature. Furthermore, deployed on the NAO robot, the system was evaluated by 275 participants via a comprehensive questionnaire, with results demonstrating high satisfaction during interactions. This work advances social robotics by enabling robots to dynamically mimic human gaze behavior in complex social contexts.
summary_zh: 非语言行为，尤其是视线方向，在增强社交互动中的有效沟通方面起着至关重要的作用。随着社交机器人越来越多地参与这些互动，它们必须根据人类活动调整视线，并对所有人为和非人为的线索保持敏感，以确保无缝和有效的沟通。本研究旨在提高机器人在各种社交情境中与人类视线行为的相似度，这些情境包括人与非人的刺激（例如，对话、指点、开门和掉落物体）。本研究的一个关键创新是调查对非人类刺激的视线反应，这是先前研究中一个关键但未被充分探索的领域。这些场景在Unity软件中模拟成3D动画和360度真实世界视频。通过虚拟现实（VR）眼镜收集了41名参与者的视线方向数据。预处理后的数据用于训练两个神经网络——LSTM和Transformer——以基于个体视线模式构建预测模型。在动画场景中，LSTM和Transformer模型的预测准确率分别为67.6%和70.4%；在真实世界场景中，LSTM和Transformer模型的准确率分别为72%和71.6%。尽管个体之间的视线模式存在差异，但我们的模型在准确性方面优于现有方法，同时独特地考虑了非人类刺激，从而提供了优于先前文献的显著优势。 此外，该系统部署在NAO机器人上，并通过一份全面的问卷由275名参与者进行评估，结果表明在互动过程中满意度很高。这项工作通过使机器人能够在复杂的社交环境中动态地模仿人类的视线行为，从而推进了社交机器人技术的发展。
tldr: This paper presents a deep learning approach (LSTM & Transformer) for mimicking human-like gaze behavior in social robots, especially focusing on responses to both human and non-human stimuli in VR and real-world scenarios, and demonstrates improved accuracy and user satisfaction compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种深度学习方法（LSTM和Transformer），用于在社交机器人中模仿类人注视行为，特别关注对VR和现实场景中人类和非人类刺激的反应，并展示了比现有方法更高的准确性和用户满意度。

title: EasyMimic: A Low-Cost Framework for Robot Imitation Learning from Human Videos
summary: Robot imitation learning is often hindered by the high cost of collecting large-scale, real-world data. This challenge is especially significant for low-cost robots designed for home use, as they must be both user-friendly and affordable. To address this, we propose the EasyMimic framework, a low-cost and replicable solution that enables robots to quickly learn manipulation policies from human video demonstrations captured with standard RGB cameras. Our method first extracts 3D hand trajectories from the videos. An action alignment module then maps these trajectories to the gripper control space of a low-cost robot. To bridge the human-to-robot domain gap, we introduce a simple and user-friendly hand visual augmentation strategy. We then use a co-training method, fine-tuning a model on both the processed human data and a small amount of robot data, enabling rapid adaptation to new tasks. Experiments on the low-cost LeRobot platform demonstrate that EasyMimic achieves high performance across various manipulation tasks. It significantly reduces the reliance on expensive robot data collection, offering a practical path for bringing intelligent robots into homes. Project website: https://zt375356.github.io/EasyMimic-Project/.
summary_zh: 机器人模仿学习常常受限于收集大规模真实世界数据的巨大成本。对于为家庭使用而设计的低成本机器人而言，这一挑战尤为显著，因为它们必须兼具用户友好性和经济性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了EasyMimic框架，一种低成本且可复现的解决方案，使机器人能够通过标准RGB摄像头捕获的人类视频演示快速学习操作策略。我们的方法首先从视频中提取3D手部轨迹。然后，一个动作对齐模块将这些轨迹映射到低成本机器人的夹爪控制空间。为了弥合人与机器人的领域差距，我们引入了一个简单且用户友好的手部视觉增强策略。接着，我们使用一种协同训练方法，在一个经过处理的人类数据和一个少量机器人数据上微调模型，从而实现对新任务的快速适应。在低成本LeRobot平台上的实验表明，EasyMimic在各种操作任务中都实现了高性能。它显著降低了对昂贵的机器人数据收集的依赖，为将智能机器人引入家庭提供了一条切实可行的途径。项目网站：https://zt375356.github.io/EasyMimic-Project/.
tldr: The paper introduces EasyMimic, a low-cost framework for imitation learning on low-cost robots, leveraging human video demonstrations enhanced with 3D hand tracking and co-training to reduce the need for extensive robot data collection.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EasyMimic，一种用于低成本机器人的低成本模仿学习框架，利用通过3D手部跟踪和协同训练增强的人类视频演示，从而减少对大量机器人数据收集的需求。

title: Human Preference Modeling Using Visual Motion Prediction Improves Robot Skill Learning from Egocentric Human Video
summary: We present an approach to robot learning from egocentric human videos by modeling human preferences in a reward function and optimizing robot behavior to maximize this reward. Prior work on reward learning from human videos attempts to measure the long-term value of a visual state as the temporal distance between it and the terminal state in a demonstration video. These approaches make assumptions that limit performance when learning from video. They must also transfer the learned value function across the embodiment and environment gap. Our method models human preferences by learning to predict the motion of tracked points between subsequent images and defines a reward function as the agreement between predicted and observed object motion in a robot's behavior at each step. We then use a modified Soft Actor Critic (SAC) algorithm initialized with 10 on-robot demonstrations to estimate a value function from this reward and optimize a policy that maximizes this value function, all on the robot. Our approach is capable of learning on a real robot, and we show that policies learned with our reward model match or outperform prior work across multiple tasks in both simulation and on the real robot.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种从以人为中心的视频中进行机器人学习的方法，该方法通过在奖励函数中建模人类偏好并优化机器人行为以最大化该奖励来实现。先前基于人类视频的奖励学习工作试图衡量视觉状态的长期价值，将其作为演示视频中该状态与终止状态之间的时间距离。这些方法做出的假设限制了从视频中学习的性能。它们还必须跨越具身性和环境的差距来迁移学习到的价值函数。我们的方法通过学习预测后续图像之间跟踪点的运动来建模人类偏好，并将奖励函数定义为机器人行为在每个步骤中预测的和观察到的对象运动之间的一致性。然后，我们使用一种改进的软演员-评论家 (SAC) 算法，并用10个机器人演示数据初始化，来估计来自该奖励的价值函数，并优化最大化该价值函数的策略，所有操作均在机器人上进行。我们的方法能够在真实机器人上进行学习，并且我们表明，使用我们的奖励模型学习到的策略在模拟和真实机器人上的多个任务中，都与先前的工作相匹配或超过了它们。
tldr: This paper presents a method for robot learning from egocentric human videos by modeling human preferences as visual motion predictions. The learned reward function, based on motion agreement, is used to train a robot policy, outperforming prior methods in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种通过将人类偏好建模为视觉运动预测，从以自我为中心的人类视频中进行机器人学习的方法。学习到的奖励函数基于运动一致性，用于训练机器人策略，在模拟和真实世界实验中优于先前的方法。

title: ExtremControl: Low-Latency Humanoid Teleoperation with Direct Extremity Control
summary: Building a low-latency humanoid teleoperation system is essential for collecting diverse reactive and dynamic demonstrations. However, existing approaches rely on heavily pre-processed human-to-humanoid motion retargeting and position-only PD control, resulting in substantial latency that severely limits responsiveness and prevents tasks requiring rapid feedback and fast reactions. To address this problem, we propose ExtremControl, a low latency whole-body control framework that: (1) operates directly on SE(3) poses of selected rigid links, primarily humanoid extremities, to avoid full-body retargeting; (2) utilizes a Cartesian-space mapping to directly convert human motion to humanoid link targets; and (3) incorporates velocity feedforward control at low level to support highly responsive behavior under rapidly changing control interfaces. We further provide a unified theoretical formulation of ExtremControl and systematically validate its effectiveness through experiments in both simulation and real-world environments. Building on ExtremControl, we implement a low-latency humanoid teleoperation system that supports both optical motion capture and VR-based motion tracking, achieving end-to-end latency as low as 50ms and enabling highly responsive behaviors such as ping-pong ball balancing, juggling, and real-time return, thereby substantially surpassing the 200ms latency limit observed in prior work.
summary_zh: 构建低延迟人形机器人遥操作系统对于收集多样化的反应式和动态演示至关重要。然而，现有方法依赖于大量预处理的人-机器人运动重定向和仅基于位置的PD控制，导致显著的延迟，严重限制了响应性，并阻碍了需要快速反馈和快速反应的任务。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了ExtremControl，一种低延迟全身控制框架，该框架：（1）直接操作选定刚性连杆（主要为人形机器人四肢）的SE(3)姿态，以避免全身重定向；（2）利用笛卡尔空间映射将人类运动直接转换为人形机器人连杆目标；（3）在低层次上融入速度前馈控制，以支持在快速变化的控制界面下实现高度响应的行为。我们进一步提供了ExtremControl的统一理论公式，并通过在模拟和现实环境中的实验系统地验证了其有效性。基于ExtremControl，我们实现了一个低延迟人形机器人遥操作系统，该系统支持光学运动捕捉和基于VR的运动跟踪，实现了低至50ms的端到端延迟，并实现了诸如乒乓球平衡、杂耍和实时回馈等高度响应的行为，从而大大超过了先前工作中观察到的200ms延迟限制。
tldr: The paper introduces ExtremControl, a low-latency whole-body control framework for humanoid teleoperation that operates directly on extremity poses with velocity feedforward control, achieving significantly lower latency than prior methods and enabling more responsive behaviors.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ExtremControl，一种用于人形机器人遥操作的低延迟全身控制框架，该框架直接在肢体姿势上进行操作，并采用速度前馈控制，与之前的方法相比，显著降低了延迟，并实现了更灵敏的响应。

title: YOR: Your Own Mobile Manipulator for Generalizable Robotics
summary: Recent advances in robot learning have generated significant interest in capable platforms that may eventually approach human-level competence. This interest, combined with the commoditization of actuators, has propelled growth in low-cost robotic platforms. However, the optimal form factor for mobile manipulation, especially on a budget, remains an open question. We introduce YOR, an open-source, low-cost mobile manipulator that integrates an omnidirectional base, a telescopic vertical lift, and two arms with grippers to achieve whole-body mobility and manipulation. Our design emphasizes modularity, ease of assembly using off-the-shelf components, and affordability, with a bill-of-materials cost under 10,000 USD. We demonstrate YOR's capability by completing tasks that require coordinated whole-body control, bimanual manipulation, and autonomous navigation. Overall, YOR offers competitive functionality for mobile manipulation research at a fraction of the cost of existing platforms. Project website: https://www.yourownrobot.ai/
summary_zh: 机器人学习领域的最新进展激发了人们对具有较高能力的平台（最终可能达到人类水平）的浓厚兴趣。这种兴趣，加上执行器商品化趋势，推动了低成本机器人平台的增长。然而，移动操作的最佳外形尺寸，尤其是在预算有限的情况下，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。我们推出了YOR，一个开源、低成本的移动操作平台，它集成了全向底座、伸缩式垂直升降机构以及两个带有夹爪的机械臂，以实现全身移动和操作。我们的设计强调模块化、易于使用现成组件进行组装以及经济性，材料清单成本低于10,000美元。我们通过完成需要协调全身控制、双臂操作和自主导航的任务来展示YOR的能力。总而言之，YOR以现有平台一小部分的成本为移动操作研究提供了具有竞争力的功能。项目网站：https://www.yourownrobot.ai/
tldr: The paper introduces YOR, an open-source, low-cost mobile manipulator designed for generalizable robotics research, emphasizing affordability, modularity, and whole-body manipulation capabilities.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 YOR 的开源、低成本的移动机械臂，专为通用机器人研究设计，强调经济性、模块化和全身操控能力。

title: APEX: Learning Adaptive High-Platform Traversal for Humanoid Robots
summary: Humanoid locomotion has advanced rapidly with deep reinforcement learning (DRL), enabling robust feet-based traversal over uneven terrain. Yet platforms beyond leg length remain largely out of reach because current RL training paradigms often converge to jumping-like solutions that are high-impact, torque-limited, and unsafe for real-world deployment. To address this gap, we propose APEX, a system for perceptive, climbing-based high-platform traversal that composes terrain-conditioned behaviors: climb-up and climb-down at vertical edges, walking or crawling on the platform, and stand-up and lie-down for posture reconfiguration. Central to our approach is a generalized ratchet progress reward for learning contact-rich, goal-reaching maneuvers. It tracks the best-so-far task progress and penalizes non-improving steps, providing dense yet velocity-free supervision that enables efficient exploration under strong safety regularization. Based on this formulation, we train LiDAR-based full-body maneuver policies and reduce the sim-to-real perception gap through a dual strategy: modeling mapping artifacts during training and applying filtering and inpainting to elevation maps during deployment. Finally, we distill all six skills into a single policy that autonomously selects behaviors and transitions based on local geometry and commands. Experiments on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 humanoid demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real traversal of 0.8 meter platforms (approximately 114% of leg length), with robust adaptation to platform height and initial pose, as well as smooth and stable multi-skill transitions.
summary_zh: 基于深度强化学习的人形机器人运动已经取得了快速进展，实现了在不平坦地形上基于足部的稳健穿越。然而，超出腿长范围的平台在很大程度上仍然无法到达，因为当前的强化学习训练范式通常收敛到跳跃式的解决方案，这些方案具有高冲击、扭矩受限的特点，并且不适用于现实世界的部署。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了APEX，一个用于感知的、基于攀爬的高平台穿越系统，该系统组合了地形条件下的行为：垂直边缘处的向上攀爬和向下攀爬、在平台上行走或爬行，以及用于姿态重构的站立和躺下。我们方法的核心是一种通用的棘轮式进度奖励，用于学习富含接触的、达到目标的动作。它跟踪到目前为止的最佳任务进度，并惩罚未改进的步骤，从而提供密集但无速度的监督，从而能够在强大的安全正则化下进行高效探索。基于此公式，我们训练了基于激光雷达的全身动作策略，并通过双重策略来减少模拟到现实的感知差距：在训练期间对地图伪像进行建模，并在部署期间对高程图应用滤波和修复。最后，我们将所有六个技能提炼成一个单一的策略，该策略根据局部几何形状和指令自主选择行为和执行转换。在一台29自由度的宇树G1人形机器人上的实验表明，实现了对0.8米平台（大约为腿长的114%）的零样本模拟到真实穿越，能够稳健地适应平台高度和初始姿势，并实现平滑和稳定的多技能转换。
tldr: The paper introduces APEX, a DRL-based system for humanoid robots to traverse high platforms by composing various climbing-related skills, achieving zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a Unitree G1 robot.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于深度强化学习（DRL）的系统APEX，用于人形机器人通过组合各种攀爬相关技能来穿越高平台，并在Unitree G1机器人上实现了零样本的模拟到真实世界的迁移。

title: A receding-horizon multi-contact motion planner for legged robots in challenging environments
summary: We present a novel receding-horizon multi-contact motion planner for legged robots in challenging scenarios, able to plan motions such as chimney climbing, navigating very narrow passages or crossing large gaps. Our approach adds new capabilities to the state of the art, including the ability to reactively re-plan in response to new information, and planning contact locations and whole-body trajectories simultaneously, simplifying the implementation and removing the need for post-processing or complex multi-stage approaches. Our method is more resistant to local minima problems than other potential field based approaches, and our quadratic-program-based posture generator returns nodes more quickly than those of existing algorithms. Rigorous statistical analysis shows that, with short planning horizons (e.g., one step ahead), our planner is faster than the state-of-the-art across all scenarios tested (between 45% and 98% faster on average, depending on the scenario), while planning less efficient motions (requiring 5% fewer to 700% more stance changes on average). In all but one scenario (Chimney Walking), longer planning horizons (e.g., four steps ahead) extended the average planning times (between 73% faster and 400% slower than the state-of-the-art) but resulted in higher quality motion plans (between 8% more and 47% fewer stance changes than the state-of-the-art).
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新型的用于腿足机器人应对复杂环境的后退视界多接触运动规划器，该规划器能规划诸如烟囱攀爬、穿越狭窄通道或跨越大间隙等运动。我们的方法为现有技术增加了新的能力，包括对新信息作出反应性重规划的能力，以及同时规划接触位置和全身轨迹的能力，从而简化了实现过程，并消除了对后处理或复杂多阶段方法的需求。我们的方法比其他基于势场的方法更不容易陷入局部最小值问题，并且我们基于二次规划的姿态生成器返回节点的速度比现有算法更快。严格的统计分析表明，在较短规划视界（例如，提前一步）下，我们的规划器比所有测试情景下的最先进方法都快（平均快45%到98%，具体取决于情景），但规划的运动效率较低（平均需要多5%到700%的站姿切换）。除了一个情景（烟囱行走）外，更长的规划视界（例如，提前四步）延长了平均规划时间（比最先进方法快73%到慢400%），但产生了更高质量的运动规划（比最先进方法少8%到47%的站姿切换）。
tldr: This paper presents a receding-horizon multi-contact motion planner for legged robots in complex environments, demonstrating improved speed and adaptability compared to existing methods, albeit with trade-offs in motion efficiency depending on the planning horizon.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文提出了一种用于复杂环境中腿式机器人的后退水平多接触运动规划器，与现有方法相比，该规划器在速度和适应性方面有所提高，但运动效率有所权衡，具体取决于规划范围。

title: On the Complexity of Offline Reinforcement Learning with $Q^\star$-Approximation and Partial Coverage
summary:
We study offline reinforcement learning under $Q^\star$-approximation and partial coverage, a setting that motivates practical algorithms such as Conservative $Q$-Learning (CQL; Kumar et al., 2020) but has received limited theoretical attention. Our work is inspired by the following open question: "Are $Q^\star$-realizability and Bellman completeness sufficient for sample-efficient offline RL under partial coverage?"
  We answer in the negative by establishing an information-theoretic lower bound. Going substantially beyond this, we introduce a general framework that characterizes the intrinsic complexity of a given $Q^\star$ function class, inspired by model-free decision-estimation coefficients (DEC) for online RL (Foster et al., 2023b; Liu et al., 2025b). This complexity recovers and improves the quantities underlying the guarantees of Chen and Jiang (2022) and Uehara et al. (2023), and extends to broader settings. Our decision-estimation decomposition can be combined with a wide range of $Q^\star$ estimation procedures, modularizing and generalizing existing approaches.
  Beyond the general framework, we make further contributions: By developing a novel second-order performance difference lemma, we obtain the first $ε^{-2}$ sample complexity under partial coverage for soft $Q$-learning, improving the $ε^{-4}$ bound of Uehara et al. (2023). We remove Chen and Jiang's (2022) need for additional online interaction when the value gap of $Q^\star$ is unknown. We also give the first characterization of offline learnability for general low-Bellman-rank MDPs without Bellman completeness (Jiang et al., 2017; Du et al., 2021; Jin et al., 2021), a canonical setting in online RL that remains unexplored in offline RL except for special cases. Finally, we provide the first analysis for CQL under $Q^\star$-realizability and Bellman completeness beyond the tabular case.
summary_zh:
我们研究了$Q^\star$近似和部分覆盖下的离线强化学习，这是一种激发了诸如保守Q学习（CQL; Kumar et al., 2020）等实用算法的设置，但其理论研究较少。我们的工作受到以下开放问题的启发：“在部分覆盖下，$Q^\star$可实现性和贝尔曼完备性是否足以支持样本高效的离线RL？”

我们建立了一个信息论下界，从而否定了这个问题。更重要的是，我们引入了一个通用框架，用于表征给定$Q^\star$函数类的内在复杂性，其灵感来源于在线RL的无模型决策估计系数（DEC）（Foster et al., 2023b; Liu et al., 2025b）。这种复杂性恢复并改进了Chen和Jiang（2022）以及Uehara等人（2023）的保证背后的数量，并扩展到更广泛的设置。我们的决策估计分解可以与各种$Q^\star$估计过程相结合，从而将现有方法模块化和泛化。

除了通用框架之外，我们还做出了进一步的贡献：通过开发一种新颖的二阶性能差异引理，我们获得了soft $Q$-learning在部分覆盖下的第一个$ε^{-2}$样本复杂度，改进了Uehara等人（2023）的$ε^{-4}$界。我们消除了Chen和Jiang（2022）在$Q^\star$的值差距未知时对额外在线交互的需求。我们还首次对一般低贝尔曼秩MDP的离线可学习性进行了表征，这些MDP没有贝尔曼完备性（Jiang et al., 2017; Du et al., 2021; Jin et al., 2021），这是在线RL中的一个典型设置，但在离线RL中除了特殊情况外仍未被探索。最后，我们提供了在表格情况之外的，$Q^\star$可实现性和贝尔曼完备性下对CQL的首次分析。
tldr: This paper investigates the complexity of offline RL under Q*-approximation and partial coverage, providing a general framework for characterizing this complexity, improved sample complexity for soft Q-learning, and analysis of CQL and low-Bellman-rank MDPs in this setting.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在Q*-近似和部分覆盖下的离线RL的复杂性，提供了一个表征这种复杂性的通用框架，改进了软Q学习的样本复杂度，并分析了在这种设置下的CQL和低Bellman秩MDP。

title: Differentiable Modal Logic for Multi-Agent Diagnosis, Orchestration and Communication
summary:
As multi-agent AI systems evolve from simple chatbots to autonomous swarms, debugging semantic failures requires reasoning about knowledge, belief, causality, and obligation, precisely what modal logic was designed to formalize. However, traditional modal logic requires manual specification of relationship structures that are unknown or dynamic in real systems. This tutorial demonstrates differentiable modal logic (DML), implemented via Modal Logical Neural Networks (MLNNs), enabling systems to learn trust networks, causal chains, and regulatory boundaries from behavioral data alone.
  We present a unified neurosymbolic debugging framework through four modalities: epistemic (who to trust), temporal (when events cause failures), deontic (what actions are permitted), and doxastic (how to interpret agent confidence). Each modality is demonstrated on concrete multi-agent scenarios, from discovering deceptive alliances in diplomacy games to detecting LLM hallucinations, with complete implementations showing how logical contradictions become learnable optimization objectives. Key contributions for the neurosymbolic community: (1) interpretable learned structures where trust and causality are explicit parameters, not opaque embeddings; (2) knowledge injection via differentiable axioms that guide learning with sparse data (3) compositional multi-modal reasoning that combines epistemic, temporal, and deontic constraints; and (4) practical deployment patterns for monitoring, active control and communication of multi-agent systems. All code provided as executable Jupyter notebooks.
summary_zh:
随着多智能体人工智能系统从简单的聊天机器人演变为自主集群，调试语义故障需要对知识、信念、因果关系和义务进行推理，而这些正是模态逻辑旨在形式化的内容。然而，传统的模态逻辑需要手动指定关系结构，而这些结构在实际系统中是未知的或动态的。本教程演示了可微分模态逻辑（DML），通过模态逻辑神经网络（MLNNs）实现，使系统能够仅从行为数据中学习信任网络、因果链和监管边界。

我们通过四种模态，提出了一个统一的神经符号调试框架：认知模态（信任谁）、时间模态（何时事件导致故障）、道义模态（允许采取什么行动）和信念模态（如何解释智能体的置信度）。每种模态都在具体的多智能体场景中进行演示，从发现外交游戏中的欺骗联盟到检测大型语言模型的幻觉，并提供完整的实现，展示了逻辑矛盾如何成为可学习的优化目标。 为神经符号社区的主要贡献包括：（1）可解释的学习结构，其中信任和因果关系是显式参数，而不是不透明的嵌入；（2）通过可微分公理注入知识，利用稀疏数据指导学习；（3）组合式的多模态推理，结合了认知、时间和道义约束；以及（4）用于监控、主动控制和多智能体系统通信的实际部署模式。所有代码均以可执行的Jupyter Notebook形式提供。
tldr: This paper introduces Differentiable Modal Logic (DML) implemented via Modal Logical Neural Networks (MLNNs) for debugging multi-agent systems by learning trust networks, causal chains, and regulatory boundaries from behavioral data.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种通过模态逻辑神经网络 (MLNN) 实现的可微模态逻辑 (DML)，用于调试多智能体系统，通过从行为数据中学习信任网络、因果链和监管边界。

title: AdaptEvolve: Improving Efficiency of Evolutionary AI Agents through Adaptive Model Selection
summary: Evolutionary agentic systems intensify the trade-off between computational efficiency and reasoning capability by repeatedly invoking large language models (LLMs) during inference. This setting raises a central question: how can an agent dynamically select an LLM that is sufficiently capable for the current generation step while remaining computationally efficient? While model cascades offer a practical mechanism for balancing this trade-off, existing routing strategies typically rely on static heuristics or external controllers and do not explicitly account for model uncertainty. We introduce AdaptEvolve: Adaptive LLM Selection for Multi-LLM Evolutionary Refinement within an evolutionary sequential refinement framework that leverages intrinsic generation confidence to estimate real-time solvability. Empirical results show that confidence-driven selection yields a favourable Pareto frontier, reducing total inference cost by an average of 37.9% across benchmarks while retaining 97.5% of the upper-bound accuracy of static large-model baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/raypretam/adaptive_llm_selection.
summary_zh: 进化式智能体系统通过在推理过程中重复调用大型语言模型(LLM)，加剧了计算效率和推理能力之间的权衡。 这种设定引出了一个核心问题：智能体如何动态选择一个既足以胜任当前生成步骤，又能保持计算高效的LLM？ 虽然模型级联为平衡这种权衡提供了一种实用的机制，但现有的路由策略通常依赖于静态启发式方法或外部控制器，并且没有明确考虑模型的不确定性。 我们引入了AdaptEvolve：一种自适应LLM选择方法，用于进化式顺序改进框架中的多LLM进化式改进，该方法利用内在生成置信度来估计实时可解性。 实验结果表明，置信度驱动的选择产生了一个有利的帕累托前沿，在基准测试中平均降低了37.9% 的总推理成本，同时保留了静态大型模型基线97.5% 的上限精度。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/raypretam/adaptive_llm_selection获取。
tldr: AdaptEvolve dynamically selects LLMs during evolutionary agent inference based on generation confidence, achieving a better trade-off between efficiency and accuracy compared to static or heuristic approaches. The method reduces inference costs by an average of 37.9% while maintaining high accuracy.
tldr_zh: AdaptEvolve 是一种基于生成置信度的动态 LLM 选择方法，用于进化代理推理，与静态或启发式方法相比，在效率和准确性之间实现了更好的权衡。该方法将推理成本平均降低了 37.9%，同时保持了较高的准确性。

title: Intelligent AI Delegation
summary: AI agents are able to tackle increasingly complex tasks. To achieve more ambitious goals, AI agents need to be able to meaningfully decompose problems into manageable sub-components, and safely delegate their completion across to other AI agents and humans alike. Yet, existing task decomposition and delegation methods rely on simple heuristics, and are not able to dynamically adapt to environmental changes and robustly handle unexpected failures. Here we propose an adaptive framework for intelligent AI delegation - a sequence of decisions involving task allocation, that also incorporates transfer of authority, responsibility, accountability, clear specifications regarding roles and boundaries, clarity of intent, and mechanisms for establishing trust between the two (or more) parties. The proposed framework is applicable to both human and AI delegators and delegatees in complex delegation networks, aiming to inform the development of protocols in the emerging agentic web.
summary_zh: 人工智能体能够处理日益复杂的任务。为了实现更宏伟的目标，人工智能体需要能够有意义地将问题分解为可管理的子组件，并将它们的完成安全地委托给其他人工智能体以及人类。然而，现有的任务分解和委托方法依赖于简单的启发式算法，并且无法动态地适应环境变化和稳健地处理意外故障。本文中，我们提出了一个用于智能人工智能委托的自适应框架——一个包含任务分配的决策序列，该序列还包括权力的转移、责任、可问责性、关于角色和界限的清晰规范、意图的清晰性以及在双方（或多方）之间建立信任的机制。所提出的框架适用于复杂委托网络中的人类和人工智能委托者及被委托者，旨在为新兴的主动代理网络中协议的开发提供信息。
tldr: This paper introduces an adaptive framework for intelligent AI delegation, addressing task decomposition and delegation in complex AI and human agent networks with a focus on dynamic adaptation and robustness. It appears relevant to the broader field of agent collaboration and task distribution.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个智能AI委托的自适应框架，旨在解决复杂AI和人类代理网络中的任务分解和委托问题，重点关注动态适应性和鲁棒性。它与代理协作和任务分配的更广泛领域相关。

title: Cooperation Breakdown in LLM Agents Under Communication Delays
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS), in which autonomous AI agents cooperate to solve tasks, are gaining increasing attention. For such systems to be deployed in society, agents must be able to establish cooperation and coordination under real-world computational and communication constraints. We propose the FLCOA framework (Five Layers for Cooperation/Coordination among Autonomous Agents) to conceptualize how cooperation and coordination emerge in groups of autonomous agents, and highlight that the influence of lower-layer factors - especially computational and communication resources - has been largely overlooked. To examine the effect of communication delay, we introduce a Continuous Prisoner's Dilemma with Communication Delay and conduct simulations with LLM-based agents. As delay increases, agents begin to exploit slower responses even without explicit instructions. Interestingly, excessive delay reduces cycles of exploitation, yielding a U-shaped relationship between delay magnitude and mutual cooperation. These results suggest that fostering cooperation requires attention not only to high-level institutional design but also to lower-layer factors such as communication delay and resource allocation, pointing to new directions for MAS research.
summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）正受到越来越多的关注，在该系统中，自主AI智能体协作解决任务。为了使此类系统能够在社会中部署，智能体必须能够在真实的计算和通信约束下建立合作和协调。我们提出了FLCOA框架（自主智能体间合作/协调的五层模型），以概念化自主智能体群体中合作和协调是如何产生的，并强调了底层因素——特别是计算和通信资源——的影响在很大程度上被忽视了。为了检验通信延迟的影响，我们引入了带有通信延迟的连续囚徒困境，并对基于LLM的智能体进行了模拟。 随着延迟的增加，智能体开始利用较慢的响应，即使没有明确的指示。 有趣的是，过度的延迟会减少剥削周期，从而产生延迟幅度与相互合作之间的U型关系。 这些结果表明，促进合作不仅需要关注高层制度设计，还需要关注底层因素，例如通信延迟和资源分配，这为MAS研究指明了新的方向。
tldr: This paper investigates the impact of communication delays on cooperation in multi-agent systems using LLM agents in a Continuous Prisoner's Dilemma, finding a U-shaped relationship between delay and cooperation.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了通信延迟对多智能体系统中LLM智能体合作的影响，通过连续囚徒困境，发现延迟与合作之间存在U型关系。

title: Provable Offline Reinforcement Learning for Structured Cyclic MDPs
summary: We introduce a novel cyclic Markov decision process (MDP) framework for multi-step decision problems with heterogeneous stage-specific dynamics, transitions, and discount factors across the cycle. In this setting, offline learning is challenging: optimizing a policy at any stage shifts the state distributions of subsequent stages, propagating mismatch across the cycle. To address this, we propose a modular structural framework that decomposes the cyclic process into stage-wise sub-problems. While generally applicable, we instantiate this principle as CycleFQI, an extension of fitted Q-iteration enabling theoretical analysis and interpretation. It uses a vector of stage-specific Q-functions, tailored to each stage, to capture within-stage sequences and transitions between stages. This modular design enables partial control, allowing some stages to be optimized while others follow predefined policies. We establish finite-sample suboptimality error bounds and derive global convergence rates under Besov regularity, demonstrating that CycleFQI mitigates the curse of dimensionality compared to monolithic baselines. Additionally, we propose a sieve-based method for asymptotic inference of optimal policy values under a margin condition. Experiments on simulated and real-world Type 1 Diabetes data sets demonstrate CycleFQI's effectiveness.
summary_zh: 我们引入了一种新颖的循环马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）框架，用于解决具有异构阶段特定动力学、转移概率和跨循环折扣因子的多步决策问题。 在这种情况下，离线学习面临挑战：在任何阶段优化策略都会改变后续阶段的状态分布，并在整个循环中传播不匹配。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种模块化的结构框架，将循环过程分解为阶段性的子问题。 虽然该框架具有普遍适用性，但我们将此原则实例化为CycleFQI，它是拟合Q迭代（fitted Q-iteration）的扩展，可以进行理论分析和解释。 它使用一个阶段特定的Q函数向量，专为每个阶段定制，以捕获阶段内的序列以及阶段之间的转移。这种模块化设计实现了局部控制，允许优化某些阶段的策略，而其他阶段遵循预定义的策略。我们建立了有限样本的次优性误差界，并在Besov正则性下推导出全局收敛速率，证明了CycleFQI相比于单体基线可以缓解维度诅咒。 此外，我们提出了一种基于筛法的渐近推理方法，用于在边际条件下推断最优策略值。在模拟和真实世界的一型糖尿病数据集上的实验证明了CycleFQI的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces CycleFQI, a modular offline reinforcement learning algorithm designed for cyclic MDPs with stage-specific dynamics, and provides theoretical guarantees and empirical validation on diabetes management.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 CycleFQI，一种专为具有阶段特定动态的循环 MDP 设计的模块化离线强化学习算法，并提供了理论保证和糖尿病管理方面的实证验证。

title: Human-Inspired Continuous Learning of Internal Reasoning Processes: Learning How to Think for Adaptive AI Systems
summary: Learning internal reasoning processes is crucial for developing AI systems capable of sustained adaptation in dynamic real-world environments. However, most existing approaches primarily emphasize learning task-specific outputs or static knowledge representations, while overlooking the continuous refinement of internal reasoning structures, action scheduling policies, and learning mechanisms themselves. In this paper, we propose a human-inspired continuous learning framework that unifies reasoning, action, reflection, and verification within a sequential reasoning model enhanced by parallel learning. The framework explicitly treats internal thinking processes as primary learning objects. It systematically records internal reasoning trajectories and environmental interactions as structured learning material, enabling the system to optimize not only task-level content but also the organization, scheduling, and evolution of reasoning activities. This design realizes learning alongside processing, allowing cognitive structures to improve during execution. Furthermore, the framework supports controlled replacement of predefined logic with learned procedures and introduces a hierarchical learning-to-learn mechanism that jointly adapts task-level parameters and learning strategies. As a result, the system progressively evolves its internal cognitive architecture while preserving operational stability. Experimental results on a temperature sensor abnormality detection task show that incorporating internal-process learning reduces average runtime by 23.9%.
summary_zh: 学习内部推理过程对于开发能够在动态现实环境中持续适应的人工智能系统至关重要。然而，现有的大多数方法主要强调学习特定于任务的输出或静态知识表示，而忽略了内部推理结构、行动调度策略和学习机制本身的持续改进。在本文中，我们提出了一种受人类启发的连续学习框架，该框架在并行学习增强的顺序推理模型中统一了推理、行动、反思和验证。该框架将内部思维过程明确地视为主要的学习对象。它系统地记录内部推理轨迹和环境交互作为结构化学习材料，使系统不仅能够优化任务级的内容，还能优化推理活动的组织、调度和演化。这种设计实现了伴随处理的学习，从而允许认知结构在执行过程中得到改进。此外，该框架支持用学习的程序替换预定义的逻辑，并引入了一种分层学习-去-学习机制，该机制联合调整任务级参数和学习策略。因此，系统在保持运行稳定性的同时，逐步演化其内部认知架构。在温度传感器异常检测任务上的实验结果表明，结合内部过程学习可将平均运行时间减少23.9%。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for AI systems to continuously learn and refine their internal reasoning processes, including action scheduling and learning mechanisms, leading to improved performance and efficiency. The proposed framework enables optimization of how the system thinks alongside task-level content.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个框架，使人工智能系统能够持续学习和改进其内部推理过程，包括行动调度和学习机制，从而提高性能和效率。该框架能够优化系统思考的方式，同时优化任务级内容。

title: Distributionally Robust Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Robust Value Factorization
summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) commonly adopts centralized training with decentralized execution, where value-factorization methods enforce the individual-global-maximum (IGM) principle so that decentralized greedy actions recover the team-optimal joint action. However, the reliability of this recipe in real-world settings remains unreliable due to environmental uncertainties arising from the sim-to-real gap, model mismatch, and system noise. We address this gap by introducing Distributionally robust IGM (DrIGM), a principle that requires each agent's robust greedy action to align with the robust team-optimal joint action. We show that DrIGM holds for a novel definition of robust individual action values, which is compatible with decentralized greedy execution and yields a provable robustness guarantee for the whole system. Building on this foundation, we derive DrIGM-compliant robust variants of existing value-factorization architectures (e.g., VDN/QMIX/QTRAN) that (i) train on robust Q-targets, (ii) preserve scalability, and (iii) integrate seamlessly with existing codebases without bespoke per-agent reward shaping. Empirically, on high-fidelity SustainGym simulators and a StarCraft game environment, our methods consistently improve out-of-distribution performance. Code and data are available at https://github.com/crqu/robust-coMARL.
summary_zh: 合作式多智能体强化学习(MARL)通常采用集中式训练和分散式执行，其中价值分解方法强制执行个体-全局-最大化(IGM)原则，以便分散式的贪婪动作能够恢复团队最优的联合动作。然而，由于来源于从仿真到真实环境的差距、模型不匹配和系统噪声等环境不确定性，这种方法在实际环境中的可靠性仍然不稳定。我们通过引入分布鲁棒IGM (DrIGM)来解决这一问题，该原则要求每个智能体的鲁棒贪婪动作与鲁棒的团队最优联合动作对齐。我们证明，DrIGM对于鲁棒个体动作价值的新定义成立，该定义与分散式贪婪执行兼容，并为整个系统提供可证明的鲁棒性保证。在此基础上，我们推导出与DrIGM兼容的现有价值分解架构(例如VDN/QMIX/QTRAN)的鲁棒变体，这些变体(i)基于鲁棒Q-目标进行训练，(ii)保持可扩展性，并且(iii)与现有代码库无缝集成，无需定制的每个智能体的奖励塑造。在真实度高的SustainGym模拟器和星际争霸游戏环境中进行的实证表明，我们的方法始终能够提高分布外(out-of-distribution)性能。代码和数据可在https://github.com/crqu/robust-coMARL上获取。
tldr: This paper introduces a Distributionally Robust Individual-Global-Maximum (DrIGM) principle for cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning to improve out-of-distribution performance in uncertain environments, and proposes DrIGM-compliant robust variants of existing value-factorization architectures.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于合作式多智能体强化学习的分布鲁棒个体-全局最大（DrIGM）原则，以提高在不确定环境中的分布外性能，并提出了与DrIGM兼容的现有价值分解架构的鲁棒变体。

title: TRACER: Trajectory Risk Aggregation for Critical Episodes in Agentic Reasoning
summary: Estimating uncertainty for AI agents in real-world multi-turn tool-using interaction with humans is difficult because failures are often triggered by sparse critical episodes (e.g., looping, incoherent tool use, or user-agent miscoordination) even when local generation appears confident. Existing uncertainty proxies focus on single-shot text generation and therefore miss these trajectory-level breakdown signals. We introduce TRACER, a trajectory-level uncertainty metric for dual-control Tool-Agent-User interaction. TRACER combines content-aware surprisal with situational-awareness signals, semantic and lexical repetition, and tool-grounded coherence gaps, and aggregates them using a tail-focused risk functional with a MAX-composite step risk to surface decisive anomalies. We evaluate TRACER on $τ^2$-bench by predicting task failure and selective task execution. To this end, TRACER improves AUROC by up to 37.1% and AUARC by up to 55% over baselines, enabling earlier and more accurate detection of uncertainty in complex conversational tool-use settings. Our code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/sinatayebati/agent-tracer.
summary_zh: 在与人类进行真实世界多轮工具使用交互中，为人工智能主体估计不确定性是困难的，因为即使局部生成看起来很自信，失败通常是由稀疏的关键事件触发的（例如，循环、不连贯的工具使用，或用户-主体不协调）。现有的不确定性代理主要关注单次文本生成，因此错过了这些轨迹级别的崩溃信号。我们引入了 TRACER，一种用于双控制工具-主体-用户交互的轨迹级别不确定性度量。TRACER 将内容感知的惊异度与情境感知信号、语义和词汇重复，以及工具关联的连贯性 gap 相结合，并使用尾部聚焦的风险泛函，结合 MAX 复合步骤风险来聚合它们，以突出决定性的异常。我们通过预测任务失败和选择性任务执行在 $τ^2$-bench 上评估 TRACER。为此，TRACER 相比基线提高了 AUROC 高达 37.1%，AUARC 高达 55%，从而能够在复杂的对话式工具使用环境中更早，更准确地检测不确定性。我们的代码和基准测试可在 https://github.com/sinatayebati/agent-tracer 上获取。
tldr: The paper introduces TRACER, a trajectory-level uncertainty metric for tool-using agents in human interaction, which combines various signals to detect critical failures, achieving significant improvement in predicting task failure compared to baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TRACER，一种用于人机交互工具使用代理的轨迹级不确定性度量指标，它结合了各种信号来检测关键故障，与基线相比，在预测任务失败方面取得了显著改进。

title: AssetFormer: Modular 3D Assets Generation with Autoregressive Transformer
summary: The digital industry demands high-quality, diverse modular 3D assets, especially for user-generated content~(UGC). In this work, we introduce AssetFormer, an autoregressive Transformer-based model designed to generate modular 3D assets from textual descriptions. Our pilot study leverages real-world modular assets collected from online platforms. AssetFormer tackles the challenge of creating assets composed of primitives that adhere to constrained design parameters for various applications. By innovatively adapting module sequencing and decoding techniques inspired by language models, our approach enhances asset generation quality through autoregressive modeling. Initial results indicate the effectiveness of AssetFormer in streamlining asset creation for professional development and UGC scenarios. This work presents a flexible framework extendable to various types of modular 3D assets, contributing to the broader field of 3D content generation. The code is available at https://github.com/Advocate99/AssetFormer.
summary_zh: 数字产业对高质量、多样化的模块化 3D 资产有着迫切需求，尤其是在用户生成内容 (UGC) 方面。 在这项工作中，我们推出 AssetFormer，一种基于自回归 Transformer 的模型，旨在从文本描述中生成模块化 3D 资产。 我们的初步研究利用了从在线平台收集的真实模块化资产。 AssetFormer 解决了创建由基元组成的资产的挑战，这些基元必须遵守各种应用的约束性设计参数。 通过创新性地调整受语言模型启发的模块序列化和解码技术，我们的方法通过自回归建模提高了资产生成质量。 初步结果表明，AssetFormer 在简化专业开发和 UGC 场景的资产创建方面是有效的。 这项工作提出了一个可扩展到各种类型模块化 3D 资产的灵活框架，为更广泛的 3D 内容生成领域做出了贡献。 代码见 https://github.com/Advocate99/AssetFormer。
tldr: AssetFormer is a Transformer-based model generating modular 3D assets from text, leveraging autoregressive modeling to improve asset quality for applications like UGC. The method's ability to generate constrained 3D assets from text descriptions could be beneficial for creating simulated environments for training embodied agents.
tldr_zh: AssetFormer是一个基于Transformer的模型，可以从文本生成模块化的3D资产，利用自回归建模来提高资产质量，适用于用户生成内容(UGC)等应用。该方法从文本描述生成约束3D资产的能力可能有利于创建用于训练具身智能体的模拟环境。

title: Efficient Segment Anything with Depth-Aware Fusion and Limited Training Data
summary: Segment Anything Models (SAM) achieve impressive universal segmentation performance but require massive datasets (e.g., 11M images) and rely solely on RGB inputs. Recent efficient variants reduce computation but still depend on large-scale training. We propose a lightweight RGB-D fusion framework that augments EfficientViT-SAM with monocular depth priors. Depth maps are generated with a pretrained estimator and fused mid-level with RGB features through a dedicated depth encoder. Trained on only 11.2k samples (less than 0.1\% of SA-1B), our method achieves higher accuracy than EfficientViT-SAM, showing that depth cues provide strong geometric priors for segmentation.
summary_zh: 分割一切模型（SAM）实现了令人印象深刻的通用分割性能，但需要海量数据集（例如，1100万张图像）并且仅依赖于RGB输入。近期的效率变体降低了计算量，但仍依赖于大规模训练。我们提出了一种轻量级的RGB-D融合框架，该框架使用单目深度先验来增强EfficientViT-SAM。深度图使用预训练的估计器生成，并通过专用深度编码器在中间层与RGB特征融合。仅在1.12万个样本（不到SA-1B的0.1％）上进行训练，我们的方法就实现了比EfficientViT-SAM更高的精度，表明深度线索为分割提供了强大的几何先验。
tldr: This paper introduces a lightweight RGB-D fusion framework to improve the efficiency of Segment Anything Models (SAM) by incorporating monocular depth priors and requiring significantly less training data.
