tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了一种轻量级的RGB-D融合框架，通过结合单目深度先验，提高了Segment Anything Models (SAM)的效率，并显著减少了所需的训练数据。

title: Move What Matters: Parameter-Efficient Domain Adaptation via Optimal Transport Flow for Collaborative Perception
summary: Fast domain adaptation remains a fundamental challenge for deploying multi-agent systems across diverse environments in Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) collaborative perception. Despite the success of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) in natural language processing and conventional vision tasks, directly applying PEFT to multi-agent settings leads to significant performance degradation and training instability. In this work, we conduct a detailed analysis and identify two key factors: (i) inter-frame redundancy in heterogeneous sensory streams, and (ii) erosion of fine-grained semantics in deep-layer representations under PEFT adaptation. To address these issues, we propose FlowAdapt, a parameter-efficient framework grounded in optimal transport theory, which minimizes information transport costs across both data distributions and network hierarchies. Specifically, we introduce a Wasserstein Greedy Sampling strategy to selectively filter redundant samples via a bounded covering radius. Furthermore, Progressive Knowledge Transfer module is designed to progressively inject compressed early-stage representations into later stages through learnable pathways, alleviating semantic degradation in late-stage adaptation. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that FlowAdapt achieves state-of-the-art performance with only 1% of trainable parameters, effectively bridging domain gaps with superior sample efficiency and generalization.
summary_zh: 快速领域适应仍然是车辆与一切互联（V2X）协同感知中，在多样化环境中部署多智能体系统的一项根本挑战。尽管参数高效微调（PEFT）在自然语言处理和传统视觉任务中取得了成功，但直接将PEFT应用于多智能体环境会导致显著的性能下降和训练不稳定。在这项工作中，我们进行了详细的分析，并确定了两个关键因素：（i）异构传感器流中的帧间冗余，以及（ii）PEFT适应下深层表示中细粒度语义的侵蚀。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了FlowAdapt，一个基于最优传输理论的参数高效框架，它最小化了数据分布和网络层次结构上的信息传输成本。具体而言，我们引入了一种 Wasserstein 贪婪采样策略，通过有界覆盖半径选择性地过滤冗余样本。此外，设计了渐进知识迁移模块，通过可学习的路径将压缩的早期阶段表示逐渐注入到后期阶段，以缓解后期阶段适应中的语义退化。在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，FlowAdapt仅用 1% 的可训练参数就实现了最先进的性能，有效地弥合了领域差距，并具有卓越的样本效率和泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces FlowAdapt, a parameter-efficient domain adaptation framework for collaborative perception in V2X systems, using optimal transport to address inter-frame redundancy and semantic degradation issues, achieving SOTA performance with minimal trainable parameters.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了FlowAdapt，一个参数高效的领域自适应框架，用于V2X系统中的协同感知。该方法利用最优传输理论解决帧间冗余和语义退化问题，并以极少的训练参数实现了最先进的性能。

title: Ctrl&Shift: High-Quality Geometry-Aware Object Manipulation in Visual Generation
summary: Object-level manipulation, relocating or reorienting objects in images or videos while preserving scene realism, is central to film post-production, AR, and creative editing. Yet existing methods struggle to jointly achieve three core goals: background preservation, geometric consistency under viewpoint shifts, and user-controllable transformations. Geometry-based approaches offer precise control but require explicit 3D reconstruction and generalize poorly; diffusion-based methods generalize better but lack fine-grained geometric control. We present Ctrl&Shift, an end-to-end diffusion framework to achieve geometry-consistent object manipulation without explicit 3D representations. Our key insight is to decompose manipulation into two stages, object removal and reference-guided inpainting under explicit camera pose control, and encode both within a unified diffusion process. To enable precise, disentangled control, we design a multi-task, multi-stage training strategy that separates background, identity, and pose signals across tasks. To improve generalization, we introduce a scalable real-world dataset construction pipeline that generates paired image and video samples with estimated relative camera poses. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Ctrl&Shift achieves state-of-the-art results in fidelity, viewpoint consistency, and controllability. To our knowledge, this is the first framework to unify fine-grained geometric control and real-world generalization for object manipulation, without relying on any explicit 3D modeling.
summary_zh: 目标级别的操控，即在图像或视频中重新定位或调整物体方向，同时保持场景的真实感，是电影后期制作、增强现实和创意编辑的核心。然而，现有方法难以同时实现三个核心目标：背景保持、视角变换下的几何一致性以及用户可控的变换。基于几何的方法能够提供精确的控制，但需要显式的3D重建，并且泛化能力较差；基于扩散模型的方法泛化能力较好，但缺乏细粒度的几何控制。我们提出 Ctrl&Shift，一个端到端扩散框架，无需显式的3D表示即可实现几何一致的物体操控。我们的关键洞察在于将操控分解为两个阶段：物体移除和显式相机姿态控制下的参考引导式图像修复，并将这两者编码在一个统一的扩散过程中。为实现精确的、解耦的控制，我们设计了一种多任务、多阶段的训练策略，将背景、身份和姿态信号在不同任务之间进行分离。为了提高泛化能力，我们引入了一种可扩展的真实世界数据集构建流程，生成带有估计的相对相机姿态的配对图像和视频样本。大量实验表明，Ctrl&Shift 在保真度、视角一致性和可控性方面均实现了最先进的结果。据我们所知，这是第一个统一了细粒度几何控制和真实世界泛化的物体操控框架，并且不依赖于任何显式的3D建模。
tldr: The paper introduces Ctrl&Shift, a diffusion-based framework for geometry-consistent object manipulation in images and videos, achieving state-of-the-art results in fidelity, viewpoint consistency, and controllability without explicit 3D modeling.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍Ctrl&Shift，一个基于扩散模型的框架，用于在图像和视频中实现几何一致的物体操作。该框架在保真度、视点一致性和可控性方面达到了最先进的水平，且无需显式的3D建模。

title: MDE-VIO: Enhancing Visual-Inertial Odometry Using Learned Depth Priors
summary: Traditional monocular Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO) systems struggle in low-texture environments where sparse visual features are insufficient for accurate pose estimation. To address this, dense Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) has been widely explored as a complementary information source. While recent Vision Transformer (ViT) based complex foundational models offer dense, geometrically consistent depth, their computational demands typically preclude them from real-time edge deployment. Our work bridges this gap by integrating learned depth priors directly into the VINS-Mono optimization backend. We propose a novel framework that enforces affine-invariant depth consistency and pairwise ordinal constraints, explicitly filtering unstable artifacts via variance-based gating. This approach strictly adheres to the computational limits of edge devices while robustly recovering metric scale. Extensive experiments on the TartanGround and M3ED datasets demonstrate that our method prevents divergence in challenging scenarios and delivers significant accuracy gains, reducing Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) by up to 28.3%. Code will be made available.
summary_zh: 传统单目视觉惯性里程计（VIO）系统在低纹理环境中表现不佳，因为稀疏的视觉特征不足以进行精确的位姿估计。为了解决这个问题，密集的单目深度估计（MDE）已被广泛探索作为一种补充信息来源。虽然最近基于视觉Transformer（ViT）的复杂基础模型提供了密集、几何一致的深度信息，但它们的计算需求通常使其无法在实时边缘部署中使用。我们的工作通过将学习到的深度先验直接集成到VINS-Mono优化后端来弥合这一差距。我们提出了一种新颖的框架，该框架强制执行仿射不变的深度一致性和成对序数约束，并通过基于方差的门控显式地过滤不稳定的伪影。这种方法严格遵守边缘设备的计算限制，同时稳健地恢复尺度。在TartanGround和M3ED数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法可以防止在具有挑战性的场景中出现发散，并显著提高精度，将绝对轨迹误差（ATE）降低高达28.3%。代码将会开源。
tldr: This paper introduces a method to enhance Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO) in low-texture environments by integrating learned depth priors into the VINS-Mono backend, achieving real-time performance on edge devices with improved accuracy and robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过将学习到的深度先验知识整合到 VINS-Mono 后端来增强低纹理环境中的视觉惯性里程计 (VIO) 的方法，从而在边缘设备上实现实时性能，并提高准确性和鲁棒性。

title: Few-Shot Design Optimization by Exploiting Auxiliary Information
summary: Many real-world design problems involve optimizing an expensive black-box function $f(x)$, such as hardware design or drug discovery. Bayesian Optimization has emerged as a sample-efficient framework for this problem. However, the basic setting considered by these methods is simplified compared to real-world experimental setups, where experiments often generate a wealth of useful information. We introduce a new setting where an experiment generates high-dimensional auxiliary information $h(x)$ along with the performance measure $f(x)$; moreover, a history of previously solved tasks from the same task family is available for accelerating optimization. A key challenge of our setting is learning how to represent and utilize $h(x)$ for efficiently solving new optimization tasks beyond the task history. We develop a novel approach for this setting based on a neural model which predicts $f(x)$ for unseen designs given a few-shot context containing observations of $h(x)$. We evaluate our method on two challenging domains, robotic hardware design and neural network hyperparameter tuning, and introduce a novel design problem and large-scale benchmark for the former. On both domains, our method utilizes auxiliary feedback effectively to achieve more accurate few-shot prediction and faster optimization of design tasks, significantly outperforming several methods for multi-task optimization.
summary_zh: 许多现实世界的设计问题都涉及优化一个昂贵的黑盒函数 $f(x)$，例如硬件设计或药物发现。贝叶斯优化已经成为解决此类问题的一种具有样本效率的框架。然而，这些方法所考虑的基本设置相对于真实的实验设置而言过于简化，因为实验通常产生大量有用的信息。我们引入一个新的设置，其中实验产生高维辅助信息 $h(x)$ 以及性能指标 $f(x)$；此外，还可以利用同一任务族中先前已解决任务的历史记录来加速优化。我们这一设置的一个关键挑战是如何学习表示和利用 $h(x)$，从而在任务历史之外高效地解决新的优化任务。我们基于神经模型为此设置开发了一种新方法，该神经模型能够在给定包含 $h(x)$ 观测值的少量样本上下文的情况下，预测未见设计的 $f(x)$。我们在两个具有挑战性的领域，即机器人硬件设计和神经网络超参数调优方面评估了我们的方法，并为前者引入了一个新的设计问题和大规模基准。在这两个领域，我们的方法都能有效地利用辅助反馈，从而实现更准确的少量样本预测和更快的设计任务优化，显著优于几种多任务优化方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a new Bayesian Optimization setting for expensive black-box function optimization utilizing high-dimensional auxiliary information and task history. They propose a neural model for few-shot prediction and demonstrate its effectiveness in robotic hardware design and hyperparameter tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的贝叶斯优化设置，用于利用高维辅助信息和任务历史优化昂贵的黑盒函数。他们提出了一种用于少样本预测的神经模型，并在机器人硬件设计和超参数调整中证明了其有效性。

title: Improving HPC Code Generation Capability of LLMs via Online Reinforcement Learning with Real-Machine Benchmark Rewards
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong code generation capabilities, yet the runtime performance of generated code is not guaranteed, and there have been few attempts to train LLMs using runtime performance as a reward in the HPC domain. We propose an online reinforcement learning approach that executes LLM-generated code on a supercomputer and directly feeds back the measured runtime performance (GFLOPS) as a reward. We further introduce a Staged Quality-Diversity (SQD) algorithm that progressively varies the permitted optimization techniques on a per-problem basis, enabling the model to learn code optimization from diverse perspectives. We build a distributed system connecting a GPU training cluster with a CPU benchmarking cluster, and train Qwen2.5 Coder 14B on a double-precision matrix multiplication task using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Through two experiments, we show that reinforcement learning combining runtime performance feedback with staged optimization can improve the HPC code generation capability of LLMs.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已展现出强大的代码生成能力，但生成代码的运行时性能却无法得到保证，且鲜有尝试在高性能计算（HPC）领域中使用运行时性能作为奖励来训练LLMs。我们提出了一种在线强化学习方法，该方法在超级计算机上执行LLM生成的代码，并将测量的运行时性能（GFLOPS）直接反馈作为奖励。我们进一步引入了一种分阶段质量-多样性（SQD）算法，该算法在每个问题基础上逐步改变允许的优化技术，使模型能够从不同的角度学习代码优化。我们构建了一个分布式系统，将GPU训练集群与CPU基准测试集群相连接，并使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）在双精度矩阵乘法任务上训练Qwen2.5 Coder 14B。通过两个实验，我们证明了将运行时性能反馈与分阶段优化相结合的强化学习可以提高LLMs的高性能计算代码生成能力。
tldr: This paper presents an online reinforcement learning approach to train LLMs for HPC code generation using runtime performance as a reward, incorporating a staged quality-diversity algorithm for code optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在线强化学习方法，利用运行时性能作为奖励来训练LLM进行HPC代码生成，并结合分阶段质量多样性算法进行代码优化。

title: FedGRPO: Privately Optimizing Foundation Models with Group-Relative Rewards from Domain Client
summary: One important direction of Federated Foundation Models (FedFMs) is leveraging data from small client models to enhance the performance of a large server-side foundation model. Existing methods based on model level or representation level knowledge transfer either require expensive local training or incur high communication costs and introduce unavoidable privacy risks. We reformulate this problem as a reinforcement learning style evaluation process and propose FedGRPO, a privacy preserving framework comprising two modules. The first module performs competence-based expert selection by building a lightweight confidence graph from auxiliary data to identify the most suitable clients for each question. The second module leverages the "Group Relative" concept from the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework by packaging each question together with its solution rationale into candidate policies, dispatching these policies to a selected subset of expert clients, and aggregating solely the resulting scalar reward signals via a federated group-relative loss function. By exchanging reward values instead of data or model updates, FedGRPO reduces privacy risk and communication overhead while enabling parallel evaluation across heterogeneous devices. Empirical results on diverse domain tasks demonstrate that FedGRPO achieves superior downstream accuracy and communication efficiency compared to conventional FedFMs baselines.
summary_zh: 联邦基础模型（FedFMs）的一个重要方向是利用小型客户端模型的数据来增强大型服务器端基础模型的性能。现有的基于模型层面或表示层面知识迁移的方法要么需要昂贵的本地训练，要么产生高昂的通信成本，并引入不可避免的隐私风险。我们将此问题重新定义为一个强化学习风格的评估过程，并提出了FedGRPO，一个包含两个模块的隐私保护框架。第一个模块通过从辅助数据构建轻量级置信图来执行基于能力的专家选择，从而为每个问题识别最合适的客户端。第二个模块利用Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)框架中的“群体相对”概念，将每个问题及其解决方案原理打包成候选策略，并将这些策略分派到选定的专家客户端子集，并通过联邦群体相对损失函数聚合仅由此产生的标量奖励信号。通过交换奖励值而不是数据或模型更新，FedGRPO降低了隐私风险和通信开销，同时实现了异构设备上的并行评估。在不同领域任务上的实证结果表明，与传统的FedFMs基线相比，FedGRPO实现了卓越的下游精度和通信效率。
tldr: The paper introduces FedGRPO, a privacy-preserving federated learning framework for optimizing foundation models using group-relative rewards from domain client feedback, achieving better accuracy and communication efficiency compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了FedGRPO，一个隐私保护的联邦学习框架，通过利用领域客户端的组相对奖励来优化基础模型，相比现有方法，实现了更高的准确性和通信效率。

title: Temporal Difference Learning with Constrained Initial Representations
summary: Recently, there have been numerous attempts to enhance the sample efficiency of off-policy reinforcement learning (RL) agents when interacting with the environment, including architecture improvements and new algorithms. Despite these advances, they overlook the potential of directly constraining the initial representations of the input data, which can intuitively alleviate the distribution shift issue and stabilize training. In this paper, we introduce the Tanh function into the initial layer to fulfill such a constraint. We theoretically unpack the convergence property of the temporal difference learning with the Tanh function under linear function approximation. Motivated by theoretical insights, we present our Constrained Initial Representations framework, tagged CIR, which is made up of three components: (i) the Tanh activation along with normalization methods to stabilize representations; (ii) the skip connection module to provide a linear pathway from the shallow layer to the deep layer; (iii) the convex Q-learning that allows a more flexible value estimate and mitigates potential conservatism. Empirical results show that CIR exhibits strong performance on numerous continuous control tasks, even being competitive or surpassing existing strong baseline methods.
summary_zh: 近年来，出现了很多尝试提升离策略强化学习（RL）智能体与环境交互时的样本效率的方法，包括架构改进和新算法。尽管取得了这些进展，但它们忽略了直接约束输入数据的初始表征的潜力，而这直观上可以缓解分布偏移问题并稳定训练。在本文中，我们引入Tanh函数到初始层以实现这种约束。我们从理论上分析了在线性函数逼近下，带Tanh函数的时间差分学习的收敛性。受到理论洞见的启发，我们提出了我们的约束初始表征框架，标记为CIR，它由三个部分组成：（i）Tanh激活函数及规范化方法，以稳定表征；（ii）跳跃连接模块，提供从浅层到深层的线性通路；（iii）凸Q学习，允许更灵活的价值估计并减轻潜在的保守性。实验结果表明，CIR在许多连续控制任务上表现出强大的性能，甚至可以与现有的强大基线方法竞争或超越这些方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a Constrained Initial Representations (CIR) framework for off-policy RL, using a Tanh function and other components to improve sample efficiency and stabilize training, achieving competitive performance on continuous control tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于离策略强化学习的约束初始表示（CIR）框架，该框架使用Tanh函数和其他组件来提高样本效率并稳定训练，在连续控制任务上实现了有竞争力的性能。

title: Partial GFlowNet: Accelerating Convergence in Large State Spaces via Strategic Partitioning
summary: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) have shown promising potential to generate high-scoring candidates with probability proportional to their rewards. As existing GFlowNets freely explore in state space, they encounter significant convergence challenges when scaling to large state spaces. Addressing this issue, this paper proposes to restrict the exploration of actor. A planner is introduced to partition the entire state space into overlapping partial state spaces. Given their limited size, these partial state spaces allow the actor to efficiently identify subregions with higher rewards. A heuristic strategy is introduced to switch partial regions thus preventing the actor from wasting time exploring fully explored or low-reward partial regions. By iteratively exploring these partial state spaces, the actor learns to converge towards the high-reward subregions within the entire state space. Experiments on several widely used datasets demonstrate that \modelname converges faster than existing works on large state spaces. Furthermore, \modelname not only generates candidates with higher rewards but also significantly improves their diversity.
summary_zh: 生成流网络（GFlowNets）已经在生成概率与其回报成比例的高分候选者方面显示出很有希望的潜力。由于现有的GFlowNets在状态空间中自由探索，因此在扩展到大型状态空间时，它们会遇到显著的收敛挑战。为了解决这个问题，本文提出限制actor的探索。引入一个规划器，将整个状态空间划分为重叠的部分状态空间。鉴于其有限的尺寸，这些部分状态空间允许actor有效地识别具有更高回报的子区域。引入一种启发式策略来切换部分区域，从而防止actor浪费时间探索已充分探索或低回报的部分区域。通过迭代地探索这些部分状态空间，actor学习收敛到整个状态空间内的高回报子区域。在几个广泛使用的数据集上的实验表明，\modelname比现有工作在大型状态空间上收敛得更快。此外，\modelname不仅生成具有更高回报的候选者，而且还显著提高了它们的多样性。
tldr: This paper introduces Partial GFlowNet, a method to accelerate GFlowNet convergence in large state spaces by partitioning the space and strategically switching between regions. It claims faster convergence, higher rewards, and improved diversity in generated candidates.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了Partial GFlowNet，通过划分状态空间并策略性地切换区域来加速GFlowNet在大型状态空间中的收敛。它声称在生成的候选者中实现了更快的收敛速度、更高的奖励以及改进的多样性。

title: Optimizing Agent Planning for Security and Autonomy
summary: Indirect prompt injection attacks threaten AI agents that execute consequential actions, motivating deterministic system-level defenses. Such defenses can provably block unsafe actions by enforcing confidentiality and integrity policies, but currently appear costly: they reduce task completion rates and increase token usage compared to probabilistic defenses. We argue that existing evaluations miss a key benefit of system-level defenses: reduced reliance on human oversight. We introduce autonomy metrics to quantify this benefit: the fraction of consequential actions an agent can execute without human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval while preserving security. To increase autonomy, we design a security-aware agent that (i) introduces richer HITL interactions, and (ii) explicitly plans for both task progress and policy compliance. We implement this agent design atop an existing information-flow control defense against prompt injection and evaluate it on the AgentDojo and WASP benchmarks. Experiments show that this approach yields higher autonomy without sacrificing utility.
summary_zh: 间接提示注入攻击威胁着执行重要行动的AI智能体，因此需要确定性的系统级防御。 这种防御可以通过强制执行保密性和完整性策略来可靠地阻止不安全的行为，但目前看来代价高昂：与概率性防御相比，它们降低了任务完成率并增加了token使用量。我们认为，现有的评估忽略了系统级防御的一个关键优势：减少对人工监督的依赖。我们引入自主性指标来量化这一优势：在保持安全性的前提下，智能体无需人工干预(HITL)许可即可执行的重要行动的比例。为了提高自主性，我们设计了一个具有安全意识的智能体，该智能体（i）引入更丰富的HITL交互，以及（ii）明确规划任务进度和策略合规性。我们在现有的针对提示注入的信息流控制防御之上实施此智能体设计，并在AgentDojo和WASP基准测试上对其进行评估。实验表明，这种方法可在不牺牲效用的情况下产生更高的自主性。
tldr: This paper introduces a security-aware agent that optimizes autonomy by planning for both task progress and policy compliance, evaluated with increased autonomy without sacrificing utility on standard benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种安全感知代理，通过规划任务进度和策略合规性来优化自主性，并在标准基准上评估其自主性，而无需牺牲实用性。

title: Provably Efficient Algorithms for S- and Non-Rectangular Robust MDPs with General Parameterization
summary: We study robust Markov decision processes (RMDPs) with general policy parameterization under s-rectangular and non-rectangular uncertainty sets. Prior work is largely limited to tabular policies, and hence either lacks sample complexity guarantees or incurs high computational cost. Our method reduces the average reward RMDPs to entropy-regularized discounted robust MDPs, restoring strong duality and enabling tractable equilibrium computation. We prove novel Lipschitz and Lipschitz-smoothness properties for general policy parameterizations that extends to infinite state spaces. To address infinite-horizon gradient estimation, we introduce a multilevel Monte Carlo gradient estimator with $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity, a factor of $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-2})$ improvement over prior work. Building on this, we design a projected gradient descent algorithm for s-rectangular uncertainty ($\mathcal{O}(ε^{-5})$) and a Frank--Wolfe algorithm for non-rectangular uncertainty ($\mathcal{O}(ε^{-4})$ discounted, $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-10.5})$ average reward), significantly improving prior results in both the discounted setting and average reward setting. Our work is the first one to provide sample complexity guarantees for RMDPs with general policy parameterization beyond $(s, a)$-rectangularity. It also provides the first such guarantees in the average reward setting and improves existing bounds for discounted robust MDPs.
summary_zh: 我们研究了具有一般策略参数化下的稳健马尔可夫决策过程（RMDPs），包括s-矩形和非矩形不确定性集合。先前的工作在很大程度上局限于表格型策略，因此要么缺乏样本复杂度保证，要么导致高昂的计算成本。我们的方法将平均奖励RMDPs转化为熵正则化的折扣稳健MDPs，从而恢复了强对偶性，并实现了易于处理的均衡计算。我们证明了对于一般策略参数化的新的 Lipschitz 和 Lipschitz 光滑性属性，该属性可扩展到无限状态空间。为了解决无限视界梯度估计问题，我们引入了一种多层蒙特卡洛梯度估计器，其样本复杂度为 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-2})$，比先前的工作提高了 $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-2})$ 倍。在此基础上，我们为 s-矩形不确定性设计了一种投影梯度下降算法（$\mathcal{O}(ε^{-5})$），并为非矩形不确定性设计了一种 Frank--Wolfe 算法（折扣奖励 $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-4})$，平均奖励 $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-10.5})$），显著改进了折扣设置和平均奖励设置中的先前结果。我们的工作是第一个为除 $(s, a)$-矩形性之外的具有一般策略参数化的 RMDPs 提供样本复杂度保证的工作。它还提供了第一个平均奖励设置中的此类保证，并改进了现有折扣稳健 MDPs 的界限。
tldr: This paper proposes provably efficient algorithms for robust MDPs with general policy parameterization, improving sample complexity in both discounted and average reward settings, including the first such guarantees beyond (s, a)-rectangularity and in the average reward setting.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了针对具有通用策略参数化的鲁棒MDP的高效算法，改进了折扣和平均奖励环境下的样本复杂度，包括在(s, a)-矩形之外和平均奖励环境中的第一个此类保证。

title: Decentralized Multi-Robot Obstacle Detection and Tracking in a Maritime Scenario
summary: Autonomous aerial-surface robot teams are promising for maritime monitoring. Robust deployment requires reliable perception over reflective water and scalable coordination under limited communication. We present a decentralized multi-robot framework for detecting and tracking floating containers using multiple UAVs cooperating with an autonomous surface vessel. Each UAV performs YOLOv8 and stereo-disparity-based visual detection, then tracks targets with per-object EKFs using uncertainty-aware data association. Compact track summaries are exchanged and fused conservatively via covariance intersection, ensuring consistency under unknown correlations. An information-driven assignment module allocates targets and selects UAV hover viewpoints by trading expected uncertainty reduction against travel effort and safety separation. Simulation results in a maritime scenario demonstrate improved coverage, localization accuracy, and tracking consistency while maintaining modest communication requirements.
summary_zh:
以下是翻译结果：

自主水空机器人团队在海洋监测方面具有广阔前景。鲁棒的部署需要对反射水面的可靠感知以及在有限通信下的可扩展协调。我们提出了一种去中心化的多机器人框架，用于利用多个无人机与自主水面船只合作，探测和跟踪漂浮集装箱。每个无人机执行YOLOv8和基于立体视差的视觉检测，然后使用基于物体卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）并采用不确定性感知的数据关联来跟踪目标。紧凑的轨迹摘要通过协方差交叉（covariance intersection）进行保守的交换和融合，从而确保在未知相关性下的数据一致性。一个信息驱动的分配模块通过权衡预期不确定性降低与行程努力和安全间距，来分配目标并选择无人机的悬停视点。海上场景的仿真结果表明，在保持适度通信需求的同时，覆盖范围、定位精度和跟踪一致性均得到改善。
tldr: This paper presents a decentralized multi-robot framework using UAVs and an autonomous surface vessel for detecting and tracking floating containers in a maritime environment, using YOLOv8, EKFs, and information-driven assignment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分散式多机器人框架，该框架使用无人机和自主水面舰艇来检测和跟踪海上环境中的漂浮集装箱，使用YOLOv8、EKF和信息驱动的分配。

title: PhyNiKCE: A Neurosymbolic Agentic Framework for Autonomous Computational Fluid Dynamics
summary: The deployment of autonomous agents for Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), is critically limited by the probabilistic nature of Large Language Models (LLMs), which struggle to enforce the strict conservation laws and numerical stability required for physics-based simulations. Reliance on purely semantic Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) often leads to "context poisoning," where agents generate linguistically plausible but physically invalid configurations due to a fundamental Semantic-Physical Disconnect. To bridge this gap, this work introduces PhyNiKCE (Physical and Numerical Knowledgeable Context Engineering), a neurosymbolic agentic framework for trustworthy engineering. Unlike standard black-box agents, PhyNiKCE decouples neural planning from symbolic validation. It employs a Symbolic Knowledge Engine that treats simulation setup as a Constraint Satisfaction Problem, rigidly enforcing physical constraints via a Deterministic RAG Engine with specialized retrieval strategies for solvers, turbulence models, and boundary conditions. Validated through rigorous OpenFOAM experiments on practical, non-tutorial CFD tasks using Gemini-2.5-Pro/Flash, PhyNiKCE demonstrates a 96% relative improvement over state-of-the-art baselines. Furthermore, by replacing trial-and-error with knowledge-driven initialization, the framework reduced autonomous self-correction loops by 59% while simultaneously lowering LLM token consumption by 17%. These results demonstrate that decoupling neural generation from symbolic constraint enforcement significantly enhances robustness and efficiency. While validated on CFD, this architecture offers a scalable, auditable paradigm for Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence in broader industrial automation.
summary_zh: 用于计算流体动力学（CFD）的自主智能体的部署受到大语言模型（LLM）概率性质的严重限制，因为它们难以执行基于物理仿真的严格守恒定律和数值稳定性要求。仅仅依赖语义检索增强生成（RAG）常常导致“上下文污染”，即智能体生成语言上看似合理但物理上无效的配置，这是由于根本性的语义-物理脱节造成的。为了弥合这一差距，本研究引入了PhyNiKCE（物理与数值知识化上下文工程），这是一个用于可信工程的神经符号智能体框架。与标准的黑盒智能体不同，PhyNiKCE将神经规划与符号验证解耦。它采用一个符号知识引擎，将仿真设置视为一个约束满足问题，通过具有专业检索策略（用于求解器、湍流模型和边界条件）的确定性RAG引擎，严格执行物理约束。通过使用Gemini-2.5-Pro/Flash在实际的、非教程CFD任务上进行的严格OpenFOAM实验验证，PhyNiKCE比最先进的基线方法表现出96%的相对改进。此外，通过用知识驱动的初始化代替试错法，该框架将自主自纠正循环减少了59%，同时降低了17%的LLM Token消耗。这些结果表明，将神经生成与符号约束执行解耦可以显著提高鲁棒性和效率。虽然在CFD上进行了验证，但这种架构为更广泛的工业自动化领域中的可信人工智能提供了一个可扩展、可审计的范例。
tldr: PhyNiKCE is a neurosymbolic framework that improves the accuracy and efficiency of autonomous agents for CFD by decoupling neural planning from symbolic validation and enforcing physical constraints.
tldr_zh: PhyNiKCE是一个神经符号框架，通过将神经规划与符号验证分离并强制执行物理约束，提高了用于CFD的自主代理的准确性和效率。

title: How to Sample High Quality 3D Fractals for Action Recognition Pre-Training?
summary: Synthetic datasets are being recognized in the deep learning realm as a valuable alternative to exhaustively labeled real data. One such synthetic data generation method is Formula Driven Supervised Learning (FDSL), which can provide an infinite number of perfectly labeled data through a formula driven approach, such as fractals or contours. FDSL does not have common drawbacks like manual labor, privacy and other ethical concerns. In this work we generate 3D fractals using 3D Iterated Function Systems (IFS) for pre-training an action recognition model. The fractals are temporally transformed to form a video that is used as a pre-training dataset for downstream task of action recognition. We find that standard methods of generating fractals are slow and produce degenerate 3D fractals. Therefore, we systematically explore alternative ways of generating fractals and finds that overly-restrictive approaches, while generating aesthetically pleasing fractals, are detrimental for downstream task performance. We propose a novel method, Targeted Smart Filtering, to address both the generation speed and fractal diversity issue. The method reports roughly 100 times faster sampling speed and achieves superior downstream performance against other 3D fractal filtering methods.
summary_zh: 合成数据集正逐渐被深度学习领域认可为一种替代详尽标注的真实数据的有价值方案。其中一种合成数据生成方法是公式驱动的监督学习 (FDSL)，它可以通过公式驱动的方式，如分形或轮廓，提供无限数量的完美标注数据。FDSL 不存在人工劳动、隐私和其他伦理问题等常见缺点。在这项工作中，我们使用 3D 迭代函数系统 (IFS) 生成 3D 分形来预训练一个动作识别模型。这些分形经过时间变换形成视频，用作动作识别下游任务的预训练数据集。我们发现，生成分形的标准方法速度慢且会产生退化的 3D 分形。因此，我们系统地探索了生成分形的替代方法，并发现过于严格的方法虽然能生成美观的分形，但对下游任务的性能不利。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，称为定向智能过滤，以解决生成速度和分形多样性问题。该方法报告了大约快 100 倍的采样速度，并实现了优于其他 3D 分形过滤方法的下游性能。
tldr: This paper presents a novel method called Targeted Smart Filtering for generating 3D fractals for action recognition pre-training, achieving faster sampling speeds and superior downstream performance compared to other fractal filtering methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为“目标智能过滤”的新方法，用于生成用于动作识别预训练的3D分形，与其他分形过滤方法相比，该方法实现了更快的采样速度和更优越的下游性能。

title: From Circuits to Dynamics: Understanding and Stabilizing Failure in 3D Diffusion Transformers
summary: Reliable surface completion from sparse point clouds underpins many applications spanning content creation and robotics. While 3D diffusion transformers attain state-of-the-art results on this task, we uncover that they exhibit a catastrophic mode of failure: arbitrarily small on-surface perturbations to the input point cloud can fracture the output into multiple disconnected pieces -- a phenomenon we call Meltdown. Using activation-patching from mechanistic interpretability, we localize Meltdown to a single early denoising cross-attention activation. We find that the singular-value spectrum of this activation provides a scalar proxy: its spectral entropy rises when fragmentation occurs and returns to baseline when patched. Interpreted through diffusion dynamics, we show that this proxy tracks a symmetry-breaking bifurcation of the reverse process. Guided by this insight, we introduce PowerRemap, a test-time control that stabilizes sparse point-cloud conditioning. We demonstrate that Meltdown persists across state-of-the-art architectures (WaLa, Make-a-Shape), datasets (GSO, SimJEB) and denoising strategies (DDPM, DDIM), and that PowerRemap effectively counters this failure with stabilization rates of up to 98.3%. Overall, this work is a case study on how diffusion model behavior can be understood and guided based on mechanistic analysis, linking a circuit-level cross-attention mechanism to diffusion-dynamics accounts of trajectory bifurcations.
summary_zh: 从稀疏点云进行可靠的表面补全支撑着内容创作和机器人领域的诸多应用。虽然3D扩散Transformer在这项任务上取得了最先进的结果，但我们发现它们表现出一种灾难性的失效模式：输入点云上任意小的表面扰动都可能使输出破碎成多个不连通的部分——我们称之为“熔毁”。利用来自机制可解释性的激活补丁技术，我们将“熔毁”定位到单个早期去噪交叉注意力激活。我们发现，该激活的奇异值谱提供了一个标量代理：其谱熵在分段发生时升高，并在打补丁时恢复到基线水平。通过扩散动力学解释，我们表明该代理跟踪了逆过程的一个对称性破缺分叉。受此启发，我们引入了PowerRemap，这是一种测试时控件，用于稳定稀疏点云条件反射。我们证明了“熔毁”在最先进的架构（WaLa、Make-a-Shape）、数据集（GSO、SimJEB）和去噪策略（DDPM、DDIM）中持续存在，并且PowerRemap通过高达98.3%的稳定率有效地克服了这种失效。总而言之，这项工作是一个案例研究，展示了扩散模型行为如何基于机制分析来理解和引导，将电路级的交叉注意力机制与关于轨迹分叉的扩散动力学解释联系起来。
tldr: The paper identifies and mitigates a fragility (Meltdown) in 3D diffusion transformers for surface completion, linking it to a cross-attention mechanism and diffusion dynamics, and proposes a stabilization method (PowerRemap).
tldr_zh: 该论文发现并缓解了3D扩散Transformer用于表面补全时的一种缺陷（Meltdown），将其与交叉注意力机制和扩散动力学联系起来，并提出了一种稳定方法（PowerRemap）。

title: Convex Markov Games and Beyond: New Proof of Existence, Characterization and Learning Algorithms for Nash Equilibria
summary: Convex Markov Games (cMGs) were recently introduced as a broad class of multi-agent learning problems that generalize Markov games to settings where strategic agents optimize general utilities beyond additive rewards. While cMGs expand the modeling frontier, their theoretical foundations, particularly the structure of Nash equilibria (NE) and guarantees for learning algorithms, are not yet well understood. In this work, we address these gaps for an extension of cMGs, which we term General Utility Markov Games (GUMGs), capturing new applications requiring coupling between agents' occupancy measures. We prove that in GUMGs, Nash equilibria coincide with the fixed points of projected pseudo-gradient dynamics (i.e., first-order stationary points), enabled by a novel agent-wise gradient domination property. This insight also yields a simple proof of NE existence using Brouwer's fixed-point theorem. We further show the existence of Markov perfect equilibria. Building on this characterization, we establish a policy gradient theorem for GUMGs and design a model-free policy gradient algorithm. For potential GUMGs, we establish iteration complexity guarantees for computing approximate-NE under exact gradients and provide sample complexity bounds in both the generative model and on-policy settings. Our results extend beyond prior work restricted to zero-sum cMGs, providing the first theoretical analysis of common-interest cMGs.
summary_zh: 凸马尔可夫博弈（cMGs）最近被引入，作为一种广泛的多智能体学习问题，它将马尔可夫博弈推广到博弈参与者优化超出加性奖励的一般效用的环境。尽管cMGs扩展了建模的前沿，但它们的理论基础，特别是纳什均衡（NE）的结构以及学习算法的保证，尚未得到充分理解。在这项工作中，我们针对cMGs的扩展形式，即一般效用马尔可夫博弈（GUMGs），填补了这些空白，它捕捉了需要智能体占用度量之间耦合的新应用。我们证明了在GUMGs中，纳什均衡与投影伪梯度动力学的固定点（即，一阶静止点）重合，这得益于一种新颖的智能体层面的梯度支配性质。这一洞见也促成了一种使用布劳威尔不动点定理证明纳什均衡存在性的简单方法。我们进一步证明了马尔可夫完美均衡的存在性。基于这一表征，我们建立了GUMGs的策略梯度定理，并设计了一种无模型的策略梯度算法。对于势GUMGs，我们建立了在精确梯度下计算近似纳什均衡的迭代复杂性保证，并在生成模型和在线策略设置中提供了样本复杂性界限。我们的结果超越了先前局限于零和cMGs的工作，提供了对共同利益cMGs的首次理论分析。
tldr: This paper introduces General Utility Markov Games (GUMGs), an extension of Convex Markov Games, proves Nash equilibria properties, derives a policy gradient theorem, and provides learning algorithm analysis, including complexity guarantees.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了通用效用马尔可夫博弈（GUMGs），它是凸马尔可夫博弈的扩展。论文证明了纳什均衡性质，推导了策略梯度定理，并提供了学习算法分析，包括复杂性保证。

title: A$^{2}$V-SLP: Alignment-Aware Variational Modeling for Disentangled Sign Language Production
summary: Building upon recent structural disentanglement frameworks for sign language production, we propose A$^{2}$V-SLP, an alignment-aware variational framework that learns articulator-wise disentangled latent distributions rather than deterministic embeddings. A disentangled Variational Autoencoder (VAE) encodes ground-truth sign pose sequences and extracts articulator-specific mean and variance vectors, which are used as distributional supervision for training a non-autoregressive Transformer. Given text embeddings, the Transformer predicts both latent means and log-variances, while the VAE decoder reconstructs the final sign pose sequences through stochastic sampling at the decoding stage. This formulation maintains articulator-level representations by avoiding deterministic latent collapse through distributional latent modeling. In addition, we integrate a gloss attention mechanism to strengthen alignment between linguistic input and articulated motion. Experimental results show consistent gains over deterministic latent regression, achieving state-of-the-art back-translation performance and improved motion realism in a fully gloss-free setting.
summary_zh: 我们提出了A$^{2}$V-SLP，这是一种对齐感知的变分框架，基于近期的手语生成结构解耦框架构建，它学习关节级别的解耦潜在分布，而非确定性嵌入。 一个解耦的变分自编码器（VAE）编码真实的手语姿势序列，并提取关节特定的均值和方差向量，这些向量被用作分布监督来训练一个非自回归的Transformer。 给定文本嵌入，Transformer预测潜在均值和对数方差，而VAE解码器在解码阶段通过随机采样重建最终的手语姿势序列。 这种公式通过分布式的潜在建模避免了确定性潜在塌缩，从而保持了关节级别的表示。 此外，我们集成了一种手势词注意力机制，以加强语言输入和关节运动之间的对齐。 实验结果表明，与确定性潜在回归相比，该方法获得了持续的提升，在完全无手势词设置下实现了最先进的反向翻译性能，并提高了运动真实感。
tldr: The paper introduces A$^{2}$V-SLP, a novel alignment-aware variational framework for sign language production that leverages articulator-wise disentangled latent distributions and a gloss attention mechanism, achieving state-of-the-art back-translation performance and improved motion realism.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 A$^{2}$V-SLP，一种新颖的对齐感知变分框架，用于手语生成，它利用了关节分离的潜在分布和词汇注意机制，实现了最先进的反向翻译性能和改进的运动逼真度。

title: Sample-Free Safety Assessment of Neural Network Controllers via Taylor Methods
summary: In recent years, artificial neural networks have been increasingly studied as feedback controllers for guidance problems. While effective in complex scenarios, they lack the verification guarantees found in classical guidance policies. Their black-box nature creates significant concerns regarding trustworthiness, limiting their adoption in safety-critical spaceflight applications. This work addresses this gap by developing a method to assess the safety of a trained neural network feedback controller via automatic domain splitting and polynomial bounding. The methodology involves embedding the trained neural network into the system's dynamical equations, rendering the closed-loop system autonomous. The system flow is then approximated by high-order Taylor polynomials, which are subsequently manipulated to construct polynomial maps that project state uncertainties onto an event manifold. Automatic domain splitting ensures the polynomials are accurate over their relevant subdomains, whilst also allowing an extensive state-space to be analysed efficiently. Utilising polynomial bounding techniques, the resulting event values may be rigorously constrained and analysed within individual subdomains, thereby establishing bounds on the range of possible closed-loop outcomes from using such neural network controllers and supporting safety assessment and informed operational decision-making in real-world missions.
summary_zh: 近年来，人工神经网络作为制导问题的反馈控制器受到了越来越多的研究。虽然它们在复杂场景中有效，但却缺乏经典制导策略中固有的验证保证。它们的黑箱特性引起了对可信度的重大担忧，限制了它们在安全攸关的航天应用中的采用。本工作通过开发一种通过自动域分割和多项式有界来评估训练后的神经网络反馈控制器安全性的方法，来弥补这一差距。该方法包括将训练后的神经网络嵌入到系统的动力学方程中，使闭环系统成为自治系统。然后，系统流通过高阶泰勒多项式来近似，随后对其进行处理以构建多项式映射，将状态不确定性投影到事件流形上。自动域分割确保多项式在其相关子域内是准确的，同时也允许有效地分析广泛的状态空间。利用多项式有界技术，可以严格约束和分析所得的事件值在各个子域内，从而建立在使用此类神经网络控制器时可能出现的闭环结果范围的界限，并支持真实任务中的安全评估和知情决策。
tldr: This paper presents a method for assessing the safety of neural network controllers using Taylor methods and domain splitting, aiming to provide verification guarantees for safety-critical applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用泰勒方法和域分割来评估神经网络控制器安全性的方法，旨在为安全关键型应用提供验证保证。

title: Sub--Riemannian boundary value problems for Optimal Geometric Locomotion
summary: We propose a geometric model for optimal shape-change-induced motions of slender locomotors, e.g., snakes slithering on sand. In these scenarios, the motion of a body in world coordinates is completely determined by the sequence of shapes it assumes. Specifically, we formulate Lagrangian least-dissipation principles as boundary value problems whose solutions are given by sub-Riemannian geodesics. Notably, our geometric model accounts not only for the energy dissipated by the body's displacement through the environment, but also for the energy dissipated by the animal's metabolism or a robot's actuators to induce shape changes such as bending and stretching, thus capturing overall locomotion efficiency. Our continuous model, together with a consistent time and space discretization, enables numerical computation of sub-Riemannian geodesics for three different types of boundary conditions, i.e., fixing initial and target body, restricting to cyclic motion, or solely prescribing body displacement and orientation. The resulting optimal deformation gaits qualitatively match observed motion trajectories of organisms such as snakes and spermatozoa, as well as known optimality results for low-dimensional systems such as Purcell's swimmers. Moreover, being geometrically less rigid than previous frameworks, our model enables new insights into locomotion mechanisms of, e.g., generalized Purcell's swimmers. The code is publicly available.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种几何模型，用于研究细长运动体（例如在沙地上滑行的蛇）由形状改变引起的最佳运动。在这些情况下，物体在世界坐标系中的运动完全由其所呈现的形状序列决定。具体而言，我们将拉格朗日最小耗散原理表述为边值问题，其解由亚黎曼测地线给出。值得注意的是，我们的几何模型不仅考虑了物体在环境中位移所消耗的能量，还考虑了动物新陈代谢或机器人执行器为诱导形状改变（如弯曲和伸展）所消耗的能量，从而捕捉了整体的运动效率。我们的连续模型与一致的时空离散化方法相结合，可以对三种不同类型的边界条件进行亚黎曼测地线的数值计算，即固定初始和目标物身、限制为循环运动，或仅指定物体的位移和姿态。由此产生的最佳变形步态在定性上与观察到的生物（如蛇和精子）的运动轨迹相匹配，也与低维系统 (如 Purcell 游泳者) 的已知最优结果相符。此外，由于我们的模型在几何上比以往的框架更灵活，因此能够提供对运动机制的新见解，例如广义 Purcell 游泳者的运动机制。代码已公开提供。
tldr: This paper presents a geometric model for optimal shape-change-induced locomotion of slender locomotors, formulated as a sub-Riemannian boundary value problem, accounting for both movement and shape-change energy dissipation. The model enables computation of optimal gaits that qualitatively match observed motion trajectories. The code is publicly available.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于细长运动体最优形变诱导运动的几何模型，将其公式化为一个次黎曼边界值问题，同时考虑了运动和形变能量耗散。该模型能够计算出与观测到的运动轨迹定性匹配的最优步态。代码已公开。

title: Multi Graph Search for High-Dimensional Robot Motion Planning
summary: Efficient motion planning for high-dimensional robotic systems, such as manipulators and mobile manipulators, is critical for real-time operation and reliable deployment. Although advances in planning algorithms have enhanced scalability to high-dimensional state spaces, these improvements often come at the cost of generating unpredictable, inconsistent motions or requiring excessive computational resources and memory. In this work, we introduce Multi-Graph Search (MGS), a search-based motion planning algorithm that generalizes classical unidirectional and bidirectional search to a multi-graph setting. MGS maintains and incrementally expands multiple implicit graphs over the state space, focusing exploration on high-potential regions while allowing initially disconnected subgraphs to be merged through feasible transitions as the search progresses. We prove that MGS is complete and bounded-suboptimal, and empirically demonstrate its effectiveness on a range of manipulation and mobile manipulation tasks. Demonstrations, benchmarks and code are available at https://multi-graph-search.github.io/.
summary_zh: 高效的针对高维机器人系统的运动规划，例如机械臂和移动机械臂，对于实时操作和可靠部署至关重要。尽管规划算法的进步提高了对高维状态空间的可扩展性，但这些改进通常以生成不可预测的、不一致的运动或需要过多的计算资源和内存为代价。在这项工作中，我们引入了多图搜索（MGS），一种基于搜索的运动规划算法，它将经典单向和双向搜索推广到多图设置。MGS维护并增量式地扩展状态空间上的多个隐式图，将探索重点放在高潜力区域，同时允许最初断开连接的子图随着搜索的进行通过可行的转换进行合并。我们证明了MGS是完备的且有界次优的，并通过一系列操作和移动操作任务的实验证明了其有效性。演示、基准和代码可在https://multi-graph-search.github.io/获得。
tldr: The paper introduces Multi-Graph Search (MGS), a complete and bounded-suboptimal search-based motion planning algorithm for high-dimensional robotic systems, improving efficiency and consistency in motion generation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为多图搜索(MGS)的算法，它是一种完备且有界次优的基于搜索的运动规划算法，用于高维机器人系统，旨在提高运动生成过程中的效率和一致性。

title: Multi UAVs Preflight Planning in a Shared and Dynamic Airspace
summary: Preflight planning for large-scale Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) fleets in dynamic, shared airspace presents significant challenges, including temporal No-Fly Zones (NFZs), heterogeneous vehicle profiles, and strict delivery deadlines. While Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) provides a formal framework, existing methods often lack the scalability and flexibility required for real-world Unmanned Traffic Management (UTM). We propose DTAPP-IICR: a Delivery-Time Aware Prioritized Planning method with Incremental and Iterative Conflict Resolution. Our framework first generates an initial solution by prioritizing missions based on urgency. Secondly, it computes roundtrip trajectories using SFIPP-ST, a novel 4D single-agent planner (Safe Flight Interval Path Planning with Soft and Temporal Constraints). SFIPP-ST handles heterogeneous UAVs, strictly enforces temporal NFZs, and models inter-agent conflicts as soft constraints. Subsequently, an iterative Large Neighborhood Search, guided by a geometric conflict graph, efficiently resolves any residual conflicts. A completeness-preserving directional pruning technique further accelerates the 3D search. On benchmarks with temporal NFZs, DTAPP-IICR achieves near-100% success with fleets of up to 1,000 UAVs and gains up to 50% runtime reduction from pruning, outperforming batch Enhanced Conflict-Based Search in the UTM context. Scaling successfully in realistic city-scale operations where other priority-based methods fail even at moderate deployments, DTAPP-IICR is positioned as a practical and scalable solution for preflight planning in dense, dynamic urban airspace.
summary_zh: 大规模无人机（UAV）机队在动态共享空域中的飞行前规划面临着严峻的挑战，包括时间禁飞区（NFZ）、异构飞行器特性和严格的交付期限。虽然多智能体路径搜索（MAPF）提供了一个正式的框架，但现有方法通常缺乏现实世界无人交通管理（UTM）所需的可扩展性和灵活性。我们提出DTAPP-IICR：一种具有增量和迭代冲突解决的交付时间感知优先级规划方法。我们的框架首先通过基于紧急程度对任务进行优先级排序来生成初始解。其次，它使用SFIPP-ST（一种新型4D单智能体规划器，即具有软约束和时间约束的安全飞行间隔路径规划）计算往返轨迹。SFIPP-ST处理异构无人机，严格执行时间禁飞区，并将智能体间冲突建模为软约束。随后，由几何冲突图引导的迭代大规模邻域搜索有效地解决任何剩余冲突。一种保持完备性的定向剪枝技术进一步加速了3D搜索。在使用时间禁飞区的基准测试中，DTAPP-IICR在使用高达1,000架无人机的机队时实现了接近100%的成功率，并且剪枝带来了高达50%的运行时间缩减，优于UTM环境中的批量增强冲突搜索。DTAPP-IICR在现实城市规模的运营中成功扩展，而其他基于优先级的方法即使在中等部署规模下也会失败，这使其成为密集、动态城市空域中飞行前规划的一种实用且可扩展的解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces DTAPP-IICR, a novel and scalable preflight planning method for large UAV fleets in dynamic urban airspace, handling temporal No-Fly Zones, heterogeneous vehicle profiles, and strict delivery deadlines, outperforming existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为DTAPP-IICR的新型可扩展的无人机机群预飞行规划方法，用于应对动态城市空域中大型无人机机群面临的挑战，包括临时禁飞区、异构飞行器配置和严格的交付期限，其性能优于现有方法。

title: Adaptive-Horizon Conflict-Based Search for Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Path Finding
summary: MAPF is a core coordination problem for large robot fleets in automated warehouses and logistics. Existing approaches are typically either open-loop planners, which generate fixed trajectories and struggle to handle disturbances, or closed-loop heuristics without reliable performance guarantees, limiting their use in safety-critical deployments. This paper presents ACCBS, a closed-loop algorithm built on a finite-horizon variant of CBS with a horizon-changing mechanism inspired by iterative deepening in MPC. ACCBS dynamically adjusts the planning horizon based on the available computational budget, and reuses a single constraint tree to enable seamless transitions between horizons. As a result, it produces high-quality feasible solutions quickly while being asymptotically optimal as the budget increases, exhibiting anytime behavior. Extensive case studies demonstrate that ACCBS combines flexibility to disturbances with strong performance guarantees, effectively bridging the gap between theoretical optimality and practical robustness for large-scale robot deployment.
summary_zh: 多智能体路径规划（MAPF）是自动化仓库和物流中大型机器人集群的核心协调问题。现有方法通常要么是开环规划器，生成固定轨迹且难以应对扰动；要么是闭环启发式算法，缺乏可靠的性能保证，限制了其在安全关键部署中的应用。本文提出了一种名为ACCBS的闭环算法，该算法基于CBS的有限视界变体构建，并采用受模型预测控制（MPC）中迭代加深法启发的视界变化机制。ACCBS根据可用的计算预算动态调整规划视界，并重用单个约束树，以实现视界之间的无缝过渡。因此，它能够快速生成高质量的可行解，并在预算增加时渐近最优，展现出随时可用的行为。大量的案例研究表明，ACCBS将应对扰动的灵活性与强大的性能保证相结合，有效地弥合了大规模机器人部署中理论最优性和实际鲁棒性之间的差距。
tldr: This paper introduces ACCBS, a closed-loop Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) algorithm that dynamically adjusts the planning horizon to balance solution quality and computational efficiency, offering a practical solution for large-scale robot deployments with performance guarantees.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种闭环的多智能体路径规划算法ACCBS，该算法动态调整规划范围，平衡了解决方案的质量和计算效率，为大规模机器人部署提供了一种具有性能保证的实用解决方案。

title: GSO-SLAM: Bidirectionally Coupled Gaussian Splatting and Direct Visual Odometry
summary: We propose GSO-SLAM, a real-time monocular dense SLAM system that leverages Gaussian scene representation. Unlike existing methods that couple tracking and mapping with a unified scene, incurring computational costs, or loosely integrate them with well-structured tracking frameworks, introducing redundancies, our method bidirectionally couples Visual Odometry (VO) and Gaussian Splatting (GS). Specifically, our approach formulates joint optimization within an Expectation-Maximization (EM) framework, enabling the simultaneous refinement of VO-derived semi-dense depth estimates and the GS representation without additional computational overhead. Moreover, we present Gaussian Splat Initialization, which utilizes image information, keyframe poses, and pixel associations from VO to produce close approximations to the final Gaussian scene, thereby eliminating the need for heuristic methods. Through extensive experiments, we validate the effectiveness of our method, showing that it not only operates in real time but also achieves state-of-the-art geometric/photometric fidelity of the reconstructed scene and tracking accuracy.
summary_zh: 我们提出了GSO-SLAM，一种利用高斯场景表示的实时单目稠密SLAM系统。与将跟踪和地图构建耦合在统一场景中，导致计算成本增加，或将它们与结构良好的跟踪框架松散集成，引入冗余的现有方法不同，我们的方法双向耦合视觉里程计(VO)和高斯溅射(GS)。具体来说，我们的方法在期望最大化(EM)框架内制定联合优化，从而能够同时细化VO导出的半稠密深度估计和GS表示，而无需额外的计算开销。此外，我们提出了高斯溅射初始化，它利用图像信息、关键帧位姿和来自VO的像素关联，以产生接近最终高斯场景的近似值，从而消除了对启发式方法的需求。通过广泛的实验，我们验证了我们方法的有效性，表明它不仅能够实时运行，而且实现了重建场景和跟踪精度的最先进的几何/光度保真度。
tldr: GSO-SLAM introduces a real-time monocular dense SLAM system that bidirectionally couples Visual Odometry and Gaussian Splatting within an EM framework, achieving state-of-the-art performance without extra computation, and presents a novel Gaussian Splat Initialization method.
tldr_zh: GSO-SLAM 提出了一种实时单目稠密SLAM系统，在EM框架内双向耦合了视觉里程计和高斯溅射，无需额外计算即可实现最先进的性能，并提出了一种新颖的高斯溅射初始化方法。

title: HyperDet: 3D Object Detection with Hyper 4D Radar Point Clouds
summary: 4D mmWave radar provides weather-robust, velocity-aware measurements and is more cost-effective than LiDAR. However, radar-only 3D detection still trails LiDAR-based systems because radar point clouds are sparse, irregular, and often corrupted by multipath noise, yielding weak and unstable geometry. We present HyperDet, a detector-agnostic radar-only 3D detection framework that constructs a task-aware hyper 4D radar point cloud for standard LiDAR-oriented detectors. HyperDet aggregates returns from multiple surround-view 4D radars over consecutive frames to improve coverage and density, then applies geometry-aware cross-sensor consensus validation with a lightweight self-consistency check outside overlap regions to suppress inconsistent returns. It further integrates a foreground-focused diffusion module with training-time mixed radar-LiDAR supervision to densify object structures while lifting radar attributes (e.g., Doppler, RCS); the model is distilled into a consistency model for single-step inference. On MAN TruckScenes, HyperDet consistently improves over raw radar inputs with VoxelNeXt and CenterPoint, partially narrowing the radar-LiDAR gap. These results show that input-level refinement enables radar to better leverage LiDAR-oriented detectors without architectural modifications.
summary_zh: 4D毫米波雷达能够提供抗恶劣天气、感知速度的测量数据，并且比激光雷达更具成本效益。然而，纯雷达的3D目标检测性能仍然落后于基于激光雷达的系统，因为雷达点云稀疏、不规则，并且经常被多径噪声干扰，导致几何信息微弱且不稳定。我们提出了HyperDet，一个与检测器无关的纯雷达3D目标检测框架，它构建了一个任务相关的超4D雷达点云，供标准的、面向激光雷达的检测器使用。HyperDet聚合了来自多个环视4D雷达在连续帧上的回波，以提高覆盖率和密度，然后应用几何感知的跨传感器一致性验证，并在重叠区域外进行轻量级的自洽性检查，以抑制不一致的回波。它进一步整合了一个以前景为中心的扩散模块，在训练时采用混合雷达-激光雷达监督，以增强目标结构的密度，同时提升雷达属性（例如，多普勒、雷达截面积）；该模型被提炼成一个一致性模型，用于单步推理。在MAN TruckScenes数据集上，HyperDet在使用VoxelNeXt和CenterPoint时，始终优于原始雷达输入的结果，部分缩小了雷达与激光雷达之间的差距。这些结果表明，输入层面的优化能够使雷达更好地利用面向激光雷达的检测器，而无需进行架构上的修改。
tldr: The paper introduces HyperDet, a radar-only 3D object detection framework that refines radar point clouds through aggregation, validation, and diffusion, demonstrating improved performance on the MAN TruckScenes dataset when used with standard LiDAR-oriented detectors.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了HyperDet，一个纯雷达的3D目标检测框架，通过聚合、验证和扩散来优化雷达点云，并在MAN TruckScenes数据集上展示了与标准激光雷达检测器结合使用时性能的提升。

title: Multi-UAV Trajectory Optimization for Bearing-Only Localization in GPS Denied Environments
summary: Accurate localization of maritime targets by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) remains challenging in GPS-denied environments. UAVs equipped with gimballed electro-optical sensors are typically used to localize targets, however, reliance on these sensors increases mechanical complexity, cost, and susceptibility to single-point failures, limiting scalability and robustness in multi-UAV operations. This work presents a new trajectory optimization framework that enables cooperative target localization using UAVs with fixed, non-gimballed cameras operating in coordination with a surface vessel. This estimation-aware optimization generates dynamically feasible trajectories that explicitly account for mission constraints, platform dynamics, and out-of-frame events. Estimation-aware trajectories outperform heuristic paths by reducing localization error by more than a factor of two, motivating their use in cooperative operations. Results further demonstrate that coordinated UAVs with fixed, non-gimballed cameras achieve localization accuracy that meets or exceeds that of single gimballed systems, while substantially lowering system complexity and cost, enabling scalability, and enhancing mission resilience.
summary_zh: 在GPS拒止环境中，利用无人机(UAV)对海上目标进行精确定位仍然具有挑战性。通常使用配备万向节光电传感器的无人机来定位目标，然而，对这些传感器的依赖增加了机械复杂性、成本以及对单点故障的敏感性，限制了多无人机操作的可扩展性和稳健性。本研究提出了一个全新的轨迹优化框架，使配备固定式非万向节相机的无人机能够与水面舰艇协同进行目标协同定位。这种估计感知优化方法生成动态可行的轨迹，明确考虑任务约束、平台动力学和视场外事件。估计感知轨迹在降低定位误差方面优于启发式路径超过两倍，这促使它们应用于协同操作中。结果进一步表明，配备固定式非万向节相机的协同无人机能够实现达到或超过单个万向节系统的定位精度，同时显著降低系统复杂度和成本，从而实现可扩展性并增强任务弹性。
tldr: This paper introduces a trajectory optimization framework for multi-UAV cooperative target localization in GPS-denied environments using fixed cameras, achieving accuracy comparable to gimballed systems with reduced complexity and cost.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多无人机协同目标定位的轨迹优化框架，该框架在无GPS环境下使用固定摄像头，实现了与云台系统相当的精度，同时降低了复杂性和成本。

title: Resource-Aware Deployment Optimization for Collaborative Intrusion Detection in Layered Networks
summary: Collaborative Intrusion Detection Systems (CIDS) are increasingly adopted to counter cyberattacks, as their collaborative nature enables them to adapt to diverse scenarios across heterogeneous environments. As distributed critical infrastructure operates in rapidly evolving environments, such as drones in both civil and military domains, there is a growing need for CIDS architectures that can flexibly accommodate these dynamic changes. In this study, we propose a novel CIDS framework designed for easy deployment across diverse distributed environments. The framework dynamically optimizes detector allocation per node based on available resources and data types, enabling rapid adaptation to new operational scenarios with minimal computational overhead. We first conducted a comprehensive literature review to identify key characteristics of existing CIDS architectures. Based on these insights and real-world use cases, we developed our CIDS framework, which we evaluated using several distributed datasets that feature different attack chains and network topologies. Notably, we introduce a public dataset based on a realistic cyberattack targeting a ground drone aimed at sabotaging critical infrastructure. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed CIDS framework can achieve adaptive, efficient intrusion detection in distributed settings, automatically reconfiguring detectors to maintain an optimal configuration, without requiring heavy computation, since all experiments were conducted on edge devices.
summary_zh: 协同入侵检测系统（CIDS）正日益被采用来对抗网络攻击，因为其协同特性使其能够适应异构环境中的各种场景。随着分布式关键基础设施在快速演进的环境中运行，例如民用和军用领域的无人机，对能够灵活适应这些动态变化的CIDS架构的需求日益增长。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新型CIDS框架，旨在便于在各种分布式环境中部署。该框架基于可用资源和数据类型，动态优化每个节点的检测器分配，从而能够快速适应新的操作场景，且计算开销最小。我们首先进行了全面的文献综述，以识别现有CIDS架构的关键特征。基于这些见解和实际用例，我们开发了我们的CIDS框架，并使用包含不同攻击链和网络拓扑的多个分布式数据集对其进行了评估。值得注意的是，我们引入了一个公开数据集，该数据集基于针对地面无人机的真实网络攻击，旨在破坏关键基础设施。实验结果表明，所提出的CIDS框架能够在分布式环境中实现自适应、高效的入侵检测，自动重新配置检测器以维持最佳配置，而无需大量的计算，因为所有实验都是在边缘设备上进行的。
tldr: This paper introduces a Collaborative Intrusion Detection System (CIDS) framework that dynamically optimizes detector allocation in distributed environments, especially for scenarios involving drones and critical infrastructure, while minimizing computational overhead.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个协作入侵检测系统（CIDS）框架，该框架可以在分布式环境中动态优化检测器分配，特别是在涉及无人机和关键基础设施的场景中，同时最大限度地减少计算开销。

title: OMEGA-Avatar: One-shot Modeling of 360° Gaussian Avatars
summary: Creating high-fidelity, animatable 3D avatars from a single image remains a formidable challenge. We identified three desirable attributes of avatar generation: 1) the method should be feed-forward, 2) model a 360° full-head, and 3) should be animation-ready. However, current work addresses only two of the three points simultaneously. To address these limitations, we propose OMEGA-Avatar, the first feed-forward framework that simultaneously generates a generalizable, 360°-complete, and animatable 3D Gaussian head from a single image. Starting from a feed-forward and animatable framework, we address the 360° full-head avatar generation problem with two novel components. First, to overcome poor hair modeling in full-head avatar generation, we introduce a semantic-aware mesh deformation module that integrates multi-view normals to optimize a FLAME head with hair while preserving its topology structure. Second, to enable effective feed-forward decoding of full-head features, we propose a multi-view feature splatting module that constructs a shared canonical UV representation from features across multiple views through differentiable bilinear splatting, hierarchical UV mapping, and visibility-aware fusion. This approach preserves both global structural coherence and local high-frequency details across all viewpoints, ensuring 360° consistency without per-instance optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OMEGA-Avatar achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming existing baselines in 360° full-head completeness while robustly preserving identity across different viewpoints.
summary_zh: 从单张图像创建高保真、可动画的3D头像仍然是一个巨大的挑战。我们确定了头像生成的三个理想属性：1) 该方法应该是前馈的， 2) 对360°全头部进行建模，以及3) 应当是为动画而生的。然而，目前的工作仅能同时满足这三点中的两点。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了OMEGA-Avatar，这是第一个前馈框架，它能同时从单张图像生成可泛化、360°完整且可动画的3D高斯头部。从一个前馈且可动画的框架出发，我们通过两个新颖的组件来解决360°全头部头像生成问题。首先，为了克服全头部头像生成中糟糕的头发建模问题，我们引入了一个语义感知的网格变形模块，该模块整合了多视角法线来优化带有头发的FLAME头部，同时保留其拓扑结构。其次，为了实现全头部特征的有效前馈解码，我们提出了一个多视角特征喷溅模块，该模块通过可微的双线性喷溅、分层UV映射和可见性感知的融合，从多个视角的特征构建一个共享的规范UV表示。这种方法保留了所有视点的全局结构一致性和局部高频细节，确保了360°一致性，而无需进行逐实例优化。大量实验表明，OMEGA-Avatar实现了最先进的性能，在360°全头部完整性方面显著优于现有基线，同时稳健地保留了不同视角的身份信息。
tldr: The paper introduces OMEGA-Avatar, a novel feed-forward framework for generating animatable, 360-degree complete 3D Gaussian head avatars from a single image, addressing limitations in existing approaches regarding full-head modeling and animation readiness.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了OMEGA-Avatar，一种新颖的前馈框架，用于从单张图像生成可动画的、360度完整的3D高斯头部化身，解决了现有方法在全头部建模和动画就绪方面的局限性。

title: WorldTree: Towards 4D Dynamic Worlds from Monocular Video using Tree-Chains
summary: Dynamic reconstruction has achieved remarkable progress, but there remain challenges in monocular input for more practical applications. The prevailing works attempt to construct efficient motion representations, but lack a unified spatiotemporal decomposition framework, suffering from either holistic temporal optimization or coupled hierarchical spatial composition. To this end, we propose WorldTree, a unified framework comprising Temporal Partition Tree (TPT) that enables coarse-to-fine optimization based on the inheritance-based partition tree structure for hierarchical temporal decomposition, and Spatial Ancestral Chains (SAC) that recursively query ancestral hierarchical structure to provide complementary spatial dynamics while specializing motion representations across ancestral nodes. Experimental results on different datasets indicate that our proposed method achieves 8.26% improvement of LPIPS on NVIDIA-LS and 9.09% improvement of mLPIPS on DyCheck compared to the second-best method. Code: https://github.com/iCVTEAM/WorldTree.
summary_zh: 动态重建已经取得了显著进展，但在单目输入方面仍然存在挑战，限制了其在更实际应用中的普及。现有的工作致力于构建高效的运动表示，但缺乏统一的时空分解框架，要么采用整体时间优化，要么采用耦合的分层空间组合。为此，我们提出了 WorldTree，一个统一的框架，包含时间分割树（TPT）和空间祖先链（SAC）。时间分割树通过基于继承的分割树结构实现由粗到精的优化，从而实现分层时间分解；空间祖先链递归查询祖先层级结构，提供互补的空间动态，同时对跨祖先节点的运动表示进行特殊化处理。在不同数据集上的实验结果表明，与第二好的方法相比，我们提出的方法在 NVIDIA-LS 上实现了 8.26% 的 LPIPS 提升，在 DyCheck 上实现了 9.09% 的 mLPIPS 提升。代码：https://github.com/iCVTEAM/WorldTree。
tldr: The paper introduces WorldTree, a framework for dynamic 4D reconstruction from monocular video using Temporal Partition Trees and Spatial Ancestral Chains, achieving improved performance on benchmark datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了WorldTree，一个从单目视频进行动态4D重建的框架，它使用时间分割树和空间祖先链，并在基准数据集上取得了更好的性能。

title: Advancing Digital Twin Generation Through a Novel Simulation Framework and Quantitative Benchmarking
summary: The generation of 3D models from real-world objects has often been accomplished through photogrammetry, i.e., by taking 2D photos from a variety of perspectives and then triangulating matched point-based features to create a textured mesh. Many design choices exist within this framework for the generation of digital twins, and differences between such approaches are largely judged qualitatively. Here, we present and test a novel pipeline for generating synthetic images from high-quality 3D models and programmatically generated camera poses. This enables a wide variety of repeatable, quantifiable experiments which can compare ground-truth knowledge of virtual camera parameters and of virtual objects against the reconstructed estimations of those perspectives and subjects.
summary_zh: 从真实世界物体生成3D模型通常通过摄影测量法实现，即从多个视角拍摄2D照片，然后三角化匹配的点特征以创建纹理网格。在这个框架下，存在许多数字孪生生成的设计选择，而不同方法之间的差异通常是定性判断的。在这里，我们提出并测试了一种新颖的流程，该流程从高质量3D模型和程序化生成的相机位姿中生成合成图像。这使得能够进行各种可重复、可量化的实验，从而将虚拟相机参数和虚拟对象的真实信息与这些视角和对象的重建估计进行比较。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel pipeline for generating synthetic images from 3D models and camera poses, enabling repeatable, quantifiable experiments to benchmark digital twin generation methods by comparing ground-truth data with reconstructed estimations.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的管道，用于从 3D 模型和相机姿势生成合成图像，从而能够通过将地面实况数据与重建估计进行比较，进行可重复、可量化的实验来评估数字孪生生成方法。

title: PathCRF: Ball-Free Soccer Event Detection via Possession Path Inference from Player Trajectories
summary: Despite recent advances in AI, event data collection in soccer still relies heavily on labor-intensive manual annotation. Although prior work has explored automatic event detection using player and ball trajectories, ball tracking also remains difficult to scale due to high infrastructural and operational costs. As a result, comprehensive data collection in soccer is largely confined to top-tier competitions, limiting the broader adoption of data-driven analysis in this domain. To address this challenge, this paper proposes PathCRF, a framework for detecting on-ball soccer events using only player tracking data. We model player trajectories as a fully connected dynamic graph and formulate event detection as the problem of selecting exactly one edge corresponding to the current possession state at each time step. To ensure logical consistency of the resulting edge sequence, we employ a Conditional Random Field (CRF) that forbids impossible transitions between consecutive edges. Both emission and transition scores dynamically computed from edge embeddings produced by a Set Attention-based backbone architecture. During inference, the most probable edge sequence is obtained via Viterbi decoding, and events such as ball controls or passes are detected whenever the selected edge changes between adjacent time steps. Experiments show that PathCRF produces accurate, logically consistent possession paths, enabling reliable downstream analyses while substantially reducing the need for manual event annotation. The source code is available at https://github.com/hyunsungkim-ds/pathcrf.git.
summary_zh: 尽管人工智能领域取得了最新进展，足球赛事数据的收集仍然严重依赖于劳动密集型的手工标注。虽然先前的研究已经探索了使用球员和球的轨迹进行自动事件检测，但由于高昂的基础设施和运营成本，球的跟踪仍然难以扩展。因此，足球赛事数据的全面收集主要局限于顶级联赛，限制了数据驱动分析在该领域更广泛的应用。为了解决这一挑战，本文提出PathCRF，一个仅使用球员跟踪数据来检测足球控球事件的框架。我们将球员轨迹建模为一个完全连接的动态图，并将事件检测表述为在每个时间步选择恰好一条对应于当前控球状态的边的难题。为了确保所生成边序列的逻辑一致性，我们采用条件随机场（CRF），禁止连续边之间不可能的转换。发射分数和转移分数都由基于集合注意力机制骨干架构生成的边嵌入动态计算。在推理过程中，通过维特比解码获得最可能的边序列，并且当选定的边在相邻时间步之间发生变化时，就可以检测到诸如控球或传球之类的事件。实验表明，PathCRF可以生成准确、逻辑上一致的控球路径，从而实现可靠的下游分析，同时大大减少了对人工标注的需要。源代码可在https://github.com/hyunsungkim-ds/pathcrf.git 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces PathCRF, a method for detecting soccer events using only player trajectories and Conditional Random Fields, eliminating the need for ball tracking and manual annotation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为PathCRF的方法，该方法仅使用球员轨迹和条件随机场来检测足球事件，无需进行球跟踪和手动标注。

title: Calibration and Evaluation of Car-Following Models for Autonomous Shuttles Using a Novel Multi-Criteria Framework
summary:
Autonomous shuttles (AS) are fully autonomous transit vehicles with operating characteristics distinct from conventional autonomous vehicles (AV). Developing dedicated car-following models for AS is critical to understanding their traffic impacts; however, few studies have calibrated such models with field data. More advanced machine learning (ML) techniques have not yet been applied to AS trajectories, leaving the potential of ML for capturing AS dynamics unexplored and constraining the development of dedicated AS models. Furthermore, there is a lack of a unified framework for systematically evaluating and comparing the performance of car-following models to replicate real trajectories. Existing car-following studies often rely on disparate metrics, which limit reproducibility and performance comparability.
  This study addresses these gaps through two main contributions: (1) the calibration of a diverse set of car-following models using real-world AS trajectory data, including eight machine learning algorithms and two physics-based models; and (2) the introduction of a multi-criteria evaluation framework that integrates measures of prediction accuracy, trajectory stability, and statistical similarity, which provides a generalizable methodology for a systematic assessment of car-following models.
  Results indicated that the proposed calibrated XGBoost model achieved the best overall performance. Sequential model type, such as LSTM and CNN, captured long-term positional stability but were less responsive to short-term dynamics. LSTM and CNN captured long-term positional stability but were less responsive to short-term dynamics. Traditional models (IDM, ACC) and kernel methods showed lower accuracy and stability than most ML models tested.
summary_zh:
自动驾驶摆渡车（AS）是完全自动驾驶的交通工具，其运行特性与传统的自动驾驶汽车（AV）不同。开发专门的AS跟驰模型对于理解其交通影响至关重要；然而，很少有研究使用现场数据校准此类模型。更先进的机器学习（ML）技术尚未应用于AS轨迹，这使得ML在捕捉AS动态方面的潜力未被探索，并限制了专用AS模型的开发。此外，缺乏一个统一的框架来系统地评估和比较跟驰模型复制真实轨迹的性能。现有的跟驰研究通常依赖于不同的指标，这限制了可重复性和性能可比性。

本研究通过两个主要贡献来弥补这些差距：（1）使用真实世界的AS轨迹数据校准了一系列不同的跟驰模型，包括八种机器学习算法和两种基于物理的模型；以及（2）引入了一个多标准评估框架，该框架整合了预测精度、轨迹稳定性和统计相似性的度量标准，从而为系统评估跟驰模型提供了一种通用的方法。

结果表明，所提出的校准后的XGBoost模型实现了最佳的整体性能。诸如LSTM和CNN之类的序列模型类型能够捕捉到长期的位置稳定性，但对短期动态的响应较差。传统模型（IDM、ACC）和核方法显示出比大多数经过测试的ML模型更低的准确性和稳定性。
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-criteria framework for evaluating car-following models for autonomous shuttles, comparing machine learning and physics-based models using real-world trajectory data and finding that XGBoost performed best.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个多标准框架，用于评估自动驾驶摆渡车的车辆跟随模型，使用真实轨迹数据比较机器学习和基于物理的模型，并发现 XGBoost 性能最佳。

title: Exploring Multiple High-Scoring Subspaces in Generative Flow Networks
summary: As a probabilistic sampling framework, Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) show strong potential for constructing complex combinatorial objects through the sequential composition of elementary components. However, existing GFlowNets often suffer from excessive exploration over vast state spaces, leading to over-sampling of low-reward regions and convergence to suboptimal distributions. Effectively biasing GFlowNets toward high-reward solutions remains a non-trivial challenge. In this paper, we propose CMAB-GFN, which integrates a combinatorial multi-armed bandit (CMAB) framework with GFlowNet policies. The CMAB component prunes low-quality actions, yielding compact high-scoring subspaces for exploration. Restricting GFNs to these compact high-scoring subspaces accelerates the discovery of high-value candidates, while the exploration of different subspaces ensures that diversity is not sacrificed. Experimental results on multiple tasks demonstrate that CMAB-GFN generates higher-reward candidates than existing approaches.
summary_zh: 作为一种概率采样框架，生成式流网络 (GFlowNets) 在通过基本组件的顺序组合构建复杂组合对象方面显示出强大的潜力。然而，现有的 GFlowNets 常常由于在广阔的状态空间中过度探索而受到影响，导致对低奖励区域的过度采样以及收敛到次优分布。有效地引导 GFlowNets 倾向于高奖励解决方案仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。在本文中，我们提出了 CMAB-GFN，它将组合多臂老虎机 (CMAB) 框架与 GFlowNet 策略相结合。CMAB 组件剪枝低质量动作，从而产生用于探索的紧凑型高分子空间。将 GFN 限制在这些紧凑型高分子空间中加速了高价值候选者的发现，同时对不同子空间的探索确保了多样性不会被牺牲。在多个任务上的实验结果表明，CMAB-GFN 生成的候选者比现有方法具有更高的奖励。
tldr: The paper introduces CMAB-GFN, a method integrating combinatorial multi-armed bandits with Generative Flow Networks to prune low-quality actions, accelerating the discovery of high-reward solutions in complex combinatorial spaces and maintaining diversity.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CMAB-GFN，这是一种将组合多臂老虎机与生成流网络相结合的方法，用于剪除低质量动作，加速在复杂组合空间中发现高回报解决方案，并保持多样性。

title: Min-Sum Uniform Coverage Problem by Autonomous Mobile Robots
summary: We study the \textit{min-sum uniform coverage} problem for a swarm of $n$ mobile robots on a given finite line segment and on a circle having finite positive radius, where the circle is given as an input. The robots must coordinate their movements to reach a uniformly spaced configuration that minimizes the total distance traveled by all robots. The robots are autonomous, anonymous, identical, and homogeneous, and operate under the \textit{Look-Compute-Move} (LCM) model with \textit{non-rigid} motion controlled by a fair asynchronous scheduler. They are oblivious and silent, possessing neither persistent memory nor a means of explicit communication. In the \textbf{line-segment setting}, the \textit{min-sum uniform coverage} problem requires placing the robots at uniformly spaced points along the segment so as to minimize the total distance traveled by all robots. In the \textbf{circle setting} for this problem, the robots have to arrange themselves uniformly around the given circle to form a regular $n$-gon. There is no fixed orientation or designated starting vertex, and the goal is to minimize the total distance traveled by all the robots. We present a deterministic distributed algorithm that achieves uniform coverage in the line-segment setting with minimum total movement cost. For the circle setting, we characterize all initial configurations for which the \textit{min-sum uniform coverage} problem is deterministically unsolvable under the considered robot model. For all the other remaining configurations, we provide a deterministic distributed algorithm that achieves uniform coverage while minimizing the total distance traveled. These results characterize the deterministic solvability of min-sum coverage for oblivious robots and achieve optimal cost whenever solvable.
summary_zh: 我们研究了一群 $n$ 个移动机器人在给定有限线段和具有有限正半径的圆上的\textit{最小和均匀覆盖}问题，其中圆作为输入给出。机器人必须协调它们的运动以达到均匀间隔的配置，从而最小化所有机器人行进的总距离。机器人是自主的、匿名的、相同的和同质的，并在一个由公平的异步调度器控制的具有\textit{非刚性}运动的\textit{观察-计算-移动} (LCM) 模型下运行。它们是无记忆和静默的，既没有持久性内存，也没有显式通信的手段。在\textbf{线段设定}中，\textit{最小和均匀覆盖}问题要求将机器人放置在线段上均匀间隔的点处，以最小化所有机器人行进的总距离。在此问题的\textbf{圆形设定}中，机器人必须围绕给定的圆均匀排列，形成一个正 $n$ 边形。没有固定的方向或指定的起始顶点，目标是最小化所有机器人行进的总距离。我们提出了一种确定性的分布式算法，该算法在线段设定中以最小的总移动成本实现均匀覆盖。对于圆形设定，我们描述了在此问题中，在所考虑的机器人模型下，\textit{最小和均匀覆盖}问题是确定性不可解的所有初始配置。对于所有剩余的其他配置，我们提供了一种确定性的分布式算法，该算法在最小化行进总距离的同时实现均匀覆盖。这些结果表征了无记忆机器人的最小和覆盖的确定性可解性，并在可解的情况下实现最优成本。
tldr: This paper presents deterministic distributed algorithms for achieving min-sum uniform coverage with a swarm of oblivious robots on a line segment and a circle, characterizing solvability and achieving optimal cost where possible.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种确定性的分布式算法，用于在一群无记忆机器人在线段和圆上实现最小和均匀覆盖，表征了可解性，并在可能的情况下实现了最优成本。

title: KAN-FIF: Spline-Parameterized Lightweight Physics-based Tropical Cyclone Estimation on Meteorological Satellite
summary: Tropical cyclones (TC) are among the most destructive natural disasters, causing catastrophic damage to coastal regions through extreme winds, heavy rainfall, and storm surges. Timely monitoring of tropical cyclones is crucial for reducing loss of life and property, yet it is hindered by the computational inefficiency and high parameter counts of existing methods on resource-constrained edge devices. Current physics-guided models suffer from linear feature interactions that fail to capture high-order polynomial relationships between TC attributes, leading to inflated model sizes and hardware incompatibility. To overcome these challenges, this study introduces the Kolmogorov-Arnold Network-based Feature Interaction Framework (KAN-FIF), a lightweight multimodal architecture that integrates MLP and CNN layers with spline-parameterized KAN layers. For Maximum Sustained Wind (MSW) prediction, experiments demonstrate that the KAN-FIF framework achieves a $94.8\%$ reduction in parameters (0.99MB vs 19MB) and $68.7\%$ faster inference per sample (2.3ms vs 7.35ms) compared to baseline model Phy-CoCo, while maintaining superior accuracy with $32.5\%$ lower MAE. The offline deployment experiment of the FY-4 series meteorological satellite processor on the Qingyun-1000 development board achieved a 14.41ms per-sample inference latency with the KAN-FIF framework, demonstrating promising feasibility for operational TC monitoring and extending deployability to edge-device AI applications. The code is released at https://github.com/Jinglin-Zhang/KAN-FIF.
summary_zh: 热带气旋是最具破坏力的自然灾害之一，通过极端大风、强降雨和风暴潮对沿海地区造成灾难性破坏。及时监测热带气旋对于减少生命和财产损失至关重要，但现有方法在资源受限的边缘设备上的计算效率低下和参数量巨大阻碍了这一目标的实现。目前基于物理机制的模型存在线性特征交互的问题，无法捕获热带气旋属性之间的高阶多项式关系，从而导致模型尺寸膨胀和硬件不兼容。为了克服这些挑战，本研究提出了一种基于柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络(KAN)的特征交互框架(KAN-FIF)，这是一种轻量级的多模态架构，将MLP和CNN层与样条参数化的KAN层集成在一起。对于最大持续风速(MSW)预测，实验表明，与基线模型Phy-CoCo相比，KAN-FIF框架在保持优异精度的同时，参数量减少了94.8%（0.99MB vs 19MB），每个样本的推理速度提高了68.7%（2.3ms vs 7.35ms），平均绝对误差(MAE)降低了32.5%。在青云-1000开发板上对风云四号系列气象卫星处理器进行的离线部署实验表明，使用KAN-FIF框架的单样本推理延迟为14.41ms，证明了其在业务化热带气旋监测中的可行性，并将可部署性扩展到边缘设备AI应用。相关代码已在https://github.com/Jinglin-Zhang/KAN-FIF 上发布。
tldr: The paper introduces KAN-FIF, a lightweight neural network architecture using spline-parameterized KAN layers for efficient and accurate tropical cyclone monitoring on edge devices, achieving significant parameter reduction and faster inference compared to existing physics-guided models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 KAN-FIF，一种轻量级的神经网络架构，使用样条参数化的 KAN 层，用于边缘设备上高效准确的热带气旋监测，与现有的物理引导模型相比，实现了显著的参数减少和更快的推理速度。

title: Egocentric Gaze Estimation via Neck-Mounted Camera
summary: This paper introduces neck-mounted view gaze estimation, a new task that estimates user gaze from the neck-mounted camera perspective. Prior work on egocentric gaze estimation, which predicts device wearer's gaze location within the camera's field of view, mainly focuses on head-mounted cameras while alternative viewpoints remain underexplored. To bridge this gap, we collect the first dataset for this task, consisting of approximately 4 hours of video collected from 8 participants during everyday activities. We evaluate a transformer-based gaze estimation model, GLC, on the new dataset and propose two extensions: an auxiliary gaze out-of-bound classification task and a multi-view co-learning approach that jointly trains head-view and neck-view models using a geometry-aware auxiliary loss. Experimental results show that incorporating gaze out-of-bound classification improves performance over standard fine-tuning, while the co-learning approach does not yield gains. We further analyze these results and discuss implications for neck-mounted gaze estimation.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了颈部视角注视点估计，这是一项新的任务，旨在从颈部安装的摄像机视角估计用户注视点。以往关于以自我为中心的注视点估计的研究主要集中于头戴式摄像机，此类研究预测设备佩戴者在摄像机视野内的注视位置，而其他视角仍未得到充分探索。为了弥补这一差距，我们收集了该任务的首个数据集，其中包含 8 名参与者在日常活动中收集的约 4 小时的视频。我们在新的数据集上评估了一个基于 Transformer 的注视点估计模型，GLC，并提出了两个扩展：一个辅助的注视点超出边界分类任务和一个多视角协同学习方法，该方法使用几何感知的辅助损失联合训练头部视角和颈部视角的模型。实验结果表明，结合注视点超出边界分类可以提高优于标准微调的性能，而协同学习方法没有产生增益。我们进一步分析了这些结果并讨论了颈部视角注视点估计的意义。
tldr: The paper introduces a new egocentric gaze estimation task using a neck-mounted camera, provides a new dataset, and evaluates a transformer-based model with two proposed extensions. The out-of-bound classification improves performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用颈部摄像头进行以自我为中心的注视估计的新任务，提供了一个新的数据集，并评估了一个基于transformer的模型以及两个扩展。 越界分类提高了性能。

title: HairWeaver: Few-Shot Photorealistic Hair Motion Synthesis with Sim-to-Real Guided Video Diffusion
summary: We present HairWeaver, a diffusion-based pipeline that animates a single human image with realistic and expressive hair dynamics. While existing methods successfully control body pose, they lack specific control over hair, and as a result, fail to capture the intricate hair motions, resulting in stiff and unrealistic animations. HairWeaver overcomes this limitation using two specialized modules: a Motion-Context-LoRA to integrate motion conditions and a Sim2Real-Domain-LoRA to preserve the subject's photoreal appearance across different data domains. These lightweight components are designed to guide a video diffusion backbone while maintaining its core generative capabilities. By training on a specialized dataset of dynamic human motion generated from a CG simulator, HairWeaver affords fine control over hair motion and ultimately learns to produce highly realistic hair that responds naturally to movement. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that our approach sets a new state of the art, producing lifelike human hair animations with dynamic details.
summary_zh: 我们提出 HairWeaver，一种基于扩散模型的流程，能够以逼真且富有表现力的头发动态来动画化单个人物图像。 虽然现有的方法成功控制了身体姿态，但它们缺乏对头发的精细控制，因此无法捕捉到复杂的头发运动，从而产生僵硬且不真实的动画。 HairWeaver 通过两个专门的模块克服了这一限制：一个用于整合运动条件的运动上下文 LoRA (Motion-Context-LoRA) 和一个用于在不同数据域中保持主体逼真外观的 Sim2Real 域 LoRA (Sim2Real-Domain-LoRA)。 这些轻量级组件旨在引导视频扩散骨干网络，同时保持其核心生成能力。 通过在从 CG 模拟器生成的动态人体运动专业数据集上进行训练，HairWeaver 能对头发运动进行精细控制，并最终学会生成对运动做出自然反应的高度逼真的头发。 全面的评估表明，我们的方法设定了新的技术水平，能够产生具有动态细节的逼真的人类头发动画。
tldr: HairWeaver is a video diffusion pipeline that animates a single human image with realistic hair dynamics by using Motion-Context-LoRA and Sim2Real-Domain-LoRA to guide the diffusion process, trained on CG data.
tldr_zh: HairWeaver是一个视频扩散流程，通过使用Motion-Context-LoRA和Sim2Real-Domain-LoRA来引导扩散过程，从而赋予单个人物图像逼真的头发动态效果，并在CG数据上进行训练。

title: Assessing Low Back Movement with Motion Tape Sensor Data Through Deep Learning
summary: Back pain is a pervasive issue affecting a significant portion of the population, often worsened by certain movements of the lower back. Assessing these movements is important for helping clinicians prescribe appropriate physical therapy. However, it can be difficult to monitor patients' movements remotely outside the clinic. High-fidelity data from motion capture sensors can be used to classify different movements, but these sensors are costly and impractical for use in free-living environments. Motion Tape (MT), a new fabric-based wearable sensor, addresses these issues by being low cost and portable. Despite these advantages, novelty and variability in sensor stability make the MT dataset small scale and inherent to noise. In this work, we propose the Motion-Tape Augmentation Inference Model (MT-AIM), a deep learning classification pipeline trained on MT data. In order to address the challenges of limited sample size and noise present within the MT dataset, MT-AIM leverages conditional generative models to generate synthetic MT data of a desired movement, as well as predicting joint kinematics as additional features. This combination of synthetic data generation and feature augmentation enables MT-AIM to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy in classifying lower back movements, bridging the gap between physiological sensing and movement analysis.
summary_zh: 腰背疼痛是一个普遍存在的问题，影响着相当一部分人群，某些腰部动作常会加剧疼痛。评估这些动作对于帮助临床医生开出合适的物理治疗方案至关重要。然而，在诊所以外远程监测患者的动作可能比较困难。来自动作捕捉传感器的高保真数据可以用于对不同的动作进行分类，但这些传感器成本高昂且不适合在自由生活环境中使用。运动胶带（MT）是一种新型的基于织物的可穿戴传感器，它通过低成本和便携性解决了这些问题。尽管有这些优点，但传感器的稳定性的新颖性和可变性导致MT数据集规模较小且固有噪声。在这项工作中，我们提出了运动胶带增强推理模型（MT-AIM），这是一个基于MT数据训练的深度学习分类管道。为了应对MT数据集中存在的样本量有限和噪声的挑战，MT-AIM利用条件生成模型来生成所需动作的合成MT数据，并预测关节运动学作为附加特征。合成数据生成和特征增强的结合使MT-AIM能够在腰部动作分类中实现最先进的准确性，从而弥合了生理传感和运动分析之间的差距。
tldr: This paper introduces MT-AIM, a deep learning pipeline that uses conditional generative models to augment noisy data from a new wearable motion sensor (Motion Tape) for accurate classification of lower back movements.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种深度学习管道MT-AIM，它使用条件生成模型来增强来自新型可穿戴运动传感器（Motion Tape）的噪声数据，从而准确分类下背部运动。

title: Data-Driven Trajectory Imputation for Vessel Mobility Analysis
summary: Modeling vessel activity at sea is critical for a wide range of applications, including route planning, transportation logistics, maritime safety, and environmental monitoring. Over the past two decades, the Automatic Identification System (AIS) has enabled real-time monitoring of hundreds of thousands of vessels, generating huge amounts of data daily.
