summary_zh: 许多现实世界的控制问题，例如金融和机器人学，都在连续时间内演化，并伴随非均匀、事件驱动的决策。基于固定步长贝尔曼更新的标准离散时间强化学习(RL)在这种背景下表现不佳：随着时间间隔缩小，$Q$-函数坍缩为值函数$V$，从而消除了行为排序。现有的连续时间方法通过优势速率函数$q$重新引入动作信息。然而，它们通过复杂的鞅损失或正交性约束来强制执行最优性，这对于测试过程的选择非常敏感。这些方法将$V$和$q$纠缠成一个庞大而复杂的优化问题，难以可靠地训练。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新的解耦连续时间Actor-Critic算法，采用交替更新方式：$q$从$V$上的扩散生成器学习，而$V$通过基于哈密顿量的价值流进行更新，该价值流在无限小的时间步长下仍然保持信息量，而标准的最大/softmax备份则失效。理论上，我们通过新的概率论证证明了严格的收敛性，避开了基于生成器的哈密顿量在sup-norm下缺乏贝尔曼式收缩的挑战。在实验方面，我们的方法在具有挑战性的连续控制基准测试和真实的交易任务中，优于先前的连续时间和领先的离散时间基线，在一个季度内实现了21%的利润——几乎是第二佳方法的两倍。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel decoupled continuous-time reinforcement learning algorithm using Hamiltonian flow to address limitations of existing methods in continuous control tasks, showing improvements over both continuous and discrete-time baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的解耦连续时间强化学习算法，该算法使用哈密顿流来解决现有方法在连续控制任务中的局限性，并在连续和离散时间基线上均显示出改进。

title: pFedNavi: Structure-Aware Personalized Federated Vision-Language Navigation for Embodied AI
summary: Vision-Language Navigation VLN requires large-scale trajectory instruction data from private indoor environments, raising significant privacy concerns. Federated Learning FL mitigates this by keeping data on-device, but vanilla FL struggles under VLNs' extreme cross-client heterogeneity in environments and instruction styles, making a single global model suboptimal. This paper proposes pFedNavi, a structure-aware and dynamically adaptive personalized federated learning framework tailored for VLN. Our key idea is to personalize where it matters: pFedNavi adaptively identifies client-specific layers via layer-wise mixing coefficients, and performs fine-grained parameter fusion on the selected components (e.g., the encoder-decoder projection and environment-sensitive decoder layers) to balance global knowledge sharing with local specialization. We evaluate pFedNavi on two standard VLN benchmarks, R2R and RxR, using both ResNet and CLIP visual representations. Across all metrics, pFedNavi consistently outperforms the FedAvg-based VLN baseline, achieving up to 7.5% improvement in navigation success rate and up to 7.8% gain in trajectory fidelity, while converging 1.38x faster under non-IID conditions.
summary_zh: 视觉语言导航(VLN) 需要来自私有室内环境的大规模轨迹指令数据，从而引发了严重的隐私问题。联邦学习(FL) 通过将数据保存在设备上来缓解这一问题，但原生的联邦学习在 VLN 领域面临着环境和指令风格上极端的跨客户端异构性，使得单一的全局模型变得次优。本文提出 pFedNavi，一个结构感知且动态自适应的个性化联邦学习框架，专为 VLN 定制。我们的核心思想是个性化处理关键部分：pFedNavi 通过层级的混合系数自适应地识别客户端特定的层，并在所选组件（例如，编码器-解码器投影和环境敏感的解码器层）上执行细粒度的参数融合，以平衡全局知识共享与局部专业化。我们在两个标准 VLN 基准测试 R2R 和 RxR 上，使用 ResNet 和 CLIP 视觉表征对 pFedNavi 进行了评估。在所有指标上，pFedNavi 始终优于基于 FedAvg 的 VLN 基线，在导航成功率方面提高了高达 7.5%，在轨迹保真度方面提高了高达 7.8%，同时在非独立同分布(non-IID)条件下收敛速度提高了 1.38 倍。
tldr: The paper introduces pFedNavi, a structure-aware personalized federated learning framework for Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) that addresses data privacy concerns and cross-client heterogeneity by adaptively identifying and fusing client-specific layers. It outperforms FedAvg-based VLN baselines in navigation success rate and trajectory fidelity.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了pFedNavi，一个结构感知的个性化联邦学习框架，用于视觉-语言导航（VLN），它通过自适应地识别和融合客户端特定的层来解决数据隐私问题和跨客户端异构性。在导航成功率和轨迹保真度方面，该方法优于基于FedAvg的VLN基线。

title: WIMLE: Uncertainty-Aware World Models with IMLE for Sample-Efficient Continuous Control
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning promises strong sample efficiency but often underperforms in practice due to compounding model error, unimodal world models that average over multi-modal dynamics, and overconfident predictions that bias learning. We introduce WIMLE, a model-based method that extends Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (IMLE) to the model-based RL framework to learn stochastic, multi-modal world models without iterative sampling and to estimate predictive uncertainty via ensembles and latent sampling. During training, WIMLE weights each synthetic transition by its predicted confidence, preserving useful model rollouts while attenuating bias from uncertain predictions and enabling stable learning. Across $40$ continuous-control tasks spanning DeepMind Control, MyoSuite, and HumanoidBench, WIMLE achieves superior sample efficiency and competitive or better asymptotic performance than strong model-free and model-based baselines. Notably, on the challenging Humanoid-run task, WIMLE improves sample efficiency by over $50$\% relative to the strongest competitor, and on HumanoidBench it solves $8$ of $14$ tasks (versus $4$ for BRO and $5$ for SimbaV2). These results highlight the value of IMLE-based multi-modality and uncertainty-aware weighting for stable model-based RL.
summary_zh: 基于模型的强化学习具有很强的样本效率潜力，但由于模型误差累积、对多模态动力学进行平均的单峰世界模型，以及偏袒学习的过度自信预测等问题，在实践中常常表现不佳。我们介绍了一种名为WIMLE的基于模型的方法，它将隐式最大似然估计(IMLE)扩展到基于模型的强化学习框架，以学习随机、多模态的世界模型，无需迭代采样，并通过集成和潜在采样来估计预测不确定性。在训练过程中，WIMLE根据预测的置信度对每个合成转移进行加权，在保留有用的模型回滚的同时，减弱来自不确定预测的偏差，并实现稳定的学习。在涵盖DeepMind Control、MyoSuite和HumanoidBench的40个连续控制任务中，WIMLE实现了优异的样本效率，并获得了与强大的无模型和基于模型的基线方法相比具有竞争力或更优的渐近性能。值得注意的是，在具有挑战性的人形跑步任务中，WIMLE相对于最强竞争对手，将样本效率提高了超过50%；在HumanoidBench上，它解决了14个任务中的8个（相比之下，BRO为4个，SimbaV2为5个）。这些结果突出了基于IMLE的多模态性和不确定性感知加权对于稳定的基于模型的强化学习的价值。
tldr: The paper introduces WIMLE, a model-based RL method using Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (IMLE) for learning stochastic, multi-modal world models with uncertainty-aware weighting, demonstrating superior sample efficiency on complex continuous control tasks. It specifically addresses deficiencies of existing model-based RL methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了WIMLE，一种基于模型的强化学习方法，它使用隐式最大似然估计 (IMLE) 来学习具有不确定性感知权重的随机多模态世界模型，并在复杂的连续控制任务中展示出卓越的样本效率。它专门针对现有基于模型的强化学习方法的不足之处。

title: Zero-Shot Instruction Following in RL via Structured LTL Representations
summary: We study instruction following in multi-task reinforcement learning, where an agent must zero-shot execute novel tasks not seen during training. In this setting, linear temporal logic (LTL) has recently been adopted as a powerful framework for specifying structured, temporally extended tasks. While existing approaches successfully train generalist policies, they often struggle to effectively capture the rich logical and temporal structure inherent in LTL specifications. In this work, we address these concerns with a novel approach to learn structured task representations that facilitate training and generalisation. Our method conditions the policy on sequences of Boolean formulae constructed from a finite automaton of the task. We propose a hierarchical neural architecture to encode the logical structure of these formulae, and introduce an attention mechanism that enables the policy to reason about future subgoals. Experiments in a variety of complex environments demonstrate the strong generalisation capabilities and superior performance of our approach.
summary_zh: 我们研究多任务强化学习中的指令遵循问题，在该场景下，智能体必须零样本执行训练期间未见过的新任务。在此设定中，线性时序逻辑(LTL)最近被采用作为指定结构化、时间扩展任务的强大框架。尽管现有方法成功训练了通才策略，但它们通常难以有效捕获LTL规范中固有的丰富逻辑和时间结构。在这项工作中，我们提出一种学习结构化任务表示的新方法来解决这些问题，从而促进训练和泛化。我们的方法以由任务的有限自动机构建的布尔公式序列为条件来控制策略。我们提出了一种分层神经架构来编码这些公式的逻辑结构，并引入了一种注意力机制，使策略能够推理未来的子目标。在各种复杂环境中的实验表明，我们的方法具有强大的泛化能力和优越的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel method for zero-shot instruction following in RL using structured LTL representations and a hierarchical attention-based neural architecture, showing strong generalization across complex environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的零样本强化学习指令跟随方法，该方法使用结构化的线性时序逻辑（LTL）表示和一个分层的基于注意力的神经网络架构，并在复杂的环境中表现出强大的泛化能力。

title: AutoWebWorld: Synthesizing Infinite Verifiable Web Environments via Finite State Machines
summary: The performance of autonomous Web GUI agents heavily relies on the quality and quantity of their training data. However, a fundamental bottleneck persists: collecting interaction trajectories from real-world websites is expensive and difficult to verify. The underlying state transitions are hidden, leading to reliance on inconsistent and costly external verifiers to evaluate step-level correctness. To address this, we propose AutoWebWorld, a novel framework for synthesizing controllable and verifiable web environments by modeling them as Finite State Machines (FSMs) and use coding agents to translate FSMs into interactive websites. Unlike real websites, where state transitions are implicit, AutoWebWorld explicitly defines all states, actions, and transition rules. This enables programmatic verification: action correctness is checked against predefined rules, and task success is confirmed by reaching a goal state in the FSM graph. AutoWebWorld enables a fully automated search-and-verify pipeline, generating over 11,663 verified trajectories from 29 diverse web environments at only $0.04 per trajectory. Training on this synthetic data significantly boosts real-world performance. Our 7B Web GUI agent outperforms all baselines within 15 steps on WebVoyager. Furthermore, we observe a clear scaling law: as the synthetic data volume increases, performance on WebVoyager and Online-Mind2Web consistently improves.
summary_zh: 自主Web图形界面代理的性能很大程度上取决于其训练数据的质量和数量。然而，一个根本性的瓶颈依然存在：从真实网站收集交互轨迹成本高昂且难以验证。底层状态转换是隐藏的，导致需要依赖不一致且昂贵的外部验证器来评估步骤级别的正确性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了AutoWebWorld，这是一个新颖的框架，通过将Web环境建模为有限状态机（FSM）并使用编码代理将FSM转换为交互式网站，从而合成可控且可验证的Web环境。与状态转换隐式的真实网站不同，AutoWebWorld显式地定义了所有状态、动作和转换规则。这实现了程序化验证：动作的正确性通过预定义的规则进行检查，任务的成功则通过到达FSM图中的目标状态来确认。AutoWebWorld支持完全自动化的搜索和验证流程，从29个不同的Web环境中生成超过11,663条经过验证的轨迹，每条轨迹仅花费0.04美元。在这种合成数据上进行训练可以显著提升现实世界的性能。我们的7B Web图形界面代理在WebVoyager上超过所有基线，在15步之内完成任务。此外，我们观察到一个清晰的规模法则：随着合成数据量的增加，在WebVoyager和Online-Mind2Web上的性能持续提升。
tldr: AutoWebWorld synthesizes verifiable web environments using Finite State Machines, enabling automated generation of large-scale training data for web GUI agents and improving their real-world performance.
tldr_zh: AutoWebWorld通过使用有限状态机合成可验证的Web环境，从而能够自动生成大规模训练数据，并提高Web GUI代理的真实世界性能。

title: Integrating Affordances and Attention models for Short-Term Object Interaction Anticipation
summary: Short Term object-interaction Anticipation consists in detecting the location of the next active objects, the noun and verb categories of the interaction, as well as the time to contact from the observation of egocentric video. This ability is fundamental for wearable assistants to understand user goals and provide timely assistance, or to enable human-robot interaction. In this work, we present a method to improve the performance of STA predictions. Our contributions are two-fold: 1 We propose STAformer and STAformer plus plus, two novel attention-based architectures integrating frame-guided temporal pooling, dual image-video attention, and multiscale feature fusion to support STA predictions from an image-input video pair; 2 We introduce two novel modules to ground STA predictions on human behavior by modeling affordances. First, we integrate an environment affordance model which acts as a persistent memory of interactions that can take place in a given physical scene. We explore how to integrate environment affordances via simple late fusion and with an approach which adaptively learns how to best fuse affordances with end-to-end predictions. Second, we predict interaction hotspots from the observation of hands and object trajectories, increasing confidence in STA predictions localized around the hotspot. Our results show significant improvements on Overall Top-5 mAP, with gain up to +23p.p on Ego4D and +31p.p on a novel set of curated EPIC-Kitchens STA labels. We released the code, annotations, and pre-extracted affordances on Ego4D and EPIC-Kitchens to encourage future research in this area.
summary_zh: 短期物体-交互预测包括从自我中心视频的观察中，检测下一个活跃物体的位置、交互的名词和动词类别，以及接触时间。这种能力对于可穿戴助手理解用户目标并提供及时帮助，或实现人机交互至关重要。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种方法来提高 STA 预测的性能。我们的贡献体现在两个方面：1. 我们提出了 STAformer 和 STAformer plus plus，这两种新型的基于注意力的架构集成了帧引导的时间池化、双重图像-视频注意力和多尺度特征融合，以支持来自图像-输入视频对的 STA 预测；2. 我们引入了两个新的模块，通过对可供性建模，将 STA 预测与人类行为结合起来。首先，我们集成了一个环境可供性模型，该模型充当给定物理场景中可能发生的交互的持久记忆。我们探索了如何通过简单的后期融合以及一种自适应学习如何最好地将可供性与端到端预测融合的方法来集成环境可供性。其次，我们从手和物体轨迹的观察中预测交互热点，提高了对围绕热点定位的 STA 预测的置信度。我们的结果显示，在 Top-5 mAP 总分上取得了显著的改进，在 Ego4D 上提升高达 +23 个百分点，在一个新的整理的 EPIC-Kitchens STA 标签集上提升高达 +31 个百分点。我们发布了 Ego4D 和 EPIC-Kitchens 上的代码、注释和预提取的可供性，以鼓励未来在该领域的研究。
tldr: This paper introduces STAformer, a novel attention-based architecture, along with affordance modeling techniques, to improve short-term object interaction anticipation, demonstrating significant performance gains on Ego4D and EPIC-Kitchens datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了STAformer，一种新颖的基于注意力的结构，结合了可供性建模技术，以改进短期物体交互预测，并在Ego4D和EPIC-Kitchens数据集上展示了显著的性能提升。

title: DriveFine: Refining-Augmented Masked Diffusion VLA for Precise and Robust Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving increasingly adopt generative planners trained with imitation learning followed by reinforcement learning. Diffusion-based planners suffer from modality alignment difficulties, low training efficiency, and limited generalization. Token-based planners are plagued by cumulative causal errors and irreversible decoding. In summary, the two dominant paradigms exhibit complementary strengths and weaknesses. In this paper, we propose DriveFine, a masked diffusion VLA model that combines flexible decoding with self-correction capabilities. In particular, we design a novel plug-and-play block-MoE, which seamlessly injects a refinement expert on top of the generation expert. By enabling explicit expert selection during inference and gradient blocking during training, the two experts are fully decoupled, preserving the foundational capabilities and generic patterns of the pretrained weights, which highlights the flexibility and extensibility of the block-MoE design. Furthermore, we design a hybrid reinforcement learning strategy that encourages effective exploration of refinement expert while maintaining training stability. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM v1, v2, and Navhard benchmarks demonstrate that DriveFine exhibits strong efficacy and robustness. The code will be released at https://github.com/MSunDYY/DriveFine.
summary_zh: 用于自动驾驶的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型越来越多地采用生成式规划器，这些规划器首先通过模仿学习进行训练，然后通过强化学习进行训练。基于扩散的规划器面临模态对齐困难、训练效率低以及泛化能力有限的问题。基于令牌的规划器则受累于累积因果错误和不可逆解码。总而言之，这两种主流范式展现出互补的优势和劣势。在本文中，我们提出了 DriveFine，一种掩码扩散 VLA 模型，它结合了灵活解码和自我纠正能力。特别地，我们设计了一种新颖的即插即用型块状专家混合 (block-MoE)，它在生成专家之上无缝注入了精炼专家。通过在推理期间启用显式的专家选择，并在训练期间启用梯度阻断，这两个专家完全解耦，保留了预训练权重的基本能力和通用模式，这突出了块状专家混合设计的灵活性和可扩展性。此外，我们设计了一种混合强化学习策略，该策略鼓励对精炼专家进行有效探索，同时保持训练稳定性。在 NAVSIM v1、v2 和 Navhard 基准上的大量实验表明，DriveFine 表现出强大的有效性和鲁棒性。代码将在https://github.com/MSunDYY/DriveFine 上发布。
tldr: DriveFine is a masked diffusion VLA model for autonomous driving that combines generative planning with self-correction using a novel block-MoE architecture and hybrid reinforcement learning, demonstrating strong efficacy and robustness on various benchmarks.
tldr_zh: DriveFine是一个用于自动驾驶的masked diffusion VLA模型，它结合了生成式规划和使用新型block-MoE架构和混合强化学习的自我校正功能，在各种基准测试中表现出强大的有效性和鲁棒性。

title: MoRL: Reinforced Reasoning for Unified Motion Understanding and Generation
summary: Human motion understanding and generation are crucial for vision and robotics but remain limited in reasoning capability and test-time planning. We propose MoRL, a unified multimodal motion model trained with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Our task-specific reward design combines semantic alignment and reasoning coherence for understanding with physical plausibility and text-motion consistency for generation, improving both logical reasoning and perceptual realism. To further enhance inference, we introduce Chain-of-Motion (CoM), a test-time reasoning method that enables step-by-step planning and reflection. We also construct two large-scale CoT datasets, MoUnd-CoT-140K and MoGen-CoT-140K, to align motion sequences with reasoning traces and action descriptions. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML show that MoRL achieves significant gains over state-of-the-art baselines. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/MoRL. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/MoRL.
summary_zh: 人体动作理解和生成对于视觉和机器人领域至关重要，但在推理能力和测试时规划方面仍存在局限性。我们提出了 MoRL，一个统一的多模态动作模型，通过监督微调和带有可验证奖励的强化学习进行训练。我们针对特定任务的奖励设计结合了语义对齐和用于理解的推理连贯性，以及用于生成的物理合理性和文本-动作一致性，从而提高逻辑推理和感知真实感。为了进一步增强推理能力，我们引入了动作链（CoM），一种测试时推理方法，能够进行逐步规划和反思。我们还构建了两个大规模的CoT数据集，MoUnd-CoT-140K和MoGen-CoT-140K，用于将动作序列与推理轨迹和动作描述对齐。在HumanML3D和KIT-ML上的实验表明，MoRL相比于最先进的基线方法取得了显著提升。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/MoRL。网站：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/MoRL。
tldr: The paper proposes MoRL, a reinforcement learning-based framework for unified human motion understanding and generation, incorporating Chain-of-Motion reasoning and large-scale datasets for improved logical reasoning and perceptual realism.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了MoRL，一个基于强化学习的统一框架，用于人类运动理解和生成，结合了Chain-of-Motion推理和大规模数据集，以提高逻辑推理和感知真实感。

title: Multi-Turn Adaptive Prompting Attack on Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Multi-turn jailbreak attacks are effective against text-only large language models (LLMs) by gradually introducing malicious content across turns. When extended to large vision-language models (LVLMs), we find that naively adding visual inputs can cause existing multi-turn jailbreaks to be easily defended. For example, overly malicious visual input will easily trigger the defense mechanism of safety-aligned LVLMs, making the response more conservative. To address this, we propose MAPA: a multi-turn adaptive prompting attack that 1) at each turn, alternates text-vision attack actions to elicit the most malicious response; and 2) across turns, adjusts the attack trajectory through iterative back-and-forth refinement to gradually amplify response maliciousness. This two-level design enables MAPA to consistently outperform state-of-the-art methods, improving attack success rates by 11-35% on recent benchmarks against LLaVA-V1.6-Mistral-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-Vision-11B-Instruct and GPT-4o-mini.
summary_zh: 多轮越狱攻击通过在多个回合中逐步引入恶意内容，对纯文本大型语言模型（LLMs）非常有效。当扩展到大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）时，我们发现简单地添加视觉输入会导致现有的多轮越狱攻击很容易被防御。例如，过度恶意的视觉输入将很容易触发安全对齐的 LVLMs 的防御机制，使响应更保守。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 MAPA：一种多轮自适应提示攻击，其 1) 在每一轮中，交替使用文本-视觉攻击动作来引出最恶意的响应；以及 2) 在多轮中，通过迭代式的来回优化来调整攻击轨迹，以逐步放大响应恶意性。这种双层设计使 MAPA 能够持续优于最先进的方法，在针对 LLaVA-V1.6-Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.2-Vision-11B-Instruct 和 GPT-4o-mini 的最新基准测试中，攻击成功率提高了 11-35%。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel multi-turn adaptive prompting attack (MAPA) on LVLMs that alternates text and vision inputs and refines the attack trajectory to improve jailbreak success rates, outperforming existing methods by 11-35%.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新颖的多轮自适应提示攻击 (MAPA) 方法，用于攻击大型视觉语言模型 (LVLM)。该方法交替使用文本和视觉输入，并改进攻击轨迹，从而提高越狱成功率，比现有方法提高 11-35%。

title: Moving Beyond Sparse Grounding with Complete Screen Parsing Supervision
summary: Modern computer-use agents (CUA) must perceive a screen as a structured state, what elements are visible, where they are, and what text they contain, before they can reliably ground instructions and act. Yet, most available grounding datasets provide sparse supervision, with insufficient and low-diversity labels that annotate only a small subset of task-relevant elements per screen, which limits both coverage and generalization; moreover, practical deployment requires efficiency to enable low-latency, on-device use. We introduce ScreenParse, a large-scale dataset for complete screen parsing, with dense annotations of all visible UI elements (boxes, 55-class types, and text) across 771K web screenshots (21M elements). ScreenParse is generated by Webshot, an automated, scalable pipeline that renders diverse urls, extracts annotations and applies VLM-based relabeling and quality filtering. Using ScreenParse, we train ScreenVLM, a compact, 316M-parameter vision language model (VLM) that decodes a compact ScreenTag markup representation with a structure-aware loss that upweights structure-critical tokens. ScreenVLM substantially outperforms much larger foundation VLMs on dense parsing (e.g., 0.592 vs. 0.294 PageIoU on ScreenParse) and shows strong transfer to public benchmarks. Moreover, finetuning foundation VLMs on ScreenParse consistently improves their grounding performance, suggesting that dense screen supervision provides transferable structural priors for UI understanding. Project page: https://saidgurbuz.github.io/screenparse/.
summary_zh: 现代计算机使用代理 (CUA) 必须将屏幕感知为一个结构化的状态，即哪些元素是可见的、它们的位置以及它们包含的文本，然后才能可靠地解析指令和执行动作。然而，大多数可用的指令解析数据集提供的监督信息是稀疏的，具有不足且低多样性的标签，这些标签仅标注每个屏幕上一小部分与任务相关的元素，从而限制了覆盖范围和泛化能力；此外，实际部署需要效率以实现低延迟的设备端使用。我们引入了 ScreenParse，这是一个用于完整屏幕解析的大规模数据集，包含对 77.1 万个网页截图（2100 万个元素）中所有可见 UI 元素（框、55 类类型和文本）的密集标注。ScreenParse 由 Webshot 生成，这是一个自动化的、可扩展的流程，可以渲染多种 URL、提取标注，并应用基于 VLM 的重标记和质量过滤。利用 ScreenParse，我们训练了 ScreenVLM，一个紧凑的、拥有 3.16 亿参数的视觉语言模型 (VLM)，它解码一种紧凑的 ScreenTag 标记表示，并采用一种结构感知损失，该损失会提升结构关键型标记的权重。ScreenVLM 在密集解析方面显著优于更大的基础 VLM（例如，在 ScreenParse 上 PageIoU 为 0.592 vs. 0.294），并且在公共基准测试中表现出强大的迁移能力。此外，在 ScreenParse 上微调基础 VLM 可以持续提升它们的指令解析性能，这表明密集的屏幕监督为 UI 理解提供了可迁移的结构先验。项目主页：https://saidgurbuz.github.io/screenparse/。
tldr: This paper introduces ScreenParse, a large-scale dataset for complete screen parsing, and ScreenVLM, a vision-language model trained on this dataset, demonstrating significantly improved performance in dense screen parsing and transfer learning for UI understanding.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了ScreenParse，一个用于完整屏幕解析的大规模数据集，以及ScreenVLM，一个基于此数据集训练的视觉-语言模型，该模型在密集屏幕解析和用于UI理解的迁移学习方面表现出显著的性能改进。

title: Interactionless Inverse Reinforcement Learning: A Data-Centric Framework for Durable Alignment
summary: AI alignment is growing in importance, yet current approaches suffer from a critical structural flaw that entangles the safety objectives with the agent's policy. Methods such as Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback and Direct Preference Optimization create opaque, single-use alignment artifacts, which we term Alignment Waste. We propose Interactionless Inverse Reinforcement Learning to decouple alignment artifact learning from policy optimization, producing an inspectable, editable, and model-agnostic reward model. Additionally, we introduce the Alignment Flywheel, a human-in-the-loop lifecycle that iteratively hardens the reward model through automated audits and refinement. This architecture transforms safety from a disposable expense into a durable, verifiable engineering asset.
summary_zh: 人工智能对齐的重要性日益增加，然而目前的方法存在一个关键的结构性缺陷，即将安全目标与智能体的策略纠缠在一起。诸如基于人类反馈的强化学习和直接偏好优化等方法会产生不透明、一次性的对齐产物，我们称之为对齐废弃物。我们提出无交互逆强化学习，以将对齐产物学习与策略优化解耦，从而产生一个可检查、可编辑且与模型无关的奖励模型。此外，我们引入对齐飞轮，这是一个以人工参与的生命周期，通过自动化审计和改进，迭代地强化奖励模型。这种架构将安全性从一次性支出转变为持久、可验证的工程资产。
tldr: This paper proposes Interactionless Inverse Reinforcement Learning and the Alignment Flywheel to create durable, inspectable, and editable reward models, addressing the problem of Alignment Waste in current AI alignment approaches.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无交互式逆强化学习和对齐飞轮方法，旨在创建持久、可检查和可编辑的奖励模型，从而解决当前人工智能对齐方法中的对齐浪费问题。

title: Near-Optimal Sample Complexity for Online Constrained MDPs
summary:
Safety is a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning (RL), particularly in real-world applications such as autonomous driving, robotics, and healthcare. To address this, Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) are commonly used to enforce safety constraints while optimizing performance. However, existing methods often suffer from significant safety violations or require a high sample complexity to generate near-optimal policies. We address two settings: relaxed feasibility, where small violations are allowed, and strict feasibility, where no violation is allowed. We propose a model-based primal-dual algorithm that balances regret and bounded constraint violations, drawing on techniques from online RL and constrained optimization. For relaxed feasibility, we prove that our algorithm returns an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy with $\varepsilon$-bounded violation with arbitrarily high probability, requiring $\tilde{O}\left(\frac{SAH^3}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$ learning episodes, matching the lower bound for unconstrained MDPs. For strict feasibility, we prove that our algorithm returns an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy with zero violation with arbitrarily high probability, requiring $\tilde{O}\left(\frac{SAH^5}{\varepsilon^2ζ^2}\right)$ learning episodes, where $ζ$ is the problem-dependent Slater constant characterizing the size of the feasible region. This result matches the lower bound for learning CMDPs with access to a generative model.
  Our results demonstrate that learning CMDPs in an online setting is as easy as learning with a generative model and is no more challenging than learning unconstrained MDPs when small violations are allowed.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）中的安全性是一个根本性的挑战，尤其是在自动驾驶、机器人和医疗保健等真实世界应用中。为了解决这个问题，受约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDPs）通常被用来在优化性能的同时强制执行安全约束。然而，现有方法通常遭受显著的安全违例，或者需要很高的样本复杂度才能生成接近最优的策略。我们针对两种设置进行研究：松弛可行性（允许小的违例）和严格可行性（不允许任何违例）。我们提出了一种基于模型的原始-对偶算法，该算法借鉴了在线强化学习和约束优化中的技术，从而平衡了遗憾和有界约束违例。对于松弛可行性，我们证明我们的算法以任意高的概率返回一个$\varepsilon$-最优的策略，其违例 bounded 于 $\varepsilon$，需要 $\tilde{O}\left(\frac{SAH^3}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$ 个学习轮次，与无约束 MDP 的下界相匹配。对于严格可行性，我们证明我们的算法以任意高的概率返回一个违例为零的 $\varepsilon$-最优策略，需要 $\tilde{O}\left(\frac{SAH^5}{\varepsilon^2ζ^2}\right)$ 个学习轮次，其中 $ζ$ 是问题相关的 Slater 常数，用于描述可行区域的大小。该结果与学习具有生成模型的 CMDP 的下界相匹配。我们的结果表明，在在线环境中学习 CMDP 与使用生成模型进行学习一样容易，并且在允许小的违例时，并不比学习无约束 MDP 更具挑战性。
tldr: This paper presents a model-based primal-dual algorithm for online Constrained MDPs (CMDPs), achieving near-optimal sample complexity for both relaxed and strict feasibility settings, matching existing lower bounds. The key finding suggests learning CMDPs online is comparably efficient to learning with a generative model or unconstrained MDPs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于模型的原始-对偶算法，用于在线约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），在宽松和严格可行性设置下均实现了接近最优的样本复杂度，与现有下界相匹配。 主要发现表明，在线学习CMDP与使用生成模型或无约束MDP学习一样有效。

title: Augmenting Human Balance with Generic Supernumerary Robotic Limbs
summary: Supernumerary robotic limbs (SLs) have the potential to transform a wide range of human activities, yet their usability remains limited by key technical challenges, particularly in ensuring safety and achieving versatile control. Here, we address the critical problem of maintaining balance in the human-SLs system, a prerequisite for safe and comfortable augmentation tasks. Unlike previous approaches that developed SLs specifically for stability support, we propose a general framework for preserving balance with SLs designed for generic use. Our hierarchical three-layer architecture consists of: (i) a prediction layer that estimates human trunk and center of mass (CoM) dynamics, (ii) a planning layer that generates optimal CoM trajectories to counteract trunk movements and computes the corresponding SL control inputs, and (iii) a control layer that executes these inputs on the SL hardware. We evaluated the framework with ten participants performing forward and lateral bending tasks. The results show a clear reduction in stance instability, demonstrating the framework's effectiveness in enhancing balance. This work paves the path towards safe and versatile human-SLs interactions. [This paper has been submitted for publication to IEEE.]
summary_zh: 超限机械肢（SLs）具有改变人类广泛活动方式的潜力，但其可用性仍然受到关键技术挑战的限制，尤其是在确保安全性和实现通用控制方面。本文着重解决维持人-SLs系统平衡这一关键问题，这是安全舒适的增强任务的先决条件。与先前专门为提供稳定性支持而开发的SLs不同，我们提出了一种通用框架，用于在使用为通用目的设计的SLs时保持平衡。我们的分层三层架构包括：（i）预测层，用于估计人体躯干和质心(CoM)的动力学，（ii）规划层，用于生成优化后的CoM轨迹以抵消躯干运动并计算相应的SL控制输入，以及（iii）控制层，用于在SL硬件上执行这些输入。我们通过十名参与者执行的前屈和侧屈任务对该框架进行了评估。结果表明，站立不稳定性明显降低，证明了该框架在增强平衡方面的有效性。这项工作为实现安全且通用的的人-SLs交互铺平了道路。[本文已提交给IEEE发表。]
tldr: This paper presents a hierarchical framework for maintaining human balance using generic supernumerary robotic limbs by predicting trunk and CoM dynamics and planning optimal CoM trajectories. Experiments with human participants demonstrated a reduction in stance instability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个分层框架，通过预测躯干和重心 (CoM) 动力学并规划最佳 CoM 轨迹，使用通用辅助机器人肢体来维持人体平衡。人体实验表明站立不稳情况有所减少。

title: Affordance Transfer Across Object Instances via Semantically Anchored Functional Map
summary: Traditional learning from demonstration (LfD) generally demands a cumbersome collection of physical demonstrations, which can be time-consuming and challenging to scale. Recent advances show that robots can instead learn from human videos by extracting interaction cues without direct robot involvement. However, a fundamental challenge remains: how to generalize demonstrated interactions across different object instances that share similar functionality but vary significantly in geometry. In this work, we propose \emph{Semantic Anchored Functional Maps} (SemFM), a framework for transferring affordances across objects from a single visual demonstration. Starting from a coarse mesh reconstructed from an image, our method identifies semantically corresponding functional regions between objects, selects mutually exclusive semantic anchors, and propagates these constraints over the surface using a functional map to obtain a dense, semantically consistent correspondence. This enables demonstrated interaction regions to be transferred across geometrically diverse objects in a lightweight and interpretable manner. Experiments on synthetic object categories and real-world robotic manipulation tasks show that our approach enables accurate affordance transfer with modest computational cost, making it well-suited for practical robotic perception-to-action pipelines.
summary_zh: 传统的示教学习（LfD）通常需要繁琐的物理演示数据收集，这既耗时又难以扩展。 近期进展表明，机器人可以通过提取交互线索，在无需直接机器人参与的情况下学习人类视频。 然而，一个根本性的挑战仍然存在：如何将演示的交互推广到在几何形状上差异显著，但功能相似的不同对象实例上。 在这项工作中，我们提出\emph{语义锚定功能映射}（SemFM），一个从单一视觉演示中跨对象传递可供性的框架。 从图像重建的粗糙网格开始，我们的方法识别对象之间语义对应的功能区域，选择互斥的语义锚点，并使用功能映射在表面上传播这些约束，以获得密集的，语义一致的对应关系。 这使得演示的交互区域能够以轻量级和可解释的方式跨越几何形状多样的对象进行传递。 在合成对象类别和真实世界机器人操作任务上的实验表明，我们的方法能够以适中的计算成本实现准确的可供性传递，使其非常适合实际的机器人感知到行动的流水线。
tldr: This paper introduces Semantic Anchored Functional Maps (SemFM) for transferring affordances across geometrically diverse object instances from a single visual demonstration, enabling robots to learn manipulation skills more efficiently.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了语义锚定功能映射(SemFM)，用于从单个视觉演示中将可供性转移到几何上不同的对象实例，从而使机器人能够更有效地学习操作技能。

title: Scalable Multi-Robot Path Planning via Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization
summary: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) remains a fundamental challenge in robotics, where classical centralized approaches exhibit exponential growth in joint-state complexity as the number of agents increases. This paper investigates Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) as a structurally scalable alternative for simultaneous multi-robot path planning. This approach is a robotics-oriented QUBO formulation incorporating BFS-based logical pre-processing (achieving over 95% variable reduction), adaptive penalty design for collision and constraint enforcement, and a time-windowed decomposition strategy that enables execution within current hardware limitations. An experimental evaluation in grid environments with up to four robots demonstrated near-optimal solutions in dense scenarios and favorable scaling behavior compared to sequential classical planning. These results establish a practical and reproducible baseline for future quantum and quantum-inspired multi-robot coordinations.
summary_zh: 多智能体路径规划 (MAPF) 仍然是机器人学中的一个根本性挑战，其中经典的集中式方法随着智能体数量的增加，联合状态复杂性呈指数级增长。本文研究了二次无约束二元优化 (QUBO) 作为一种在结构上可扩展的替代方案，用于同步多机器人路径规划。该方法是一种面向机器人学的 QUBO 公式，融合了基于 BFS 的逻辑预处理（实现超过 95% 的变量缩减）、用于碰撞和约束强制执行的自适应惩罚设计，以及一种时间窗口分解策略，可在当前硬件限制内执行。在多达四个机器人的网格环境中进行的实验评估表明，在密集场景中获得了接近最优的解决方案，并且与顺序经典规划相比，具有良好的缩放行为。这些结果为未来的量子和类量子多机器人协调建立了一个实用且可重复的基准。
tldr: This paper presents a QUBO-based approach for scalable multi-robot path planning, incorporating pre-processing, adaptive penalty design, and time-windowed decomposition to achieve near-optimal solutions in dense environments with up to four robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于QUBO的多机器人路径规划方法，通过预处理、自适应惩罚设计和时间窗口分解，在密集环境中实现了最多四个机器人的近优解，并具有良好的可扩展性。

title: ManeuverNet: A Soft Actor-Critic Framework for Precise Maneuvering of Double-Ackermann-Steering Robots with Optimized Reward Functions
summary: Autonomous control of double-Ackermann-steering robots is essential in agricultural applications, where robots must execute precise and complex maneuvers within a limited space. Classical methods, such as the Timed Elastic Band (TEB) planner, can address this problem, but they rely on parameter tuning, making them highly sensitive to changes in robot configuration or environment and impractical to deploy without constant recalibration. At the same time, end-to-end deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods often fail due to unsuitable reward functions for non-holonomic constraints, resulting in sub-optimal policies and poor generalization. To address these challenges, this paper presents ManeuverNet, a DRL framework tailored for double-Ackermann systems, combining Soft Actor-Critic with CrossQ. Furthermore, ManeuverNet introduces four specifically designed reward functions to support maneuver learning. Unlike prior work, ManeuverNet does not depend on expert data or handcrafted guidance. We extensively evaluate ManeuverNet against both state-of-the-art DRL baselines and the TEB planner. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework substantially improves maneuverability and success rates, achieving more than a 40% gain over DRL baselines. Moreover, ManeuverNet effectively mitigates the strong parameter sensitivity observed in the TEB planner. In real-world trials, ManeuverNet achieved up to a 90% increase in maneuvering trajectory efficiency, highlighting its robustness and practical applicability.
summary_zh: 双阿克曼转向机器人的自主控制在农业应用中至关重要，因为机器人必须在有限空间内执行精确而复杂的操作。诸如时序弹性带(TEB)规划器等经典方法可以解决这个问题，但它们依赖于参数调整，使其对机器人配置或环境的变化高度敏感，若不进行持续重新校准则难以部署。同时，端到端深度强化学习(DRL)方法常常因非完整约束的不适当奖励函数而失败，导致次优策略和泛化能力差。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种为双阿克曼系统定制的DRL框架ManeuverNet，它将软行动者 critic (Soft Actor-Critic) 与 CrossQ 相结合。此外，ManeuverNet 引入了四种专门设计的奖励函数来支持操作学习。与以往工作不同，ManeuverNet 不依赖于专家数据或手工指导。我们针对最先进的 DRL 基线和 TEB 规划器对 ManeuverNet 进行了广泛的评估。实验结果表明，我们的框架大幅提高了可操作性和成功率，相比 DRL 基线提高了40%以上。此外，ManeuverNet 有效缓解了 TEB 规划器中观察到的强参数敏感性。在真实世界的试验中，ManeuverNet实现了高达90%的操作轨迹效率提升，突显了其鲁棒性和实际适用性。
tldr: The paper presents ManeuverNet, a DRL framework (Soft Actor-Critic with CrossQ and optimized reward functions) for precise maneuvering of double-Ackermann-steering robots, demonstrating improved maneuverability and robustness compared to existing DRL and classical methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了ManeuverNet，一个用于精确控制双阿克曼转向机器人的DRL框架（Soft Actor-Critic with CrossQ和优化的奖励函数）。实验结果表明，与现有的DRL和传统方法相比，ManeuverNet在机动性和鲁棒性方面都有显著提高。

title: Real-time Monocular 2D and 3D Perception of Endoluminal Scenes for Controlling Flexible Robotic Endoscopic Instruments
summary: Endoluminal surgery offers a minimally invasive option for early-stage gastrointestinal and urinary tract cancers but is limited by surgical tools and a steep learning curve. Robotic systems, particularly continuum robots, provide flexible instruments that enable precise tissue resection, potentially improving outcomes. This paper presents a visual perception platform for a continuum robotic system in endoluminal surgery. Our goal is to utilize monocular endoscopic image-based perception algorithms to identify position and orientation of flexible instruments and measure their distances from tissues. We introduce 2D and 3D learning-based perception algorithms and develop a physically-realistic simulator that models flexible instruments dynamics. This simulator generates realistic endoluminal scenes, enabling control of flexible robots and substantial data collection. Using a continuum robot prototype, we conducted module and system-level evaluations. Results show that our algorithms improve control of flexible instruments, reducing manipulation time by over 70% for trajectory-following tasks and enhancing understanding of surgical scenarios, leading to robust endoluminal surgeries.
summary_zh: 腔内手术为早期胃肠道和泌尿道癌症提供了一种微创选择，但受到手术工具和陡峭学习曲线的限制。机器人系统，特别是连续体机器人，提供了灵活的器械，可以进行精确的组织切除，从而可能改善治疗效果。本文提出了一种用于连续体机器人系统在腔内手术中的视觉感知平台。我们的目标是利用基于单目内窥镜图像的感知算法来识别柔性器械的位置和方向，并测量其与组织之间的距离。我们引入了基于学习的2D和3D感知算法，并开发了一个模拟柔性器械动力学的物理逼真模拟器。该模拟器生成逼真的腔内场景，从而能够控制柔性机器人并进行大量数据收集。我们使用连续体机器人原型进行了模块和系统级评估。结果表明，我们的算法改进了对柔性器械的控制，在轨迹跟踪任务中减少了70%以上的操作时间，并增强了对手术场景的理解，从而实现了稳健的腔内手术。
tldr: This paper presents a monocular vision-based perception platform for controlling flexible robotic endoscopic instruments in endoluminal surgery, achieving significant improvements in instrument control and surgical scenario understanding.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个基于单目视觉的感知平台，用于控制内腔手术中的柔性机器人内窥镜器械，在器械控制和手术场景理解方面取得了显著改进。

title: Learning Transferability: A Two-Stage Reinforcement Learning Approach for Enhancing Quadruped Robots' Performance in U-Shaped Stair Climbing
summary: Quadruped robots are employed in various scenarios in building construction. However, autonomous stair climbing across different indoor staircases remains a major challenge for robot dogs to complete building construction tasks. In this project, we employed a two-stage end-to-end deep reinforcement learning (RL) approach to optimize a robot's performance on U-shaped stairs. The training robot-dog modality, Unitree Go2, was first trained to climb stairs on Isaac Lab's pyramid-stair terrain, and then to climb a U-shaped indoor staircase using the learned policies. This project explores end-to-end RL methods that enable robot dogs to autonomously climb stairs. The results showed (1) the successful goal reached for robot dogs climbing U-shaped stairs with a stall penalty, and (2) the transferability from the policy trained on U-shaped stairs to deployment on straight, L-shaped, and spiral stair terrains, and transferability from other stair models to deployment on U-shaped terrain.
summary_zh: 四足机器人在建筑建造的各种场景中得到应用。然而，自主攀爬不同的室内楼梯仍然是机器狗完成建筑建造任务的一大挑战。在这个项目中，我们采用了一种两阶段的端到端深度强化学习（RL）方法，以优化机器人在U型楼梯上的性能。训练机器人狗形态，宇树Go2，首先在Isaac Lab的金字塔楼梯地形上进行楼梯攀爬训练，然后利用学习到的策略攀爬U型室内楼梯。本项目探索了使机器狗能够自主爬楼梯的端到端RL方法。结果表明：（1）机器狗在带有停滞惩罚的U型楼梯攀爬中成功到达目标，以及（2）从U型楼梯训练的策略到直线、L型和螺旋楼梯地形部署的迁移性，以及从其他楼梯模型到U型地形部署的迁移性。
tldr: This paper presents a two-stage reinforcement learning approach for enabling a quadruped robot (Unitree Go2) to climb U-shaped stairs, demonstrating transferability to other stair terrains.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种两阶段强化学习方法，使四足机器人(Unitree Go2)能够攀爬U型楼梯，并展示了其在其他楼梯地形上的迁移性。

title: A Soft Wrist with Anisotropic and Selectable Stiffness for Robust Robot Learning in Contact-rich Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich manipulation tasks in unstructured environments pose significant robustness challenges for robot learning, where unexpected collisions can cause damage and hinder policy acquisition. Existing soft end-effectors face fundamental limitations: they either provide a limited deformation range, lack directional stiffness control, or require complex actuation systems that compromise practicality. This study introduces CLAW (Compliant Leaf-spring Anisotropic soft Wrist), a novel soft wrist mechanism that addresses these limitations through a simple yet effective design using two orthogonal leaf springs and rotary joints with a locking mechanism. CLAW provides large 6-degree-of-freedom deformation (40mm lateral, 20mm vertical), anisotropic stiffness that is tunable across three distinct modes, while maintaining lightweight construction (330g) at low cost ($550). Experimental evaluations using imitation learning demonstrate that CLAW achieves 76% success rate in benchmark peg-insertion tasks, outperforming both the Fin Ray gripper (43%) and rigid gripper alternatives (36%). CLAW successfully handles diverse contact-rich scenarios, including precision assembly with tight tolerances and delicate object manipulation, demonstrating its potential to enable robust robot learning in contact-rich domains. Project page: https://project-page-manager.github.io/CLAW/
summary_zh: 在非结构化环境中进行富接触式操作任务给机器人学习带来了显著的鲁棒性挑战，其中意外碰撞可能导致损坏并阻碍策略获取。现有的软末端执行器面临着根本性的限制：它们或者提供有限的形变范围，或者缺乏方向刚度控制，或者需要复杂的驱动系统，从而影响实用性。本研究介绍了一种新型软腕机构 CLAW (Compliant Leaf-spring Anisotropic soft Wrist，顺应性板簧各向异性软腕)，它通过使用两个正交板簧和带有锁定机构的旋转关节的简单而有效的设计，解决了这些局限性。CLAW 提供较大的六自由度形变（40mm 横向，20mm 纵向），在三种不同模式下可调的各向异性刚度，同时保持轻量化结构（330g）和低成本（550 美元）。使用模仿学习的实验评估表明，CLAW 在基准插销任务中实现了 76% 的成功率，优于 Fin Ray 夹爪 (43%) 和刚性夹爪替代方案 (36%)。CLAW 成功处理了各种富接触场景，包括具有严格公差的精密装配和精细物体操作，证明了其在富接触领域中实现鲁棒机器人学习的潜力。项目页面：https://project-page-manager.github.io/CLAW/
tldr: The paper introduces CLAW, a novel soft wrist with anisotropic and selectable stiffness, designed for robust robot learning in contact-rich manipulation. Experiments show improved performance in benchmark peg-insertion tasks compared to other grippers.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新型软手腕CLAW，它具有各向异性和可选择的刚度，专为在接触丰富的操作中实现鲁棒的机器人学习而设计。 实验表明，与其他夹具相比，在基准插钉任务中性能得到提高。

title: MAC-AMP: A Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Collaboration System for Multi-Objective Antimicrobial Peptide Design
summary: To address the global health threat of antimicrobial resistance, antimicrobial peptides (AMP) are being explored for their potent and promising ability to fight resistant pathogens. While artificial intelligence (AI) is being employed to advance AMP discovery and design, most AMP design models struggle to balance key goals like activity, toxicity, and novelty, using rigid or unclear scoring methods that make results hard to interpret and optimize. As the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLM) advance and evolve swiftly, we turn to AI multi-agent collaboration based on such models (multi-agent LLMs), which show rapidly rising potential in complex scientific design scenarios. Based on this, we introduce MAC-AMP, a closed-loop multi-agent collaboration (MAC) system for multi-objective AMP design. The system implements a fully autonomous simulated peer review-adaptive reinforcement learning framework that requires only a task description and example dataset to design novel AMPs. The novelty of our work lies in introducing a closed-loop multi-agent system for AMP design, with cross-domain transferability, that supports multi-objective optimization while remaining explainable rather than a 'black box'. Experiments show that MAC-AMP outperforms other AMP generative models by effectively optimizing AMP generation for multiple key molecular properties, demonstrating exceptional results in antibacterial activity, AMP likeliness, toxicity compliance, and structural reliability.
summary_zh: 为了解决抗菌素耐药性的全球健康威胁，抗菌肽（AMP）因其强大的且有前景的对抗耐药病原体的能力而被探索。虽然人工智能（AI）正在被用于推进AMP的发现和设计，但大多数AMP设计模型难以平衡关键目标，如活性、毒性和新颖性，它们使用僵化或不明确的评分方法，导致结果难以解释和优化。随着大型语言模型（LLM）的能力快速发展和演变，我们转向基于此类模型（多智能体LLM）的AI多智能体协作，它们在复杂的科学设计场景中显示出快速增长的潜力。基于此，我们引入了MAC-AMP，一个用于多目标AMP设计的闭环多智能体协作（MAC）系统。该系统实现了一个完全自主的模拟同行评审自适应强化学习框架，只需要一个任务描述和示例数据集即可设计新的AMP。我们工作的创新之处在于引入了一个用于AMP设计的闭环多智能体系统，具有跨域可迁移性，支持多目标优化，同时保持可解释性而非“黑盒”。实验表明，MAC-AMP优于其他AMP生成模型，它能有效地优化AMP生成，以满足多个关键分子性质，并在抗菌活性、AMP可能性、毒性合规性和结构可靠性方面表现出卓越的结果。
tldr: The paper introduces MAC-AMP, a closed-loop multi-agent collaboration system using LLMs for multi-objective antimicrobial peptide design, optimized through a peer review-adaptive reinforcement learning framework, demonstrating superior performance in generating effective and safe AMPs.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MAC-AMP，一种基于LLM的闭环多智能体协作系统，用于多目标抗菌肽设计。该系统通过一种同行评审自适应强化学习框架进行优化，在生成有效且安全的抗菌肽方面表现出优越的性能。

title: On the Learning Dynamics of RLVR at the Edge of Competence
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been a main driver of recent breakthroughs in large reasoning models. Yet it remains a mystery how rewards based solely on final outcomes can help overcome the long-horizon barrier to extended reasoning. To understand this, we develop a theory of the training dynamics of RL for transformers on compositional reasoning tasks. Our theory characterizes how the effectiveness of RLVR is governed by the smoothness of the difficulty spectrum. When data contains abrupt discontinuities in difficulty, learning undergoes grokking-type phase transitions, producing prolonged plateaus before progress recurs. In contrast, a smooth difficulty spectrum leads to a relay effect: persistent gradient signals on easier problems elevate the model's capabilities to the point where harder ones become tractable, resulting in steady and continuous improvement. Our theory explains how RLVR can improve performance at the edge of competence, and suggests that appropriately designed data mixtures can yield scalable gains. As a technical contribution, our analysis develops and adapts tools from Fourier analysis on finite groups to our setting. We validate the predicted mechanisms empirically via synthetic experiments.
summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）一直是近期大型推理模型突破的主要驱动力。然而，仅仅基于最终结果的奖励如何克服扩展推理中的长时域障碍仍然是未解之谜。为了理解这一点，我们发展了一种关于transformer在组合推理任务上进行RL训练动态的理论。我们的理论描述了RLVR的有效性如何被难度谱的平滑性所支配。当数据包含难度上的突变不连续性时，学习会经历groking型的相变，产生长时间的平台期，然后才会再次取得进展。相反，平滑的难度谱会导致一种接力效应：较简单问题上的持续梯度信号提升模型的能力，使其能够处理更难的问题，从而实现稳定和持续的改进。我们的理论解释了RLVR如何提高在能力边缘的性能，并表明适当设计的数据混合可以产生可扩展的收益。作为一项技术贡献，我们的分析开发并调整了有限群上的傅里叶分析工具以适应我们的环境。我们通过合成实验验证了预测的机制。
tldr: This paper develops a theory explaining how Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) overcomes the long-horizon barrier in reasoning tasks, focusing on the impact of data difficulty spectrum smoothness on learning dynamics, particularly grokking transitions.
tldr_zh: 本文开发了一种理论，解释了带有可验证奖励的强化学习(RLVR)如何克服推理任务中的长程障碍，重点关注数据难度谱平滑性对学习动态的影响，特别是Grokking转变。

title: EmbeWebAgent: Embedding Web Agents into Any Customized UI
summary: Most web agents operate at the human interface level, observing screenshots or raw DOM trees without application-level access, which limits robustness and action expressiveness. In enterprise settings, however, explicit control of both the frontend and backend is available. We present EmbeWebAgent, a framework for embedding agents directly into existing UIs using lightweight frontend hooks (curated ARIA and URL-based observations, and a per-page function registry exposed via a WebSocket) and a reusable backend workflow that performs reasoning and takes actions. EmbeWebAgent is stack-agnostic (e.g., React or Angular), supports mixed-granularity actions ranging from GUI primitives to higher-level composites, and orchestrates navigation, manipulation, and domain-specific analytics via MCP tools. Our demo shows minimal retrofitting effort and robust multi-step behaviors grounded in a live UI setting. Live Demo: https://youtu.be/Cy06Ljee1JQ
summary_zh: 大多数网络代理在人机界面层面上运行，观察屏幕截图或原始DOM树，而无法访问应用层，这限制了其鲁棒性和行动表达能力。然而，在企业环境中，前端和后端的显式控制是可用的。我们提出了EmbeWebAgent，一个将代理直接嵌入到现有用户界面中的框架，它使用轻量级前端钩子（精心设计的ARIA和基于URL的观察，以及通过WebSocket暴露的每个页面函数注册表）和一个可重用的后端工作流程，执行推理并采取行动。EmbeWebAgent与技术栈无关（例如，React或Angular），支持从GUI原语到更高级复合操作的混合粒度操作，并通过MCP工具协调导航、操作和特定领域的分析。我们的演示展示了最小的改造工作量和基于真实UI环境的稳健多步骤行为。在线演示：https://youtu.be/Cy06Ljee1JQ
tldr: EmbeWebAgent is a framework for embedding web agents directly into existing UIs with frontend hooks and a reusable backend workflow, enabling more robust and expressive actions compared to traditional web agents.
tldr_zh: EmbeWebAgent是一个框架，用于将Web代理直接嵌入到现有的UI中，具有前端钩子和可重用的后端工作流程，与传统的Web代理相比，能够实现更强大和更具表现力的动作。

title: ST-EVO: Towards Generative Spatio-Temporal Evolution of Multi-Agent Communication Topologies
summary: LLM-powered Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have emerged as an effective approach towards collaborative intelligence, and have attracted wide research interests. Among them, ``self-evolving'' MAS, treated as a more flexible and powerful technical route, can construct task-adaptive workflows or communication topologies, instead of relying on a predefined static structue template. Current self-evolving MAS mainly focus on Spatial Evolving or Temporal Evolving paradigm, which only considers the single dimension of evolution and does not fully incentivize LLMs' collaborative capability. In this work, we start from a novel Spatio-Temporal perspective by proposing ST-EVO, which supports dialogue-wise communication scheduling with a compact yet powerful flow-matching based Scheduler. To make precise Spatio-Temporal scheduling, ST-EVO can also perceive the uncertainty of MAS, and possesses self-feedback ability to learn from accumulated experience. Extensive experiments on nine benchmarks demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of ST-EVO, achieving about 5%--25% accuracy improvement.
summary_zh: 由大型语言模型驱动的多智能体系统(MAS)已成为一种有效的协同智能方法，并引起了广泛的研究兴趣。其中，“自进化” MAS被视为一种更灵活、更强大的技术路线，能够构建任务自适应的工作流程或通信拓扑，而不是依赖于预定义的静态结构模板。目前的自进化MAS主要集中在空间进化或时间进化范式上，仅考虑单维度的进化，未能充分激励大型语言模型的协同能力。在这项工作中，我们从一种新颖的时空视角出发，提出了ST-EVO，它支持对话级别的通信调度，并配备了一个紧凑而强大的基于流匹配的调度器。为了实现精确的时空调度，ST-EVO还可以感知MAS的不确定性，并具备从积累的经验中学习的自反馈能力。在九个基准测试上的大量实验表明，ST-EVO具有最先进的性能，实现了约5%-25%的准确率提升。
tldr: The paper introduces ST-EVO, a novel Spatio-Temporal evolving multi-agent system leveraging LLMs for improved collaborative intelligence through dialogue-wise communication scheduling and uncertainty perception, demonstrating SOTA results on several benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 ST-EVO，一种新颖的时空演化多智能体系统，利用 LLM 通过对话式通信调度和不确定性感知来提高协作智能，并在多个基准测试中展示了 SOTA 结果。

title: Fluid-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: The primary focus of multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has been to study interactions among a fixed number of agents embedded in an environment. However, in the real world, the number of agents is neither fixed nor known a priori. Moreover, an agent can decide to create other agents (for example, a cell may divide, or a company may spin off a division). In this paper, we propose a framework that allows agents to create other agents; we call this a fluid-agent environment. We present game-theoretic solution concepts for fluid-agent games and empirically evaluate the performance of several MARL algorithms within this framework. Our experiments include fluid variants of established benchmarks such as Predator-Prey and Level-Based Foraging, where agents can dynamically spawn, as well as a new environment we introduce that highlights how fluidity can unlock novel solution strategies beyond those observed in fixed-population settings. We demonstrate that this framework yields agent teams that adjust their size dynamically to match environmental demands.
summary_zh: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）的主要关注点一直是研究嵌入在环境中的固定数量智能体之间的交互。 然而，在现实世界中，智能体的数量既不是固定的，也不是先验已知的。 此外，智能体可以决定创建其他智能体（例如，细胞可能分裂，或者公司可能剥离一个部门）。 在本文中，我们提出了一个允许智能体创建其他智能体的框架； 我们称之为流体智能体环境。 我们提出了流体智能体博弈的博弈论解概念，并在该框架内实证评估了几种MARL算法的性能。 我们的实验包括已有的基准测试（如捕食者-猎物和基于等级的觅食）的流体变体，其中智能体可以动态产生，以及我们引入的一个新环境，该环境突出了流体性如何能解锁超越固定种群环境中观察到的新颖解决方案策略。 我们证明了该框架产生了能够动态调整其规模以适应环境需求的智能体团队。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel "fluid-agent" reinforcement learning framework where agents can dynamically create other agents, demonstrating its effectiveness in benchmarks like Predator-Prey and Level-Based Foraging.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的“流体代理”强化学习框架，其中代理可以动态创建其他代理，并在诸如Predator-Prey和Level-Based Foraging等基准测试中展示了其有效性。

title: A Trajectory-Based Safety Audit of Clawdbot (OpenClaw)
summary: Clawdbot is a self-hosted, tool-using personal AI agent with a broad action space spanning local execution and web-mediated workflows, which raises heightened safety and security concerns under ambiguity and adversarial steering. We present a trajectory-centric evaluation of Clawdbot across six risk dimensions. Our test suite samples and lightly adapts scenarios from prior agent-safety benchmarks (including ATBench and LPS-Bench) and supplements them with hand-designed cases tailored to Clawdbot's tool surface. We log complete interaction trajectories (messages, actions, tool-call arguments/outputs) and assess safety using both an automated trajectory judge (AgentDoG-Qwen3-4B) and human review. Across 34 canonical cases, we find a non-uniform safety profile: performance is generally consistent on reliability-focused tasks, while most failures arise under underspecified intent, open-ended goals, or benign-seeming jailbreak prompts, where minor misinterpretations can escalate into higher-impact tool actions. We supplemented the overall results with representative case studies and summarized the commonalities of these cases, analyzing the security vulnerabilities and typical failure modes that Clawdbot is prone to trigger in practice.
summary_zh: Clawdbot是一个自托管的、使用工具的个人AI代理，拥有广泛的行动空间，涵盖本地执行和网络中介的工作流程，这在模糊性和对抗性引导下提出了更高的安全风险和安全问题。我们提出了一个以轨迹为中心的Clawdbot评估方法，涵盖六个风险维度。我们的测试套件采样并轻微调整了先前智能体安全基准测试（包括ATBench和LPS-Bench）中的场景，并用专为Clawdbot的工具界面量身定制的手工设计案例进行补充。我们记录了完整的交互轨迹（消息、动作、工具调用参数/输出），并使用自动化轨迹评估器（AgentDoG-Qwen3-4B）和人工审核来评估安全性。在34个典型案例中，我们发现了一个非均匀的安全概况：在以可靠性为中心的任务中，性能通常是一致的，而大多数失败情况出现在意图不明确、目标开放或看似良性的越狱提示下，其中轻微的误解可能会升级为影响更大的工具操作。我们用代表性的案例研究补充了总体结果，并总结了这些案例的共性，分析了Clawdbot在实践中容易触发的安全漏洞和典型故障模式。
tldr: The paper presents a trajectory-based safety audit of Clawdbot, a tool-using personal AI agent, identifying failure modes under ambiguity and adversarial steering using both automated and human evaluation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了对 Clawdbot（一种使用工具的个人AI代理）的基于轨迹的安全审计， 通过自动化和人工评估，识别了在模糊性和对抗性引导下的故障模式。

title: SAILS: Segment Anything with Incrementally Learned Semantics for Task-Invariant and Training-Free Continual Learning
summary: Continual learning remains constrained by the need for repeated retraining, high computational costs, and the persistent challenge of forgetting. These factors significantly limit the applicability of continuous learning in real-world settings, as iterative model updates require significant computational resources and inherently exacerbate forgetting. We present SAILS -- Segment Anything with Incrementally Learned Semantics, a training-free framework for Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation (CISS) that sidesteps these challenges entirely. SAILS leverages foundational models to decouple CISS into two stages: Zero-shot region extraction using Segment Anything Model (SAM), followed by semantic association through prototypes in a fixed feature space. SAILS incorporates selective intra-class clustering, resulting in multiple prototypes per class to better model intra-class variability. Our results demonstrate that, despite requiring no incremental training, SAILS typically surpasses the performance of existing training-based approaches on standard CISS datasets, particularly in long and challenging task sequences where forgetting tends to be most severe. By avoiding parameter updates, SAILS completely eliminates forgetting and maintains consistent, task-invariant performance. Furthermore, SAILS exhibits positive backward transfer, where the introduction of new classes can enhance performance on previous classes.
summary_zh: 持续学习仍然受到重复训练的需求、高昂的计算成本以及持续存在的遗忘挑战的限制。这些因素严重限制了持续学习在现实世界环境中的适用性，因为迭代模型更新需要大量的计算资源，并且固有地加剧了遗忘。我们提出了SAILS——使用增量学习的语义分割一切事物，这是一个免训练的框架，用于类增量语义分割（CISS），可完全避免这些挑战。SAILS利用基础模型将CISS解耦为两个阶段：使用一切事物分割模型（SAM）进行零样本区域提取，随后通过固定特征空间中的原型进行语义关联。SAILS结合了选择性的类内聚类，从而为每个类生成多个原型，以更好地建模类内变异性。我们的结果表明，尽管不需要增量训练，SAILS通常超过现有基于训练的方法在标准CISS数据集上的性能，尤其是在遗忘往往最为严重的长期和具有挑战性的任务序列中。通过避免参数更新，SAILS完全消除了遗忘，并保持了一致的、任务不变的性能。此外，SAILS表现出正向的后向迁移，即新类的引入可以提高先前类的性能。
tldr: SAILS is a training-free class-incremental semantic segmentation framework using SAM for region extraction and prototype-based semantic association, outperforming training-based methods with no forgetting and positive backward transfer.
tldr_zh: SAILS是一个免训练的类别增量语义分割框架，使用SAM进行区域提取，并使用基于原型的语义关联。该方法优于基于训练的方法，且无遗忘现象和正向反向转移行为。

title: RNM-TD3: N:M Semi-structured Sparse Reinforcement Learning From Scratch
summary: Sparsity is a well-studied technique for compressing deep neural networks (DNNs) without compromising performance. In deep reinforcement learning (DRL), neural networks with up to 5% of their original weights can still be trained with minimal performance loss compared to their dense counterparts. However, most existing methods rely on unstructured fine-grained sparsity, which limits hardware acceleration opportunities due to irregular computation patterns. Structured coarse-grained sparsity enables hardware acceleration, yet typically degrades performance and increases pruning complexity. In this work, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first study on N:M structured sparsity in RL, which balances compression, performance, and hardware efficiency. Our framework enforces row-wise N:M sparsity throughout training for all networks in off-policy RL (TD3), maintaining compatibility with accelerators that support N:M sparse matrix operations. Experiments on continuous-control benchmarks show that RNM-TD3, our N:M sparse agent, outperforms its dense counterpart at 50%-75% sparsity (e.g., 2:4 and 1:4), achieving up to a 14% increase in performance at 2:4 sparsity on the Ant environment. RNM-TD3 remains competitive even at 87.5% sparsity (1:8), while enabling potential training speedups.
summary_zh: 稀疏化是一种经过充分研究的压缩深度神经网络（DNN）的技术，它可以在不损害性能的情况下进行压缩。在深度强化学习（DRL）中，即使神经网络的权重仅保留原始权重的5%，其训练性能与密集的对应网络相比，性能损失也很小。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于非结构化的细粒度稀疏性，这限制了硬件加速的机会，因为其计算模式不规则。结构化的粗粒度稀疏性支持硬件加速，但通常会降低性能并增加剪枝的复杂性。在本文中，据我们所知，我们首次研究了RL中的N:M结构化稀疏性，该方法平衡了压缩率、性能和硬件效率。我们的框架在离策略RL（TD3）中，对所有网络强制执行行级别的N:M稀疏性训练，从而保持与支持N:M稀疏矩阵运算的加速器的兼容性。在连续控制基准测试上的实验表明，我们的N:M稀疏智能体RNM-TD3，在50%-75%的稀疏度（例如，2:4和1:4）下，优于其密集对应网络，在Ant环境中，在2:4稀疏度下，性能最多提升14%。即使在87.5%的稀疏度（1:8）下，RNM-TD3仍然具有竞争力，同时还能够实现潜在的训练加速。
tldr: The paper introduces RNM-TD3, a novel reinforcement learning framework using N:M semi-structured sparsity for efficient training with hardware acceleration, demonstrating performance gains over dense TD3 at significant sparsity levels on continuous control tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RNM-TD3，一个使用N:M半结构化稀疏性的新型强化学习框架，可在硬件加速下实现高效训练。在连续控制任务中，该框架在显著稀疏度下表现优于Dense TD3。

title: Frequentist Regret Analysis of Gaussian Process Thompson Sampling via Fractional Posteriors
summary: We study Gaussian Process Thompson Sampling (GP-TS) for sequential decision-making over compact, continuous action spaces and provide a frequentist regret analysis based on fractional Gaussian process posteriors, without relying on domain discretization as in prior work. We show that the variance inflation commonly assumed in existing analyses of GP-TS can be interpreted as Thompson Sampling with respect to a fractional posterior with tempering parameter $α\in (0,1)$. We derive a kernel-agnostic regret bound expressed in terms of the information gain parameter $γ_t$ and the posterior contraction rate $ε_t$, and identify conditions on the Gaussian process prior under which $ε_t$ can be controlled. As special cases of our general bound, we recover regret of order $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{\frac{1}{2}})$ for the squared exponential kernel, $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{\frac{2ν+3d}{2(2ν+d)}} )$ for the Matérn-$ν$ kernel, and a bound of order $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{\frac{2ν+3d}{2(2ν+d)}})$ for the rational quadratic kernel. Overall, our analysis provides a unified and discretization-free regret framework for GP-TS that applies broadly across kernel classes.
summary_zh: 我们研究了高斯过程汤普森采样（GP-TS）在紧凑、连续动作空间上的序贯决策问题，并基于分数高斯过程后验提供了频率学遗憾分析，而无需像先前工作那样依赖于领域离散化。我们表明，GP-TS现有分析中通常假设的方差膨胀可以解释为关于具有退火参数 $α\in (0,1)$ 的分数后验的汤普森采样。我们推导出一个内核不可知的遗憾界，用信息增益参数 $γ_t$ 和后验收缩率 $ε_t$ 表示，并确定了在哪些高斯过程先验条件下可以控制 $ε_t$。作为我们一般界限的特例，我们恢复了平方指数内核的 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{\frac{1}{2}})$ 阶遗憾，Matérn-$ν$ 内核的 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{\frac{2ν+3d}{2(2ν+d)}} )$ 阶遗憾，以及有理二次内核的 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{\frac{2ν+3d}{2(2ν+d)}})$ 阶遗憾。总的来说，我们的分析为GP-TS提供了一个统一且无离散化的遗憾框架，可以广泛应用于各种内核类别。
tldr: This paper provides a discretization-free frequentist regret analysis for Gaussian Process Thompson Sampling (GP-TS) using fractional posteriors, deriving kernel-agnostic regret bounds applicable to various kernel classes.
tldr_zh: 本文使用分数后验，为高斯过程汤普森抽样（GP-TS）提供了无离散化的频率主义后悔分析，并推导了适用于各种核类的与核无关的后悔界限。

title: Conformal Signal Temporal Logic for Robust Reinforcement Learning Control: A Case Study
summary: We investigate how formal temporal logic specifications can enhance the safety and robustness of reinforcement learning (RL) control in aerospace applications. Using the open source AeroBench F-16 simulation benchmark, we train a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent to regulate engine throttle and track commanded airspeed. The control objective is encoded as a Signal Temporal Logic (STL) requirement to maintain airspeed within a prescribed band during the final seconds of each maneuver. To enforce this specification at run time, we introduce a conformal STL shield that filters the RL agent's actions using online conformal prediction. We compare three settings: (i) PPO baseline, (ii) PPO with a classical rule-based STL shield, and (iii) PPO with the proposed conformal shield, under both nominal conditions and a severe stress scenario involving aerodynamic model mismatch, actuator rate limits, measurement noise, and mid-episode setpoint jumps. Experiments show that the conformal shield preserves STL satisfaction while maintaining near baseline performance and providing stronger robustness guarantees than the classical shield. These results demonstrate that combining formal specification monitoring with data driven RL control can substantially improve the reliability of autonomous flight control in challenging environments.
summary_zh: 我们研究了形式化时序逻辑规范如何增强强化学习（RL）控制在航空航天应用中的安全性和鲁棒性。使用开源AeroBench F-16仿真基准，我们训练了一个近端策略优化（PPO）智能体来调节发动机油门并跟踪指令空速。控制目标被编码为信号时序逻辑（STL）需求，以在每次机动的最后几秒内将空速维持在规定的范围内。为了在运行时强制执行此规范，我们引入了一种保角STL盾牌，该盾牌使用在线保角预测来过滤RL智能体的动作。我们比较了三种设置：（i）PPO基线，（ii）带有经典规则的STL盾牌的PPO，以及（iii）带有提议的保角盾牌的PPO，在标称条件下以及涉及气动模型失配、执行机构速率限制、测量噪声和中期目标点跳跃的严重压力场景下。实验表明，保角盾牌在保持接近基线性能的同时保留了STL满意度，并提供了比经典盾牌更强的鲁棒性保证。这些结果表明，将形式化规范监控与数据驱动的RL控制相结合可以显著提高自主飞行控制在具有挑战性环境中的可靠性。
tldr: This paper introduces a conformal Signal Temporal Logic (STL) shield to improve the safety and robustness of Reinforcement Learning (RL) control in aerospace applications, specifically airspeed regulation in an F-16 simulation environment.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种保形信号时序逻辑 (STL) 屏障，以提高强化学习 (RL) 控制在航空航天应用中的安全性和鲁棒性，特别是在 F-16 模拟环境中进行空速调节。

title: In Transformer We Trust? A Perspective on Transformer Architecture Failure Modes
summary: Transformer architectures have revolutionized machine learning across a wide range of domains, from natural language processing to scientific computing. However, their growing deployment in high-stakes applications, such as computer vision, natural language processing, healthcare, autonomous systems, and critical areas of scientific computing including climate modeling, materials discovery, drug discovery, nuclear science, and robotics, necessitates a deeper and more rigorous understanding of their trustworthiness. In this work, we critically examine the foundational question: \textitHow trustworthy are transformer models?} We evaluate their reliability through a comprehensive review of interpretability, explainability, robustness against adversarial attacks, fairness, and privacy. We systematically examine the trustworthiness of transformer-based models in safety-critical applications spanning natural language processing, computer vision, and science and engineering domains, including robotics, medicine, earth sciences, materials science, fluid dynamics, nuclear science, and automated theorem proving; highlighting high-impact areas where these architectures are central and analyzing the risks associated with their deployment. By synthesizing insights across these diverse areas, we identify recurring structural vulnerabilities, domain-specific risks, and open research challenges that limit the reliable deployment of transformers.
summary_zh: Transformer 架构彻底革新了机器学习，应用领域从自然语言处理到科学计算，范围广泛。然而，它们在高风险应用中日益普及，例如计算机视觉、自然语言处理、医疗保健、自动驾驶系统，以及包括气候建模、材料发现、药物发现、核科学和机器人技术在内的科学计算关键领域，这就要求我们对它们的可靠性进行更深刻、更严谨的理解。在这项工作中，我们批判性地考察了以下基础问题：\textit{Transformer 模型有多可靠？} 我们通过对可解释性、可说明性、对抗攻击的鲁棒性、公平性和隐私性进行全面审查来评估它们的可靠性。我们系统地考察了基于 Transformer 的模型在安全关键应用中的可靠性，这些应用涵盖自然语言处理、计算机视觉以及科学与工程领域，包括机器人技术、医学、地球科学、材料科学、流体动力学、核科学和自动定理证明；重点关注这些架构发挥核心作用的高影响力领域，并分析与其部署相关的风险。通过综合这些不同领域的见解，我们发现了反复出现的结构性漏洞、特定领域的风险以及限制 Transformer 可靠部署的开放性研究挑战。
tldr: This paper reviews the trustworthiness of transformer models across various safety-critical applications, identifying structural vulnerabilities, domain-specific risks, and open research challenges.
tldr_zh: 本文回顾了 Transformer 模型在各种安全关键应用中的可信度，识别了结构性漏洞、领域特定风险和未解决的研究难题。

title: Autonomous Robotic Tissue Palpation and Abnormalities Characterisation via Ergodic Exploration
summary: We propose a novel autonomous robotic palpation framework for real-time elastic mapping during tissue exploration using a viscoelastic tissue model. The method combines force-based parameter estimation using a commercial force/torque sensor with an ergodic control strategy driven by a tailored Expected Information Density, which explicitly biases exploration toward diagnostically relevant regions by jointly considering model uncertainty, stiffness magnitude, and spatial gradients. An Extended Kalman Filter is employed to estimate viscoelastic model parameters online, while Gaussian Process Regression provides spatial modelling of the estimated elasticity, and a Heat Equation Driven Area Coverage controller enables adaptive, continuous trajectory planning. Simulations on synthetic stiffness maps demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves better reconstruction accuracy, enhanced segmentation capability, and improved robustness in detecting stiff inclusions compared to Bayesian Optimisation-based techniques. Experimental validation on a silicone phantom with embedded inclusions emulating pathological tissue regions further corroborates the potential of the method for autonomous tissue characterisation in diagnostic and screening applications.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的自主机器人触诊框架，用于在使用粘弹性组织模型进行组织探索期间的实时弹性mapping。该方法结合了使用商用力/力矩传感器的基于力的参数估计和由定制的期望信息密度驱动的遍历控制策略，后者通过共同考虑模型不确定性、刚度大小和空间梯度，明确地将探索偏向于诊断相关的区域。利用扩展卡尔曼滤波器在线估计粘弹性模型参数，而高斯过程回归提供估计弹性的空间建模，并且热方程驱动的区域覆盖控制器实现自适应的连续轨迹规划。在合成刚度图上的仿真表明，与基于贝叶斯优化的技术相比，所提出的方法实现了更好的重建精度，增强的分割能力，以及在检测硬包块方面的改进的鲁棒性。在具有模拟病理组织区域的嵌入包块的硅胶体模上的实验验证进一步证实了该方法在诊断和筛查应用中进行自主组织表征的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents an autonomous robotic palpation framework using ergodic exploration for real-time elastic mapping of tissue, demonstrating improved reconstruction accuracy and inclusion detection compared to Bayesian Optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自主机器人触诊框架，利用遍历探索进行组织实时弹性映射，实验表明与贝叶斯优化相比，该方法具有更高的重建精度和病灶检测能力。

title: Picking the Right Specialist: Attentive Neural Process-based Selection of Task-Specialized Models as Tools for Agentic Healthcare Systems
summary: Task-specialized models form the backbone of agentic healthcare systems, enabling the agents to answer clinical queries across tasks such as disease diagnosis, localization, and report generation. Yet, for a given task, a single "best" model rarely exists. In practice, each task is better served by multiple competing specialist models where different models excel on different data samples. As a result, for any given query, agents must reliably select the right specialist model from a heterogeneous pool of tool candidates. To this end, we introduce ToolSelect, which adaptively learns model selection for tools by minimizing a population risk over sampled specialist tool candidates using a consistent surrogate of the task-conditional selection loss. Concretely, we propose an Attentive Neural Process-based selector conditioned on the query and per-model behavioral summaries to choose among the specialist models. Motivated by the absence of any established testbed, we, for the first time, introduce an agentic Chest X-ray environment equipped with a diverse suite of task-specialized models (17 disease detection, 19 report generation, 6 visual grounding, and 13 VQA) and develop ToolSelectBench, a benchmark of 1448 queries. Our results demonstrate that ToolSelect consistently outperforms 10 SOTA methods across four different task families.
summary_zh: 任务专用模型构成了智能医疗系统的骨干，使智能体能够处理跨疾病诊断、定位和报告生成等任务的临床查询。然而，对于给定的任务，通常不存在单一的“最佳”模型。在实践中，每个任务通过多个相互竞争的专家模型来更好地完成，不同的模型在不同的数据样本上表现出色。因此，对于任何给定的查询，智能体必须从异构的工具候选项池中可靠地选择合适的专家模型。为此，我们引入了ToolSelect，它通过最小化基于抽样专家工具候选者的群体风险，并利用任务条件选择损失的一致代理，自适应地学习工具的模型选择。具体而言，我们提出了一种基于注意力神经过程的selector，其以查询和每个模型的行为摘要为条件，在专家模型中进行选择。受缺乏已建立测试平台的驱动，我们首次引入了一个智能胸部X射线环境，配备了一套多样化的任务专用模型（17个疾病检测、19个报告生成、6个视觉接地和13个VQA），并开发了ToolSelectBench，一个包含1448个查询的基准。我们的结果表明，ToolSelect在四个不同的任务族中始终优于10种SOTA方法。
tldr: The paper introduces ToolSelect, a method for adaptively selecting between task-specialized models in agentic healthcare systems using an Attentive Neural Process, and presents ToolSelectBench, a novel benchmark for chest X-ray analysis, demonstrating superior performance compared to SOTA methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ToolSelect，一种使用注意力神经过程自适应地在智能医疗系统中的任务专用模型之间进行选择的方法，并提出了ToolSelectBench，一个用于胸部X光分析的新基准，证明了其优于SOTA方法的性能。

title: GOT-JEPA: Generic Object Tracking with Model Adaptation and Occlusion Handling using Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture
summary: The human visual system tracks objects by integrating current observations with previously observed information, adapting to target and scene changes, and reasoning about occlusion at fine granularity. In contrast, recent generic object trackers are often optimized for training targets, which limits robustness and generalization in unseen scenarios, and their occlusion reasoning remains coarse, lacking detailed modeling of occlusion patterns. To address these limitations in generalization and occlusion perception, we propose GOT-JEPA, a model-predictive pretraining framework that extends JEPA from predicting image features to predicting tracking models. Given identical historical information, a teacher predictor generates pseudo-tracking models from a clean current frame, and a student predictor learns to predict the same pseudo-tracking models from a corrupted version of the current frame. This design provides stable pseudo supervision and explicitly trains the predictor to produce reliable tracking models under occlusions, distractors, and other adverse observations, improving generalization to dynamic environments. Building on GOT-JEPA, we further propose OccuSolver to enhance occlusion perception for object tracking. OccuSolver adapts a point-centric point tracker for object-aware visibility estimation and detailed occlusion-pattern capture. Conditioned on object priors iteratively generated by the tracker, OccuSolver incrementally refines visibility states, strengthens occlusion handling, and produces higher-quality reference labels that progressively improve subsequent model predictions. Extensive evaluations on seven benchmarks show that our method effectively enhances tracker generalization and robustness.
summary_zh: 人类视觉系统通过整合当前观测结果与之前观测的信息来跟踪目标，适应目标和场景变化，并以精细的粒度推理遮挡情况。相比之下，最近的通用目标跟踪器通常针对训练目标进行优化，这限制了在未见场景中的鲁棒性和泛化能力，并且它们的遮挡推理仍然粗糙，缺乏对遮挡模式的详细建模。为了解决泛化和遮挡感知方面的这些局限性，我们提出了一种模型预测预训练框架GOT-JEPA，它将JEPA从预测图像特征扩展到预测跟踪模型。给定相同的历史信息，教师预测器从干净的当前帧生成伪跟踪模型，而学生预测器学习从被破坏的当前帧预测相同的伪跟踪模型。这种设计提供了稳定的伪监督，并显式地训练预测器在遮挡、干扰项和其他不利观测条件下产生可靠的跟踪模型，从而提高对动态环境的泛化能力。在GOT-JEPA的基础上，我们进一步提出了OccuSolver来增强目标跟踪的遮挡感知。OccuSolver调整了一个以点为中心的点跟踪器，用于目标感知的可见性估计和详细的遮挡模式捕获。以跟踪器迭代生成的对象先验为条件，OccuSolver增量地细化可见性状态，加强遮挡处理，并生成更高质量的参考标签，从而逐步改善后续模型预测。在七个基准测试上的大量评估表明，我们的方法有效地增强了跟踪器的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces GOT-JEPA, a model-predictive pretraining framework for generic object tracking that improves generalization and occlusion handling by predicting tracking models based on corrupted input. It also proposes OccuSolver to refine visibility states for enhanced occlusion perception.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GOT-JEPA，一个用于通用目标跟踪的模型预测预训练框架，通过基于受损输入预测跟踪模型来提高泛化能力和遮挡处理能力。它还提出了OccuSolver来细化可见性状态，以增强遮挡感知。

title: KernelBlaster: Continual Cross-Task CUDA Optimization via Memory-Augmented In-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: Optimizing CUDA code across multiple generations of GPU architectures is challenging, as achieving peak performance requires an extensive exploration of an increasingly complex, hardware-specific optimization space. Traditional compilers are constrained by fixed heuristics, whereas finetuning Large Language Models (LLMs) can be expensive. However, agentic workflows for CUDA code optimization have limited ability to aggregate knowledge from prior exploration, leading to biased sampling and suboptimal solutions. We propose KernelBlaster, a Memory-Augmented In-context Reinforcement Learning (MAIC-RL) framework designed to improve CUDA optimization search capabilities of LLM-based GPU coding agents. KernelBlaster enables agents to learn from experience and make systematically informed decisions on future tasks by accumulating knowledge into a retrievable Persistent CUDA Knowledge Base. We propose a novel profile-guided, textual-gradient-based agentic flow for CUDA generation and optimization to achieve high performance across generations of GPU architectures. KernelBlaster guides LLM agents to systematically explore high-potential optimization strategies beyond naive rewrites. Compared to the PyTorch baseline, our method achieves geometric mean speedups of 1.43x, 2.50x, and 1.50x on KernelBench Levels 1, 2, and 3, respectively. We release KernelBlaster as an open-source agentic framework, accompanied by a test harness, verification components, and a reproducible evaluation pipeline.
summary_zh: 跨多个世代GPU架构优化CUDA代码极具挑战，因为要达到峰值性能，需要对日益复杂的、特定于硬件的优化空间进行广泛探索。传统编译器受到固定启发式方法的限制，而微调大型语言模型（LLM）的成本可能很高。然而，用于CUDA代码优化的基于代理的工作流程在聚合先前探索的知识方面能力有限，导致有偏差的采样和次优的解决方案。我们提出了KernelBlaster，一种内存增强的上下文强化学习（MAIC-RL）框架，旨在提高基于LLM的GPU编码代理的CUDA优化搜索能力。 KernelBlaster通过将知识积累到可检索的持久性CUDA知识库中，使代理能够从经验中学习，并对未来的任务做出系统性的知情决策。我们提出了一种新颖的、剖面引导的、基于文本梯度的代理流程，用于CUDA生成和优化，以在各代GPU架构上实现高性能。 KernelBlaster引导LLM代理系统地探索超越简单重写的高潜力优化策略。与PyTorch基线相比，我们的方法在KernelBench的1级、2级和3级上分别实现了1.43倍、2.50倍和1.50倍的几何平均加速。我们将KernelBlaster作为开源代理框架发布，并附带测试工具、验证组件和可重现的评估流程。
tldr: The paper introduces KernelBlaster, a memory-augmented in-context reinforcement learning framework for optimizing CUDA code across different GPU architectures, achieving speedups over a PyTorch baseline using a novel profile-guided, textual-gradient-based agentic flow.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了KernelBlaster，一个内存增强的上下文强化学习框架，用于优化不同GPU架构上的CUDA代码。通过一种新的基于配置文件引导和文本梯度的代理流程，该方法相对于PyTorch基线实现了加速。

title: Wrivinder: Towards Spatial Intelligence for Geo-locating Ground Images onto Satellite Imagery
summary: Aligning ground-level imagery with geo-registered satellite maps is crucial for mapping, navigation, and situational awareness, yet remains challenging under large viewpoint gaps or when GPS is unreliable. We introduce Wrivinder, a zero-shot, geometry-driven framework that aggregates multiple ground photographs to reconstruct a consistent 3D scene and align it with overhead satellite imagery. Wrivinder combines SfM reconstruction, 3D Gaussian Splatting, semantic grounding, and monocular depth--based metric cues to produce a stable zenith-view rendering that can be directly matched to satellite context for metrically accurate camera geo-localization. To support systematic evaluation of this task, which lacks suitable benchmarks, we also release MC-Sat, a curated dataset linking multi-view ground imagery with geo-registered satellite tiles across diverse outdoor environments. Together, Wrivinder and MC-Sat provide a first comprehensive baseline and testbed for studying geometry-centered cross-view alignment without paired supervision. In zero-shot experiments, Wrivinder achieves sub-30\,m geolocation accuracy across both dense and large-area scenes, highlighting the promise of geometry-based aggregation for robust ground-to-satellite localization.
summary_zh: 将地面图像与地理注册卫星地图对齐对于地图绘制、导航和态势感知至关重要，但在大视角差异或 GPS 不可靠的情况下仍然具有挑战性。我们引入 Wrivinder，一个零样本、几何驱动的框架，它聚合多个地面照片以重建一致的 3D 场景，并将其与顶视卫星图像对齐。Wrivinder 结合了 SfM 重建、3D 高斯 Splatting、语义 grounding 和基于单目深度信息的度量线索，以生成稳定的天顶视角渲染，该渲染可以与卫星上下文直接匹配，从而实现度量精度高的相机地理定位。为了支持对该任务的系统评估（由于缺乏合适的基准），我们还发布了 MC-Sat，这是一个经过精心策划的数据集，将多视角地面图像与地理注册卫星瓦片在各种户外环境中关联起来。Wrivinder 和 MC-Sat 共同为研究无需配对监督的以几何为中心的跨视角对齐提供了一个首个全面的基线和测试平台。在零样本实验中，Wrivinder 在密集和广阔区域场景中均实现了低于 30 米的地理定位精度，突显了基于几何的聚合在稳健的地面至卫星定位方面的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces Wrivinder, a zero-shot framework for geo-locating ground images onto satellite imagery by reconstructing a 3D scene from multiple ground photographs and aligning it with satellite imagery using geometry-driven methods. They also release a dataset, MC-Sat, to evaluate this task.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Wrivinder，一个零样本框架，用于将地面图像地理定位到卫星图像上，通过从多个地面照片重建3D场景，并使用几何驱动方法将其与卫星图像对齐。他们还发布了一个数据集MC-Sat来评估此任务。

title: Kalman Filtering Based Flight Management System Modeling for AAM Aircraft
summary: Advanced Aerial Mobility (AAM) operations require strategic flight planning services that predict both spatial and temporal uncertainties to safely validate flight plans against hazards such as weather cells, restricted airspaces, and CNS disruption areas. Current uncertainty estimation methods for AAM vehicles rely on conservative linear models due to limited real-world performance data. This paper presents a novel Kalman Filter-based uncertainty propagation method that models AAM Flight Management System (FMS) architectures through sigmoid-blended measurement noise covariance. Unlike existing approaches with fixed uncertainty thresholds, our method continuously adapts the filter's measurement trust based on progress toward waypoints, enabling FMS correction behavior to emerge naturally. The approach scales proportionally with control inputs and is tunable to match specific aircraft characteristics or route conditions. We validate the method using real ADS-B data from general aviation aircraft divided into training and verification sets. Uncertainty propagation parameters were tuned on the training set, achieving 76% accuracy in predicting arrival times when compared against the verification dataset, demonstrating the method's effectiveness for strategic flight plan validation in AAM operations.
summary_zh: 先进空中交通 (AAM) 运营需要战略飞行计划服务，这些服务能够预测空间和时间上的不确定性，从而针对诸如气象单元、限制空域和 CNS 中断区域等危险安全地验证飞行计划。 目前针对 AAM 车辆的不确定性估计方法，由于真实世界性能数据的限制，依赖于保守的线性模型。 本文提出了一种新颖的基于卡尔曼滤波的不确定性传播方法，该方法通过 sigmoid 混合的测量噪声协方差来对 AAM 飞行管理系统 (FMS) 架构进行建模。 与具有固定不确定性阈值的现有方法不同，我们的方法能够基于朝向航路点的进展情况，持续调整滤波器的测量信任度，从而使 FMS 校正行为自然呈现。 该方法能够与控制输入成比例地缩放，并且可以进行调整以匹配特定的飞机特性或航线条件。 我们使用来自通用航空飞机的真实 ADS-B 数据（分为训练集和验证集）来验证该方法。 在训练集上调整了不确定性传播参数，与验证数据集相比，在预测到达时间方面实现了 76% 的准确率，这证明了该方法在 AAM 运营中进行战略飞行计划验证的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a Kalman Filter-based uncertainty propagation method for AAM flight planning, improving arrival time prediction accuracy by adapting to waypoint progress. It validates the method using real ADS-B data, achieving 76% accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于卡尔曼滤波的AAM飞行规划不确定性传播方法，通过适应航路点进度来提高到达时间预测准确性。该方法使用真实的ADS-B数据进行验证，实现了76%的准确率。

title: ROSA: Roundabout Optimized Speed Advisory with Multi-Agent Trajectory Prediction in Multimodal Traffic
summary: We present ROSA -- Roundabout Optimized Speed Advisory -- a system that combines multi-agent trajectory prediction with coordinated speed guidance for multimodal, mixed traffic at roundabouts. Using a Transformer-based model, ROSA jointly predicts the future trajectories of vehicles and Vulnerable Road Users (VRUs) at roundabouts. Trained for single-step prediction and deployed autoregressively, it generates deterministic outputs, enabling actionable speed advisories. Incorporating motion dynamics, the model achieves high accuracy (ADE: 1.29m, FDE: 2.99m at a five-second prediction horizon), surpassing prior work. Adding route intention further improves performance (ADE: 1.10m, FDE: 2.36m), demonstrating the value of connected vehicle data. Based on predicted conflicts with VRUs and circulating vehicles, ROSA provides real-time, proactive speed advisories for approaching and entering the roundabout. Despite prediction uncertainty, ROSA significantly improves vehicle efficiency and safety, with positive effects even on perceived safety from a VRU perspective. The source code of this work is available under: github.com/urbanAIthi/ROSA.
summary_zh: 我们提出了ROSA——环岛优化速度建议系统，该系统将多智能体轨迹预测与协同速度引导相结合，用于环岛上的多模式混合交通环境。ROSA使用基于Transformer的模型，联合预测环岛内车辆和弱势道路使用者（VRU）的未来轨迹。该模型经过单步预测训练，并以自回归方式部署，生成确定性输出，从而实现可执行的速度建议。该模型结合了运动动力学，实现了高精度（在五秒预测范围内，ADE: 1.29米，FDE: 2.99米），超过了以往的工作。添加路线意图进一步提高了性能（ADE: 1.10米，FDE: 2.36米），证明了联网车辆数据的价值。基于与VRU和环岛内车辆的预测冲突，ROSA为接近和进入环岛的车辆提供实时、主动的速度建议。尽管存在预测不确定性，ROSA仍显著提高了车辆效率和安全性，即使从VRU的角度来看，也对感知安全性产生了积极影响。该工作的源代码可在github.com/urbanAIthi/ROSA获得。
tldr: The paper introduces ROSA, a system that uses Transformer-based multi-agent trajectory prediction to provide real-time speed advisories for vehicles approaching roundabouts, aiming to improve efficiency and safety in mixed traffic conditions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ROSA，一个基于Transformer的多智能体轨迹预测系统，旨在为接近环岛的车辆提供实时速度建议，从而提高混合交通条件下的效率和安全性。
