tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于D-最优统计量的测试时自适应（TTA）框架，用于稳定并提高高维仿真代理在部署期间面临分布偏移时的性能。

title: Sensor Query Schedule and Sensor Noise Covariances for Accuracy-constrained Trajectory Estimation
summary: Trajectory estimation involves determining the trajectory of a mobile robot by combining prior knowledge about its dynamic model with noisy observations of its state obtained using sensors. The accuracy of such a procedure is dictated by the system model fidelity and the sensor parameters, such as the accuracy of the sensor (as represented by its noise covariance) and the rate at which it can generate observations, referred to as the sensor query schedule. Intuitively, high-rate measurements from accurate sensors lead to accurate trajectory estimation. However, cost and resource constraints limit the sensor accuracy and its measurement rate. Our work's novel contribution is the estimation of sensor schedules and sensor covariances necessary to achieve a specific estimation accuracy. Concretely, we focus on estimating: (i) the rate or schedule with which a sensor of known covariance must generate measurements to achieve specific estimation accuracy, and alternatively, (ii) the sensor covariance necessary to achieve specific estimation accuracy for a given sensor update rate. We formulate the problem of estimating these sensor parameters as semidefinite programs, which can be solved by off-the-shelf solvers. We validate our approach in simulation and real experiments by showing that the sensor schedules and the sensor covariances calculated using our proposed method achieve the desired trajectory estimation accuracy. Our method also identifies scenarios where certain estimation accuracy is unachievable with the given system and sensor characteristics.
summary_zh: 轨迹估计涉及结合移动机器人的动力学模型的先验知识，以及由传感器获取的状态噪声观测值，来确定移动机器人的轨迹。该过程的准确性取决于系统模型的逼真度和传感器参数，例如传感器的精度（以其噪声协方差表示）及其生成观测值的速率（称为传感器查询调度）。直观上，来自精确传感器的高速率测量可以实现精确的轨迹估计。然而，成本和资源限制限制了传感器的精度及其测量速率。我们工作的新颖贡献在于估计实现特定估计精度所需的传感器调度和传感器协方差。具体而言，我们侧重于估计：（i）具有已知协方差的传感器必须生成测量值的速率或调度，以实现特定的估计精度，以及（ii）对于给定的传感器更新速率，实现特定估计精度所需的传感器协方差。我们将估计这些传感器参数的问题建模为半定规划问题，可以通过现成的求解器来解决。我们通过仿真和实际实验验证了我们的方法，结果表明，使用我们提出的方法计算的传感器调度和传感器协方差能够实现所需的轨迹估计精度。我们的方法还可以识别出在给定系统和传感器特性下，某些估计精度无法实现的场景。
tldr: This paper presents a method to estimate sensor schedules and sensor covariances needed to achieve a desired trajectory estimation accuracy for mobile robots, formulating the problem as semidefinite programs and validating it with simulations and real experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种估计传感器调度和传感器协方差的方法，该方法旨在为移动机器人实现所需的轨迹估计精度。该方法将问题转化为半定规划，并通过仿真和实际实验进行了验证。

title: Smooth trajectory generation and hybrid B-splines-Quaternions based tool path interpolation for a 3T1R parallel kinematic milling robot
summary: This paper presents a smooth trajectory generation method for a four-degree-of-freedom parallel kinematic milling robot. The proposed approach integrates B-spline and Quaternion interpolation techniques to manage decoupled position and orientation data points. The synchronization of orientation and arc-length-parameterized position data is achieved through the fitting of smooth piece-wise Bezier curves, which describe the non-linear relationship between path length and tool orientation, solved via sequential quadratic programming. By leveraging the convex hull properties of Bezier curves, the method ensures spatial and temporal separation constraints for multi-agent trajectory generation. Unit quaternions are employed for orientation interpolation, providing a robust and efficient representation that avoids gimbal lock and facilitates smooth, continuous rotation. Modifier polynomials are used for position interpolation. Temporal trajectories are optimized using minimum jerk, time-optimal piece-wise Bezier curves in two stages: task space followed by joint space, implemented on a low-cost microcontroller. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method offers enhanced accuracy, reduced velocity fluctuations, and computational efficiency compared to conventional interpolation methods.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于四自由度并联运动铣削机器人的平滑轨迹生成方法。该方法整合了B样条和四元数插值技术，以处理解耦的位置和姿态数据点。通过拟合平滑的分段Bezier曲线来实现姿态与弧长参数化位置数据的同步，这些曲线描述了路径长度与刀具姿态之间的非线性关系，并通过序列二次规划求解。通过利用Bezier曲线的凸包特性，该方法确保了多智能体轨迹生成的空间和时间分离约束。采用单位四元数进行姿态插值，提供了一种稳健高效的表示方式，避免了万向节锁，并促进了平滑连续的旋转。使用调整多项式进行位置插值。时间轨迹采用最小加加速度、时间最优的分段Bezier曲线分两个阶段进行优化：先在任务空间优化，然后在关节空间优化，并在低成本微控制器上实现。实验结果表明，与传统的插值方法相比，该方法具有更高的精度、更小的速度波动以及更高的计算效率。
tldr: This paper presents a novel method for smooth trajectory generation in a 3T1R parallel kinematic milling robot using B-splines, Quaternions, and Bezier curves, demonstrating improved accuracy and efficiency compared to conventional methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的方法，使用B样条、四元数和贝塞尔曲线，在3T1R并联运动铣削机器人中实现平滑轨迹生成，与传统方法相比，提高了精度和效率。

title: Image Measurement Method for Automatic Insertion of Forks into Inclined Pallet
summary: In order to insert a fork into a hole of a pallet by a forklift located in front of a pallet, it is necessary to control the height position, reach position, and tilt angle of the fork to match the position and orientation of the hole of the pallet. In order to make AGF (Autonomous Guided Forklift) do this automatically, we propose an image measurement method to measure the pitch inclination of the pallet in the camera coordinate system from an image obtained by using a wide-angle camera. In addition, we propose an image measurement method to easily acquire the calibration information between the camera coordinate system and the fork coordinate system necessary to apply the measurements in the camera coordinate system to the fork control. In the experiment space, a wide-angle camera was fixed at the backrest of a reach type forklift. The wide-angle images taken by placing a pallet in front of the camera were processed. As a result of evaluating the error by comparing the image measurement value with the hand measurement value when changing the pitch inclination angle of the pallet, the relative height of the pallet and the fork, and whether the pallet is loaded or not, it was confirmed that the error was within the allowable range for safely inserting the fork.
summary_zh: 为了使位于托盘前方的叉车能将货叉插入托盘孔，有必要控制货叉的高度位置、伸展位置和倾斜角度，使其与托盘孔的位置和方向相匹配。为了让AGF（自动导引叉车）自动完成此操作，我们提出了一种图像测量方法，利用广角相机获取的图像，测量托盘在相机坐标系中的俯仰倾角。此外，我们提出了一种图像测量方法，可以轻松获取相机坐标系和货叉坐标系之间的标定信息，以便将相机坐标系中的测量结果应用于货叉控制。在实验空间中，一个广角相机被固定在伸缩式叉车的靠背上。对在相机前方放置托盘所拍摄的广角图像进行了处理。通过比较图像测量值与手动测量值，并改变托盘的俯仰倾角、托盘和货叉的相对高度以及托盘是否装载，对误差进行评估，结果证实误差在安全插入货叉的允许范围内。
tldr: The paper proposes an image measurement method to automatically control an autonomous guided forklift (AGF) for pallet insertion by estimating pallet pose using a wide-angle camera and calibrating the camera-fork coordinate system. Experiments show the method achieves acceptable accuracy for safe fork insertion.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种图像测量方法，通过使用广角相机估计托盘姿态并校准相机-叉坐标系，从而自动控制自动导引叉车（AGF）进行托盘插入。实验表明该方法实现了安全叉插入的可接受精度。

title: ICP-Based Pallet Tracking for Unloading on Inclined Surfaces by Autonomous Forklifts
summary: This paper proposes a control method for autonomous forklifts to unload pallets on inclined surfaces, enabling the fork to be withdrawn without dragging the pallets. The proposed method applies the Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm to point clouds measured from the upper region of the pallet and thereby tracks the relative position and attitude angle difference between the pallet and the fork during the unloading operation in real-time. According to the tracking result, the fork is aligned parallel to the target surface. After the fork is aligned, it is possible to complete the unloading process by withdrawing the fork along the tilt, preventing any dragging of the pallet. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through dynamic simulations and experiments using a real forklift that replicate unloading operations onto the inclined bed of a truck.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自主叉车在倾斜表面卸载托盘的控制方法，能够实现叉子在不拖拽托盘的情况下退出。该方法应用迭代最近点(ICP)算法处理从托盘上部区域测量的点云，从而实时跟踪卸载操作期间托盘和叉子之间的相对位置和姿态角差异。根据跟踪结果，叉子与目标表面对齐平行。叉子对齐后，可以通过沿着倾斜方向退出叉子来完成卸载过程，从而避免拖拽托盘。提出的方法通过动态仿真和使用真实叉车进行的实验验证了其有效性，实验模拟了在卡车倾斜货厢上卸载的操作。
tldr: This paper presents an ICP-based method for real-time tracking of pallets during unloading on inclined surfaces, enabling autonomous forklifts to withdraw forks without dragging the pallet. The method's effectiveness is validated through simulations and experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于ICP的实时托盘跟踪方法，用于在倾斜表面上卸载货物，使自动叉车能够在不拖动托盘的情况下撤回叉子。该方法的有效性通过仿真和实验得到验证。

title: Graph neural network for colliding particles with an application to sea ice floe modeling
summary: This paper introduces a novel approach to sea ice modeling using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), utilizing the natural graph structure of sea ice, where nodes represent individual ice pieces, and edges model the physical interactions, including collisions. This concept is developed within a one-dimensional framework as a foundational step. Traditional numerical methods, while effective, are computationally intensive and less scalable. By utilizing GNNs, the proposed model, termed the Collision-captured Network (CN), integrates data assimilation (DA) techniques to effectively learn and predict sea ice dynamics under various conditions. The approach was validated using synthetic data, both with and without observed data points, and it was found that the model accelerates the simulation of trajectories without compromising accuracy. This advancement offers a more efficient tool for forecasting in marginal ice zones (MIZ) and highlights the potential of combining machine learning with data assimilation for more effective and efficient modeling.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种利用图神经网络（GNNs）进行海冰建模的新方法，该方法利用了海冰的自然图结构，其中节点代表单个冰块，边模拟物理相互作用，包括碰撞。该概念在一个一维框架内开发，作为基础步骤。传统的数值方法尽管有效，但计算密集且可扩展性较差。通过使用GNNs，提出的模型，称为碰撞捕获网络（CN），集成了数据同化（DA）技术，以有效地学习和预测各种条件下的海冰动力学。该方法使用合成数据（包括有和没有观测数据点的情况）进行了验证，结果表明该模型在不影响准确性的前提下加速了轨迹的模拟。这一进步为边缘冰区（MIZ）的预测提供了一种更有效的工具，并突出了将机器学习与数据同化相结合以实现更有效和高效建模的潜力。
tldr: The paper proposes using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to model sea ice dynamics, incorporating data assimilation to improve computational efficiency and accuracy compared to traditional methods. The model is validated on synthetic data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出使用图神经网络（GNN）来模拟海冰动力学，结合数据同化技术，相比传统方法提高了计算效率与准确率。该模型已在合成数据上验证。

title: Breaking the Sub-Millimeter Barrier: Eyeframe Acquisition from Color Images
summary: Eyeframe lens tracing is an important process in the optical industry that requires sub-millimeter precision to ensure proper lens fitting and optimal vision correction. Traditional frame tracers rely on mechanical tools that need precise positioning and calibration, which are time-consuming and require additional equipment, creating an inefficient workflow for opticians. This work presents a novel approach based on artificial vision that utilizes multi-view information. The proposed algorithm operates on images captured from an InVision system. The full pipeline includes image acquisition, frame segmentation to isolate the eyeframe from background, depth estimation to obtain 3D spatial information, and multi-view processing that integrates segmented RGB images with depth data for precise frame contour measurement. To this end, different configurations and variants are proposed and analyzed on real data, providing competitive measurements from still color images with respect to other solutions, while eliminating the need for specialized tracing equipment and reducing workflow complexity for optical technicians.
summary_zh: 眼框镜片追踪是光学工业中的一项重要工艺，需要亚毫米级的精度，以确保镜片的正确适配和最佳的视力矫正。 传统的镜框追踪仪依赖于机械工具，需要精确定位和校准，这既耗时又需要额外的设备，为配镜师造成了低效的工作流程。 本文提出了一种基于人工智能视觉的新方法，该方法利用多视点信息。 所提出的算法运行于从InVision系统捕获的图像上。 完整的流程包括图像采集、镜框分割以将眼框从背景中分离出来、深度估计以获得3D空间信息，以及多视点处理，该处理集成了分割的RGB图像和深度数据，以进行精确的镜框轮廓测量。 为此，本文在真实数据上提出并分析了不同的配置和变体，在静态彩色图像上提供了相对于其他解决方案具有竞争力的测量结果，同时消除了对专用追踪设备的需求，并降低了光学技术人员的工作流程复杂性。
tldr: This paper presents a novel artificial vision system for eyeframe lens tracing from color images, eliminating the need for specialized tracing equipment and reducing workflow complexity for opticians.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于彩色图像的眼镜框镜头追踪的人工视觉系统，从而无需专门的追踪设备，并降低了配镜师的工作流程复杂性。

title: Automated Assessment of Kidney Ureteroscopy Exploration for Training
summary:
Purpose: Kidney ureteroscopic navigation is challenging with a steep learning curve. However, current clinical training has major deficiencies, as it requires one-on-one feedback from experts and occurs in the operating room (OR). Therefore, there is a need for a phantom training system with automated feedback to greatly \revision{expand} training opportunities.
  Methods: We propose a novel, purely ureteroscope video-based scope localization framework that automatically identifies calyces missed by the trainee in a phantom kidney exploration. We use a slow, thorough, prior exploration video of the kidney to generate a reference reconstruction. Then, this reference reconstruction can be used to localize any exploration video of the same phantom.
  Results: In 15 exploration videos, a total of 69 out of 74 calyces were correctly classified. We achieve < 4mm camera pose localization error. Given the reference reconstruction, the system takes 10 minutes to generate the results for a typical exploration (1-2 minute long).
  Conclusion: We demonstrate a novel camera localization framework that can provide accurate and automatic feedback for kidney phantom explorations. We show its ability as a valid tool that enables out-of-OR training without requiring supervision from an expert.
summary_zh:
目的：输尿管肾镜导航具有挑战性，学习曲线陡峭。然而，目前的临床培训存在重大缺陷，因为它需要专家的一对一反馈并且在手术室（OR）中进行。因此，亟需一种具有自动化反馈功能的体外模型训练系统，以大幅扩展培训机会。
  方法：我们提出了一种新颖的、纯粹基于输尿管肾镜视频的镜体定位框架，该框架能够自动识别学员在体外模型肾脏探索中遗漏的肾盏。我们使用缓慢、彻底的肾脏事先探索视频来生成参考重建模型。然后，该参考重建模型可用于定位同一体外模型的任何探索视频。
  结果：在 15 个探索视频中，总共 74 个肾盏中的 69 个被正确分类。我们实现了小于 4 毫米的相机姿态定位误差。在给定参考重建模型的情况下，该系统需要 10 分钟来生成典型探索（1-2 分钟长）的结果。
  结论：我们展示了一种新颖的相机定位框架，可以为肾脏体外模型探索提供准确和自动的反馈。我们证明了其作为一种有效工具的能力，可以实现脱离手术室的训练，而无需专家的监督。
tldr: The paper presents a ureteroscope video-based localization framework for automated assessment of kidney ureteroscopy training, enabling objective feedback on trainee performance in a phantom environment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于输尿管镜视频的定位框架，用于自动评估肾脏输尿管镜检查培训，从而能够在体模环境中对学员表现提供客观反馈。

title: Automated Re-Identification of Holstein-Friesian Cattle in Dense Crowds
summary: Holstein-Friesian detection and re-identification (Re-ID) methods capture individuals well when targets are spatially separate. However, existing approaches, including YOLO-based species detection, break down when cows group closely together. This is particularly prevalent for species which have outline-breaking coat patterns. To boost both effectiveness and transferability in this setting, we propose a new detect-segment-identify pipeline that leverages the Open-Vocabulary Weight-free Localisation and the Segment Anything models as pre-processing stages alongside Re-ID networks. To evaluate our approach, we publish a collection of nine days CCTV data filmed on a working dairy farm. Our methodology overcomes detection breakdown in dense animal groupings, resulting in a 98.93% accuracy. This significantly outperforms current oriented bounding box-driven, as well as SAM species detection baselines with accuracy improvements of 47.52% and 27.13%, respectively. We show that unsupervised contrastive learning can build on this to yield 94.82% Re-ID accuracy on our test data. Our work demonstrates that Re-ID in crowded scenarios is both practical as well as reliable in working farm settings with no manual intervention. Code and dataset are provided for reproducibility.
summary_zh: 荷斯坦-弗里生牛的检测与重识别（Re-ID）方法在目标个体空间分离时表现良好。然而，现有的方法，包括基于YOLO的物种检测，在牛群密集聚集时会失效。对于具有轮廓断裂式毛色图案的物种而言，这种情况尤其普遍。为了提高在这种场景下的有效性和可迁移性，我们提出了一种新的检测-分割-识别流水线，该流水线利用开放词汇免权重定位和Segment Anything模型作为预处理阶段，与Re-ID网络结合使用。为了评估我们的方法，我们发布了一个包含九天CCTV数据的集合，这些数据是在一个实际运作的奶牛场拍摄的。我们的方法克服了密集动物群中的检测失效问题，实现了98.93%的准确率。这显著优于当前的定向边界框驱动的以及SAM物种检测基线，准确率分别提高了47.52%和27.13%。我们表明，无监督对比学习可以在此基础上构建，在我们的测试数据上产生94.82%的Re-ID准确率。我们的工作表明，在拥挤场景中进行Re-ID在实际运作的农场环境中既实用又可靠，无需人工干预。我们提供代码和数据集以确保可重复性。
tldr: This paper presents a novel detect-segment-identify pipeline using Open-Vocabulary Weight-free Localisation and Segment Anything models to improve Holstein-Friesian cattle re-identification in dense crowds, achieving significant accuracy gains over existing methods. They also provide a new dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的检测-分割-识别流程，利用开放词汇无权重定位和Segment Anything模型来提高密集人群中荷斯坦-弗里生奶牛的重识别，与现有方法相比，实现了显著的准确性提升。他们还提供了一个新的数据集。

title: MoDE-Boost: Boosting Shared Mobility Demand with Edge-Ready Prediction Models
summary: Urban demand forecasting plays a critical role in optimizing routing, dispatching, and congestion management within Intelligent Transportation Systems. By leveraging data fusion and analytics techniques, traffic demand forecasting serves as a key intermediate measure for identifying emerging spatial and temporal demand patterns. In this paper, we tackle this challenge by proposing two gradient boosting model variations, one for classiffication and one for regression, both capable of generating demand forecasts at various temporal horizons, from 5 minutes up to one hour. Our overall approach effectively integrates temporal and contextual features, enabling accurate predictions that are essential for improving the efficiency of shared (micro-) mobility services. To evaluate its effectiveness, we utilize open shared mobility data derived from e-scooter and e-bike networks in five metropolitan areas. These real-world datasets allow us to compare our approach with state-of-the-art methods as well as a Generative AI-based model, demonstrating its effectiveness in capturing the complexities of modern urban mobility. Ultimately, our methodology offers novel insights on urban micro-mobility management, helping to tackle the challenges arising from rapid urbanization and thus, contributing to more sustainable, efficient, and livable cities.
summary_zh: 城市需求预测在优化智能交通系统中的路线规划、调度和拥堵管理方面起着至关重要的作用。通过利用数据融合和分析技术，交通需求预测成为识别新兴时空需求模式的关键中间指标。在本文中，我们通过提出两种梯度提升模型的变体来应对这一挑战，一种用于分类，另一种用于回归，二者都能够生成从 5 分钟到 1 小时等不同时间尺度的需求预测。我们的整体方法有效地整合了时间特征和情境特征，从而能够进行准确的预测，这对于提高共享（微型）出行服务的效率至关重要。为了评估其有效性，我们使用了来自五个大都市区的电动滑板车和电动自行车网络的开放共享出行数据。这些真实世界的数据集使我们能够将我们的方法与最先进的方法以及基于生成式人工智能的模型进行比较，从而证明其在捕捉现代城市出行复杂性方面的有效性。最终，我们的方法为城市微型出行管理提供了新的见解，有助于应对快速城市化带来的挑战，从而为建设更具可持续性、效率和宜居性的城市做出贡献。
tldr: The paper introduces MoDE-Boost, a gradient boosting model for predicting shared mobility demand using temporal and contextual features, validated on real-world e-scooter/e-bike data across five cities.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MoDE-Boost，一种使用时序和上下文特征预测共享出行需求的梯度提升模型，并在五个城市的真实电动滑板车/电动自行车数据上进行了验证。

title: Axle Sensor Fusion for Online Continual Wheel Fault Detection in Wayside Railway Monitoring
summary: Reliable and cost-effective maintenance is essential for railway safety, particularly at the wheel-rail interface, which is prone to wear and failure. Predictive maintenance frameworks increasingly leverage sensor-generated time-series data, yet traditional methods require manual feature engineering, and deep learning models often degrade in online settings with evolving operational patterns. This work presents a semantic-aware, label-efficient continual learning framework for railway fault diagnostics. Accelerometer signals are encoded via a Variational AutoEncoder into latent representations capturing the normal operational structure in a fully unsupervised manner. Importantly, semantic metadata, including axle counts, wheel indexes, and strain-based deformations, is extracted via AI-driven peak detection on fiber Bragg grating sensors (resistant to electromagnetic interference) and fused with the VAE embeddings, enhancing anomaly detection under unknown operational conditions. A lightweight gradient boosting supervised classifier stabilizes anomaly scoring with minimal labels, while a replay-based continual learning strategy enables adaptation to evolving domains without catastrophic forgetting. Experiments show the model detects minor imperfections due to flats and polygonization, while adapting to evolving operational conditions, such as changes in train type, speed, load, and track profiles, captured using a single accelerometer and strain gauge in wayside monitoring.
summary_zh: 可靠且经济高效的维护对于铁路安全至关重要，尤其是在车轮-钢轨界面，该界面容易发生磨损和失效。预测性维护框架越来越多地利用传感器生成的时间序列数据，然而，传统方法需要手动特征工程，而深度学习模型在具有不断变化的运营模式的在线环境中通常会退化。本工作提出了一种语义感知、标签高效的持续学习框架，用于铁路故障诊断。加速度计信号通过变分自编码器被编码成潜在表示，以完全无监督的方式捕获正常的运营结构。重要的是，语义元数据，包括轴数、车轮索引和基于应变的形变，通过人工智能驱动的光纤布拉格光栅传感器（抗电磁干扰）上的峰值检测提取，并与VAE嵌入融合，从而增强了在未知运营条件下的异常检测能力。一种轻量级的梯度提升监督分类器使用最少的标签稳定了异常评分，而基于重放的持续学习策略使得能够适应不断发展的领域，而不会发生灾难性遗忘。实验表明，该模型能够检测由于车轮扁疤和多边形化引起的微小缺陷，同时适应不断变化的运营条件，如列车类型、速度、负载和轨道剖面的变化，这些变化是通过路旁监测中使用单个加速度计和应变计捕获的。
tldr: The paper presents a semantic-aware, label-efficient continual learning framework for railway wheel fault detection using sensor fusion and a variational autoencoder, adapting to evolving operational conditions through a continual learning strategy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种语义感知的、标签高效的持续学习框架，用于铁路车轮故障检测，该框架融合了传感器数据和变分自编码器，并通过持续学习策略适应不断变化的操作条件。

title: EgoScale: Scaling Dexterous Manipulation with Diverse Egocentric Human Data
summary: Human behavior is among the most scalable sources of data for learning physical intelligence, yet how to effectively leverage it for dexterous manipulation remains unclear. While prior work demonstrates human to robot transfer in constrained settings, it is unclear whether large scale human data can support fine grained, high degree of freedom dexterous manipulation. We present EgoScale, a human to dexterous manipulation transfer framework built on large scale egocentric human data. We train a Vision Language Action (VLA) model on over 20,854 hours of action labeled egocentric human video, more than 20 times larger than prior efforts, and uncover a log linear scaling law between human data scale and validation loss. This validation loss strongly correlates with downstream real robot performance, establishing large scale human data as a predictable supervision source. Beyond scale, we introduce a simple two stage transfer recipe: large scale human pretraining followed by lightweight aligned human robot mid training. This enables strong long horizon dexterous manipulation and one shot task adaptation with minimal robot supervision. Our final policy improves average success rate by 54% over a no pretraining baseline using a 22 DoF dexterous robotic hand, and transfers effectively to robots with lower DoF hands, indicating that large scale human motion provides a reusable, embodiment agnostic motor prior.
summary_zh: 人类行为是学习物理智能最具扩展性的数据来源之一，但如何有效地将其用于灵巧操作仍不清楚。虽然先前的工作展示了在受限环境中人到机器人的迁移，但尚不清楚大规模的人类数据是否可以支持精细的、高自由度的灵巧操作。我们提出了EgoScale，一种基于大规模第一人称人类数据的以人为本的灵巧操作迁移框架。我们训练了一个视觉-语言-行为（VLA）模型，该模型使用超过20,854小时的带有动作标签的第一人称人类视频，是先前工作的20多倍，并发现了人类数据规模与验证损失之间的对数线性缩放规律。这种验证损失与下游真实机器人的性能高度相关，从而确定了大规模人类数据是一种可预测的监督来源。除了规模之外，我们还引入了一个简单的两阶段迁移方案：大规模的人类预训练，然后是轻量级的对齐的人-机器人中期训练。这使得强大的长程灵巧操作和一键式的任务适应成为可能，只需最少的机器人监督。我们最终的策略在使用22个自由度的灵巧机械手时，平均成功率比没有预训练的基线提高了54%，并且可以有效地迁移到自由度较低的机械手上，表明大规模的人类运动提供了可重复使用的、与具身无关的运动先验。
tldr: EgoScale uses a VLA model trained on a massive dataset of egocentric human video to achieve strong dexterous manipulation on robots, showcasing a log-linear scaling law between human data and robot performance. Their two-stage transfer learning approach significantly improves success rates and generalizes across different robot embodiments.
tldr_zh: EgoScale通过在大量以自我为中心的人类视频数据集上训练的VLA模型实现了强大的机器人灵巧操作，展示了人类数据规模和机器人性能之间的对数线性比例关系。他们的两阶段迁移学习方法显着提高了成功率，并且可以推广到不同的机器人形态。

title: KLong: Training LLM Agent for Extremely Long-horizon Tasks
summary: This paper introduces KLong, an open-source LLM agent trained to solve extremely long-horizon tasks. The principle is to first cold-start the model via trajectory-splitting SFT, then scale it via progressive RL training. Specifically, we first activate basic agentic abilities of a base model with a comprehensive SFT recipe. Then, we introduce Research-Factory, an automated pipeline that generates high-quality training data by collecting research papers and constructing evaluation rubrics. Using this pipeline, we build thousands of long-horizon trajectories distilled from Claude 4.5 Sonnet (Thinking). To train with these extremely long trajectories, we propose a new trajectory-splitting SFT, which preserves early context, progressively truncates later context, and maintains overlap between sub-trajectories. In addition, to further improve long-horizon task-solving capability, we propose a novel progressive RL, which schedules training into multiple stages with progressively extended timeouts. Experiments demonstrate the superiority and generalization of KLong, as shown in Figure 1. Notably, our proposed KLong (106B) surpasses Kimi K2 Thinking (1T) by 11.28% on PaperBench, and the performance improvement generalizes to other coding benchmarks like SWE-bench Verified and MLE-bench.
summary_zh: 本文介绍 KLong，一个用于解决极长时程任务的开源 LLM Agent。其原理是首先通过轨迹分割的 SFT 冷启动模型，然后通过渐进式 RL 训练进行扩展。具体而言，我们首先利用全面的 SFT 配方激活基础模型的基本 Agent 能力。然后，我们引入 Research-Factory，一个通过收集研究论文和构建评估细则来生成高质量训练数据的自动化流程。利用该流程，我们构建了数千条从 Claude 4.5 Sonnet (Thinking) 提炼出的长时程轨迹。为了使用这些极长轨迹进行训练，我们提出了一种新的轨迹分割 SFT，该方法保留早期上下文，逐步截断后期上下文，并保持子轨迹之间的重叠。此外，为了进一步提升长时程任务解决能力，我们提出了一种新颖的渐进式 RL，该方法将训练安排为多个阶段，并逐步扩大超时时间。实验证明了 KLong 的优越性和泛化能力，如图 1 所示。值得注意的是，我们提出的 KLong (106B) 在 PaperBench 上超过了 Kimi K2 Thinking (1T) 11.28%，并且性能改进推广到其他编码基准测试，如 SWE-bench Verified 和 MLE-bench。
tldr: The paper introduces KLong, an open-source 106B LLM agent trained via trajectory-splitting SFT and progressive RL, outperforming Kimi K2 Thinking (1T) on long-horizon tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了KLong，一个开源的106B LLM Agent，通过轨迹分割SFT和渐进式RL进行训练，在长时程任务上优于Kimi K2 Thinking (1T)。

title: Mind the GAP: Text Safety Does Not Transfer to Tool-Call Safety in LLM Agents
summary: Large language models deployed as agents increasingly interact with external systems through tool calls--actions with real-world consequences that text outputs alone do not carry. Safety evaluations, however, overwhelmingly measure text-level refusal behavior, leaving a critical question unanswered: does alignment that suppresses harmful text also suppress harmful actions? We introduce the GAP benchmark, a systematic evaluation framework that measures divergence between text-level safety and tool-call-level safety in LLM agents. We test six frontier models across six regulated domains (pharmaceutical, financial, educational, employment, legal, and infrastructure), seven jailbreak scenarios per domain, three system prompt conditions (neutral, safety-reinforced, and tool-encouraging), and two prompt variants, producing 17,420 analysis-ready datapoints. Our central finding is that text safety does not transfer to tool-call safety. Across all six models, we observe instances where the model's text output refuses a harmful request while its tool calls simultaneously execute the forbidden action--a divergence we formalize as the GAP metric. Even under safety-reinforced system prompts, 219 such cases persist across all six models. System prompt wording exerts substantial influence on tool-call behavior: TC-safe rates span 21 percentage points for the most robust model and 57 for the most prompt-sensitive, with 16 of 18 pairwise ablation comparisons remaining significant after Bonferroni correction. Runtime governance contracts reduce information leakage in all six models but produce no detectable deterrent effect on forbidden tool-call attempts themselves. These results demonstrate that text-only safety evaluations are insufficient for assessing agent behavior and that tool-call safety requires dedicated measurement and mitigation.
summary_zh: 作为代理部署的大型语言模型越来越多地通过工具调用与外部系统交互——这些行动具有文本输出本身无法传达的真实世界后果。然而，安全评估绝大多数衡量的是文本级别的拒绝行为，留下了一个关键问题未得到解答：抑制有害文本的对齐是否也抑制有害行动？我们引入了GAP基准，这是一个系统的评估框架，用于衡量 LLM 代理中文本级别安全与工具调用级别安全之间的差异。我们测试了六个前沿模型，涵盖六个受监管领域（制药、金融、教育、就业、法律和基础设施），每个领域七种越狱场景，三种系统提示条件（中性、安全强化和工具鼓励），以及两种提示变体，生成了 17,420 个可用于分析的数据点。我们的中心发现是文本安全性不会转移到工具调用安全性。在所有六个模型中，我们观察到模型文本输出拒绝有害请求，而其工具调用同时执行被禁止行动的情况——我们将这种差异形式化为 GAP 指标。即使在安全强化的系统提示下，所有六个模型中仍然存在 219 个这样的案例。系统提示措辞对工具调用行为产生重大影响：最稳健模型的TC安全率跨度为 21 个百分点，而对提示最敏感的模型的TC安全率跨度为 57 个百分点，18 个成对消融比较中有 16 个在经过 Bonferroni 校正后仍然显著。运行时治理合同减少了所有六个模型中的信息泄露，但对禁止的工具调用尝试本身没有产生可检测到的威慑效果。这些结果表明，仅限文本的安全评估不足以评估代理行为，并且工具调用安全性需要专门的测量和缓解。
tldr: The paper introduces the GAP benchmark, revealing that text-level safety in LLM agents doesn't guarantee tool-call safety, highlighting the need for dedicated tool-call safety evaluations and mitigations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GAP基准，揭示了LLM代理中的文本级安全性不能保证工具调用安全性，强调了对工具调用安全进行专门评估和缓解的必要性。

title: AgentLAB: Benchmarking LLM Agents against Long-Horizon Attacks
summary: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in long-horizon, complex environments to solve challenging problems, but this expansion exposes them to long-horizon attacks that exploit multi-turn user-agent-environment interactions to achieve objectives infeasible in single-turn settings. To measure agent vulnerabilities to such risks, we present AgentLAB, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating LLM agent susceptibility to adaptive, long-horizon attacks. Currently, AgentLAB supports five novel attack types including intent hijacking, tool chaining, task injection, objective drifting, and memory poisoning, spanning 28 realistic agentic environments, and 644 security test cases. Leveraging AgentLAB, we evaluate representative LLM agents and find that they remain highly susceptible to long-horizon attacks; moreover, defenses designed for single-turn interactions fail to reliably mitigate long-horizon threats. We anticipate that AgentLAB will serve as a valuable benchmark for tracking progress on securing LLM agents in practical settings. The benchmark is publicly available at https://tanqiujiang.github.io/AgentLAB_main.
summary_zh: LLM智能体越来越多地被部署在长时程、复杂的环境中以解决具有挑战性的问题，但这种扩展也使其暴露于长时程攻击之下。这些攻击利用多轮用户-智能体-环境交互来实现单轮环境中无法实现的目标。为了衡量智能体对此类风险的脆弱性，我们提出了AgentLAB，这是首个专门评估LLM智能体对自适应、长时程攻击的敏感性的基准测试。目前，AgentLAB支持五种新型攻击类型，包括意图劫持、工具链式攻击、任务注入、目标漂移和记忆中毒，涵盖28个实际的智能体现实环境和644个安全测试用例。通过AgentLAB，我们评估了具有代表性的LLM智能体，并发现它们仍然极易受到长时程攻击；此外，为单轮交互设计的防御机制无法可靠地缓解长时程威胁。我们预计AgentLAB将成为一个有价值的基准测试，用于跟踪在实际场景中保护LLM智能体方面取得的进展。该基准测试可在https://tanqiujiang.github.io/AgentLAB_main公开获取。
tldr: The paper introduces AgentLAB, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agent vulnerabilities to long-horizon attacks, revealing significant weaknesses in current agents and the ineffectiveness of single-turn defenses.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AgentLAB，一个用于评估LLM智能体在长程攻击下的脆弱性的基准测试平台。结果表明，当前智能体存在显著弱点，且单轮交互防御措施对此类攻击无效。

title: FRAPPE: Infusing World Modeling into Generalist Policies via Multiple Future Representation Alignment
summary: Enabling VLA models to predict environmental dynamics, known as world modeling, has been recognized as essential for improving robotic reasoning and generalization. However, current approaches face two main issues: 1. The training objective forces models to over-emphasize pixel-level reconstruction, which constrains semantic learning and generalization 2. Reliance on predicted future observations during inference often leads to error accumulation. To address these challenges, we introduce Future Representation Alignment via Parallel Progressive Expansion (FRAPPE). Our method adopts a two-stage fine-tuning strategy: In the mid-training phase, the model learns to predict the latent representations of future observations; In the post-training phase, we expand the computational workload in parallel and align the representation simultaneously with multiple different visual foundation models. By significantly improving fine-tuning efficiency and reducing dependence on action-annotated data, FRAPPE provides a scalable and data-efficient pathway to enhance world-awareness in generalist robotic policies. Experiments on the RoboTwin benchmark and real-world tasks demonstrate that FRAPPE outperforms state-of-the-art approaches and shows strong generalization in long-horizon and unseen scenarios.
summary_zh: 使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够预测环境动态，即世界建模，已被认为是提升机器人推理和泛化能力的关键。然而，当前的方法面临两个主要问题：1. 训练目标迫使模型过度强调像素级重建，从而限制了语义学习和泛化；2. 推理过程中对预测的未来观测的依赖常常导致误差累积。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了基于并行渐进扩展的未来表征对齐（FRAPPE）。我们的方法采用了一种两阶段微调策略：在训练中期，模型学习预测未来观测的潜在表征；在训练后期，我们并行扩展计算负载，并同时将表征与多个不同的视觉基础模型对齐。通过显著提高微调效率并减少对动作标注数据的依赖，FRAPPE为增强通用机器人策略中的世界认知提供了一种可扩展且数据高效的途径。在RoboTwin基准测试和真实世界任务上的实验表明，FRAPPE优于最先进的方法，并在长时程和未见场景中表现出强大的泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces FRAPPE, a two-stage fine-tuning method that aligns future representations with multiple visual foundation models to improve world modeling in generalist robotic policies, demonstrating superior performance and generalization on benchmarks and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 FRAPPE，一种两阶段微调方法，通过将未来表征与多个视觉基础模型对齐，以提高通用机器人策略中的世界建模能力，并在基准测试和实际任务中展示了卓越的性能和泛化能力。

title: MALLVI: a multi agent framework for integrated generalized robotics manipulation
summary: Task planning for robotic manipulation with large language models (LLMs) is an emerging area. Prior approaches rely on specialized models, fine tuning, or prompt tuning, and often operate in an open loop manner without robust environmental feedback, making them fragile in dynamic settings.We present MALLVi, a Multi Agent Large Language and Vision framework that enables closed loop feedback driven robotic manipulation. Given a natural language instruction and an image of the environment, MALLVi generates executable atomic actions for a robot manipulator. After action execution, a Vision Language Model (VLM) evaluates environmental feedback and decides whether to repeat the process or proceed to the next step.Rather than using a single model, MALLVi coordinates specialized agents, Decomposer, Localizer, Thinker, and Reflector, to manage perception, localization, reasoning, and high level planning. An optional Descriptor agent provides visual memory of the initial state. The Reflector supports targeted error detection and recovery by reactivating only relevant agents, avoiding full replanning.Experiments in simulation and real world settings show that iterative closed loop multi agent coordination improves generalization and increases success rates in zero shot manipulation tasks.Code available at https://github.com/iman1234ahmadi/MALLVI.
summary_zh: 利用大型语言模型（LLM）进行机器人操作的任务规划是一个新兴领域。先前的方法依赖于专门的模型、微调或提示调整，并且通常以开环方式运行，缺乏稳健的环境反馈，这使得它们在动态环境中变得脆弱。我们提出了MALLVi，一个多智能体大型语言和视觉框架，它能够实现闭环反馈驱动的机器人操作。给定自然语言指令和环境图像，MALLVi为机器人机械臂生成可执行的原子动作。在动作执行后，视觉语言模型（VLM）评估环境反馈，并决定是否重复该过程或继续下一步。MALLVi没有使用单一模型，而是协调专门的智能体，包括分解器（Decomposer）、定位器（Localizer）、思考者（Thinker）和反射器（Reflector），以管理感知、定位、推理和高层规划。一个可选的描述器（Descriptor）智能体提供初始状态的视觉记忆。反射器通过仅重新激活相关的智能体来支持有针对性的错误检测和恢复，避免完全重新规划。在模拟和真实世界环境中的实验表明，迭代的闭环多智能体协作提高了零样本操作任务中的泛化能力和成功率。代码已在https://github.com/iman1234ahmadi/MALLVI提供。
tldr: The paper introduces MALLVi, a multi-agent framework using LLMs and VLMs for closed-loop robotic manipulation, demonstrating improved generalization and success rates in zero-shot tasks through coordinated agent interaction and error recovery.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MALLVi，一个使用LLM和VLM的多智能体框架，用于闭环机械臂操作。它通过协调智能体间的交互和错误恢复，展示了在零样本任务中改进的泛化能力和成功率。

title: SimToolReal: An Object-Centric Policy for Zero-Shot Dexterous Tool Manipulation
summary: The ability to manipulate tools significantly expands the set of tasks a robot can perform. Yet, tool manipulation represents a challenging class of dexterity, requiring grasping thin objects, in-hand object rotations, and forceful interactions. Since collecting teleoperation data for these behaviors is challenging, sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising alternative. However, prior approaches typically require substantial engineering effort to model objects and tune reward functions for each task. In this work, we propose SimToolReal, taking a step towards generalizing sim-to-real RL policies for tool manipulation. Instead of focusing on a single object and task, we procedurally generate a large variety of tool-like object primitives in simulation and train a single RL policy with the universal goal of manipulating each object to random goal poses. This approach enables SimToolReal to perform general dexterous tool manipulation at test-time without any object or task-specific training. We demonstrate that SimToolReal outperforms prior retargeting and fixed-grasp methods by 37% while matching the performance of specialist RL policies trained on specific target objects and tasks. Finally, we show that SimToolReal generalizes across a diverse set of everyday tools, achieving strong zero-shot performance over 120 real-world rollouts spanning 24 tasks, 12 object instances, and 6 tool categories.
summary_zh: 工具操控能力显著扩展了机器人可以执行的任务范围。然而，工具操控代表了一类具有挑战性的灵巧操作，需要抓取细长物体、进行手中物体旋转以及进行力量交互。由于收集这些行为的遥操作数据具有挑战性，因此从仿真到现实的强化学习(RL)是一种很有前景的替代方案。然而，以往的方法通常需要大量的工程工作来为每个任务建模对象和调整奖励函数。在这项工作中，我们提出了SimToolReal，朝着推广用于工具操控的从仿真到现实的RL策略迈出了一步。与专注于单个对象和任务不同，我们在仿真中程序化地生成大量类工具对象基元，并训练一个具有通用目标的RL策略，即将每个对象操纵到随机目标姿态。这种方法使SimToolReal能够在测试时执行通用灵巧工具操控，而无需任何对象或任务特定的训练。我们证明了SimToolReal的性能优于先前的重定向和固定抓取方法37%，同时与在特定目标对象和任务上训练的专家RL策略的性能相匹配。最后，我们表明SimToolReal可以推广到各种日常工具，在涵盖24个任务、12个对象实例和6个工具类别的120次真实世界实验中实现了强大的零样本性能。
tldr: The paper introduces SimToolReal, a sim-to-real reinforcement learning approach that trains a single policy on procedurally generated tool-like objects, achieving zero-shot dexterous tool manipulation across diverse real-world scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SimToolReal，一种sim-to-real强化学习方法，通过在程序生成的工具类对象上训练单个策略，实现了跨越各种真实场景的零样本灵巧工具操作。

title: One Hand to Rule Them All: Canonical Representations for Unified Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation policies today largely assume fixed hand designs, severely restricting their generalization to new embodiments with varied kinematic and structural layouts. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a parameterized canonical representation that unifies a broad spectrum of dexterous hand architectures. It comprises a unified parameter space and a canonical URDF format, offering three key advantages. 1) The parameter space captures essential morphological and kinematic variations for effective conditioning in learning algorithms. 2) A structured latent manifold can be learned over our space, where interpolations between embodiments yield smooth and physically meaningful morphology transitions. 3) The canonical URDF standardizes the action space while preserving dynamic and functional properties of the original URDFs, enabling efficient and reliable cross-embodiment policy learning. We validate these advantages through extensive analysis and experiments, including grasp policy replay, VAE latent encoding, and cross-embodiment zero-shot transfer. Specifically, we train a VAE on the unified representation to obtain a compact, semantically rich latent embedding, and develop a grasping policy conditioned on the canonical representation that generalizes across dexterous hands. We demonstrate, through simulation and real-world tasks on unseen morphologies (e.g., 81.9% zero-shot success rate on 3-finger LEAP Hand), that our framework unifies both the representational and action spaces of structurally diverse hands, providing a scalable foundation for cross-hand learning toward universal dexterous manipulation.
summary_zh: 目前，灵巧操作策略在很大程度上假设固定的手部设计，这严重限制了它们对具有不同运动学和结构布局的新型机械手的泛化能力。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种参数化的规范表示，它统一了广泛的灵巧手架构。它包含一个统一的参数空间和一个规范的URDF格式，提供了三个关键优势：1) 该参数空间捕获了关键的形态和运动学变化，以便在学习算法中进行有效的条件化。2) 可以在我们的空间上学习一个结构化的潜在流形，其中机械手之间的插值会产生平滑的、具有物理意义的形态过渡。3) 规范的URDF标准化了动作空间，同时保留了原始URDF的动力学和功能属性，从而实现了高效可靠的跨机械手策略学习。我们通过广泛的分析和实验验证了这些优势，包括抓取策略重放、VAE潜在编码和跨机械手零样本迁移。具体而言，我们在统一表示上训练了一个VAE，以获得紧凑且语义丰富的潜在嵌入，并开发了一个以规范表示为条件的抓取策略，该策略可以跨灵巧手泛化。通过模拟和在未见过的形态上的真实世界任务（例如，在3指LEAP Hand上的零样本成功率为81.9%）我们证明了我们的框架统一了结构多样化手部的表示空间和动作空间，为实现通用灵巧操作的跨手学习提供了可扩展的基础。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel canonical representation framework for unifying diverse dexterous hand architectures, enabling cross-embodiment policy learning and zero-shot transfer to unseen hand morphologies. It trains a grasping policy conditioned on this representation and demonstrates strong zero-shot performance.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新型的规范表示框架，用于统一各种灵巧手结构，从而实现跨结构策略学习和零样本迁移到未见过的手结构。它训练了一个以这种表示为条件的抓取策略，并展示了强大的零样本性能。

title: Learning Humanoid End-Effector Control for Open-Vocabulary Visual Loco-Manipulation
summary: Visual loco-manipulation of arbitrary objects in the wild with humanoid robots requires accurate end-effector (EE) control and a generalizable understanding of the scene via visual inputs (e.g., RGB-D images). Existing approaches are based on real-world imitation learning and exhibit limited generalization due to the difficulty in collecting large-scale training datasets. This paper presents a new paradigm, HERO, for object loco-manipulation with humanoid robots that combines the strong generalization and open-vocabulary understanding of large vision models with strong control performance from simulated training. We achieve this by designing an accurate residual-aware EE tracking policy. This EE tracking policy combines classical robotics with machine learning. It uses a) inverse kinematics to convert residual end-effector targets into reference trajectories, b) a learned neural forward model for accurate forward kinematics, c) goal adjustment, and d) replanning. Together, these innovations help us cut down the end-effector tracking error by 3.2x. We use this accurate end-effector tracker to build a modular system for loco-manipulation, where we use open-vocabulary large vision models for strong visual generalization. Our system is able to operate in diverse real-world environments, from offices to coffee shops, where the robot is able to reliably manipulate various everyday objects (e.g., mugs, apples, toys) on surfaces ranging from 43cm to 92cm in height. Systematic modular and end-to-end tests in simulation and the real world demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed design. We believe the advances in this paper can open up new ways of training humanoid robots to interact with daily objects.
summary_zh: 具有人形机器人在真实环境中对任意物体进行视觉操作需要精确的末端执行器(EE)控制，以及通过视觉输入（例如RGB-D图像）对场景的可泛化理解。现有方法基于现实世界的模仿学习，由于收集大规模训练数据集的困难，其泛化能力有限。本文提出了一种新范式HERO，用于人形机器人的物体操作，该范式结合了大型视觉模型的强大泛化能力和开放词汇理解能力，以及来自模拟训练的强大控制性能。我们通过设计一种精确的残差感知EE跟踪策略来实现这一点。该EE跟踪策略结合了经典机器人学和机器学习。它使用a) 逆运动学将残余末端执行器目标转换为参考轨迹，b) 学习的神经前向模型来实现精确的正向运动学，c) 目标调整，以及d) 重新规划。这些创新共同帮助我们减少了3.2倍的末端执行器跟踪误差。我们使用这种精确的末端执行器跟踪器来构建一个用于操作的模块化系统，其中我们使用开放词汇大型视觉模型来实现强大的视觉泛化。我们的系统能够在各种真实环境（从办公室到咖啡店）中运行，机器人能够可靠地操作各种日常物品（例如，马克杯、苹果、玩具），这些物体位于高度从43厘米到92厘米的表面上。在模拟和现实世界中进行的系统模块化和端到端测试证明了我们提出的设计的有效性。我们相信本文的进展可以为训练人形机器人与日常物品互动开辟新的途径。
tldr: This paper presents HERO, a new system for humanoid robot loco-manipulation that combines visual understanding from large vision models with accurate end-effector control trained in simulation, enabling operation in diverse real-world environments. The system uses a residual-aware end-effector tracking policy integrating inverse kinematics, a learned forward model, goal adjustment, and replanning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了HERO，一种用于人形机器人局部操作的新系统，该系统结合了大型视觉模型的视觉理解能力和在模拟环境中训练获得的精确末端执行器控制能力，从而能够在不同的真实世界环境中运行。该系统使用残差感知末端执行器跟踪策略，集成了逆运动学、学习的前向模型、目标调整和重新规划。

title: Learning to unfold cloth: Scaling up world models to deformable object manipulation
summary: Learning to manipulate cloth is both a paradigmatic problem for robotic research and a problem of immediate relevance to a variety of applications ranging from assistive care to the service industry. The complex physics of the deformable object makes this problem of cloth manipulation nontrivial. In order to create a general manipulation strategy that addresses a variety of shapes, sizes, fold and wrinkle patterns, in addition to the usual problems of appearance variations, it becomes important to carefully consider model structure and their implications for generalisation performance. In this paper, we present an approach to in-air cloth manipulation that uses a variation of a recently proposed reinforcement learning architecture, DreamerV2. Our implementation modifies this architecture to utilise surface normals input, in addition to modiying the replay buffer and data augmentation procedures. Taken together these modifications represent an enhancement to the world model used by the robot, addressing the physical complexity of the object being manipulated by the robot. We present evaluations both in simulation and in a zero-shot deployment of the trained policies in a physical robot setup, performing in-air unfolding of a variety of different cloth types, demonstrating the generalisation benefits of our proposed architecture.
summary_zh: 学习操控布料既是机器人研究的一个典型问题，也是与辅助护理到服务业等多种应用直接相关的问题。可变形物体的复杂物理特性使得布料操控问题变得非常复杂。为了创建一个通用的操控策略，能够处理各种形状、尺寸、折叠和褶皱模式，以及通常的外观变化问题，仔细考虑模型结构及其对泛化性能的影响非常重要。在本文中，我们提出了一种使用近期提出的强化学习架构 DreamerV2 的变体的空中布料操控方法。我们的实现修改了该架构，除了修改回放缓冲区和数据增强过程之外，还利用了表面法向量输入。总而言之，这些修改代表了对机器人所用世界模型的增强，解决了机器人所操控物体的物理复杂性。我们在模拟中和物理机器人设置中训练策略的零样本部署中都进行了评估，执行了各种不同类型布料的空中展开，证明了我们提出的架构的泛化优势。
tldr: This paper presents a modified DreamerV2 architecture for in-air cloth manipulation, incorporating surface normals and enhanced data augmentation to improve generalization across different cloth types, demonstrated in both simulation and real-world zero-shot deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种改进的DreamerV2架构，用于空中织物操作，结合了表面法线和增强的数据增强，以提高不同织物类型的泛化能力，并在模拟和真实世界的零样本部署中进行了演示。

title: MASPO: Unifying Gradient Utilization, Probability Mass, and Signal Reliability for Robust and Sample-Efficient LLM Reasoning
summary: Existing Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) algorithms, such as GRPO, rely on rigid, uniform, and symmetric trust region mechanisms that are fundamentally misaligned with the complex optimization dynamics of Large Language Models (LLMs). In this paper, we identify three critical challenges in these methods: (1) inefficient gradient utilization caused by the binary cutoff of hard clipping, (2) insensitive probability mass arising from uniform ratio constraints that ignore the token distribution, and (3) asymmetric signal reliability stemming from the disparate credit assignment ambiguity between positive and negative samples. To bridge these gaps, we propose Mass-Adaptive Soft Policy Optimization (MASPO), a unified framework designed to harmonize these three dimensions. MASPO integrates a differentiable soft Gaussian gating to maximize gradient utility, a mass-adaptive limiter to balance exploration across the probability spectrum, and an asymmetric risk controller to align update magnitudes with signal confidence. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that MASPO serves as a robust, all-in-one RLVR solution, significantly outperforming strong baselines. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ma1/README.md.
summary_zh: 现有的基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）算法，例如GRPO，依赖于刚性、均匀和对称的置信域机制，这与大型语言模型（LLM）的复杂优化动态从根本上不相符。在本文中，我们指出了这些方法中的三个关键挑战：（1）硬裁剪二元截断导致梯度利用效率低下，（2）由于忽略了词元分布的均匀比例约束导致不敏感的概率质量，以及（3）正样本和负样本之间不同的信用分配模糊性导致不对称的信号可靠性。为了弥合这些差距，我们提出了一种质量自适应的软策略优化（MASPO）框架，该框架旨在协调这三个维度。MASPO集成了可微的软高斯门控，以最大化梯度效用；一种质量自适应的限制器，以平衡整个概率频谱的探索；以及一个非对称的风险控制器，以将更新幅度与信号置信度对齐。大量评估表明，MASPO是一种稳健的、一体化的RLVR解决方案，显著优于强大的基线。我们的代码可在以下网址获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ma1/README.md。
tldr: The paper introduces MASPO, a Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) framework for LLMs that addresses limitations in gradient utilization, probability mass sensitivity, and signal reliability found in existing methods like GRPO. It claims significant performance improvements over strong baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为MASPO的基于可验证奖励的强化学习(RLVR)框架，用于大型语言模型(LLM)，它解决了现有方法(如GRPO)中梯度利用率、概率质量敏感性和信号可靠性的局限性。该论文声称MASPO 在性能方面优于强基线模型。

title: What Breaks Embodied AI Security:LLM Vulnerabilities, CPS Flaws,or Something Else?
summary: Embodied AI systems (e.g., autonomous vehicles, service robots, and LLM-driven interactive agents) are rapidly transitioning from controlled environments to safety critical real-world deployments. Unlike disembodied AI, failures in embodied intelligence lead to irreversible physical consequences, raising fundamental questions about security, safety, and reliability. While existing research predominantly analyzes embodied AI through the lenses of Large Language Model (LLM) vulnerabilities or classical Cyber-Physical System (CPS) failures, this survey argues that these perspectives are individually insufficient to explain many observed breakdowns in modern embodied systems. We posit that a significant class of failures arises from embodiment-induced system-level mismatches, rather than from isolated model flaws or traditional CPS attacks. Specifically, we identify four core insights that explain why embodied AI is fundamentally harder to secure: (i) semantic correctness does not imply physical safety, as language-level reasoning abstracts away geometry, dynamics, and contact constraints; (ii) identical actions can lead to drastically different outcomes across physical states due to nonlinear dynamics and state uncertainty; (iii) small errors propagate and amplify across tightly coupled perception-decision-action loops; and (iv) safety is not compositional across time or system layers, enabling locally safe decisions to accumulate into globally unsafe behavior. These insights suggest that securing embodied AI requires moving beyond component-level defenses toward system-level reasoning about physical risk, uncertainty, and failure propagation.
summary_zh: 具身人工智能系统（例如，自动驾驶汽车、服务机器人和LLM驱动的交互式代理）正快速从受控环境过渡到安全攸关的真实世界部署。与非具身人工智能不同，具身智能的失败会导致不可逆转的物理后果，从而引发关于安全性、安全性和可靠性的根本性问题。虽然现有研究主要通过大型语言模型（LLM）漏洞或经典信息-物理系统（CPS）故障的视角来分析具身人工智能，但本综述认为，这些观点单独来看不足以解释现代具身系统中观察到的许多崩溃。我们认为，相当大一部分故障源于具身性引起的系统级不匹配，而不是源于孤立的模型缺陷或传统的CPS攻击。具体来说，我们确定了四个核心见解，解释了为什么具身人工智能在安全方面更具挑战性：（i）语义正确性并不意味着物理安全，因为语言层面的推理会抽象掉几何、动力学和接触约束；（ii）由于非线性动力学和状态不确定性，相同的动作可能导致跨物理状态的截然不同的结果；（iii）微小误差会在紧密耦合的感知-决策-行动环路中传播和放大；（iv）安全性在时间和系统层面上不具备可组合性，使得局部安全的决策累积成全局不安全的行为。这些见解表明，确保具身人工智能的安全需要超越组件级防御，转向对物理风险、不确定性和故障传播进行系统级推理。
tldr: This paper argues that securing embodied AI systems requires a holistic, system-level approach rather than focusing solely on LLM vulnerabilities or CPS failures, highlighting the unique challenges posed by embodiment.
tldr_zh: 本文认为，保护具身人工智能系统需要一种整体的、系统层面的方法，而不是仅仅关注LLM漏洞或CPS故障，强调了具身化带来的独特挑战。

title: Web Verbs: Typed Abstractions for Reliable Task Composition on the Agentic Web
summary: The Web is evolving from a medium that humans browse to an environment where software agents act on behalf of users. Advances in large language models (LLMs) make natural language a practical interface for goal-directed tasks, yet most current web agents operate on low-level primitives such as clicks and keystrokes. These operations are brittle, inefficient, and difficult to verify. Complementing content-oriented efforts such as NLWeb's semantic layer for retrieval, we argue that the agentic web also requires a semantic layer for web actions. We propose \textbf{Web Verbs}, a web-scale set of typed, semantically documented functions that expose site capabilities through a uniform interface, whether implemented through APIs or robust client-side workflows. These verbs serve as stable and composable units that agents can discover, select, and synthesize into concise programs. This abstraction unifies API-based and browser-based paradigms, enabling LLMs to synthesize reliable and auditable workflows with explicit control and data flow. Verbs can carry preconditions, postconditions, policy tags, and logging support, which improves \textbf{reliability} by providing stable interfaces, \textbf{efficiency} by reducing dozens of steps into a few function calls, and \textbf{verifiability} through typed contracts and checkable traces. We present our vision, a proof-of-concept implementation, and representative case studies that demonstrate concise and robust execution compared to existing agents. Finally, we outline a roadmap for standardization to make verbs deployable and trustworthy at web scale.
summary_zh: Web正在从人类浏览的媒介演变为软件代理代表用户行动的环境。大型语言模型（LLM）的进步使自然语言成为目标导向型任务的实用接口，但当前大多数Web代理仍然在点击和按键等低级原语上运行。这些操作脆弱、低效且难以验证。作为对NLWeb等面向内容的检索语义层的补充，我们认为代理式Web也需要Web操作的语义层。我们提出\textbf{Web动词（Web Verbs）}，这是一个Web规模的、类型化的、具有语义文档记录的函数集，通过统一的接口暴露站点的能力，无论这些能力是通过API还是健壮的客户端工作流实现的。这些动词作为稳定且可组合的单元，代理可以发现、选择并将它们合成为简洁的程序。这种抽象统一了基于API和基于浏览器的范例，使LLM能够合成具有显式控制和数据流的可靠且可审计的工作流。动词可以携带前提条件、后置条件、策略标签和日志记录支持，通过提供稳定的接口来提高\textbf{可靠性}，通过将数十个步骤减少为几个函数调用来提高\textbf{效率}，并通过类型化契约和可检查的追踪来提高\textbf{可验证性}。我们介绍了我们的愿景、概念验证实现，以及代表性的案例研究，这些案例研究表明与现有代理相比，Web动词执行的简洁性和鲁棒性。最后，我们概述了一个用于标准化的路线图，以使动词能够在Web规模上可部署且值得信赖。
tldr: This paper introduces "Web Verbs," a set of typed, semantically documented functions designed to provide a stable and composable interface for web agents using LLMs, improving their reliability, efficiency, and verifiability compared to low-level operations.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了“Web Verbs”，这是一组类型化、语义明确的函数，旨在为使用LLM的Web代理提供稳定且可组合的接口，从而提高其可靠性、效率和可验证性，相比于低级操作。

title: Continual learning and refinement of causal models through dynamic predicate invention
summary: Efficiently navigating complex environments requires agents to internalize the underlying logic of their world, yet standard world modelling methods often struggle with sample inefficiency, lack of transparency, and poor scalability. We propose a framework for constructing symbolic causal world models entirely online by integrating continuous model learning and repair into the agent's decision loop, by leveraging the power of Meta-Interpretive Learning and predicate invention to find semantically meaningful and reusable abstractions, allowing an agent to construct a hierarchy of disentangled, high-quality concepts from its observations. We demonstrate that our lifted inference approach scales to domains with complex relational dynamics, where propositional methods suffer from combinatorial explosion, while achieving sample-efficiency orders of magnitude higher than the established PPO neural-network-based baseline.
authors: Telmo de Menezes e Silva Filho
summary_zh: 高效地导航复杂环境需要智能体将环境的内在逻辑内化，然而，标准的世界建模方法通常面临样本效率低、透明度不足以及可扩展性差等问题。我们提出了一种框架，通过将连续模型学习和修复集成到智能体的决策循环中，完全在线地构建符号因果世界模型。该框架利用元解释学习和谓词发明的能力，寻找语义上有意义且可重用的抽象概念，从而允许智能体从其观察中构建一个分离的、高质量概念的层级结构。我们证明了我们的提升推理方法可以扩展到具有复杂关系动态的领域，而在这些领域中，命题方法会受到组合爆炸的影响。同时，我们的方法比已建立的基于PPO神经网络的基线方法实现了高几个数量级的样本效率。
tldr: The paper introduces a framework for online construction of symbolic causal world models using Meta-Interpretive Learning and predicate invention, achieving sample-efficient learning in complex relational environments compared to PPO.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个使用元解释学习和谓词发明的在线构建符号因果世界模型的框架，与PPO相比，在复杂关系环境中实现了样本高效的学习。

title: Narrow fine-tuning erodes safety alignment in vision-language agents
summary: Lifelong multimodal agents must continuously adapt to new tasks through post-training, but this creates fundamental tension between acquiring capabilities and preserving safety alignment. We demonstrate that fine-tuning aligned vision-language models on narrow-domain harmful datasets induces severe emergent misalignment that generalizes broadly across unrelated tasks and modalities. Through experiments on Gemma3-4B, we show that misalignment scales monotonically with LoRA rank, and that multimodal evaluation reveals substantially higher misalignment ($70.71 \pm 1.22$ at $r=128$) than text-only evaluation ($41.19 \pm 2.51$), suggesting that unimodal safety benchmarks may underestimate alignment degradation in vision-language models. Critically, even 10\% harmful data in the training mixture induces substantial alignment degradation. Geometric analysis reveals that harmful behaviors occupy a remarkably low-dimensional subspace, with the majority of misalignment information captured in 10 principal components. To mitigate misalignment, we evaluate two strategies: benign narrow fine-tuning and activation-based steering. While both approaches substantially reduce misalignment, neither completely removes the learned harmful behaviors. Our findings highlight the need for robust continual learning frameworks, as current post-training paradigms may not sufficiently preserve alignment in post-deployment settings.
summary_zh: 终身多模态智能体必须通过训练后调整来持续适应新的任务，但这在获取能力与保持安全对齐之间产生了根本性的张力。我们证明，在窄域有害数据集上对齐的视觉-语言模型进行微调会诱发严重的涌现式失准，这种失准会广泛泛化到不相关的任务和模态中。通过在Gemma3-4B上的实验，我们表明失准度与LoRA秩单调相关，并且多模态评估揭示出比仅文本评估高得多的失准度（在$r=128$时为$70.71 \pm 1.22$，而文本评估为$41.19 \pm 2.51$），这表明单模态安全基准可能低估视觉-语言模型中的对齐退化。至关重要的是，即使训练混合物中含有10%的有害数据也会导致显著的对齐退化。几何分析表明，有害行为占据一个非常低维的子空间，大部分失准信息都包含在10个主成分中。为了缓解失准，我们评估了两种策略：良性窄域微调和基于激活的引导。虽然这两种方法都显著降低了失准程度，但都没有完全消除学到的有害行为。我们的研究结果强调了对稳健的持续学习框架的需求，因为当前训练后范式可能无法充分保持部署后环境中的对齐。
tldr: The paper demonstrates that fine-tuning vision-language models on narrow-domain harmful datasets induces severe safety misalignment, even with small amounts of harmful data, and explores mitigation strategies.
tldr_zh: 该论文表明，在狭窄领域的有害数据集上微调视觉-语言模型会导致严重的安全失调，即使使用少量的有害数据，并探讨了缓解策略。

title: OpenSage: Self-programming Agent Generation Engine
summary: Agent development kits (ADKs) provide effective platforms and tooling for constructing agents, and their designs are critical to the constructed agents' performance, especially the functionality for agent topology, tools, and memory. However, current ADKs either lack sufficient functional support or rely on humans to manually design these components, limiting agents' generalizability and overall performance. We propose OpenSage, the first ADK that enables LLMs to automatically create agents with self-generated topology and toolsets while providing comprehensive and structured memory support. OpenSage offers effective functionality for agents to create and manage their own sub-agents and toolkits. It also features a hierarchical, graph-based memory system for efficient management and a specialized toolkit tailored to software engineering tasks. Extensive experiments across three state-of-the-art benchmarks with various backbone models demonstrate the advantages of OpenSage over existing ADKs. We also conduct rigorous ablation studies to demonstrate the effectiveness of our design for each component. We believe OpenSage can pave the way for the next generation of agent development, shifting the focus from human-centered to AI-centered paradigms.
summary_zh: 智能体开发工具包 (ADK) 为构建智能体提供了有效的平台和工具，其设计对构建的智能体的性能至关重要，特别是智能体拓扑、工具和内存的功能。然而，当前的 ADK 要么缺乏足够的功能支持，要么依赖人工手动设计这些组件，从而限制了智能体的泛化性和整体性能。我们提出了 OpenSage，这是第一个 ADK，它使 LLM 能够自动创建具有自生成拓扑和工具集的智能体，同时提供全面且结构化的内存支持。OpenSage 为智能体创建和管理其自身的子智能体和工具包提供了有效的功能。它还具有一个分层的、基于图的内存系统，用于高效管理，以及一个专门为软件工程任务定制的工具包。在三个最先进的基准测试中，使用各种骨干模型的广泛实验证明了 OpenSage 相对于现有 ADK 的优势。我们还进行了严格的消融研究，以证明我们为每个组件设计的有效性。我们相信 OpenSage 可以为下一代智能体开发铺平道路，将重点从以人为中心的范式转变为以人工智能为中心的范式。
tldr: OpenSage is a new Agent Development Kit (ADK) that enables LLMs to automatically generate agents with self-designed topology, toolsets, and structured memory. Experimental results show OpenSage outperforms existing ADKs.
tldr_zh: OpenSage是一个新的Agent开发工具包（ADK），它使LLM能够自动生成具有自我设计的拓扑、工具集和结构化内存的代理。实验结果表明OpenSage优于现有的ADK。

title: VAM: Verbalized Action Masking for Controllable Exploration in RL Post-Training -- A Chess Case Study
summary: Exploration remains a key bottleneck for reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of large language models (LLMs), where sparse feedback and large action spaces can lead to premature collapse into repetitive behaviors. We propose Verbalized Action Masking (VAM), which verbalizes an action mask in the prompt and enforces that the model outputs an action from the masked set. Building on this interface, we introduce iterative action-space pruning: if the target action is not sampled, we remove valid sampled actions from the mask and resample under the reduced candidate set, repeating until the target is sampled or a fixed budget is exhausted. We study VAM in chess and evaluate it under two training regimes: an engine-play regime that generates states via play against an engine opponent and a fixed-dataset regime that trains from a fixed dataset of positions with verifier scores. Across held-out chess puzzles and full-game play measured by average centipawn loss (ACPL), VAM improves learning efficiency and final performance over strong baselines, highlighting verbalized masking as a practical mechanism for controllable exploration in LLM RL post-training.
summary_zh: 探索仍然是大型语言模型（LLM）事后强化学习（RL）的一个关键瓶颈，其中稀疏反馈和大型动作空间可能导致过早地陷入重复行为。我们提出了一种口头化动作掩码（VAM）方法，它在提示中口头表达一个动作掩码，并强制模型从掩码集合中输出一个动作。在此接口的基础上，我们引入了迭代动作空间剪枝：如果目标动作未被采样，我们将从掩码中移除有效的被采样动作，并在缩减的候选集合下重新采样，重复此过程直到目标被采样或固定预算耗尽。我们在国际象棋中研究了VAM，并在两种训练方案下对其进行评估：一种是引擎对弈方案，该方案通过与引擎对手对弈生成状态；另一种是固定数据集方案，该方案从具有验证器分数的固定位置数据集进行训练。通过平均百分厘损失（ACPL）衡量的保留国际象棋谜题和完整对局，VAM提高了学习效率和最终性能，优于强大的基线，突出口头化掩码作为LLM事后强化学习中控制性探索的实用机制。
tldr: The paper introduces Verbalized Action Masking (VAM) for controllable exploration in RL post-training of LLMs, specifically applied to chess, showing improved learning efficiency and performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了用于LLM的RL事后训练中可控探索的口头化动作掩码（VAM），特别应用于象棋，表明提高了学习效率和性能。

title: Calibrate-Then-Act: Cost-Aware Exploration in LLM Agents
summary: LLMs are increasingly being used for complex problems which are not necessarily resolved in a single response, but require interacting with an environment to acquire information. In these scenarios, LLMs must reason about inherent cost-uncertainty tradeoffs in when to stop exploring and commit to an answer. For instance, on a programming task, an LLM should test a generated code snippet if it is uncertain about the correctness of that code; the cost of writing a test is nonzero, but typically lower than the cost of making a mistake. In this work, we show that we can induce LLMs to explicitly reason about balancing these cost-uncertainty tradeoffs, then perform more optimal environment exploration. We formalize multiple tasks, including information retrieval and coding, as sequential decision-making problems under uncertainty. Each problem has latent environment state that can be reasoned about via a prior which is passed to the LLM agent. We introduce a framework called Calibrate-Then-Act (CTA), where we feed the LLM this additional context to enable it to act more optimally. This improvement is preserved even under RL training of both the baseline and CTA. Our results on information-seeking QA and on a simplified coding task show that making cost-benefit tradeoffs explicit with CTA can help agents discover more optimal decision-making strategies.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于解决复杂问题，这些问题并非总能通过单次响应解决，而是需要与环境交互以获取信息。 在这些场景中，LLM必须对何时停止探索并提交答案时固有的成本-不确定性权衡进行推理。 例如，在编程任务中，如果LLM对其生成的代码片段的正确性不确定，则应该测试该代码； 编写测试的成本非零，但通常低于犯错的成本。 在这项工作中，我们证明可以诱导LLM显式地推理平衡这些成本-不确定性权衡，然后执行更优化的环境探索。 我们将包括信息检索和编码在内的多个任务形式化为不确定性下的序列决策问题。 每个问题都有潜在的环境状态，可以通过先验知识进行推理，该先验知识传递给LLM代理。 我们引入了一个名为“校准-行动（CTA）”的框架，在该框架中，我们将此附加上下文提供给LLM，以使其能够更优地行动。 即使在 baseline 和 CTA 都经过强化学习训练后，这种改进仍然保留。 我们在信息搜索式问答和一个简化的编码任务上的结果表明，通过CTA明确成本效益权衡可以帮助代理发现更优化的决策策略。
tldr: The paper introduces Calibrate-Then-Act (CTA), a framework that encourages LLMs to explicitly reason about cost-uncertainty tradeoffs in sequential decision-making tasks, leading to more optimal environment exploration in information retrieval and coding scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Calibrate-Then-Act (CTA) 框架，该框架鼓励LLM在序列决策任务中明确地推理成本-不确定性权衡，从而在信息检索和编码场景中实现更优化的环境探索。

title: Towards a Science of AI Agent Reliability
summary: AI agents are increasingly deployed to execute important tasks. While rising accuracy scores on standard benchmarks suggest rapid progress, many agents still continue to fail in practice. This discrepancy highlights a fundamental limitation of current evaluations: compressing agent behavior into a single success metric obscures critical operational flaws. Notably, it ignores whether agents behave consistently across runs, withstand perturbations, fail predictably, or have bounded error severity. Grounded in safety-critical engineering, we provide a holistic performance profile by proposing twelve concrete metrics that decompose agent reliability along four key dimensions: consistency, robustness, predictability, and safety. Evaluating 14 agentic models across two complementary benchmarks, we find that recent capability gains have only yielded small improvements in reliability. By exposing these persistent limitations, our metrics complement traditional evaluations while offering tools for reasoning about how agents perform, degrade, and fail.
summary_zh: 人工智能智能体正越来越多地被部署来执行重要任务。尽管标准基准测试中不断上升的准确率表明取得了快速进展，但许多智能体在实践中仍然持续失败。这种差异凸显了当前评估的一个根本局限性：将智能体行为压缩成单一成功指标掩盖了关键的操作缺陷。值得注意的是，它忽略了智能体在不同运行中是否行为一致、能否承受扰动、是否以可预测的方式失败以及是否具有有界误差严重性。基于安全关键工程，我们通过提出十二个具体的指标来提供一个整体的性能剖析，这些指标沿着四个关键维度分解智能体的可靠性：一致性、鲁棒性、可预测性和安全性。通过在两个互补的基准测试中评估14个智能体模型，我们发现最近的能力提升仅仅在可靠性方面产生了很小的改进。通过揭示这些持续存在的局限性，我们的指标补充了传统的评估，同时提供了用于推理智能体如何执行、降级和失败的工具。
tldr: The paper introduces a set of metrics to evaluate AI agent reliability beyond accuracy, focusing on consistency, robustness, predictability, and safety, revealing that recent performance gains haven't significantly improved agent reliability across these dimensions.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一系列用于评估人工智能体可靠性的指标，超越了准确率本身，关注一致性、鲁棒性、可预测性和安全性。研究发现，最近的性能提升并没有显著提高智能体在这些维度上的可靠性。

title: RetouchIQ: MLLM Agents for Instruction-Based Image Retouching with Generalist Reward
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown great potential for extending vision-language reasoning to professional tool-based image editing, enabling intuitive and creative editing. A promising direction is to use reinforcement learning (RL) to enable MLLMs to reason about and execute optimal tool-use plans within professional image-editing software. However, training remains challenging due to the lack of reliable, verifiable reward signals that can reflect the inherently subjective nature of creative editing. In this work, we introduce RetouchIQ, a framework that performs instruction-based executable image editing through MLLM agents guided by a generalist reward model. RetouchIQ interprets user-specified editing intentions and generates corresponding, executable image adjustments, bridging high-level aesthetic goals with precise parameter control. To move beyond conventional, rule-based rewards that compute similarity against a fixed reference image using handcrafted metrics, we propose a generalist reward model, an RL fine-tuned MLLM that evaluates edited results through a set of generated metrics on a case-by-case basis. Then, the reward model provides scalar feedback through multimodal reasoning, enabling reinforcement learning with high-quality, instruction-consistent gradients. We curate an extended dataset with 190k instruction-reasoning pairs and establish a new benchmark for instruction-based image editing. Experiments show that RetouchIQ substantially improves both semantic consistency and perceptual quality over previous MLLM-based and diffusion-based editing systems. Our findings demonstrate the potential of generalist reward-driven MLLM agents as flexible, explainable, and executable assistants for professional image editing.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）的最新进展展现了将视觉-语言推理扩展到基于专业工具的图像编辑的巨大潜力，从而实现直观和创造性的编辑。一个有前景的方向是利用强化学习（RL）使MLLM能够推理和执行专业图像编辑软件中的最佳工具使用方案。然而，由于缺乏可靠、可验证的奖励信号来反映创造性编辑固有的主观性，训练仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们介绍了RetouchIQ，一个通过通用奖励模型引导的MLLM代理执行基于指令的可执行图像编辑的框架。 RetouchIQ解释用户指定的编辑意图，并生成相应的、可执行的图像调整，从而将高层次的审美目标与精确的参数控制联系起来。为了超越传统的、基于规则的奖励，这些奖励使用手工设计的指标计算与固定参考图像的相似性，我们提出了一种通用奖励模型，这是一个RL微调的MLLM，它通过一组在个案基础上生成的指标来评估编辑结果。然后，奖励模型通过多模态推理提供标量反馈，从而实现具有高质量、指令一致梯度的强化学习。我们整理了一个包含19万个指令-推理对的扩展数据集，并为基于指令的图像编辑建立了一个新的基准。实验表明，RetouchIQ在语义一致性和感知质量方面都比以前基于MLLM和基于扩散的编辑系统有了显著提高。我们的研究结果表明，通用奖励驱动的MLLM代理作为灵活、可解释和可执行的专业图像编辑助手具有巨大潜力。
tldr: RetouchIQ introduces a framework using MLLM agents guided by a generalist reward model for instruction-based image retouching, significantly improving semantic consistency and perceptual quality compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: RetouchIQ介绍了一个框架，该框架利用多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）智能体，通过一个通用奖励模型指导，实现基于指令的图像修饰。相比现有方法，该框架在语义一致性和感知质量上都有显著提升。

title: Selective Training for Large Vision Language Models via Visual Information Gain
summary: Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress, yet they often suffer from language bias, producing answers without relying on visual evidence. While prior work attempts to mitigate this issue through decoding strategies, architectural modifications, or curated instruction data, they typically lack a quantitative measure of how much individual training samples or tokens actually benefit from the image. In this work, we introduce Visual Information Gain (VIG), a perplexity-based metric that measures the reduction in prediction uncertainty provided by visual input. VIG enables fine-grained analysis at both sample and token levels, effectively highlighting visually grounded elements such as colors, spatial relations, and attributes. Leveraging this, we propose a VIG-guided selective training scheme that prioritizes high-VIG samples and tokens. This approach improves visual grounding and mitigates language bias, achieving superior performance with significantly reduced supervision by focusing exclusively on visually informative samples and tokens.
summary_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）取得了显著进展，但它们常常受到语言偏差的影响，产生答案而没有依赖于视觉证据。尽管先前的工作尝试通过解码策略、架构修改或精心策划的指令数据来缓解这个问题，但它们通常缺乏对单个训练样本或token从图像中实际获益程度的定量衡量。在这项工作中，我们引入了视觉信息增益（VIG），这是一个基于困惑度的指标，它测量视觉输入所带来的预测不确定性的降低程度。VIG实现了样本和token级别的细粒度分析，有效地突出了视觉接地的元素，如颜色、空间关系和属性。利用这一点，我们提出了一种VIG引导的选择性训练方案，该方案优先考虑高VIG的样本和token。这种方法通过专注于视觉信息丰富的样本和token，提高了视觉接地能力并降低了语言偏差，从而以显著减少的监督实现了卓越的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces Visual Information Gain (VIG), a metric to quantify the benefit of visual input in LVLMs, and uses it for selective training to improve visual grounding and reduce language bias, achieving better performance with less supervision.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了视觉信息增益（VIG）这一指标，用于量化视觉输入在大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中的益处，并利用它进行选择性训练，从而改善视觉扎根并减少语言偏差，以更少的监督实现更好的性能。

title: Learning Situated Awareness in the Real World
summary: A core aspect of human perception is situated awareness, the ability to relate ourselves to the surrounding physical environment and reason over possible actions in context. However, most existing benchmarks for multimodal foundation models (MFMs) emphasize environment-centric spatial relations (relations among objects in a scene), while largely overlooking observer-centric relationships that require reasoning relative to agent's viewpoint, pose, and motion. To bridge this gap, we introduce SAW-Bench (Situated Awareness in the Real World), a novel benchmark for evaluating egocentric situated awareness using real-world videos. SAW-Bench comprises 786 self-recorded videos captured with Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 2) smart glasses spanning diverse indoor and outdoor environments, and over 2,071 human-annotated question-answer pairs. It probes a model's observer-centric understanding with six different awareness tasks. Our comprehensive evaluation reveals a human-model performance gap of 37.66%, even with the best-performing MFM, Gemini 3 Flash. Beyond this gap, our in-depth analysis uncovers several notable findings; for example, while models can exploit partial geometric cues in egocentric videos, they often fail to infer a coherent camera geometry, leading to systematic spatial reasoning errors. We position SAW-Bench as a benchmark for situated spatial intelligence, moving beyond passive observation to understanding physically grounded, observer-centric dynamics.
summary_zh: 人类感知的一个核心方面是情境感知，即能够将自身与周围物理环境关联起来并在上下文中推理可能采取的行动的能力。然而，现有的多模态基础模型(MFM)基准测试大多强调以环境为中心的空间关系（场景中物体之间的关系），而很大程度上忽略了以观察者为中心的关系，后者需要相对于代理的视角、姿态和运动进行推理。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了SAW-Bench（真实世界中的情境感知），这是一个用于评估以自我为中心的情境感知的全新基准，它使用真实世界的视频。SAW-Bench包含786个使用雷朋Meta（第二代）智能眼镜自行录制的视频，涵盖了各种室内和室外环境，以及超过2,071个人工标注的问答对。它通过六种不同的感知任务来探测模型以观察者为中心的理解能力。我们的综合评估揭示了37.66%的人工智能模型性能差距，即使是性能最佳的MFM，Gemini 3 Flash也存在这一差距。除了这个差距之外，我们的深入分析还揭示了几个值得注意的发现；例如，虽然模型可以利用以自我为中心的视频中的部分几何线索，但它们往往无法推断出连贯的相机几何结构，从而导致系统的空间推理错误。我们将SAW-Bench定位为情境空间智能的基准，从被动观察转向理解物理上扎根的、以观察者为中心的动态。
tldr: The paper introduces SAW-Bench, a new benchmark for evaluating egocentric situated awareness in multimodal foundation models using real-world smart glasses videos. The benchmark reveals a significant performance gap between humans and current models, highlighting limitations in observer-centric spatial reasoning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SAW-Bench，一个新的基准，用于评估多模态基础模型在现实世界中使用智能眼镜视频进行以自我为中心的场景感知能力。该基准揭示了人类与当前模型之间的显著差距，突出了以观察者为中心的空间推理的局限性。

title: Learning to Stay Safe: Adaptive Regularization Against Safety Degradation during Fine-Tuning
summary: Instruction-following language models are trained to be helpful and safe, yet their safety behavior can deteriorate under benign fine-tuning and worsen under adversarial updates. Existing defenses often offer limited protection or force a trade-off between safety and utility. We introduce a training framework that adapts regularization in response to safety risk, enabling models to remain aligned throughout fine-tuning. To estimate safety risk at training time, we explore two distinct approaches: a judge-based Safety Critic that assigns high-level harm scores to training batches, and an activation-based risk predictor built with a lightweight classifier trained on intermediate model activations to estimate harmful intent. Each approach provides a risk signal that is used to constrain updates deemed higher risk to remain close to a safe reference policy, while lower-risk updates proceed with standard training. We empirically verify that harmful intent signals are predictable from pre-generation activations and that judge scores provide effective high-recall safety guidance. Across multiple model families and attack scenarios, adaptive regularization with either risk estimation approach consistently lowers attack success rate compared to standard fine-tuning, preserves downstream performance, and adds no inference-time cost. This work demonstrates a principled mechanism for maintaining safety without sacrificing utility.
summary_zh: 指令遵循语言模型被训练为有帮助和安全的，然而，它们的安全性行为会在良性微调下恶化，并在对抗性更新下加剧。现有的防御措施通常只能提供有限的保护，或者迫使在安全性和实用性之间进行权衡。我们引入了一个训练框架，能根据安全风险调整正则化，使模型在整个微调过程中保持对齐。为了在训练时评估安全风险，我们探索了两种不同的方法：一种基于裁判的“安全评论家”，它为训练批次分配高级别的危害评分；以及一种基于激活的风险预测器，它使用轻量级分类器，基于中间模型激活进行训练，以估计有害意图。每种方法都提供一个风险信号，该信号用于约束被认为风险较高的更新，使其保持接近一个安全的参考策略，而风险较低的更新则可按标准训练进行。我们通过实验验证了有害意图信号可以从生成前的激活中预测，并且裁判评分提供了有效的高召回率的安全指导。在多个模型家族和攻击场景中，使用任一风险估计方法的自适应正则化，与标准微调相比，都能始终如一地降低攻击成功率，保持下游性能，并且不增加推理时成本。这项工作展示了一种在不牺牲实用性的前提下，维持安全性的原则性机制。
tldr: This paper introduces an adaptive regularization framework that utilizes safety risk estimators to mitigate safety degradation during fine-tuning of instruction-following language models, balancing safety and utility without inference-time costs.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种自适应正则化框架，该框架利用安全风险估计器来缓解指令跟随语言模型微调过程中的安全降级问题，从而在不产生推理时成本的情况下平衡安全性和效用。

title: Retrospective In-Context Learning for Temporal Credit Assignment with Large Language Models
summary: Learning from self-sampled data and sparse environmental feedback remains a fundamental challenge in training self-evolving agents. Temporal credit assignment mitigates this issue by transforming sparse feedback into dense supervision signals. However, previous approaches typically depend on learning task-specific value functions for credit assignment, which suffer from poor sample efficiency and limited generalization. In this work, we propose to leverage pretrained knowledge from large language models (LLMs) to transform sparse rewards into dense training signals (i.e., the advantage function) through retrospective in-context learning (RICL). We further propose an online learning framework, RICOL, which iteratively refines the policy based on the credit assignment results from RICL. We empirically demonstrate that RICL can accurately estimate the advantage function with limited samples and effectively identify critical states in the environment for temporal credit assignment. Extended evaluation on four BabyAI scenarios show that RICOL achieves comparable convergent performance with traditional online RL algorithms with significantly higher sample efficiency. Our findings highlight the potential of leveraging LLMs for temporal credit assignment, paving the way for more sample-efficient and generalizable RL paradigms.
summary_zh: 从自采样数据和稀疏环境反馈中学习仍然是训练自进化智能体中的一个根本挑战。时间信用分配通过将稀疏反馈转化为密集监督信号来缓解这个问题。然而，以往的方法通常依赖于学习任务特定的价值函数来进行信用分配，这会导致样本效率低下以及泛化能力受限。本文中，我们提出利用来自大型语言模型（LLMs）的预训练知识，通过回顾性上下文学习（RICL）将稀疏奖励转化为密集的训练信号（即优势函数）。我们进一步提出了一种在线学习框架RICOL，它基于RICL的信用分配结果迭代地改进策略。实验结果表明，RICL能够在有限的样本下准确估计优势函数，并有效地识别环境中用于时间信用分配的关键状态。在四个BabyAI场景中的扩展评估表明，RICOL能以显著更高的样本效率达到与传统在线强化学习算法相当的收敛性能。我们的发现突显了利用LLM进行时间信用分配的潜力，为更具样本效率和泛化性的强化学习范式铺平了道路。
tldr: This paper introduces Retrospective In-Context Learning (RICL) and RICOL, a method leveraging LLMs for temporal credit assignment in RL, achieving improved sample efficiency in BabyAI environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了回顾性上下文学习（RICL）和RICOL，一种利用大型语言模型进行强化学习中时间信用分配的方法，在BabyAI环境中实现了更高的样本效率。

title: MDP Planning as Policy Inference
summary: We cast episodic Markov decision process (MDP) planning as Bayesian inference over _policies_. A policy is treated as the latent variable and is assigned an unnormalized probability of optimality that is monotone in its expected return, yielding a posterior distribution whose modes coincide with return-maximizing solutions while posterior dispersion represents uncertainty over optimal behavior. To approximate this posterior in discrete domains, we adapt variational sequential Monte Carlo (VSMC) to inference over deterministic policies under stochastic dynamics, introducing a sweep that enforces policy consistency across revisited states and couples transition randomness across particles to avoid confounding from simulator noise. Acting is performed by posterior predictive sampling, which induces a stochastic control policy through a Thompson-sampling interpretation rather than entropy regularization. Across grid worlds, Blackjack, Triangle Tireworld, and Academic Advising, we analyze the structure of inferred policy distributions and compare the resulting behavior to discrete Soft Actor-Critic, highlighting qualitative and statistical differences that arise from policy-level uncertainty.
summary_zh: 我们将分幕马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）规划视为对_策略_的贝叶斯推断。策略被视为潜在变量，并赋予其一个非归一化的最优概率，该概率与其期望回报单调相关，从而产生一个后验分布，其众数与回报最大化解相一致，而后验离散度则代表了对最优行为的不确定性。为了在离散域中近似这个后验分布，我们调整了变分序列蒙特卡洛（VSMC）方法，以推断具有随机动态的确定性策略，引入了一个策略一致性扫描，该扫描在重新访问状态时强制执行策略一致性，并将粒子间的转移随机性耦合，以避免模拟器噪声的混淆。通过后验预测抽样执行行动，通过汤普森抽样解释而非熵正则化，诱导出一个随机控制策略。在网格世界、二十一点、三角轮胎世界和学术咨询等环境中，我们分析了推断的策略分布的结构，并将结果行为与离散Soft Actor-Critic进行了比较，突出了由策略层面的不确定性所产生的定性和统计差异。
tldr: The paper proposes casting MDP planning as Bayesian inference over policies, using variational sequential Monte Carlo to approximate the posterior distribution of optimal policies and posterior predictive sampling for action selection. They demonstrate its effectiveness and analyze the inferred policy distributions on several benchmark tasks.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文将MDP规划视为策略的贝叶斯推断问题，使用变分序贯蒙特卡洛方法来近似最优策略的后验分布，并使用后验预测采样进行动作选择。他们在多个基准任务上展示了该方法的有效性，并分析了推断出的策略分布。

title: LexiSafe: Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning with Lexicographic Safety-Reward Hierarchy
summary: Offline safe reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly important for cyber-physical systems (CPS), where safety violations during training are unacceptable and only pre-collected data are available. Existing offline safe RL methods typically balance reward-safety tradeoffs through constraint relaxation or joint optimization, but they often lack structural mechanisms to prevent safety drift. We propose LexiSafe, a lexicographic offline RL framework designed to preserve safety-aligned behavior. We first develop LexiSafe-SC, a single-cost formulation for standard offline safe RL, and derive safety-violation and performance-suboptimality bounds that together yield sample-complexity guarantees. We then extend the framework to hierarchical safety requirements with LexiSafe-MC, which supports multiple safety costs and admits its own sample-complexity analysis. Empirically, LexiSafe demonstrates reduced safety violations and improved task performance compared to constrained offline baselines. By unifying lexicographic prioritization with structural bias, LexiSafe offers a practical and theoretically grounded approach for safety-critical CPS decision-making.
