summary_zh: 离线安全强化学习(RL)对于信息物理系统(CPS)越来越重要，在训练过程中安全违规是不可接受的，且只能使用预先收集的数据。现有的离线安全RL方法通常通过约束松弛或联合优化来平衡奖励-安全性的权衡，但它们经常缺乏防止安全漂移的结构性机制。我们提出了LexiSafe，一个旨在保持与安全性对齐行为的词典式离线RL框架。我们首先开发了LexiSafe-SC，用于标准离线安全RL的单代价公式，并推导出安全违规和性能次优性的界限，它们共同产生了样本复杂度保证。然后，我们将该框架扩展到具有分层安全要求的LexiSafe-MC，它支持多个安全代价并允许其自身的样本复杂度分析。实验结果表明，与基于约束的离线基线相比，LexiSafe减少了安全违规并提高了任务性能。通过将词典式优先级排序与结构性偏差统一起来，LexiSafe为安全关键的CPS决策提供了一种实用且具有理论基础的方法。
tldr: The paper introduces LexiSafe, a lexicographic offline safe RL framework with theoretical guarantees and empirical validation, designed to prevent safety drift in cyber-physical systems with hierarchical safety requirements.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LexiSafe，一种具有理论保证和经验验证的词典式离线安全强化学习框架，旨在防止具有分层安全要求的网络物理系统中的安全漂移。

title: Action-Graph Policies: Learning Action Co-dependencies in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Coordinating actions is the most fundamental form of cooperation in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Successful decentralized decision-making often depends not only on good individual actions, but on selecting compatible actions across agents to synchronize behavior, avoid conflicts, and satisfy global constraints. In this paper, we propose Action Graph Policies (AGP), that model dependencies among agents' available action choices. It constructs, what we call, \textit{coordination contexts}, that enable agents to condition their decisions on global action dependencies. Theoretically, we show that AGPs induce a strictly more expressive joint policy compared to fully independent policies and can realize coordinated joint actions that are provably more optimal than greedy execution even from centralized value-decomposition methods. Empirically, we show that AGP achieves 80-95\% success on canonical coordination tasks with partial observability and anti-coordination penalties, where other MARL methods reach only 10-25\%. We further demonstrate that AGP consistently outperforms these baselines in diverse multi-agent environments.
summary_zh: 在多智能体强化学习（MARL）中，协同行动是最基本的合作形式。成功的去中心化决策通常不仅取决于良好的个体行为，还取决于跨智能体选择兼容的动作以同步行为、避免冲突并满足全局约束。在本文中，我们提出了动作图策略（AGP），该策略对智能体可用动作选择之间的依赖关系进行建模。它构建了我们称之为 \textit{协同上下文} 的结构，使智能体能够根据全局动作依赖性来调整其决策。从理论上讲，我们证明了 AGP 相比于完全独立的策略，可以诱导出一个严格更具表达力的联合策略，并且可以实现经证明比贪婪执行更优的协同联合动作，即使是从集中式价值分解方法中也能获得。通过实验，我们表明 AGP 在具有部分可观察性和反协同惩罚的典型协同任务中实现了 80-95% 的成功率，而其他 MARL 方法仅达到 10-25%。我们进一步证明 AGP 在各种多智能体环境中始终优于这些基线方法。
tldr: This paper introduces Action Graph Policies (AGP), a MARL method that explicitly models action dependencies among agents, leading to significantly improved coordination in partially observable environments compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了动作图策略（AGP），这是一种 MARL 方法，它显式地对智能体之间的动作依赖关系进行建模，与现有方法相比，在部分可观察环境中显著提高了协调能力。

title: FR-GESTURE: An RGBD Dataset For Gesture-based Human-Robot Interaction In First Responder Operations
summary: The ever increasing intensity and number of disasters make even more difficult the work of First Responders (FRs). Artificial intelligence and robotics solutions could facilitate their operations, compensating these difficulties. To this end, we propose a dataset for gesture-based UGV control by FRs, introducing a set of 12 commands, drawing inspiration from existing gestures used by FRs and tactical hand signals and refined after incorporating feedback from experienced FRs. Then we proceed with the data collection itself, resulting in 3312 RGBD pairs captured from 2 viewpoints and 7 distances. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first dataset especially intended for gesture-based UGV guidance by FRs. Finally we define evaluation protocols for our RGBD dataset, termed FR-GESTURE, and we perform baseline experiments, which are put forward for improvement. We have made data publicly available to promote future research on the domain: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18131333.
summary_zh: 日益增强的灾害强度和频次使得急救人员（FRs）的工作更加困难。人工智能和机器人解决方案能够促进他们的行动，弥补这些困难。为此，我们提出一个基于手势的无人地面车辆（UGV）控制数据集，用于急救人员，引入了一组12个指令，其灵感来源于急救人员和战术手势已经使用的手势，并在纳入经验丰富的急救人员的反馈后进行了改进。然后我们进行数据收集，最终获得了从2个视角和7个距离捕获的3312个RGBD图像对。据我们所知，这是第一个专门为急救人员基于手势的无人地面车辆引导而设计的数据集。最后，我们为我们的RGBD数据集（命名为FR-GESTURE）定义了评估协议，并进行了基线实验，这些实验为进一步改进奠定了基础。 我们已经公开了数据，以促进该领域未来的研究：https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18131333。
tldr: The paper introduces FR-GESTURE, a new RGBD dataset specifically designed for gesture-based control of UGVs by first responders, accompanied by baseline experiments and evaluation protocols.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为FR-GESTURE的新型RGBD数据集，专门为急救人员基于手势控制UGV而设计，并提供了基线实验和评估协议。

title: IRIS: Learning-Driven Task-Specific Cinema Robot Arm for Visuomotor Motion Control
summary: Robotic camera systems enable dynamic, repeatable motion beyond human capabilities, yet their adoption remains limited by the high cost and operational complexity of industrial-grade platforms. We present the Intelligent Robotic Imaging System (IRIS), a task-specific 6-DOF manipulator designed for autonomous, learning-driven cinematic motion control. IRIS integrates a lightweight, fully 3D-printed hardware design with a goal-conditioned visuomotor imitation learning framework based on Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT). The system learns object-aware and perceptually smooth camera trajectories directly from human demonstrations, eliminating the need for explicit geometric programming. The complete platform costs under $1,000 USD, supports a 1.5 kg payload, and achieves approximately 1 mm repeatability. Real-world experiments demonstrate accurate trajectory tracking, reliable autonomous execution, and generalization across diverse cinematic motions.
summary_zh: 机器相机系统能够实现超越人类能力的动态、可重复运动，但其应用仍然受限于工业级平台的高成本和操作复杂性。 我们提出了智能机器人影像系统 (IRIS)，这是一个专为自主、学习驱动的电影化运动控制而设计的特定任务的 6 自由度机械臂。IRIS 集成了轻量级、完全 3D 打印的硬件设计，以及基于 Transformer 的动作分块 (ACT) 的目标条件下的视觉运动模仿学习框架。 该系统直接从人类演示中学习感知平滑的、对象感知的相机轨迹，无需显式的几何编程。 完整的平台成本低于 1,000 美元，支持 1.5 公斤的有效载荷，并实现约 1 毫米的重复精度。 真实世界的实验表明了精确的轨迹跟踪、可靠的自主执行以及跨各种电影化运动的泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces IRIS, a low-cost, 3D-printed 6-DOF robot arm for autonomous cinematic motion control, which uses goal-conditioned visuomotor imitation learning to learn camera trajectories from human demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种低成本的3D打印六自由度机器人手臂IRIS，用于自主电影运动控制，它使用目标条件下的视觉运动模仿学习，从人类演示中学习相机轨迹。

title: Distributed Virtual Model Control for Scalable Human-Robot Collaboration in Shared Workspace
summary: We present a decentralized, agent agnostic, and safety-aware control framework for human-robot collaboration based on Virtual Model Control (VMC). In our approach, both humans and robots are embedded in the same virtual-component-shaped workspace, where motion is the result of the interaction with virtual springs and dampers rather than explicit trajectory planning. A decentralized, force-based stall detector identifies deadlocks, which are resolved through negotiation. This reduces the probability of robots getting stuck in the block placement task from up to 61.2% to zero in our experiments. The framework scales without structural changes thanks to the distributed implementation: in experiments we demonstrate safe collaboration with up to two robots and two humans, and in simulation up to four robots, maintaining inter-agent separation at around 20 cm. Results show that the method shapes robot behavior intuitively by adjusting control parameters and achieves deadlock-free operation across team sizes in all tested scenarios.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种基于虚拟模型控制(VMC)的去中心化、与代理无关、且具有安全意识的人机协作控制框架。在我们的方法中，人类和机器人都嵌入在同一个虚拟组件形状的工作空间中，其中的运动是与虚拟弹簧和阻尼器交互的结果，而不是显式的轨迹规划。一个去中心化的、基于力的失速检测器可以识别僵局，并通过协商解决。这在我们的实验中，将机器人卡在块放置任务中的概率从高达61.2%降低到零。由于分布式实现，该框架无需结构性更改即可扩展：在实验中，我们展示了与最多两个机器人和两个人类的安全协作，并在模拟中展示了与最多四个机器人的安全协作，同时保持大约20厘米的代理间距。结果表明，该方法可以通过调整控制参数直观地塑造机器人行为，并在所有测试场景中实现跨团队规模的无僵局运行。
tldr: This paper presents a decentralized Virtual Model Control framework for safe and scalable human-robot collaboration in shared workspaces, eliminating deadlocks during block placement tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分散式虚拟模型控制框架，用于共享工作空间中安全且可扩展的人机协作，消除了块放置任务中的死锁。

title: Multi-session Localization and Mapping Exploiting Topological Information
summary: Operating in previously visited environments is becoming increasingly crucial for autonomous systems, with direct applications in autonomous driving, surveying, and warehouse or household robotics. This repeated exposure to observing the same areas poses significant challenges for mapping and localization -- key components for enabling any higher-level task. In this work, we propose a novel multi-session framework that builds on map-based localization, in contrast to the common practice of greedily running full SLAM sessions and trying to find correspondences between the resulting maps. Our approach incorporates a topology-informed, uncertainty-aware decision-making mechanism that analyzes the pose-graph structure to detect low-connectivity regions, selectively triggering mapping and loop closing modules. The resulting map and pose-graph are seamlessly integrated into the existing model, reducing accumulated error and enhancing global consistency. We validate our method on overlapping sequences from datasets and demonstrate its effectiveness in a real-world mine-like environment.
summary_zh: 在先前访问过的环境中运行对自主系统变得越来越重要，直接应用于自动驾驶、勘测以及仓库或家庭机器人。这种重复观察同一区域的情况对地图构建和定位提出了重大挑战，而地图构建和定位是实现任何更高级别任务的关键组成部分。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的多会话框架，它建立在基于地图的定位之上，这与贪婪地运行完整 SLAM 会话并尝试在生成的地图之间找到对应关系的常见做法不同。我们的方法包含一个拓扑结构知情、不确定性感知的决策机制，该机制分析姿态图结构以检测低连通性区域，从而有选择地触发地图构建和闭环检测模块。生成的地图和姿态图被无缝地集成到现有模型中，从而减少累积误差并增强全局一致性。我们在来自数据集的重叠序列上验证了我们的方法，并证明了其在真实矿井类似环境中的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel multi-session localization and mapping framework that utilizes topology-informed decision-making to improve global consistency and reduce errors in environments visited multiple times.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的多会话定位和建图框架，该框架利用拓扑结构的决策机制来提高全局一致性并减少多次访问环境中的误差。

title: Grasp Synthesis Matching From Rigid To Soft Robot Grippers Using Conditional Flow Matching
summary: A representation gap exists between grasp synthesis for rigid and soft grippers. Anygrasp [1] and many other grasp synthesis methods are designed for rigid parallel grippers, and adapting them to soft grippers often fails to capture their unique compliant behaviors, resulting in data-intensive and inaccurate models. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a novel framework to map grasp poses from a rigid gripper model to a soft Fin-ray gripper. We utilize Conditional Flow Matching (CFM), a generative model, to learn this complex transformation. Our methodology includes a data collection pipeline to generate paired rigid-soft grasp poses. A U-Net autoencoder conditions the CFM model on the object's geometry from a depth image, allowing it to learn a continuous mapping from an initial Anygrasp pose to a stable Fin-ray gripper pose. We validate our approach on a 7-DOF robot, demonstrating that our CFM-generated poses achieve a higher overall success rate for seen and unseen objects (34% and 46% respectively) compared to the baseline rigid poses (6% and 25% respectively) when executed by the soft gripper. The model shows significant improvements, particularly for cylindrical (50% and 100% success for seen and unseen objects) and spherical objects (25% and 31% success for seen and unseen objects), and successfully generalizes to unseen objects. This work presents CFM as a data-efficient and effective method for transferring grasp strategies, offering a scalable methodology for other soft robotic systems.
summary_zh: 刚性夹爪和柔性夹爪的抓取合成之间存在表示差距。Anygrasp [1] 和许多其他抓取合成方法是为刚性平行夹爪设计的，将其应用于柔性夹爪时往往无法捕捉到它们独特的柔顺特性，从而导致数据密集且不准确的模型。为了弥合这一差距，本文提出了一种新的框架，将抓取姿态从刚性夹爪模型映射到柔性 Fin-ray 夹爪。我们利用条件流匹配 (CFM) 这种生成模型来学习这种复杂的转换。我们的方法包括一个数据收集流程，用于生成配对的刚性-柔性抓取姿态。一个 U-Net 自编码器根据来自深度图像的物体几何形状对 CFM 模型进行条件约束，使其能够学习从初始 Anygrasp 姿态到稳定 Fin-ray 夹爪姿态的连续映射。我们在一个 7 自由度机器人上验证了我们的方法，结果表明，与由柔性夹爪执行的基线刚性姿态（分别为 6% 和 25%）相比，我们 CFM 生成的姿态对于已见和未见的物体都获得了更高的总体成功率（分别为 34% 和 46%）。该模型显示出了显著的改进，尤其是在圆柱形（已见和未见物体的成功率分别为 50% 和 100%）和球形物体（已见和未见物体的成功率分别为 25% 和 31%）方面，并且成功泛化到未见物体。这项工作表明 CFM 是一种数据高效且有效的抓取策略迁移方法，为其他柔性机器人系统提供了一种可扩展的方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) based framework to map grasp poses from rigid grippers to soft Fin-ray grippers, demonstrating improved grasp success rates on a robot with seen and unseen objects.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于条件流匹配（CFM）的框架，用于将刚性夹爪的抓取姿势映射到软性Fin-ray夹爪，并在配备它的机器人上展示了对见过的和未见过的物体的抓取成功率的提高。

title: Benchmarking the Effects of Object Pose Estimation and Reconstruction on Robotic Grasping Success
summary: 3D reconstruction serves as the foundational layer for numerous robotic perception tasks, including 6D object pose estimation and grasp pose generation. Modern 3D reconstruction methods for objects can produce visually and geometrically impressive meshes from multi-view images, yet standard geometric evaluations do not reflect how reconstruction quality influences downstream tasks such as robotic manipulation performance. This paper addresses this gap by introducing a large-scale, physics-based benchmark that evaluates 6D pose estimators and 3D mesh models based on their functional efficacy in grasping. We analyze the impact of model fidelity by generating grasps on various reconstructed 3D meshes and executing them on the ground-truth model, simulating how grasp poses generated with an imperfect model affect interaction with the real object. This assesses the combined impact of pose error, grasp robustness, and geometric inaccuracies from 3D reconstruction. Our results show that reconstruction artifacts significantly decrease the number of grasp pose candidates but have a negligible effect on grasping performance given an accurately estimated pose. Our results also reveal that the relationship between grasp success and pose error is dominated by spatial error, and even a simple translation error provides insight into the success of the grasping pose of symmetric objects. This work provides insight into how perception systems relate to object manipulation using robots.
summary_zh: 三维重建是众多机器人感知任务的基础层，包括六自由度物体姿态估计和抓取姿态生成。现代物体三维重建方法可以通过多视角图像生成视觉上和几何上令人印象深刻的网格，然而，标准几何评估并不能反映重建质量如何影响下游任务，例如机器人操控性能。本文通过引入一个大规模、基于物理的基准来弥补这一差距，该基准依据六自由度姿态估计器和三维网格模型在抓取中的功能有效性对其进行评估。我们通过在各种重建的三维网格上生成抓取姿态，并在真实模型上执行抓取姿态，模拟了使用不完美模型生成的抓取姿态如何影响与真实物体的交互，从而分析了模型保真度的影响。这评估了姿态误差、抓取鲁棒性和三维重建中几何不准确性的综合影响。我们的结果表明，重建伪影显著减少了抓取姿态候选的数量，但对于准确估计的姿态，对抓取性能的影响可以忽略不计。我们的结果还表明，抓取成功率和姿态误差之间的关系主要受空间误差控制，即使是简单的平移误差也能提供对对称物体抓取姿态成功率的洞察。这项工作提供了关于感知系统如何与使用机器人的物体操作相关的见解。
tldr: This paper introduces a benchmark to evaluate the impact of 3D reconstruction quality and 6D pose estimation on robotic grasping success, finding that reconstruction artifacts reduce grasp candidates but pose accuracy is paramount for successful grasping, even for symmetric objects.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个基准，用于评估3D重建质量和6D姿态估计对机器人抓取成功率的影响。研究发现，重建伪影会减少抓取候选数量，但姿态估计的准确性对于成功抓取最为重要，即使对于对称物体也是如此。

title: IntentCUA: Learning Intent-level Representations for Skill Abstraction and Multi-Agent Planning in Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents operate over long horizons under noisy perception, multi-window contexts, evolving environment states. Existing approaches, from RL-based planners to trajectory retrieval, often drift from user intent and repeatedly solve routine subproblems, leading to error accumulation and inefficiency. We present IntentCUA, a multi-agent computer-use framework designed to stabilize long-horizon execution through intent-aligned plan memory. A Planner, Plan-Optimizer, and Critic coordinate over shared memory that abstracts raw interaction traces into multi-view intent representations and reusable skills. At runtime, intent prototypes retrieve subgroup-aligned skills and inject them into partial plans, reducing redundant re-planning and mitigating error propagation across desktop applications. In end-to-end evaluations, IntentCUA achieved a 74.83% task success rate with a Step Efficiency Ratio of 0.91, outperforming RL-based and trajectory-centric baselines. Ablations show that multi-view intent abstraction and shared plan memory jointly improve execution stability, with the cooperative multi-agent loop providing the largest gains on long-horizon tasks. These results highlight that system-level intent abstraction and memory-grounded coordination are key to reliable and efficient desktop automation in large, dynamic environments.
summary_zh: 计算机使用智能体在长期的时间跨度内运行，面临着嘈杂的感知，多窗口上下文和不断变化的环境状态。现有的方法，从基于强化学习的规划器到轨迹检索，经常偏离用户意图并重复解决常规子问题，导致误差累积和效率低下。我们提出了IntentCUA，一个多智能体计算机使用框架，旨在通过与意图对齐的计划记忆来稳定长期执行。规划器、计划优化器和评论器协同工作，共享内存，将原始交互轨迹抽象为多视角意图表示和可重用的技能。在运行时，意图原型会检索与子组对齐的技能，并将它们注入到部分计划中，从而减少了冗余的重新规划并减轻了跨桌面应用程序的误差传播。在端到端评估中，IntentCUA实现了74.83%的任务成功率，步数效率比为0.91，优于基于强化学习和以轨迹为中心的基线方法。消融实验表明，多视角意图抽象和共享计划记忆共同提高了执行的稳定性，其中协同多智能体循环在长期任务中提供了最大的增益。这些结果表明，系统级别的意图抽象和基于记忆的协调是大型动态环境中可靠和高效桌面自动化的关键。
tldr: The paper introduces IntentCUA, a framework for computer-use agents that uses intent-aligned plan memory and multi-agent coordination to improve long-horizon task success and step efficiency in desktop automation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了IntentCUA，一个用于计算机应用代理的框架，它使用与意图对齐的计划记忆和多智能体协作来提高在桌面自动化任务中的长时程任务成功率和步效率。

title: SparTa: Sparse Graphical Task Models from a Handful of Demonstrations
summary: Learning long-horizon manipulation tasks efficiently is a central challenge in robot learning from demonstration. Unlike recent endeavors that focus on directly learning the task in the action domain, we focus on inferring what the robot should achieve in the task, rather than how to do so. To this end, we represent evolving scene states using a series of graphical object relationships. We propose a demonstration segmentation and pooling approach that extracts a series of manipulation graphs and estimates distributions over object states across task phases. In contrast to prior graph-based methods that capture only partial interactions or short temporal windows, our approach captures complete object interactions spanning from the onset of control to the end of the manipulation. To improve robustness when learning from multiple demonstrations, we additionally perform object matching using pre-trained visual features. In extensive experiments, we evaluate our method's demonstration segmentation accuracy and the utility of learning from multiple demonstrations for finding a desired minimal task model. Finally, we deploy the fitted models both in simulation and on a real robot, demonstrating that the resulting task representations support reliable execution across environments.
summary_zh: 有效学习长期操作任务是从演示中学习机器人的一项核心挑战。与最近专注于直接在动作域内学习任务的尝试不同，我们专注于推断机器人应该在任务中实现什么，而不是如何实现。为此，我们使用一系列图形化的对象关系来表示不断演变的场景状态。我们提出了一种演示分割和池化方法，该方法提取一系列操作图，并估计跨任务阶段的对象状态分布。与仅捕获部分交互或短时间窗口的现有基于图的方法相比，我们的方法捕获从控制开始到操作结束的完整对象交互。为了提高从多次演示中学习时的鲁棒性，我们还使用预训练的视觉特征执行对象匹配。在大量的实验中，我们评估了我们方法的演示分割准确性，以及从多次演示中学习以找到所需最小任务模型的效用。最后，我们将拟合的模型部署在模拟和真实的机器人上，证明所得到的任务表示支持跨环境的可靠执行。
tldr: The paper introduces SparTa, which learns sparse graphical task models from demonstrations by inferring task achievements based on object relationships, focusing on *what* the robot should do rather than *how*. They demonstrate its effectiveness in simulation and on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SparTa，它通过基于对象关系推断任务成果，从演示中学习稀疏图形任务模型，重点关注机器人*应该*做什么而不是*如何*做。他们在模拟和真实机器人上展示了其有效性。

title: Toward a Fully Autonomous, AI-Native Particle Accelerator
summary: This position paper presents a vision for self-driving particle accelerators that operate autonomously with minimal human intervention. We propose that future facilities be designed through artificial intelligence (AI) co-design, where AI jointly optimizes the accelerator lattice, diagnostics, and science application from inception to maximize performance while enabling autonomous operation. Rather than retrofitting AI onto human-centric systems, we envision facilities designed from the ground up as AI-native platforms. We outline nine critical research thrusts spanning agentic control architectures, knowledge integration, adaptive learning, digital twins, health monitoring, safety frameworks, modular hardware design, multimodal data fusion, and cross-domain collaboration. This roadmap aims to guide the accelerator community toward a future where AI-driven design and operation deliver unprecedented science output and reliability.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种自主粒子加速器的愿景，该加速器能够在最小的人工干预下自主运行。我们建议未来的设施通过人工智能（AI）协同设计来设计，其中AI从一开始就联合优化加速器格子、诊断系统和科学应用，以最大限度地提高性能，同时实现自主运行。我们设想的设施并非将AI改装到以人为中心的系统上，而是从头开始设计为AI原生平台。我们概述了九个关键的研究方向，包括主动控制架构、知识集成、自适应学习、数字孪生、健康监测、安全框架、模块化硬件设计、多模态数据融合以及跨领域合作。该路线图旨在引导加速器界走向一个未来，在这个未来中，人工智能驱动的设计和运行将带来前所未有的科学产出和可靠性。
tldr: This paper proposes a vision for fully autonomous particle accelerators designed from the ground up using AI co-design, outlining nine key research areas to achieve this goal. It advocates for an AI-native approach rather than retrofitting AI onto existing systems.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个关于使用人工智能协同设计从头开始构建完全自主粒子加速器的愿景，并概述了实现这一目标的九个关键研究领域。它提倡一种人工智能原生方法，而不是将人工智能改造到现有系统中。

title: Voice-Driven Semantic Perception for UAV-Assisted Emergency Networks
summary: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV)-assisted networks are increasingly foreseen as a promising approach for emergency response, providing rapid, flexible, and resilient communications in environments where terrestrial infrastructure is degraded or unavailable. In such scenarios, voice radio communications remain essential for first responders due to their robustness; however, their unstructured nature prevents direct integration with automated UAV-assisted network management. This paper proposes SIREN, an AI-driven framework that enables voice-driven perception for UAV-assisted networks. By integrating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) with Large Language Model (LLM)-based semantic extraction and Natural Language Processing (NLP) validation, SIREN converts emergency voice traffic into structured, machine-readable information, including responding units, location references, emergency severity, and Quality-of-Service (QoS) requirements. SIREN is evaluated using synthetic emergency scenarios with controlled variations in language, speaker count, background noise, and message complexity. The results demonstrate robust transcription and reliable semantic extraction across diverse operating conditions, while highlighting speaker diarization and geographic ambiguity as the main limiting factors. These findings establish the feasibility of voice-driven situational awareness for UAV-assisted networks and show a practical foundation for human-in-the-loop decision support and adaptive network management in emergency response operations.
summary_zh: 无人机（UAV）辅助网络日益被视为一种有前景的应急响应方法，可在陆地基础设施退化或不可用的环境中提供快速、灵活且具有弹性的通信。在此类场景中，语音无线电通信因其稳健性对急救人员而言仍然至关重要；然而，其非结构化特性阻碍了与自动化无人机辅助网络管理的直接集成。本文提出SIREN，一种AI驱动的框架，可为无人机辅助网络实现语音驱动的感知。通过将自动语音识别（ASR）与基于大型语言模型（LLM）的语义提取和自然语言处理（NLP）验证相结合，SIREN将紧急语音流量转换为结构化的、机器可读的信息，包括响应单位、位置参考、紧急程度和服务质量（QoS）要求。SIREN通过合成的紧急场景进行评估，其中语言、说话者数量、背景噪声和消息复杂度受到控制变化。结果表明，在各种运行条件下， transcription稳健且语义提取可靠，同时突出了说话者分离和地理模糊性是主要的限制因素。这些发现确立了无人机辅助网络语音驱动态势感知的可行性，并为应急响应操作中的人机协同决策支持和自适应网络管理奠定了实践基础。
tldr: The paper presents SIREN, an AI-driven framework that converts voice-based emergency communications into structured data for UAV-assisted network management, enabling improved situational awareness and decision support.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了SIREN，一个AI驱动的框架，将基于语音的紧急通信转换为结构化数据，用于无人机辅助的网络管理，从而提高情境感知和决策支持。

title: Flickering Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: We introduce Flickering Multi-Armed Bandits (FMAB), a new MAB framework where the set of available arms (or actions) can change at each round, and the available set at any time may depend on the agent's previously selected arm. We model this constrained, evolving availability using random graph processes, where arms are nodes and the agent's movement is restricted to its local neighborhood. We analyze this problem under two random graph models: an i.i.d. Erdős--Rényi (ER) process and an Edge-Markovian process. We propose and analyze a two-phase algorithm that employs a lazy random walk for exploration to efficiently identify the optimal arm, followed by a navigation and commitment phase for exploitation. We establish high-probability and expected sublinear regret bounds for both graph settings. We show that the exploration cost of our algorithm is near-optimal by establishing a matching information-theoretic lower bound for this problem class, highlighting the fundamental cost of exploration under local-move constraints. We complement our theoretical guarantees with numerical simulations, including a scenario of a robotic ground vehicle scouting a disaster-affected region.
summary_zh: 我们引入了闪烁多臂老虎机（FMAB），一种新的MAB框架，其中可用臂（或动作）的集合在每一轮可能会发生变化，且任何时候的可用集合可能取决于智能体先前选择的臂。我们使用随机图过程来建模这种受约束的、不断变化的可用性，其中臂是节点，智能体的移动被限制在其局部邻域内。我们分析了在两种随机图模型下的这个问题：独立同分布的Erdős--Rényi (ER)过程和一个边缘马尔可夫过程。我们提出并分析了一种两阶段算法，该算法采用惰性随机游走进行探索，以有效识别最优臂，然后进入导航和承诺阶段进行利用。我们为两种图设置建立了高概率和期望亚线性遗憾界。通过为此问题类别建立匹配的信息论下界，我们表明了算法的探索成本接近最优，突出了在局部移动约束下探索的根本成本。我们用数值模拟补充了我们的理论保证，包括地面机器人车辆侦察受灾害影响区域的场景。
tldr: The paper introduces Flickering Multi-Armed Bandits (FMAB), a new framework where the available arms change dynamically based on the agent's previous action, modeled as random graph processes, and provides a near-optimal two-phase algorithm with theoretical and empirical guarantees.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的多臂老虎机框架（FMAB），其中可用臂根据智能体的先前动作动态变化，并由随机图过程建模。同时，论文提出了一种近似最优的两阶段算法，并提供了理论和实验保证。

title: Continual uncertainty learning
summary: Robust control of mechanical systems with multiple uncertainties remains a fundamental challenge, particularly when nonlinear dynamics and operating-condition variations are intricately intertwined. While deep reinforcement learning (DRL) combined with domain randomization has shown promise in mitigating the sim-to-real gap, simultaneously handling all sources of uncertainty often leads to sub-optimal policies and poor learning efficiency. This study formulates a new curriculum-based continual learning framework for robust control problems involving nonlinear dynamical systems in which multiple sources of uncertainty are simultaneously superimposed. The key idea is to decompose a complex control problem with multiple uncertainties into a sequence of continual learning tasks, in which strategies for handling each uncertainty are acquired sequentially. The original system is extended into a finite set of plants whose dynamic uncertainties are gradually expanded and diversified as learning progresses. The policy is stably updated across the entire plant sets associated with tasks defined by different uncertainty configurations without catastrophic forgetting. To ensure learning efficiency, we jointly incorporate a model-based controller (MBC), which guarantees a shared baseline performance across the plant sets, into the learning process to accelerate the convergence. This residual learning scheme facilitates task-specific optimization of the DRL agent for each uncertainty, thereby enhancing sample efficiency. As a practical industrial application, this study applies the proposed method to designing an active vibration controller for automotive powertrains. We verified that the resulting controller is robust against structural nonlinearities and dynamic variations, realizing successful sim-to-real transfer.
summary_zh: 对具有多重不确定性的机械系统进行鲁棒控制仍然是一个根本性的挑战，尤其是在非线性动力学和工作条件变化错综复杂地交织在一起时。虽然深度强化学习(DRL)结合领域随机化在缓解从仿真到现实的差距方面展现出潜力，但同时处理所有不确定性来源通常会导致次优策略和较差的学习效率。本研究针对涉及多重不确定性同时叠加的非线性动力学系统，提出了一种新的基于课程的持续学习框架，用于解决鲁棒控制问题。其核心思想是将一个具有多重不确定性的复杂控制问题分解为一系列持续学习任务，并按顺序获得处理每种不确定性的策略。原始系统被扩展为一组有限的控制对象，其动态不确定性随着学习的进行而逐渐扩大和多样化。策略在与不同不确定性配置定义的任务相关的整个控制对象集合中稳定更新，而不会发生灾难性遗忘。为了确保学习效率，我们将基于模型的控制器(MBC)与学习过程相结合，该控制器保证了控制对象集合中的共享基线性能，从而加速收敛。这种残差学习方案有助于DRL智能体针对每种不确定性进行特定于任务的优化，从而提高样本效率。作为一个实际的工业应用，本研究将提出的方法应用于汽车动力总成主动振动控制器的设计。我们验证了由此产生的控制器对结构非线性和动态变化具有鲁棒性，实现了成功的从仿真到现实的迁移。
tldr: This paper introduces a curriculum-based continual learning framework using DRL for robust control of nonlinear dynamical systems under multiple uncertainties, validated through active vibration control in automotive powertrains.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于课程的持续学习框架，利用深度强化学习来鲁棒地控制具有多种不确定性的非线性动力系统，并通过汽车动力总成的有源振动控制进行了验证。

title: Retaining Suboptimal Actions to Follow Shifting Optima in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Value decomposition is a core approach for cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). However, existing methods still rely on a single optimal action and struggle to adapt when the underlying value function shifts during training, often converging to suboptimal policies. To address this limitation, we propose Successive Sub-value Q-learning (S2Q), which learns multiple sub-value functions to retain alternative high-value actions. Incorporating these sub-value functions into a Softmax-based behavior policy, S2Q encourages persistent exploration and enables $Q^{\text{tot}}$ to adjust quickly to the changing optima. Experiments on challenging MARL benchmarks confirm that S2Q consistently outperforms various MARL algorithms, demonstrating improved adaptability and overall performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/hyeon1996/S2Q.
summary_zh: 值分解是协作多智能体强化学习（MARL）中的一种核心方法。然而，现有方法仍然依赖于单一最优动作，并且难以适应训练过程中基础价值函数的移动，经常收敛到次优策略。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了连续子价值Q学习（S2Q），它学习多个子价值函数以保留备选的高价值动作。通过将这些子价值函数整合到基于Softmax的行为策略中，S2Q鼓励持续探索并使$Q^{\text{tot}}$能够快速适应不断变化的最优解。在具有挑战性的MARL基准测试上的实验证实，S2Q始终优于各种MARL算法，展现出改进的适应性和整体性能。我们的代码可在https://github.com/hyeon1996/S2Q获取。
tldr: The paper introduces Successive Sub-value Q-learning (S2Q) to improve adaptability in cooperative MARL by retaining alternative high-value actions for faster adjustment to shifting optima.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了连续子值Q学习（S2Q），通过保留备选的高价值动作来改善合作多智能体强化学习中的适应性，从而更快地适应不断变化的优化。

title: Phase-Aware Mixture of Experts for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has equipped LLM agents with a strong ability to solve complex tasks. However, existing RL methods normally use a \emph{single} policy network, causing \emph{simplicity bias} where simple tasks occupy most parameters and dominate gradient updates, leaving insufficient capacity for complex tasks. A plausible remedy could be employing the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture in the policy network, as MoE allows different parameters (experts) to specialize in different tasks, preventing simple tasks from dominating all parameters. However, a key limitation of traditional MoE is its token-level routing, where the router assigns each token to specialized experts, which fragments phase-consistent patterns into scattered expert assignments and thus undermines expert specialization. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Phase-Aware Mixture of Experts (PA-MoE)}. It first features a lightweight \emph{phase router} that learns latent phase boundaries directly from the RL objective without pre-defining phase categories. Then, the phase router allocates temporally consistent assignments to the same expert, allowing experts to preserve phase-specific expertise. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed PA-MoE.
summary_zh: 强化学习(RL)赋予了LLM智能体解决复杂任务的强大能力。然而，现有的强化学习方法通常使用\emph{单一}策略网络，导致\emph{简单性偏差}, 即简单任务占据了大部分参数并主导梯度更新，从而为复杂任务留下了不足的容量。一个可能的补救方法是在策略网络中采用混合专家(MoE)架构，因为MoE允许不同的参数（专家）专注于不同的任务，防止简单任务支配所有参数。然而，传统MoE的一个关键限制是其令牌级别的路由，即将每个令牌分配给专门的专家，这会将阶段一致的模式分割成分散的专家分配，从而破坏专家的专业化。在本文中，我们提出了\textbf{阶段感知混合专家(PA-MoE)}。它首先采用轻量级的\emph{阶段路由器}，该路由器直接从强化学习目标中学习潜在的阶段边界，而无需预定义阶段类别。然后，阶段路由器将时间上一致的分配分配给同一专家，从而使专家能够保持特定于阶段的专业知识。实验结果表明了我们提出的PA-MoE的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces Phase-Aware Mixture of Experts (PA-MoE) to address the simplicity bias in RL for LLM agents by employing a phase router that learns latent phase boundaries to allocate temporally consistent expert assignments, thereby improving expert specialization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了阶段感知混合专家（PA-MoE），通过一个阶段路由学习潜在的阶段边界，并分配时间上一致的专家任务，以解决RL在LLM agents应用中的简单性偏差，从而提高专家专业化。

title: Persona2Web: Benchmarking Personalized Web Agents for Contextual Reasoning with User History
summary: Large language models have advanced web agents, yet current agents lack personalization capabilities. Since users rarely specify every detail of their intent, practical web agents must be able to interpret ambiguous queries by inferring user preferences and contexts. To address this challenge, we present Persona2Web, the first benchmark for evaluating personalized web agents on the real open web, built upon the clarify-to-personalize principle, which requires agents to resolve ambiguity based on user history rather than relying on explicit instructions. Persona2Web consists of: (1) user histories that reveal preferences implicitly over long time spans, (2) ambiguous queries that require agents to infer implicit user preferences, and (3) a reasoning-aware evaluation framework that enables fine-grained assessment of personalization. We conduct extensive experiments across various agent architectures, backbone models, history access schemes, and queries with varying ambiguity levels, revealing key challenges in personalized web agent behavior. For reproducibility, our codes and datasets are publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Persona2Web-73E8.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型推动了Web代理的发展，然而当前的代理缺乏个性化能力。由于用户很少明确指定意图的每个细节，因此实用的Web代理必须能够通过推断用户偏好和上下文来解释模糊的查询。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 Persona2Web，这是首个在真实的开放Web上评估个性化Web代理的基准，它建立在“澄清以个性化”的原则之上，要求代理基于用户历史来解决歧义，而不是依赖于明确的指令。Persona2Web 包含：(1) 揭示长时间跨度内隐含偏好的用户历史；(2) 需要代理推断隐含用户偏好的模糊查询；以及 (3) 一种支持个性化细粒度评估的推理感知评估框架。我们针对各种代理架构、骨干模型、历史访问方案以及具有不同模糊程度的查询进行了广泛的实验，揭示了个性化Web代理行为中的关键挑战。为了可复现性，我们的代码和数据集已在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Persona2Web-73E8 公开提供。
tldr: The paper introduces Persona2Web, a new benchmark for evaluating personalized web agents that can infer user preferences from historical data to resolve ambiguous queries.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Persona2Web，这是一个新的基准测试，用于评估个性化Web代理，这些代理可以从历史数据中推断用户偏好，以解决模糊查询。

title: Fundamental Limits of Black-Box Safety Evaluation: Information-Theoretic and Computational Barriers from Latent Context Conditioning
summary: Black-box safety evaluation of AI systems assumes model behavior on test distributions reliably predicts deployment performance. We formalize and challenge this assumption through latent context-conditioned policies -- models whose outputs depend on unobserved internal variables that are rare under evaluation but prevalent under deployment. We establish fundamental limits showing that no black-box evaluator can reliably estimate deployment risk for such models. (1) Passive evaluation: For evaluators sampling i.i.d. from D_eval, we prove minimax lower bounds via Le Cam's method: any estimator incurs expected absolute error >= (5/24)*delta*L approximately 0.208*delta*L, where delta is trigger probability under deployment and L is the loss gap. (2) Adaptive evaluation: Using a hash-based trigger construction and Yao's minimax principle, worst-case error remains >= delta*L/16 even for fully adaptive querying when D_dep is supported over a sufficiently large domain; detection requires Theta(1/epsilon) queries. (3) Computational separation: Under trapdoor one-way function assumptions, deployment environments possessing privileged information can activate unsafe behaviors that any polynomial-time evaluator without the trapdoor cannot distinguish. For white-box probing, estimating deployment risk to accuracy epsilon_R requires O(1/(gamma^2 * epsilon_R^2)) samples, where gamma = alpha_0 + alpha_1 - 1 measures probe quality, and we provide explicit bias correction under probe error. Our results quantify when black-box testing is statistically underdetermined and provide explicit criteria for when additional safeguards -- architectural constraints, training-time guarantees, interpretability, and deployment monitoring -- are mathematically necessary for worst-case safety assurance.
summary_zh: 人工智能系统的黑盒安全评估假设模型在测试分布上的行为能够可靠地预测部署性能。我们形式化地提出了对这一假设的挑战，通过引入潜在上下文条件策略——模型输出依赖于未观察到的内部变量，这些变量在评估期间很少出现，但在部署期间很普遍。我们建立了基本限制，表明没有黑盒评估器能够可靠地估计此类模型的部署风险。(1) 被动评估：对于从 D_eval 中进行 i.i.d. 采样的评估器，我们通过 Le Cam 方法证明了 minimax 下界：任何估计器的预期绝对误差 >= (5/24)*delta*L 约为 0.208*delta*L，其中 delta 是部署下的触发概率，L 是损失差距。(2) 自适应评估：使用基于哈希的触发构造和姚氏 minimax 原理，即使对于充分自适应的查询，当 D_dep 在足够大的域上支持时，最坏情况下的误差仍然 >= delta*L/16；检测需要 Theta(1/epsilon) 次查询。(3) 计算分离：在单向陷门函数假设下，拥有特权信息的部署环境可以激活不安全行为，任何没有陷门的多项式时间评估器都无法区分这些行为。对于白盒探测，以精度 epsilon_R 估计部署风险需要 O(1/(gamma^2 * epsilon_R^2)) 个样本，其中 gamma = alpha_0 + alpha_1 - 1 度量探测质量，并且我们在探测误差下提供了显式偏差校正。我们的结果量化了黑盒测试在何时是统计上欠定的，并提供了明确的标准，说明在何时，额外的安全措施——架构约束、训练时保证、可解释性以及部署监控——对于最坏情况下的安全保障是数学上必需的。
tldr: This paper proves fundamental limitations of black-box safety evaluation for AI systems with latent context-conditioned policies, demonstrating information-theoretic and computational barriers to reliably estimating deployment risk.
tldr_zh: 该论文证明了具有潜在上下文条件策略的AI系统黑盒安全评估的根本局限性，展示了可靠估计部署风险的信息论和计算障碍。

title: A Unified Framework for Locality in Scalable MARL
summary: Scalable Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is fundamentally challenged by the curse of dimensionality. A common solution is to exploit locality, which hinges on an Exponential Decay Property (EDP) of the value function. However, existing conditions that guarantee the EDP are often conservative, as they are based on worst-case, environment-only bounds (e.g., supremums over actions) and fail to capture the regularizing effect of the policy itself. In this work, we establish that locality can also be a \emph{policy-dependent} phenomenon. Our central contribution is a novel decomposition of the policy-induced interdependence matrix, $H^π$, which decouples the environment's sensitivity to state ($E^{\mathrm{s}}$) and action ($E^{\mathrm{a}}$) from the policy's sensitivity to state ($Π(π)$). This decomposition reveals that locality can be induced by a smooth policy (small $Π(π)$) even when the environment is strongly action-coupled, exposing a fundamental locality-optimality tradeoff. We use this framework to derive a general spectral condition $ρ(E^{\mathrm{s}}+E^{\mathrm{a}}Π(π)) < 1$ for exponential decay, which is strictly tighter than prior norm-based conditions. Finally, we leverage this theory to analyze a provably-sound localized block-coordinate policy improvement framework with guarantees tied directly to this spectral radius.
summary_zh: 可扩展多智能体强化学习（MARL）从根本上受到维度诅咒的挑战。一种常见的解决方案是利用局部性，这依赖于价值函数的指数衰减性质（EDP）。然而，现有保证EDP的条件通常是保守的，因为它们基于最坏情况、仅环境的边界（例如，对动作的最高限），并且未能捕捉到策略本身的正则化效应。在这项工作中，我们确立局部性也可以是一种\emph{策略相关的}现象。我们的核心贡献是对策略诱导的互依赖矩阵 $H^π$ 的一种新颖分解，它将环境对状态 ($E^{\mathrm{s}}$) 和动作 ($E^{\mathrm{a}}$) 的敏感性与策略对状态的敏感性 ($Π(π)$) 解耦。这种分解揭示了，即使环境强动作耦合，局部性也可以通过平滑的策略（小的 $Π(π)$）来诱导，从而揭示了一个根本的局部性-最优性权衡。我们使用此框架推导出指数衰减的一般谱条件 $ρ(E^{\mathrm{s}}+E^{\mathrm{a}}Π(π)) < 1$，该条件严格优于先前的基于范数的条件。最后，我们利用这一理论来分析一个可证明合理的局部块坐标策略改进框架，并将其保证与该谱半径直接联系起来。
tldr: This paper presents a new framework for analyzing locality in scalable MARL by decoupling environment and policy sensitivities, leading to less conservative conditions for exponential decay of the value function and a provably-sound localized policy improvement algorithm.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于分析可扩展MARL中局部性的新框架，通过解耦环境和策略敏感性，从而为价值函数的指数衰减导出了更宽松的条件，并提出了一个可证明正确的局部策略改进算法。

title: LLM4Cov: Execution-Aware Agentic Learning for High-coverage Testbench Generation
summary: Execution-aware LLM agents offer a promising paradigm for learning from tool feedback, but such feedback is often expensive and slow to obtain, making online reinforcement learning (RL) impractical. High-coverage hardware verification exemplifies this challenge due to its reliance on industrial simulators and non-differentiable execution signals. We propose LLM4Cov, an offline agent-learning framework that models verification as memoryless state transitions guided by deterministic evaluators. Building on this formulation, we introduce execution-validated data curation, policy-aware agentic data synthesis, and worst-state-prioritized sampling to enable scalable learning under execution constraints. We further curate a reality-aligned benchmark adapted from an existing verification suite through a revised evaluation protocol. Using the proposed pipeline, a compact 4B-parameter model achieves 69.2% coverage pass rate under agentic evaluation, outperforming its teacher by 5.3% and demonstrating competitive performance against models an order of magnitude larger.
summary_zh: 执行感知的LLM智能体为从工具反馈中学习提供了一种有前景的范式，但这种反馈通常成本高昂且获取速度慢，使得在线强化学习（RL）变得不切实际。高覆盖率的硬件验证因其对工业仿真器和不可微执行信号的依赖而突显了这一挑战。我们提出LLM4Cov，一种离线智能体学习框架，该框架将验证建模为由确定性评估器引导的无记忆状态转换。在此基础上，我们引入了执行验证的数据管理、策略感知的智能体数据合成和最差状态优先采样，以在执行约束下实现可扩展的学习。我们还通过修订后的评估协议，从现有的验证套件中整理出一个与真实世界对齐的基准。使用所提出的流程，一个紧凑的40亿参数模型在智能体评估下实现了69.2%的覆盖率通过率，比它的教师模型高出5.3%，并展示了与规模大一个数量级的模型具有竞争力的性能。
tldr: The paper presents LLM4Cov, an offline agent-learning framework that utilizes LLMs to generate high-coverage testbenches for hardware verification, achieving competitive performance with smaller models compared to existing approaches.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了LLM4Cov，一个离线智能体学习框架，它利用大型语言模型为硬件验证生成高覆盖率的测试平台，与现有方法相比，以较小的模型实现了具有竞争力的性能。

title: Say It My Way: Exploring Control in Conversational Visual Question Answering with Blind Users
summary: Prompting and steering techniques are well established in general-purpose generative AI, yet assistive visual question answering (VQA) tools for blind users still follow rigid interaction patterns with limited opportunities for customization. User control can be helpful when system responses are misaligned with their goals and contexts, a gap that becomes especially consequential for blind users that may rely on these systems for access. We invite 11 blind users to customize their interactions with a real-world conversational VQA system. Drawing on 418 interactions, reflections, and post-study interviews, we analyze prompting-based techniques participants adopted, including those introduced in the study and those developed independently in real-world settings. VQA interactions were often lengthy: participants averaged 3 turns, sometimes up to 21, with input text typically tenfold shorter than the responses they heard. Built on state-of-the-art LLMs, the system lacked verbosity controls, was limited in estimating distance in space and time, relied on inaccessible image framing, and offered little to no camera guidance. We discuss how customization techniques such as prompt engineering can help participants work around these limitations. Alongside a new publicly available dataset, we offer insights for interaction design at both query and system levels.
summary_zh: 提示和引导技术在通用生成式人工智能中已得到充分应用，然而，面向盲人用户的辅助视觉问答（VQA）工具仍然遵循僵化的交互模式，定制机会有限。当系统响应与其目标和上下文不符时，用户控制可能会有所帮助，对于可能依赖这些系统进行访问的盲人用户而言，这一差距尤其重要。我们邀请了11位盲人用户来定制他们与真实场景下的对话式VQA系统的交互。基于418次交互、反思和事后访谈，我们分析了参与者采用的基于提示的技术，包括研究中引入的技术以及他们在真实场景中独立开发的技术。 VQA交互通常很冗长：参与者平均进行3轮对话，有时甚至高达21轮，输入文本通常比他们听到的回应短十倍。该系统基于最先进的大型语言模型（LLM），但缺乏冗余控制，在估计空间和时间上的距离方面存在局限性，依赖于难以访问的图像取景，并且几乎没有提供摄像头指导。我们讨论了诸如提示工程之类的定制技术如何帮助参与者解决这些限制。除了一个新的公开可用的数据集外，我们还为查询和系统级别的交互设计提供了见解。
tldr: This paper investigates how blind users customize interactions with conversational VQA systems using prompting techniques to overcome limitations in current systems, revealing insights for interaction design and providing a new dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了盲人用户如何通过提示技术自定义与会话式VQA系统的交互，以克服当前系统的局限性，揭示了交互设计的见解并提供了一个新的数据集。

title: Discovering Multiagent Learning Algorithms with Large Language Models
summary: Much of the advancement of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) in imperfect-information games has historically depended on manual iterative refinement of baselines. While foundational families like Counterfactual Regret Minimization (CFR) and Policy Space Response Oracles (PSRO) rest on solid theoretical ground, the design of their most effective variants often relies on human intuition to navigate a vast algorithmic design space. In this work, we propose the use of AlphaEvolve, an evolutionary coding agent powered by large language models, to automatically discover new multiagent learning algorithms. We demonstrate the generality of this framework by evolving novel variants for two distinct paradigms of game-theoretic learning. First, in the domain of iterative regret minimization, we evolve the logic governing regret accumulation and policy derivation, discovering a new algorithm, Volatility-Adaptive Discounted (VAD-)CFR. VAD-CFR employs novel, non-intuitive mechanisms-including volatility-sensitive discounting, consistency-enforced optimism, and a hard warm-start policy accumulation schedule-to outperform state-of-the-art baselines like Discounted Predictive CFR+. Second, in the regime of population based training algorithms, we evolve training-time and evaluation-time meta strategy solvers for PSRO, discovering a new variant, Smoothed Hybrid Optimistic Regret (SHOR-)PSRO. SHOR-PSRO introduces a hybrid meta-solver that linearly blends Optimistic Regret Matching with a smoothed, temperature-controlled distribution over best pure strategies. By dynamically annealing this blending factor and diversity bonuses during training, the algorithm automates the transition from population diversity to rigorous equilibrium finding, yielding superior empirical convergence compared to standard static meta-solvers.
summary_zh: 不完全信息博弈多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 的发展历来很大程度上依赖于基线的手动迭代优化。虽然反事实后悔最小化 (CFR) 和策略空间响应预言机 (PSRO) 等基础系列奠定在坚实的理论基础上，但其最有效变体的设计通常依赖于人类直觉来驾驭广阔的算法设计空间。在这项工作中，我们提出使用 AlphaEvolve，一种由大型语言模型驱动的进化编码智能体，来自动发现新的多智能体学习算法。我们通过为两种不同的博弈论学习范式进化出新的变体，证明了该框架的通用性。首先，在迭代后悔最小化领域，我们进化了控制后悔积累和策略推导的逻辑，发现了一种新的算法，即波动率自适应折扣 (VAD-)CFR。VAD-CFR 采用新颖的、非直观的机制——包括波动率敏感的折扣、一致性增强的乐观以及硬启动策略累积计划——来超越最先进的基线，如折扣预测 CFR+。其次，在基于种群的训练算法体系中，我们为 PSRO 进化了训练时和评估时的元策略求解器，发现了一种新的变体，即平滑混合乐观后悔 (SHOR-)PSRO。SHOR-PSRO 引入了一种混合元求解器，该求解器将乐观后悔匹配与最佳纯策略上的平滑、温度控制分布进行线性混合。通过在训练期间动态退火这种混合因子和多样性奖励，该算法自动实现从种群多样性到严格均衡寻找到过渡，与标准静态元求解器相比，产生卓越的经验收敛性。
tldr: The paper introduces AlphaEvolve, a large language model-powered evolutionary coding agent for automatically discovering new multiagent learning algorithms, demonstrating its effectiveness by evolving improved variants of CFR and PSRO.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 AlphaEvolve 的大型语言模型驱动的进化编码代理，用于自动发现新的多智能体学习算法，并通过进化 CFR 和 PSRO 的改进变体来证明其有效性。

title: Overseeing Agents Without Constant Oversight: Challenges and Opportunities
summary: To enable human oversight, agentic AI systems often provide a trace of reasoning and action steps. Designing traces to have an informative, but not overwhelming, level of detail remains a critical challenge. In three user studies on a Computer User Agent, we investigate the utility of basic action traces for verification, explore three alternatives via design probes, and test a novel interface's impact on error finding in question-answering tasks. As expected, we find that current practices are cumbersome, limiting their efficacy. Conversely, our proposed design reduced the time participants spent finding errors. However, although participants reported higher levels of confidence in their decisions, their final accuracy was not meaningfully improved. To this end, our study surfaces challenges for human verification of agentic systems, including managing built-in assumptions, users' subjective and changing correctness criteria, and the shortcomings, yet importance, of communicating the agent's process.
summary_zh: 为了实现人工监督，智能体AI系统通常会提供推理和行动步骤的轨迹。设计具有信息量但又不至于过于详细的轨迹仍然是一个关键挑战。我们在一个计算机用户代理上进行了三项用户研究，调查了基本行动轨迹对于验证的效用，通过设计探针探索了三种替代方案，并测试了一种新型界面对问答任务中错误查找的影响。正如预期的那样，我们发现目前的实践繁琐且效率有限。相反，我们提出的设计减少了参与者查找错误所花费的时间。然而，尽管参与者报告了对决策更高的信心水平，但他们的最终准确性并没有得到显著提高。为此，我们的研究揭示了智能体系统人工验证的挑战，包括管理内置假设、用户主观且不断变化正确性标准，以及沟通智能体过程的缺陷和重要性。
tldr: This paper investigates the effectiveness of different trace designs for human oversight of AI agents, finding that current practices are cumbersome and that proposed designs improve error finding time but not accuracy, highlighting key challenges for human verification.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了用于人工智能代理的人工监督的不同轨迹设计的有效性，发现当前的实践很麻烦，并且所提出的设计可以缩短查找错误的时间，但不能提高准确性，突出了人工验证的关键挑战。

title: HiVAE: Hierarchical Latent Variables for Scalable Theory of Mind
summary: Theory of mind (ToM) enables AI systems to infer agents' hidden goals and mental states, but existing approaches focus mainly on small human understandable gridworld spaces. We introduce HiVAE, a hierarchical variational architecture that scales ToM reasoning to realistic spatiotemporal domains. Inspired by the belief-desire-intention structure of human cognition, our three-level VAE hierarchy achieves substantial performance improvements on a 3,185-node campus navigation task. However, we identify a critical limitation: while our hierarchical structure improves prediction, learned latent representations lack explicit grounding to actual mental states. We propose self-supervised alignment strategies and present this work to solicit community feedback on grounding approaches.
summary_zh: 心智理论（ToM）使人工智能系统能够推断智能体的隐藏目标和心理状态，但现有方法主要集中于人类易于理解的小型网格世界空间。我们引入了HiVAE，一种分层变分架构，可以将心智理论推理扩展到现实的时空域。受到人类认知的信念-欲望-意图结构的启发，我们的三层VAE层级结构在包含3185个节点的校园导航任务上实现了显著的性能提升。然而，我们发现了一个关键的局限性：虽然我们的分层结构提高了预测能力，但学习到的潜在表征缺乏与实际心理状态的明确关联。我们提出了自监督对齐策略，并展示这项工作以征求社区对接地方法的反馈。
tldr: The paper introduces HiVAE, a hierarchical VAE for scaling Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning to complex environments, showing performance improvements on a campus navigation task, but identifies a grounding issue in latent representations and seeks community feedback on solutions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种分层VAE模型HiVAE，用于将心理理论(ToM)推理扩展到复杂环境，在校园导航任务中表现出性能提升，但同时指出了隐空间表征中存在无法与实际心理状态对齐的问题，并寻求社区对解决方案的反馈。

title: GraphThinker: Reinforcing Video Reasoning with Event Graph Thinking
summary: Video reasoning requires understanding the causal relationships between events in a video. However, such relationships are often implicit and costly to annotate manually. While existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often infer event relations through dense captions or video summaries for video reasoning, such modeling still lacks causal understanding. Without explicit causal structure modeling within and across video events, these models suffer from hallucinations during the video reasoning. In this work, we propose GraphThinker, a reinforcement finetuning-based method that constructs structural event-level scene graphs and enhances visual grounding to jointly reduce hallucinations in video reasoning. Specifically, we first employ an MLLM to construct an event-based video scene graph (EVSG) that explicitly models both intra- and inter-event relations, and incorporate these formed scene graphs into the MLLM as an intermediate thinking process. We also introduce a visual attention reward during reinforcement finetuning, which strengthens video grounding and further mitigates hallucinations. We evaluate GraphThinker on two datasets, RexTime and VidHalluc, where it shows superior ability to capture object and event relations with more precise event localization, reducing hallucinations in video reasoning compared to prior methods.
summary_zh: 视频推理需要理解视频中事件之间的因果关系。然而，这种关系通常是隐式的，并且手动标注的成本很高。尽管现有的多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）通常通过密集的字幕或视频摘要来推断事件关系以进行视频推理，但这种建模仍然缺乏因果理解。在没有明确的视频事件内部和事件之间因果结构建模的情况下，这些模型在视频推理过程中容易出现幻觉。在这项工作中，我们提出GraphThinker，一种基于强化微调的方法，它构建结构化的事件级场景图，并增强视觉定位，从而共同减少视频推理中的幻觉。具体而言，我们首先采用MLLM构建一个基于事件的视频场景图（EVSG），该图明确地建模了事件内部和事件之间的关系，并将这些形成的场景图作为中间的思考过程整合到MLLM中。我们还在强化微调过程中引入了视觉注意力奖励，这增强了视频定位并进一步减轻了幻觉。我们在RexTime和VidHalluc两个数据集上评估了GraphThinker，结果表明，与先前的方法相比，它具有更强的捕获对象和事件关系的能力，以及更精确的事件定位，从而减少了视频推理中的幻觉。
tldr: The paper introduces GraphThinker, a reinforcement learning-based method to construct event-level scene graphs and enhance visual grounding to reduce hallucinations in video reasoning using MLLMs.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GraphThinker，一种基于强化学习的方法，通过构建事件级别的场景图并增强视觉基础来减少MLLM在视频推理中的幻觉。

title: PredMapNet: Future and Historical Reasoning for Consistent Online HD Vectorized Map Construction
summary: High-definition (HD) maps are crucial to autonomous driving, providing structured representations of road elements to support navigation and planning. However, existing query-based methods often employ random query initialization and depend on implicit temporal modeling, which lead to temporal inconsistencies and instabilities during the construction of a global map. To overcome these challenges, we introduce a novel end-to-end framework for consistent online HD vectorized map construction, which jointly performs map instance tracking and short-term prediction. First, we propose a Semantic-Aware Query Generator that initializes queries with spatially aligned semantic masks to capture scene-level context globally. Next, we design a History Rasterized Map Memory to store fine-grained instance-level maps for each tracked instance, enabling explicit historical priors. A History-Map Guidance Module then integrates rasterized map information into track queries, improving temporal continuity. Finally, we propose a Short-Term Future Guidance module to forecast the immediate motion of map instances based on the stored history trajectories. These predicted future locations serve as hints for tracked instances to further avoid implausible predictions and keep temporal consistency. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes and Argoverse2 datasets demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods with good efficiency.
summary_zh: 高清(HD)地图对于自动驾驶至关重要，它提供道路元素的结构化表示以支持导航和规划。然而，现有的基于查询的方法通常采用随机查询初始化，并且依赖于隐式的时序建模，这导致了全局地图构建过程中的时序不一致性和不稳定性。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了一种用于一致性在线HD矢量化地图构建的新型端到端框架，该框架联合执行地图实例跟踪和短期预测。首先，我们提出了一种语义感知查询生成器，它使用空间对齐的语义掩码初始化查询，以全局捕获场景级的上下文。接下来，我们设计了一个历史栅格化地图内存来存储每个被跟踪实例的细粒度实例级地图，从而实现显式的历史先验。然后，一个历史地图引导模块将栅格化的地图信息集成到跟踪查询中，从而提高了时间连续性。最后，我们提出了一个短期未来引导模块，根据存储的历史轨迹预测地图实例的即时运动。这些预测的未来位置作为跟踪实例的提示，进一步避免不合理的预测并保持时间一致性。在nuScenes和Argoverse2数据集上的大量实验表明，我们提出的方法以良好的效率优于最先进(SOTA)的方法。
tldr: The paper introduces PredMapNet, a novel framework for consistent online HD vectorized map construction using semantic-aware query generation, historical map memory, and short-term future prediction, outperforming SOTA methods on nuScenes and Argoverse2.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PredMapNet，一种用于一致的在线高清矢量地图构建的新框架，它使用语义感知查询生成、历史地图记忆和短期未来预测，在nuScenes和Argoverse2数据集上优于最先进的方法。

title: WS-GRPO: Weakly-Supervised Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Rollout-Efficient Reasoning
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is effective for training language models on complex reasoning. However, since the objective is defined relative to a group of sampled trajectories, extended deliberation can create more chances to realize relative gains, leading to inefficient reasoning and overthinking, and complicating the trade-off between correctness and rollout efficiency. Controlling this behavior is difficult in practice, considering (i) Length penalties are hard to calibrate because longer rollouts may reflect harder problems that require longer reasoning, penalizing tokens risks truncating useful reasoning along with redundant continuation; and (ii) supervision that directly indicates when to continue or stop is typically unavailable beyond final answer correctness. We propose Weakly Supervised GRPO (WS-GRPO), which improves rollout efficiency by converting terminal rewards into correctness-aware guidance over partial trajectories. Unlike global length penalties that are hard to calibrate, WS-GRPO trains a preference model from outcome-only correctness to produce prefix-level signals that indicate when additional continuation is beneficial. Thus, WS-GRPO supplies outcome-derived continue/stop guidance, reducing redundant deliberation while maintaining accuracy. We provide theoretical results and empirically show on reasoning benchmarks that WS-GRPO substantially reduces rollout length while remaining competitive with GRPO baselines.
summary_zh: 群组相对策略优化(GRPO)在训练语言模型进行复杂推理方面是有效的。然而，由于其目标是相对于一组采样的轨迹定义的，因此更长时间的推敲可能产生更多的机会来实现相对收益，从而导致推理效率低下和过度思考，并使正确性和推出效率之间的权衡变得复杂。在实践中控制这种行为是困难的，考虑到：(i) 长度惩罚很难校准，因为更长的推出可能反映了需要更长时间推理的更难问题，惩罚 token 可能会截断有用的推理以及冗余的延续；以及 (ii) 指示何时继续或停止的直接监督通常在最终答案正确性之外是不可用的。我们提出了弱监督 GRPO (WS-GRPO)，通过将终端奖励转换为对部分轨迹的正确性感知指导，来提高推出效率。与难以校准的全局长度惩罚不同，WS-GRPO从结果导向的正确性训练一个偏好模型，以产生前缀级别的信号，指示何时额外的延续是有益的。因此，WS-GRPO提供了结果导出的继续/停止指导，减少了冗余的推敲，同时保持了准确性。我们提供了理论结果，并在推理基准上进行了实证研究，表明 WS-GRPO 在保持与 GRPO 基线竞争力的同时，显着减少了推出长度。
tldr: The paper introduces WS-GRPO, a weakly-supervised improvement on Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for training LMs on reasoning tasks. It addresses the rollout inefficiency of GRPO by using correctness-aware guidance to reduce redundant deliberation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了WS-GRPO，这是对用于训练语言模型进行推理的Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 的一种弱监督改进。它通过使用感知正确性的指导来减少冗余思考，从而解决了GRPO的rollout效率问题。

title: Multi-Agent Lipschitz Bandits
summary: We study the decentralized multi-player stochastic bandit problem over a continuous, Lipschitz-structured action space where hard collisions yield zero reward. Our objective is to design a communication-free policy that maximizes collective reward, with coordination costs that are independent of the time horizon $T$. We propose a modular protocol that first solves the multi-agent coordination problem -- identifying and seating players on distinct high-value regions via a novel maxima-directed search -- and then decouples the problem into $N$ independent single-player Lipschitz bandits. We establish a near-optimal regret bound of $\tilde{O}(T^{(d+1)/(d+2)})$ plus a $T$-independent coordination cost, matching the single-player rate. To our knowledge, this is the first framework providing such guarantees, and it extends to general distance-threshold collision models.
summary_zh: 我们研究了连续、满足 Lipschitz 结构动作空间上的去中心化多玩家随机bandit问题，其中硬碰撞会导致零奖励。我们的目标是设计一种无通信策略，以最大化集体奖励，并且协调成本与时间范围 $T$ 无关。我们提出了一种模块化协议，该协议首先解决多智能体协调问题——通过一种新颖的极大值导向搜索方法识别并引导玩家位于不同的高价值区域——然后将问题解耦为 $N$ 个独立的单玩家 Lipschitz bandit 问题。我们建立了接近最优的遗憾界 $\tilde{O}(T^{(d+1)/(d+2)})$ 加上一个与 $T$ 无关的协调成本，这与单玩家速率匹配。据我们所知，这是第一个提供此类保证的框架，并且可以扩展到一般的距离阈值碰撞模型。
tldr: This paper presents a communication-free algorithm for decentralized multi-player stochastic Lipschitz bandits, guaranteeing near-optimal regret with a coordination cost independent of the time horizon. It achieves this by first coordinating players and then solving independent single-player bandit problems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需通信的去中心化多智能体随机Lipschitz bandit算法，保证了近乎最优的后悔值，且协调成本与时间范围无关。该算法首先协调智能体，然后解决独立的单智能体bandit问题。

title: RA-Nav: A Risk-Aware Navigation System Based on Semantic Segmentation for Aerial Robots in Unpredictable Environments
summary: Existing aerial robot navigation systems typically plan paths around static and dynamic obstacles, but fail to adapt when a static obstacle suddenly moves. Integrating environmental semantic awareness enables estimation of potential risks posed by suddenly moving obstacles. In this paper, we propose RA- Nav, a risk-aware navigation framework based on semantic segmentation. A lightweight multi-scale semantic segmentation network identifies obstacle categories in real time. These obstacles are further classified into three types: stationary, temporarily static, and dynamic. For each type, corresponding risk estimation functions are designed to enable real-time risk prediction, based on which a complete local risk map is constructed. Based on this map, the risk-informed path search algorithm is designed to guarantee planning that balances path efficiency and safety. Trajectory optimization is then applied to generate trajectories that are safe, smooth, and dynamically feasible. Comparative simulations demonstrate that RA-Nav achieves higher success rates than baselines in sudden obstacle state transition scenarios. Its effectiveness is further validated in simulations using real- world data.
summary_zh: 现有无人机导航系统通常围绕静态和动态障碍物进行路径规划，但当静态障碍物突然移动时无法适应。集成环境语义感知能力可以估计突然移动的障碍物带来的潜在风险。本文提出了一种基于语义分割的风险感知导航框架RA-Nav。一个轻量级的多尺度语义分割网络可以实时识别障碍物类别。这些障碍物进一步被分为三类：静止的、临时静止的和动态的。针对每一种类型，设计了相应的风险估计函数以实现实时风险预测，并在此基础上构建完整的局部风险地图。基于该地图，设计了风险知情的路径搜索算法，以保证规划能够平衡路径效率和安全。然后应用轨迹优化来生成安全、平滑和动态可行的轨迹。对比仿真结果表明，在突发的障碍物状态转换场景中，RA-Nav比基线方法实现了更高的成功率。其有效性在使用了真实世界数据的仿真中得到了进一步验证。
tldr: RA-Nav is a risk-aware aerial robot navigation system that uses semantic segmentation to classify obstacles and predict risks, enabling safer and more efficient path planning in dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: RA-Nav 是一种风险感知的无人机导航系统，它利用语义分割来分类障碍物并预测风险，从而在动态环境中实现更安全、更高效的路径规划。

title: NRGS-SLAM: Monocular Non-Rigid SLAM for Endoscopy via Deformation-Aware 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Visual simultaneous localization and mapping (V-SLAM) is a fundamental capability for autonomous perception and navigation. However, endoscopic scenes violate the rigidity assumption due to persistent soft-tissue deformations, creating a strong coupling ambiguity between camera ego-motion and intrinsic deformation. Although recent monocular non-rigid SLAM methods have made notable progress, they often lack effective decoupling mechanisms and rely on sparse or low-fidelity scene representations, which leads to tracking drift and limited reconstruction quality. To address these limitations, we propose NRGS-SLAM, a monocular non-rigid SLAM system for endoscopy based on 3D Gaussian Splatting. To resolve the coupling ambiguity, we introduce a deformation-aware 3D Gaussian map that augments each Gaussian primitive with a learnable deformation probability, optimized via a Bayesian self-supervision strategy without requiring external non-rigidity labels. Building on this representation, we design a deformable tracking module that performs robust coarse-to-fine pose estimation by prioritizing low-deformation regions, followed by efficient per-frame deformation updates. A carefully designed deformable mapping module progressively expands and refines the map, balancing representational capacity and computational efficiency. In addition, a unified robust geometric loss incorporates external geometric priors to mitigate the inherent ill-posedness of monocular non-rigid SLAM. Extensive experiments on multiple public endoscopic datasets demonstrate that NRGS-SLAM achieves more accurate camera pose estimation (up to 50\% reduction in RMSE) and higher-quality photo-realistic reconstructions than state-of-the-art methods. Comprehensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of our key design choices. Source code will be publicly available upon paper acceptance.
summary_zh: 视觉同步定位与地图构建 (V-SLAM) 是自主感知和导航的一项基本能力。然而，由于持续的软组织变形，内窥镜场景违反了刚性假设，从而在相机自身运动和内在变形之间产生了强烈的耦合模糊性。尽管最近的单目非刚性 SLAM 方法取得了显著进展，但它们通常缺乏有效的解耦机制，并且依赖于稀疏或低保真度的场景表示，这导致跟踪漂移和有限的重建质量。为了解决这些限制，我们提出 NRGS-SLAM，一种基于 3D 高斯溅射的内窥镜单目非刚性 SLAM 系统。为了消除耦合模糊性，我们引入了一种形变感知 3D 高斯地图, 该地图通过可学习的形变概率增强每个高斯基元，并使用贝叶斯自监督策略进行优化，无需外部非刚性标签。基于这种表示，我们设计了一个可变形跟踪模块，通过优先考虑低形变区域来执行稳健的由粗到精的姿态估计，然后进行高效的逐帧形变更新。一个精心设计可变形地图构建模块逐步扩展和细化地图，从而平衡了表示能力和计算效率。此外，统一的鲁棒几何损失结合了外部几何先验，以减轻单目非刚性 SLAM 固有的不适定性。在多个公共内窥镜数据集上进行的大量实验表明，NRGS-SLAM 比最先进的方法实现了更准确的相机姿态估计（RMSE 最高减少 50%）和更高质量的照片级真实感重建。全面的消融研究进一步验证了我们关键设计选择的有效性。源代码将在论文被接收后公开。
tldr: The paper introduces NRGS-SLAM, a novel monocular non-rigid SLAM system for endoscopy that uses deformation-aware 3D Gaussian splatting and Bayesian self-supervision to improve pose estimation and reconstruction quality in deformable environments, demonstrating significant improvements over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出NRGS-SLAM，一种新颖的内窥镜单目非刚性SLAM系统，该系统利用形变感知的3D高斯溅射和贝叶斯自监督来提高形变环境中的姿态估计和重建质量，与现有方法相比有了显著改进。

title: 3D Scene Rendering with Multimodal Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D scene reconstruction and rendering are core tasks in computer vision, with applications spanning industrial monitoring, robotics, and autonomous driving. Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (GS) and its variants have achieved impressive rendering fidelity while maintaining high computational and memory efficiency. However, conventional vision-based GS pipelines typically rely on a sufficient number of camera views to initialize the Gaussian primitives and train their parameters, typically incurring additional processing cost during initialization while falling short in conditions where visual cues are unreliable, such as adverse weather, low illumination, or partial occlusions. To cope with these challenges, and motivated by the robustness of radio-frequency (RF) signals to weather, lighting, and occlusions, we introduce a multimodal framework that integrates RF sensing, such as automotive radar, with GS-based rendering as a more efficient and robust alternative to vision-only GS rendering. The proposed approach enables efficient depth prediction from only sparse RF-based depth measurements, yielding a high-quality 3D point cloud for initializing Gaussian functions across diverse GS architectures. Numerical tests demonstrate the merits of judiciously incorporating RF sensing into GS pipelines, achieving high-fidelity 3D scene rendering driven by RF-informed structural accuracy.
summary_zh: 三维场景重建和渲染是计算机视觉中的核心任务，其应用涵盖工业监控、机器人和自动驾驶。三维高斯溅射(GS)及其变体的最新进展在保持高计算和内存效率的同时，实现了令人印象深刻的渲染保真度。然而，传统的基于视觉的GS流程通常依赖于足够数量的相机视图来初始化高斯基元并训练其参数，这通常会在初始化期间产生额外的处理成本，并且在视觉线索不可靠的情况下（例如恶劣天气、低照度或部分遮挡）表现不佳。为了应对这些挑战，并受到射频(RF)信号对天气、光照和遮挡的鲁棒性的启发，我们引入了一种多模态框架，该框架将RF传感（如车载雷达）与基于GS的渲染集成在一起，作为一种更高效、更稳健的视觉GS渲染替代方案。所提出的方法能够仅从稀疏的基于RF的深度测量中进行高效的深度预测，从而产生高质量的3D点云，用于初始化各种GS架构中的高斯函数。数值测试表明，在GS流程中明智地整合RF传感具有优势，能够实现由RF信息结构精度驱动的高保真度3D场景渲染。
tldr: This paper introduces a multimodal 3D scene rendering framework that integrates RF sensing (automotive radar) with 3D Gaussian Splatting to improve robustness and efficiency, especially in challenging visual conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多模态3D场景渲染框架，该框架将射频感知（汽车雷达）与3D高斯溅射相结合，以提高鲁棒性和效率，尤其是在具有挑战性的视觉条件下。

title: Sound of Touch: Active Acoustic Tactile Sensing via String Vibrations
summary: Distributed tactile sensing remains difficult to scale over large areas: dense sensor arrays increase wiring, cost, and fragility, while many alternatives provide limited coverage or miss fast interaction dynamics. We present Sound of Touch, an active acoustic tactile-sensing methodology that uses vibrating tensioned strings as sensing elements. The string is continuously excited electromagnetically, and a small number of pickups (contact microphones) observe spectral changes induced by contact. From short-duration audio signals, our system estimates contact location and normal force, and detects slip. To guide design and interpret the sensing mechanism, we derive a physics-based string-vibration simulator that predicts how contact position and force shift vibration modes. Experiments demonstrate millimeter-scale localization, reliable force estimation, and real-time slip detection. Our contributions are: (i) a lightweight, scalable string-based tactile sensing hardware concept for instrumenting extended robot surfaces; (ii) a physics-grounded simulation and analysis tool for contact-induced spectral shifts; and (iii) a real-time inference pipeline that maps vibration measurements to contact state.
summary_zh: 分布式触觉传感在大面积应用中仍然面临扩展难题：密集传感器阵列会增加布线、成本和脆弱性，而许多替代方案提供的覆盖范围有限或遗漏快速互动动态。我们提出了一种名为“触碰之声”的主动声学触觉传感方法，它使用振动的张紧弦作为传感元件。弦被持续地电磁激发，少量拾音器（接触式麦克风）观察由接触引起的频谱变化。从短时音频信号中，我们的系统可估计接触位置和法向力，并检测滑移。为了指导设计和解释传感机制，我们推导了一种基于物理的弦振动模拟器，该模拟器可以预测接触位置和力如何改变振动模式。实验表明，该系统可以实现毫米级定位、可靠的力估计和实时滑移检测。我们的贡献包括：（i）一种轻量级、可扩展的基于弦的触觉传感硬件概念，用于装配扩展的机器人表面；（ii）一种基于物理的仿真和分析工具，用于研究接触引起的频谱偏移；以及（iii）一种将振动测量映射到接触状态的实时推理流程。
tldr: This paper introduces Sound of Touch, a novel tactile sensing method using vibrating strings to estimate contact location, force, and slip detection, demonstrating millimeter-scale localization and real-time performance.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新型触觉传感方法：Sound of Touch，它使用振动弦来估计接触位置、作用力和滑移检测，并展示了毫米级的定位和实时性能。

title: NeuDiff Agent: A Governed AI Workflow for Single-Crystal Neutron Crystallography
summary: Large-scale facilities increasingly face analysis and reporting latency as the limiting step in scientific throughput, particularly for structurally and magnetically complex samples that require iterative reduction, integration, refinement, and validation. To improve time-to-result and analysis efficiency, NeuDiff Agent is introduced as a governed, tool-using AI workflow for TOPAZ at the Spallation Neutron Source that takes instrument data products through reduction, integration, refinement, and validation to a validated crystal structure and a publication-ready CIF. NeuDiff Agent executes this established pipeline under explicit governance by restricting actions to allowlisted tools, enforcing fail-closed verification gates at key workflow boundaries, and capturing complete provenance for inspection, auditing, and controlled replay. Performance is assessed using a fixed prompt protocol and repeated end-to-end runs with two large language model backends, with user and machine time partitioned and intervention burden and recovery behaviors quantified under gating. In a reference-case benchmark, NeuDiff Agent reduces wall time from 435 minutes (manual) to 86.5(4.7) to 94.4(3.5) minutes (4.6-5.0x faster) while producing a validated CIF with no checkCIF level A or B alerts. These results establish a practical route to deploy agentic AI in facility crystallography while preserving traceability and publication-facing validation requirements.
summary_zh: 大型设施日益面临分析和报告延迟，这成为科学吞吐量的限制步骤，特别是对于需要迭代进行规约、集成、精修和验证的结构和磁性复杂的样品。为了提高结果获取时间和分析效率，我们引入了NeuDiff Agent，作为散裂中子源TOPAZ的受控、工具使用的AI工作流，该工作流将仪器数据产品通过规约、集成、精修和验证，最终得到一个经过验证的晶体结构和一个可用于发表的CIF文件。NeuDiff Agent在显式治理下执行这个既定的流程，通过将操作限制在允许列表中的工具内，在关键工作流边界强制执行故障关闭验证门，并捕获完整的溯源信息以供检查、审计和受控重放。我们使用固定的提示协议和具有两个大型语言模型后端的重复端到端运行评估了其性能，对用户和机器时间进行了划分，并在门控下量化了干预负担和恢复行为。在一个参考案例基准测试中，NeuDiff Agent将实际运行时间从435分钟（手动）减少到86.5(4.7)至94.4(3.5)分钟（速度提高4.6-5.0倍），同时生成一个经过验证的CIF文件，且没有checkCIF的A或B级警报。这些结果确立了一条在设施晶体学中部署代理式AI的实用途径，同时保留了可追溯性和面向发表的验证要求。
tldr: The paper introduces NeuDiff Agent, an AI workflow using LLMs for automated single-crystal neutron crystallography, significantly reducing processing time while maintaining validation standards and provenance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了NeuDiff Agent，一个利用大型语言模型（LLM）的自动化单晶中子晶体学AI工作流程，在保持验证标准和溯源的同时，显著缩短了处理时间。

title: Policy Compiler for Secure Agentic Systems
summary:
LLM-based agents are increasingly being deployed in contexts requiring complex authorization policies: customer service protocols, approval workflows, data access restrictions, and regulatory compliance. Embedding these policies in prompts provides no enforcement guarantees. We present PCAS, a Policy Compiler for Agentic Systems that provides deterministic policy enforcement.
  Enforcing such policies requires tracking information flow across agents, which linear message histories cannot capture. Instead, PCAS models the agentic system state as a dependency graph capturing causal relationships among events such as tool calls, tool results, and messages. Policies are expressed in a Datalog-derived language, as declarative rules that account for transitive information flow and cross-agent provenance. A reference monitor intercepts all actions and blocks violations before execution, providing deterministic enforcement independent of model reasoning.
  PCAS takes an existing agent implementation and a policy specification, and compiles them into an instrumented system that is policy-compliant by construction, with no security-specific restructuring required. We evaluate PCAS on three case studies: information flow policies for prompt injection defense, approval workflows in a multi-agent pharmacovigilance system, and organizational policies for customer service. On customer service tasks, PCAS improves policy compliance from 48% to 93% across frontier models, with zero policy violations in instrumented runs.
summary_zh:
基于LLM的智能体正越来越多地部署在需要复杂授权策略的场景中：客户服务协议、审批工作流、数据访问限制以及法规遵从。将这些策略嵌入提示词无法保证强制执行。我们提出了PCAS，一种用于智能体系统的策略编译器，其可提供确定性的策略执行。

  执行此类策略需要跟踪跨智能体的信息流动，而线性消息历史无法捕获这些信息。作为替代，PCAS将智能体系统状态建模为依赖图，该图捕获事件之间的因果关系，例如工具调用、工具结果和消息。策略使用一种源于Datalog的语言表达，作为声明式规则，这些规则考虑了传递信息流和跨智能体的溯源。参考监视器拦截所有行动，并在执行之前阻止违规行为，从而提供独立于模型推理的确定性执行。

  PCAS接受现有的智能体实现和策略规范，并将它们编译成一个根据构造就符合策略的工具化系统，无需进行任何针对安全性的重组。我们通过三个案例研究来评估PCAS：用于提示注入防御的信息流策略、多智能体药物警戒系统中的审批工作流，以及客户服务的组织策略。在客户服务任务中，PCAS将策略遵从性从前沿模型的48%提高到93%，并且在工具化运行中没有出现策略违规。
tldr: The paper introduces PCAS, a system that compiles authorization policies into agentic systems to ensure deterministic policy enforcement by modeling agent interactions as dependency graphs and blocking violations before execution, improving compliance significantly.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为PCAS 的系统，通过将授权策略编译到基于LLM的智能体系统中，来确保策略的确定性执行。PCAS通过将智能体交互建模为依赖关系图，并在执行前阻止违规行为，从而显著提高了策略的合规性。

title: Attachment Anchors: A Novel Framework for Laparoscopic Grasping Point Prediction in Colorectal Surgery
summary: Accurate grasping point prediction is a key challenge for autonomous tissue manipulation in minimally invasive surgery, particularly in complex and variable procedures such as colorectal interventions. Due to their complexity and prolonged duration, colorectal procedures have been underrepresented in current research. At the same time, they pose a particularly interesting learning environment due to repetitive tissue manipulation, making them a promising entry point for autonomous, machine learning-driven support. Therefore, in this work, we introduce attachment anchors, a structured representation that encodes the local geometric and mechanical relationships between tissue and its anatomical attachments in colorectal surgery. This representation reduces uncertainty in grasping point prediction by normalizing surgical scenes into a consistent local reference frame. We demonstrate that attachment anchors can be predicted from laparoscopic images and incorporated into a grasping framework based on machine learning. Experiments on a dataset of 90 colorectal surgeries demonstrate that attachment anchors improve grasping point prediction compared to image-only baselines. There are particularly strong gains in out-of-distribution settings, including unseen procedures and operating surgeons. These results suggest that attachment anchors are an effective intermediate representation for learning-based tissue manipulation in colorectal surgery.
summary_zh: 在微创手术中，精确的抓取点预测是自主组织操作的关键挑战，尤其是在诸如结直肠干预等复杂且多变的程序中。由于其复杂性和持续时间较长，结直肠手术在目前的研究中代表性不足。与此同时，由于重复的组织操作，它们构成了一个特别有趣的学习环境，使其成为自主、机器学习驱动支持的有希望的切入点。因此，在这项工作中，我们引入了附着锚点，这是一种结构化表示，它编码了结直肠手术中组织与其解剖附着点之间的局部几何和力学关系。这种表示通过将手术场景标准化为一致的局部参考系，从而降低了抓取点预测的不确定性。我们证明了附着锚点可以从腹腔镜图像中预测出来，并融入到基于机器学习的抓取框架中。在包含 90 例结直肠手术的数据集上进行的实验表明，与仅使用图像的基线方法相比，附着锚点提高了抓取点预测的准确性。在分布外设置中，包括未见过的手术和操作外科医生，增益尤为显著。这些结果表明，附着锚点是基于学习的结直肠手术中组织操作的有效中间表示。
tldr: The paper introduces "attachment anchors," a novel representation for laparoscopic images that encodes tissue relationships in colorectal surgery, leading to improved grasping point prediction, especially in out-of-distribution settings.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为“附着锚”的新型腹腔镜图像表示方法，该方法编码了结直肠手术中的组织关系，从而改进了抓取点预测，尤其是在分布外环境中。

title: HiMAP: History-aware Map-occupancy Prediction with Fallback
summary: Accurate motion forecasting is critical for autonomous driving, yet most predictors rely on multi-object tracking (MOT) with identity association, assuming that objects are correctly and continuously tracked. When tracking fails due to, e.g., occlusion, identity switches, or missed detections, prediction quality degrades and safety risks increase. We present \textbf{HiMAP}, a tracking-free, trajectory prediction framework that remains reliable under MOT failures. HiMAP converts past detections into spatiotemporally invariant historical occupancy maps and introduces a historical query module that conditions on the current agent state to iteratively retrieve agent-specific history from unlabeled occupancy representations. The retrieved history is summarized by a temporal map embedding and, together with the final query and map context, drives a DETR-style decoder to produce multi-modal future trajectories. This design lifts identity reliance, supports streaming inference via reusable encodings, and serves as a robust fallback when tracking is unavailable. On Argoverse~2, HiMAP achieves performance comparable to tracking-based methods while operating without IDs, and it substantially outperforms strong baselines in the no-tracking setting, yielding relative gains of 11\% in FDE, 12\% in ADE, and a 4\% reduction in MR over a fine-tuned QCNet. Beyond aggregate metrics, HiMAP delivers stable forecasts for all agents simultaneously without waiting for tracking to recover, highlighting its practical value for safety-critical autonomy. The code is available under: https://github.com/XuYiMing83/HiMAP.
summary_zh: 精确的运动预测对于自动驾驶至关重要，但大多数预测器依赖于带身份关联的多目标跟踪（MOT），假设目标能够被正确且持续地跟踪。当由于遮挡、身份切换或漏检等原因导致跟踪失败时，预测质量会下降，安全风险也会增加。我们提出了 \textbf{HiMAP}，一个无需跟踪的轨迹预测框架，在 MOT 失败的情况下仍能保持可靠性。 HiMAP 将过去的检测转换为时空不变的历史占用地图，并引入一个历史查询模块，该模块以当前智能体状态为条件，从无标签的占用表示中迭代检索智能体特定的历史信息。检索到的历史信息通过时间地图嵌入进行总结，并与最终查询和地图上下文一起，驱动一个 DETR 风格的解码器生成多模态的未来轨迹。这种设计消除了对身份的依赖，支持通过可重用编码进行流式推理，并在无法进行跟踪时作为一种稳健的后备方案。在 Argoverse~2 数据集上，HiMAP 在没有身份信息的情况下实现了与基于跟踪的方法相当的性能，并且在无跟踪的设置下明显优于强大的基线，在 FDE 上实现了 11% 的相对增益，在 ADE 上实现了 12% 的相对增益，以及在 MR 上相对于微调后的 QCNet 降低了 4%。除了汇总指标外，HiMAP 能够同时为所有智能体提供稳定的预测，而无需等待跟踪恢复，突出了其在安全攸关的自动驾驶方面的实用价值。代码可在以下地址获取：https://github.com/XuYiMing83/HiMAP。
tldr: HiMAP is a tracking-free trajectory prediction framework that uses historical occupancy maps to achieve comparable performance to tracking-based methods, especially when tracking fails, demonstrating practical value for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: HiMAP是一个无需跟踪的轨迹预测框架，它使用历史占用地图实现了与基于跟踪的方法相当的性能，尤其是在跟踪失败时，展示了对自动驾驶的实用价值。

title: PartRAG: Retrieval-Augmented Part-Level 3D Generation and Editing
summary: Single-image 3D generation with part-level structure remains challenging: learned priors struggle to cover the long tail of part geometries and maintain multi-view consistency, and existing systems provide limited support for precise, localized edits. We present PartRAG, a retrieval-augmented framework that integrates an external part database with a diffusion transformer to couple generation with an editable representation. To overcome the first challenge, we introduce a Hierarchical Contrastive Retrieval module that aligns dense image patches with 3D part latents at both part and object granularity, retrieving from a curated bank of 1,236 part-annotated assets to inject diverse, physically plausible exemplars into denoising. To overcome the second challenge, we add a masked, part-level editor that operates in a shared canonical space, enabling swaps, attribute refinements, and compositional updates without regenerating the whole object while preserving non-target parts and multi-view consistency. PartRAG achieves competitive results on Objaverse, ShapeNet, and ABO-reducing Chamfer Distance from 0.1726 to 0.1528 and raising F-Score from 0.7472 to 0.844 on Objaverse-with inference of 38s and interactive edits in 5-8s. Qualitatively, PartRAG produces sharper part boundaries, better thin-structure fidelity, and robust behavior on articulated objects. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/PartRAG. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/PartRAG.
summary_zh: 利用部件级结构进行单图像三维生成仍然面临挑战：学习到的先验难以覆盖部件几何形状的长尾分布，并且难以维持多视角一致性；现有的系统对精准的局部编辑支持不足。我们提出了 PartRAG，一个检索增强框架，该框架将外部部件数据库与扩散Transformer相结合，从而将生成与可编辑的表示形式耦合。为了克服第一个挑战，我们引入了分层对比检索模块，该模块在部件和对象粒度上，将密集的图像块与三维部件潜在空间对齐，从一个包含1236个部件标注资产的精心整理库中进行检索，以将多样化的、物理上合理的范例注入到去噪过程中。为了克服第二个挑战，我们增加了一个屏蔽的、部件级编辑器，该编辑器在共享的规范空间中运行，从而能够在不重新生成整个对象的情况下进行交换、属性细化和组合更新，同时保留非目标部件和多视角一致性。PartRAG 在 Objaverse、ShapeNet 和 ABO 上取得了有竞争力的结果，在 Objaverse 上将 Chamfer 距离从 0.1726 降低到 0.1528，并将 F-Score 从 0.7472 提高到 0.844，推理时间为 38 秒，交互式编辑在 5-8 秒内完成。在质量方面，PartRAG 能够产生更清晰的部件边界、更好的细结构保真度，以及在铰接对象上表现出稳健的行为。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/PartRAG。网站：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/PartRAG。
tldr: PartRAG is a retrieval-augmented 3D generation framework that uses a part database and diffusion transformer to generate and edit 3D objects from single images with improved part fidelity and editing capabilities.
tldr_zh: PartRAG是一个检索增强的3D生成框架，它使用部件数据库和扩散Transformer从单张图像生成和编辑3D对象，提高了部件保真度和编辑能力。

title: StereoAdapter-2: Globally Structure-Consistent Underwater Stereo Depth Estimation
summary: Stereo depth estimation is fundamental to underwater robotic perception, yet suffers from severe domain shifts caused by wavelength-dependent light attenuation, scattering, and refraction. Recent approaches leverage monocular foundation models with GRU-based iterative refinement for underwater adaptation; however, the sequential gating and local convolutional kernels in GRUs necessitate multiple iterations for long-range disparity propagation, limiting performance in large-disparity and textureless underwater regions.
