In this paper, we propose StereoAdapter-2, which replaces the conventional ConvGRU updater with a novel ConvSS2D operator based on selective state space models. The proposed operator employs a four-directional scanning strategy that naturally aligns with epipolar geometry while capturing vertical structural consistency, enabling efficient long-range spatial propagation within a single update step at linear computational complexity. Furthermore, we construct UW-StereoDepth-80K, a large-scale synthetic underwater stereo dataset featuring diverse baselines, attenuation coefficients, and scattering parameters through a two-stage generative pipeline combining semantic-aware style transfer and geometry-consistent novel view synthesis. Combined with dynamic LoRA adaptation inherited from StereoAdapter, our framework achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on underwater benchmarks with 17% improvement on TartanAir-UW and 7.2% improvment on SQUID, with real-world validation on the BlueROV2 platform demonstrates the robustness of our approach. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/StereoAdapter-2. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/StereoAdapter-2.
summary_zh: 水下机器人感知的基础是立体深度估计，但它受到波长依赖的光衰减、散射和折射引起的严重领域迁移的影响。最近的方法利用单目基础模型结合基于GRU的迭代细化来进行水下适应；然而， GRU中的序列门控和局部卷积核需要多次迭代才能进行长程视差传播，从而限制了大视差和无纹理水下区域的性能。本文提出StereoAdapter-2，它用一种基于选择性状态空间模型的新型ConvSS2D算子取代了传统的ConvGRU更新器。所提出的算子采用四向扫描策略，自然地与极线几何对齐，同时捕获垂直结构一致性，从而能够在单个更新步骤中以线性计算复杂度实现有效的长程空间传播。此外，我们构建了UW-StereoDepth-80K，这是一个大规模的合成水下立体数据集，通过结合语义感知风格迁移和几何一致的新视角合成的两阶段生成流程，具有多样化的基线、衰减系数和散射参数。结合继承自StereoAdapter的动态LoRA自适应，我们的框架在水下基准测试中实现了最先进的零样本性能，在TartanAir-UW上的提升为17%，在SQUID上的提升为7.2%，在BlueROV2平台上的真实世界验证证明了我们方法的稳健性。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/StereoAdapter-2。网站：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/StereoAdapter-2。
tldr: The paper introduces StereoAdapter-2, a novel stereo depth estimation method for underwater robotics using a ConvSS2D operator for efficient long-range disparity propagation and a large-scale synthetic underwater stereo dataset (UW-StereoDepth-80K). It claims state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on underwater benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了StereoAdapter-2，一种用于水下机器人的新型立体深度估计方法，它使用 ConvSS2D 算子进行高效的远距离视差传播，并构建了一个大规模的合成水下立体数据集 (UW-StereoDepth-80K)。它声称在水下基准测试中实现了最先进的零样本性能。

title: Linear Convergence in Games with Delayed Feedback via Extra Prediction
summary: Feedback delays are inevitable in real-world multi-agent learning. They are known to severely degrade performance, and the convergence rate under delayed feedback is still unclear, even for bilinear games. This paper derives the rate of linear convergence of Weighted Optimistic Gradient Descent-Ascent (WOGDA), which predicts future rewards with extra optimism, in unconstrained bilinear games. To analyze the algorithm, we interpret it as an approximation of the Extra Proximal Point (EPP), which is updated based on farther future rewards than the classical Proximal Point (PP). Our theorems show that standard optimism (predicting the next-step reward) achieves linear convergence to the equilibrium at a rate $\exp(-Θ(t/m^{5}))$ after $t$ iterations for delay $m$. Moreover, employing extra optimism (predicting farther future reward) tolerates a larger step size and significantly accelerates the rate to $\exp(-Θ(t/(m^{2}\log m)))$. Our experiments also show accelerated convergence driven by the extra optimism and are qualitatively consistent with our theorems. In summary, this paper validates that extra optimism is a promising countermeasure against performance degradation caused by feedback delays.
summary_zh: 真实世界的多智能体学习中，反馈延迟是不可避免的。反馈延迟会严重降低性能，即使对于双线性博弈而言，延迟反馈下的收敛速度仍然不明确。本文推导了在无约束双线性博弈中，加权乐观梯度下降-上升算法（WOGDA）的线性收敛率，该算法利用额外的乐观性预测未来的奖励。为了分析该算法，我们将其解释为额外近端点算法（EPP）的一种近似，该算法基于比经典近端点算法（PP）更远的未来奖励值进行更新。我们的定理表明，标准乐观性（预测下一步奖励）在延迟为$m$的条件下，经过$t$次迭代后可以线性收敛到均衡，收敛速率为$\exp(-Θ(t/m^{5}))$。此外，采用额外的乐观性（预测更远的未来奖励）可以容忍更大的步长，并显著加速收敛速率至$\exp(-Θ(t/(m^{2}\log m)))$。我们的实验也表明，额外的乐观性驱动了更快的收敛速度，并且在质量上与我们的定理相符。总而言之，本文验证了额外的乐观性是应对反馈延迟导致的性能下降的一种有希望的对策。
tldr: This paper proposes Weighted Optimistic Gradient Descent-Ascent (WOGDA) with extra optimism to achieve linear convergence in bilinear games with delayed feedback, demonstrating accelerated convergence rates compared to standard optimism.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了加权乐观梯度下降-上升 (WOGDA) 算法，该算法采用额外的乐观性，从而在具有延迟反馈的双线性博弈中实现线性收敛。实验表明，与标准乐观算法相比，该算法能加速收敛。

title: Variational Grey-Box Dynamics Matching
summary: Deep generative models such as flow matching and diffusion models have shown great potential in learning complex distributions and dynamical systems, but often act as black-boxes, neglecting underlying physics. In contrast, physics-based simulation models described by ODEs/PDEs remain interpretable, but may have missing or unknown terms, unable to fully describe real-world observations. We bridge this gap with a novel grey-box method that integrates incomplete physics models directly into generative models. Our approach learns dynamics from observational trajectories alone, without ground-truth physics parameters, in a simulation-free manner that avoids scalability and stability issues of Neural ODEs. The core of our method lies in modelling a structured variational distribution within the flow matching framework, by using two latent encodings: one to model the missing stochasticity and multi-modal velocity, and a second to encode physics parameters as a latent variable with a physics-informed prior. Furthermore, we present an adaptation of the framework to handle second-order dynamics. Our experiments on representative ODE/PDE problems show that our method performs on par with or superior to fully data-driven approaches and previous grey-box baselines, while preserving the interpretability of the physics model. Our code is available at https://github.com/DMML-Geneva/VGB-DM.
summary_zh: 诸如Flow Matching和扩散模型等深度生成模型在学习复杂分布和动力学系统方面展现出巨大潜力，但通常表现为黑盒，忽略了潜在的物理规律。相反，由常微分方程/偏微分方程描述的基于物理的仿真模型仍然具有可解释性，但可能存在缺失或未知的项，无法完全描述真实世界的观测结果。我们提出一种新的灰盒方法来弥合这一差距，该方法将不完整的物理模型直接集成到生成模型中。我们的方法仅从观测轨迹中学习动力学，无需真实的物理参数，并且以无仿真的方式避免了神经常微分方程的可扩展性和稳定性问题。我们方法的核心在于通过在Flow Matching框架内建模结构化的变分分布，使用两个潜在编码：一个用于建模缺失的随机性和多模速度，另一个用于将物理参数编码为具有物理信息先验的潜在变量。此外，我们还提出了该框架的一种改写，以处理二阶动力学。我们在具有代表性的常微分方程/偏微分方程问题上的实验表明，我们的方法与完全数据驱动的方法和之前的灰盒基线相比，表现相当或更优，同时保留了物理模型的可解释性。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/DMML-Geneva/VGB-DM 获取。
tldr: This paper introduces a variational grey-box method that integrates incomplete physics models into generative models for learning dynamics from observational trajectories, outperforming data-driven and grey-box baselines while maintaining interpretability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种变分灰盒方法，将不完整的物理模型集成到生成模型中，以从观测轨迹中学习动力学。该方法优于纯数据驱动方法和现有的灰盒方法，同时保持了物理模型的可解释性。

title: i-PhysGaussian: Implicit Physical Simulation for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Physical simulation predicts future states of objects based on material properties and external loads, enabling blueprints for both Industry and Engineering to conduct risk management. Current 3D reconstruction-based simulators typically rely on explicit, step-wise updates, which are sensitive to step time and suffer from rapid accuracy degradation under complicated scenarios, such as high-stiffness materials or quasi-static movement. To address this, we introduce i-PhysGaussian, a framework that couples 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with an implicit Material Point Method (MPM) integrator. Unlike explicit methods, our solution obtains an end-of-step state by minimizing a momentum-balance residual through implicit Newton-type optimization with a GMRES solver. This formulation significantly reduces time-step sensitivity and ensures physical consistency. Our results demonstrate that i-PhysGaussian maintains stability at up to 20x larger time steps than explicit baselines, preserving structural coherence and smooth motion even in complex dynamic transitions.
summary_zh: 基于物理的仿真能够根据材料属性和外部载荷预测物体的未来状态，从而为工业和工程领域进行风险管理提供蓝图。目前基于三维重建的模拟器通常依赖于显式的、步进式的更新，这对于步长大小非常敏感，并且在高刚度材料或准静态运动等复杂场景下，精度会迅速下降。为了解决这个问题，我们提出 i-PhysGaussian，一个将三维高斯溅射 (3DGS) 与隐式Material Point Method (MPM) 积分器耦合的框架。与显式方法不同，我们的方案通过使用GMRES求解器的隐式牛顿型优化算法，最小化动量平衡残差来获得步进结束时的物体状态。这种公式显著降低了对时间步长的敏感性，并保证了物理一致性。我们的结果表明，相比显式基线方法，i-PhysGaussian 能够在高达 20 倍的时间步长下保持稳定性，即使在复杂的动态过渡中也能保持结构连贯性和平滑运动。
tldr: The paper presents i-PhysGaussian, a framework that combines 3D Gaussian Splatting with an implicit Material Point Method (MPM) integrator for physical simulation, achieving improved stability and larger time steps compared to explicit methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了i-PhysGaussian，一个结合了3D高斯溅射和隐式材料点方法(MPM)积分器的物理模拟框架，与显式方法相比，实现了更好的稳定性和更大的时间步长。

title: Hybrid System Planning using a Mixed-Integer ADMM Heuristic and Hybrid Zonotopes
summary: Embedded optimization-based planning for hybrid systems is challenging due to the use of mixed-integer programming, which is computationally intensive and often sensitive to the specific numerical formulation. To address that challenge, this article proposes a framework for motion planning of hybrid systems that pairs hybrid zonotopes - an advanced set representation - with a new alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) mixed-integer programming heuristic. A general treatment of piecewise affine (PWA) system reachability analysis using hybrid zonotopes is presented and extended to formulate optimal planning problems. Sets produced using the proposed identities have lower memory complexity and tighter convex relaxations than equivalent sets produced from preexisting techniques. The proposed ADMM heuristic makes efficient use of the hybrid zonotope structure. For planning problems formulated as hybrid zonotopes, the proposed heuristic achieves improved convergence rates as compared to state-of-the-art mixed-integer programming heuristics. The proposed methods for hybrid system planning on embedded hardware are experimentally applied in a combined behavior and motion planning scenario for autonomous driving.
summary_zh: 面向混合系统的嵌入式优化规划面临挑战，原因在于混合整数规划计算密集，且通常对特定的数值公式敏感。为应对该挑战，本文提出一种混合系统运动规划框架，该框架将混合区域（一种高级集合表示）与一种新的交替方向乘子法(ADMM)混合整数规划启发式算法相结合。本文提出了使用混合区域对分段仿射(PWA)系统可达性分析的通用处理方法，并将其扩展以制定最优规划问题。使用所提出的恒等式产生的集合，相比于使用现有技术产生的等价集合，具有更低的内存复杂度和更紧凑的凸松弛。所提出的ADMM启发式算法有效地利用了混合区域的结构。 对于以混合区域形式表达的规划问题，与最先进的混合整数规划启发式算法相比，所提出的启发式算法实现了更高的收敛速度。 所提出的混合系统嵌入式硬件规划方法，通过实验应用于自动驾驶的组合行为和运动规划场景中。
tldr: This paper presents a novel mixed-integer programming heuristic using hybrid zonotopes and ADMM for motion planning of hybrid systems, demonstrating improved convergence rates in autonomous driving applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的混合整数规划启发式算法，使用混合Zonotopes和ADMM进行混合系统的运动规划，并在自动驾驶应用中展示了改进的收敛速度。

title: Dodging the Moose: Experimental Insights in Real-Life Automated Collision Avoidance
summary: The sudden appearance of a static obstacle on the road, i.e. the moose test, is a well-known emergency scenario in collision avoidance for automated driving. Model Predictive Control (MPC) has long been employed for planning and control of automated vehicles in the state of the art. However, real-time implementation of automated collision avoidance in emergency scenarios such as the moose test remains unaddressed due to the high computational demand of MPC for evasive action in such hazardous scenarios. This paper offers new insights into real-time collision avoidance via the experimental imple- mentation of MPC for motion planning after a sudden and unexpected appearance of a static obstacle. As the state-of-the-art nonlinear MPC shows limited capability to provide an acceptable solution in real-time, we propose a human-like feed-forward planner to assist when the MPC optimization problem is either infeasible or unable to find a suitable solution due to the poor quality of its initial guess. We introduce the concept of maximum steering maneuver to design the feed-forward planner and mimic a human-like reaction after detecting the static obstacle on the road. Real-life experiments are conducted across various speeds and level of emergency using FPEV2-Kanon electric vehicle. Moreover, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our planning strategy via comparison with the state-of- the-art MPC motion planner.
summary_zh: 在道路上突然出现静态障碍物，即麋鹿测试，是自动驾驶中一种众所周知的避撞紧急场景。模型预测控制 (MPC) 长期以来一直被用于自动驾驶汽车的规划和控制。然而，由于 MPC 在此类危险场景中采取规避动作时计算需求高，因此在诸如麋鹿测试等紧急场景中实时实现自动避撞仍然未得到解决。本文通过对静态障碍物突然且意外出现后，采用 MPC 进行运动规划的实验实施，为实时避撞提供了新的见解。由于最先进的非线性 MPC 在实时提供可接受的解决方案方面能力有限，因此我们提出了一种类人的前馈规划器，以在 MPC 优化问题不可行或由于其初始猜测质量差而无法找到合适的解决方案时提供帮助。我们引入了最大转向机动的概念来设计前馈规划器，并模拟人类在检测到道路上静态障碍物后的反应。我们使用 FPEV2-Kanon 电动汽车，在各种速度和紧急程度下进行了真实实验。此外，我们通过与最先进的 MPC 运动规划器进行比较，证明了我们规划策略的有效性。
tldr: This paper presents a real-time collision avoidance system using MPC with a human-like feed-forward planner to handle emergency scenarios like the moose test, experimentally validated on an electric vehicle.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于MPC的实时避撞系统，该系统采用类人前馈规划器来处理像麋鹿测试这样的紧急情况，并在电动汽车上进行了实验验证。

title: Optically Sensorized Electro-Ribbon Actuator (OS-ERA)
summary: Electro-Ribbon Actuators (ERAs) are lightweight flexural actuators that exhibit ultrahigh displacement and fast movement. However, their embedded sensing relies on capacitive sensors with limited precision, which hinders accurate control. We introduce OS-ERA, an optically sensorized ERA that yields reliable proprioceptive information, and we focus on the design and integration of a sensing solution without affecting actuation. To analyse the complex curvature of an ERA in motion, we design and embed two soft optical waveguide sensors. A classifier is trained to map the sensing signals in order to distinguish eight bending states. We validate our model on six held-out trials and compare it against signals' trajectories learned from training runs. Across all tests, the sensing output signals follow the training manifold, and the predicted sequence mirrors real performance and confirms repeatability. Despite deliberate train-test mismatches in actuation speed, the signal trajectories preserve their shape, and classification remains consistently accurate, demonstrating practical voltage- and speed-invariance. As a result, OS-ERA classifies bending states with high fidelity; it is fast and repeatable, solving a longstanding bottleneck of the ERA, enabling steps toward closed-loop control.
summary_zh: 电致带状驱动器(ERA)是一种轻量级的弯曲驱动器，具有超高的位移和快速的运动。然而，其嵌入式传感依赖于精度有限的电容式传感器，这阻碍了精确的控制。我们引入了OS-ERA，一种光学传感的ERA，能够产生可靠的本体感受信息，并且我们专注于设计和集成一种在不影响驱动的情况下实现传感的解决方案。为了分析运动中ERA的复杂曲率，我们设计并嵌入了两个软光波导传感器。训练了一个分类器来映射传感信号，从而区分八种弯曲状态。我们在六个预留试验中验证了我们的模型，并将其与从训练运行中学习到的信号轨迹进行比较。在所有测试中，传感输出信号都遵循训练流形，预测的序列反映了真实的性能并证实了可重复性。尽管在驱动速度上存在刻意的训练-测试不匹配，但信号轨迹保持了其形状，并且分类仍然保持一致的准确性，从而证明了实际的电压和速度不变性。因此，OS-ERA能够高保真地分类弯曲状态；它快速且可重复，解决了ERA的一个长期瓶颈，为实现闭环控制奠定了基础。
tldr: The paper introduces OS-ERA, an electro-ribbon actuator with embedded optical sensors, achieving high-fidelity bending state classification and enabling closed-loop control, addressing limitations of previous ERA sensing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为OS-ERA的电驱动带状执行器，它集成了光学传感器，实现了高精度的弯曲状态分类，并为闭环控制铺平了道路，解决了以往ERA传感方法的局限性。

title: A Cost-Effective and Climate-Resilient Air Pressure System for Rain Effect Reduction on Automated Vehicle Cameras
summary:
Recent advances in automated vehicles have focused on improving perception performance under adverse weather conditions; however, research on physical hardware solutions remains limited, despite their importance for perception critical applications such as vehicle platooning. Existing approaches, such as hydrophilic or hydrophobic lenses and sprays, provide only partial mitigation, while industrial protection systems imply high cost and they do not enable scalability for automotive deployment.
  To address these limitations, this paper presents a cost-effective hardware solution for rainy conditions, designed to be compatible with multiple cameras simultaneously.
  Beyond its technical contribution, the proposed solution supports sustainability goals in transportation systems. By enabling compatibility with existing camera-based sensing platforms, the system extends the operational reliability of automated vehicles without requiring additional high-cost sensors or hardware replacements. This approach reduces resource consumption, supports modular upgrades, and promotes more cost-efficient deployment of automated vehicle technologies, particularly in challenging weather conditions where system failures would otherwise lead to inefficiencies and increased emissions. The proposed system was able to increase pedestrian detection accuracy of a Deep Learning model from 8.3% to 41.6%.
summary_zh:
自动驾驶车辆的最新进展主要集中在提升恶劣天气条件下的感知性能；然而，尽管物理硬件解决方案对于车辆队列等感知关键应用至关重要，但相关研究仍然有限。现有的方法，如亲水或疏水镜头及喷涂，仅能提供部分缓解，而工业保护系统成本高昂，且无法实现汽车部署的可扩展性。

为了解决这些局限性，本文提出了一种在雨天条件下具有成本效益的硬件解决方案，该方案旨在同时兼容多个摄像头。

除了技术贡献之外，所提出的解决方案还支持交通运输系统的可持续发展目标。通过实现与现有基于摄像头的传感平台的兼容性，该系统扩展了自动驾驶车辆的运行可靠性，而无需额外的高成本传感器或硬件更换。这种方法减少了资源消耗，支持模块化升级，并促进了自动驾驶车辆技术的更具成本效益的部署，尤其是在恶劣天气条件下，在这些条件下，系统故障可能会导致效率降低和排放增加。所提出的系统能够将深度学习模型对行人的检测精度从8.3%提高到41.6%。
tldr: This paper introduces a cost-effective and climate-resilient air pressure system to reduce rain effect on automated vehicle cameras, improving pedestrian detection accuracy from 8.3% to 41.6%. The aim is to enhance the operational reliability of automated vehicles without expensive hardware replacements, supporting sustainability goals.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种经济高效且具有气候适应性的气压系统，以减少雨水对自动驾驶车辆摄像头的影响，并将行人检测的准确率从8.3％提高到41.6％。其目标是在不更换昂贵硬件的情况下提高自动驾驶车辆的运行可靠性，从而支持可持续发展目标。

title: 3D-printed Soft Optical sensor with a Lens (SOLen) for light guidance in mechanosensing
summary: Additive manufacturing is enabling soft robots with increasingly complex geometries, creating a demand for sensing solutions that remain compatible with single-material, one-step fabrication. Optical soft sensors are attractive for monolithic printing, but their performance is often degraded by uncontrolled light propagation (ambient coupling, leakage, scattering), while common miti- gation strategies typically require multimaterial interfaces. Here, we present an approach for 3D printed soft optical sensing (SOLen), in which a printed lens is placed in front of an emitter within a Y-shaped waveguide. The sensing mechanism relies on deformation-induced lens rotation and focal-spot translation, redistributing optical power between the two branches to generate a differential output that encodes both motion direction and amplitude. An acrylate polyurethane resin was modified with lauryl acrylate to improve compliance and optical transmittance, and single-layer optical characterization was used to derive wavelength-dependent refractive index and transmittance while minimizing DLP layer-related artifacts. The measured refractive index was used in simulations to design a lens profile for a target focal distance, which was then printed with sub-millimeter fidelity. Rotational tests demonstrated reproducible branch-selective signal switching over multiple cycles. These results establish a transferable material-to-optics workflow for soft optical sensors with lens with new functionalities for next-generation soft robots
summary_zh: 增材制造正在推动软体机器人的几何形状日益复杂化，从而产生了对能够与单材料、一步制造兼容的传感解决方案的需求。光学软传感器因适用于单片打印而备受青睐，但其性能通常因不受控制的光传播（环境耦合、泄漏、散射）而降低，而常见的缓解策略通常需要多材料界面。在此，我们提出了一种用于3D打印软光学传感（SOLen）的方法，其中将打印的透镜放置在Y形波导内的发射器前方。传感机制依赖于形变诱导的透镜旋转和焦点位置移动，从而在两个分支之间重新分配光功率，产生差分输出，以编码运动方向和幅度。使用丙烯酸月桂酯对丙烯酸酯聚氨酯树脂进行了改性，以提高柔顺性和光学透射率，并使用单层光学特性来推导与波长相关的折射率和透射率，同时最大限度地减少与DLP层相关的伪影。测得的折射率用于模拟中，以设计目标焦距的透镜轮廓，然后以亚毫米级的保真度进行打印。旋转测试表明，在多个周期内，可重复地进行分支选择性信号切换。这些结果为具有透镜的软光学传感器建立了一种可转移的材料到光学的工作流程，为下一代软体机器人带来了新的功能。
tldr: This paper introduces a 3D-printed soft optical sensor (SOLen) with a lens to improve light guidance and mechanosensing for soft robotics using a single-material fabrication process. It demonstrates improved performance compared to existing optical soft sensors by mitigating uncontrolled light propagation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种具有透镜的3D打印软光传感器 (SOLen)，旨在通过单材料制造工艺改善软机器人中的光导和机械传感。与现有的光学软传感器相比，它通过减轻不受控制的光传播来提高性能。

title: Contact-Anchored Proprioceptive Odometry for Quadruped Robots
summary: Reliable odometry for legged robots without cameras or LiDAR remains challenging due to IMU drift and noisy joint velocity sensing. This paper presents a purely proprioceptive state estimator that uses only IMU and motor measurements to jointly estimate body pose and velocity, with a unified formulation applicable to biped, quadruped, and wheel-legged robots. The key idea is to treat each contacting leg as a kinematic anchor: joint-torque--based foot wrench estimation selects reliable contacts, and the corresponding footfall positions provide intermittent world-frame constraints that suppress long-term drift. To prevent elevation drift during extended traversal, we introduce a lightweight height clustering and time-decay correction that snaps newly recorded footfall heights to previously observed support planes. To improve foot velocity observations under encoder quantization, we apply an inverse-kinematics cubature Kalman filter that directly filters foot-end velocities from joint angles and velocities. The implementation further mitigates yaw drift through multi-contact geometric consistency and degrades gracefully to a kinematics-derived heading reference when IMU yaw constraints are unavailable or unreliable. We evaluate the method on four quadruped platforms (three Astrall robots and a Unitree Go2 EDU) using closed-loop trajectories. On Astrall point-foot robot~A, a $\sim$200\,m horizontal loop and a $\sim$15\,m vertical loop return with 0.1638\,m and 0.219\,m error, respectively; on wheel-legged robot~B, the corresponding errors are 0.2264\,m and 0.199\,m. On wheel-legged robot~C, a $\sim$700\,m horizontal loop yields 7.68\,m error and a $\sim$20\,m vertical loop yields 0.540\,m error. Unitree Go2 EDU closes a $\sim$120\,m horizontal loop with 2.2138\,m error and a $\sim$8\,m vertical loop with less than 0.1\,m vertical error. github.com/ShineMinxing/Ros2Go2Estimator.git
summary_zh: 对于没有相机或激光雷达的腿式机器人而言，由于IMU漂移和嘈杂的关节速度传感，可靠的里程计仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了一种纯本体感受状态估计器，仅使用IMU和电机测量值来联合估计身体姿态和速度，该估计器采用统一的公式，适用于双足、四足和轮腿机器人。关键思想是将每个接触腿视为一个运动学锚点：基于关节力矩的足端力估计选择可靠的接触点，并且相应的落脚点位置提供间歇性的世界坐标系约束，以抑制长期漂移。为了防止在长时间运动过程中的高度漂移，我们引入了一种轻量级的高度聚类和时间衰减校正方法，将新记录的落脚点高度与先前观察到的支撑平面进行匹配。为了改善编码器量化下的足部速度观测，我们应用了一种逆运动学的容积卡尔曼滤波器，该滤波器直接从关节角度和速度中滤波足端速度。该实现还通过多接触几何一致性来减轻偏航漂移，并且在IMU偏航约束不可用或不可靠时，优雅地降级为运动学推导的航向参考。我们使用闭环轨迹在四个四足机器人平台上（三个Astrall机器人和一个宇树Go2 EDU）评估了该方法。在Astrall点足机器人A上，一个约200米的水平环路和一个约15米的垂直环路分别以0.1638米和0.219米的误差返回；在轮腿机器人B上，相应的误差分别为0.2264米和0.199米。在轮腿机器人C上，一个约700米的水平环路产生7.68米的误差，一个约20米的垂直环路产生0.540米的误差。宇树Go2 EDU以2.2138米的误差闭合了一个约120米的水平环路，以及以小于0.1米的垂直误差闭合了一个约8米的垂直环路。github.com/ShineMinxing/Ros2Go2Estimator.git
tldr: This paper presents a purely proprioceptive odometry method for legged robots using IMU and motor measurements, achieving good performance on quadruped platforms with a contact-anchored approach to suppress drift and a lightweight height clustering method for preventing elevation drift.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种纯粹的本体感受里程计方法，用于腿式机器人，该方法仅使用IMU和电机测量。 它在四足平台上实现了良好的性能，采用接触锚定方法来抑制漂移，并采用轻量级的高度聚类方法来防止高度漂移。

title: Nonlinear Predictive Control of the Continuum and Hybrid Dynamics of a Suspended Deformable Cable for Aerial Pick and Place
summary: This paper presents a framework for aerial manipulation of an extensible cable that combines a high-fidelity model based on partial differential equations (PDEs) with a reduced-order representation suitable for real-time control. The PDEs are discretised using a finite-difference method, and proper orthogonal decomposition is employed to extract a reduced-order model (ROM) that retains the dominant deformation modes while significantly reducing computational complexity. Based on this ROM, a nonlinear model predictive control scheme is formulated, capable of stabilizing cable oscillations and handling hybrid transitions such as payload attachment and detachment. Simulation results confirm the stability, efficiency, and robustness of the ROM, as well as the effectiveness of the controller in regulating cable dynamics under a range of operating conditions. Additional simulations illustrate the application of the ROM for trajectory planning in constrained environments, demonstrating the versatility of the proposed approach. Overall, the framework enables real-time, dynamics-aware control of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) carrying suspended flexible cables.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一个用于空中操作可伸展缆索的框架，该框架结合了基于偏微分方程（PDEs）的高保真模型与适用于实时控制的降阶表示。PDEs通过有限差分法离散化，并采用本征正交分解提取降阶模型（ROM），该模型在显著降低计算复杂度的同时，保留了主要的变形模式。基于此ROM，制定了一种非线性模型预测控制方案，能够稳定缆索振荡并处理诸如有效载荷附加和分离等混合转换。仿真结果证实了ROM的稳定性、效率和鲁棒性，以及控制器在调节各种运行条件下缆索动力学方面的有效性。额外的仿真展示了ROM在受约束环境中轨迹规划的应用，证明了所提出方法的通用性。总而言之，该框架能够对携带悬挂柔性缆索的无人机（UAVs）进行实时的、动力学感知的控制。
tldr: The paper presents a nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) framework for real-time aerial manipulation of deformable cables using a reduced-order model (ROM) derived from PDEs, demonstrating stability, efficiency, and robustness in simulations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种非线性模型预测控制(NMPC)框架，用于实时空中操作可变形电缆，使用从偏微分方程(PDEs)推导出的降阶模型(ROM)，在模拟中展示了稳定性和效率。

title: Geometric Inverse Flight Dynamics on SO(3) and Application to Tethered Fixed-Wing Aircraft
summary: We present a robotics-oriented, coordinate-free formulation of inverse flight dynamics for fixed-wing aircraft on SO(3). Translational force balance is written in the world frame and rotational dynamics in the body frame; aerodynamic directions (drag, lift, side) are defined geometrically, avoiding local attitude coordinates. Enforcing coordinated flight (no sideslip), we derive a closed-form trajectory-to-input map yielding the attitude, angular velocity, and thrust-angle-of-attack pair, and we recover the aerodynamic moment coefficients component-wise. Applying such a map to tethered flight on spherical parallels, we obtain analytic expressions for the required bank angle and identify a specific zero-bank locus where the tether tension exactly balances centrifugal effects, highlighting the decoupling between aerodynamic coordination and the apparent gravity vector. Under a simple lift/drag law, the minimal-thrust angle of attack admits a closed form. These pointwise quasi-steady inversion solutions become steady-flight trim when the trajectory and rotational dynamics are time-invariant. The framework bridges inverse simulation in aeronautics with geometric modeling in robotics, providing a rigorous building block for trajectory design and feasibility checks.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种面向机器人学的、无坐标的固定翼飞机在SO(3)上的逆飞行动力学公式。平移力平衡在世界坐标系中描述，旋转动力学在机体坐标系中描述；气动方向（阻力、升力、侧力）采用几何方式定义，避免了局部姿态坐标。通过强制协调飞行（无侧滑），我们推导出从轨迹到输入的闭式映射，该映射产生姿态、角速度和推力-攻角对，并逐分量地恢复气动弯矩系数。将该映射应用于球面平行线系留飞行，我们获得了所需倾斜角的解析表达式，并识别出一个特殊的零倾斜轨迹，在该轨迹上，系绳张力恰好平衡离心效应，突出了气动协调与表观重力矢量之间的解耦。在简单的升力/阻力定律下，最小推力攻角存在闭式解。当轨迹和旋转动力学是时不变时，这些逐点准静态反演解就成为了稳态飞行配平。该框架将航空领域的逆向仿真与机器人领域的几何建模联系起来，为轨迹设计和可行性检查提供了一个严格的构建模块。
tldr: This paper presents a coordinate-free approach to inverse flight dynamics for fixed-wing aircraft on SO(3), deriving closed-form solutions for trajectory-to-input mapping and applying it to tethered flight, potentially useful for geometric modeling in robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在SO(3)上针对固定翼飞机的逆飞行动力学的无坐标方法，推导出轨迹到输入的映射的闭式解，并将其应用于系绳飞行，可能对机器人技术的几何建模有用。

title: Physical Human-Robot Interaction for Grasping in Augmented Reality via Rigid-Soft Robot Synergy
summary: Hybrid rigid-soft robots combine the precision of rigid manipulators with the compliance and adaptability of soft arms, offering a promising approach for versatile grasping in unstructured environments. However, coordinating hybrid robots remains challenging, due to difficulties in modeling, perception, and cross-domain kinematics. In this work, we present a novel augmented reality (AR)-based physical human-robot interaction framework that enables direct teleoperation of a hybrid rigid-soft robot for simple reaching and grasping tasks. Using an AR headset, users can interact with a simulated model of the robotic system integrated into a general-purpose physics engine, which is superimposed on the real system, allowing simulated execution prior to real-world deployment. To ensure consistent behavior between the virtual and physical robots, we introduce a real-to-simulation parameter identification pipeline that leverages the inherent geometric properties of the soft robot, enabling accurate modeling of its static and dynamic behavior as well as the control system's response.
summary_zh: 混合刚柔机器人结合了刚性机械臂的精度和柔性臂的顺应性与适应性，为非结构化环境下的通用抓取提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，由于建模、感知和跨域运动学方面的困难，协调混合机器人仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于增强现实（AR）的物理人机交互框架，该框架能够直接遥操作混合刚柔机器人来完成简单的到达和抓取任务。使用AR头显，用户可以与集成到通用物理引擎中的机器人系统模拟模型进行交互，该模型叠加在真实系统之上，从而允许在真实部署之前进行模拟执行。为了确保虚拟机器人和物理机器人之间行为的一致性，我们引入了一个从真实到模拟的参数识别流程，该流程利用了柔性机器人的固有几何特性，从而能够精确建模其静态和动态行为以及控制系统的响应。
tldr: The paper introduces an augmented reality (AR)-based teleoperation framework for hybrid rigid-soft robots, enabling users to control the robot for grasping tasks with a focus on real-to-simulation consistency through parameter identification.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于增强现实（AR）的混合刚柔机器人遥操作框架，使用户能够控制机器人执行抓取任务，重点是通过参数识别实现真实环境到仿真环境的一致性。

title: Boreas Road Trip: A Multi-Sensor Autonomous Driving Dataset on Challenging Roads
summary: The Boreas Road Trip (Boreas-RT) dataset extends the multi-season Boreas dataset to new and diverse locations that pose challenges for modern autonomous driving algorithms. Boreas-RT comprises 60 sequences collected over 9 real-world routes, totalling 643 km of driving. Each route is traversed multiple times, enabling evaluation in identical environments under varying traffic and, in some cases, weather conditions. The data collection platform includes a 5MP FLIR Blackfly S camera, a 360 degree Navtech RAS6 Doppler-enabled spinning radar, a 128-channel 360 degree Velodyne Alpha Prime lidar, an Aeva Aeries II FMCW Doppler-enabled lidar, a Silicon Sensing DMU41 inertial measurement unit, and a Dynapar wheel encoder. Centimetre-level ground truth is provided via post-processed Applanix POS LV GNSS-INS data. The dataset includes precise extrinsic and intrinsic calibrations, a publicly available development kit, and a live leaderboard for odometry and metric localization. Benchmark results show that many state-of-the-art odometry and localization algorithms overfit to simple driving environments and degrade significantly on the more challenging Boreas-RT routes. Boreas-RT provides a unified dataset for evaluating multi-modal algorithms across diverse road conditions. The dataset, leaderboard, and development kit are available at www.boreas.utias.utoronto.ca.
summary_zh: Boreas公路旅行(Boreas-RT)数据集扩展了多季Boreas数据集，覆盖了新的且多样化的地点，这些地点对现代自动驾驶算法提出了挑战。Boreas-RT包含在9条真实世界路线收集的60个序列，总驾驶里程达643公里。每条路线被多次遍历，从而能够在相同的环境下评估算法在不同交通状况以及某些情况下的天气条件下的表现。数据采集平台包括一个5MP FLIR Blackfly S相机、一个360度Navtech RAS6多普勒旋转雷达、一个128线360度 Velodyne Alpha Prime 激光雷达、一个Aeva Aeries II FMCW多普勒激光雷达、一个Silicon Sensing DMU41惯性测量单元以及一个Dynapar轮式编码器。通过后处理的Applanix POS LV GNSS-INS数据提供厘米级真值。该数据集包括精确的内外参校准、一个公开可用的开发工具包以及一个用于里程计和度量定位的实时排行榜。基准测试结果表明，许多最先进的里程计和定位算法过度拟合简单的驾驶环境，并在更具挑战性的Boreas-RT路线上显著退化。Boreas-RT提供了一个统一的数据集，用于评估跨不同路况的多模态算法。数据集、排行榜和开发工具包可在www.boreas.utias.utoronto.ca上获取。
tldr: The Boreas Road Trip dataset is a new multi-sensor autonomous driving dataset comprising challenging real-world routes with ground truth and benchmarks, designed to evaluate the robustness of odometry and localization algorithms in diverse conditions.
tldr_zh: Boreas Road Trip数据集是一个新的多传感器自动驾驶数据集，包含具有挑战性的真实世界路线、真值和基准，旨在评估测程和定位算法在各种条件下的鲁棒性。

title: RRT$^η$: Sampling-based Motion Planning and Control from STL Specifications using Arithmetic-Geometric Mean Robustness
summary:
Sampling-based motion planning has emerged as a powerful approach for robotics, enabling exploration of complex, high-dimensional configuration spaces. When combined with Signal Temporal Logic (STL), a temporal logic widely used for formalizing interpretable robotic tasks, these methods can address complex spatiotemporal constraints. However, traditional approaches rely on min-max robustness measures that focus only on critical time points and subformulae, creating non-smooth optimization landscapes with sharp decision boundaries that hinder efficient tree exploration.
  We propose RRT$^η$, a sampling-based planning framework that integrates the Arithmetic-Geometric Mean (AGM) robustness measure to evaluate satisfaction across all time points and subformulae. Our key contributions include: (1) AGM robustness interval semantics for reasoning about partial trajectories during tree construction, (2) an efficient incremental monitoring algorithm computing these intervals, and (3) enhanced Direction of Increasing Satisfaction vectors leveraging Fulfillment Priority Logic (FPL) for principled objective composition. Our framework synthesizes dynamically feasible control sequences satisfying STL specifications with high robustness while maintaining the probabilistic completeness and asymptotic optimality of RRT$^\ast$. We validate our approach on three robotic systems. A double integrator point robot, a unicycle mobile robot, and a 7-DOF robot arm, demonstrating superior performance over traditional STL robustness-based planners in multi-constraint scenarios with limited guidance signals.
summary_zh:
基于采样的运动规划已成为机器人领域一种强大的方法，能够探索复杂的高维构型空间。当与信号时序逻辑(STL)相结合时，该方法可用于形式化可解释的机器人任务，并能处理复杂的时空约束。然而，传统方法依赖于极小-极大鲁棒性度量，该度量仅关注关键时间点和子公式，从而产生具有尖锐决策边界的非光滑优化地形，阻碍了高效的树状探索。

我们提出RRT$^η$，一种基于采样的规划框架，集成了算术-几何平均(AGM)鲁棒性度量，以评估所有时间点和子公式的满足程度。我们的主要贡献包括：（1）用于在树构建期间推理部分轨迹的AGM鲁棒性区间语义，（2）计算这些区间的有效增量监控算法，以及（3）利用履行优先级逻辑(FPL)改进的递增满意度方向向量，用于有原则性的目标组合。我们的框架综合了满足STL规范且具有高鲁棒性的动态可行控制序列，同时保持了RRT$^\ast$的概率完备性和渐近最优性。我们在三个机器人系统上验证了我们的方法：一个双积分器点机器人、一个单轮移动机器人和一个7自由度机器人手臂，在具有有限引导信号的多约束场景中，相比传统的基于STL鲁棒性的规划器，表现出更优越的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces RRT$^η$, a sampling-based motion planning framework using Arithmetic-Geometric Mean robustness to improve performance in satisfying STL specifications for robotic systems compared to traditional min-max robustness methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RRT$^η$，一种基于采样的运动规划框架，它使用算术-几何平均鲁棒性，与传统的最小-最大鲁棒性方法相比，提高了机器人系统满足STL规范的性能。

title: Node Learning: A Framework for Adaptive, Decentralised and Collaborative Network Edge AI
summary: The expansion of AI toward the edge increasingly exposes the cost and fragility of cen- tralised intelligence. Data transmission, latency, energy consumption, and dependence on large data centres create bottlenecks that scale poorly across heterogeneous, mobile, and resource-constrained environments. In this paper, we introduce Node Learning, a decen- tralised learning paradigm in which intelligence resides at individual edge nodes and expands through selective peer interaction. Nodes learn continuously from local data, maintain their own model state, and exchange learned knowledge opportunistically when collaboration is beneficial. Learning propagates through overlap and diffusion rather than global synchro- nisation or central aggregation. It unifies autonomous and cooperative behaviour within a single abstraction and accommodates heterogeneity in data, hardware, objectives, and connectivity. This concept paper develops the conceptual foundations of this paradigm, contrasts it with existing decentralised approaches, and examines implications for communi- cation, hardware, trust, and governance. Node Learning does not discard existing paradigms, but places them within a broader decentralised perspective
summary_zh: 人工智能向边缘的扩展日益暴露了中心化智能的成本和脆弱性。数据传输、延迟、能源消耗以及对大型数据中心的依赖造成了瓶颈，这些瓶颈在异构、移动和资源受限的环境中难以有效扩展。在本文中，我们提出了一种去中心化学习范式——节点学习，其中智能驻留在各个边缘节点上，并通过选择性的对等交互进行扩展。节点从本地数据持续学习，维护自己的模型状态，并在协作有利时伺机交换学习到的知识。学习通过重叠和扩散传播，而不是通过全局同步或中心聚合。它在一个单一抽象中统一了自主和协作行为，并适应数据、硬件、目标和连接方面的异构性。这篇概念性论文阐述了这种范式的概念基础，将其与现有的去中心化方法进行对比，并探讨了其对通信、硬件、信任和治理的影响。节点学习并非抛弃现有的范式，而是将其置于更广泛的去中心化视角之中。
tldr: The paper introduces Node Learning, a decentralized learning paradigm for edge AI that promotes autonomous learning and collaborative knowledge exchange among edge nodes. It contrasts the approach with existing decentralized systems and examines implications for communication, hardware, trust, and governance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为Node Learning的去中心化学习范式，用于边缘AI，促进边缘节点之间的自主学习和协作知识交换。它将此方法与现有的去中心化系统进行了对比，并考察了其对通信、硬件、信任和治理的影响。

title: FoundationPose-Initialized 3D-2D Liver Registration for Surgical Augmented Reality
summary: Augmented reality can improve tumor localization in laparoscopic liver surgery. Existing registration pipelines typically depend on organ contours; deformable (non-rigid) alignment is often handled with finite-element (FE) models coupled to dimensionality-reduction or machine-learning components. We integrate laparoscopic depth maps with a foundation pose estimator for camera-liver pose estimation and replace FE-based deformation with non-rigid iterative closest point (NICP) to lower engineering/modeling complexity and expertise requirements. On real patient data, the depth-augmented foundation pose approach achieved 9.91 mm mean registration error in 3 cases. Combined rigid-NICP registration outperformed rigid-only registration, demonstrating NICP as an efficient substitute for finite-element deformable models. This pipeline achieves clinically relevant accuracy while offering a lightweight, engineering-friendly alternative to FE-based deformation.
summary_zh: 增强现实技术可以改善腹腔镜肝脏手术中肿瘤的定位。现有的配准流程通常依赖于器官轮廓；可变形（非刚性）对齐通常采用有限元（FE）模型，并耦合降维或机器学习组件。我们集成腹腔镜深度图与基础姿态估计器，用于相机-肝脏姿态估计，并用非刚性迭代最近点 (NICP) 方法替换基于有限元的变形，以降低工程/建模复杂性和专业知识要求。在真实的患者数据上，深度增强的基础姿态方法在3个病例中实现了9.91毫米的平均配准误差。刚性-NICP 联合配准优于仅使用刚性配准，证明了 NICP 可以作为有限元可变形模型的有效替代方案。该流程在实现临床相关精度的同时，提供了一种轻量级、工程友好的替代方案，以取代基于有限元的变形方法。
tldr: This paper presents a 3D-2D liver registration pipeline for surgical augmented reality using a foundation pose estimator and non-rigid ICP, offering a simpler alternative to FE-based deformation models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于外科增强现实的3D-2D肝脏配准流程，该流程使用基础姿态估计器和非刚性ICP，为基于有限元的变形模型提供了一种更简单的替代方案。

title: 4D Monocular Surgical Reconstruction under Arbitrary Camera Motions
summary: Reconstructing deformable surgical scenes from endoscopic videos is challenging and clinically important. Recent state-of-the-art methods based on implicit neural representations or 3D Gaussian splatting have made notable progress. However, most are designed for deformable scenes with fixed endoscope viewpoints and rely on stereo depth priors or accurate structure-from-motion for initialization and optimization, limiting their ability to handle monocular sequences with large camera motion in real clinical settings. To address this, we propose Local-EndoGS, a high-quality 4D reconstruction framework for monocular endoscopic sequences with arbitrary camera motion. Local-EndoGS introduces a progressive, window-based global representation that allocates local deformable scene models to each observed window, enabling scalability to long sequences with substantial motion. To overcome unreliable initialization without stereo depth or accurate structure-from-motion, we design a coarse-to-fine strategy integrating multi-view geometry, cross-window information, and monocular depth priors, providing a robust foundation for optimization. We further incorporate long-range 2D pixel trajectory constraints and physical motion priors to improve deformation plausibility. Experiments on three public endoscopic datasets with deformable scenes and varying camera motions show that Local-EndoGS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in appearance quality and geometry. Ablation studies validate the effectiveness of our key designs. Code will be released upon acceptance at: https://github.com/IRMVLab/Local-EndoGS.
summary_zh: 从内窥镜视频重建可变形手术场景既具有挑战性，又在临床上非常重要。基于隐式神经表示或3D高斯溅射的最新方法已经取得了显著进展。然而，大多数方法是为具有固定内窥镜视点的可变形场景设计的，并且依赖于立体深度先验或精确的运动恢复结构进行初始化和优化，从而限制了它们处理真实临床环境中具有较大相机运动的单目序列的能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Local-EndoGS，一个用于具有任意相机运动的单目内窥镜序列的高质量4D重建框架。Local-EndoGS引入了一种渐进的、基于窗口的全局表示，该表示将局部可变形场景模型分配给每个观测到的窗口，从而实现了对具有大量运动的长序列的可扩展性。为了克服在没有立体深度或精确运动恢复结构的情况下不可靠的初始化问题，我们设计了一种粗到精的策略，集成了多视几何、跨窗口信息和单目深度先验，为优化提供了稳健的基础。我们进一步结合了长程2D像素轨迹约束和物理运动先验，以提高变形的合理性。在三个公开的包含可变形场景和不同相机运动的内窥镜数据集上的实验表明，Local-EndoGS在外观质量和几何结构方面始终优于最先进的方法。消融研究验证了我们关键设计的有效性。代码将在接收后发布于：https://github.com/IRMVLab/Local-EndoGS。
tldr: The paper introduces Local-EndoGS, a novel framework for high-quality 4D reconstruction of deformable surgical scenes from monocular endoscopic videos with arbitrary camera motion, addressing limitations of existing methods that rely on stereo depth priors or accurate structure-from-motion.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为Local-EndoGS的新框架，用于从具有任意相机运动的单目内窥镜视频中高质量地进行可变形手术场景的4D重建，解决了现有方法依赖立体深度先验或精确的结构-运动推断的局限性。

title: Cross Pseudo Labeling For Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Weakly supervised video anomaly detection aims to detect anomalies and identify abnormal categories with only video-level labels. We propose CPL-VAD, a dual-branch framework with cross pseudo labeling. The binary anomaly detection branch focuses on snippet-level anomaly localization, while the category classification branch leverages vision-language alignment to recognize abnormal event categories. By exchanging pseudo labels, the two branches transfer complementary strengths, combining temporal precision with semantic discrimination. Experiments on XD-Violence and UCF-Crime demonstrate that CPL-VAD achieves state-of-the-art performance in both anomaly detection and abnormal category classification.
summary_zh: 弱监督视频异常检测旨在仅利用视频级别标签来检测异常并识别异常类别。 我们提出 CPL-VAD，一个带有交叉伪标签的双分支框架。 二元异常检测分支专注于片段级别的异常定位，而类别分类分支利用视觉-语言对齐来识别异常事件类别。 通过交换伪标签，这两个分支传递互补优势，将时间精度与语义区分相结合。 在 XD-Violence 和 UCF-Crime 上的实验表明，CPL-VAD 在异常检测和异常类别分类方面都达到了最先进的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces CPL-VAD, a dual-branch framework with cross pseudo labeling for weakly supervised video anomaly detection and abnormal category classification, achieving state-of-the-art performance on XD-Violence and UCF-Crime.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为CPL-VAD的双分支框架，该框架采用交叉伪标签方法，用于弱监督视频异常检测和异常类别分类，并在XD-Violence和UCF-Crime数据集上取得了最先进的性能。

title: Cholec80-port: A Geometrically Consistent Trocar Port Segmentation Dataset for Robust Surgical Scene Understanding
summary: Trocar ports are camera-fixed, pseudo-static structures that can persistently occlude laparoscopic views and attract disproportionate feature points due to specular, textured surfaces. This makes ports particularly detrimental to geometry-based downstream pipelines such as image stitching, 3D reconstruction, and visual SLAM, where dynamic or non-anatomical outliers degrade alignment and tracking stability. Despite this practical importance, explicit port labels are rare in public surgical datasets, and existing annotations often violate geometric consistency by masking the central lumen (opening), even when anatomical regions are visible through it. We present Cholec80-port, a high-fidelity trocar port segmentation dataset derived from Cholec80, together with a rigorous standard operating procedure (SOP) that defines a port-sleeve mask excluding the central opening. We additionally cleanse and unify existing public datasets under the same SOP. Experiments demonstrate that geometrically consistent annotations substantially improve cross-dataset robustness beyond what dataset size alone provides.
summary_zh: 套管端口（Trocar ports）是相机固定的伪静态结构，由于其镜面、纹理化的表面，会持续遮挡腹腔镜视野并吸引不成比例的特征点。这使得端口对于基于几何的下游流程（如图像拼接、3D重建和视觉SLAM）尤其不利，因为动态或非解剖学异常值会降低对齐和跟踪的稳定性。尽管其具有实际重要性，但公开手术数据集中显式的端口标签很少，并且现有的标注常常违背几何一致性，即使通过端口中央管腔（开口）可以看到解剖区域，也会将其遮蔽。我们提出了Cholec80-port，这是一个从Cholec80衍生出的高质量套管端口分割数据集，以及定义了排除中央开口的端口套筒掩模的严格的标准操作程序（SOP）。我们还按照相同的SOP清理和统一了现有的公共数据集。实验表明，在数据集大小之外，几何一致性的标注能显著提高跨数据集的鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces Cholec80-port, a geometrically consistent trocar port segmentation dataset for surgical scenes, addressing the lack of accurate port annotations and their negative impact on geometry-based surgical pipelines. They also standardize existing datasets under the same protocol and demonstrate improved cross-dataset robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 Cholec80-port，一个几何一致的套管端口分割数据集，用于手术场景理解。该数据集旨在解决缺乏准确端口标注的问题，并改善其对基于几何的手术流程（如图像拼接和三维重建）的负面影响。作者还统一了现有数据集的标准，并展示了其在跨数据集上的鲁棒性提升。

title: HS-3D-NeRF: 3D Surface and Hyperspectral Reconstruction From Stationary Hyperspectral Images Using Multi-Channel NeRFs
summary: Advances in hyperspectral imaging (HSI) and 3D reconstruction have enabled accurate, high-throughput characterization of agricultural produce quality and plant phenotypes, both essential for advancing agricultural sustainability and breeding programs. HSI captures detailed biochemical features of produce, while 3D geometric data substantially improves morphological analysis. However, integrating these two modalities at scale remains challenging, as conventional approaches involve complex hardware setups incompatible with automated phenotyping systems. Recent advances in neural radiance fields (NeRF) offer computationally efficient 3D reconstruction but typically require moving-camera setups, limiting throughput and reproducibility in standard indoor agricultural environments. To address these challenges, we introduce HSI-SC-NeRF, a stationary-camera multi-channel NeRF framework for high-throughput hyperspectral 3D reconstruction targeting postharvest inspection of agricultural produce. Multi-view hyperspectral data is captured using a stationary camera while the object rotates within a custom-built Teflon imaging chamber providing diffuse, uniform illumination. Object poses are estimated via ArUco calibration markers and transformed to the camera frame of reference through simulated pose transformations, enabling standard NeRF training on stationary-camera data. A multi-channel NeRF formulation optimizes reconstruction across all hyperspectral bands jointly using a composite spectral loss, supported by a two-stage training protocol that decouples geometric initialization from radiometric refinement. Experiments on three agricultural produce samples demonstrate high spatial reconstruction accuracy and strong spectral fidelity across the visible and near-infrared spectrum, confirming the suitability of HSI-SC-NeRF for integration into automated agricultural workflows.
summary_zh: 高光谱成像（HSI）和三维重建技术的进步，实现了对农产品质量和植物表型进行准确、高通量的表征，这对促进农业可持续性和育种计划至关重要。高光谱成像能够捕捉农产品的详细生化特征，而三维几何数据则显著提升了形态分析能力。然而，大规模整合这两种模态仍然具有挑战性，因为传统方法需要复杂的硬件设置，与自动化表型分析系统不兼容。近年来，神经辐射场（NeRF）的进展提供了计算效率高的三维重建方法，但通常需要移动式摄像机设置，限制了标准室内农业环境中的吞吐量和可重复性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了HSI-SC-NeRF，这是一种面向农产品采后检测的高通量高光谱三维重建的固定式摄像机多通道NeRF框架。使用固定式摄像机捕获多视角高光谱数据，同时对象在定制的聚四氟乙烯成像室内旋转，从而提供漫射、均匀的光照。对象姿态通过ArUco校准标记进行估计，并通过模拟姿态变换转换到相机参考系中，从而能够在固定式摄像机采集的数据上进行标准的NeRF训练。一种多通道NeRF公式使用复合光谱损失联合优化所有高光谱波段的重建，该优化得到两阶段训练协议的支持，该协议将几何初始化与辐射度精细化解耦。针对三种农产品样本的实验证明，该方法在可见光和近红外光谱范围内具有较高的空间重建精度和较强的光谱保真度，证实了HSI-SC-NeRF适合集成到自动化农业工作流程中。
tldr: The paper introduces HSI-SC-NeRF, a novel stationary-camera multi-channel NeRF framework for high-throughput hyperspectral 3D reconstruction of agricultural produce, enabling automated phenotyping workflows.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 HSI-SC-NeRF，一种用于农产品高通量高光谱 3D 重建的新型固定相机多通道 NeRF 框架，从而实现自动表型分析工作流程。

title: RLGT: A reinforcement learning framework for extremal graph theory
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a subfield of machine learning that focuses on developing models that can autonomously learn optimal decision-making strategies over time. In a recent pioneering paper, Wagner demonstrated how the Deep Cross-Entropy RL method can be applied to tackle various problems from extremal graph theory by reformulating them as combinatorial optimization problems. Subsequently, many researchers became interested in refining and extending the framework introduced by Wagner, thereby creating various RL environments specialized for graph theory. Moreover, a number of problems from extremal graph theory were solved through the use of RL. In particular, several inequalities concerning the Laplacian spectral radius of graphs were refuted, new lower bounds were obtained for certain Ramsey numbers, and contributions were made to the Turán-type extremal problem in which the forbidden structures are cycles of length three and four. Here, we present Reinforcement Learning for Graph Theory (RLGT), a novel RL framework that systematizes the previous work and provides support for both undirected and directed graphs, with or without loops, and with an arbitrary number of edge colors. The framework efficiently represents graphs and aims to facilitate future RL-based research in extremal graph theory through optimized computational performance and a clean and modular design.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）是机器学习的一个子领域，专注于开发能够自主学习随时间推移的最佳决策策略的模型。在最近一篇开创性的论文中，Wagner 展示了如何通过将极值图论中的各种问题重新表述为组合优化问题，来应用深度交叉熵 RL 方法解决这些问题。随后，许多研究人员对完善和扩展 Wagner 提出的框架产生了兴趣，从而创建了各种专门用于图论的 RL 环境。此外，通过使用 RL 解决了一系列极值图论中的问题。特别地，一些关于图的拉普拉斯谱半径的不等式被证伪，获得了某些拉姆齐数的新下界，并对禁止结构为长度为三和四的环的 Turán 型极值问题做出了贡献。本文提出了图论强化学习 (RLGT)，这是一个新颖的 RL 框架，系统化了先前的工作，并为有向图和无向图（无论是否带有环），以及任意数量的边着色提供了支持。该框架能够高效地表示图，旨在通过优化的计算性能以及简洁和模块化的设计，促进未来基于 RL 的极值图论研究。
tldr: The paper introduces RLGT, a novel reinforcement learning framework for solving problems in extremal graph theory, supporting various graph types and optimized for computational performance and modularity.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为RLGT的新型强化学习框架，用于解决极值图论中的问题，支持各种图类型，并针对计算性能和模块化进行了优化。

title: Anti-causal domain generalization: Leveraging unlabeled data
summary: The problem of domain generalization concerns learning predictive models that are robust to distribution shifts when deployed in new, previously unseen environments. Existing methods typically require labeled data from multiple training environments, limiting their applicability when labeled data are scarce. In this work, we study domain generalization in an anti-causal setting, where the outcome causes the observed covariates. Under this structure, environment perturbations that affect the covariates do not propagate to the outcome, which motivates regularizing the model's sensitivity to these perturbations. Crucially, estimating these perturbation directions does not require labels, enabling us to leverage unlabeled data from multiple environments. We propose two methods that penalize the model's sensitivity to variations in the mean and covariance of the covariates across environments, respectively, and prove that these methods have worst-case optimality guarantees under certain classes of environments. Finally, we demonstrate the empirical performance of our approach on a controlled physical system and a physiological signal dataset.
summary_zh: 领域泛化问题关注的是学习对部署在新环境中、先前未见的环境中时，对分布偏移具有鲁棒性的预测模型。现有方法通常需要来自多个训练环境的带标签数据，当带标签数据稀缺时，这限制了它们的适用性。在这项工作中，我们研究了反因果设置下的领域泛化，其中结果导致观察到的协变量。在这种结构下，影响协变量的环境扰动不会传播到结果，这促使我们对模型对这些扰动的敏感性进行正则化。关键的是，估计这些扰动方向不需要标签，使我们能够利用来自多个环境的无标签数据。我们提出了两种方法，分别惩罚模型对协变量在不同环境中的均值和协方差变化的敏感性，并证明了这些方法在某些环境类别下具有最坏情况下的最优性保证。最后，我们在一个受控物理系统和一个生理信号数据集上展示了我们方法的经验性能。
tldr: This paper addresses domain generalization in an anti-causal setting by leveraging unlabeled data to regularize model sensitivity to environment perturbations, showing promising results on a physical system and a physiological signal dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了反因果关系下的领域泛化问题，通过利用无标签数据来规范模型对环境扰动的敏感性，并在物理系统和生理信号数据集上展示了良好的结果。

title: Spatio-temporal dual-stage hypergraph MARL for human-centric multimodal corridor traffic signal control
summary: Human-centric traffic signal control in corridor networks must increasingly account for multimodal travelers, particularly high-occupancy public transportation, rather than focusing solely on vehicle-centric performance. This paper proposes STDSH-MARL (Spatio-Temporal Dual-Stage Hypergraph based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning), a scalable multi-agent deep reinforcement learning framework that follows a centralized training and decentralized execution paradigm. The proposed method captures spatio-temporal dependencies through a novel dual-stage hypergraph attention mechanism that models interactions across both spatial and temporal hyperedges. In addition, a hybrid discrete action space is introduced to jointly determine the next signal phase configuration and its corresponding green duration, enabling more adaptive signal timing decisions. Experiments conducted on a corridor network under five traffic scenarios demonstrate that STDSH-MARL consistently improves multimodal performance and provides clear benefits for public transportation priority. Compared with state-of-the-art baseline methods, the proposed approach achieves superior overall performance. Further ablation studies confirm the contribution of each component of STDSH-MARL, with temporal hyperedges identified as the most influential factor driving the observed performance gains.
summary_zh:
摘要：
走廊网络中以人为中心的交通信号控制必须日益重视多模式出行者，特别是高载客率的公共交通，而不能仅仅关注以车辆为中心的性能。本文提出了一种可扩展的多智能体深度强化学习框架 STDSH-MARL (基于时空双阶段超图的多智能体强化学习)，该框架遵循集中式训练和分散式执行范式。所提出的方法通过一种新颖的双阶段超图注意力机制来捕捉时空依赖性，该机制对空间和时间超边上的交互进行建模。此外，引入了一种混合离散动作空间，以联合确定下一个信号相位配置及其相应的绿灯时长，从而实现更具适应性的信号配时决策。在五个交通场景下对走廊网络进行的实验表明，STDSH-MARL 始终能够提高多模式性能，并为公共交通优先提供明显的优势。与最先进的基线方法相比，所提出的方法实现了卓越的整体性能。进一步的消融研究证实了 STDSH-MARL 每个组成部分的贡献，其中时间超边被认为是驱动观察到的性能提升的最关键因素。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel multi-agent deep reinforcement learning framework (STDSH-MARL) for human-centric multimodal traffic signal control, utilizing a dual-stage hypergraph attention mechanism and a hybrid discrete action space to improve public transportation priority and overall traffic performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的多智能体深度强化学习框架(STDSH-MARL)，用于以人为中心的多模式交通信号控制。该框架采用双阶段超图注意力机制和混合离散动作空间，以提高公共交通优先权和整体交通性能。

title: Bluetooth Phased-array Aided Inertial Navigation Using Factor Graphs: Experimental Verification
summary: Phased-array Bluetooth systems have emerged as a low-cost alternative for performing aided inertial navigation in GNSS-denied use cases such as warehouse logistics, drone landings, and autonomous docking. Basing a navigation system off of commercial-off-the-shelf components may reduce the barrier of entry for phased-array radio navigation systems, albeit at the cost of significantly noisier measurements and relatively short feasible range. In this paper, we compare robust estimation strategies for a factor graph optimisation-based estimator using experimental data collected from multirotor drone flight. We evaluate performance in loss-of-GNSS scenarios when aided by Bluetooth angular measurements, as well as range or barometric pressure.
summary_zh: 相控阵蓝牙系统已成为在GNSS拒止场景（如仓库物流、无人机降落和自主对接）中执行辅助惯性导航的一种低成本替代方案。基于商用现成组件构建导航系统可以降低相控阵无线电导航系统的入门门槛，但代价是测量噪声显著增加且可行范围相对较短。在本文中，我们比较了基于因子图优化估计器的鲁棒估计策略，该估计器使用从多旋翼无人机飞行中收集的实验数据。我们评估了在蓝牙角度测量、距离测量或气压辅助下，GNSS信号丢失场景中的导航性能。
tldr: This paper explores robust estimation strategies for inertial navigation using Bluetooth phased-arrays, range, and barometric pressure in GNSS-denied environments, evaluating performance with experimental drone flight data.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了在GNSS拒止环境下，使用蓝牙相控阵、测距和气压的高度测量的数据，实现了鲁棒的惯性导航估计策略，并通过实验性无人机飞行数据评估了性能。

title: Patch-Based Spatial Authorship Attribution in Human-Robot Collaborative Paintings
summary: As agentic AI becomes increasingly involved in creative production, documenting authorship has become critical for artists, collectors, and legal contexts. We present a patch-based framework for spatial authorship attribution within human-robot collaborative painting practice, demonstrated through a forensic case study of one human artist and one robotic system across 15 abstract paintings. Using commodity flatbed scanners and leave-one-painting-out cross-validation, the approach achieves 88.8% patch-level accuracy (86.7% painting-level via majority vote), outperforming texture-based and pretrained-feature baselines (68.0%-84.7%). For collaborative artworks, where ground truth is inherently ambiguous, we use conditional Shannon entropy to quantify stylistic overlap; manually annotated hybrid regions exhibit 64% higher uncertainty than pure paintings (p=0.003), suggesting the model detects mixed authorship rather than classification failure. The trained model is specific to this human-robot pair but provides a methodological grounding for sample-efficient attribution in data-scarce human-AI creative workflows that, in the future, has the potential to extend authorship attribution to any human-robot collaborative painting.
summary_zh: 随着能动人工智能越来越多地参与创意生产，记录作者身份对于艺术家、收藏家和法律界而言至关重要。我们提出了一种基于图像块的空间作者身份归属框架，用于人机协作绘画实践，并通过一项法庭案例研究对一位人类艺术家和一个机器人系统在15幅抽象画作品中的协作进行分析。在商用平板扫描仪和留一画作交叉验证的条件下，该方法实现了88.8%的图像块级别准确率（通过多数投票实现86.7%的画作级别准确率），优于基于纹理的和基于预训练特征的基线方法（68.0%-84.7%）。对于协作艺术品，由于真实标签本身具有模糊性，我们使用条件香农熵来量化风格重叠；手动标注的混合区域的不确定性比纯绘画作品高64%（p=0.003），表明该模型检测到了混合作者身份，而非分类失败。尽管训练后的模型仅适用于该人类-机器人组合，但它为人机创意工作流程中数据稀缺情况下的样本高效归属提供了一个方法学基础，并在未来具有将作者身份归属扩展到任何人机协作绘画的可能性。
tldr: This paper introduces a patch-based method for attributing authorship in human-robot collaborative paintings, demonstrating its effectiveness on a dataset of paintings created by one human and one robot, and quantifying stylistic overlap using conditional Shannon entropy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于图像块的方法，用于识别人类-机器人协作绘画作品的作者身份。该方法在一组由一人一机器人创作的绘画数据集上进行了验证，并通过条件香农熵量化了风格上的重叠。

title: "It's like a pet...but my pet doesn't collect data about me": Multi-person Households' Privacy Design Preferences for Household Robots
summary: Household robots boasting mobility, more sophisticated sensors, and powerful processing models have become increasingly prevalent in the commercial market. However, these features may expose users to unwanted privacy risks, including unsolicited data collection and unauthorized data sharing. While security and privacy researchers thus far have explored people's privacy concerns around household robots, literature investigating people's preferred privacy designs and mitigation strategies is still limited. Additionally, the existing literature has not yet accounted for multi-user perspectives on privacy design and household robots. We aimed to fill this gap by conducting in-person participatory design sessions with 15 households to explore how they would design a privacy-aware household robot based on their concerns and expectations. We found that participants did not trust that robots, or their respective manufacturers, would respect the data privacy of household members or operate in a multi-user ecosystem without jeopardizing users' personal data. Based on these concerns, they generated designs that gave them authority over their data, contained accessible controls and notification systems, and could be customized and tailored to suit the needs and preferences of each user over time. We synthesize our findings into actionable design recommendations for robot manufacturers and developers.
summary_zh: 家庭机器人凭借其移动性、更先进的传感器和强大的处理模型，在商业市场上日益普及。然而，这些特性也可能使使用者面临不必要的隐私风险，包括未经请求的数据收集和未经授权的数据共享。虽然安全和隐私研究人员迄今为止已经探索了人们对家庭机器人隐私的担忧，但研究人们偏好的隐私设计和缓解策略的文献仍然有限。此外，现有文献尚未考虑多用户对隐私设计和家庭机器人的视角。我们旨在通过与15个家庭进行面对面的参与式设计会议来填补这一空白，探索他们将如何根据其担忧和期望来设计一种具有隐私意识的家庭机器人。我们发现，参与者并不信任机器人或其各自的制造商会尊重家庭成员的数据隐私，或在不损害用户个人数据的情况下在多用户生态系统中运行。基于这些担忧，他们设计了赋予其数据权限、包含可访问的控制和通知系统，并可以定制和量身定制以适应每个用户随时间推移的需求和偏好的方案。我们将我们的发现综合成可操作的设计建议，供机器人制造商和开发者参考。
tldr: This paper explores multi-person households' privacy concerns and design preferences for household robots via participatory design sessions, revealing a lack of trust in manufacturers and a desire for user control over data and customization.
tldr_zh: 本文通过参与式设计会议探讨了多人口家庭对家用机器人的隐私担忧和设计偏好，揭示了他们对制造商缺乏信任，并希望用户能够掌控数据并进行定制。

title: "Hello, I'm Delivering. Let Me Pass By": Navigating Public Pathways with Walk-along with Robots in Crowded City Streets
summary: As the presence of autonomous robots in public spaces increases-whether navigating campus walkways or neighborhood sidewalks-understanding how to carefully study these robots becomes critical. While HRI research has conducted field studies in public spaces, these are often limited to controlled experiments with prototype robots or structured observational methods, such as the Wizard of Oz technique. However, the autonomous mobile robots we encounter today, particularly delivery robots, operate beyond the control of researchers, navigating dynamic routes and unpredictable environments. To address this challenge, a more deliberate approach is required. Drawing inspiration from public realm ethnography in urban studies, geography, and sociology, this paper proposes the Walk-Along with Robots (WawR) methodology. We outline the key features of this method, the steps we applied in our study, the unique insights it offers, and the ways it can be evaluated. We hope this paper stimulates further discussion on research methodologies for studying autonomous robots in public spaces.
summary_zh: 随着自主机器人在公共场所的普及——无论是在大学校园的小路上还是在社区的人行道上——理解如何谨慎地研究这些机器人变得至关重要。虽然人机交互（HRI）研究已经在公共场所进行了实地研究，但这些研究通常仅限于使用原型机器人进行的受控实验或结构化的观察方法，例如“绿野仙踪”技术。然而，我们今天遇到的自主移动机器人，特别是送货机器人，其运行超出了研究人员的控制范围，在动态路线和不可预测的环境中导航。为了应对这一挑战，需要一种更谨慎的方法。借鉴城市研究、地理学和社会学中公共领域人种学的灵感，本文提出了“跟随机器人同行”（Walk-Along with Robots, WawR）的方法论。我们概述了该方法论的关键特征、我们在研究中应用的步骤、它提供的独特见解以及可以评估它的方式。我们希望本文能够激发对研究公共场所自主机器人的研究方法进行进一步讨论。
tldr: This paper introduces the 'Walk-Along with Robots' (WawR) methodology for studying autonomous robots in uncontrolled public spaces, drawing inspiration from ethnographic methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为“与机器人同行”(WawR)的方法，该方法借鉴了民族志方法，用于研究在不受控制的公共空间中的自主机器人。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Portfolio Allocation: A Comparative Study with Mean-Variance Optimization
summary:
Portfolio Management is the process of overseeing a group of investments, referred to as a portfolio, with the objective of achieving predetermined investment goals. Portfolio optimization is a key component that involves allocating the portfolio assets so as to maximize returns while minimizing risk taken. It is typically carried out by financial professionals who use a combination of quantitative techniques and investment expertise to make decisions about the portfolio allocation.
  Recent applications of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) have shown promising results when used to optimize portfolio allocation by training model-free agents on historical market data. Many of these methods compare their results against basic benchmarks or other state-of-the-art DRL agents but often fail to compare their performance against traditional methods used by financial professionals in practical settings. One of the most commonly used methods for this task is Mean-Variance Portfolio Optimization (MVO), which uses historical time series information to estimate expected asset returns and covariances, which are then used to optimize for an investment objective.
  Our work is a thorough comparison between model-free DRL and MVO for optimal portfolio allocation. We detail the specifics of how to make DRL for portfolio optimization work in practice, also noting the adjustments needed for MVO. Backtest results demonstrate strong performance of the DRL agent across many metrics, including Sharpe ratio, maximum drawdowns, and absolute returns.
summary_zh:
投资组合管理是指监督一组投资（称为投资组合）的过程，其目标是实现预定的投资目标。投资组合优化是一个关键组成部分，它涉及分配投资组合资产，以在承担的风险最小化的同时最大化回报。它通常由金融专业人士执行，他们利用量化技术和投资专业知识相结合来做出关于投资组合配置的决策。

深度强化学习（DRL）的最新应用在用于通过在历史市场数据上训练无模型代理来优化投资组合配置方面显示出令人鼓舞的结果。许多这些方法将其结果与基本基准或其他最先进的DRL代理进行比较，但通常未能将其性能与金融专业人士在实际环境中使用的传统方法进行比较。最常用的方法之一是均值-方差投资组合优化（MVO），它使用历史时间序列信息来估计预期资产收益和协方差，然后将其用于优化投资目标。

我们的工作是对无模型DRL和MVO在最优投资组合配置方面进行的全面比较。我们详细说明了如何在实践中使DRL用于投资组合优化，并注意到MVO所需的调整。回测结果表明，DRL代理在许多指标上表现出色，包括夏普比率、最大回撤和绝对收益。
tldr: This paper compares Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) and Mean-Variance Optimization (MVO) for portfolio allocation, demonstrating strong performance of DRL agents based on backtesting.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了深度强化学习(DRL)和均值-方差优化(MVO)在投资组合分配中的应用，并通过回测显示DRL代理具有优异的表现。

title: A Multi-modal Detection System for Infrastructure-based Freight Signal Priority
summary: Freight vehicles approaching signalized intersections require reliable detection and motion estimation to support infrastructure-based Freight Signal Priority (FSP). Accurate and timely perception of vehicle type, position, and speed is essential for enabling effective priority control strategies. This paper presents the design, deployment, and evaluation of an infrastructure-based multi-modal freight vehicle detection system integrating LiDAR and camera sensors. A hybrid sensing architecture is adopted, consisting of an intersection-mounted subsystem and a midblock subsystem, connected via wireless communication for synchronized data transmission. The perception pipeline incorporates both clustering-based and deep learning-based detection methods with Kalman filter tracking to achieve stable real-time performance. LiDAR measurements are registered into geodetic reference frames to support lane-level localization and consistent vehicle tracking. Field evaluations demonstrate that the system can reliably monitor freight vehicle movements at high spatio-temporal resolution. The design and deployment provide practical insights for developing infrastructure-based sensing systems to support FSP applications.
summary_zh: 接近信号交叉口的货运车辆需要可靠的检测和运动估计来支持基于基础设施的货运信号优先(FSP)。准确且及时的车辆类型、位置和速度感知对于实现有效的优先控制策略至关重要。本文介绍了基于基础设施的多模态货运车辆检测系统的设计、部署和评估，该系统集成了激光雷达和摄像头传感器。采用了一种混合感知架构，包括一个安装在交叉路口的子系统和一个路段中间的子系统，通过无线通信连接，用于同步数据传输。感知流程结合了基于聚类和基于深度学习的检测方法，并采用卡尔曼滤波跟踪，以实现稳定的实时性能。激光雷达测量数据被注册到大地坐标系中，以支持车道级定位和一致的车辆跟踪。现场评估表明，该系统能够以高时空分辨率可靠地监测货运车辆的移动。该设计和部署为开发基于基础设施的感知系统以支持FSP应用提供了实践见解。
tldr: This paper presents a multi-modal (LiDAR and camera) infrastructure-based system for freight vehicle detection and tracking to support Freight Signal Priority (FSP) applications, achieving real-time lane-level localization.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于多模态（激光雷达和相机）基础设施的货运车辆检测和跟踪系统，以支持货运信号优先（FSP）应用，实现了实时的车道级定位。

title: When More Experts Hurt: Underfitting in Multi-Expert Learning to Defer
summary: Learning to Defer (L2D) enables a classifier to abstain from predictions and defer to an expert, and has recently been extended to multi-expert settings. In this work, we show that multi-expert L2D is fundamentally more challenging than the single-expert case. With multiple experts, the classifier's underfitting becomes inherent, which seriously degrades prediction performance, whereas in the single-expert setting it arises only under specific conditions. We theoretically reveal that this stems from an intrinsic expert identifiability issue: learning which expert to trust from a diverse pool, a problem absent in the single-expert case and renders existing underfitting remedies failed. To tackle this issue, we propose PiCCE (Pick the Confident and Correct Expert), a surrogate-based method that adaptively identifies a reliable expert based on empirical evidence. PiCCE effectively reduces multi-expert L2D to a single-expert-like learning problem, thereby resolving multi expert underfitting. We further prove its statistical consistency and ability to recover class probabilities and expert accuracies. Extensive experiments across diverse settings, including real-world expert scenarios, validate our theoretical results and demonstrate improved performance.
summary_zh: 学习推迟（L2D）使分类器能够避免预测并推迟到专家，并且最近已被扩展到多专家设置。在这项工作中，我们表明多专家L2D在本质上比单专家情况更具挑战性。对于多个专家，分类器的欠拟合变得内在固有，这严重降低了预测性能，而在单专家设置中，它仅在特定条件下出现。我们从理论上揭示，这源于一个内在的专家可识别性问题：从不同的专家池中学习信任哪个专家，这个问题在单专家情况下不存在，并且使得现有的欠拟合补救措施失效。为了解决这个问题，我们提出 PiCCE（选择自信且正确的专家），这是一种基于代理的方法，可以根据经验证据自适应地识别可靠的专家。PiCCE有效地将多专家 L2D 简化为类似于单专家的学习问题，从而解决了多专家欠拟合问题。我们进一步证明了它的统计一致性以及恢复类别概率和专家准确性的能力。跨多种设置（包括真实世界的专家场景）的大量实验验证了我们的理论结果并证明了性能的提高。
tldr: The paper addresses the underfitting problem in multi-expert Learning to Defer (L2D) scenarios caused by expert identifiability issues and proposes PiCCE, a surrogate-based method, to improve performance by effectively reducing the problem to a single-expert setting.
tldr_zh: 该论文解决了多专家延迟学习 (L2D) 场景中由于专家可识别性问题引起的欠拟合问题，并提出了一种基于代理的方法 PiCCE，通过有效地将问题简化为单专家设置来提高性能。

title: Proximal powered knee placement: a case study
summary: Lower limb amputation affects millions worldwide, leading to impaired mobility, reduced walking speed, and limited participation in daily and social activities. Powered prosthetic knees can partially restore mobility by actively assisting knee joint torque, improving gait symmetry, sit-to-stand transitions, and walking speed. However, added mass from powered components may diminish these benefits, negatively affecting gait mechanics and increasing metabolic cost. Consequently, optimizing mass distribution, rather than simply minimizing total mass, may provide a more effective and practical solution. In this exploratory study, we evaluated the feasibility of above-knee powertrain placement for a powered prosthetic knee in a small cohort. Compared to below-knee placement, the above-knee configuration demonstrated improved walking speed (+9.2% for one participant) and cadence (+3.6%), with mixed effects on gait symmetry. Kinematic measures indicated similar knee range of motion and peak velocity across configurations. Additional testing on ramps and stairs confirmed the robustness of the control strategy across multiple locomotion tasks. These preliminary findings suggest that above-knee placement is functionally feasible and that careful mass distribution can preserve the benefits of powered assistance while mitigating adverse effects of added weight. Further studies are needed to confirm these trends and guide design and clinical recommendations.
summary_zh: 下肢截肢影响着全球数百万人，导致行动受损、行走速度降低以及日常和社交活动参与受限。 动力假膝可以通过主动辅助膝关节力矩来部分恢复行动能力，改善步态对称性、坐站转换和行走速度。 然而，来自动力部件的额外质量可能会削弱这些益处，对步态力学产生负面影响并增加代谢成本。 因此，优化质量分布，而不是简单地最小化总质量，可能提供一个更有效和实用的解决方案。 在这项探索性研究中，我们评估了小样本人群中动力假膝的膝上动力总成布局的可行性。 与膝下布局相比，膝上配置显示出改进的行走速度（一名参与者提升+9.2%）和步频（+3.6%），对步态对称性的影响不一。 运动学测量表明，两种配置下膝关节活动范围和峰值速度相似。 在坡道和楼梯上进行的额外测试证实了控制策略在多种运动任务中的稳健性。 这些初步发现表明，膝上布局在功能上是可行的，而且精心的质量分布可以在减轻额外重量的负面影响的同时，保留动力辅助的益处。 还需要进一步的研究来证实这些趋势，并指导设计和临床建议。
tldr: This paper investigates the feasibility of placing the powertrain of a powered prosthetic knee above the knee instead of below, finding potential improvements in walking speed and cadence, suggesting optimized mass distribution is key for powered prosthetics.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了动力假肢膝关节的动力总成置于膝盖上方而非下方的可行性，发现步行速度和步频可能得以提高，表明优化质量分布是动力假肢的关键。

title: SimVLA: A Simple VLA Baseline for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robotic manipulation, leveraging large-scale pre-training to achieve strong performance. The field has rapidly evolved with additional spatial priors and diverse architectural innovations. However, these advancements are often accompanied by varying training recipes and implementation details, which can make it challenging to disentangle the precise source of empirical gains. In this work, we introduce SimVLA, a streamlined baseline designed to establish a transparent reference point for VLA research. By strictly decoupling perception from control, using a standard vision-language backbone and a lightweight action head, and standardizing critical training dynamics, we demonstrate that a minimal design can achieve state-of-the-art performance. Despite having only 0.5B parameters, SimVLA outperforms multi-billion-parameter models on standard simulation benchmarks without robot pretraining. SimVLA also reaches on-par real-robot performance compared to pi0.5. Our results establish SimVLA as a robust, reproducible baseline that enables clear attribution of empirical gains to future architectural innovations. Website: https://frontierrobo.github.io/SimVLA
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为一种有前景的通用机器人操作范例，利用大规模预训练来实现强大的性能。该领域随着额外的空间先验和多样化的架构创新而迅速发展。然而，这些进步通常伴随着不同的训练方案和实现细节，这使得分辨经验收益的精确来源具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们引入了SimVLA，一个简化的基线，旨在为VLA研究建立一个透明的参考点。通过严格地将感知与控制解耦，使用标准的视觉-语言骨干网络和轻量级的动作头，并标准化关键的训练动态，我们证明了一种最小的设计可以实现最先进的性能。尽管只有0.5B参数，但SimVLA在标准模拟基准测试中优于数十亿参数的模型，且没有进行机器人预训练。SimVLA也在实际机器人上达到了与pi0.5相当的性能。我们的结果将SimVLA确立为一个稳健、可复现的基线，能够清晰地将经验收益归因于未来的架构创新。网站：https://frontierrobo.github.io/SimVLA
tldr: SimVLA introduces a simplified, state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) baseline for robotic manipulation, demonstrating that a minimal design can outperform larger models on standard simulated tasks and achieve comparable performance on real robots.
tldr_zh: SimVLA 提出了一个简化的、最先进的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 基线模型，用于机器人操作。该模型表明，最小的设计可以在标准模拟任务上优于更大的模型，并在真实机器人上实现相当的性能。

title: When Vision Overrides Language: Evaluating and Mitigating Counterfactual Failures in VLAs
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) promise to ground language instructions in robot control, yet in practice often fail to faithfully follow language. When presented with instructions that lack strong scene-specific supervision, VLAs suffer from counterfactual failures: they act based on vision shortcuts induced by dataset biases, repeatedly executing well-learned behaviors and selecting objects frequently seen during training regardless of language intent. To systematically study it, we introduce LIBERO-CF, the first counterfactual benchmark for VLAs that evaluates language following capability by assigning alternative instructions under visually plausible LIBERO layouts. Our evaluation reveals that counterfactual failures are prevalent yet underexplored across state-of-the-art VLAs. We propose Counterfactual Action Guidance (CAG), a simple yet effective dual-branch inference scheme that explicitly regularizes language conditioning in VLAs. CAG combines a standard VLA policy with a language-unconditioned Vision-Action (VA) module, enabling counterfactual comparison during action selection. This design reduces reliance on visual shortcuts, improves robustness on under-observed tasks, and requires neither additional demonstrations nor modifications to existing architectures or pretrained models. Extensive experiments demonstrate its plug-and-play integration across diverse VLAs and consistent improvements. For example, on LIBERO-CF, CAG improves $π_{0.5}$ by 9.7% in language following accuracy and 3.6% in task success on under-observed tasks using a training-free strategy, with further gains of 15.5% and 8.5%, respectively, when paired with a VA model. In real-world evaluations, CAG reduces counterfactual failures of 9.4% and improves task success by 17.2% on average.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行动模型 (VLAs) 有望将语言指令植根于机器人控制中，但实际上往往无法忠实地遵循语言。当呈现缺少强场景特定监督的指令时，VLAs 会遭受反事实失败：它们基于数据集偏差引入的视觉捷径采取行动，重复执行良好学习的行为，并选择训练期间经常看到的物体，而忽略语言意图。为了系统地研究这一点，我们引入了 LIBERO-CF，这是第一个用于 VLAs 的反事实基准，它通过在视觉上合理的 LIBERO 布局下分配替代指令来评估语言遵循能力。我们的评估揭示了反事实失败在最先进的 VLAs 中普遍存在，但尚未得到充分探索。我们提出了一种反事实行动引导 (CAG)，这是一种简单而有效的双分支推理方案，它显式地正则化了 VLAs 中的语言条件化。CAG 将标准 VLA 策略与不依赖语言条件的视觉-行动 (VA) 模块相结合，从而能够在行动选择期间进行反事实比较。这种设计减少了对视觉捷径的依赖，提高了在观测不足任务上的鲁棒性，并且不需要额外的演示数据，也不需要修改现有的架构或预训练模型。大量的实验证明了其在各种 VLAs 中的即插即用集成和持续改进。例如，在LIBERO-CF 上，CAG 通过无训练策略，在使用 VA 模型时，在语言遵循准确率上将 $π_{0.5}$ 提高了 9.7%，在观测不足任务上的任务成功率提高了 3.6%，并且分别进一步获得了15.5% 和 8.5% 的提升。在真实世界的评估中，CAG 平均减少了 9.4% 的反事实失败，并将任务成功率提高了 17.2%。
tldr: The paper identifies and mitigates counterfactual failures in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models where VLAs act based on visual shortcuts rather than language intent, using a new benchmark and a Counterfactual Action Guidance (CAG) inference scheme to improve language following accuracy and task success.
tldr_zh: 该论文识别并缓解了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的反事实失败，即VLA模型根据视觉捷径而非语言意图执行动作。论文提出了一个新的基准测试和一个反事实动作指导（CAG）推理方案，以提高语言跟随的准确性和任务成功率。

title: Zero-shot Interactive Perception
summary: Interactive perception (IP) enables robots to extract hidden information in their workspace and execute manipulation plans by physically interacting with objects and altering the state of the environment -- crucial for resolving occlusions and ambiguity in complex, partially observable scenarios. We present Zero-Shot IP (ZS-IP), a novel framework that couples multi-strategy manipulation (pushing and grasping) with a memory-driven Vision Language Model (VLM) to guide robotic interactions and resolve semantic queries. ZS-IP integrates three key components: (1) an Enhanced Observation (EO) module that augments the VLM's visual perception with both conventional keypoints and our proposed pushlines -- a novel 2D visual augmentation tailored to pushing actions, (2) a memory-guided action module that reinforces semantic reasoning through context lookup, and (3) a robotic controller that executes pushing, pulling, or grasping based on VLM output. Unlike grid-based augmentations optimized for pick-and-place, pushlines capture affordances for contact-rich actions, substantially improving pushing performance. We evaluate ZS-IP on a 7-DOF Franka Panda arm across diverse scenes with varying occlusions and task complexities. Our experiments demonstrate that ZS-IP outperforms passive and viewpoint-based perception techniques such as Mark-Based Visual Prompting (MOKA), particularly in pushing tasks, while preserving the integrity of non-target elements.
summary_zh: 交互式感知（IP）使机器人能够通过与物体进行物理交互并改变环境状态来提取工作空间中的隐藏信息并执行操作计划——这对于解决复杂、部分可观察场景中的遮挡和模糊性至关重要。我们提出了零样本交互式感知（ZS-IP），这是一个新颖的框架，它将多策略操作（推和抓取）与记忆驱动的视觉语言模型（VLM）相结合，以指导机器人交互并解决语义查询。ZS-IP集成了三个关键组件：（1）增强观察（EO）模块，该模块通过常规关键点和我们提出的推线（一种专为推操作量身定制的新颖2D视觉增强）来增强VLM的视觉感知，（2）记忆引导的操作模块，通过上下文查找来增强语义推理，以及（3）一个机器人控制器，根据VLM的输出来执行推、拉或抓取动作。与针对拾放操作优化的基于网格的增强不同，推线捕获了富接触操作的容度，从而显着提高了推的性能。我们在一个7自由度的Franka Panda机械臂上，在具有不同遮挡和任务复杂度的各种场景中评估了ZS-IP。我们的实验表明，ZS-IP优于被动和基于视点的感知技术，例如基于标记的视觉提示（MOKA），尤其是在推任务中，同时保持非目标元素的完整性。
tldr: The paper introduces Zero-Shot IP (ZS-IP), a framework that combines multi-strategy manipulation (pushing and grasping) with a memory-driven Vision Language Model (VLM) to enable robots to interact with objects and resolve semantic queries in complex, partially observable environments, particularly excelling in pushing tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Zero-Shot IP (ZS-IP)，它结合了多策略操作（推和抓）与记忆驱动的视觉语言模型（VLM），使机器人能够在复杂、部分可观察的环境中与物体交互并解决语义查询，尤其擅长于推的动作。

title: Learning Smooth Time-Varying Linear Policies with an Action Jacobian Penalty
summary: Reinforcement learning provides a framework for learning control policies that can reproduce diverse motions for simulated characters. However, such policies often exploit unnatural high-frequency signals that are unachievable by humans or physical robots, making them poor representations of real-world behaviors. Existing work addresses this issue by adding a reward term that penalizes a large change in actions over time. This term often requires substantial tuning efforts. We propose to use the action Jacobian penalty, which penalizes changes in action with respect to the changes in simulated state directly through auto differentiation. This effectively eliminates unrealistic high-frequency control signals without task specific tuning. While effective, the action Jacobian penalty introduces significant computational overhead when used with traditional fully connected neural network architectures. To mitigate this, we introduce a new architecture called a Linear Policy Net (LPN) that significantly reduces the computational burden for calculating the action Jacobian penalty during training. In addition, a LPN requires no parameter tuning, exhibits faster learning convergence compared to baseline methods, and can be more efficiently queried during inference time compared to a fully connected neural network. We demonstrate that a Linear Policy Net, combined with the action Jacobian penalty, is able to learn policies that generate smooth signals while solving a number of motion imitation tasks with different characteristics, including dynamic motions such as a backflip and various challenging parkour skills. Finally, we apply this approach to create policies for dynamic motions on a physical quadrupedal robot equipped with an arm.
summary_zh:
摘要：
强化学习提供了一种学习控制策略的框架，该策略可以为模拟角色复现各种动作。然而，此类策略通常会利用人类或物理机器人无法实现的不自然的、高频信号，使其成为真实世界行为的不良表示。现有工作通过添加一个奖励项来解决这个问题，该奖励项会惩罚动作随时间的大的变化。该奖励项通常需要大量的调整工作。我们提出使用动作雅可比惩罚，它通过自动微分直接惩罚动作相对于模拟状态变化的改变。这有效地消除了不切实际的高频控制信号，而无需针对特定任务进行调整。虽然有效，但当与传统的全连接神经网络架构一起使用时，动作雅可比惩罚会引入显著的计算开销。为了缓解这个问题，我们引入了一种名为线性策略网络 (LPN) 的新架构，它显著减少了训练期间计算动作雅可比惩罚的计算负担。此外，LPN 不需要参数调整，与基线方法相比表现出更快的学习收敛性，并且在推理时可以更有效地查询，相比于全连接神经网络。 我们证明了线性策略网络与动作雅可比惩罚相结合，能够学习生成平滑信号的策略，同时解决许多具有不同特征的运动模仿任务，包括像后空翻这样的动态运动以及各种具有挑战性的跑酷技能。最后，我们将此方法应用于为配备手臂的物理四足机器人创建动态运动策略。
tldr: This paper introduces a Linear Policy Net (LPN) architecture and action Jacobian penalty to learn smooth, realistic control policies for robots, mitigating the need for task-specific tuning and reducing computational overhead compared to traditional neural networks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种线性策略网络 (LPN) 架构和动作雅可比惩罚，用于学习平滑、真实的机器人控制策略，减少了特定任务调整的需求，并降低了与传统神经网络相比的计算开销。

title: GrandTour: A Legged Robotics Dataset in the Wild for Multi-Modal Perception and State Estimation
