To address these challenges, OpenVO (1) explicitly encodes temporal dynamics information within a two-frame pose regression framework and (2) leverages 3D geometric priors derived from foundation models. We validate our method on three major autonomous-driving benchmarks - KITTI, nuScenes, and Argoverse 2 - achieving more than 20 performance improvement over state-of-the-art approaches. Under varying observation rate settings, our method is significantly more robust, achieving 46%-92% lower errors across all metrics. These results demonstrate the versatility of OpenVO for real-world 3D reconstruction and diverse downstream applications.
summary_zh: 我们提出了OpenVO，一个新颖的开放世界视觉里程计（VO）框架，能够在有限的输入条件下感知时间信息。OpenVO能够有效估计来自单目行车记录仪视频的真实尺度自运动，视频具有不同的观测频率和未经标定的相机，从而能够从行车记录仪中记录的罕见驾驶事件中构建稳健的轨迹数据集。现有的VO方法在固定的观测频率（例如，10Hz或12Hz）下进行训练，完全忽略了时间动态信息。许多先前的方法还需要已知内参的标定相机。因此，当（1）部署在未见过的观测频率下或（2）应用于未经标定的相机时，它们的性能会下降。这些显著限制了它们对许多下游任务的泛化能力，例如从行车记录仪视频中提取轨迹。为了应对这些挑战，OpenVO（1）在一个双帧姿态回归框架中显式地编码时间动态信息，并且（2）利用从基础模型导出的3D几何先验。我们在三个主要的自动驾驶基准测试数据集——KITTI、nuScenes和Argoverse 2——上验证了我们的方法，相比最先进的方法，实现了超过 20% 的性能提升。在不同的观测速率设置下，我们的方法明显更具鲁棒性，在所有指标上的误差降低了46%-92%。这些结果证明了 OpenVO 在真实世界3D重建和各种下游应用中的多功能性。
tldr: OpenVO is a new visual odometry framework that improves ego-motion estimation from monocular dashcam footage with varying frame rates and uncalibrated cameras by encoding temporal dynamics and leveraging 3D geometric priors, achieving significant performance gains on standard datasets.
tldr_zh: OpenVO是一个新的视觉里程计框架，通过编码时间动态和利用3D几何先验，提高了从具有变化帧率和未校准的单目行车记录仪视频中的自我运动估计，并在标准数据集上取得了显著的性能提升。

title: MoBind: Motion Binding for Fine-Grained IMU-Video Pose Alignment
summary: We aim to learn a joint representation between inertial measurement unit (IMU) signals and 2D pose sequences extracted from video, enabling accurate cross-modal retrieval, temporal synchronization, subject and body-part localization, and action recognition. To this end, we introduce MoBind, a hierarchical contrastive learning framework designed to address three challenges: (1) filtering out irrelevant visual background, (2) modeling structured multi-sensor IMU configurations, and (3) achieving fine-grained, sub-second temporal alignment. To isolate motion-relevant cues, MoBind aligns IMU signals with skeletal motion sequences rather than raw pixels. We further decompose full-body motion into local body-part trajectories, pairing each with its corresponding IMU to enable semantically grounded multi-sensor alignment. To capture detailed temporal correspondence, MoBind employs a hierarchical contrastive strategy that first aligns token-level temporal segments, then fuses local (body-part) alignment with global (body-wide) motion aggregation. Evaluated on mRi, TotalCapture, and EgoHumans, MoBind consistently outperforms strong baselines across all four tasks, demonstrating robust fine-grained temporal alignment while preserving coarse semantic consistency across modalities. Code is available at https://github.com/bbvisual/ MoBind.
summary_zh: 我们旨在学习惯性测量单元（IMU）信号与从视频中提取的2D姿态序列之间的联合表征，从而实现精确的跨模态检索、时间同步、对象和身体部位定位以及动作识别。 为此，我们引入了MoBind，这是一个分层对比学习框架，旨在应对三个挑战： (1) 过滤掉无关的视觉背景，(2) 建模结构化的多传感器IMU配置，以及 (3) 实现精细化的、亚秒级的时间对齐。 为了隔离与运动相关的线索，MoBind将IMU信号与骨骼运动序列而非原始像素对齐。 我们进一步将全身运动分解为局部身体部位轨迹，将每个轨迹与其相应的IMU配对，以实现语义相关的多传感器对齐。 为了捕捉详细的时间对应关系，MoBind 采用了一种分层对比策略，该策略首先对齐令牌级的时间段，然后将局部（身体部位）对齐与全局（全身范围）运动聚合融合。 在 mRi、TotalCapture 和 EgoHumans 数据集上进行的评估表明，MoBind 在所有四项任务中均始终优于强大的基线模型，证明了其鲁棒的精细化时间对齐能力，同时保留了跨模态的粗略语义一致性。 代码可在 https://github.com/bbvisual/ MoBind 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces MoBind, a hierarchical contrastive learning framework for aligning IMU signals and video-extracted 2D poses, enabling fine-grained cross-modal retrieval, synchronization, and action recognition by focusing on motion-relevant cues and structured multi-sensor configurations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MoBind，一种分层对比学习框架，用于对齐IMU信号和视频提取的2D姿势，通过关注运动相关的线索和结构化的多传感器配置，实现细粒度的跨模态检索、同步和动作识别。

title: Learning Cross-View Object Correspondence via Cycle-Consistent Mask Prediction
summary: We study the task of establishing object-level visual correspondence across different viewpoints in videos, focusing on the challenging egocentric-to-exocentric and exocentric-to-egocentric scenarios. We propose a simple yet effective framework based on conditional binary segmentation, where an object query mask is encoded into a latent representation to guide the localization of the corresponding object in a target video. To encourage robust, view-invariant representations, we introduce a cycle-consistency training objective: the predicted mask in the target view is projected back to the source view to reconstruct the original query mask. This bidirectional constraint provides a strong self-supervisory signal without requiring ground-truth annotations and enables test-time training (TTT) at inference. Experiments on the Ego-Exo4D and HANDAL-X benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our optimization objective and TTT strategy, achieving state-of-the-art performance. The code is available at https://github.com/shannany0606/CCMP.
summary_zh: 我们研究了在视频中跨不同视角建立对象级视觉对应关系的任务，重点关注具有挑战性的第一人称视角到第三人称视角以及第三人称视角到第一人称视角的场景。我们提出了一种简单而有效的基于条件二元分割的框架，其中对象查询掩码被编码成一个潜在表示，以指导目标视频中相应对象的定位。为了鼓励稳健的、视角不变的表示，我们引入了一个循环一致性训练目标：目标视角中预测的掩码被反向投影到源视角以重建原始查询掩码。这种双向约束提供了一个强大的自监督信号，无需真实标签，并支持推理时的测试时训练 (TTT)。在 Ego-Exo4D 和 HANDAL-X 基准测试上的实验表明了我们的优化目标和 TTT 策略的有效性，实现了最先进的性能。代码可在 https://github.com/shannany0606/CCMP 获取。
tldr: This paper presents a cycle-consistency based method for learning object correspondence between different viewpoints in videos, demonstrating SOTA performance on Ego-Exo4D and HANDAL-X benchmarks and introducing a test-time training strategy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于循环一致性的方法，用于学习视频中不同视点之间的物体 correspondence，并在 Ego-Exo4D 和 HANDAL-X 基准测试上实现了 SOTA 性能，并介绍了一种测试时训练策略。

title: IDSelect: A RL-Based Cost-Aware Selection Agent for Video-based Multi-Modal Person Recognition
summary: Video-based person recognition achieves robust identification by integrating face, body, and gait. However, current systems waste computational resources by processing all modalities with fixed heavyweight ensembles regardless of input complexity. To address these limitations, we propose IDSelect, a reinforcement learning-based cost-aware selector that chooses one pre-trained model per modality per-sequence to optimize the accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Our key insight is that an input-conditioned selector can discover complementary model choices that surpass fixed ensembles while using substantially fewer resources. IDSelect trains a lightweight agent end-to-end using actor-critic reinforcement learning with budget-aware optimization. The reward balances recognition accuracy with computational cost, while entropy regularization prevents premature convergence. At inference, the policy selects the most probable model per modality and fuses modality-specific similarities for the final score. Extensive experiments on challenging video-based datasets demonstrate IDSelect's superior efficiency: on CCVID, it achieves 95.9% Rank-1 accuracy with 92.4% less computation than strong baselines while improving accuracy by 1.8%; on MEVID, it reduces computation by 41.3% while maintaining competitive performance.
summary_zh: 基于视频的人员识别通过整合面部、身体和步态实现稳健的身份识别。然而，当前的系统不考虑输入复杂度，采用固定的重量级集成模型处理所有模态，造成计算资源的浪费。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出IDSelect，一种基于强化学习的成本敏感选择器，它为每个序列的每个模态选择一个预训练模型，以优化准确率-效率的权衡。我们的关键在于，一个输入条件的选择器可以发现互补模型选择，超越固定集成模型，同时使用更少的资源。IDSelect使用演员-评论家强化学习框架端到端地训练一个轻量级代理，并采用预算感知的优化方法。奖励函数平衡了识别准确率和计算成本，同时熵正则化防止了过早收敛。在推理阶段，该策略选择每个模态最可能的模型，并融合模态特定的相似度以获得最终的分数。在具有挑战性的视频数据集上的大量实验表明，IDSelect具有卓越的效率：在CCVID数据集上，它实现了95.9%的Rank-1准确率，计算量比强大的基线降低了92.4%，同时提高了1.8%的准确率；在MEVID数据集上，它将计算量降低了41.3%，同时保持了有竞争力的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces IDSelect, a reinforcement learning-based approach for dynamically selecting modality-specific models in video-based person recognition to optimize accuracy and computational cost, achieving significant efficiency gains.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了IDSelect，一种基于强化学习的方法，用于在基于视频的行人识别中动态选择特定模态的模型，以优化准确性和计算成本，并实现了显著的效率提升。

title: Adaptive Problem Generation via Symbolic Representations
summary: We present a method for generating training data for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards to improve small open-weights language models on mathematical tasks. Existing data generation approaches rely on open-loop pipelines and fixed modifications that do not adapt to the model's capabilities. Furthermore, they typically operate directly on word problems, limiting control over problem structure. To address this, we perform modifications in a symbolic problem space, representing each problem as a set of symbolic variables and constraints (e.g., via algebraic frameworks such as SymPy or SMT formulations). This representation enables precise control over problem structure, automatic generation of ground-truth solutions, and decouples mathematical reasoning from linguistic realization. We also show that this results in more diverse generations. To adapt the problem difficulty to the model, we introduce a closed-loop framework that learns modification strategies through prompt optimization in symbolic space. Experimental results demonstrate that both adaptive problem generation and symbolic representation modifications contribute to improving the model's math solving ability.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种为强化学习生成具有可验证奖励的训练数据的方法，以提高小型开放权重语言模型在数学任务上的表现。 现有的数据生成方法依赖于开环管道和固定的修改，无法适应模型的能力。此外，它们通常直接对文字题进行操作，限制了对问题结构的控制。 为了解决这个问题，我们在符号问题空间中执行修改，将每个问题表示为一组符号变量和约束（例如，通过代数框架如SymPy或SMT公式）。 这种表示可以精确控制问题结构，自动生成真值解，并将数学推理与语言表达分离。 我们还表明，这会产生更多样化的生成结果。 为了使问题难度适应模型，我们引入了一个闭环框架，该框架通过在符号空间中进行提示优化来学习修改策略。 实验结果表明，自适应问题生成和符号表示修改都有助于提高模型的数学解题能力。
tldr: The paper introduces an adaptive problem generation method using symbolic representations to improve the math solving abilities of small language models through reinforcement learning. It uses a closed-loop framework with prompt optimization in symbolic space.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种自适应问题生成方法，使用符号表示，通过强化学习来提高小型语言模型的数学解题能力。它使用闭环框架，在符号空间里进行提示优化。

title: Distributional Stability of Tangent-Linearized Gaussian Inference on Smooth Manifolds
summary: Gaussian inference on smooth manifolds is central to robotics, but exact marginalization and conditioning are generally non-Gaussian and geometry-dependent. We study tangent-linearized Gaussian inference and derive explicit non-asymptotic $W_2$ stability bounds for projection marginalization and surface-measure conditioning. The bounds separate local second-order geometric distortion from nonlocal tail leakage and, for Gaussian inputs, yield closed-form diagnostics from $(μ,Σ)$ and curvature/reach surrogates. Circle and planar-pushing experiments validate the predicted calibration transition near $\sqrt{\|Σ\|_{\mathrm{op}}}/R\approx 1/6$ and indicate that normal-direction uncertainty is the dominant failure mode when locality breaks. These diagnostics provide practical triggers for switching from single-chart linearization to multi-chart or sample-based manifold inference.
summary_zh: 对光滑流形上的高斯推断是机器人学的核心，但精确的边缘化和条件化通常是非高斯的，且与几何结构相关。我们研究了切线线性化高斯推断，并推导出投影边缘化和表面测度条件化的显式非渐近$W_2$稳定性界。这些界将局部二阶几何畸变与非局部尾部泄露分离，并且对于高斯输入，可以从$(μ,Σ)$和曲率/可达性替代物中获得闭合形式诊断。圆形和平面推拉实验验证了预测的校准过渡发生在$\sqrt{\|Σ\|_{\mathrm{op}}}/R\approx 1/6$附近，并表明当局部性破坏时，法线方向的不确定性是主要的失效模式。这些诊断为从单图线性化切换到多图或基于样本的流形推断提供了实际的触发条件。
tldr: The paper analyzes the stability of tangent-linearized Gaussian inference on smooth manifolds, providing practical diagnostics for switching to more complex manifold inference methods in robotics applications when single-chart linearization becomes unreliable.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了光滑流形上切线线性化高斯推断的稳定性，为在机器人应用中，当单图线性化变得不可靠时，切换到更复杂的流形推断方法提供了实用的诊断。

title: Distributed and Consistent Multi-Robot Visual-Inertial-Ranging Odometry on Lie Groups
summary: Reliable localization is a fundamental requirement for multi-robot systems operating in GPS-denied environments. Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) provides lightweight and accurate motion estimation but suffers from cumulative drift in the absence of global references. Ultra-wideband (UWB) ranging offers complementary global observations, yet most existing UWB-aided VIO methods are designed for single-robot scenarios and rely on pre-calibrated anchors, which limits their robustness in practice. This paper proposes a distributed collaborative visual-inertial-ranging odometry (DC-VIRO) framework that tightly fuses VIO and UWB measurements across multiple robots. Anchor positions are explicitly included in the system state to address calibration uncertainty, while shared anchor observations are exploited through inter-robot communication to provide additional geometric constraints. By leveraging a right-invariant error formulation on Lie groups, the proposed approach preserves the observability properties of standard VIO, ensuring estimator consistency. Simulation results with multiple robots demonstrate that DC-VIRO significantly improves localization accuracy and robustness, while simultaneously enabling anchor self-calibration in distributed settings.
summary_zh: 可靠的定位是在无GPS环境中运行的多机器人系统的基本要求。视觉惯性里程计(VIO)提供轻量且精确的运动估计，但在缺乏全局参考时会受到累积漂移的影响。超宽带(UWB)测距提供互补的全局观测，然而大多数现有的UWB辅助VIO方法是为单机器人场景设计的，并依赖于预先校准的锚点，这限制了它们在实践中的鲁棒性。本文提出了一种分布式协作视觉惯性测距里程计(DC-VIRO)框架，该框架紧耦合了多个机器人之间的VIO和UWB测量数据。锚点位置被显式地包含在系统状态中，以解决校准不确定性，而共享的锚点观测通过机器人间的通信被利用，从而提供额外的几何约束。通过利用李群上的右不变误差公式，所提出的方法保留了标准VIO的可观测性特性，从而确保估计器的一致性。多机器人的仿真结果表明，DC-VIRO显著提高了定位精度和鲁棒性，同时实现了分布式环境中的锚点自校准。
tldr: This paper introduces a distributed collaborative visual-inertial-ranging odometry (DC-VIRO) framework for multi-robot systems that tightly fuses VIO and UWB measurements, addressing localization accuracy and robustness in GPS-denied environments and enabling anchor self-calibration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分布式协作的视觉惯性测距里程计（DC-VIRO）框架，用于多机器人系统，该框架紧密融合了VIO和UWB测量数据，解决了在无GPS环境中的定位精度和鲁棒性问题，并支持传感器自校准。

title: Understanding Fire Through Thermal Radiation Fields for Mobile Robots
summary: Safely moving through environments affected by fire is a critical capability for autonomous mobile robots deployed in disaster response. In this work, we present a novel approach for mobile robots to understand fire through building real-time thermal radiation fields. We register depth and thermal images to obtain a 3D point cloud annotated with temperature values. From these data, we identify fires and use the Stefan-Boltzmann law to approximate the thermal radiation in empty spaces. This enables the construction of a continuous thermal radiation field over the environment. We show that this representation can be used for robot navigation, where we embed thermal constraints into the cost map to compute collision-free and thermally safe paths. We validate our approach on a Boston Dynamics Spot robot in controlled experimental settings. Our experiments demonstrate the robot's ability to avoid hazardous regions while still reaching navigation goals. Our approach paves the way toward mobile robots that can be autonomously deployed in fire-affected environments, with potential applications in search-and-rescue, firefighting, and hazardous material response.
summary_zh: 在受火灾影响的环境中安全移动是部署于灾难响应中的自主移动机器人的关键能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，使移动机器人能够通过构建实时热辐射场来理解火灾。我们注册深度图像和热图像以获得带有温度值注释的 3D 点云。 从这些数据中，我们识别火源并使用斯特藩-玻尔兹曼定律来近似估计空旷空间中的热辐射。 这使得能够在环境中构建连续的热辐射场。我们证明了这种表达方式可用于机器人导航，其中我们将热约束嵌入到代价地图中，以计算出无碰撞且热安全的路径。我们在 Boston Dynamics Spot 机器人上，在受控实验环境中验证了我们的方法。我们的实验表明了机器人避开危险区域同时仍能到达导航目标的能力。 我们的方法为自主部署在火灾影响环境中的移动机器人铺平了道路，并在搜索和救援、消防和危险材料响应方面具有潜在应用。
tldr: This paper presents a method for mobile robots to navigate fire-affected environments by constructing real-time thermal radiation fields from depth and thermal images, enabling thermally safe path planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种移动机器人在火灾环境中导航的方法，通过深度和热图像构建实时热辐射场，从而实现热安全的路径规划。

title: TeFlow: Enabling Multi-frame Supervision for Self-Supervised Feed-forward Scene Flow Estimation
summary: Self-supervised feed-forward methods for scene flow estimation offer real-time efficiency, but their supervision from two-frame point correspondences is unreliable and often breaks down under occlusions. Multi-frame supervision has the potential to provide more stable guidance by incorporating motion cues from past frames, yet naive extensions of two-frame objectives are ineffective because point correspondences vary abruptly across frames, producing inconsistent signals. In the paper, we present TeFlow, enabling multi-frame supervision for feed-forward models by mining temporally consistent supervision. TeFlow introduces a temporal ensembling strategy that forms reliable supervisory signals by aggregating the most temporally consistent motion cues from a candidate pool built across multiple frames. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that TeFlow establishes a new state-of-the-art for self-supervised feed-forward methods, achieving performance gains of up to 33\% on the challenging Argoverse 2 and nuScenes datasets. Our method performs on par with leading optimization-based methods, yet speeds up 150 times. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/KTH-RPL/OpenSceneFlow along with trained model weights.
summary_zh: 用于场景流估计的自监督前馈方法具有实时的效率，但它们来自双帧点对应关系的监督是不可靠的，并且在遮挡下经常失效。 多帧监督有潜力通过结合来自过去帧的运动线索来提供更稳定的指导，然而，双帧目标的简单扩展是无效的，因为点对应关系在帧间会突然变化，产生不一致的信号。 在本文中，我们提出了TeFlow，通过挖掘时间上一致的监督，为前馈模型启用多帧监督。 TeFlow引入了一种时间集成策略，通过聚合从跨多个帧构建的候选池中最具时间一致性的运动线索，来形成可靠的监督信号。 大量的评估表明，TeFlow为自监督前馈方法建立了一个新的最先进水平，在具有挑战性的Argoverse 2和nuScenes数据集上实现了高达33%的性能提升。 我们的方法与领先的基于优化的方法性能相当，但速度提高了150倍。 代码和训练好的模型权重已在https://github.com/KTH-RPL/OpenSceneFlow中开源。
tldr: TeFlow introduces a temporal ensembling strategy for self-supervised scene flow estimation, achieving state-of-the-art performance while maintaining feed-forward efficiency.
tldr_zh: TeFlow 引入了一种用于自监督场景流估计的时间集成策略，在保持前馈效率的同时实现了最先进的性能。

title: FruitTouch: A Perceptive Gripper for Gentle and Scalable Fruit Harvesting
summary: The automation of fruit harvesting has gained increasing significance in response to rising labor shortages. A sensorized gripper is a key component of this process, which must be compact enough for confined spaces, able to stably grasp diverse fruits, and provide reliable feedback on fruit conditions for efficient harvesting. To address this need, we propose FruitTouch, a compact gripper that integrates high-resolution, vision-based tactile sensing through an optimized optical design. This configuration accommodates a wide range of fruit sizes while maintaining low cost and mechanical simplicity. Tactile images captured by an embedded camera provide rich information for real-time force estimation, slip detection, and softness prediction. We validate the gripper in real-world fruit harvesting experiments, demonstrating robust grasp stability and effective damage prevention.
summary_zh:
摘要：
为应对日益增长的劳动力短缺问题，水果采摘自动化变得越来越重要。 传感器化的夹爪是此过程的关键组成部分，它必须足够紧凑以适应狭窄空间，能够稳定地抓取各种水果，并提供关于水果状况的可靠反馈以实现高效采摘。 为了满足这一需求，我们提出了一种紧凑型夹爪FruitTouch，它通过优化的光学设计集成了高分辨率的基于视觉的触觉感知。 此配置能够适应各种尺寸的水果，同时保持低成本和机械简洁性。 嵌入式摄像头捕获的触觉图像提供了丰富的实时力估计、滑移检测和软度预测的信息。 我们通过真实的果实采摘实验验证了该夹爪，证明了其强大的抓取稳定性和有效的损伤预防能力。
tldr: The paper presents FruitTouch, a compact, sensorized gripper for fruit harvesting, integrating vision-based tactile sensing for force estimation, slip detection, and softness prediction, validated in real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为FruitTouch的紧凑型传感器夹爪，用于水果采摘。它集成了基于视觉的触觉传感，用于力估计、滑移检测和软度预测，并在真实世界的实验中得到了验证。

title: Bumper Drone: Elastic Morphology Design for Aerial Physical Interaction
summary: Aerial robots are evolving from avoiding obstacles to exploiting the environmental contact interactions for navigation, exploration and manipulation. A key challenge in such aerial physical interactions lies in handling uncertain contact forces on unknown targets, which typically demand accurate sensing and active control. We present a drone platform with elastic horns that enables touch-and-go manoeuvres - a self-regulated, consecutive bumping motion that allows the drone to maintain proximity to a wall without relying on active obstacle avoidance. It leverages environmental interaction as a form of embodied control, where low-level stabilisation and near-obstacle navigation emerge from the passive dynamic responses of the drone-obstacle system that resembles a mass-spring-damper system. Experiments show that the elastic horn can absorb impact energy while maintaining vehicle stability, reducing pitch oscillations by 38% compared to the rigid horn configuration. The lower horn arrangement was found to reduce pitch oscillations by approximately 54%. In addition to intermittent contact, the platform equipped with elastic horns also demonstrates stable, sustained contact with static objects, relying on a standard attitude PID controller.
summary_zh: 无人机正从避开障碍物发展到利用环境接触交互进行导航、探索和操作。在此类空中物理交互中，一个关键挑战在于处理未知目标上不确定的接触力，这通常需要精确的传感和主动控制。我们提出了一种带有弹性角的无人机平台，该平台能够实现触碰即走动作——一种自我调节的连续碰撞运动，使无人机能够在不依赖主动避障的情况下保持与墙壁的接近。它利用环境交互作为一种具身控制形式，其中低层稳定和近障碍物导航源于无人机-障碍物系统的被动动态响应，该系统类似于一个 mass-spring-damper（质量-弹簧-阻尼器）系统。实验表明，弹性角能够吸收冲击能量并保持飞行器稳定性，与刚性角配置相比，俯仰振荡降低了 38%。实验发现，较低的角部布置能够将俯仰振荡降低大约 54%。除了间歇性接触外，该平台在配备弹性角的情况下，还能依靠标准的姿态 PID 控制器，实现与静态物体的稳定、持续接触。
tldr: This paper presents a drone with elastic horns designed for aerial physical interaction, enabling stable touch-and-go maneuvers and sustained contact with objects without relying on active obstacle avoidance, offering improved stability compared to rigid horns.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种带有弹性角翼的无人机，旨在实现空中物理交互，使其能够稳定地进行接触式飞行和与物体的持续接触，而无需依赖主动避障，与刚性角翼相比，稳定性有所提高。

title: Temporal-Logic-Aware Frontier-Based Exploration
summary: This paper addresses the problem of temporal logic motion planning for an autonomous robot operating in an unknown environment. The objective is to enable the robot to satisfy a syntactically co-safe Linear Temporal Logic (scLTL) specification when the exact locations of the desired labels are not known a priori. We introduce a new type of automaton state, referred to as commit states. These states capture intermediate task progress resulting from actions whose consequences are irreversible. In other words, certain future paths to satisfaction become not feasible after taking those actions that lead to the commit states. By leveraging commit states, we propose a sound and complete frontier-based exploration algorithm that strategically guides the robot to make progress toward the task while preserving all possible ways of satisfying it. The efficacy of the proposed method is validated through simulations.
summary_zh: 本文研究了在未知环境中自主机器人进行时序逻辑运动规划的问题。目标是使机器人满足语法上安全的线性时序逻辑（scLTL）规范，同时预先未知所需标签的精确位置。我们引入了一种新型的自动机状态，称为提交状态。这些状态捕捉了由于采取不可逆转的动作而产生的中间任务进展。换句话说，在采取导致提交状态的动作后，某些满足任务的未来路径将变得不可行。通过利用提交状态，我们提出了一种可靠且完备的基于边界的探索算法，该算法战略性地引导机器人向任务进展，同时保留所有可能的满足任务的方式。通过仿真验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces a frontier-based exploration algorithm using 'commit states' to guide robots in unknown environments towards satisfying syntactically co-safe Linear Temporal Logic (scLTL) specifications. The algorithm ensures progress while preserving task satisfaction possibilities.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于前沿探索的算法，利用“提交状态”引导机器人在未知环境中满足句法上协同安全的线性时序逻辑（scLTL）规范。 该算法确保在取得进展的同时，保持任务满足的可能性。

title: DGPO: RL-Steered Graph Diffusion for Neural Architecture Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning has proven effective for steering generative diffusion models toward desired properties in image and molecular domains. Graph diffusion models have similarly been applied to combinatorial structure generation, including neural architecture search (NAS). However, neural architectures are directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) where edge direction encodes functional semantics such as data flow-information that existing graph diffusion methods, designed for undirected structures, discard. We propose Directed Graph Policy Optimization (DGPO), which extends reinforcement learning fine-tuning of discrete graph diffusion models to DAGs via topological node ordering and positional encoding. Validated on NAS-Bench-101 and NAS-Bench-201, DGPO matches the benchmark optimum on all three NAS-Bench-201 tasks (91.61%, 73.49%, 46.77%). The central finding is that the model learns transferable structural priors: pretrained on only 7% of the search space, it generates near-oracle architectures after fine-tuning, within 0.32 percentage points of the full-data model and extrapolating 7.3 percentage points beyond its training ceiling. Bidirectional control experiments confirm genuine reward-driven steering, with inverse optimization reaching near random-chance accuracy (9.5%). These results demonstrate that reinforcement learning-steered discrete diffusion, once extended to handle directionality, provides a controllable generative framework for directed combinatorial structures.
summary_zh: 强化学习微调已被证明可有效引导生成式扩散模型在图像和分子领域朝着期望的属性发展。图扩散模型也被类似地应用于组合结构生成，包括神经架构搜索（NAS）。然而，神经架构是有向无环图（DAG），其中边的方向编码了诸如数据流这样的功能语义——而现有的图扩散方法是为无向结构设计的，会丢弃这些信息。我们提出了有向图策略优化（DGPO），它通过拓扑节点排序和位置编码，将离散图扩散模型的强化学习微调扩展到DAG。在NAS-Bench-101和NAS-Bench-201上的验证表明，DGPO在所有三个NAS-Bench-201任务中都达到了基准最优（91.61%、73.49%、46.77%）。核心发现是该模型学习了可迁移的结构先验：仅在7%的搜索空间上进行预训练后，它就能在微调后生成接近最优的架构，与全数据模型相差不到0.32个百分点，并将其训练上限外推7.3个百分点。双向控制实验证实是真正的奖励驱动引导，逆向优化达到了接近随机概率的精度（9.5%）。这些结果表明，一旦扩展到处理方向性，强化学习引导的离散扩散就为有向组合结构提供了一个可控的生成框架。
tldr: The paper introduces Directed Graph Policy Optimization (DGPO), a reinforcement learning-steered graph diffusion model for generating neural architectures (DAGs), demonstrating strong performance on NAS-Bench benchmarks and transferable structural priors.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了有向图策略优化 (DGPO)，一种强化学习引导的图扩散模型，用于生成神经架构（DAG），并在 NAS-Bench 基准测试中展示了强大的性能和可转移的结构先验。

title: Robust Exploration in Directed Controller Synthesis via Reinforcement Learning with Soft Mixture-of-Experts
summary: On-the-fly Directed Controller Synthesis (OTF-DCS) mitigates state-space explosion by incrementally exploring the system and relies critically on an exploration policy to guide search efficiently. Recent reinforcement learning (RL) approaches learn such policies and achieve promising zero-shot generalization from small training instances to larger unseen ones. However, a fundamental limitation is anisotropic generalization, where an RL policy exhibits strong performance only in a specific region of the domain-parameter space while remaining fragile elsewhere due to training stochasticity and trajectory-dependent bias. To address this, we propose a Soft Mixture-of-Experts framework that combines multiple RL experts via a prior-confidence gating mechanism and treats these anisotropic behaviors as complementary specializations. The evaluation on the Air Traffic benchmark shows that Soft-MoE substantially expands the solvable parameter space and improves robustness compared to any single expert.
summary_zh: 动态导向控制器合成（OTF-DCS）通过增量式探索系统来缓解状态空间爆炸问题，并严重依赖于探索策略来高效地引导搜索。最近的强化学习（RL）方法学习此类策略，并实现了从小型训练实例到大型未见实例的有希望的零样本泛化。然而，一个根本的局限性是各向异性泛化，即RL策略仅在领域参数空间的特定区域表现出强大的性能，但在其他地方由于训练的随机性和轨迹依赖性偏差而仍然脆弱。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个软性混合专家框架，该框架通过先验置信度门控机制组合多个RL专家，并将这些各向异性行为视为互补的专业化。在空中交通基准测试上的评估表明，与任何单个专家相比，软性混合专家框架(Soft-MoE) 显着扩展了可解参数空间并提高了鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces a Soft Mixture-of-Experts framework to improve the robustness of reinforcement learning policies used for on-the-fly directed controller synthesis, addressing the issue of anisotropic generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种软混合专家框架，旨在提高用于飞行中定向控制器合成的强化学习策略的鲁棒性，解决了各向异性泛化问题。

title: High Dimensional Procedural Content Generation
summary: Procedural content generation (PCG) has made substantial progress in shaping static 2D/3D geometry, while most methods treat gameplay mechanics as auxiliary and optimize only over space. We argue that this limits controllability and expressivity, and formally introduce High-Dimensional PCG (HDPCG): a framework that elevates non-geometric gameplay dimensions to first-class coordinates of a joint state space. We instantiate HDPCG along two concrete directions. Direction-Space augments geometry with a discrete layer dimension and validates reachability in 4D (x,y,z,l), enabling unified treatment of 2.5D/3.5D mechanics such as gravity inversion and parallel-world switching. Direction-Time augments geometry with temporal dynamics via time-expanded graphs, capturing action semantics and conflict rules. For each direction, we present three general, practicable algorithms with a shared pipeline of abstract skeleton generation, controlled grounding, high-dimensional validation, and multi-metric evaluation. Large-scale experiments across diverse settings validate the integrity of our problem formulation and the effectiveness of our methods on playability, structure, style, robustness, and efficiency. Beyond quantitative results, Unity-based case studies recreate playable scenarios that accord with our metrics. We hope HDPCG encourages a shift in PCG toward general representations and the generation of gameplay-relevant dimensions beyond geometry, paving the way for controllable, verifiable, and extensible level generation.
summary_zh: 程序化内容生成(PCG)在塑造静态2D/3D几何体方面取得了显著进展，但大多数方法将游戏机制视为辅助手段，仅在空间维度上进行优化。我们认为这限制了可控性和表现力，并正式引入了高维PCG(HDPCG)：一个将非几何游戏维度提升为联合状态空间中一等坐标的框架。我们沿着两个具体方向实例化HDPCG。方向-空间通过离散的层维度增强了几何体，并在4D空间(x,y,z,l)中验证了可达性，从而能够统一处理2.5D/3.5D机制，例如重力反转和平行世界切换。方向-时间通过时间扩展图将几何体与时间动态相结合，捕捉动作语义和冲突规则。对于每个方向，我们提出了三种通用、可行的算法，具有共享的抽象骨架生成、受控接地、高维验证和多指标评估的流水线。跨越各种场景的大规模实验验证了我们问题表述的完整性以及我们方法在可玩性、结构、风格、鲁棒性和效率方面的有效性。除了量化结果之外，基于Unity的案例研究重新创建了符合我们指标的可玩场景。我们希望HDPCG能够鼓励PCG向通用表示和生成超越几何体的游戏相关维度转变，为可控、可验证和可扩展的关卡生成铺平道路。
tldr: The paper introduces High-Dimensional PCG (HDPCG), a framework that extends procedural content generation beyond geometry, incorporating gameplay mechanics as first-class coordinates in a joint state space and demonstrating its effectiveness with various algorithms and Unity-based case studies.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了高维程序内容生成 (HDPCG) 框架，该框架将程序内容生成扩展到几何之外，将游戏机制作为联合状态空间中的一流坐标纳入，并通过各种算法和基于 Unity 的案例研究证明了其有效性。

title: UniE2F: A Unified Diffusion Framework for Event-to-Frame Reconstruction with Video Foundation Models
summary: Event cameras excel at high-speed, low-power, and high-dynamic-range scene perception. However, as they fundamentally record only relative intensity changes rather than absolute intensity, the resulting data streams suffer from a significant loss of spatial information and static texture details. In this paper, we address this limitation by leveraging the generative prior of a pre-trained video diffusion model to reconstruct high-fidelity video frames from sparse event data. Specifically, we first establish a baseline model by directly applying event data as a condition to synthesize videos. Then, based on the physical correlation between the event stream and video frames, we further introduce the event-based inter-frame residual guidance to enhance the accuracy of video frame reconstruction. Furthermore, we extend our method to video frame interpolation and prediction in a zero-shot manner by modulating the reverse diffusion sampling process, thereby creating a unified event-to-frame reconstruction framework. Experimental results on real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous approaches both quantitatively and qualitatively. We also refer the reviewers to the video demo contained in the supplementary material for video results. The code will be publicly available at https://github.com/CS-GangXu/UniE2F.
summary_zh: 事件相机在高速度、低功耗和高动态范围场景感知方面表现出色。然而，由于它们从根本上只记录相对强度变化，而非绝对强度，因此生成的数据流会遭受显著的空间信息和静态纹理细节损失。本文通过利用预训练视频扩散模型的生成先验，从稀疏事件数据中重建高质量视频帧来解决这一局限性。具体而言，我们首先建立一个基线模型，直接将事件数据作为条件来合成视频。然后，基于事件流与视频帧之间的物理相关性，我们进一步引入基于事件的帧间残差引导，以增强视频帧重建的准确性。此外，我们通过调节反向扩散采样过程，以零样本方式将我们的方法扩展到视频帧插值和预测，从而创建一个统一的事件到帧的重建框架。在真实世界和合成数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在定量和定性方面均显著优于以往方法。我们还建议审稿人参考补充材料中包含的视频Demo，以观看视频结果。 代码将在 https://github.com/CS-GangXu/UniE2F 上公开。
tldr: This paper introduces UniE2F, a unified diffusion framework leveraging video foundation models to reconstruct high-fidelity video frames from event data, outperforming previous methods in event-to-frame reconstruction, interpolation, and prediction.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了UniE2F，一个统一的扩散框架，利用视频基础模型从事件数据中重建高保真视频帧，在事件到帧的重构、插值和预测方面优于以往方法。

title: Design, Locomotion, and Control of Amphibious Robots: Recent Advances
summary: Amphibious robots, operating seamlessly across land and water, are advancing applications in conservation, disaster response, and defense. Their performance depends on locomotion mechanisms, actuation technologies, and sensor-control integration. This review highlights recent progress in these areas, examining movement strategies, material-based actuators, and control systems for autonomy and adaptability. Challenges and opportunities are outlined to guide future research toward more efficient, resilient, and multifunctional amphibious robots.
summary_zh: 两栖机器人可在陆地和水域间无缝运行，正在推动环境保护、灾害响应和国防等领域的应用。它们的性能取决于运动机制、驱动技术和传感器-控制集成。本文综述了这些领域的最新进展，探讨了运动策略、基于材料的驱动器以及用于自主性和适应性的控制系统。文章还概述了挑战和机遇，以指导未来研究朝着更高效、更具弹性和更多功能的两栖机器人方向发展。
tldr: This review paper summarizes recent advances in amphibious robot design, locomotion, and control, highlighting movement strategies, actuators, and control systems for autonomy and adaptability. It also outlines future research directions in the field.
tldr_zh: 该综述论文总结了水陆两栖机器人设计、运动和控制方面的最新进展，重点介绍了自主和适应性的运动策略、执行器和控制系统。 它还概述了该领域未来的研究方向。

title: Path planning for unmanned surface vehicle based on predictive artificial potential field. International Journal of Advanced Robotic Systems
summary: Path planning for high-speed unmanned surface vehicles requires more complex solutions to reduce sailing time and save energy. This article proposes a new predictive artificial potential field that incorporates time information and predictive potential to plan smoother paths. It explores the principles of the artificial potential field, considering vehicle dynamics and local minimum reachability. The study first analyzes the most advanced traditional artificial potential field and its drawbacks in global and local path planning. It then introduces three modifications to the predictive artificial potential field-angle limit, velocity adjustment, and predictive potential to enhance the feasibility and flatness of the generated path. A comparison between the traditional and predictive artificial potential fields demonstrates that the latter successfully restricts the maximum turning angle, shortens sailing time, and intelligently avoids obstacles. Simulation results further verify that the predictive artificial potential field addresses the concave local minimum problem and improves reachability in special scenarios, ultimately generating a more efficient path that reduces sailing time and conserves energy for unmanned surface vehicles.
summary_zh: 高速无人艇的路径规划需要更复杂的解决方案以减少航行时间和节省能源。本文提出了一种新的预测人工势场，它结合了时间信息和预测势能，以规划更平滑的路径。文章探讨了人工势场的原理，并考虑了车辆动力学和局部最小值可达性。该研究首先分析了最先进的传统人工势场及其在全球和局部路径规划中的不足之处。然后，文章对预测人工势场引入了三个改进——角度限制、速度调整和预测势能——以增强生成路径的可行性和平滑性。传统人工势场与预测人工势场之间的比较表明，后者成功地限制了最大转向角，缩短了航行时间，并智能地避开了障碍物。仿真结果进一步证实，预测人工势场解决了凹陷型局部最小值问题，并提高了特殊场景中的可达性，最终为无人艇生成了一条更高效的路径，从而减少了航行时间并节约了能源。
tldr: This paper proposes a predictive artificial potential field method for unmanned surface vehicle path planning, incorporating time information and predictive potential to generate smoother, more efficient paths while avoiding obstacles and local minima.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于无人水面艇路径规划的预测人工势场方法，该方法结合了时间信息和预测势能，从而生成更平滑、更高效的路径，同时避开障碍物和局部极小值。

title: Characterizing MARL for Energy Control: A Multi-KPI Benchmark on the CityLearn Environment
summary: The optimization of urban energy systems is crucial for the advancement of sustainable and resilient smart cities, which are becoming increasingly complex with multiple decision-making units. To address scalability and coordination concerns, Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is a promising solution. This paper addresses the imperative need for comprehensive and reliable benchmarking of MARL algorithms on energy management tasks. CityLearn is used as a case study environment because it realistically simulates urban energy systems, incorporates multiple storage systems, and utilizes renewable energy sources. By doing so, our work sets a new standard for evaluation, conducting a comparative study across multiple key performance indicators (KPIs). This approach illuminates the key strengths and weaknesses of various algorithms, moving beyond traditional KPI averaging which often masks critical insights. Our experiments utilize widely accepted baselines such as Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Soft Actor Critic (SAC), and encompass diverse training schemes including Decentralized Training with Decentralized Execution (DTDE) and Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) approaches and different neural network architectures. Our work also proposes novel KPIs that tackle real world implementation challenges such as individual building contribution and battery storage lifetime. Our findings show that DTDE consistently outperforms CTDE in both average and worst-case performance. Additionally, temporal dependency learning improved control on memory dependent KPIs such as ramping and battery usage, contributing to more sustainable battery operation. Results also reveal robustness to agent or resource removal, highlighting both the resilience and decentralizability of the learned policies.
summary_zh: 城市能源系统的优化对于推进可持续和具有韧性的智慧城市至关重要，而智慧城市正变得日益复杂，涉及多个决策单元。为解决可扩展性和协调性问题，多智能体强化学习（MARL）是一种很有前景的解决方案。本文针对能源管理任务中MARL算法的全面且可靠的基准测试的迫切需求。以CityLearn作为案例研究环境，因为它能真实地模拟城市能源系统，包含多个储能系统，并利用可再生能源。以此为基础，我们的工作设立了新的评估标准，对多个关键绩效指标（KPI）进行了对比研究。这种方法揭示了各种算法的关键优势和劣势，超越了传统KPI平均化，后者往往掩盖了关键洞察。我们的实验采用了广泛接受的基线算法，如近端策略优化（PPO）和软演员-评论家（SAC），并涵盖了不同的训练方案，包括去中心化训练-去中心化执行（DTDE）和中心化训练-去中心化执行（CTDE）方法，以及不同的神经网络架构。我们的工作还提出了新的KPI，以应对实际应用中的挑战，例如单栋建筑贡献和电池储能寿命。我们的研究结果表明，在平均性能和最坏情况性能方面，DTDE始终优于CTDE。此外，时间依赖性学习改进了对内存依赖型KPI（如斜坡和电池使用）的控制，从而有助于实现更可持续的电池运行。结果还揭示了对智能体或资源移除的鲁棒性，突显了学习策略的弹性和去中心化特性。
tldr: This paper benchmarks MARL algorithms for energy management in smart cities using the CityLearn environment, proposing novel KPIs and showing that decentralized training outperforms centralized training.
tldr_zh: 本文使用CityLearn环境，对智能城市能源管理中的MARL算法进行基准测试，提出了新的KPI，并表明去中心化训练优于中心化训练。

title: (Perlin) Noise as AI coordinator
summary: Large scale control of nonplayer agents is central to modern games, while production systems still struggle to balance several competing goals: locally smooth, natural behavior, and globally coordinated variety across space and time. Prior approaches rely on handcrafted rules or purely stochastic triggers, which either converge to mechanical synchrony or devolve into uncorrelated noise that is hard to tune. Continuous noise signals such as Perlin noise are well suited to this gap because they provide spatially and temporally coherent randomness, and they are already widely used for terrain, biomes, and other procedural assets. We adapt these signals for the first time to large scale AI control and present a general framework that treats continuous noise fields as an AI coordinator. The framework combines three layers of control: behavior parameterization for movement at the agent level, action time scheduling for when behaviors start and stop, and spawn or event type and feature generation for what appears and where. We instantiate the framework reproducibly and evaluate Perlin noise as a representative coordinator across multiple maps, scales, and seeds against random, filtered, deterministic, neighborhood constrained, and physics inspired baselines. Experiments show that coordinated noise fields provide stable activation statistics without lockstep, strong spatial coverage and regional balance, better diversity with controllable polarization, and competitive runtime. We hope this work motivates a broader exploration of coordinated noise in game AI as a practical path to combine efficiency, controllability, and quality.
summary_zh: 大型非玩家角色(NPC)的规模化控制是现代游戏的核心，但生产系统仍难以平衡几个相互竞争的目标：局部平滑、自然的行为，以及全局协调的、跨越空间和时间的多样性。以往的方法依赖于手工编写的规则或纯粹的随机触发器，这要么收敛于机械的同步，要么演化为难以调整的、不相关的噪声。像柏林噪声这样的连续噪声信号非常适合填补这一空白，因为它们提供了空间和时间上连贯的随机性，并且已经被广泛用于地形、生物群落和其他程序化资产。我们首次将这些信号应用于大规模人工智能控制，并提出了一个将连续噪声场视为AI协调器的通用框架。该框架结合了三个控制层：代理层面上用于运动的行为参数化，用于控制行为开始和停止的动作时间调度，以及用于确定出现什么以及在哪里的生成方式（包括生成事件类型和特征）。我们可重复地实例化该框架，并在多个地图、规模和种子下，将柏林噪声作为代表性的协调器，与随机、滤波、确定性、邻域约束和受物理启发的基础模型进行评估。实验表明，协调的噪声场提供了稳定的激活统计数据而没有锁步现象，强大的空间覆盖和区域平衡，更好的多样性以及可控的极化，以及具有竞争力的运行时。我们希望这项工作能够推动对游戏AI中协调噪声的更广泛探索，将其作为结合效率、可控性和质量的实用途径。
tldr: The paper introduces a framework using Perlin noise as an AI coordinator in games, demonstrating its effectiveness in generating diverse and coordinated agent behaviors.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个使用Perlin噪声作为游戏AI协调器的框架，展示了其在生成多样化和协调的代理行为方面的有效性。

title: BriMA: Bridged Modality Adaptation for Multi-Modal Continual Action Quality Assessment
summary: Action Quality Assessment (AQA) aims to score how well an action is performed and is widely used in sports analysis, rehabilitation assessment, and human skill evaluation. Multi-modal AQA has recently achieved strong progress by leveraging complementary visual and kinematic cues, yet real-world deployments often suffer from non-stationary modality imbalance, where certain modalities become missing or intermittently available due to sensor failures or annotation gaps. Existing continual AQA methods overlook this issue and assume that all modalities remain complete and stable throughout training, which restricts their practicality. To address this challenge, we introduce Bridged Modality Adaptation (BriMA), an innovative approach to multi-modal continual AQA under modality-missing conditions. BriMA consists of a memory-guided bridging imputation module that reconstructs missing modalities using both task-agnostic and task-specific representations, and a modality-aware replay mechanism that prioritizes informative samples based on modality distortion and distribution drift. Experiments on three representative multi-modal AQA datasets (RG, Fis-V, and FS1000) show that BriMA consistently improves performance under different modality-missing conditions, achieving 6--8\% higher correlation and 12--15\% lower error on average. These results demonstrate a step toward robust multi-modal AQA systems under real-world deployment constraints.
summary_zh: 动作质量评估 (AQA) 旨在对动作表现的优劣进行评分，并广泛应用于运动分析、康复评估和人类技能评价。最近，多模态 AQA 通过利用互补的视觉和运动学线索取得了显著进展，但实际部署往往受到非平稳模态失衡的影响，即由于传感器故障或标注缺失，某些模态会缺失或间歇性地不可用。现有的持续 AQA 方法忽略了这个问题，并且假设所有模态在整个训练过程中保持完整和稳定，这限制了它们的实用性。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了桥接模态适应 (BriMA)，这是一种在模态缺失条件下进行多模态持续 AQA 的创新方法。BriMA 由一个记忆引导的桥接插补模块组成，该模块使用任务无关和任务特定的表示来重建缺失的模态，以及一个模态感知的重放机制，该机制根据模态扭曲和分布漂移来优先考虑信息量大的样本。在三个代表性的多模态 AQA 数据集（RG、Fis-V 和 FS1000）上的实验表明，BriMA 在不同的模态缺失条件下都能持续提高性能，平均达到 6-8% 的更高相关性和 12-15% 的更低误差。这些结果展示了在真实部署约束下构建鲁棒的多模态 AQA 系统的一步。
tldr: The paper introduces BriMA, a novel approach for multi-modal continual Action Quality Assessment (AQA) that addresses modality-missing scenarios in real-world deployments by using a bridged imputation module and a modality-aware replay mechanism.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了BriMA，一种新颖的多模态持续动作质量评估（AQA）方法，通过使用桥接插补模块和模态感知重放机制，解决了现实部署中模态缺失的问题。

title: An Interpretable Data-Driven Model of the Flight Dynamics of Hawks
summary: Despite significant analysis of bird flight, generative physics models for flight dynamics do not currently exist. Yet the underlying mechanisms responsible for various flight manoeuvres are important for understanding how agile flight can be accomplished. Even in a simple flight, multiple objectives are at play, complicating analysis of the overall flight mechanism. Using the data-driven method of dynamic mode decomposition (DMD) on motion capture recordings of hawks, we show that multiple behavioral states such as flapping, turning, landing, and gliding, can be modeled by simple and interpretable modal structures (i.e. the underlying wing-tail shape) which can be linearly combined to reproduce the experimental flight observations. Moreover, the DMD model can be used to extrapolate naturalistic flapping. Flight is highly individual, with differences in style across the hawks, but we find they share a common set of dynamic modes. The DMD model is a direct fit to data, unlike traditional models constructed from physics principles which can rarely be tested on real data and whose assumptions are typically invalid in real flight. The DMD approach gives a highly accurate reconstruction of the flight dynamics with only three parameters needed to characterize flapping, and a fourth to integrate turning manoeuvres. The DMD analysis further shows that the underlying mechanism of flight, much like simplest walking models, displays a parametric coupling between dominant modes suggesting efficiency for locomotion.
summary_zh: 尽管对鸟类飞行进行了大量的分析，但目前尚不存在飞行动力学的生成物理模型。然而，负责各种飞行机动的潜在机制对于理解如何实现敏捷飞行至关重要。即使在简单的飞行中，也存在多个目标，从而复杂化了对整体飞行机制的分析。通过对鹰的运动捕捉记录使用动态模式分解（DMD）这种数据驱动方法，我们表明，诸如拍打、转弯、着陆和平滑等多种行为状态，可以用简单且可解释的模态结构（即潜在的翼 - 尾形状）来建模，并且这些模态结构可以线性组合以重现实验飞行观测结果。此外，DMD模型可用于外推自然的拍打动作。飞行具有高度的个体性，不同鹰的飞行风格存在差异，但我们发现它们共享一组通用的动态模式。与传统的基于物理原理构建的模型不同，DMD模型直接拟合数据，而传统模型很少能用真实数据进行测试，并且其假设通常在真实飞行中无效。DMD方法能够以高精度重建飞行动力学，仅需三个参数来表征拍打，以及第四个参数来整合转弯机动。DMD分析进一步表明，飞行的潜在机制，与最简单的行走模型非常相似，表现出主导模式之间的参数耦合，暗示了运动的效率。
tldr: This paper presents a data-driven approach using Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to model hawk flight dynamics, achieving interpretable and accurate reconstructions of flight maneuvers from motion capture data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种数据驱动方法，使用动态模式分解（DMD）来模拟鹰的飞行动力学，从运动捕捉数据中实现了对飞行动作的可解释且准确的重建。

title: A User-driven Design Framework for Robotaxi
summary: Robotaxis are emerging as a promising form of urban mobility, yet research has largely emphasized technical driving performance while leaving open how passengers experience and evaluate rides without a human driver. To address the limitations of prior work that often relies on simulated or hypothetical settings, we investigate real-world robotaxi use through 18 semi-structured interviews and autoethnographic ride experiences. We found that users were drawn to robotaxis by low cost, social recommendation, and curiosity. They valued a distinctive set of benefits, such as an increased sense of agency, and consistent driving behavioral consistency and standardized ride experiences. However, they encountered persistent challenges around limited flexibility, insufficient transparency, management difficulty, robustness concerns in edge cases, and emergency handling concerns. Robotaxi experiences were shaped by privacy, safety, ethics, and trust. Users were often privacy-indifferent yet sensitive to opaque access and leakage risks; safety perceptions were polarized; and ethical considerations surfaced round issues such as accountability, feedback responsibility and absence of human-like social norms. Based on these findings, we propose a user-driven design framework spanning the end-to-end journey, such as pre-ride configuration (hailing), context-aware pickup facilitation (pick-up) in-ride explainability (traveling), and accountable post-ride feedback (drop-off) to guide robotaxi interaction and service design.
summary_zh: 无人驾驶出租车正在成为一种有前景的城市出行方式，但研究主要侧重于技术驾驶性能，而忽略了乘客在没有人类驾驶员的情况下如何体验和评价乘车过程。为了解决先前研究通常依赖模拟或假设环境的局限性，我们通过18次半结构化访谈和自民族志乘车体验，调查了现实世界中无人驾驶出租车的使用情况。我们发现，用户被低成本、社交推荐和好奇心所吸引。他们珍视一套独特的优势，例如增强的自主感、一致的驾驶行为连贯性和标准化的乘车体验。然而，他们也遇到了持续的挑战，如有限的灵活性、透明度不足、管理困难、极端情况下的鲁棒性问题以及紧急情况处理问题。无人驾驶出租车的体验受到隐私、安全、伦理和信任的影响。用户通常对隐私漠不关心，但对不透明的访问和泄露风险很敏感；安全认知两极分化；伦理考量围绕诸如责任归属、反馈责任和缺乏类似人类的社交规范等问题浮出水面。基于这些发现，我们提出了一个用户驱动的设计框架，涵盖了端到端的旅程，例如乘车前的配置（叫车）、情境感知的接送便利（接送）、旅途中的可解释性（行进）和负责任的乘车后反馈（下车），以指导无人驾驶出租车的交互和服务设计。
tldr: This paper investigates user experiences with real-world robotaxis and proposes a user-driven design framework to address issues like flexibility, transparency, and safety based on user feedback.
tldr_zh: 本文调查了用户在真实世界中使用无人驾驶出租车的体验，并提出了一个用户驱动的设计框架，以解决诸如灵活性、透明度和安全性等问题，该框架基于用户反馈。

title: A Checklist for Deploying Robots in Public: Articulating Tacit Knowledge in the HRI Community
summary: Many of the challenges encountered in in-the-wild public deployments of robots remain undocumented despite sharing many common pitfalls. This creates a high barrier of entry and results in repetition of avoidable mistakes. To articulate the tacit knowledge in the HRI community, this paper presents a guideline in the form of a checklist to support researchers in preparing for robot deployments in public. Drawing on their own experience with public robot deployments, the research team collected essential topics to consider in public HRI research. These topics are represented as modular flip cards in a hierarchical table, structured into deployment phases and important domains. We interviewed six interdisciplinary researchers with expertise in public HRI and show how including community input refines the checklist. We further show the checklist in action in context of real public studies. Finally, we contribute the checklist as an open-source, customizable community resource that both collects joint expertise for continual evolution and is usable as a list, set of cards, and an interactive web tool.
summary_zh: 尽管在野外公共环境中机器人部署遇到的许多挑战存在共同的陷阱，但多数仍未被记录。这导致了较高的入门门槛，并造成了可避免错误的重复发生。为了阐明人机交互（HRI）领域的隐性知识，本文以检查清单的形式提供了一份指南，以支持研究人员为公共环境中的机器人部署做准备。研究团队根据自身在公共机器人部署方面的经验，收集了在公共HRI研究中需要考虑的关键主题。这些主题以模块化的翻转卡片形式呈现在一个分层表格中，并按照部署阶段和重要领域进行组织。我们采访了六位具有公共HRI专业知识的跨学科研究人员，展示了纳入社群意见如何完善检查清单。我们还展示了该检查清单在实际公共研究背景下的应用。最后，我们将该检查清单作为开源、可定制的社群资源贡献出来，它既收集了共同的专业知识以进行持续演变，又可以作为清单、卡片集和交互式网络工具使用。
tldr: This paper introduces a checklist designed to help researchers avoid common pitfalls when deploying robots in public settings. It presents the checklist as an open-source, customizable tool that facilitates knowledge sharing and continual improvement within the HRI community.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个清单，旨在帮助研究人员避免在公共场所部署机器人时常犯的错误。 它将清单作为一个开源、可定制的工具，促进了人机交互（HRI）社区内的知识共享和持续改进。

title: A Two-Stage Detection-Tracking Framework for Stable Apple Quality Inspection in Dense Conveyor-Belt Environments
summary: Industrial fruit inspection systems must operate reliably under dense multi-object interactions and continuous motion, yet most existing works evaluate detection or classification at the image level without ensuring temporal stability in video streams. We present a two-stage detection-tracking framework for stable multi-apple quality inspection in conveyor-belt environments. An orchard-trained YOLOv8 model performs apple localization, followed by ByteTrack multi-object tracking to maintain persistent identities. A ResNet18 defect classifier, fine-tuned on a healthy-defective fruit dataset, is applied to cropped apple regions. Track-level aggregation is introduced to enforce temporal consistency and reduce prediction oscillation across frames. We define video-level industrial metrics such as track-level defect ratio and temporal consistency to evaluate system robustness under realistic processing conditions. Results demonstrate improved stability compared to frame-wise inference, suggesting that integrating tracking is essential for practical automated fruit grading systems.
summary_zh: 工业水果检测系统必须在密集的多个物体交互和连续运动下可靠运行，然而，现有的大部分工作都在图像级别评估检测或分类，而没有确保视频流的时间稳定性。我们提出了一种两阶段的检测-跟踪框架，用于传送带环境下稳定的多苹果质量检测。首先，一个在果园训练过的YOLOv8模型执行苹果定位，然后使用ByteTrack多目标跟踪来保持持久的身份。一个在健康-缺陷水果数据集上微调的ResNet18缺陷分类器被应用于裁剪的苹果区域。引入了轨迹级别的聚合来增强时间一致性，并减少跨帧的预测振荡。我们定义了视频级别的工业指标，如轨迹级别的缺陷率和时间一致性，以评估系统在实际处理条件下的鲁棒性。结果表明，与逐帧推断相比，稳定性得到了提高，这表明集成跟踪对于实用的自动化水果分级系统至关重要。
tldr: The paper introduces a two-stage detection-tracking framework using YOLOv8 and ByteTrack for stable apple quality inspection on conveyor belts, improving temporal consistency and overall robustness compared to frame-wise inference.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个两阶段检测跟踪框架，使用YOLOv8和ByteTrack，在传送带上进行稳定的苹果质量检测，与逐帧推理相比，提高了时间一致性和整体鲁棒性。

title: Depth-Enhanced YOLO-SAM2 Detection for Reliable Ballast Insufficiency Identification
summary:
This paper presents a depth-enhanced YOLO-SAM2 framework for detecting ballast insufficiency in railway tracks using RGB-D data. Although YOLOv8 provides reliable localization, the RGB-only model shows limited safety performance, achieving high precision (0.99) but low recall (0.49) due to insufficient ballast, as it tends to over-predict the sufficient class. To improve reliability, we incorporate depth-based geometric analysis enabled by a sleeper-aligned depth-correction pipeline that compensates for RealSense spatial distortion using polynomial modeling, RANSAC, and temporal smoothing. SAM2 segmentation further refines region-of-interest masks, enabling accurate extraction of sleeper and ballast profiles for geometric classification.
  Experiments on field-collected top-down RGB-D data show that depth-enhanced configurations substantially improve the detection of insufficient ballast. Depending on bounding-box sampling (AABB or RBB) and geometric criteria, recall increases from 0.49 to as high as 0.80, and F1-score improves from 0.66 to over 0.80. These results demonstrate that integrating depth correction with YOLO-SAM2 yields a more robust and reliable approach for automated railway ballast inspection, particularly in visually ambiguous or safety-critical scenarios.
summary_zh:
本文提出了一种深度增强的YOLO-SAM2框架，用于利用RGB-D数据检测铁轨道砟不足。尽管YOLOv8提供了可靠的定位，但仅依赖RGB的模型在安全性方面表现有限，精度较高（0.99）但召回率较低（0.49），这是由于道砟不足时，该模型倾向于过度预测充足类别。为了提高可靠性，我们结合了基于深度的几何分析，该分析通过枕木对齐的深度校正流程来实现，该流程利用多项式建模、RANSAC算法和时间平滑来补偿RealSense的空间畸变。SAM2分割进一步细化了感兴趣区域的掩码，从而能够准确提取枕木和道砟的轮廓用于几何分类。
  在现场采集的俯视RGB-D数据上的实验表明，深度增强的配置显著改善了道砟不足的检测效果。取决于边界框采样方法（AABB或RBB）和几何标准，召回率从0.49提高到高达0.80，F1分数从0.66提高到0.80以上。这些结果表明，将深度校正与YOLO-SAM2相结合，能够为自动化铁路道砟检测提供一种更鲁棒和可靠的方法，尤其是在视觉模糊或安全关键的场景中。
tldr: The paper introduces a depth-enhanced YOLO-SAM2 framework for improved detection of ballast insufficiency in railway tracks using RGB-D data, achieving significant gains in recall and F1-score compared to RGB-only YOLOv8.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种深度增强的 YOLO-SAM2 框架，用于利用 RGB-D 数据改进铁路轨道中道砟不足的检测，与仅使用 RGB 的 YOLOv8 相比，在召回率和 F1 分数方面取得了显着提升。

title: YOLOv10-Based Multi-Task Framework for Hand Localization and Laterality Classification in Surgical Videos
summary: Real-time hand tracking in trauma surgery is essential for supporting rapid and precise intraoperative decisions. We propose a YOLOv10-based framework that simultaneously localizes hands and classifies their laterality (left or right) in complex surgical scenes. The model is trained on the Trauma THOMPSON Challenge 2025 Task 2 dataset, consisting of first-person surgical videos with annotated hand bounding boxes. Extensive data augmentation and a multi-task detection design improve robustness against motion blur, lighting variations, and diverse hand appearances. Evaluation demonstrates accurate left-hand (67\%) and right-hand (71\%) classification, while distinguishing hands from the background remains challenging. The model achieves an $mAP_{[0.5:0.95]}$ of 0.33 and maintains real-time inference, highlighting its potential for intraoperative deployment. This work establishes a foundation for advanced hand-instrument interaction analysis in emergency surgical procedures.
summary_zh: 创伤手术中的实时手部跟踪对于支持快速而精确的术中决策至关重要。我们提出了一种基于YOLOv10的框架，可以在复杂的手术场景中同时定位手部并对其左右侧进行分类。该模型在 Trauma THOMPSON Challenge 2025 Task 2 数据集上进行训练，该数据集包含带标注手部边界框的第一人称手术视频。广泛的数据增强和多任务检测设计提高了模型对抗运动模糊、光照变化和各种手部外观的鲁棒性。评估结果表明，左手分类准确率为 67%，右手分类准确率为 71%，但区分手部和背景仍然具有挑战性。该模型实现了 0.33 的 $mAP_{[0.5:0.95]}$，并保持了实时推理速度，突显了其术中部署的潜力。这项工作为急诊手术中高级手-器械交互分析奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper presents a YOLOv10-based multi-task framework for real-time hand localization and laterality classification in surgical videos, achieving real-time performance with an mAP of 0.33. While the hand localization accuracy could be improved, it lays a foundation for hand-instrument interaction analysis.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于YOLOv10的多任务框架，用于实时手术视频中手部定位和左右手分类，实现了实时性能，mAP为0.33。虽然手部定位精度有待提高，但为手-器交互分析奠定了基础。

title: AdsorbFlow: energy-conditioned flow matching enables fast and realistic adsorbate placement
summary:
Identifying low-energy adsorption geometries on catalytic surfaces is a practical bottleneck for computational heterogeneous catalysis: the difficulty lies not only in the cost of density functional theory (DFT) but in proposing initial placements that relax into the correct energy basins. Conditional denoising diffusion has improved success rates, yet requires $\sim$100 iterative steps per sample.
  Here we introduce AdsorbFlow, a deterministic generative model that learns an energy-conditioned vector field on the rigid-body configuration space of adsorbate translation and rotation via conditional flow matching. Energy information enters through classifier-free guidance conditioning -- not energy-gradient guidance -- and sampling reduces to integrating an ODE in as few as 5 steps.
  On OC20-Dense with full DFT single-point verification, AdsorbFlow with an EquiformerV2 backbone achieves 61.4% SR@10 and 34.1% SR@1 -- surpassing AdsorbDiff (31.8% SR@1, 41.0% SR@10) at every evaluation level and AdsorbML (47.7% SR@10) -- while using 20 times fewer generative steps and achieving the lowest anomaly rate among generative methods (6.8%). On 50 out-of-distribution systems, AdsorbFlow retains 58.0% SR@10 with a MLFF-to-DFT gap of only 4~percentage points. These results establish that deterministic transport is both faster and more accurate than stochastic denoising for adsorbate placement.
summary_zh:
识别催化表面上的低能吸附几何构型是计算非均相催化的一个实际瓶颈：困难不仅在于密度泛函理论（DFT）的计算成本，还在于提出能够弛豫到正确能量盆地的初始位置。条件去噪扩散提高了成功率，但每个样本需要约100次迭代步骤。

  在此，我们引入AdsorbFlow，一种确定性的生成模型，它通过条件流匹配学习吸附质平动和转动刚体构型空间上的能量条件向量场。能量信息通过无分类器引导条件化（而不是能量梯度引导）进入，而采样简化为在至多5步中积分一个常微分方程。

  在使用完整DFT单点验证的OC20-Dense数据集上，带有EquiformerV2骨干网络的AdsorbFlow实现了61.4%的SR@10和34.1%的SR@1 —— 在每个评估级别上都超过了AdsorbDiff（31.8%的SR@1，41.0%的SR@10）和AdsorbML（47.7%的SR@10）—— 同时使用少20倍的生成步骤，并实现了生成方法中最低的异常率（6.8%）。在50个超出分布的体系上，AdsorbFlow保留了58.0%的SR@10，且MLFF到DFT的差距仅为4个百分点。这些结果表明，对于吸附质放置，确定性传输比随机去噪更快且更准确。
tldr: AdsorbFlow, a novel energy-conditioned flow matching method, significantly improves the speed and accuracy of adsorbate placement for catalytic surface simulations compared to existing diffusion-based methods by learning a deterministic vector field. It demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on the OC20-Dense dataset.
tldr_zh: AdsorbFlow是一种新的能量条件流匹配方法，与现有的基于扩散的方法相比，它通过学习确定性向量场，显著提高了用于催化表面模拟的吸附物放置的速度和准确性。它在OC20-Dense数据集上展示了最先进的性能。

title: Seeing Farther and Smarter: Value-Guided Multi-Path Reflection for VLM Policy Optimization
summary: Solving complex, long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks requires a deep understanding of physical interactions, reasoning about their long-term consequences, and precise high-level planning. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer a general perceive-reason-act framework for this goal. However, previous approaches using reflective planning to guide VLMs in correcting actions encounter significant limitations. These methods rely on inefficient and often inaccurate implicit learning of state-values from noisy foresight predictions, evaluate only a single greedy future, and suffer from substantial inference latency. To address these limitations, we propose a novel test-time computation framework that decouples state evaluation from action generation. This provides a more direct and fine-grained supervisory signal for robust decision-making. Our method explicitly models the advantage of an action plan, quantified by its reduction in distance to the goal, and uses a scalable critic to estimate. To address the stochastic nature of single-trajectory evaluation, we employ beam search to explore multiple future paths and aggregate them during decoding to model their expected long-term returns, leading to more robust action generation. Additionally, we introduce a lightweight, confidence-based trigger that allows for early exit when direct predictions are reliable, invoking reflection only when necessary. Extensive experiments on diverse, unseen multi-stage robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate a 24.6% improvement in success rate over state-of-the-art baselines, while significantly reducing inference time by 56.5%.
summary_zh: 解决复杂、长程的机器人操作任务需要深入理解物理交互，推理其长期影响，以及精确的高层规划。视觉-语言模型（VLMs）为此目标提供了一个通用的感知-推理-行动框架。然而，先前使用反思规划来指导VLMs纠正动作的方法遇到了显著的局限性。这些方法依赖于低效且通常不准确的、从噪声性的前瞻预测中隐式学习状态价值，仅评估单个贪婪的未来，并且遭受显著的推理延迟。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的测试时计算框架，该框架将状态评估与动作生成分离。这为稳健的决策提供了更直接和细粒度的监督信号。我们的方法显式地建模了动作计划的优势，由其到目标的距离减少来量化，并使用可扩展的评论器进行估计。为了解决单轨迹评估的随机性，我们采用束搜索来探索多个未来路径，并在解码过程中对其进行聚合，以建模其预期的长期回报，从而实现更稳健的动作生成。此外，我们引入了一种轻量级的、基于置信度的触发器，允许在直接预测可靠时提前退出，仅在必要时调用反思。在各种未见过的多阶段机器人操作任务上的大量实验表明，成功率比最先进的基线提高了24.6%，同时将推理时间显著减少了56.5%。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel framework for improving VLM policy optimization in robotics by decoupling state evaluation from action generation, using advantage estimation, beam search, and a confidence-based trigger for reflection, achieving significant performance gains and inference time reduction in multi-stage robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的框架，通过将状态评估与动作生成分离、使用优势估计、束搜索和基于置信度的反射触发，来改进机器人技术中的 VLM 策略优化，从而在多阶段机器人操作任务中实现了显著的性能提升和推理时间缩短。

title: TOPReward: Token Probabilities as Hidden Zero-Shot Rewards for Robotics
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have seen rapid progress in pretraining, their advancement in Reinforcement Learning (RL) remains hampered by low sample efficiency and sparse rewards in real-world settings. Developing generalizable process reward models is essential for providing the fine-grained feedback necessary to bridge this gap, yet existing temporal value functions often fail to generalize beyond their training domains. We introduce TOPReward, a novel, probabilistically grounded temporal value function that leverages the latent world knowledge of pretrained video Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to estimate robotic task progress. Unlike prior methods that prompt VLMs to directly output progress values, which are prone to numerical misrepresentation, TOPReward extracts task progress directly from the VLM's internal token logits. In zero-shot evaluations across 130+ distinct real-world tasks and multiple robot platforms (e.g., Franka, YAM, SO-100/101), TOPReward achieves 0.947 mean Value-Order Correlation (VOC) on Qwen3-VL, dramatically outperforming the state-of-the-art GVL baseline which achieves near-zero correlation on the same open-source model. We further demonstrate that TOPReward serves as a versatile tool for downstream applications, including success detection and reward-aligned behavior cloning.
summary_zh: 虽然视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型在预训练方面取得了快速进展，但它们在强化学习 (RL) 方面的进步仍然受到现实世界环境中低样本效率和稀疏奖励的阻碍。开发可泛化的过程奖励模型对于提供弥合这一差距所需的精细反馈至关重要，然而现有的时序价值函数往往无法泛化到其训练领域之外。我们引入了 TOPReward，一种新颖的、基于概率的时序价值函数，它利用预训练视频视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 的潜在世界知识来估计机器人任务进度。与之前提示 VLM 直接输出进度值（容易出现数值表示错误）的方法不同，TOPReward 直接从 VLM 的内部 token logits 中提取任务进度。在超过 130 个不同的现实世界任务和多个机器人平台（例如，Franka、YAM、SO-100/101）上的零样本评估中，TOPReward 在 Qwen3-VL 上实现了 0.947 的平均价值-顺序相关性 (VOC)，显著优于最先进的 GVL 基线，后者在相同的开源模型上实现了接近于零的相关性。我们进一步证明 TOPReward 是一种多功能的下游应用工具，包括成功检测和奖励对齐的行为克隆。
tldr: The paper introduces TOPReward, a novel method that leverages token probabilities from pretrained video Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as a hidden, zero-shot reward signal for robotic RL, demonstrating significantly improved performance across diverse real-world tasks compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 TOPReward 的新方法，该方法利用预训练视频视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 中的 token 概率作为机器人强化学习的隐藏式零样本奖励信号，与现有方法相比，在各种现实世界任务中表现出显著提高的性能。

title: WildOS: Open-Vocabulary Object Search in the Wild
summary: Autonomous navigation in complex, unstructured outdoor environments requires robots to operate over long ranges without prior maps and limited depth sensing. In such settings, relying solely on geometric frontiers for exploration is often insufficient. In such settings, the ability to reason semantically about where to go and what is safe to traverse is crucial for robust, efficient exploration. This work presents WildOS, a unified system for long-range, open-vocabulary object search that combines safe geometric exploration with semantic visual reasoning. WildOS builds a sparse navigation graph to maintain spatial memory, while utilizing a foundation-model-based vision module, ExploRFM, to score frontier nodes of the graph. ExploRFM simultaneously predicts traversability, visual frontiers, and object similarity in image space, enabling real-time, onboard semantic navigation tasks. The resulting vision-scored graph enables the robot to explore semantically meaningful directions while ensuring geometric safety. Furthermore, we introduce a particle-filter-based method for coarse localization of the open-vocabulary target query, that estimates candidate goal positions beyond the robot's immediate depth horizon, enabling effective planning toward distant goals. Extensive closed-loop field experiments across diverse off-road and urban terrains demonstrate that WildOS enables robust navigation, significantly outperforming purely geometric and purely vision-based baselines in both efficiency and autonomy. Our results highlight the potential of vision foundation models to drive open-world robotic behaviors that are both semantically informed and geometrically grounded. Project Page: https://leggedrobotics.github.io/wildos/
summary_zh: 在复杂、非结构化的室外环境中进行自主导航需要机器人能够在没有先验地图和有限深度感知的情况下，远距离运行。在这种情况下，仅仅依靠几何边界进行探索往往是不够的。语义推理能力，即推理去哪里以及什么地方可以安全通行，对于鲁棒、高效的探索至关重要。本工作提出了 WildOS，一个用于远距离、开放词汇表物体搜索的统一系统，它结合了安全的几何探索和语义视觉推理。WildOS 构建了一个稀疏导航图来维护空间记忆，同时利用一个基于基础模型的视觉模块 ExploRFM 来对导航图的边界节点进行评分。 ExploRFM 在图像空间中同时预测可通行性、视觉边界和物体相似度，从而实现实时的、板载的语义导航任务。由此产生的视觉评分图使机器人能够探索语义上有意义的方向，同时确保几何安全性。此外，我们引入了一种基于粒子滤波的方法，用于对开放词汇表目标查询进行粗略的定位，该方法可以估计超出机器人直接深度范围之外的候选目标位置，从而实现有效的目标方向规划。在各种越野和城市地形上进行的大量闭环现场实验表明，WildOS 实现了鲁棒的导航，在效率和自主性方面均显著优于纯几何和纯视觉基线。我们的结果突出了视觉基础模型在驱动语义信息丰富且几何上基础扎实的开放世界机器人行为方面的潜力。项目主页：https://leggedrobotics.github.io/wildos/
tldr: WildOS is a system for long-range robot navigation combining geometric exploration with semantic visual reasoning using a foundation model to score frontier nodes for traversability, visual frontiers, and object similarity, enabling efficient open-vocabulary object search in unstructured environments.
tldr_zh: WildOS是一个用于长距离机器人导航的系统，它结合了几何探索和语义视觉推理，使用基础模型来评分前沿结点的可通行性、视觉前沿和物体相似性，从而在非结构化环境中实现高效的开放词汇物体搜索。

title: The LLMbda Calculus: AI Agents, Conversations, and Information Flow
summary: A conversation with a large language model (LLM) is a sequence of prompts and responses, with each response generated from the preceding conversation. AI agents build such conversations automatically: given an initial human prompt, a planner loop interleaves LLM calls with tool invocations and code execution. This tight coupling creates a new and poorly understood attack surface. A malicious prompt injected into a conversation can compromise later reasoning, trigger dangerous tool calls, or distort final outputs. Despite the centrality of such systems, we currently lack a principled semantic foundation for reasoning about their behaviour and safety. We address this gap by introducing an untyped call-by-value lambda calculus enriched with dynamic information-flow control and a small number of primitives for constructing prompt-response conversations. Our language includes a primitive that invokes an LLM: it serializes a value, sends it to the model as a prompt, and parses the response as a new term. This calculus faithfully represents planner loops and their vulnerabilities, including the mechanisms by which prompt injection alters subsequent computation. The semantics explicitly captures conversations, and so supports reasoning about defenses such as quarantined sub-conversations, isolation of generated code, and information-flow restrictions on what may influence an LLM call. A termination-insensitive noninterference theorem establishes integrity and confidentiality guarantees, demonstrating that a formal calculus can provide rigorous foundations for safe agentic programming.
summary_zh: 与大型语言模型（LLM）的对话就是一个由提示和回复构成的序列，每个回复都由之前的对话生成。人工智能代理自动构建这样的对话：给定一个初始的人工提示，规划器循环交织地进行 LLM 调用、工具调用和代码执行。这种紧耦合创建了一个新的且理解不足的攻击面。注入到对话中的恶意提示可能会损害后续的推理，触发危险的工具调用，或扭曲最终输出。尽管这类系统至关重要，但我们目前缺乏一个有原则的语义基础来推断其行为和安全性。我们通过引入一个非类型化的按值调用 lambda 演算来弥补这一差距，该演算通过动态信息流控制和用于构建提示-回复对话的少量原语进行增强。我们的语言包括一个调用 LLM 的原语：它序列化一个值，将其作为提示发送给模型，并将响应解析为新的项。该演算忠实地表示规划器循环及其漏洞，包括提示注入改变后续计算的机制。语义显式地捕获对话，从而支持对防御措施的推理，例如隔离的子对话、生成代码的隔离以及影响 LLM 调用的信息流限制。一个与终止无关的非干扰定理建立了完整性和保密性保证，表明形式演算可以为安全的代理编程提供严格的基础。
tldr: This paper introduces a lambda calculus for reasoning about the safety and behavior of LLM-based AI agents, explicitly modeling prompt injection vulnerabilities and defenses using information-flow control.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种lambda演算，用于推理基于LLM的AI代理的安全性和行为，使用信息流控制明确建模提示注入漏洞和防御。

title: IR$^3$: Contrastive Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Interpretable Detection and Mitigation of Reward Hacking
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) enables powerful LLM alignment but can introduce reward hacking - models exploit spurious correlations in proxy rewards without genuine alignment. Compounding this, the objectives internalized during RLHF remain opaque, making hacking behaviors difficult to detect or correct. We introduce IR3 (Interpretable Reward Reconstruction and Rectification), a framework that reverse-engineers, interprets, and surgically repairs the implicit objectives driving RLHF-tuned models. We propose Contrastive Inverse Reinforcement Learning (C-IRL), which reconstructs the implicit reward function by contrasting paired responses from post-alignment and baseline policies to explain behavioral shifts during RLHF. We then decompose the reconstructed reward via sparse autoencoders into interpretable features, enabling identification of hacking signatures through contribution analysis. Finally, we propose mitigation strategies - clean reward optimization, adversarial shaping, constrained optimization, and feature-guided distillation - that target problematic features while preserving beneficial alignment. Experiments across multiple reward model configurations show that IR3 achieves 0.89 correlation with ground-truth rewards, identifies hacking features with over 90% precision, and significantly reduces hacking behaviors while maintaining capabilities within 3% of the original model.
summary_zh: 从人类反馈中强化学习(RLHF)能够实现强大的LLM对齐，但也可能引入奖励入侵——模型会利用代理奖励中的虚假相关性，而并非真正的对齐。更糟糕的是，RLHF期间内化的目标仍然是不透明的，使得入侵行为难以检测或纠正。我们提出IR3（可解释的奖励重构与修正）框架，该框架能够逆向工程、解释并外科手术式地修复驱动RLHF调整模型的隐式目标。我们提出对比逆强化学习(C-IRL)，通过对比对齐后策略和基线策略的配对响应来重构隐式奖励函数，从而解释RLHF期间的行为转变。然后，我们通过稀疏自编码器将重构的奖励分解为可解释的特征，从而能够通过贡献分析识别入侵签名。最后，我们提出缓解策略——干净奖励优化、对抗塑造、约束优化和特征引导的蒸馏——这些策略针对问题特征，同时保留有益的对齐。跨多个奖励模型配置的实验表明，IR3实现了与真实奖励0.89的相关性，以超过90%的精度识别了入侵特征，并显著减少了入侵行为，同时保持了原始模型3%以内的能力。
tldr: The paper introduces IR$^3$, a framework to reverse-engineer, interpret, and repair reward hacking in RLHF-tuned LLMs via contrastive IRL, interpretable feature decomposition, and targeted mitigation strategies, demonstrating high correlation with ground-truth rewards and effective hacking mitigation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了IR$^3$框架，通过对比逆强化学习、可解释特征分解和有针对性的缓解策略，对RLHF调优的LLM中的奖励黑客行为进行逆向工程、解释和修复，展示了与真实奖励的高相关性和有效的黑客缓解。

title: MeanFuser: Fast One-Step Multi-Modal Trajectory Generation and Adaptive Reconstruction via MeanFlow for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Generative models have shown great potential in trajectory planning. Recent studies demonstrate that anchor-guided generative models are effective in modeling the uncertainty of driving behaviors and improving overall performance. However, these methods rely on discrete anchor vocabularies that must sufficiently cover the trajectory distribution during testing to ensure robustness, inducing an inherent trade-off between vocabulary size and model performance. To overcome this limitation, we propose MeanFuser, an end-to-end autonomous driving method that enhances both efficiency and robustness through three key designs. (1) We introduce Gaussian Mixture Noise (GMN) to guide generative sampling, enabling a continuous representation of the trajectory space and eliminating the dependency on discrete anchor vocabularies. (2) We adapt ``MeanFlow Identity" to end-to-end planning, which models the mean velocity field between GMN and trajectory distribution instead of the instantaneous velocity field used in vanilla flow matching methods, effectively eliminating numerical errors from ODE solvers and significantly accelerating inference. (3) We design a lightweight Adaptive Reconstruction Module (ARM) that enables the model to implicitly select from all sampled proposals or reconstruct a new trajectory when none is satisfactory via attention weights. Experiments on the NAVSIM closed-loop benchmark demonstrate that MeanFuser achieves outstanding performance without the supervision of the PDM Score. and exceptional inference efficiency, offering a robust and efficient solution for end-to-end autonomous driving. Our code and model are available at https://github.com/wjl2244/MeanFuser.
summary_zh: 生成模型在轨迹规划中展现出巨大的潜力。最近的研究表明，锚点引导的生成模型在建模驾驶行为的不确定性和提高整体性能方面非常有效。然而，这些方法依赖于离散的锚点词汇，在测试期间必须充分覆盖轨迹分布以确保鲁棒性，这导致了词汇量大小和模型性能之间固有的权衡。为了克服这个限制，我们提出MeanFuser，一种端到端的自动驾驶方法，通过三个关键设计来提高效率和鲁棒性。(1) 我们引入了高斯混合噪声 (GMN) 来引导生成采样，从而实现轨迹空间的连续表示，并消除对离散锚点词汇的依赖。(2) 我们将``MeanFlow Identity"应用于端到端规划，该方法建模GMN和轨迹分布之间的平均速度场，而不是原始流匹配方法中使用的瞬时速度场，从而有效地消除了ODE求解器的数值误差，并显著加速了推理。(3) 我们设计了一个轻量级的自适应重构模块 (ARM)，使得模型能够通过注意力权重，从所有采样的提议中隐式地选择或重新构建一个新的轨迹，当没有一个提议令人满意时。在NAVSIM闭环基准上的实验表明，MeanFuser在没有PDM Score监督的情况下实现了出色的性能，并且具有卓越的推理效率，为端到端的自动驾驶提供了一种稳健而高效的解决方案。我们的代码和模型可在https://github.com/wjl2244/MeanFuser获取。
tldr: MeanFuser is a novel end-to-end autonomous driving method that uses Gaussian Mixture Noise and a modified MeanFlow approach to improve trajectory generation efficiency and robustness, along with an Adaptive Reconstruction Module for enhanced performance.
tldr_zh: MeanFuser 是一种新颖的端到端自动驾驶方法，它使用高斯混合噪声和改进的 MeanFlow 方法来提高轨迹生成效率和鲁棒性，以及一个自适应重建模块以增强性能。

title: AdaWorldPolicy: World-Model-Driven Diffusion Policy with Online Adaptive Learning for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Effective robotic manipulation requires policies that can anticipate physical outcomes and adapt to real-world environments. Effective robotic manipulation requires policies that can anticipate physical outcomes and adapt to real-world environments. In this work, we introduce a unified framework, World-Model-Driven Diffusion Policy with Online Adaptive Learning (AdaWorldPolicy) to enhance robotic manipulation under dynamic conditions with minimal human involvement. Our core insight is that world models provide strong supervision signals, enabling online adaptive learning in dynamic environments, which can be complemented by force-torque feedback to mitigate dynamic force shifts. Our AdaWorldPolicy integrates a world model, an action expert, and a force predictor-all implemented as interconnected Flow Matching Diffusion Transformers (DiT). They are interconnected via the multi-modal self-attention layers, enabling deep feature exchange for joint learning while preserving their distinct modularity characteristics. We further propose a novel Online Adaptive Learning (AdaOL) strategy that dynamically switches between an Action Generation mode and a Future Imagination mode to drive reactive updates across all three modules. This creates a powerful closed-loop mechanism that adapts to both visual and physical domain shifts with minimal overhead. Across a suite of simulated and real-robot benchmarks, our AdaWorldPolicy achieves state-of-the-art performance, with dynamical adaptive capacity to out-of-distribution scenarios.
summary_zh: 有效机器人操作需要能够预测物理结果并适应真实世界环境的策略。为增强机器人在动态条件下进行操作的能力，并最大程度减少人为干预，我们提出了一种统一的框架，即基于世界模型的扩散策略与在线自适应学习 (AdaWorldPolicy)。我们的核心洞见是，世界模型提供强大的监督信号，从而能够在动态环境中进行在线自适应学习，并可以通过力矩反馈来缓解动态力变化。我们的 AdaWorldPolicy 集成了世界模型、动作专家和力预测器——所有这些都以相互连接的 Flow Matching 扩散Transformer (DiT) 的形式实现。它们通过多模态自注意力层连接起来，从而进行深度特征交换以进行联合学习，同时保持各自的模块化特性。我们进一步提出了一种新颖的在线自适应学习 (AdaOL) 策略，该策略在动作生成模式和未来想象模式之间动态切换，以驱动所有三个模块之间的反应性更新。这创建了一个强大的闭环机制，能够以最小的开销适应视觉和物理领域的变化。在一系列模拟和真实机器人基准测试中，我们的 AdaWorldPolicy 实现了最先进的性能，并具备针对分布外场景的动态自适应能力。
tldr: The paper introduces AdaWorldPolicy, a world-model-driven diffusion policy with online adaptive learning, for robotic manipulation, showing state-of-the-art performance in simulated and real-world environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AdaWorldPolicy，一种基于世界模型的扩散策略，具有在线自适应学习能力，用于机器人操作，并在模拟和真实环境中表现出最先进的性能。

title: To Move or Not to Move: Constraint-based Planning Enables Zero-Shot Generalization for Interactive Navigation
summary: Visual navigation typically assumes the existence of at least one obstacle-free path between start and goal, which must be discovered/planned by the robot. However, in real-world scenarios, such as home environments and warehouses, clutter can block all routes. Targeted at such cases, we introduce the Lifelong Interactive Navigation problem, where a mobile robot with manipulation abilities can move clutter to forge its own path to complete sequential object- placement tasks - each involving placing an given object (eg. Alarm clock, Pillow) onto a target object (eg. Dining table, Desk, Bed). To address this lifelong setting - where effects of environment changes accumulate and have long-term effects - we propose an LLM-driven, constraint-based planning framework with active perception. Our framework allows the LLM to reason over a structured scene graph of discovered objects and obstacles, deciding which object to move, where to place it, and where to look next to discover task-relevant information. This coupling of reasoning and active perception allows the agent to explore the regions expected to contribute to task completion rather than exhaustively mapping the environment. A standard motion planner then executes the corresponding navigate-pick-place, or detour sequence, ensuring reliable low-level control. Evaluated in physics-enabled ProcTHOR-10k simulator, our approach outperforms non-learning and learning-based baselines. We further demonstrate our approach qualitatively on real-world hardware.
summary_zh: 视觉导航通常假设起点和目标之间至少存在一条无障碍路径，机器人必须发现/规划该路径。 然而，在现实场景中，例如家庭环境和仓库，杂物可能会阻挡所有路线。 针对这种情况，我们提出了终身交互导航问题，其中具有操纵能力的移动机器人可以通过移动杂物来开辟自己的路径，以完成顺序的物体放置任务——每个任务都涉及将给定的物体（例如，闹钟、枕头）放置到目标物体上（例如，餐桌、书桌、床）。 为了解决这种终身设置——环境变化的影响会积累并产生长期影响——我们提出了一种由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动、基于约束的规划框架，该框架具有主动感知能力。 我们的框架允许 LLM 对已发现的物体和障碍物的结构化场景图进行推理，从而决定移动哪个物体、将其放置在哪里，以及接下来应该看向哪里以发现与任务相关的信息。 这种推理和主动感知的耦合使得智能体能够探索预计有助于完成任务的区域，而不是详尽地绘制环境地图。 然后，标准的运动规划器执行相应的导航-拾取-放置或绕行序列，确保可靠的底层控制。 在启用物理特性的 ProcTHOR-10k 模拟器中进行评估后，我们的方法优于非学习和基于学习的基线。 我们进一步在真实世界的硬件上对我们的方法进行了定性演示。
tldr: The paper introduces a new Lifelong Interactive Navigation problem where a robot manipulates clutter to create paths for sequential object placement, using an LLM-driven, constraint-based planning framework with active perception, demonstrating zero-shot generalization in simulation and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个新的终身交互式导航问题，即机器人通过操纵杂物来创建路径，以进行顺序物体放置。它使用一个基于LLM驱动的、基于约束的规划框架以及主动感知，并在模拟和真实环境中展示了零样本泛化能力。

title: Contextual Safety Reasoning and Grounding for Open-World Robots
summary: Robots are increasingly operating in open-world environments where safe behavior depends on context: the same hallway may require different navigation strategies when crowded versus empty, or during an emergency versus normal operations. Traditional safety approaches enforce fixed constraints in user-specified contexts, limiting their ability to handle the open-ended contextual variability of real-world deployment. We address this gap via CORE, a safety framework that enables online contextual reasoning, grounding, and enforcement without prior knowledge of the environment (e.g., maps or safety specifications). CORE uses a vision-language model (VLM) to continuously reason about context-dependent safety rules directly from visual observations, grounds these rules in the physical environment, and enforces the resulting spatially-defined safe sets via control barrier functions. We provide probabilistic safety guarantees for CORE that account for perceptual uncertainty, and we demonstrate through simulation and real-world experiments that CORE enforces contextually appropriate behavior in unseen environments, significantly outperforming prior semantic safety methods that lack online contextual reasoning. Ablation studies validate our theoretical guarantees and underscore the importance of both VLM-based reasoning and spatial grounding for enforcing contextual safety in novel settings.
