We provide additional resources at https://zacravichandran.github.io/CORE.
summary_zh: 机器人越来越多地在开放世界环境中运行，在这些环境中，安全行为取决于上下文：同一条走廊在拥挤时和空旷时，或在紧急情况和正常运行期间可能需要不同的导航策略。传统的安全方法在用户指定的上下文中强制执行固定的约束，限制了它们处理现实世界部署中开放式上下文可变性的能力。我们通过CORE来解决这一差距，CORE是一个安全框架，它能够在没有环境先验知识（例如，地图或安全规范）的情况下，进行在线上下文推理、具象化和执行。CORE使用视觉-语言模型(VLM)直接从视觉观察中连续推理与上下文相关的安全规则，将这些规则具象化到物理环境中，并通过控制屏障函数执行由此产生的空间定义的安全集。我们为CORE提供了考虑感知不确定性的概率安全保证，并通过仿真和真实世界的实验证明，CORE在未见过的环境中执行上下文适当的行为，显著优于缺乏在线上下文推理的先前语义安全方法。消融研究验证了我们的理论保证，并强调了基于VLM的推理和空间具象化对于在新环境中执行上下文安全的重要性。我们提供了更多资源，网址为https://zacravichandran.github.io/CORE。
tldr: The paper introduces CORE, a framework for robots to reason about contextual safety rules using vision-language models and enforce them using control barrier functions in open-world environments without prior knowledge, demonstrating improved performance over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 CORE 的框架，该框架使机器人能够使用视觉语言模型推理上下文安全规则，并在开放世界环境中通过控制障碍函数执行它们，而无需先验知识，证明了比现有方法更好的性能。

title: Towards Dexterous Embodied Manipulation via Deep Multi-Sensory Fusion and Sparse Expert Scaling
summary: Realizing dexterous embodied manipulation necessitates the deep integration of heterogeneous multimodal sensory inputs. However, current vision-centric paradigms often overlook the critical force and geometric feedback essential for complex tasks. This paper presents DeMUSE, a Deep Multimodal Unified Sparse Experts framework leveraging a Diffusion Transformer to integrate RGB, depth, and 6-axis force into a unified serialized stream. Adaptive Modality-specific Normalization (AdaMN) is employed to recalibrate modality-aware features, mitigating representation imbalance and harmonizing the heterogeneous distributions of multi-sensory signals. To facilitate efficient scaling, the architecture utilizes a Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with shared experts, increasing model capacity for physical priors while maintaining the low inference latency required for real-time control. A Joint denoising objective synchronously synthesizes environmental evolution and action sequences to ensure physical consistency. Achieving success rates of 83.2% and 72.5% in simulation and real-world trials, DeMUSE demonstrates state-of-the-art performance, validating the necessity of deep multi-sensory integration for complex physical interactions.
summary_zh: 实现灵巧具身操作需要深度整合异构多模态感知输入。然而，目前以视觉为中心的范式通常忽略了复杂任务所需的关键力和几何反馈。本文提出了一种深度多模态统一稀疏专家框架DeMUSE，该框架利用扩散Transformer将RGB图像、深度信息和六轴力整合到统一的序列化数据流中。采用自适应模态专属归一化(AdaMN)来重新校准模态感知的特征，从而减轻表示不平衡并协调多感官信号的异构分布。为了便于高效扩展，该架构利用具有共享专家的稀疏混合专家模型（MoE），从而在保持实时控制所需的低推理延迟的同时，增加模型的物理先验知识容量。联合去噪目标同步合成环境演化和动作序列，以确保物理一致性。DeMUSE在模拟和现实世界试验中分别实现了83.2%和72.5%的成功率，展示了最先进的性能，从而验证了深度多感官整合对于复杂物理交互的必要性。
tldr: The paper introduces DeMUSE, a deep learning framework that integrates RGB, depth, and force data for dexterous embodied manipulation using a Diffusion Transformer and Sparse Mixture-of-Experts, achieving state-of-the-art results in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DeMUSE，一个深度学习框架，它集成了RGB、深度和力数据，用于灵巧的具身操作，使用扩散Transformer和稀疏混合专家，在模拟和真实世界实验中实现了最先进的结果。

title: Universal Pose Pretraining for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary:
Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often suffer from feature collapse and low training efficiency because they entangle high-level perception with sparse, embodiment-specific action supervision. Since these models typically rely on VLM backbones optimized for Visual Question Answering (VQA), they excel at semantic identification but often overlook subtle 3D state variations that dictate distinct action patterns.
  To resolve these misalignments, we propose Pose-VLA, a decoupled paradigm that separates VLA training into a pre-training phase for extracting universal 3D spatial priors in a unified camera-centric space, and a post-training phase for efficient embodiment alignment within robot-specific action space. By introducing discrete pose tokens as a universal representation, Pose-VLA seamlessly integrates spatial grounding from diverse 3D datasets with geometry-level trajectories from robotic demonstrations. Our framework follows a two-stage pre-training pipeline, establishing fundamental spatial grounding via poses followed by motion alignment through trajectory supervision.
  Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Pose-VLA achieves state-of-the-art results on RoboTwin 2.0 with a 79.5% average success rate and competitive performance on LIBERO at 96.0%. Real-world experiments further showcase robust generalization across diverse objects using only 100 demonstrations per task, validating the efficiency of our pre-training paradigm.
summary_zh:
现有的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型通常受困于特征崩溃和训练效率低下，因为它们将高层感知与稀疏、特定于具身性的动作监督纠缠在一起。由于这些模型通常依赖于针对视觉问答(VQA)优化的VLM骨干网络，因此它们擅长语义识别，但常常忽略决定着不同动作模式的细微3D状态变化。

为了解决这些错位问题，我们提出了Pose-VLA，一种解耦范式，将VLA训练分为两个阶段：预训练阶段，用于在统一的以相机为中心的空间中提取通用的3D空间先验；后训练阶段，用于在机器人特定的动作空间内进行高效的具身对齐。通过引入离散姿态令牌作为通用表示，Pose-VLA将来自各种3D数据集的空间基准与来自机器人演示的几何级别轨迹无缝集成。我们的框架遵循两阶段预训练流程，首先通过姿态建立基本的空间基准，然后通过轨迹监督进行运动对齐。

广泛的评估表明，Pose-VLA在RoboTwin 2.0上实现了最先进的结果，平均成功率达到79.5%，并在LIBERO上实现了96.0%的具有竞争力的性能。真实世界的实验进一步展示了跨各种对象的鲁棒泛化能力，每个任务仅使用100个演示，验证了我们预训练范式的效率。
tldr: The paper introduces Pose-VLA, a decoupled Vision-Language-Action model pre-trained on 3D pose and trajectory data, demonstrating improved performance and generalization in robotic manipulation tasks with minimal task-specific demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Pose-VLA，一种解耦的视觉-语言-动作模型，该模型在 3D 姿势和轨迹数据上进行预训练，在机器人操作任务中表现出更高的性能和泛化能力，并且只需少量的特定任务演示即可。

title: CACTO-BIC: Scalable Actor-Critic Learning via Biased Sampling and GPU-Accelerated Trajectory Optimization
summary: Trajectory Optimization (TO) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) offer complementary strengths for solving optimal control problems. TO efficiently computes locally optimal solutions but can struggle with non-convexity, while RL is more robust to non-convexity at the cost of significantly higher computational demands. CACTO (Continuous Actor-Critic with Trajectory Optimization) was introduced to combine these advantages by learning a warm-start policy that guides the TO solver towards low-cost trajectories. However, scalability remains a key limitation, as increasing system complexity significantly raises the computational cost of TO. This work introduces CACTO-BIC to address these challenges. CACTO-BIC improves data efficiency by biasing initial-state sampling leveraging a property of the value function associated with locally optimal policies; moreover, it reduces computation time by exploiting GPU acceleration. Empirical evaluations show improved sample efficiency and faster computation compared to CACTO. Comparisons with PPO demonstrate that our approach can achieve similar solutions in less time. Finally, experiments on the AlienGO quadruped robot demonstrate that CACTO-BIC can scale to high-dimensional systems and is suitable for real-time applications.
summary_zh: 轨迹优化(TO)和强化学习(RL)在解决最优控制问题上具有互补的优势。轨迹优化能够高效地计算局部最优解，但在非凸性问题上表现不佳，而强化学习对于非凸性问题更具鲁棒性，但计算量却显著增加。CACTO（基于轨迹优化的连续型Actor-Critic）通过学习一个热启动策略来引导轨迹优化求解器找到低成本轨迹，从而结合了这些优势。然而，可扩展性仍然是一个关键限制，因为增加系统复杂性会显著提高轨迹优化的计算成本。本文提出了CACTO-BIC来应对这些挑战。CACTO-BIC利用与局部最优策略相关的价值函数的属性，通过偏置初始状态采样来提高数据效率；此外，它通过利用GPU加速来减少计算时间。实验评估表明，与CACTO相比，其样本效率更高，计算速度更快。与PPO的比较表明，我们的方法可以在更短的时间内获得相似的解决方案。最后，在AlienGO四足机器人上的实验表明，CACTO-BIC可以扩展到高维系统，并且适用于实时应用。
tldr: CACTO-BIC improves upon CACTO by using biased sampling and GPU acceleration to scale up actor-critic learning via trajectory optimization for high-dimensional robotic systems, demonstrating improved sample efficiency and faster computation.
tldr_zh: CACTO-BIC 通过使用偏差采样和 GPU 加速来扩展 actor-critic 学习， 采用了基于轨迹优化的方法， 适用于高维机器人系统。实验表明其具有更高的样本效率和更快的计算速度，是对 CACTO 的改进。

title: What Matters for Simulation to Online Reinforcement Learning on Real Robots
summary: We investigate what specific design choices enable successful online reinforcement learning (RL) on physical robots. Across 100 real-world training runs on three distinct robotic platforms, we systematically ablate algorithmic, systems, and experimental decisions that are typically left implicit in prior work. We find that some widely used defaults can be harmful, while a set of robust, readily adopted design choices within standard RL practice yield stable learning across tasks and hardware. These results provide the first large-sample empirical study of such design choices, enabling practitioners to deploy online RL with lower engineering effort.
summary_zh: 我们研究了哪些具体的设计选择能够实现物理机器人上成功的在线强化学习（RL）。在三个不同的机器人平台上进行了 100 次真实世界的训练运行后，我们系统地消融了算法、系统和实验决策，这些决策在之前的工作中通常是隐式的。我们发现，一些广泛使用的默认设置可能是有害的，而标准强化学习实践中的一组稳健且易于采用的设计选择可以在任务和硬件之间产生稳定的学习效果。这些结果提供了对这类设计选择的首个大样本实证研究，使从业者能够以更少的工程投入来部署在线强化学习。
tldr: This paper investigates the key design choices for successful online reinforcement learning on physical robots through extensive experimentation, identifying robust and readily adopted designs while highlighting potentially harmful defaults.
tldr_zh: 本文通过大量实验研究了在物理机器人上成功进行在线强化学习的关键设计选择，确定了稳健且易于采用的设计，同时突出了可能有害的默认设置。

title: An Approach to Combining Video and Speech with Large Language Models in Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Interpreting human intent accurately is a central challenge in human-robot interaction (HRI) and a key requirement for achieving more natural and intuitive collaboration between humans and machines. This work presents a novel multimodal HRI framework that combines advanced vision-language models, speech processing, and fuzzy logic to enable precise and adaptive control of a Dobot Magician robotic arm. The proposed system integrates Florence-2 for object detection, Llama 3.1 for natural language understanding, and Whisper for speech recognition, providing users with a seamless and intuitive interface for object manipulation through spoken commands. By jointly addressing scene perception and action planning, the approach enhances the reliability of command interpretation and execution. Experimental evaluations conducted on consumer-grade hardware demonstrate a command execution accuracy of 75\%, highlighting both the robustness and adaptability of the system. Beyond its current performance, the proposed architecture serves as a flexible and extensible foundation for future HRI research, offering a practical pathway toward more sophisticated and natural human-robot collaboration through tightly coupled speech and vision-language processing.
summary_zh: 准确理解人类意图是人机交互（HRI）的核心挑战，也是实现更自然、更直观的人机协作的关键要求。本文提出了一种新型多模态人机交互框架，该框架结合了先进的视觉-语言模型、语音处理和模糊逻辑，从而实现对Dobot Magician机械臂的精确和自适应控制。所提出的系统集成了 Florence-2 用于目标检测，Llama 3.1 用于自然语言理解，以及 Whisper 用于语音识别，从而为用户提供了一个无缝和直观的界面，通过语音命令进行目标操作。通过联合处理场景感知和行动规划，该方法提高了命令解释和执行的可靠性。在消费级硬件上进行的实验评估表明，命令执行准确率达到了75%，突出了系统的稳健性和适应性。除了目前的性能之外，所提出的架构还作为未来人机交互研究的灵活和可扩展的基础，为通过紧密耦合的语音和视觉-语言处理实现更复杂和自然的人机协作提供了一条切实可行的途径。
tldr: This paper presents a multimodal Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) framework using vision-language models (Florence-2, Llama 3.1), speech processing (Whisper), and fuzzy logic to enable spoken command-based control of a robotic arm, achieving 75% command execution accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个多模态人机交互 (HRI) 框架，使用视觉语言模型 (Florence-2, Llama 3.1)、语音处理 (Whisper) 和模糊逻辑，以实现基于语音命令的机械臂控制，实现了 75% 的命令执行准确率。

title: Large Language Model-Assisted UAV Operations and Communications: A Multifaceted Survey and Tutorial
summary: Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are widely deployed across diverse applications due to their mobility and agility. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a transformative opportunity to enhance UAV intelligence beyond conventional optimization-based and learning-based approaches. By integrating LLMs into UAV systems, advanced environmental understanding, swarm coordination, mobility optimization, and high-level task reasoning can be achieved, thereby allowing more adaptive and context-aware aerial operations. This survey systematically explores the intersection of LLMs and UAV technologies and proposes a unified framework that consolidates existing architectures, methodologies, and applications for UAVs. We first present a structured taxonomy of LLM adaptation techniques for UAVs, including pretraining, fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and prompt engineering, along with key reasoning capabilities such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and In-Context Learning (ICL). We then examine LLM-assisted UAV communications and operations, covering navigation, mission planning, swarm control, safety, autonomy, and network management. After that, the survey further discusses Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for human-swarm interaction, perception-driven navigation, and collaborative control. Finally, we address ethical considerations, including bias, transparency, accountability, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) strategies, and outline future research directions. Overall, this work positions LLM-assisted UAVs as a foundation for intelligent and adaptive aerial systems.
summary_zh:
摘要：
无人机（UAV）因其机动性和灵活性而被广泛部署于各种应用中。大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展为提升无人机智能提供了变革性机会，超越了传统的基于优化和基于学习的方法。通过将LLM集成到无人机系统中，可以实现高级环境理解、集群协同、移动性优化和高层任务推理，从而实现更具适应性和上下文感知的空中作业。本综述系统地探讨了LLM和无人机技术的交叉领域，并提出了一个统一的框架，该框架整合了无人机现有的架构、方法和应用。我们首先提出了一个结构化的LLM无人机适配技术分类法，包括预训练、微调、检索增强生成（RAG）和提示工程，以及关键的推理能力，如思维链（CoT）和上下文学习（ICL）。然后，我们考察了LLM辅助的无人机通信和操作，涵盖导航、任务规划、集群控制、安全、自主性和网络管理。之后，本综述进一步讨论了用于人机群交互、基于感知的导航和协同控制的多模态LLM（MLLM）。最后，我们讨论了伦理考量，包括偏见、透明度、问责制和人在环路（HITL）策略，并概述了未来的研究方向。总而言之，这项工作将LLM辅助的无人机定位为智能和自适应空中系统的基础。
tldr: This survey explores the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) with Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) for enhanced intelligence and autonomy, covering various applications, techniques, and ethical considerations.
tldr_zh: 该综述探讨了大型语言模型 (LLM) 与无人机 (UAV) 的集成，以增强智能和自主性，涵盖各种应用、技术和伦理考虑。

title: Anticipate, Adapt, Act: A Hybrid Framework for Task Planning
summary: Anticipating and adapting to failures is a key capability robots need to collaborate effectively with humans in complex domains. This continues to be a challenge despite the impressive performance of state of the art AI planning systems and Large Language Models (LLMs) because of the uncertainty associated with the tasks and their outcomes. Toward addressing this challenge, we present a hybrid framework that integrates the generic prediction capabilities of an LLM with the probabilistic sequential decision-making capability of Relational Dynamic Influence Diagram Language. For any given task, the robot reasons about the task and the capabilities of the human attempting to complete it; predicts potential failures due to lack of ability (in the human) or lack of relevant domain objects; and executes actions to prevent such failures or recover from them. Experimental evaluation in the VirtualHome 3D simulation environment demonstrates substantial improvement in performance compared with state of the art baselines.
summary_zh: 预测并适应失败是机器人在复杂领域与人类高效协作所需的一项关键能力。尽管最先进的AI规划系统和大型语言模型(LLMs)表现出色，但由于任务及其结果的不确定性，这仍然是一个挑战。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个混合框架，该框架将LLM的通用预测能力与关系动态影响图语言的概率序列决策能力相结合。对于任何给定的任务，机器人会推理该任务和尝试完成该任务的人的能力；预测由于（人类）能力不足或缺乏相关领域对象而可能发生的失败；并执行动作来预防此类失败或从中恢复。在VirtualHome 3D仿真环境中的实验评估表明，与最先进的基线相比，性能有了显著提高。
tldr: This paper introduces a hybrid framework combining LLMs for failure prediction with Relational Dynamic Influence Diagram Language for probabilistic decision-making, enabling robots to anticipate and adapt to potential task failures in human-robot collaboration within a simulated environment.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种混合框架，它结合了用于故障预测的LLM和用于概率决策的关系动态影响图语言，使机器人能够在模拟环境中预测和适应人机协作中潜在的任务故障。

title: Vid2Sid: Videos Can Help Close the Sim2Real Gap
summary: Calibrating a robot simulator's physics parameters (friction, damping, material stiffness) to match real hardware is often done by hand or with black-box optimizers that reduce error but cannot explain which physical discrepancies drive the error. When sensing is limited to external cameras, the problem is further compounded by perception noise and the absence of direct force or state measurements. We present Vid2Sid, a video-driven system identification pipeline that couples foundation-model perception with a VLM-in-the-loop optimizer that analyzes paired sim-real videos, diagnoses concrete mismatches, and proposes physics parameter updates with natural language rationales. We evaluate our approach on a tendon-actuated finger (rigid-body dynamics in MuJoCo) and a deformable continuum tentacle (soft-body dynamics in PyElastica). On sim2real holdout controls unseen during training, Vid2Sid achieves the best average rank across all settings, matching or exceeding black-box optimizers while uniquely providing interpretable reasoning at each iteration. Sim2sim validation confirms that Vid2Sid recovers ground-truth parameters most accurately (mean relative error under 13\% vs. 28--98\%), and ablation analysis reveals three calibration regimes. VLM-guided optimization excels when perception is clean and the simulator is expressive, while model-class limitations bound performance in more challenging settings.
summary_zh: 将机器人模拟器的物理参数（摩擦力、阻尼、材料刚度）校准，使其与真实硬件相匹配，通常通过手动进行或使用黑盒优化器，这些优化器可以减少误差，但无法解释哪些物理差异导致了误差。当传感仅限于外部摄像头时，问题会因感知噪声和缺乏直接的力或状态测量而进一步复杂化。我们提出了一种视频驱动的系统辨识流程 Vid2Sid，它将基础模型感知与 VLM 环路式优化器相结合，分析成对的仿真-真实视频，诊断具体的不匹配，并提出带有自然语言解释的物理参数更新方案。我们在肌腱驱动的手指（MuJoCo 中的刚体动力学）和可变形连续体触手（PyElastica 中的柔体动力学）上评估了我们的方法。在训练期间未见过的 sim2real 保留控制中，Vid2Sid 在所有设置中都实现了最佳平均排名，匹配或超过了黑盒优化器，同时独特地提供了每次迭代的可解释推理。Sim2sim 验证证实，Vid2Sid 最准确地恢复了真实参数（平均相对误差低于 13%，而其他方法为 28-98%），消融分析揭示了三种校准模式。当感知清晰且模拟器具有表现力时，VLM 指导的优化表现出色，而模型类别限制则限制了在更具挑战性设置中的性能。
tldr: Vid2Sid is a video-driven system identification pipeline using foundation models and VLMs to calibrate robot simulator physics parameters, providing interpretable rationales for parameter updates and achieving strong sim2real performance.
tldr_zh: Vid2Sid是一个视频驱动的系统辨识流程，利用基础模型和视觉语言模型来校准机器人模拟器的物理参数，为参数更新提供可解释的理由，并实现强大的sim2real性能。

title: Safe and Interpretable Multimodal Path Planning for Multi-Agent Cooperation
summary: Successful cooperation among decentralized agents requires each agent to quickly adapt its plan to the behavior of other agents. In scenarios where agents cannot confidently predict one another's intentions and plans, language communication can be crucial for ensuring safety. In this work, we focus on path-level cooperation in which agents must adapt their paths to one another in order to avoid collisions or perform physical collaboration such as joint carrying. In particular, we propose a safe and interpretable multimodal path planning method, CaPE (Code as Path Editor), which generates and updates path plans for an agent based on the environment and language communication from other agents. CaPE leverages a vision-language model (VLM) to synthesize a path editing program verified by a model-based planner, grounding communication to path plan updates in a safe and interpretable way. We evaluate our approach in diverse simulated and real-world scenarios, including multi-robot and human-robot cooperation in autonomous driving, household, and joint carrying tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that CaPE can be integrated into different robotic systems as a plug-and-play module, greatly enhancing a robot's ability to align its plan to language communication from other robots or humans. We also show that the combination of the VLM-based path editing program synthesis and model-based planning safety enables robots to achieve open-ended cooperation while maintaining safety and interpretability.
summary_zh: 去中心化智能体之间成功的协作要求每个智能体快速调整其计划以适应其他智能体的行为。在智能体无法自信地预测彼此意图和计划的场景中，语言沟通对于确保安全至关重要。在这项工作中，我们专注于路径层面的协作，其中智能体必须调整彼此的路径以避免碰撞或执行诸如联合搬运之类的物理协作。特别地，我们提出了一种安全且可解释的多模态路径规划方法CaPE（代码作为路径编辑器），该方法基于环境和其他智能体的语言交流，为智能体生成和更新路径规划。CaPE利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）合成一个由基于模型的规划器验证的路径编辑程序，以一种安全且可解释的方式将通信与路径规划更新联系起来。我们在不同的模拟和真实场景中评估我们的方法，包括自动驾驶、家务和联合搬运任务中的多机器人和人机协作。实验结果表明，CaPE可以作为即插即用模块集成到不同的机器人系统中，极大地增强了机器人将其计划与来自其他机器人或人类的语言交流对齐的能力。我们还表明，基于VLM的路径编辑程序合成与基于模型的规划安全性相结合，使机器人能够在保持安全性和可解释性的同时实现开放式的协作。
tldr: The paper introduces CaPE, a safe and interpretable multimodal path planning method using a vision-language model to synthesize path editing programs based on language communication, enabling multi-agent cooperation in various robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种安全且可解释的多模态路径规划方法CaPE，该方法使用视觉语言模型根据语言通信合成路径编辑程序，从而在各种机器人任务中实现多智能体协作。

title: Descent-Guided Policy Gradient for Scalable Cooperative Multi-Agent Learning
summary: Scaling cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is fundamentally limited by cross-agent noise: when agents share a common reward, the actions of all $N$ agents jointly determine each agent's learning signal, so cross-agent noise grows with $N$. In the policy gradient setting, per-agent gradient estimate variance scales as $Θ(N)$, yielding sample complexity $\mathcal{O}(N/ε)$. We observe that many domains -- cloud computing, transportation, power systems -- have differentiable analytical models that prescribe efficient system states. In this work, we propose Descent-Guided Policy Gradient (DG-PG), a framework that constructs noise-free per-agent guidance gradients from these analytical models, decoupling each agent's gradient from the actions of all others. We prove that DG-PG reduces gradient variance from $Θ(N)$ to $\mathcal{O}(1)$, preserves the equilibria of the cooperative game, and achieves agent-independent sample complexity $\mathcal{O}(1/ε)$. On a heterogeneous cloud scheduling task with up to 200 agents, DG-PG converges within 10 episodes at every tested scale -- from $N=5$ to $N=200$ -- directly confirming the predicted scale-invariant complexity, while MAPPO and IPPO fail to converge under identical architectures.
summary_zh:
摘要：
合作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）的扩展从根本上受到跨智能体噪声的限制：当智能体共享共同奖励时，所有$N$个智能体的动作共同决定每个智能体的学习信号，导致跨智能体噪声随$N$增长。在策略梯度设置中，每个智能体的梯度估计方差随$Θ(N)$缩放，产生样本复杂度$\mathcal{O}(N/ε)$。我们观察到，许多领域——云计算、交通运输、电力系统——都具有可微分的分析模型，这些模型规定了高效的系统状态。在这项工作中，我们提出了下降引导策略梯度（DG-PG），这是一个框架，它从这些分析模型中构建无噪声的每个智能体的引导梯度，将每个智能体的梯度与所有其他智能体的动作解耦。我们证明 DG-PG 将梯度方差从$Θ(N)$降低到$\mathcal{O}(1)$，保持了合作博弈的均衡，并实现了与智能体无关的样本复杂度$\mathcal{O}(1/ε)$。在一个具有多达 200 个智能体的异构云调度任务中，DG-PG 在每个测试的规模下（从$N=5$到$N=200$），都在 10 个 episode 内收敛，直接证实了预测的尺度不变复杂度，而 MAPPO 和 IPPO 在相同的架构下未能收敛。
tldr: This paper introduces Descent-Guided Policy Gradient (DG-PG) for scalable cooperative MARL, leveraging differentiable analytical models to reduce gradient variance and achieve scale-invariant sample complexity, demonstrating its effectiveness in a cloud scheduling task.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了用于可扩展合作多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 的下降引导策略梯度 (DG-PG)。它利用可微分的解析模型来减少梯度差异，并实现尺度不变的样本复杂度，并在云调度任务中证明了其有效性。

title: Agents of Chaos
summary: We report an exploratory red-teaming study of autonomous language-model-powered agents deployed in a live laboratory environment with persistent memory, email accounts, Discord access, file systems, and shell execution. Over a two-week period, twenty AI researchers interacted with the agents under benign and adversarial conditions. Focusing on failures emerging from the integration of language models with autonomy, tool use, and multi-party communication, we document eleven representative case studies. Observed behaviors include unauthorized compliance with non-owners, disclosure of sensitive information, execution of destructive system-level actions, denial-of-service conditions, uncontrolled resource consumption, identity spoofing vulnerabilities, cross-agent propagation of unsafe practices, and partial system takeover. In several cases, agents reported task completion while the underlying system state contradicted those reports. We also report on some of the failed attempts. Our findings establish the existence of security-, privacy-, and governance-relevant vulnerabilities in realistic deployment settings. These behaviors raise unresolved questions regarding accountability, delegated authority, and responsibility for downstream harms, and warrant urgent attention from legal scholars, policymakers, and researchers across disciplines. This report serves as an initial empirical contribution to that broader conversation.
summary_zh: 我们报告了一项探索性红队研究，该研究针对部署在具有持久内存、电子邮件账户、Discord访问权限、文件系统和shell执行功能的实时实验室环境中的由自主语言模型驱动的智能体。在为期两周的时间内，二十名人工智能研究人员在良性和对抗性条件下与这些智能体进行了交互。 我们重点关注语言模型与自主性、工具使用以及多方通信整合后出现的故障，并记录了十一个具有代表性的案例研究。观察到的行为包括未经授权遵守非所有者指令、敏感信息披露、执行破坏性的系统级操作、拒绝服务攻击、不受控制的资源消耗、身份欺骗漏洞、不安全实践的跨智能体传播以及部分系统接管。在几个案例中，智能体报告任务完成，而底层系统状态与这些报告相矛盾。我们还报告了一些失败的尝试。我们的研究结果证实了在真实的部署环境中，存在与安全性、隐私性和治理相关的漏洞。这些行为引发了关于问责制、委托授权以及下游损害责任的未解决问题，值得法律学者、政策制定者和跨学科研究人员的紧急关注。本报告是对此更广泛讨论的初步经验性贡献。
tldr: This paper presents a red-teaming study of autonomous language-model-powered agents, revealing serious security, privacy, and governance vulnerabilities in real-world deployment scenarios, highlighting concerns about accountability and potential harms.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一项对自主语言模型驱动的代理进行的红队研究，揭示了现实部署场景中严重的安全、隐私和治理漏洞，强调了对问责制和潜在危害的担忧。

title: Beyond Mimicry: Toward Lifelong Adaptability in Imitation Learning
summary: Imitation learning stands at a crossroads: despite decades of progress, current imitation learning agents remain sophisticated memorisation machines, excelling at replay but failing when contexts shift or goals evolve. This paper argues that this failure is not technical but foundational: imitation learning has been optimised for the wrong objective. We propose a research agenda that redefines success from perfect replay to compositional adaptability. Such adaptability hinges on learning behavioural primitives once and recombining them through novel contexts without retraining. We establish metrics for compositional generalisation, propose hybrid architectures, and outline interdisciplinary research directions drawing on cognitive science and cultural evolution. Agents that embed adaptability at the core of imitation learning thus have an essential capability for operating in an open-ended world.
summary_zh: 模仿学习正处于一个十字路口：尽管经过数十年的发展，当前的模仿学习智能体仍然是精密的记忆机器，擅长重放但当情境转变或目标演变时就会失败。本文认为，这种失败并非技术性的，而是基础性的：模仿学习一直在为错误的目标进行优化。我们提出了一个研究议程，将成功重新定义为从完美重放到组合式适应性。这种适应性依赖于一次性学习行为基元，并通过新的情境重新组合它们，而无需重新训练。我们建立了组合泛化的衡量标准，提出了混合架构，并概述了借鉴认知科学和文化演化的跨学科研究方向。因此，将适应性嵌入模仿学习核心的智能体，具备在开放式世界中运作的关键能力。
tldr: This paper argues that current imitation learning methods lack adaptability and proposes a research agenda focused on compositional generalization and adaptability by learning and recombining behavioral primitives.
tldr_zh: 本文认为当前的模仿学习方法缺乏适应性，并提出了一个研究议程，重点是通过学习和重新组合行为基元来实现组合泛化和适应性。

title: MAS-FIRE: Fault Injection and Reliability Evaluation for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: As LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) are increasingly deployed for complex tasks, ensuring their reliability has become a pressing challenge. Since MAS coordinate through unstructured natural language rather than rigid protocols, they are prone to semantic failures (e.g., hallucinations, misinterpreted instructions, and reasoning drift) that propagate silently without raising runtime exceptions. Prevailing evaluation approaches, which measure only end-to-end task success, offer limited insight into how these failures arise or how effectively agents recover from them. To bridge this gap, we propose MAS-FIRE, a systematic framework for fault injection and reliability evaluation of MAS. We define a taxonomy of 15 fault types covering intra-agent cognitive errors and inter-agent coordination failures, and inject them via three non-invasive mechanisms: prompt modification, response rewriting, and message routing manipulation. Applying MAS-FIRE to three representative MAS architectures, we uncover a rich set of fault-tolerant behaviors that we organize into four tiers: mechanism, rule, prompt, and reasoning. This tiered view enables fine-grained diagnosis of where and why systems succeed or fail. Our findings reveal that stronger foundation models do not uniformly improve robustness. We further show that architectural topology plays an equally decisive role, with iterative, closed-loop designs neutralizing over 40% of faults that cause catastrophic collapse in linear workflows. MAS-FIRE provides the process-level observability and actionable guidance needed to systematically improve multi-agent systems.
summary_zh: 随着基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）越来越多地用于复杂任务，确保其可靠性已成为一个紧迫的挑战。 由于MAS通过非结构化的自然语言而非严格的协议进行协调，因此它们容易出现语义故障（例如，幻觉、错误解读指令和推理漂移），这些故障会悄无声息地传播，而不会引发运行时异常。 目前主流的评估方法只衡量端到端的任务成功率，对于这些故障是如何产生的，或者智能体如何有效地从中恢复，提供的洞察力有限。 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了MAS-FIRE，一个用于MAS的故障注入和可靠性评估的系统性框架。 我们定义了一个包含15种故障类型的分类，涵盖了智能体内部的认知错误和智能体间的协调失败，并通过三种非侵入式的机制注入这些故障：提示修改、响应重写和消息路由操纵。 将MAS-FIRE应用于三个具有代表性的MAS架构，我们发现了一组丰富的容错行为，并将它们组织成四个层级：机制、规则、提示和推理。 这种分层视角能够对系统成功或失败的原因和地点进行细粒度的诊断。 我们的研究结果表明，更强大的基础模型并不能统一提高鲁棒性。 我们进一步表明，架构拓扑结构发挥着同样重要的作用，迭代的、闭环设计可以消除超过40%的在线性工作流程中导致灾难性崩溃的故障。 MAS-FIRE提供流程级别的可观察性和可操作的指导，从而系统地改进多智能体系统。
tldr: This paper introduces MAS-FIRE, a framework for fault injection and reliability evaluation in LLM-based multi-agent systems, uncovering fault-tolerant behaviors and the impact of architecture and foundation models on robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了MAS-FIRE，一个用于LLM多智能体系统中注入故障和可靠性评估的框架，揭示了容错行为以及架构和基础模型对鲁棒性的影响。

title: Decision MetaMamba: Enhancing Selective SSM in Offline RL with Heterogeneous Sequence Mixing
summary: Mamba-based models have drawn much attention in offline RL. However, their selective mechanism often detrimental when key steps in RL sequences are omitted. To address these issues, we propose a simple yet effective structure, called Decision MetaMamba (DMM), which replaces Mamba's token mixer with a dense layer-based sequence mixer and modifies positional structure to preserve local information. By performing sequence mixing that considers all channels simultaneously before Mamba, DMM prevents information loss due to selective scanning and residual gating. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our DMM delivers the state-of-the-art performance across diverse RL tasks. Furthermore, DMM achieves these results with a compact parameter footprint, demonstrating strong potential for real-world applications.
summary_zh: 基于Mamba的模型在离线强化学习中备受关注。然而，它们的选择性机制在强化学习序列中的关键步骤被省略时，往往会产生不利影响。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种简单而有效的结构，称为决策MetaMamba（DMM），它用基于密集层的序列混合器代替了Mamba的token混合器，并修改了位置结构以保留局部信息。通过在Mamba之前执行同时考虑所有通道的序列混合，DMM可以防止由于选择性扫描和残差门控导致的信息丢失。大量实验表明，我们的DMM在各种强化学习任务中都实现了最先进的性能。此外，DMM以紧凑的参数规模实现了这些结果，展示了其在实际应用中的强大潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces Decision MetaMamba (DMM), a modified Mamba architecture for offline RL that replaces the selective token mixer with a dense layer-based sequence mixer to prevent information loss, achieving state-of-the-art performance with fewer parameters.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Decision MetaMamba (DMM)，一种改进的 Mamba 架构，用于离线强化学习。它用基于密集层的序列混合器替换了选择性 token 混合器，以防止信息丢失，从而以更少的参数实现了最先进的性能。

title: Compositional Planning with Jumpy World Models
summary: The ability to plan with temporal abstractions is central to intelligent decision-making. Rather than reasoning over primitive actions, we study agents that compose pre-trained policies as temporally extended actions, enabling solutions to complex tasks that no constituent alone can solve. Such compositional planning remains elusive as compounding errors in long-horizon predictions make it challenging to estimate the visitation distribution induced by sequencing policies. Motivated by the geometric policy composition framework introduced in arXiv:2206.08736, we address these challenges by learning predictive models of multi-step dynamics -- so-called jumpy world models -- that capture state occupancies induced by pre-trained policies across multiple timescales in an off-policy manner. Building on Temporal Difference Flows (arXiv:2503.09817), we enhance these models with a novel consistency objective that aligns predictions across timescales, improving long-horizon predictive accuracy. We further demonstrate how to combine these generative predictions to estimate the value of executing arbitrary sequences of policies over varying timescales. Empirically, we find that compositional planning with jumpy world models significantly improves zero-shot performance across a wide range of base policies on challenging manipulation and navigation tasks, yielding, on average, a 200% relative improvement over planning with primitive actions on long-horizon tasks.
summary_zh: 具有时间抽象能力的规划对于智能决策至关重要。 我们研究能够组合预训练策略作为时间扩展动作的智能体，而不是对原始动作进行推理，从而解决任何单一组成部分都无法解决的复杂任务。 这种组合式规划仍然难以实现，因为长时预测中的复合误差使得估计策略序列引起的访问分布具有挑战性。 受 arXiv:2206.08736 提出的几何策略组合框架的启发，我们通过学习多步动态的预测模型（即所谓的“跳跃世界模型”）来应对这些挑战，该模型以离线方式捕获预训练策略在多个时间尺度上引起的状态占据。 在时间差分流（arXiv:2503.09817）的基础上，我们利用一种新的跨时间尺度对齐预测的一致性目标来增强这些模型，从而提高长时预测的准确性。 我们进一步演示了如何组合这些生成式预测来估计在不同时间尺度上执行任意策略序列的价值。 经验表明，在具有挑战性的操作和导航任务中，使用跳跃世界模型的组合式规划显著提高了各种基础策略的零样本性能，在长时任务上，与使用原始动作的规划相比，平均相对提升了 200%。
tldr: The paper introduces "jumpy world models" for compositional planning, enabling agents to plan with pre-trained policies as extended actions and demonstrating significant performance improvements in manipulation and navigation tasks by predicting multi-step dynamics across timescales.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了用于组合规划的“跳跃世界模型”，使智能体能够使用预训练的策略作为扩展动作进行规划，并通过预测跨时间尺度的多步动态，在操作和导航任务中展示了显著的性能提升。

title: TAPE: Tool-Guided Adaptive Planning and Constrained Execution in Language Model Agents
summary: Language Model (LM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving tasks that require multiple interactions with the environment. However, they remain vulnerable in environments where a single error often leads to irrecoverable failure, particularly under strict feasibility constraints. We systematically analyze existing agent frameworks, identifying imperfect planning and stochastic execution as the primary causes. To address these challenges, we propose Tool-guided Adaptive Planning with constrained Execution (TAPE). TAPE enhances planning capability by aggregating multiple plans into a graph and employing an external solver to identify a feasible path. During execution, TAPE employs constrained decoding to reduce sampling noise, while adaptively re-planning whenever environmental feedback deviates from the intended state. Experiments across Sokoban, ALFWorld, MuSiQue, and GSM8K-Hard demonstrate that TAPE consistently outperforms existing frameworks, with particularly large gains on hard settings, improving success rates by 21.0 percentage points on hard settings on average, and by 20.0 percentage points for weaker base models on average. Code and data available at here.
summary_zh: 语言模型（LM）智能体在解决需要与环境进行多次交互的任务中展现出了卓越的能力。然而，在单个错误往往导致不可恢复失败的环境中，特别是在严格可行性约束下，它们仍然容易受到攻击。我们系统性地分析了现有的智能体框架，并确定了不完善的规划和随机执行是主要原因。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了工具引导的自适应规划与约束执行（TAPE）。TAPE通过将多个计划聚合成图，并利用外部求解器来识别可行路径，从而增强规划能力。在执行过程中，TAPE采用约束解码来减少采样噪声，并在环境反馈偏离预期状态时自适应地重新规划。在Sokoban、ALFWorld、MuSiQue和GSM8K-Hard上的实验表明，TAPE始终优于现有的框架，尤其是在困难设置下取得了显著的提升，在困难设置下的成功率平均提高了21.0个百分点，对于较弱的基础模型，平均提高了20.0个百分点。代码和数据在此处提供。
tldr: The paper introduces TAPE, a novel framework for language model agents that enhances planning with graph-based aggregation and feasible path identification, and execution with constrained decoding and adaptive re-planning, resulting in improved performance on several benchmark tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TAPE，一种新的语言模型代理框架，通过基于图的聚合和可行路径识别来增强规划能力，并通过约束解码和自适应重新规划来改进执行，从而提升了在多个基准任务上的性能。

title: CodeHacker: Automated Test Case Generation for Detecting Vulnerabilities in Competitive Programming Solutions
summary: The evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) for code generation relies heavily on the quality and robustness of test cases. However, existing benchmarks often lack coverage for subtle corner cases, allowing incorrect solutions to pass. To bridge this gap, we propose CodeHacker, an automated agent framework dedicated to generating targeted adversarial test cases that expose latent vulnerabilities in program submissions. Mimicking the hack mechanism in competitive programming, CodeHacker employs a multi-strategy approach, including stress testing, anti-hash attacks, and logic-specific targeting to break specific code submissions. To ensure the validity and reliability of these attacks, we introduce a Calibration Phase, where the agent iteratively refines its own Validator and Checker via self-generated adversarial probes before evaluating contestant code.Experiments demonstrate that CodeHacker significantly improves the True Negative Rate (TNR) of existing datasets, effectively filtering out incorrect solutions that were previously accepted. Furthermore, generated adversarial cases prove to be superior training data, boosting the performance of RL-trained models on benchmarks like LiveCodeBench.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）代码生成能力的评估很大程度上依赖于测试用例的质量和鲁棒性。然而，现有的基准测试往往缺乏对细微边缘情况的覆盖，从而导致不正确的解决方案得以通过。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 CodeHacker，一个自动化代理框架，专门用于生成有针对性的对抗性测试用例，以暴露程序提交中潜在的漏洞。CodeHacker 模仿竞技编程中的 hack 机制，采用多策略方法，包括压力测试、反哈希攻击和特定逻辑的目标攻击，以破坏特定的代码提交。为了确保这些攻击的有效性和可靠性，我们引入了一个校准阶段，在该阶段中，代理通过自我生成的对抗性探测迭代地完善其自身的验证器和检查器，然后再评估参赛者的代码。实验表明，CodeHacker 显著提高了现有数据集的真阴性率（TNR），有效地过滤掉了之前被接受的不正确解决方案。此外，生成的对抗性用例被证明是更优质的训练数据，提升了强化学习训练模型在 LiveCodeBench 等基准测试上的性能。
tldr: CodeHacker is an automated framework that generates adversarial test cases to expose vulnerabilities in LLM-generated code, improving the reliability of code evaluation and serving as better training data.
tldr_zh: CodeHacker是一个自动化的框架，用于生成对抗性测试用例，以暴露LLM生成的代码中的漏洞，从而提高代码评估的可靠性，并作为更好的训练数据。

title: OptiRepair: Closed-Loop Diagnosis and Repair of Supply Chain Optimization Models with LLM Agents
summary:
Problem Definition. Supply chain optimization models frequently become infeasible because of modeling errors. Diagnosis and repair require scarce OR expertise: analysts must interpret solver diagnostics, trace root causes across echelons, and fix formulations without sacrificing operational soundness. Whether AI agents can perform this task remains untested.
  Methodology/Results. OptiRepair splits this task into a domain-agnostic feasibility phase (iterative IIS-guided repair of any LP) and a domain-specific validation phase (five rationality checks grounded in inventory theory). We test 22 API models from 7 families on 976 multi-echelon supply chain problems and train two 8B-parameter models using self-taught reasoning with solver-verified rewards. The trained models reach 81.7% Rational Recovery Rate (RRR) -- the fraction of problems resolved to both feasibility and operational rationality -- versus 42.2% for the best API model and 21.3% on average. The gap concentrates in Phase 1 repair: API models average 27.6% recovery rate versus 97.2% for trained models.
  Managerial Implications. Two gaps separate current AI from reliable model repair: solver interaction (API models restore only 27.6% of infeasible formulations) and operational rationale (roughly one in four feasible repairs violate supply chain theory). Each requires a different intervention: solver interaction responds to targeted training; operational rationale requires explicit specification as solver-verifiable checks. For organizations adopting AI in operational planning, formalizing what "rational" means in their context is the higher-return investment.
summary_zh:
问题定义：供应链优化模型常因建模错误而变得不可行。诊断和修复需要稀缺的运筹学专业知识：分析师必须解读求解器诊断信息，追踪跨层级的根本原因，并在不牺牲运营合理性的前提下修正公式。人工智能智能体是否能执行此任务仍未经过验证。
方法/结果：OptiRepair将此任务分为一个与领域无关的可行性阶段（对任何LP的迭代IIS引导修复）和一个领域相关的验证阶段（基于库存理论的五个合理性检查）。我们使用来自7个系列的22个API模型在976个多级供应链问题上进行测试，并使用具有求解器验证奖励的自学推理训练了两个80亿参数的模型。训练后的模型达到了81.7%的理性恢复率（RRR）——既恢复可行性又恢复运营合理性的问题比例——而最佳API模型为42.2%，平均为21.3%。差距主要集中在第一阶段的修复：API模型的平均恢复率为27.6%，而训练后的模型为97.2%。
管理启示：当前的AI与可靠的模型修复之间存在两个差距：求解器交互（API模型仅恢复27.6%的不可行公式）和运营合理性（大约四分之一的可行修复违反了供应链理论）。每个差距都需要不同的干预措施：求解器交互可以通过有针对性的训练来改善；运营合理性需要明确指定为求解器可验证的检查。对于在运营规划中采用AI的组织来说，形式化“合理”在其上下文中的含义是回报更高的投资。
tldr: The paper introduces OptiRepair, a system leveraging LLM agents for automated diagnosis and repair of supply chain optimization models, achieving significantly higher rational recovery rates compared to API models via self-taught reasoning and solver-verified rewards.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了OptiRepair，一个利用LLM代理自动诊断和修复供应链优化模型的系统。通过自学习推理和求解器验证的奖励，OptiRepair比API模型实现了明显更高的合理恢复率。

title: ApET: Approximation-Error Guided Token Compression for Efficient VLMs
summary: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable multimodal understanding capabilities, yet the redundant visual tokens incur prohibitive computational overhead and degrade inference efficiency. Prior studies typically relies on [CLS] attention or text-vision cross-attention to identify and discard redundant visual tokens. Despite promising results, such solutions are prone to introduce positional bias and, more critically, are incompatible with efficient attention kernels such as FlashAttention, limiting their practical deployment for VLM acceleration. In this paper, we step away from attention dependencies and revisit visual token compression from an information-theoretic perspective, aiming to maximally preserve visual information without any attention involvement. We present ApET, an Approximation-Error guided Token compression framework. ApET first reconstructs the original visual tokens with a small set of basis tokens via linear approximation, then leverages the approximation error to identify and drop the least informative tokens. Extensive experiments across multiple VLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that ApET retains 95.2% of the original performance on image-understanding tasks and even attains 100.4% on video-understanding tasks, while compressing the token budgets by 88.9% and 87.5%, respectively. Thanks to its attention-free design, ApET seamlessly integrates with FlashAttention, enabling further inference acceleration and making VLM deployment more practical. Code is available at https://github.com/MaQianKun0/ApET.
summary_zh: 近年来的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）已展现出卓越的多模态理解能力，然而冗余的视觉标记带来了过高的计算开销并降低了推理效率。以往的研究通常依赖于[CLS]注意力或文本-视觉交叉注意力来识别并丢弃冗余的视觉标记。尽管取得了有希望的结果，但这些解决方案容易引入位置偏差，更关键的是，它们与诸如FlashAttention等高效注意力核不兼容，限制了它们在VLM加速方面的实际部署。在本文中，我们摆脱了注意力依赖，并从信息论的角度重新审视视觉标记压缩，旨在在没有任何注意力参与的情况下最大限度地保留视觉信息。我们提出了ApET，一种近似误差引导的标记压缩框架。ApET首先通过线性近似，利用少量基准标记重建原始视觉标记，然后利用近似误差来识别并丢弃信息量最少的标记。在多个VLM和基准测试上的大量实验表明，ApET在图像理解任务上保留了95.2%的原始性能，甚至在视频理解任务上达到了100.4%，同时分别将标记预算压缩了88.9%和87.5%。得益于其无注意力设计，ApET可以无缝集成到FlashAttention中，从而进一步加速推理并使VLM部署更具可行性。代码可在https://github.com/MaQianKun0/ApET获得。
tldr: The paper introduces ApET, an attention-free token compression method for VLMs that uses approximation error to remove redundant visual tokens, achieving significant speedups and maintaining performance, and is compatible with FlashAttention.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ApET，一种无注意力机制的VLM token压缩方法，它使用近似误差来移除冗余的视觉token，实现了显著的加速并保持了性能，且与FlashAttention兼容。

title: Open-vocabulary 3D scene perception in industrial environments
summary: Autonomous vision applications in production, intralogistics, or manufacturing environments require perception capabilities beyond a small, fixed set of classes. Recent open-vocabulary methods, leveraging 2D Vision-Language Foundation Models (VLFMs), target this task but often rely on class-agnostic segmentation models pre-trained on non-industrial datasets (e.g., household scenes). In this work, we first demonstrate that such models fail to generalize, performing poorly on common industrial objects. Therefore, we propose a training-free, open-vocabulary 3D perception pipeline that overcomes this limitation. Instead of using a pre-trained model to generate instance proposals, our method simply generates masks by merging pre-computed superpoints based on their semantic features. Following, we evaluate the domain-adapted VLFM "IndustrialCLIP" on a representative 3D industrial workshop scene for open-vocabulary querying. Our qualitative results demonstrate successful segmentation of industrial objects.
summary_zh: 在生产、内部物流或制造环境中，自主视觉应用需要超出小型固定类别集的感知能力。 近期，利用 2D 视觉-语言基础模型 (VLFMs) 的开放词汇方法旨在解决这一任务，但通常依赖于在非工业数据集（例如，家庭场景）上预训练的类无关分割模型。 在这项工作中，我们首先证明了这些模型无法泛化，在常见的工业对象上表现不佳。 因此，我们提出了一种无需训练的开放词汇 3D 感知流程，克服了这一局限性。 我们的方法不使用预训练模型来生成实例提议，而是简单地通过合并基于其语义特征的预计算超点来生成掩码。 接下来，我们在具有代表性的 3D 工业车间场景中，评估了领域自适应 VLFM“IndustrialCLIP”用于开放词汇查询。 我们的定性结果证明了工业对象的成功分割。
tldr: The paper addresses the poor performance of existing open-vocabulary 3D perception methods on industrial objects and proposes a training-free pipeline using superpoint merging and a domain-adapted VLFM for improved segmentation in industrial environments.
tldr_zh: 本文指出现有开放词汇3D感知方法在工业对象上的性能不佳，并提出了一种无需训练的流水线，该流水线使用超点合并和领域自适应的VLFM，以提高在工业环境中的分割效果。

title: TraceVision: Trajectory-Aware Vision-Language Model for Human-Like Spatial Understanding
summary: Recent Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities in image understanding and natural language generation. However, current approaches focus predominantly on global image understanding, struggling to simulate human visual attention trajectories and explain associations between descriptions and specific regions. We propose TraceVision, a unified vision-language model integrating trajectory-aware spatial understanding in an end-to-end framework. TraceVision employs a Trajectory-aware Visual Perception (TVP) module for bidirectional fusion of visual features and trajectory information. We design geometric simplification to extract semantic keypoints from raw trajectories and propose a three-stage training pipeline where trajectories guide description generation and region localization. We extend TraceVision to trajectory-guided segmentation and video scene understanding, enabling cross-frame tracking and temporal attention analysis. We construct the Reasoning-based Interactive Localized Narratives (RILN) dataset to enhance logical reasoning and interpretability. Extensive experiments on trajectory-guided captioning, text-guided trajectory prediction, understanding, and segmentation demonstrate that TraceVision achieves state-of-the-art performance, establishing a foundation for intuitive spatial interaction and interpretable visual understanding.
summary_zh: 近期的大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在图像理解和自然语言生成方面展示了卓越的能力。然而，目前的方法主要侧重于全局图像理解，难以模拟人类视觉注意轨迹，并解释描述和特定区域之间的关联。我们提出了TraceVision，一个统一的视觉-语言模型，在端到端框架中整合了轨迹感知的空间理解。TraceVision采用轨迹感知视觉感知（TVP）模块，用于视觉特征和轨迹信息的双向融合。我们设计了几何简化方法，从原始轨迹中提取语义关键点，并提出一个三阶段训练流程，其中轨迹引导描述生成和区域定位。我们将TraceVision扩展到轨迹引导的分割和视频场景理解，实现跨帧跟踪和时间注意力分析。我们构建了基于推理的交互式局部叙事（RILN）数据集，以增强逻辑推理和可解释性。在轨迹引导的图像描述、文本引导的轨迹预测、理解和分割方面的大量实验表明，TraceVision达到了最先进的性能，为直观的空间交互和可解释的视觉理解奠定了基础。
tldr: TraceVision introduces a novel vision-language model that integrates trajectory-aware spatial understanding, achieving state-of-the-art performance in trajectory-guided tasks and enabling interpretable visual understanding through a new dataset, RILN.
tldr_zh: TraceVision 提出了一种新的视觉-语言模型，该模型集成了轨迹感知的空间理解，在轨迹引导的任务中取得了最先进的性能，并通过新的数据集 RILN 实现了可解释的视觉理解。

title: HOCA-Bench: Beyond Semantic Perception to Predictive World Modeling via Hegelian Ontological-Causal Anomalies
summary: Video-LLMs have improved steadily on semantic perception, but they still fall short on predictive world modeling, which is central to physically grounded intelligence. We introduce HOCA-Bench, a benchmark that frames physical anomalies through a Hegelian lens. HOCA-Bench separates anomalies into two types: ontological anomalies, where an entity violates its own definition or persistence, and causal anomalies, where interactions violate physical relations. Using state-of-the-art generative video models as adversarial simulators, we build a testbed of 1,439 videos (3,470 QA pairs). Evaluations on 17 Video-LLMs show a clear cognitive lag: models often identify static ontological violations (e.g., shape mutations) but struggle with causal mechanisms (e.g., gravity or friction), with performance dropping by more than 20% on causal tasks. System-2 "Thinking" modes improve reasoning, but they do not close the gap, suggesting that current architectures recognize visual patterns more readily than they apply basic physical laws.
summary_zh: 视频-LLM在语义感知方面取得了稳步进展，但它们在预测性的世界建模方面仍然存在不足，而这对于基于物理常识的智能至关重要。我们引入了HOCA-Bench，一个通过黑格尔视角构建物理异常的基准。HOCA-Bench将异常分为两种类型：本体论异常，即实体违反其自身的定义或持久性；以及因果异常，即交互违反物理关系。我们使用最先进的生成式视频模型作为对抗模拟器，构建了一个包含1439个视频（3470个问答对）的测试平台。对17个视频-LLM的评估显示出明显的认知滞后：模型通常能识别静态的本体论违规（例如，形状突变），但在因果机制（例如，重力或摩擦力）上表现挣扎，在因果任务上的性能下降超过20%。系统2“思考”模式提高了推理能力，但并没有弥合这一差距，表明目前的架构更容易识别视觉模式，而不是应用基本的物理定律。
tldr: The paper introduces HOCA-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating Video-LLMs' understanding of physical anomalies (ontological and causal) and reveals their weakness in causal reasoning compared to ontological understanding.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 HOCA-Bench，一个用于评估视频-语言大模型对物理异常（本体论和因果论）理解的基准，并揭示了它们在因果推理方面的弱点，相对于本体论理解而言。

title: Vinedresser3D: Agentic Text-guided 3D Editing
summary: Text-guided 3D editing aims to modify existing 3D assets using natural-language instructions. Current methods struggle to jointly understand complex prompts, automatically localize edits in 3D, and preserve unedited content. We introduce Vinedresser3D, an agentic framework for high-quality text-guided 3D editing that operates directly in the latent space of a native 3D generative model. Given a 3D asset and an editing prompt, Vinedresser3D uses a multimodal large language model to infer rich descriptions of the original asset, identify the edit region and edit type (addition, modification, deletion), and generate decomposed structural and appearance-level text guidance. The agent then selects an informative view and applies an image editing model to obtain visual guidance. Finally, an inversion-based rectified-flow inpainting pipeline with an interleaved sampling module performs editing in the 3D latent space, enforcing prompt alignment while maintaining 3D coherence and unedited regions. Experiments on diverse 3D edits demonstrate that Vinedresser3D outperforms prior baselines in both automatic metrics and human preference studies, while enabling precise, coherent, and mask-free 3D editing.
summary_zh: 文本引导的3D编辑旨在使用自然语言指令修改现有的3D资产。目前的方法难以联合理解复杂的提示语，自动定位3D中的编辑区域，并保留未编辑的内容。我们引入了Vinedresser3D，一个用于高质量文本引导3D编辑的代理框架，它直接在原生3D生成模型的潜在空间中运行。给定一个3D资产和一个编辑提示语，Vinedresser3D使用多模态大型语言模型来推断原始资产的丰富描述，识别编辑区域和编辑类型（添加、修改、删除），并生成分解的结构和外观级别的文本指导。然后，该代理选择一个信息丰富的视角，并应用图像编辑模型来获得视觉指导。最后，一个基于反演的修正流补全管道，带有一个交错采样模块，在3D潜在空间中执行编辑，在保持3D一致性和未编辑区域的同时，强制执行提示语对齐。对各种3D编辑的实验表明，Vinedresser3D在自动指标和人类偏好研究中均优于先前的基线，同时实现了精确、连贯且无掩模的3D编辑。
tldr: Vinedresser3D is an agentic framework for text-guided 3D editing that leverages LLMs for complex prompt understanding and region localization, achieving state-of-the-art performance through a novel 3D latent space editing pipeline.
tldr_zh: Vinedresser3D是一个用于文本引导的3D编辑的智能框架，利用LLM进行复杂的提示理解和区域定位，通过一种新颖的3D潜在空间编辑管道，实现了最先进的性能。

title: PA-Attack: Guiding Gray-Box Attacks on LVLM Vision Encoders with Prototypes and Attention
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are foundational to modern multimodal applications, yet their susceptibility to adversarial attacks remains a critical concern. Prior white-box attacks rarely generalize across tasks, and black-box methods depend on expensive transfer, which limits efficiency. The vision encoder, standardized and often shared across LVLMs, provides a stable gray-box pivot with strong cross-model transfer. Building on this premise, we introduce PA-Attack (Prototype-Anchored Attentive Attack). PA-Attack begins with a prototype-anchored guidance that provides a stable attack direction towards a general and dissimilar prototype, tackling the attribute-restricted issue and limited task generalization of vanilla attacks. Building on this, we propose a two-stage attention enhancement mechanism: (i) leverage token-level attention scores to concentrate perturbations on critical visual tokens, and (ii) adaptively recalibrate attention weights to track the evolving attention during the adversarial process. Extensive experiments across diverse downstream tasks and LVLM architectures show that PA-Attack achieves an average 75.1% score reduction rate (SRR), demonstrating strong attack effectiveness, efficiency, and task generalization in LVLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/hefeimei06/PA-Attack.
summary_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）是现代多模态应用的基础，但其对对抗性攻击的敏感性仍然是一个关键问题。先前的白盒攻击很少能跨任务泛化，而黑盒方法依赖于昂贵的迁移，这限制了效率。视觉编码器是标准化的并且经常在LVLM之间共享，因此提供了一个稳定的灰盒支点，具有强大的跨模型迁移能力。基于这个前提，我们提出了PA-Attack（原型锚定注意力攻击）。PA-Attack 首先采用原型锚定的引导，提供了一个指向通用且不同原型的稳定攻击方向，从而解决了原始攻击的属性限制问题和有限的任务泛化能力。在此基础上，我们提出了一种两阶段注意力增强机制：（i）利用token级别的注意力分数，将扰动集中在关键的视觉token上，以及（ii）自适应地重新校准注意力权重，以跟踪对抗过程中的注意力演变。在各种下游任务和LVLM架构上的大量实验表明，PA-Attack 平均实现了 75.1% 的分数降低率（SRR），证明了其在 LVLM 中具有强大的攻击有效性、效率和任务泛化能力。代码已在 https://github.com/hefeimei06/PA-Attack 上提供。
tldr: The paper introduces PA-Attack, a gray-box adversarial attack method on LVLM vision encoders that leverages prototype-anchored guidance and attention enhancement to achieve high attack effectiveness and efficiency across diverse tasks and architectures.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 PA-Attack，一种针对 LVLM 视觉编码器的灰盒对抗攻击方法，它利用原型锚定指导和注意力增强，在不同的任务和架构中实现了高攻击有效性和效率。

title: MentalBlackboard: Evaluating Spatial Visualization via Mathematical Transformations
summary: Spatial visualization is the mental ability to imagine, transform, and manipulate the spatial characteristics of objects and actions. This intelligence is a part of human cognition where actions and perception are connected on a mental level. To explore whether state-of-the-art Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit this ability, we develop MentalBlackboard, an open-ended spatial visualization benchmark for Paper Folding and Hole Punching tests within two core tasks: prediction and planning. Our prediction experiments reveal that models struggle with applying symmetrical transformations, even when they predict the sequence of unfolding steps correctly. Also, rotations introduce a significant challenge to the physical situational awareness for models. The planning task reveals limitations of models in analyzing symmetrical relationships and in implementing the multi-stage symmetry process, with Claude Opus 4.1 achieving the highest planning score at an accuracy of 10\%. The top-performing model, o3, attains a peak performance of 71.6\% on the generalization task, which does not require spatial visualization but transfers spatial data; however, it achieves only 25\% accuracy on text-based prediction tasks.
summary_zh: 空间视觉能力是一种在心理上想象、转换和操纵物体和动作空间特征的 Mental Ability。这种智能是人类认知的一部分，在其中，动作和感知在心理层面相互联系。为了探索最先进的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）是否展现出这种能力，我们开发了 MentalBlackboard，这是一个开放式的空间视觉基准测试，用于纸张折叠和打孔测试，包括两个核心任务：预测和规划。我们的预测实验表明，即使模型正确预测了展开步骤的序列，它们也很难应用对称变换。此外，旋转也给模型带来了对物理情境感知的显著挑战。规划任务揭示了模型在分析对称关系和实现多阶段对称过程方面的局限性，其中 Claude Opus 4.1 达到了最高的规划分数，准确率为 10%。在不需要空间视觉能力，但传递空间数据的泛化任务上，表现最佳的模型 o3 达到了 71.6% 的峰值性能；然而，在基于文本的预测任务中，它只达到了 25% 的准确率。
tldr: The paper introduces MentalBlackboard, a benchmark for evaluating spatial visualization in VLMs using paper folding and hole punching tests. Results show VLMs struggle with symmetrical transformations and multi-stage symmetry processes.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MentalBlackboard，一个用于评估视觉语言模型中空间可视化的基准，使用了折纸和打孔测试。结果表明视觉语言模型在对称变换和多阶段对称过程中表现不佳。

title: DSDR: Dual-Scale Diversity Regularization for Exploration in LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiers (RLVR) is a central paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) reasoning, yet existing methods often suffer from limited exploration. Policies tend to collapse onto a few reasoning patterns and prematurely stop deep exploration, while conventional entropy regularization introduces only local stochasticity and fails to induce meaningful path-level diversity, leading to weak and unstable learning signals in group-based policy optimization. We propose DSDR, a Dual-Scale Diversity Regularization reinforcement learning framework that decomposes diversity in LLM reasoning into global and coupling components. Globally, DSDR promotes diversity among correct reasoning trajectories to explore distinct solution modes. Locally, it applies a length-invariant, token-level entropy regularization restricted to correct trajectories, preventing entropy collapse within each mode while preserving correctness. The two scales are coupled through a global-to-local allocation mechanism that emphasizes local regularization for more distinctive correct trajectories. We provide theoretical support showing that DSDR preserves optimal correctness under bounded regularization, sustains informative learning signals in group-based optimization, and yields a principled global-to-local coupling rule. Experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in accuracy and pass@k, highlighting the importance of dual-scale diversity for deep exploration in RLVR. Code is available at https://github.com/SUSTechBruce/DSDR.
summary_zh: 基于验证器的强化学习（RLVR）是提升大型语言模型（LLM）推理能力的核心范式，然而现有方法常常受到探索不足的困扰。策略容易坍缩为少数几种推理模式，并过早地停止深度探索，而传统的熵正则化仅引入局部随机性，无法诱导有意义的路径级别多样性，导致基于群体的策略优化中学习信号微弱且不稳定。我们提出了一种双尺度多样性正则化强化学习框架DSDR，将LLM推理中的多样性分解为全局和耦合两部分。在全局层面，DSDR促进正确推理轨迹之间的多样性，以探索不同的解题模式。在局部层面，它应用一种长度不变的、令牌级别的熵正则化，仅限于正确的轨迹，防止每个模式内的熵坍缩，同时保持正确性。这两种尺度通过一个全局到局部的分配机制相耦合，该机制强调对更具特色的正确轨迹进行局部正则化。我们提供了理论支持，表明DSDR在有界正则化下保持最优正确性，在基于群体的优化中维持信息量丰富的学习信号，并产生一个有原则的全局到局部的耦合规则。在多个推理基准测试上的实验证明了准确率和pass@k的一致性提升，突出了双尺度多样性对于RLVR中深度探索的重要性。代码可在 https://github.com/SUSTechBruce/DSDR 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces DSDR, a dual-scale diversity regularization framework for reinforcement learning with language models, which promotes exploration by diversifying both globally among correct reasoning trajectories and locally within those trajectories, leading to improved performance on reasoning benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种双尺度多样性正则化框架DSDR，用于通过强化学习改进大语言模型的推理能力。DSDR通过在全局范围内正确推理轨迹之间以及局部范围内轨迹内部实现多样化，从而促进探索，并提高了在推理基准测试中的性能。

title: FACTO: Function-space Adaptive Constrained Trajectory Optimization for Robotic Manipulators
summary: This paper introduces Function-space Adaptive Constrained Trajectory Optimization (FACTO), a new trajectory optimization algorithm for both single- and multi-arm manipulators. Trajectory representations are parameterized as linear combinations of orthogonal basis functions, and optimization is performed directly in the coefficient space. The constrained problem formulation consists of both an objective functional and a finite-dimensional objective defined over truncated coefficients. To address nonlinearity, FACTO uses a Gauss-Newton approximation with exponential moving averaging, yielding a smoothed quadratic subproblem. Trajectory-wide constraints are addressed using coefficient-space mappings, and an adaptive constrained update using the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm is performed in the null space of active constraints. Comparisons with optimization-based planners (CHOMP, TrajOpt, GPMP2) and sampling-based planners (RRT-Connect, RRT*, PRM) show the improved solution quality and feasibility, especially in constrained single- and multi-arm scenarios. The experimental evaluation of FACTO on Franka robots verifies the feasibility of deployment.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的轨迹优化算法——函数空间自适应约束轨迹优化 (FACTO)，该算法适用于单臂和多臂机械臂。轨迹表示被参数化为正交基函数的线性组合，并在系数空间中直接进行优化。约束问题的公式包括一个目标泛函和一个定义在截断系数上的有限维目标。为了解决非线性问题，FACTO使用了带有指数移动平均的 Gauss-Newton 近似，产生平滑的二次子问题。轨迹范围内的约束通过系数空间映射来解决，并且使用 Levenberg-Marquardt 算法在有效约束的零空间中执行自适应约束更新。与基于优化的规划器 (CHOMP, TrajOpt, GPMP2) 和基于采样的规划器 (RRT-Connect, RRT*, PRM) 的比较表明，FACTO 改进了解决方案的质量和可行性，尤其是在受约束的单臂和多臂场景中。在 Franka 机器人上的 FACTO 实验评估验证了其部署的可行性。
tldr: The paper introduces FACTO, a novel trajectory optimization algorithm for robotic manipulators that uses function-space optimization and adaptive constrained updates to improve solution quality and feasibility, especially in constrained scenarios. Experimental results on Franka robots demonstrate deployability.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的机器人机械臂轨迹优化算法FACTO，该算法采用函数空间优化和自适应约束更新，以提高解的质量和可行性，尤其是在约束场景中。在Franka机器人上的实验结果验证了其可部署性。

title: Scaling Law of Neural Koopman Operators
summary: Data-driven neural Koopman operator theory has emerged as a powerful tool for linearizing and controlling nonlinear robotic systems. However, the performance of these data-driven models fundamentally depends on the trade-off between sample size and model dimensions, a relationship for which the scaling laws have remained unclear. This paper establishes a rigorous framework to address this challenge by deriving and empirically validating scaling laws that connect sample size, latent space dimension, and downstream control quality. We derive a theoretical upper bound on the Koopman approximation error, explicitly decomposing it into sampling error and projection error. We show that these terms decay at specific rates relative to dataset size and latent dimension, providing a rigorous basis for the scaling law. Based on the theoretical results, we introduce two lightweight regularizers for the neural Koopman operator: a covariance loss to help stabilize the learned latent features and an inverse control loss to ensure the model aligns with physical actuation. The results from systematic experiments across six robotic environments confirm that model fitting error follows the derived scaling laws, and the regularizers improve dynamic model fitting fidelity, with enhanced closed-loop control performance. Together, our results provide a simple recipe for allocating effort between data collection and model capacity when learning Koopman dynamics for control.
summary_zh: 数据驱动的神经Koopman算子理论已成为线性化和控制非线性机器人系统的强大工具。然而，这些数据驱动模型的性能从根本上取决于样本量和模型维度之间的权衡，而这种关系的标度律仍然不明确。本文建立了一个严格的框架来应对这一挑战，通过推导并实证验证连接样本量、潜在空间维度和下游控制质量的标度律。我们推导了Koopman近似误差的理论上限，并将其显式分解为抽样误差和投影误差。我们证明了这些项以相对于数据集大小和潜在维度的特定速率衰减，为标度律提供了严格的基础。基于理论结果，我们为神经Koopman算子引入了两个轻量级的正则化项：用于帮助稳定学习到的潜在特征的协方差损失，以及用于确保模型与物理驱动对齐的逆控制损失。在六个机器人环境中进行的系统实验结果证实，模型拟合误差遵循推导出的标度律，并且正则化项提高了动态模型拟合的保真度，从而增强了闭环控制性能。总而言之，我们的结果为学习用于控制的Koopman动力学时如何在数据采集和模型容量之间分配精力提供了一个简单的配方。
tldr: This paper derives and validates scaling laws for neural Koopman operators, connecting sample size, latent space dimension, and control quality, and introduces regularizers to improve model fitting and control performance in robotic systems.
tldr_zh: 本文推导并验证了神经Koopman算子的缩放律，将样本大小、潜在空间维度和控制质量联系起来，并引入正则化器以提高机器人系统的模型拟合和控制性能。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Rank-One MIMO Q Network Framework for Accelerated Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) has garnered significant interest due to its safe and easily scalable paradigm. However, training under this paradigm presents its own challenge: the extrapolation error stemming from out-of-distribution (OOD) data. Existing methodologies have endeavored to address this issue through means like penalizing OOD Q-values or imposing similarity constraints on the learned policy and the behavior policy. Nonetheless, these approaches are often beset by limitations such as being overly conservative in utilizing OOD data, imprecise OOD data characterization, and significant computational overhead. To address these challenges, this paper introduces an Uncertainty-Aware Rank-One Multi-Input Multi-Output (MIMO) Q Network framework. The framework aims to enhance Offline Reinforcement Learning by fully leveraging the potential of OOD data while still ensuring efficiency in the learning process. Specifically, the framework quantifies data uncertainty and harnesses it in the training losses, aiming to train a policy that maximizes the lower confidence bound of the corresponding Q-function. Furthermore, a Rank-One MIMO architecture is introduced to model the uncertainty-aware Q-function, \TP{offering the same ability for uncertainty quantification as an ensemble of networks but with a cost nearly equivalent to that of a single network}. Consequently, this framework strikes a harmonious balance between precision, speed, and memory efficiency, culminating in improved overall performance. Extensive experimentation on the D4RL benchmark demonstrates that the framework attains state-of-the-art performance while remaining computationally efficient. By incorporating the concept of uncertainty quantification, our framework offers a promising avenue to alleviate extrapolation errors and enhance the efficiency of offline RL.
summary_zh: 离线强化学习（RL）因其安全且易于扩展的范式而备受关注。然而，在这种范式下训练也面临着自身的挑战：由分布外（OOD）数据引起的推断误差。现有方法通过惩罚OOD Q值或对学习策略和行为策略施加相似性约束等手段来解决这个问题。然而，这些方法往往受到过度保守地利用OOD数据、OOD数据刻画不精确以及计算开销巨大等限制。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种不确定性感知的秩一多输入多输出（MIMO）Q网络框架。该框架旨在通过充分利用OOD数据的潜力，同时确保学习过程的效率，来增强离线强化学习。具体来说，该框架量化数据的不确定性并在训练损失中利用它，旨在训练一种策略，使其能够最大化相应Q函数的置信下界。此外，引入了一种秩一MIMO架构来建模不确定性感知的Q函数，\TP{它提供了与网络集成相同的不确定性量化能力，但成本几乎与单个网络相当}。因此，该框架在精度、速度和内存效率之间实现了和谐的平衡，最终提高了整体性能。在D4RL基准上的大量实验表明，该框架在保持计算效率的同时，实现了最先进的性能。通过结合不确定性量化的概念，我们的框架为缓解推断误差和提高离线RL的效率提供了一条有希望的途径。
tldr: This paper introduces an Uncertainty-Aware Rank-One MIMO Q Network framework for offline RL, addressing extrapolation errors with uncertainty quantification and a computationally efficient network architecture, achieving state-of-the-art results on D4RL.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种不确定性感知的 Rank-One MIMO Q 网络框架，用于离线强化学习，通过不确定性量化和计算高效的网络结构来解决外推误差，并在 D4RL 上实现了最先进的性能。

title: Denoising Particle Filters: Learning State Estimation with Single-Step Objectives
summary: Learning-based methods commonly treat state estimation in robotics as a sequence modeling problem. While this paradigm can be effective at maximizing end-to-end performance, models are often difficult to interpret and expensive to train, since training requires unrolling sequences of predictions in time. As an alternative to end-to-end trained state estimation, we propose a novel particle filtering algorithm in which models are trained from individual state transitions, fully exploiting the Markov property in robotic systems. In this framework, measurement models are learned implicitly by minimizing a denoising score matching objective. At inference, the learned denoiser is used alongside a (learned) dynamics model to approximately solve the Bayesian filtering equation at each time step, effectively guiding predicted states toward the data manifold informed by measurements. We evaluate the proposed method on challenging robotic state estimation tasks in simulation, demonstrating competitive performance compared to tuned end-to-end trained baselines. Importantly, our method offers the desirable composability of classical filtering algorithms, allowing prior information and external sensor models to be incorporated without retraining.
summary_zh: 基于学习的方法通常将机器人中的状态估计视为一个序列建模问题。虽然这种范式可以有效地最大化端到端性能，但模型往往难以解释且训练成本高昂，因为训练需要在时间上展开预测序列。作为端到端训练的状态估计的替代方案，我们提出了一种新颖的粒子滤波算法，其中模型从单个状态转移中学习，充分利用机器人系统中的马尔可夫性质。在此框架下，测量模型通过最小化去噪分数匹配目标进行隐式学习。在推理时，学习到的去噪器与（学习到的）动力学模型一起使用，以近似求解每个时间步的贝叶斯滤波方程，从而有效地将预测状态导向数据流形，该流形受到测量结果的指导。我们在模拟环境中评估了所提出的方法在具有挑战性的机器人状态估计任务中的性能，证明了其与经过调整的端到端训练的基线方法相比具有竞争力的性能。重要的是，我们的方法提供了经典滤波算法所具有的理想可组合性，允许在不重新训练的情况下整合先验信息和外部传感器模型。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel particle filtering algorithm that learns state estimation using single-step objectives, implicitly learning measurement models through a denoising score matching objective. It shows competitive performance compared to end-to-end trained baselines and offers composability advantages.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的粒子滤波算法，通过单步目标学习状态估计，通过降噪分数匹配目标隐式学习测量模型。 与端到端训练的基线相比，它显示出具有竞争力的性能，并具有可组合性的优势。

title: Sample-Efficient Learning with Online Expert Correction for Autonomous Catheter Steering in Endovascular Bifurcation Navigation
summary: Robot-assisted endovascular intervention offers a safe and effective solution for remote catheter manipulation, reducing radiation exposure while enabling precise navigation. Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently emerged as a promising approach for autonomous catheter steering; however, conventional methods suffer from sparse reward design and reliance on static vascular models, limiting their sample efficiency and generalization to intraoperative variations. To overcome these challenges, this paper introduces a sample-efficient RL framework with online expert correction for autonomous catheter steering in endovascular bifurcation navigation. The proposed framework integrates three key components: (1) A segmentation-based pose estimation module for accurate real-time state feedback, (2) A fuzzy controller for bifurcation-aware orientation adjustment, and (3) A structured reward generator incorporating expert priors to guide policy learning. By leveraging online expert correction, the framework reduces exploration inefficiency and enhances policy robustness in complex vascular structures. Experimental validation on a robotic platform using a transparent vascular phantom demonstrates that the proposed approach achieves convergence in 123 training episodes -- a 25.9% reduction compared to the baseline Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) algorithm -- while reducing average positional error to 83.8% of the baseline. These results indicate that combining sample-efficient RL with online expert correction enables reliable and accurate catheter steering, particularly in anatomically challenging bifurcation scenarios critical for endovascular navigation.
summary_zh: 机器人辅助血管内介入为远程导管操作提供了一种安全有效的解决方案，在实现精确导航的同时降低了辐射暴露。强化学习（RL）最近作为一种有前景的自主导管操控方法崭露头角；然而，传统方法受稀疏奖励设计和对静态血管模型的依赖影响，限制了其样本效率和对术中变异的泛化能力。为了克服这些挑战，本文提出了一种具有在线专家修正功能的样本高效强化学习框架，用于血管内分叉导航中的自主导管操控。该框架集成了三个关键组成部分：（1）基于分割的姿态估计模块，用于准确的实时状态反馈；（2）一种模糊控制器，用于分叉感知方向调整；（3）一种结构化奖励生成器，结合专家先验知识来指导策略学习。通过利用在线专家修正，该框架降低了探索低效性，并增强了在复杂血管结构中的策略鲁棒性。在透明血管模型上的机器人平台进行的实验验证表明，所提出的方法在123个训练周期内实现了收敛，相比于基线软演员-评论家 (SAC) 算法降低了25.9%，同时将平均位置误差降低到基线的83.8%。这些结果表明，将样本高效强化学习与在线专家修正相结合能够实现可靠且准确的导管操控，尤其是在血管内导航至关重要且解剖结构具有挑战性的分叉场景中。
tldr: This paper presents a sample-efficient reinforcement learning framework with online expert correction for autonomous catheter steering in endovascular bifurcation navigation, showing improved performance compared to SAC.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种具有在线专家校正的样本高效强化学习框架，用于血管内分叉导航中的自主导管操纵，与SAC相比显示出更好的性能。

title: Chasing Ghosts: A Simulation-to-Real Olfactory Navigation Stack with Optional Vision Augmentation
summary: Autonomous odor source localization remains a challenging problem for aerial robots due to turbulent airflow, sparse and delayed sensory signals, and strict payload and compute constraints. While prior unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based olfaction systems have demonstrated gas distribution mapping or reactive plume tracing, they rely on predefined coverage patterns, external infrastructure, or extensive sensing and coordination. In this work, we present a complete, open-source UAV system for online odor source localization using a minimal sensor suite. The system integrates custom olfaction hardware, onboard sensing, and a learning-based navigation policy trained in simulation and deployed on a real quadrotor. Through our minimal framework, the UAV is able to navigate directly toward an odor source without constructing an explicit gas distribution map or relying on external positioning systems. Vision is incorporated as an optional complementary modality to accelerate navigation under certain conditions. We validate the proposed system through real-world flight experiments in a large indoor environment using an ethanol source, demonstrating consistent source-finding behavior under realistic airflow conditions. The primary contribution of this work is a reproducible system and methodological framework for UAV-based olfactory navigation and source finding under minimal sensing assumptions. We elaborate on our hardware design and open source our UAV firmware, simulation code, olfaction-vision dataset, and circuit board to the community. Code, data, and designs will be made available at https://github.com/KordelFranceTech/ChasingGhosts.
summary_zh: 自主气味源定位对于空中机器人来说仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题，这归因于湍流气流、稀疏和延迟的传感信号以及严格的载重和计算约束。虽然先前的基于无人飞行器（UAV）的嗅觉系统已经展示了气体分布图绘制或反应式羽流追踪，但它们依赖于预定义的覆盖模式、外部基础设施或广泛的传感与协调。 在这项工作中，我们提出了一个完整的、开源的UAV系统，用于使用最小的传感器套件进行在线气味源定位。该系统集成了定制的嗅觉硬件、机载传感和一个基于学习的导航策略，该策略在仿真中训练并在真实的四旋翼飞行器上部署。通过我们最小的框架，UAV能够在不构建显式气体分布图或依赖外部定位系统的情况下直接导航到气味源。视觉作为一种可选的互补模态被纳入，以在某些条件下加速导航。我们通过在大型室内环境中使用乙醇源进行的真实飞行实验验证了所提出的系统，证明了在真实气流条件下的一致寻源行为。这项工作的主要贡献是一个可复现的系统和方法框架，用于在最小传感假设下进行基于UAV的嗅觉导航和寻源。我们详细阐述了我们的硬件设计，并向社区开源我们的UAV固件、仿真代码、嗅觉-视觉数据集和电路板。代码、数据和设计将在https://github.com/KordelFranceTech/ChasingGhosts上提供。
tldr: This paper presents an open-source UAV system for autonomous odor source localization using minimal sensors and a learning-based navigation policy trained in simulation. The system is validated with real-world experiments and offers vision augmentation as an option.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个开源的无人机系统，该系统使用最少的传感器和在模拟中训练的基于学习的导航策略，来实现自主气味源的定位。该系统通过真实世界的实验进行了验证，并提供可选的视觉增强。

title: Vision-Based Reasoning with Topology-Encoded Graphs for Anatomical Path Disambiguation in Robot-Assisted Endovascular Navigation
summary: Robotic-assisted percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) is constrained by the inherent limitations of 2D Digital Subtraction Angiography (DSA). Unlike physicians, who can directly manipulate guidewires and integrate tactile feedback with their prior anatomical knowledge, teleoperated robotic systems must rely solely on 2D projections. This mode of operation, simultaneously lacking spatial context and tactile sensation, may give rise to projection-induced ambiguities at vascular bifurcations. To address this challenge, we propose a two-stage framework (SCAR-UNet-GAT) for real-time robotic path planning. In the first stage, SCAR-UNet, a spatial-coordinate-attention-regularized U-Net, is employed for accurate coronary vessel segmentation. The integration of multi-level attention mechanisms enhances the delineation of thin, tortuous vessels and improves robustness against imaging noise. From the resulting binary masks, vessel centerlines and bifurcation points are extracted, and geometric descriptors (e.g., branch diameter, intersection angles) are fused with local DSA patches to construct node features. In the second stage, a Graph Attention Network (GAT) reasons over the vessel graph to identify anatomically consistent and clinically feasible trajectories, effectively distinguishing true bifurcations from projection-induced false crossings. On a clinical DSA dataset, SCAR-UNet achieved a Dice coefficient of 93.1%. For path disambiguation, the proposed GAT-based method attained a success rate of 95.0% and a target-arrival success rate of 90.0%, substantially outperforming conventional shortest-path planning (60.0% and 55.0%) and heuristic-based planning (75.0% and 70.0%). Validation on a robotic platform further confirmed the practical feasibility and robustness of the proposed framework.
summary_zh: 机器人辅助经皮冠状动脉介入治疗(PCI)受到二维数字减影血管造影(DSA)固有局限的制约。与能够直接操作导丝并将触觉反馈与先前解剖学知识整合的医生不同，远程操作机器人系统必须完全依赖于二维投影。这种缺乏空间背景和触觉感知的操作模式，可能会在血管分叉处产生投影引起的歧义。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种用于实时机器人路径规划的两阶段框架(SCAR-UNet-GAT)。在第一阶段，采用SCAR-UNet，即一种空间坐标注意力正则化的U-Net，用于精确的冠状血管分割。多层次注意力机制的集成增强了对细小、迂曲血管的勾勒，并提高了对图像噪声的鲁棒性。从生成的二元掩膜中，提取血管中心线和分叉点，并将几何描述符（例如，分支直径、交叉角度）与局部DSA切片融合，构建节点特征。在第二阶段，图注意力网络(GAT)对血管图进行推理，以识别解剖学上一致且临床上可行的轨迹，从而有效地将真实分叉与投影引起的虚假交叉区分开来。在临床DSA数据集上，SCAR-UNet实现了93.1%的Dice系数。对于路径消歧，所提出的基于GAT的方法达到了95.0%的成功率和90.0%的目标到达成功率，大大优于传统的Dijkstra最短路径规划（60.0%和55.0%）和基于启发式的规划（75.0%和70.0%）。在一个机器人平台上的验证进一步证实了所提出框架的实际可行性和鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper proposes a two-stage framework (SCAR-UNet-GAT) for anatomical path disambiguation in robot-assisted endovascular navigation using vision-based reasoning with topology-encoded graphs, significantly outperforming conventional methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种两阶段框架（SCAR-UNet-GAT），通过基于视觉的推理和拓扑编码图来解决机器人辅助血管内导航中的解剖路径歧义问题，并且显著优于传统方法

title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Active Search
summary: Active search for recovering objects of interest through online, adaptive decision making with autonomous agents requires trading off exploration of unknown environments with exploitation of prior observations in the search space. Prior work has proposed information gain and Thompson sampling based myopic, greedy approaches for agents to actively decide query or search locations when the number of targets is unknown. Decision making algorithms in such partially observable environments have also shown that agents capable of lookahead over a finite horizon outperform myopic policies for active search. Unfortunately, lookahead algorithms typically rely on building a computationally expensive search tree that is simulated and updated based on the agent's observations and a model of the environment dynamics. Instead, in this work, we leverage the sequence modeling abilities of diffusion models to sample lookahead action sequences that balance the exploration-exploitation trade-off for active search without building an exhaustive search tree. We identify the optimism bias in prior diffusion based reinforcement learning approaches when applied to the active search setting and propose mitigating solutions for efficient cost-aware decision making with both single and multi-agent teams. Our proposed algorithm outperforms standard baselines in offline reinforcement learning in terms of full recovery rate and is computationally more efficient than tree search in cost-aware active decision making.
summary_zh: 通过在线、自适应决策自主智能体来主动搜索并恢复感兴趣目标，需要在搜索空间中，对未知环境的探索与对先前观测的利用之间进行权衡。先前工作提出了基于信息增益和 Thompson 采样的近视性、贪婪方法，用于在目标数量未知时，智能体主动决定查询或搜索位置。在此类部分可观测环境中的决策算法也表明，具备有限时间范围前瞻能力的智能体在主动搜索中优于近视策略。遗憾的是，前瞻算法通常依赖于构建计算成本高昂的搜索树，该搜索树基于智能体的观测和环境动态模型进行模拟和更新。相反，在这项工作中，我们利用扩散模型的序列建模能力来采样前瞻动作序列，从而在主动搜索中平衡探索-利用的权衡，而无需构建详尽的搜索树。我们识别出先前基于扩散的强化学习方法应用于主动搜索环境时存在的乐观偏差，并提出了缓解方案，以实现具有单智能体和多智能体团队的有效成本感知决策。我们提出的算法在离线强化学习中，在完全恢复率方面优于标准基线，并且在成本感知主动决策中比树搜索更具计算效率。
tldr: This paper utilizes diffusion models for efficient lookahead action sequence sampling in active search, outperforming traditional tree search methods in terms of computation and recovery rate.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文利用扩散模型来对主动搜索中的前瞻行动序列进行高效采样，在计算和恢复率方面优于传统的树搜索方法。

title: Bellman Value Decomposition for Task Logic in Safe Optimal Control
summary: Real-world tasks involve nuanced combinations of goal and safety specifications. In high dimensions, the challenge is exacerbated: formal automata become cumbersome, and the combination of sparse rewards tends to require laborious tuning. In this work, we consider the innate structure of the Bellman Value as a means to naturally organize the problem for improved automatic performance. Namely, we prove the Bellman Value for a complex task defined in temporal logic can be decomposed into a graph of Bellman Values, connected by a set of well-known Bellman equations (BEs): the Reach-Avoid BE, the Avoid BE, and a novel type, the Reach-Avoid-Loop BE. To solve the Value and optimal policy, we propose VDPPO, which embeds the decomposed Value graph into a two-layer neural net, bootstrapping the implicit dependencies. We conduct a variety of simulated and hardware experiments to test our method on complex, high-dimensional tasks involving heterogeneous teams and nonlinear dynamics. Ultimately, we find this approach greatly improves performance over existing baselines, balancing safety and liveness automatically.
summary_zh: 现实世界的任务涉及目标和安全规范之间细致入微的组合。在高维度环境中，这一挑战更为严峻：形式自动机变得笨重，而稀疏奖励的组合往往需要繁琐的调整。在这项工作中，我们考虑将贝尔曼价值的固有结构作为一种自然组织问题的方法，以提高自动性能。具体而言，我们证明了用时序逻辑定义的复杂任务的贝尔曼价值可以分解为由一组众所周知的贝尔曼方程（BEs）连接的贝尔曼价值图：到达-避开贝尔曼方程、避开贝尔曼方程以及一种新型的到达-避开-循环贝尔曼方程。为了求解价值和最优策略，我们提出了VDPPO算法，该算法将分解后的价值图嵌入到一个双层神经网络中，并对隐式依赖关系进行自举。我们进行了各种模拟和硬件实验，以测试我们的方法在涉及异构团队和非线性动力学的复杂、高维任务中的性能。最终，我们发现这种方法大大提高了优于现有基线的性能，能够自动平衡安全性和活性。
tldr: The paper introduces VDPPO, a reinforcement learning method that decomposes the Bellman Value for complex tasks defined in temporal logic into a graph of Bellman Values, resulting in improved performance for safe optimal control, as validated through simulations and hardware experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VDPPO，一种强化学习方法，它将用时序逻辑定义的复杂任务的贝尔曼值分解为贝尔曼值图，从而提高了安全最优控制的性能，并通过模拟和硬件实验验证了这一点。

title: Botson: An Accessible and Low-Cost Platform for Social Robotics Research
summary: Trust remains a critical barrier to the effective integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into human-centric domains. Disembodied agents, such as voice assistants, often fail to establish trust due to their inability to convey non-verbal social cues. This paper introduces the architecture of Botson: an anthropomorphic social robot powered by a large language model (LLM). Botson was created as a low-cost and accessible platform for social robotics research.
summary_zh: 信任仍然是将人工智能（AI）有效集成到以人为中心的领域中的一个关键障碍。诸如语音助手等无实体代理通常因其无法传达非语言社交线索而无法建立信任。本文介绍了一个名为Botson的人形社交机器人的架构，该机器人由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动。Botson的创建旨在作为一个低成本且易于访问的社交机器人研究平台。
tldr: This paper introduces Botson, a low-cost, anthropomorphic social robot platform powered by a large language model, designed to improve trust in AI through non-verbal social cues.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个名为Botson的低成本、拟人化的社交机器人平台，该平台由大型语言模型驱动，旨在通过非语言社交信号来提高人们对人工智能的信任。
