summary: Long-term environmental monitoring requires the ability to reconstruct and align 3D models across repeated site visits separated by months or years. However, existing Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipelines implicitly assume near-simultaneous image capture and limited appearance change, and therefore fail when applied to long-term monitoring scenarios such as coral reef surveys, where substantial visual and structural change is common. In this paper, we show that the primary limitation of current approaches lies in their reliance on post-hoc alignment of independently reconstructed sessions, which is insufficient under large temporal appearance change. We address this limitation by enforcing cross-session correspondences directly within a joint SfM reconstruction. Our approach combines complementary handcrafted and learned visual features to robustly establish correspondences across large temporal gaps, enabling the reconstruction of a single coherent 3D model from imagery captured years apart, where standard independent and joint SfM pipelines break down. We evaluate our method on long-term coral reef datasets exhibiting significant real-world change, and demonstrate consistent joint reconstruction across sessions in cases where existing methods fail to produce coherent reconstructions. To ensure scalability to large datasets, we further restrict expensive learned feature matching to a small set of likely cross-session image pairs identified via visual place recognition, which reduces computational cost and improves alignment robustness.
summary_zh: 长期环境监测需要能够重建和对齐在数月或数年时间间隔下重复现场访问的3D模型。然而，现有的运动结构（SfM）流程隐含地假设近乎同步的图像采集和有限的外观变化，因此无法应用于珊瑚礁调查等长期监测场景，在这些场景中，视觉和结构变化是常见的。在本文中，我们表明，当前方法的主要局限性在于它们依赖于独立重建会话的事后对齐，这在大的时间外观变化下是不够的。我们通过在联合SfM重建中直接强制执行跨会话对应关系来解决此限制。我们的方法结合了互补的手工和学习的视觉特征，以稳健地建立跨越较大时间间隔的对应关系，从而能够从相隔数年捕获的图像中重建单个连贯的3D模型，而标准的独立和联合SfM流程会失效。我们在展示显著真实世界变化的长期珊瑚礁数据集上评估了我们的方法，并证明了在现有方法无法产生连贯重建的情况下，跨会话的一致联合重建。为了确保可扩展到大型数据集，我们进一步将昂贵的学习特征匹配限制到通过视觉地点识别确定的一小部分可能的跨会话图像对，这降低了计算成本并提高了对齐的稳健性。
tldr: This paper presents a novel Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipeline that enforces cross-session correspondences directly within a joint reconstruction, enabling coherent 3D model creation from images captured years apart, even with significant appearance changes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的运动结构（SfM）流程，它在联合重建中直接强制执行跨会话对应关系，从而能够从几年前拍摄的图像创建连贯的3D模型，即使外观变化很大。

title: POMDPPlanners: Open-Source Package for POMDP Planning
summary: We present POMDPPlanners, an open-source Python package for empirical evaluation of Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) planning algorithms. The package integrates state-of-the-art planning algorithms, a suite of benchmark environments with safety-critical variants, automated hyperparameter optimization via Optuna, persistent caching with failure recovery, and configurable parallel simulation -- reducing the overhead of extensive simulation studies. POMDPPlanners is designed to enable scalable, reproducible research on decision-making under uncertainty, with particular emphasis on risk-sensitive settings where standard toolkits fall short.
summary_zh: 我们提出了POMDPPlanners，一个开源的Python软件包，用于对部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程(POMDP)规划算法进行实证评估。该软件包集成了最先进的规划算法、一套包含安全关键变体的基准环境、通过Optuna实现的自动化超参数优化、具有故障恢复功能的持久缓存以及可配置的并行仿真，从而降低了大规模仿真研究的开销。POMDPPlanners旨在实现不确定性下决策制定的可扩展、可复现的研究，尤其侧重于标准工具包无法胜任的风险敏感型设置。
tldr: POMDPPlanners is an open-source Python package providing state-of-the-art POMDP planning algorithms, benchmark environments, and tools for scalable, reproducible research, especially in risk-sensitive settings.
tldr_zh: POMDPPlanners 是一个开源 Python 包，提供最先进的 POMDP 规划算法、基准环境，以及用于可扩展、可重复研究的工具，尤其是在风险敏感的环境中。

title: When can we trust untrusted monitoring? A safety case sketch across collusion strategies
summary: AIs are increasingly being deployed with greater autonomy and capabilities, which increases the risk that a misaligned AI may be able to cause catastrophic harm. Untrusted monitoring -- using one untrusted model to oversee another -- is one approach to reducing risk. Justifying the safety of an untrusted monitoring deployment is challenging because developers cannot safely deploy a misaligned model to test their protocol directly. In this paper, we develop upon existing methods for rigorously demonstrating safety based on pre-deployment testing. We relax assumptions that previous AI control research made about the collusion strategies a misaligned AI might use to subvert untrusted monitoring. We develop a taxonomy covering passive self-recognition, causal collusion (hiding pre-shared signals), acausal collusion (hiding signals via Schelling points), and combined strategies. We create a safety case sketch to clearly present our argument, explicitly state our assumptions, and highlight unsolved challenges. We identify conditions under which passive self-recognition could be a more effective collusion strategy than those studied previously. Our work builds towards more robust evaluations of untrusted monitoring.
summary_zh: 人工智能正以更高的自主性和能力被日益广泛地部署，这增加了对齐不良的人工智能可能造成灾难性危害的风险。不可信监控--使用一个不可信的模型来监督另一个模型--是一种降低风险的方法。证明不可信监控部署的安全性具有挑战性，因为开发者无法安全地部署对齐不良的模型来直接测试他们的协议。在本文中，我们基于预部署测试，对现有严格证明安全性的方法进行了改进。我们放宽了以往人工智能控制研究对对齐不良的人工智能可能采用的串谋策略，以颠覆不可信监控的假设。我们提出了一个分类体系，涵盖被动自我识别、因果串谋（隐藏预先共享的信号）、非因果串谋（通过谢林点隐藏信号）以及组合策略。我们创建了一个安全案例草图，以清晰地呈现我们的论点，明确地陈述我们的假设，并突出未解决的挑战。我们确定了被动自我识别在哪些条件下可能比以前研究的串谋策略更有效。我们的工作旨在构建更强大的不可信监控评估方法。
tldr: This paper analyzes the safety of "untrusted monitoring" of AIs, considering various collusion strategies that a misaligned AI might employ to subvert the monitoring process. It proposes a taxonomy of collusion strategies and sketches a safety case for this approach.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了AI的“不可信监控”的安全性，考虑了错位AI可能用来破坏监控过程的各种勾结策略。它提出了勾结策略的分类，并概述了这种方法的安全案例。

title: Monocular Endoscopic Tissue 3D Reconstruction with Multi-Level Geometry Regularization
summary: Reconstructing deformable endoscopic tissues is crucial for achieving robot-assisted surgery. However, 3D Gaussian Splatting-based approaches encounter challenges in achieving consistent tissue surface reconstruction, while existing NeRF-based methods lack real-time rendering capabilities. In pursuit of both smooth deformable surfaces and real-time rendering, we introduce a novel approach based on 3D Gaussian Splatting. Specifically, we introduce surface-aware reconstruction, initially employing a Sign Distance Field-based method to construct a mesh, subsequently utilizing this mesh to constrain the Gaussian Splatting reconstruction process. Furthermore, to ensure the generation of physically plausible deformations, we incorporate local rigidity and global non-rigidity restrictions to guide Gaussian deformation, tailored for the highly deformable nature of soft endoscopic tissue. Based on 3D Gaussian Splatting, our proposed method delivers a fast rendering process and smooth surface appearances. Quantitative and qualitative analysis against alternative methodologies shows that our approach achieves solid reconstruction quality in both textures and geometries.
summary_zh: 重建可变形的内窥镜组织对于实现机器人辅助手术至关重要。然而，基于3D高斯溅射的方法在实现一致的组织表面重建方面面临挑战，而现有的基于NeRF的方法缺乏实时渲染能力。为了同时追求平滑的可变形表面和实时渲染，我们提出了一种基于3D高斯溅射的新方法。具体来说，我们引入了表面感知重建，首先采用基于符号距离场的方法构建网格，然后利用该网格来约束高斯溅射重建过程。此外，为了确保生成物理上合理的形变，我们结合了局部刚性和全局非刚性约束来引导高斯形变，专为软性内窥镜组织的高度可变形特性而设计。基于3D高斯溅射，我们提出的方法能够实现快速的渲染过程和平滑的表面外观。与替代方法的定量和定性分析表明，我们的方法在纹理和几何结构方面都实现了可靠的重建质量。
tldr: This paper presents a 3D Gaussian Splatting-based method for monocular endoscopic tissue reconstruction, incorporating surface-aware reconstruction and deformation restrictions to achieve smooth surfaces and real-time rendering.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于3D高斯溅射的单目内窥镜组织重建方法，该方法结合了表面感知重建和变形约束，以实现平滑的表面和实时渲染。

title: BoxSplitGen: A Generative Model for 3D Part Bounding Boxes in Varying Granularity
summary: Human creativity follows a perceptual process, moving from abstract ideas to finer details during creation. While 3D generative models have advanced dramatically, models specifically designed to assist human imagination in 3D creation -- particularly for detailing abstractions from coarse to fine -- have not been explored. We propose a framework that enables intuitive and interactive 3D shape generation by iteratively splitting bounding boxes to refine the set of bounding boxes. The main technical components of our framework are two generative models: the box-splitting generative model and the box-to-shape generative model. The first model, named BoxSplitGen, generates a collection of 3D part bounding boxes with varying granularity by iteratively splitting coarse bounding boxes. It utilizes part bounding boxes created through agglomerative merging and learns the reverse of the merging process -- the splitting sequences. The model consists of two main components: the first learns the categorical distribution of the box to be split, and the second learns the distribution of the two new boxes, given the set of boxes and the indication of which box to split. The second model, the box-to-shape generative model, is trained by leveraging the 3D shape priors learned by an existing 3D diffusion model while adapting the model to incorporate bounding box conditioning. In our experiments, we demonstrate that the box-splitting generative model outperforms token prediction models and the inpainting approach with an unconditional diffusion model. Also, we show that our box-to-shape model, based on a state-of-the-art 3D diffusion model, provides superior results compared to a previous model.
summary_zh: 人类的创造力遵循一种感知过程，在创作过程中从抽象想法转向更精细的细节。虽然3D生成模型已经取得了显著的进展，但专门用于辅助人类在3D创作中进行想象的模型 —— 特别是用于将抽象概念从粗糙到精细地进行详细描述的模型 —— 尚未得到探索。我们提出了一种框架，通过迭代分割边界框来细化边界框集合，从而实现直观和交互式的3D形状生成。该框架的主要技术组成部分是两个生成模型：框分割生成模型和框到形状生成模型。第一个模型，名为BoxSplitGen，通过迭代分割粗糙边界框来生成一组具有不同粒度的3D零件边界框。它利用通过凝聚式合并创建的零件边界框，并学习合并过程的反向过程 —— 分割序列。该模型由两个主要组成部分组成：第一个学习要分割的框的类别分布，第二个学习两个新框的分布，给定框集合和要分割的框的指示。第二个模型，框到形状生成模型，通过利用现有3D扩散模型学习的3D形状先验进行训练，同时调整该模型以包含边界框条件。在我们的实验中，我们证明了框分割生成模型优于token预测模型以及使用无条件扩散模型的图像修复方法。此外，我们表明，我们基于最先进的3D扩散模型的框到形状模型，相比之前的模型提供了更优越的结果。
tldr: The paper introduces BoxSplitGen, a generative framework for 3D shape creation that iteratively refines bounding boxes from coarse to fine, using two generative models: one for box splitting and another for converting boxes to shapes, outperforming existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了BoxSplitGen，一个用于3D形状生成的框架，通过迭代地细化边界框来实现从粗略到精细的创建过程。该框架使用两个生成模型：一个用于边界框拆分，另一个用于将边界框转换为形状，并在性能上优于现有方法。

title: SD4R: Sparse-to-Dense Learning for 3D Object Detection with 4D Radar
summary: 4D radar measurements offer an affordable and weather-robust solution for 3D perception. However, the inherent sparsity and noise of radar point clouds present significant challenges for accurate 3D object detection, underscoring the need for effective and robust point clouds densification. Despite recent progress, existing densification methods often fail to address the extreme sparsity of 4D radar point clouds and exhibit limited robustness when processing scenes with a small number of points. In this paper, we propose SD4R, a novel framework that transforms sparse radar point clouds into dense representations. SD4R begins by utilizing a foreground point generator (FPG) to mitigate noise propagation and produce densified point clouds. Subsequently, a logit-query encoder (LQE) enhances conventional pillarization, resulting in robust feature representations. Through these innovations, our SD4R demonstrates strong capability in both noise reduction and foreground point densification. Extensive experiments conducted on the publicly available View-of-Delft dataset demonstrate that SD4R achieves state-of-the-art performance. Source code is available at https://github.com/lancelot0805/SD4R.
summary_zh: 4D雷达测量为3D感知提供了一种经济且具气象鲁棒性的解决方案。然而，雷达点云固有的稀疏性和噪声给精确的3D目标检测带来了重大挑战，凸显了有效且鲁棒的点云稠密化的必要性。尽管最近取得了一些进展，但现有的稠密化方法通常无法解决4D雷达点云的极端稀疏性，并且在处理点数较少的场景时表现出有限的鲁棒性。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的框架SD4R，该框架将稀疏的雷达点云转换为密集的表示。 SD4R首先利用前景点生成器（FPG）来减轻噪声传播并生成稠密化的点云。随后，logit查询编码器（LQE）增强了传统的体素化，从而产生稳健的特征表示。通过这些创新，我们的SD4R在降噪和前景点稠密化方面都表现出强大的能力。在公开的View-of-Delft数据集上进行的大量实验表明，SD4R实现了最先进的性能。源代码可在https://github.com/lancelot0805/SD4R获取。
tldr: The paper introduces SD4R, a novel method for densifying sparse 4D radar point clouds for 3D object detection, achieving state-of-the-art results on the View-of-Delft dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SD4R，一种用于密集化稀疏 4D 雷达点云以进行 3D 物体检测的新方法，在 View-of-Delft 数据集上取得了最先进的结果。

title: Boosting Instance Awareness via Cross-View Correlation with 4D Radar and Camera for 3D Object Detection
summary: 4D millimeter-wave radar has emerged as a promising sensing modality for autonomous driving due to its robustness and affordability. However, its sparse and weak geometric cues make reliable instance activation difficult, limiting the effectiveness of existing radar-camera fusion paradigms. BEV-level fusion offers global scene understanding but suffers from weak instance focus, while perspective-level fusion captures instance details but lacks holistic context. To address these limitations, we propose SIFormer, a scene-instance aware transformer for 3D object detection using 4D radar and camera. SIFormer first suppresses background noise during view transformation through segmentation- and depth-guided localization. It then introduces a cross-view activation mechanism that injects 2D instance cues into BEV space, enabling reliable instance awareness under weak radar geometry. Finally, a transformer-based fusion module aggregates complementary image semantics and radar geometry for robust perception. As a result, with the aim of enhancing instance awareness, SIFormer bridges the gap between the two paradigms, combining their complementary strengths to address inherent sparse nature of radar and improve detection accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that SIFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance on View-of-Delft, TJ4DRadSet and NuScenes datasets. Source code is available at github.com/shawnnnkb/SIFormer.
summary_zh:
摘要：
4D毫米波雷达因其鲁棒性和经济性，已成为自动驾驶领域极具前景的传感方式。然而，其稀疏且微弱的几何线索使得可靠的目标激活变得困难，限制了现有雷达-相机融合范式的能力。BEV（鸟瞰图）层面的融合提供了全局场景理解，但缺乏对目标的关注，而透视层面的融合则捕捉了目标细节，但缺乏整体上下文。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了一种名为SIFormer的场景-目标感知Transformer，用于使用4D雷达和相机进行3D目标检测。SIFormer首先通过分割和深度引导的定位，抑制视图变换期间的背景噪声。然后，它引入了一种跨视图激活机制，将2D目标线索注入到BEV空间中，从而在微弱的雷达几何条件下实现可靠的目标感知。最后，一个基于Transformer的融合模块聚合互补的图像语义和雷达几何信息，以实现强大的感知能力。因此，以增强目标感知为目标，SIFormer弥合了两种范式之间的差距，结合了它们互补的优势，以解决雷达固有的稀疏性并提高检测精度。实验表明，SIFormer在View-of-Delft、TJ4DRadSet和NuScenes数据集上实现了最先进的性能。源代码可在github.com/shawnnnkb/SIFormer上获取。
tldr: The paper presents SIFormer, a novel scene-instance aware transformer that fuses 4D radar and camera data for improved 3D object detection in autonomous driving, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple datasets by addressing radar's sparsity issue.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了SIFormer，一种新的场景实例感知Transformer，融合4D雷达和相机数据，以改进自动驾驶中的3D物体检测。通过解决雷达的稀疏性问题，SIFormer在多个数据集上取得了最先进的结果。

title: PropFly: Learning to Propagate via On-the-Fly Supervision from Pre-trained Video Diffusion Models
summary: Propagation-based video editing enables precise user control by propagating a single edited frame into following frames while maintaining the original context such as motion and structures. However, training such models requires large-scale, paired (source and edited) video datasets, which are costly and complex to acquire. Hence, we propose the PropFly, a training pipeline for Propagation-based video editing, relying on on-the-Fly supervision from pre-trained video diffusion models (VDMs) instead of requiring off-the-shelf or precomputed paired video editing datasets. Specifically, our PropFly leverages one-step clean latent estimations from intermediate noised latents with varying Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) scales to synthesize diverse pairs of 'source' (low-CFG) and 'edited' (high-CFG) latents on-the-fly. The source latent serves as structural information of the video, while the edited latent provides the target transformation for learning propagation. Our pipeline enables an additional adapter attached to the pre-trained VDM to learn to propagate edits via Guidance-Modulated Flow Matching (GMFM) loss, which guides the model to replicate the target transformation. Our on-the-fly supervision ensures the model to learn temporally consistent and dynamic transformations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our PropFly significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on various video editing tasks, producing high-quality editing results.
summary_zh: 基于传播的视频编辑通过将单个编辑帧传播到后续帧，同时保持原始上下文（例如运动和结构），从而实现精确的用户控制。然而，训练此类模型需要大规模的配对（源和编辑后）视频数据集，这既昂贵又复杂。因此，我们提出 PropFly，一种基于传播的视频编辑的训练流程，它依赖于来自预训练视频扩散模型（VDM）的即时监督，而不是需要现成的或预计算的配对视频编辑数据集。具体来说，我们的PropFly利用具有不同无分类器引导（CFG）尺度的中间噪声潜变量的单步干净潜变量估计，来即时合成各种“源”（低CFG）和“编辑后”（高CFG）潜变量对。源潜变量充当视频的结构信息，而编辑后的潜变量提供用于学习传播的目标变换。我们的流程使附加到预训练VDM的额外适配器能够学习通过引导调制流匹配（GMFM）损失传播编辑，该损失引导模型复制目标变换。我们的即时监督确保模型学习到时间上一致且动态的变换。大量实验表明，我们的PropFly在各种视频编辑任务上显著优于最先进的方法，产生高质量的编辑结果。
tldr: The paper introduces PropFly, a method for training propagation-based video editing models using on-the-fly supervision from pre-trained video diffusion models, eliminating the need for paired video datasets. It learns to propagate edits via Guidance-Modulated Flow Matching, achieving superior results in various video editing tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PropFly，一种利用预训练视频扩散模型进行即时监督来训练基于传播的视频编辑模型的方法，无需配对的视频数据集。它通过引导调制流匹配学习传播编辑，并在各种视频编辑任务中取得了优异的成果。

title: Aesthetic Camera Viewpoint Suggestion with 3D Aesthetic Field
summary: The aesthetic quality of a scene depends strongly on camera viewpoint. Existing approaches for aesthetic viewpoint suggestion are either single-view adjustments, predicting limited camera adjustments from a single image without understanding scene geometry, or 3D exploration approaches, which rely on dense captures or prebuilt 3D environments coupled with costly reinforcement learning (RL) searches. In this work, we introduce the notion of 3D aesthetic field that enables geometry-grounded aesthetic reasoning in 3D with sparse captures, allowing efficient viewpoint suggestions in contrast to costly RL searches. We opt to learn this 3D aesthetic field using a feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting network that distills high-level aesthetic knowledge from a pretrained 2D aesthetic model into 3D space, enabling aesthetic prediction for novel viewpoints from only sparse input views. Building on this field, we propose a two-stage search pipeline that combines coarse viewpoint sampling with gradient-based refinement, efficiently identifying aesthetically appealing viewpoints without dense captures or RL exploration. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently suggests viewpoints with superior framing and composition compared to existing approaches, establishing a new direction toward 3D-aware aesthetic modeling.
summary_zh: 场景的美学质量强烈依赖于相机视角。现有的美学视角建议方法要么是单视角调整，即从单张图像预测有限的相机调整而不理解场景几何结构；要么是3D探索方法，依赖于密集的捕捉数据或预先构建的3D环境，并结合代价高昂的强化学习（RL）搜索。在这项工作中，我们引入了3D美学场的概念，它能够在稀疏捕捉数据的基础上进行基于几何结构的3D美学推理，从而实现高效的视角建议，而无需代价高昂的RL搜索。我们选择使用前馈3D高斯溅射网络来学习这个3D美学场，该网络将预训练的2D美学模型中的高层美学知识提炼到3D空间中，从而仅利用稀疏的输入视角就能预测新视角的审美价值。在此基础上，我们提出了一种两阶段搜索流程，它结合了粗略的视角采样和基于梯度的细化，从而高效地识别出具有美学吸引力的视角，而无需密集的捕捉数据或RL探索。大量实验表明，与现有方法相比，我们的方法能够始终如一地提出具有更好构图和取景的视角，为3D感知美学建模开辟了一个新的方向。
tldr: This paper proposes a method for aesthetic camera viewpoint suggestion using a 3D aesthetic field learned from sparse views, avoiding the need for dense captures or reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种利用从稀疏视角学习的3D美学场来推荐美学相机视点的方法，避免了使用密集捕捉或强化学习。

title: N4MC: Neural 4D Mesh Compression
summary: We present N4MC, the first 4D neural compression framework to efficiently compress time-varying mesh sequences by exploiting their temporal redundancy. Unlike prior neural mesh compression methods that treat each mesh frame independently, N4MC takes inspiration from inter-frame compression in 2D video codecs, and learns motion compensation in long mesh sequences. Specifically, N4MC converts consecutive irregular mesh frames into regular 4D tensors to provide a uniform and compact representation. These tensors are then condensed using an auto-decoder, which captures both spatial and temporal correlations for redundancy removal. To enhance temporal coherence, we introduce a transformer-based interpolation model that predicts intermediate mesh frames conditioned on latent embeddings derived from tracked volume centers, eliminating motion ambiguities. Extensive evaluations show that N4MC outperforms state-of-the-art in rate-distortion performance, while enabling real-time decoding of 4D mesh sequences. The implementation of our method is available at: https://github.com/frozzzen3/N4MC.
summary_zh: 我们提出了 N4MC，这是首个 4D 神经压缩框架，旨在通过利用时变网格序列的时间冗余来高效压缩它们。与先前独立处理每个网格帧的神经网格压缩方法不同，N4MC 从 2D 视频编解码器中的帧间压缩获得灵感，并学习长网格序列中的运动补偿。具体而言，N4MC 将连续的不规则网格帧转换为规则的 4D 张量，以提供统一且紧凑的表示。然后，使用自解码器压缩这些张量，该自解码器捕获空间和时间相关性以消除冗余。为了增强时间连贯性，我们引入了一种基于 Transformer 的插值模型，该模型以从跟踪的体中心导出的潜在嵌入为条件，预测中间网格帧，从而消除运动歧义。广泛的评估表明，N4MC 在率失真性能方面优于最先进的方法，同时能够实现 4D 网格序列的实时解码。我们的方法的实现可在以下网址获得：https://github.com/frozzzen3/N4MC。
tldr: N4MC is a novel 4D neural compression framework for time-varying mesh sequences using motion compensation and a transformer-based interpolation model for real-time decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.
tldr_zh: N4MC是一种新颖的 4D 神经压缩框架，用于时变网格序列，它采用运动补偿和基于 Transformer 的插值模型实现实时解码，优于当前最优方法。

title: MAST: A Multi-fidelity Augmented Surrogate model via Spatial Trust-weighting
summary: In engineering design and scientific computing, computational cost and predictive accuracy are intrinsically coupled. High-fidelity simulations provide accurate predictions but at substantial computational costs, while lower-fidelity approximations offer efficiency at the expense of accuracy. Multi-fidelity surrogate modelling addresses this trade-off by combining abundant low-fidelity data with sparse high-fidelity observations. However, existing methods suffer from expensive training cost or rely on global correlation assumptions that often fail in practice to capture how fidelity relationships vary across the input space, leading to poor performance particularly under tight budget constraints. We introduce MAST, a method that blends corrected low-fidelity observations with high-fidelity predictions, trusting high-fidelity near observed samples and relying on corrected low-fidelity elsewhere. MAST achieves this through explicit discrepancy modelling and distance-based weighting with closed-form variance propagation, producing a single heteroscedastic Gaussian process. Across multi-fidelity synthetic benchmarks, MAST shows a marked improvement over the current state-of-the-art techniques. Crucially, MAST maintains robust performance across varying total budget and fidelity gaps, conditions under which competing methods exhibit significant degradation or unstable behaviour.
summary_zh: 在工程设计和科学计算中，计算成本和预测精度本质上是相互关联的。高保真度模拟提供准确的预测，但计算成本高昂，而低保真度近似则以牺牲精度为代价来提高效率。多保真度代理建模通过结合丰富的低保真度数据和稀疏的高保真度观测来解决这一权衡。然而，现有方法存在训练成本高昂或依赖全局相关性假设的问题，这些假设在实践中通常无法捕捉保真度关系如何在输入空间中变化，从而导致性能不佳，尤其是在预算紧张的情况下。我们提出了MAST，一种将校正后的低保真度观测与高保真度预测相结合的方法，在高保真度样本附近信任高保真度，并在其他地方依赖校正后的低保真度。MAST通过显式差异建模和基于距离的加权以及闭式方差传播来实现这一点，生成一个异方差高斯过程。在多保真度合成基准测试中，MAST与当前最先进的技术相比显示出显著的改进。至关重要的是，MAST在变化的总体预算和保真度差距下保持稳健的性能，而竞争方法在这些条件下表现出明显的退化或不稳定的行为。
tldr: The paper introduces MAST, a multi-fidelity surrogate modeling method that combines high- and low-fidelity data using spatial trust-weighting to improve prediction accuracy and robustness under varying budget constraints, outperforming existing approaches.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为MAST的多精度代理模型方法，该方法通过空间信任加权结合高精度和低精度数据，提高了预测精度和在不同预算约束下的鲁棒性，优于现有方法。

title: A Micro-Macro Model of Encounter-Driven Information Diffusion in Robot Swarms
summary: In this paper, we propose the problem of Encounter-Driven Information Diffusion (EDID). In EDID, robots are allowed to exchange information only upon meeting. Crucially, EDID assumes that the robots are not allowed to schedule their meetings. As such, the robots have no means to anticipate when, where, and who they will meet. As a step towards the design of storage and routing algorithms for EDID, in this paper we propose a model of information diffusion that captures the essential dynamics of EDID. The model is derived from first principles and is composed of two levels: a micro model, based on a generalization of the concept of `mean free path'; and a macro model, which captures the global dynamics of information diffusion. We validate the model through extensive robot simulations, in which we consider swarm size, communication range, environment size, and different random motion regimes. We conclude the paper with a discussion of the implications of this model on the algorithms that best support information diffusion according to the parameters of interest.
summary_zh: 本文提出了基于偶遇驱动的信息扩散（EDID）问题。在EDID中，只有在机器人相遇时才允许它们交换信息。关键在于，EDID假设机器人不允许安排它们的相遇。因此，机器人无法预测何时、何地以及与谁相遇。作为设计EDID存储和路由算法的第一步，本文提出了一个信息扩散模型，该模型捕捉了EDID的基本动态特性。该模型从第一性原理推导，由两个层次组成：一个基于“平均自由程”概念推广的微观模型；以及一个捕捉信息扩散全局动态的宏观模型。我们通过大量的机器人仿真验证了该模型，仿真中考虑了群体规模、通信范围、环境大小以及不同的随机运动机制。最后，我们讨论了该模型对于根据感兴趣的参数选择最支持信息扩散的算法的影响。
tldr: This paper proposes a micro-macro model for information diffusion in robot swarms where robots can only exchange information upon encounters, without scheduling capabilities, and validates it through simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个微观-宏观模型，用于机器人群中基于偶遇的信息扩散。在该模型中，机器人只能在相遇时交换信息，且不能进行调度。论文通过仿真验证该模型。

title: Visual Cooperative Drone Tracking for Open-Path Gas Measurements
summary: Open-path Tunable Diode Laser Absorption Spectroscopy offers an effective method for measuring, mapping, and monitoring gas concentrations, such as leaking CO2 or methane. Compared to spatial sampling of gas distributions using in-situ sensors, open-path sensors in combination with gas tomography algorithms can cover large outdoor environments faster in a non-invasive way. However, the requirement of a dedicated reflection surface for the open-path laser makes automating the spatial sampling process challenging. This publication presents a robotic system for collecting open-path measurements, making use of a sensor mounted on a ground-based pan-tilt unit and a small drone carrying a reflector. By means of a zoom camera, the ground unit visually tracks red LED markers mounted on the drone and aligns the sensor's laser beam with the reflector. Incorporating GNSS position information provided by the drone's flight controller further improves the tracking approach. Outdoor experiments validated the system's performance, demonstrating successful autonomous tracking and valid CO2 measurements at distances up to 60 meters. Furthermore, the system successfully measured a CO2 plume without interference from the drone's propulsion system, demonstrating its superiority compared to flying in-situ sensors.
summary_zh: 开放路径可调谐二极管激光吸收光谱法提供了一种有效的方法来测量、绘制和监测气体浓度，例如泄漏的二氧化碳或甲烷。与使用原位传感器对气体分布进行空间采样相比，开放路径传感器与气体层析成像算法相结合，可以以非侵入的方式更快地覆盖大型户外环境。然而，开放路径激光器需要专用的反射面，这使得空间采样过程的自动化具有挑战性。本出版物介绍了一种用于收集开放路径测量的机器人系统，该系统利用安装在地面云台上的传感器和一架携带反射器的小型无人机。通过变焦相机，地面单元视觉跟踪安装在无人机上的红色LED标记，并将传感器的激光束与反射器对齐。结合无人机飞行控制器提供的GNSS位置信息，进一步改进了跟踪方法。户外实验验证了该系统的性能，表明在高达60米的距离上实现了成功的自主跟踪和有效的二氧化碳测量。此外，该系统成功地测量了一个二氧化碳羽流，且不受无人机推进系统的干扰，证明了其优于飞行原位传感器。
tldr: This paper presents a robotic system using a ground-based sensor and a drone with a reflector for automated open-path gas measurements via laser spectroscopy, validated through CO2 plume measurement.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种机器人系统，该系统使用地面传感器和带有反射器的无人机，通过激光光谱法自动进行开放路径气体测量，并通过 CO2 羽流测量进行了验证。

title: Dual-Branch INS/GNSS Fusion with Inequality and Equality Constraints
summary: Reliable vehicle navigation in urban environments remains a challenging problem due to frequent satellite signal blockages caused by tall buildings and complex infrastructure. While fusing inertial reading with satellite positioning in an extended Kalman filter provides short-term navigation continuity, low-cost inertial sensors suffer from rapid error accumulation during prolonged outages. Existing information aiding approaches, such as the non-holonomic constraint, impose rigid equality assumptions on vehicle motion that may be violated under dynamic urban driving conditions, limiting their robustness precisely when aiding is most needed. In this paper, we propose a dual-branch information aiding framework that fuses equality and inequality motion constraints through a variance-weighted scheme, requiring only a software modification to an existing navigation filter with no additional sensors or hardware. The proposed method is evaluated on four publicly available urban datasets featuring various inertial sensors, road conditions, and dynamics, covering a total duration of 4.3 hours of recorded data. Under Full GNSS availability, the method reduces vertical position error by 16.7% and improves altitude accuracy by 50.1% over the standard non-holonomic constraint. Under GNSS-denied conditions, vertical drift is reduced by 24.2% and altitude accuracy improves by 20.2%. These results demonstrate that replacing hard motion equality assumptions with physically motivated inequality bounds is a practical and cost-free strategy for improving navigation resilience, continuity, and drift robustness without relying on additional sensors, map data, or learned models.
summary_zh: 在城市环境中实现可靠的车辆导航仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题，这是由于高层建筑和复杂基础设施经常导致卫星信号阻塞。虽然在扩展卡尔曼滤波器中融合惯性数据和卫星定位可以提供短期的导航连续性，但低成本的惯性传感器在长时间的信号中断期间会遭受快速的误差累积。现有的信息辅助方法，例如非完整约束，对车辆运动施加了严格的等式假设，这些假设在动态城市驾驶条件下可能被违反，这限制了它们在最需要辅助时期的鲁棒性。在本文中，我们提出了一种双分支信息辅助框架，该框架通过方差加权方案融合等式和不等式运动约束，只需对现有导航滤波器进行软件修改，而无需额外的传感器或硬件。所提出的方法在四个公开的城市数据集中进行了评估，这些数据集具有各种惯性传感器、道路状况和动力学，涵盖了总共 4.3 小时的记录数据。在完全 GNSS 可用性下，该方法将垂直位置误差降低了 16.7%，并将高度精度提高了 50.1%，优于标准的非完整约束。在 GNSS 受限条件下，垂直漂移降低了 24.2%，高度精度提高了 20.2%。这些结果表明，用物理驱动的不等式边界替代硬性运动等式假设是一种实用的且零成本的策略，可以在不依赖额外的传感器、地图数据或学习模型的情况下，提高导航的弹性、连续性和漂移鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces a dual-branch INS/GNSS fusion method using both equality and inequality motion constraints to improve navigation in urban environments with GNSS outages. The method achieves improved accuracy and robustness without requiring additional sensors or hardware.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种双分支INS/GNSS融合方法，该方法结合了等式和不等式运动约束，以提高在GNSS中断的城市环境中导航的准确性。该方法在不需要额外传感器或硬件的情况下，实现了更高的精度和鲁棒性。

title: Acoustic Feedback for Closed-Loop Force Control in Robotic Grinding
summary:
Acoustic feedback is a critical indicator for assessing the contact condition between the tool and the workpiece when humans perform grinding tasks with rotary tools. In contrast, robotic grinding systems typically rely on force sensing, with acoustic information largely ignored. This reliance on force sensors is costly and difficult to adapt to different grinding tools, whereas audio sensors (microphones) are low-cost and can be mounted on any medium that conducts grinding sound.
  This paper introduces a low-cost Acoustic Feedback Robotic Grinding System (AFRG) that captures audio signals with a contact microphone, estimates grinding force from the audio in real time, and enables closed-loop force control of the grinding process. Compared with conventional force-sensing approaches, AFRG achieves a 4-fold improvement in consistency across different grinding disc conditions. AFRG relies solely on a low-cost microphone, which is approximately 200-fold cheaper than conventional force sensors, as the sensing modality, providing an easily deployable, cost-effective robotic grinding solution.
summary_zh:
声反馈是评估人使用旋转工具进行研磨任务时，工具与工件之间接触状况的关键指标。相比之下，机器人研磨系统通常依赖于力传感，而声学信息在很大程度上被忽略。 这种对力传感器的依赖成本高昂，且难以适应不同的研磨工具，而音频传感器（麦克风）成本低廉，并且可以安装在任何传导研磨声音的介质上。

本文介绍了一种低成本的声反馈机器人研磨系统（AFRG），该系统利用接触式麦克风捕获音频信号，实时估计音频中的研磨力，并实现研磨过程的闭环力控制。与传统的力传感方法相比，AFRG在不同研磨盘条件下实现了4倍的一致性提升。作为传感方式，AFRG仅依赖于一个低成本的麦克风，其成本约为传统力传感器的1/200，从而提供了一种易于部署、经济高效的机器人研磨解决方案。
tldr: This paper presents a low-cost robotic grinding system (AFRG) that uses acoustic feedback from a microphone to estimate grinding force and enable closed-loop force control, achieving better consistency and lower cost compared to force sensor-based systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种低成本的机器人磨削系统 (AFRG)，该系统利用来自麦克风的声学反馈来估计磨削力，并实现闭环力控制。与基于力传感器的系统相比，该系统具有更好的一致性和更低的成本。

title: Energy-Based Injury Protection Database: Including Shearing Contact Thresholds for Hand and Finger Using Porcine Surrogates
summary: While robotics research continues to propose strategies for collision avoidance in human-robot interaction, the reality of constrained environments and future humanoid systems makes contact inevitable. To mitigate injury risks, energy-constraining control approaches are commonly used, often relying on safety thresholds derived from blunt impact data in EN ISO 10218-2:2025. However, this dataset does not extend to edged or pointed collisions. Without scalable, clinically grounded datasets covering diverse contact scenarios, safety validation remains limited. Previous studies have laid the groundwork by assessing surrogate-based velocity and mass limits across various geometries, focusing on perpendicular impacts. This study expands those datasets by including shearing contact scenarios in unconstrained collisions, revealing that collision angle significantly affects injury outcomes. Notably, unconstrained shearing contacts result in fewer injuries than perpendicular ones. By reevaluating all prior porcine surrogate data, we establish energy thresholds across geometries and contact types, forming the first energy-based Injury Protection Database. This enables the development of meaningful energy-limiting controllers that ensure safety across a wide range of realistic collision events.
summary_zh: 随着机器人研究不断提出人机交互中碰撞避免策略，但受限环境和未来人形系统的现实情况使得接触不可避免。为了减轻受伤风险，通常使用能量约束控制方法，这些方法通常依赖于从EN ISO 10218-2:2025 中的钝性冲击数据导出的安全阈值。然而，该数据集并未涵盖边缘或尖锐物体的碰撞。 在缺乏涵盖多样接触场景的可扩展、以临床为基础的数据集的情况下，安全验证仍然有限。先前的研究已通过评估基于替代物的速度和质量限制奠定了基础，该研究涵盖了各种几何形状，并侧重于垂直冲击。本研究通过在无约束碰撞中包含剪切接触场景来扩展这些数据集，揭示了碰撞角度对损伤结果的显著影响。值得注意的是，无约束剪切接触造成的损伤少于垂直接触造成的损伤。通过重新评估所有先前的猪替代物数据，我们建立了跨几何形状和接触类型的能量阈值，形成了第一个基于能量的损伤保护数据库。这使得能够开发有意义的能量限制控制器，从而确保在各种现实碰撞事件中的安全性。
tldr: This paper introduces an energy-based Injury Protection Database incorporating shearing contact thresholds for hand and finger injuries in human-robot interaction, using porcine surrogates. The study reveals that collision angle significantly affects injury outcomes, establishing energy thresholds across geometries and contact types.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个基于能量的损伤保护数据库，该数据库结合了人机交互中手和手指受到剪切接触的阈值，该研究使用了猪的替代物。这项研究表明，碰撞角度显著影响损伤结果，从而建立了跨几何形状和接触类型的能量阈值。

title: Onboard-Targeted Segmentation of Straylight in Space Camera Sensors
summary: This study details an artificial intelligence (AI)-based methodology for the semantic segmentation of space camera faults. Specifically, we address the segmentation of straylight effects induced by solar presence around the camera's Field of View (FoV). Anomalous images are sourced from our published dataset. Our approach emphasizes generalization across diverse flare textures, leveraging pre-training on a public dataset (Flare7k++) including flares in various non-space contexts to mitigate the scarcity of realistic space-specific data. A DeepLabV3 model with MobileNetV3 backbone performs the segmentation task. The model design targets deployment in spacecraft resource-constrained hardware. Finally, based on a proposed interface between our model and the onboard navigation pipeline, we develop custom metrics to assess the model's performance in the system-level context.
summary_zh: 本研究详细介绍了一种基于人工智能（AI）的空间相机故障语义分割方法。具体而言，我们致力于分割由太阳光在相机视场（FoV）附近引起的杂散光效应。异常图像来源于我们已发布的公开数据集。我们的方法强调在各种耀斑纹理上的泛化能力，利用在包括各种非空间环境下的耀斑的公开数据集（Flare7k++）上的预训练来缓解真实空间专用数据的稀缺性。采用带有MobileNetV3骨干网络的DeepLabV3模型执行分割任务。该模型设计旨在部署于航天器资源受限的硬件中。最后，基于我们提出的模型与在轨导航流水线之间的接口，我们开发了定制的指标来评估模型在系统级环境中的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces an AI-based method for segmenting straylight in space camera images, using a DeepLabV3 model pre-trained on non-space flare datasets for generalization and designed for onboard deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于人工智能的航天相机图像中杂散光分割方法，该方法使用在非航天耀斑数据集上预训练的 DeepLabV3 模型以实现泛化，并设计用于星载部署。

title: Optimizing Occupancy Sensor Placement in Smart Environments
summary: Understanding the locations of occupants in a commercial built environment is critical for realizing energy savings by delivering lighting, heating, and cooling only where it is needed. The key to achieving this goal is being able to recognize zone occupancy in real time, without impeding occupants' activities or compromising privacy. While low-resolution, privacy-preserving time-of-flight (ToF) sensor networks have demonstrated good performance in zone counting, the performance depends on careful sensor placement. To address this issue, we propose an automatic sensor placement method that determines optimal sensor layouts for a given number of sensors, and can predict the counting accuracy of such a layout. In particular, given the geometric constraints of an office environment, we simulate a large number of occupant trajectories. We then formulate the sensor placement problem as an integer linear programming (ILP) problem and solve it with the branch and bound method. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method based on simulations of several different office environments.
summary_zh: 理解商业建筑环境中人员的定位对于实现节能至关重要，因为它可以只在需要的地方提供照明、供暖和制冷。实现这一目标的关键在于能够实时识别区域占用情况，同时不影响人员的活动或损害隐私。尽管低分辨率、保护隐私的飞行时间（ToF）传感器网络已在区域计数方面表现出良好的性能，但其性能取决于精心的传感器布置。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种自动传感器布置方法，该方法可以确定给定数量传感器的最佳传感器布局，并可以预测这种布局的计数精度。具体而言，在给定办公环境的几何约束条件下，我们模拟了大量人员轨迹。然后，我们将传感器布置问题表述为一个整数线性规划（ILP）问题，并使用分支定界法求解。我们基于几个不同办公环境的模拟，证明了所提出方法的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes an automatic sensor placement method to optimize occupancy detection in smart environments using time-of-flight sensors and integer linear programming, aiming for energy savings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自动传感器放置方法，通过使用飞行时间传感器和整数线性规划来优化智能环境中的占用检测，旨在节能。

title: Progressive Per-Branch Depth Optimization for DEFOM-Stereo and SAM3 Joint Analysis in UAV Forestry Applications
summary: Accurate per-branch 3D reconstruction is a prerequisite for autonomous UAV-based tree pruning; however, dense disparity maps from modern stereo matchers often remain too noisy for individual branch analysis in complex forest canopies. This paper introduces a progressive pipeline integrating DEFOM-Stereo foundation-model disparity estimation, SAM3 instance segmentation, and multi-stage depth optimization to deliver robust per-branch point clouds. Starting from a naive baseline, we systematically identify and resolve three error families through successive refinements. Mask boundary contamination is first addressed through morphological erosion and subsequently refined via a skeleton-preserving variant to safeguard thin-branch topology. Segmentation inaccuracy is then mitigated using LAB-space Mahalanobis color validation coupled with cross-branch overlap arbitration. Finally, depth noise - the most persistent error source - is initially reduced by outlier removal and median filtering, before being superseded by a robust five-stage scheme comprising MAD global detection, spatial density consensus, local MAD filtering, RGB-guided filtering, and adaptive bilateral filtering. Evaluated on 1920x1080 stereo imagery of Radiata pine (Pinus radiata) acquired with a ZED Mini camera (63 mm baseline) from a UAV in Canterbury, New Zealand, the proposed pipeline reduces the average per-branch depth standard deviation by 82% while retaining edge fidelity. The result is geometrically coherent 3D point clouds suitable for autonomous pruning tool positioning. All code and processed data are publicly released to facilitate further UAV forestry research.
summary_zh: 精确的单枝条三维重建是基于无人机的自主树木修剪的前提；然而，现代立体匹配器生成的密集视差图通常噪声过大，难以用于复杂森林冠层中的单枝条分析。本文提出了一种渐进式流程，集成了DEFOM-Stereo基础模型的视差估计、SAM3实例分割和多阶段深度优化，以生成稳健的单枝条点云。从一个朴素的基线开始，我们通过连续的改进系统地识别并解决了三个误差族。首先，通过形态学腐蚀解决掩模边界污染，随后通过保留骨架的变体进行细化，以保护细枝条拓扑结构。然后，通过LAB颜色空间马氏距离验证以及跨枝条重叠仲裁来缓解分割不准确性。最后，深度噪声——最持久的误差来源——最初通过离群值剔除和中值滤波来减少，然后被一个稳健的五阶段方案所取代，该方案包括MAD全局检测、空间密度一致性、局部MAD滤波、RGB引导滤波和自适应双边滤波。在利用ZED Mini相机（63毫米基线）从新西兰坎特伯雷的无人机上获取的Radiata松树（辐射松）的1920x1080立体图像上进行评估，所提出的流程将单枝条的平均深度标准差降低了82%，同时保持了边缘保真度。结果是几何上连贯的三维点云，适用于自主修剪工具的定位。所有代码和处理后的数据均已公开发布，以促进进一步的无人机林业研究。
tldr: This paper presents a pipeline for generating accurate per-branch 3D point clouds from UAV stereo imagery for forestry applications, specifically autonomous pruning. It combines DEFOM-Stereo, SAM3, and a multi-stage depth optimization scheme to achieve robust and geometrically coherent reconstructions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种从无人机立体图像中生成精确的逐枝3D点云的流程，用于林业应用，特别是自主修剪。它结合了DEFOM-Stereo、SAM3和一个多阶段深度优化方案，以实现鲁棒和几何一致的重建。

title: Bikelution: Federated Gradient-Boosting for Scalable Shared Micro-Mobility Demand Forecasting
summary: The rapid growth of dockless bike-sharing systems has generated massive spatio-temporal datasets useful for fleet allocation, congestion reduction, and sustainable mobility. Bike demand, however, depends on several external factors, making traditional time-series models insufficient. Centralized Machine Learning (CML) yields high-accuracy forecasts but raises privacy and bandwidth issues when data are distributed across edge devices. To overcome these limitations, we propose Bikelution, an efficient Federated Learning (FL) solution based on gradient-boosted trees that preserves privacy while delivering accurate mid-term demand forecasts up to six hours ahead. Experiments on three real-world BSS datasets show that Bikelution is comparable to its CML-based variant and outperforms the current state-of-the-art. The results highlight the feasibility of privacy-aware demand forecasting and outline the trade-offs between FL and CML approaches.
summary_zh:
摘要：
无桩共享单车系统的快速发展产生了大量的时空数据集，可用于车队分配、拥堵缓解和可持续交通。然而，单车需求依赖于多种外部因素，使得传统时间序列模型捉襟见肘。集中式机器学习（CML）能够产生高精度的预测，但当数据分布在边缘设备上时，会引发隐私和带宽问题。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出Bikelution，一种基于梯度提升树的高效联邦学习（FL）解决方案，在保护隐私的同时，提供准确的中期需求预测，提前预测时间可达六小时。在三个真实世界共享单车系统数据集上的实验表明，Bikelution与基于CML的变体相当，并优于当前最先进的方法。结果突显了隐私感知需求预测的可行性，并概述了联邦学习和集中式机器学习方法之间的权衡。
tldr: The paper introduces Bikelution, a federated learning approach using gradient-boosted trees for predicting bike-sharing demand, achieving performance comparable to centralized methods while preserving privacy.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Bikelution，一种使用梯度提升树的联邦学习方法，用于预测共享单车需求，在保护隐私的同时实现了与集中式方法相当的性能。

title: Computer-Aided Design of Rational Motions for 4R and 6R Spatial Mechanism Synthesis
summary: This paper focuses on geometric methods for generating rational motions used in the design of single-loop rational linkages, 1-degree-of-freedom mechanisms that can execute prescribed spatial tasks. Building on established rational motion synthesis methods, we introduce a new interpolation scheme for seven 3D points based on cubic quaternionic Bezier curves. The resulting motion admits factorization, i.e. the synthesis of a spatial six-bar mechanism whose tool frame passes the specified seven points. To support engineering practice, we provide open-source CAD tools that implement also the other methods and provide fast visual evaluation of motion generation and mechanism synthesis.
summary_zh: 本文着重研究用于设计单环有理连杆机构的几何方法，该连杆机构是一种具有一度自由度的机构，可以执行指定的空间任务。在已建立的有理运动综合方法的基础上，我们介绍了一种基于三次四元数Bezier曲线的七个3D点的新插值方案。得到的运动允许分解，即综合出一个工具坐标系经过指定的七个点的空间六杆机构。为了支持工程实践，我们提供了开源CAD工具，这些工具也实现了其他方法，并可对运动生成和机构综合进行快速的视觉评估。
tldr: The paper introduces a CAD tool that generates rational motions for 4R and 6R spatial mechanisms using a cubic quaternionic Bezier curve interpolation scheme for 3D point-based motion synthesis, with open-source availability.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个CAD工具，通过使用三次四元数Bezier曲线插值方案进行3D点运动合成，为4R和6R空间机构生成有理运动，并提供开源版本。

title: Conflict-Based Search for Multi-Agent Path Finding with Elevators
summary: This paper investigates a problem called Multi-Agent Path Finding with Elevators (MAPF-E), which seeks conflict-free paths for multiple agents from their start to goal locations that may locate on different floors, and the agents can use elevators to travel between floors. The existence of elevators complicates the interaction among the agents and introduces new challenges to the planning. On the one hand, elevators can cause many conflicts among the agents due to its relatively long traversal time across floors, especially when many agents need to reach a different floor. On the other hand, the planner has to reason in a larger state space including the states of the elevators, besides the locations of the agents.
summary_zh: 本文研究了一个名为“多智能体路径规划与电梯”（MAPF-E）的问题，该问题旨在为多个智能体寻找从起点到终点的无冲突路径，这些起点和终点可能位于不同的楼层，并且智能体可以使用电梯在楼层之间移动。电梯的存在使得智能体之间的交互更加复杂，并给规划带来了新的挑战。一方面，由于电梯跨楼层移动的时间相对较长，尤其是当许多智能体需要到达不同的楼层时，电梯可能会导致智能体之间产生许多冲突。另一方面，除了智能体的位置之外，规划器还必须在包括电梯状态的更大的状态空间中进行推理。
tldr: This paper addresses the Multi-Agent Path Finding problem in environments with elevators, highlighting the challenges of managing conflicts and larger state spaces introduced by elevator usage.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了包含电梯的多智能体路径规划问题 (MAPF-E)，强调了由于电梯的使用而引入的冲突管理和更大的状态空间所带来的挑战。

title: Joint-Aligned Latent Action: Towards Scalable VLA Pretraining in the Wild
summary: Despite progress, Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are limited by a scarcity of large-scale, diverse robot data. While human manipulation videos offer a rich alternative, existing methods are forced to choose between small, precisely-labeled datasets and vast in-the-wild footage with unreliable hand tracking labels. We present JALA, a pretraining framework that learns Jointly-Aligned Latent Actions. JALA bypasses full visual dynamic reconstruction, instead learns a predictive action embedding aligned with both inverse dynamics and real actions. This yields a transition-aware, behavior-centric latent space for learning from heterogeneous human data. We scale this approach with UniHand-Mix, a 7.5M video corpus (>2,000 hours) blending laboratory and in-the-wild footage. Experiments demonstrate that JALA generates more realistic hand motions in both controlled and unconstrained scenarios, significantly improving downstream robot manipulation performance in both simulation and real-world tasks. These results indicate that jointly-aligned latent actions offer a scalable pathway for VLA pretraining from human data.
summary_zh: 尽管取得了进展，视觉-语言-动作模型(VLAs)仍受限于大规模、多样化机器人数据的稀缺。尽管人类操作视频提供了一种丰富的替代方案，但现有方法被迫在小型、精确标注的数据集和庞大的、具有不可靠手部追踪标签的野外素材之间做出选择。我们提出了JALA，一种学习联合对齐潜在动作的预训练框架。JALA绕过了完整的视觉动态重建，而是学习一个与逆动力学和真实动作对齐的预测性动作嵌入。这产生了一个过渡感知、行为中心的潜在空间，用于从异构人类数据中学习。我们利用UniHand-Mix，一个包含750万个视频样本（>2000小时）的大型语料库，融合了实验室和野外素材，来扩展这种方法。实验表明，JALA在受控和非受限场景下都能生成更逼真的手部运动，显著提升了模拟和真实世界任务中的下游机器人操作性能。这些结果表明，联合对齐的潜在动作提供了一条可扩展的途径，用于从人类数据中进行VLA预训练。
tldr: The paper introduces JALA, a VLA pretraining framework that learns jointly-aligned latent actions to scale learning from heterogeneous human manipulation videos by aligning a predictive action embedding with inverse dynamics and real actions, leading to improved robot manipulation performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种VLA预训练框架JALA，它通过学习联合对齐的潜在动作，从异构的人类操作视频中扩展学习。JALA通过将预测动作嵌入与逆动力学和真实动作对齐来实现这一点，从而提高了机器人操作的性能。

title: Self-Correcting VLA: Online Action Refinement via Sparse World Imagination
summary: Standard vision-language-action (VLA) models rely on fitting statistical data priors, limiting their robust understanding of underlying physical dynamics. Reinforcement learning enhances physical grounding through exploration yet typically relies on external reward signals that remain isolated from the agent's internal states. World action models have emerged as a promising paradigm that integrates imagination and control to enable predictive planning. However, they rely on implicit context modeling, lacking explicit mechanisms for self-improvement. To solve these problems, we propose Self-Correcting VLA (SC-VLA), which achieve self-improvement by intrinsically guiding action refinement through sparse imagination. We first design sparse world imagination by integrating auxiliary predictive heads to forecast current task progress and future trajectory trends, thereby constraining the policy to encode short-term physical evolution. Then we introduce the online action refinement module to reshape progress-dependent dense rewards, adjusting trajectory orientation based on the predicted sparse future states. Evaluations on challenging robot manipulation tasks from simulation benchmarks and real-world settings demonstrate that SC-VLA achieve state-of-the-art performance, yielding the highest task throughput with 16% fewer steps and a 9% higher success rate than the best-performing baselines, alongside a 14% gain in real-world experiments. Code is available at https://github.com/Kisaragi0/SC-VLA.
summary_zh: 标准视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型依赖于拟合统计数据先验，限制了其对底层物理动力学的稳健理解。强化学习通过探索来增强物理基础，但通常依赖于与智能体内部状态隔离的外部奖励信号。世界动作模型作为一种有前景的范式出现，它整合了想象和控制，以实现预测性规划。然而，它们依赖于隐式上下文建模，缺乏用于自我改进的显式机制。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了自校正VLA（SC-VLA），通过内在引导的动作精细化，利用稀疏想象来实现自我改进。我们首先通过集成辅助预测头来预测当前任务进度和未来轨迹趋势，从而设计稀疏世界想象，进而约束策略以编码短期物理演化。然后，我们引入在线动作精细化模块来重塑依赖于进度的密集奖励，并基于预测的稀疏未来状态来调整轨迹方向。在来自模拟基准和真实世界环境的具有挑战性的机器人操控任务上的评估表明，SC-VLA实现了最先进的性能，以减少16%的步数和比表现最佳的基线高9%的成功率，产生了最高的任务吞吐量，并在真实世界实验中获得了14%的提升。代码可在https://github.com/Kisaragi0/SC-VLA 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces Self-Correcting VLA (SC-VLA), a novel vision-language-action model that enhances physical grounding through sparse world imagination and online action refinement, achieving state-of-the-art performance in robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为自校正VLA（SC-VLA）的新型视觉-语言-动作模型，该模型通过稀疏世界想象和在线动作优化来增强物理基础，并在机器人操作任务中实现了最先进的性能。

title: LiLo-VLA: Compositional Long-Horizon Manipulation via Linked Object-Centric Policies
summary: General-purpose robots must master long-horizon manipulation, defined as tasks involving multiple kinematic structure changes (e.g., attaching or detaching objects) in unstructured environments. While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer the potential to master diverse atomic skills, they struggle with the combinatorial complexity of sequencing them and are prone to cascading failures due to environmental sensitivity. To address these challenges, we propose LiLo-VLA (Linked Local VLA), a modular framework capable of zero-shot generalization to novel long-horizon tasks without ever being trained on them. Our approach decouples transport from interaction: a Reaching Module handles global motion, while an Interaction Module employs an object-centric VLA to process isolated objects of interest, ensuring robustness against irrelevant visual features and invariance to spatial configurations. Crucially, this modularity facilitates robust failure recovery through dynamic replanning and skill reuse, effectively mitigating the cascading errors common in end-to-end approaches. We introduce a 21-task simulation benchmark consisting of two challenging suites: LIBERO-Long++ and Ultra-Long. In these simulations, LiLo-VLA achieves a 69% average success rate, outperforming Pi0.5 by 41% and OpenVLA-OFT by 67%. Furthermore, real-world evaluations across 8 long-horizon tasks demonstrate an average success rate of 85%. Project page: https://yy-gx.github.io/LiLo-VLA/.
summary_zh: 通用机器人必须掌握长时程操作，即在非结构化环境中涉及多次运动学结构变化（例如，物体连接或分离）的任务。虽然视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型具有掌握各种原子技能的潜力，但它们在对这些技能进行排序时会面临组合复杂性问题，并且容易因环境敏感性而导致级联失败。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了LiLo-VLA（Linked Local VLA），一种模块化框架，能够在零样本泛化的情况下处理从未训练过的新型长时程任务。我们的方法将运动与交互分离：一个到达模块处理全局运动，而一个交互模块采用以物体为中心的VLA来处理孤立的目标物体，从而确保对不相关的视觉特征的鲁棒性以及对空间配置的不变性。至关重要的是，这种模块化通过动态重规划和技能重用来促进稳健的故障恢复，有效地减轻了端到端方法中常见的级联错误。我们引入了一个包含21项任务的模拟基准，该基准由两个具有挑战性的套件组成：LIBERO-Long++和Ultra-Long。在这些模拟中，LiLo-VLA 实现了 69% 的平均成功率，比 Pi0.5 高出 41%，比 OpenVLA-OFT 高出 67%。此外，在 8 项长时程任务的真实世界评估中，LiLo-VLA 展示了 85% 的平均成功率。项目主页：https://yy-gx.github.io/LiLo-VLA/。
tldr: LiLo-VLA introduces a modular Vision-Language-Action framework for long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks, decoupling transport and interaction to achieve robust zero-shot generalization and failure recovery, demonstrating strong performance in simulation and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: LiLo-VLA 提出了一个用于长时程机器人操作任务的模块化视觉-语言-动作框架，将运输和交互分离，以实现鲁棒的零样本泛化和故障恢复，并在模拟和现实环境中表现出强大的性能。

title: HALO: A Unified Vision-Language-Action Model for Embodied Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance in robotic manipulation, but often struggle in long-horizon or out-of-distribution scenarios due to the lack of explicit mechanisms for multimodal reasoning and anticipating how the world will evolve under action. Recent works introduce textual chain-of-thought or visual subgoal prediction within VLA models to reason, but still fail to offer a unified human-like reasoning framework for joint textual reasoning, visual foresight, and action prediction. To this end, we propose HALO, a unified VLA model that enables embodied multimodal chain-of-thought (EM-CoT) reasoning through a sequential process of textual task reasoning, visual subgoal prediction for fine-grained guidance, and EM-CoT-augmented action prediction. We instantiate HALO with a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture that decouples semantic reasoning, visual foresight, and action prediction into specialized experts while allowing seamless cross-expert collaboration. To enable HALO learning at scale, we introduce an automated pipeline to synthesize EM-CoT training data along with a carefully crafted training recipe. Extensive experiments demonstrate that: (1) HALO achieves superior performance in both simulated and real-world environments, surpassing baseline policy pi_0 by 34.1% on RoboTwin benchmark; (2) all proposed components of the training recipe and EM-CoT design help improve task success rate; and (3) HALO exhibits strong generalization capabilities under aggressive unseen environmental randomization with our proposed EM-CoT reasoning.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型在机器人操作中表现出强大的性能，但由于缺乏用于多模态推理和预测动作下世界如何演变的显式机制，它们通常在长程或分布外场景中表现不佳。最近的研究在 VLA 模型中引入了文本思维链或视觉子目标预测来进行推理，但仍然无法提供一个统一的类人推理框架，用于联合文本推理、视觉预测和动作预测。为此，我们提出了 HALO，一种统一的 VLA 模型，它通过文本任务推理、用于精细化指导的视觉子目标预测以及增强 EM-CoT 的动作预测的顺序过程，实现具身多模态思维链 (EM-CoT) 推理。我们使用混合 Transformer (MoT) 架构实例化 HALO，该架构将语义推理、视觉预测和动作预测解耦为专门的专家，同时允许无缝的跨专家协作。为了实现 HALO 的大规模学习，我们引入了一个自动化流水线来合成 EM-CoT 训练数据，并精心设计了训练方案。大量的实验表明：（1）HALO 在模拟和真实世界环境中均取得了卓越的性能，在 RoboTwin 基准测试中超过基线策略 pi_0 达 34.1%；（2）训练方案和 EM-CoT 设计的所有提议组件都有助于提高任务成功率；并且（3）HALO 在我们提出的 EM-CoT 推理下，在激进的未知环境随机化下表现出强大的泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces HALO, a unified Vision-Language-Action model that uses embodied multimodal chain-of-thought (EM-CoT) reasoning through textual task reasoning, visual subgoal prediction, and EM-CoT-augmented action prediction, demonstrating improved performance and generalization in simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了HALO，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作模型，它通过文本任务推理、视觉子目标预测和EM-CoT增强的动作预测，使用具身多模态思维链（EM-CoT）推理，在模拟和现实世界的机器人操作任务中表现出改进的性能和泛化能力。

title: ProactiveMobile: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Boosting Proactive Intelligence on Mobile Devices
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in mobile agent development, yet their capabilities are predominantly confined to a reactive paradigm, where they merely execute explicit user commands. The emerging paradigm of proactive intelligence, where agents autonomously anticipate needs and initiate actions, represents the next frontier for mobile agents. However, its development is critically bottlenecked by the lack of benchmarks that can address real-world complexity and enable objective, executable evaluation. To overcome these challenges, we introduce ProactiveMobile, a comprehensive benchmark designed to systematically advance research in this domain. ProactiveMobile formalizes the proactive task as inferring latent user intent across four dimensions of on-device contextual signals and generating an executable function sequence from a comprehensive function pool of 63 APIs. The benchmark features over 3,660 instances of 14 scenarios that embrace real-world complexity through multi-answer annotations. To ensure quality, a team of 30 experts conducts a final audit of the benchmark, verifying factual accuracy, logical consistency, and action feasibility, and correcting any non-compliant entries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct achieves a success rate of 19.15%, outperforming o1 (15.71%) and GPT-5 (7.39%). This result indicates that proactivity is a critical competency widely lacking in current MLLMs, yet it is learnable, emphasizing the importance of the proposed benchmark for proactivity evaluation.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在移动代理的开发中取得了显著进展，然而，它们的能力主要局限于反应式范式，仅执行明确的用户指令。主动智能的新兴范式，即代理自主地预测需求并启动行动，代表了移动代理的下一个前沿。然而，缺乏能够应对真实世界复杂性并实现客观、可执行评估的基准测试，严重阻碍了其发展。为了克服这些挑战，我们引入了ProactiveMobile，这是一个全面的基准测试，旨在系统地推进该领域的研究。ProactiveMobile将主动式任务形式化为推断设备上四个维度上下文信号中的潜在用户意图，并从包含63个API的综合函数池中生成可执行的函数序列。该基准测试拥有超过3660个实例，涵盖14种场景，通过多答案标注来体现真实世界的复杂性。为了确保质量，由30名专家组成的团队对基准测试进行了最终审核，验证了事实准确性、逻辑一致性和行动可行性，并纠正了任何不合规的条目。大量实验表明，我们微调后的Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct的成功率达到了19.15%，优于o1（15.71%）和GPT-5（7.39%）。这个结果表明，主动性是当前MLLMs普遍缺乏的关键能力，但它是可学习的，强调了所提出的主动性评估基准的重要性。
tldr: The paper introduces ProactiveMobile, a new benchmark for evaluating proactive intelligence in mobile agents using multimodal large language models. The benchmark addresses the lack of resources for developing agents that autonomously anticipate user needs and outperformed existing models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ProactiveMobile，这是一个新的基准，用于评估在移动代理中使用多模态大型语言模型的主动智能。该基准旨在解决缺乏开发能够自主预测用户需求的代理的资源的问题，并且性能优于现有模型。

title: Exploring Vision-Language Models for Open-Vocabulary Zero-Shot Action Segmentation
summary: Temporal Action Segmentation (TAS) requires dividing videos into action segments, yet the vast space of activities and alternative breakdowns makes collecting comprehensive datasets infeasible. Existing methods remain limited to closed vocabularies and fixed label sets. In this work, we explore the largely unexplored problem of Open-Vocabulary Zero-Shot Temporal Action Segmentation (OVTAS) by leveraging the strong zero-shot capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). We introduce a training-free pipeline that follows a segmentation-by-classification design: Frame-Action Embedding Similarity (FAES) matches video frames to candidate action labels, and Similarity-Matrix Temporal Segmentation (SMTS) enforces temporal consistency. Beyond proposing OVTAS, we present a systematic study across 14 diverse VLMs, providing the first broad analysis of their suitability for open-vocabulary action segmentation. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that OVTAS achieves strong results without task-specific supervision, underscoring the potential of VLMs for structured temporal understanding.
summary_zh: 时序动作分割 (TAS) 要求将视频分割成动作片段，但由于活动种类繁多且分割方式多样，收集全面的数据集是不可行的。现有方法仍局限于封闭词汇表和固定的标签集。 在这项工作中，我们探索了在很大程度上未被探索的开放词汇零样本时序动作分割 (OVTAS) 问题，该问题利用了视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 强大的零样本能力。 我们引入了一种无训练的流程，该流程遵循一种基于分类的分割设计：帧-动作嵌入相似性 (FAES) 将视频帧与候选动作标签进行匹配，而相似度矩阵时序分割 (SMTS) 则强制执行时序一致性。 除了提出 OVTAS 之外，我们还对 14 个不同的 VLM 进行了系统研究，首次对它们在开放词汇动作分割中的适用性进行了广泛分析。在标准基准上的实验表明，OVTAS 在没有特定任务监督的情况下取得了良好的结果，突显了 VLM 在结构化时序理解方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper explores open-vocabulary zero-shot temporal action segmentation (OVTAS) using vision-language models (VLMs) and introduces a training-free pipeline achieving strong results without task-specific supervision.
tldr_zh: 本文探索了使用视觉-语言模型（VLM）的开放词汇零样本时间动作分割（OVTAS）， 并提出了一个无需训练的流程，在没有特定任务监督的情况下取得了良好的效果。

title: Tool-R0: Self-Evolving LLM Agents for Tool-Learning from Zero Data
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming the foundation for autonomous agents that can use tools to solve complex tasks. Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a common approach for injecting such agentic capabilities, but typically under tightly controlled training setups. It often depends on carefully constructed task-solution pairs and substantial human supervision, which creates a fundamental obstacle to open-ended self-evolution toward superintelligent systems. In this paper, we propose Tool-R0 framework for training general purpose tool-calling agents from scratch with self-play RL, under a zero-data assumption. Initialized from the same base LLM, Tool-R0 co-evolves a Generator and a Solver with complementary rewards: one proposes targeted challenging tasks at the other's competence frontier and the other learns to solve them with real-world tool calls. This creates a self-evolving cycle that requires no pre-existing tasks or datasets. Evaluation on different tool-use benchmarks show that Tool-R0 yields 92.5 relative improvement over the base model and surpasses fully supervised tool-calling baselines under the same setting. Our work further provides empirical insights into self-play LLM agents by analyzing co-evolution, curriculum dynamics, and scaling behavior.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正成为自主代理的基础，这些代理可以使用工具来解决复杂的任务。强化学习（RL）已成为注入此类代理能力的常用方法，但通常是在严格控制的训练环境中。它常常依赖于精心构建的任务-解决方案对以及大量的人工监督，这为迈向超智能系统的开放式自我进化设置了根本性的障碍。在本文中，我们提出了 Tool-R0 框架，用于在零数据假设下，通过自博弈强化学习从零开始训练通用工具调用代理。Tool-R0 从相同的基础 LLM 初始化，共同进化一个生成器和一个求解器，并具有互补的奖励：一个在另一个的能力边界上提出有针对性的挑战性任务，另一个学习使用真实世界的工具调用来解决这些任务。这创建了一个自我进化的循环，不需要预先存在的任务或数据集。在不同的工具使用基准上的评估表明，Tool-R0 比基础模型产生了 92.5% 的相对改进，并且在相同的设置下超过了完全监督的工具调用基线。我们的工作还通过分析共同进化、课程动态和缩放行为，进一步提供了对自博弈 LLM 代理的实证见解。
tldr: The paper introduces Tool-R0, a framework for training tool-calling LLM agents from scratch using self-play reinforcement learning, achieving significant performance gains over baselines without relying on pre-existing data or human supervision.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Tool-R0，一个使用自博弈强化学习从零开始训练工具调用LLM代理的框架，在不依赖预先存在的数据或人工监督的情况下，实现了相对于基线的显著性能提升。

title: Force Policy: Learning Hybrid Force-Position Control Policy under Interaction Frame for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich manipulation demands human-like integration of perception and force feedback: vision should guide task progress, while high-frequency interaction control must stabilize contact under uncertainty. Existing learning-based policies often entangle these roles in a monolithic network, trading off global generalization against stable local refinement, while control-centric approaches typically assume a known task structure or learn only controller parameters rather than the structure itself. In this paper, we formalize a physically grounded interaction frame, an instantaneous local basis that decouples force regulation from motion execution, and propose a method to recover it from demonstrations. Based on this, we address both issues by proposing Force Policy, a global-local vision-force policy in which a global policy guides free-space actions using vision, and upon contact, a high-frequency local policy with force feedback estimates the interaction frame and executes hybrid force-position control for stable interaction. Real-world experiments across diverse contact-rich tasks show consistent gains over strong baselines, with more robust contact establishment, more accurate force regulation, and reliable generalization to novel objects with varied geometries and physical properties, ultimately improving both contact stability and execution quality. Project page: https://force-policy.github.io/
summary_zh:
摘要：
富接触操纵要求类人的感知和力反馈集成：视觉应引导任务进度，而高频交互控制必须在不确定性下稳定接触。现有的基于学习的策略通常在一个单体网络中纠缠这些角色，从而牺牲了全局泛化能力以换取稳定的局部优化，而以控制为中心的方法通常假设已知任务结构，或者仅学习控制器参数而非结构本身。在本文中，我们形式化了一个物理上合理的交互框架，一个瞬时局部基，它将力调节与运动执行解耦，并提出了一种从演示中恢复它的方法。基于此，我们通过提出力策略（Force Policy）来解决这两个问题，力策略是一种全局-局部视觉-力策略，其中全局策略使用视觉引导自由空间动作，并且在接触时，具有力反馈的高频局部策略估计交互框架并执行混合力-位置控制以实现稳定交互。跨多类富接触任务的真实世界实验表明，相对于强大的基线，该方法具有持续的增益，在建立更稳健的接触、更精确的力调节以及对具有不同几何形状和物理特性的新对象的可靠泛化方面更胜一筹，最终提高了接触稳定性和执行质量。项目页面：https://force-policy.github.io/
tldr: The paper introduces Force Policy, a novel vision-force policy for contact-rich manipulation that decouples vision-guided free-space actions from force-feedback-based local hybrid force-position control, demonstrating improved stability, accuracy, and generalization in real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为Force Policy的新型视觉-力觉策略，用于接触丰富的操作。该策略将视觉引导的自由空间动作与基于力反馈的局部混合力-位置控制分离，从而在真实世界的任务中表现出更好的稳定性、准确性和泛化能力。

title: FlowCorrect: Efficient Interactive Correction of Generative Flow Policies for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Generative manipulation policies can fail catastrophically under deployment-time distribution shift, yet many failures are near-misses: the robot reaches almost-correct poses and would succeed with a small corrective motion. We present FlowCorrect, a deployment-time correction framework that converts near-miss failures into successes using sparse human nudges, without full policy retraining. During execution, a human provides brief corrective pose nudges via a lightweight VR interface. FlowCorrect uses these sparse corrections to locally adapt the policy, improving actions without retraining the backbone while preserving the model performance on previously learned scenarios. We evaluate on a real-world robot across three tabletop tasks: pick-and-place, pouring, and cup uprighting. With a low correction budget, FlowCorrect improves success on hard cases by 85\% while preserving performance on previously solved scenarios. The results demonstrate clearly that FlowCorrect learns only with very few demonstrations and enables fast and sample-efficient incremental, human-in-the-loop corrections of generative visuomotor policies at deployment time in real-world robotics.
summary_zh: 生成式操作策略在部署时面临分布偏移可能发生灾难性失败，但许多失败都只是差之毫厘：机器人已经达到几乎正确的姿态，只需一个小的修正动作就能成功。我们提出 FlowCorrect，一种部署时修正框架，它利用稀疏的人工干预将差之毫厘的失败转化为成功，无需完全重新训练策略。在执行过程中，人通过一个轻量级的 VR 界面提供简短的修正姿态干预。FlowCorrect 使用这些稀疏的修正来局部地调整策略，在不重新训练主干网络的情况下提高动作性能，同时保持模型在先前学习场景中的表现。我们通过一个真实世界的机器人在三个桌面任务上进行了评估：拾取放置、倾倒和杯子竖立。在低修正预算下，FlowCorrect 将困难案例的成功率提高了 85%，同时保持了在先前解决场景中的表现。结果清晰地表明，FlowCorrect 仅通过极少的演示进行学习，并能在真实世界机器人技术的部署时，对生成式视觉运动策略进行快速且样本高效的增量式人机循环修正。
tldr: FlowCorrect presents a method for efficiently correcting failures in generative robotic manipulation policies at deployment time with sparse human input, significantly improving success rates without retraining.
tldr_zh: FlowCorrect提出了一种在部署时通过少量人工干预高效修正生成式机器人操作策略失败的方法，显著提高了成功率，且无需重新训练。

title: World Guidance: World Modeling in Condition Space for Action Generation
summary: Leveraging future observation modeling to facilitate action generation presents a promising avenue for enhancing the capabilities of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, existing approaches struggle to strike a balance between maintaining efficient, predictable future representations and preserving sufficient fine-grained information to guide precise action generation. To address this limitation, we propose WoG (World Guidance), a framework that maps future observations into compact conditions by injecting them into the action inference pipeline. The VLA is then trained to simultaneously predict these compressed conditions alongside future actions, thereby achieving effective world modeling within the condition space for action inference. We demonstrate that modeling and predicting this condition space not only facilitates fine-grained action generation but also exhibits superior generalization capabilities. Moreover, it learns effectively from substantial human manipulation videos. Extensive experiments across both simulation and real-world environments validate that our method significantly outperforms existing methods based on future prediction. Project page is available at: https://selen-suyue.github.io/WoGNet/
summary_zh: 利用未来观测建模来促进动作生成，为提升视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的能力提供了一条很有前景的途径。然而，现有方法难以在保持高效、可预测的未来表征和保留足够的细粒度信息以指导精确动作生成之间取得平衡。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了 WoG (World Guidance)，一个通过将未来观测注入到动作推断流程中，把未来观测映射为紧凑条件的框架。然后，VLA 模型被训练为同时预测这些压缩条件和未来动作，从而在动作推断的条件空间内实现有效的世界建模。我们证明了建模和预测这个条件空间不仅有助于细粒度动作生成，而且表现出卓越的泛化能力。此外，它还能有效地从大量人类操纵视频中学习。在仿真和真实世界环境中的大量实验验证了我们的方法显著优于基于未来预测的现有方法。项目主页请访问：https://selen-suyue.github.io/WoGNet/
tldr: The paper introduces WoG, a framework that models future observations as compact conditions injected into the action inference pipeline of Vision-Language-Action models, leading to fine-grained action generation and improved generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为WoG的框架，它将未来的观察结果建模为紧凑的条件，并将这些条件注入到Vision-Language-Action模型的动作推断流程中，从而实现精细的动作生成和更好的泛化能力。

title: Are Foundation Models the Route to Full-Stack Transfer in Robotics?
summary: In humans and robots alike, transfer learning occurs at different levels of abstraction, from high-level linguistic transfer to low-level transfer of motor skills. In this article, we provide an overview of the impact that foundation models and transformer networks have had on these different levels, bringing robots closer than ever to "full-stack transfer". Considering LLMs, VLMs and VLAs from a robotic transfer learning perspective allows us to highlight recurring concepts for transfer, beyond specific implementations. We also consider the challenges of data collection and transfer benchmarks for robotics in the age of foundation models. Are foundation models the route to full-stack transfer in robotics? Our expectation is that they will certainly stay on this route as a key technology.
summary_zh: 在人类和机器人中，迁移学习发生在不同的抽象层级，从高级语言迁移到低级运动技能迁移。在本文中，我们概述了基础模型和Transformer网络对这些不同层级的影响，使机器人比以往任何时候都更接近于“全栈迁移”。从机器人迁移学习的角度考虑LLM、VLM和VLA，可以让我们在特定实现之外，突出显示用于迁移的重复概念。我们还考虑了基础模型时代机器人数据收集和迁移基准测试的挑战。基础模型是实现机器人全栈迁移的途径吗？我们预计它们肯定会作为一项关键技术继续沿着这条路线前进。
tldr: This paper reviews the impact of foundation models (LLMs, VLMs, VLAs) on robotic transfer learning, highlighting recurring concepts and challenges in data collection and benchmarks, suggesting they are crucial for achieving full-stack transfer in robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文综述了基础模型（LLMs, VLMs, VLAs）对机器人迁移学习的影响，强调了迁移学习中反复出现的核心概念以及数据收集和基准测试的挑战，认为它们是实现机器人全栈迁移的关键技术。

title: Humanizing Robot Gaze Shifts: A Framework for Natural Gaze Shifts in Humanoid Robots
summary: Leveraging auditory and visual feedback for attention reorientation is essential for natural gaze shifts in social interaction. However, enabling humanoid robots to perform natural and context-appropriate gaze shifts in unconstrained human--robot interaction (HRI) remains challenging, as it requires the coupling of cognitive attention mechanisms and biomimetic motion generation. In this work, we propose the Robot Gaze-Shift (RGS) framework, which integrates these two components into a unified pipeline. First, RGS employs a vision--language model (VLM)-based gaze reasoning pipeline to infer context-appropriate gaze targets from multimodal interaction cues, ensuring consistency with human gaze-orienting regularities. Second, RGS introduces a conditional Vector Quantized-Variational Autoencoder (VQ-VAE) model for eye--head coordinated gaze-shift motion generation, producing diverse and human-like gaze-shift behaviors. Experiments validate that RGS effectively replicates human-like target selection and generates realistic, diverse gaze-shift motions.
summary_zh: 利用听觉和视觉反馈进行注意力重定向对于社交互动中自然的视线转移至关重要。然而，使人形机器人能够在不受约束的人机交互（HRI）中执行自然且符合场景的视线转移仍然具有挑战性，因为它需要认知注意力机制与仿生运动生成相结合。在这项工作中，我们提出了机器人视线转移（RGS）框架，该框架将这两个组件集成到一个统一的管道中。首先，RGS采用基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的视线推理管道，从多模态交互线索中推断出符合场景的视线目标，确保与人类的视线定向规律保持一致。其次，RGS引入了一种有条件向量量化-变分自编码器（VQ-VAE）模型，用于眼-头协同视线转移运动生成，产生多样化且类人的视线转移行为。实验验证了RGS能够有效地复制类人的目标选择，并生成逼真、多样化的视线转移运动。
tldr: This paper introduces a framework (RGS) for generating natural, context-aware gaze shifts in humanoid robots by integrating a vision-language model for target selection and a conditional VQ-VAE for motion generation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个框架(RGS)，通过整合用于目标选择的视觉-语言模型和用于运动生成的条件VQ-VAE，在人形机器人中生成自然、上下文感知的注视转移。

title: Dream-SLAM: Dreaming the Unseen for Active SLAM in Dynamic Environments
summary: In addition to the core tasks of simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), active SLAM additionally in- volves generating robot actions that enable effective and efficient exploration of unknown environments. However, existing active SLAM pipelines are limited by three main factors. First, they inherit the restrictions of the underlying SLAM modules that they may be using. Second, their motion planning strategies are typically shortsighted and lack long-term vision. Third, most approaches struggle to handle dynamic scenes. To address these limitations, we propose a novel monocular active SLAM method, Dream-SLAM, which is based on dreaming cross-spatio-temporal images and semantically plausible structures of partially observed dynamic environments. The generated cross-spatio-temporal im- ages are fused with real observations to mitigate noise and data incompleteness, leading to more accurate camera pose estimation and a more coherent 3D scene representation. Furthermore, we integrate dreamed and observed scene structures to enable long- horizon planning, producing farsighted trajectories that promote efficient and thorough exploration. Extensive experiments on both public and self-collected datasets demonstrate that Dream-SLAM outperforms state-of-the-art methods in localization accuracy, mapping quality, and exploration efficiency. Source code will be publicly available upon paper acceptance.
summary_zh: 除了同步定位与地图构建(SLAM)的核心任务之外，主动SLAM还包括生成能够有效且高效地探索未知环境的机器人动作。然而，现有的主动SLAM流程受到三个主要因素的限制。首先，它们沿袭了其可能使用的底层SLAM模块的局限性。其次，它们的运动规划策略通常是短视的，缺乏长期视野。第三，大多数方法难以处理动态场景。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的单目主动SLAM方法，Dream-SLAM，它基于对部分观测到的动态环境进行跨时空图像和语义上合理的结构的梦想。生成的跨时空图像与真实观测融合，以减轻噪声和数据不完整性，从而实现更准确的相机姿态估计和更连贯的3D场景表示。此外，我们集成了梦想的和观测到的场景结构，以实现长程规划，产生促进高效和彻底探索的具有远见的轨迹。在公共数据集和我们自己收集的数据集上进行的大量实验表明，Dream-SLAM在定位精度、地图质量和探索效率方面优于最先进的方法。源代码将在论文被接收后公开。
tldr: Dream-SLAM introduces a monocular active SLAM method that uses "dreamed" cross-spatio-temporal images of dynamic environments to improve localization accuracy, mapping quality, and exploration efficiency, particularly in dynamic scenes.
tldr_zh: Dream-SLAM 提出了一种单目主动 SLAM 方法，该方法使用动态环境的“梦境”跨时空图像来提高定位准确性、地图质量和探索效率，尤其是在动态场景中。

title: Self-Curriculum Model-based Reinforcement Learning for Shape Control of Deformable Linear Objects
summary: Precise shape control of Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) is crucial in robotic applications such as industrial and medical fields. However, existing methods face challenges in handling complex large deformation tasks, especially those involving opposite curvatures, and lack efficiency and precision. To address this, we propose a two-stage framework combining Reinforcement Learning (RL) and online visual servoing. In the large-deformation stage, a model-based reinforcement learning approach using an ensemble of dynamics models is introduced to significantly improve sample efficiency. Additionally, we design a self-curriculum goal generation mechanism that dynamically selects intermediate-difficulty goals with high diversity through imagined evaluations, thereby optimizing the policy learning process. In the small-deformation stage, a Jacobian-based visual servo controller is deployed to ensure high-precision convergence. Simulation results show that the proposed method enables efficient policy learning and significantly outperforms mainstream baselines in shape control success rate and precision. Furthermore, the framework effectively transfers the policy trained in simulation to real-world tasks with zero-shot adaptation. It successfully completes all 30 cases with diverse initial and target shapes across DLOs of different sizes and materials. The project website is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/sc-mbrl-dlo-EB48/
summary_zh: 可变形线性物体 (DLO) 的精确形状控制在诸如工业和医疗领域等机器人应用中至关重要。然而，现有方法在处理复杂的大变形任务（尤其是涉及相反曲率的任务）时面临挑战，并且缺乏效率和精度。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种结合强化学习 (RL) 和在线视觉伺服的两阶段框架。在大变形阶段，引入了一种使用动力学模型集成的基于模型的强化学习方法，以显著提高样本效率。此外，我们设计了一种自课程目标生成机制，通过想象评估动态选择具有高度多样性的中等难度目标，从而优化策略学习过程。在小变形阶段，部署基于雅可比矩阵的视觉伺服控制器，以确保高精度收敛。仿真结果表明，所提出的方法能够实现高效的策略学习，并且在形状控制成功率和精度方面显著优于主流基线方法。此外，该框架能够有效地将仿真中训练的策略零样本迁移到现实世界任务中。该方法成功完成了所有30个案例，这些案例涵盖了不同尺寸和材料的DLO，并具有不同的初始形状和目标形状。项目网站地址：https://anonymous.4open.science/w/sc-mbrl-dlo-EB48/
tldr: This paper presents a two-stage RL framework with a self-curriculum model-based RL approach for efficient and precise shape control of Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs), demonstrating strong simulation and zero-shot real-world results.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个两阶段强化学习框架，采用基于自课程模型的强化学习方法，用于高效、精确地控制可变形线性物体（DLOs）的形状，并在仿真和零样本真实环境中展示了强大的结果。

title: DexRepNet++: Learning Dexterous Robotic Manipulation with Geometric and Spatial Hand-Object Representations
summary: Robotic dexterous manipulation is a challenging problem due to high degrees of freedom (DoFs) and complex contacts of multi-fingered robotic hands. Many existing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based methods aim at improving sample efficiency in high-dimensional output action spaces. However, existing works often overlook the role of representations in achieving generalization of a manipulation policy in the complex input space during the hand-object interaction. In this paper, we propose DexRep, a novel hand-object interaction representation to capture object surface features and spatial relations between hands and objects for dexterous manipulation skill learning. Based on DexRep, policies are learned for three dexterous manipulation tasks, i.e. grasping, in-hand reorientation, bimanual handover, and extensive experiments are conducted to verify the effectiveness. In simulation, for grasping, the policy learned with 40 objects achieves a success rate of 87.9% on more than 5000 unseen objects of diverse categories, significantly surpassing existing work trained with thousands of objects; for the in-hand reorientation and handover tasks, the policies also boost the success rates and other metrics of existing hand-object representations by 20% to 40%. The grasp policies with DexRep are deployed to the real world under multi-camera and single-camera setups and demonstrate a small sim-to-real gap.
summary_zh: 灵巧的机器人操作是一个具有挑战性的问题，因为它涉及到高自由度（DoFs）和多指机器人手的复杂接触。许多现有的基于深度强化学习（DRL）的方法旨在提高高维输出动作空间中的样本效率。然而，现有的工作常常忽视了表征在手-物交互过程中复杂输入空间中实现操作策略泛化中的作用。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的手-物交互表征DexRep，用于捕获物体表面特征以及手和物体之间的空间关系，从而用于灵巧操作技能的学习。基于DexRep，我们针对三种灵巧操作任务学习了策略，即抓取、手中重定向、双手递物，并进行了大量的实验来验证其有效性。在仿真中，对于抓取任务，使用40个物体训练的策略在超过5000个不同类别、未见过的物体上实现了87.9%的成功率，显著超过了使用数千个物体训练的现有工作；对于手中重定向和递物任务，该策略也将现有手-物表征的成功率和其他指标提高了20%至40%。具有DexRep的抓取策略已部署到多摄像头和单摄像头设置下的真实世界中，并展示了较小的仿真到现实的差距。
tldr: The paper introduces DexRep, a novel hand-object representation to improve the generalization of dexterous manipulation policies learned via reinforcement learning, showing significant improvements in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的手-物互动表征方法DexRep，旨在提高通过强化学习训练出的灵巧操作策略的泛化能力，并在仿真和真实世界实验中表现出显著的改进。

title: LessMimic: Long-Horizon Humanoid Interaction with Unified Distance Field Representations
summary: Humanoid robots that autonomously interact with physical environments over extended horizons represent a central goal of embodied intelligence. Existing approaches rely on reference motions or task-specific rewards, tightly coupling policies to particular object geometries and precluding multi-skill generalization within a single framework. A unified interaction representation enabling reference-free inference, geometric generalization, and long-horizon skill composition within one policy remains an open challenge. Here we show that Distance Field (DF) provides such a representation: LessMimic conditions a single whole-body policy on DF-derived geometric cues--surface distances, gradients, and velocity decompositions--removing the need for motion references, with interaction latents encoded via a Variational Auto-Encoder (VAE) and post-trained using Adversarial Interaction Priors (AIP) under Reinforcement Learning (RL). Through DAgger-style distillation that aligns DF latents with egocentric depth features, LessMimic further transfers seamlessly to vision-only deployment without motion capture (MoCap) infrastructure. A single LessMimic policy achieves 80--100% success across object scales from 0.4x to 1.6x on PickUp and SitStand where baselines degrade sharply, attains 62.1% success on 5 task instances trajectories, and remains viable up to 40 sequentially composed tasks. By grounding interaction in local geometry rather than demonstrations, LessMimic offers a scalable path toward humanoid robots that generalize, compose skills, and recover from failures in unstructured environments.
