We further leverage incremental constraint solvers to support goal and constraint updates. Empirically, compared to baselines, our system produces a comparable number of invariants, detects up to 2 times more infeasibilities, performs competitively in one-shot planning, and outperforms in sequential plan updates in the tested domains.
summary_zh: 计划经常会因为情况的变化或我们对情况理解的改变而发生变化。有时，甚至可能不存在可行的计划，而识别这种不可行性有助于确定何时需要调整需求。常见的规划方法侧重于可行情况下的高效一次性规划，而不是更新领域或检测不可行性。我们提出了一种Petri网可达性松弛方法，以实现稳健的不变式综合、高效的目标不可达性检测以及有用的不可行性解释。我们进一步利用增量约束求解器来支持目标和约束的更新。经验结果表明，与基线相比，我们的系统能够产生相当数量的不变式，检测到高达2倍的不可行性，在一次性规划中表现出竞争力，并在测试领域中的序列化计划更新方面表现更优异。
tldr: This paper introduces a Petri net relaxation approach for detecting infeasibility in planning problems, generating explanations, and updating plans incrementally. It shows improved infeasibility detection and plan update performance compared to baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种Petri网松弛方法，用于检测规划问题中的不可行性，生成解释，并增量更新计划。与基线相比，该方法在不可行性检测和计划更新性能方面有所改进。

title: Survey on Neural Routing Solvers
summary: Neural routing solvers (NRSs) that leverage deep learning to tackle vehicle routing problems have demonstrated notable potential for practical applications. By learning implicit heuristic rules from data, NRSs replace the handcrafted counterparts in classic heuristic frameworks, thereby reducing reliance on costly manual design and trial-and-error adjustments. This survey makes two main contributions: (1) The heuristic nature of NRSs is highlighted, and existing NRSs are reviewed from the perspective of heuristics. A hierarchical taxonomy based on heuristic principles is further introduced. (2) A generalization-focused evaluation pipeline is proposed to address limitations of the conventional pipeline. Comparative benchmarking of representative NRSs across both pipelines uncovers a series of previously unreported gaps in current research.
summary_zh: 利用深度学习解决车辆路径问题的神经路由求解器（NRS）已展现出在实际应用中的显著潜力。通过从数据中学习隐式的启发式规则，NRS替代了经典启发式框架中的手工设计部分，从而减少了对昂贵的手动设计和试错调整的依赖。本综述做出以下两项主要贡献：（1）强调了NRS的启发式本质，并从启发式的角度回顾了现有的NRS。进一步引入了一个基于启发式原则的层级分类法。（2）提出了一个以泛化性为中心的评估流程，以解决传统流程的局限性。通过对具有代表性的NRS在两个流程中进行对比基准测试，揭示了当前研究中一系列先前未报告的差距。
tldr: This survey paper reviews neural routing solvers (NRSs) for vehicle routing problems, framing them as learned heuristics and proposing a new generalization-focused evaluation pipeline that reveals gaps in current research.
tldr_zh: 该综述论文回顾了用于车辆路径问题的神经路由求解器（NRS），将其视为学习的启发式方法，并提出了一种新的以泛化为中心的评估流程，揭示了当前研究中的差距。

title: On the Structural Non-Preservation of Epistemic Behaviour under Policy Transformation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) agents under partial observability often condition actions on internally accumulated information such as memory or inferred latent context. We formalise such information-conditioned interaction patterns as behavioural dependency: variation in action selection with respect to internal information under fixed observations. This induces a probe-relative notion of $ε$-behavioural equivalence and a within-policy behavioural distance that quantifies probe sensitivity. We establish three structural results. First, the set of policies exhibiting non-trivial behavioural dependency is not closed under convex aggregation. Second, behavioural distance contracts under convex combination. Third, we prove a sufficient local condition under which gradient ascent on a skewed mixture objective decreases behavioural distance when a dominant-mode gradient aligns with the direction of steepest contraction. Minimal bandit and partially observable gridworld experiments provide controlled witnesses of these mechanisms. In the examined settings, behavioural distance decreases under convex aggregation and under continued optimisation with skewed latent priors, and in these experiments it precedes degradation under latent prior shift. These results identify structural conditions under which probe-conditioned behavioural separation is not preserved under common policy transformations.
summary_zh: 在部分可观察性下，强化学习（RL）智能体常常基于内部积累的信息（如记忆或推断的潜在上下文）来决定动作。我们将这种信息条件化的交互模式形式化为行为依赖性：即在固定观测条件下，动作选择随内部信息的变化。由此引出了探针相关的 $ε$-行为等价性概念以及量化探针敏感性的策略内行为距离。我们建立了三个结构性结果。首先，展现出非平凡行为依赖性的策略集合在凸聚合下不闭合。其次，行为距离在凸组合下收缩。第三，我们证明了一个充分的局部条件，在此条件下，当一个主导模态的梯度与最速收缩方向对齐时，倾斜混合目标上的梯度上升会减小行为距离。最简的bandit和部分可观察的网格世界实验为这些机制提供了受控的证明。在所考察的设置中，行为距离在凸聚合下和在持续的倾斜潜在先验优化下均减小，并且在这些实验中，它先于潜在先验移位下的性能退化。这些结果识别了在常见策略变换下探针条件化的行为分离不被保留的结构性条件。
tldr: This paper studies how internal information (memory/latent context) in RL agents under partial observability affects action selection and shows that behavioral dependency is not preserved under common policy transformations like convex aggregation and certain optimization schemes.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了部分可观察RL智能体中内部信息（记忆/潜在环境）如何影响动作选择，并表明行为依赖性在常见的策略转换（如凸聚合和某些优化方案）下不会被保留。

title: AdaSpot: Spend Resolution Where It Matters for Precise Event Spotting
summary: Precise Event Spotting aims to localize fast-paced actions or events in videos with high temporal precision, a key task for applications in sports analytics, robotics, and autonomous systems. Existing methods typically process all frames uniformly, overlooking the inherent spatio-temporal redundancy in video data. This leads to redundant computation on non-informative regions while limiting overall efficiency. To remain tractable, they often spatially downsample inputs, losing fine-grained details crucial for precise localization. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{AdaSpot}, a simple yet effective framework that processes low-resolution videos to extract global task-relevant features while adaptively selecting the most informative region-of-interest in each frame for high-resolution processing. The selection is performed via an unsupervised, task-aware strategy that maintains spatio-temporal consistency across frames and avoids the training instability of learnable alternatives. This design preserves essential fine-grained visual cues with a marginal computational overhead compared to low-resolution-only baselines, while remaining far more efficient than uniform high-resolution processing. Experiments on standard PES benchmarks demonstrate that \textbf{AdaSpot} achieves state-of-the-art performance under strict evaluation metrics (\eg, $+3.96$ and $+2.26$ mAP$@0$ frames on Tennis and FineDiving), while also maintaining strong results under looser metrics. Code is available at: \href{https://github.com/arturxe2/AdaSpot}{https://github.com/arturxe2/AdaSpot}.
summary_zh:
摘要：
精确事件定位旨在以高时间精度定位视频中快速发生的动作或事件，这是运动分析、机器人技术和自主系统应用中的一项关键任务。现有方法通常一致地处理所有帧，忽略了视频数据中固有的时空冗余。这导致在非信息区域上进行冗余计算，同时限制了整体效率。为了保持易处理性，它们通常在空间上对输入进行降采样，从而丢失了对精确局部化至关重要的细粒度细节。为解决这些限制，我们提出了\textbf{AdaSpot}，一个简单而有效的框架，它处理低分辨率视频以提取全局任务相关特征，同时自适应地选择每帧中最富信息的感兴趣区域进行高分辨率处理。该选择通过一种无监督的、任务感知的策略执行，该策略保持帧之间的时空一致性，并避免了可学习替代方案的训练不稳定。与仅使用低分辨率的基线相比，这种设计以边际计算开销保留了必要的细粒度视觉线索，同时比一致的高分辨率处理效率更高。在标准PES基准测试上的实验表明，\textbf{AdaSpot}在严格的评估指标下实现了最先进的性能（例如，在Tennis和FineDiving上分别提高了$+3.96$和$+2.26$ mAP$@0$帧），同时在更宽松的指标下也保持了强大的结果。代码可从以下网址获得：\href{https://github.com/arturxe2/AdaSpot}{https://github.com/arturxe2/AdaSpot}。
tldr: AdaSpot adaptively selects high-resolution regions of interest in videos for precise event spotting, improving efficiency and accuracy compared to uniform processing methods.
tldr_zh: AdaSpot自适应地选择视频中的高分辨率感兴趣区域，用于精确的事件识别，与统一处理方法相比，提高了效率和准确性。

title: AutoSew: A Geometric Approach to Stitching Prediction with Graph Neural Networks
summary: Automating garment assembly from sewing patterns remains a significant challenge due to the lack of standardized annotation protocols and the frequent absence of semantic cues. Existing methods often rely on panel labels or handcrafted heuristics, which limit their applicability to real-world, non-conforming patterns. We present AutoSew, a fully automatic, geometry-based approach for predicting stitch correspondences directly from 2D pattern contours. AutoSew formulates the problem as a graph matching task, leveraging a Graph Neural Network to capture local and global geometric context, and employing a differentiable optimal transport solver to infer stitching relationships-including multi-edge connections. To support this task, we update the GarmentCodeData dataset modifying over 18k patterns with realistic multi-edge annotations, reflecting industrial assembly scenarios. AutoSew achieves 96% F1-score and successfully assembles 73.3% of test garments without error, outperforming existing methods while relying solely on geometric input. Our results demonstrate that geometry alone can robustly guide stitching prediction, enabling scalable garment assembly without manual input.
summary_zh: 由于缺乏标准化的标注协议和语义线索的频繁缺失，从缝纫样片自动进行服装组装仍然是一个重大挑战。现有方法通常依赖于裁片标签或手工设计的启发式方法，这限制了它们在真实、不规范样片上的适用性。我们提出了AutoSew，这是一种完全自动的、基于几何的方法，用于直接从二维样片轮廓预测缝合对应关系。AutoSew将该问题形式化为一个图匹配任务，利用图神经网络来捕捉局部和全局几何上下文，并采用可微分的最优传输求解器来推断缝合关系——包括多边连接。为了支持这项任务，我们更新了GarmentCodeData数据集，使用反映工业组装场景的真实多边标注修改了超过1.8万个样片。AutoSew实现了96%的F1分数，并成功组装了73.3%的测试服装而没有错误，在仅依赖几何输入的情况下优于现有方法。我们的结果表明，仅凭几何形状可以稳健地指导缝合预测，从而在无需人工输入的情况下实现可扩展的服装组装。
tldr: AutoSew uses a Graph Neural Network and geometric information to predict stitch correspondences in garment patterns, updating a dataset with multi-edge annotations and achieving state-of-the-art performance in automated garment assembly.
tldr_zh: AutoSew 使用图神经网络和几何信息来预测服装图案中的缝合对应关系，并通过多边注释更新数据集，在自动服装组装中实现了最先进的性能。

title: Global-Aware Edge Prioritization for Pose Graph Initialization
summary: The pose graph is a core component of Structure-from-Motion (SfM), where images act as nodes and edges encode relative poses. Since geometric verification is expensive, SfM pipelines restrict the pose graph to a sparse set of candidate edges, making initialization critical. Existing methods rely on image retrieval to connect each image to its $k$ nearest neighbors, treating pairs independently and ignoring global consistency. We address this limitation through the concept of edge prioritization, ranking candidate edges by their utility for SfM. Our approach has three components: (1) a GNN trained with SfM-derived supervision to predict globally consistent edge reliability; (2) multi-minimal-spanning-tree-based pose graph construction guided by these ranks; and (3) connectivity-aware score modulation that reinforces weak regions and reduces graph diameter. This globally informed initialization yields more reliable and compact pose graphs, improving reconstruction accuracy in sparse and high-speed settings and outperforming SOTA retrieval methods on ambiguous scenes. The ode and trained models are available at https://github.com/weitong8591/global_edge_prior.
summary_zh: 姿态图是运动恢复结构(SfM)的核心组成部分，其中图像作为节点，边编码相对姿态。由于几何验证开销巨大，SfM流程通常将姿态图限制为稀疏的候选边集合，使得初始化变得至关重要。现有方法依赖图像检索将每个图像与其$k$个最近邻连接，独立处理图像对且忽略全局一致性。我们通过边优先级排序的概念来解决这一局限性，根据其对SfM的效用对候选边进行排序。我们的方法包含三个组成部分：(1)一个使用SfM导出的监督信息训练的GNN，用于预测全局一致的边可靠性；(2)基于多最小生成树的姿态图构建，由这些排序引导；以及(3)连通性感知的分数调制，增强弱连接区域并减小图直径。这种全局感知的初始化产生更可靠和紧凑的姿态图，提高了在稀疏和高速场景中的重建精度，并在模糊场景中胜过SOTA检索方法。代码和训练好的模型可在https://github.com/weitong8591/global_edge_prior获得。
tldr: This paper introduces a global-aware edge prioritization method using a GNN to improve pose graph initialization for Structure-from-Motion, leading to more accurate and robust reconstructions, especially in challenging scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种使用 GNN 的全局感知边缘优先级排序方法，以改进 Structure-from-Motion 的姿态图初始化，从而在具有挑战性的场景中实现更准确和鲁棒的重建。

title: LiREC-Net: A Target-Free and Learning-Based Network for LiDAR, RGB, and Event Calibration
summary: Advanced autonomous systems rely on multi-sensor fusion for safer and more robust perception. To enable effective fusion, calibrating directly from natural driving scenes (i.e., target-free) with high accuracy is crucial for precise multi-sensor alignment. Existing learning-based calibration methods are typically designed for only a single pair of sensor modalities (i.e., a bi-modal setup). Unlike these methods, we propose LiREC-Net, a target-free, learning-based calibration network that jointly calibrates multiple sensor modality pairs, including LiDAR, RGB, and event data, within a unified framework. To reduce redundant computation and improve efficiency, we introduce a shared LiDAR representation that leverages features from both its 3D nature and projected depth map, ensuring better consistency across modalities. Trained and evaluated on established datasets, such as KITTI and DSEC, our LiREC-Net achieves competitive performance to bi-modal models and sets a new strong baseline for the tri-modal use case.
summary_zh: 先进的自主系统依赖于多传感器融合以实现更安全、更鲁棒的感知。为了实现有效的融合，以高精度直接从自然驾驶场景（即，无需标靶）进行标定对于精确的多传感器对齐至关重要。现有的基于学习的标定方法通常只针对单一的传感器模态对（即，双模态设置）。与这些方法不同，我们提出了 LiREC-Net，一个无需标靶、基于学习的标定网络，能够在统一的框架内联合标定多种传感器模态对，包括激光雷达、RGB和事件数据。为了减少冗余计算并提高效率，我们引入了一种共享的激光雷达表示，该表示利用了其3D本质和投影深度图的特征，从而确保了跨模态的更好一致性。在经过既定的数据集（如KITTI和DSEC）的训练和评估后，我们的LiREC-Net获得了与双模态模型相当的性能，并为三模态使用场景建立了一个新的强大基线。
tldr: The paper introduces LiREC-Net, a novel target-free, learning-based network for jointly calibrating LiDAR, RGB, and event data, achieving competitive performance on established datasets and setting a new baseline for tri-modal calibration.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LiREC-Net，一种新的无需目标、基于学习的网络，用于联合校准激光雷达、RGB和事件数据，在已建立的数据集上实现了有竞争力的性能，并为三模态校准设定了新的基准。

title: SEF-MAP: Subspace-Decomposed Expert Fusion for Robust Multimodal HD Map Prediction
summary: High-definition (HD) maps are essential for autonomous driving, yet multi-modal fusion often suffers from inconsistency between camera and LiDAR modalities, leading to performance degradation under low-light conditions, occlusions, or sparse point clouds. To address this, we propose SEFMAP, a Subspace-Expert Fusion framework for robust multimodal HD map prediction. The key idea is to explicitly disentangle BEV features into four semantic subspaces: LiDAR-private, Image-private, Shared, and Interaction. Each subspace is assigned a dedicated expert, thereby preserving modality-specific cues while capturing cross-modal consensus. To adaptively combine expert outputs, we introduce an uncertainty-aware gating mechanism at the BEV-cell level, where unreliable experts are down-weighted based on predictive variance, complemented by a usage balance regularizer to prevent expert collapse. To enhance robustness in degraded conditions and promote role specialization, we further propose distribution-aware masking: during training, modality-drop scenarios are simulated using EMA-statistical surrogate features, and a specialization loss enforces distinct behaviors of private, shared, and interaction experts across complete and masked inputs. Experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse2 benchmarks demonstrate that SEFMAP achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing prior methods by +4.2% and +4.8% in mAP, respectively. SEF-MAPprovides a robust and effective solution for multi-modal HD map prediction under diverse and degraded conditions.
summary_zh: 高清(HD)地图对于自动驾驶至关重要，然而，多模态融合常常面临摄像头和激光雷达模态不一致的问题，导致在低光照条件、遮挡或稀疏点云下性能下降。为了解决这个问题，我们提出SEFMAP，一个用于稳健的多模态高清地图预测的子空间-专家融合框架。其核心思想是将BEV特征显式地解耦为四个语义子空间：激光雷达私有、图像私有、共享和交互。每个子空间都被分配一个专门的专家，从而在捕获跨模态共识的同时，保留模态特定的线索。为了自适应地组合专家输出，我们引入了一种BEV-cell级别的、感知不确定性的门控机制，其中不可靠的专家根据预测方差被降低权重，同时辅以使用平衡正则化器以防止专家崩溃。为了增强在退化条件下的鲁棒性并促进角色专业化，我们进一步提出分布感知掩码：在训练期间，使用EMA统计替代特征模拟模态丢弃场景，并且一个专业化损失强制私有、共享和交互专家在完整和掩码输入上表现出不同的行为。在nuScenes和Argoverse2基准测试上的实验表明，SEFMAP实现了最先进的性能，分别以+4.2%和+4.8%的mAP超越了先前的方法。SEFMAP为在多样和退化条件下进行多模态高清地图预测提供了一种稳健而有效的解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces SEF-MAP, a subspace-expert fusion framework for robust multimodal HD map prediction, showing state-of-the-art performance by explicitly disentangling BEV features and using an uncertainty-aware gating mechanism.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SEF-MAP，一种用于鲁棒的多模态高清地图预测的子空间专家融合框架。它通过显式地分解BEV特征并使用不确定性感知门控机制，实现了最先进的性能。

title: Automatic Map Density Selection for Locally-Performant Visual Place Recognition
summary: A key challenge in translating Visual Place Recognition (VPR) from the lab to long-term deployment is ensuring a priori that a system can meet user-specified performance requirements across different parts of an environment, rather than just on average globally. A critical mechanism for controlling local VPR performance is the density of the reference mapping database, yet this factor is largely neglected in existing work, where benchmark datasets with fixed, engineering-driven (sensors, storage, GPS frequency) sampling densities are typically used. In this paper, we propose a dynamic VPR mapping approach that uses pairs of reference traverses from the target environment to automatically select an appropriate map density to satisfy two user-defined requirements: (1) a target Local Recall@1 level, and (2) the proportion of the operational environment over which this requirement must be met or exceeded, which we term the Recall Achievement Rate (RAR). Our approach is based on the hypothesis that match patterns between multiple reference traverses, evaluated across different map densities, can be modelled to predict the density required to meet these performance targets on unseen deployment data. Through extensive experiments across multiple VPR methods and the Nordland and Oxford RobotCar benchmarks, we show that our system consistently achieves or exceeds the specified local recall level over at least the user-specified proportion of the environment. Comparisons with alternative baselines demonstrate that our approach reliably selects the correct operating point in map density, avoiding unnecessary over-densification. Finally, ablation studies and analysis evaluate sensitivity to reference map choice and local space definitions, and reveal that conventional global Recall@1 is a poor predictor of the often more operationally meaningful RAR metric.
summary_zh: 将视觉定位识别 (VPR) 从实验室转化为长期部署的关键挑战在于，确保系统能够先验地满足用户在环境不同部分指定的性能要求，而不仅仅是全局平均水平。控制局部 VPR 性能的一个关键机制是参考地图数据库的密度，然而，现有工作主要忽略了这一因素，通常使用具有固定、由工程驱动（传感器、存储、GPS 频率）的采样密度的基准数据集。在本文中，我们提出了一种动态 VPR 地图构建方法，该方法使用来自目标环境的参考轨迹对，自动选择合适的地图密度，以满足两个用户定义的要求：（1）目标局部召回率@1 水平，以及（2）必须满足或超过此要求的操作环境的比例，我们将其称为召回率达成率 (RAR)。我们的方法基于以下假设：在across不同地图密度评估的多个参考轨迹之间的匹配模式可以进行建模，以预测在未见过的部署数据上满足这些性能目标所需的密度。通过在多种 VPR 方法以及 Nordland 和 Oxford RobotCar 基准测试中进行的大量实验，我们表明我们的系统始终在至少用户指定比例的环境中达到或超过指定的局部召回率水平。与替代基线的比较表明，我们的方法可靠地选择了地图密度中的正确工作点，避免了不必要的过度密集化。最后，消融研究和分析评估了对参考地图选择和局部空间定义的敏感性，并揭示了传统的全局召回率@1 是操作上更有意义的 RAR 指标的较差预测指标。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for automatically selecting the optimal map density in Visual Place Recognition (VPR) to meet user-defined local performance requirements, specifically local recall and recall achievement rate, demonstrated on standard datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自动选择视觉定位识别（VPR）中最佳地图密度的方法，以满足用户定义的本地性能要求，特别是本地召回率和召回达成率，并在标准数据集上进行了演示。

title: Compact Circulant Layers with Spectral Priors
summary: Critical applications in areas such as medicine, robotics and autonomous systems require compact (i.e., memory efficient), uncertainty-aware neural networks suitable for edge and other resource-constrained deployments. We study compact spectral circulant and block-circulant-with-circulant-blocks (BCCB) layers: FFT-diagonalizable circular convolutions whose weights live directly in the real FFT (RFFT) half (1D) or half-plane (2D). Parameterizing filters in the frequency domain lets us impose simple spectral structure, perform structured variational inference in a low-dimensional weight space, and calculate exact layer spectral norms, enabling inexpensive global Lipschitz bounds and margin-based robustness diagnostics. By placing independent complex Gaussians on the Hermitian support we obtain a discrete instance of the spectral representation of stationary kernels, inducing an exact stationary Gaussian-process prior over filters on the discrete circle/torus. We exploit this to define a practical spectral prior and a Hermitian-aware low-rank-plus-diagonal variational posterior in real coordinates. Empirically, spectral circulant/BCCB layers are effective compact building blocks in both (variational) Bayesian and point estimate regimes: compact Bayesian neural networks on MNIST->Fashion-MNIST, variational heads on frozen CIFAR-10 features, and deterministic ViT projections on CIFAR-10/Tiny ImageNet; spectral layers match strong baselines while using substantially fewer parameters and with tighter Lipschitz certificates.
summary_zh: 医学、机器人和自动驾驶等领域的关键应用需要紧凑（即内存高效）、具有不确定性感知能力的神经网络，以适用于边缘计算和其他资源受限的部署。我们研究了紧凑的谱循环和块循环-循环块（BCCB）层：FFT可对角化的循环卷积，其权重直接存在于实FFT（RFFT）的半空间（1D）或半平面（2D）中。在频域中参数化滤波器使我们能够施加简单的谱结构，在低维权重空间中执行结构化变分推断，并计算精确的层谱范数，从而实现低成本的全局Lipschitz边界和基于裕度的鲁棒性诊断。通过在Hermitian支持上放置独立的复高斯分布，我们获得了平稳核的谱表示的离散实例，从而在离散圆/环面上对滤波器引入了精确的平稳高斯过程先验。我们利用这一点来定义一个实用的谱先验和一个在实坐标中具有Hermitian感知的低秩加对角变分后验。在实验中，谱循环/BCCB层是在（变分）贝叶斯和点估计机制中都有效的紧凑构建块：MNIST到Fashion-MNIST上的紧凑贝叶斯神经网络、在冻结的CIFAR-10特征上的变分头，以及CIFAR-10/Tiny ImageNet上的确定性ViT投影；谱层在使用明显更少的参数和更严格的Lipschitz证书的同时，匹配了强大的基线。
tldr: This paper introduces compact spectral circulant and block-circulant layers, leveraging FFT diagonalization and spectral priors for efficient and uncertainty-aware neural networks, demonstrating competitive performance on image classification tasks with fewer parameters and tighter Lipschitz bounds.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了紧凑型谱循环和块循环层，利用 FFT 对角化和谱先验来实现高效且具有不确定性感知的神经网络，并在图像分类任务上展示了具有竞争力的性能，同时使用的参数更少， Lipschitz 边界更严格。

title: Deep Accurate Solver for the Geodesic Problem
summary: A common approach to compute distances on continuous surfaces is by considering a discretized polygonal mesh approximating the surface and estimating distances on the polygon. We show that exact geodesic distances restricted to the polygon are at most second-order accurate with respect to the distances on the corresponding continuous surface. By order of accuracy we refer to the convergence rate as a function of the average distance between sampled points. Next, a higher-order accurate deep learning method for computing geodesic distances on surfaces is introduced. Traditionally, one considers two main components when computing distances on surfaces: a numerical solver that locally approximates the distance function, and an efficient causal ordering scheme by which surface points are updated. Classical minimal path methods often exploit a dynamic programming principle with quasi-linear computational complexity in the number of sampled points. The quality of the distance approximation is determined by the local solver that is revisited in this paper. To improve state of the art accuracy, we consider a neural network-based local solver which implicitly approximates the structure of the continuous surface. We supply numerical evidence that the proposed learned update scheme provides better accuracy compared to the best possible polyhedral approximations and previous learning-based methods. The result is a third-order accurate solver with a bootstrapping-recipe for further improvement.
summary_zh: 计算连续曲面上距离的常用方法是考虑一个逼近曲面的离散多边形网格，并在多边形上估计距离。我们证明了限制在多边形上的精确测地距离，相对于相应连续曲面上的距离，其精度至多是二阶的。这里所说的精度阶数是指收敛速度与采样点之间平均距离的函数关系。接下来，介绍了一种用于计算曲面上测地距离的高阶精度深度学习方法。传统上，计算曲面上距离时主要考虑两个组成部分：一种局部逼近距离函数的数值求解器，以及一种高效的因果排序方案，通过该方案更新曲面上的点。经典的极小路径方法通常利用动态规划原理，其计算复杂度与采样点的数量呈准线性关系。距离逼近的质量取决于本文重新审视的局部求解器。为了提高现有技术的精度，我们考虑一种基于神经网络的局部求解器，该求解器隐式地逼近了连续曲面的结构。我们提供了数值证据，表明所提出的学习更新方案相比于最佳的可能多面体逼近和之前的基于学习的方法，能够提供更好的精度。最终的结果是一个三阶精度的求解器，并提供了一个用于进一步改进的自举范式。
tldr: This paper introduces a deep learning method for computing geodesic distances on surfaces with third-order accuracy, claiming improvements over existing methods and polyhedral approximations.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于深度学习的曲面测地线距离计算方法，其精度达到三阶，并声称优于现有方法和多面体逼近。

title: Mamba Meets Scheduling: Learning to Solve Flexible Job Shop Scheduling with Efficient Sequence Modeling
summary: The Flexible Job Shop Problem (FJSP) is a well-studied combinatorial optimization problem with extensive applications for manufacturing and production scheduling. It involves assigning jobs to various machines to optimize criteria, such as minimizing total completion time. Current learning-based methods in this domain often rely on localized feature extraction models, limiting their capacity to capture overarching dependencies spanning operations and machines. This paper introduces an innovative architecture that harnesses Mamba, a state-space model with linear computational complexity, to facilitate comprehensive sequence modeling tailored for FJSP. In contrast to prevalent graph-attention-based frameworks that are computationally intensive for FJSP, we show our model is more efficient. Specifically, the proposed model possesses an encoder and a decoder. The encoder incorporates a dual Mamba block to extract operation and machine features separately. Additionally, we introduce an efficient cross-attention decoder to learn interactive embeddings of operations and machines. Our experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves faster solving speed and surpasses the performance of state-of-the-art learning-based methods for FJSP across various benchmarks.
summary_zh: 柔性作业车间调度问题（FJSP）是一个经过深入研究的组合优化问题，在制造和生产调度中有着广泛的应用。它涉及将作业分配给不同的机器，以优化诸如最小化总完工时间等准则。目前该领域基于学习的方法通常依赖于局部特征提取模型，限制了它们捕获跨越工序和机器的全局依赖关系的能力。本文介绍了一种创新架构，利用具有线性计算复杂度的状态空间模型Mamba，以促进专为FJSP量身定制的全面序列建模。与主要采用的、计算密集型的基于图注意力的框架相比，我们证明了我们的模型更高效。具体来说，所提出的模型包含一个编码器和一个解码器。编码器集成了一个双Mamba块，以分别提取工序和机器的特征。此外，我们引入了一种高效的交叉注意力解码器来学习工序和机器的交互式嵌入。我们的实验结果表明，我们的方法在各种基准测试中实现了更快的求解速度，并且超越了最先进的基于学习的FJSP方法。
tldr: This paper proposes a novel Mamba-based sequence modeling architecture for the Flexible Job Shop Problem (FJSP), demonstrating improved efficiency and performance compared to existing graph-attention-based methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于 Mamba 的新型序列建模架构，用于解决柔性作业车间调度问题 (FJSP)，与现有的基于图注意力的方法相比，展示了更高的效率和性能。

title: The Swarm Intelligence Freeway-Urban Trajectories (SWIFTraj) Dataset - Part II: A Graph-Based Approach for Trajectory Connection
summary: In Part I of this companion paper series, we introduced SWIFTraj, a new open-source vehicle trajectory dataset collected using a unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm. The dataset has two distinctive features. First, by connecting trajectories across consecutive UAV videos, it provides long-distance continuous trajectories, with the longest exceeding 4.5 km. Second, it covers an integrated traffic network consisting of both freeways and their connected urban roads. Obtaining such long-distance continuous trajectories from a UAV swarm is challenging, due to the need for accurate time alignment across multiple videos and the irregular spatial distribution of UAVs. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel graph-based approach for connecting vehicle trajectories captured by a UAV swarm. An undirected graph is constructed to represent flexible UAV layouts, and an automatic time alignment method based on trajectory matching cost minimization is developed to estimate optimal time offsets across videos. To associate trajectories of the same vehicle observed in different videos, a vehicle matching table is established using the Hungarian algorithm. The proposed approach is evaluated using both simulated and real-world data. Results from real-world experiments show that the time alignment error is within three video frames, corresponding to approximately 0.1 s, and that the vehicle matching achieves an F1-score of about 0.99. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in addressing key challenges in UAV-based trajectory connection and highlight its potential for large-scale vehicle trajectory collection.
summary_zh: 作为配套论文系列的第一部分，我们介绍了SWIFTraj，这是一个使用无人机蜂群收集的新型开源车辆轨迹数据集。该数据集具有两个显著特征。首先，通过连接连续无人机视频中的轨迹，它提供了长程连续轨迹，最长超过4.5公里。其次，它覆盖了一个由高速公路及其相连的城市道路组成的综合交通网络。从无人机蜂群中获得如此长距离的连续轨迹极具挑战性，这源于需要准确地对齐多个视频的时间，以及无人机不规则的空间分布。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种基于图的新方法，用于连接无人机蜂群捕获的车辆轨迹。构建一个无向图来表示灵活的无人机布局，并开发了一种基于轨迹匹配成本最小化的自动时间对齐方法，以估计视频之间的最佳时间偏移。为了关联在不同视频中观察到的同一车辆的轨迹，使用匈牙利算法建立了一个车辆匹配表。所提出的方法使用模拟数据和真实世界数据进行了评估。真实世界实验结果表明，时间对齐误差在三个视频帧内，对应于大约0.1秒，并且车辆匹配实现了约0.99的F1分数。这些结果证明了所提出的方法在解决基于无人机的轨迹连接中的关键挑战方面的有效性，并突出了其在大规模车辆轨迹收集方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a graph-based method for connecting vehicle trajectories captured by a UAV swarm, addressing challenges in time alignment and vehicle matching. They introduce a dataset SWIFTraj that contains long driving traces in complex environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于图的方法，用于连接无人机群捕获的车辆轨迹，解决了时间对齐和车辆匹配方面的挑战。他们介绍了一个名为 SWIFTraj 的数据集，该数据集包含复杂环境中的长驾驶轨迹。

title: fEDM+: A Risk-Based Fuzzy Ethical Decision Making Framework with Principle-Level Explainability and Pluralistic Validation
summary: In a previous work, we introduced the fuzzy Ethical Decision-Making framework (fEDM), a risk-based ethical reasoning architecture grounded in fuzzy logic. The original model combined a fuzzy Ethical Risk Assessment module (fERA) with ethical decision rules, enabled formal structural verification through Fuzzy Petri Nets (FPNs), and validated outputs against a single normative referent. Although this approach ensured formal soundness and decision consistency, it did not fully address two critical challenges: principled explainability of decisions and robustness under ethical pluralism. In this paper, we extend fEDM in two major directions. First, we introduce an Explainability and Traceability Module (ETM) that explicitly links each ethical decision rule to the underlying moral principles and computes a weighted principle-contribution profile for every recommended action. This enables transparent, auditable explanations that expose not only what decision was made but why, and on the basis of which principles. Second, we replace single-referent validation with a pluralistic semantic validation framework that evaluates decisions against multiple stakeholder referents, each encoding distinct principle priorities and risk tolerances. This shift allows principled disagreement to be formally represented rather than suppressed, thus increasing robustness and contextual sensitivity. The resulting extended fEDM, called fEDM+, preserves formal verifiability while achieving enhanced interpretability and stakeholder-aware validation, making it suitable as an oversight and governance layer for ethically sensitive AI systems.
summary_zh: 在之前的工作中，我们提出了模糊伦理决策框架（fEDM），这是一种基于风险的伦理推理架构，以模糊逻辑为基础。原始模型将模糊伦理风险评估模块（fERA）与伦理决策规则相结合，通过模糊Petri网（FPNs）实现了形式化结构验证，并根据单一规范参照物验证输出。虽然这种方法确保了形式上的可靠性和决策一致性，但它未能充分解决两个关键挑战：有原则的决策可解释性和伦理多元主义下的稳健性。在本文中，我们从两个主要方向扩展了fEDM。首先，我们引入了一个可解释性和可追溯性模块（ETM），该模块明确地将每个伦理决策规则与底层道德原则联系起来，并为每个推荐的操作计算一个加权的原则贡献概况。这使得透明、可审计的解释不仅能揭示做出的是什么决策，还能揭示原因以及基于哪些原则。其次，我们用一个多元化的语义验证框架取代了单一参照物的验证，该框架根据多个利益相关者参照物评估决策，每个参照物都编码了不同的原则优先级和风险承受能力。这种转变允许有原则的分歧以正式方式表示，而不是被压制，从而提高了稳健性和情境敏感性。由此产生的扩展fEDM，称为fEDM+，在实现增强的可解释性和利益相关者意识验证的同时，保留了形式可验证性，使其适合作为伦理敏感人工智能系统的监督和治理层。
tldr: The paper introduces fEDM+, an extension of a fuzzy ethical decision-making framework, enhancing it with principle-level explainability and pluralistic validation for ethical AI systems.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了fEDM+，一个模糊伦理决策框架的扩展，通过增加原则层面的可解释性和多元验证，从而提升伦理人工智能系统的性能。

title: Exploring Human-Machine Coexistence in Symmetrical Reality
summary: In the context of the evolution of artificial intelligence (AI), the interaction between humans and AI entities has become increasingly salient, challenging the conventional human-centric paradigms of human-machine interaction. To address this challenge, it is imperative to reassess the relationship between AI entities and humans. Through considering both the virtual and physical worlds, we can construct a novel descriptive framework for a world where humans and machines coexist symbiotically. This paper will introduce a fresh research direction engendered for studying harmonious human-machine coexistence across physical and virtual worlds, which has been termed "symmetrical reality". We will elucidate its key characteristics, offering innovative research insight for renovating human-machine interaction paradigms.
summary_zh: 在人工智能（AI）演进的背景下，人类与AI实体之间的交互日益显著，挑战了传统以人为中心的人机交互范式。为了应对这一挑战，必须重新评估AI实体与人类之间的关系。通过同时考虑虚拟和物理世界，我们可以构建一种新型描述框架，用于一个人类和机器共生共存的世界。本文将介绍一个为研究物理和虚拟世界中和谐人机共存而生的新研究方向，并将其命名为“对称现实”。我们将阐明其关键特征，为革新人机交互范式提供创新性的研究见解。
tldr: The paper introduces the concept of "symmetrical reality" as a framework for studying harmonious human-machine coexistence in both physical and virtual worlds, aiming to renovate human-machine interaction paradigms.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了“对称现实”的概念，作为研究物理和虚拟世界中和谐人机共存的框架，旨在革新人机交互范式。

title: Structure-to-Image: Zero-Shot Depth Estimation in Colonoscopy via High-Fidelity Sim-to-Real Adaptation
summary: Monocular depth estimation (MDE) for colonoscopy is hampered by the domain gap between simulated and real-world images. Existing image-to-image translation methods, which use depth as a posterior constraint, often produce structural distortions and specular highlights by failing to balance realism with structure consistency. To address this, we propose a Structure-to-Image paradigm that transforms the depth map from a passive constraint into an active generative foundation. We are the first to introduce phase congruency to colonoscopic domain adaptation and design a cross-level structure constraint to co-optimize geometric structures and fine-grained details like vascular textures. In zero-shot evaluations conducted on a publicly available phantom dataset, the MDE model that was fine-tuned on our generated data achieved a maximum reduction of 44.18% in RMSE compared to competing methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/YyangJJuan/PC-S2I.git.
summary_zh: 结肠镜单目深度估计(MDE)受到模拟图像与真实世界图像之间域差异的阻碍。现有的图像到图像翻译方法，尽管采用深度作为后验约束，但往往因未能平衡真实感与结构一致性而产生结构扭曲和镜面高光。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种结构到图像的范式，将深度图从被动约束转变为主动生成基础。我们率先将相位一致性引入结肠镜域自适应，并设计了一种跨层结构约束，以协同优化几何结构和诸如血管纹理之类的细粒度细节。在公开的体模数据集上进行的零样本评估中，使用我们生成的数据进行微调的MDE模型，与同类方法相比，RMSE最多降低了44.18%。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/YyangJJuan/PC-S2I.git 获取。
tldr: This paper proposes a novel Structure-to-Image approach for zero-shot depth estimation in colonoscopy, using phase congruency and cross-level structure constraints to improve sim-to-real adaptation and achieve significant RMSE reduction on a phantom dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新颖的Structure-to-Image方法，用于结肠镜检查中的零样本深度估计，利用相位一致性和跨层结构约束来改善sim-to-real适应性，并在幻影数据集上实现了显著的RMSE降低。

title: Error-awareness Accelerates Active Automata Learning
summary: Active automata learning (AAL) algorithms can learn a behavioral model of a system from interacting with it. The primary challenge remains scaling to larger models, in particular in the presence of many possible inputs to the system. Modern AAL algorithms fail to scale even if, in every state, most inputs lead to errors. In various challenging problems from the literature, these errors are observable, i.e., they emit a known error output. Motivated by these problems, we study learning these systems more efficiently. Further, we consider various degrees of knowledge about which inputs are non-error producing at which state. For each level of knowledge, we provide a matching adaptation of the state-of-the-art AAL algorithm L# to make the most of this domain knowledge. Our empirical evaluation demonstrates that the methods accelerate learning by orders of magnitude with strong but realistic domain knowledge to a single order of magnitude with limited domain knowledge.
summary_zh: 主动自动机学习(AAL)算法能够通过与系统交互学习系统的行为模型。主要的挑战依然是扩展到更大的模型，尤其是在系统存在许多可能的输入时。即使在每个状态下，大多数输入都会导致错误，现代AAL算法也无法扩展。在文献中出现的各种具有挑战性的问题中，这些错误是可观察的，即它们会产生一个已知的错误输出。受这些问题的启发，我们研究如何更有效地学习这些系统。此外，我们考虑了在哪个状态下哪些输入不会产生错误的不同程度的知识。对于每个知识级别，我们提供了对最先进的AAL算法L#的匹配式适配，以最大程度地利用这些领域知识。我们的实证评估表明，这些方法在具有强但现实的领域知识的情况下，可以将学习速度提高几个数量级，而在领域知识有限的情况下，也可以提高一个数量级。
tldr: The paper introduces adaptations to the L# active automata learning algorithm that leverage knowledge of error-producing inputs to accelerate learning, achieving orders of magnitude speedup in certain scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了对 L# 主动自动机学习算法的改进，利用关于产生错误的输入的信息来加速学习，在某些情况下实现了数量级的加速。

title: Dual-Regime Hybrid Aerodynamic Modeling of Winged Blimps With Neural Mixing
summary: Winged blimps operate across distinct aerodynamic regimes that cannot be adequately captured by a single model. At high speeds and small angles of attack, their dynamics exhibit strong coupling between lift and attitude, resembling fixed-wing aircraft behavior. At low speeds or large angles of attack, viscous effects and flow separation dominate, leading to drag-driven and damping-dominated dynamics. Accurately representing transitions between these regimes remains a fundamental challenge. This paper presents a hybrid aerodynamic modeling framework that integrates a fixed-wing Aerodynamic Coupling Model (ACM) and a Generalized Drag Model (GDM) using a learned neural network mixer with explicit physics-based regularization. The mixer enables smooth transitions between regimes while retaining explicit, physics-based aerodynamic representation. Model parameters are identified through a structured three-phase pipeline tailored for hybrid aerodynamic modeling. The proposed approach is validated on the RGBlimp platform through a large-scale experimental campaign comprising 1,320 real-world flight trajectories across 330 thruster and moving mass configurations, spanning a wide range of speeds and angles of attack. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed hybrid model consistently outperforms single-model and predefined-mixer baselines, establishing a practical and robust aerodynamic modeling solution for winged blimps.
summary_zh: 带翼飞艇在不同的空气动力学状态下运行，而单一模型无法充分捕捉这些状态。在高速和小攻角下，它们的动力学表现出升力和姿态之间的强耦合，类似于固定翼飞机的行为。在低速或大攻角下，粘性效应和流动分离占主导地位，导致由阻力驱动和阻尼主导的动力学特性。准确地表示这些状态之间的过渡仍然是一个根本性的挑战。本文提出了一种混合空气动力学建模框架，该框架集成了基于固定翼的空气动力学耦合模型 (ACM) 和广义阻力模型 (GDM)，并使用包含明确的基于物理的正则化的学习型神经网络混合器。该混合器能够在状态之间实现平滑过渡，同时保留明确的、基于物理的空气动力学表示。模型参数通过专门为混合空气动力学建模设计的结构化三阶段流水线进行识别。所提出的方法在 RGBlimp 平台上通过大规模实验活动进行验证，该活动包括跨越 330 种推进器和移动质量配置的 1320 条真实飞行轨迹，涵盖了广泛的速度和攻角范围。实验结果表明，所提出的混合模型始终优于单模型和预定义混合器基线，从而为带翼飞艇建立了一种实用且稳健的空气动力学建模解决方案。
tldr: This paper introduces a hybrid aerodynamic model for winged blimps that combines fixed-wing and drag models using a neural network mixer with physics-based regularization, demonstrating improved performance compared to single models. It validated with extensive experiments on a real-world blimp platform.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于带翼飞艇的混合气动模型，该模型结合了固定翼和阻力模型，使用具有基于物理的正则化的神经网络混合器，与单一模型相比，性能有所提高。 通过在真实世界的飞艇平台上进行的大量实验验证了这一点。

title: Automating Timed Up and Go Phase Segmentation and Gait Analysis via the tugturn Markerless 3D Pipeline
summary: Instrumented Timed Up and Go (TUG) analysis can support clinical and research decision-making, but robust and reproducible markerless pipelines are still limited. We present \textit{tugturn.py}, a Python-based workflow for 3D markerless TUG processing that combines phase segmentation, gait-event detection, spatiotemporal metrics, intersegmental coordination, and dynamic stability analysis. The pipeline uses spatial thresholds to segment each trial into stand, first gait, turning, second gait, and sit phases, and applies a relative-distance strategy to detect heel-strike and toe-off events within valid gait windows. In addition to conventional kinematics, \textit{tugturn} provides Vector Coding outputs and Extrapolated Center of Mass (XCoM)-based metrics. The software is configured through TOML files and produces reproducible artifacts, including HTML reports, CSV tables, and quality-assurance visual outputs. A complete runnable example is provided with test data and command-line instructions. This manuscript describes the implementation, outputs, and reproducibility workflow of \textit{tugturn} as a focused software contribution for markerless biomechanical TUG analysis.
summary_zh: 仪器化计时起立行走测试（TUG）分析可支持临床和研究决策，但稳健且可重复的无标记管线仍然有限。我们提出了\textit{tugturn.py}，一个基于Python的3D无标记TUG处理工作流程，它结合了阶段分割、步态事件检测、时空指标、节段间协调和动态稳定性分析。该管线使用空间阈值将每个试验分割为站立、第一次步态、转身、第二次步态和坐下阶段，并应用相对距离策略来检测有效步态窗口内的足跟着地和足尖离地事件。除了传统的运动学指标外，\textit{tugturn}还提供向量编码输出和基于外推质心（XCoM）的指标。该软件通过TOML文件进行配置，并生成可重复的产物，包括HTML报告、CSV表格和质量保证的可视化输出。提供了一个完整的可运行示例，包含测试数据和命令行说明。本手稿描述了\textit{tugturn}的实现、输出和可重复性工作流程，作为针对无标记生物力学TUG分析的重点软件贡献。
tldr: The paper introduces tugturn.py, a Python-based software for markerless 3D Timed Up and Go (TUG) analysis with phase segmentation, gait analysis, and kinematic metrics, designed for reproducible research.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为tugturn.py的Python软件，用于无标记3D起身-行走计时测试 (TUG) 分析，该软件具有阶段分割、步态分析和运动学指标，专为可重复性研究而设计。

title: Rethinking the Practicality of Vision-language-action Model: A Comprehensive Benchmark and An Improved Baseline
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a generalist robotic agent. However, existing VLAs are hindered by excessive parameter scales, prohibitive pre-training requirements, and limited applicability to diverse embodiments. To improve the practicality of VLAs, we propose a comprehensive benchmark and an improved baseline. First, we propose CEBench, a new benchmark spanning diverse embodiments in both simulation and the real world with consideration of domain randomization. We collect 14.4k simulated trajectories and 1.6k real-world expert-curated trajectories to support training on CEBench. Second, using CEBench as our testbed, we study three critical aspects of VLAs' practicality and offer several key findings. Informed by these findings, we introduce LLaVA-VLA, a lightweight yet powerful VLA designed for practical deployment on consumer-grade GPUs. Architecturally, it integrates a compact VLM backbone with multi-view perception, proprioceptive tokenization, and action chunking. To eliminate reliance on costly pre-training, LLaVA-VLA adopts a two-stage training paradigm including post-training and fine-tuning. Furthermore, LLaVA-VLA extends the action space to unify navigation and manipulation. Experiments across embodiments demonstrate the capabilities of generalization and versatility of LLaVA-VLA , while real-world mobile manipulation experiments establish it as the first end-to-end VLA model for mobile manipulation. We will open-source all datasets, codes, and checkpoints upon acceptance to foster reproducibility and future research.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型已成为一种通用的机器人智能体。然而，现有的 VLA 模型受限于过大的参数规模、高昂的预训练需求以及对多样化形态的有限适用性。为了提高 VLA 模型的实用性，我们提出了一个全面的基准测试和一个改进的基线模型。首先，我们提出了 CEBench，这是一个新的基准测试，涵盖了模拟和现实世界中各种形态，并考虑了领域随机化。我们收集了 1.44 万条模拟轨迹和 1.6 千条人工标注的真实世界轨迹，以支持 CEBench 上的训练。其次，以 CEBench 作为测试平台，我们研究了 VLA 模型实用性的三个关键方面，并提供了一些重要的发现。基于这些发现，我们推出了 LLaVA-VLA，这是一个轻量级但功能强大的 VLA 模型，旨在用于消费级 GPU 上的实际部署。在架构上，它集成了紧凑型 VLM 主干网络、多视角感知、本体感受标记化和动作分块。为了消除对昂贵预训练的依赖，LLaVA-VLA 采用了一种包含后训练和微调的两阶段训练范式。此外，LLaVA-VLA 扩展了动作空间，以统一导航和操作。跨形态的实验证明了 LLaVA-VLA 的泛化能力和多功能性，而真实世界的移动操作实验则将其确立为首个用于移动操作的端到端 VLA 模型。我们将在接收后开源所有数据集、代码和检查点，以促进可重复性和未来的研究。
tldr: This paper introduces CEBench, a benchmark for Vision-Language-Action models across various robots, and LLaVA-VLA, a lightweight VLA model, achieving mobile manipulation without costly pre-training.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍CEBench，一个针对各种机器人的视觉-语言-行动模型基准测试，以及LLaVA-VLA，一个轻量级的VLA模型，无需昂贵的预训练即可实现移动操作。

title: General Agent Evaluation
summary: The promise of general-purpose agents - systems that perform tasks in unfamiliar environments without domain-specific engineering - remains largely unrealized. Existing agents are predominantly specialized, and while emerging implementations like OpenAI SDK Agent and Claude Code hint at broader capabilities, no systematic evaluation of their general performance has been pursued. Current agentic benchmarks assume domain-specific integration, encoding task information in ways that preclude fair evaluation of general agents. This paper frames general-agent evaluation as a first-class research objective. We propose conceptual principles for such evaluation, a Unified Protocol enabling agent-benchmark integration, and Exgentic - a practical framework for general agent evaluation. We benchmark five prominent agent implementations across six environments as the first Open General Agent Leaderboard. Our experiments show that general agents generalize across diverse environments, achieving performance comparable to domain-specific agents without any environment-specific tuning. We release our evaluation protocol, framework, and leaderboard to establish a foundation for systematic research on general-purpose agents.
summary_zh: 通用智能体（即在未知的环境中执行任务而不需要特定领域工程设计的系统）的愿景在很大程度上尚未实现。现有的智能体主要为特定领域所优化，尽管像 OpenAI SDK Agent 和 Claude Code 这样的新兴实现暗示了更广泛的能力，但对其通用性能的系统性评估尚未开展。目前的智能体 benchmark 假设特定领域的集成，并以排除对通用智能体进行公平评估的方式对任务信息进行编码。本文将通用智能体评估视为首要的研究目标。我们提出了此类评估的概念性原则、实现智能体-benchmark 集成的统一协议，以及用于通用智能体评估的实用框架 Exgentic。我们对六个环境中的五个突出智能体实现进行了 benchmark 测试，并建立了首个开放式通用智能体排行榜。我们的实验表明，通用智能体可以跨越不同的环境进行泛化，在没有任何针对特定环境的调整的情况下，实现与特定领域智能体相当的性能。我们发布了我们的评估协议、框架和排行榜，以建立通用智能体系统性研究的基础。
tldr: This paper introduces a framework (Exgentic) and benchmark (Open General Agent Leaderboard) for evaluating general-purpose agents across diverse environments, demonstrating their performance comparable to specialized agents without domain-specific tuning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个框架 (Exgentic) 和一个基准 (Open General Agent Leaderboard)，用于评估通用代理在各种环境中的表现，并证明它们的性能与专门代理相当，且无需特定领域的调整。

title: OmniGAIA: Towards Native Omni-Modal AI Agents
summary: Human intelligence naturally intertwines omni-modal perception -- spanning vision, audio, and language -- with complex reasoning and tool usage to interact with the world. However, current multi-modal LLMs are primarily confined to bi-modal interactions (e.g., vision-language), lacking the unified cognitive capabilities required for general AI assistants. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniGAIA, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate omni-modal agents on tasks necessitating deep reasoning and multi-turn tool execution across video, audio, and image modalities. Constructed via a novel omni-modal event graph approach, OmniGAIA synthesizes complex, multi-hop queries derived from real-world data that require cross-modal reasoning and external tool integration. Furthermore, we propose OmniAtlas, a native omni-modal foundation agent under tool-integrated reasoning paradigm with active omni-modal perception. Trained on trajectories synthesized via a hindsight-guided tree exploration strategy and OmniDPO for fine-grained error correction, OmniAtlas effectively enhances the tool-use capabilities of existing open-source models. This work marks a step towards next-generation native omni-modal AI assistants for real-world scenarios.
summary_zh: 人类智能自然地将全模态感知——涵盖视觉、听觉和语言——与复杂的推理和工具使用相融合，从而与世界互动。然而，当前的多模态大型语言模型主要局限于双模态交互（例如，视觉-语言），缺乏通用人工智能助手所需的统一认知能力。为了弥补这一差距，我们推出了OmniGAIA，一个全面的基准测试，旨在评估全模态智能体在需要深度推理和跨视频、音频和图像模态的多轮工具执行任务上的表现。OmniGAIA通过一种新颖的全模态事件图方法构建，它合成了从真实世界数据中提取的复杂的多跳查询，这些查询需要跨模态推理和外部工具集成。此外，我们提出了OmniAtlas，一个原生全模态基础智能体，它采用工具集成推理范式和主动全模态感知。通过一种后见之明引导的树状探索策略合成的轨迹以及用于细粒度错误纠正的OmniDPO进行训练，OmniAtlas有效地增强了现有开源模型的工具使用能力。这项工作标志着朝着用于真实世界场景的下一代原生全模态人工智能助手迈出了一步。
tldr: The paper introduces OmniGAIA, a benchmark for evaluating omni-modal AI agents across vision, audio, and language, and OmniAtlas, an omni-modal agent trained with tool integration and error correction.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了OmniGAIA，一个用于评估跨视觉、音频和语言的通用模态AI代理的基准，以及OmniAtlas，一个经过工具集成和错误纠正训练的通用模态代理。

title: AgentVista: Evaluating Multimodal Agents in Ultra-Challenging Realistic Visual Scenarios
summary: Real-world multimodal agents solve multi-step workflows grounded in visual evidence. For example, an agent can troubleshoot a device by linking a wiring photo to a schematic and validating the fix with online documentation, or plan a trip by interpreting a transit map and checking schedules under routing constraints. However, existing multimodal benchmarks mainly evaluate single-turn visual reasoning or specific tool skills, and they do not fully capture the realism, visual subtlety, and long-horizon tool use that practical agents require. We introduce AgentVista, a benchmark for generalist multimodal agents that spans 25 sub-domains across 7 categories, pairing realistic and detail-rich visual scenarios with natural hybrid tool use. Tasks require long-horizon tool interactions across modalities, including web search, image search, page navigation, and code-based operations for both image processing and general programming. Comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art models exposes significant gaps in their ability to carry out long-horizon multimodal tool use. Even the best model in our evaluation, Gemini-3-Pro with tools, achieves only 27.3% overall accuracy, and hard instances can require more than 25 tool-calling turns. We expect AgentVista to accelerate the development of more capable and reliable multimodal agents for realistic and ultra-challenging problem solving.
summary_zh: 真实世界的多模态智能体需要在视觉证据的基础上解决多步骤的工作流程。例如，一个智能体可以通过将线路照片与原理示意图连接并使用在线文档验证修复方案来排除设备故障，或者通过解释交通地图并在路径约束下检查时刻表来规划行程。然而，现有的多模态基准测试主要评估单轮视觉推理或特定的工具技能，并且未能充分捕捉到实际智能体所需的真实性、视觉微妙之处和长程工具使用。我们推出了 AgentVista，这是一个针对通用多模态智能体的基准测试，涵盖了7个类别中的25个子领域，将真实且细节丰富的视觉场景与自然的混合工具使用相结合。任务需要跨模态的长程工具交互，包括网页搜索、图像搜索、页面导航以及用于图像处理和通用编程的基于代码的操作。对最先进模型的全面评估揭示了它们在执行长程多模态工具使用方面的显著差距。即使我们评估中最好的模型，带有工具的 Gemini-3-Pro，也仅能达到27.3%的总体准确率，并且困难的实例可能需要超过25轮的工具调用。我们期望 AgentVista 能够加速开发更强大、更可靠的多模态智能体，以解决现实且极具挑战性的问题。
tldr: The paper introduces AgentVista, a new benchmark for evaluating multimodal agents in realistic, visually rich scenarios requiring long-horizon tool use, and finds that current models struggle significantly on it.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AgentVista，这是一个新的基准，用于评估在现实、视觉丰富的场景中需要长期工具使用的多模态代理，并发现当前的模型在这方面表现不佳。

title: Simple Models, Real Swimming: Digital Twins for Tendon-Driven Underwater Robots
summary: Mimicking the graceful motion of swimming animals remains a core challenge in soft robotics due to the complexity of fluid-structure interaction and the difficulty of controlling soft, biomimetic bodies. Existing modeling approaches are often computationally expensive and impractical for complex control or reinforcement learning needed for realistic motions to emerge in robotic systems. In this work, we present a tendon-driven fish robot modeled in an efficient underwater swimmer environment using a simplified, stateless hydrodynamics formulation implemented in the widespread robotics framework MuJoCo. With just two real-world swimming trajectories, we identify five fluid parameters that allow a matching to experimental behavior and generalize across a range of actuation frequencies. We show that this stateless fluid model can generalize to unseen actuation and outperform classical analytical models such as the elongated body theory. This simulation environment runs faster than real-time and can easily enable downstream learning algorithms such as reinforcement learning for target tracking, reaching a 93% success rate. Due to the simplicity and ease of use of the model and our open-source simulation environment, our results show that even simple, stateless models -- when carefully matched to physical data -- can serve as effective digital twins for soft underwater robots, opening up new directions for scalable learning and control in aquatic environments.
summary_zh: 模仿游泳动物的优雅运动一直是软体机器人领域的核心挑战，这归因于流固耦合的复杂性以及控制柔软仿生躯体的难度。现有的建模方法通常计算成本高昂，并且不适用于复杂控制或强化学习，而这些对于在机器人系统中产生逼真运动至关重要。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个由肌腱驱动的鱼形机器人，该机器人在一个高效的水下游泳环境中使用简化的、无状态的水动力学公式建模，并在广泛使用的机器人框架MuJoCo中实现。仅使用两条真实世界的游泳轨迹，我们识别出五个流体参数，这些参数允许与实验行为相匹配，并在一定范围内的驱动频率上进行泛化。我们表明，这种无状态流体模型可以泛化到未见过的驱动，并且优于诸如细长体理论等经典分析模型。该仿真环境的运行速度快于实时，并且可以轻松地支持下游学习算法，例如用于目标跟踪的强化学习，达到93%的成功率。由于模型的简单性和易用性以及我们的开源仿真环境，我们的结果表明，即使是简单的、无状态的模型——当仔细匹配到物理数据时——也可以作为软体水下机器人的有效数字孪生体，为水生环境中可扩展的学习和控制开辟新的方向。
tldr: This paper presents a simplified, real-time capable MuJoCo simulation environment for tendon-driven underwater robots, demonstrating its effectiveness as a digital twin for reinforcement learning-based control and achieving high success rates in target tracking.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种简化的、实时的 MuJoCo 水下机器人仿真环境，证明了其作为基于强化学习控制的数字孪生的有效性，并在目标跟踪中取得了很高的成功率。

title: Risk-Aware World Model Predictive Control for Generalizable End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: With advances in imitation learning (IL) and large-scale driving datasets, end-to-end autonomous driving (E2E-AD) has made great progress recently. Currently, IL-based methods have become a mainstream paradigm: models rely on standard driving behaviors given by experts, and learn to minimize the discrepancy between their actions and expert actions. However, this objective of "only driving like the expert" suffers from limited generalization: when encountering rare or unseen long-tail scenarios outside the distribution of expert demonstrations, models tend to produce unsafe decisions in the absence of prior experience. This raises a fundamental question: Can an E2E-AD system make reliable decisions without any expert action supervision? Motivated by this, we propose a unified framework named Risk-aware World Model Predictive Control (RaWMPC) to address this generalization dilemma through robust control, without reliance on expert demonstrations. Practically, RaWMPC leverages a world model to predict the consequences of multiple candidate actions and selects low-risk actions through explicit risk evaluation. To endow the world model with the ability to predict the outcomes of risky driving behaviors, we design a risk-aware interaction strategy that systematically exposes the world model to hazardous behaviors, making catastrophic outcomes predictable and thus avoidable. Furthermore, to generate low-risk candidate actions at test time, we introduce a self-evaluation distillation method to distill riskavoidance capabilities from the well-trained world model into a generative action proposal network without any expert demonstration. Extensive experiments show that RaWMPC outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution scenarios, while providing superior decision interpretability.
summary_zh: 随着模仿学习(IL)和大规模驾驶数据集的进步，端到端自动驾驶(E2E-AD)近年来取得了显著进展。目前，基于模仿学习的方法已经成为主流范式：模型依赖于专家提供的标准驾驶行为，并学习最小化其动作与专家动作之间的差异。然而，这种“仅仅像专家一样驾驶”的目标存在泛化能力有限的问题：当遇到专家演示分布之外的罕见或未见过的长尾场景时，由于缺乏先验经验，模型往往会做出不安全的决策。这就引出了一个根本问题：端到端自动驾驶系统是否可以在没有任何专家动作监督的情况下做出可靠的决策？受此启发，我们提出了一个名为风险感知世界模型预测控制(RaWMPC)的统一框架，通过鲁棒控制来解决这种泛化困境，而无需依赖专家演示。实际上，RaWMPC利用世界模型来预测多个候选动作的后果，并通过显式的风险评估来选择低风险动作。为了赋予世界模型预测危险驾驶行为结果的能力，我们设计了一种风险感知的交互策略，该策略系统地将世界模型暴露于危险行为中，使灾难性结果可预测，从而可避免。此外，为了在测试时生成低风险的候选动作，我们引入了一种自评估蒸馏方法，将从训练良好的世界模型中学习到的风险规避能力提炼到一个生成式动作提议网络中，而无需任何专家演示。大量实验表明，RaWMPC在分布内和分布外场景中均优于当前最先进的方法，同时提供了卓越的决策可解释性。
tldr: This paper introduces Risk-aware World Model Predictive Control (RaWMPC) for end-to-end autonomous driving, which learns to avoid risks by predicting the consequences of actions using a world model trained with a risk-aware interaction strategy, and distilling risk-avoidance into a generative action proposal network without expert demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了风险感知的世界模型预测控制 (RaWMPC)，用于端到端自动驾驶。它通过使用世界模型预测行动的后果来学习避免风险，该世界模型通过风险感知的交互策略进行训练，并将风险避免能力提炼到生成式行动提议网络中，无需专家演示。

title: SPARR: Simulation-based Policies with Asymmetric Real-world Residuals for Assembly
summary: Robotic assembly presents a long-standing challenge due to its requirement for precise, contact-rich manipulation. While simulation-based learning has enabled the development of robust assembly policies, their performance often degrades when deployed in real-world settings due to the sim-to-real gap. Conversely, real-world reinforcement learning (RL) methods avoid the sim-to-real gap, but rely heavily on human supervision and lack generalization ability to environmental changes. In this work, we propose a hybrid approach that combines a simulation-trained base policy with a real-world residual policy to efficiently adapt to real-world variations. The base policy, trained in simulation using low-level state observations and dense rewards, provides strong priors for initial behavior. The residual policy, learned in the real world using visual observations and sparse rewards, compensates for discrepancies in dynamics and sensor noise. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that our method, SPARR, achieves near-perfect success rates across diverse two-part assembly tasks. Compared to the state-of-the-art zero-shot sim-to-real methods, SPARR improves success rates by 38.4% while reducing cycle time by 29.7%. Moreover, SPARR requires no human expertise, in contrast to the state-of-the-art real-world RL approaches that depend heavily on human supervision.
summary_zh:
摘要：
机器人装配因其对精确、富接触操控的需求而成为一个长期存在的挑战。虽然基于仿真的学习已经能够开发出鲁棒的装配策略，但由于仿真到现实的差距，它们的性能在部署到真实世界环境中时通常会下降。相反，真实世界的强化学习（RL）方法避免了仿真到现实的差距，但严重依赖于人工监督，且缺乏对环境变化的泛化能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种混合方法，将仿真训练的基础策略与真实世界的残差策略相结合，以高效地适应真实世界的变化。基础策略在仿真中使用底层状态观测和密集奖励进行训练，为初始行为提供了强大的先验知识。残差策略在真实世界中使用视觉观测和稀疏奖励进行学习，以补偿动力学和传感器噪声方面的差异。大量的真实世界实验表明，我们的方法SPARR在各种两部分装配任务中都实现了接近完美的成功率。与最先进的零样本仿真到现实方法相比，SPARR将成功率提高了38.4%，同时将周期时间缩短了29.7%。此外，与严重依赖人工监督的最先进的真实世界强化学习方法相比，SPARR不需要任何人工专业知识。
tldr: The paper presents SPARR, a hybrid approach combining simulation-trained policies with real-world residual policies for robotic assembly, achieving improved success rates and reduced cycle time compared to existing methods without human supervision.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了SPARR，一种混合方法，结合了仿真训练的策略和真实世界的残差策略，用于机器人组装，与现有方法相比，实现了更高的成功率和更短的周期时间，且无需人工监督。

title: UniScale: Unified Scale-Aware 3D Reconstruction for Multi-View Understanding via Prior Injection for Robotic Perception
summary: We present UniScale, a unified, scale-aware multi-view 3D reconstruction framework for robotic applications that flexibly integrates geometric priors through a modular, semantically informed design. In vision-based robotic navigation, the accurate extraction of environmental structure from raw image sequences is critical for downstream tasks. UniScale addresses this challenge with a single feed-forward network that jointly estimates camera intrinsics and extrinsics, scale-invariant depth and point maps, and the metric scale of a scene from multi-view images, while optionally incorporating auxiliary geometric priors when available. By combining global contextual reasoning with camera-aware feature representations, UniScale is able to recover the metric-scale of the scene. In robotic settings where camera intrinsics are known, they can be easily incorporated to improve performance, with additional gains obtained when camera poses are also available. This co-design enables robust, metric-aware 3D reconstruction within a single unified model. Importantly, UniScale does not require training from scratch, and leverages world priors exhibited in pre-existing models without geometric encoding strategies, making it particularly suitable for resource-constrained robotic teams. We evaluate UniScale on multiple benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalization and consistent performance across diverse environments. We will release our implementation upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 我们提出UniScale，一种统一的、尺度感知的多视图3D重建框架，用于机器人应用。该框架通过模块化、语义信息化的设计灵活地整合了几何先验。在基于视觉的机器人导航中，从原始图像序列中准确提取环境结构对于下游任务至关重要。UniScale通过单个前馈网络解决这一挑战，从多视图图像中联合估计相机内参和外参、尺度不变深度和点云图，以及场景的度量尺度，并在可用时选择性地结合辅助几何先验。通过将全局上下文推理与相机感知的特征表示相结合，UniScale能够恢复场景的度量尺度。在相机内参已知的机器人环境中，可以轻松地整合这些信息以提高性能，并且在相机位姿也可用时可以获得额外的增益。这种协同设计使得在单个统一模型中实现稳健的、度量感知的3D重建。重要的是，UniScale不需要从头开始训练，并且可以利用预训练模型中呈现的世界先验，而无需几何编码策略，使其特别适合资源受限的机器人团队。我们在多个基准测试中评估了UniScale，展示了强大的泛化能力和在各种环境中稳定一致的性能。我们将在接受后发布我们的实现。
tldr: UniScale is a unified, scale-aware 3D reconstruction framework for robotics that estimates camera parameters, depth maps, and metric scale from multi-view images, incorporating geometric priors and leveraging pre-existing models without geometric encoding.
tldr_zh: UniScale是一个统一的、尺度感知的机器人三维重建框架，通过多视角图像估计相机参数、深度图和场景的度量尺度，结合了几何先验知识，并利用了没有几何编码的预训练模型。

title: Latent Gaussian Splatting for 4D Panoptic Occupancy Tracking
summary: Capturing 4D spatiotemporal surroundings is crucial for the safe and reliable operation of robots in dynamic environments. However, most existing methods address only one side of the problem: they either provide coarse geometric tracking via bounding boxes, or detailed 3D structures like voxel-based occupancy that lack explicit temporal association. In this work, we present Latent Gaussian Splatting for 4D Panoptic Occupancy Tracking (LaGS) that advances spatiotemporal scene understanding in a holistic direction. Our approach incorporates camera-based end-to-end tracking with mask-based multi-view panoptic occupancy prediction, and addresses the key challenge of efficiently aggregating multi-view information into 3D voxel grids via a novel latent Gaussian splatting approach. Specifically, we first fuse observations into 3D Gaussians that serve as a sparse point-centric latent representation of the 3D scene, and then splat the aggregated features onto a 3D voxel grid that is decoded by a mask-based segmentation head. We evaluate LaGS on the Occ3D nuScenes and Waymo datasets, achieving state-of-the-art performance for 4D panoptic occupancy tracking. We make our code available at https://lags.cs.uni-freiburg.de/.
summary_zh: 在动态环境中，捕捉4D时空环境对于机器人安全可靠的运行至关重要。然而，现存的大多数方法仅解决问题的一个方面：它们要么提供基于包围盒的粗略几何跟踪，要么提供缺乏明确时间关联的如基于体素的占据等详细3D结构。在这项工作中，我们提出用于4D全景占据跟踪的潜在高斯溅射(LaGS)，在整体方向上推进时空场景理解。我们的方法结合了基于相机的端到端跟踪与基于掩码的多视角全景占据预测，并通过一种新颖的潜在高斯溅射方法，解决了将多视角信息有效聚合到3D体素网格中的关键挑战。具体来说，我们首先将观测结果融合到3D高斯中，作为3D场景的稀疏、以点为中心的潜在表示，然后将聚合的特征溅射到3D体素网格上，并由基于掩码的分割头进行解码。我们在Occ3D nuScenes和Waymo数据集上评估LaGS，实现了4D全景占据跟踪的最新性能。我们的代码可在https://lags.cs.uni-freiburg.de/上获取。
tldr: This paper introduces Latent Gaussian Splatting (LaGS) for 4D panoptic occupancy tracking, achieving state-of-the-art results on Occ3D nuScenes and Waymo datasets by fusing camera data into 3D Gaussians and splatting them onto a voxel grid for mask-based segmentation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了用于4D全景占用追踪的潜在高斯溅射（LaGS），通过将相机数据融合到3D高斯并溅射到体素网格上进行基于掩码的分割，在Occ3D nuScenes和Waymo数据集上实现了最先进的结果。

title: GeoWorld: Geometric World Models
summary: Energy-based predictive world models provide a powerful approach for multi-step visual planning by reasoning over latent energy landscapes rather than generating pixels. However, existing approaches face two major challenges: (i) their latent representations are typically learned in Euclidean space, neglecting the underlying geometric and hierarchical structure among states, and (ii) they struggle with long-horizon prediction, which leads to rapid degradation across extended rollouts. To address these challenges, we introduce GeoWorld, a geometric world model that preserves geometric structure and hierarchical relations through a Hyperbolic JEPA, which maps latent representations from Euclidean space onto hyperbolic manifolds. We further introduce Geometric Reinforcement Learning for energy-based optimization, enabling stable multi-step planning in hyperbolic latent space. Extensive experiments on CrossTask and COIN demonstrate around 3% SR improvement in 3-step planning and 2% SR improvement in 4-step planning compared to the state-of-the-art V-JEPA 2. Project website: https://steve-zeyu-zhang.github.io/GeoWorld.
summary_zh: 基于能量的预测世界模型通过推理潜在的能量景观而非生成像素，为多步视觉规划提供了一种强大的方法。然而，现有方法面临两个主要挑战：（i）它们的潜在表征通常在欧几里得空间中学习，忽略了状态之间潜在的几何和分层结构；以及（ii）它们难以进行长程预测，这导致了在扩展展开过程中的快速退化。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了GeoWorld，一种几何世界模型，它通过一个双曲JEPA（Hyperbolic JEPA）来保持几何结构和分层关系，该双曲JEPA将潜在表征从欧几里得空间映射到双曲流形上。我们进一步引入了用于基于能量优化的几何强化学习，从而能够在双曲潜在空间中进行稳定的多步规划。在CrossTask和COIN上的大量实验表明，与最先进的V-JEPA 2相比，在3步规划中成功率（SR）提高了约3%，在4步规划中成功率提高了约2%。项目网站：https://steve-zeyu-zhang.github.io/GeoWorld。
tldr: GeoWorld improves multi-step visual planning by using hyperbolic geometry to learn latent representations that preserve geometric structure, leading to improved success rates in long-horizon prediction compared to Euclidean-based methods.
tldr_zh: GeoWorld通过使用双曲几何学习保留几何结构的潜在表示来改善多步视觉规划，与基于欧几里德的方法相比，提高了长时程预测的成功率。

title: InCoM: Intent-Driven Perception and Structured Coordination for Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation
summary: Whole-body mobile manipulation is a fundamental capability for general-purpose robotic agents, requiring both coordinated control of the mobile base and manipulator and robust perception under dynamically changing viewpoints. However, existing approaches face two key challenges: strong coupling between base and arm actions complicates whole-body control optimization, and perceptual attention is often poorly allocated as viewpoints shift during mobile manipulation. We propose InCoM, an intent-driven perception and structured coordination framework for whole-body mobile manipulation. InCoM infers latent motion intent to dynamically reweight multi-scale perceptual features, enabling stage-adaptive allocation of perceptual attention. To support robust cross-modal perception, InCoM further incorporates a geometric-semantic structured alignment mechanism that enhances multimodal correspondence. On the control side, we design a decoupled coordinated flow matching action decoder that explicitly models coordinated base-arm action generation, alleviating optimization difficulties caused by control coupling. Without access to privileged perceptual information, InCoM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on three ManiSkill-HAB scenarios by 28.2%, 26.1%, and 23.6% in success rate, demonstrating strong effectiveness for whole-body mobile manipulation.
summary_zh: 全身移动操作是通用机器人代理的一项基本能力，它既需要移动底座和机械臂的协同控制，又需要在动态变化视角下的鲁棒感知。然而，现有方法面临两个关键挑战：底座和手臂动作之间的强耦合使得全身控制优化变得复杂，并且感知注意力在移动操作过程中视角变化时通常分配不佳。我们提出了InCoM，一种用于全身移动操作的意图驱动感知和结构化协调框架。InCoM推断潜在的运动意图来动态地重新加权多尺度感知特征，从而实现感知注意力的阶段自适应分配。为了支持鲁棒的跨模态感知，InCoM进一步整合了一种几何-语义结构化对齐机制，从而增强多模态对应关系。在控制方面，我们设计了一个解耦的协调流匹配动作解码器，该解码器显式地建模协调的底座-手臂动作生成，从而缓解了控制耦合导致的优化困难。在没有访问特权感知信息的情况下，InCoM在三个ManiSkill-HAB场景中的成功率分别超过了最先进的方法28.2%、26.1%和23.6%，证明了其在全身移动操作方面的强大有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces InCoM, a framework for whole-body mobile manipulation that uses intent-driven perception and structured coordination, achieving state-of-the-art results on ManiSkill-HAB benchmarks by decoupling base and arm control and adaptively allocating perceptual attention.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了InCoM，一个用于全身移动操作的框架，它利用意图驱动的感知和结构化协调，通过解耦底座和手臂的控制并自适应地分配感知注意力，在ManiSkill-HAB基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。

title: WaterVideoQA: ASV-Centric Perception and Rule-Compliant Reasoning via Multi-Modal Agents
summary: While autonomous navigation has achieved remarkable success in passive perception (e.g., object detection and segmentation), it remains fundamentally constrained by a void in knowledge-driven, interactive environmental cognition. In the high-stakes domain of maritime navigation, the ability to bridge the gap between raw visual perception and complex cognitive reasoning is not merely an enhancement but a critical prerequisite for Autonomous Surface Vessels to execute safe and precise maneuvers. To this end, we present WaterVideoQA, the first large-scale, comprehensive Video Question Answering benchmark specifically engineered for all-waterway environments. This benchmark encompasses 3,029 video clips across six distinct waterway categories, integrating multifaceted variables such as volatile lighting and dynamic weather to rigorously stress-test ASV capabilities across a five-tier hierarchical cognitive framework. Furthermore, we introduce NaviMind, a pioneering multi-agent neuro-symbolic system designed for open-ended maritime reasoning. By synergizing Adaptive Semantic Routing, Situation-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning, and Autonomous Self-Reflective Verification, NaviMind transitions ASVs from superficial pattern matching to regulation-compliant, interpretable decision-making. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework significantly transcends existing baselines, establishing a new paradigm for intelligent, trustworthy interaction in dynamic maritime environments.
summary_zh: 自主导航在被动感知（例如，目标检测和分割）方面取得了显著成功，但其根本上仍受限于知识驱动的、交互式环境认知方面的空白。在风险较高的海事导航领域，弥合原始视觉感知和复杂认知推理之间差距的能力，不仅仅是一个增强，更是自主水面艇（ASV）执行安全且精确机动的关键先决条件。为此，我们提出了 WaterVideoQA，这是首个大规模、综合性的视频问答基准，专门为所有水道环境设计。该基准涵盖了六个不同水道类别的 3,029 个视频片段，整合了多方面的变量，例如不稳定的光照和动态天气，以严格测试 ASV 在五层分级认知框架下的能力。此外，我们引入了 NaviMind，一个用于开放式海事推理的先驱性多智能体神经-符号系统。通过协同自适应语义路由、情境感知分层推理和自主自反验证，NaviMind 使 ASV 从肤浅的模式匹配过渡到符合法规、可解释的决策制定。实验结果表明，我们的框架显著超越了现有基线，为在动态海事环境中进行智能、可信的交互建立了一个新的范例。
tldr: The paper introduces WaterVideoQA, a new large-scale video QA benchmark for maritime environments, and NaviMind, a multi-agent neuro-symbolic system for autonomous surface vessel reasoning and decision-making.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 WaterVideoQA，一个新的大型水域环境视频问答基准，以及 NaviMind，一个用于自主水面舰艇推理和决策的多智能体神经符号系统。

title: DySL-VLA: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model Inference via Dynamic-Static Layer-Skipping for Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable success in robotic tasks like manipulation by fusing a language model's reasoning with a vision model's 3D understanding. However, their high computational cost remains a major obstacle for real-world applications that require real-time performance. We observe that the actions within a task have varying levels of importance: critical steps demand high precision, while less important ones can tolerate more variance. Leveraging this insight, we propose DySL-VLA, a novel framework that addresses computational cost by dynamically skipping VLA layers based on each action's importance. DySL-VLA categorizes its layers into two types: informative layers, which are consistently executed, and incremental layers, which can be selectively skipped. To intelligently skip layers without sacrificing accuracy, we invent a prior-post skipping guidance mechanism to determine when to initiate layer-skipping. We also propose a skip-aware two-stage knowledge distillation algorithm to efficiently train a standard VLA into a DySL-VLA. Our experiments indicate that DySL-VLA achieves 2.1% improvement in success length over Deer-VLA on the Calvin dataset, while simultaneously reducing trainable parameters by a factor of 85.7 and providing a 3.75x speedup relative to the RoboFlamingo baseline at iso-accuracy. Our code is available on https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/DYSL_VLA.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型通过融合语言模型的推理能力和视觉模型的3D理解能力，在机器人操控任务中展现了显著的成功。然而，其高昂的计算成本仍然是需要实时性能的实际应用中的主要障碍。我们观察到，任务中的动作具有不同程度的重要性：关键步骤需要高精度，而不太重要的步骤可以容忍更大的差异。基于这一洞察，我们提出 DySL-VLA，一种新颖的框架，通过根据每个动作的重要性动态跳过VLA层来解决计算成本问题。DySL-VLA将其层分为两种类型：信息层，始终执行；增量层，可以选择性地跳过。为了在不牺牲准确性的情况下智能地跳过层，我们发明了一种先验-后验跳过指导机制，以确定何时启动层跳过。我们还提出了一种跳过感知的两阶段知识蒸馏算法，以将标准VLA有效地训练成 DySL-VLA。我们的实验表明，在Calvin数据集上，DySL-VLA在成功长度方面比Deer-VLA提高了2.1%，同时将可训练参数减少了85.7倍，并且在等精度的情况下，相对于 RoboFlamingo 基线提供了3.75倍的加速。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/DYSL_VLA 上获取。
tldr: The paper introduces DySL-VLA, a method for efficient VLA model inference in robotics by dynamically skipping layers based on action importance, achieving speedup and parameter reduction while maintaining accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DySL-VLA，一种通过基于动作重要性动态跳过层来提高机器人VLA模型推理效率的方法，在保持精度的同时实现了加速和参数减少。

title: LeRobot: An Open-Source Library for End-to-End Robot Learning
summary: Robotics is undergoing a significant transformation powered by advances in high-level control techniques based on machine learning, giving rise to the field of robot learning. Recent progress in robot learning has been accelerated by the increasing availability of affordable teleoperation systems, large-scale openly available datasets, and scalable learning-based methods. However, development in the field of robot learning is often slowed by fragmented, closed-source tools designed to only address specific sub-components within the robotics stack. In this paper, we present \texttt{lerobot}, an open-source library that integrates across the entire robot learning stack, from low-level middleware communication for motor controls to large-scale dataset collection, storage and streaming. The library is designed with a strong focus on real-world robotics, supporting accessible hardware platforms while remaining extensible to new embodiments. It also supports efficient implementations for various state-of-the-art robot learning algorithms from multiple prominent paradigms, as well as a generalized asynchronous inference stack. Unlike traditional pipelines which heavily rely on hand-crafted techniques, \texttt{lerobot} emphasizes scalable learning approaches that improve directly with more data and compute. Designed for accessibility, scalability, and openness, \texttt{lerobot} lowers the barrier to entry for researchers and practitioners to robotics while providing a platform for reproducible, state-of-the-art robot learning.
summary_zh: 机器人技术正经历着由基于机器学习的高级控制技术的进步所驱动的重大变革，从而催生了机器人学习领域。低成本遥操作系统、大规模开放数据集以及可扩展的基于学习的方法日益普及，加速了机器人学习的最新进展。然而，机器人学习领域的发展常常受到碎片化、闭源工具的阻碍，这些工具仅旨在解决机器人技术堆栈中的特定子组件。\textbf{\textit{在本文中，我们提出了\texttt{lerobot}，这是一个开放源代码库，它集成了从用于电机控制的底层中间件通信到大规模数据集收集、存储和流式传输的整个机器人学习堆栈。}}该库的设计强烈关注现实世界的机器人技术，支持易于使用的硬件平台，同时保持对新实现的扩展性。它还支持来自多种著名范例的各种最先进机器人学习算法的有效实现，以及一个通用的异步推理堆栈。与严重依赖手工技术的传统管道不同，\texttt{lerobot} 强调可扩展的学习方法，这些方法可以直接随着更多的数据和计算而改进。 \texttt{lerobot} 以可访问性、可扩展性和开放性为设计理念，降低了研究人员和从业人员进入机器人领域的门槛，同时为可复现的、最先进的机器人学习提供了一个平台。
tldr: The paper introduces LeRobot, an open-source library aiming to streamline the robot learning pipeline from low-level control to large-scale data management, supporting various learning algorithms and accessible hardware.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为 LeRobot 的开源库，旨在简化机器人学习流程，从低级控制到大规模数据管理，并支持各种学习算法和易于访问的硬件平台。

title: Unleashing the Potential of Diffusion Models for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Diffusion models have become a popular choice for decision-making tasks in robotics, and more recently, are also being considered for solving autonomous driving tasks. However, their applications and evaluations in autonomous driving remain limited to simulation-based or laboratory settings. The full strength of diffusion models for large-scale, complex real-world settings, such as End-to-End Autonomous Driving (E2E AD), remains underexplored. In this study, we conducted a systematic and large-scale investigation to unleash the potential of the diffusion models as planners for E2E AD, based on a tremendous amount of real-vehicle data and road testing. Through comprehensive and carefully controlled studies, we identify key insights into the diffusion loss space, trajectory representation, and data scaling that significantly impact E2E planning performance. Moreover, we also provide an effective reinforcement learning post-training strategy to further enhance the safety of the learned planner. The resulting diffusion-based learning framework, Hyper Diffusion Planner} (HDP), is deployed on a real-vehicle platform and evaluated across 6 urban driving scenarios and 200 km of real-world testing, achieving a notable 10x performance improvement over the base model. Our work demonstrates that diffusion models, when properly designed and trained, can serve as effective and scalable E2E AD planners for complex, real-world autonomous driving tasks.
summary_zh: 扩散模型已成为机器人决策任务的热门选择，最近也被考虑用于解决自动驾驶任务。然而，它们在自动驾驶中的应用和评估仍然局限于基于模拟或实验室环境。扩散模型在大规模、复杂现实世界环境中的全部潜力，例如端到端自动驾驶（E2E AD），仍未得到充分探索。在本研究中，我们基于大量的真实车辆数据和道路测试，对扩散模型作为E2E AD规划器的潜力进行了系统且大规模的调查。通过全面且精心控制的研究，我们深入了解了扩散损失空间、轨迹表示和数据缩放等关键因素，这些因素显著影响E2E规划性能。此外，我们还提供了一种有效的强化学习后训练策略，以进一步提高学习到的规划器的安全性。由此产生的基于扩散的学习框架，Hyper Diffusion Planner (HDP)，被部署在真实车辆平台上，并在 6 个城市驾驶场景和 200 公里的真实世界测试中进行了评估，与基础模型相比，性能显著提高了 10 倍。我们的工作表明，经过适当设计和训练后，扩散模型可以作为复杂、现实世界自动驾驶任务的有效且可扩展的E2E AD规划器。
tldr: This paper explores the potential of diffusion models for end-to-end autonomous driving (E2E AD) using real-world data and road testing, achieving significant performance improvements with a novel architecture (HDP) and reinforcement learning post-training.
tldr_zh: 本文通过真实世界数据和道路测试，探索了扩散模型在端到端自动驾驶 (E2E AD) 中的潜力，并通过一种新颖的架构 (HDP) 和强化学习后训练实现了显著的性能提升。

title: Pixel2Catch: Multi-Agent Sim-to-Real Transfer for Agile Manipulation with a Single RGB Camera
summary: To catch a thrown object, a robot must be able to perceive the object's motion and generate control actions in a timely manner. Rather than explicitly estimating the object's 3D position, this work focuses on a novel approach that recognizes object motion using pixel-level visual information extracted from a single RGB image. Such visual cues capture changes in the object's position and scale, allowing the policy to reason about the object's motion. Furthermore, to achieve stable learning in a high-DoF system composed of a robot arm equipped with a multi-fingered hand, we design a heterogeneous multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that defines the arm and hand as independent agents with distinct roles. Each agent is trained cooperatively using role-specific observations and rewards, and the learned policies are successfully transferred from simulation to the real world.
summary_zh: 为了抓住抛掷物体，机器人需要能够及时感知物体的运动并生成控制动作。本研究没有显式估计物体的3D位置，而是专注于一种新颖的方法，该方法利用从单张RGB图像中提取的像素级视觉信息来识别物体的运动。这些视觉线索捕捉物体位置和尺度的变化，从而使策略能够推断物体的运动。此外，为了在高自由度系统中实现稳定的学习，该系统由装有多指手的机械臂组成，我们设计了一种异构的多智能体强化学习框架，将机械臂和手定义为具有不同角色的独立智能体。每个智能体使用角色特定的观察和奖励进行协同训练，学习到的策略已成功地从仿真环境迁移到真实世界。
tldr: The paper presents a multi-agent reinforcement learning approach for a robot to catch thrown objects using only pixel-level visual input from a single RGB camera and successfully transfers the learned policy from simulation to the real world.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多智能体强化学习方法，使机器人仅使用来自单个RGB摄像头的像素级视觉输入来接住抛出的物体，并将学习到的策略成功地从仿真转移到现实世界。

title: Metamorphic Testing of Vision-Language Action-Enabled Robots
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are multimodal robotic task controllers that, given an instruction and visual inputs, produce a sequence of low-level control actions (or motor commands) enabling a robot to execute the requested task in the physical environment. These systems face the test oracle problem from multiple perspectives. On the one hand, a test oracle must be defined for each instruction prompt, which is a complex and non-generalizable approach. On the other hand, current state-of-the-art oracles typically capture symbolic representations of the world (e.g., robot and object states), enabling the correctness evaluation of a task, but fail to assess other critical aspects, such as the quality with which VLA-enabled robots perform a task. In this paper, we explore whether Metamorphic Testing (MT) can alleviate the test oracle problem in this context. To do so, we propose two metamorphic relation patterns and five metamorphic relations to assess whether changes to the test inputs impact the original trajectory of the VLA-enabled robots. An empirical study involving five VLA models, two simulated robots, and four robotic tasks shows that MT can effectively alleviate the test oracle problem by automatically detecting diverse types of failures, including, but not limited to, uncompleted tasks. More importantly, the proposed MRs are generalizable, making the proposed approach applicable across different VLA models, robots, and tasks, even in the absence of test oracles.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型是一种多模态机器人任务控制器，它在给定指令和视觉输入的情况下，产生一系列低层控制动作（或电机指令），使机器人能够在物理环境中执行请求的任务。这些系统面临来自多个角度的测试判断问题。一方面，必须为每个指令提示定义一个测试判断标准，这是一种复杂且不具通用性的方法。另一方面，当前最先进的判断标准通常捕获世界的符号表示（例如，机器人和对象状态），从而能够评估任务的正确性，但未能评估其他关键方面，例如VLA赋能机器人执行任务的质量。在本文中，我们探讨了变质测试（MT）是否可以缓解此背景下的测试判断问题。为此，我们提出了两种变质关系模式和五种变质关系，以评估测试输入的更改是否会影响VLA赋能机器人的原始轨迹。一项涉及五个VLA模型、两个模拟机器人和四个机器人任务的实证研究表明，MT可以通过自动检测各种类型的故障（包括但不限于未完成的任务）来有效缓解测试判断问题。更重要的是，所提出的变质关系具有通用性，使得所提出的方法适用于不同的VLA模型、机器人和任务，即使在没有测试判断标准的情况下也是如此。
tldr: The paper proposes a Metamorphic Testing (MT) approach to address the test oracle problem in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotics, demonstrating its effectiveness in detecting failures and generalizing across models, robots, and tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种变形测试（MT）方法，旨在解决机器人中视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的测试预言问题，证明了该方法在检测故障和推广到不同模型、机器人和任务中的有效性。

title: SignVLA: A Gloss-Free Vision-Language-Action Framework for Real-Time Sign Language-Guided Robotic Manipulation
summary:
We present, to our knowledge, the first sign language-driven Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework for intuitive and inclusive human-robot interaction. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on gloss annotations as intermediate supervision, the proposed system adopts a gloss-free paradigm and directly maps visual sign gestures to semantic instructions. This design reduces annotation cost and avoids the information loss introduced by gloss representations, enabling more natural and scalable multimodal interaction.
  In this work, we focus on a real-time alphabet-level finger-spelling interface that provides a robust and low-latency communication channel for robotic control. Compared with large-scale continuous sign language recognition, alphabet-level interaction offers improved reliability, interpretability, and deployment feasibility in safety-critical embodied environments.
