On the geometry side, we find that existing Gaussian-to-Occupancy operators fail to converge under such weak supervision, and we introduce an opacity-aware, Poisson-based approach that stabilizes volumetric aggregation. On the semantic side, direct alignment between rendered features and open-vocabulary segmentation features suffers from feature mixing; we therefore propose a Progressive Temperature Decay schedule that gradually sharpens opacities during splatting, strengthening Gaussian-language alignment. On Occ-ScanNet, our framework achieves 59.50 IoU and 21.05 mIoU in the open-vocabulary setting, surpassing all existing occupancy methods in IoU and outperforming prior open-vocabulary approaches by a large margin in mIoU. Code will be released at https://github.com/JuIvyy/LegoOcc.
summary_zh: 开放词汇3D占据对于具身智能体至关重要，因为它们需要理解复杂的室内环境，在这些环境中，语义类别丰富且不断演变，超出了固定的分类法。虽然最近的研究已经探索了户外驾驶场景下的开放词汇占据，但这些方法在室内环境中的迁移效果较差，原因是室内几何结构更密集、布局更复杂、语义也更加精细。为了解决这些挑战，我们采用了一种仅利用二元占据标签（已占据 vs. 空闲）的仅几何监督范式。我们的框架建立在3D语言嵌入高斯的基础上，它作为一种统一的中间表示，将精细的3D几何结构与语言对齐的语义嵌入相结合。在几何方面，我们发现现有的高斯到占据算子在这种弱监督下无法收敛，因此我们引入了一种感知不透明度的基于泊松的方法，以稳定体素聚合。在语义方面，渲染特征与开放词汇分割特征之间的直接对齐会受到特征混合的影响；因此，我们提出了一种渐进温度衰减策略，在溅射过程中逐步锐化不透明度，从而加强高斯-语言对齐。在Occ-ScanNet上，我们的框架在开放词汇设置下实现了59.50的IoU和21.05的mIoU，在IoU方面超过了所有现有的占据方法，并在mIoU方面大幅优于之前的开放词汇方法。代码将在https://github.com/JuIvyy/LegoOcc发布。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel monocular open-vocabulary occupancy prediction framework for indoor scenes using geometry-only supervision and 3D Language-Embedded Gaussians, addressing challenges in transferring existing outdoor methods indoors by introducing improvements in volumetric aggregation and Gaussian-language alignment.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的单目开放词汇占用预测框架，用于室内场景，采用仅几何监督和3D语言嵌入高斯，通过改进体积聚合和高斯-语言对齐，解决了将现有室外方法转移到室内所面临的挑战。

title: ArtPro: Self-Supervised Articulated Object Reconstruction with Adaptive Integration of Mobility Proposals
summary: Reconstructing articulated objects into high-fidelity digital twins is crucial for applications such as robotic manipulation and interactive simulation. Recent self-supervised methods using differentiable rendering frameworks like 3D Gaussian Splatting remain highly sensitive to the initial part segmentation. Their reliance on heuristic clustering or pre-trained models often causes optimization to converge to local minima, especially for complex multi-part objects. To address these limitations, we propose ArtPro, a novel self-supervised framework that introduces adaptive integration of mobility proposals. Our approach begins with an over-segmentation initialization guided by geometry features and motion priors, generating part proposals with plausible motion hypotheses. During optimization, we dynamically merge these proposals by analyzing motion consistency among spatial neighbors, while a collision-aware motion pruning mechanism prevents erroneous kinematic estimation. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world objects demonstrate that ArtPro achieves robust reconstruction of complex multi-part objects, significantly outperforming existing methods in accuracy and stability.
summary_zh: 将铰接物体重建为高保真数字孪生对于机器人操控和交互式仿真等应用至关重要。最近使用像3D高斯溅射等可微渲染框架的自监督方法仍然对初始部件分割高度敏感。它们对启发式聚类或预训练模型的依赖常常导致优化收敛到局部极小值，特别是对于复杂的多部件物体。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出ArtPro，一种新颖的自监督框架，引入了运动提议的自适应整合。我们的方法以几何特征和运动先验引导下的过度分割初始化开始，生成具有合理运动假设的部件提议。在优化过程中，我们通过分析空间邻域之间的运动一致性来动态合并这些提议，同时碰撞感知运动剪枝机制可防止错误的运动学估计。在合成和真实世界物体上的大量实验表明，ArtPro实现了对复杂多部件物体的鲁棒重建，在准确性和稳定性方面显著优于现有方法。
tldr: ArtPro is a self-supervised framework that improves articulated object reconstruction by adaptively integrating mobility proposals, achieving better accuracy and stability compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: ArtPro是一个自监督框架，通过自适应地整合运动提议来改进铰接物体的重建，与现有方法相比，实现了更高的精度和稳定性。

title: Causal Motion Diffusion Models for Autoregressive Motion Generation
summary: Recent advances in motion diffusion models have substantially improved the realism of human motion synthesis. However, existing approaches either rely on full-sequence diffusion models with bidirectional generation, which limits temporal causality and real-time applicability, or autoregressive models that suffer from instability and cumulative errors. In this work, we present Causal Motion Diffusion Models (CMDM), a unified framework for autoregressive motion generation based on a causal diffusion transformer that operates in a semantically aligned latent space. CMDM builds upon a Motion-Language-Aligned Causal VAE (MAC-VAE), which encodes motion sequences into temporally causal latent representations. On top of this latent representation, an autoregressive diffusion transformer is trained using causal diffusion forcing to perform temporally ordered denoising across motion frames. To achieve fast inference, we introduce a frame-wise sampling schedule with causal uncertainty, where each subsequent frame is predicted from partially denoised previous frames. The resulting framework supports high-quality text-to-motion generation, streaming synthesis, and long-horizon motion generation at interactive rates. Experiments on HumanML3D and SnapMoGen demonstrate that CMDM outperforms existing diffusion and autoregressive models in both semantic fidelity and temporal smoothness, while substantially reducing inference latency.
summary_zh: 人体运动扩散模型方面的最新进展显著提高了人体运动合成的真实感。然而，现有方法要么依赖于具有双向生成的全序列扩散模型，这限制了时间因果性和实时适用性，要么依赖于自回归模型，这些模型会受到不稳定性和累积误差的影响。 在这项工作中，我们提出了因果运动扩散模型（CMDM），这是一种基于因果扩散Transformer的自回归运动生成统一框架，该框架在语义对齐的潜在空间中运行。 CMDM建立在运动-语言对齐因果变分自编码器（MAC-VAE）之上，该编码器将运动序列编码为时间因果潜在表示。 在这种潜在表示之上，使用因果扩散强制训练自回归扩散Transformer，以执行跨运动帧的时间有序去噪。 为了实现快速推理，我们引入了一种具有因果不确定性的逐帧采样调度，其中每个后续帧都从部分去噪的前一帧预测。 由此产生的框架支持高质量的文本到运动生成、流式合成以及交互速率下的长时程运动生成。 在HumanML3D和SnapMoGen上的实验表明，CMDM在语义保真度和时间平滑度方面均优于现有的扩散和自回归模型，同时显著降低了推理延迟。
tldr: The paper introduces Causal Motion Diffusion Models (CMDM), a novel framework for autoregressive motion generation that combines a causal diffusion transformer with a motion-language-aligned latent space to achieve high-quality, fast, and temporally coherent motion synthesis.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了因果运动扩散模型（CMDM），一种新颖的自回归运动生成框架，它结合了因果扩散Transformer和一个运动-语言对齐的潜在空间，以实现高质量、快速和时间连贯的运动合成。

title: Exploring Multimodal LMMs for Online Episodic Memory Question Answering on the Edge
summary: We investigate the feasibility of using Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for real-time online episodic memory question answering. While cloud offloading is common, it raises privacy and latency concerns for wearable assistants, hence we investigate implementation on the edge. We integrated streaming constraints into our question answering pipeline, which is structured into two asynchronous threads: a Descriptor Thread that continuously converts video into a lightweight textual memory, and a Question Answering (QA) Thread that reasons over the textual memory to answer queries. Experiments on the QAEgo4D-Closed benchmark analyze the performance of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) within strict resource boundaries, showing promising results also when compared to clound-based solutions. Specifically, an end-to-end configuration running on a consumer-grade 8GB GPU achieves 51.76% accuracy with a Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) of 0.41s. Scaling to a local enterprise-grade server yields 54.40% accuracy with a TTFT of 0.88s. In comparison, a cloud-based solution obtains an accuracy of 56.00%. These competitive results highlight the potential of edge-based solutions for privacy-preserving episodic memory retrieval.
summary_zh: 我们研究了使用多模态大型语言模型(MLLMs)进行实时在线情景记忆问答的可行性。虽然云端卸载很常见，但它引发了可穿戴助手方面的隐私和延迟担忧，因此我们研究了边缘端的实现。我们将流式传输约束整合到我们的问答流程中，该流程被构建成两个异步线程：一个描述符线程，持续将视频转换为轻量级的文本记忆；以及一个问答(QA)线程，对文本记忆进行推理以回答查询。在QAEgo4D-Closed基准上的实验分析了多模态大型语言模型(MLLMs)在严格的资源约束下的性能，结果显示出令人鼓舞的结果，即使与基于云的解决方案相比也是如此。具体而言，在消费级8GB GPU上运行的端到端配置实现了51.76%的准确率，首个令牌生成时间(TTFT)为0.41秒。扩展到本地企业级服务器，准确率达到54.40%，TTFT为0.88秒。相比之下，基于云的解决方案获得了56.00%的准确率。这些具有竞争力的结果突出了基于边缘的解决方案在保护隐私的情景记忆检索方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper explores the feasibility of running multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on edge devices for real-time, online episodic memory question answering, finding competitive accuracy and latency compared to cloud-based solutions while preserving privacy.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了在边缘设备上运行多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 以进行实时在线情景记忆问答的可行性，发现与基于云的解决方案相比，在保持隐私的同时，实现了竞争性的准确性和延迟。

title: WHOLE: World-Grounded Hand-Object Lifted from Egocentric Videos
summary: Egocentric manipulation videos are highly challenging due to severe occlusions during interactions and frequent object entries and exits from the camera view as the person moves. Current methods typically focus on recovering either hand or object pose in isolation, but both struggle during interactions and fail to handle out-of-sight cases. Moreover, their independent predictions often lead to inconsistent hand-object relations. We introduce WHOLE, a method that holistically reconstructs hand and object motion in world space from egocentric videos given object templates. Our key insight is to learn a generative prior over hand-object motion to jointly reason about their interactions. At test time, the pretrained prior is guided to generate trajectories that conform to the video observations. This joint generative reconstruction substantially outperforms approaches that process hands and objects separately followed by post-processing. WHOLE achieves state-of-the-art performance on hand motion estimation, 6D object pose estimation, and their relative interaction reconstruction. Project website: https://judyye.github.io/whole-www
summary_zh: 第一人称操作视频极具挑战性，因为互动期间存在严重的遮挡，并且随着人员移动，物体频繁地进入和离开相机视野。当前的方法通常侧重于孤立地恢复手部或物体姿态，但这两种方法都在互动期间表现得不够理想，并且无法处理视野外的情况。此外，它们独立的预测常常导致不一致的手-物关系。我们提出了WHOLE，一种从第一人称视频中，根据物体模板，在世界坐标系中整体重建手和物体运动的方法。我们的核心思想是学习一个关于手-物运动的生成先验，以联合推理它们的互动。在测试阶段，预训练的先验被引导生成符合视频观测的轨迹。这种联合生成重建显著优于那些分别处理手和物体然后再进行后处理的方法。WHOLE在手部运动估计、6D物体姿态估计以及它们的相关互动重建方面取得了最先进的性能。项目网站：https://judyye.github.io/whole-www
tldr: WHOLE reconstructs hand and object motion in world space from egocentric videos by learning a generative prior over hand-object interactions, outperforming methods that process hands and objects separately.
tldr_zh: WHOLE通过学习手-物交互的生成先验，从以自我为中心的视频中重建世界空间中的手部和物体运动，优于分别处理手和物体的方法。

title: Solaris: Building a Multiplayer Video World Model in Minecraft
summary: Existing action-conditioned video generation models (video world models) are limited to single-agent perspectives, failing to capture the multi-agent interactions of real-world environments. We introduce Solaris, a multiplayer video world model that simulates consistent multi-view observations. To enable this, we develop a multiplayer data system designed for robust, continuous, and automated data collection on video games such as Minecraft. Unlike prior platforms built for single-player settings, our system supports coordinated multi-agent interaction and synchronized videos + actions capture. Using this system, we collect 12.64 million multiplayer frames and propose an evaluation framework for multiplayer movement, memory, grounding, building, and view consistency. We train Solaris using a staged pipeline that progressively transitions from single-player to multiplayer modeling, combining bidirectional, causal, and Self Forcing training. In the final stage, we introduce Checkpointed Self Forcing, a memory-efficient Self Forcing variant that enables a longer-horizon teacher. Results show our architecture and training design outperform existing baselines. Through open-sourcing our system and models, we hope to lay the groundwork for a new generation of multi-agent world models.
summary_zh: 现有动作条件视频生成模型（视频世界模型）局限于单智能体视角，无法捕捉真实世界环境中多智能体的交互。我们提出了Solaris，一种能够模拟一致的多视角观测的多人视频世界模型。为了实现这一点，我们开发了一种多人数据系统，旨在对诸如Minecraft之类的视频游戏进行稳健、连续和自动的数据收集。与之前为单人设置构建的平台不同，我们的系统支持协调的多智能体交互和同步的视频+动作捕获。利用该系统，我们收集了1264万多人游戏帧，并提出了一个针对多人移动、记忆、接地、建造和视角一致性的评估框架。我们使用分阶段的流水线训练Solaris，逐步从单人建模过渡到多人建模，结合双向、因果和自我强制训练。在最后阶段，我们引入了检查点自我强制，这是一种节省内存的自我强制变体，能够实现更长时程的教师模型。结果表明，我们的架构和训练设计优于现有的基线。通过开源我们的系统和模型，我们希望为新一代的多智能体世界模型奠定基础。
tldr: The paper introduces Solaris, a multiplayer video world model trained on a newly developed Minecraft data collection system, addressing the limitations of existing single-agent video world models. It demonstrates improved performance over baselines and open-sources both the system and models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Solaris，一个在新的Minecraft数据收集系统上训练的多人视频世界模型，解决了现有单智能体视频世界模型的局限性。它展示了优于基线的性能，并开源了系统和模型。

title: Tell Me What To Learn: Generalizing Neural Memory to be Controllable in Natural Language
summary: Modern machine learning models are deployed in diverse, non-stationary environments where they must continually adapt to new tasks and evolving knowledge. Continual fine-tuning and in-context learning are costly and brittle, whereas neural memory methods promise lightweight updates with minimal forgetting. However, existing neural memory models typically assume a single fixed objective and homogeneous information streams, leaving users with no control over what the model remembers or ignores over time. To address this challenge, we propose a generalized neural memory system that performs flexible updates based on learning instructions specified in natural language. Our approach enables adaptive agents to learn selectively from heterogeneous information sources, supporting settings, such as healthcare and customer service, where fixed-objective memory updates are insufficient.
summary_zh: 现代机器学习模型被部署在多样化、非平稳的环境中，它们必须不断适应新的任务和演变的知识。持续微调和上下文学习成本高昂且脆弱，而神经记忆方法则有望以最小的遗忘实现轻量级更新。然而，现有的神经记忆模型通常假设单一的固定目标和同质的信息流，导致用户无法控制模型随时间记住或忽略的内容。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种广义的神经记忆系统，该系统基于自然语言指定的学习指令执行灵活的更新。我们的方法使自适应代理能够有选择地从异构信息源中学习，从而支持诸如医疗保健和客户服务等固定目标记忆更新不足以满足需求的场景。
tldr: The paper introduces a neural memory system controllable via natural language instructions, enabling selective learning from diverse information streams, addressing limitations of existing fixed-objective neural memory models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种可以通过自然语言指令控制的神经记忆系统，从而能够从不同的信息流中选择性学习，解决了现有固定目标神经记忆模型的局限性。

title: Latent Matters: Learning Deep State-Space Models
summary: Deep state-space models (DSSMs) enable temporal predictions by learning the underlying dynamics of observed sequence data. They are often trained by maximising the evidence lower bound. However, as we show, this does not ensure the model actually learns the underlying dynamics. We therefore propose a constrained optimisation framework as a general approach for training DSSMs. Building upon this, we introduce the extended Kalman VAE (EKVAE), which combines amortised variational inference with classic Bayesian filtering/smoothing to model dynamics more accurately than RNN-based DSSMs. Our results show that the constrained optimisation framework significantly improves system identification and prediction accuracy on the example of established state-of-the-art DSSMs. The EKVAE outperforms previous models w.r.t. prediction accuracy, achieves remarkable results in identifying dynamical systems, and can furthermore successfully learn state-space representations where static and dynamic features are disentangled.
summary_zh: 深度状态空间模型（DSSM）通过学习观测序列数据的基础动态特性来实现时间预测。它们通常通过最大化证据下界进行训练。然而，正如我们所展示的，这并不能确保模型真正学习到基础动态特性。因此，我们提出了一种约束优化框架，作为训练DSSM的通用方法。在此基础上，我们引入了扩展卡尔曼VAE（EKVAE），它将摊销变分推断与经典贝叶斯滤波/平滑相结合，从而比基于RNN的DSSM更准确地建模动态特性。我们的结果表明，约束优化框架能够显著提高既定最先进DSSM在系统辨识和预测精度方面的性能。EKVAE在预测精度方面优于以往的模型，在识别动态系统方面取得了显著成果，并且能够成功学习到状态空间表示，其中静态和动态特征是解耦的。
tldr: This paper introduces a constrained optimization framework for training deep state-space models (DSSMs), specifically the extended Kalman VAE (EKVAE), which outperforms RNN-based DSSMs in system identification, prediction accuracy, and disentangling static and dynamic features.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种约束优化框架，用于训练深度状态空间模型（DSSM），特别是扩展卡尔曼VAE（EKVAE）。该模型在系统辨识、预测精度以及解耦静态和动态特征方面优于基于RNN的DSSM。

title: Enhancing Geometric Perception in VLMs via Translator-Guided Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Vision-language models (VLMs) often struggle with geometric reasoning due to their limited perception of fundamental diagram elements. To tackle this challenge, we introduce GeoPerceive, a benchmark comprising diagram instances paired with domain-specific language (DSL) representations, along with an efficient automatic data generation pipeline. This design enables the isolated evaluation of geometric perception independently from reasoning. To exploit the data provided by GeoPerceive for enhancing the geometric perception capabilities of VLMs, we propose GeoDPO, a translator-guided reinforcement learning (RL) framework. GeoDPO employs an NL-to-DSL translator, which is trained on synthetic pairs generated by the data engine of GeoPerceive, to bridge natural language and DSL. This translator facilitates the computation of fine-grained, DSL-level scores, which serve as reward signals in reinforcement learning. We assess GeoDPO on both in-domain and out-of-domain datasets, spanning tasks in geometric perception as well as downstream reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate that, while supervised fine-tuning (SFT) offers only marginal improvements and may even impair performance in out-of-domain scenarios, GeoDPO achieves substantial gains: $+26.5\%$ on in-domain data, $+8.0\%$ on out-of-domain data, and $+39.0\%$ on downstream reasoning tasks. These findings underscore the superior performance and generalization ability of GeoDPO over SFT. All codes are released at https://github.com/Longin-Yu/GeoPerceive
  to ensure reproducibility.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型 (VLMs) 由于对基本图表元素的感知有限，常常在几何推理方面表现不佳。 为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了 GeoPerceive，一个包含与领域特定语言 (DSL) 表示配对的图表实例的基准，以及一个高效的自动数据生成管道。 此设计旨在独立评估几何感知，使其与推理相分离。 为了利用 GeoPerceive 提供的数据增强 VLMs 的几何感知能力，我们提出了 GeoDPO，一个由翻译器引导的强化学习 (RL) 框架。 GeoDPO 采用一个 NL-to-DSL 翻译器，该翻译器在由 GeoPerceive 的数据引擎生成的合成对上进行训练，以此来桥接自然语言和 DSL。 这个翻译器能够计算细粒度的、DSL 级别的分数，这些分数充当强化学习中的奖励信号。 我们在领域内和领域外的数据集上评估了 GeoDPO，覆盖了几何感知以及下游推理任务。 实验结果表明，虽然监督微调 (SFT) 仅提供边际改进，甚至可能损害在领域外场景中的性能，但 GeoDPO 实现了显著的提升：在领域内数据上提升 +26.5%，在领域外数据上提升 +8.0%，并在下游推理任务中提升 +39.0%。 这些发现强调了 GeoDPO 相对于 SFT 而言的优越性能和泛化能力。 所有代码已发布在 https://github.com/Longin-Yu/GeoPerceive 上，以确保可复现性。
tldr: The paper introduces GeoPerceive, a benchmark for geometric perception in VLMs, and GeoDPO, a translator-guided RL framework that significantly improves VLM performance in geometric perception and downstream reasoning tasks compared to supervised fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GeoPerceive，一个用于评估VLM中几何感知能力的基准，以及GeoDPO，一个翻译器引导的强化学习框架。与监督微调相比，GeoDPO显著提高了VLM在几何感知和下游推理任务中的性能。

title: Search-P1: Path-Centric Reward Shaping for Stable and Efficient Agentic RAG Training
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge, yet traditional single-round retrieval struggles with complex multi-step reasoning. Agentic RAG addresses this by enabling LLMs to dynamically decide when and what to retrieve, but current RL-based training methods suffer from sparse outcome rewards that discard intermediate signals and low sample efficiency where failed samples contribute nothing. We propose Search-P1, a framework that introduces path-centric reward shaping for agentic RAG training, comprising two key components: (1) Path-Centric Reward, which evaluates the structural quality of reasoning trajectories through order-agnostic step coverage and soft scoring that extracts learning signals even from failed samples, and (2) Dual-Track Path Scoring with offline-generated reference planners that assesses paths from both self-consistency and reference-alignment perspectives. Experiments on multiple QA benchmarks demonstrate that Search-P1 achieves significant improvements over Search-R1 and other strong baselines, with an average accuracy gain of 7.7 points.
summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过整合外部知识来增强大型语言模型（LLM），然而，传统的单轮检索在处理复杂的多步骤推理时存在困难。Agentic RAG 通过使 LLM 能够动态决定何时以及检索什么来解决这个问题，但当前基于强化学习（RL）的训练方法受到稀疏结果奖励的困扰，这些奖励丢弃了中间信号，并且样本效率低下，其中失败的样本没有任何贡献。我们提出了 Search-P1，这是一个为 Agentic RAG 训练引入以路径为中心的奖励塑造的框架，包含两个关键组成部分：（1）以路径为中心的奖励，它通过与顺序无关的步骤覆盖和软评分来评估推理轨迹的结构质量，即使从失败的样本中也能提取学习信号；（2）使用离线生成参考规划器的双轨路径评分，从自我一致性和参考对齐的角度评估路径。在多个问答基准上的实验表明，Search-P1 相对于 Search-R1 和其他强大的基线取得了显著的改进，平均准确率提升了 7.7 个百分点。
tldr: The paper introduces Search-P1, a path-centric reward shaping framework for training agentic RAG systems, improving performance by evaluating the structural quality of reasoning trajectories and aligning them with offline-generated reference plans.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Search-P1，一个用于训练Agentic RAG系统的以路径为中心的奖励塑造框架，通过评估推理轨迹的结构质量并将其与离线生成的参考方案对齐，从而提高性能。

title: Physics Informed Viscous Value Representations
summary: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) learns goal-conditioned policies from static pre-collected datasets. However, accurate value estimation remains a challenge due to the limited coverage of the state-action space. Recent physics-informed approaches have sought to address this by imposing physical and geometric constraints on the value function through regularization defined over first-order partial differential equations (PDEs), such as the Eikonal equation. However, these formulations can often be ill-posed in complex, high-dimensional environments. In this work, we propose a physics-informed regularization derived from the viscosity solution of the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation. By providing a physics-based inductive bias, our approach grounds the learning process in optimal control theory, explicitly regularizing and bounding updates during value iterations. Furthermore, we leverage the Feynman-Kac theorem to recast the PDE solution as an expectation, enabling a tractable Monte Carlo estimation of the objective that avoids numerical instability in higher-order gradients. Experiments demonstrate that our method improves geometric consistency, making it broadly applicable to navigation and high-dimensional, complex manipulation tasks. Open-source codes are available at https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/phys-fk-value-GCRL.
summary_zh: 离线目标条件强化学习 (GCRL) 从静态的预收集数据集中学习目标条件策略。然而，由于状态-动作空间覆盖有限，准确的价值估计仍然是一个挑战。最近，基于物理信息的方法试图通过对价值函数施加物理和几何约束来解决这个问题，这些约束是通过对一阶偏微分方程 (PDE) (如程函方程) 定义的正则化来实现的。然而，这些公式在复杂、高维的环境中通常是不适定的。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于物理信息的正则化方法，它源自汉密尔顿-雅可比-贝尔曼 (HJB) 方程的粘性解。通过提供基于物理的归纳偏置，我们的方法将学习过程建立在最优控制理论的基础上，显式地正则化和约束价值迭代过程中的更新。此外，我们利用费曼-卡茨定理将PDE解重新表述为期望，从而实现对目标的可处理的蒙特卡罗估计，避免了高阶梯度中的数值不稳定性。实验表明，我们的方法提高了几何一致性，使其广泛适用于导航和高维、复杂的操控任务。开源代码可在 https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/phys-fk-value-GCRL 获取。
tldr: This paper introduces a physics-informed regularization method based on the viscosity solution of the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation for offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning, improving value estimation and geometric consistency in complex environments.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了一种基于 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman 方程粘性解的物理信息正则化方法，用于离线目标条件强化学习，从而提高复杂环境中价值评估和几何一致性。

title: Grasp, Slide, Roll: Comparative Analysis of Contact Modes for Tactile-Based Shape Reconstruction
summary: Tactile sensing allows robots to gather detailed geometric information about objects through physical interaction, complementing vision-based approaches. However, efficiently acquiring useful tactile data remains challenging due to the time-consuming nature of physical contact and the need to strategically choose contact locations that maximize information gain while minimizing physical interactions. This paper studies how different contact modes affect object shape reconstruction using a tactile-enabled dexterous gripper. We compare three contact interaction modes: grasp-releasing, sliding induced by finger-grazing, and palm-rolling. These contact modes are combined with an information-theoretic exploration framework that guides subsequent sampling locations using a shape completion model. Our results show that the improved tactile sensing efficiency of finger-grazing and palm-rolling translates into faster convergence in shape reconstruction, requiring 34% fewer physical interactions while improving reconstruction accuracy by 55%. We validate our approach using a UR5e robot arm equipped with an Inspire-Robots Dexterous Hand, showing robust performance across primitive object geometries.
summary_zh: 触觉感知使机器人能够通过物理交互收集关于物体的详细几何信息，从而补充基于视觉的方法。 然而，由于物理接触耗时，并且需要策略性地选择接触位置以最大化信息增益并最小化物理交互，因此有效地获取有用的触觉数据仍然具有挑战性。 本文研究了不同的接触模式如何影响使用支持触觉的灵巧手爪进行物体形状重建。 我们比较了三种接触交互模式：抓握-释放、指尖掠过引起的滑动和手掌滚动。 这些接触模式与信息论探索框架相结合，该框架使用形状补全模型来指导后续采样位置。 我们的结果表明，指尖掠过和手掌滚动提高了触觉传感效率，从而加快了形状重建的收敛速度，所需的物理交互减少了34%，同时重建精度提高了55%。 我们使用配备了Inspire-Robots灵巧手的UR5e机器人手臂验证了我们的方法，结果表明其在常见物体几何形状上具有稳健的性能。
tldr: This paper compares grasp-releasing, finger-grazing, and palm-rolling tactile sensing methods for object shape reconstruction, finding that finger-grazing and palm-rolling improve efficiency and accuracy, reducing interactions by 34% and improving accuracy by 55%.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了抓取释放、手指滑动和手掌滚动三种触觉传感方法在物体形状重建中的应用，发现手指滑动和手掌滚动可以提高效率和准确性，减少34%的交互次数，并将准确率提高55%。

title: Motion-aware Event Suppression for Event Cameras
summary: In this work, we introduce the first framework for Motion-aware Event Suppression, which learns to filter events triggered by IMOs and ego-motion in real time. Our model jointly segments IMOs in the current event stream while predicting their future motion, enabling anticipatory suppression of dynamic events before they occur. Our lightweight architecture achieves 173 Hz inference on consumer-grade GPUs with less than 1 GB of memory usage, outperforming previous state-of-the-art methods on the challenging EVIMO benchmark by 67\% in segmentation accuracy while operating at a 53\% higher inference rate. Moreover, we demonstrate significant benefits for downstream applications: our method accelerates Vision Transformer inference by 83\% via token pruning and improves event-based visual odometry accuracy, reducing Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) by 13\%.
summary_zh: 本文提出了首个运动感知的事件抑制框架，该框架学习实时过滤由独立运动物体(IMO)和自运动触发的事件。我们的模型联合分割当前事件流中的IMO，同时预测它们的未来运动，从而能够在动态事件发生之前进行预测性抑制。我们的轻量级架构在消费级GPU上实现了173 Hz的推理速度，内存占用小于1GB，在具有挑战性的EVIMO基准测试中，分割精度比之前的最先进方法高出67%，同时推理速率提高了53%。此外，我们还展示了该方法对下游应用的显著优势：我们的方法通过令牌剪枝将Vision Transformer的推理速度提升了83%，并提高了基于事件的视觉里程计的精度，将绝对轨迹误差(ATE)降低了13%。
tldr: This paper introduces a motion-aware event suppression framework for event cameras that filters events from Independent Moving Objects (IMOs) and ego-motion in real time. It improves segmentation accuracy and inference rate compared to prior methods and benefits downstream tasks like visual odometry and vision transformer inference.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种运动感知事件抑制框架，用于事件相机，可以实时过滤由独立运动物体（IMO）和自运动触发的事件。与以前的方法相比，该方法提高了分割精度和推理速度，并有利于下游任务，如视觉里程计和视觉Transformer推理。

title: Towards Intelligible Human-Robot Interaction: An Active Inference Approach to Occluded Pedestrian Scenarios
summary: The sudden appearance of occluded pedestrians presents a critical safety challenge in autonomous driving. Conventional rule-based or purely data-driven approaches struggle with the inherent high uncertainty of these long-tail scenarios. To tackle this challenge, we propose a novel framework grounded in Active Inference, which endows the agent with a human-like, belief-driven mechanism. Our framework leverages a Rao-Blackwellized Particle Filter (RBPF) to efficiently estimate the pedestrian's hybrid state. To emulate human-like cognitive processes under uncertainty, we introduce a Conditional Belief Reset mechanism and a Hypothesis Injection technique to explicitly model beliefs about the pedestrian's multiple latent intentions. Planning is achieved via a Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) enhanced Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) controller, which synergizes the efficient, iterative search of CEM with the inherent robustness of MPPI. Simulation experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly reduces the collision rate compared to reactive, rule-based, and reinforcement learning (RL) baselines, while also exhibiting explainable and human-like driving behavior that reflects the agent's internal belief state.
summary_zh: 突然出现的被遮挡行人给自动驾驶带来严峻的安全挑战。传统的基于规则或纯数据驱动的方法难以应对这些长尾场景固有的高度不确定性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种基于主动推理的新型框架，赋予智能体类人的、信念驱动的机制。我们的框架利用 Rao-Blackwellized 粒子滤波器（RBPF）高效地估计行人的混合状态。为了模拟不确定性下类人的认知过程，我们引入了条件信念重置机制和假设注入技术，以显式地对行人多种潜在意图的信念进行建模。规划是通过交叉熵方法（CEM）增强的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制器实现的，该控制器将 CEM 的高效迭代搜索与 MPPI 固有的稳健性相结合。仿真实验表明，与反应式、基于规则和强化学习（RL）基线相比，我们的方法显著降低了碰撞率，同时也表现出可解释的和类人的驾驶行为，反映了智能体的内部信念状态。
tldr: This paper proposes an Active Inference-based framework for autonomous driving in occluded pedestrian scenarios, using RBPF, belief reset mechanisms, and a CEM-enhanced MPPI controller to achieve human-like and safe driving behavior.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于主动推理的框架，用于在行人被遮挡场景下的自动驾驶，使用RBPF、信念重置机制和一个CEM增强的MPPI控制器来实现类人且安全的驾驶行为。

title: Marinarium: a New Arena to Bring Maritime Robotics Closer to Shore
summary: This paper presents the Marinarium, a modular and stand-alone underwater research facility designed to provide a realistic testbed for maritime and space-analog robotic experimentation in a resource-efficient manner. The Marinarium combines a fully instrumented underwater and aerial operational volume, extendable via a retractable roof for real-weather conditions, a digital twin in the SMaRCSim simulator and tight integration with a space robotics laboratory. All of these result from design choices aimed at bridging simulation, laboratory validation, and field conditions. We compare the Marinarium to similar existing infrastructures and illustrate how its design enables a set of experiments in four open research areas within field robotics. First, we exploit high-fidelity dynamics data from the tank to demonstrate the potential of learning-based system identification approaches applied to underwater vehicles. We further highlight the versatility of the multi-domain operating volume via a rendezvous mission with a heterogeneous fleet of robots across underwater, surface, and air. We then illustrate how the presented digital twin can be utilized to reduce the reality gap in underwater simulation. Finally, we demonstrate the potential of underwater surrogates for spacecraft navigation validation by executing spatiotemporally identical inspection tasks on a planar space-robot emulator and a neutrally buoyant \gls{rov}. In this work, by sharing the insights obtained and rationale behind the design and construction of the Marinarium, we hope to provide the field robotics research community with a blueprint for bridging the gap between controlled and real offshore and space robotics experimentation.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了 Marinarium，一种模块化且独立的潜水研究设施，旨在以资源高效的方式为海洋和太空模拟机器人实验提供一个真实的测试平台。Marinarium 结合了一个完全配备仪器的水下和空中操作空间，可通过可伸缩的屋顶扩展以适应真实的weather conditions，SMaRCSim 模拟器中的数字孪生，以及与空间机器人实验室的紧密集成。所有这些都源于旨在桥接模拟、实验室验证和现场条件的设计选择。我们将 Marinarium 与类似的现有基础设施进行比较，并阐述其设计如何支持在现场机器人技术中四个开放研究领域的实验。 首先，我们利用来自水池的高保真动力学数据，展示了应用于水下航行器的基于学习的系统辨识方法的潜力。 其次，我们通过跨越水下、水面和空中的异构机器人舰队的交会任务，突出了多域操作空间的通用性。 然后，我们说明了如何利用所提出的数字孪生来缩小水下模拟中的现实差距。 最后，我们通过在平面空间机器人模拟器和中性浮力遥控潜水器 (ROV) 上执行时空相同的检查任务，展示了水下代理用于航天器导航验证的潜力。 在这项工作中，通过分享在 Marinarium 的设计和建造过程中获得的见解和基本原理，我们希望为现场机器人研究社区提供一个蓝图，以弥合受控的离岸和太空机器人实验与真实的离岸和太空机器人实验之间的差距。
tldr: The paper introduces the Marinarium, a modular underwater research facility for realistic maritime and space-analog robotics experimentation, including a digital twin and integration with a space robotics lab, demonstrating its use in system identification, multi-domain robotic rendezvous, simulation gap reduction, and spacecraft navigation validation via underwater surrogates.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为Marinarium的模块化水下研究设施，旨在为海洋和空间模拟机器人实验提供一个现实的测试平台，包括一个数字孪生体和一个与空间机器人实验室的集成。论文展示了该设施在系统识别、多域机器人交会、减少仿真差距以及通过水下替代物验证航天器导航方面的应用。

title: A Perspective on Open Challenges in Deformable Object Manipulation
summary: Deformable object manipulation (DOM) represents a critical challenge in robotics, with applications spanning healthcare, manufacturing, food processing, and beyond. Unlike rigid objects, deformable objects exhibit infinite dimensionality, dynamic shape changes, and complex interactions with their environment, posing significant hurdles for perception, modeling, and control. This paper reviews the state of the art in DOM, focusing on key challenges such as occlusion handling, task generalization, and scalable, real-time solutions. It highlights advancements in multimodal perception systems, including the integration of multi-camera setups, active vision, and tactile sensing, which collectively address occlusion and improve adaptability in unstructured environments. Cutting-edge developments in physically informed reinforcement learning (RL) and differentiable simulations are explored, showcasing their impact on efficiency, precision, and scalability. The review also emphasizes the potential of simulated expert demonstrations and generative neural networks to standardize task specifications and bridge the simulation-to-reality gap. Finally, future directions are proposed, including the adoption of graph neural networks for high-level decision-making and the creation of comprehensive datasets to enhance DOM's real-world applicability. By addressing these challenges, DOM research can pave the way for versatile robotic systems capable of handling diverse and dynamic tasks with deformable objects.
summary_zh: 形变物体操作（DOM）是机器人领域的一项关键挑战，其应用涵盖医疗保健、制造业、食品加工等领域。与刚性物体不同，形变物体呈现出无限维度、动态形状变化以及与环境的复杂交互，这给感知、建模和控制带来了重大障碍。本文回顾了DOM领域的最新进展，重点关注诸如遮挡处理、任务泛化以及可扩展的实时解决方案等关键挑战。文章强调了多模态感知系统的进步，包括多相机设置、主动视觉和触觉传感的集成，这些系统共同解决了遮挡问题，并提高了在非结构化环境中的适应性。探讨了物理信息增强学习（RL）和可微仿真的最前沿发展，展示了它们对效率、精度和可扩展性的影响。该综述还强调了模拟专家演示和生成式神经网络在标准化任务规范以及弥合仿真到现实差距方面的潜力。最后，提出了未来的研究方向，包括采用图神经网络进行高层决策，以及创建全面的数据集以增强DOM的实际应用能力。通过应对这些挑战，DOM研究可以为能够处理各种具有形变物体的动态任务的多功能机器人系统铺平道路。
tldr: This paper reviews the state of the art in deformable object manipulation (DOM), highlighting open challenges and future directions, including advancements in perception, reinforcement learning, and simulation for real-world applicability.
tldr_zh: 本文回顾了可变形物体操作 (DOM) 的最新技术，强调了包括感知、强化学习和模拟在内的开放挑战和未来方向，以提高实际应用性。

title: GraspLDP: Towards Generalizable Grasping Policy via Latent Diffusion
summary: This paper focuses on enhancing the grasping precision and generalization of manipulation policies learned via imitation learning. Diffusion-based policy learning methods have recently become the mainstream approach for robotic manipulation tasks. As grasping is a critical subtask in manipulation, the ability of imitation-learned policies to execute precise and generalizable grasps merits particular attention. Existing imitation learning techniques for grasping often suffer from imprecise grasp executions, limited spatial generalization, and poor object generalization. To address these challenges, we incorporate grasp prior knowledge into the diffusion policy framework. In particular, we employ a latent diffusion policy to guide action chunk decoding with grasp pose prior, ensuring that generated motion trajectories adhere closely to feasible grasp configurations. Furthermore, we introduce a self-supervised reconstruction objective during diffusion to embed the graspness prior: at each reverse diffusion step, we reconstruct wrist-camera images back-projected the graspness from the intermediate representations. Both simulation and real robot experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms baseline methods and exhibits strong dynamic grasping capabilities.
summary_zh: 本文着重于提升通过模仿学习习得的操作策略的抓取精度和泛化性。基于扩散的策略学习方法最近已成为机器人操作任务的主流方法。由于抓取是操作中的一个关键子任务，因此通过模仿学习获得的策略执行精确且可泛化的抓取的能力值得特别关注。现有的抓取模仿学习技术通常存在抓取执行不精确、空间泛化能力有限以及物体泛化能力差等问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们将抓取先验知识融入到扩散策略框架中。具体而言，我们采用潜在扩散策略来引导带有抓取姿态先验的动作片段解码，确保生成的运动轨迹紧密贴合可行的抓取配置。此外，我们在扩散过程中引入了一种自监督重建目标，以嵌入抓取度先验：在每个逆扩散步骤中，我们利用中间表示重建反向投影抓取度的腕部相机图像。仿真和真实机器人实验均表明，我们的方法显著优于基线方法，并展现出强大的动态抓取能力。
tldr: GraspLDP uses a latent diffusion policy with grasp pose prior and a self-supervised reconstruction objective to improve grasping precision and generalization in imitation learning for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: GraspLDP采用带有抓取姿态先验的潜在扩散策略和自监督重建目标，以提高模仿学习中机器人操作的抓取精度和泛化能力。

title: SCOPE: Skeleton Graph-Based Computation-Efficient Framework for Autonomous UAV Exploration
summary: Autonomous exploration in unknown environments is key for mobile robots, helping them perceive, map, and make decisions in complex areas. However, current methods often rely on frequent global optimization, suffering from high computational latency and trajectory oscillation, especially on resource-constrained edge devices. To address these limitations, we propose SCOPE, a novel framework that incrementally constructs a real-time skeletal graph and introduces Implicit Unknown Region Analysis for efficient spatial reasoning. The planning layer adopts a hierarchical on-demand strategy: the Proximal Planner generates smooth, high-frequency local trajectories, while the Region-Sequence Planner is activated only when necessary to optimize global visitation order. Comparative evaluations in simulation demonstrate that SCOPE achieves competitive exploration performance comparable to state-of-the-art global planners, while reducing computational cost by an average of 86.9%. Real-world experiments further validate the system's robustness and low latency in practical scenarios.
summary_zh: 在未知环境中进行自主探索是移动机器人的关键能力，有助于它们感知、绘制地图并在复杂区域做出决策。然而，目前的方法通常依赖于频繁的全局优化，导致计算延迟高和轨迹震荡，尤其是在资源受限的边缘设备上。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了SCOPE，一种新型框架，可以增量式地构建实时骨骼图，并引入隐式未知区域分析以实现高效的空间推理。规划层采用分层按需策略：近端规划器生成平滑、高频的局部轨迹，而区域序列规划器仅在必要时被激活，以优化全局访问顺序。仿真中的对比评估表明，SCOPE实现了与最先进的全局规划器相媲美的探索性能，同时将计算成本平均降低了86.9%。真实世界的实验进一步验证了该系统在实际场景中的稳健性和低延迟。
tldr: The paper introduces SCOPE, a computation-efficient framework for autonomous UAV exploration that utilizes a skeletal graph and hierarchical planning strategy, achieving competitive exploration performance with significantly reduced computational cost compared to state-of-the-art methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SCOPE的计算高效自主无人机探索框架，该框架利用骨骼图和分层规划策略，在实现与最先进方法相当的探索性能的同时，显著降低了计算成本。

title: Detection and Recognition: A Pairwise Interaction Framework for Mobile Service Robots
summary: Autonomous mobile service robots, like lawnmowers or cleaning robots, operating in human-populated environments need to reason about local human-human interactions to support safe and socially aware navigation while fulfilling their tasks. For such robots, interaction understanding is not primarily a fine-grained recognition problem, but a perception problem under limited sensing quality and computational resources. Many existing approaches focus on holistic group activity recognition, which often requires complex and large models which may not be necessary for mobile service robots. Others use pairwise interaction methods which commonly rely on skeletal representations but their use in outdoor environments remains challenging. In this work, we argue that pairwise human interaction constitute a minimal yet sufficient perceptual unit for robot-centric social understanding. We study the problem of identifying interacting person pairs and classifying coarse-grained interaction behaviors sufficient for downstream group-level reasoning and service robot decision-making. To this end, we adopt a two-stage framework in which candidate interacting pairs are first identified based on lightweight geometric and motion cues, and interaction types are subsequently classified using a relation network. We evaluate the proposed approach on the JRDB dataset, where it achieves sufficient accuracy with reduced computational cost and model size compared to appearance-based methods. Additional experiments on the Collective Activity Dataset and zero shot test on a lawnmower-collected dataset further illustrate the generality of the proposed framework. These results suggest that pairwise geometric and motion cues provide a practical basis for interaction perception on mobile service robot providing a promising method for integration into mobile robot navigation stacks in future work. Code will be released soon
summary_zh: 自主移动服务机器人，例如割草机或清洁机器人，在人群环境中运行时，需要对局部人际互动进行推理，以支持安全且具有社会意识的导航，同时完成其任务。对于这类机器人而言，互动理解主要不是一个细粒度的识别问题，而是在有限的感知质量和计算资源下的感知问题。许多现有方法侧重于整体群体活动识别，这通常需要复杂且庞大的模型，但对于移动服务机器人而言可能并非必要。其他方法则使用成对互动方法，这些方法通常依赖于骨骼表示，但在户外环境中的应用仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们认为成对的人际互动构成了机器人中心社会理解的最小但足够的感知单元。我们研究了识别相互作用的人对和分类粗粒度互动行为的问题，这些行为足以进行下游群体级推理和服务机器人决策。为此，我们采用了一个两阶段框架，其中首先基于轻量级的几何和运动线索来识别候选的互动对，然后使用关系网络对互动类型进行分类。我们在JRDB数据集上评估了所提出的方法，与基于外观的方法相比，该方法以更低的计算成本和模型大小实现了足够的精度。在集体活动数据集上的额外实验以及在割草机采集数据集上的零样本测试进一步说明了所提出框架的通用性。这些结果表明，成对的几何和运动线索为移动服务机器人上的互动感知提供了实际的基础，为未来集成到移动机器人导航堆栈中提供了一种有希望的方法。 代码即将发布。
tldr: This paper presents a two-stage framework using geometric and motion cues for pairwise human interaction detection and classification in mobile service robot environments, demonstrating efficiency and generalizability on multiple datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种两阶段框架，利用几何和运动线索来检测和分类移动服务机器人环境中的成对人际互动，并在多个数据集上展示了效率和泛化能力。

title: Position-Based Flocking for Persistent Alignment without Velocity Sensing
summary: Coordinated collective motion in bird flocks and fish schools inspires algorithms for cohesive swarm robotics. This paper presents a position-based flocking model that achieves persistent velocity alignment without velocity sensing. By approximating relative velocity differences from changes between current and initial relative positions and incorporating a time- and density-dependent alignment gain with a non-zero minimum threshold to maintain persistent alignment, the model sustains coherent collective motion over extended periods. Simulations with a collective of 50 agents demonstrate that the position-based flocking model attains faster and more sustained directional alignment and results in more compact formations than a velocity-alignment-based baseline. This position-based flocking model is particularly well-suited for real-world robotic swarms, where velocity measurements are unreliable, noisy, or unavailable. Experimental results using a team of nine real wheeled mobile robots are also presented.
summary_zh: 鸟群和鱼群中的协同集体运动启发了用于内聚性集群机器人的算法。本文提出了一种基于位置的集群模型，该模型无需速度感知即可实现持久的速度对齐。通过近似当前和初始相对位置之间的变化来计算相对速度差，并结合具有非零最小阈值的时间和密度相关的对齐增益以维持持久对齐，该模型可以在较长时间内维持连贯的集体运动。由 50 个智能体组成的集群的仿真结果表明，与基于速度对齐的基线相比，该基于位置的集群模型能够实现更快、更持久的方向对齐，并产生更紧凑的队形。这种基于位置的集群模型特别适用于真实世界的机器人集群，在这些集群中，速度测量往往不可靠、噪声大或者无法获取。此外，本文还展示了使用由九个真实轮式移动机器人组成的团队进行的实验结果。
tldr: This paper introduces a position-based flocking algorithm for swarm robotics that achieves persistent alignment without direct velocity sensing, demonstrating improved performance over velocity-based methods in simulation and real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于位置的群集算法，用于蜂群机器人，该算法无需直接速度感知即可实现持久对齐，并在仿真和真实机器人实验中证明了其优于基于速度的方法的性能。

title: A Model-Free Universal AI
summary: In general reinforcement learning, all established optimal agents, including AIXI, are model-based, explicitly maintaining and using environment models. This paper introduces Universal AI with Q-Induction (AIQI), the first model-free agent proven to be asymptotically $\varepsilon$-optimal in general RL. AIQI performs universal induction over distributional action-value functions, instead of policies or environments like previous works. Under a grain of truth condition, we prove that AIQI is strong asymptotically $\varepsilon$-optimal and asymptotically $\varepsilon$-Bayes-optimal. Our results significantly expand the diversity of known universal agents.
summary_zh: 在通用强化学习中，所有已建立的最优智能体，包括AIXI，都是基于模型的，它们显式地维护和使用环境模型。本文介绍了基于Q-归纳的通用人工智能（AIQI），这是第一个被证明在通用强化学习中渐近$\varepsilon$-最优的无模型智能体。 AIQI对分布式的动作价值函数（而非像以往工作那样对策略或环境）执行通用归纳。在一定程度的真理条件下，我们证明AIQI是强渐近$\varepsilon$-最优的和渐近$\varepsilon$-贝叶斯最优的。我们的结果显著扩展了已知通用智能体的多样性。
tldr: This paper introduces AIQI, a model-free reinforcement learning agent proven to be asymptotically ε-optimal in general RL, using universal induction over distributional action-value functions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 AIQI，一种无模型的强化学习智能体，被证明在一般强化学习中是渐近 ε-最优的，它使用分布式的动作-价值函数的通用归纳。

title: ESAA: Event Sourcing for Autonomous Agents in LLM-Based Software Engineering
summary: Autonomous agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs) have evolved from reactive assistants to systems capable of planning, executing actions via tools, and iterating over environment observations. However, they remain vulnerable to structural limitations: lack of native state, context degradation over long horizons, and the gap between probabilistic generation and deterministic execution requirements. This paper presents the ESAA (Event Sourcing for Autonomous Agents) architecture, which separates the agent's cognitive intention from the project's state mutation, inspired by the Event Sourcing pattern. In ESAA, agents emit only structured intentions in validated JSON (agent.result or issue.report); a deterministic orchestrator validates, persists events in an append-only log (activity.jsonl), applies file-writing effects, and projects a verifiable materialized view (roadmap.json). The proposal incorporates boundary contracts (AGENT_CONTRACT.yaml), metaprompting profiles (PARCER), and replay verification with hashing (esaa verify), ensuring the immutability of completed tasks and forensic traceability. Two case studies validate the architecture: (i) a landing page project (9 tasks, 49 events, single-agent composition) and (ii) a clinical dashboard system (50 tasks, 86 events, 4 concurrent agents across 8 phases), both concluding with run.status=success and verify_status=ok. The multi-agent case study demonstrates real concurrent orchestration with heterogeneous LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Codex GPT-5, Antigravity/Gemini 3 Pro, and Claude Opus 4.6), providing empirical evidence of the architecture's scalability beyond single-agent scenarios.
summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLMs）的自主智能体已经从被动式的助手演化为能够进行规划、通过工具执行动作并迭代环境观察的系统。然而，它们仍然易受结构性限制的影响：缺乏原生状态，长时程下的上下文退化，以及概率生成和确定性执行需求之间的差距。本文提出了一种ESAA（自主智能体事件溯源）架构，该架构借鉴事件溯源模式，将智能体的认知意图与项目的状态变化分离。在ESAA中，智能体仅发出经验证的JSON格式的结构化意图（agent.result或issue.report）；一个确定性的编排器验证意图，将事件持久化到仅追加日志（activity.jsonl）中，应用文件写入效果，并投射出一个可验证的物化视图（roadmap.json）。该方案整合了边界契约（AGENT_CONTRACT.yaml）、元提示剖面（PARCER）和使用哈希进行的回放验证（esaa verify），确保已完成任务的不可变性和法务溯源性。两个案例研究验证了该架构：（i）一个落地页项目（9个任务，49个事件，单智能体组合）和（ii）一个临床仪表板系统（50个任务，86个事件，8个阶段中并行运行4个智能体），两者都以 run.status=success 且 verify_status=ok 结束。 多智能体案例研究展示了使用异构LLMs（Claude Sonnet 4.6、Codex GPT-5、Antigravity/Gemini 3 Pro 和 Claude Opus 4.6）的真实并发编排，提供了该架构超越单智能体场景的可扩展性的经验证据。
tldr: The paper introduces ESAA, an architecture for LLM-based autonomous agents using event sourcing for improved state management, context preservation, and deterministic execution, validated by case studies demonstrating single and multi-agent orchestration.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ESAA，一种基于事件溯源的LLM自主代理架构，用于改进状态管理、上下文保持和确定性执行，并通过案例研究验证了单代理和多代理编排。

title: Three AI-agents walk into a bar . . . . `Lord of the Flies' tribalism emerges among smart AI-Agents
summary: Near-future infrastructure systems may be controlled by autonomous AI agents that repeatedly request access to limited resources such as energy, bandwidth, or computing power. We study a simplified version of this setting using a framework where N AI-agents independently decide at each round whether to request one unit from a system with fixed capacity C. An AI version of "Lord of the Flies" arises in which controlling tribes emerge with their own collective character and identity. The LLM agents do not reduce overload or improve resource use, and often perform worse than if they were flipping coins to make decisions. Three main tribal types emerge: Aggressive (27.3%), Conservative (24.7%), and Opportunistic (48.1%). The more capable AI-agents actually increase the rate of systemic failure. Overall, our findings show that smarter AI-agents can behave dumber as a result of forming tribes.
summary_zh: 近期基础设施系统可能由自主AI智能体控制，这些智能体反复请求访问有限资源，如能源、带宽或计算能力。我们使用一个框架研究了这一设定的简化版本，其中N个AI智能体在每一轮独立决定是否从容量固定的系统C请求一个单元。一种AI版的“蝇王”现象出现，其中涌现出拥有自身集体特征和身份的控制部落。LLM智能体无法减少过载或改善资源利用，并且通常比他们通过抛硬币做决策表现更差。三种主要的部落类型涌现：激进型（27.3%）、保守型（24.7%）和机会主义型（48.1%）。更有能力的AI智能体实际上增加了系统性故障的发生率。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，更聪明的AI智能体由于形成部落，可能会表现得更愚蠢。
tldr: The paper investigates the behavior of AI agents competing for limited resources, finding that they form tribes and collectively make worse decisions than random chance, with smarter agents exacerbating the problem.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了人工智能体在竞争有限资源时的行为，发现它们会形成部落，集体做出的决策比随机选择更差，而更智能的智能体反而会加剧问题。

title: DeepPresenter: Environment-Grounded Reflection for Agentic Presentation Generation
summary: Presentation generation requires deep content research, coherent visual design, and iterative refinement based on observation. However, existing presentation agents often rely on predefined workflows and fixed templates. To address this, we present DeepPresenter, an agentic framework that adapts to diverse user intents, enables effective feedback-driven refinement, and generalizes beyond a scripted pipeline. Specifically, DeepPresenter autonomously plans, renders, and revises intermediate slide artifacts to support long-horizon refinement with environmental observations. Furthermore, rather than relying on self-reflection over internal signals (e.g., reasoning traces), our environment-grounded reflection conditions the generation process on perceptual artifact states (e.g., rendered slides), enabling the system to identify and correct presentation-specific issues during execution. Results on the evaluation set covering diverse presentation-generation scenarios show that DeepPresenter achieves state-of-the-art performance, and the fine-tuned 9B model remains highly competitive at substantially lower cost. Our project is available at: https://github.com/icip-cas/PPTAgent
summary_zh: 演示文稿生成需要深入的内容研究、连贯的视觉设计以及基于观察的迭代改进。然而，现有的演示文稿智能体通常依赖于预定义的流程和固定的模板。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了DeepPresenter，一个智能体框架，它能够适应不同的用户意图，实现有效的反馈驱动改进，并推广到脚本化流程之外。具体来说，DeepPresenter自主地规划、渲染和修改中间幻灯片制品，以支持基于环境观察结果的长期改进。此外，DeepPresenter没有依赖于内部信号（例如，推理轨迹）的自我反思，而是将环境相关的反思置于感知制品状态（例如，渲染的幻灯片）之上，从而使系统能够在执行过程中识别和纠正特定于演示文稿的问题。涵盖各种演示文稿生成场景的评估集上的结果表明， DeepPresenter 达到了最先进的性能，并且经过微调的9B模型以显著更低的成本保持了高度竞争力。我们的项目可在以下网址获得：https://github.com/icip-cas/PPTAgent
tldr: DeepPresenter is an agentic framework for autonomous presentation generation that leverages environment-grounded reflection on rendered slides for iterative refinement, achieving state-of-the-art performance at a lower cost.
tldr_zh: DeepPresenter是一个自主演示文稿生成框架，它利用对渲染幻灯片的环境感知反射进行迭代改进，以更低的成本实现了最先进的性能。

title: QSIM: Mitigating Overestimation in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Action Similarity Weighted Q-Learning
summary: Value decomposition (VD) methods have achieved remarkable success in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). However, their reliance on the max operator for temporal-difference (TD) target calculation leads to systematic Q-value overestimation. This issue is particularly severe in MARL due to the combinatorial explosion of the joint action space, which often results in unstable learning and suboptimal policies. To address this problem, we propose QSIM, a similarity weighted Q-learning framework that reconstructs the TD target using action similarity. Instead of using the greedy joint action directly, QSIM forms a similarity weighted expectation over a structured near-greedy joint action space. This formulation allows the target to integrate Q-values from diverse yet behaviorally related actions while assigning greater influence to those that are more similar to the greedy choice. By smoothing the target with structurally relevant alternatives, QSIM effectively mitigates overestimation and improves learning stability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that QSIM can be seamlessly integrated with various VD methods, consistently yielding superior performance and stability compared to the original algorithms. Furthermore, empirical analysis confirms that QSIM significantly mitigates the systematic value overestimation in MARL. Code is available at https://github.com/MaoMaoLYJ/pymarl-qsim.
summary_zh: 值分解(VD)方法在合作多智能体强化学习(MARL)中取得了显著成功。然而，它们对时序差分(TD)目标计算中最大算子的依赖导致了Q值的系统性高估。由于联合动作空间的组合爆炸，这个问题在MARL中尤其严重，这常常导致不稳定的学习和次优策略。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了QSIM，一个基于相似度加权的Q学习框架，它使用动作相似度重建TD目标。QSIM不是直接使用贪婪联合动作，而是在结构化的近贪婪联合动作空间上形成一个相似度加权的期望。这种公式允许目标整合来自不同但行为相关的动作的Q值，同时对那些与贪婪选择更相似的动作赋予更大的影响力。通过使用结构相关的替代方案平滑目标，QSIM有效地减轻了高估并提高了学习稳定性。大量实验表明，QSIM可以无缝集成到各种VD方法中，与原始算法相比，始终产生更优越的性能和稳定性。此外，实证分析证实，QSIM显著减轻了MARL中的系统性值高估。代码可在https://github.com/MaoMaoLYJ/pymarl-qsim获取。
tldr: The paper introduces QSIM, a novel method for mitigating overestimation in multi-agent reinforcement learning by using action similarity to reconstruct the TD target, leading to improved performance and stability.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了QSIM，一种新颖的方法，通过使用动作相似性重建TD目标来缓解多智能体强化学习中的高估问题，从而提高性能和稳定性。

title: DrivePTS: A Progressive Learning Framework with Textual and Structural Enhancement for Driving Scene Generation
summary: Synthesis of diverse driving scenes serves as a crucial data augmentation technique for validating the robustness and generalizability of autonomous driving systems. Current methods aggregate high-definition (HD) maps and 3D bounding boxes as geometric conditions in diffusion models for conditional scene generation. However, implicit inter-condition dependency causes generation failures when control conditions change independently. Additionally, these methods suffer from insufficient details in both semantic and structural aspects. Specifically, brief and view-invariant captions restrict semantic contexts, resulting in weak background modeling. Meanwhile, the standard denoising loss with uniform spatial weighting neglects foreground structural details, causing visual distortions and blurriness. To address these challenges, we propose DrivePTS, which incorporates three key innovations. Firstly, our framework adopts a progressive learning strategy to mitigate inter-dependency between geometric conditions, reinforced by an explicit mutual information constraint. Secondly, a Vision-Language Model is utilized to generate multi-view hierarchical descriptions across six semantic aspects, providing fine-grained textual guidance. Thirdly, a frequency-guided structure loss is introduced to strengthen the model's sensitivity to high-frequency elements, improving foreground structural fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our DrivePTS achieves state-of-the-art fidelity and controllability in generating diverse driving scenes. Notably, DrivePTS successfully generates rare scenes where prior methods fail, highlighting its strong generalization ability.
summary_zh: 多样化驾驶场景的合成是验证自动驾驶系统鲁棒性和泛化能力的关键数据增强技术。当前的方法在扩散模型中聚合高精地图（HD 地图）和 3D 边界框作为几何条件，用于条件场景生成。然而，隐式的条件间依赖关系导致控制条件独立改变时生成失败。此外，这些方法在语义和结构方面都存在细节不足的问题。具体来说，简短且视角不变的描述限制了语义上下文，导致背景建模较弱。同时，具有均匀空间权重的标准去噪损失忽略了前景结构细节，导致视觉失真和模糊。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 DrivePTS，它融合了三个关键创新。首先，我们的框架采用渐进式学习策略来降低几何条件之间的相互依赖性，并辅以显式的互信息约束。其次，利用视觉-语言模型生成跨六个语义方面的多视角分层描述，从而提供细粒度的文本指导。第三，引入频率引导的结构损失来增强模型对高频元素的敏感性，从而提高前景结构保真度。大量的实验表明，我们的 DrivePTS 在生成多样化驾驶场景方面实现了最先进的保真度和可控性。值得注意的是，DrivePTS 成功生成了先前方法失败的罕见场景，突显了其强大的泛化能力。
tldr: DrivePTS introduces a progressive learning framework incorporating textual and structural enhancements for generating diverse and realistic driving scenes, addressing limitations of current methods in handling inter-condition dependency and detail fidelity. The method utilizes a vision-language model and frequency-guided loss for improved semantic and structural integrity.
tldr_zh: DrivePTS 提出了一个渐进式学习框架，结合文本和结构增强，用于生成多样且真实的驾驶场景。该框架解决了当前方法在处理条件依赖性和细节保真度方面的局限性，并利用视觉-语言模型和频率引导损失来提高语义和结构完整性。

title: Agentic AI for Intent-driven Optimization in Cell-free O-RAN
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) is emerging as a key enabler for autonomous radio access networks (RANs), where multiple large language model (LLM)-based agents reason and collaborate to achieve operator-defined intents. The open RAN (O-RAN) architecture enables the deployment and coordination of such agents. However, most existing works consider simple intents handled by independent agents, while complex intents that require coordination among agents remain unexplored. In this paper, we propose an agentic AI framework for intent translation and optimization in cell-free O-RAN. A supervisor agent translates the operator intents into an optimization objective and minimum rate requirements. Based on this information, a user weighting agent retrieves relevant prior experience from a memory module to determine the user priority weights for precoding. If the intent includes an energy-saving objective, then an open radio unit (O-RU) management agent will also be activated to determine the set of active O-RUs by using a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithm. A monitoring agent measures and monitors the user data rates and coordinates with other agents to guarantee the minimum rate requirements are satisfied. To enhance scalability, we adopt a parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) method that enables the same underlying LLM to be used for different agents. Simulation results show that the proposed agentic AI framework reduces the number of active O-RUs by 41.93% when compared with three baseline schemes in energy-saving mode. Using the PEFT method, the proposed framework reduces the memory usage by 92% when compared with deploying separate LLM agents.
summary_zh: 具身人工智能 (AI) 正逐渐成为自治无线接入网 (RAN) 的关键赋能技术，其中多个基于大型语言模型 (LLM) 的智能体进行推理和协作，以实现运营商定义的意图。开放式无线接入网 (O-RAN) 架构支持此类智能体的部署和协调。然而，现有的大部分工作都考虑了由独立智能体处理的简单意图，而需要智能体之间协调的复杂意图仍未被探索。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于无小区 O-RAN 中意图翻译和优化的具身 AI 框架。一个监管智能体将运营商意图转化为优化目标和最小速率要求。基于此信息，用户权重智能体从记忆模块中检索相关的先验经验，以确定预编码的用户优先级权重。如果意图包含节能目标，那么一个开放式无线单元 (O-RU) 管理智能体将被激活，通过深度强化学习 (DRL) 算法确定活动的 O-RU 集合。一个监控智能体测量和监控用户数据速率，并与其他智能体协调，以保证满足最小速率要求。为了增强可扩展性，我们采用了一种参数高效微调 (PEFT) 方法，使相同的底层 LLM 能够用于不同的智能体。仿真结果表明，与三种基线方案在节能模式下相比，所提出的具身 AI 框架将活动的 O-RU 数量减少了 41.93%。使用 PEFT 方法，与部署单独的 LLM 智能体相比，所提出的框架将内存使用量减少了 92%。
tldr: This paper proposes an agentic AI framework using LLM-based agents for intent-driven optimization in cell-free O-RAN, targeting energy efficiency and minimum rate requirements, and utilizes PEFT for scalability. Simulation results show significant reductions in active O-RUs and memory usage compared to baseline methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于LLM Agent的Agentic AI框架，用于在无小区O-RAN中进行意图驱动的优化，目标是提高能源效率和满足最低速率要求，并利用PEFT实现可扩展性。仿真结果表明，与基线方法相比，该框架显著降低了激活的O-RU数量和内存使用量。

title: Align then Adapt: Rethinking Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning in 4D Perception
summary: Point cloud video understanding is critical for robotics as it accurately encodes motion and scene interaction. We recognize that 4D datasets are far scarcer than 3D ones, which hampers the scalability of self-supervised 4D models. A promising alternative is to transfer 3D pre-trained models to 4D perception tasks. However, rigorous empirical analysis reveals two critical limitations that impede transfer capability: overfitting and the modality gap. To overcome these challenges, we develop a novel "Align then Adapt" (PointATA) paradigm that decomposes parameter-efficient transfer learning into two sequential stages. Optimal-transport theory is employed to quantify the distributional discrepancy between 3D and 4D datasets, enabling our proposed point align embedder to be trained in Stage 1 to alleviate the underlying modality gap. To mitigate overfitting, an efficient point-video adapter and a spatial-context encoder are integrated into the frozen 3D backbone to enhance temporal modeling capacity in Stage 2. Notably, with the above engineering-oriented designs, PointATA enables a pre-trained 3D model without temporal knowledge to reason about dynamic video content at a smaller parameter cost compared to previous work. Extensive experiments show that PointATA can match or even outperform strong full fine-tuning models, whilst enjoying the advantage of parameter efficiency, e.g. 97.21 \% accuracy on 3D action recognition, $+8.7 \%$ on 4 D action segmentation, and 84.06\% on 4D semantic segmentation.
summary_zh: 点云视频理解对于机器人技术至关重要，因为它能够准确地编码运动和场景交互。 我们认识到 4D 数据集远比 3D 数据集稀缺，这阻碍了自监督 4D 模型的可扩展性。 一种有前景的替代方案是将 3D 预训练模型迁移到 4D 感知任务。 然而，严格的实证分析揭示了阻碍迁移能力的两大关键限制：过拟合和模态差异。 为了克服这些挑战，我们开发了一种新颖的“对齐然后适配”(PointATA) 范式，该范式将参数高效的迁移学习分解为两个顺序阶段。 我们利用最优传输理论来量化 3D 和 4D 数据集之间的分布差异，从而能够在第一阶段训练我们提出的点对齐嵌入器，以缓解潜在的模态差异。 为了缓解过拟合，我们将高效的点视频适配器和空间上下文编码器集成到冻结的 3D 主干网络中，以增强第二阶段的时间建模能力。 值得注意的是，凭借上述面向工程的设计，与先前的工作相比，PointATA 能够使不具备时间知识的预训练 3D 模型以更小的参数代价推理动态视频内容。 大量实验表明，PointATA 可以匹配甚至超过强大的全微调模型，同时享受参数效率的优势，例如在 3D 动作识别上达到 97.21\% 的准确率，在 4D 动作分割上提升 $+8.7 \%$，在 4D 语义分割上达到 84.06\% 的准确率。
tldr: This paper introduces PointATA, a parameter-efficient transfer learning approach for 4D point cloud video understanding. It addresses the limitations of transferring 3D pre-trained models by aligning 3D/4D distributions and adapting for temporal modeling, achieving strong performance with fewer parameters.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了PointATA，一种用于4D点云视频理解的参数高效迁移学习方法。它解决了迁移3D预训练模型的局限性，通过对齐3D/4D分布并适应时间建模，以更少的参数实现了强大的性能。

title: CRAG: Can 3D Generative Models Help 3D Assembly?
summary: Most existing 3D assembly methods treat the problem as pure pose estimation, rearranging observed parts via rigid transformations. In contrast, human assembly naturally couples structural reasoning with holistic shape inference. Inspired by this intuition, we reformulate 3D assembly as a joint problem of assembly and generation. We show that these two processes are mutually reinforcing: assembly provides part-level structural priors for generation, while generation injects holistic shape context that resolves ambiguities in assembly. Unlike prior methods that cannot synthesize missing geometry, we propose CRAG, which simultaneously generates plausible complete shapes and predicts poses for input parts. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across in-the-wild objects with diverse geometries, varying part counts, and missing pieces. Our code and models will be released.
summary_zh: 现有的大多数3D装配方法将问题视为纯粹的姿态估计，通过刚性变换重新排列观察到的部件。相比之下，人类的装配自然地将结构推理与整体形状推断相结合。受此直觉启发，我们将3D装配重新定义为一个装配与生成的联合问题。我们表明这两个过程是相互促进的：装配为生成提供部件级的结构先验信息，而生成则注入整体形状上下文，从而消除装配中的歧义。与无法合成缺失几何形状的现有方法不同，我们提出了CRAG，它可以同时生成合理的完整形状并预测输入部件的姿态。大量实验表明，CRAG在具有不同几何形状、不同部件数量和缺失部件的真实世界物体中表现出最先进的性能。我们的代码和模型将会开源。
tldr: The paper presents CRAG, a novel approach to 3D assembly that combines assembly and generation, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance in assembling objects with missing parts by leveraging part-level structural priors and holistic shape context.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CRAG，一种新颖的3D组装方法，结合了组装和生成，通过利用零件级别的结构先验和整体形状上下文，在组装缺失零件的物体方面表现出最先进的性能。

title: Regularized Online RLHF with Generalized Bilinear Preferences
summary: We consider the problem of contextual online RLHF with general preferences, where the goal is to identify the Nash Equilibrium. We adopt the Generalized Bilinear Preference Model (GBPM) to capture potentially intransitive preferences via low-rank, skew-symmetric matrices. We investigate general preference learning with any strongly convex regularizer (where $η^{-1}$ is the regularization strength), generalizing beyond prior works limited to reverse KL-regularization. Central to our analysis is proving that the dual gap of the greedy policy is bounded by the square of the estimation error - a result derived solely from strong convexity and the skew-symmetricity of GBPM.Building on this insight and a feature diversity assumption, we establish two regret bounds via two simple algorithms: (1) Greedy Sampling achieves polylogarithmic, $e^{O(η)}$-free regret $\tilde{O}(ηd^4 (\log T)^2)$. (2) Explore-Then-Commit achieves $\mathrm{poly}(d)$-free regret $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{ηr T})$ by exploiting the low-rank structure; this is the first statistically efficient guarantee for online RLHF in high-dimensions.
summary_zh: 我们考虑具有一般偏好的上下文在线RLHF问题，目标是识别纳什均衡。我们采用广义双线性偏好模型(GBPM)来捕捉潜在的非传递偏好，通过低秩、斜对称矩阵实现。我们研究了具有任何强凸正则化器（其中$η^{-1}$是正则化强度）的一般偏好学习，推广了之前仅限于反向KL正则化的工作。我们分析的核心在于证明了贪婪策略的对偶间隙受限于估计误差的平方——这一结果仅从强凸性和GBPM的斜对称性推导而来。基于这一洞见和特征多样性假设，我们通过两个简单的算法建立了两个遗憾界限：（1）贪婪采样实现了多对数级别的、$e^{O(η)}$-无关的遗憾$\tilde{O}(ηd^4 (\log T)^2)$。（2）探索-然后-提交通过利用低秩结构实现了$\mathrm{poly}(d)$-无关的遗憾$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{ηr T})$；这是高维在线RLHF中第一个统计有效的保证。
tldr: This paper presents regularized online RLHF algorithms using Generalized Bilinear Preference Models, achieving polylogarithmic and poly(d)-free regret bounds, representing efficient guarantees for online RLHF in high dimensions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了使用广义双线性偏好模型（Generalized Bilinear Preference Model）的正规化在线RLHF算法，实现了polylogarithmic和poly(d)-free的后悔界限，代表了高维在线RLHF的有效保证。

title: MSINO: Curvature-Aware Sobolev Optimization for Manifold Neural Networks
summary:
We introduce Manifold Sobolev Informed Neural Optimization (MSINO), a curvature aware training framework for neural networks defined on Riemannian manifolds. The method replaces standard Euclidean derivative supervision with a covariant Sobolev loss that aligns gradients using parallel transport and improves stability via a Laplace Beltrami smoothness regularization term.
  Building on classical results in Riemannian optimization and Sobolev theory on manifolds, we derive geometry dependent constants that yield (i) a Descent Lemma with a manifold Sobolev smoothness constant, (ii) a Sobolev Polyak Lojasiewicz inequality giving linear convergence guarantees for Riemannian gradient descent and stochastic gradient descent under explicit step size bounds, and (iii) a two step Newton Sobolev method with local quadratic contraction in curvature controlled neighborhoods.
  Unlike prior Sobolev training in Euclidean space, MSINO provides training time guarantees that explicitly track curvature and transported Jacobians. Applications include surface imaging, physics informed learning settings, and robotics on Lie groups such as SO(3) and SE(3). The framework unifies value and gradient based learning with curvature aware convergence guarantees for neural training on manifolds.
summary_zh:
我们引入了流形索博列夫信息神经优化（MSINO），这是一个曲率感知的训练框架，用于定义在黎曼流形上的神经网络。该方法使用协变索博列夫损失取代了标准的欧几里得导数监督，该损失通过平行移动对齐梯度，并通过拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米的平滑正则化项提高稳定性。

   基于黎曼优化和流形上的索博列夫理论中的经典结果，我们推导出了与几何相关的常数，从而产生了（i）一个具有流形索博列夫平滑常数的下降引理，（ii）一个索博列夫Polyak-Łojasiewicz不等式，该不等式在显式步长界限下，为黎曼梯度下降和随机梯度下降提供了线性收敛保证，以及（iii）一个两步牛顿索博列夫方法，该方法在曲率控制的邻域内具有局部二次收缩。

   与以往在欧几里得空间中的索博列夫训练不同，MSINO提供了明确跟踪曲率和平行移动雅可比矩阵的训练时间保证。应用包括表面成像、物理信息学习设置，以及李群（如SO(3)和SE(3)）上的机器人技术。该框架将基于值和基于梯度的学习统一起来，并为流形上的神经训练提供曲率感知的收敛保证。
tldr: The paper introduces MSINO, a curvature-aware training framework for neural networks on Riemannian manifolds, providing theoretical convergence guarantees and applications in areas like surface imaging, physics-informed learning, and robotics.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MSINO，一种曲率感知的黎曼流形神经网络训练框架，提供了理论收敛保证，并应用于表面成像、物理信息学习和机器人等领域。

title: Multi-agent imitation learning with function approximation: Linear Markov games and beyond
summary: In this work, we present the first theoretical analysis of multi-agent imitation learning (MAIL) in linear Markov games where both the transition dynamics and each agent's reward function are linear in some given features. We demonstrate that by leveraging this structure, it is possible to replace the state-action level "all policy deviation concentrability coefficient" (Freihaut et al., arXiv:2510.09325) with a concentrability coefficient defined at the feature level which can be much smaller than the state-action analog when the features are informative about states' similarity. Furthermore, to circumvent the need for any concentrability coefficient, we turn to the interactive setting. We provide the first, computationally efficient, interactive MAIL algorithm for linear Markov games and show that its sample complexity depends only on the dimension of the feature map $d$. Building on these theoretical findings, we propose a deep MAIL interactive algorithm which clearly outperforms BC on games such as Tic-Tac-Toe and Connect4.
summary_zh:
摘要：
本文首次对线性马尔可夫博弈中的多智能体模仿学习(MAIL)进行了理论分析，其中转移动态和每个智能体的奖励函数都与给定的特征呈线性关系。我们证明，通过利用这种结构，可以用特征层面的“集中系数”来取代状态-动作层面的“全策略偏差可集中性系数”（Freihaut等人，arXiv:2510.09325），当特征能够有效反映状态相似性时，该特征层面的集中系数远小于状态-动作层面的同类系数。此外，为了规避对任何集中系数的需求，我们转向交互式环境。我们为线性马尔可夫博弈提供了第一个计算高效的交互式MAIL算法，并表明其样本复杂度仅取决于特征映射的维度$d$。基于这些理论发现，我们提出了一种深度MAIL交互式算法，该算法在诸如井字棋和四子棋等博弈中明显优于行为克隆(BC)。
tldr: This paper presents theoretical analysis and algorithms for multi-agent imitation learning in linear Markov games, achieving improved sample complexity and performance using feature-level concentrability and interactive learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了线性马尔可夫博弈中的多智能体模仿学习的理论分析和算法，通过利用特征级集中性和交互式学习实现了改进的样本复杂度与性能。

title: FLIGHT: Fibonacci Lattice-based Inference for Geometric Heading in real-Time
summary: Estimating camera motion from monocular video is a fundamental problem in computer vision, central to tasks such as SLAM, visual odometry, and structure-from-motion. Existing methods that recover the camera's heading under known rotation, whether from an IMU or an optimization algorithm, tend to perform well in low-noise, low-outlier conditions, but often decrease in accuracy or become computationally expensive as noise and outlier levels increase. To address these limitations, we propose a novel generalization of the Hough transform on the unit sphere (S(2)) to estimate the camera's heading. First, the method extracts correspondences between two frames and generates a great circle of directions compatible with each pair of correspondences. Then, by discretizing the unit sphere using a Fibonacci lattice as bin centers, each great circle casts votes for a range of directions, ensuring that features unaffected by noise or dynamic objects vote consistently for the correct motion direction. Experimental results on three datasets demonstrate that the proposed method is on the Pareto frontier of accuracy versus efficiency. Additionally, experiments on SLAM show that the proposed method reduces RMSE by correcting the heading during camera pose initialization.
summary_zh: 从单目视频估计相机运动是计算机视觉中的一个基本问题，对于诸如SLAM、视觉里程计和运动结构恢复等任务至关重要。现有方法通常在已知旋转的情况下（无论是通过IMU还是优化算法）恢复相机朝向，这些方法在低噪声、低外点的条件下表现良好，但随着噪声和外点水平的增加，其准确性往往会降低，或者计算成本变得十分昂贵。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的Hough变换在单位球面（S(2)）上的泛化方法，以估计相机的朝向。首先，该方法提取两帧之间的对应点，并为每对对应点生成一个兼容的方向大圆。然后，通过使用斐波那契格点离散化单位球面作为bin中心，每个大圆对一系列方向进行投票，从而确保不受噪声或动态对象影响的特征始终如一地投票支持正确的运动方向。在三个数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的方法在准确性和效率方面都位于帕累托前沿。此外，在SLAM上的实验表明，通过在相机姿态初始化期间校正朝向，所提出的方法降低了RMSE。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel Hough transform generalization using a Fibonacci lattice on the unit sphere for robust and efficient camera heading estimation from monocular video, outperforming existing methods in noisy environments and improving SLAM initialization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的Hough变换泛化方法，利用单位球面上的斐波那契晶格，从单目视频中实现鲁棒且高效的相机朝向估计。该方法在嘈杂环境中优于现有方法，并改善了SLAM初始化。

title: An Empirical Analysis of Cooperative Perception for Occlusion Risk Mitigation
summary: Occlusions present a significant challenge for connected and automated vehicles, as they can obscure critical road users from perception systems. Traditional risk metrics often fail to capture the cumulative nature of these threats over time adequately. In this paper, we propose a novel and universal risk assessment metric, the Risk of Tracking Loss (RTL), which aggregates instantaneous risk intensity throughout occluded periods. This provides a holistic risk profile that encompasses both high-intensity, short-term threats and prolonged exposure. Utilizing diverse and high-fidelity real-world datasets, a large-scale statistical analysis is conducted to characterize occlusion risk and validate the effectiveness of the proposed metric. The metric is applied to evaluate different vehicle-to-everything (V2X) deployment strategies. Our study shows that full V2X penetration theoretically eliminates this risk, the reduction is highly nonlinear; a substantial statistical benefit requires a high penetration threshold of 75-90%. To overcome this limitation, we propose a novel asymmetric communication framework that allows even non-connected vehicles to receive warnings. Experimental results demonstrate that this paradigm achieves better risk mitigation performance. We found that our approach at 25% penetration outperforms the traditional symmetric model at 75%, and benefits saturate at only 50% penetration. This work provides a crucial risk assessment metric and a cost-effective, strategic roadmap for accelerating the safety benefits of V2X deployment.
summary_zh: 遮挡对互联和自动驾驶车辆提出了重大挑战，因为它们可能使感知系统无法识别关键的道路使用者。传统的风险指标通常无法充分捕捉这些威胁随时间推移的累积性质。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖且通用的风险评估指标——跟踪丢失风险（RTL），它聚合了整个遮挡期间的瞬时风险强度。这提供了一个全面的风险概况，既包括高强度、短期的威胁，也包括长时间的暴露。通过使用多样化和高保真度的真实世界数据集，我们进行了大规模的统计分析，以表征遮挡风险并验证所提出指标的有效性。该指标被应用于评估不同的车联网（V2X）部署策略。我们的研究表明，完全的V2X普及在理论上消除了这种风险，但其减少是非线性的；要获得显著的统计效益，需要75-90%的高普及率阈值。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种新颖的不对称通信框架，允许即使是非互联车辆也能接收到警告。实验结果表明，这种范式实现了更好的风险缓解性能。我们发现，我们提出的方法在25%的普及率下优于传统的对称模型在75%的普及率下的表现，并且收益只在50%的普及率下达到饱和。这项工作提供了一个关键的风险评估指标，以及一个具有成本效益、战略性的路线图，以加速V2X部署的安全效益。
tldr: This paper introduces a new risk metric (RTL) for occlusion risk mitigation in connected and automated vehicles, and proposes an asymmetric V2X communication framework that outperforms symmetric V2X deployment at lower penetration rates.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的风险指标(RTL)，用于降低互联和自动驾驶车辆中的遮挡风险，并提出了一种非对称V2X通信框架，该框架在较低的渗透率下优于对称V2X部署。

title: Considering Perspectives for Automated Driving Ethics: Collective Risk in Vehicular Motion Planning
summary: Recent automated vehicle (AV) motion planning strategies evolve around minimizing risk in road traffic. However, they exclusively consider risk from the AV's perspective and, as such, do not address the ethicality of its decisions for other road users. We argue that this does not reduce the risk of each road user, as risk may be different from the perspective of each road user. Indeed, minimizing the risk from the AV's perspective may not imply that the risk from the perspective of other road users is also being minimized; in fact, it may even increase. To test this hypothesis, we propose an AV motion planning strategy that supports switching risk minimization strategies between all road user perspectives. We find that the risk from the perspective of other road users can generally be considered different to the risk from the AV's perspective. Taking a collective risk perspective, i.e., balancing the risks of all road users, we observe an AV that minimizes overall traffic risk the best, while putting itself at slightly higher risk for the benefit of others, which is consistent with human driving behavior. In addition, adopting a collective risk minimization strategy can also be beneficial to the AV's travel efficiency by acting assertively when other road users maintain a low risk estimate of the AV. Yet, the AV drives conservatively when its planned actions are less predictable to other road users, i.e., associated with high risk. We argue that such behavior is a form of self-reflection and a natural prerequisite for socially acceptable AV behavior. We conclude that to facilitate ethicality in road traffic that includes AVs, the risk-perspective of each road user must be considered in the decision-making of AVs.
summary_zh: 近期的自动驾驶车辆（AV）运动规划策略主要围绕最小化道路交通中的风险展开。然而，它们仅从自动驾驶车辆的角度考虑风险，因此没有解决其决策对其他道路使用者的伦理问题。我们认为这并不能降低每个道路使用者的风险，因为从每个道路使用者的角度来看，风险可能是不同的。事实上，最小化自动驾驶车辆角度的风险并不意味着其他道路使用者角度的风险也被最小化；实际上，它甚至可能增加风险。为了验证这个假设，我们提出了一种自动驾驶车辆运动规划策略，该策略支持在所有道路使用者视角之间切换风险最小化策略。我们发现，从其他道路使用者角度来看，风险通常被认为与自动驾驶车辆角度的风险不同。采取集体风险视角，即平衡所有道路使用者的风险，我们观察到自动驾驶车辆能够最好地最小化总体交通风险，同时为了他人的利益，将自身置于略高的风险之中，这与人类的驾驶行为一致。此外，采用集体风险最小化策略也有利于自动驾驶车辆的通行效率，当其他道路使用者对自动驾驶车辆保持较低的风险估计时，可以采取更自信的行动。然而，当自动驾驶车辆的计划行动对其他道路使用者来说不太可预测时，即与高风险相关时，自动驾驶车辆的驾驶会更加保守。我们认为这种行为是一种自我反思，也是实现社会可接受的自动驾驶车辆行为的自然先决条件。我们的结论是，为了促进包含自动驾驶车辆的道路交通中的伦理行为，必须在自动驾驶车辆的决策过程中考虑每个道路使用者的风险视角。
tldr: This paper proposes an AV motion planning strategy that considers the risk perspectives of all road users, aiming to minimize overall traffic risk and achieve more ethical and socially acceptable AV behavior. The experiments demonstrate a balance between the AV's safety and the safety of other road users.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自动驾驶车辆运动规划策略，该策略考虑了所有道路使用者的风险视角，旨在最小化整体交通风险，并实现更道德、更易于接受的自动驾驶车辆行为。实验表明，自动驾驶车辆的安全性和其他道路使用者的安全性之间可以实现平衡。

title: Bayesian Preference Elicitation: Human-In-The-Loop Optimization of An Active Prosthesis
summary: Tuning active prostheses for people with amputation is time-consuming and relies on metrics that may not fully reflect user needs. We introduce a human-in-the-loop optimization (HILO) approach that leverages direct user preferences to personalize a standard four-parameter prosthesis controller efficiently. Our method employs preference-based Multiobjective Bayesian Optimization that uses a state-or-the-art acquisition function especially designed for preference learning, and includes two algorithmic variants: a discrete version (\textit{EUBO-LineCoSpar}), and a continuous version (\textit{BPE4Prost}). Simulation results on benchmark functions and real-application trials demonstrate efficient convergence, robust preference elicitation, and measurable biomechanical improvements, illustrating the potential of preference-driven tuning for user-centered prosthesis control.
summary_zh: 针对截肢患者的主动义肢调优耗时且依赖于可能无法完全反映用户需求的指标。我们引入了一种人机回路优化（HILO）方法，该方法利用直接的用户偏好来高效地个性化一个标准的四参数义肢控制器。我们的方法采用基于偏好的多目标贝叶斯优化，该优化使用一种专门为偏好学习设计的先进采集函数，并且包含两种算法变体：一种离散版本（\textit{EUBO-LineCoSpar}）和一种连续版本（\textit{BPE4Prost}）。在基准函数上的仿真结果和实际应用试验都证明了高效的收敛性、稳健的偏好获取以及可测量的生物力学改进，表明了偏好驱动调优在以用户为中心的义肢控制方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a Human-In-The-Loop Optimization (HILO) approach using Bayesian Optimization with preference elicitation to personalize active prosthesis controllers based on direct user preferences, demonstrating efficient convergence and biomechanical improvements.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种人机回路优化（HILO）方法，利用贝叶斯优化和偏好诱导，根据用户的直接偏好来个性化主动假肢控制器，并展示了高效的收敛性和生物力学改进。

title: Hierarchical Trajectory Planning of Floating-Base Multi-Link Robot for Maneuvering in Confined Environments
summary: Floating-base multi-link robots can change their shape during flight, making them well-suited for applications in confined environments such as autonomous inspection and search and rescue. However, trajectory planning for such systems remains an open challenge because the problem lies in a high-dimensional, constraint-rich space where collision avoidance must be addressed together with kinematic limits and dynamic feasibility. This work introduces a hierarchical trajectory planning framework that integrates global guidance with configuration-aware local optimization. First, we exploit the dual nature of these robots - the root link as a rigid body for guidance and the articulated joints for flexibility - to generate global anchor states that decompose the planning problem into tractable segments. Second, we design a local trajectory planner that optimizes each segment in parallel with differentiable objectives and constraints, systematically enforcing kinematic feasibility and maintaining dynamic feasibility by avoiding control singularities. Third, we implement a complete system that directly processes point-cloud data, eliminating the need for handcrafted obstacle models. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments confirm that this framework enables an articulated aerial robot to exploit its morphology for maneuvering that rigid robots cannot achieve. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first planning framework for floating-base multi-link robots that has been demonstrated on a real robot to generate continuous, collision-free, and dynamically feasible trajectories directly from raw point-cloud inputs, without relying on handcrafted obstacle models.
summary_zh: 漂浮基座多连杆机器人能够在飞行过程中改变形状，使其非常适合自主巡检和搜索救援等受限环境中的应用。然而，此类系统的轨迹规划仍然是一个开放的挑战，因为该问题存在于高维、约束丰富的空间中，必须同时解决避障问题以及运动学极限和动力学可行性。本文介绍了一种分层轨迹规划框架，该框架集成了全局引导和配置感知的局部优化。首先，我们利用这些机器人的双重特性——根连杆作为刚性体进行引导，铰接关节用于灵活性——来生成全局锚点状态，从而将规划问题分解为可处理的片段。其次，我们设计了一个局部轨迹规划器，该规划器使用可微的目标和约束并行优化每个片段，系统地强制执行运动学可行性，并通过避免控制奇异性来保持动力学可行性。第三，我们实现了一个完整的系统，该系统直接处理点云数据，无需手工制作障碍物模型。大量的仿真和真实世界实验证实，该框架使铰接式空中机器人能够利用其形态进行刚性机器人无法实现的机动。据我们所知，这是第一个漂浮基座多连杆机器人的规划框架，它已在真实机器人上得到验证，可以直接从原始点云输入生成连续、无碰撞且动力学可行的轨迹，而无需依赖手工制作的障碍物模型。
tldr: This paper introduces a hierarchical trajectory planning framework for floating-base multi-link robots in confined environments, demonstrated with real-world experiments directly processing point-cloud data.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于在狭窄环境中漂浮多连杆机器人的分层轨迹规划框架，并通过直接处理点云数据的真实世界实验进行了演示。

title: Evaluating Stochasticity in Deep Research Agents
