tldr: The paper introduces D-FINE-seg, an instance segmentation extension of the D-FINE object detector, achieving improved F1-score compared to YOLO26 on the TACO dataset with competitive latency, and provides an end-to-end deployment pipeline and releases the code.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 D-FINE-seg，它是 D-FINE 目标检测器的一个实例分割扩展，在 TACO 数据集上实现了优于 YOLO26 的 F1 分数，并具有竞争性的延迟。它还提供了一个端到端的部署管道，并开源了代码。

title: OSDaR-AR: Enhancing Railway Perception Datasets via Multi-modal Augmented Reality
summary: Although deep learning has significantly advanced the perception capabilities of intelligent transportation systems, railway applications continue to suffer from a scarcity of high-quality, annotated data for safety-critical tasks like obstacle detection. While photorealistic simulators offer a solution, they often struggle with the ``sim-to-real" gap; conversely, simple image-masking techniques lack the spatio-temporal coherence required to obtain augmented single- and multi-frame scenes with the correct appearance and dimensions. This paper introduces a multi-modal augmented reality framework designed to bridge this gap by integrating photorealistic virtual objects into real-world railway sequences from the OSDaR23 dataset. Utilizing Unreal Engine 5 features, our pipeline leverages LiDAR point-clouds and INS/GNSS data to ensure accurate object placement and temporal stability across RGB frames. This paper also proposes a segmentation-based refinement strategy for INS/GNSS data to significantly improve the realism of the augmented sequences, as confirmed by the comparative study presented in the paper. Carefully designed augmented sequences are collected to produce OSDaR-AR, a public dataset designed to support the development of next-generation railway perception systems. The dataset is available at the following page: https://syndra.retis.santannapisa.it/osdarar.html
summary_zh: 尽管深度学习显著提升了智能交通系统的感知能力，但铁路应用仍然面临着用于障碍物检测等安全关键任务的高质量、标注数据匮乏的问题。逼真的仿真器提供了一种解决方案，但它们往往难以克服“仿真到真实”的差距；相反，简单的图像掩蔽技术缺乏获得具有正确外观和尺寸的增强单帧和多帧场景所需的时空连贯性。本文介绍了一种多模态增强现实框架，旨在通过将逼真的虚拟对象集成到来自OSDaR23数据集的真实铁路序列中来弥合这一差距。利用Unreal Engine 5的特性，我们的流程利用LiDAR点云和INS/GNSS数据，以确保物体在RGB帧中的准确定位和时间稳定性。本文还提出了一种基于分割的INS/GNSS数据精炼策略，以显著提高增强序列的真实感，这已通过本文提出的比较研究得到证实。 我们精心设计并收集了增强序列，从而生成了OSDaR-AR，这是一个旨在支持下一代铁路感知系统开发的公共数据集。该数据集可在以下页面获得：https://syndra.retis.santannapisa.it/osdarar.html
tldr: The paper introduces OSDaR-AR, a multi-modal augmented reality framework and dataset designed to enhance railway perception by integrating photorealistic virtual objects into real-world railway sequences, addressing the sim-to-real gap.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 OSDaR-AR，一个多模态增强现实框架和数据集，旨在通过将逼真的虚拟对象集成到真实世界的铁路序列中来增强铁路感知，从而解决了 sim-to-real 的差距。

title: UFO-DETR: Frequency-Guided End-to-End Detector for UAV Tiny Objects
summary: Small target detection in UAV imagery faces significant challenges such as scale variations, dense distribution, and the dominance of small targets. Existing algorithms rely on manually designed components, and general-purpose detectors are not optimized for UAV images, making it difficult to balance accuracy and complexity. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an end-to-end object detection framework, UFO-DETR, which integrates an LSKNet-based backbone network to optimize the receptive field and reduce the number of parameters. By combining the DAttention and AIFI modules, the model flexibly models multi-scale spatial relationships, improving multi-scale target detection performance. Additionally, the DynFreq-C3 module is proposed to enhance small target detection capability through cross-space frequency feature enhancement. Experimental results show that, compared to RT-DETR-L, the proposed method offers significant advantages in both detection performance and computational efficiency, providing an efficient solution for UAV edge computing.
summary_zh: 无人机影像中小目标检测面临着尺度变化、密集分布以及小目标主导等重大挑战。现有算法依赖于手动设计的组件，而通用检测器未针对无人机影像进行优化，难以平衡精度和复杂性。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种端到端的目标检测框架UFO-DETR，该框架集成了一个基于LSKNet的主干网络，以优化感受野并减少参数数量。通过结合DAttention和AIFI模块，该模型可以灵活地建模多尺度空间关系，从而提高多尺度目标检测性能。此外，还提出了DynFreq-C3模块，通过跨空间频率特征增强来提升小目标检测能力。实验结果表明，与RT-DETR-L相比，所提出的方法在检测性能和计算效率方面都具有显著优势，为无人机边缘计算提供了一种高效的解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces UFO-DETR, an end-to-end object detection framework designed to improve the detection of tiny objects in UAV imagery by optimizing receptive fields, modeling multi-scale spatial relationships, and enhancing small target features frequency representation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了UFO-DETR，一个端到端的物体检测框架，旨在通过优化感受野、建模多尺度空间关系和增强小目标特征的频率表示来提高无人机图像中小目标的检测。

title: TopoEdit: Fast Post-Optimization Editing of Topology Optimized Structures
summary: Despite topology optimization producing high-performance structures, late-stage localized revisions remain brittle: direct density-space edits (e.g., warping pixels, inserting holes, swapping infill) can sever load paths and sharply degrade compliance, while re-running optimization is slow and may drift toward a qualitatively different design. We present TopoEdit, a fast post-optimization editor that demonstrates how structured latent embeddings from a pre-trained topology foundation model (OAT) can be repurposed as an interface for physics-aware engineering edits. Given an optimized topology, TopoEdit encodes it into OAT's spatial latent, applies partial noising to preserve instance identity while increasing editability, and injects user intent through an edit-then-denoise diffusion pipeline. We instantiate three edit operators: drag-based topology warping with boundary-condition-consistent conditioning updates, shell-infill lattice replacement using a lattice-anchored reference latent with updated volume-fraction conditioning, and late-stage no-design region enforcement via masked latent overwrite followed by diffusion-based recovery. A consistency-preserving guided DDIM procedure localizes changes while allowing global structural adaptation; multiple candidates can be sampled and selected using a compliance-aware criterion, with optional short SIMP refinement for warps. Across diverse case studies and large edit sweeps, TopoEdit produces intention-aligned modifications that better preserve mechanical performance and avoid catastrophic failure modes compared to direct density-space edits, while generating edited candidates in sub-second diffusion time per sample.
summary_zh: 虽然拓扑优化能够产生高性能结构，但后期的局部修改仍然很脆弱：直接在密度空间进行编辑（如扭曲像素、插入孔洞、交换填充）可能会切断载荷路径并显著降低顺性，而重新运行优化速度慢且可能漂移到定性上不同的设计。我们提出了TopoEdit，一种快速的优化后编辑器，展示了如何将预训练拓扑基础模型（OAT）的结构化潜在嵌入重新用作物理感知工程编辑的界面。给定一个优化后的拓扑，TopoEdit将其编码到OAT的空间潜在空间中，应用部分噪声以保留实例身份，同时提高可编辑性，并通过编辑-然后-去噪扩散管道注入用户意图。我们实例化了三个编辑算子：基于拖拽的拓扑扭曲，具有边界条件一致的条件更新；使用网格锚定参考潜在空间和更新的体积分数条件进行的壳-填充网格替换；以及通过掩码的潜在覆盖和随后基于扩散的恢复来强制执行后期的禁止设计区域。一种保持一致性的引导式DDIM过程可定位更改，同时允许全局结构自适应；可以使用顺性感知标准对多个候选方案进行采样和选择，并可选择对扭曲进行简短的SIMP细化。在各种案例研究和大规模编辑扫描中，与直接的密度空间编辑相比，TopoEdit产生了与意图对齐的修改，更好地保持了机械性能并避免了灾难性的失效模式，同时在亚秒级的扩散时间内生成每个样本的编辑候选方案。
tldr: TopoEdit introduces a fast post-optimization editing method for topology-optimized structures using latent embeddings and diffusion models, enabling physics-aware engineering edits that outperform direct density-space edits. It enhances design workflows by allowing users to make modifications more quickly and reliably.
tldr_zh: TopoEdit引入了一种快速的拓扑优化结构后优化编辑方法，利用潜在嵌入和扩散模型，实现物理感知工程编辑，优于直接密度空间编辑。它通过允许用户更快、更可靠地进行修改来增强设计工作流程。

title: Does the testing environment matter? Carsickness across on-road, test-track, and driving simulator conditions
summary: Carsickness has gained significant attention with the rise of automated vehicles, prompting extensive research across on-road, test-track, and driving simulator environments to understand its occurrence and develop mitigation strategies. However, the lack of carsickness standardization complicates comparisons across studies and environments. Previous works demonstrate measurement validity between two setups at most (e.g., on-road vs. driving simulator), leaving gaps in multi-environment comparisons. This study investigates the recreation of an on-road motion sickness exposure - previously replicated on a test track - using a motion-based driving simulator. Twenty-eight participants performed an eyes-off-road non-driving task while reporting motion sickness using the Misery Scale during the experiment and the Motion Sickness Assessment Questionnaire afterward. Psychological factors known to influence motion sickness were also assessed. The results present subjective and objective measurements for motion sickness across the considered environments. In this paper, acceleration measurements, objective metrics and subjective motion sickness ratings across environments are compared, highlighting key differences in sickness occurrence for simulator-based research validity. Significantly lower motion sickness scores are reported in the simulator compared to on-road and test-track conditions, due to its limited working envelope to reproduce low-frequency (<0.5 Hz) motions, which are the most provocative for motion sickness.
summary_zh: 汽车晕动症随着自动驾驶汽车的兴起而备受关注，这促使人们在实际道路、测试跑道和驾驶模拟器环境中进行了广泛的研究，以了解其发生机制并开发缓解策略。然而，缺乏汽车晕动症标准化使得跨研究和环境的比较变得复杂。以往的研究最多只展示了两种设置之间的测量有效性（例如，实际道路与驾驶模拟器），从而在多环境比较中留下了空白。本研究旨在利用基于动作的驾驶模拟器，重现此前已在测试跑道上复现的实际道路晕动症暴露。28 名参与者在进行脱眼非驾驶任务的同时，使用 Misery 量表在实验期间报告晕动症情况，并在实验后填写《晕动症评估问卷》。同时评估了已知会影响晕动症的心理因素。结果呈现了所考虑环境中晕动症的主观和客观测量结果。本文比较了各个环境中的加速度测量值、客观指标及主观晕动症评级，突出了基于模拟器的研究在效度方面，晕动症发生的关键差异。与实际道路和测试跑道条件相比，模拟器中报告的晕动症得分显著降低，这是由于其工作范围有限，无法重现低频（<0.5 Hz）运动，而这种低频运动最容易诱发晕动症。
tldr: This paper investigates carsickness in on-road, test-track, and simulator environments, finding significantly lower motion sickness in the simulator due to its limited ability to reproduce low-frequency motions.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在公路、测试跑道和模拟器环境中出现的晕车现象，发现模拟器中的晕车程度明显较低，原因是其再现低频运动的能力有限。

title: Velocity and stroke rate reconstruction of canoe sprint team boats based on panned and zoomed video recordings
summary: Pacing strategies, defined by velocity and stroke rate profiles, are essential for peak performance in canoe sprint. While GPS is the gold standard for analysis, its limited availability necessitates automated video-based solutions. This paper presents an extended framework for reconstructing performance metrics from panned and zoomed video recordings across all sprint disciplines (K1-K4, C1-C2) and distances (200m-500m). Our method utilizes YOLOv8 for buoy and athlete detection, leveraging the known buoy grid to estimate homographies. We generalized the estimation of the boat position by means of learning a boat-specific athlete offset using a U-net based boat tip calibration. Further, we implement a robust tracking scheme using optical flow to adapt to multi-athlete boat types. Finally, we introduce methods to extract stroke rate information from either pose estimations or the athlete bounding boxes themselves. Evaluation against GPS data from elite competitions yields a velocity RRMSE of 0.020 +- 0.011 (rho = 0.956) and a stroke rate RRMSE of 0.022 +- 0.024 (rho = 0.932). The methods provide coaches with highly accurate, automated feedback without requiring on-boat sensors or manual annotation.
summary_zh: 配速策略，由速度和划桨频率的曲线定义，对于皮划艇短跑的巅峰表现至关重要。虽然GPS是分析的金标准，但其可用性有限，因此需要基于视频的自动化解决方案。本文提出了一种扩展框架，用于从横摇和变焦视频记录中重建所有短跑项目（K1-K4、C1-C2）和距离（200米-500米）的性能指标。我们的方法利用YOLOv8进行浮标和运动员检测，并利用已知的浮标网格来估计单应性矩阵。我们通过学习基于U-net的船头校准方法，估计船只的特定运动员偏移量，从而推广了船只位置的估计。此外，我们采用了一种使用光流的鲁棒跟踪方案，以适应多运动员船型。最后，我们引入了从姿势估计或运动员边界框中提取划桨频率信息的方法。针对来自精英比赛的GPS数据进行评估，得出的速度RRMSE为0.020 +- 0.011（rho = 0.956），划桨频率RRMSE为0.022 +- 0.024（rho = 0.932）。这些方法为教练提供了高度准确的自动化反馈，且无需船载传感器或手动标注。
tldr: This paper presents a video-based method using YOLOv8, U-Net, and optical flow to accurately reconstruct velocity and stroke rate of canoe sprint teams, offering coaches automated feedback without on-boat sensors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于视频的方法，使用YOLOv8、U-Net和光流来准确重建皮划艇冲刺团队的速度和划桨率，为教练提供自动反馈，无需船载传感器。

title: Utilizing LLMs for Industrial Process Automation
summary: A growing number of publications address the best practices to use Large Language Models (LLMs) for software engineering in recent years. However, most of this work focuses on widely-used general purpose programming languages like Python due to their widespread usage training data. The utility of LLMs for software within the industrial process automation domain, with highly-specialized languages that are typically only used in proprietary contexts, remains underexplored. This research aims to utilize and integrate LLMs in the industrial development process, solving real-life programming tasks (e.g., generating a movement routine for a robotic arm) and accelerating the development cycles of manufacturing systems.
summary_zh: 近年来，越来越多的出版物探讨了使用大型语言模型（LLMs）进行软件工程的最佳实践。 然而，由于其训练数据使用的广泛性，大部分工作集中于像 Python 这样被广泛使用的通用编程语言。在工业过程自动化领域，大型语言模型在软件方面的效用，特别是对于通常只在专有环境中使用的、高度专业化的语言，仍然有待探索。 本研究旨在利用大型语言模型并将其集成到工业开发过程中，解决实际编程任务（例如，生成机器人手臂的运动程序），并加速制造系统的开发周期。
tldr: This paper explores the use of LLMs in the industrial process automation domain, focusing on specialized programming languages and real-world automation tasks like robotic arm control.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了LLM在工业过程自动化领域的应用，重点关注专用编程语言和实际自动化任务，如机器人手臂控制。

title: MediX-R1: Open Ended Medical Reinforcement Learning
summary: We introduce MediX-R1, an open-ended Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework for medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that enables clinically grounded, free-form answers beyond multiple-choice formats. MediX-R1 fine-tunes a baseline vision-language backbone with Group Based RL and a composite reward tailored for medical reasoning: an LLM-based accuracy reward that judges semantic correctness with a strict YES/NO decision, a medical embedding-based semantic reward to capture paraphrases and terminology variants, and lightweight format and modality rewards that enforce interpretable reasoning and modality recognition. This multi-signal design provides stable, informative feedback for open-ended outputs where traditional verifiable or MCQ-only rewards fall short. To measure progress, we propose a unified evaluation framework for both text-only and image+text tasks that uses a Reference-based LLM-as-judge in place of brittle string-overlap metrics, capturing semantic correctness, reasoning, and contextual alignment. Despite using only $\sim51$K instruction examples, MediX-R1 achieves excellent results across standard medical LLM (text-only) and VLM (image + text) benchmarks, outperforming strong open-source baselines and delivering particularly large gains on open-ended clinical tasks. Our results demonstrate that open-ended RL with comprehensive reward signals and LLM-based evaluation is a practical path toward reliable medical reasoning in multimodal models. Our trained models, curated datasets and source code are available at https://medix.cvmbzuai.com
summary_zh: 我们介绍了MediX-R1，一个开放式的强化学习（RL）框架，用于医学多模态大型语言模型（MLLM），它能够提供临床层面扎实、自由形式的答案，超越了多项选择题的形式。 MediX-R1 使用基于组的强化学习和专为医学推理定制的复合奖励，对基线的视觉-语言主干网络进行微调：一个基于LLM的准确度奖励，通过严格的是/否决策来判断语义的正确性；一个基于医学嵌入的语义奖励，用于捕捉释义和术语变体；以及轻量级的格式和模态奖励，用于加强可解释的推理和模态识别。这种多信号设计为开放式输出提供了稳定且信息丰富的反馈，而传统的、可验证的或仅基于多项选择题的奖励则相形见绌。为了衡量进展，我们提出了一种统一的评估框架，用于纯文本任务和图像+文本任务，该框架使用基于参考的LLM作为评判者来替代脆弱的字符串重叠度量，从而捕捉语义正确性、推理和上下文一致性。尽管只使用了约 5.1 万个指令示例，MediX-R1 在标准医学LLM（纯文本）和VLM（图像+文本）基准测试中均取得了优异的成绩，超越了强大的开源基线，尤其是在开放式临床任务中取得了显著的提升。我们的结果表明，带有全面奖励信号和基于 LLM 评估的开放式强化学习是多模态模型中实现可靠医学推理的有效途径。我们训练的模型，整理的数据集和源代码可在 https://medix.cvmbzuai.com 获取。
tldr: MediX-R1 is an open-ended RL framework for medical MLLMs that utilizes group-based RL and a composite reward system for improved medical reasoning and benchmark performance, especially on open-ended tasks.
tldr_zh: MediX-R1是一个用于医疗多模态大型语言模型的开放式强化学习框架，它利用基于群体的强化学习和一个综合奖励系统来提高医疗推理能力和基准性能，特别是在开放式任务上。

title: Interface-Aware Trajectory Reconstruction of Limited Demonstrations for Robot Learning
summary: Assistive robots offer agency to humans with severe motor impairments. Often, these users control high-DoF robots through low-dimensional interfaces, such as using a 1-D sip-and-puff interface to operate a 6-DoF robotic arm. This mismatch results in having access to only a subset of control dimensions at a given time, imposing unintended and artificial constraints on robot motion. As a result, interface-limited demonstrations embed suboptimal motions that reflect interface restrictions rather than user intent. To address this, we present a trajectory reconstruction algorithm that reasons about task, environment, and interface constraints to lift demonstrations into the robot's full control space. We evaluate our approach using real-world demonstrations of ADL-inspired tasks performed via a 2-D joystick and 1-D sip-and-puff control interface, teleoperating two distinct 7-DoF robotic arms. Analyses of the reconstructed demonstrations and derived control policies show that lifted trajectories are faster and more efficient than their interface-constrained counterparts while respecting user preferences.
summary_zh: 辅助机器人为重度运动障碍人士提供了行动能力。通常，这些用户通过低维界面控制高自由度机器人，例如使用一维吹吸界面操作六自由度机械臂。这种不匹配导致在给定时间只能访问控制维度的一个子集，从而对机器人运动施加了非预期的和人为的约束。因此，受界面限制的示教数据嵌入了次优运动，这些运动反映了界面限制而不是用户的意图。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种轨迹重建算法，该算法能推理任务、环境和界面约束，从而将示教数据提升到机器人的完整控制空间中。我们使用通过二维操纵杆和一维吹吸控制界面进行远程操作两种不同的七自由度机械臂所执行的、受日常生活活动启发的真实示教数据来评估我们的方法。对重建的示教数据和导出的控制策略的分析表明，提升后的轨迹比其受界面约束的对应轨迹更快、更高效，同时尊重用户偏好。
tldr: The paper introduces a trajectory reconstruction algorithm to improve robot learning from demonstrations using low-dimensional interfaces, addressing the limitations imposed by interface constraints and generating faster, more efficient robot trajectories.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种轨迹重建算法，该算法通过低维界面改进从演示中进行的机器人学习，解决了界面约束带来的限制，并生成更快、更高效的机器人轨迹。

title: SeeThrough3D: Occlusion Aware 3D Control in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: We identify occlusion reasoning as a fundamental yet overlooked aspect for 3D layout-conditioned generation. It is essential for synthesizing partially occluded objects with depth-consistent geometry and scale. While existing methods can generate realistic scenes that follow input layouts, they often fail to model precise inter-object occlusions. We propose SeeThrough3D, a model for 3D layout conditioned generation that explicitly models occlusions. We introduce an occlusion-aware 3D scene representation (OSCR), where objects are depicted as translucent 3D boxes placed within a virtual environment and rendered from desired camera viewpoint. The transparency encodes hidden object regions, enabling the model to reason about occlusions, while the rendered viewpoint provides explicit camera control during generation. We condition a pretrained flow based text-to-image image generation model by introducing a set of visual tokens derived from our rendered 3D representation. Furthermore, we apply masked self-attention to accurately bind each object bounding box to its corresponding textual description, enabling accurate generation of multiple objects without object attribute mixing. To train the model, we construct a synthetic dataset with diverse multi-object scenes with strong inter-object occlusions. SeeThrough3D generalizes effectively to unseen object categories and enables precise 3D layout control with realistic occlusions and consistent camera control.
summary_zh: 我们将遮挡推理识别为3D布局条件生成中一个基础但被忽视的方面。它对于合成具有深度一致的几何形状和大小的、部分遮挡的对象至关重要。虽然现有方法可以生成符合输入布局的逼真场景，但它们通常无法精确建模对象间的遮挡。我们提出了SeeThrough3D，一个用于3D布局条件生成且显式建模遮挡的模型。我们引入了一种遮挡感知3D场景表示(OSCR)，其中对象被描绘为放置在虚拟环境中的半透明3D盒子，并从所需的相机视角渲染。透明度编码隐藏的对象区域，使模型能够进行遮挡推理，而渲染的视点在生成过程中提供显式的相机控制。通过引入一组从我们渲染的3D表示中导出的视觉令牌，我们对预训练的基于流的文本到图像生成模型进行条件化。此外，我们应用掩码自注意力来精确地将每个对象边界框绑定到其对应的文本描述，从而实现多个对象的准确生成，而不会发生对象属性混合。为了训练模型，我们构建了一个合成数据集，其中包含具有强烈对象间遮挡的各种多对象场景。SeeThrough3D能够有效地推广到未见过的对象类别，并实现精确的3D布局控制，同时保证逼真的遮挡效果和一致的相机控制。
tldr: SeeThrough3D introduces an occlusion-aware 3D scene representation for text-to-image generation, enabling better object occlusion and camera control in generated images based on text prompts and 3D layouts.
tldr_zh: SeeThrough3D 提出了一种用于文本到图像生成的、具有遮挡感知能力的 3D 场景表示，可以在基于文本提示和 3D 布局生成的图像中实现更好的对象遮挡和相机控制。

title: Evaluating Zero-Shot and One-Shot Adaptation of Small Language Models in Leader-Follower Interaction
summary: Leader-follower interaction is an important paradigm in human-robot interaction (HRI). Yet, assigning roles in real time remains challenging for resource-constrained mobile and assistive robots. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for natural communication, their size and latency limit on-device deployment. Small language models (SLMs) offer a potential alternative, but their effectiveness for role classification in HRI has not been systematically evaluated. In this paper, we present a benchmark of SLMs for leader-follower communication, introducing a novel dataset derived from a published database and augmented with synthetic samples to capture interaction-specific dynamics. We investigate two adaptation strategies: prompt engineering and fine-tuning, studied under zero-shot and one-shot interaction modes, compared with an untrained baseline. Experiments with Qwen2.5-0.5B reveal that zero-shot fine-tuning achieves robust classification performance (86.66% accuracy) while maintaining low latency (22.2 ms per sample), significantly outperforming baseline and prompt-engineered approaches. However, results also indicate a performance degradation in one-shot modes, where increased context length challenges the model's architectural capacity. These findings demonstrate that fine-tuned SLMs provide an effective solution for direct role assignment, while highlighting critical trade-offs between dialogue complexity and classification reliability on the edge.
summary_zh: 领导者-追随者交互是人机交互（HRI）中一个重要的范式。然而，对于资源受限的移动和辅助机器人而言，实时分配角色仍然具有挑战性。虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）在自然通信方面表现出潜力，但其尺寸和延迟限制了设备端部署。小型语言模型（SLMs）提供了一种潜在的替代方案，但其在HRI中角色分类方面的有效性尚未得到系统评估。本文提出了一个针对领导者-追随者通信的SLM基准测试，引入了一个新颖的数据集，该数据集源自已发布的数据库，并使用合成样本进行增强以捕获特定于交互的动态。我们研究了两种适应策略：提示工程和微调，并在零样本和单样本交互模式下进行了研究，并与未经训练的基线进行了比较。使用Qwen2.5-0.5B进行的实验表明，零样本微调实现了稳健的分类性能（准确率86.66%），同时保持了低延迟（每个样本22.2毫秒），显著优于基线和提示工程方法。然而，结果也表明在单样本模式下性能下降，其中增加的上下文长度挑战了模型的架构能力。这些发现表明，经过微调的SLM为直接角色分配提供了一种有效的解决方案，同时突出了边缘设备上对话复杂性和分类可靠性之间的关键权衡。
tldr: This paper benchmarks the effectiveness of small language models (SLMs) for leader-follower role classification in human-robot interaction, finding that zero-shot fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-0.5B achieves high accuracy with low latency, but performance degrades in one-shot scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了小型语言模型 (SLM) 在人机交互中领导者-跟随者角色分类的有效性，发现 Qwen2.5-0.5B 的零样本微调实现了高精度和低延迟，但性能在单样本场景中下降。

title: Generalized Rapid Action Value Estimation in Memory-Constrained Environments
summary: Generalized Rapid Action Value Estimation (GRAVE) has been shown to be a strong variant within the Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) family of algorithms for General Game Playing (GGP). However, its reliance on storing additional win/visit statistics at each node makes its use impractical in memory-constrained environments, thereby limiting its applicability in practice. In this paper, we introduce the GRAVE2, GRAVER and GRAVER2 algorithms, which extend GRAVE through two-level search, node recycling, and a combination of both techniques, respectively. We show that these enhancements enable a drastic reduction in the number of stored nodes while matching the playing strength of GRAVE.
summary_zh:
摘要：
广义快速动作价值估计（GRAVE）已被证明是蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）算法族中用于通用游戏博弈（GGP）的一种强大变体。然而，其对在每个节点存储额外胜/访统计数据的依赖使得它在内存受限的环境中应用不切实际，从而限制了其实际应用。在本文中，我们分别引入了GRAVE2、GRAVER和GRAVER2算法，它们通过两级搜索、节点回收以及两种技术的结合来扩展GRAVE。我们表明，这些增强能够在匹配GRAVE博弈强度的同时，大幅减少存储的节点数量。
tldr: This paper introduces GRAVE2, GRAVER, and GRAVER2 algorithms that improve upon the GRAVE algorithm for General Game Playing (GGP) by significantly reducing memory usage without sacrificing playing strength.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了GRAVE2，GRAVER和GRAVER2算法，它们改进了用于通用游戏玩法（GGP）的GRAVE算法，通过显着减少内存使用量而不牺牲游戏强度。
